papers.title: Neurotransmitter receptor architecture links local neurochemistry to semantic memory
papers.authors: Jung J, Gim J, Lambon Ralph M.
papers.abstract: A fundamental challenge in neuroscience is understanding how the molecular and neurochemical architecture of the human cortex gives rise to sophisticated higher cognitive functions. The anterior temporal lobe (ATL) is a key hub for semantic memory, and its underlying GABAergic and glutamatergic neurochemistry supports semantic memory performance. However, the molecular receptor architecture underlying these neurochemical-cognitive relationships remains unknown. Here, we combined imaging transcriptomics and in vivo magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) to investigate how neurotransmitter receptor organisation relates to local neurochemistry and semantic memory in the human ATL. We found that the ATL exhibited a distinct transcriptomically inferred receptor-subunit profile relative to control cortical regions (occipital cortex and vertex). Individual-specific spatial estimates of receptor-subunit gene expression were systematically associated with local GABA+ and Glx concentrations, revealing preferential coupling between GABAergic receptor genes and GABA+ and between glutamatergic receptor genes and Glx, alongside widespread cross-system associations between GABAergic receptor architecture and Glx. ATL GABA+ and Glx concentrations were positively associated with semantic memory performance, and GABAergic and glutamatergic receptor-subunit expression showed selective relationships with semantic memory accuracy. Crucially, mediation analyses revealed that GABA+ mediated associations between GABAergic receptor architecture and semantic performance, whereas Glx mediated both glutamatergic and widespread GABAergic receptor associations. Together, these findings reveal a coupled molecular-neurochemical architecture of the human ATL, linking neurotransmitter receptor organisation to regional neurochemical state and individual differences in semantic memory. Our findings provide a multiscale account of how cortical molecular organisation is associated with human higher cognitive function.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑颞极的神经递质受体分子架构如何与局部神经化学及语义记忆相关联。作者结合影像转录组学与在体磁共振波谱，在健康成人中估计受体亚基基因表达的空间分布，并测定局部GABA+与Glx浓度。结果显示，颞极具有区别于对照皮层区域的受体亚基表达特征，GABA能受体基因与GABA+、谷氨酸能受体基因与Glx分别呈现优先耦合，同时GABA能受体架构与Glx也存在广泛的跨系统关联。颞极GABA+和Glx浓度与语义记忆表现正相关，受体亚基表达与语义记忆准确率存在选择性关联；中介分析提示GABA+和Glx分别承载部分上述关联。研究据此提出颞极分子与神经化学架构相耦合、并与个体语义记忆差异相联系的多尺度解释，但相关结果尚不能确立因果关系。

papers.title: Microstructure of white matter association tracts in the temporal lobe predicts the timing of electrophysiological activity and behaviour in picture naming
papers.authors: Chupina I, Roos NM, Sierpowska J, Oostenveld R, Tuladhar AM, Westner BU, Piai V.
papers.abstract: White matter (WM) microstructure has been mainly associated with accuracy of picture naming. However, little is known about how WM properties relate to the timing of picture naming and its underlying electrophysiological activity. Here, we linked diffusion-weighted, electrophysiological, and behavioural data, using time-based measures to conceptually connect WM deterioration to alterations in conduction speed and precision. Our sample included individuals of varying age, with or without stroke. We correlated fractional anisotropy (FA) of bilateral WM tracts traversing the temporal lobe with mean response times (RTs) and response time variability (coefficient of variation, CV) in picture naming, and with the onset latency of neuronal activity, represented by the electrophysiological P2 component time-locked to picture onset. We selected tracts showing associations with P2 latency and naming performance separately, on which we conducted path analyses examining the relationship between structure, neuronal activity and behaviour. Depending on the tract, higher FA was associated with faster and/or more consistent naming, suggesting that ventral tracts differentially contribute to naming speed and consistency. Importantly, path modelling for the right inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus (IFOF) revealed that FA predicted P2 latency, which in turn predicted RTs, possibly reflecting a structure-activity-behaviour relationship in lexical-semantic processing. P2 source reconstruction demonstrated anatomical proximity to posterior segments of the right IFOF, supporting these findings. Overall, this study provides a proof of concept for modelling structure-activity-behaviour relationships in language research, while highlighting the need for elaboration of such relations at a more mechanistic level.

relevance.reason: 该研究将颞叶白质微结构与图片命名的电生理时序和行为联系起来，直接探讨语言产出及结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察颞叶白质关联纤维束的微结构能否预测图片命名的时间进程及其背后的电生理活动，将弥散加权成像、脑电与行为数据结合，在包含不同年龄、有或无卒中史的个体中分析各向异性分数与命名反应时、反应时变异及P2成分潜伏期的关系。结果显示，不同纤维束的各向异性分数较高分别与更快或更一致的命名相关，提示腹侧纤维束对命名速度与稳定性的贡献存在差异；路径分析进一步表明，右侧额枕下束的各向异性分数可预测P2潜伏期，而P2潜伏期又预测反应时，可能反映词汇语义加工中的结构—活动—行为关系，源定位结果也显示P2源靠近该束后段。作者据此提出结构—活动—行为关系建模的概念验证，同时指出这些关系仍需在更机制化的层面加以阐明。

papers.title: Older Adults Show Preserved Neural Signatures of Audiovisual Integration but Altered Links to Speech Comprehension
papers.authors: Reynolds C, Jensen O, Segaert K, Park H.
papers.abstract: Older adults often experience difficulty understanding speech in noisy environments despite relatively preserved hearing. Although visual speech cues can improve speech perception, it remains unclear whether the neural mechanisms supporting audiovisual integration are preserved in healthy ageing. We addressed this question using magnetoencephalography (MEG) combined with Rapid Invisible Frequency Tagging (RIFT) during challenging audiovisual speech task. Forty younger and forty older adults attended to one of two competing speech streams while the speaker's lip movements were frequency tagged, with the visual modulation driven by either the attended or unattended speech envelope. Task-Relevant amplitude modulation of frequency tagging in visual speech improved speech comprehension in younger adults as previously reported for this cohort; this accuracy benefit was absent in older adults. Auditory and visual tagging responses were modulated by task relevance similarly across age groups, indicating largely preserved modality-specific sensory processing in older adults. Intermodulation responses, reflecting nonlinear interactions between auditory and visual speech signals, also remained sensitive to task relevance and did not differ in their condition-dependent modulation between age groups. Greater Task-Relevant versus Task-Irrelevant differences in intermodulation coherence were also associated with greater comprehension benefits in younger adults; no significant association was found in older adults, and this relationship differed significantly between age groups. These findings suggest that the absence of a comprehension benefit in older adults is linked to a change in the relationship between audiovisual intermodulation and behaviour, despite largely preserved task-sensitive brain responses.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究老年人视听言语整合的神经表征及其与言语理解的关系，属语言与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注健康老年人视听言语整合的神经机制是否保留，以及其与言语理解的关系是否改变。研究者用脑磁图结合快速不可见频率标记，让年轻人和老年人在竞争言语流中完成视听言语任务。结果发现，老年人视听整合相关的神经反应仍能随任务相关性调节，与年轻人相近，提示感觉层面的整合机制大体保留；但视觉言语线索带来的理解准确率提升在老年人中消失，且视听交互反应与理解获益的关联仅在年轻人中显著，两组间关系存在差异。作者据此认为，老年人缺少理解获益可能源于视听整合神经活动与行为之间关系的改变，而非整合本身缺失。

papers.title: Cerebello-basal ganglia networks and behavior across adulthood and aging
papers.authors: Delaney C, Herrejon I, Magalhaes TNC, Jackson TB, Hicks TH, Bernard JA.
papers.abstract: The cerebellum contributes to aging, cognition, and reward related processing, but has been relatively understudied in these domains. The cerebello-basal ganglia (CB-BG) circuit may be key to better understanding how the brain ages. Prior work has implicated this circuit in aging in a small sample, though it is also of interest in age-related neurodegenerative disease, particularly Parkinson's Disease. Here, we investigated the CB-BG network, which has been implicated in modulation of cognitive, motor, and reward-related functions. In a sample of 138 participants between the ages of 35 and 86 we looked at network connectivity in cognitive and motor sub-circuits. Participants completed motor and cognitive testing batteries followed by 26 minutes of resting state functional connectivity magnetic resonance imaging (fcMRI). This data was analyzed using the CONN toolbox with an ROI-ROI approach targeting the CB-BG circuit. We replicated the previously mapped cognitive subcircuit and motor subcircuits. When examining connectivity by age group (early and late middle age and older adult hood), we found higher functional connectivity in early middle age compared to older adulthood, with no results related to late middle age. Analysis of connectivity as it relates to performance on the Stroop task showed higher connectivity-behavior associations in early middle-aged adults compared to older adults. We also explored sex differences and found higher functional connectivity in females compared to males. Analysis of steroid hormone levels revealed higher connectivity associated with progesterone in females relative to males. Together, we have replicated motor and cognitive CB-BG subcircuits and further demonstrated that this network has altered connectivity associated with age, sex, progesterone, and cognitive performance. This expanded investigation of CB-BG networks represents an essential new step in increasing our knowledge of age-related cognitive and motor declines and may be particularly relevant for consideration in Parkinson's Disease.

relevance.reason: 研究成人至老年小脑-基底节网络静息态功能连接与年龄、性别及Stroop认知表现的关系，涉及认知老化与脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注小脑-基底节环路在成年与衰老过程中的作用，对138名35至86岁参与者进行运动与认知测试及静息态功能连接磁共振成像，采用感兴趣区间分析方法考察认知和运动亚环路。研究复现了既有的认知与运动亚环路，并发现早中年组的连接强度高于老年组，晚中年组未见相关结果；连接与Stroop任务表现的关联也在早中年组更强。此外，女性连接高于男性，女性中孕酮水平与连接升高相关。作者据此认为该环路的连接随年龄、性别、孕酮和认知表现而变化，并提示其与年龄相关认知运动衰退及帕金森病的潜在关联，但相关发现尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Habitual sleep duration is associated with the cortical organisation of brain network controllability
papers.authors: Liu X, Lu R, Wang S, Yu Q, Zhang M, Cui R, Xiao J, Liu X, Fan T.
papers.abstract: Sleep is fundamental to adaptive brain function, yet how habitual sleep relates to the structural network properties that support flexible transitions between brain states remains poorly understood. Combining wrist-accelerometer sleep measures with diffusion MRI connectomes from 15,799 UK Biobank adults, we show that longer workday sleep is associated with higher modal controllability of somatomotor systems and lower controllability of visual cortex. This system-specific signature reproduced in a locked test set (n = 4,740) and was robust across extensive sensitivity analyses. Decomposition showed that it reflects a redistribution of structural connection weight, with greater absolute visual connectivity and a smaller somatomotor share of the whole-brain total. Weekend catch-up sleep showed no comparable association. The signature was distinct from brain-ageing patterns and, across 1,226 phenotypes, related mainly to physical activity and body composition rather than cognition. These findings link everyday sleep habits to the system-specific organisation of brain network controllability.

relevance.reason: 该研究将习惯性睡眠时长与扩散MRI结构连接组及脑网络可控性组织联系起来，属于脑结构与功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注日常睡眠时长与支持脑状态灵活转换的结构网络特性之间的关系，结合腕部加速度计睡眠测量与弥散MRI连接组数据进行分析。结果显示，工作日睡眠较长与躯体运动系统模态可控性较高、视觉皮层可控性较低相关，这一系统特异性模式在独立测试集中得到重复，并在多项敏感性分析中保持稳健。分解分析表明，该模式反映结构连接权重的重新分配，即视觉绝对连接增强而躯体运动系统在全脑总量中的占比下降；周末补觉未显示类似关联。该特征不同于脑老化模式，且主要与体力活动和身体成分相关而非认知。这些发现将日常睡眠习惯与脑网络可控性的系统特异性组织联系起来，但关联性不等于因果。

papers.title: Insula functional connectivity development follows a canonical antero-posterior axis of organization
papers.authors: Flook EA, Shafiei G, Cieslak M, Horien C, Luo AC, Meisler SL, Salo T, Sydnor VJ, Tong TT, Barch DM, Goldsmith J, Gur RE, Somerville LH, Uddin LQ, Alexander-Bloch A, Shinohara RT, Satterthwaite TD.
papers.abstract: The insula is a heterogeneous region associated with a range of functional domains including sensory, cognitive, and emotional processing. Cytoarchitectural and functional studies have described an antero-posterior axis of insula organization. However, the insula's functional development remains sparsely described. We delineated the development of insula resting-state functional connectivity across 562 individuals (6-22 years) using generalized additive models and population value decomposition. We show insulo-cortical functional connectivity development differs across the insula: anterior subregions have predominantly decreasing connectivity across the age range examined, whereas posterior subregions have variable connectivity that aligns with the sensorimotor-association axis. Vertex-level analysis revealed that age-related trajectories followed an antero-posterior axis that aligned with estimates of insula microstructure. Our results emphasize that the development of insula connectivity is spatially heterogeneous and aligns with known cytoarchitecture. The normative insula development described here provides a foundation for investigating how emerging psychopathology may be linked to variation in insula development.

relevance.reason: 研究岛叶静息态功能连接随年龄发育，并与微结构及前后轴组织对齐，涉及脑网络发育与结构功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注岛叶静息态功能连接在发育过程中的变化，利用广义相加模型和群体值分解，刻画了6至22岁人群岛叶与皮层连接随年龄发展的轨迹。结果显示，岛叶不同亚区的发育模式并不一致：前部亚区的连接随年龄总体下降，后部亚区的连接变化则与感觉运动—联合轴相对应；顶点水平的分析进一步表明，年龄相关轨迹沿前后轴分布，并与岛叶微结构估计相吻合。作者据此指出，岛叶功能连接的发育具有空间异质性，且与已知细胞构筑组织相一致，这为后续考察精神病理相关的岛叶发育变异提供了正常发育参照。

papers.title: Brain Age Gap Associations with Externalising Behaviours in Youth: A Longitudinal Investigation in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Cohort
papers.authors: Asikin A, Visontay R, Devine EK, Squeglia LM, Byrne H, Mewton L.
papers.abstract: Background: Early adolescence is a period of heightened risk for the emergence of externalising psychopathology, making it an important window for identifying neurodevelopmental risk markers. Differences between predicted brain age and chronological age - termed the brain age gap - reflect variation from age-typical patterns of brain structure. While brain age gap has been closely linked with internalising behaviours in adolescence, less is known about its relationship with externalising symptoms. This study examined whether brain age gap in late childhood/early adolescence (9-11 years) is associated with current externalising symptoms and whether it predicts externalising trajectories over seven-year follow-up. Methods. Participants were 10,516 adolescents (aged 9-11 at baseline; up to 18 years at follow-up) from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study who met inclusion/exclusion criteria. Brain age gap for each participant was derived from an external validated prediction model (Drobinin et al., 2022) applied to baseline measurements of cortical volume, area, and subcortical volume. Linear mixed-effects models were used to test cross-sectional and longitudinal associations between baseline brain age gap and externalising symptoms, as assessed using the Child Behaviour Checklist. Primary models were adjusted for age, sex, pubertal status, and prior to inclusion of sociodemographic covariates (ethnoracial identity and caregiver highest education). Results. A higher/more positive brain age gap was associated with greater externalising symptoms at baseline (B[SE]=0.067[0.033], p=.042), but this association was removed following sociodemographic adjustment (B[SE]=0.056[0.033], p=.088). Longitudinally, a significant brain age gap x age interaction was identified that remained evident after sociodemographic adjustment, with this relationship weakening across adolescence (B[SE]=-0.007[0.003], p=.033). Conclusions. These findings suggest that a more positive brain age gap, indicating more mature-appearing brain structure for age, in late childhood/early adolescence may be associated with externalising psychopathology, but this relationship is likely to be age- and context-dependent rather than a stable marker of persistent behavioural risk.

relevance.reason: 该研究用结构MRI估计脑龄差并考察其与青少年外化行为的纵向关联，属于脑结构发育与行为关系的脑机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ABCD队列，考察儿童晚期至青春期早期的脑龄差（预测脑龄与实际年龄之差）是否与当前外化行为症状相关，并能否预测此后数年的外化症状变化轨迹。结果显示，脑龄差较正（脑结构显得比同龄人更成熟）与基线外化症状较多相关，但纳入社会人口学协变量后该关联不再显著；纵向分析发现脑龄差与年龄的交互作用在调整后仍存在，且这一关系随青春期推进而减弱。作者据此认为，较正的脑龄差可能与外化精神病理相关，但这种关系更可能是年龄和情境依赖的，而非持续行为风险的稳定标志。

papers.title: Familiarity synchronizes brain rhythms during natural viewing
papers.authors: Noad KN, Kaiser D.
papers.abstract: Our perception of the world is shaped not only by sensory information, but also by prior experience. However, how familiarity alters the coordination of neural representations across distributed brain networks remains unclear. Rhythmic neural activity provides a potential mechanism for coordinating information across sensory and higher-order brain regions in the light of previous experience. Here, we thus investigated whether familiarity alters the coordination of brain rhythms during naturalistic viewing. Participants who were either familiar or unfamiliar with the television series Game of Thrones viewed clips from the series while EEG or fMRI was recorded. We calculated the intersubject correlations of neural activity across EEG frequency bands and related this rhythmic activity to fMRI BOLD responses. Across participants, all brain rhythms showed reliable intersubject synchrony and related to activity across large-scale brain networks. Familiarity selectively enhanced intersubject synchronisation in beta and gamma rhythms, with these effects reflected in visual and default mode brain regions. Moreover, beta and gamma band activity were modulated by similar aspects of the movie, suggesting coordinated familiarity-related processing. These findings show that familiarity selectively shapes rhythmic neural dynamics across the cortex, providing a mechanism through which prior experience alters the coordination of neural representations during naturalistic perception.

relevance.reason: 研究自然观看时熟悉性如何调节人脑节律同步及网络协调，属自然刺激下的脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察熟悉程度如何影响自然观看时大脑节律的协调，让对电视剧《权力的游戏》熟悉或不熟悉的参与者观看剧集片段，同时记录脑电或功能磁共振信号，并分析脑电各频段的参与者间同步及其与血氧信号的关系。结果显示，各脑节律均表现出稳定的参与者间同步，并与大规模脑网络活动相关；熟悉程度选择性地增强了beta和gamma节律的同步，这一效应体现在视觉和默认模式脑区，且两个频段受影片相似方面调制，提示熟悉相关加工具有协调性。作者据此认为，先前经验通过调节皮层节律动态，改变自然知觉中神经表征的协调方式。

papers.title: Evaluating the mobile MUSE EEG headband for studying resting state EEG and event-related potentials
papers.authors: Godde B.
papers.abstract: We examined whether and how tactile EEG experiments could be done through self-assessments by participants at home or through online experiments with consumer-grade mobile EEG devices. As a first step towards this aim, we performed a Flanker task in an online scenario with a MUSE headband and similarly a conventional lab experiment with a standard EEG device.Five undergraduate students participated in a visual flanker experiment and associated ERP components were recorded with either a standard 32-channel EEG System or a 4-channel MUSE EEG headband. In addition, we performed a 2-minutes resting state recording.Resting state brain oscillations measured with the Muse device revealed a similar pattern as with a standard EEG machine, however, strength of alpha oscillations was significantly reduced. For the Flanker task, in the Muse data, the stimulus-locked ERP components were less visible as compared to standard EEG, still the N200 was clearly expressed for the correct trials. Interestingly, in the incorrect trials, time-locked to the response there was the same negative Ne component visible as for the standard experiment. Our results reveal that the Muse device is suitable to obtain event-related potentials – even from interpolated electrode channels. Advanced preprocessing and artifact removal algorithms specifically targeting such devices with only a few and peripheral channels might help to better isolate ERP components of interest. It remains the challenge to develop devices and procedures for online tactile testing.

relevance.reason: 比较消费级MUSE头带与标准EEG记录静息态振荡和Flanker任务ERP成分，属人脑自发活动与注意执行功能神经机制的方法研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察消费级便携脑电设备能否用于居家或在线触觉脑电实验，以五名本科生为对象，用MUSE头带与标准32导脑电系统分别记录视觉Flanker任务和静息态脑电。结果显示，MUSE测得的静息态振荡模式与标准设备相近，但alpha振荡强度明显偏低；任务中刺激锁时的ERP成分不如标准设备清晰，不过正确试次的N200仍可辨认，错误试次中与反应锁时的Ne成分也与标准实验一致。作者据此认为MUSE可用于获取事件诱发电位，甚至包括插值电极通道，但需针对少通道外周设备改进预处理与伪迹去除，在线触觉测试的设备与流程仍有待发展。

papers.title: The Impact of Attention on Speech Entrainment in Clinical High-Risk for Psychosis Individuals
papers.authors: Poulton VR, Grent-'T-Jong T, Brickwedde M, gross j, Correll CU, Uhlhaas PJ.
papers.abstract: Language comprehension is disrupted in schizophrenia and early-stage psychosis, but the contributions of bottom-up and top-down processing remain unclear. In the current electroencephalography (EEG) study, we investigated speech entrainment in a sample of n=21 individuals at clinical high-risk for psychosis (CHR-P) and n=25 healthy controls (HCs). Continuous speech was presented through an audiobook in three listening conditions: (1) “Active”, in which participants attended to speech; (2) “Passive”, in which participants passively listened to the audiobook while performing a concurrent visual Flanker task; and (3) “Passive-reversed”, in which participants listened to an unintelligible time-reversed and noise-vocoded version of the audiobook while performing the Flanker task. Mutual Information (MI) analyses were used to assess shared information between the speech amplitude envelope and neural oscillations in the delta (0.25-3 Hz), theta (4.5-6.5 Hz), and alpha (7-10 Hz) frequency ranges. Sensor-level and source-level results indicate stronger delta entrainment in the Active vs. Passive conditions across groups. However, compared to controls, CHR-Ps showed reduced theta entrainment in auditory cortices, independent of condition, and decreased alpha entrainment in the Passive vs. Active condition. The findings point to theta entrainment deficits in CHR-Ps during continuous speech processing, indexing a bottom-up impairment. In contrast, delta and alpha entrainment in CHR-Ps were modulated by attention. Together, these findings highlight that both bottom-up and top-down impairments contribute to speech entrainment deficits in CHR-Ps.

relevance.reason: 该研究用EEG考察精神病临床高危人群在连续语音加工中的言语包络-神经振荡耦合及注意调控，直接涉及语言听觉加工和脑疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该脑电研究考察精神病临床高危人群在连续语音加工中的语音神经夹带，并区分自下而上与自上而下的贡献。参与者分别在主动注意语音、被动听语音并完成视觉任务、以及听不可懂反转语音三种条件下接受记录，研究比较语音包络与神经振荡之间的共享信息。结果显示，主动注意在两组中都增强了delta夹带；而高危个体在听觉皮层表现出与条件无关的theta夹带减弱，并在被动条件下出现alpha夹带下降。作者据此认为，theta夹带不足可能反映自下而上的加工缺陷，而delta和alpha夹带则受注意调制，提示两类损伤共同参与高危人群的语音夹带异常。

papers.title: Neuroimaging Correlates of Adolescent Substance Use: A Systematic Review of the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study
papers.authors: Assari S, Ray J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Neuroimaging may help characterize brain and contextual factors associated with substance use during development. The ABCD study supports investigation of developmental pathways relevant to substance use [1]. Objective: To synthesize original ABCD publications examining MRI measures in relation to substance use and substance-related exposures. Methods: The authors screened all 2,700 publications in the ABCD corpus. Original empirical articles reporting an MRI measure of any modality and a substance use variable were eligible; methodological, conceptual, review, and commentary articles were excluded. Imaging modality, brain measures, substances, design, and association direction were extracted for descriptive synthesis. Results: The evidence considered spans morphology, white matter microstructure, resting-state connectivity, and task activation. Findings concerning youth initiation, prenatal exposure, and familial liability address distinct developmental questions. Family history and stressful life events feature in the white matter literature [2]. Findings vary by modality, exposure definition, and temporal direction, and include null associations. Conclusions: The literature suggests distributed and context-dependent neuroimaging associations. Observational designs, overlapping participants, confounding, and analytic heterogeneity limit causal interpretation and assessment of independent replication. The findings support further longitudinal investigation but do not establish a validated MRI screening tool.

papers.title: Investigating the Association of Physical Activity and Muscular Fitness with Structural Brain Changes and Cognitive Performance
papers.authors: Schellin J, Herden M, Neumann M, Petersen M, Nägele FL, Bischoff LL, Cheng B, Twerenbold R, Thomalla G, Jensen M, Schumacher N.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Physical activity (PA) is a modifiable factor linked to cognitive decline, but its relationship with structural brain changes remains inconsistent. We studied associations of self-reported PA and handgrip strength with brain structure and cognition. Methods We examined middle-aged to elderly participants from the population-based Hamburg City Health Study, who underwent brain MRI and cognitive testing. PA was assessed via questionnaires (overall PA, sport participation, strength training frequency), and handgrip strength indexed muscular fitness. MRI markers included among others peak width of skeletonized mean diffusivity (PSMD), cortical thickness, and structural connectivity metrics. Cognition was assessed with CERAD-Plus subtests. Associations were examined using multivariable linear regression and mediation analysis. Results Among 2,618 participants (mean age 64 ± 8.3 years; 44% female), higher handgrip strength was associated with lower PSMD (β=-0.117, 95% CI [-0.194, -0.041]), greater cortical thickness (β = 0.100, 95% CI [0.019, 0.181]), and faster processing speed (β=-0.155, 95% CI [-0.234, -0.076]). Self-reported PA showed no associations with brain structure. Sport participation was associated with faster processing speed (β=-0.059, 95% CI [-0.105, -0.014]), better executive function (β=-0.045, 95% CI [-0.088, -0.002]), and better verbal memory (β = 0.052, 95% CI [0.007, 0.097]). PSMD partially mediated the association between handgrip strength and processing speed (ab=-0.008, 95% CI [-0.019, -0.001]). Conclusions Handgrip strength, unlike self-reported PA, was associated with brain structure and cognitive performance, highlighting the importance of PA assessment modality in brain health research. Mediation of associations between handgrip strength and cognition by PSMD suggest white matter microstructural injury as one pathway linking neuromuscular and cognitive function. Clinical Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT03934957.

papers.title: Impairment of mental time travel in patients with depressive disorders: Neural mechanisms and individual-level identification based on default mode network connectivity
papers.authors: Ran W, Shi Q, Pan G, Yuan Y, Zhang T, Chen G.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Mental time travel (MTT) enables re-experiencing past and pre-experiencing future events. Impairment in MTT is a core cognitive feature of major depressive disorder (MDD), but its neural mechanisms involving default mode network (DMN) functional connectivity remain unclear. Methods Thirty-six MDD patients and 36 healthy controls (HC) completed an adapted Autobiographical Memory Test to assess MTT. Resting-state fMRI examined DMN functional connectivity. Brain–behavior correlations used Spearman rank with Holm–Bonferroni correction. A support vector machine (SVM) classifier and support vector regression (SVR) evaluated individual discriminative and predictive values of identified connectivity features. Results Patients showed significantly reduced specificity in past recall and future imagination, with lower emotional valence, field perspective, and intensity. Resting-state connectivity revealed dissociated DMN patterns: weakened right anterior supramarginal gyrus–frontal pole, left frontal pole–posterior parietal, and hippocampus–lingual/cerebellar connections; enhanced left medial prefrontal–occipital and dorsal medial prefrontal–frontal pole connections. In HC, frontoparietal connectivity correlated with visual perspective; in patients, enhanced prefrontal connectivity negatively correlated with negative valence. Machine learning achieved 94.4% accuracy (AUC = 0.971) in classifying MDD vs HC, with frontal pole connections most discriminative. DMN connectivity significantly predicted individual specificity and neutral valence. Conclusions MTT impairment in MDD reflects system-level DMN imbalance and functional reorganization, providing neural targets for interventions. High individual classification accuracy supports DMN connectivity as a potential biomarker.

papers.title: The path from brain to words is rerouted in opioid addiction
papers.authors: Pais S, Tikochinski R, King SG, Calderon N, Goldstein RZ, Reichart R.
papers.abstract: Whether spontaneous speech preserves how the brain encoded an experience is unknown. We tested this question in opioid use disorder (OUD), in which drug cues outweigh other rewards. Eighty-two people with OUD and 34 controls watched the opening of the film Trainspotting during functional magnetic resonance imaging, then retold it in their own words. Language-model analyses showed that people with OUD dwelt on craving, personal identification and recovery, devoting more of their retelling to drug scenes. In 65 participants with imaging, this speech bias tracked how strongly the brain had distinguished drug from non-drug scenes during viewing, in left frontoparietal cortex in controls but left temporal cortex in OUD. Direct comparison showed left accumbens coupling positive in OUD and negative in controls, and left superior frontal coupling weaker in OUD. Spontaneous speech thus carries a trace of neural encoding whose route depends on what the experience meant to the speaker.

papers.title: Beyond reduced alpha power: a weaker temporal link between alpha and other brain rhythms in Alzheimer's disease
papers.authors: Wei J, Zhou C.
papers.abstract: Background: Reduced alpha power is among the most consistently reported resting electroencephalography (EEG) features of Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, alpha activity also interacts with other rhythms over time, a dynamic aspect that power measures do not capture. Whether AD weakens this temporal interaction, and whether such a change carries information beyond reduced alpha power, remains unclear. Methods: We analyzed public eyes-closed resting EEG from 29 healthy controls (HC), 36 patients with AD and 23 with frontotemporal dementia (FTD). After separating periodic from aperiodic activity, we tracked the aperiodic exponent and periodic theta, alpha, beta and gamma activity in consecutive 1-s windows. A vector autoregressive model predicted these five measures from the preceding window. Alpha's predictive contribution (Gα) was the increase in prediction error for theta, beta and gamma when the model was refitted without alpha as a predictor, with training and testing on separate time blocks of each recording. AD-HC differences were adjusted for age and sex, then for alpha expression (periodic alpha power) and signal quality (dynamic range and spatial reliability), with alpha self-persistence (alpha's carry-over between windows) as a benchmark. We also tested whether expression and Gα each added information about AD beyond the other. An exploratory Jansen-Rit-family circuit model examined whether expression and Gα can change partly independently. Results: Gα was lower in AD than in HC (adjusted difference in 10^3Gα, -3.19; 95% confidence interval -5.25 to -1.13; p = 0.0035), with a consistent direction across sensitivity analyses. Adjustment for alpha expression and signal quality retained 75.8% of this difference but only 4.4% of the self-persistence difference. Expression and Gα each added information beyond the other (Holm-adjusted p = 0.012 for both). FTD contrasts were inconclusive. In the circuit model, reducing local recurrent excitation lowered alpha expression without an estimated decrease in Gα, whereas reducing downstream input lowered Gα with a smaller change in expression. Conclusions: At the group level, the resting alpha abnormality in AD comprises two partly nonredundant dimensions: reduced expression and a weaker temporal link between alpha and subsequent multi-rhythm activity. Quantifying this temporal link may complement conventional spectral markers of AD.

papers.title: Posterior-anterior striatal reorganization after weight restoration in anorexia nervosa is associated with remission outcome: from mice to longitudinal human study
papers.authors: Adl Zarrabi A, Cachia A, Tolle V, Da Costa C, Lebrun N, Debacker C, Charron S, Chakravarty M, Daumas S, El Mestikawy S, Oppenheim C, Gorwood P, Duriez P.
papers.abstract: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is a severe psychiatric disorder with high relapse rates despite successful weight restoration. Altered reward processing and an imbalance between goal-directed and habitual control within the striatum have been proposed to contribute to the persistence of maladaptive behaviours, but the striatal mechanisms underlying recovery and relapse remain unclear. Here, we combined cross-species structural MRI with longitudinal clinical characterization to investigate striatal alterations associated with recovery from AN. Mice with deletion of the vesicular acetylcholine transporter (VAChTcKO), a model of maladaptive eating behaviour, showed reduced dorsolateral striatal volume compared with wild-type mice. At baseline, women with AN (n = 71) showed reduced striatal volumes compared with healthy controls (n = 30). Longitudinally, patients with AN (n = 41) and healthy controls (n = 28) were reassessed, revealing substantial recovery of striatal volumes following weight restoration in AN. Posterior-anterior putamen gradient changes differed according to subsequent remission status, with changes in the right putamen gradient predicting relapse. Striatal gradient changes were also associated with goal-directed and habitual behaviour during the slip-of-action task, response consistency during delay discounting, and circulating ghrelin and desacyl ghrelin concentrations. These findings identify longitudinal putamen reorganization as a candidate marker of vulnerability to relapse and link striatal plasticity to reward-related and metabolic processes in AN.

papers.title: From micro-architecture to networks: canonical neurobiological architecture of functional brain organization across the lifespan and in psychopathology
papers.authors: Feng G, Chen J, Iraji A, Sendi MS, Fu Z, Calhoun VD.
papers.abstract: Understanding how macroscale functional network connectivity (FNC) across the lifespan and in psychopathology is spatially organized with respect to microscale neurobiological architecture remains a challenge. Here, we constructed a cross-omics mapping framework by linking resting-state fMRI data (5,349 individuals, 6-80 years) with 49 neurobiological markers (24 cell types, 19 neurotransmitters, 6 mitochondria). We show that FNC development and aging unfold along cellular and molecular gradients. Specifically, spatial correspondence between age-related FNC changes and neurobiological microprofile networks varied by life stage, peaking for cell types in adolescence, neurotransmitter systems in mid-young adulthood and mitochondrial phenotypes in early adulthood. Applying normative modeling to 5 psychiatric disorders (schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder, autism, and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder), we identified disorder-specific and cross-disorder FNC phenotypes spatially associated with neurobiological architecture. Together, these findings provide a hypothesis-generating framework linking functional brain organization and dysfunction to canonical neurobiological architecture across the lifespan and psychiatric disorders.

papers.title: Cumulative Prenatal Adversity and Fronto-Limbic White Matter Development Across Adolescence
papers.authors: Costello LA, Garavan H, Makowski C, Ahern J, Potter AS, Reid BM, Johnson ME, Albaugh MD, Dib Goncalves P.
papers.abstract: Importance: The prenatal period is a critical window for intergenerational transmission of adversity, yet the neural substrates through which cumulative prenatal stress becomes biologically embedded in offspring brain development remain poorly understood. White matter microstructure is a candidate mechanism linking prenatal adversity to downstream emotional dysregulation. Objective: To examine associations between cumulative adverse prenatal exposure (APE) burden and fronto-limbic white matter fractional anisotropy (FA) at baseline and across adolescent developmental trajectories, and to test whether white matter FA mediates prenatal APE effects on emotional dysregulation. Design, Setting, and Participants: Cohort study using data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, Release 7.0, a diverse longitudinal cohort of US children recruited at ages 9 to 10 years across 21 sites. After diffusion tensor imaging quality control exclusions and retention of one twin or triplet per family, the final cross-sectional analytic sample comprised 10 483 participants. Longitudinal analyses included participants with data at one or more follow-up timepoints across four imaging waves. Exposures: Cumulative APE burden, operationalized as a sum of six binary adverse prenatal exposures (unplanned pregnancy; early alcohol, tobacco, and cannabis use before pregnancy recognition; complicated pregnancy; complicated birth; range, 0-6) following Zhi et al. (2026). Main Outcomes and Measures: Fractional anisotropy in 11 a priori fronto-limbic white matter tracts at baseline (ages approximately 10 years) and across four imaging timepoints (ages approximately 10, 12, 14, and 16 years). Exploratory outcomes included Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) dysregulation profile and Emotion Regulation Questionnaire (ERQ) subscales. Results: Higher prenatal APE burden was associated with lower baseline FA in left uncinate fasciculus (b = −0.00096; 95% CI, −0.00151 to −0.00042; FDR-corrected P = .006), corpus callosum (b = −0.00079; 95% CI, −0.00125 to −0.00032; FDR-corrected P = .006), and right uncinate fasciculus (b = −0.00071; 95% CI, −0.00120 to −0.00021; FDR-corrected P = .019). These associations were robust to adjustment for diffusion image quality, and prenatal burden was not associated with baseline image quality. In repeated-measures models across four imaging timepoints, higher APE burden was associated with steeper FA increases across adolescence (positive APE x Age interaction in 5 of 11 tracts; positive across all 11), though these trajectory effects were attenuated after adjustment for image quality. Post hoc analyses indicated that pregnancy complications and prenatal cannabis exposure were the most consistent contributors to these associations. White matter FA partially mediated the association between prenatal APE burden and involuntary emotional dysregulation, with no association with voluntary emotion regulation strategies. Conclusions and Relevance: Cumulative prenatal APE burden was associated with lower fronto-limbic white matter FA at the start of adolescence, an association that was stable across development and robust to image-quality adjustment. Evidence for altered developmental trajectories was more sensitive to image quality and should be interpreted cautiously. These findings identify fronto-limbic white matter-- particularly the uncinate fasciculus and corpus callosum-- as a candidate neurobiological correlate of cumulative prenatal adversity, while underscoring that this pathway reflects a bounded set of prenatal exposures.

papers.title: Proteogenomics captures a midlife biological state of Alzheimer's disease susceptibility
papers.authors: Perry A, Adegboye H, Bledsoe X, Archer D, Tiwari A, Lin P, Farber-Eger E, Perera BL, Zhao S, Sheng Q, Ma S, Hutchins E, Zhang P, Alexander M, Sale R, Chen Y, Colangelo L, Bahorik A, Tanriverdi K, Risitano A, Freedman J, Nayor M, Das S, Liu D, Pechman K, Shashikumar N, Bolton C, Davis LT, Landman B, Hou L, Cruchaga C, Saloner R, Yaffe K, Wells Q, Hohman T, Jefferson A, Keuren-Jensen K, Shah R, Gamazon E.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) develops over decades, but biological processes underlying susceptibility during midlife remain poorly understood. Using multimodal neuroimaging and plasma proteomics in UK Biobank participants, we identified circulating proteomic signatures of brain structure and organization. This 'neurostructural proteome' predicted future cognitive decline, incident dementia, and later-life AD pathology across independent cohorts spanning two decades of follow-up. Genetic and single-nucleus transcriptomic analyses demonstrated convergence of the neurostructural proteome and AD genetic architecture, highlighting enrichment in astrocyte, microglia, and endothelial pathways beyond the APOE region. Collectively, these findings identify a circulating neurostructural proteome detectable in midlife that captures molecular processes associated with future AD susceptibility and provide a framework for uncovering an early biological landscape of disease susceptibility that precedes conventional biomarkers and clinical onset.

papers.title: Whole-brain normative modeling across multiple functional connectivity metrics in MEG
papers.authors: Kobbersmed JRL, Gohil C, Woolrich MW, Vidaurre D.
papers.abstract: Normative modeling has recently emerged in structural and functional neuroimaging as a promising approach to characterize neuropathology at the individual level. Trained on large healthy cohorts, these models predict expected measurements from covariates such as age and sex while quantifying normal population variability. Individual measurements can then be compared against the model to identify deviations associated with pathology. While most normative models of brain function have been based on functional MRI, EEG and MEG offer more direct measurements of brain activity at higher temporal resolution. Despite the promise, how to adequately perform normative modelling at the whole-brain level on these modalities remains challenging. We here propose M/EEG-FUNCOIN to identify age- and sex-related dimensions of change in functional connectivity from a plethora of FC measures from electrophysiology: amplitude envelope correlation, phase-locking value, and time-delay embedding covariance. Using resting-state MEG data from the Cambridge Centre for Aging and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN) dataset, we show that M/EEG-FUNCOIN can: (i) characterize age- and sex-related whole-brain functional connectivity patterns in greater detail than existing methods; and (ii) effectively capture meaningful deviations in connectivity in individuals that rank high and low in cognitive ability. Altogether, these results show great potential for applications in complex, network-level brain pathology.

relevance.reason: 用静息态MEG构建全脑功能连接规范模型并关联年龄性别与认知能力，属静息态脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出M/EEG-FUNCOIN方法，用于在脑磁图数据上开展全脑功能连接规范建模，并基于静息态数据检验其效果。结果显示，该方法能比现有方法更细致地刻画与年龄和性别相关的全脑功能连接模式，还能捕捉认知能力高低不同个体间有意义的连接偏差。作者据此认为，这一框架在复杂网络层面的脑病理研究上具有应用潜力，但摘要未报告临床诊断或干预效果。

papers.title: Functional and Structural Brain Age Gaps as Complementary Predictive Markers for Cognitive Performance
papers.authors: Crocetta A, Morandini M, Bittner N, Caspers S, Cauda F, Brovelli A, Gilson M.
papers.abstract: Cognitive decline is characterized by substantial inter-individual variability across the lifespan, even among clinically healthy adults. However, it is unclear how structural and functional brain organization jointly relate to differences in cognitive performance within the typical populations. We considered a multimodal brain age framework by predicting for each subject its age from either structural MRI or resting-state functional MRI, after training on the 1000BRAINS cohort (901 participants, 18-85 years). Following, a structural and a functional brain age gap markers were defined as the deviations with respect to the real chronological age. We then used the markers to characterize the interplay between structure and function in shaping cognitive performances. Our findings reveal that the functional marker is as important to predict global cognitive performance as the structural marker. The most accurate prediction was found for global cognition, executive functions and episodic memory, followed by working memory, attention and language. In particular, the structural marker was contributing to all domains, except for working memory, whereas the functional marker had the highest contribution. Overall, structural and functional brain age models together provide a meaningful subject-level summary of brain information for predicting cognition, supporting a multidimensional view of typical aging.

relevance.reason: 用结构MRI与静息态fMRI脑龄差联合预测认知表现，涉及脑结构与功能组织及认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在临床健康成年人中，结构性与功能性脑组织如何共同关联认知表现的个体差异。作者基于多模态脑年龄框架，分别用结构MRI和静息态功能MRI预测个体年龄，并以预测年龄与实际年龄的偏差定义结构性和功能性脑年龄差标记，再考察二者与认知表现的关系。结果显示，功能性标记对整体认知表现的预测作用与结构性标记相当；对整体认知、执行功能和情景记忆的预测最准确，其次为工作记忆、注意和语言。结构性标记除工作记忆外对各认知域均有贡献，而功能性标记贡献最高。作者认为，两类脑年龄模型可共同提供个体层面的脑信息摘要以预测认知，支持典型老化的多维视角。

papers.title: Shared control-network recruitment and task-dependent brain-behavior associations in bilingual language and rule switching.
papers.authors: Guo T, Wu YJ, Chen J, Liu X, Chen S, Peng P, Li Y, Xie X, Wen R, Guo T.
papers.abstract: Bilingual language control is thought to draw on domain-general cognitive control, yet it remains unclear whether cross-task overlap in neural recruitment is accompanied by similar brain-behavior relationships. Previous connectivity studies have typically estimated functional connectivity (FC) across entire tasks or blocks, obscuring network changes specific to switch trials. We combined hierarchical drift-diffusion modeling, regional activation, and beta-series FC in 126 Chinese-English bilinguals (123 with usable fMRI data) who completed language- and rule-switching tasks. Both tasks reduced drift rates and prolonged nondecision times on switch trials. They also recruited a common 28-region switch-sensitive control core and showed increased switch-related FC within this core and between the core and default mode, subcortical, and cerebellar systems. At the individual-difference level, generalized estimating equations revealed task-dependent brain-behavior relationships: core-within and core-subcortical FC were more positively associated with drift-rate switch cost during language switching than during rule switching. Together, the results identify partial overlap in regional recruitment, similarly directed system-level FC changes, and distinct FC-evidence-accumulation relationships across tasks.

relevance.reason: 研究双语者语言切换与规则切换共享控制网络及脑-行为关联，涉及语言控制的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察双语语言控制与一般认知控制在神经层面是否存在重叠，以及这种重叠是否伴随相似的行为关联。作者结合漂移扩散建模、脑区激活和beta序列功能连接，分析中英双语者在语言切换与规则切换任务中的表现。两项任务在切换试次上均降低漂移率、延长非决策时间，并共同招募一个对切换敏感的28脑区控制核心，同时增强核心内部及核心与默认模式、皮层下和小脑系统之间的切换相关连接。但在个体差异层面，脑行为关系随任务而异：语言切换时，核心内部及核心与皮层下连接与漂移率切换代价的正向关联强于规则切换。结果表明两任务在脑区招募上部分重叠、系统层面连接变化方向相似，而连接与证据累积的关系则具有任务依赖性。

papers.title: Hidden Neural Variability and the Unexplained Cochlear Implant Outcome
papers.authors: Strelnikov K.
papers.abstract: Cochlear implants work, but not equally. After decades of cohort studies, the familiar predictors of outcome (age, duration of deafness, residual hearing, etiology) still leave most of the spread between patients unexplained. Research on how the brain handles degraded speech, audiovisual cues and everyday sounds shows that implant outcome measures test the brain at least as much as the ear. Yet candidacy assessment still examines the cochlea, the auditory nerve and inner-ear anatomy, and rarely the cognitive and structural state of the brain that must learn to use the device. This article argues that undetected neural variability, including cognitive decline, hearing-related atrophy and incidental pathology in brains assumed to be normal, is a plausible and largely unmeasured contributor to the missing variance. It proposes routine cognitive and volumetric phenotyping of implant candidates, and of the control groups against which they are judged. Because the brain restores much of the degraded implant signal through its predictive mechanisms, the article also calls for a new line of work: the development of dedicated tests of predictive brain capacity, a measure currently absent from both candidacy assessment and outcome research.

relevance.reason: 论述人工耳蜗使用者大脑处理退化语音的预测机制及认知/结构差异对语言结局的影响。

papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论人工耳蜗效果为何在患者间差异很大：年龄、耳聋时长、残余听力与病因等已知因素仍无法解释大部分结果差异。作者指出，现有评估主要检查耳蜗、听神经和内耳结构，却很少考察大脑的认知与结构状态，而未识别的神经差异（如认知衰退、与听力相关的萎缩及被假定为正常的脑部偶发病变）可能是这部分未解释变异的重要来源。文章据此建议对候选者及对照群体开展常规认知与脑容量表型评估，并呼吁开发针对大脑预测能力的专门测试，以补足当前评估与结果研究中的空白。

papers.title: Resting-state alpha scale-free dynamics predict individual differences in the balance between reward-learned and preference-based values during free choice
papers.authors: Zhu J, Hashimoto J, Honda T, Yamamoto K, Anno M, Northoff G, Nakao T.
papers.abstract: Values learned through reward can continue to influence choices guided by one's own preferences, such as which painting to hang, to an extent that varies across individuals. Because such preferences build up gradually across choices, their expression may depend on how well internally generated states are sustained over time, a property indexed by long-range temporal correlations (LRTC) in intrinsic brain activity. We tested whether resting-state alpha-band LRTC predicts individual differences in the balance between reward-learned and preference-based values. Eighty-one participants learned through probabilistic feedback which of four abstract shapes tended to be rewarded, and then judged their preferences among these shapes and 11 new shapes without feedback. Alpha LRTC was estimated by detrended fluctuation analysis of resting-state electroencephalography recorded before, between, and after the tasks. A trial-level mixed-effects model showed that reward history influenced preference judgments and that this influence decreased with resting-state alpha LRTC: participants with weak LRTC chose high-reward shapes over new shapes on 75% of trials, whereas those with strong LRTC were close to indifference (54%). The relationship was distributed across the scalp, stable across recordings, and not explained by spectral power or learning performance. Resting-state alpha LRTC is thus related to how strongly reward-learned values are carried into preference-based choice. Given the view that stronger LRTC reflects a longer window over which internally generated states are integrated, the observed relationship could arise because the window is biased toward values built up through one's own choices, or because it attenuates values learned under a criterion that no longer applies; which account holds remains to be determined.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态alpha频段长程时间相关性如何预测奖赏学习与偏好价值在自由选择中的权衡，属决策与静息脑活动组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察静息态α波段的长程时间相关性（LRTC）能否预测个体在自由选择中受奖赏学习价值与自身偏好价值影响的相对程度。81名参与者在概率反馈中学习四种图形的奖赏倾向，随后在无反馈条件下对旧图形和新图形作偏好判断，并在任务前后及中间记录静息脑电以估计α LRTC。试次水平混合效应模型显示，奖赏历史会影响偏好判断，且这种影响随α LRTC增强而减弱：LRTC较弱者多数选择高奖赏图形而非新图形，LRTC较强者则接近无偏好。该关系分布于全头皮、跨记录稳定，且不能由频谱功率或学习表现解释。作者据此提出，α LRTC可能与奖赏学习价值被带入偏好选择的程度有关，但其具体机制尚待确定。

papers.title: Emotional Content Enhances Attentional Tracking of Conversations through Context-Sensitive Modulation of Auditory-Language Networks.
papers.authors: Heikkinen P, Lepistö S, Wikman P, Koskinen E, Peräkylä A, Ravaja N, Harjunen VJ.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Engagement in conversation often requires continuous monitoring of relevant speech in a continuously evolving auditory environment. Emotional salience of semantic content may influence this process, but its role in attentional tracking of continuous speech remains unclear. We address this question using an audiovisual "Cocktail-party" paradigm combined with source-localized magnetoencephalography and encoding-decoding analyses. Participants (18 female, 14 male) selectively attended to one dialogue while ignoring a concurrent distractor dialogue, with both emotional salience and semantic coherence of the conversations manipulated independently. Decoding analyses revealed that negatively valenced, high-arousal, and socially relevant semantic content strengthened neural speech tracking, but only for attended dialogues. This effect depended on semantic structure, emerging earlier in semantically coherent than incoherent dialogues. Encoding analyses further showed latency- and region-specific effects across temporal, parietal, and frontal cortical regions. Emotional salience and coherence jointly modulated mid-latency (100 - 250 ms) responses, whereas late-latency (270 - 450 ms) responses were driven primarily by emotional salience. These findings demonstrate that emotional meaning enhances neural prioritization of attended speech and semantic coherence shapes the temporal dynamics of this enhancement. Together, these results indicate context-sensitive emotional modulation of auditory-language processing during selective listening of continuous speech.Significance Statement Understanding how the brain prioritizes and selectively processes information in naturalistic, continuously evolving audiovisual scenes such as conversations is a central challenge in neuroscience. Here, we show that conversations conveying negatively valenced, high-arousal, and socially relevant content enhance neural tracking of attended speech in a noisy cocktail-party setting. This enhanced tracking depends on the semantic structure of the conversation, emerging earlier for coherent dialogues that are easy to follow. Furthermore, we show that emotional content strengthens mechanisms related to speech comprehension and sharpens segregation of relevant from irrelevant talk. These findings demonstrate that emotional meaning and semantic continuity jointly shape cortical processing of continuous speech, providing new insight into how the brain selects and processes meaningful information during a conversation.

relevance.reason: MEG研究揭示情绪语义内容对连续言语注意追踪的神经调制机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注对话中语义内容的情绪显著性如何影响对连续语音的注意追踪，采用视听“鸡尾酒会”范式结合脑磁图源定位与编解码分析，让参与者在干扰对话存在时选择性聆听一段对话，并独立操纵情绪显著性与语义连贯性。解码结果显示，负性、高唤醒且具社会相关性的语义内容会增强神经语音追踪，但仅针对被注意的对话，且该效应依赖语义结构，在语义连贯的对话中出现得更早。编码分析进一步表明，情绪显著性与连贯性共同调节中潜伏期反应，而晚潜伏期反应主要由情绪显著性驱动，说明情绪意义可提升对被注意语音的神经优先化，语义连贯性则塑造这一增强的时间动态。

papers.title: Neurocognitive characteristics of perceptual feedback processing differ in autism.
papers.authors: Zuk NJ, Slobodskoy-Plusnin JY, Weiss Y, Sampath V, Düsterwald KM, Akrami A, Ahissar M.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Autistic individuals often show reduced adaptation to changing environmental demands, but the neurocognitive mechanisms underlying this difference remain unclear. We asked whether it may be explained by reduced sensitivity to external feedback and changes in task difficulty. Autistic and non-autistic adults of either sex, matched for cognitive ability, performed a pitch discrimination task in which their response was immediately followed by feedback. Accuracy was similar between the two groups, yet autistic participants exhibited a markedly reduced feedback-related negativity (FRN), an event-related EEG potential differentiating explicit negative versus positive feedback. They also showed weaker modulation of feedback-evoked EEG responses by perceptual difficulty. Lastly, they showed reduced trial-by-trial behavioral updating of perceptual bias following recent correct and easy trials. These effects were replicated in a follow-up experiment conducted 1-2 years later. When combined they classified autistic and non-autistic participants with about 80% accuracy. Together, our findings indicate that multiple processes for evaluating perceptual decisions and adjusting subsequent behavior differ in autism and likely contribute to slow updating in changing contexts.Significance Statement Autism is associated with reduced adaptation to changing environments in both behavior and neural signals, but the underlying neurocognitive mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we show that autistic individuals exhibit a reduced feedback-related negativity (FRN), an EEG component that is present when receiving negative instead of positive feedback. They also show weaker neural modulation by perceptual difficulty and reduced trial-by-trial behavioral updating of perceptual bias following recent correct and easy trials. These effects were replicated in a follow-up study. When combined, they classified autistic and non-autistic participants with high accuracy. These findings suggest that reduced flexibility in autism is associated with reduced processing of external feedback and task difficulty.

relevance.reason: 该研究用EEG反馈相关负波考察自闭症成人感知决策反馈加工的神经认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察自闭症成人对感知反馈的加工是否不同于非自闭症者，并试图解释其在变化环境中适应较慢的机制。两组认知能力匹配的成人完成音高辨别任务，反应后立即获得反馈，同时记录脑电。结果发现两组准确率相近，但自闭症参与者的反馈相关负波明显减弱，即对负性与正性反馈的区分较弱；其反馈诱发脑电受知觉难度调节的程度也更弱，且依据近期正确、容易试次调整知觉偏向的逐试次行为更新减少。这些效应在约一两年后的追踪实验中得到重复，多项指标结合可较高准确率区分两组。作者据此认为，自闭症者在评估感知决策和调整后续行为上的多个过程存在差异，可能共同导致其在变化情境中更新较慢。

papers.title: Repeated Head Impacts May Compromise White Matter Integrity and Bimanual Coordination in American Football Players.
papers.authors: D'Amario S, Magee B, Champagne AA, Wilson ME, Ramírez-García G, Coverdale NS, Cook DJ.
papers.abstract: Background Repeated head impacts (RHI) in American Football may contribute to subtle white matter (WM) abnormalities and functional deficits even in the absence of clinically diagnosed concussion. Hypothesis Contact athletes would demonstrate tract-specific differences in fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) compared with noncontact controls, and high-exposure (HE) athletes would show greater within-season diffusion change, worse bimanual coordination, and greater symptom burden than low-exposure (LE) athletes. Study design Prospective cohort study. Level of evidence Level 3. Methods Twenty-two male varsity American Football players and 13 male noncontact controls underwent preseason diffusion tensor imaging. Football athletes were monitored over a single season using helmet-mounted accelerometers and stratified into HE and LE groups. Tract-specific FA and MD were derived using probabilistic tractography. Pre-post SCAT3 symptom and severity checklist data were collected from all football athletes, and pre-post Kinarm Ball-on-Bar (BOB) bimanual coordination data were available for 12 athletes. Results At preseason, contact athletes demonstrated higher FA in 15 of 16 tracts compared with noncontact controls, with lower FA in the forceps minor. MD was lower in 10 of 16 tracts, higher in the bilateral inferior longitudinal fasciculus, and similar in the corticospinal tract and superior thalamic radiation. Over the season, HE athletes sustained more impacts (P < 0.001) and greater cumulative g -force (P = 0.001) than LE athletes. On the BOB task, LE athletes showed modest improvement, whereas HE athletes worsened, yielding a between-group difference in change of 0.59 (95% CI, 0.22-0.96; P = 0.005). Generalized estimating equation models accounting for within-athlete tract correlations did not detect HE-versus-LE differences in FA change (Wald χ²(1) = 0.14; P = 0.71) or MD change (Wald χ²(1) < 0.01; P > 0.99), and SCAT3 symptom and severity scores remained low with no meaningful between-group differences. Conclusion In 22 contact athletes, repeated head-impact exposure was associated with preseason WM differences and worsening bimanual coordination across a single season, while longitudinal tract-level DTI and symptom-based clinical measures showed limited between-group change. Clinical relevance Objective motor assessment and advanced neuroimaging may help characterize subtle consequences of RHIs that are missed by routine symptom-based tools.

relevance.reason: 研究重复头部撞击与白质弥散指标及双手协调功能的关系，属白质结构与运动认知功能关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该前瞻性队列研究考察美式橄榄球运动员在无临床诊断脑震荡情况下的重复头部撞击是否与白质弥散指标及双手协调表现相关，比较了接触性运动运动员与非接触对照，并按赛季内撞击暴露高低分组。赛前接触组在多数白质纤维束上显示各向异性等弥散指标差异；赛季中高暴露组撞击更多，双手协调任务表现变差，而低暴露组略有改善。不过，纵向纤维束弥散变化和症状量表均未显示有意义的高、低暴露组差异。作者据此认为，客观运动评估与先进神经影像或有助于识别常规症状工具遗漏的细微影响，但结果属关联性观察，尚不能说明因果关系或临床疗效。

papers.title: Targeting central thalamus with transcranial ultrasound reduces arousal in healthy volunteers.
papers.authors: Hopkins AR, Cain JA, White EA, Abakians SM, Monti MM.
papers.abstract: Using low-intensity focused transcranial ultrasound stimulation, we test the causal roles of the central thalamus in arousal and the pulvinar in visuospatial attention in the healthy human brain. In a within-subjects, counterbalanced design, 27 healthy volunteers (two females) complete a vigilance task (Psychomotor Vigilance Task) and a visuospatial attention task (Egly-Driver Task) before and after sham, central thalamic, and pulvinar sonication. Targeting the central thalamus slows responses and increases lapses in attention during the vigilance task, indicating reduced arousal. Pulvinar sonication reduces (and slows) responses to visual stimuli presented contralaterally, suggesting a disruption of contralateral visuospatial attention. These results provide causal evidence linking the pulvinar to visuospatial attention and the central thalamus to arousal in the healthy human brain and demonstrate that ultrasound can elicit distinct behavioral changes in healthy volunteers when delivered to close but functionally distinct thalamic regions, underscoring its potential as a tool for noninvasive brain mapping.

relevance.reason: 经颅超声调控健康人丘脑，因果性检验中央丘脑在觉醒、丘脑枕在视空间注意中的作用。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康志愿者中考察丘脑中央核团与丘脑枕的因果作用，采用低强度聚焦经颅超声刺激，并结合警觉任务与视空间注意任务进行刺激前后对比。结果显示，刺激丘脑中央核团会减慢警觉任务中的反应并增加注意脱漏，提示觉醒水平下降；刺激丘脑枕则削弱并减慢对侧视野视觉刺激的反应，提示对侧视空间注意受到干扰。作者据此认为，这为丘脑中央核团参与觉醒、丘脑枕参与视空间注意提供了因果证据，也说明超声作用于相邻但功能不同的丘脑区域可产生不同行为变化，具有作为无创脑功能定位工具的潜力。

papers.title: Neural limits of temporal feature binding in human visual cortex.
papers.authors: Schönemann N, Merkel C, Strumpf H, Felßberg AM, Bartsch MV, Schoenfeld MA, Hopf JM.
papers.abstract: Humans are able to track the change of color and orientation (CO) of an object at a stunning rate. However, spatially separating those features slows this rate by an order of magnitude - a temporal limit of feature binding that is little understood. Here, we investigate the underlying mechanisms using high-temporal resolution cortical source localization of the magnetic field response elicited by CO-pairs alternating at different frequencies in color and orientation. We show that (1) binding requires a rapid recurrent modulation (~120 ms) of activity in V1/V2, whose latency is independent of the alternation rate. (2) Performance drops to chance when the alternation rate becomes too high to accommodate the recurrent process within a single alternation. (3) CO binding itself is mediated by color-based attention, which gradually biases re-occurring CO combinations containing the attended color. These observations together demonstrate that CO-binding across space depends on rapid recurrent processing in early visual cortex, with its temporal limit being set by the time this process takes to be completed. Binding ultimately results from a slower and gradual attentional bias of the recurrent process instantiating a form of stroboscopic stationarity in the stream of alternations for unambiguous discrimination of the correct feature-combination.

relevance.reason: 研究人视觉皮层特征绑定的时间限制及V1/V2快速递归加工机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类视觉系统中颜色与朝向特征绑定的时间极限问题，利用高时间分辨率的皮层源定位技术，记录颜色与朝向交替变化的刺激所诱发的磁场反应。结果显示，特征绑定依赖V1/V2中约120毫秒的快速递归调制，该过程潜伏期不随交替频率改变；当交替过快、使递归加工无法在单次交替内完成时，行为表现降至随机水平。研究进一步表明，绑定本身由基于颜色的注意所介导，注意会逐渐偏向包含被注意颜色的重复出现的特征组合。作者据此认为，跨空间的特征绑定依赖早期视觉皮层的快速递归加工，其时间极限由该加工完成所需时间决定，而最终绑定则源于较慢的、渐进的注意偏向。

papers.title: Low-dose ketamine modulates brain entropy in treatment-resistant depression: Results from two neuroimaging clinical trials.
papers.authors: Liou YJ, Cheng LK, Lin WC, Su TP, Chen LF, Tu PC, Li CT, Bai YM, Tsai SJ, Chen MH.
papers.abstract: Background Several studies have reported entropy reductions in regions of the brain associated with affective-regulatory and reward- and motivation-related processes in patients with major depressive disorder. However, whether low-dose ketamine modulates this reduction remains unclear. Methods We analyzed resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data from two single-infusion low-dose ketamine trials. Data at baseline and 3 days after infusion were analyzed. In Trial 1, patients with treatment-resistant depression were randomized to receive 0.2 or 0.5 mg/kg ketamine or normal saline. In Trial 2, patients with treatment-resistant depression and suicidal ideation were randomized to receive either 0.5 mg/kg ketamine or 0.045 mg/kg midazolam. Sample entropy was calculated from the spontaneous blood oxygenation level-dependent time series of 166 regions of interest defined by the automated anatomical labeling atlas 3. Results In Trial 1, increased brain entropy was observed in the gyrus rectus, cerebellar vermis I/II, substantia nigra, red nucleus, and bilateral locus coeruleus after low-dose ketamine infusion. In Trial 2, the ketamine group exhibited higher brain entropy in the left amygdala compared with the midazolam group. Discussion Low-dose ketamine rapidly increases brain entropy (from baseline to day 3) in frontolimbic, cerebellar, and ascending neuromodulatory regions, including the gyrus rectus, cerebellar vermis I/II, substantia nigra, red nucleus, bilateral locus coeruleus, and left amygdala. Changes in brain entropy after low-dose ketamine infusion may be associated with its rapid antidepressant and antianhedonic effects, although this relationship requires further investigation.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用静息态fMRI分析难治性抑郁患者脑熵变化，探讨氯胺酮对脑自发活动组织的影响，属于脑疾病与静息态脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注低剂量氯胺酮能否改变难治性抑郁症患者脑熵降低的状态，分析了两个单次输注临床试验的静息态功能磁共振数据，比较基线及输注后第3天的脑熵变化。结果显示，低剂量氯胺酮在直回、小脑蚓部、黑质、红核、双侧蓝斑及左侧杏仁核等额边缘、小脑和上行神经调制区域引起脑熵升高。作者认为，这种脑熵变化可能与氯胺酮的快速抗抑郁和抗快感缺失作用有关，但该关系仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Environment-specific virtual head direction representation in the human anteroventral thalamus during memory-guided spatial orientation.
papers.authors: Lv P, Chen D, Zhang C, Zhang K, Wang L.
papers.abstract: Knowing which way you are facing is essential for navigation. In animals, a dedicated set of neurons-head direction cells-acts as an internal compass: each cell fires most strongly when the animal faces a particular direction. The anterior thalamus is a key hub for this system. In humans, however, direct electrophysiological evidence for a comparable head direction signal remains limited. To address this gap, we recorded intracranial electroencephalography (EEG) from the anteroventral thalamus (AVT) in patients with epilepsy while they performed a virtual navigation task. We analyzed neural activity during in-place rotation to isolate virtual head direction (vHD) information. Using inverted encoding models applied to multi-band neural activity, we reconstructed continuous vHD within two distinct virtual environments. Critically, the decoders failed to generalize across environments, indicating that the AVT vHD representation is environment specific rather than a fixed, universal map. This encoding was observed in the AVT and was temporally specific to rotation epochs; no significant encoding was detected in the pulvinar, another thalamic subregion not part of the classic head direction network in rodents. Together, these findings suggest that the human AVT carries environment-specific vHD information, bridging a gap between animal models and human navigation and highlighting a potential link to spatial disorientation disorders.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类丘脑前腹核是否存在类似动物的头方向信号，为此在癫痫患者执行虚拟导航任务时记录了颅内脑电，并分析原地转向时的神经活动。研究者用反向编码模型在两种虚拟环境中重建连续的头方向信息，发现这种编码出现在前腹核且集中于转向时段，但解码器无法跨环境泛化，说明其表征是环境特异的而非固定通用地图；另一丘脑亚区未检出显著编码。作者据此认为，人类前腹核携带环境特异的虚拟头方向信息，为连接动物模型与人类导航提供了电生理证据，并提示其可能与空间定向障碍有关，但这一联系尚属推测。

papers.title: High-Intensity Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation for Post-Stroke Cognitive Impairment: A Triple-Blind Randomized Trial.
papers.authors: Ai Y, Zhang S, Huang L, Chen Q, Liu Y, Yin M, Zheng F, Wu S, Ye Z, Zheng H, Zhang L, Hu X.
papers.abstract: Background Non-invasive neuromodulation for post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI) holds promise, but high-level evidence is lacking, partly due to the challenge of targeting single brain regions in a condition with diverse lesions and multi-network dysfunction. Objective The present study aimed to evaluate the effect of high-intensity transcranial alternating current stimulation (Hi-tACS) on cognitive function in patients with PSCI. Methods In this triple-blind, randomized, sham-controlled trial, PSCI patients were randomized to receive either active or sham Hi-tACS. The tACS group received active Hi-tACS at 15 mA and 77.5 Hz for 40 minutes, twice daily, 5 days a week for 2 weeks. The sham group used identical devices without current delivery. The primary outcome was the change in Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) score. Secondary outcomes included Digit Span Test and cerebral oxyhemoglobin (HbO) concentration changes measured by functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). Results The tACS group (n=34) showed higher MoCA response rates than the sham group (n=34) immediately after treatment (73.5% vs 38.2%, P=0.003) and at the 4-week post-treatment follow-up (88.2% vs 55.9%, P=0.003). Improvements in forward and backward digit span were also greater in the tACS group at both assessments. The intention-to-treat analysis of all 70 randomized participants yielded results consistent with the per-protocol analysis. Exploratory fNIRS analyses identified greater HbO increases in the left, right, and medial prefrontal regions in the tACS group at T1 after FDR correction (all q=0.033), whereas no regional difference remained significant at T2. Conclusion Hi-tACS improved global cognition and working memory in patients with PSCI and was generally well tolerated. Exploratory fNIRS findings suggested possible accompanying changes in cortical activation and network organization but did not establish a neurophysiological mechanism. Importantly, as a broad-network stimulation approach, Hi-tACS may reduce reliance on selecting a single precise target, a potential practical advantage in heterogeneous PSCI.

relevance.reason: 该试验研究高强度经颅交流电刺激对卒中后认知障碍患者认知功能及fNIRS皮层激活的影响，属于脑疾病认知机制与神经调控研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该三盲随机假对照试验评估高强度经颅交流电刺激（Hi-tACS）对卒中后认知障碍患者认知功能的作用，以MoCA评分变化为主要结局，并辅以数字广度和fNIRS探索性指标。结果显示，接受活性刺激的患者在治疗结束时及4周随访时的MoCA应答率均高于假刺激组，前向和后向数字广度改善也更明显，意向性分析与符合方案分析结果一致。探索性fNIRS分析提示治疗结束时前额叶多个区域氧合血红蛋白升高，但随访时该差异不再显著，作者据此强调这些神经生理发现仅为探索性，未确立机制。总体而言，Hi-tACS改善了整体认知和工作记忆且耐受性尚可，其作为广网络刺激方式可能减少对单一精准靶点的依赖，但临床应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: A Sensorimotor-Interoceptive Model for Sensory Phenomena in Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder: Neural and Computational Mechanisms.
papers.authors: Zhang G, Han H, Cheng J, Luo Q, Stern ER, Wang Z.
papers.abstract: Classical models of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) grounded in cognitive-affective processes do not fully account for sensory phenomena (SP), including bodily discomfort, incompleteness, and not-just-right experiences that often precede or accompany compulsive behavior. To address this gap, we propose a sensorimotor-interoceptive model for the sources, generation, and maintenance of SP and SP-driven compulsions in OCD. Specifically, the posterior insula may integrate external sensory signals with internal bodily signals within the perceptual module. These integrated signals are subsequently processed by the salience module centered on the anterior insula and anterior cingulate cortex, where heightened error monitoring may assign excessive salience to integrated signals and recruit the supplementary motor area and primary motor cortex to initiate corrective actions. Dysfunction of a cerebellum-centered forward system may then produce persistent mismatches between predicted and actual action outcomes, which are re-entered into the perceptual module and sustain a recurrent feedback loop. The framework therefore conceptualizes SP-driven compulsions as maladaptive attempts to resolve persistent sensory errors. Predictive coding and active inference provide a computational account of these processes. We underscore that this sensorimotor-interoceptive model, intended to complement existing models, provides an account of symptoms in which SP are prominent and may therefore contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of OCD.

relevance.reason: 提出强迫症感觉现象的脑岛-运动-内感受神经计算模型，涉及脑机制与精神疾病认知加工。

papers.summary_zh: 针对经典认知—情感模型难以解释强迫症中躯体不适、不完整感和“不太对劲”等感觉现象的问题，作者提出一个感觉运动—内感受模型，用以说明这类感觉及其驱动的强迫行为的来源、产生和维持。模型认为，后岛叶在知觉模块中整合外部感觉与体内信号，前岛叶和前扣带皮层为主的显著性模块对这些整合信号过度赋权并启动纠正动作，而小脑为中心的前向系统功能障碍则造成预测与实际行动结果持续不匹配，并回馈至知觉模块形成循环。作者据此将感觉驱动的强迫行为理解为试图消解持续感觉误差的适应不良尝试，并用预测编码和主动推断提供计算解释。该模型定位为对现有模型的补充，而非替代。

papers.title: Histological morphometric correlates of MRI-defined cortical thinning in temporal lobe epilepsy
papers.authors: Bartkiewicz J, Xiao F, Lim YM, Ryniejska M, El Hachami H, Mrzyglod A, Liu J, Miserocchi A, McEnvoy AW, Duncan JS, Koepp M, Thom M.
papers.abstract: Large-scale MRI studies have consistently demonstrated progressive and age-accelerated neocortical thinning in temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE). These findings are frequently interpreted as evidence of cumulative neurodegeneration. However, the histopathological substrates underlying MRI-confirmed cortical thinning in epilepsy remain poorly defined. In particular, it is unknown whether cortical thinning reflects irreversible neuronal loss or potentially reversible epilepsy-related network alterations in cortical microstructure. We analysed the resected middle temporal gyrus from 117 individuals undergoing surgery for temporal lobe epilepsy, including cases with (n= 74) or without hippocampal sclerosis (HS) and 12 cases with additional temporal lobe sclerosis (TLS, or Focal Cortical Dysplasia IIIa), defined by a distinct pattern of cytoarchitectural reorganisation and gliosis involving superficial layers. All cases were stratified by the presence or absence of pre-operative MRI-defined cortical thinning of the middle temporal gyrus, quantified using CAT12 relative to healthy controls. On NeuN-immuno-labelled sections using automated image analysis we assessed neuronal spatial distributions relative to their size and packing density; relative cortical layer thickness and sulcal-gyral cytoarchitectural variation were also quantified. MRI-defined cortical thinning was not associated with diffuse neuronal loss. Instead, thinning correlated with increased neuronal density and altered cell-size spatial organisation in superficial and deep layers, particularly in right temporal lobe epilepsy cases with HS. There was limited evidence of layer-specific laminar thinning, being confined to layer VI in the right TLE/HS group only. Of note, TLS cases did not show either cortical thinning on MRI or laminar thinning on histology compared to cases without TLS but altered neuronal densities and composition that was not confined to the superficial cortex. MRI cortical thinning was also characterised by attenuation of normal sulcal/gyral cytoarchitectural variations suggesting disruption of cortical architectural gradients. In contrast, cases with HS but without MRI cortical thinning demonstrated loss of the expected inter-hemispheric cytoarchitectural asymmetry, indicating a distinct pathological process dissociated from thinning. Clinical-pathological correlations were lateralised, including age of onset, further supporting distinct mechanisms contributing to MRI cortical thinning between left and right TLE. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that MRI-defined cortical thinning in epilepsy reflects progressive neuronal degeneration. Rather than laminar neuronal loss and atrophy, thinning was associated with altered neuronal packing and cell-size distributions between layers. This points towards altered neuropil volumes, including myelin content and dendritic remodelling, in turn suggesting potentially reversible dynamic seizure- or network-related processes.

relevance.reason: 以颞叶癫痫患者切除组织结合术前MRI皮层变薄，探讨脑结构影像改变的细胞构筑基础，属脑疾病与结构-功能关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究要回答的问题是：癫痫中MRI所见的皮层变薄究竟对应不可逆的神经元丢失，还是可能与可逆的微结构改变有关。作者对接受手术的颞叶癫痫患者切除的中颞回组织做组织学定量，并按术前MRI是否显示该区域变薄分组比较。结果显示，MRI变薄并未伴随弥漫性神经元丢失，而是与神经元密度升高、浅层和深层细胞大小空间组织改变相关，且仅在部分右侧伴海马硬化病例中见到局限于第VI层的层厚变薄；变薄还伴随正常沟回细胞构筑梯度的减弱。作者据此认为，MRI皮层变薄未必反映进行性神经元变性，更可能涉及神经毡体积、髓鞘和树突重塑等改变，提示其中包含潜在的动态、可逆过程。

papers.title: Cellular and mitochondrial correlates of regional glucose metabolism in the human cortex
papers.authors: Murgaš M, Habernig S, Milz C, Graf S, Reed MB, Eggerstorfer B, Falb P, Schmidt C, Briem E, Schlosser G, Mayerweg A, Al Barede K, Pörnbacher I, Nics L, Rasul S, Hacker M, Rujescu D, Hahn A, Lanzenberger R.
papers.abstract: Regional differences in human brain glucose metabolism reflect local energy demands, but their cellular and mitochondrial determinants remain unclear. We combined [18F]FDG positron emission tomography in healthy human participants with estimates of cellular composition and mitochondrial density to unravel (sub)cellular correlates of heterogeneity in brain glucose metabolism. By correcting for RNA content and differential gene expression due to postmortem sampling, we addressed methodological shortcomings in multimodal neuroimaging integration. We introduce transcriptionally derived cytoarchitectonic maps of the human cortex that are consistent with histological findings, providing a biologically grounded framework for relating in vivo neuroimaging signals. Accordingly, mitochondrial distribution showed strong association with the intrinsic energy requirements at resting state. In contrast, relations between metabolism and neuronal composition were driven by sensory input and mitochondria-sparse thin-axon neurons, suggesting that stimulation-induced energy demand is met rather by neuronal processes that are independent of mitochondrial abundance to maintain efficient information processing.
