papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑皮层葡萄糖代谢区域差异的细胞与线粒体基础，将健康参与者的[18F]FDG正电子发射断层扫描与细胞组成和线粒体密度的估计相结合，并校正RNA含量及死后采样导致的基因表达差异。作者据此构建了与组织学发现一致的皮层细胞构筑图谱，发现线粒体分布与静息状态下的内在能量需求密切相关；而代谢与神经元组成的关系则受感觉输入和线粒体稀疏的薄轴突神经元驱动，提示刺激诱发的能量需求可能更多由不依赖线粒体丰度的神经元过程来满足，以维持高效的信息处理。这些结果强调了细胞和线粒体特征在解释脑代谢异质性中的作用。

papers.title: Brain synchrony between interacting sibling pairs during real-time cooperation: an fMRI hyperscanning study
papers.authors: Hernandez-Pena L, Taebi A, Koch J, Mathiak K, Wagels L.
papers.abstract: Siblings typically represent the longest-lasting social relationships. Second-person neuroscience provides a framework for studying the neural mechanisms of real-time, reciprocal social interactions. Yet, most studies have focused on simplified coordination tasks, limited brain regions, and did not investigate neural dynamics between siblings. In the first study investigating brain synchrony between siblings to date, we used fMRI hyperscanning to simultaneously record brain activity in 50 same-sex healthy young adult sibling pairs while they played a complex collaborative problem-solving Tetris game requiring continuous non-verbal complementary coordination. Brain synchrony was quantified using inter-subject correlation across 36 regions of interest (ROIs) of the social brain atlas. The interacting sibling pairs showed significantly higher brain synchrony than randomly permuted non-sibling pairs in 19 ROIs (FDR-corrected p < .05). These regions were primarily located within the higher-level theory of mind subnetwork (including bilateral temporo-parietal junction, precuneus and dorsomedial prefrontal cortex), and intermediate-level subnetwork (including anterior insula, inferior frontal gyrus). Greater synchrony in the left temporo-parietal junction significantly predicted better cooperative performance, suggesting that shared neural modelling of a partner's intentions supports effective collaboration. Synchrony in frontal and temporal regions was weakly modulated by cooperative and competitive sibling relationship characteristics; however, these effects did not survive correction for multiple comparisons and should be interpreted cautiously (uncorr. p < .05). This study provides first evidence that real-time cooperation between siblings is supported by inter-brain synchrony in core social brain networks. We highlight the value of ecologically valid hyperscanning approaches for investigating neural mechanisms of cooperation in long-term relationships, advancing the field of relational neuroscience.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用fMRI超扫描同步记录健康年轻成年同性兄弟姐妹配对在实时合作俄罗斯方块任务中的脑活动，考察其脑间同步是否高于随机重排的非兄弟姐妹配对。结果显示，兄弟姐妹配对在多个社会脑网络区域表现出更高的脑间同步，主要涉及心理理论相关的高层级子网络和中间层子网络；左侧颞顶联合区的同步还能预测更好的合作表现，提示对伙伴意图的共同神经建模有助于有效协作。兄弟姐妹关系特征对额颞区同步的调节较弱且未通过多重比较校正，需谨慎解读。研究据此提出，实时合作可由核心社会脑网络的脑间同步支持。

papers.title: Resting-state functional brain changes in temporal lobe epilepsy with comorbid depression: A meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Fu J, Zhou X, Wei L, Kong Z, Cai L.
papers.abstract: Objective To compare the differences in functional brain activity between patients with temporal lobe epilepsy comorbid with depressive disorder (TLE-D) and those with temporal lobe epilepsy without depressive disorder (TLE-ND) via a meta‑analysis of resting‑state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) studies, and to explore the functional brain activity features associated with depressive symptoms. Methods Systematic searches were conducted in PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), and Wanfang Data from database inception to September 2026 to identify cross-sectional studies comparing rs-fMRI-derived differences in functional brain activity between patients with temporal lobe epilepsy comorbid with depressive disorder (TLE-D) and those without depressive disorder (TLE-ND). Eligible rs-fMRI metrics included regional brain activity indices and functional connectivity indices. A meta-analysis of studies reporting regional brain activity indices was performed using anisotropic effect-size signed differential mapping (AES-SDM). Due to their limited number, studies reporting functional connectivity indices were only described narratively. Study selection and data extraction were then completed, and a voxel-based meta-analysis of the included studies was performed with AES-SDM. Results A total of six studies yielding nine datasets met the inclusion criteria, involving 100 patients with TLE-D and 108 patients with TLE-ND. Meta-analysis showed that, compared with the TLE-ND group, the TLE-D group had significantly increased spontaneous brain activity in the right precuneus, right angular gyrus, right superior frontal gyrus, left middle frontal gyrus, and left cerebellum (analyzed via AES-SDM with an initial exploratory threshold of uncorrected voxel-level P < 0.005 and cluster size ≥10 voxels, and validated by leave-one-out sensitivity analysis). No brain regions with significantly decreased spontaneous brain activity were detected. Conclusion These exploratory findings suggest that, compared with patients with TLE-ND, patients with TLE-D show distinct patterns of functional brain activity in multiple key nodes of the default mode network, including the precuneus and angular gyrus, as well as in prefrontal-related regions. These differences may provide preliminary neuroimaging evidence for understanding the neural mechanisms underlying depressive symptoms associated with temporal lobe epilepsy.

papers.title: Global synchrony moderates sad mood and is associated with emotional Stroop interference and somatic symptoms.
papers.authors: Mabel-Kenzie STST, Wong NML, Lee TMC.
papers.abstract: Mood-congruent attention in depression has been studied via emotional interference tasks, including tasks comparing responses to sad and happy stimuli. Mood induction offers a way to experimentally induce sad mood in non-clinical samples and examine its association with subsequent emotional interference, including Sad-Happy interference. Previous studies have separately linked resting-state global neural dynamics (synchrony, metastability) to depressive symptoms and attentional processing. However, whether individual differences in baseline global synchrony and metastability relate to how individuals respond to sad mood remains largely unclear. This study therefore examined the relationship between neural dynamics, sadder mood after induction, and Sad-Happy interference. Depressive symptoms also encompass somatic domains alongside cognitive-affective domains, though these are rarely distinguished in neuroimaging studies. We further examined whether baseline neural dynamics and their association with sadder mood and Sad-Happy interference were related to depressive symptoms (total, cognitive-affective, and somatic). Forty-eight non-clinical individuals completed resting-state neuroimaging, mood induction (sad or non-sad), and an emotional Stroop task. We found in a cross-sectional moderated mediation model that sadder mood after induction was associated with greater interference from sad compared to happy stimuli at medium and high levels of global synchrony, particularly in exploratory path models that included somatic symptoms. Findings suggest that individual differences in resting-state global synchrony may be a neural correlate of sadder mood after induction and Sad-Happy interference in non-clinical individuals. This study offers preliminary associations linking neural dynamics, sad mood, emotional interference, and somatic symptoms, providing insights into the role of neural dynamics in emotional and attentional processing.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在非临床个体中考察静息态全局神经动力学（同步性与亚稳态）与悲伤情绪诱导后情绪干扰之间的关系，并进一步区分抑郁症状的认知情感与躯体维度。48名参与者完成静息态成像、情绪诱导和情绪Stroop任务；横断面有调节的中介模型显示，在全局同步性中高水平下，诱导后更悲伤的情绪与对悲伤刺激相对高兴刺激的更大干扰相关，这一关联在纳入躯体症状的探索性路径模型中尤为明显。作者据此提出，静息态全局同步性的个体差异可能是非临床人群诱导后悲伤情绪及悲伤-高兴干扰的神经相关物，并初步将神经动力学、悲伤情绪、情绪干扰与躯体症状联系起来；但结果仅为横断面初步关联，不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: The b-Value Dependence for Higher-Degree Spherical Harmonic Powers of the Diffusion MRI Signal Follows Stick Model Predictions in White Matter.
papers.authors: Moss HG, Jensen JH, Benitez A.
papers.abstract: Purpose To compare the dependence on b-value of the spherical harmonic powers for the diffusion MRI signal in white matter to theoretical predictions from the stick model of water diffusion within axons. Methods Diffusion MRI data were acquired at 3 T in three healthy adults with 10 b-value shells (b = 1000-10 000 s/mm2 ) and 64 directions per shell. For every b-value, the signal was expanded in spherical harmonics for all even degrees l up to l = 6, and the harmonic power for each degree was calculated. These were compared in selected white matter regions of interest to the theoretical predictions of the stick model, which depend on just two adjustable parameters: the intra-axonal diffusivity and an amplitude factor for each degree. The intra-axonal diffusivity was estimated independently using triple diffusion encoding MRI, leaving the amplitude factor as the sole fitting parameter. Results Close agreement between experiment and theory was found for b ≳ 4000 s/mm2 , the threshold where extra-axonal water signal is expected to be strongly suppressed, for total cerebral white matter as well as separately within the genu, body, and splenium of the corpus callosum. These findings extend prior studies that either considered only the l = 0 harmonic power or treated the intra-axonal diffusivity as a fitting parameter. Conclusion In white matter, the b-value dependence of the diffusion MRI signal's even degree spherical harmonic powers up to l = 6 are relatively well-described by the stick model of axons for b ≳ 4000 s/mm2 .

relevance.reason: 该研究用扩散MRI验证白质轴突内水扩散的stick模型，属于白质微结构与组织建模。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了白质扩散MRI信号中各阶球谐功率随b值的变化与轴突内水扩散“棍状模型”的理论预测是否一致。作者在健康成人中采集多b值扩散MRI数据，将信号展开为球谐函数并计算各偶数阶功率，再与仅含轴突内扩散率和幅度因子两个可调参数的模型预测进行对照。结果显示，在b值较高、细胞外水信号被明显抑制的条件下，全脑白质及胼胝体多个部位的实测结果与理论预测吻合较好；作者据此认为，该模型能在这一b值范围内较好描述白质中直至六阶的偶数阶球谐功率的b值依赖关系。

papers.title: Early-Life Environmental Exposures and Brain Structure in Schizophrenia
papers.authors: Stano A, Quinones JF, Fischer DJ, Weber S, Klock L, Amaya I, Lorenz RC, Kuhn S.
papers.abstract: Background: Schizophrenia is widely considered a neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by premorbid alterations in brain structure. Urban upbringing is a well-established environmental risk factor. However, urbanicity is often operationalised using broad population-based measures, leaving unclear which features of urban environments might affect the developing brain. This gap limits progress in understanding the pathways linking urban upbringing to schizophrenia, an increasingly important question as global urbanisation progresses. Cortical gyrification is especially informative in this context, as it is largely established before birth and remains relatively stable thereafter, offering a promising retrospective marker of early-life neurodevelopmental disturbances. Study Design: In this case-control MRI study, we examined whether residential environmental exposures at birth were associated with adult brain structure in 51 individuals with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder and 88 healthy controls matched for age, sex and socioeconomic status. Birth addresses were linked to geospatial measures of air pollution, green space, built volume, built surface and population density. Study Results: Higher air pollution at birth was associated with lower cortical gyrification in individuals with schizophrenia, but not in healthy controls, particularly in orbitofrontal and inferior frontal regions. No comparable associations were observed for grey matter volume, cortical thickness or surface area. Conclusions: These findings suggest that air pollution at birth may be linked to hypogyria in schizophrenia and provide a potential bridge between epidemiological research on urbanicity and neurodevelopmental models of schizophrenia. In turn, this work provides a critical starting point for future work assessing how early urban environments become biologically embedded in schizophrenia risk.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注城市环境中的具体特征是否与精神分裂症患者成年期脑结构相关，采用病例对照MRI设计，将患者与健康对照者的出生住址与空气污染、绿地、建筑量和人口密度等地理空间指标关联。结果显示，出生时空气污染较高与患者皮层脑回化程度较低相关，尤其在眶额区和额下区，而健康对照中未见这种关联；灰质体积、皮层厚度和表面积则没有类似联系。作者据此提出，出生期空气污染可能与精神分裂症中的脑回化不足有关，为城市生活流行病学发现与神经发育模型之间提供了潜在连接，但强调这只是后续研究的起点，尚不能说明因果或临床意义。

papers.title: Age and sex impact resting-state EEG aperiodic activity beyond symptom associations in persistent post-concussive symptoms
papers.authors: Louras M, D’Archambeau G, Meys M, Martens G, Kaux J, Annen J, Thibaut A, Lejeune N.
papers.abstract: 1. Objective to investigate whether resting-state EEG aperiodic parameters (i.e., offset and exponent) are associated with symptom burden and demographic factors in patients with persistent post-concussive symptoms (PPCS) and differ from healthy controls. Methods In this cross-sectional observational study, resting-state eye-closed high-density EEG was recorded in patients with PPCS and in age-matched healthy controls. Aperiodic parameters were extracted from EEG power spectra. In patients, hierarchical multiple linear regression models included age and sex as a base model, with additional demographic and clinical symptoms entered separately. Patient-control differences were assessed using multiple linear regression adjusted for age and sex. Results Seventy patients with PPCS (54 female; 39.57±12.21 y.; 109.5 [76.5; 196] days post-concussion) recruited from a concussion care pathway and 38 healthy controls (17 female; 39.61±13.57 y.) were included. In patients, younger age and male sex were associated with higher offset and exponent values (all p ≤.014). None of the additional demographic and clinical variables improved model fit beyond age and sex (all p ≥.143). After adjustment for age and sex, neither offset ( p =.898) nor exponent ( p =.100) differed between patients and controls. Conclusion Resting-state aperiodic EEG parameters were consistently associated with age and sex, but not with self-reported symptom burden or clinical characteristics in patients with PPCS. Not accounting for these factors may generate apparent group differences attributable, at least in part, to demographic variability. Significance Age and sex are important sources of inter-individual variability in resting-state aperiodic EEG activity and should be systematically considered when investigating such features. Highlights Age and sex significantly impact resting-state EEG aperiodic activity. Aperiodic EEG parameters were not associated with symptom burden in persistent post-concussive symptoms. Aperiodic offset and exponent did not differ between patients with persistent post-concussive symptoms and healthy controls after adjustment for age and sex.

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面观察研究探讨持续性脑震荡后症状患者的静息态EEG非周期参数是否与症状负担及人口学因素相关，并与健康对照比较。研究从脑震荡诊疗路径招募患者和年龄匹配的健康对照，采集闭眼高密度静息态EEG并提取非周期参数。结果发现，在患者中，较年轻和男性与更高的offset和exponent值相关，而其他人口学和临床变量均未在年龄和性别之外改善模型拟合；校正年龄和性别后，患者的非周期参数与健康对照并无差异。这表明非周期EEG活动主要与年龄和性别相关，而非与患者自报症状负担或临床特征相关，提示若忽略这些人口学因素，可能产生部分由人口学变异造成的表观组间差异。

papers.title: Understanding cognitive function in post-COVID-19 condition with fatigue: an interdisciplinary multimodal investigation
papers.authors: Birberg Thornberg U, Eklund A, Zeiler K, Morberg Jamterud S, Leon F, Ozarslan E, Andersson A, Levi R, Engblom D, Divanoglou A, Blystad I.
papers.abstract: Lingering cognitive symptoms of post-COVID-19 condition (PCC) continue to challenge our understanding, highlighting the need for interdisciplinary research. We investigated whether individuals with PCC and fatigue differ from matched controls across neurocognitive, neuroimaging, and immunological measures, integrating these findings with qualitative phenomenological analyses through multimodal cross-analysis. Individuals with PCC and clinically significant fatigue (n=34), and age-, sex-, and education-matched controls recovered from COVID-19 without PCC (n=37) were included. Assessments encompassed physician evaluation, neuropsychological and functional tests, structural and functional MRI, immunological tests, and qualitative phenomenological analysis of interviews. Data were analyzed using established methods and an interdisciplinary cross-analysis to examine persistent cognitive symptoms in PCC. Group comparisons revealed subtle differences between individuals with PCC and controls, while neurocognitive performance and immunological markers remained within normative ranges. Modest differences in white matter, myelin related, and global brain measures were observed, alongside differences in associations between network connectivity and neurocognitive performance across groups, suggesting reduced network resilience rather than domain specific deficits. This pattern resonated with qualitative phenomenological findings: altered experiences of concentrating and difficulties to execute decisions and actions, despite preserved performance on standard neurocognitive tests. These findings suggest that cognitive symptoms in post-COVID-19 fatigue are associated with subtle neurobiological alterations not captured by standard cognitive assessments. In this highly fatigued sample, converging neuroimaging, neurocognitive and immunological findings point toward reduced network efficiency rather than overt cognitive impairment. Qualitative phenomenological analysis further highlighted altered modes of being in the world characterized by increased cognitive effort and difficulties executing decisions and actions.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注新冠感染后状况（PCC）伴疲劳者的持续认知症状，将患者与新冠康复但无PCC的匹配对照进行比较，整合神经认知、神经影像、免疫学测量与访谈的现象学分析。组间差异总体细微，神经认知表现和免疫指标多在正常范围内，影像上可见白质、髓鞘相关及全脑指标的轻度差异，且网络连接与认知表现之间的关联模式在两组间不同，作者据此倾向于网络韧性下降而非特定认知域缺损。质性分析也提到，尽管标准测验表现保留，受访者仍感到集中注意和执行决定、行动更费力。研究提示这类认知症状可能与常规认知评估捕捉不到的细微神经生物学改变有关，而非明显的认知损害。

papers.title: Post-Learning Reactivation of Memories for Naturalistic Continuous Experiences
papers.authors: Wolf N, Antony JW, Delarazan AI, Reagh ZM, Michelmann S, Ranganath C, Liu XL.
papers.abstract: Memories are not static records of the past; rather, the act of remembering can change how an event is recalled. Intriguingly, several studies also suggest that memories may be reactivated during rest. However, reactivation has largely been studied for spatial tasks and discrete stimuli, and we know little about whether spontaneous reactivation occurs for long timescale naturalistic events and how reactivation affects retention. Using fMRI, we show that neural activity patterns in the hippocampus and the Default Mode Network during encoding of narrative events were spontaneously reactivated during rest. Contrary to predictions, reactivation did not strengthen recall of movie details, and instead exploratory analyses suggested that reactivation in the hippocampus was associated with more gist-like recall one week later. These findings support the idea that memories for complex events may be spontaneously reactivated, but they suggest that rather than simply strengthening episodic memories, reactivation might help transform them.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然连续经历的记忆在休息时是否会被自发重激活，以及这种重激活如何影响后续保持。研究者用fMRI记录被试编码叙事事件时的神经活动，发现海马和默认模式网络的活动模式在休息期间自发重现。与预期相反，重激活并未增强对影片细节的回忆；探索性分析提示，海马重激活与一周后更偏概要式的回忆相关。作者据此认为，复杂事件的记忆确实可能自发重激活，但其作用或许不是简单强化情节记忆，而是促进记忆表征的转化。

papers.title: Longitudinal fMRI reveals altered developmental trajectories of functional network organisation associated with adolescent cannabis use
papers.authors: Davies EJ, Ertl N, Freeman TP, Borissova A, Lees Thorne R, Ofori S, Petrilli K, Mokrysz C, Curran HV, Lawn W, Wall MB.
papers.abstract: Adolescence is a critical period of brain development during which the endocannabinoid system continues to mature. These developmental changes may contribute to age-related differences in the association between cannabis use and large-scale functional network organisation, yet this association remains incompletely characterised. We hypothesised that regular cannabis use would be associated with differential one-year changes in resting-state functional connectivity between adolescents and adults. Resting-state fMRI data at two time points, one year apart, were analysed from 66 participants (31 aged 16-17 years; 35 aged 26-29 years) including 29 with regular cannabis use and 37 age-matched cannabis-naive controls. Seed-to-voxel analyses examined longitudinal changes in functional connectivity across age and cannabis-use groups. Year change, age by user-group interactions were identified in salience and default mode network connectivity, including divergent changes in anticorrelations with medial prefrontal, thalamic, cerebellar and juxtapositional regions. Directionality of effects differed by network and region. Additional main effects of user group were observed for executive control and associative striatal connectivity, with the cannabis-use group showing decreased positive connectivity and reduced anticorrelation, respectively. Changes in functional connectivity were developmentally dissociable and predominantly observed in regions contributing to attentional and transmodal processing. These findings suggest that cannabis may be associated with alterations in the maturational refinement of higher-order neural systems, potentially reflecting age-related differences in neurobiological sensitivity to cannabis exposure. Considering developmental stage may therefore be important for characterising cannabis-related neurobiological differences and may have implications for understanding age-dependent vulnerability to cannabis-related psychiatric outcomes.

papers.title: Altered intersubject variability of functional connectivity in gray and white matter underlying neurocognition and genetic profiles in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder.
papers.authors: Huang C, Lu W, Liu J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder is an autoimmune disease that causes inflammatory damage to the central nervous system. While alterations in functional connectivity have been reported in neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, changes in intersubject variability of functional connectivity within gray matter and white matter are not yet understood. A total of 66 patients with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder and 71 healthy controls were recruited. We compared intersubject variability of functional connectivity between patients with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder and healthy controls and performed subgroup analyses comparing neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder patients with and without a history of optic neuritis. We also examined the associations between intersubject variability of functional connectivity alterations and disease duration, clinical disability, and cognitive scores. We combined our imaging results with those of the Allen Human Brain Atlas to conduct transcriptome-neuroimaging association analyses, identified gene expression profiles linked to intersubject variability of functional connectivity alterations and characterized their potential biological functions. Compared with healthy controls, patients with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder showed widespread increases in intersubject variability of functional connectivity. Notable gray matter alterations included the precentral and postcentral gyri; extensive occipital areas; and the insula, putamen, and thalamus. The corresponding white matter changes involved the fornix, corticospinal tract, widespread corona radiata, cingulum, and uncinate fasciculus. Compared with patients without optic neuritis, the optic neuritis subgroup exhibited distinct intersubject variability of functional connectivity alterations in specific regions, such as the inferior parietal lobule, angular gyrus, thalamus, fornix, and internal capsule. Clinically, only white matter-intersubject variability of functional connectivity correlated significantly with physical disability and cognitive processing speed and was not significantly associated with disease duration. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that genes positively associated with white matter-intersubject variability of functional connectivity were enriched in synaptic plasticity and cognition, while negatively associated genes were enriched in oxidative stress. Additionally, genes positively associated with the gray matter-intersubject variability of functional connectivity were enriched in myelination and lipid biosynthesis, whereas genes negatively associated with the gray matter-intersubject variability of functional connectivity were involved in synapse organization. In conclusion, our study revealed alterations in gray matter- and white matter-intersubject variability of functional connectivity across neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder and clinical subtypes. We demonstrate that changes in white matter-intersubject variability of functional connectivity correlate with clinical disability and neurocognition. Linking these connectivity patterns with gene expression profiles may provide insights into the underlying pathophysiology of neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder.

papers.title: Mapping Lifespan Functional Connectivity with Vision Transformer and Attention-Guided Trajectory Analysis.
papers.authors: Cho K, Choi J, Park M, Shin NY, Han S.
papers.abstract: Brain aging involves widespread reorganization of functional networks, yet characterizing these changes across the lifespan remains challenging. This study presents an innovative application of a Vision Transformer (ViT) to resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) functional connectivity for age group classification using the Human Connectome Project (HCP) Lifespan datasets. A ViT model was fine-tuned on [Formula: see text] ROI-to-ROI connectivity matrices to perform three binary age group classifications (Young versus Old, Adult versus Aging, Young versus Aging). The model achieved accuracies of 91%, 71%, and 93%, respectively, under five-fold cross-validation. To interpret model decisions, attention weight maps from the final transformer encoder layer were extracted using attention rollout and thresholded with a scree plot analysis, identifying 48 high-salience connections across 28 brain regions. These features were analyzed across the lifespan using generalized additive models (GAM), and k-means clustering of the trajectories revealed three dominant lifespan connectivity patterns: Age-Declining, Mid-Life Peaking, and Age-Increasing. This study demonstrates the viability of the ViT for functional connectome analysis and shows that attention-based interpretability combined with GAM trajectory analysis can enrich insights into age-related changes in brain network connectivity, offering a framework for interpretable brain-age modeling.

papers.title: Pain mechanisms in trigeminal neuralgia: From peripheral pathology to brain network reorganization and neurosurgical implications.
papers.authors: Serhiienko YH, Nekrasova NO, Piatykop VO, Yu Kaliuzhka V.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
papers.abstract: Objectives Trigeminal neuralgia (TN) involves peripheral neurovascular pathology and may also be associated with maladaptive neuroplastic changes in central nervous system networks. This review synthesizes evidence on peripheral and central pain mechanisms, neuroimaging biomarkers, molecular and transcriptomic correlates, and neurosurgical implications, including emerging neuromodulation strategies. Materials and methods This narrative review drew on topic-oriented searches of PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science conducted between June 27 and July 5, 2026, covering literature published through June 2026. Supplementary targeted searches and reference-list screening were used to identify relevant publications. Evidence was synthesized qualitatively. Results Evidence supports a multilevel model of TN involving peripheral pathology and central neuroplastic changes. Neuroimaging studies report structural and functional alterations in sensorimotor, salience, limbic, and default mode networks, alongside disrupted structure-function coupling. Partial restoration of functional connectivity after neurosurgical treatment has been reported, although outcomes vary. Transcriptomic findings link imaging abnormalities to genes involved in ion channel function, synaptic signaling, neuroinflammation, and energy metabolism but remain hypothesis-generating. Transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) may provide short-term analgesic benefit; however, evidence is limited and heterogeneous. Conclusions TN may be understood as a disorder involving interactions between peripheral pathology and central nervous system reorganization. Integrating neuroimaging and molecular evidence may inform future patient stratification and neurosurgical decision-making. Individualized neuromodulation remains investigational and requires further clinical validation.

papers.title: Visual-linguistic cues in manual communication: Neural and behavioral responses to Mouthings in sign-naïve perception.
papers.authors: Krebs J, Wilbur RB, Roehm D, Malaia EA.
papers.abstract: Gesture serves as a foundational modality for conveying event structure, providing critical visual information about transitivity and participant roles. Sign languages integrate manual (hand-based) and non-manual (face, torso, head) articulations to encode complex linguistic information. Among these, mouth movements provide phonological and lexical cues, but their role in sign-naïve individuals remains underexplored. This study investigates how sign-naïve individuals process non-manual markers (mouthings) in unfamiliar signed verbs, to explore how linguistic information is extracted from visual stimuli sharing properties with both gesture and sign language. Using EEG, we examined whether lip-reading functions as a linguistic cue or a general perceptual enhancement in non-signers viewing Austrian Sign Language (ÖGS) and non-ÖGS stimuli. Findings reveal distinct neural signatures for manual signs presented with and without congruent mouthings. An early posterior negativity followed by a late posterior positivity suggests that mouthings facilitate lexical access by providing phonological cues that activate stored lexical representations. Conversely, stimuli without mouthings elicited increased anterior activity, reflecting heightened cognitive control demands. Further, telic verbs, which inherently encode event endpoints, showed earlier and stronger facilitation from congruent mouthings compared to atelic verbs. These findings align with the Event Visibility Hypothesis and reinforce the role of visual cues in linguistic comprehension.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察从未学过手语的个体如何加工不熟悉手语动词中的口动线索，用脑电记录其观看奥地利手语及非手语刺激时的反应。结果显示，手动手势配合一致口动时出现早期后部负波和晚期后部正波，提示口动通过提供语音线索促进词汇通达；缺少口动则引起前部活动增强，反映认知控制需求上升。此外，有界动词比无界动词更早、更强地受益于一致口动，作者据此认为结果支持事件可见性假说，并强调视觉线索在语言理解中的作用。

papers.title: Impact of clinical risk factors on white matter microstructure in preterm-born infants: investigation with diffusion MRI and tractography at term-equivalent age.
papers.authors: Devisscher L, Leprince Y, Biran V, Elbaz N, Ghozland C, Adibpour P, Chiron C, Neumane S, Gonzalez Carpinteiro A, Elmaleh-Bergès M, Hertz-Pannier L, Héneau A, Barbu-Roth M, Alison M, Dubois J.
papers.abstract: Premature birth occurs during a phase of intense brain maturation, making white matter (WM) particularly vulnerable to injury. Beyond major lesions, subtle and widespread microstructural alterations also contribute to later neurodevelopmental impairments. We aimed to characterize the impact of key clinical risk factors on global and tract-specific WM microstructure at term-equivalent age (TEA), using 3T-diffusion-MRI data of 111 infants born before 33 weeks of gestation. We implemented a tractography pipeline adapted for use in infants with heterogeneous brain anatomy, including macroscopic abnormalities and lesions, and extracted diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) metrics in sensorimotor tracts: corticospinal tract (CST), superior thalamic radiation (STR), frontal aslant tract (FAT), forceps minor (FMI) and middle cerebellar peduncle (MCP). Associations with risk factors were assessed accounting for age at MRI or global WM microstructure. Tractography succeeded in most infants despite marked anatomical variability and/or overt lesions. Being a male, small for gestational age (SGA) at birth, encountering sepsis and having severe Kidokoro radiological score for WM were associated with altered global WM metrics. At the tract level, CST and STR showed the strongest susceptibility to SGA, prolonged parenteral nutrition, and Kidokoro score. In contrast, associations after adjustment for global WM microstructure suggested that FAT might be less vulnerable than other tracts to extreme prematurity, SGA and invasive ventilation. Findings were partially replicated in infants without macroscopic abnormalities, supporting the presence of WM dysmaturation even in the absence of visible injury. DTI metrics thus provide tract-specific biomarkers of early WM microstructure in preterm infants, which are sensitive to risk factors and could inform targeted prevention and intervention.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产儿在矫正胎龄足月时，关键临床风险因素如何影响整体及特定白质纤维束的微结构。作者对111名胎龄不足33周的早产儿进行3T扩散MRI和适用于婴儿解剖变异的纤维束成像，提取感觉运动通路的弥散张量指标，并分析其与风险因素的关联。结果显示，男性、出生时小于胎龄、败血症及较重的Kidokoro白质影像评分与整体白质指标改变相关；皮质脊髓束和丘脑上辐射对小于胎龄、长期肠外营养和Kidokoro评分尤为敏感，而额斜束在调整整体白质微结构后似乎较不易受极端早产等因素影响。部分结果在无宏观异常的婴儿中重复，提示即使未见明显损伤也可能存在白质发育异常，这些指标有望作为早期风险分层依据。

papers.title: Large language models poorly capture how word order shapes representations of sentence meaning in the human brain.
papers.authors: Fodor J, Murawski C, Suzuki S.
papers.abstract: Large language models based on the transformer architecture are now capable of producing human-like language. But do they encode and process linguistic meaning in a human-like way? Here, we address this question by analysing 7T fMRI data from 30 participants reading 108 sentences each. These sentences are carefully designed to disentangle sentence structure from word meaning, thereby testing whether transformer representations of sentence meaning resemble those formed by the brain. Using representational similarity analysis, we compared representations from eight transformers and eleven other semantic models to brain activity in language regions of interest. We found that while transformer models match brain representations better than models that completely ignore word order, all transformers poorly match human brain representations of sentences that require sensitivity to structural relations such as semantic roles (who did what to whom). Further, transformers were significantly inferior to models explicitly designed to encode the structural relations between words. Our results provide insight into the nature of sentence representation in the brain, highlighting the critical role of sentence structure. They also cast doubt on the claim that transformers represent sentence meaning similarly to the human brain.

relevance.reason: 用7T fMRI比较Transformer与人脑句子语义表征，直接研究语言结构加工的神经表征。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用7T fMRI考察Transformer类大语言模型表征句子意义的方式是否与人脑相似，通过分离句子结构与词义，比较了多种模型与人脑语言区表征的对应关系。结果显示，Transformer模型虽优于完全忽略词序的模型，但在需要把握语义角色等结构关系时，其与人脑句子表征的匹配普遍较差，且明显不如显式编码词间结构关系的模型。作者据此强调句子结构在人脑句子意义表征中的关键作用，并对Transformer能类人地表征句义这一说法提出质疑。

papers.title: Mapping the topographic organization of the human zona incerta using diffusion MRI.
papers.authors: Haast RAM, Kai J, Taha A, Liu V, Kasa LW, Gilmore G, Guye M, Khan AR, Lau JC.
papers.abstract: The zona incerta (ZI) is a deep brain region originally described by Auguste Forel as an 'immensely confusing area about which nothing can be said'. Despite the elusive nature of this structure, mounting evidence supports the role of the ZI and surrounding regions across a diverse range of brain functions and as a candidate target for neuromodulatory therapies. Using in vivo diffusion magnetic resonance imaging and data-driven connectivity, we identify a topographic organization between the ZI and neocortex. Specifically, our methods identify a rostral-caudal gradient predominantly connecting the frontopolar and ventral prefrontal cortices with the rostral ZI, and the primary sensorimotor cortices with the caudal ZI. Moreover, we demonstrate how clustering and gradient approaches build complementary evidence including facilitating the mapping of a central region of the ZI, connected with the dorsal prefrontal cortex. These results were shown to be replicable across multiple datasets and at the individual subject level, building evidence for the important role of the ZI in mediating frontal lobe-associated tasks, ranging from motor to cognitive to emotional control. Finally, we consider the impact of this topographic organization on the refinement of neuromodulatory targets. These results pave the way for an increasingly detailed understanding of ZI substructures, and considerations for in vivo targeting of the ZI for neuromodulation.

relevance.reason: 用扩散MRI在活体人脑绘制未定带与皮层的拓扑连接组织，属脑结构连接与功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用在体扩散磁共振成像和数据驱动的连接分析，考察人类未定带与大脑皮层之间的拓扑组织方式。结果显示，未定带与皮层连接呈现由前到后的梯度：前部未定带主要与额极和腹侧前额叶皮层相连，后部未定带主要与初级感觉运动皮层相连；聚类与梯度方法还共同刻画出一个与背侧前额叶皮层相连的中央区域。这些结果在多个数据集和个体水平上可重复，提示未定带可能参与从运动到认知、情绪控制的额叶相关功能，并为神经调控靶点的细化提供依据。

papers.title: Pediatric brain charts reveal ADHD biotypes with distinct developmental, molecular, and therapeutic profiles
papers.authors: Bu X, Sun L, Fu Z, Zhao Y, Zheng X, Zhang K, Liang X, Cui Z, Gao J, Gong G, Huang R, Li S, Luo L, Men W, Peng Y, Sun L, Sun X, Wang X, Xia M, Zhao T, Zhu L, Zuo X, Wang Y, Dong Q, Cao Q, Yang L, He Y.
papers.abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) exhibits profound clinical heterogeneity; however, its underlying neurobiological substrates remain unclear. Here, leveraging large – scale structural magnetic resonance imaging data from 12,663 typically developing children and 1,699 children with ADHD across Chinese and United States cohorts, we construct population specific pediatric brain charts via hierarchical Bayesian normative modeling to quantify individual deviations in cortical morphology. Data-driven clustering identifies two robust, cross – ethnically replicable ADHD biotypes: an infra – normal biotype characterized by widespread cortical thinning and a supra – normal biotype marked by cortical thickening. Multivariate analyses reveal distinct brain–behavior architectures: cortical deviations correlate preferentially with symptom severity in the infra–normal biotype but with both symptom severity and cognitive performance in the supranormal biotype. Clinically, the infra–normal biotype demonstrates a superior response to methylphenidate over atomoxetine, whereas the supra–normal biotype responds comparably to both. Transcriptomic analyses identify biotype–specific molecular signatures converging with ADHD genome–wide association study (GWAS) risk loci but exhibiting distinct expression patterns in the brain. These findings classify ADHD heterogeneity into neurobiologically distinct, clinically informed biotypes, providing a mechanistic framework for precision psychiatry in pediatric ADHD.

relevance.reason: 基于儿童ADHD结构MRI皮层形态分型并关联认知与治疗反应，属脑疾病认知机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于中美儿童的结构磁共振数据，用层级贝叶斯规范模型构建儿童脑图谱，量化ADHD个体皮层形态的偏离，并通过数据驱动聚类识别出两种可跨族群复现的ADHD生物型：皮层广泛变薄的低于正常型和皮层增厚的高于正常型。多变量分析显示，两种生物型的行为关联不同，低于正常型的皮层偏离主要与症状严重程度相关，高于正常型则同时与症状和认知表现相关；临床上低于正常型对哌甲酯的反应优于托莫西汀，高于正常型对两者反应相近。转录组分析还发现各生物型特异的分子特征，与ADHD全基因组关联风险位点有交集但表达模式不同，作者据此提出将ADHD异质性划分为神经生物学和临床上有区别的生物型，为精准精神病学提供机制框架。

papers.title: The Concise Language Paradigm in left and right hemisphere stroke: a longitudinal source-localized EEG study
papers.authors: Roos NM, Oostenveld R, Piastra MC, Tuladhar AM, Ruiter MB, Kessels RP, Westner BU, Piai V.
papers.abstract: Language recovery after stroke can be supported by neuroplasticity, but its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Most previous studies have either focused on language comprehension or production and/or relied on hemodynamic measures, with limited complementary electrophysiological evidence. Here, we combined a paradigm assessing comprehension and production with individualized electroencephalography (EEG) source reconstruction to investigate post-stroke language function and changes in hemispheric dominance over time. We tested 31 participants: 13 stroke-free controls, 8 individuals with left hemisphere (LH), and 10 with right hemisphere (RH) stroke in the middle cerebral artery territory. Participants with stroke were assessed approximately two and seven months post-stroke. We employed the Concise Language Paradigm (CLaP), which combines auditory sentence comprehension with picture naming, in addition to standardized neuropsychological tests. EEG data were analyzed using event-related potentials and time-frequency representations, followed by source reconstruction based on individual MRI-derived forward models. Laterality indices were calculated to assess changes in hemispheric dominance between sessions. Behaviorally, the LH group showed low performance at two months followed by overall improvement, whereas the RH group mainly improved in visuospatial memory and functional communication. EEG activity was significantly modulated by task condition across comprehension and production contrasts. Source-level results in controls were consistent with established language-related networks, serving as regions of interest for the stroke analyses. In the stroke groups, hemispheric dominance differed between LH and RH stroke participants. Notably, several LH participants shifted from left-to right-hemisphere dominance between sessions, whereas those initially showing right-hemisphere dominance remained stable. Our study provides evidence on comprehension and production performance after stroke using a single paradigm. These findings demonstrate dynamic changes in hemispheric dominance during post-stroke recovery, ultimately highlighting the value of individualized EEG source reconstruction to investigate post-stroke plasticity.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注卒中后语言功能恢复及大脑半球优势随时间的变化，将同时评估语言理解与产生的简明语言范式与个体化脑电源定位EEG结合，比较左、右半球卒中患者与无卒中对照在任务中的表现。行为上，左半球卒中组初期表现较差但随后整体改善，右半球卒中组主要在视空间记忆和功能性交流上改善；EEG活动随理解和产生任务条件而显著变化，对照者的源水平结果与已知语言网络相符。卒中组中，左、右半球卒中的半球优势存在差异，部分左半球卒中者两次评估间由左半球优势转向右半球优势，而最初呈右半球优势者保持稳定。作者据此指出，卒中后恢复期半球优势呈动态变化，并强调个体化EEG源重建对研究卒中后可塑性的价值。

papers.title: Unstable word form representations and greater reliance on right hemisphere during word learning in adults with a history of developmental language disorder
papers.authors: Nora A, Yan C, Husa V, Wilkki V, van Vliet M, Service E, Salmelin R.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Impairment in acquiring new vocabulary is a persistent deficit in developmental language disorder (DLD), but its cortical substrates remain unclear. We investigated learning of new words in young adults with DLD and typically developing (TD) control participants using magnetoencephalography (MEG). Participants were exposed to spoken real words and two sets of pseudowords, with shared beginnings, in two MEG sessions. One set of pseudowords was actively trained for three days, paired with fantasy animal pictures. Both groups learned new pseudowords, but adults with DLD recalled fewer items and confused similar sounding pseudowords more often than TD adults. MEG recordings revealed robust left temporal learning effects in both groups, along with left inferior frontal involvement. The DLD group additionally showed stronger right-hemispheric involvement and a significant right temporal learning effect for the newly learned words. Furthermore, only the DLD group showed changes in the left and right temporal responses for the real words after the learning phase, indicating altered lexical access for familiar words after integration of new word forms with overlapping phonology into the mental lexicon. Together, the findings suggest persisting problems in creating and accessing stable and distinctive phonological memory representations for word forms in adults with DLD, along with altered hemispheric balance in processing.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究发展性语言障碍成人新词学习的脑半球加工与词汇表征机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注发育性语言障碍（DLD）成人学习新词时的大脑活动基础，用脑磁图记录了DLD成人与典型发育对照者在学习真词和两组语音相近假词时的反应，其中一组假词经过三天配对图片的训练。两组都能学会新假词，但DLD成人回忆出的词更少，也更容易混淆发音相近的假词；两组均出现左颞叶学习效应并涉及左额下区，DLD组还表现出更强的右半球参与和显著的右颞叶学习效应。此外，只有DLD组在学习后对真词的左右颞叶反应发生变化，提示新词整合进心理词库后影响了熟悉词的词汇提取。作者据此认为，DLD成人可能在建立和提取稳定、可区分的词形语音记忆表征方面存在持续困难，同时半球加工平衡也有所改变。

papers.title: Functional and Structural Neuroanatomic Correlates of Intraoperative Anesthetic Dose-Adjusted EEG Alpha Power Among Older Surgical Patients
papers.authors: Reekes T, Browndyke JN, Reese Smith M, Weiss Y, Yu J, Cooter Wright M, Kang HJ, Timko NJ, Boykin P, Hsia B, Devinney MJ, Berger M.
papers.abstract: Background: Alterations in intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) alpha power and anesthetic dose-adjusted EEG alpha power (ADA-FP alpha power) have been associated with both preoperative cognitive impairment and postoperative delirium (POD) among older surgical patients, yet the neurologic underpinnings of alterations in these anesthetic brain response patterns are unknown. Methods: We conducted a single center prospective observational cohort study (ALADDIN), of older adults undergoing non-cardiac/non-cranial surgery, which included preoperative structural and resting state functional MRI, lumbar punctures to obtain CSF, 32 channel intraoperative EEG recordings, and repeated POD assessments. To account for anesthetic dose, frontoparietal EEG alpha power (ADA-FP alpha power) was adjusted using our established formula: [intraoperative alpha power]/(2.5 - end-tidal MAC fraction). Multivoxel pattern analysis (MVPA) with follow-up seed-to-voxel analyses identified functional connectivity patterns associated with intraoperative ADA-FP alpha power. Voxel-wise regression analysis with threshold free cluster estimation (TFCE) correction was used to evaluate associations between cortical thickness and ADA-FP alpha power. CSF biomarker values were obtained from NULISA proximity extension assays. Delirium incidence and severity was assessed with the 3-Minute Diagnostic Confusion Assessment Method (3D-CAM). Delirium severity area under the curve (AUC) during hospitalization was defined as the sum of all 3D-CAM delirium severity scores within the postoperative hospitalization period (for up to 7 days after surgery). The Confusion Assessment Method for the Intensive Care Unit (CAM-ICU) was used in cases of non-verbal/intubated patients. Results: ALADDIN enrolled 215 patients, of whom 168 underwent surgery and had high-quality intraoperative EEG data (44.6% female; mean age 70.9 years). MVPA showed that ADA-FP alpha power was associated with altered functional connectivity within the bilateral frontal poles, left superior frontal gyrus and the right superior parietal lobule (p-FWE < 0.05). Seed-to-voxel analyses revealed that higher ADA-FP alpha power was associated with increased connectivity between DMN MVPA regions and DMN, DAN and salience/ventral attention and decreased connectivity with visual regions. Conversely, right superior parietal lobule connectivity shifted towards greater DMN segregation and increased somatosensory/motor coupling (p-FWE < 0.05). Lower ADA-FP alpha power was also associated with lower cortical thickness in left occipitotemporal and superior parietal cortices (TFCE-corrected p < 0.05). ADA-FP alpha power was also lower among participants with (vs those without) postoperative ward/floor delirium (mean difference, 1.33; 95% CI, 0.22 to 2.44; p=0.019), and ADA-FP alpha power was inversely associated with peak delirium severity (spearman's rho = -0.26; 95% CI, -0.40 to -0.11; p <0.001) and delirium severity AUC (spearman's rho = -0.28; 95% CI, -0.42 to -0.13; p < 0.001). Discussion: These findings suggest a functional and structural neuroanatomic basis for the decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power values seen among some older surgical patients, which may explain the association between decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power and increased rates of both preoperative cognitive impairment and postoperative delirium. More specifically, these findings suggest that altered default mode and dorsal attention network connectivity is linked to decreased EEG ADA-FP alpha power and raise the possibility that preoperative/baseline functional connectivity alterations within these networks may play a role in delirium risk.

relevance.reason: 研究老年手术患者术中麻醉脑电alpha功率的皮层厚度与静息功能连接基础，并关联术后谵妄，属脑网络组织与脑疾病认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在老年非心脏、非颅脑手术患者中，考察术中麻醉剂量校正后额顶区脑电α功率（ADA-FP alpha power）与术前脑功能连接、皮层厚度及术后谵妄的关系。多体素模式分析显示，ADA-FP alpha功率与双侧额极、左侧额上回及右侧顶上小叶的功能连接模式相关；种子点分析进一步表明，较高功率对应默认网络与注意、突显网络连接增强而与视觉区连接减弱，较低功率则与左侧枕颞及顶上皮层变薄相关。术后病房谵妄者该功率较低，且功率与谵妄严重程度呈负相关。作者据此提出，默认网络和背侧注意网络的功能连接改变可能与α功率降低及谵妄风险相关，但研究为观察性设计，相关关系不等于因果。

papers.title: The joint modulation of language distance and task demands on the neural mechanisms underlying bilingual lexical processing
papers.authors: Qi Y, Cai W, Li Z, Yang J, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Whether bilinguals share the same neural mechanisms for processing their first language (L1) and second language (L2) is a question of broad interest to researchers. Existing studies have accumulated substantial evidence, yet findings remain divergent. The primary sources of inconsistency lie in the language distance between bilinguals' L1 and L2, as well as differences in experimental tasks. Leveraging the advantages of meta-analysis, the present study examined brain activation patterns during L1 and L2 lexical processing in two groups of bilinguals: Chinese–English bilinguals with distant language distance (logographically–alphabetic) and alphabetic–alphabetic bilinguals with close language distance—across different tasks (phonological and semantic). Results showed that in phonological tasks, Chinese–English bilinguals recruited the left inferior parietal lobule/supramarginal gyrus more for L2, a region implicated in orthography-to-phonology conversion; in contrast, alphabetic bilinguals with close language distance shared overlapping neural mechanisms for L1 and L2. In semantic tasks, Chinese–English bilinguals engaged the left middle frontal gyrus and left precuneus more for L1 to support orthography-to-semantics conversion. In contrast, alphabetic bilinguals recruited the left middle temporal gyrus more for L1 for phonology-to-semantics conversion, and engaged language-control regions including the left middle frontal gyrus/inferior frontal gyrus, insula, and inferior parietal lobule more for L2. Further comparisons of brain activation during language-switching tasks between the two bilingual groups also revealed that alphabetic bilinguals with close language distance required greater involvement of executive control regions. Collectively, these findings indicate that the differential brain activation patterns observed when bilinguals process L1 and L2 arise from differences in underlying cognitive processes, jointly driven by language distance and task demands.

relevance.reason: 元分析比较双语者L1/L2词汇加工的脑激活模式，直接涉及双语语言神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该元分析关注双语者加工母语和第二语言是否共享神经机制，并比较了语言距离较远的中英双语者与语言距离较近的字母语言双语者在语音和语义任务中的脑激活模式。结果显示，在语音任务中，中英双语者加工第二语言时更多招募与形音转换有关的左侧顶下小叶/缘上回，而语言距离近的双语者两种语言出现重叠机制；在语义任务中，中英双语者加工母语时更多依赖支持形义转换的左侧额中回和楔前叶，语言距离近的双语者则表现出不同的语义转换及语言控制区域参与。作者据此认为，双语者加工两种语言时的脑激活差异源于底层认知过程不同，并由语言距离和任务需求共同驱动。

papers.title: Neuroanatomy of Orthorexia Nervosa: Emerging Insights from Structural Neuroimaging
papers.authors: Tinelli E, Maiolo A, Renzo AD, Muscari MA, Tallarico N, Sabatini U, Segura-Garcia C, Tarsitano MG.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective There are no published studies in the contemporary scientific literature that have directly applied neuroimaging techniques (such as fMRI, PET, or structural/functional MRI) to individuals with orthorexia nervosa (ON) to characterize brain alterations specific to this condition. Although interest in ON is increasing, a critical area of investigation concerns its phenomenological overlap with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and other feeding and eating disorders (FED). The present study aims to examine morphological brain differences in individuals with ON using high-resolution 3D T1-weighted MRI, with the goal of determining whether structural profiles observed in ON are comparable to those seen in OCD and in established eating disorder phenotypes. Methods Twenty-seven participants (12 females, 15 males) were enrolled in the study and underwent a comprehensive psychometric assessment including the ORTO-15, Italian-Düsseldorf Orthorexia Scale (I-DOS), Yale-Brown Obsessive Compulsive Scale (Y-BOCS), and the Multidimensional Perfectionism Scale (MPS). Participants were stratified into those exhibiting orthorexic behaviour and those without (healthy control group, HC) according to ORTO-15 scores. The imaging protocol included the acquisition of high-resolution three-dimensional T1-weighted MRI scans. Groups were compared regarding cortical and subcortical parameters in order to identify neuroanatomical differences associated with orthorexic behaviour. Results Morphometric analysis revealed a significant correlation between ORTO-15 score and cortical thickness (CT) in key brain regions. Specifically, lower ORTO-15 scores—indicative of greater orthorexic tendencies—were associated with a marked reduction in CT of the entorhinal cortex (EC). Conversely, an increased CT was observed in the right posterior cingulate cortex (PCC). Discussions The observed alterations in the EC and PCC suggest that ON may share neurobiological patterns with OCD and FED. These findings support the notion of ON as a distinct yet transdiagnostic clinical entity. However, the small sample size highlights the need for further large-scale investigations to confirm the presence and reliability of these potential neurobiological biomarkers.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对目前尚无直接神经影像学证据刻画神经性正食症（ON）脑改变的问题，用高分辨率三维T1加权MRI考察具有正食倾向者的皮层与皮层下形态，并借助心理测量量表评估正食、强迫及完美主义特征。结果显示，正食倾向越强（ORTO-15得分越低），内嗅皮层厚度越低，而右侧后扣带皮层厚度越高。作者据此提出，ON可能与强迫症及进食障碍共享部分神经生物学模式，支持其作为一种独立却跨诊断的临床实体；但样本量小，这些潜在生物标志物仍需更大规模研究确认。

papers.title: Changes in gray matter volume associated with gait speed and muscle mass in older adults with mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Chuang TC, Liang CK, Chou MY, Chan YH, Wang HP, Wang YC, Hsu YH, Lin YT.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMild cognitive impairment (MCI) is an early stage of cognitive decline between normal aging and dementia. Gait speed, a key marker of physical function, has been associated with both cognitive decline and brain atrophy. Sarcopenia, characterized by age-related loss of muscle mass and function, has also been linked to structural brain changes.ObjectiveTo investigate the associations between sarcopenia, its individual components and regional gray matter volume (GMV) in older adults with MCI.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 234 older adults with MCI. Sarcopenia, gait speed, handgrip strength, and appendicular skeletal muscle mass index (ASMI) were assessed according to the 2019 Asian Working Group for Sarcopenia criteria. Brain T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging was analyzed using voxel-based morphometry. Voxel-wise group comparisons were performed to identify GMV differences after adjustment age, sex, comorbidity, depressive symptoms, nutritional status, and total intracranial volume.ResultsSlower gait speed was significantly associated with lower GMV in the bilateral putamen and left superior frontal cortex. Lower ASMI was associated with higher GMV in the left inferior temporal cortex. No significant GMV differences were found by sarcopenia status or handgrip strength.ConclusionsSlower gait speed is associated with reduced GMV in motor-related brain regions, indicating early brain structural changes in older adults with MCI. Although lower ASMI was associated with higher GMV, this finding should be interpreted cautiously. These findings highlight the complex interactions between physical function and brain structure, emphasizing gait speed as a potential indicator of brain health in older adults with MCI.

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察轻度认知障碍老年人的肌肉减少症及其各成分与局部灰质体积的关联，评估了步速、握力和四肢骨骼肌质量指数，并用磁共振成像做基于体素的形态学分析。结果显示，步速较慢与双侧壳核和左侧上额叶皮层灰质体积较低相关；四肢骨骼肌质量指数较低反而与左侧下颞叶皮层灰质体积较高相关，而按肌肉减少症状态或握力分组未见显著灰质体积差异。作者认为，步速慢可能反映轻度认知障碍老年人运动相关脑区的早期结构变化，步速或可作为脑健康的潜在指标；但肌肉质量与灰质体积的反向关联需谨慎解读，相关结果不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: The uncinate fasciculus in frontotemporal dementia subtypes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of diffusion-tensor imaging studies.
papers.authors: Mowafi S, Nassar L, Ezzeldin S, Salama M, Chun S.
papers.abstract: BackgroundFrontotemporal dementia (FTD) is a leading cause of early-onset neurodegeneration with selective frontal and temporal lobe degeneration. Despite well-characterized gray and white matter atrophy patterns across FTD subtypes, the extent of degeneration of the uncinate fasciculus (UF) tract has not been systematically quantified across FTD subtypes.ObjectiveTo compare uncinate fasciculus fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity, radial diffusivity, and axial diffusivity between frontotemporal dementia subtypes and healthy controls.MethodsWe systematically searched PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science and performed a random-effects meta-analysis of diffusion tensor imaging studies published between 2011 and October 2025 according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines.ResultsWe systematically reviewed 11 studies and performed a meta-analysis of 540 participants across 10 studies. We found that all FTD subtypes demonstrated significant degeneration of the UF compared to controls. The greatest effect sizes were observed when comparing the left UF between the semantic variant primary progressive aphasia (svPPA) and controls (FA: SMD = -2.5396, 95% CI: -3.7914, -1.2878, p < 0.0001; RD: SMD = 2.2414, 95% CI:1.7972, 2.6855, p < 0.0001; AD: SMD = 1.9831, 95% CI: 1.1434, 2.8227, p < 0.0001; MD: SMD = 2.5268, 95% CI: 1.9993, 3.0542, p < 0.0001), while the behavioral variant (bvFTD) showed the largest reduction in right UF fractional anisotropy. Within-group analyses revealed significant left-right asymmetry in svPPA and non-fluent aphasia (nfvPPA), with greater left UF involvement, while bvFTD and controls showed no hemispheric differences.ConclusionsWe highlight the UF as a promising tract for understanding disease mechanisms and developing imaging biomarkers in FTD.

relevance.reason: 系统综述与元分析量化额颞叶痴呆亚型钩束白质微结构改变，并报告svPPA/nfvPPA左偏侧化，涉及语言相关白质束与脑疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述与荟萃分析系统检索并汇总了额颞叶痴呆各亚型与健康对照之间钩束弥散张量成像的研究，比较各向异性、平均弥散率、径向和轴向弥散率。结果显示，所有额颞叶痴呆亚型均存在钩束的显著退变；其中语义变异型原发性进行性失语与对照相比，左侧钩束的效应量最大，行为变异型则在右侧钩束各向异性下降上最明显。组内分析还发现语义变异型和非流利变异型存在左右不对称、以左侧受累更重，而行为变异型和对照未见半球差异。作者据此认为钩束是理解额颞叶痴呆疾病机制和开发影像生物标志物的有前景的纤维束。

papers.title: An exploratory synthetic MRI-derived FLAIR-DIR contrast in olfactory-limbic regions in mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Ekanayake A, Hwang S, Peiris S, Elyan R, Mustafa G, Tulchinsky M, Wang J, Eslinger P, Yang Q, Karunanayaka P.
papers.abstract: BackgroundOdor identification impairment is an early feature of Alzheimer's disease and predicts memory decline, but its microstructural basis remains unclear.ObjectiveTo evaluate FD, a semi-quantitative synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-derived Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery (FLAIR)-Double Inversion Recovery (DIR) contrast, against myelin volume fraction (MVF) in olfactory-limbic brain regions of patients diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment (MCI).MethodsSixteen healthy controls (HC) and 17 individuals diagnosed with MCI completed olfactory and cognitive testing and underwent 3T MRI using a QALAS sequence. MVF maps were generated and FD was computed as (FLAIR - DIR)/FLAIR. Group differences were examined in olfactory-limbic gray matter and associated white-matter tracts, and voxel-wise regression assessed FD-odor identification associations, including models adjusted for voxel-wise MVF. Region of interest and voxel-wise analyses were exploratory and largely uncorrected for multiple comparisons.ResultsCompared with HC, MCI showed lower FD across olfactory-limbic gray matter and white-matter pathways, including hippocampus, amygdala, orbitofrontal cortex, thalamus and corpus callosum, whereas MVF differences were more limited. Better odor identification was associated with higher FD in hippocampal/parahippocampal regions and insula, persisting after MVF adjustment. MVF showed positive associations in the right parahippocampal gyrus, left thalamus and genu of the corpus callosum. In an exploratory secondary analysis reported in the Supplemental Material, FD-based classification exceeded chance but was not separable from age alone.ConclusionsFD is a semi-quantitative relaxation-contrast metric showing regional patterns partially distinct from MVF. These exploratory findings require replication in larger, demographically matched, biomarker-confirmed cohorts before FD can be regarded as a marker of early olfactory-limbic microstructural change in MCI.

relevance.reason: 研究MCI患者嗅-边缘系统灰白质微结构（合成MRI对比与髓鞘体积分数）及其与嗅觉识别的关系，属脑结构基础与疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究比较了轻度认知障碍患者与健康对照在嗅-边缘系统灰质及白质通路中的合成MRI衍生FLAIR-DIR对比度（FD），并以髓鞘体积分数（MVF）作参照。结果显示，患者组多个嗅-边缘区域的FD降低，而MVF差异较有限；嗅觉识别表现较好与海马/海马旁及岛叶FD较高相关，且在调整MVF后仍存在。作者指出FD是半定量指标，其区域模式与MVF部分不同，这些未校正的探索性发现尚需在更大、匹配且经生物标志物确认的队列中重复，不能据此将FD视为MCI早期微结构改变的标志物。

papers.title: Temporal lobe cortical thickness and cognition in paediatric cancer survivors previously treated with chemotherapy.
papers.authors: Henry SS, Nandi S, Holtzer R, Rabin M, Gennarini L, Tal A, Lu J, Duong TQ.
papers.abstract: Long-term neurocognitive outcomes in paediatric cancer survivors treated with chemotherapy remain incompletely characterized, particularly in relation to cortical structure. Prior neuroimaging studies have included limited representation of racial and ethnic minority survivors. We analysed temporal lobe cortical thickness and cognition in paediatric cancer survivors treated with chemotherapy (n = 21; 8-25 years post-chemotherapy; aged 15-34 years) and age-matched controls (n = 21). Cognition was assessed using National Institute of Health (NIH) Toolbox scores. Cortical thickness of nine bilateral temporal regions was derived from T1-weighted 3T magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) using FreeSurfer. Group differences and brain-cognition associations were analysed using adjusted regression models with false discovery rate correction. Survivors scored lower on crystallized (p < 0.001), fluid (p = 0.013) and total cognition scores (p = 0.001). They showed reduced temporal lobe cortical thickness (2.62 ± 0.13 vs. 2.74 ± 0.11 mm; p = 0.001), with reductions in seven subregions. Greater thickness was associated with better cognitive performance in 10 of 27 associations, most prominently for crystallized cognition. Fully corrected T-score sensitivity analyses showed crystallized cognition remained lower in survivors (p = 0.044). Paediatric cancer survivors previously treated with chemotherapy showed reduced temporal lobe cortical thickness, which was associated with worse crystallized cognition, suggesting a potential structure-function association.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注接受过化疗的儿童癌症幸存者其颞叶皮层厚度与认知表现的关系，比较了幸存者与年龄匹配对照，并结合磁共振成像测量的颞叶皮层厚度与NIH Toolbox认知评分进行分析。结果显示，幸存者的晶体化、流体及总体认知得分均较低，颞叶皮层整体及多个亚区厚度也减少；在部分脑区与认知的关联中，皮层越厚对应认知表现越好，尤以晶体化认知最为突出。作者据此提出，颞叶皮层变薄可能与幸存者晶体化认知较差存在结构-功能关联，但这一关联尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Action features dominate cortical representation during natural vision.
papers.authors: Jung H, Jain H, Han X, Feilong M, Han J, Shokeen D, Van Uden C, Hanson I, Connolly AC, Wager TD, Haxby JV, Nastase SA.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Cortical resources are allocated into systems specialized for processing ecologically relevant features of the world. These features are typically studied in isolation using controlled experimental stimuli, making it difficult to assess the relative importance of different kinds of features that tend to overlap during natural vision. In the current study, we evaluated the relative contributions of action, agent, and scene features in predicting cortical activity while participants viewed a 1-h nature documentary. We tested four sets of model features: semantic vectors capturing the observed action, agent, and scene features derived from an annotation of the stimulus, as well as low-level visual motion-energy features. We used banded ridge regression to fit vertex-wise encoding models from the combination of all four sets of features. While each set of features predicted neural activity in the expected areas, the action features predicted more widespread activity. A variance partitioning analysis revealed that the action features captured the most unique variance in neural activity across a much larger extent of cortex than the agent or scene features. Our findings suggest that cortical activity during dynamic, natural vision is dominated by features for understanding the actions of others.

relevance.reason: 研究自然观看纪录片时人脑皮层对动作、主体、场景特征的编码表征，属自然刺激下的脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然观看动态影像时，动作、行动者与场景等特征对皮层活动的相对贡献。研究者让被试观看一段自然纪录片，用标注提取动作、行动者和场景的语义特征，并结合低层视觉运动能量特征，以带状岭回归构建逐顶点编码模型。结果显示，各类特征都能预测其预期区域的活动，但动作特征预测的范围更广；方差分解进一步表明，动作特征在更大范围皮层上捕获了最多的独特方差。作者据此认为，动态自然视觉下的皮层活动主要由理解他人动作的特征所主导。

papers.title: Multimodal associations between posterior hippocampus glutamate metabolism, visual cortex connectivity, and intrusive trauma reexperiencing symptoms.
papers.authors: Clancy KJ, Chen X, Song X, Song T, Zhou S, Akman E, Ostrand C, Ren B, Du F, Rosso IM.
papers.abstract: Hippocampal dysfunction is implicated in posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), particularly intrusive reexperiencing symptoms, and may be mediated by glutamatergic excitotoxicity. Markers of glutamate dysfunction (higher glutamate to N-acetyl aspartate levels; Glu/NAA) in the hippocampus (HPC) have been linked to reexperiencing symptoms. However, the HPC demonstrates heterogeneity along its anterior-posterior axis, with different functional connectivity patterns and PTSD symptom associations, motivating investigations into glutamate metabolism in anterior and posterior HPC subregions (a/pHPC). To this end, 121 symptomatic trauma-exposed adults with current trauma reexperiencing symptoms completed magnetic resonance spectroscopy and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging to examine the regional specificity of HPC Glu/NAA associations with reexperiencing symptoms and the link to a/pHPC functional connectivity. PTSD symptoms were assessed with the Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale for DSM-5. Reexperiencing symptom severity was associated with greater Glu/NAA in the pHPC, but not aHPC. pHPC Glu/NAA was further linked to stronger functional connectivity between the pHPC and visual cortex (VC), which in turn correlated with more severe reexperiencing symptoms. This strengthened pHPC-VC connectivity explained the shared variance between pHPC Glu/NAA and reexperiencing severity, suggesting dysregulated glutamate metabolism in the pHPC may contribute to reexperiencing symptoms through functional connectivity with the VC. These findings replicate prior work linking HPC Glu/NAA to trauma reexperiencing symptoms and provide novel evidence of this association in the pHPC, but not aHPC, which is mediated by its functional connectivity with the VC. This multimodal investigation supports translational models of glutamatergic dysfunction in trauma-related disorders and highlights new targets for pharmacological and neuromodulatory interventions.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在有创伤再体验症状的创伤暴露成人中，结合磁共振波谱与静息态功能磁共振成像，考察海马谷氨酸代谢与再体验症状的关联是否沿前后轴存在区域特异性。结果发现，再体验症状严重程度与后海马而非前海马的谷氨酸/NAA水平相关；后海马该指标还与其和视觉皮层更强的功能连接相关，而这种连接又对应更严重的再体验症状，并可解释后海马谷氨酸代谢与症状严重度之间的共享变异。作者据此提出，后海马谷氨酸代谢失调可能通过其与视觉皮层的功能连接参与再体验症状，为创伤相关障碍的谷氨酸假说提供了多模态证据，但这些关联性发现尚不能确立因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Distinct profiles of white matter diffusivity in obesity and bipolar disorders: An ENIGMA bipolar disorders study in 2166 individuals.
papers.authors: Dietze LMF, McWhinney SR, Favre P, Abé C, Alda M, Alexander N, Bauer J, Benedetti F, Berk M, Bøen E, Böhnlein J, Boye B, Brosch K, Butler AD, Canales-Rodríguez EJ, Cannon DM, Carruthers SF, Caruana GF, Corley E, Dannlowski U, Díaz-Zuluaga AM, Elvsåshagen T, Fortea L, Fuentes-Claramonte P, Furlong LS, Goldstein BI, Goltermann J, Grotegerd D, Haarman BCM, Hahn T, Howells FM, Mwangi B, Jahanshad N, Jamalabadi H, Jansen A, Kang MJY, Karuk A, Karantonis JA, Kennedy KG, Kircher TTJ, Klahn AL, Kochunov P, Konowski M, Kraus A, Landén M, Leehr EJ, López-Jaramillo C, MacIntosh BJ, Mackinnon ED, Madero S, Mazza E, McDonald C, McIntosh AM, Meinert S, Melloni EMT, Mitchell PB, Nabulsi L, Nenadić I, Opel N, Ortuño M, Phillips ML, Piguet C, Polosan M, Pomarol-Clotet E, Pouchon A, De Prisco M, Radua J, Roberts G, Romaniuk L, Roos A, Rossell SL, Saccaro LF, Salvador R, Scheffler F, Sim K, Soares JC, Stein DJ, Stein F, Straube B, Suo C, Temmingh HS, Teutenberg L, Thomas-Odenthal F, Thomopoulos SI, Usemann P, Valentí M, Van Rheenen TE, Vieta E, Vilajosana E, Whalley HC, Wu MJ, Zunta-Soares GB, Andreassen OA, Ching CRK, Thompson PM, Houenou J, Hajek T, ENIGMA Bipolar Disorder Working Group, ENIGMA BMI-X Working Group.
papers.abstract: Background Bipolar disorders (BD) are associated with a wide range of brain white matter abnormalities, but results vary across studies. This heterogeneity likely relates to effects of additional clinical/diagnostic variables, including medications and obesity, on white matter in BD. In this mega-analysis, we studied the links between relevant clinical variables and four diffusivity measures. Methods We obtained diffusion tensor imaging-derived fractional anisotropy (FA), mean, axial, and radial diffusivity (MD, AD, RD) values from 910 individuals with BD and 1256 healthy controls across 16 research sites in the ENIGMA-BD Working Group. We used principal component analysis to detect patterns of covariance across white matter tracts and studied associations between multivariate patterns of white matter alterations and demographic and clinical variables, including body mass index (BMI), medications, and diagnostic information, using mixed regression models. Results Higher BMI was associated with lower PC1 FA and higher PC1 RD; BD was associated with higher PC1 MD, while treatment with antiepileptic medications was associated with lower PC1 FA, higher PC1 MD, and PC1 RD. Conclusions We found FA and MD are weakly associated, providing complementary information, and there are unique associations between specific diffusivity measures and clinical predictors. Treatment with antiepileptics may inflate the statistical effects of BD on white matter. By using all diffusivity measures and accounting for additional clinical factors, we can gain new insights into brain correlates of severe mental illness.
