papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ENIGMA双相障碍工作组的多中心扩散张量成像数据，比较双相障碍患者与健康对照者的白质弥散指标，并考察体重指数、药物等临床变量与这些指标的关系。分析显示，较高的体重指数与较低的各向异性及较高的径向弥散相关，双相障碍诊断与较高的平均弥散相关，而抗癫痫药物使用则与较低的各向异性和较高的平均、径向弥散相关。作者指出，各向异性与平均弥散仅呈弱关联、提供互补信息，不同弥散指标与临床预测因素存在各自特异的联系；抗癫痫药物治疗可能放大双相障碍对白质统计效应的影响，提示分析时需纳入全部弥散指标并控制相关临床因素。

papers.title: Decoding individual differences in mental information from human brain responses predicted by deep neural networks.
papers.authors: Kawahata K, Wang J, Blanc A, Maeda N, Nishimoto S, Nishida S.
papers.abstract: Brain decoding using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has high potential for evaluating unobservable mental information that varies across individuals in everyday situations. Although estimating individual differences in mental information using brain decoding could be effective for social applications, especially in neuromarketing, the physical constraints and high costs of fMRI limit the practical application in real-world settings. To overcome these limitations, we propose a framework to estimate individual differences in decodable mental information using brain responses predicted by deep neural networks (DNNs). In this framework, DNN-based models are trained to predict fMRI responses to natural movie scenes. Then, additional fMRI measurements are no longer required because mental information for new movie scenes can be decoded from the predicted responses instead of the measured ones. A large-scale analysis revealed that the proposed predicted-response decoding captures individual difference patterns consistent with those derived from conventional measured-response decoding across various cognitive domains. Of the 88 cognitive labels associated with movie scenes, individual difference patterns could be captured for more than 70% of the labels. This framework offers a promising approach for evaluating personal mental information with substantially reduced reliance on fMRI, thereby expanding the potential for social applications of brain decoding.

relevance.reason: 用DNN预测fMRI对自然电影的反应并解码个体心理信息，涉及人脑自然刺激加工与个体差异。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种框架，用深度神经网络预测的脑活动替代实际fMRI测量，来解码个体心理信息的差异。模型先学习从自然电影场景预测fMRI响应，之后对新场景即可直接从预测响应中解码，无需再采集fMRI数据。大规模分析显示，这种预测响应解码在多种认知维度上得到的个体差异模式与传统实测响应解码基本一致，在电影场景关联的多数认知标签上都能捕捉到个体差异。作者认为，这有望大幅减少对fMRI的依赖，推动脑解码在社会场景中的应用，但结论基于预测响应与实测响应的对照，尚非实际应用验证。

papers.title: Digital twin control framework uncovers individualized cross-scale links between functional connectivity deviations, communication impairment, and molecular mechanisms in autism.
papers.authors: Liu G, Qiu J.
papers.abstract: Background Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is hallmarked by pronounced inter-individual heterogeneity in brain function and clinical manifestations. Conventional neuroimaging studies yield highly inconsistent findings, as extrinsic confounding factors and intrinsic disease heterogeneity mask ASD-specific functional connectivity (FC) signatures, hampering the identification of individualized neural mechanisms linked to symptom severity. Methods We developed a digital twin control analytical framework based on deep contrastive learning. By comparing each ASD participant with their matched digital twin control, we quantified individual-specific FC deviations. Principal component analysis was applied to extract the core aberrant pattern, followed by multi-dimensional analyzes and validation including clinical correlation, transcriptomic decoding, neurotransmitter and mitochondrial co-localization, as well as disease and cognitive enrichment. Results The model effectively disentangled disease‑related from non‑disease‑related variations. The identified dominant aberrant FC pattern was significantly associated with Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS) communication scores, suggesting it is associated with to communication impairment. This pattern showed convergent associations with synaptic pathways, excitatory/inhibitory neuronal signatures, critical developmental windows and subcortical structures, and exhibited negative spatial association with multiple neurotransmitter systems and mitochondrial respiratory complexes. Biological validation further supported its ASD specificity and communication‑related cognitive relevance. Conclusions Leveraging the twin control analytical framework, this study provides an exploratory cross-scale framework linking individualized FC deviations with clinical, transcriptomic, neurochemical, and mitochondrial maps. The findings indicate that communication difficulties in ASD may partly arise from multi-scale disturbances in neural integration, social-perceptual processing and activity-dependent cellular energy regulation.

relevance.reason: 以自闭症患者个体化功能连接偏差关联交流障碍与神经机制，属脑疾病认知机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自闭症谱系障碍患者脑功能与临床表现高度异质、传统影像研究难以稳定识别个体化神经机制的问题，构建了基于深度对比学习的数字孪生对照分析框架，通过将每名自闭症参与者与其匹配的对照比较来量化个体特异的脑功能连接偏差。研究发现，所提取的主导异常功能连接模式与自闭症诊断观察量表（ADOS）的沟通得分显著相关，提示其与沟通障碍相关；该模式还与突触通路、兴奋/抑制神经元特征、关键发育窗口及皮层下结构呈现趋同关联，并与多种神经递质系统和线粒体呼吸复合体呈负向空间关联，生物学验证支持其自闭症特异性及与沟通相关的认知意义。作者据此提出一个探索性的跨尺度框架，将个体化功能连接偏差与临床、转录组、神经化学和线粒体图谱联系起来，并认为自闭症的沟通困难可能部分源于神经整合、社会知觉加工和活动依赖性细胞能量调控的多尺度紊乱。

papers.title: Coarse motor-state structure across paired preoperative fMRI and intraoperative ECoG in patients with brain tumors.
papers.authors: Hu J, Ma J, Guo W, Jiao Y, Yang J, Wang H, Yin Y, He R, Cheng G, Bai H, Zheng H, Liang D, Zhang J, Hu Z.
papers.abstract: Presurgical motor mapping in patients with tumors near eloquent motor cortex is commonly based on task-evoked activation maps, yet local BOLD responses may be difficult to interpret in lesion-affected tissue because of anatomical distortion, altered vascular coupling, and variability in task performance. In this study, we used a four-state motor paradigm spanning Action, kinesthetic motor imagery (IMG), Watch, and recent-action recall (REC) - to test whether coarse task-state relationships are preserved across paired preoperative fMRI and intraoperative ECoG in10 patients with brain tumors. Activation summaries and preoperative task familiarization were used to support task engagement, representational similarity analysis (RSA) was used to characterize within-modality state geometry, and cross-modal RSA was used to assess shared organization. Across modalities, Action and IMG showed relatively similar response patterns, Watch was more distinct, and REC occupied an intermediate position that should be interpreted cautiously because of the fixed task order. Cross-modal RSA showed positive correspondence between fMRI and ECoG representational dissimilarity matrices, supporting a shared coarse state structure rather than fine-grained equivalence between modalities. These findings support a hypothesis-generating, relation-based complementary framework for interpreting functional organization in patients with brain tumors, while the limited state space, clinically determined ECoG coverage, fixed task order, and indirect verification of internally generated states warrant cautious interpretation.

relevance.reason: 在脑肿瘤患者中配对术前fMRI与术中ECoG，比较运动任务状态表征几何及跨模态对应，涉及人脑功能组织与结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑肿瘤邻近运动皮层的患者，比较术前fMRI与术中ECoG能否保留粗略的运动任务状态结构，采用涵盖动作、动觉运动想象、观察和近期动作回忆的四状态范式，并用表征相似性分析刻画模态内状态几何与跨模态对应关系。结果显示，两种模态中动作与运动想象的响应模式较为接近，观察状态相对独特，回忆状态居中，但因任务顺序固定需谨慎解读；跨模态分析支持fMRI与ECoG之间存在共享的粗略状态结构，而非细粒度等价。作者据此提出一种基于关系的互补解释框架，用于理解此类患者的功能组织，同时强调状态空间有限、ECoG覆盖由临床决定、任务顺序固定及内部生成状态验证间接等限制，结论仍属假设生成性质。

papers.title: The Visual Cortex and Beyond: Investigating Long-Term Cortical Plasticity Following Monocular Deprivation.
papers.authors: Wagner F, Grajewki L, Schmidt A, Ulrike T, Ullsperger M, Finke K, Gaser C, Dahnke R, Klingner CM, Brodoehl S.
papers.abstract: Aim To characterise short- and long-term plastic changes in cortical and subcortical structures induced by ultra-long (five-day) monocular deprivation (MD), and to assess the extent and regional specificity of structural changes and their reversibility following the restoration of binocular vision. Methods In this single-arm longitudinal study, 21 healthy adults underwent five structural MRI sessions: at baseline, during MD on days 1, 3 and 5, and after a seven-day recovery period (day 12). MD was induced by occluding the right eye with a translucent eye patch for five consecutive days. Grey matter volume (GMV) changes were analysed using voxel-based morphometry (VBM) for whole-brain effects and generalised estimating equations (GEE) to model temporal trajectories in predefined cortical and subcortical regions. Results Ultra-long MD induced dynamic GMV changes in primary and higher visual cortices, with exploratory changes also in subcortical and cerebellar structures. VBM showed cumulative volume increases in bilateral occipital cortex, including calcarine, lateral occipital and fusiform regions, and adjacent cerebellar lobules, peaking between days 3 and 5. Region-wise modelling resolved the temporal build-up of these changes across visual, subcortical and sensorimotor regions; after correction for multiple comparisons, a time-dependent effect remained in occipital and ventral occipito-temporal cortex (occipital pole, fusiform and calcarine cortex), converging with the voxel-wise result. Following binocular restoration, an exploratory GMV decrease was observed selectively in the left middle occipital gyrus, while an exploratory increase was observed in the left hippocampus, compatible with persistent plasticity in associative memory networks. Conclusion Prolonged sensory imbalance via ultra-long MD induces rapid, region-specific and possibly persistent GMV plasticity in the adult brain. These changes follow temporally stratified trajectories across visual, subcortical and integrative systems, consistent with models of homeostatic and hierarchical plasticity. Corrected evidence supports cumulative occipital plasticity during deprivation; whether the exploratory extra-visual and post-recovery changes reflect persistent adaptation requires confirmation. MD-based paradigms thus offer a controlled window on structural plasticity in both healthy individuals and clinical populations.
keywords: Monocular Deprivation · Sensitive Period · Volume Effect · Plasticity Model

relevance.reason: 研究成人单眼剥夺诱导的视觉皮层及皮层下灰质体积可塑性，属感知学习与脑结构可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察健康成人连续五天单眼遮盖所引发的皮层及皮层下结构可塑性及其在双眼视觉恢复后的变化，采用纵向结构磁共振成像结合基于体素的形态学分析和区域时间轨迹建模。结果显示，长时间单眼遮盖期间，双侧枕叶及邻近小脑区域灰质体积呈累积性增加，并在遮盖中后期达到峰值；经多重比较校正后，枕叶与腹侧枕颞皮层的随时间变化效应仍然成立。恢复双眼视觉后，仅在左侧中枕回和左侧海马观察到探索性体积变化，作者认为这可能提示联合记忆网络存在持续可塑性，但超视觉区及恢复后的变化是否反映持久适应仍需进一步确认。

papers.title: Translational evidence for habenula's role in human addiction: A scoping review.
papers.authors: Parisien C, Abidi NH, Khalaf E, Fortin JS, Pat N, Hétu S.
papers.abstract: Addiction is characterized by persistent substance use or engagement in behaviors despite adverse consequences and impaired control, but its expression varies substantially across individuals, substances, and severity. Within one influential neurocircuitry framework, addiction processes are organized into binge, withdrawal, and preoccupation stages. Preclinical research implicates the habenula across these processes but indicates that its contribution varies across drugs, subdivisions, and experimental models. Research on the human habenula in addiction remains fragmented, and the extent to which it converges with preclinical mechanisms is unclear. This scoping review synthesized evidence on the human habenula in addiction and examined its convergence with preclinical findings. Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, databases and grey literature were searched in November 2025, with literature surveillance continued through April 2026. Human studies reported reduced fronto-habenula white-matter integrity, elevated habenula-striatal resting-state functional connectivity, withdrawal-related habenula-frontal connectivity, increased habenula blood flow during opioid withdrawal, altered task-evoked responses to reward and feedback, and nicotine-related genetic signals. By contrast, morphological studies found no consistent differences in habenula structure across addiction samples. Most human neuroimaging studies could not distinguish the medial and lateral habenula, limiting direct comparison with subdivision-specific preclinical mechanisms. Overall, across human and preclinical studies, the evidence does not support a unitary habenular alteration across addiction. Cross-species convergence was strongest for withdrawal-related activity, particularly for opioids, and for nicotine-related molecular mechanisms, but remained limited by differences in substances, circuits, measures, and paradigms. Future studies using subdivision-sensitive imaging and more comparable cross-species designs are needed.

relevance.reason: 综述综合人类缰核在成瘾中的白质完整性、静息功能连接、任务反应等脑机制证据，属脑疾病机理与结构功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了人类缰核在成瘾中的研究证据，并考察其与临床前发现的吻合程度。人类研究涉及额叶-缰核白质完整性下降、缰核-纹状体静息态功能连接增强、戒断相关的缰核-额叶连接与阿片戒断时缰核血流增加，以及奖赏与反馈相关任务反应改变和尼古丁相关遗传信号；但形态学研究未发现成瘾样本间缰核结构的一致差异，且多数人类神经影像研究无法区分内侧与外侧缰核。作者指出，跨物种证据并不支持成瘾中存在单一的缰核改变，吻合最强的是戒断相关活动（尤其阿片类）和尼古丁相关分子机制，但仍受物质、环路、测量与范式差异限制。

papers.title: Insular subregional dysfunction in panic disorder: A multimodal MRI study.
papers.authors: Li Y, Wang F, Huang Y, Deng M, Wang G, Yang Z, Feng J, Chen H, Zou Z.
papers.abstract: Background The spatial organization of insular abnormalities across connectional-architecture-defined subregions in panic disorder (PD) remains unclear. We examined structural and resting-state functional measures using the Brainnetome Atlas. Methods Forty-nine medication-naïve patients with PD and Fifty healthy controls underwent structural and resting-state MRI. Gray matter volume (GMV), amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF), and regional homogeneity (ReHo) were assessed across six insular subregions. Four prespecified functional connections were examined, together with exploratory Granger causality analysis between dIg and S1 and an AAL3 whole-insula comparison. Results dIg-S1 functional connectivity was reduced in PD (β = -0.148, 95% CI [-0.248, -0.048], pFDR = 0.017). ALFF showed a Group × Subregion interaction (F(5,578) = 4.162, p = 0.001). Only the ventral agranular insula (vIa) showed significantly higher ALFF after false discovery rate (FDR) correction (pFDR = 0.016), with a larger group effect than other subregions. The interaction persisted after temporal signal-to-noise ratio (tSNR) adjustment (F(5,577) = 2.582, p = 0.025), but the vIa-specific effect was nonsignificant in a separate vIa-only tSNR-adjusted model (p = 0.194). ReHo was directionally lower across all six subregions, but no contrast survived FDR correction. No robust subregional GMV differences or significant group differences in exploratory Granger causality were detected. Adjusted AAL3 whole-insula differences were nonsignificant. Conclusions PD showed measure-dependent insular functional alterations, including reduced dIg-S1 coupling and vIa-predominant ALFF differences, with the latter sensitive to signal quality and spatial smoothing.

relevance.reason: 该研究以惊恐障碍患者为对象，用静息态与结构MRI考察岛叶亚区功能异常，属于以脑疾病理解脑网络/表征组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注惊恐障碍患者岛叶各亚区的结构与静息态功能异常如何按连接架构分区分布，采用多模态MRI比较未用药患者与健康对照的岛叶亚区指标。结果显示，患者背侧颗粒岛叶与初级感觉皮层间的功能连接减弱，低频波动幅度存在组别与亚区交互，仅腹侧无颗粒岛叶的幅度升高较突出，但该亚区效应在单独校正信号质量后不再显著；局部一致性和灰质体积未见经校正的稳健差异。作者据此认为，惊恐障碍的岛叶功能改变依赖具体测量指标，且部分结果对信号质量与空间平滑敏感，解释时需谨慎。

papers.title: Infant Negative Affect During Mother-Infant Interaction Is Associated with Neonatal Limbic-Prefrontal Connectivity in the First Month of Life.
papers.authors: Posner J, Michael AM, Fay M, Abraham E, Feldman R, Coelho Milani AC, Silva I, Abdala N, Maria de Araújo C, Fanton MR, Lodi A, Duarte CS, Jackowski A.
papers.journal: Biological psychiatry. Cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging
papers.abstract: Background Early caregiving may shape neonatal limbic circuit organization, yet whether microanalytically coded interaction quality relates to neonatal limbic-prefrontal connectivity is unknown. We tested associations between infant and maternal affect during mother-infant interaction and neonatal limbic-prefrontal cortex (PFC) connectivity. Methods At approximately 30 days postnatal, 143 mother-infant dyads from the Healthy MiNDS cohort (São Paulo, Brazil) completed a video-recorded interaction coded with the Coding Interactive Behavior (CIB) system; infant negative affect was the percentage of interaction time in distress. Neonates underwent resting-state fMRI; limbic-PFC connectivity was quantified by principal component analysis of amygdala and hippocampus seed-to-ROI maps. Covariate-adjusted regressions tested associations. Results Infant negative affect was associated with right amygdala-PFC (β = -0.247, p = .003) and right hippocampus-PFC connectivity (β = -0.202, p = .021), both surviving FDR correction and robust across multiple analytic approaches. The amygdala association was limited to infant distress-related behaviors, whereas maternal positive expressiveness showed an independent, opposing association (β = 0.202, p = .019); no other CIB measure was significant. Exploratorily, connectivity was associated with sleep problems at 18-24 months in females (r = -.324, p = .030). Conclusions The emotional quality of early caregiving is associated with neonatal limbic circuit organization: infant distress is selectively associated with weaker amygdala-PFC connectivity, whereas maternal positive affect shows an independent opposing association. These findings identify the mother-infant relationship as a modifiable input to neonatal brain development.

relevance.reason: 研究新生儿静息态边缘-前额叶功能连接与母婴互动中负性情绪行为的关联，涉及情绪相关脑网络发育与功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察母婴互动中的情绪质量是否与新生儿期边缘系统—前额叶皮层的功能连接相关。研究者在婴儿约一个月大时，对母婴互动录像进行编码，并以静息态fMRI量化杏仁核和海马与前额叶的连接，随后用回归分析检验关联。结果发现，婴儿负面情绪越强，右侧杏仁核—前额叶及右侧海马—前额叶连接越弱；其中杏仁核的关联仅限于婴儿痛苦相关行为，而母亲积极表达则呈现独立的相反关联。作者据此认为，早期照护的情感质量与新生儿边缘回路组织相关，母婴关系可能是可干预的输入；但这是关联性证据，不能推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Positive-affective and negative-cognitive brain-behavior axes in clinical high risk for psychosis.
papers.authors: Vieira S, Aleman Y, Bici L, Meijer J, Penzel N, Jacobs GR, Yassin W, Alameda L, Bastürk Ö, Pries LK, Kiakos D, Armando M, Klauser P, Abrahamyan-Empson L, Conus P, Wannan CMJ, Dwyer D, Cho KIK, Knight SR, Cecchi G, Polosecki P, Allott K, Addington J, Arango C, Breitborde NJK, Broome MR, Cadenhead KS, Calkins ME, Carrión RE, Castillo-Passi RI, Hai Chen EY, Choi J, Cornblatt BA, Diaz-Caneja CM, Ellman LM, Fusar-Poli P, Gaspar PA, Gerber C, Glenthøj LB, Horton LE, Ming Hui CL, Kambeitz J, Kambeitz-Ilankovic L, Keshavan M, Kim M, Kim SW, Koutsouleris N, Kwon JS, Langbein K, Mamah D, Mathalon DH, Mittal VA, Nordentoft M, Pearlson GD, Perez J, Perkins DO, Powers AR, Roalf D, Rogers J, Sabb FW, Schiffman J, Shah JL, Silverstein SM, Smesny S, Stone WS, Strauss GP, Thompson JL, Tod S, Upthegrove R, Verma SK, Wang J, Wolf DH, Wood SJ, Yung AR, Zhang T, Bouix S, Corcoran CM, Kapur T, Pasternak O, Bearden CE, Kahn RS, Kane JM, McGorry PD, Shenton ME, Woods SW, Nelson B, Accelerating Medicines Partnership® Schizophrenia (AMP® SCZ), Marquand A, Hagmann P.
papers.abstract: Background Individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis (CHR) present with heterogeneous combinations of positive, negative, and affective symptoms, cognitive difficulties, and functional impairment. However, reproducible multivariate links between this multidomain phenotype and brain morphology remain limited. This study explored the multivariate brain-behavior associations in CHR using a data-driven approach. Methods Baseline data from 720 CHR participants from the Accelerating Medicines Partnership® Schizophrenia program (AMP® SCZ) were analyzed using sparse canonical correlation analysis to identify associations between 95 regional brain volumes and 28 behavioral variables indexing symptoms, cognition, and functioning. Generalizability was tested using leave-one-network-out cross-validation (PRoNET and PRESCIENT), and stability was assessed using bootstrapping and leave-one-site-out analyses. Associations with demographic, clinical and site-related variables were examined. Results Two brain-behavior dimensions generalized across networks. A positive-affective axis (r=0.21-0.23), linking higher depression, anxiety/stress, positive symptoms and anhedonia with predominantly frontal-cingulate-insular volume reductions and relatively larger corpus callosum and putamen volumes. This axis was associated with comorbid depression, cannabis use and family history of depression or affective psychosis. A negative-cognitive axis (r=0.17-0.18) linked greater asociality, alogia, emotional withdrawal, blunted affect, and motor retardation, poorer cognition and functioning with reduced cerebellar and parietal volumes, and relatively larger lateral ventricles and corpus callosum. This axis was associated with lower IQ and poorer premorbid adjustment. Conclusions Two partially dissociable brain-behavior dimensions were identified: a positive-affective axis capturing the co-expression of affective and attenuated positive symptoms, and a negative-cognitive axis suggestive of neurodevelopmental vulnerability.

relevance.reason: 以精神病临床高危人群为对象，用多变量方法揭示脑区体积与症状/认知/功能的行为-脑维度关联，属脑疾病机理与结构-功能研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神病临床高危（CHR）人群中多维症状、认知与功能表型能否与脑形态建立可重复的多元联系，利用数据驱动方法分析了该人群的基线脑区体积与行为变量。结果识别出两个可跨网络泛化的脑-行为维度：一个正性-情感轴将抑郁、焦虑/压力、阳性症状及快感缺失与以额-扣带-岛叶体积减小为主的模式相联系，并与共病抑郁、大麻使用及情感障碍家族史相关；另一个阴性-认知轴将社交退缩、言语贫乏、情感淡漠、运动迟滞及较差的认知与功能与特定脑体积模式相联系，并与较低智商和较差病前适应相关。作者认为这两个部分可分离的维度分别反映情感与弱化阳性症状的共表达，以及提示神经发育易感性的阴性-认知特征；这些关联为横断面观察，尚不能说明因果或临床预测效用。

papers.title: The Spectrum within the Spectrum: Neural Heterogeneity in Autism.
papers.authors: Bakul F, Krafick KI, Kana RK.
papers.abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) encompasses diverse behavioral, cognitive, and neural profiles that vary widely across individuals. Because diagnosis remains predominantly behavior-based, clinically meaningful within-spectrum differences are often missed. Recent advances in neuroimaging analysis have created opportunities for the identification of distinct neural profiles within ASD. These new avenues provide ways to examine intra-ASD heterogeneity directly, identifying person-specific brain-behavior patterns that group-level comparisons fail to capture. The present systematic review focused on neuroimaging methods (i.e., resting-state fMRI; rs-fMRI, cortical morphology) that emphasized heterogeneity-informed outcomes based on normative modeling, data-driven subtyping, clustering analysis and similar analytic choices. For rs-fMRI, findings showed that differences in connectivity within the default mode and salience networks were linked to social-communication and language impairments, with subtype-specific patterns emerging across samples. In cortical thickness and surface area, studies identified distinct developmental trajectories and individual deviation profiles, with prefrontal and temporal regions often tied to repetitive behaviors and social-communication difficulties. Voxel-based analyses revealed subgroup-specific gray matter alterations, including cerebellar and cortical differences, that aligned with variation in repetitive behaviors and social difficulties. Collectively, this emerging evidence supports the notion that neural heterogeneity in autism is a core feature rather than a limitation. Embracing individual variability can provide crucial insight into the inconsistencies and contradictions of earlier case-control and group-level findings. Moving forward, autism research must prioritize heterogeneity-based methods to establish reproducible subtypes and individualized brain-behavior links.

relevance.reason: 系统综述聚焦自闭症谱系内神经影像异质性，连接脑连接/皮层形态与社会交流、语言及重复行为差异，属脑疾病认知与结构功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦自闭症谱系障碍内部的行为、认知与神经异质性，梳理了静息态功能连接、皮层形态等神经影像研究中采用规范性建模、数据驱动分型与聚类等异质性导向分析的结果。研究发现，默认网络与突显网络内的连接差异同社交沟通和语言障碍相关，并呈现亚型特异模式；皮层厚度与表面积分析揭示出不同的发育轨迹和个体偏离特征，前额叶与颞叶区域常与重复行为和社交沟通困难相联系；基于体素的分析则显示亚组特异的灰质改变，涉及小脑和皮层，并与重复行为和社交困难的变异相吻合。作者据此提出，神经异质性是自闭症的核心特征而非研究局限，重视个体差异有助于理解以往病例对照和组水平研究中的不一致与矛盾，并呼吁未来研究优先采用基于异质性的方法，以建立可重复的亚型及个体化的脑—行为联系。

papers.title: Loneliness relates to smaller hippocampal subfield volumes in individuals with elevated plasma pTau217: results from IGNITE.
papers.authors: Martín-Fuentes I, Inagaki TK, Solis-Urra P, Oberlin LE, Sewell KR, Karikari TK, Zeng X, Kang C, Morris JK, Ripperger HS, Grove GA, Huang H, Sutton BP, Wan L, Vidoni ED, Marsland AL, Hillman CH, McAuley E, Kramer AF, Burns JM, Erickson KI.
papers.abstract: Loneliness is associated with cognitive decline and dementia risk, but the role of Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathology in its associations with medial temporal lobe (MTL) morphology remains unclear. We examined whether loneliness was related to total hippocampal volume, hippocampal subfields, and entorhinal cortex (ERC) volumes, and whether plasma phosphorylated tau 217 (pTau217) moderated these relationships. We analyzed baseline data from cognitively unimpaired older adults aged 65-80 years enrolled in IGNITE. Loneliness was assessed using the revised UCLA Loneliness Scale. Structural 3 T MRI included a high-resolution T2-weighted hippocampal sequence. Hippocampal subfields and ERC volumes were extracted using ASHS, and FreeSurfer estimated total hippocampal volume and intracranial volume. Participants were classified as pTau217-positive or negative using an Aβ-PET-calibrated threshold (> 0.46 pg/mL). Covariate-adjusted linear regression models tested loneliness associations and loneliness×pTau217 interactions. We included 601 participants (69.8 ± 3.7 years; 72.2% female; 76.4% White); 582 had usable pTau217 data, of whom 28.9% were pTau217-positive. pTau217 moderated associations with CA3 (β = - 0.215, 95% CI - 0.381 to - 0.048) and ERC (β = - 0.167, 95% CI - 0.318 to - 0.016), with negative associations observed among pTau217-positive but not pTau217-negative participants. Greater loneliness was associated with smaller total hippocampal volume (β = - 0.077, 95% CI, - 0.147 to - 0.007, p = 0.031), but not with individual subfields. Loneliness showed biomarker-dependent associations with MTL subfields, suggesting that pTau217-defined biological risk may modify links between psychosocial factors and neuroanatomical vulnerability. This biomarker-informed framework may help explain heterogeneity in prior loneliness-neuroimaging findings.Trial registrationClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02875301.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在认知未受损的老年人中，孤独感是否与海马总体积、海马亚区及内嗅皮层体积相关，以及血浆pTau217是否调节这些关系；分析基于IGNITE队列的基线数据，用孤独感量表、结构MRI和协变量调整的线性回归进行。结果显示，孤独感与较小的海马总体积相关，但与各海马亚区无独立关联；pTau217显著调节孤独感与CA3及内嗅皮层体积的关系，这种负向关联仅出现在pTau217阳性者中。作者据此提出，由pTau217标示的生物学风险可能改变心理社会因素与内侧颞叶结构易感性之间的联系，或有助于解释既往孤独感与神经影像结果的不一致，但该发现来自横断面关联，尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: HD-DRUM Rhythmic Training in Huntington's Disease: Feasibility, Motor, and Brain Microstructural Pilot Signals.
papers.authors: Laguna PL, Ioakeimidis V, Drew CJG, Pallmann P, Busse-Morris M, Watson GB, Schubert R, Rosser AE, Metzler-Baddeley C.
papers.abstract: Background Rhythmic cuing may benefit motor functions in Huntington's disease (HD) by compensating for the loss of predictive timing associated with basal ganglia degeneration. To our knowledge no remote rhythmic training application has been developed or evaluated that seeks to improve function in HD. HD-DRUM is a tablet-based rhythmic cuing application for the training of paced movements. Feasibility of 8 weeks at-home HD-DRUM compared with usual-activity control was assessed in a two-arm, pilot randomized controlled trial (RCT) in people with HD. HD-DRUM-related changes in motor and cognitive functions, mood, and brain microstructure were explored. Objectives Primary outcomes were feasibility rates (recruitment, retention, adherence, acceptability) for an effectiveness RCT. Secondary outcomes were estimates of HD-DRUM-related effect sizes on motor functions, cognition, mood, and brain microstructure to explore training mechanisms. Methods Fifty-five individuals with HD were randomized into either HD-DRUM (n = 32, 1 excluded) or control (n = 23) groups. Participants underwent Quantitative-Motor, cognitive and mood assessments and diffusion-weighted MRI at baseline and follow-up. Recruitment, retention, and adherence rates were recorded, and HD-DRUM acceptability was assessed with a self-report questionnaire. Group differences of changes in behavioral and brain microstructural measures were reported with 95% confidence intervals. Results Acceptability of HD-DRUM, retention, and adherence rates averages were high (>80%) and target recruitment was reached. Performance in paced tapping and brain microstructure in motor networks signaled training benefits and were associated with each other. Conclusions HD-DRUM may provide an accessible intervention that can aid maintenance of motor function and brain microstructure in HD.

papers.title: Effects of dance and music training on the plasticity of the core empathy network: intra- and inter-network connectivity.
papers.authors: Liu Y, He H, Li G, Sun P, Deng S, Liu Y, Klugah-Brown B, Yu Y, Duan M, Bringas-Vega ML, Rodríguez-Labrada R, Lu J, Pollick F, Yin L, Heyang T, Yao D, Luo C.
papers.abstract: Background Dance and music are two of the oldest and most universal forms of artistic expression, each requiring extensive training. Prolonged training is known to induce neuroplastic changes and enhance socio-emotional abilities such as empathy. The mirror neuron system (MNS) is associated with empathy; however, few studies systematically explored how dance and music training modulate the core empathy network, including subcortical regions within the limbic MNS. Method Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data were obtained from 25 dancers, 24 musicians and 39 demographically matched control group (both groups are healthy). Core regions within relevant brain networks, along with key subcortical components of limbic MNS, specifically the amygdala and basal ganglia, were defined as regions of interest (ROIs) to build a core empathy network. Graph-theoretical metrics, including within-network degree (WND) and between-network degree (BND), were calculated to evaluate connectivity patterns. These metrics were further correlated with empathy scores. Results Both dancers and musicians exhibited altered connectivity within the core empathy network. Dancers showed increased WND and BND between basal ganglia regions and the ventral attention network, whereas musicians demonstrated enhanced WND between the amygdala and the subcortical network. Notably, both groups exhibited reduced WND between the superior frontal gyrus and the sensorimotor network. The neural changes were correlated with Interpersonal Reactivity Index (IRI) empathy subscale scores, indicating training-related modulations in affective and cognitive empathy. Conclusion Dance and music training induce both distinct and overlapping patterns of neuroplasticity within the core empathy network that are associated with enhanced empathic ability. The findings support the potential of dance and music as systematic intervention programs.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fMRI比较舞蹈/音乐训练者共情核心网络的连接可塑性，属社会认知与脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察舞蹈和音乐训练如何影响核心共情网络的可塑性，比较健康舞者、音乐人与匹配对照者的静息态功能磁共振连接模式。结果显示，两类训练者均出现核心共情网络内部连接改变，但模式各有特点：舞者在基底节与腹侧注意网络间连接增强，音乐人则在杏仁核与皮层下网络间连接增强，同时两组均表现出上额回与感觉运动网络间连接降低。这些神经变化与共情量表得分相关，提示训练相关的情绪与认知共情调制。作者认为，舞蹈和音乐训练可诱发既相异又重叠的共情网络可塑性，支持其作为系统干预的潜力，但相关结果尚不能直接推断训练因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Individual Differences in Sustained Attention Tune Semantic Abstraction in Neural Encoding of Narratives
papers.authors: Gao S, Leong YC, Rosenberg MD.
papers.abstract: Neural encoding modeling for narrative comprehension—using LLM embeddings to predict the temporal dynamics of neural activation—is widely used to evaluate how well the brain represents certain semantic information. This approach, however, typically collapses semantic representation into a scalar fidelity score aggregated across participants, overlooking potentially rich individual differences and qualitative differences in naturalistic neural representations. In the current study, we addressed this gap by investigating how neural semantic encoding varies across individuals with sustained attention, and whether this difference is qualitative in addition to quantitative. Using fMRI data from 49 participants listening to an audiobook, Le Petit Prince , in English, we trained encoding models with GPT-2 embeddings at varying layers and forecasting lengths. Encoding models trained on high-level embeddings (from the 8th layer of GPT-2) showed significant brain-LLM alignment in 73 of 122 cortical and subcortical ROIs, concentrated in the temporal cortex and the default mode network. Functional connectivity strength in a validated connectome-based predictive model of sustained attention correlated with encoding performance in 18 ROIs, most strongly in the insula and in control and attention networks, with no ROI showing significant opposite relationship. Decomposing semantic information by levels of abstraction showed that the neural signature of sustained attention was selectively associated with a greater proportion of high-level gist information encoded in the frontoparietal and attention networks, while the opposite relationship emerged for proportion of low-level information. Sustained attention scores further predicted stronger predictive coding of upcoming narrative content across multiple networks across the whole brain (control, default mode, salience/ventral attention, limbic, and somatomotor networks). These findings suggest that sustained attention does not uniformly amplify neural semantic encoding, but instead shifts neural representations toward more compressed, gist-level formats that support anticipation of upcoming content. Individual differences in brain-LLM alignment can be a signature of representational strategy rather than noise, with potential utility for cognitive phenotyping.

relevance.reason: 研究自然叙事理解中持续注意调节语义抽象水平的fMRI神经编码，涉及语言语义加工与注意的脑网络机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用fMRI数据和GPT-2嵌入构建叙事理解的神经编码模型，考察持续注意的个体差异如何影响语义信息的神经表征。结果发现，持续注意的功能连接强度与多个脑区的编码表现相关，且这种关联并非简单增强编码，而是选择性地与更高比例的高层概要信息编码相联系，低层信息则呈相反关系；持续注意还预测了对后续叙事内容更强的预测性编码。作者据此提出，持续注意使神经语义表征转向更压缩的概要化格式以支持预期，脑与语言模型的对齐差异可能反映表征策略而非噪声。

papers.title: Development of Neonatal Functional Brain Network Organisation and Its Association with Childhood Neurodevelopmental Outcomes
papers.authors: Chang Q, Fenn-Moltu S, Chew A, Bonthrone AF, Gal-Er B, Nosarti C, Arichi T, McAlonan G, Counsell SJ, Batalle D.
papers.abstract: The human brain undergoes rapid dynamic changes in the neonatal period that are essential for later cognitive and behavioural performance. Using resting-state fMRI data from 394 neonates (325 term-born, 69 preterm-born) within the first month after birth, we characterised the early development of functional network organisation, the effects of preterm birth, and the association between neonatal functional organisation and later neurodevelopmental outcomes in infancy (18 months) and childhood (4-6 years). We found increased functional integration and segregation across a wide range of functional sub-networks and increased mean functional connectivity strength (mean FCS) within the subcortical and cerebellar regions with increasing PMA at scan. Compared with term-born neonates, preterm-born neonates showed significantly lower mean FCS, functional integration and segregation globally. We further showed that whilst neonatal functional brain network organisation was not associated with neurodevelopmental outcomes measured during infancy (18 months), it was associated with later neurodevelopmental outcomes in early childhood (4-6 years). Specifically, higher functional integration and segregation at birth were linked with lower SDQ total difficulties score at 4-6 years. Our findings suggest that neonatal functional brain organisation reflects not only transient developmental processes, but also stable individual differences that provide insight into neurodevelopmental outcomes in later childhood.

relevance.reason: 研究新生儿静息态功能网络组织发育及其与儿童期认知行为结局的关联，属脑发育与静息态功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用394名新生儿（325名足月、69名早产）出生后一个月内的静息态fMRI数据，刻画功能性脑网络组织的早期发育，并考察早产的影响及其与18个月婴儿期和4至6岁儿童期神经发育结局的关联。结果显示，随扫描时受孕后年龄增加，多个功能子网络的功能整合与分离增强，皮层下和小脑区域平均功能连接强度升高；相比足月儿，早产儿整体平均功能连接强度及功能整合、分离均显著较低。新生儿脑网络组织与18个月时的神经发育结局无关，但与4至6岁早期儿童期结局相关：出生时功能整合与分离越高，SDQ总困难分越低。作者据此认为新生儿功能脑组织既反映短暂发育过程，也体现与后期神经发育结局相关的稳定个体差异。

papers.title: Faster peak alpha frequency precedes higher menstrual pain in adolescence
papers.authors: Osborne NR, Tu FF, Darnell SE, Kmiecik MJ, Hellman KM.
papers.abstract: Brain differences in chronic pain are almost always measured after years of pain experience, leaving unresolved whether they create vulnerability to pain or result from it. Uniquely, menstrual pain has a developmentally scheduled onset (menarche, the first menstrual period), allowing the brain to be characterized before and after pain exposure occurs. Here we used longitudinal 64-channel EEG to measure resting brain activity in adolescents once before (n=250) and twice after (n=161, n=140) menarche. Before their first period, adolescents who later reported higher menstrual pain (30 or greater on a 0 to 100 VAS) already showed faster occipital peak alpha frequency compared to those who reported lower menstrual pain, a difference that persisted in the early (3 to 14 months) post-menarche time period. In contrast, oscillatory power and functional connectivity did not differ by menstrual pain group, suggesting that the widespread functional brain alterations reported in adults with painful periods take years to emerge. Peak alpha frequency increased, and theta power and connectivity decreased across the menarchal transition, consistent with typical adolescent maturation. However, longitudinal analyses stratified by higher and lower menstrual pain group suggested group specific timings for these neurodevelopmental changes. Overall, these findings suggest that early menstrual pain is not associated with widespread alterations in neural oscillations, but aspects of menstrual pain susceptibility may be reflected in resting peak alpha frequency. To our knowledge, this is the first neurophysiological trait shown to precede the onset of menstrual pain.

relevance.reason: 纵向静息EEG研究显示月经痛易感性在初潮前已与枕区峰α频率相关，涉及自发脑活动与疼痛感知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性疼痛相关脑差异究竟先于疼痛还是由疼痛造成，利用月经痛具有明确发育起点（初潮）这一特点，在青少年初潮前及初潮后两次用纵向64通道脑电测量静息脑活动。结果显示，初潮前后来报告较高月经痛者在初潮前就已表现出更快的枕区峰α频率，这一差异在初潮后早期仍存在；而振荡功率和功能连接未随月经痛分组不同，提示成人痛经者中广泛的功能改变可能需要多年才出现。作者据此认为，早期月经痛并不伴随广泛的神经振荡改变，但月经痛易感性的一些方面可能反映在静息峰α频率上，且这是首个被显示先于月经痛出现的神经生理特征。

papers.title: A brain–behavior generative model links individual brain dynamics to perceptual decisions
papers.authors: Wang C, Yang G, Wang S, Luo H.
papers.abstract: Perceptual decision speed varies across individuals and trials. Explaining this variability requires linking individual brain anatomy, neural dynamics, and behavior, yet whole-brain models typically reproduce brain signals without behavior, whereas behavioral models lack anatomical constraints. Here we introduce a brain–behavior generative model in which whole-brain dynamics on each participant’s structural connectome generate both single-trial electroencephalography (EEG) and reaction times. Fitted to 17 participants performing motion discrimination, the models reproduced individual eventrelated potentials and reaction-time distributions. Joint fitting enabled the models to predict whether held-out trials were relatively fast or slow within each stimulus condition. In silico silencing further predicted where, how, and when each person’s brain controls decision speed. Sensorimotor regions affected decision speed consistently across most participants, whereas the same parietal region had opposite effects in different participants. These opposite effects reflected whether the region acted mainly through network dynamics or the decision readout. Temporal analyses suggested that early activity largely set decision speed, whereas late EEG mainly tracked the unfolding decision. These results show that brain–behavior generative modeling can link individual brain dynamics to perceptual decisions and yield testable predictions of why decision speed varies across individuals and trials.

relevance.reason: 该研究用个体结构连接组约束的全脑生成模型，将EEG动态与知觉决策速度联系起来，属于认知与脑结构-功能耦合研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个脑—行为生成模型，用每位参与者的结构连接组约束全脑动力学，同时生成单试次脑电和反应时，以解释知觉决策速度在个体与试次间的差异。模型拟合后能重现个体的事件相关电位和反应时分布，并可预测同一刺激条件下留出试次反应相对快慢。模拟沉默进一步提示，感觉运动区对决策速度的影响在多数人中一致，而同一顶叶区在不同人身上效应相反，这与其主要经网络动力学还是决策读出起作用有关；早期活动主要设定决策速度，晚期脑电更多反映决策展开。结果表明，该建模可将个体脑动力学与知觉决策联系起来，并对决策速度差异给出可检验的预测。

papers.title: Field Position and Subjective Number of Headers Are Associated with Subcortical Volumes in Female Soccer Players.
papers.authors: Schultz V, Hermsdörfer J, Kern J, Koerte IK, Zimmer C, Reinsberger C, Sollmann N.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Repetitive head impacts (RHI) from soccer headers could be linked to neurodegeneration, but their effects on young, active athletes are still under debate. This exploratory, cross-sectional study aimed to generate hypotheses about the relationship between soccer headers, brain volume alterations, and neuropsychological function in female soccer players. The analysis focused on brain regions previously identified as vulnerable to RHI. Materials and methods Nineteen semiprofessional female soccer players (mean age: 22.4 ± 4.1 years) and 15 noncontact-sport controls underwent structural MRI. Players were assessed for neuropsychological function and measures of exposure (field position, subjective number of headers, age at first exposure, and total years played). Subcortical gray and corpus callosum white matter volumes were calculated using FreeSurfer for all participants. Group differences in brain volumes were assessed. Among players, associations between brain volumes, exposure measures, and neuropsychological function were analyzed, controlling for multiple comparisons using a 25% false discovery rate. Results This study found no statistically significant group differences in brain regional volumes. Among players, a higher subjective number of headers correlated with lower left thalamic (r = -0.54; P = .02) and posterior corpus callosum volumes (r = -0.57; P = .01), whereas field positions with an expected higher number of headers were linked to lower volumes of the right nucleus accumbens (r = 0.58; P = .01) and hippocampus (r = 0.72; P = .001). No statistically significant associations were found for other exposure measures, brain volumes, or any of the neuropsychological outcomes. Conclusions A higher subjective number of headers among female soccer players was associated with group-level findings regarding reduced subcortical gray and central white matter brain volumes in our small sample of female soccer players. Although these findings are exploratory, group level, and of uncertain clinical significance, they provide hypotheses for future studies and suggest directions for further investigation.

relevance.reason: 研究女性足球运动员头球暴露与皮层下灰质及胼胝体白质体积的关联，属脑结构与暴露相关性的结构影像研究。

papers.summary_zh: 这项探索性横断面研究考察女性足球运动员的重复头球暴露是否与皮层下灰质和胼胝体白质体积及神经心理功能相关，比较了半职业女足运动员与非接触性运动对照者的结构MRI结果。研究未发现两组在脑区体积上的显著差异；但在运动员内部，主观报告头球次数较多与左侧丘脑和后部胼胝体体积较低相关，而预期头球较多的场上位置则与右侧伏隔核和海马体积较低相关。其他暴露指标及神经心理结果均无显著关联。作者强调这些组水平关联样本小、临床意义不确定，仅用于提出假设，不能据此推断头球导致脑结构改变或临床损害。

papers.title: Neural correlates of infant dialect discrimination: An fNIRS study.
papers.authors: Cristia A, MINAGAWA Y, Egorova-Brumley N, Gervain J, Filippin L, Cabrol D, Dupoux E.
papers.abstract: The present study investigated the neural correlates of infant discrimination of very similar linguistic varieties (Quebecois and Parisian French) using functional Near InfraRed Spectroscopy. In line with previous behavioral and electrophysiological data, there was no evidence that 3-month-olds discriminated the two regional accents, whereas 5-month-olds did, with the locus of discrimination in left anterior perisylvian regions. These neuroimaging results suggest that a developing language network relying crucially on left perisylvian cortices sustains infants’ discrimination of similar linguistic varieties within this early period of infancy.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS研究婴儿方言辨别，发现5个月婴儿左前侧外侧裂区参与语言变体辨别，直接涉及语言感知的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能性近红外光谱考察婴儿能否区分两种非常接近的法语地区口音，并寻找其神经相关。结果与以往行为和电生理数据一致：3个月婴儿未表现出区分证据，5个月婴儿则能区分，辨别相关的活动定位在左前侧外侧裂周围区域。作者据此认为，婴儿早期对相似语言变体的辨别依赖正在发育、以左侧外侧裂周围皮层为核心的语言网络。

papers.title: Frequency-Specific Cognitive Control Network Hypoconnectivity in Adolescents With Elevated Externalizing Symptoms
papers.authors: Souri S, Bigdeli MR, Abravani P.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Externalizing symptoms during adolescence are associated with behavioral difficulties and an increased risk of adverse developmental outcomes, and are often accompanied by difficulties in self-regulation across cognitive and emotional domains. Although prior neuroimaging studies have reported altered brain connectivity in externalizing psychopathology, most evidence comes from functional magnetic resonance imaging, leaving frequency-specific electrophysiological network dynamics poorly understood. We examined resting-state electroencephalographic (EEG) functional connectivity in a community-based sample of 35 adolescents aged 13–15 years with relatively high or low parent-reported externalizing symptoms. Source-level connectivity was estimated using exact low-resolution electromagnetic tomography and lagged phase synchronization across delta-to-gamma frequency bands within the cognitive control network (CCN) and default mode network (DMN). Results Adolescents with higher externalizing symptoms showed reduced connectivity in five beta1- and gamma-band CCN connections, whereas no significant group differences were observed within the DMN. After adjustment for internalizing symptoms, bilateral anterior-insula connectivity in the beta1 band and left anterior insula–right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex connectivity in the gamma band remained significant. Lower left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex–right inferior frontal junction beta1 connectivity was also associated with greater self-reported physical aggression. Conclusions Elevated externalizing symptoms during adolescence may be linked to altered functional coordination within the cognitive control network. These findings highlight the potential value of frequency-resolved EEG connectivity for characterizing the neural correlates of adolescent externalizing symptoms.

relevance.reason: 研究青少年外化症状与静息态EEG认知控制网络频段特异性功能连接降低，涉及认知控制脑网络组织及精神病理相关脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年外化症状升高是否伴随认知控制网络（CCN）和默认模式网络（DMN）在特定频段上的静息态功能连接改变，采用脑电溯源连接分析，比较了社区样本中高、低外化症状青少年。结果显示，高外化症状组在beta1和gamma频段的CCN内出现多处连接减弱，而DMN未见显著组间差异；控制内化症状后，部分前岛叶及前岛叶—背外侧前额叶连接仍存在差异，且左侧背外侧前额叶—右侧额下连接较弱与自报身体攻击较多相关。作者据此认为，青少年外化症状升高可能与认知控制网络内部功能协调改变有关，并提示按频段分析脑电连接有助于刻画其神经相关特征；这些关联性发现尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Aperiodic EEG activity is a domain-specific marker of attentional aging in neurotypical adults.
papers.authors: Cazares C, Rigby A, Kang L, Getzmann S, Arnau S, Wascher E, Voytek B.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Aperiodic neural activity has been reliably shown to be reduced among older adults, and these reductions are associated with age-related cognitive decline. These results suggest that aperiodic activity, as measured by the spectral exponent, might be a viable electrophysiological biomarker for cognitive aging. However, this has not been tested longitudinally, within participants, during normal aging. Here, we used a longitudinal cohort of either sex to test whether changes in aperiodic activity between two sessions, approximately 5 years apart, track behavioral change across two domains: sustained attention (Psychomotor Vigilance Test) and executive function (modified Simon task). We found that aperiodic activity declined within individuals after the interval, independent of age at baseline. This within-person change tracked concurrent changes in reaction times during sustained attention but was not associated with changes in any Simon task measure. Within a resampling framework, the aperiodic-PVT association was stable across cohort resamples and independently fitted partitions, though it was not confirmed in a small, frozen held-out set. These findings suggest the longitudinal decline in aperiodic activity tracks attentional processing speed rather than executive function, supporting its potential as a domain-specific biomarker of attentional aging in neurotypical populations.Significance Statement Aperiodic (non-oscillatory) neural activity, indexed by the aperiodic exponent, is known to decline in older adults, but whether this happens within individuals over just a few years, and in step with cognitive change, remains unclear. Here we leveraged scalp EEG and cognitive-behavioral data from 276 neurotypical adults, tested twice approximately five years apart, and found that the aperiodic exponent declines within individuals over this interval, independent of age at baseline. This decline tracked concurrent slowing on a sustained attention task, but not change on an executive function task, and only in EEG recorded before, not after, cognitive testing. Based on this dissociation, we propose that aperiodic exponent decline indexes attentional processing speed rather than general cognitive decline in neurotypical aging.

relevance.reason: 纵向EEG研究，考察非周期脑电活动变化与持续注意/执行功能衰退的关系，属注意与认知老化的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用纵向队列的脑电与行为数据，检验正常衰老过程中非周期脑电活动（以频谱指数衡量）的个体内变化是否与认知变化同步。结果显示，间隔约五年后个体内非周期活动下降，且这一下降与持续注意任务反应时的变化相关，而与执行功能任务（修改版Simon任务）的各项指标变化无关；该关联在重采样中较稳定，但未在小型冻结留出集中得到确认。作者据此提出，非周期活动的纵向下降更多反映注意加工速度而非一般执行功能，可能作为神经典型人群注意老化的领域特异性生物标记，但尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Probing the neural geometry of conscious object perception in time.
papers.authors: Hachisuka A, Baumgarten TJ, Spector D, Koenig L, He BJ.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Conscious object recognition is a critical brain function, key to making sense of the plethora of visual inputs and guiding adaptive behavior. Yet, the sequence of neural processing underlying conscious object recognition remains unclear. Existing proposals alternatively suggest that conscious object recognition proceeds in a "coarse-to-fine" sequence or a "fine-to-coarse" sequence. Here, we recorded high-density EEG while participants of both sexes performed a threshold-level object recognition task under different viewing conditions. Both superordinate and basic-level category information emerged early in neural activity, followed by a late superordinate category representation in an abstract format that is disentangled from low-level object features. Strikingly, in the early period, while basic-level category information positively correlated with perceptual awareness, superordinate category information negatively predicted perceptual awareness. By contrast, both superordinate and basic-level category information positively correlated with objective categorization accuracy in the early period. In the late period, both levels of category information positively correlated with awareness. These results suggest that neural processing underlying conscious object perception proceeds from the basic to the superordinate category level.Significance statement Despite significant interests, the sequence of neural processing underlying conscious perception remains unclear. Here, we investigated the unfolding of neural events in time that support perceptual awareness of visual objects. Using a threshold-level object perception task involving three image conditions (normal, low-pass filtered, masked) and high-density EEG, we reveal that basic and superordinate category information both emerge early in the neural activity (at ∼100 ms), but only the basic-level category representation positively contributes to awareness. By contrast, the early superordinate category representation negatively correlates with perceptual awareness. At ∼300 ms, an abstract superordinate category representation emerges, which also positively correlates with perceptual awareness. Therefore, category-level neural processing underlying conscious object perception proceeds from the basic to the superordinate level.

relevance.reason: 高密度EEG研究意识物体识别的时间进程与类别层级神经表征，属知觉/意识神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注有意识物体识别背后的神经加工时序，比较“由粗到细”与“由细到粗”两种假说。研究者让被试在不同观看条件下完成阈限水平的物体识别任务，并用高密度脑电记录其神经活动。结果显示，基本与上位类别信息都在神经活动早期出现，但早期只有基本类别信息与知觉意识正相关，上位类别信息反而负向预测意识；晚期则出现与低层特征分离的抽象上位类别表征，并与意识正相关。作者据此认为，有意识物体知觉的类别加工按从基本类别到上位类别的顺序展开，而非由粗到细。

papers.title: A cortical semantic map integrates fractions and integers in the human brain.
papers.authors: Valério D, Debray S, Karami A, Cauté M, Gravel N, Dehaene S.
papers.abstract: How does the human brain represent the meaning of abstract symbols? Some theories postulate the existence of semantic spaces where concepts occupy positions that reflect their conceptual relationships. In the number domain, psychological evidence suggests that integers are represented along a mental number line which, with education, integrates higher-level number concepts such as fractions. To test this hypothesis, we recorded whole-brain 7T fMRI responses to integer and fraction symbols during an active magnitude comparison task designed to engage magnitude processing. Consistent with predictions, we found both behavioral and neural numerical distance effects. Activation vectors in intraparietal, inferior temporal, prefrontal, hippocampal, and parahippocampal cortices formed a two-dimensional semantic space organized by numerical magnitude and domain (fractions versus integers). Gaussian fits revealed a topographic map of numerical preferences in the anterior inferior parietal cortex, common to both domains. Our results suggest that, when educated adults engage in an explicit magnitude comparison task, their brain can construct an ordered representation that integrates fractions and integers, with a topographic organization in the anterior IPS/IPL.

relevance.reason: 用7T fMRI研究整数与分数符号的语义/数量表征及脑内拓扑组织，属除语言外的认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑如何表征分数与整数这类抽象符号的意义，用7T全脑fMRI记录受试者在主动数量比较任务中对两类数字符号的反应。行为与神经层面均出现数字距离效应，多个皮层区域的激活向量构成由数值大小和数字领域（分数与整数）组织的二维语义空间；前部顶下皮层还呈现两个领域共有的数值偏好拓扑图。作者据此认为，受过教育的成人在明确的数量比较任务中可构建整合分数与整数的有序表征，但这一结论限于该任务情境，不宜直接外推为日常理解或临床效果。

papers.title: DTI-Associated Blood Biomarkers in a Human Perioperative Brain Perturbation Model.
papers.authors: Liu J, Wang Y, Gao Z, Bao X, Han C, Sun Z, Tong H, Xue Z, Lv W, Xu A, Li M, Song X, Li W, Yang Z, Li S, Duan L, Wu C, Zhang J.
papers.abstract: Circulating biomarkers of brain perturbation are rarely evaluated against anatomically localized in vivo imaging measures, limiting biological interpretation. We tested whether perioperative changes in candidate biomarkers were associated with diffusion tensor imaging (DTI)-defined microstructural changes in a controlled human perioperative model. In a paired cohort of 75 patients undergoing left-sided encephaloduroarteriosynangiosis, we obtained matched pre- and postoperative DTI and blood samples. Six biomarkers (ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase-L1 [UCH-L1], glial fibrillary acidic protein [GFAP], S100 calcium-binding protein B [S100B], neurofilament light chain, neuron-specific enolase, and protein tau) were quantified. Analyses included paired comparisons, region-of-interest-based cross-modal correlations, sparse canonical correlation analysis (sCCA) with bootstrap stability assessment, and patient-grouped regularized logistic regression for state discrimination. DTI showed perioperative changes in bilateral temporal-limbic regions and connected white matter, with the largest effects in left hippocampal and amygdalar territories on the operated side. UCH-L1, GFAP, and S100B showed the clearest paired increases and dominated internal perioperative-state discrimination. Blood-DTI associations were heterogeneous across biomarkers and states, and paired-change associations were not confined to these three markers. An observed three-biomarker panel discriminated perioperative state with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.914 in the test set. Several circulating biomarkers covaried with regional DTI measures in this exploratory perioperative cohort. UCH-L1, GFAP, and S100B were the most perioperatively responsive and state-discriminative markers, but the DTI-association pattern was not specific to this trio. The findings support a structure-associated framework for evaluating blood biomarkers against regional imaging changes; they do not validate these biomarkers for traumatic brain injury, and relevance to traumatic brain injury (TBI) remains hypothesis-generating.

relevance.reason: 在人类围手术期脑扰动模型中，将血液生物标志物与DTI局部微结构变化进行跨模态关联，属于结构影像与脑组织机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在75名接受左侧脑硬膜动脉血管融通术的患者中，配对采集术前术后血液和弥散张量成像（DTI）数据，考察围手术期候选血液标志物是否与局部脑微结构变化相关。DTI显示双侧颞叶-边缘系统及相连白质出现围手术期改变，手术侧左海马和杏仁核区域效应最大；UCH-L1、GFAP和S100B的配对升高最明显，并在区分围手术期状态上表现最佳，三者组合在测试集中区分状态的曲线下面积为0.914。不过，血液标志物与DTI的关联在不同标志物和状态间并不一致，配对变化关联也不限于这三种标志物。作者据此提出以结构关联为框架评估血液标志物，同时强调这些结果不能用于验证创伤性脑损伤标志物，其与创伤性脑损伤的相关性仍属假设性。

papers.title: The electro-MICA toolbox for integrating electrophysiology within multimodal imaging and connectomics workflows.
papers.authors: von Ellenrieder N, Cai Z, Arafat T, Vavassori L, Abdallah C, De Kraker J, Rodriguez-Cruces R, Royer J, Sahlas E, Bautin P, Pana R, Aron O, Frauscher B, Bernhardt BC.
papers.abstract: The integration of electrophysiological recordings with multimodal neuroimaging data holds great promise for advancing our understanding of brain function and neurological disorders. To facilitate this endeavor, we present electro-MICA, an open-access Python toolbox designed to project electrophysiological features from scalp and intracranial electroencephalography (EEG) onto cortical and hippocampal surfaces generated by validated multimodal imaging ecosystems. The toolbox comprises two pipelines: one for intracranial EEG (iEEG) recorded with stereo-EEG depth electrodes and one for scalp EEG source localization. Both pipelines are grounded in numerical solutions to the electromagnetic equations governing electric activity in the brain, solved using the Boundary Element Method. A key methodological contribution is the use of a current density double layer model for neural generators, which avoids the mathematical singularities introduced by conventional dipole-based models when electrodes are near the cortical surface, a situation that can arise in iEEG. Electrode contacts are additionally modeled with non-zero length, improving physical realism. Scalp EEG source localization is performed using eLORETA on a subject-specific three-layer head model derived from the anatomical input. Validation against empirical gamma-band iEEG data from 32 subjects demonstrates that the distributed generator model outperforms both distance-based and dipole-based alternatives. An illustrative clinical example demonstrates the toolbox's capacity to reveal associations between intracranial spike rates, cortical thickness, and anatomical connectivity in an epilepsy patient. Electro-MICA requires no parameter selection from the user, facilitating straightforward multimodal analyses. The toolbox is available at http://github.com/MICA-MNI/electromica with extensive online documentation at http://electromica.readthedocs.io.

relevance.reason: 该工具箱将头皮/颅内电生理特征投射到皮层与海马表面，并与皮层厚度和结构连接整合，属于电生理与结构功能耦合的方法学贡献。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究介绍了一个名为electro-MICA的开源Python工具箱，用于将头皮脑电和颅内脑电特征投影到多模态影像生成的头皮与海马表面，包含颅内立体脑电和头皮脑电源定位两条流程，均基于边界元法求解电磁方程。其方法学要点是采用电流密度双层模型表示神经发生器，以避免传统偶极子模型在电极靠近皮层表面时产生的数学奇异性，并将电极触点建模为非零长度。基于32名被试真实伽马波段颅内脑电数据的验证显示，该分布式发生器模型优于基于距离和基于偶极子的替代方案；一个癫痫患者的示例则展示了该工具揭示颅内棘波率、皮层厚度与解剖连接之间关联的能力。工具箱无需用户选择参数，便于开展多模态分析。

papers.title: Interactions between age and sex in multiscale entropy and spectral power changes across the lifespan.
papers.authors: Solomon JP, Dobri SGJ, Shen K, Vakorin VA, Moreno S, McIntosh AR.
papers.abstract: Multiscale entropy (MSE) changes in relation to age, whereby ageing is associated with an increasing bias towards fine scale entropy. This change is thought to represent a shift towards localized information processing in the brain as we age. However, this relationship has not been tested in large sample sizes alongside other demographic factors and cognitive behaviours. This study aimed to replicate previously reported effects of ageing on MSE in an open access database (Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience, N = 587) and expand the findings to include an investigation of the effects of sex and a variety of cognitive behaviours. MSE curves and power spectrum densities (PSD) were calculated for each region of interest from the magnetoencephalography data. Multivariate partial least squares analyses were used to assess the relationship between MSE or PSD and five behavioural/demographic factors including age, sex, fluid intelligence, visual short-term memory, and a generalized measure of cognitive function. Age was associated with increased fine scale and decreased coarse scale entropy, as well as complementary spectral changes, including slowing of peak alpha rhythms, increased beta-band activity, and reduced gamma-band activity, which replicates prior MSE and PSD findings. In both domains, these age-related patterns differentiated based on sex with advancing age. Importantly, the unique effects of sex diverged between MSE and PSD. This result indicates that entropy-based measures can isolate aspects of temporal organization that are not clearly summarized by spectral structure alone.

relevance.reason: 该研究用MEG多尺度熵与频谱分析揭示衰老和性别对脑自发活动时间组织的影响，属认知老化与静息脑组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用开放获取的脑磁图数据，考察多尺度熵与频谱功率随年龄的变化，并检验性别和多种认知行为因素的作用。结果复现了既往发现：年龄增长与细尺度熵升高、粗尺度熵降低相关，频谱上则表现为α峰减慢、β活动增强和γ活动减弱；这些年龄相关模式随年龄增长在性别间出现分化，且性别在多尺度熵与频谱功率上的独特效应并不一致。作者据此指出，基于熵的指标能够捕捉频谱结构未能清楚概括的时间组织特征。

papers.title: Beta-band dynamics during a naturalistic motor task: An OPM-MEG study.
papers.authors: Gibson J, Fildes J, Kirby A, Holmes N, Rier L, Mullinger KJ, Ison M, Morris PG, Boto E, Hill RM, Brookes MJ.
papers.abstract: Beta oscillations are a fundamental feature of brain activity, linked to long-range connectivity within canonical networks, inhibition of sensorimotor cortices, and the maintenance of a stable sensorimotor state in situations where the external world is predictable. The importance of beta oscillations in brain function is underscored by observations of their perturbation in neurological and psychiatric disorders. However, the precise role played by beta activity, particularly in mediating complex or skilful movements, remains incompletely understood. Here, we used a newly developed wearable optically pumped magnetometer-based magnetoencephalography (OPM-MEG) system to measure beta dynamics as participants learned to play a musical instrument. Twenty-two novice players took part in a study in which OPM-MEG data were recorded during two scanning sessions, while participants attempted to play a tune on a violin. Between the two sessions, participants received a violin lesson from an expert teacher. Results showed that robust data could be acquired during this naturalistic task, with beta oscillations decreasing in amplitude during movement and increasing upon movement cessation, as expected. Moreover, beta power while playing, in the motor and pre-motor areas, was significantly elevated after the lesson compared to before, and the movement-related modulation of beta amplitude was more pronounced after the lesson. These findings align with predictive coding models which suggest that beta amplitude should increase when individuals have greater certainty over the movements they carry out. Our study adds to an expanding literature on the role of beta oscillations and provides further evidence for the utility of OPM-MEG in naturalistic neuroscience.

relevance.reason: 用OPM-MEG在自然小提琴演奏任务中记录感觉运动beta振荡，考察学习后运动相关脑动力学变化。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注β振荡在复杂或熟练运动中的作用，利用可穿戴的光学泵磁强计脑磁图（OPM-MEG）记录新手在两次扫描中尝试拉小提琴时的β动态，两次扫描之间接受专家授课。结果显示，该自然任务中可获得可靠数据，β振荡在运动时振幅下降、停止后回升；上课后，运动与前运动区在演奏时的β功率显著升高，β振幅的运动相关调制也更明显。作者认为，这与预测编码模型一致，即个体对自身动作更有把握时β振幅应上升，并进一步支持OPM-MEG用于自然情境神经科学研究的可行性。

papers.title: Longitudinal Changes in Brain Connectivity and Structure after MRgFUS VIM Thalamotomy for Essential Tremor.
papers.authors: Pijar J, Crompton DBJ, Elias G, Pancholi A, Iskin S, Loh A, Chow CT, Yang A, Ranjan M, Milosevic L, Schwartz M, Lozano A, Boutet A, Germann J.
papers.abstract: Essential Tremor (ET) is the most common movement disorder. Magnetic Resonance-guided Focused Ultrasound (MRgFUS), an incisionless surgery involving thermal ablation of targeted brain regions, like the Ventral Intermediate Nucleus of the Thalamus (VIM) and surrounding white matter tracts, is an effective treatment option. Fractional Anisotropy (FA), a metric of diffusion tensor imaging, can be used to determine white matter structural integrity and their changes following MRgFUS. This study investigates white matter and morphological brain remodeling after MRgFUS VIM thalamotomy and its association with tremor improvement, assessed by the Clinical Rating Scale for Tremor (CRST), over the first postoperative year. We retrospectively analyzed 56 ET patients who underwent unilateral MRgFUS VIM thalamotomy. Subjects' CRST scores, T1-weighted MRI scans, and diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) scans were acquired pre-operatively and at three and twelve months post-operatively. FA maps were generated and registered to a standard space. Voxel clusters that exhibited significant change in FA over time were identified using FSL's cluster tool (p<0.001) and their change in FA value over time was Spearman correlated with relative change in CRST score. Deformation-Based Morphometry of T1-weighted images evaluated changes in structural volume, and a linear mixed-effects model was applied. We permuted these values 1000 times randomly to isolate significant (p<0.01) clusters related to the interaction between time and outcome and Spearman correlated them with relative improvement in CRST. Four main FA clusters demonstrated strong associations between CRST score and time. The insula produced consistent positive correlations at three (R=0.32, p=0.04) and twelve months (R=0.29, p=0.11). Yet, the visual cortex exhibited no significant association at three months (R=0.11, p=0.46), but did at twelve months (R=0.35, p=0.05), suggesting malleable white matter remodeling. Our morphometry analysis revealed two primary clusters located in the pre-supplementary motor area (pre-SMA) and visual cortex. The pre-SMA exhibited the strongest correlations at three months (three months: R=0.34, p=0.03, twelve months: R=0.17, p=0.36), while the visual cortex displayed a similar strength throughout (three months: R=0.20, p=0.18, twelve months: R=-0.22, p=0.23). These findings suggest that MRgFUS VIM thalamotomy is associated with broad structural tract and volumetric changes that extend beyond motor networks. Both analyses demonstrated post-treatment volume growth and increased tract structure in visual and cognitive regions. Correlation with tremor improvement indicates many of these changes may contribute to individual outcomes during the first post-operative year.

relevance.reason: 研究特发性震颤患者MRgFUS术后白质微结构与灰质体积重塑及其与症状改善关联，属脑损伤/干预后脑重组与结构功能研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究回顾性分析了56名接受单侧MRgFUS丘脑VIM毁损术的特发性震颤患者，结合弥散张量成像的FA指标和基于形变的形态学分析，考察术后一年内白质与脑结构的变化及其与震颤改善（CRST评分）的关联。结果显示，FA变化与CRST评分相关的区域涉及岛叶和视觉皮层，其中岛叶在术后三个月和十二个月呈较一致的正相关，视觉皮层则在十二个月时出现关联；形态学分析发现前辅助运动区和视觉皮层两个主要区域，前者在三个月时相关性最强。作者据此认为，该手术与超出运动网络的广泛结构束和体积改变有关，视觉与认知区域出现治疗后体积增长和纤维结构增强，且这些变化可能与术后第一年的个体震颤改善相关。需注意这些为相关性结果，尚不能确立因果或治疗效应。

papers.title: Infra-slow brain-heart-gut electrophysiological interactions reveal a co-ordinated multisystem physiological network in humans.
papers.authors: Sitti G, Pitti L, Candia-Rivera D.
papers.abstract: Growing evidence indicates that brain continuously interacts with other physiological systems through neural and non-neural pathways. The brain-heart and brain-gut axes play a central role in homoeostasis, allostasis and behaviour, but also in cognitive aspects, including emotion and decision-making. Disruptions in these axes have been linked to a wide range of cardiovascular, neurological and psychiatric disorders. Despite this evidence, triadic crosstalk between the brain, heart and gut remains largely unexplored. Brain activity, cardiac autonomic fluctuations and gastric rhythms all exhibit slow temporal components in resting state, suggesting that brain-heart-gut electrophysiological interactions may occur over time scales from the infra-slow (0.01-0.1 Hz) physiological range. Using open-access electrophysiological recordings from 28 healthy subjects at rest, we extracted time-varying power dynamics describing the activity of the three organs: brain alpha power, cardiac sympathetic and parasympathetic indices, and the power of the gastric rhythm. Statistical associations among these organs were quantified using the maximal information coefficient across the extended temporal delay range. Physiological interactions were confirmed using surrogate-based testing, which allowed us to construct the network topology of interactions between the three organs. Our findings show that triadic brain-heart-gut interactions form a multidirectional network primarily at infra-slow time scales during resting state. This study offers one of the first insights into the physiology of brain-heart-gut interplay, providing a methodological baseline for the development of more comprehensive biomarkers based on network dynamics capable of linking pathological conditions to dysregulation across multiple organ systems. KEY POINTS: First in-human, non-invasive investigation of parallel brain-heart-gut electrophysiological interactions in awake, healthy subjects. We analysed simultaneous electroencephalographic (EEG), electrocardiographic (ECG) and electrogastrographic (EGG) recordings and quantified strength and temporal scale of the derived time series associations to construct a large-scale network of interactions. We found that brain-heart-gut interactions extend into the infra-slow range (0.01-0.1 Hz), indicating that spontaneous fluctuations in the electrophysiological activity of one organ at rest are typically followed by corresponding changes in the other two. We consistently found a robust brain-heart-gut network topology across subjects, with multidirectional interactions and bodily dynamics converging towards midline central-posterior EEG regions. These findings provide one of the first endeavours in characterizing the physiology of brain-heart-gut interactions and a methodology with strong biomarker development potential.

papers.title: Clinically unresponsive patients with acute brain injury activate a brain-computer interface.
papers.authors: Shen Q, Eliseyev A, Kansara V, Neves Briard J, Song YL, Carmona J, Gonzales IJ, Velazquez A, Klein AJ, Agarwal S, Park S, Ghoshal S, Roh D, Connolly ES, Claassen J.
papers.abstract: Brain activation to verbal commands can be detected by EEG in clinically unresponsive patients. These patients with cognitive motor dissociation (CMD) are unable to communicate with the environment despite preserved consciousness. Advanced brain-computer interfaces (BCI) are promising to support motor function in patients with motor neuron disease or spinal cord injury. Our primary objective was to determine if clinically unresponsive patients can control a self-paced, one-way BCI early after acute brain injury. Secondarily, we assessed the association of BCI control with short- and long-term outcomes. We conducted a prospective single-centre cohort study in 41 clinically unresponsive, critically ill and acutely brain injured patients, as well as in a convenience sample of 8 healthy volunteers and 22 conscious critically ill patients. The self-paced BCI analysed EEG in real time and modulated frequency and pitch of a tone that patients controlled by attempting a motor task: patients were provided with instructions 'to make the beep sound faster, keep opening and closing your right hand' alternating with 'to make the beep sound slower, stop opening and closing your right hand'. CMD was detected by applying machine learning to EEG recorded while patients listened to motor commands. Clinical outcomes were recovery of consciousness by hospital discharge, assessed with the Coma Recovery Scale-Revised, and recovery of functional independence at 12 months, defined as a Glasgow Outcome Scale-Extended score of 4 or higher (denoting the ability to function independently for 8 h or more). Additionally, we invited conscious patients as well as family members of conscious and clinically unresponsive patients to complete a survey on perceived utility and challenges associated with the BCI. All healthy volunteers and nine conscious patients (41%) were able to control the BCI. Median signal delay for BCI control was 49.8 [interquartile range (IQR) 39.9-75.6] seconds for clinically unresponsive patients, 17.1 (IQR 7.8-19.9) for conscious patients and 15.5 (IQR 12.9-21.2) for healthy volunteers. In the group of 41 clinically unresponsive patients, 4 of 13 patients with (31%) and 1 of 28 without BCI control (4%) recovered clinical consciousness at hospital discharge [odds ratio (OR) 21.2; 95% confidence interval (CI) 2.3-930.7]. At 12 months, 6 of 13 patients with (46%) and 2 of 28 without BCI control (7%) recovered functional independence (OR 9.9; 95% CI 1.8-81.6). None of the patients that were unable to control the BCI and were CMD-negative recovered. Patients with BCI control had shorter times to recovery of functional independence by 12 months than those who did not (hazards ratio 6.0; 95% CI 1.2-30.6). All respondents of the BCI survey (n = 37) expressed strong support for the potential future use of BCI devices. These results suggest that BCI control is a strong predictor of outcomes following acute brain injury and provide initial evidence that a bedside, EEG-based BCI system might permit bidirectional communication in critically ill unresponsive patients.

papers.abstract: Objective Neuroimaging evidence has increasingly revealed associations between brain mechanisms and temporomandibular disorders (TMD). Greater T0 GMV in the anterior insula was associated with a lower muscle pain score at T1 . Conclusion The new findings suggest that individual differences in structural brain features may be associated with pain and masticatory performance before and after TMD treatment.

papers.title: Neuropharmacology of language: ERP evidence for catecholaminergic modulation of syntactic processing.
papers.authors: Tan Y, Lewis AG, Schmits IC, Verkes RJ, Cools R, Hagoort P.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: A few studies have shown that brain catecholamines are implicated in language comprehension. However, the specific cognitive processes they modulate remain underexplored. Methylphenidate amplified the P600 event-related potential effect, which has been linked to the recruitment of cognitive resources for processing sentences with increased syntactic load. papers.title: Neonatal brain network integration trajectories predict neurodevelopment in congenital heart disease.
papers.authors: Harasymiw L, Kuang A, Xu D, Scheffler A, George E, Peyvandi S, McQuillen P.
papers.abstract: Background Infants with critical congenital heart disease (CHD) are at high risk for abnormal brain development and later neurodevelopmental impairment. We hypothesized that the trajectory of perioperative whole-brain network development would predict neurodevelopmental outcomes in early childhood. Methods This prospective longitudinal cohort of neonates with critical CHD (n = 97) underwent preoperative and/or postoperative brain MRI with diffusion imaging. Whole-brain network measures were derived from structural connectomes from 80 infants, and 50 had neurodevelopment assessed at 1-4 years using the Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development. Results White matter injury was associated with a slower perioperative increase in global efficiency (p = 0.013), a measure of network integration, whereas cardiac physiology was not associated with network development. Infants with greater perioperative increases in global efficiency had higher cognitive (p = 0.001), language (p < 0.001), and motor (p = 0.008) scores. For each 1-standard deviation increase in the trajectory of global efficiency, cognitive scores increased by 8.2 points (95% CI: 3.64-12.78), independent of brain injury and socioeconomic factors. Conclusion In infants with critical CHD, longitudinal whole-brain network development was associated with neurodevelopment across multiple domains. Early network development may serve as a biomarker of neurodevelopmental risk and resilience in this population. Impact In infants with critical congenital heart disease, perioperative increase in whole-brain network integration was associated with cognitive, language, and motor outcomes in early childhood. White matter injury was associated with a slower increase in network integration, whereas cardiac physiology subtype was not associated with network development. This study extends prior work by showing that a longitudinal measure of neonatal whole-brain network development, rather than a single imaging timepoint, predicts neurodevelopment across multiple domains. These findings identify early network development as a potential biomarker of neurodevelopmental risk and resilience, and support future risk-stratification and intervention studies in this population.

papers.title: Adult aphasic status epilepticus: A systematic review and patient-level synthesis of clinical phenotypes and multimodal diagnostic evidence.
papers.authors: Chu QC, Do TT.
papers.abstract: Background Aphasic status epilepticus (ASE) is an uncommon manifestation of focal status epilepticus in which aphasia is the sole or predominant clinical feature. Recognition may be difficult because consciousness can be relatively preserved, convulsive activity may be absent, and the presentation can mimic acute stroke. Objective To characterize diagnostic phenotypes of adult ASE and synthesize clinical, electrographic, and neuroimaging features across published cases. Methods We conducted a systematic review and patient-level synthesis of adult ASE cases. Eligible patients were adjudicated as definite or probable ASE using prespecified criteria. Clinical phenotype, electroencephalographic (EEG) findings, neuroimaging, initial diagnostic impressions, treatment, and language outcomes were extracted. Results Ninety-nine publications contributed 168 adults with ASE, including 89 definite and 79 probable cases. Aphasia was the sole manifestation in 42.9% and predominant in 57.1%, while consciousness was preserved in 78.0%. Ictal EEG activity or electrographic status epilepticus was documented in 53.0%, and 41.7% had supportive epileptiform abnormalities. Among cases with interpretable EEG laterality, 92.7% were left-lateralized. Peri-ictal MRI abnormalities occurred in 41.2% of performed interpretable studies. Among 55 patients with interpretable functional perfusion or metabolic imaging, hyperperfusion was reported in 32. FDG-PET hypermetabolism was treated as a distinct metabolic finding. Stroke or transient ischemic attack was the most frequent reported initial impression (44.2%). Complete language recovery was reported in 77.4% of evaluable patients. Conclusions Published adult ASE cases show a heterogeneous phenotype in which recognition commonly rests on concordance between language disturbance and focal EEG abnormalities, with peri-ictal imaging providing complementary evidence. These findings do not establish diagnostic accuracy of individual features or multimodal combinations.
