papers.authors: Beño-Ruiz-de-la-Sierra RM, Arjona-Valladares A, Osorio-Iriarte E, Sobrino-Conde L, Rodríguez V, Núñez P, Poza J, Roig-Herrero A, Díez Á, Molina V.
papers.abstract: Anomalous self-experiences (ASEs) are a core feature of psychotic disorders and reflect disturbances in ipseity. These findings suggest that excessive gamma-band network segregation may be correlated with disrupted corollary discharge functioning and may compromise the distinction between self-generated and external stimuli. Therefore, it may alter the sense of ipseity by interfering with the integration of mental contents into the flow of consciousness, thereby contributing to greater severity of ASEs.

papers.abstract: Exhaustion due to chronic stress, a hallmark feature of burnout, represents a substantial and growing public health burden, yet its structural brain correlates remain poorly understood. We used voxel-based morphometry (VBM) to examine associations between regional gray matter volume and symptom severity in a cohort of 300 individuals on self-reported sick leave due to the Swedish medical condition stress-induced exhaustion disorder (ED), characterized by debilitating fatigue following prolonged stress exposure. Symptom severity was assessed using the Shirom-Melamed Burnout Questionnaire (SMBQ-18) and its subscales. Overall symptom severity (SMBQ-18 total score) and Physical Exhaustion (PE) were negatively associated with gray matter volume in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC), a region implicated in stress regulation and affective control, which remained significant when adjusting for depressive symptoms. An exploratory finding was that Listlessness was negatively associated with gray matter volume in the bilateral hippocampi and right middle temporal gyrus after adjustment for depressive symptoms. These results provide evidence from a large cohort for brain-symptom associations in chronic stress and highlight the value of dimensional approaches for capturing heterogeneity in stress-related conditions.

relevance.reason: 研究慢性应激所致耗竭的灰质体积与症状严重度关联，涉及mPFC、海马等情绪与应激调控脑区的结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注长期压力导致的应激性耗竭障碍（ED）的症状严重程度与脑结构的关系，采用基于体素的形态学分析，在因该病休病假的人群中考察区域灰质体积与症状评分的关联。结果显示，总体症状严重程度和躯体耗竭与内侧前额叶皮层灰质体积呈负相关，且在控制抑郁症状后仍成立；探索性分析还发现，倦怠无力感与双侧海马及右侧颞中回灰质体积呈负相关。作者认为，这为慢性压力下脑结构与症状的关联提供了大样本证据，并提示用维度化方法刻画应激相关状况的异质性具有价值。上述关联为横断面观察，不能据此推断因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Advanced brain age and longitudinal cognitive decline in healthy older adults.
papers.authors: Kristinsson S, Newman-Norlund R, Bonilha L, Bakos L, Rorden C, Sigurdsson S, Gudnason V, Fridriksson J.
papers.abstract: Advanced brain age relative to chronological age may predict cognitive decline in healthy aging, but prospective evidence remains limited. We tested whether the brain age gap (BAG) predicts cognition and 5-year cognitive decline in the AGES-Reykjavik Study. Participants with structural MRI and neuropsychological data were included cross-sectionally (n = 4,606); mean age 76.4y; 58% female) and longitudinally (n = 2,561; mean follow-up 5.2y). BAG was estimated from T1-weighted MRI. Mixed-effects models examined BAG effects on Memory (M), processing speed (PS), and executive function (EF), adjusting for age, sex, and education. Higher BAG was associated with worse cognition across all domains (β = -0.037 to -0.047, all p < 0.001). BAG significantly predicted greater decline in M (β = -0.007, p = 0.046); subgroup analyses revealed steeper decline in M and EF with advanced brain age. BAG predicts longitudinal cognitive decline beyond chronological age, supporting its utility as a biomarker in preventative care of healthy aging.

relevance.reason: 该研究用结构MRI估计脑龄差并预测健康老年人认知下降，属于脑结构与认知及发育/老化意义的研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于AGES-Reykjavik队列，用结构MRI估计大脑年龄差（BAG），即大脑预测年龄与实际年龄之差，并考察其能否预测健康老年人的认知表现及5年内的认知下降。结果显示，BAG越大，记忆、加工速度和执行功能的表现越差；纵向分析中，BAG较高者记忆下降更明显，亚组分析还提示记忆和执行功能的下降更陡。作者认为，BAG在 chronological age 之外仍能预测认知衰退，支持其作为健康老龄化预防性照护中的生物标志物；但这是观察性预测证据，尚不能说明因果关系或干预效果。

papers.title: Glymphatic dysfunction in early-onset schizophrenia: DTI-ALPS index reduction tracks illness burden and is independently associated with cognitive performance in treatment-resistant patients.
papers.authors: Oz A, Saglam Y, Turan K, Ficicioglu IEG, Karacetin G, Yesilkaya UH.
papers.abstract: Early-onset schizophrenia (EOS) is associated with greater cognitive impairment than adult-onset disease, and many patients also develop treatment resistance. Glymphatic dysfunction has been described in adult schizophrenia but not in EOS or in relation to treatment resistance. We used diffusion tensor imaging along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) to assess glymphatic function in 30 adolescents with EOS (15 treatment-resistant, TRS; 15 non-treatment-resistant, nTRS) and 29 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HC). Participants completed a neuropsychological battery covering verbal memory, processing speed, executive function, working memory, verbal fluency, and social cognition. ALPS differed across groups (F(2,56) = 34.66, p < 0.001, η² = 0.553), with values decreasing from HC (1.625 ± 0.072) to nTRS (1.501 ± 0.098) to TRS (1.439 ± 0.048); the TRS-nTRS difference was not significant (d = 0.81, p = 0.066). Patients showed broad cognitive deficits relative to HC, but nTRS and TRS did not differ on any measure after FDR correction. ALPS showed a nominal inverse association with the number of psychotic episodes (ρ = -0.391, p = 0.033) but was unrelated to PANSS scores or antipsychotic dose. Within TRS, ALPS was independently associated with phonemic verbal fluency (COWAT: β = +0.74, p = 0.003); a parallel association with categorical fluency (β = +0.88, p < 0.001) was partly driven by an influential observation and is exploratory. Glymphatic dysfunction appears to be a disease-intrinsic feature of EOS, lowest in TRS, possibly linked to cumulative episodes rather than current symptoms, and may contribute to cognitive impairment in treatment-resistant patients.

relevance.reason: 以DTI-ALPS评估早发精神分裂症患者脑类淋巴功能并与认知表现关联，属脑疾病与脑结构功能研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用弥散张量成像评估早发性精神分裂症青少年的类淋巴功能，比较治疗抵抗、非治疗抵抗患者与健康对照，并考察其与认知的关系。结果显示，类淋巴功能指标从健康对照到非治疗抵抗再到治疗抵抗患者依次降低，提示类淋巴功能障碍可能是早发性精神分裂症的疾病内在特征，且在治疗抵抗者中最明显。该指标与既往精神病发作次数呈名义上的负相关，而与当前症状严重程度和抗精神病药剂量无关；在治疗抵抗患者中，它还独立关联于音位言语流畅性，但类别流畅性的关联受个别观测影响，属探索性。作者据此推测，类淋巴功能异常可能与发作累积有关，并可能参与治疗抵抗患者的认知损害。

papers.title: Quantifying dexterity and grip strength associations between age, cognitive function (MoCA), and cerebellar gray matter volume in healthy adults across the adult lifespan.
papers.authors: Rajesh Kannan P, Pallapothu R, Kudaravalli S, Pallapothu S, Newman-Norlund RD.
papers.abstract: Cerebellar Crus I/II gray matter volume (GMV) is a structural marker of cognitive aging, and motor performance predicts age-related cognitive decline. Whether grip strength and manual dexterity dissociate in their cerebellar and cognitive correlates is unknown. We computed Pearson partial correlations (age, sex, and race covaried) between grip strength, Nine-Hole Peg Test (9HPT) dexterity, cerebellar Crus I/II GMV, and Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) subscores in 304 healthy adults aged 20-79 from the University of South Carolina Aging Brain Cohort. GMV was derived from T1-weighted MRI using CAT12 with the AAL3 atlas. After false discovery rate (FDR) correction, dominant 9HPT time correlated with MoCA total score (r=-.240) and memory index (r=-.220; both pFDR<0.001). Grip strength was unrelated to any MoCA measure but correlated bilaterally with Crus II GMV (r=.156-.224, all pFDR≤0.041). Bootstrapped mediation indicated that dexterity statistically accounted for 28.8% of the age-cognition association and Crus II volume for 34.4-41.4% of the age-grip association. Dichotomizing at the MoCA cut-off of 26, each additional second of peg time carried 17.6% higher odds of scoring below cut-off (odds ratio = 1.176, 95% CI [1.062,1.302]) while grip strength carried none. Grip strength, but not dexterity, was independently associated with Crus II GMV, whereas dexterity, but not grip, was associated with cognition. Grip strength and dexterity are therefore not interchangeable indices of motor function. Because the design is cross-sectional, mediation estimates describe shared variance rather than causal pathways, and the pronounced MoCA ceiling likely attenuated the cognitive associations.

relevance.reason: 在健康成人中考察小脑灰质体积与认知（MoCA）及运动功能的关系，属认知老化与结构-功能关联研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康成年人中考察握力与手部灵巧性是否在认知和小脑结构上呈现不同关联，使用九孔插板测试灵巧性、握力测量、小脑Crus I/II灰质体积以及MoCA认知评分，并控制年龄、性别和种族后进行相关分析。结果显示，灵巧性与MoCA总分及记忆得分相关，而握力与任何MoCA指标均无关；握力却与双侧Crus II灰质体积相关，灵巧性则不然。中介分析提示灵巧性可解释部分年龄与认知的共享变异，Crus II体积可解释部分年龄与握力的共享变异。作者据此认为握力和灵巧性并非可互换的运动功能指标，但研究为横断面设计，中介结果只反映共享变异而非因果通路，且MoCA明显的天花板效应可能削弱了认知关联。

papers.title: A mechanistic theory of planning in prefrontal cortex.
papers.authors: Jensen KT, Doohan PT, Sablé-Meyer M, Reinert S, Baram AB, Sahani M, Akam T, Behrens TE.
papers.abstract: Planning is critical for adaptive behaviour in a changing world, because it lets us anticipate the future and adjust our actions accordingly. While prefrontal cortex is crucial for this process, it remains unknown how planning is implemented in neural circuits. Prefrontal representations were recently discovered in simpler sequence memory tasks, where different populations of neurons represent different future time points. We demonstrate that combining such representations with the ubiquitous principle of neural attractor dynamics allows circuits to solve much richer problems, including planning. This is achieved by embedding the environment structure directly in synaptic connections to implement an attractor network that infers desirable futures. The resulting 'spacetime attractor' excels at planning in challenging tasks known to depend on the prefrontal cortex. Recurrent neural networks trained by gradient descent on such tasks learn a solution that precisely recapitulates the spacetime attractor - in representation, in dynamics, and in connectivity. Analyses of networks trained across different environment structures reveal a generalisation mechanism that rapidly reconfigures the world model used for planning, without the need for synaptic plasticity. The spacetime attractor is a testable mechanistic theory of planning. If true, it would provide a path towards detailed mechanistic understanding of how prefrontal cortex structures adaptive behaviour.

relevance.reason: 提出前额叶规划机制的计算理论，并与真实前额叶表征及任务比较，属认知神经机制框架。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对前额叶皮层如何实现规划这一未解问题，提出一种机制性理论。作者将序列记忆任务中发现的、由不同神经元群体表征不同未来时间点的前额叶表征，与神经吸引子动力学结合，构建出“时空吸引子”：把环境结构直接嵌入突触连接，由吸引子网络推断理想未来。该模型在依赖前额叶的困难规划任务中表现良好，且经梯度下降训练的循环网络所学解法在表征、动力学和连接上均与该吸引子高度吻合。跨不同环境结构的分析还提示一种无需突触可塑性的泛化机制，可快速重构用于规划的世界模型。作者据此提出可检验的规划理论，并指出若成立，将有助于从机制层面理解前额叶如何组织适应性行为。

papers.title: Strong mnemonic prediction errors increase cognitive control, attention, and arousal.
papers.authors: Xue AM, Jokhani J, Norcia AM, Wagner AD.
papers.abstract: Ongoing experience is continuously processed in the context of past events. Divergence between current experience and memory-based predictions (i.e., a mnemonic prediction error; MPE) is theorized to be a signal that encoding, as opposed to retrieval, should be prioritized. We asked how MPEs place demands on control and attention-related processes, and whether these demands differ as a function of prediction strength. We investigated these questions across two experiments, wherein we recorded scalp electroencephalography and/or pupillometry as 101 young human adults performed an associative memory task. Strong MPEs, more so than weak MPEs, increased physiological indices of cognitive control (frontal theta), attention (posterior alpha and pupil size), and arousal (pupil size). Greater cognitive control (frontal theta) during strong MPEs promoted better learning of prediction-violating (i.e., unexpected) stimuli. Collectively, these findings reveal multiple pathways through which the mind and brain respond adaptively to violations of strong mnemonic predictions.

relevance.reason: 用EEG和瞳孔测量研究人类联想记忆中的预测误差如何调动认知控制与注意，报告了额叶theta、后部alpha等脑活动指标。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨记忆预测误差（当前体验与基于记忆的预测之间的偏离）如何对认知控制和注意过程提出要求，以及这种要求是否随预测强度不同而变化。作者通过两项实验，在年轻成人执行联想记忆任务时记录脑电和/或瞳孔测量指标。结果显示，强预测误差相比弱预测误差，会增强认知控制（额区theta）、注意（后部alpha和瞳孔大小）及唤醒（瞳孔大小）的生理指标；强预测误差期间更强的认知控制还促进了对违反预测的意外刺激的学习。这些发现揭示了心智与大脑适应性应对强记忆预测违背的多条通路。

papers.title: Left Temporoparietal Neural Synchrony Tracks Cooperative Performance Across Adult Dyads
papers.authors: Carollo A, Cavallaro R, Bizzego A, Dimitriou D, Hoehl S, Esposito G.
papers.abstract: Cooperation requires interacting individuals to coordinate their actions toward shared goals, and interpersonal neural synchrony (INS) has been proposed as a neural correlate of this coordination. However, the relationship between INS and cooperative performance remains heterogeneous, and relatively little is known about how it varies across social relationships. The present study examined INS and behavioral performance during a naturalistic cooperative tabletop Jenga task in close-friend, romantic-partner, and mother–child dyads (N = 284 participants). Brain activity was simultaneously recorded using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning, and INS was quantified using wavelet transform coherence across the bilateral inferior frontal gyrus (IFG) and temporoparietal junction (TPJ). Cooperative performance was assessed using tower collapse and the number of valid turns completed during the game. True interacting dyads exhibited significantly greater neural synchrony than surrogate dyads across all examined regional pairings ( d range = 0.35–0.55), indicating robust interaction-related inter-brain synchrony. Behavioral performance was not associated with INS at the whole-network level. Region-specific analyses, however, showed that tower collapse was associated with reduced synchrony in the left TPJ–left TPJ ( p Bonf = 0.009) and left TPJ–right TPJ ( p Bonf = 0.017) pairings, whereas the number of valid turns was unrelated to INS. Follow-up analyses further indicated that the association between tower collapse and left TPJ–left TPJ synchrony was present in close-friend ( p Bonf = 0.020) and romantic-partner ( p Bonf = 0.026) dyads but not in mother–child dyads. These findings suggest that the behavioral relevance of interpersonal neural synchrony is not uniform, but depends on the neural systems involved, the specific index of cooperative performance, and the relational and developmental context in which interaction unfolds.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS超扫描在自然合作任务中考察人际神经同步与行为表现的关系，属社会认知与自然情境脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察合作任务中的人际神经同步是否与行为表现相关，以及这种关系是否随社会关系类型而变化。研究让亲密朋友、恋人和母子配对完成合作性桌面叠叠乐游戏，同时用功能性近红外光谱超扫描记录脑活动，并分析额下回与颞顶联合区的神经同步。结果发现，真实互动配对的神经同步普遍高于替代配对，但整体网络层面的同步与合作表现无关；只有左侧颞顶联合区相关配对的同步降低与叠塔倒塌有关，且这一关联出现在朋友和恋人配对中，未见于母子配对。作者据此指出，人际神经同步的行为意义取决于所涉及的神经系统、具体的合作表现指标以及互动发生的关系与发展情境。

papers.title: Anatomically optimised structural connectome derivation for the neonatal brain
papers.authors: Hew CK, Leserri S, Aydogan DB, Bastin ME, Bonthrone AF, Paterson K, Barclay G, Jardine C, Smith KM, Thrippleton MJ, Marioni R, Boardman JP, Blesa Cabez M.
papers.abstract: Structural connectomics provides a means of characterising white matter (WM) network organisation using diffusion MRI (dMRI), but reconstructing neonatal structural connectomes remains challenging due to the immature and heterogeneous nature of the developing brain. Although recent neonatal studies have increasingly adopted approaches beyond conventional diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), there remains scope to incorporate more advanced tractography and streamline post-processing approaches within neonatal pipelines. Here, we propose a neonatal structural connectome pipeline integrating surface-based anatomical constraints, ensemble tractography, hierarchical anatomical refinement of pathways (HARP) filtering, and spherical-deconvolution informed filtering (SIFT2) reweighting. We acquired 3T MRI data from 300 neonates (185 preterm, 115 term-born) to assess the impact of pipeline configuration on network organisation. Mean gestational age (GA) at birth was 29.31 (23.43–32.86) weeks in preterm infants and 39.52 (37.00–42.43) weeks in term infants. At scan, mean GA was 40.85 (36.29–49.00) weeks in preterm infants and 42.06 (38.29–48.00) weeks in term infants. Four connectome variants were generated: raw surfaced-based tractograms, HARP-filtered, SIFT2-weighted, and combined HARP+SIFT2. Pipeline performance was primarily evaluated using an existing brain age prediction model: connectome-based predictive model (CPM) and our derived connectomes to estimate GA at scan in term and preterm infants. In addition, global graph theoretical metric analyses were conducted to provide a complementary assessment of pipeline configuration differences in network organisation. In total, seven graph theoretical metrics were calculated and evaluated: global efficiency, local efficiency, transitivity, modularity, assortativity, degree variance and statistical complexity. Across all configurations, connectomes supported accurate brain age prediction, with mean absolute errors (MAE) of 0.76–0.79 weeks in term infants and 1.00–1.06 weeks in preterm infants. Prediction error and brain age gap variability were greater in preterm than term infants across configurations, with HARP+SIFT2 achieving the lowest preterm MAE (1.00 weeks) and brain age gap (BAG) variability (SD = 1.38 weeks). However, differences in prediction performance across configurations were minimal, suggesting limited influence of pipeline choice on brain age prediction. However, analysis of global network metrics demonstrated that pipeline choice significantly influenced downstream measures of network organisation, with HARP+SIFT2 being the only configuration to identify significant preterm vs. term differences across all seven metrics examined. These findings demonstrate the importance of considering tractography and streamline-processing choices when constructing neonatal structural connectomes and provide a framework for more anatomically informed investigation of early brain development. Issue Section Research

relevance.reason: 研究新生儿结构连接组（扩散MRI白质网络）构建方法及其对网络组织指标的影响，属脑结构连接与发育。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对新生儿大脑结构连接组重建困难的问题，提出了一套整合表面解剖约束、集成纤维追踪、分层解剖路径细化（HARP）过滤和SIFT2重加权的处理流程，并利用足月与早产新生儿的弥散MRI数据，以脑龄预测和全局图论指标评估不同流程配置对网络组织刻画的影响。结果显示，各配置下的连接组均能较准确地预测扫描时胎龄，且配置间预测表现差异很小，说明流程选择对脑龄预测影响有限；但全局网络指标对流程配置敏感，仅HARP+SIFT2组合在所有考察指标上均检出早产与足月的差异。作者据此强调，构建新生儿结构连接组时需重视纤维追踪与流线后处理的选择，并为更符合解剖结构的早期脑发育研究提供了流程框架。

papers.title: Accentuated Divergence, Constrained Expression: Autistic Traits Modulate the Creative Brain in Adults with ADHD
papers.authors: Liu N, Mu Z, Wang X, Jia G, Alitanshunbuer, Liu J, Xu J, Li H, Wang Y, Qiu J, Qian Q, Liu L.
papers.abstract: Background Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition, and co-occurring autistic traits may shape its phenotypic expression. Although creativity has been discussed as a relative strength in ADHD, it remains unclear whether autistic traits are associated with different dimensions of creativity in adults with ADHD and whether large-scale brain networks contribute to these associations. Methods We compared divergent thinking (DT) and real-life creativity between 65 adults with ADHD and 73 neurotypical controls. We used subgroup comparisons, partial correlation analyses, and multiple regression models to determine the effects of autistic traits (ATs) on creativity dimensions within the ADHD cohort. Guided by prior creativity-network research, we analyzed resting-state functional connectivity (FC) of the Default Mode Network (DMN) and Frontoparietal Network (FPN) to uncover the neural mechanisms. Results The ADHD cohort demonstrated significantly higher scores on both DT ( p s = 0.002–0.009) and real-life creativity measures ( p s = 0.011–0.017) compared to the neurotypical control group. Importantly, increased ATs within the ADHD group were associated with a dissociated creativity profile, showing positive associations with DT but negative associations with real-life creativity. At the neural level, stronger right DMN–FPN connectivity mediated positive associations between ATs and DT performance (ps = 0.007–0.018), but mediated a negative association between ATs and self-reported imagination (p = 0.029). Conclusions In individuals with ADHD, co-occurring ATs exert a paradoxical effect on creativity, enhancing DT while compromising real-life creative achievement. In this subgroup with ADHD and elevated ATs, interventions should capitalize on ATs-associated ideational strengths while circumventing translational barriers, to enhance real-world creative outcomes.

relevance.reason: 研究ADHD成人中自闭特质与创造力及静息态DMN-FPN功能连接的关联，涉及认知（创造力）的脑网络机制与精神疾病人群。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）成人中并存的孤独症特质是否与创造力的不同维度相关，以及默认网络与额顶网络的功能连接是否参与其中。研究比较了ADHD成人与神经典型对照的发散思维和现实生活创造力，并在ADHD组内分析孤独症特质的作用。结果显示，ADHD组在两类创造力指标上均高于对照组；而在ADHD组内，孤独症特质越高，发散思维表现越好，现实生活创造力却越差，呈现分离的创造力剖面。神经层面，右侧默认网络—额顶网络连接增强中介了孤独症特质与发散思维的正向关联，也中介了其与自报想象力的负向关联。作者据此提出，并存孤独症特质对ADHD成人的创造力具有看似矛盾的影响，干预上或可借助其观念生成优势，同时设法跨越现实转化障碍。

papers.title: Dose-dependent myelin g-ratio alterations in the white matter of 16p11.2 copy number variations
papers.authors: Lu WD, Martin C, Jizi K, Nelson MC, Draganski B, Jacquemont S, Tardif CL.
papers.abstract: Copy number variations (CNVs) at the 16p11.2 locus are major genetic risk factors for neurodevelopmental conditions and drive reciprocal alterations in cerebral white matter structure and connectivity. However, whether these alterations reflect differences in the axonal or myelin compartments remains unresolved with conventional diffusion MRI. We combined diffusion MRI with magnetization transfer saturation mapping across two ComBat-harmonized cohorts comprising 80 controls, 26 16p11.2 deletion carriers, and 13 duplication carriers. We quantified axonal volume, myelin volume, and aggregate g-ratio of white matter tracts forming the structural connectome. Metrics were evaluated using normative modeling across tract length, resting-state functional networks, and cortical nodes. We additionally examined 29 individuals carrying other neurodevelopmental CNVs. 16p11.2 gene dosage was associated with regional reciprocal differences in tract axonal volume, with greater volume in deletion carriers and lower volume in duplication carriers. In contrast, myelin volume did not differ significantly from controls. This mismatch resulted in pervasive aggregate g-ratio alterations, with higher g-ratios (relatively thinner myelin sheaths) in deletion carriers and lower g-ratios (relatively thicker sheaths) in duplication carriers. Regional g-ratio alterations also extended to other neurodevelopmental CNVs. These findings resolve some of the biological ambiguity underlying white matter alterations in 16p11.2 CNV carriers, implicating the axonal compartment while revealing comparatively stable myelin volume. The disrupted axon-myelin scaling results in connectome-wide g-ratio alterations and may represent a shared microstructural hallmark of genetic neurodevelopmental risk.

relevance.reason: 研究16p11.2拷贝数变异携带者白质轴突/髓鞘微结构及结构连接组改变，属脑结构与发育/疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注16p11.2拷贝数变异携带者白质结构改变究竟源于轴突还是髓鞘区室，为此结合弥散MRI与磁化转移饱和成像，在缺失型与重复型携带者及对照中量化结构连接组各纤维束的轴突体积、髓鞘体积和总体g比。结果显示，16p11.2基因剂量与轴突体积呈区域性反向差异相关：缺失携带者轴突体积较大，重复携带者较小；而髓鞘体积与对照无显著差异。这种轴突与髓鞘的不匹配造成广泛的g比改变，缺失携带者g比偏高（髓鞘相对较薄），重复携带者偏低（髓鞘相对较厚），且类似改变也见于其他神经发育相关拷贝数变异。作者据此认为，白质改变主要涉及轴突区室，轴突-髓鞘比例失调可能是此类遗传风险共有的微结构特征。

papers.title: Perisynaptic matrix gene variants underlie DystoniaGeneNet endophenotypes in isolated focal dystonia
papers.authors: Domingo A, Yao D, Kshatriya N, Mangkalaphiban K, Battistella G, O’Flynn LC, Reese B, Hincher M, Yadav R, Sharma N, Williams L, Fearon C, Killian O, Reilly R, Hutchinson M, Raymond D, Saunders-Pullman R, Bressman S, Frucht SJ, Talkowski M, Simonyan K, Ozelius LJ.
papers.abstract: Isolated focal dystonia is a rare movement disorder characterized by abnormalities in brain structure and function. The genes underlying isolated focal dystonia are not fully elucidated, and genetic studies are constrained by incomplete penetrance and small family sizes. Neuroimaging endophenotypes shared by patients and unaffected relatives can reveal genetic liability independently of clinical manifestation and offer a strategy for advancing gene discovery. We developed DystoniaGeneNet, a 3D convolutional neural network that predicts familial status from T1-weighted brain MRIs. We then used its predictions to guide genetic analyses in isolated focal dystonia. DystoniaGeneNet was trained on 40 patients with familial laryngeal dystonia and 40 healthy controls, then applied to independent cohorts of 21 patients with familial isolated focal dystonia, 364 patients with sporadic dystonia, and 98 unaffected relatives. Model predictions were incorporated into variant prioritization and segregation analysis in 214 individuals with whole-exome sequencing data, and results were replicated in another 738 independent exomes, in genetic data from a hospital-based biobank (892 dystonia cases, 2,475 controls), and in the All of Us Research Program genetic data (1,343 dystonia cases, 6,840 controls). DystoniaGeneNet discriminated familial dystonia from healthy controls in the training set and correctly classified 85.7% of independent familial cases, using a biomarker centred on the corpus callosum and inferior temporal gyrus. Across the discovery and replication cohorts, we identified rare, likely pathogenic genetic variants in RAP1GAP and TNN segregating with disease in families. Additional variants were found in singletons with isolated focal dystonia. In patients with clinically sporadic dystonia but predicted to have familial features, we observed multiple rare variants in ITSN2 , including three high-confidence loss-of-function variants, and an enrichment of damaging missense variants in its Dbl homology domain. To determine the functional impact of discovered genetic variants, we assessed gene expression and splicing via qPCR and RNA sequencing ( n = 74), revealing reduced RAP1GAP and ITSN2 expression in variant carriers. At the pathway level, rare nonsynonymous variants in brain-expressed matrisome genes were associated with dystonia ( P = 0.012). Our strategy utilizing a deep learning-derived neuroimaging endophenotype to empower gene discovery uncovered RAP1GAP, TNN , and ITSN2 as novel genes associated with isolated focal dystonia. These genes converge on perisynaptic extracellular matrix-synapse signalling, implicating a mechanism linked to synaptic plasticity deficits, and identifying a molecular substrate for network-level brain abnormalities that characterize this disorder. Further, we exemplify a generalizable framework for leveraging endophenotypes in rare neurogenetic diseases with incomplete penetrance.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用脑MRI内表型（胼胝体与颞下回）连接局灶性肌张力障碍的遗传变异与脑网络异常机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对孤立性局灶性肌张力障碍遗传基础不明的问题，构建了基于T1加权脑MRI的深度学习模型DystoniaGeneNet，以预测家族性特征并指导基因分析。模型能较好区分家族性患者与健康对照，其预测被用于变异优先级排序和共分离分析，在发现与多个独立复制数据集中识别出RAP1GAP、TNN和ITSN2的罕见可能致病变异，且变异携带者相应基因表达降低。脑表达的基质体基因罕见非同义变异也与疾病相关。作者据此提出，这些基因汇聚于突触周围细胞外基质—突触信号，可能通过突触可塑性缺陷解释该病的网络层面脑异常，并展示了利用内表型推进罕见神经遗传病基因发现的框架。

papers.title: Auditory Stimulation-Evoked Frontoparietal Theta Asymmetry for Subtype Classification and Long-Term Prognosis Prediction in Disorders of Consciousness.
papers.authors: Chen C, Hu Y, Wang S, Zhang X, Zheng S, Han J, Wang K.
papers.abstract: Background : Quantitative electroencephalography (qEEG) facilitates the objective assessment of residual brain function in patients with disorders of consciousness (DOC), which addresses the intrinsic limitations of behavioral assessment methods. Nevertheless, the characteristics of frontoparietal neural oscillation asymmetry between resting state and auditory stimulation state have not been fully elucidated, and its incremental prognostic value for DOC subtype classification and outcome prediction remains to be confirmed. Methods : Fifty-seven patients with DOC and 23 healthy controls completed qEEG recordings at baseline and during auditory stimulation. Interhemispheric asymmetry indices of the frontal lobe and parietal lobe were calculated for the theta band and alpha band. Linear mixed-effects models (LMMs) were adopted to test the main effects and interaction effects of diagnosis, brain region and stimulation condition. The correlations between asymmetry indicators, Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (CRS-R) scores and 6-month Glasgow Outcome Scale (GOS) scores were analyzed. Nested logistic regression and Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis were performed to quantify the incremental prognostic value of oscillatory asymmetry beyond conventional clinical variables; odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated for all predictive indicators. Internal leave-one-out cross-validation and external cohort validation were performed to assess the generalizability and robustness of the final prognostic model. Results : Significant diagnosis × region interaction effects were observed in both frequency bands. Vegetative state (VS) patients presented with frontal-dominant asymmetry, while minimally conscious state (MCS) patients showed parietal-dominant asymmetry; this dissociative pattern was significantly amplified after auditory stimulation. Only stimulation-evoked theta asymmetry showed consistent correlations with clinical status and prognosis: frontal theta asymmetry was negatively correlated with CRS-R scores, while parietal theta asymmetry was positively correlated with CRS-R scores and 6-month GOS outcomes. Incorporating stimulated frontoparietal theta asymmetry significantly improved prognostic performance, and the area under the curve (AUC) of the optimal model reached 0.930. Conclusions : VS and MCS present distinct frontoparietal oscillatory asymmetry phenotypes, which are specifically enhanced by auditory stimulation. Stimulation-evoked theta band asymmetry can reflect residual conscious function and provides incremental prognostic value for long-term functional recovery, with robust generalizability verified by internal and external validation.

relevance.reason: 研究意识障碍患者听觉刺激下额顶theta偏侧化与残余意识功能及预后，涉及意识神经机制与自然刺激（听觉）情境脑活动。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨意识障碍患者额顶叶神经振荡不对称性在静息与听觉刺激下的特征，并检验其对亚型分类和预后预测的增量价值；57名患者与23名健康对照完成脑电记录，比较额叶和顶叶theta与alpha频段的半球间不对称指数。结果显示，植物状态患者表现为额叶优势不对称，微意识状态患者表现为顶叶优势不对称，这种分离模式在听觉刺激后明显增强；仅刺激诱发的theta不对称与临床状态和预后一致相关，额叶theta不对称与CRS-R评分负相关，顶叶theta不对称与CRS-R评分及6个月结局正相关。将刺激诱发的额顶叶theta不对称纳入模型可显著提升预后预测表现，最优模型AUC达0.930，并经内部和外部验证支持其泛化性；作者据此认为该指标可反映残余意识功能，为长期功能恢复预测提供增量信息。

papers.title: Age and sex differences in T1 relaxation times and volumetrics in segmented brain and upper cervical spine in healthy participants using MP2RAGE protocol at 3.0 T.
papers.authors: Nguyen VS, Welch T, Penano S, Matache IM, Arndt N, Bydon M, Carroll TJ, Javed A.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose To examine the influence of age and sex on T1 relaxation and volume in brain and upper cervical cord using MP2RAGE, which offers high contrast-to-noise ratio, uniform tissue contrast, and superior anatomical resolution alongside T1 mapping. This provides an accurate analysis of the magnitude of the effects of these covariates on the outcomes. Materials and methods 208 MP2RAGE scans from the Max Planck Institute Leipzig Mind-Brain-Body LEMON dataset were segmented and labeled using FreeSurfer and Spinal Cord Toolbox. The influences of age and sex on dependent variables were analyzed using linear regression and group difference were compared using the Mann-Whitney U test. Results T1 values of cortical gray matter (GM), cerebral white matter (WM), thalamus, caudate, putamen, hippocampus, amygdala, and anterior corpus callosum (CC) varied significantly with age. Cortical GM and cervical C1 T1 showed statistical significance with sex, with latter lower in the females compared to males. T1 values of the posterior CC were significantly lower than the anterior portion. GM, WM, thalamus, caudate, putamen, hippocampus and anterior CC volumes were significantly affected by age. Spine cross-sectional area (CSA) showed statistically significant differences with sex but not age. Conclusions T1, regional brain volumes, and spinal CSA vary according to anatomical location, age, and sex, reflecting physiological differences associated with aging and sex. These results can operate as a normative baseline to gauge the magnitude of effect of these covariates on future studies in health or disease.

relevance.reason: 研究健康人脑灰白质及皮层下结构T1弛豫时间与体积随年龄和性别变化，属脑结构组织与发育/老化意义。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于健康参与者的MP2RAGE扫描，结合脑与上颈髓分割，考察年龄和性别对T1弛豫时间及体积的影响。结果显示，多个皮层灰质、白质及皮层下结构的T1值随年龄变化，皮层灰质和颈髓C1的T1值存在性别差异，女性C1的T1值更低；多个脑区体积受年龄影响，而脊髓横截面积与性别相关、与年龄无关。作者认为这些差异反映了衰老和性别相关的生理变化，可作为未来健康或疾病研究中评估协变量效应大小的参考基线。

papers.title: The Association Between Cardiorespiratory Fitness and White Matter Integrity Across the Lifespan: A Systematic Review
papers.authors: de Oliveira RM, Lox C.
papers.abstract: White matter deterioration is a hallmark of cognitive aging and a core feature of manyneurodegenerative disorders. Cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) has emerged as a modifiable factorthat may support white matter integrity across the adult lifespan. This systematic review, using anarrative synthesis, examined findings from 24 studies, identified through a systematic search ofPubMed, Web of Science, and PsycINFO databases, examining the association betweenobjectively measured CRF and neuroimaging-based white matter structure. Results revealed aconsistent positive relationship between higher CRF and stronger microstructural integrity,particularly in late-myelinating tracts such as the corpus callosum, cingulum, and longitudinalfasciculi. These associations were minimal in young adulthood, mixed in midlife, and mostrobust in adults over 60, suggesting an age-dependent neuroprotective effect that strengthensacross the lifespan. Higher CRF was also linked to reduced white matter hyperintensity (WMH)burden in older populations. While cross-sectional evidence for this relationship was largelyconsistent, findings from randomized controlled trials were considerably more mixed, with mostintervention studies failing to detect group-level improvements in white matter microstructuredespite confirmed fitness gains. These findings underscore the potential of CRF as a nonpharmacological strategy to preserve brain health and mitigate cognitive decline with age. Futureresearch should adopt longitudinal and multimodal designs to clarify causal mechanisms andidentify age-specific moderators of these effects. Keywords: cardiorespiratory fitness, white matter, fractional anisotropy, aging, aerobic exercise

relevance.reason: 系统综述考察心肺适能与白质微结构完整性（胼胝体、扣带、纵束等）的关联及其随年龄变化，属白质结构与脑健康关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统检索并叙述性整合了24项研究，考察客观测量的心肺适能与基于神经影像的白质结构之间的关联。结果显示，较高的心肺适能与更强的白质微结构完整性呈较一致的正相关，尤其在胼胝体、扣带束和纵束等晚髓鞘化纤维束中；这种关联在青年期很弱，中年期结果不一，在60岁以上成人中最明显，提示可能存在随年龄增强的神经保护作用，老年人中较高适能还与较低的白质高信号负担相关。横断面证据较为一致，但随机对照试验结果明显更混杂，多数干预研究尽管体能确有提升，却未检测到组水平白质微结构改善。作者据此强调心肺适能作为非药物策略的潜力，同时指出因果机制尚待纵向和多模态研究澄清。

papers.title: The Influence of Contralesional Brain Age Gradients on Chronic Stroke Aphasia Severity and Treatment Response.
papers.authors: Riccardi N, Martin A, Rangus I, Busby N, Rorden C, Fridriksson J, Bonilha L.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: The adult brain follows normative aging trajectories, yet stroke abruptly disrupts this process. Beyond the focal lesion, undamaged regions can deviate from expected aging due to diaschisis or pre-existing vulnerabilities, reflecting tissue health that may constrain recovery. Chronic post-stroke aphasia, a persistent language disorder, shows wide individual variability in severity and treatment response, and these differences are not fully captured by lesion characteristics or demographic factors. Further, prior imaging biomarkers have been difficult to scale because they rely on specialized acquisitions or nonstandardized analytical pipelines. Here, we used a standardized, lifespan-informed brain age model (volBrain) trained on large public datasets to quantify regional deviations from normative aging using only routine structural MRI (T1-weighted). In 188 individuals with chronic stroke (67 female, 121 male), regional aging deviations in the contralesional hemisphere explained aphasia severity beyond lesion volume, lesion location, and basic demographics. In a treated subgroup, baseline brain aging patterns also predicted language gains that persisted 6 months after therapy, indicating prognostic value. By characterizing how individual brains diverge from expected aging, this approach captures variation in tissue integrity that is relevant for both impairment and recovery. This provides a scalable framework that can be integrated across sites and studies, linking normative aging models with post-stroke prognostics and informing precision neurorehabilitation.

relevance.reason: 研究卒中后失语症患者对侧半球区域脑龄偏差与语言严重度及治疗反应的关系，属语言脑机制与脑损伤可塑性/结构-功能。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性卒中后失语症的严重程度和治疗反应为何存在较大个体差异，并检验对侧半球区域偏离正常脑老化轨迹能否提供病灶之外的信息。研究利用基于常规结构MRI的标准化脑龄模型，在慢性卒中人群中量化各脑区相对预期老化的偏差。结果显示，对侧半球的区域老化偏差在病灶体积、位置和基本人口学因素之外仍能解释失语严重程度；在接受治疗的亚组中，基线脑老化模式还能预测治疗后持续数月的语言改善，提示其预后价值。作者据此提出，这一可扩展的框架将规范老化模型与卒中后预后评估联系起来，有望用于精准神经康复，但相关预测价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Dopamine Modulates Striatal Activity When Controlling the Output of Working Memory.
papers.authors: Nielsen NM, Calcott RD, van den Bosch R, Olraun HS, Spronkers FS, Verkes RJ, den Ouden HEM, Cools R.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Cognitive control depends on capacity-limited mechanisms that require selection. Working memory (WM) therefore relies on an input-gate to filter information into WM and an output-gate to transform current WM representations into a prioritized state to guide behavior. According to current theory, such WM gating processes are modulated by dopamine in the striatum, yet empirical evidence for this hypothesis remains sparse. We fill this gap by directly testing the role of dopamine for both WM input- and output-gating in a double-blind, placebo-controlled within-subject functional magnetic resonance imaging study (N = 34; 23 female, 11 male human subjects), using a 400 mg oral dose of the dopamine D2 receptor antagonist sulpiride. In our cued delayed-response task, which separated input- from output-gating, sulpiride altered neural activity in the striatum during output-gating. This effect was accompanied by a sulpiride-induced decrease in the neural stimulus-selectivity of gated sensory representations in visual association cortex, with greater decreases in stimulus-selectivity correlating with reduced behavioral accuracy in the task. Together, the results establish a role for striatal dopamine during the control of cortical outflow of WM.

relevance.reason: 采用双盲安慰剂对照fMRI和D2拮抗剂，研究多巴胺调控纹状体在工作记忆输出门控中的神经活动及其与视觉皮层表征选择性的关系，属工作记忆与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨多巴胺是否参与工作记忆的输入门控与输出门控，采用双盲、安慰剂对照的被试内功能磁共振设计，让健康被试服用多巴胺D2受体拮抗剂舒必利后完成可区分两类门控的线索延迟反应任务。结果显示，舒必利主要改变输出门控期间的纹状体活动，并伴随视觉联合皮层中受门控感觉表征的神经刺激选择性下降，且选择性下降越多，任务行为正确率越低。作者据此认为纹状体多巴胺参与调控工作记忆向皮层输出的过程，但这一结论基于药物干预下的健康被试，尚不能直接推及临床治疗。

papers.title: Neurophysiological dynamics related to perception, action, and language in schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Wei HT, Boutet D, Dou R, Ahrens J, Zeramdini N, Voppel A, Gonzales-Aste F, Abboud F, Baillet S, Palaniyappan L.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia disrupts both how people perceive the world and how they express and act on their thoughts, yet these symptoms are usually studied separately. Using magnetoencephalography during multisensory and motor tasks, we tested whether reduced event-related beta-band (15 to 30 hertz) modulation, a signal implicated in predictive control, provides a candidate neural marker across these domains. Compared to healthy individuals, patients showed diminished beta changes during sensory processing and movement completion, suggesting reduced flexibility in updating internal models. This neural pattern covaried with audiovisual simultaneity-judgment behavior, disorganized natural speech, and greater clinical severity. These findings suggest that distributed beta modulation may serve as a candidate cross-domain marker associated with perceptual, motor, and language disturbances in schizophrenia, motivating future studies that directly test predictive updating mechanisms.

relevance.reason: MEG研究精神分裂症患者beta振荡与感知、运动及语言障碍的关联，涉及人脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症患者的感知、动作与语言障碍是否共享同一神经生理基础，用脑磁图在多感觉与运动任务中比较患者与健康人的事件相关β频段调制。结果显示，患者在感觉加工和动作完成阶段的β变化减弱，提示其更新内部模型的灵活性下降；这一神经模式与视听同时性判断行为、自然言语的组织性以及临床严重程度相关。作者据此提出，分布式的β调制可能作为跨领域候选标记，关联精神分裂症的感知、运动与语言异常，但相关关系不等于因果，其预测性更新机制仍需未来研究直接检验。

papers.title: Predicting upcoming visual features during eye movements yields scene representations aligned with human visual cortex.
papers.authors: Thorat S, Doerig A, Kroner A, Amme C, Kietzmann TC.
papers.abstract: Natural scenes are complex arrangements of objects, surfaces, and backgrounds. For the brain's visual system to effectively operate, it needs to extract not only what objects are present but also their spatial and semantic relations. We hypothesize that such structures may be learned, in a self-supervised fashion, by exploiting temporal regularities of natural active vision: Each fixation reveals a glimpse that is related to the previous one via co-occurrence and saccade-conditioned spatial regularities. We instantiate this idea with glimpse prediction networks (GPNs), recurrent models trained to predict the embedding of the next glimpse along human-like scanpaths. GPNs are shown to successfully extract complex scene information, including object co-occurrences and spatial object arrangements, and integrate information across glimpses. GPN representations align strongly with human fMRI responses in mid- and higher-level visual cortex and match, often outperform, alternative state-of-the-art ANN models, establishing next-glimpse-prediction as a biologically plausible route toward brain-aligned scene representations.

relevance.reason: 用眼动注视预测模型表征与人类视觉皮层fMRI响应对齐，探讨自然场景视觉加工与脑表征。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出，自然场景中的物体共现与空间关系可能通过主动视觉中相邻注视点之间的时间规律以自监督方式习得，并用循环神经网络构建“注视预测网络”，训练其沿类人扫视路径预测下一注视片段的嵌入表示。结果显示，这类模型能提取物体共现和空间布局等复杂场景信息，并整合跨注视片段的信息；其表征与人类视觉皮层中高级区域的fMRI反应高度对齐，且常优于其他先进人工神经网络模型。作者据此认为，预测下一注视片段可能是形成与大脑对齐的场景表征的一条生物学上合理的途径，但这一结论主要基于表征相似性，尚不涉及因果机制或临床应用。

papers.title: EEG Edge-Centric Dynamics Reveal Distinct Post-Stroke Somatosensory Network Responses to Vibratory and Electrical Stimulation.
papers.authors: Lin L, Liao J, Huang Y, Qing W, Ye F, Rong W, Li W, Jiao J, Hu X, Ma T.
papers.journal: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics
papers.abstract: Stroke-induced somatosensory deficits disrupt sensorimotor integration (SMI) and limit motor recovery, yet the immediate network-level effects of different somatosensory interventions remain unclear, hindering patient-specific rehabilitation planning. We propose an informatics framework based on edge-centric dynamic connectivity (ECDC) to characterize transient, whole-brain EEG network responses to sensory-level focal vibratory stimulation (FVS) and neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES). We analyzed EEG recordings from 15 chronic stroke participants and 15 healthy controls during forearm stimulation and quantified temporal network dynamics, spectral network organization, and interhemispheric interactions from instantaneous overlapping functional networks. Compared with NMES, FVS in stroke participants induced a distinct neurophysiological profile, including (i) shorter global theta-network latency, suggesting faster attentional engagement; (ii) higher contralesional alpha network diversity, indicating enhanced somatosensory recruitment; and (iii) reduced theta-alpha phase-amplitude coupling, reflecting decoupled interhemispheric interactions that may support adaptive reorganization. These findings provide interpretable network signatures for differentiating stimulation-specific brain responses and suggest a data driven route toward personalized SMI rehabilitation.

relevance.reason: 研究卒中患者感觉刺激下的EEG全脑网络动态与半球间交互，属脑损伤后认知/感觉网络重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注卒中后感觉障碍患者在接受不同感觉刺激时，全脑网络层面的即时反应有何差异，并为此提出基于边中心动态连接（ECDC）的脑电分析框架，比较局灶振动刺激（FVS）与神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）下的网络动态。结果显示，与NMES相比，FVS在卒中参与者中呈现出不同的神经生理特征：全局theta网络潜伏期更短，提示注意参与更快；对侧alpha网络多样性更高，提示感觉募集增强；theta-alpha相位-幅值耦合降低，反映半球间交互解耦，可能有利于适应性重组。作者认为，这些网络特征可用于区分不同刺激引起的大脑反应，并为数据驱动的个体化感觉运动整合康复提供线索，但尚属初步探索。

papers.title: Regional blood-brain barrier dysfunction maps to lower performance in cognitive ageing.
papers.authors: Mirloo S, Shpilberg S, Druker N, Saar-Ashkenazy R, Prager O, Neustaedter SB, Ben-Arie G, Shelef I, Kamintsky L, Serlin Y, Sandsmark DK, Friedman A, Shalev H.
papers.abstract: Age-related cognitive decline is a common and growing public health challenge, associated with loss of independence, reduced quality of life, increased caregiver burden and substantial healthcare and societal costs. Yet cognitive decline in ageing is heterogeneous, and current clinical constructs do not reliably capture the underlying biological mechanisms or predict progression to dementia. This cross-sectional study examined whether blood-brain barrier dysfunction (BBBD) provides a biologically supported correlate of cognitive performance beyond clinical diagnosis. The study included 46 patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), 46 age-matched controls and 43 young controls. BBBD was assessed using dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI in 42 patients with MCI and all controls, alongside volumetric brain analysis. Standardized NeuroTrax cognitive assessment data were analysed for 41 MCI patients and 19 age-matched controls. BBBD was analysed using the BBBdetect software (Emagix Inc, Nova Scotia, Canada), quantifying voxelwise and region-wise blood-brain barrier permeability; volumetric analysis was performed using the Volbrain software; and cognitive performance was stratified into low- and high-performance subgroups based on modified z-scores. Compared with young controls, the older cohort (MCI patients combined with age-matched controls) showed significantly greater BBBD volume and regional extent. Permeability increased with age and showed marked inter-individual variability. Across participants, lower cognitive performance was associated with a greater number of regions exhibiting BBBD. Receiver operating characteristic analysis identified domain-specific spatial patterns of BBBD linked to poor performance in memory, executive, attention, verbal and motor domains, implicating frontal, cingulate, hippocampal, basal ganglia and cerebellar regions. In contrast, volumetric analyses revealed expected age-related reductions in grey and white matter and cortical thickness along with increased ventricular volume; however, these structural changes showed weak to no associations with cognitive performance. These findings suggest that BBBD is widespread in ageing and that regional BBBD maps to domain-specific cognitive deficits. BBBD thus emerges as a biologically relevant biomarker of age-related cognitive impairment and a potential therapeutic target for preserving cognitive function in ageing.

relevance.reason: 研究老年人血脑屏障通透性区域分布与认知域表现的关系，涉及脑结构与认知老化机制，MCI作为研究对象。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察血脑屏障功能障碍能否在临床诊断之外为认知表现提供有生物学依据的关联。研究比较了轻度认知障碍患者、年龄匹配的老年对照与年轻对照，用动态对比增强MRI评估血脑屏障通透性并结合脑体积分析。结果显示，老年群体的血脑屏障功能障碍范围和区域更广，且随年龄增加并存在明显个体差异；认知表现较低者出现血脑屏障功能障碍的脑区更多，不同认知域对应不同的空间模式，而灰白质体积和皮层厚度等结构变化与认知表现的关联较弱甚至缺失。作者据此认为，区域性的血脑屏障功能障碍与特定认知域缺损相对应，可能作为年龄相关认知损害的生物学标志物及潜在干预靶点，但相关发现尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Towards semantic brain-computer interfacing: The graded inventory of semantic triggers (GIST) paradigm.
papers.authors: Podmore JJ, Radman M, Poli R, Paulmann S, Daly I.
papers.abstract: Objective Semantic Brain-Computer Interfaces (sBCIs) aim to decode conceptual information directly from neural activity, enabling more efficient and natural communication for individuals with severe motor impairments. However, existing approaches are often confounded by stimulus-driven perceptual processes and lack a reliable means of tagging the moment of concept formation. We introduce the Graded Inventory of Semantic Triggers (GIST), a novel electroencephalography (EEG) paradigm designed to elicit semantic retrieval from graded verbal clues with precise temporal alignment. Approach: EEG data were recorded from 14 participants performing the GIST task across three semantic categories (food, musical instruments, and body parts). Target neural activity was aligned to each participant's self-reported moment of semantic retrieval (spacebar press), enabling response-locked analysis. Here, we propose a staged framework where the first comprises a Conformer-based encoder trained on pooled data using a hybrid contrastive objective that combines instance-level consistency and cross-participant class alignment with domain-adversarial learning to reduce participant-specific information. In the second stage, the frozen encoder is transferred to a held-out participant whose data played no part in Stage 1, and a support vector machine is calibrated on that participant's own labelled items under a nested leave-one-item-out protocol. Results: Above-chance semantic decoding was achieved in all three pairwise tasks. Mean accuracies were 73.4% (Body vs. Food), 70.7% (Body vs. Music), and 68.2% (Food vs. Music). Participant-level permutation tests were significant in 9/11 participants for Body vs. Food and 8/11 for each of the other tasks (p < 0.05). The pre-response interval at [-1.5s, -0.5s] was the most discriminative. Significance: The GIST paradigm enables controlled elicitation and temporal alignment of semantic processing while reducing perceptual confounds. Combined with cross-participant representation pretraining and participant-specific calibration, the results demonstrate above-chance decoding of semantic categories from EEG in individuals excluded from representation learning, supporting the feasibility of sBCIs.

relevance.reason: 用EEG解码语义类别，研究人脑语义提取的时间对齐与神经表征，属语言/语义神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出GIST范式，用分级言语线索诱发语义提取，并将脑电活动对齐到受试者自报的语义提取时刻，以减少刺激驱动的知觉混淆。14名受试者完成食物、乐器、身体部位三类语义任务；分析采用跨受试者预训练的Conformer编码器，再在未参与预训练的受试者数据上做个体化校准。结果显示，三组两两分类均高于随机水平，反应前一段时间的区分度最高，但个体层面并非全部显著。作者据此认为，该范式结合跨受试者表征预训练与个体校准，可在未参与表征学习的个体中实现语义类别解码，为语义脑机接口的可行性提供了初步支持。

papers.title: Naturalistic spatial education engages distinct neural processes for mental rotation, cognitive load, and linguistic demands.
papers.authors: Gacetta EB, Laws ML, Aulet LS, Ozaydin TS, Tsay JS, Zapanta C, Cantlon JF.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Neuroscience studies typically isolate spatial cognition using simplified tasks targeting a single cognitive process. However, during formal spatial education, the brain rarely performs one cognitive operation at a time. Here, we used functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) to assess neural systems involved in dynamically processing an educational spatial visualization lesson. We quantified lesson content using an instructional-design framework capturing variation in spatial complexity, cognitive load, and verbal density. We then characterized how instructional demands modulated brain function using content-evoked responses, functional connectivity, and network-centrality. Spatial transformations during instruction robustly recruited parietal and premotor regions, which were linearly modulated by spatial complexity. This parietal dominance aligns with theories that these areas encode geometric and quantitative dimensions. In contrast, domain-general frontal activity tracked overall processing demands, and language regions tracked verbal density. Activity also varied with learners' spatial abilities: higher spatial performers showed stronger modulation of parietal and premotor regions as spatial demands increased, and greater domain-general modulation across content types. Thus, the same circuitry representing spatial transformations during instruction also reflects individual variation in spatial cognition. Parietal regions showed the highest centrality and strongest within-network coherence, marking them as the central hub of the system, and distinguishing them from less central and less coherent domain-general regions. Together, the findings reveal how the brain dynamically decomposes complex spatial instruction, preserving parietal-centered spatial processing, while coordinating support from premotor, domain-general, and language systems. These findings begin to reveal how spatial cognition operates within the complexity of formal instruction.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究自然教育视频中空间认知、认知负荷与语言密度的动态神经加工，涉及顶叶/前运动区、语言区及网络中心性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在正式空间教育中，大脑如何同时处理空间变换、认知负荷和语言需求，而不是在简化任务中只完成单一认知操作。研究者用功能磁共振成像记录学习者观看一段空间可视化教学课程时的脑活动，并用教学设计框架量化课程内容的空间复杂度、认知负荷和语言密度。结果显示，空间变换主要稳定招募顶叶和运动前区，且其活动随空间复杂度线性变化；一般性额叶活动更多跟随整体加工需求，语言区则跟随语言密度。空间能力较高的学习者在空间需求增加时，顶叶和运动前区的调制更强，一般性区域的调制也随内容类型变化更明显。顶叶区域中心性最高、网络内一致性最强，处于该系统的核心位置。作者据此认为，大脑在复杂教学情境中会保留以顶叶为中心的空间加工，同时协调运动前区、一般性认知和语言系统的支持。

papers.title: A New Web-Based Word-Picture Matching Test Reveals Psycholinguistic Effects on Word-Level Reading and Auditory Comprehension in Aphasia.
papers.authors: Laks AB, Kim Y, Kelly CR, DeMarco AT, Turkeltaub PE.
papers.journal: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR
papers.abstract: Purpose Word reading comprehension deficits, often measured by word-to-picture matching (WtPM) tasks, are common in aphasia and alexia. To specify the nature of comprehension deficits, WtPM tasks should manipulate psycholinguistic features, have matched written and auditory versions, and provide normed scores measuring speed and accuracy. Here we present a novel web-based WtPM task that meets those needs. We use it to assess word comprehension deficits in left-hemisphere stroke survivors (LHSS). Method We examined scores for the novel auditory and written WtPM task in a normative sample (n = 62) and an LHSS sample (n = 63). Mixed-effects models examined accuracy and response time in both groups, and an analysis of variance compared efficiency between the groups. Correlations compared written WtPM performance and item difficulty to auditory WtPM, written lexical decision, and oral reading. A k -means clustering analysis examined deficit patterns in the LHSS group. Results WtPM performance was modulated by modality, frequency, and regularity and was impaired in the LHSS group. Written WtPM performance and item difficulty were correlated with auditory WtPM and written lexical decision in both groups and with oral reading in the LHSS group. Over half of the LHSS sample had frank deficits on at least one WtPM task. Comprehension deficits in individual LHSS were often modulated by input modality, word frequency, and regularity. Conclusions We present a clinically accessible WtPM task that captures individual patterns of word comprehension impairment in both written and auditory modalities. The use of efficiency scores allows for the assessment of mild impairments that are missed by ceiling effects on currently available tasks. Input modality, frequency, and regularity affect word comprehension as measured by WtPM. Individual stroke survivors present with different combinations of these effects, which may help to identify specific deficits and spared abilities that can guide reading comprehension treatment. Supplemental material https://doi.org/10.23641/asha.33968839.

relevance.reason: 该研究在左半球卒中失语者中考察书面与听觉词汇理解（词-图匹配）的心理语言学效应，直接涉及语言理解的神经机制与损伤模式。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了一项基于网络的词—图匹配测试，可同时评估书面与听觉词汇理解的速度和准确性，并在健康参照组与左半球卒中幸存者中比较表现。结果显示，两组的表现均受输入通道、词频和规则性影响，卒中组的词—图匹配成绩整体受损，且过半个体至少在一项任务上存在明显缺陷；书面与听觉版本的成绩及条目难度相互关联，个体缺陷模式也可按这些因素区分。作者认为，该测试能捕捉现有任务因天花板效应而遗漏的轻度理解障碍，并帮助识别卒中后阅读理解的特定缺陷与保留能力，为治疗提供参考。

papers.title: Functional architecture of the human insula.
papers.authors: Quabs J, Pantis S, Chen G, Huang W, Ma E, Del Vecchio M, Lyu D, Wang C, Avanzini P, Buch V, Ramayya AG, Caspers S, Vogel H, Parvizi J.
papers.abstract: The insular cortex has a central role in pain1,2 , interoception3,4 and feelings5,6 , yet its functional architecture and causal electrophysiological relationships among its subregions remain poorly understood. Here we combine intracranial electrical stimulation and task-based electroencephalography recordings with connectivity mapping within a cytoarchitectonic atlas of the human insula7-10 in 87 participants implanted with intracranial electrodes, and identify a quadripartite functional architecture comprising four distinct regions: (1) a dorsal-posterior region encoding somatotopically organized nociceptive/thermoceptive and somatosensory signals; (2) a ventral-posterior region with access to somatic information across multiple body parts; (3) a mid-anterior region associated with visceral sensations and anxiety states; and (4) an anterior-polar region, largely silent to direct stimulation, yet showing robust activation during salience detection and change of action mode. Critically, this anterior region, with its strong connections with the prefrontal cortex, including the anterior cingulate cortex, exerts strong and direct influence over other insular regions, while receiving less-strong indirect inputs from them, revealing an electrophysiological pathway for cognitive modulation of pain and bodily perception. Together, these findings define a functional architecture of the human insula that links cytoarchitecture to directed and asymmetric electrophysiological interactions, with mechanistic implications for cognitive modulation of pain and interoceptive experience.

relevance.reason: 颅内电刺激与脑电记录揭示人脑岛叶四分区功能架构及亚区间定向电生理交互，涉及内感受、疼痛与显著性检测的神经机制和结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究结合颅内电刺激、任务脑电记录与连接图谱，在植入颅内电极的参与者中考察人类岛叶的功能架构及其亚区间的因果电生理关系。结果识别出四个功能不同的区域：背侧后部编码按躯体定位组织的痛温觉与躯体感觉信号，腹侧后部可获取多个身体部位的躯体信息，前中部与内脏感觉和焦虑状态相关，前极区对直接刺激反应较弱却在显著性检测和行动模式转换时明显激活。前极区与前额皮层（包括前扣带皮层）连接紧密，对其他岛叶亚区施加较强直接影响而接受较弱间接输入，提示认知调控疼痛和身体感知的电生理通路。研究将细胞构筑与有方向、不对称的电生理交互联系起来，但因果机制及临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The mediating effect of circulating C-reactive protein on the association between depression and brain cortical dysconnectivity.
papers.authors: Shahi S, Hu Z, Zhang Q, Ma D, Li M, Xu Y, Deng Y, Liu K.
papers.abstract: Chronic low grade systemic inflammation is associated in the pathophysiology of major depressive disorder (MDD). However, the specific cortical structural connectivity changes associated with peripheral inflammation in MDD remains poorly understood. In this case-control study, 113 MDD patients and 107 healthy controls underwent 3T MRI and measurement of high sensitivity C-reactive protein (CRP). Fiber connectivity density (FiCD) mapping, a data driven whole-cortex pipeline combining cortical surface reconstruction with diffusion tractography, was used to examine depression and CRP interaction effects on cortical connectivity. A subgroup of MDD patients completed a six-week antidepressant follow-up with repeat MRI. A significant interaction between depression and CRP was identified in the left rostral middle frontal cortex (LRMF). FiCD in the LRMF was significantly lower in MDD patients than controls and negatively correlated with CRP in patients but not controls. Following six weeks of antidepressant treatment, FiCD in LRMF increased significantly, and this increase was negatively correlated with baseline. Peripheral inflammation is possibly associated with disrupted cortical connectivity in MDD and disturbs the brain structural recovery process during antidepressant treatment. The left rostral middle frontal cortex possibly serves as an important target.

relevance.reason: 以MDD患者为对象，结合CRP与扩散MRI纤维连接密度，考察抑郁相关皮层结构连接改变及治疗可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注外周炎症是否参与重性抑郁障碍患者皮层结构连接异常，采用病例对照设计，比较抑郁患者与健康对照的皮层纤维连接密度，并检测循环C反应蛋白水平。结果显示，抑郁与C反应蛋白在左侧额中回前部存在交互作用：患者该区域连接密度低于对照，且与C反应蛋白呈负相关，而对照中未见此关联。部分患者接受抗抑郁治疗后该区域连接密度升高，且升高幅度与基线水平负相关。作者据此推测，外周炎症可能与抑郁患者的皮层连接受损及治疗中的脑结构恢复过程有关，左侧额中回前部可能是重要靶点；但相关结果尚不能确立因果关系。

papers.title: Altered language network microstructure links with impaired language function and development in very preterm/very low birth weight born adults.
papers.authors: Gambarte L, Wendt J, Hippen R, Daamen M, Boecker H, Bartmann P, Wolke D, Schmitz-Koep B, Hedderich DM, Sorg C, Menegaux A.
papers.abstract: Premature birth is associated with impaired language function. In premature-born children, language function has been linked with microstructural alterations of the language network.Whether these brain-language associations persist into adulthood remains unclear. We investigated the microstructural properties of major dorsal and ventral language pathways in very preterm/very low birth weight (VPT/VLBW) adults and their associations with language performance in adulthood and childhood. Sixty-three VPT/VLBW and eighty full-term-born adults (mean age 26.8 years) underwent diffusion-weighted imaging and language assessment. The arcuate fasciculus, superior longitudinal fasciculus, uncinate fasciculus and inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus were reconstructed using probabilistic tractography from which fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) measures were extracted. Adult language function was assessed via the Regensburg word fluency test, rapid automatized naming and verbal IQ; childhood language was assessed at the mean age of 8 using the Kaufman Assessment Battery for children. We observed altered language network microstructure in VPT/VLBW participants, illustrated by lower FA and higher MD in the SLF and UF. These microstructural alterations were associated with language function in adulthood, but also with language development in childhood. We found that the association between tract microstructure and language abilities differed between groups. Our results demonstrate altered language network microstructure in premature born adults, which links with impaired language function and development. These findings extend previous work by comprehensively characterizing the adult dorsal and ventral language network and relating its microstructural properties to language function across development. The selective follow-up sample may limit generalizability to the broader VPT/VLBW population.

relevance.reason: 该研究考察早产成人语言通路微结构与语言功能及发育的关联，直接涉及语言纤维束与语言功能的脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察极早产/极低出生体重成人的语言网络微结构是否改变，以及这些改变是否与其成年期语言表现和童年期语言发展相关。研究对极早产/极低出生体重成人和足月出生成人进行弥散加权成像与语言评估，重建背侧和腹侧语言通路并提取微结构指标。结果显示，极早产/极低出生体重成人在上纵束和钩束表现出微结构改变，且这些改变与成年期语言功能及童年期语言发展均有关联，但通路微结构与语言能力之间的关联在两组间存在差异。作者据此认为，早产成人存在语言网络微结构改变，并与语言功能受损及发展相关；同时提示该随访样本的选择性可能限制结果外推。

papers.title: When brain networks crash: connectivity, slow-wave activity and neural replay in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Pini L, Campuzano C, Zhang L, Imbimbo BP, Allegra M.
papers.abstract: Brain connectivity disruption is a hallmark of neurodegenerative disorders, including Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet how network breakdown gives rise to cognitive deficits remains unclear. Here, we review the evidence bearing on three interconnected processes that have been proposed to link molecular pathology to cognitive decline. First, we summarize evidence that misfolded proteins propagate along brain connectivity pathways, making the connectome the biological substrate for disease progression. Second, we discuss the divergent trajectory reported across the AD continuum, an initial compensatory hyperconnectivity followed by progressive hypoconnectivity and network collapse, together with the accompanying oscillatory changes (intrusion of slow-wave activity and suppression of fast oscillatory rhythms). Third, we examine the proposal that these oscillatory alterations compromise neural replay mechanisms, critical for memory consolidation, representing the potential link between network dysfunction and cognitive decline. By integrating evidence from human neuroimaging, electrophysiology, and animal models in the AD field, this framework offers new perspectives for therapeutic interventions targeting brain connectivity and replay mechanisms in neurodegenerative diseases.

relevance.reason: 综述阿尔茨海默病中脑连接崩溃、慢波活动与神经重放如何导致记忆等认知衰退，聚焦人脑网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕阿尔茨海默病中脑网络崩溃如何导致认知障碍这一问题，梳理了三个相互关联的过程。作者指出，错误折叠蛋白可沿脑连接通路传播，使连接组成为疾病进展的生物学基础；在疾病连续过程中，连接性可能先出现代偿性过度连接，继而转为进行性低连接和网络崩溃，并伴随慢波活动侵入与快节律受抑等振荡改变。综述进一步讨论，这些振荡变化可能损害对记忆巩固至关重要的神经重放机制，从而构成网络功能障碍与认知衰退之间的潜在联系。文章整合了人类神经影像、电生理和动物模型证据，提出以脑连接和重放机制为靶点的干预视角，但相关因果链条仍属待验证的框架性假设。

papers.title: Treatment-associated structural connectome reorganization following high-frequency rTMS in major depressive disorder: A low- and high-order connectivity study.
papers.authors: Guan M, Wang Z, Liu N, Tang N, Xie Y, Wang H.
papers.abstract: Background High-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) of the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) is an established treatment for major depressive disorder (MDD), but associated changes in structural-connectome topology remains unclear. Specifically, higher-order structural connectivity (HOSC), defined by similarities between regional structural connectivity profiles, may provide information beyond direct low-order structural connectivity (LOSC). Methods Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) data were acquired from 23 patients with MDD before and after 10-Hz rTMS and from 30 matched healthy controls (HCs). LOSC networks were constructed based on deterministic tractography, whereas HOSC networks were derived from similarities between regional LOSC profiles. Graph-theoretical analysis and network-based statistics were employed to characterize topological and subnetwork differences. Results Depressive symptoms decreased significantly after treatment. Global LOSC topology remained stable, whereas HOSC showed case-control differences in network segregation and post-treatment differences in small-world organization relative to HCs. Network-based analysis revealed focal strengthening of a left insula-hippocampal-inferior temporal component in LOSC and distributed HOSC variation involving cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical circuitry, particularly the thalamus and caudate. Nodal analyses further identified treatment-associated centrality changes involving the thalamus and hippocampus. Conclusion High-frequency rTMS treatment was associated with coordinated structural-connectome variation across low- and high-order network organization in MDD. These findings should be interpreted as treatment-associated changes rather than effects attributable specifically to rTMS and suggest that HOSC may provide a complementary representation of network variation accompanying clinical improvement.

relevance.reason: 该研究用DTI追踪重度抑郁症患者rTMS治疗前后的结构连接组重组，属于以脑疾病理解脑网络组织与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨重度抑郁症患者接受左侧背外侧前额叶高频rTMS治疗后，结构连接组拓扑是否发生改变，并比较低阶结构连接与基于区域连接剖面相似性的高阶结构连接。研究对患者治疗前后及健康对照进行弥散张量成像，结合图论和网络统计分析。结果显示抑郁症状显著减轻，全局低阶拓扑保持稳定，而高阶网络在网络分离和小世界组织上呈现与对照的差异及治疗前后变化；网络层面可见低阶中左侧岛叶-海马-颞下成分的局部增强，高阶则涉及皮层-纹状体-丘脑-皮层环路的分布式变化，节点分析还提示丘脑和海马的中心性改变。作者强调这些应理解为与治疗相伴的变化，而非特异地归因于rTMS，并认为高阶连接可补充反映临床改善伴随的网络变化。

papers.title: Right putaminal gray matter change tracks psychomotor recovery after accelerated iTBS in melancholic treatment-resistant depression.
papers.authors: Mao D, Wu GR, Cavendish BA, De Smet S, De Witte S, Baeken C.
papers.abstract: Background Psychomotor retardation is a prominent and disabling feature of melancholic depression. Accelerated intermittent theta-burst stimulation (aiTBS) may hasten antidepressant effects, but neural substrates of early symptom improvement remain unclear. Given the central role of frontostriatal circuitry in motivation and behavioral activation, structural alterations in the striatum may represent a possible neural substrate of early therapeutic change. Methods Structural MRI was acquired from 61 patients with melancholic TRD and 77 healthy controls, and voxel-based morphometry was used to assess baseline striatal gray matter volume differences. Patients then underwent a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial of left dorsolateral prefrontal aiTBS, comprising 20 sessions over four days. In 50 patients with complete pre- and post-treatment data, we tested whether GMV change in the baseline-identified striatal region was associated with clinical change in the active and sham groups (n = 25 each). Results Patients showed greater right putamen GMV than controls at baseline. After active aiTBS, greater right putamen GMV increase was associated with greater psychomotor retardation improvement. This association was absent after sham stimulation and was not observed for overall depression severity. Conclusion The right putamen appears structurally altered in melancholic TRD. After active aiTBS, short-term putamen GMV increase was associated with psychomotor rather than broader depressive improvement. This pattern should not be interpreted as structural normalization but may reflect a relationship between putaminal change and early psychomotor recovery.

relevance.reason: 以忧郁型难治性抑郁患者为对象，用结构MRI追踪iTBS后右侧壳核灰质体积变化与精神运动恢复的关联，属脑疾病中结构-认知机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注忧郁型难治性抑郁症患者的精神运动迟滞，以及加速间歇性θ爆发刺激（aiTBS）早期改善可能对应的神经结构基础。研究者比较患者与健康对照的纹状体灰质体积，并在随机双盲假刺激对照试验中检验治疗前后体积变化与临床变化的关系。结果发现，患者基线右侧壳核灰质体积高于对照；接受真刺激后，右侧壳核灰质体积增加越多，精神运动迟滞改善越明显，而该关联在假刺激组及总体抑郁严重度中均未出现。作者强调，这不应被解读为结构正常化，而可能反映壳核变化与早期精神运动恢复之间的联系。

papers.title: Thalamocortical dysconnectivity shapes cortical hierarchy disruption across illness durations in schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Huang H, Palaniyappan L, Li H, Zhou J, Tang Y, Hou C, Liu Z, He H, Jiang S, Jin L, Yi Q, Tang Y, Wang J, Cui LB, Rodriguez-Labrada R, Chang X, Feng J, Jiang Y, Yao D, Luo C.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia is increasingly conceptualized as a disorder of circuit-level dysfunction. However, how thalamocortical abnormalities differ across cohorts with varying illness durations and relate to large-scale cortical hierarchical organization remains unclear. Methods We analyzed resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data from 1,223 patients with schizophrenia and 1,224 matched healthy controls across 12 datasets. The datasets were grouped as early-, middle-, and late-stage cohorts. Connectivity gradient mapping was applied to characterize thalamocortical organization, and computational modeling evaluated simulated hierarchical changes after modifying thalamic-salience connectivity. Results We identified a schizophrenia-relevant sensorimotor-salience-association axis that captures systematic differences in thalamocortical abnormality profiles across the stage cohorts. Along this axis, case-control effects in association regions were positive in the early-stage cohort but negative in the middle- and late-stage cohorts, whereas sensorimotor regions showed the converse pattern. This cross-cohort pattern was accompanied by reduced cortical hierarchical separation in cohorts with longer illness duration. In contrast, salience-related thalamic regions showed negative case-control effects in all three stage cohorts, with larger effect sizes in the middle- and late-stage cohorts, and these alterations were associated with clinical symptoms. Computational modification of thalamic-salience connectivity increased simulated cortical hierarchical differentiation, particularly in the middle-stage cohort. Conclusions These findings indicate that thalamocortical dysconnectivity, centered on disrupted thalamic-salience interactions, is associated with systematic differences in cortical hierarchical organization across cohorts. The cross-cohort pattern of salience-related abnormalities highlights thalamic-salience coupling as a circuit-level link to cortical hierarchical differentiation and a candidate for future mechanistic and interventional investigation.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用静息态功能磁共振成像，考察精神分裂症患者丘脑-皮层失连接与皮层层级组织的关系，属于脑疾病机制与脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症中丘脑-皮层连接异常如何随病程变化，以及其与皮层层级组织的关系。作者汇总多套静息态功能磁共振数据，比较早、中、晚病程患者与匹配健康对照，并用连接梯度刻画丘脑-皮层组织、以计算模型模拟改变丘脑-显著网络连接后的层级变化。结果显示，患者存在一条感觉运动-显著网络-联合皮层的异常轴：联合区与感觉运动区的病例对照效应方向在不同病程组间相反，病程较长组的皮层层级分离降低；丘脑显著网络相关区域的异常在各组均存在，中晚期更明显并与临床症状相关。模拟增强丘脑-显著网络连接可提高皮层层级分化，提示这一耦合可能是连接异常与层级组织差异的回路层面环节，但研究为横断面关联，尚不能说明因果或治疗作用。

papers.title: Neurotransmitter-defined cerebral vulnerability patterns in frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD).
papers.authors: Tahedl M, Toomey A, Mandal N, Mangan S, Siah WF, Tan EL, Hardiman O, Kleinerova J, McKenna MC, Hutchinson S, Lope J, Bede P.
papers.abstract: Background Frontotemporal dementia syndromes encompass a genetically, clinically and radiologically heterogeneous set of conditions with distinctive clinical and imaging characteristics. The main FTD phenotypes exhibit strikingly different disease burden patterns with a predilection to specific brain regions and relative sparing of others. The apparent selectivity of cerebral involvement in FTD has not been fully elucidated. Methods A prospective neuroimaging study has been undertaken with a uniform imaging protocol to characterise atrophy patterns in ALS-FTD, behavioural variant FTD, nonfluent variant primary progressive aphasia, and semantic variant primary progressive aphasia and evaluate associations with physiological neurotransmitter receptor expression maps. Anatomical correlations between focal volume loss and a large panel of neurotransmitters were systematically evaluated and associations ranked. Results Associations were noted with GABAergic, opioid, cannabinoid, microglial and acetylcholine systems in ALSFTD-C9NEG. Correlations were observed with opioid, glutaminergic, and synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A receptor populations in ALSFTD-C9POS. Atrophy in bvFTD showed predilection to serotonergic, glutaminergic, opioid, GABAergic and cannabinoid circuits. Volume loss in nfvPPA colocalised with GABAergic, opioid, microglial, serotonergic, cannabinoid, acetylcholine, glutaminergic and dopaminergic networks. A multitude of neurotransmitter populations are implicated in svPPA including opioid, serotonergic, GABAergic, dopaminergic, and microglial systems. Discussion The distinctive neuroimaging signatures of FTD phenotypes exhibit spatial associations with physiological neurotransmitter receptor density maps. The propensity of atrophy to specific brain regions in FTD subtypes may be defined by neurotransmitter populations. Our findings indirectly support the notion of neurotransmitter-system defined connectivity-based disease propagation in FTD.

relevance.reason: 研究FTD各亚型脑萎缩模式与神经递质受体分布的空间关联，以脑疾病理解脑组织易损性和网络传播机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用统一影像协议的前瞻性神经影像方法，刻画肌萎缩侧索硬化-额颞叶痴呆（ALS-FTD）、行为变异型额颞叶痴呆、非流利变异型原发进行性失语和语义变异型原发进行性失语的脑萎缩模式，并系统评估其与生理性神经递质受体表达图谱的空间关联。结果显示，各表型的局灶性体积丢失与不同递质系统存在关联，涉及GABA能、阿片、大麻素、谷氨酸能、血清素能、胆碱能、多巴胺能及小胶质等系统，且关联组合随表型而异。作者据此提出，FTD亚型萎缩好发于特定脑区可能由神经递质群体所界定，并间接支持以神经递质系统定义的连接性病变传播假说；这些关联性发现尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Mapping the brain signature of dyslexia risk onto histamine, acetylcholine and glutamate receptor systems
papers.authors: Çelik MC, Çiçek Y, Şakiroğlu MA, Aslan D, Altunç AT, Velioğlu HA.
papers.abstract: The brain differences of dyslexia are well described and its genetic risk is now measurable; the brain systems that connect the two are unknown. That link decides which measures complement one another in early identification and which systems intervention research should examine. Here we compared large-scale polygenic score maps of brain structure in dyslexia with normative maps of brain neurotransmitter systems. The structural signature of genetic liability aligned with the cortical distribution of neurotransmitter systems. The strongest and most consistent alignment appeared for the histamine H3 receptor, the vesicular acetylcholine transporter (VAChT) and the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) glutamate receptor. The alignment was most pronounced in cingulate, medial and superior frontal cortex and the paracentral lobule. The H3 alignment held after adjustment for cortical position and for metabolic and cognitive reference maps. Once the component common to all nineteen maps and position were removed together, no individual system remained significant, while the shared component itself aligned with liability. The signature therefore follows the topography these systems share. In 169 children, per-person alignment with the H3 map related to reading skill with the opposite sign to liability. To our knowledge, this is the first study to relate the structural signature of genetic liability for dyslexia to normative maps of neurotransmitter receptor and transporter density. It places that signature within the shared geography of the systems that set attention, arousal and synaptic plasticity during learning, and gives the genetics of dyslexia a testable biological axis.
