papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阅读障碍遗传风险与脑结构差异之间缺乏可测生物学桥梁的问题，将阅读障碍的大规模多基因评分脑结构图谱与规范性神经递质系统图谱进行比较。结果发现，遗传易感性的结构特征与组胺H3受体、囊泡乙酰胆碱转运体和NMDA谷氨酸受体的皮层分布对齐最明显，尤其在扣带、内侧和上额叶皮层及中央旁小叶；但去除十九张图谱共有的成分和皮层位置后，各系统单独不再显著，提示该特征主要沿这些系统共享的地形分布。在儿童中，个体与H3图谱的对齐程度与阅读技能相关，方向与遗传易感性相反。作者据此将该结构特征定位到与注意、唤醒和学习期突触可塑性相关的系统共享空间，为阅读障碍遗传学提供了一个可检验的生物学轴。

papers.title: Beyond the Percentile: CDC-referenced BMI-for-Age and Brain Structure Across Childhood and Adolescence
papers.authors: Beck D, Westlye LT, Tamnes CK.
papers.abstract: Importance Pediatric obesity affects 1 in 5 US children and has been linked to brain structural differences. Most evidence is cross-sectional and models body mass index (BMI) linearly, with metrics that compress severe obesity. Objective To examine associations between brain structure and BMI-for-age across the weight spectrum and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) weight status categories, distinguishing between- and within-person associations, and their age and sex moderation. Design, Setting, and Participants Longitudinal cohort study of youth aged 8–10 years at baseline in the US community-based Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (4 waves, 2016–2025; ages 8–18 years). Exposures Extended CDC BMI-for-age z-score, grouped by wave-mean z-score: underweight (<5th percentile, n=297), healthy weight (5th–<85th, n=7,452), overweight (85th–<95th, n=1,919), and obesity (≥95th, n=1,842). Main Outcomes and Measures Cortical thickness (12 regions) and subcortical volume (7 regions) from T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), defined a priori. Results Among 11,510 participants contributing 32,212 observations (mean [SD] age, 12.6 [2.5] years; 52.2% male), higher between-person BMI-for-age z was associated with lower frontal and temporal thickness (6 regions) and larger subcortical volume (5 regions; all q < .001), but associations were nonlinear (17 of 19 regions). Youth with obesity had lower thickness than healthy weight youth in 8 frontal and temporal regions (largest, −0.21 SD; q < .001), with dorsal frontal differences decreasing across adolescence; underweight youth had smaller subcortical volumes. Higher BMI-for-age z was associated with larger subcortical volume (all 7 regions) within the healthy weight category and lower cortical thickness (11 of 12 regions; fusiform: β = −0.27; q < .001) within the obesity category, steeper than in healthy weight youth in 10 regions, but not in overweight or underweight youth. Within-person associations did not reproduce the obesity associations, reversed from negative at age 10 to positive at age 16, and were more negative in female than male participants. Conclusions and Relevance Youth with obesity had lower cortical thickness than healthy weight peers, but associations between brain structure and BMI-for-age differed between CDC weight status groups, suggesting a complex relationship between adiposity and brain structure. Key Points Question How is BMI-for-age associated with brain structure across the weight spectrum, within CDC weight status categories, and within individuals over time in youth? Findings In this cohort study of 11,510 youth aged 8–18 years, those with obesity had lower frontal and temporal cortical thickness than healthy weight youth. Within categories, higher BMI-for-age was associated with lower thickness in obesity but larger subcortical volumes in healthy weight youth; within individuals over time, the obesity association was not reproduced. Meaning BMI–brain associations differ between CDC weight status categories and may be obscured by assuming a single linear association.

relevance.reason: 纵向队列研究BMI与儿童青少年皮层厚度及皮层下体积的关联，属脑结构与发育意义研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于美国青少年脑认知发育队列的纵向数据，考察儿童青少年BMI-for-age与皮层厚度及皮层下体积的关系，并区分个体间与个体内关联。结果发现，肥胖青少年在多个额叶和颞叶区域的皮层厚度低于健康体重同龄人，且部分差异随青春期推进而减小；在肥胖类别内，BMI-for-age越高皮层厚度越低，而在健康体重类别内则表现为皮层下体积更大。个体内随时间变化的关联未能重现上述肥胖相关模式，提示BMI与脑结构的关联在不同体重类别和个体内层面并不一致，单一线性假设可能掩盖这种复杂性。

papers.title: REM Sleep Iota Oscillations Across the Lifespan
papers.authors: Snipes S, Cox R, Krugliakova E, Kurth S, Leach S, Markovic A, Jaramillo V, Volk C, Pugin F, Wilhelm I, Tarokh L, van Someren E, Huber R, Andrillon T.
papers.abstract: Iota oscillations are a newly discovered marker of wakefulness and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep. So far, iota in REM sleep has only been reported in the surface electroencephalography (EEG) of a small sample of young adults and in intracranial recordings of epileptic patients. Here, we investigated the presence of these oscillations in a large dataset (N=937) of high-density sleep EEG recordings from individuals 7 to 70 years old. We found that iota spectral peaks during REM sleep were between 25 and 40 Hz, slightly faster than in wake (25-35 Hz). Iota power was significantly associated with REM sleep architecture, increasing with both REM duration and across progressive sleep cycles. Iota peaks were observed in individuals of all ages, although the prevalence decreased gradually with age, from 88% in children to 44% in older adults. Most iota spectral peak properties (frequency, amplitude, timing, topography) likewise shifted with age. The most striking effect, however, was in bandwidth, such that children had narrow iota peaks, older adults had broad iota peaks, and 20-30 year olds could have either. It remains unclear whether narrowband and broadband iota are functionally equivalent. On shorter time scales (< 1 year), iota properties remained stable across measurements. Analyses of a separate dataset of monozygotic and dizygotic twins revealed high heritability of all iota peak properties except bandwidth. Overall, these results establish iota as a genetically determined trait-like marker of REM sleep with unique age-related changes. Iota oscillations open new avenues to investigate the interaction between sleep, genetics, development, and aging.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑REM睡眠中iota振荡的频谱、地形与年龄变化，属睡眠/自发脑活动的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用大规模高密度睡眠脑电数据，考察了快速眼动睡眠中iota振荡在7至70岁人群中的表现。结果显示，REM期iota频谱峰值频率略高于清醒期，其功率随REM时长和睡眠周期推进而增加；各年龄段均可观察到iota峰，但出现比例随年龄增长而下降，多数峰属性也随年龄变化，最突出的是带宽——儿童峰较窄、老年人较宽，青年则两者兼有。短期内iota属性保持稳定，双生子数据分析提示除带宽外各属性具有较高遗传度。作者据此认为iota是受遗传影响、类似特质标记的REM睡眠标志物，但其窄带与宽带形式是否功能等价尚不清楚。

papers.title: Spatial Patterns of White Matter Hyperintensities and Cognitive Function in Older Adults: A Community-Based Study
papers.authors: Chen X, Nishimaki K, Tomoshige S, Chotiyanonta JS, Uchida Y, Wasserman BA, Gottesman RF, Guallar E, Windham BG, Oishi K.
papers.abstract: Objectives White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are associated with cognitive decline in older adults. We examined whether anatomically defined spatial WMH patterns are associated with cognitive performance and subsequent decline in a large community-based cohort with approximately six years of follow-up. Methods We analyzed 1,667 participants (mean age 76 years) from the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Neurocognitive Study. WMH were segmented from FLAIR images and mapped to 112 white matter regions using deep-learning-based parcellation. Principal component analysis identified dominant WMH distribution patterns; candidate components were selected by Horn’s parallel analysis and retained if stable across resampled split samples. Linear mixed-effects models examined associations between WMH patterns and cognitive performance at baseline and follow-up, adjusting for demographic, genomic, and vascular risk factors. Robustness was assessed using analyses accounting for total WMH burden, study center, and selective attrition. Results Of 14 candidate principal components (PCs) identified by parallel analysis, eight met the resampling stability criterion and were retained, together explaining 42% of the variance. Three components were associated with cross-sectional or future cognition. PC3, characterized by deep white matter burden in the corpus callosum and anterior corona radiata with relative preservation of superficial white matter, showed no cross-sectional association at baseline but was associated with accelerated decline across multiple domains. Interpretation A deep spatial pattern of WMH loading on the corpus callosum and anterior corona radiata was associated with subsequent cognitive decline in the absence of a cross-sectional association at baseline, independent of total lesion burden.

relevance.reason: 研究白质高信号空间分布模式与老年人认知功能及衰退的关系，涉及白质结构及其认知意义。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于社区老年人群的影像与认知随访数据，考察白质高信号在解剖空间上的分布模式是否与认知表现及其后续下降相关。作者用深度学习分区将白质高信号映射到多个白质区域，再以主成分分析提取稳定的分布模式，并用混合效应模型检验其与认知的关联。结果显示，多数候选模式未达稳定标准，少数保留模式中，一种以胼胝体和前放射冠深部白质受累为主、浅表白质相对保留的模式在基线时与认知无关，却与多个认知领域的加速下降相关，且独立于总体病灶负荷。这提示白质病变的空间位置可能比总负荷更能反映后续认知风险，但关联性研究尚不能确立因果。

papers.title: Synergistic modulation of the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and precuneus enhances cognitive recovery in mild cognitive impairment: A multimodal neuroimaging study.
papers.authors: Guo Z, Chen W, Xie J, Pu Y, Yang H, Mu Q.
papers.abstract: Abstract Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation is a promising intervention for mild cognitive impairment; however, conventional single-site stimulation protocols are often incapable of addressing the complex pathological network alterations underlying the condition. This study investigated the clinical efficacy and neurobiological modulatory mechanisms of multisite versus single-site repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation in patients with mild cognitive impairment. A total of 101 patients with mild cognitive impairment completed a 10-day repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation intervention and were analyzed in two cohorts: a single-site group receiving stimulation over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (n = 50) and a multi-site group receiving sequential stimulation over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and precuneus (n = 51). The multi-site group demonstrated significantly greater enhancements in global cognition [Mini-Mental State Examination: group×time interaction F(99) = 25.08, P < 0.001; Montreal Cognitive Assessment: F(99) = 6.17, P = 0.015], memory [Auditory Verbal Learning Test-immediate recall: F(99) = 6.03, P = 0.016], and language (Verbal Fluency Test, Animal Fluency Test: F(99) = 8.13, P = 0.005) compared with the single-site group. Neuroimaging analyses revealed that multi-site repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation induced robust structural and functional alterations across broader cognitionrelated regions and networks. Specifically, the multi-site protocol significantly increased gray matter volume in the left parahippocampal gyrus and large-scale networks (e.g., default mode network, executive control network), while modulating amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation and regional homogeneity in core memory and executive regions, including the precuneus, hippocampus, parahippocampal gyrus, and middle frontal gyrus. Additionally, multi-site stimulation drove more extensive functional connectivity alterations within the left parahippocampal network. Crucially, these specific neuroimaging alterations significantly correlated with behavioral improvements in memory, language, and global cognitive scores. Multi-site repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation targeting the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and precuneus yields superior cognitive improvements in mild cognitive impairment compared with conventional single-site stimulation. This enhanced efficacy is underpinned by the robust modulation of structural integrity, spontaneous neural activity, and functional connectivity within core cognitive brain networks. These mechanisms reflect repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation-induced synaptic plasticity and neurovascular coupling, driving network-level neural repair and providing a mechanistic rationale for optimized, connectivity-based neuromodulation in the early intervention of Alzheimer's disease.

relevance.reason: 研究MCI患者多靶点rTMS后认知改善与灰质体积、自发活动及功能连接改变的相关，涉及脑可塑性与结构功能机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了多位点与单位点重复经颅磁刺激对轻度认知障碍患者的认知改善效果，并借助多模态神经影像探讨其神经机制。结果显示，在左侧背外侧前额叶之外联合刺激楔前叶的多位点方案，在整体认知、记忆和语言方面的改善均优于仅刺激左侧背外侧前额叶的单位点方案。影像分析进一步表明，多位点刺激在更广泛的认知相关脑区和网络中引起结构与功能改变，且这些改变与行为改善相关。作者据此认为，联合靶向的刺激方案可能通过调控核心认知网络的结构完整性、自发活动和功能连接而带来更好的认知恢复，为基于连接组的神经调控提供了初步依据。

papers.title: Neurodegeneration epicenters: Distinct network mechanisms of dopaminergic treatment in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Duanmu X, Zhu Z, Lu N, Zhang W, Wang L, Wen J, Qin J, Tao Q, Jin Y, Zhou L, Zhou C, Guo T, Wu H, Chen J, Wu J, Yan Y, Tian J, Zhang M, Guan X, Xu X.
papers.abstract: Abstract Parkinson's disease exhibits heterogeneous spatiotemporal patterns of neurodegeneration. Dopaminergic therapy improves motor symptoms by modulating brain function in affected regions, yet whether the neural mechanisms through which dopaminergic therapy exerts its effects are linked to this heterogeneity of neurodegeneration remains unclear. A connectivity-based epicenter framework combined with spectral dynamic causal modeling was applied to resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data from 160 drug-naïve Parkinson's disease patients and 174 healthy controls to identify subtype-specific degenerative epicenters and characterize directional interactions among affected regions. Ninety-seven patients additionally underwent an acute levodopa challenge to evaluate how dopaminergic modulation influences these interactions and relates to symptom improvements. Two distinct Parkinson's disease subtypes were identified: subtype 1 was characterized by degenerative epicenters predominantly located in subcortical and cerebellar regions, whereas subtype 2 exhibited epicenters primarily involving cortical regions. Both subtypes exhibited widespread dysregulation of directional interactions among epicenter regions relative to healthy controls. Levodopa treatment partially reversed these network abnormalities in a manner specific to each subtype, notably within cerebellar vermis in subtype 1 and frontal cortex in subtype 2. Symptom improvements were linked to distinct network interactions: in subtype 1, tremor correlated with the thalamus, midbrain nuclei, and cerebellar vermis, whereas bradykinesia primarily involved the cerebellar vermis; in subtype 2, rigidity improvements mapped to frontal cortex and limbic regions, and bradykinesia to limbic regions. These findings suggest that Parkinson's disease involves distinct epicenter networks in each subtype, with widespread directional dysregulation contributing to symptom diversity in patients. Levodopa treatment selectively modulates these network interactions, shedding light on the mechanisms underlying treatment heterogeneity and guiding precision-targeted therapeutic strategies.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用静息态fMRI和动态因果模型，考察帕金森病亚型的退变中心网络及多巴胺能药物对脑网络相互作用的调节，属于以脑疾病理解脑网络组织与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病神经退行性变的异质性是否与多巴胺能治疗的网络机制相关。研究对160名未用药帕金森病患者和174名健康对照的静息态功能磁共振数据，采用基于连接性的起源中心框架结合谱动态因果建模，识别亚型特异的退行性起源中心并刻画受影响区域间的方向性相互作用；其中97名患者另接受急性左旋多巴挑战。结果识别出两个亚型：亚型1的起源中心主要位于皮层下和小脑区域，亚型2主要涉及皮层区域，两亚型相对健康对照均存在起源中心区域间方向性相互作用的广泛失调，左旋多巴以亚型特异方式部分逆转这些异常。症状改善与不同的网络相互作用相关，提示左旋多巴选择性调节这些网络相互作用，有助于理解治疗异质性，但摘要未报告效应量或临床转化证据。

papers.title: Cerebral Hemodynamic Patterns in People with Subjective Cognitive Decline: A Systematic Review Based on Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy.
papers.authors: Pebe-Muñoz CDP, Alzola P, Díez-Villoria E, Contador I.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives : Subjective cognitive decline (SCD) has been proposed as an early symptomatic manifestation of dementia/Alzheimer's disease. However, its associated brain patterns are not yet fully characterized. In recent years, functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) has emerged as a cost-effective technique to detect hemodynamic changes associated with cognitive decline. Therefore, fNIRS may be a valuable tool to investigate SCD neural underpinnings. This systematic review synthesizes current fNIRS evidence regarding the hemodynamic correlates of SCD during both resting-state and cognitive task conditions. Methods : Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched Scopus, PubMed, and Web of Science databases for studies combining keywords ('subjective cognitive decline', 'cognitive complaints', 'memory complaints', 'fNIRS', and 'near-infrared spectroscopy') with Boolean operators. Results : We identified 181 records, of which 10 studies fulfilled the inclusion and exclusion criteria. All studies were cross-sectional. Furthermore, 33% lacked a healthy control group, 56% lacked a standardized SCD identification protocol, 55% used small or imbalanced samples, and 66% did not clearly differentiate prefrontal subregions. In both resting-state and task conditions, SCD individuals showed heterogeneous hemodynamic responses in prefrontal areas. The severity of SCD and the difficulty of the tasks may be useful moderators of these associations. Conclusions : The limited evidence and methodological differences prevent identifying a specific hemodynamic pattern for SCD. Adopting longitudinal, well-powered, and well-controlled designs will be essential to evaluate fNIRS-derived hemodynamic responses in SCD.

relevance.reason: 系统综述汇总主观认知下降者前额叶fNIRS血流动力学模式，涉及认知衰退的脑功能机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述基于功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）系统梳理了主观认知下降（SCD）人群在静息态和认知任务下的脑血流动力学证据。纳入研究均为横断面设计，且多数存在缺乏健康对照组、SCD识别标准不统一、样本偏小或不均衡、前额叶子区划分不清等方法学局限。结果显示，SCD个体在前额叶的血流动力学反应呈现异质性，SCD严重程度和任务难度可能是调节因素。作者指出，现有证据有限且方法差异较大，尚无法确定SCD特异的血流动力学模式，未来需采用纵向、样本量充足且控制良好的设计加以验证。

papers.title: Functional neuroimaging as a tool to understand social determinants of health in cognitive aging and ADRD: a scoping review
papers.authors: Jenkins JE, Rich A, Manrique I, Moukaled S, Marchant NL, Carmichael O.
papers.abstract: The social, structural, and physical conditions in which individuals live, work, and age, collectively termed social determinants of health (SDOH), are associated with risk of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD). Differences in brain function in later life may offer understanding of how SDOH become biologically embedded and confer differential ADRD risk. However, how functional neuroimaging techniques have been used to study SDOH in cognitive aging and ADRD has yet to be systematically characterized. We therefore conducted a scoping review. Three databases were searched, 2,930 articles were screened, and 41 studies were included. Education was the most frequently studied SDOH domain, accounting for 65.9% (k = 27) of studies, followed by economic and occupation (k = 9, 22.0%), social and community (k = 5, 12.2%), food (k = 4, 9.8%), and physical environment (k = 3, 7.3%). Of the 41 studies, five (12.2%) examined multidomain determinants and one study (2.4%) examined three determinants each from different domains. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) was most frequently employed (k = 31, 75.6%), followed by electroencephalography (EEG; k = 7, 17.1%), and magnetoencephalography (MEG; k = 4, 9.8%). One study (2.4%) employed a multimodal approach, while none used functional near-infrared spectroscopy. Resting state paradigms (k = 27, 65.9%) outnumbered task-based (k = 14, 34.1%) and most studies were cross-sectional (k = 38, 92.7%). The predominant focus on education, fMRI, and cross-sectional designs highlights many opportunities for future investigation of how SDOH may be associated with later life brain function.

relevance.reason: 综述系统梳理功能神经影像（fMRI/EEG/MEG）如何用于研究社会决定因素与认知老化及ADRD的晚年脑功能关联，涉及脑功能组织与认知老化机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了功能神经影像如何被用于研究认知老化与阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆中的健康社会决定因素。纳入的研究以教育这一决定因素为主，其次是经济与职业、社会与社区、食品和物理环境，且多采用功能磁共振成像和静息态范式，绝大多数为横断面设计。作者指出，这种对教育、功能磁共振成像和横断面设计的集中关注，为未来探究健康社会决定因素与晚年脑功能的关联留下了大量空间。

papers.title: Problematic social media and gaming use, screen time, and youth mental health and brain structure in the ABCD Study
papers.authors: Lo W, Lopez RB, Nephew B.
papers.abstract: In an increasingly digital age, knowing which kinds of screen use relate to mental health in adolescents could help guide prevention efforts for a vulnerable population. Earlier work has examined this question, but the findings have been difficult to interpret. For instance, most studies measure screen use in hours, while it may be more informative to know whether adolescents have difficulty controlling their use. This is especially important now that adolescents use screens for school, games and contact with friends. Whether these patterns are reflected in the brain also remains largely unexplored. ABCD Study release 7.0 (N=11,860) is well suited to these questions because of its comprehensive profiling across neuroimaging, behavioral and clinical domains. In a preregistered study, we examined how screen time, problematic social media use (SMAQ) and problematic video game use (VGAQ) relate to parent-rated mental health, brain structure and resting-state connectivity. All five confirmatory associations were positive but small (β = 0.051 to 0.173) and remained consistent across several robustness checks. In the same participants, the problematic use scales were more strongly related to attention problems than hours of use were. The association between screen time and anxiety problems was present in male but not female participants. More screen time was associated with slightly smaller putamen and caudate volumes, while resting-state connectivity did not predict SMAQ. In exploratory analyses, SMAQ predicted later attention problems more than the reverse, while for gaming, attention problems predicted later VGAQ more strongly. Most of the association seemed to come from problematic use rather than use time by itself. Overall, the effects were small but consistent, in line with earlier work in the ABCD Study. We hope this analysis can contribute to a better understanding of how social media and gaming relate to adolescent mental health and brain development.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ABCD研究数据，考察青少年屏幕使用时间、问题性社交媒体使用和问题性电子游戏使用与心理健康、脑结构及静息态连接的关系。五项验证性关联均为正向但效应较小，且在多项稳健性检验中保持一致；问题性使用量表与注意力问题的关联强于使用时长，屏幕时间与焦虑问题的关联仅见于男性。屏幕时间较多与壳核和尾状核体积略小相关，而静息态连接不能预测问题性社交媒体使用。探索性分析提示，社交媒体使用对后续注意力问题的预测强于反向关系，游戏使用则相反；大部分关联似乎来自问题性使用而非使用时长本身。

papers.title: Personalized Network Mapping Reveals State-Trait Dissociation of Frontoparietal Connectivity in Adolescent Depression: A Longitudinal Study
papers.authors: Laca J, Ojha A, Herting MM, Mummaneni A, Keller A, Uddin L, Ho T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Prior research linking resting-state networks (RSNs) to adolescent depression has yielded inconsistent findings, partly because group-average templates poorly capture individual brains; a mismatch that may be especially consequential during adolescence, when RSNs grow increasingly heterogeneous across individuals. Using a personalized analysis pipeline in the longitudinal Characterizing Adolescent Trajectories of Depression cohort (38 depressed adolescents [28 female]; ages 14–18; 181 usable scans; avg. participation: 446.18 days), we derived individualized definitions of three canonical depression-related RSNs. Because longitudinal RSN connectivity may reflect both trait-like vulnerability and state-like symptom fluctuation, we used mixed-effects models to decompose connectivity profiles into both components. FPN connectivity showed a significant state-trait dissociation: chronically elevated connectivity predicted greater average symptom burden, while transient increases predicted momentary relief. These effects were undetectable using group-atlas estimates. We suggest FPN connectivity plays a dual, compensatory role in adolescent depression and demonstrate that personalized definitions can reveal clinically meaningful brain–symptom associations.

relevance.reason: 纵向研究青少年抑郁症个体化静息态网络连接与症状的关联，揭示脑网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年抑郁症中静息态网络连接与症状的关系，针对群体平均模板难以反映个体差异的问题，采用个性化分析流程在纵向队列中定义三个抑郁相关网络，并用混合效应模型把连接特征分解为特质性与状态性成分。结果显示，额顶网络连接存在明显的状态—特质分离：长期偏高的连接预测更高的平均症状负担，而短暂升高则对应症状的即时缓解，且这些关联在群体图谱估计中无法检出。作者据此提出额顶网络连接在青少年抑郁中可能起双重补偿作用，并强调个体化网络定义有助于揭示具有临床意义的大脑—症状关联。

papers.title: Molecularly distinct neurodegeneration shapes the DOPA-dependent dynamic of large-scale brain connectomics in GBA-associated Parkinson’s disease
papers.authors: Treddenti M, Guerra A, D’Onofrio V, Guidetti M, Lucchi G, Yahya V, Sartirana E, Zappasodi F, Antonini A, Priori A, Marceglia S, Bocci T.
papers.abstract: Abstract GBA1-associated Parkinson’s disease (GBA1-PD) is a biologically distinct synucleinopathy associated with glucocerebrosidase deficiency, lysosomal dysfunction, and more extensive cortical neurodegeneration. How these molecular abnormalities shape large-scale cortical network dynamics in vivo remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to characterize resting-state EEG functional connectivity and network topology in GBA1-PD and to determine whether GBA1-related molecular pathology is associated with a distinct oscillatory connectome signature and its modulation by dopaminergic treatment. We recorded resting-state EEG in 22 patients with PD (GBA1-PD = 7; LRRK2-PD = 5; sporadic PD = 10) together with 14 age-matched healthy controls. EEG was acquired in OFF and ON dopaminergic states. Functional connectivity was estimated using imaginary coherence (ImCoh) and phase-locking value (PLV) across canonical frequency bands, while network organization was quantified using the graph-theoretical clustering coefficient. Linear mixed-effects models were used to assess therapy- and subtype-specific effects. GBA1-PD exhibited a selective increase in gamma-band clustering coefficient in the ON condition (p = 0.044), which was not observed in LRRK2 or sporadic PD. PLV-based analyses highlighted opposite clustering changes in GBA1 and LRRK2 patients. ImCoh analyses further revealed different therapy-related connectivity changes in genetic and sporadic PD across all frequency bands (all p ≤ 0.0035). Compared with healthy controls, PD was associated with widespread disruption of cortico-cortical connectivity. All significant effects were abolished in surrogate-data analyses, supporting their physiological specificity. Resting-state EEG connectomics may reveal genotype-specific network alterations in GBA1-PD and their modulation by dopaminergic treatment, supporting a relationship between genetic background and large-scale brain network dynamics.

relevance.reason: 研究GBA相关帕金森病静息态EEG功能连接与网络拓扑，属脑疾病网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨GBA1相关帕金森病中葡萄糖脑苷脂酶缺乏等分子病理是否对应特异的静息态脑电连接组特征，以及多巴胺能治疗如何调节这些特征。研究比较了GBA1、LRRK2和散发性帕金森病患者在用药关与开状态下的脑电功能连接和网络拓扑，并以健康对照作参照。结果显示，GBA1患者在开状态下出现选择性的伽马频段聚类系数升高，而LRRK2和散发性患者未见这一变化；基于相位锁值的分析还提示GBA1与LRRK2患者的聚类变化方向相反，不同遗传背景与散发性患者在各频段的治疗相关连接改变也不相同。作者据此认为，静息态脑电连接组学可能揭示GBA1相关帕金森病基因型特异的网络改变及其受多巴胺能治疗的调节，但样本量小，结果尚属初步，不能据此推断临床疗效。

papers.title: Plasticity in Human Brain Language Areas After Stroke: What Can the Right Hemisphere Do?
papers.authors: Seydell-Greenwald A, Martin KC.
papers.journal: The Neuroscientist : a review journal bringing neurobiology, neurology and psychiatry
papers.abstract: Among the most devastating effects stroke can have on the lives of survivors and those around them are language production and comprehension impairments. The most notable of them - often given the joint diagnostic label of "aphasia" despite their heterogeneity and dissociability - are associated with damage to the brain's left hemisphere, which, in large part for this reason, is considered the "language-dominant" hemisphere. However, the right hemisphere's contribution to language should not be underestimated and may in fact be key to understanding the possibilities and limitations of neuroplasticity for supporting language recovery after stroke. Thus, in this review, we focus on the role of the right hemisphere in supporting human language function, in the neurologically healthy brain and after stroke. We discuss the remarkable capability of the right hemisphere to support normal language abilities after a large left-hemisphere stroke early in life, the more limited capacity for right-hemisphere language support after left-hemisphere stroke in adulthood, and potential interactions between typically left-hemisphere dominant "core" language functions with language functions typically thought to be right-hemisphere dominant, such as emotional prosody. We conclude by highlighting gaps in current knowledge and suggesting areas for future research.

relevance.reason: 综述右半球在健康脑及卒中后语言功能与可塑性中的作用，聚焦人脑语言机制与卒中后重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦右半球在人类语言功能中的作用，梳理其在健康脑以及卒中后语言恢复中的贡献。作者指出，生命早期发生大面积左半球卒中后，右半球仍能支持接近正常的语言能力；而成年期左半球卒中后，右半球的支持能力则较为有限。文章还讨论了通常由左半球主导的“核心”语言功能与情绪韵律等右半球优势功能之间可能的相互作用，并强调现有认识仍存在空白，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: The network localization and underlying biological basis of heterogeneous structural and functional brain abnormalities in insomnia disorder.
papers.authors: Xue W, Gao Z, Shi Y, Zhang Y, Du W, Tao B, Zhu F, Wan Q, Zhang W, Lui S, Lu P, Tang X, Xiao Y.
papers.abstract: Insomnia disorder (ID) has become a prevalent sleep disorder worldwide, yet its underlying neural mechanisms remain unclear due to heterogeneous neuroimaging findings and uncertain network localization. We identified brain structural and functional abnormality locations associated with ID from 63 published neuroimaging studies, including 3391 patients and 3433 healthy controls. Using coordinate network mapping combined with a normative connectome database, we mapped these abnormalities to large-scale brain networks of ID across imaging modalities and further decoded them by integrating microscale chemo-architectural, cellular, and cognitive maps. The structural network widely involved the ventral attention (VAN), sensorimotor (SMN), dorsal attention (DAN) and default mode network (DMN); the task-induced network showed a similar but less extensive pattern, predominantly implicating the VAN, DMN, SMN and subcortical network (SCN); in contrast, the resting-state network was largely confined to the left middle frontal gyrus and the bilateral mid-cingulate cortex. Molecular mapping revealed both shared and distinct neurotransmitter signatures across the three networks, involving cholinergic, histaminergic, glutamatergic, noradrenergic, and opioid systems. Cellular decoding showed relatively selective associations of the structural and task-based networks with glial cells and excitatory neurons, whereas the resting-state network exhibited broader associations with glial cells and multiple excitatory and inhibitory neuronal subtypes. Cognitive decoding linked structural and task-based networks to sensorimotor processing and the resting-state network to memory-related functions. Our findings reconcile heterogeneous neuroimaging results and reveal neurobiological substrates of ID from a network perspective, providing a promising biomarker and paving the way for circuit-based precision therapies of ID.

relevance.reason: 该研究通过坐标网络映射整合失眠障碍患者的结构与功能影像异常，定位到大规模脑网络并解码其细胞与认知关联，属于以脑疾病理解脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对失眠障碍神经影像结果异质、网络定位不清的问题，整合已发表的脑结构与功能异常坐标，借助坐标网络映射和规范连接组数据库，将异常定位到大规模脑网络，并结合分子、细胞和认知图谱进行解码。结果显示，结构网络主要涉及腹侧注意、感觉运动、背侧注意和默认模式网络，任务诱发网络模式相似但范围较小，静息态网络则较局限；三类网络在神经递质、细胞类型和认知功能关联上既有共享也有差异。作者认为，这有助于调和异质影像发现，并从网络视角揭示失眠障碍的神经生物学基础，为生物标记和环路精准治疗提供线索。

papers.title: Delineating neural contributions to electroencephalogram-based speech decoding.
papers.authors: Sato M, Hatakeyama E, Inoue M, Kabe Y, Nobe S, Yoshida A, Yamamoto A, Kita Y, Shimizu M, Tomeoka K, Cohen MX, Sasai S.
papers.abstract: Objective . Speech Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have emerged as a pivotal technology in facilitating communication for individuals with speech impairments. Utilizing electroencephalography (EEG) for noninvasive speech BCIs offers an accessible and affordable solution, potentially benefiting a broader audience. However, EEG-based speech decoding remains controversial especially for overt speech, due to difficulties in separating speech-related neural activities from myoelectric potential artifacts generated during articulation. Moreover, because paradigms for collecting covert speech data are inherently less scalable than those for overt speech, whether the neural dynamics underlying EEG-based decoding of overt speech are also present during covert speech remains an open and practically important question. Approach . Here we aim to delineate the extent of the neural contributions to EEG-based speech decoding, and the degree to which the underlying neural dynamics are shared across overt and covert speech, by employing Explainable AI techniques to a convolutional neural network predicting spoken words based on signals obtained by ultra-high-density (uhd)-EEG. Main results . We found that electrode-wise contributions to the decoding cannot be explained by their mutual information with electromyography (EMG). Furthermore, contributing periods of speech to EEG-based decoding are distinct from those to decoding solely relying on EMG. In contrast, there are significant overlaps in signal timings contributing to EEG-based decoding, regardless of vocal conditions such as overt or covert speech. Notably, the denoising process successfully enhanced the decoding contribution from electrodes within speech-related brain areas for all speech conditions. Significance

relevance.reason: 研究EEG语音解码中神经贡献与肌电伪迹的区分，涉及言语产出神经机制及电极空间贡献，属语言与脑。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注基于脑电的语音解码在多大程度上依赖真实神经活动，以及这种神经动态是否在出声与默读语音间共享。作者用可解释人工智能方法分析超高密度脑电训练的卷积神经网络，发现对解码有贡献的电极无法用其与肌电的互信息解释，且脑电解码所依赖的时段与仅靠肌电解码的时段不同；而出声和默读条件下，对脑电解码有贡献的信号时序存在明显重叠。去噪处理还能增强所有语音条件下语音相关脑区电极的解码贡献，提示脑电语音解码包含可分离于肌电伪迹的神经成分，并可能跨发声条件共享部分动态。

papers.title: The spatial extent of fast ripples is associated with cognitive and language deficits in children with focal epilepsy: An exploratory SEEG study.
papers.authors: Dallavalle M, von Ellenreider N, Bellerose J, Fiorino A, Hooker M, Sylvain-Roy S, Myers K, Osterman B, Simard-Tremblay E, Gotman J, Dudley RWR.
papers.abstract: Objective To determine if the spatial extent of interictal fast ripples in focal epilepsy patients is associated with brain dysfunction. Methods Thirty pediatric focal epilepsy patients who underwent SEEG investigation had their cognitive and language deficits assessed in scales of 0 to 4. Fast ripples (250-500 Hz), ripples (80-250 Hz), and IEDs were automatically detected in 10 min during NREM sleep. We fitted linear models to the relationship between the cognitive deficit scale and the spatial spread of the interictal neurophysiologic events (number of channels with rate of events > 10 % of maximum rate). For the language deficit, we computed the Spearman correlation between the median rate of events in all brain regions and the deficit scale. Results Cognitive deficit scale was significantly associated with the number of channels with fast ripples (p = 0.049), not so with ripples (p = 0.31), IEDs (p = 0.31). The potential confound of number of explored channels did not improve the fitting of the models. Language deficits were not correlated with the number of channels showing interictal events. However, from all brain regions the most statistically significant correlations (p < 0.01) were between median fast ripple rates in the left and right pars opercularis and triangularis of the inferior frontal gyrus (Broca's area and its contralateral counterpart) with r = 0.66, p = 0.003 (18 patients), in the superior temporal gyrus in the language dominant hemisphere with r = 0.72, p = 0.005 (13 patients), and the dominant basal temporal region with r = 0.79, p = 0.006 (10 patients). Median rates of IEDs and ripples exhibited lower correlation with language deficits in these regions. Conclusion Widespread fast ripples are associated with increased cognitive deficits, and language deficiencies are correlated with fast ripple rates in brain regions associated with language. The extent of fast-ripple activity was associated with cognitive deficit severity in this cohort, whereas the corresponding associations for ripples and IEDs did not reach statistical significance.

relevance.reason: 癫痫患儿SEEG研究，将快速涟漪空间范围与认知及语言缺陷关联，涉及语言脑区与认知功能机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究在局灶性癫痫患儿中考察发作间期快涟漪的空间范围是否与认知和语言缺陷相关，利用SEEG记录并结合缺陷量表评估。结果显示，认知缺陷严重程度与出现快涟漪的电极通道数相关，而涟漪和IEDs未见这种关联；语言缺陷则与左侧及右侧额下回、优势半球颞上回和优势基底颞区等语言相关脑区的快涟漪中位发生率相关，涟漪和IEDs在这些区域的关联较弱。作者据此认为，广泛的快涟漪活动与更重的认知缺陷相关，语言缺陷则与语言相关脑区的快涟漪发生率相关，但这是关联性发现，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: An insular-orbitofrontal pathway supporting awareness of respiratory effort.
papers.authors: Jelinčić V, von Leupoldt A.
papers.abstract: In a recent study using human intracranial EEG recordings during inspiratory loading, Assi and colleagues identified parallel pathways for respiratory compensation and awareness. The anterior insula signals a neuromechanical mismatch to the orbitofrontal cortex for conscious appraisal, while high-frequency insular-frontal coupling enables ventilatory adjustments. The findings are highly relevant for disorders of altered respiratory perception.

relevance.reason: 颅内EEG揭示岛叶-眶额通路支持呼吸努力意识，属感知意识神经机制与功能通路组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注呼吸用力感知的神经基础，利用人类颅内脑电记录，在吸气负荷条件下考察呼吸补偿与主观觉察是否由不同通路支持。结果显示，前岛叶将神经力学失配信号传递至眶额皮层，供意识层面的评估，而岛叶与额叶间的高频耦合则参与通气调节。作者据此提出呼吸补偿与呼吸觉察存在并行通路，这一区分有助于理解呼吸感知异常的疾病，但相关临床意义仍属提示性。

papers.title: Resting-state fMRI biomarkers of surgical outcome in temporal lobe epilepsy: Network reorganization, rsfMRI-based prediction models, and cognition - A systematic review.
papers.authors: Xu CMC, Marstrand-Joergensen MR, McCulloch DE, Pinborg LH.
papers.abstract: Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is a network disorder extending beyond the structurally defined epileptogenic zone. Resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) may provide information on brain network alterations relevant to seizure outcome and cognitive risk after epilepsy surgery. We reviewed rsfMRI studies in TLE surgical cohorts to evaluate postoperative network changes, preoperative predictors of seizure outcome, and associations between functional connectivity and cognition. This systematic review followed PRISMA guidelines and was registered in PROSPERO. Fifteen studies were included, comprising 474 TLE patients who underwent resective epilepsy surgery and had at least 1 year of follow-up. Studies were reviewed for patient population, surgery, rsfMRI methodology, networks or regions, outcome definition, postoperative network changes, and cognitive assessments. Despite heterogeneity in patient selection, surgery, rsfMRI analysis, and outcome definition, studies consistently reported reduced DMN-related connectivity in TLE compared with healthy controls. Postoperative functional connectivity in seizure-free patients shifted toward healthy controls patterns in few studies. Preoperative rsfMRI-based prediction models showed promising accuracy for predicting seizure outcome but were generally developed in small cohorts and lacked external validation. Evidence relating rsfMRI to cognition was limited, but implicated thalamic, ascending reticular activating system, and thalamo-occipital connectivity in attention, language, and executive functions. RsfMRI is a promising research biomarker for network-level risk stratification in TLE surgery, particularly for seizure outcome prediction and postoperative network reorganization. Current evidence remains insufficient for clinical implementation. Future studies require larger homogeneous multicenter cohorts, standardized acquisition and preprocessing, consistent outcome definitions, systematic postoperative rsfMRI, neuropsychological assessment, and external validation of prediction models.

relevance.reason: 系统综述癫痫手术队列的静息态网络重组与认知关联，以脑网络组织理解术后改变，符合脑疾病与静息态栏目。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA规范系统梳理了颞叶癫痫手术队列的静息态功能MRI研究，关注术后网络变化、术前发作结局预测以及功能连接与认知的关联。纳入研究普遍报告患者默认网络相关连接较健康对照降低，少数研究显示术后无发作患者的连接向健康模式偏移；基于术前静息态数据的预测模型对发作结局显示出较好准确度，但多在小队列中开发且缺乏外部验证。与认知相关的证据有限，涉及丘脑及丘脑-枕叶连接等。作者认为静息态功能MRI是有前景的研究性生物标志物，但现有证据尚不足以支持临床常规应用。

papers.title: Interpersonal neural synchrony and parent-child behaviors during naturalistic interactions: A systematic review.
papers.authors: De Leener M, Sfeir M, Galdiolo S, Rossignol M.
papers.abstract: Interpersonal neural synchrony (INS), defined as the temporal alignment of neural activity between socially interacting individuals, has been proposed as an index of parent-child interaction quality. However, its relationship with moment-to-moment adjustment of parent-child behavior remains insufficiently understood. This systematic review examined associations between INS and observable behavior during naturalistic parent-child interactions, the factors influencing these associations, and the methods used to investigate them. Following PRISMA guidelines, systematic searches of Scopus, PubMed, and ScienceDirect identified 15 peer-reviewed empirical studies involving children from preschool age to early adolescence. INS-behavior associations were heterogeneous across studies. Higher INS was most consistently associated with mutual engagement, shared positive affect, and supportive parenting, whereas findings concerning reciprocity, responsiveness, and child agency were more context-dependent. Time-resolved analyses further indicated that INS fluctuated in relation to specific behavioral events and revealed temporally asymmetric patterns in which parent or child neural activity preceded that of the interaction partner. However, these patterns do not establish causal directionality and may partly reflect shared exposure to task-related or interactional inputs. Task structure and the availability of direct social cues appeared to shape INS-behavior associations, while parental stress and child social functioning emerged as potential sources of variability in INS. Methodologically, the findings highlight the value of combining micro- and macro-level behavioral coding with time-resolved and directionality-sensitive analyses, alongside stronger controls for spurious synchrony and common inputs. Given the limited number and methodological heterogeneity of available studies, the findings should be regarded as preliminary and primarily hypothesis-generating.

relevance.reason: 系统综述自然亲子互动中人际神经同步与行为关联，涉及社会认知及自然情境脑活动。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述考察自然情境下亲子互动中人际神经同步与可观察行为的关联及其影响因素和方法。同步与共同投入、共享积极情绪和支持性养育关联较一致，与互惠、回应性和儿童主动性关系更依赖情境；时间分辨分析显示同步随行为事件波动，先后模式不对称，但不能确立因果，也可能反映共同输入。任务结构和社会线索似乎塑造关联，父母压力与儿童社会功能可能是变异来源。作者强调研究有限且方法异质，结论属初步、以生成假设为主。

papers.title: Stage-dependent gray matter morphological alterations across the clinical spectrum of depressive disorder.
papers.authors: Xu K, Wu B, Zhao Z, Shao Y, Li L, Jia Z.
papers.abstract: Background Previous studies have reported gray matter volume (GMV) deficits in different illness stages of depression; however, whether patients at different stages show shared or distinct GMV abnormality patterns has not been systematically characterized. Methods We conducted a quantitative voxel-wise meta-analysis of whole-brain voxel-based morphometry studies in individuals with subthreshold depression (STD), first-episode drug-naïve depression (FEND), and long-term major depressive disorder (MDD). Separate, pooled and comparative meta-analyses were performed using the seed-based d mapping (SDM) toolbox. Meta-regression analyses were conducted to explore age- and disease-related alterations in depression. Results Twelve studies including 467 individuals with STD, 19 studies including 854 patients with FEND, and 14 studies including 525 patients with long-term depression were included. Compared with controls, STD and FEND exhibited mixed patterns of GMV increases and decreases predominantly involving key emotional and default mode network regions. In contrast, long-term MDD showed consolidated GMV reductions confined to the paracingulate gyrus and left middle temporal gyrus extending to insula. Direct comparisons across stages confirmed that GMV alterations in prefrontal and temporal regions showed progressive divergence from early to chronic depression. Meta-regression analyses revealed stage-specific associations between clinical characteristics and GMV changes. Conclusions This meta-analysis reveals stage-specific GMV abnormalities across depression. GMV changes shift from mixed alterations in early stages to purely atrophic reductions in chronic MDD, supporting a progressive model. Fronto-limbic deficits at the subthreshold stage may serve as early vulnerability markers, while GMV consolidation in long-term MDD underscores the importance of early intervention.

relevance.reason: 该荟萃分析比较不同抑郁阶段的灰质体积改变，直接刻画脑结构异常随疾病进展的模式。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注不同抑郁阶段是否存在共享或特异的灰质体积异常模式，对亚临床抑郁、首发未用药抑郁和长期重性抑郁的全脑基于体素的形态学研究进行了定量元分析。结果显示，早期阶段以情绪和默认网络相关区域的灰质体积增减混合模式为主，而长期抑郁则表现为局限于扣带旁回、左颞中回并延伸至岛叶的灰质体积下降；跨阶段比较提示前额叶和颞叶的改变随病程进展而分化。作者据此提出抑郁灰质改变由早期混合性变化向慢性期单纯萎缩推进的渐进模型，并认为亚临床阶段的额边缘异常可能提示早期易感性，强调早期干预的重要性。

papers.title: Along-tract statistical mapping of white matter abnormalities in children with SeLECTS.
papers.authors: Xu G, Zhang Y, Huang K, Liu J, Song G, Chen X, Zeng L, Zhang Y, Liu H, Zhang T.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Emerging evidence suggests that self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (SeLECTS) may reflect atypical neurodevelopment. As WM maturation extends from the second trimester through adolescence, this study aimed to identify regions of delayed or aberrant white matter (WM) development in children with SeLECTS using along-tract statistical mapping for precise localization of microstructural alterations. Materials and methods 38 children with SeLECTS and 31 healthy controls underwent diffusion-weighted MRI scan. Fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), and radial diffusivity (RD) were derived from the diffusion tensor model. Whole-brain tractography was performed using deterministic EuDX tracking and registered to a standardized bundle atlas in MNI space. Thirty WM tracts per subject were extracted. Linear mixed models within the BUAN tractometry framework were used to assess segment wise group differences, while partial correlations were performed to evaluate associations between diffusion metrics and cognitive performance. FDR correction was applied per bundle for all comparisons. Results After FDR correction, children with SeLECTS showed increased MD in the forceps minor, midbody of the corpus callosum, right corticospinal tract, right extreme capsule, and bilateral uncinate fasciculi. MD values in the affected WM segments showed negative correlations with performance and full-scale IQ, and the segments showing significant correlations overlapped with those showing significant group differences. Conclusions SeLECTS is associated with MD-based microstructural alterations in superficial frontal, temporal, and parietal pathways, potentially indicating delayed white matter maturation.

relevance.reason: 以SeLECTS患儿为对象，用扩散MRI沿纤维束定位白质微结构异常并与认知/IQ关联，属脑疾病中白质结构与认知发育机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注伴中央颞区棘波的自我限定性癫痫（SeLECTS）儿童是否存在白质发育延迟或异常，采用弥散加权MRI和沿纤维束统计映射，比较患儿与健康对照的白质微结构并考察其与认知表现的关系。结果显示，患儿在额钳、胼胝体中部、右侧皮质脊髓束、右侧极外囊及双侧钩束等纤维束节段出现平均弥散率升高，且这些节段的弥散指标与认知表现和全量表智商呈负相关，相关节段与组间差异节段重叠。作者据此认为，SeLECTS与额、颞、顶叶浅表通路的弥散率改变有关，可能提示白质成熟延迟；但这是组间关联，尚不能说明因果关系或临床治疗效果。

papers.title: Human brain white matter charts in international populations
papers.authors: Huo Y, Zhang C, Ren F, Han T, Gao Y, Wang J, Ding J, Le L, Ou P, Bai T, Shen M, Feng G, Huang T, Li X, Chen Y, Jing R, Liu L, Tao S, Huang W, Cheng J, Su L, Zhang B, Xu Y, Ji G, Sun Y, Cao Q, Han Y, Ma G, He Y, Zuo X, Liu Y, Dong Q, Zhang Z, Shu N, Chinese Child Brain Development (CCBD) Consortium.
papers.abstract: Brain charts provide normative references for identifying neurodevelopmental milestones and clinically meaningful deviations. Existing white matter (WM) charts are derived predominantly from European and North American populations, limiting generalizability. Here, we established the first set of population-specific WM charts of 198 morphological and microstructural phenotypes for both Chinese (N=19,215) and Western (N=15,584) populations across the human lifespan. Developmental trajectories and spatial organization of WM maturation and degeneration were broadly conserved across the populations, whereas maturational timing varied across pathways and metrics. The Chinese population showed earlier maturation in several projection and sensorimotor pathways, but more protracted maturation in higher-order association and limbic pathways. Chinese population-matched charts more accurately predicted WM phenotypes and detected more extreme disease-related deviations in brain health in the Chinese population than Western-derived models. Individual deviation patterns further discriminated patients from healthy controls and predicted cognitive performance and plasma biomarkers. Our findings reveal population-specific WM maturation and show that reference-population mismatch can reduce the accuracy and clinical sensitivity of normative brain charts.

relevance.reason: 该研究建立跨人群白质形态与微结构常模图谱，刻画白质成熟与退化的发育轨迹及空间组织，属脑结构-功能与发育研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对现有白质脑图谱主要基于欧美人群、外推性有限的问题，分别构建了中国与西方人群覆盖全生命周期的白质形态学和微结构表型图谱。结果显示，两大人群白质发育与退化的总体轨迹及空间组织大体一致，但成熟时间因通路和指标而异：中国人群在部分投射和感觉运动通路上成熟更早，而在高阶联合和边缘通路上成熟更晚。与中国人群匹配的图谱比西方模型更准确地预测白质表型，并在脑健康评估中检出更多极端疾病相关偏差；个体偏差模式还能区分患者与健康对照，并预测认知表现和血浆生物标志物。作者据此指出，参考人群不匹配会降低规范性脑图谱的准确性和临床敏感性。

papers.title: Responses to unannounced rule changes in adults with developmental disabilities: A community-based pilot study with consumer-grade EEG
papers.authors: Jeong Y, Hyun S.
papers.abstract: Unannounced changes in rules or environments often precede challenging behavior and limit community participation for adults with developmental disabilities, yet their responses to change have rarely been quantified directly. We recruited adults with developmental disabilities, including those with intellectual disability, at a community day-service center. We administered a probabilistic reversal learning task and recorded resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) via a 14-channel wireless EEG system. Among the 12 adults who performed the task, total errors were comparable across participants (range 31–57), whereas a switch bias index, contrasting perseverative errors (persisting with the previously correct option) with regressive errors (failing to maintain the newly correct option), ranged from −0.96 to +0.91. In the 9 participants included in resting-state EEG analyses, a flatter aperiodic spectrum over the frontal cluster (preregistered, but selected as the focus post hoc) was associated with fewer switches after negative feedback (ρ = .80) and more perseverative errors (ρ = −.72). The preregistered parieto-occipital cluster showed the same direction (ρ = .69, 95% confidence interval [−.11, .97], n = 8), which was opposite to the preregistered prediction. Frontal alpha peak amplitude was associated with accuracy (ρ = .77), and the between-run reliability of resting-state measures was .82–.99. These findings provide preliminary evidence that EEG recorded in community settings can capture individual differences in how people respond to change. Field measurement that includes people with intellectual disability may help extend the evidence base for the Sustainable Development Goals of good health and well-being (SDG 3) and reduced inequalities (SDG 10).

relevance.reason: 在发育障碍成人中结合概率反转学习任务与静息态EEG，报告额区非周期频谱与行为切换/持续错误的关联，属认知控制与静息脑活动组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在社区日间服务中心招募发育障碍成人，用概率反转学习任务和便携式静息态脑电，考察他们对未预告规则变化的反应能否被直接量化。结果显示，参与者的总错误数相近，但切换偏向指数差异很大，从明显固着于旧选项到难以维持新选项不等；额区非周期频谱越平坦，负反馈后切换越少、固着性错误越多，而预先设定的顶枕区结果方向与预期相反。作者据此认为，社区环境下采集的脑电有望捕捉个体应对变化的差异，但样本小、部分分析为事后选择，只能视为初步证据。

papers.title: Hidden Markov Modeling Reveals Altered Functional Network Dynamics in Multiple Sclerosis
papers.authors: Hiremath KC, Hobbs DA, Hettish DMR, Khan E, Alias BP, Lin MM, Fox PT, Chiang FL.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Purpose Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a neurodegenerative and demyelinating disease of the central nervous system. Recent evidence suggests that localized gray matter atrophy in MS may be involved in distributed functional brain networks. However, the dynamic trajectory of functional network alterations in MS remains unclear. The current study extends prior network-mediated findings and aims to investigate the dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) and energetic landscape across an atrophy-prone network in MS. Methods Twenty MS participants and twenty healthy controls (HC) underwent resting-state fMRI. The atrophy-based functional network (AFN) model was implemented, and time series from atrophy-prone regions were fit to a 12-state hidden Markov model. Each functional network state, a recurring pattern of activity across the AFN, was characterized by the AFN regions with the strongest activation. The states were then grouped into two metastates. Dynamic functional network metrics were compared between groups by permutation testing and correlated with disability and cognition. The energetic landscape of the network was mapped with a pairwise maximum-entropy model. Temporal irreversibility was also measured, which defines the arrow-of-time asymmetry of network dynamics. Results People with MS showed lower occupancy of state 1, which peaked on the right middle frontal and anterior cingulate cortex. Occupancy and mean lifetime were higher in states 3 and 10 (p < 0.05). In state 3, cortical activity was below the network average, and state 10 peaked on the postcentral gyrus. At the metastate level, MS participants spent more time in metastate M1 and less in M2 (p = 0.04). Within the MS group, a longer interval between visits to state 3 was associated with greater disability (r = 0.57), and a higher switching rate in state 10 with poorer verbal fluency (r = −0.50). The energetic landscape was similar between groups. Temporal irreversibility was lower in MS, mainly across subcortical connections. Conclusion MS participants dwelled longer in specific dFC states of the AFN, while the rate of transition between states did not differ from healthy controls. Dynamic functional network metrics were associated with disability and cognitive performance and may serve as functional correlates of clinical impairment. The states were similar between groups, whereas the directed drive between states was lower across subcortical connections. This pattern suggests altered network dynamics rather than altered network architecture in MS. Findings from this study characterize the functional network dynamics of neurodegeneration in MS, which may inform future development of network-based approaches for monitoring disease progression.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fMRI与隐马尔可夫模型分析多发性硬化患者功能网络动态，并关联认知表现，符合静息态网络组织及脑疾病认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注多发性硬化患者易萎缩功能网络中的动态功能连接及其能量景观，采用静息态fMRI结合隐马尔可夫模型，比较患者与健康对照的功能网络状态及转换特征。结果显示，患者在某些特定状态上的停留时间更长，状态间转换速率与健康对照无差异，且状态本身在两组间相似；患者的时间不可逆性较低，主要体现在皮层下连接上。在患者组内，部分状态访问间隔和切换率与残疾程度、言语流畅性相关。作者据此认为，多发性硬化更多表现为网络动态的改变而非网络架构的改变，这些动态指标或可作为临床损害的功能相关物，但相关关系不等于因果，其临床应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Spectral power and functional connectivity of resting EEG in people exposed to armed conflict and controls
papers.authors: Nitola Pulido L, Bonilla S, Herrera E, Reyes P, Santamaría-García H.
papers.abstract: Exposure to armed conflict can leave persistent effects on mental health, yet its neurophysiological correlates remain poorly characterized, particularly in populations exposed to prolonged violence outside narrowly defined post traumatic stress disorder samples. Here we examined resting state electroencephalographic activity in 122 Colombian adults, including 74 participants exposed to armed conflict and 48 controls. Eyes closed EEG was analysed for 240 seconds per participant. We quantified absolute and relative spectral power across delta, theta, alpha and beta bands and regional functional connectivity using weighted phase lag index in theta, alpha and beta. Group comparisons were adjusted for age, education, sex and assessment year, with correction across 78 EEG contrasts. Median occipital and global alpha power was lower in exposed participants, although adjusted estimates were close to the null and confidence intervals were broad. Temporal theta relative power was lower in exposed participants at nominal significance, but this association did not survive Holm correction. No spectral power or regional connectivity contrast remained significant after multiple testing correction. Exploratory associations between EEG measures and MoCA performance were modest in participants with confirmed scores. These findings provide a systematic characterization of resting EEG after exposure to armed conflict in a population shaped by prolonged violence and displacement. They also indicate that large or widespread alterations in resting spectral power and connectivity were not detectable with the current sample and analytical framework, while defining candidate signals and methodological priorities for larger studies of conflict related brain health.

relevance.reason: 研究武装冲突暴露人群的静息态EEG频谱功率与功能连接，属人脑自发活动与功能网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察长期暴露于武装冲突是否会在静息脑电的频谱功率和功能连接上留下可检测的痕迹，对象为哥伦比亚成年人，比较暴露组与对照组，并分析闭眼静息脑电的绝对与相对频谱功率及区域功能连接。结果显示，在多重比较校正后，没有一项频谱功率或区域连接对比保持显著；枕区与全局α功率在暴露组中看似较低，但校正后的估计接近零且置信区间较宽，颞区θ相对功率的差异也未通过校正。作者据此指出，在当前样本和分析框架下未能检出广泛或大幅度的静息脑电改变，同时为更大规模研究提示了候选信号和方法学重点。

papers.title: Alpha-range neural oscillations are associated with multiple dynamic brain networks
papers.authors: Nomi J, Román-López T, Chang F, Friedman-Jha A, Truong H, Diaz-Fong J, Chang C, Karalunas S, Phadikar S, Calhoun V, Dillon A, Loo S, Lenartowicz A.
papers.abstract: We asked whether alpha range (8-12 Hz) EEG neural oscillations, a robust indicator of cortical excitability, are associated with dynamic BOLD brain networks. Two independent EEG-fMRI resting-state datasets (discovery: n = 94 and replication: n = 33) show that low-and high-alpha periods are associated with dynamic BOLD coactivation patterns (dCAPS) involving multiple dynamic networks rather than a single static network. Unique BOLD dCAPs consisting of visual cortex activation along with sensorimotor and attention networks in addition to the posterior thalamus, were mainly associated with periods of low-alpha power. However, overlapping BOLD dCAPs consisting of default, control, and attention networks were associated with periods of both low-and high-alpha power. The results suggest low-alpha dCAPS contain unique temporal-dependent configurations related to visual, sensorimotor, and attention networks while both low-and high-alpha dCAPs consist of overlapping temporal-dependent configurations involving CON, DMN, and attention networks involved in internal and external cognition. These findings reconcile discrepancies across static connectivity EEG-fMRI findings by showing that distinct transient BOLD configurations are associated with similar patterns of alpha EEG modulation in visual cortex, providing a dynamic framework for the gating function of alpha oscillations.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态EEG alpha振荡与动态BOLD网络配置的关联，涉及视觉、感觉运动、注意及默认网络组织，属人脑自发活动与网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察alpha频段（8–12 Hz）脑电振荡是否与动态BOLD脑网络相关，基于两个独立的静息态EEG-fMRI数据集进行分析。结果显示，低alpha与高alpha时段对应的是涉及多个网络的动态BOLD共激活模式，而非单一静态网络：低alpha时段主要伴随包含视觉皮层、感觉运动与注意网络以及后丘脑的独特模式，而默认网络、控制网络与注意网络重叠的模式则在低、高alpha时段均出现。作者据此认为，不同的瞬时BOLD配置可与视觉皮层相似的alpha调制相关联，这为调和既往静态连接EEG-fMRI研究间的差异提供了动态框架，并将alpha振荡的门控功能置于动态视角下理解。

papers.title: Hippocampal-somatomotor coactivation and perceived benefit following Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Life in healthcare students: An exploratory randomized study
papers.authors: Clairis N, Saccaro L, Delplanque S, Holman C, Celen Z, Cachet C, Serquet C, Meuleman B, Bondolfi G, Jermann F, Rudaz S, Piguet C.
papers.abstract: Mindfulness-based interventions are known to enhance emotion regulation and stress management, yet their neural mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Effective coping strategies for emotion regulation and stress management would be particularly beneficial for healthcare students, frequently exposed to highly stressful situations. Based on prior work implicating hippocampal-somatomotor dynamics in emotion regulation, we tested whether Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Life (MBCT-L) modulates hippocampal micro-coactivation patterns (μCAPs) in healthcare students. In a randomized controlled study including 161 healthcare students, 57 participants (39 females; mean age: 23±5 years old) completed resting-state fMRI before and after the 8-weeks intervention and were allocated to MBCT-L (N = 24) or a no-intervention control (N = 33) condition. Hippocampus-seeded CAPs analysis identified six recurrent patterns, including a somatomotor network. MBCT-L improved self-reported mindfulness, but no significant Group × Time interaction for hippocampus-somatomotor coactivation or resting physiological measures was found. In the MBCT-L group, higher hippocampus-somatomotor co-activity was associated with higher perceived importance of the intervention, perceived long-lasting benefits, and post-intervention mindfulness scores. This study suggests that the capacity to up-regulate hippocampus-somatomotor coactivation may index part of the individual benefit derived from mindfulness, supporting its role as a tool for emotion regulation and stress management.

relevance.reason: 随机对照研究用静息态fMRI考察正念干预对海马-躯体运动网络共激活及情绪调节相关脑动态的影响，属认知与静息态脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性随机研究以医护学生为对象，用静息态fMRI分析海马种子点的微共激活模式，考察为期八周的MBCT-L课程能否调节海马-躯体运动网络共激活。结果显示，干预提升了自评正念，但海马-躯体运动共激活及静息生理指标均未出现显著的组别与时间交互。在MBCT-L组内，较高的海马-躯体运动共激活与更高的干预重要性感知、持久获益感知及干预后正念得分相关。作者据此提出，上调该共激活的能力可能反映个体从正念干预中获益的差异，但这一关联并非干预效果的证据。

papers.title: Diminished ascending drive in transdiagnostic anhedonia shifts the cortico-subcortical hierarchy away from bottom-up dominance
papers.authors: Roghani P, Vohryzek J, Kringelbach ML, Deco G.
papers.abstract: Anhedonia, the diminished capacity to experience or pursue pleasure, is a core feature of mood and psychotic disorders, yet the large-scale brain dynamics underlying it remain uncharacterized. Dominant accounts posit striatal hypofunction with compensatory prefrontal over-recruitment, but they rest on activation magnitudes and symmetric correlations, which cannot resolve the direction of influence. Here, in 210 adults from the Transdiagnostic Connectome Project, we defined symptom-derived low- and high-anhedonia subgroups and estimated each participant's directed effective connectivity using a whole-brain generative model fitted to resting-state fMRI. In high anhedonia, the cortex shifted upstream relative to the subcortex, flattening the cortico-subcortical hierarchy. Correspondingly, the net balance of direct cortico-subcortical flow shifted from bottom-up to balanced. This shift recurred within the frontostriatal reward circuit and replicated across independent halves of each participant's data. Flow asymmetry also increased with subject-level severity. Decomposing flow into ascending and descending arms showed that both weakened in high anhedonia, but ascending subcortex-to-cortex and striatum-to-prefrontal drive fell more than the descending drive. These findings identify a reorganization of cortico-subcortical hierarchy in anhedonia and suggest that the previously reported prefrontal over-recruitment reflects diminished ascending drive rather than stronger cortical output.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fMRI有效连接建模，考察跨诊断快感缺失者皮层-皮层下层级方向性改变，属于情绪/奖赏的脑网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注快感缺失背后的大尺度脑动力学，尤其是皮层与皮层下之间的信息流方向。作者在跨诊断成人样本中按症状划分高低快感缺失亚组，用全脑生成模型基于静息态fMRI估计有向有效连接。结果发现，高快感缺失者的皮层相对皮层下上移，皮层-皮层下层级变平，净流向由自下而上转为大致平衡；这一变化在额纹状体奖赏环路内同样出现，并在数据分半中重复，且流向不对称随个体症状严重度增加。进一步分解显示上行与下行驱动均减弱，但上行驱动下降更多，提示既往观察到的前额叶过度激活可能反映上行驱动减弱，而非皮层输出增强。

papers.title: Combined eye tracking and electroencephalography during referential selection in dyadic interaction.
papers.authors: Brilmayer I, Georgis P, Schumacher PB.
papers.abstract: Understanding language in real-world interaction requires methods that integrate auditory, visual, and neural signals. We present a proof-of-concept study combining mobile electroencephalography (EEG) and eye tracking to investigate referential selection during dyadic communication. Using a simplified version of the director task, pairs of participants engaged in naturalistic object-movement instructions while EEG and gaze data were recorded and synchronized via LabStreamingLayer, allowing us to calculate overlap-corrected, regression-based event-related potentials (rERPs) time-locked to spoken nouns and to participants' fixations, focusing on the N400/P300 (300-500 ms) and later (500-800 ms) time windows. Our results show that gaze behavior and fixation-related potentials provide crucial information for interpreting language-related ERPs: Targets competing with occluded referents elicited a stronger posterior positivity consistent with greater attentional demands. Fixation timing systematically modulated neural responses. Contrary to predictions, competitors received little visual attention, indicating that participants prioritized task-relevant information. These findings highlight the potential of multimodal data integration for understanding attentional and predictive mechanisms in real-world communication. Importantly, we show that established analytic techniques, such as artifact subspace reconstruction, independent component analysis, and linear deconvolution for ERP calculation, apply to noisy, naturalistic datasets. In addition, we provide a subsampling sensitivity approach to test the stability of the effects across different sample sizes. This study provides a methodological framework linking gaze and neural activity during interactive language processing. All preprocessing and analysis scripts, along with example datasets, are openly available on OSF ( https://osf.io/5ds4z ; a modified and optimized Python implementation is also available on GitHub: https://github.com/XlinCLab/DGAME ).

relevance.reason: 用移动EEG与眼动在双人自然交流中考察指称选择与语言相关ERP，属自然情境下语言与注意神经加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该概念验证研究将移动脑电与眼动追踪同步，在双人互动中考察指称选择过程，记录被试执行简化指令任务时的神经与注视活动。结果显示，注视行为和注视相关电位对解读语言相关脑电十分关键：与遮挡指称物竞争的靶标引发更强的后部正波，提示注意需求更高；注视时机也系统性地调节神经反应。与预期相反，竞争物获得的视觉注意很少，表明被试优先处理任务相关信息。研究还表明常用分析技术可用于嘈杂的自然情境数据，并提供了检验效应稳定性的方法框架。

papers.title: Late Integration of Prior Expectations During Precision-Weighted Perceptual Decisions.
papers.authors: Gastrell T, Rangelov D, Mattingley JB.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Adaptive perceptual decision-making relies on the ability to combine sensory evidence with prior expectations in a precision-weighted manner. Although Bayesian inference provides a clear normative account of how such integration should occur, the neural mechanisms through which the brain represents and combines priors and likelihoods remain poorly understood. Across two preregistered experiments, we investigated how the precision of learned priors and sensory likelihoods influence visual motion judgements and associated neural activity patterns during a random-dot motion estimation task. Neurotypical adult participants (N=80, 58 female) reported directions of visual motion stimuli, with motion coherence varying randomly across trials. Prior expectations over the continuous motion direction space were manipulated block-wise by implicitly varying the probabilities with which different motion directions were presented. Consistent with precision-weighted inference, response accuracy improved as motion coherence increased with robust response biases toward the expected motion direction. Neural activity measured using electroencephalography (EEG) revealed reliable effects of prior expectation on the univariate central-parietal positivity (CPP), consistent with reduced accumulation of sensory evidence under informative priors. Multivariate analysis using inverted-encoding models revealed robust effects of prior precision on stimulus-specific neural representations, but only late, during response planning stages. Together, these findings suggest that priors learned over a continuous space do not modulate the encoding of sensory evidence and are instead integrated later in the decision-process.Significance Statement Perceptual decisions require combining noisy sensory input with prior expectations about what is likely to occur. It remains unclear how the brain integrates prior expectations with incoming sensory evidence. Using a visual motion task and concurrent brain imaging, we show that expectations do not alter early stimulus-encoding, but are instead integrated at later stages of decision formation and action planning. These findings add nuance to influential theories proposing that learned expectations directly affect stimulus representations and instead highlight their contribution to later decision-related processes. This work advances understanding of how the brain uses experience to optimise perceptual decisions under uncertainty.

relevance.reason: 用EEG研究先验期望与感觉证据在知觉决策中的神经整合机制，属感知与决策的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨大脑如何以精度加权方式整合先验预期与感觉证据，通过两项预注册实验，让神经典型成人完成随机点运动方向判断任务，并结合脑电记录。行为上，被试对预期方向的反应偏差随运动一致性提高而更准确；脑电单变量分析显示先验预期影响中央-顶区正波，符合信息性先验下感觉证据累积减少的解释；多变量反向编码分析则发现先验精度对刺激特异性神经表征的影响仅出现在较晚的反应规划阶段。作者据此认为，在连续空间中学到的先验并不调节感觉证据的编码，而是在决策过程较晚阶段才被整合，这为强调先验直接改变刺激表征的理论提供了限定。

papers.title: Representation of emotional expressions across the face and voice brain networks.
papers.authors: Mattioni S, Falagiarda F, Arya T, Gau R, Rezk M, Battal C, Van Audenhaege A, Collignon O.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Recognizing emotions from faces and voices is fundamental to successful social interaction, yet how the brain represents emotional information across sensory systems remains unclear. Here, we systematically mapped the contribution of individually-defined face- and voice-selective cortical regions in 24 human participants of either sex to unimodal and crossmodal emotion expressions. Using multivariate pattern classification, we show that emotional expressions are robustly decodable from the dominant sensory modality across all individually defined face- and voice-selective areas, and that these representations cannot be accounted for by low- and mid-level stimulus properties alone. Strikingly, emotional information from the non-dominant modality-vocal expressions within face networks and facial expressions within voice networks-was also represented throughout the network, with the exception of the occipital face areas. Crossmodal decoding further revealed a shared neural code for facial and vocal emotions in the temporal voice areas, posterior superior temporal sulcus, and precentral gyrus, indicating that these regions contain emotion representations that generalize across sensory modalities. Furthermore, in most face- and voice-selective regions, audiovisual emotional expressions could be distinguished from representations elicited by the dominant unimodal modality, indicating that bimodal signals are not simply represented as their strongest sensory component. Together, these findings reveal that emotion representations are distributed broadly across face- and voice-selective regions and identify temporo-frontal regions as key sites supporting modality-independent emotion representations.Significance statement Recognizing emotions from faces and voices is essential for everyday social interaction, yet the brain mechanisms that integrate these signals remain poorly understood. Using functional MRI (fMRI) and advanced pattern analyses, we show that emotional expressions are represented widely across both face- and voice-selective brain regions-even when conveyed through a non-preferred sensory modality. Strikingly, specific temporo-frontal regions encode facial and vocal emotions using a partially shared, modality-independent neural code. We further demonstrate that seeing and hearing emotions together reshapes how emotional information is organized in the brain, revealing a graded transition from sensory-specific to multisensory representations. These findings challenge strictly segregated models of emotion processing and provide a more integrated account of how the brain supports social understanding.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究面部与声音情绪表征在脑网络中的分布及跨模态共享编码，属社会认知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察面孔与声音选择性皮层区域如何表征单模态和跨模态情绪表达，对参与者进行功能磁共振成像并结合多变量模式分类分析。结果显示，情绪表达可从各面孔和声音选择性区域中稳定解码，且不能仅由低、中级刺激属性解释；非优势模态的情绪信息也广泛存在于相应网络中，枕面孔区除外。跨模态解码进一步发现，颞语音区、后颞上沟和中央前回存在可跨感官通道泛化的共享情绪代码，且多数区域中视听双模态情绪的表征不同于最强单模态成分，提示双模态信号并非简单叠加。这些发现表明情绪表征广泛分布于面孔和声音网络，并指向颞-额区域在模态独立情绪表征中的关键作用。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Design and Access: Toward Visual Scene Displays for Brain-Computer Interface Use in Augmentative and Alternative Communication by Children.
papers.authors: Pitt KM, Sawall J, Butler E, Bubak A, Behboodi A.
papers.journal: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR
papers.abstract: Purpose Brain-computer interface (BCI) may support communication and computer interaction through neural signals such as the P300 event-related potential (ERP). As a step toward integrating photographic visual scene displays (VSDs) in BCI, this study examined the feasibility of incorporating contextual, naturalistic scenes in which communication items were embedded asymmetrically. Method To evaluate the effects of contextual scene use, 24 neurotypical children aged 8-13 years completed three experimental conditions: (1) a contextual scene with asymmetrical item placement, (2) an asymmetrical arrangement of the same items without contextual information, and (3) a standard grid. Electroencephalogram data were analyzed for the N170, P300, and N400 ERP components, and offline (predicted) BCI augmentative and alternative communication accuracy was calculated. Results The results showed that asymmetry increased frontal and centro-parietal P300 amplitudes, and the scene enhanced occipital N170. Offline BCI performance was similar across the scene and grid conditions, and participants rated the scene as more visually appealing. Conclusion These findings indicate that asymmetry and contextual embedding within scenes may enhance neural engagement and user experience, providing a preliminary foundation for considering photographic VSDs into pediatric BCI research.

relevance.reason: 用EEG ERP研究儿童辅助沟通场景中视觉刺激的神经加工，涉及语言交流相关脑机制与注意/语义成分。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨将照片式视觉场景显示用于儿童脑机接口辅助沟通的可行性，以24名8至13岁神经发育典型儿童为对象，比较嵌入不对称摆放沟通项目的场景、无场景信息的同样不对称排列以及标准网格三种条件，并分析脑电成分与离线预测的脑机接口准确率。结果显示，不对称摆放提高了额区与中央顶区P300波幅，场景背景增强了枕区N170，而场景与网格条件下的离线脑机接口表现相近，参与者对场景的视觉吸引力评价更高。作者据此认为，场景中的不对称与情境嵌入可能提升神经参与度和使用体验，为将照片式视觉场景显示纳入儿童脑机接口研究提供了初步基础。

papers.title: Sentence Completion Expressive Language Task-Preschool: Preliminary Evidence of Validity and Feasibility for the Neuroimaging Environment.
papers.authors: Washington KN, Kokotek LE, Altaye M, Vannest J, DiFrancesco M, Maloney T.
papers.journal: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR
papers.abstract: Purpose This preliminary investigation occurred across two studies and examined validity, discriminant accuracy, and feasibility of the Sentence Completion Expressive Language Task-Preschool (SCELT-P) for characterizing language production in a neuroimaging environment for typically developing (TD) preschoolers and those with developmental language disorder (DLD). Method Two separate studies were completed. Study 1 (validity) included 82 preschoolers (50% female; 69 TD, 13 DLD) aged 4;0 (years;months) to 5;11 (M age = 4;7). All children were assessed using standardized language measures (e.g., Clinical Evaluation of Language Fundamentals Preschool-Second Edition), a play-based language sample (analyzed using Developmental Sentence Scoring), and the 30-item SCELT-P (outside the neuroimaging environment), later streamlined to 20 items (SCELT-P Revised [SCELT-PR]). Study 2 (feasibility) included 14 preschoolers (M age = 4;9, 43% female; nine TD, five with DLD) that were assessed using the SCELT-P (inside the neuroimaging environment) and functional magnetic resonance imaging using a sparse acquisition approach with a "listen" (passive) and "listen + speak" (active) condition implemented using DirectRT software. Results In Study 1, the SCELT-P and SCELT-PR demonstrated high reliability, including interrater (intraclass correlation coefficient = .99), test-retest (r = .86 and .80, respectively), and internal consistency (Cronbach's α > .86 and .83, respectively), and similar strong criterion validity (r = . 53-.84). Area under the curve analyses (.91) revealed both versions also evidenced fair sensitivity (.88 and .87) and specificity (.85) rates with a cutoff score of 15.5 and 9.5, respectively. In Study 2, 89% of TD preschoolers and 60% of preschoolers with DLD successfully completed the SCELT-P/R inside the neuroimaging environment, with activation maps illustrating relatively similar neurobiological characteristics across preschoolers in some brain regions. Conclusion The SCELT-P, including its streamlined version, the SCELT-PR, holds promise as a reliable and valid task for including 4- to 5-year-olds in the neuroimaging environment to inform neural and cognitive systems involved in language development. Supplemental material https://doi.org/10.23641/asha.34543209.

relevance.reason: 开发并验证学前儿童句子完成表达性语言任务，并在fMRI环境中采集语言产出脑激活，直接涉及语言产出神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究通过两项子研究检验学龄前句子完成表达性语言任务（SCELT-P）在神经影像环境中的效度与可行性，对象为典型发育儿童和发育性语言障碍儿童。第一项研究显示，原版及精简版任务在评分者间、重测和内部一致性上信度较高，与标准化语言测量的效标效度也较强，并表现出一定的判别敏感性和特异性。第二项研究初步表明，多数典型发育儿童能在扫描环境中完成任务，部分语言障碍儿童亦可完成，且部分脑区激活模式在儿童间相对相似。作者据此认为该任务有望用于4至5岁儿童的神经影像研究，但证据仍属初步，尚不能据此推断临床应用价值。

papers.title: An amygdala-mediated simulation-to-decision cascade aligns interbrain dynamics to solve social dilemmas.
papers.authors: Ni J, Meng F, Zhang C, Tan H, Zeng X, Yang J, Li H, Qi Y, Yan Y, Zhang Y, Zhang K, Ma Y.
papers.abstract: Mutual cooperation (MC) requires independent decision-makers to coordinate under uncertainty about each other's intentions. Using simultaneous intracranial electroencephalography from epilepsy-patient dyads playing a real-time iterated prisoner's dilemma, we identified neurocognitive mechanisms that enable interacting brains to align during mutual cooperation. Amygdala interbrain representational alignment (IBRA), similarity in fine-grained neural spectral patterns across partners, emerged selectively during MC and predicted trial-by-trial outcomes. Early θ-suppression-characterized IBRA reflected rapid, history-sensitive alignment, whereas later IBRA, characterized by low-frequency suppression and γ increases, supported coordinated commitment and action. Furthermore, mutual cooperation relied on an amygdala-mediated, simulation-to-decision cascade, operationalized here as a model-based prospective estimate of partner cooperation that guided self-choice. Amygdala low-frequency suppression tracked this prospective estimate of partner cooperation and θ-γ coupling linked this partner estimate to self-decision processes. Conditional cooperators strategically relied on partner tracking, whereas unconditional cooperators leveraged dispositional tolerance of uncertainty to transition into anticipatory neural alignment. These findings reveal the neural interdependency underpinning MC, redefining cooperation not as isolated decision-making but as a dynamic, interbrain, cognitive alignment.
