papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人脑多尺度组织研究中不同成像与染色方法难以在同一标本上兼容、跨个体比较又受变异干扰的问题，提出并验证了一套在同一张大尺度脑切片上依次整合三维偏振光成像、多重显色免疫组化和尼氏染色的多模态流程，并在猴和大鼠切片上做了验证。由此获得的高分辨率配对图像消除了个体间差异，使纤维束能够相对分子定义的细胞类型进行微米级直接定位，并带来以往难以获得的信息，例如白质成分的分子鉴定、更精细的皮层分层以及细胞构筑的区分。

papers.title: Time at Home for Whom? Unequal Returns of Paid Family Leave for Infant White Matter and Language Development
papers.authors: Lazarus MF, Nelson CA.
papers.abstract: Paid family leave (PFL) may give parents more time with infants, ease financial strain, and support stable routines. Although PFL has been linked to child development, little is known about neural pathways that might underpin its benefits or whether associations vary across families. Using data from 274 infants in the HEALthy Brain and Child Development Study, we examined associations of maternal and paternal PFL with language ability at 12 months and white matter microstructure at 6 months. We tested whether associations varied by the corresponding parent’s education. Neither maternal nor paternal PFL was directly associated with language scores or fractional anisotropy in the left arcuate, inferior longitudinal, or uncinate fasciculus. Maternal education moderated associations between maternal PFL and fractional anisotropy in the arcuate ( p = .014) and inferior longitudinal fasciculus ( p = .003; n = 148). In both tracts, PFL was associated with higher fractional anisotropy only among infants whose mothers had relatively high education. No comparable pattern emerged for language, the uncinate fasciculus, or paternal PFL. Findings suggest that the neurodevelopmental correlates of PFL may depend on family resources rather than operate uniformly across families, underscoring the need to pair paid leave with additional supports and resources. Lay Summary Paid family leave may give parents more time at home, steadier daily routines, and less financial worry in the months after a birth, all of which could change the care an infant receives. But these benefits may not be equal across families. In a national study of infants, we examined whether paid leave taken by mothers, fathers or partners was related to early language skills and to the organization of brain pathways involved in language. Paid leave was not directly related to language scores or brain development overall. However, maternal paid leave was associated with more mature organization in two language-related brain pathways only among infants whose mothers had higher levels of education. No similar pattern was found for father or partner leave. These findings suggest that paid leave alone may not reduce early developmental disparities, and that policies offering paid leave may need to be paired with additional support for families with fewer resources.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察母亲和父亲的带薪家庭假是否与婴儿语言能力及语言相关白质微结构有关，并检验这种关联是否随父母教育程度而变化，数据来自一项婴儿队列的脑发育研究。总体上，母亲或父亲的带薪假与12个月语言得分及多个语言相关纤维束的各向异性均无直接关联；但母亲教育程度调节了母亲带薪假与其中两个纤维束各向异性的关系，仅在教育程度较高的母亲所生婴儿中，带薪假与更高的各向异性相关，语言指标及其他纤维束未见类似模式，父亲带薪假也无此模式。作者据此指出，带薪家庭假的神经发育相关可能取决于家庭资源而非普遍适用，提示带薪假政策或需配合额外支持，但这些关联不等于因果，也不能据此推断带薪假具有治疗效果。

papers.title: Movie Watching for Individual Functional Brain Network Estimation in Adolescents
papers.authors: Godfrey KJ, Grimsrud GJ, Ramirez JS, Corlett A, Houlihan K, Byington N, Gell M, Kretsch S, Dosenbach NU, Barch DM, Gordon EM, Greene DJ, Mueller BA, Betzel RF, Fair DA, Conelea CA, Tervo-Clemmens B, Nelson SM.
papers.abstract: SUMMARY Precision functional mapping (PFM) reveals stable individual differences in brain functional network organization and holds promise for advancing neuropsychiatric clinical care. PFM requires sufficient high-quality and densely sampled functional MRI data at the individual level that is typically acquired during the so-called resting state while passively fixating on a crosshair. However, crosshair fixation acquisitions can be challenging especially for pediatric or patient populations, where alternatives like movie watching might be used to improve data quality and reduce participant burden. Here, we compare the use of resting state crosshair fixation and movie watching fMRI data to derive individual-specific functional brain network topography using PFM data (28–38 minutes of low-motion fMRI data per-participant per-condition) in nineteen adolescents (12-18 years) with a range of transdiagnostic psychiatric diagnoses. Network assignments were largely conserved between crosshair fixation and movie watching, with a smaller subset of reproducible network reassignments which were overwhelmingly border shifts between neighboring networks. This suggests largely conserved global structure of functional network topography between crosshair fixation and movie watching, though border shifts can compound into variable estimates of cortical network size particularly for movie positive (language, salience, and parietal memory) and movie negative networks (default mode, action mode). Functional network assignments derived from movies and crosshair were also similarly individual-specific and consistent within common neuromodulation targets including dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and somatomotor cortex. Key results were replicated in independent pediatric consortia data (Healthy Brain Network, n = 466, 6-22 years) and reproduced across independent PFM data sessions. Acknowledging individual differences and level of analysis, we conclude that movies are a viable alternative to resting state crosshair fixation for individual network definitions.

relevance.reason: 比较电影观看与静息注视fMRI在青少年个体功能网络拓扑估计中的一致性，属自然刺激下脑功能网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了静息态注视十字与观看电影两种fMRI采集方式，能否在青少年中用于个体化功能脑网络拓扑的估计。作者对十九名携带多种跨诊断精神科诊断的青少年进行了分析，发现两种条件下网络归属总体一致，仅少数可重复的归属改变，且多为相邻网络间的边界偏移；这些边界偏移会累积成皮层网络大小的不同估计，尤其影响电影正性网络和电影负性网络。两种条件得到的网络归属同样具有个体特异性，在常见神经调控靶点内也保持一致。作者据此认为，在承认个体差异和分析层次的前提下，电影观看可作为静息态注视十字的可行替代方案，用于个体网络定义。

papers.title: Aging effects on retrospective and naturalistic encoding of time and their relationship with memory
papers.authors: Fricker F, Buzi G, Morantin M, Doidy F, Clochon P, Bordas R, Leroy N, D’Argembeau A, van Wassenhove V, Hinault T.
papers.abstract: In everyday life, attention is not explicitly directed toward time. Yet, we can reconstruct how long an experience lasted from the memory traces it left behind, a process intertwined with episodic memory and subjective experience. As both memory and temporal processing change with advancing age, investigating aging effects could provide critical insights on these reconstructive processes. In this study, 31 younger (aged 24±3) and 36 older (aged 69±6) healthy adults completed two EEG sessions: 1) a resting-state recording followed by an unexpected retrospective time estimation, and 2) a video-based prospective duration estimation task where participants encoded and judged the duration of 50 naturalistic videos (2-32s) varying in eventfulness. Using a cycle-by-cycle burst analysis of alpha (α: 8-12 Hz), we examined oscillatory correlates of both retrospective temporal judgement and prospective temporal processing. Behaviorally, both groups reconstructed short intervals similarly, but older adults produced longer prospective duration estimates than younger adults for longer video clips (16-32s), particularly under low-eventfulness. Regression analyses also showed that individual differences in older adults’ prospective duration judgments were influenced by both their retrospective time estimation and episodic memory abilities, especially for longer videos. At the neural level, resting-state α-burst dynamics were higher in older adults and predicted, with α-power, longer retrospective estimates in older adults. Additionally, resting-state α-burst activity predicted α-burst during video encoding in both groups. Together, these findings reveal that individual α-power and α-burst dynamics could constitute memory-based time-tracking mechanism that aging reshapes in ways that manifest behaviorally under naturalistic conditions.

relevance.reason: 研究健康老年人时间编码与记忆的EEG振荡机制，涉及静息态alpha爆发与自然视频编码，属认知与静息/自然刺激脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察健康老年人对时间的主观重建是否随年龄改变，以及这种改变与情景记忆和静息态α振荡活动的关系。研究比较了年轻与老年健康成人在回溯性时间估计和自然视频前瞻性时长判断中的表现，并结合脑电α节律的爆发分析。行为上，两组对短时距的回溯重建相近，但老年人对较长、事件性较低的视频给出更长的时间估计；其前瞻性判断还与回溯性估计和情景记忆能力相关。神经层面，老年人静息态α爆发活动更强，并与α功率一起预测其更长的回溯估计，且静息态α爆发可预测视频编码时的α爆发。作者据此提出，个体α功率与爆发动态可能构成基于记忆的时间追踪机制，而衰老会在自然情境下改变这一机制的行为表现。

papers.title: Color and Spatial Cue Modulation of Emotional Word Processing: Evidence from ERPs.
papers.authors: Luo X, Li C, Sun Y.
papers.abstract: Emotional word processing is shaped by lexical meaning and concurrent perceptual context. This study investigated when red and green color cues and symbolic upward and downward direction cues modulate the processing of positive and negative Chinese emotional words. Thirty-four native Chinese speakers were recruited, and 27 remained in the final ERP sample after behavioral and EEG-quality exclusions. The experiment used a 2 (color: red vs. green) × 2 (direction: up vs. down) × 2 (word valence: positive vs. negative) within-subject design. Positive words elicited larger P1 amplitudes, and negative words elicited more negative-going N1 and N400 amplitudes. A significant Color × Valence interaction emerged in the late positive complex (LPC) window. The positive-minus-negative LPC difference was descriptively larger under green cues than under red cues, and neither within-color comparison reached significance after Bonferroni correction. Interactions involving spatial direction were not significant across the four components. These findings trace emotional word processing from early valence-sensitive visual attention through semantic processing to late color-dependent evaluation. The temporal pattern supports a context-sensitive account in which perceptual cues, lexical valence, and learned cultural associations contribute to emotional meaning at different processing stages.

relevance.reason: 用ERP研究颜色与空间线索如何调节中文情绪词加工，直接涉及词汇语义与情绪意义的时间进程。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察红绿色彩线索和上下方向符号线索如何影响正负性中文情绪词的加工，以脑电成分追踪其时间进程。结果发现，正性词在早期视觉注意阶段诱发了更大的P1，负性词则诱发更负的N1和N400，说明词义效价在早期注意和语义加工阶段已有体现。在晚期正成分窗口出现颜色与效价的交互：绿线索下正负词差异在描述上大于红线索，但经多重比较校正后，同一颜色内的比较均未达显著；空间方向线索在各成分上均无显著交互。作者据此提出，情绪词加工从早期效价敏感的视觉注意，经语义加工，延伸到依赖颜色的晚期评价，符合知觉线索、词汇效价与文化习得关联在不同阶段共同塑造情绪意义的观点。

papers.title: Novel Neuroimaging Biomarker of Cortical Gray/White Border Integrity in Blast-Related Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.
papers.authors: Andreu Arasa VC, Fortenbaugh FC, Knoff AA, Fortier CB, Milberg WP, Salat DH.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Recent studies suggest that blast or mid-impact neurotrauma are characterized by scar-border forming astrogliosis at the gray-white matter junction. Individuals with mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) and blast trauma have increased neuroinflammation and impairment of axonal remyelination on postmortem histopathology. However, there are currently only limited methodologies to use in the assessment of the cortical gray/white interface using in vivo neuroimaging. The purpose was to investigate the gray-white matter contrast (GWC) at the gray-white matter junction that may be linked to neuroinflammation/astrogliosis in the setting of blast exposure and/or mTBI, through 3D T1-weighted MPRAGE images. Materials and methods Post-9/11 veterans (n =723) from the Translational Research Center for TBI and Stress Disorders completed MRI. Participants were grouped into 4 categories: participants with a history of blast-related mTBI (blast-mTBI), participants with a history of mTBI due to other mechanical forces (blunt-mTBI), participants with a history of close blast exposure but no mTBI, and those without a history of lifetime mTBI or close blast exposure. MRI data processing for morphometry and cortical surface mapping was done using FreeSurfer image analysis. Signal intensities in gray and white matter along the cortical and white matter interface were used to calculate mean GWC value. Results Veterans in the blast-mTBI group showed diffuse patterns of increased GWC relative to the other groups, particularly in the frontotemporal lobes. This effect was driven primarily by a greater number of high GWC regions in the blast-mTBI group compared with the no-neurotrauma and blunt-mTBI groups. Conclusions There was diffuse increased GWC on MR in the blast-mTBI group compared with the no-neurotrauma, close blast exposure, and blunt-mTBI groups. These findings may be linked to astrogliosis and neuroinflammation in patients with blast-mTBI. Histopathologic correlation with imaging findings will be necessary to better understand these effects.

papers.title: Effective Connectivity and Clinical Correlates in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease.
papers.authors: Han KI, Bae JH, Jo HJ, Park JM, Yeo Y, Park TS, Park DW, Kim TH.
papers.journal: International journal of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
papers.abstract: Background Cognitive impairment is a substantial comorbidity in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD); however, the neural mechanisms underlying this association remain poorly understood. This study aimed to assess alterations in effective connectivity (EC) in patients with COPD and investigate their relationships with clinical measures. Methods Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (RS-fMRI) was performed in 38 patients with COPD and 30 healthy controls. EC was estimated using vector autoregressive (VAR) modelling combined with Granger causality analysis across 26 prespecified brain regions of interest derived from our previous functional connectivity study of the same cohort. Between-group differences in directed connectivity were assessed using Welch's t -tests. Associations between EC measures showing between-group differences and clinical measures were evaluated using age-adjusted partial Pearson correlations. Results At the nominal two-sided p < 0.05 level, 37 directed connections showed between-group differences in effective connectivity, and the mean vector autoregressive coefficients for 35 of these connections lay on opposite sides of zero between the COPD and control groups. Among the connections showing between-group differences, age-adjusted associations in patients with COPD involved pulmonary function, systemic oxygenation, cognition, affect, and health status. These associations involved distributed cortical, subcortical, and cerebellar regions, with several directed connections showing convergence across multiple clinical domains. Conclusion Resting-state VAR-based EC revealed distributed between-group differences in direction-sensitive BOLD temporal organization in COPD. Several of these EC measures were associated with pulmonary function, SpO2 , respiratory and COPD symptom burden, cognition, affect, and health status after age adjustment. These findings extend the functional connectivity profile of COPD by linking directed temporal relationships to its multidimensional clinical burden.

relevance.reason: 研究COPD患者静息态有效连接改变及其与认知等临床指标关联，涉及人脑网络组织与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者认知等临床负担背后的神经机制，对患者与健康对照进行静息态功能磁共振成像，并用向量自回归建模结合格兰杰因果分析估计预设脑区间的有效连接。结果显示，两组在多个方向性连接上存在差异，且部分连接的方向性模式在两组间呈相反走向；在患者中，这些有效连接指标与肺功能、血氧、认知、情绪及健康状况等临床测量相关，涉及分布广泛的皮层、皮层下和小脑区域。作者认为，这从方向敏感的时间组织层面扩展了COPD的功能连接特征，并将其与多维临床负担联系起来；但相关分析不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: EEG microstate-source coupling is spatially preserved in ALS
papers.authors: Metzger M, Costa G, Dukic S, McMackin R, Giglia E, Mitchell M, Bista S, Tadjine Y, Sirenko V, Plaitano S, Coffey A, Sharp AF, Mehra P, Suleyman N, Woods E, Heverin M, Bede P, Muthuraman M, Pender N, Hardiman O, Nasseroleslami B.
papers.abstract: Abstract EEG microstates are thought to reflect rapid transitions between brain-wide states and show disrupted temporal dynamics across neurological and psychiatric conditions, including ALS, yet the neural sources generating these states remain incompletely understood. Here, we introduce a source-resolved framework that links time-resolved microstate activations to estimated regional brain signals, enabling estimation of the neural sources underlying canonical microstate classes. Resting-state EEG from a large cohort of healthy controls (HC, n = 122) and individuals with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS, n = 121) was analysed. Canonical microstates were derived from pooled data, and time-resolved microstate activation time series were estimated via projection-based decomposition of scalp potentials. In parallel, EEG source activity was reconstructed using beamformer-based inverse modelling and parcellated into 90 cortical regions. Microstate-source coupling was quantified using ridge regression linking microstate activations to reconstructed regional timecourses, producing spatially resolved coupling maps for each microstate class. In HC, reproducible and spatially distinct microstate-source coupling patterns were observed, consistent with structured mapping between scalp-defined brain states and distributed neural systems. Spatial reproducibility was confirmed using permutation-based null models that preserved temporal autocorrelation within microstate sequences and accounted for spatial dependence across regions. In HC, microstate-source coupling was spatially reproducible across independent subgroups for the four canonical microstates (A-D; r ≥ 0.90, q < 0.05). In ALS, coupling topography was preserved relative to HC for all four microstate classes (r ≥ 0.90, q < 0.05), and cluster-based permutation testing revealed no significant group differences in coupling magnitude for any microstate class, a null result robust to sex and riluzole status. Microstate-source coupling was preserved, suggesting stability of canonical microstate organisation across sensor and source space. Overall, these findings demonstrate that canonical EEG microstates have stable, reproducible coupling with distributed brain sources, and that this coupling organisation is preserved in ALS despite known alterations in microstate temporal characteristics. This dissociation suggests that spatial and temporal organisation of microstates may be governed by partially independent mechanisms, with spatial organisation buffered against ALS-related change, potentially through degeneracy or local compensatory mechanisms, while temporal engagement remains more directly sensitive to disease.

relevance.reason: 研究ALS患者与健康人静息态EEG微状态与脑源耦合的空间组织，属静息态脑网络组织及脑疾病中脑组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个源分辨框架，将脑电微状态的瞬时激活与估计的区域脑信号联系起来，以考察经典微状态类别背后的神经来源；研究分析健康对照与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的静息态脑电，并用束流形成器逆建模重建源活动、以岭回归量化微状态与脑源的耦合。结果发现，健康对照中四种经典微状态均呈现可重复且空间上彼此区分的耦合模式，独立亚组间高度一致；ALS患者的耦合空间拓扑与健康对照相比同样保持稳定，各微状态类别的耦合强度未见显著组间差异，且该零结果对性别和利鲁唑使用状态稳健。作者据此指出，经典脑电微状态与分布式脑源之间存在稳定、可重复的耦合，这种空间组织在ALS中得以保留，尽管已知微状态的时间特征发生改变；空间与时间组织可能受部分独立的机制调控，空间组织或受到缓冲保护，而时间参与则对疾病更敏感。

papers.title: Functional and Structural Imaging Features of Cognitive Profiles in Multiple Sclerosis.
papers.authors: Jain K, Valsasina P, Mistri D, Meani A, Preziosa P, Filippi M, Rocca MA.
papers.abstract: Background and objectives Cognitive impairment affects 40%-70% of patients with multiple sclerosis (MS). Although recent hypothesis-driven and data-driven efforts have identified cognitive phenotypes, functional substrates underlying impairment in such phenotypes are still not clear. Our objective was to identify distinct cognitive phenotypes using clustering in a large cohort of patients with MS and characterize their associated clinical, structural MRI, and resting-state (RS) functional connectivity (FC) features. Methods We conducted an observational, cross-sectional study with right-handed patients with MS and age-matched and sex-matched healthy controls (HCs) who underwent neurologic and neuropsychological evaluation (Brief Repeatable Battery of Neuropsychological tests). Latent profile analysis on cognitive test Z-scores identified MS cognitive phenotypes. 3.0T MRI was used to derive atrophy measures and RS FC within default mode network (DMN I/II), executive control network (ECN), left/right fronto-parietal, language, and salience networks. Linear regression models compared structural MRI and RS FC across cognitive phenotypes and HCs, while polynomial contrasts assessed RS FC patterns across groups. Results Three hundred and sixty-nine patients with MS and 168 HCs were enrolled. Four cognitive phenotypes were detected: preserved cognition ([PC], n = 67[18.2%]), mild single-domain verbal fluency involvement (MSD-VF, n = 37[10.0%]), mild single-domain attention involvement (MSD-A, n = 197[53.4%]), and severe multidomain (SMD) involvement (SMD, n = 68[18.4%]). At corrected threshold, PC patients showed decreased deep gray matter (GM) volumes (p < 0.001-0.001) and similar RS FC vs HCs, whereas MSD-VF exhibited no significant atrophy and no differences in RS FC vs HCs. MSD-A displayed lower cortical/deep GM volumes vs HCs (p < 0.001-0.005), whereas SMD had worse clinical and atrophy features (p < 0.001-0.04), as well as decreased DMN II RS FC (p = 0.01-0.04) vs other groups. Polynomial contrast analyses revealed significant quadratic patterns with increased RS FC in MSD-VF vs HC/PC groups, followed by decrease in MSD-A and SMD, within DMN II (p = 0.005), ECN (p = 0.005), and language network (p < 0.001). Discussion PC exhibited intact RS FC, whereas SMD presented widespread structural and DMN RS FC damage. These findings advance our understanding of cognitive heterogeneity in MS by revealing distinct structural and functional neuroimaging profiles across cognitive phenotypes, encouraging future longitudinal and multimodal investigations to improve disease characterization and prognostic stratification.

relevance.reason: 在多发性硬化患者中结合结构MRI与静息态功能连接刻画认知表型，直接涉及认知的脑结构与网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注多发性硬化患者认知损害的异质性，用聚类方法在患者中识别认知表型，并比较各表型与健康对照在脑结构萎缩和静息态功能连接上的差异。结果发现四种认知表型：认知保留、轻度单域言语流畅性受损、轻度单域注意力受损和严重多域受损。认知保留者虽有深部灰质体积下降但功能连接与健康对照相近，轻度言语流畅性受损者无明显萎缩和功能连接差异，轻度注意力受损者皮层及深部灰质体积较低，而严重多域受损者临床和萎缩表现更差且默认网络II功能连接降低。作者据此指出，不同认知表型对应不同的结构与功能影像特征，认知保留者功能连接相对完整，严重受损者则呈现广泛的结构和默认网络功能连接损害，这有助于理解多发性硬化认知异质性，但相关发现仍需纵向和多模态研究验证。

papers.title: Development of the social perception pathway across the third trimester of gestation and perinatal transition.
papers.authors: Chawarska K, Scheinost D, Constable RT, Lacadie C, Sun H, Chang J, Ment LR.
papers.abstract: Babies display social perceptual skills within hours of birth which may indicate that the neural predecessors of such skills have prenatal origins. However, the putative fetal neural infrastructure supporting these skills remains unexplored. Data from 497 participants scanned between 28-44 weeks postmenstrual age were examined to map the development of intrinsic functional connectivity (iFC) within the proto social pathway (pSP), encompassing the superior temporal sulcus (STS), a region implicated in processing multimodal social stimuli later in development, and the proto ventral pathway (pVP), including the fusiform face area (FFA), a region associated with static face processing in older children and adults. IFC was greater than 0 in the bilateral pSP and pVP by 28 weeks and increased significantly in the left and right pSP and left pVP but not in the right pVP between 28 and 44 weeks. By 44 weeks, both pathways exhibited robust right-dominance. By 40 weeks, iFC for the right and left pSP was significantly higher than in the corresponding pVPs. Lastly, the right posterior STS (pSTS) and the right FFA coupling became positive by 40 and 44 weeks and the left pSTS-FFA coupling became negative by 44 weeks. These findings demonstrate that neural architecture supporting social perception later in life is present in the third trimester and undergoes rapid development across the pre- to postnatal transition. The strengthening of intrinsic connectivity, emergence of right-hemisphere dominance, and early differentiation of putative social perception and face-processing circuitry indicate that key features of the social brain begin to assemble before birth, providing a developmental scaffold for later social development.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注支持社会知觉的神经通路在出生前是否已经形成，利用497名参与者从孕28周至出生后44周的影像数据，考察了原始社会通路（含颞上沟）和原始腹侧通路（含梭状回面孔区）的内在功能连接发展。结果显示，两条通路的连接在28周时已高于零，并在左右原始社会通路和左侧原始腹侧通路中随孕龄显著增强，到44周时均表现出明显的右半球优势；约40周时原始社会通路的连接已高于对应的原始腹侧通路，且右侧颞上沟与右侧梭状回面孔区的耦合在40至44周间转为正相关。作者据此认为，社会脑的关键特征在出生前即开始组装，并在围产期经历快速发育，为日后的社会能力发展提供了神经基础。

papers.title: Evidence for hierarchical representations of written and spoken words from an open-science human neuroimaging dataset.
papers.authors: Banerjee S, Jin K, Nikolov P, Cho P, Pendri VR, Chang L, Damera SR, Riesenhuber M.
papers.abstract: Reading and speech recognition rely on multi-level processing that builds from basic visual or sound features to complete word representations, yet details of these processing hierarchies (in particular those for spoken words) are still poorly understood. We re-analyzed the functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data provided in the Mother Of all Unification Studies (MOUS) open-science dataset by using parametric regressions of word frequency and sublexical unit (bigram or syllable) frequency during reading and speech listening tasks in order to elucidate lexical and sublexical processing stages in the visual and auditory modalities. We first validated our approach in the written word domain, where the technique identified significant correlations for word frequency in the left mid-fusiform cortex (at the location of the Visual Word Form Area) and a left occipital region tracking bigram frequency, compatible with prior reports. During listening, activity in a left mid-superior temporal region consistent with the recently described Auditory Word Form Area (AWFA) showed a lexical frequency effect, while a more posterior region of the superior temporal gyrus was sensitive to syllable frequency. Activation in the left inferior frontal gyrus correlated with both written and spoken word frequencies. These findings suggest analogous posterior-to-anterior hierarchical organizations in the anteroventral visual and auditory streams, with modality-specific posterior sublexical and more anterior lexical representations that converge in higher-order language areas.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用人脑fMRI数据揭示书面与口语词汇的层级性神经表征，属于语言神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究重新分析开放科学脑成像数据，用词汇与亚词汇频率的参数回归比较阅读和听词的加工层级。结果在书写词中复现了视觉词形区的词汇频率效应及枕区对双字母组合频率的追踪；听词时听觉词形区呈词汇频率效应，更后部颞上回对音节频率敏感，左额下回与两种词频均相关。作者据此提出视觉与听觉腹侧通路存在类似的后到前层级组织，后部加工亚词汇、前部加工词汇，并在高级语言区汇聚。

papers.title: Two clusters of brain regions with distinct age-related profiles of functional connectivity in autism spectrum disorder.
papers.authors: Li X, Zuo F, Cheng Y, Perkins K, Cao F.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Brain functional connectivity changes throughout development, and individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) may follow trajectories that differ from those of typically developing controls. Using large multisite resting-state fMRI cross-sectional datasets, we examined how functional connectivity differences between ASD and typically developing controls change across a broad age range of 5 to 64 y. A data-driven analysis identified two spatially distributed clusters of cortical regions showing distinct age-related profiles of ASD-TD connectivity differences. Cluster 1 was marked by consistent hypoconnectivity across ages, suggesting a stable neural signature of ASD. Cluster 2 was characterized by hypoconnectivity in childhood that gradually diminished with age, suggesting a temporary delay profile. These clusters were systematically organized along the sensory-association axis. Cluster 1 mainly involved lower-rank sensory and sensorimotor cortices, while Cluster 2 mainly involved higher-rank association cortices. Brain-behavior analyses revealed greater and broader ASD symptom associations across ages in the consistent hypoconnectivity profile than the delay profile. Further subtype analyses suggested that social-affect symptoms were associated with greater hypoconnectivity than repetitive behavior symptoms in both clusters. Spatial correlation analyses with neurotransmitter maps revealed associations of Cluster 1 with mGluR5 and of Cluster 2 with GABAA α5, providing insight into the neurobiological basis of the two clusters. In a cross-disorder validation analysis, applying the same analytic framework to attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder did not reveal comparable results. Together, these findings suggest that ASD-related functional connectivity alterations are developmentally heterogeneous and organized along the cortical hierarchy, providing a developmental perspective for understanding the neurobiology of ASD.

relevance.reason: 利用静息态fMRI跨年龄分析ASD功能连接发育轨迹及其与症状和皮层层级组织的关系，属脑疾病认知/网络机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用多中心静息态功能磁共振横断面数据，考察5至64岁孤独症谱系障碍者与典型发育者之间功能连接差异如何随年龄变化。数据驱动分析识别出两个空间分布的皮层区域簇：一簇在各年龄段均表现为稳定的连接减弱，另一簇的连接减弱主要在童年出现并随年龄逐渐消退，呈延迟特征；两簇沿感觉—联合皮层轴组织，且稳定减弱簇与症状的关联更广更强。作者据此提出，孤独症相关功能连接改变在发育上具有异质性，并沿皮层等级组织。

papers.title: Mechanistic versus descriptive interpretation of brain activity pattern reconstruction.
papers.authors: Jung K, Eickhoff SB, Patil KR.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: The geometric eigenmodes, derived from the shape of the cortical surface, have been suggested as a better model for explaining brain function due to their high accuracy in reconstructing patterns of both spontaneous and stimulus-evoked brain activity patterns captured by functional MRI, when contrasted with alternative models including structural connectome derived bases. While a descriptive representation offers valuable utility for neuroimaging studies, it is necessary to examine the extent to which it supports a mechanistic explanation for human brain function. Although the observation that geometric eigenmodes accurately fit brain activity is intriguing, we argue that accepting them as a model of brain function risks conflating descriptive and mechanistic interpretations. While a representation that effectively describes the underlying geometry is inherently adept at fitting patterns within that geometric space; it does not necessarily shed light on mechanisms that give rise to the brain's functional attributes. To this end, we provide two lines of empirical results: a) geometric eigenmodes demonstrate a high flexibility when fit to a range of manipulated patterns, and b) localized parcel-based representations can reconstruct activity patterns as well. Based on those results, theoretical considerations, and previous data, we argue that more consideration is needed regarding the complementary roles of descriptive representation and mechanistic explanation in neuroimaging research. While we recognize the potential role of the brain's geometry in influencing its dynamics, assertions regarding its efficacy should be weighed against its inherent lack of specificity, biological interpretability, and anatomical evidence.

relevance.reason: 讨论皮层几何本征模态重构人脑活动模式，辨析描述性与机制性解释，涉及脑结构与功能组织关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该文讨论用皮层表面几何本征模态重建脑活动模式时，描述性表征与机制性解释之间的混淆问题。作者以两项实证结果说明：几何本征模态对多种人为操纵的模式也能灵活拟合，而基于局部脑区的表征同样可重建活动模式。作者据此指出，几何本征模态拟合精度高并不等于揭示了脑功能的产生机制，其特异性、生物学可解释性和解剖学证据均有限，呼吁神经影像研究更审慎地区分描述与机制解释。

papers.title: Predicting individual differences in social functioning from functional connectomes in children with autism spectrum disorder.
papers.authors: Li A, Zhang J, Yu C, Tan L, Yi A, Xiao Y.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is characterized by profound heterogeneity in social functioning. While previous studies using group-level comparisons and predefined regions of interest have identified neural correlates of social deficits in ASD, the neural basis of individual differences in social functioning remains unclear. Here, we applied connectome-based predictive modeling to resting-state functional MRI data from 65 children with ASD aged 1.5-8 years (mean age = 4.23 years) to predict individual differences in social functioning assessed by the personal-social subscale of the Griffiths Development Scales (GDS). Results showed that whole-brain functional connectivity significantly predicted personal-social scores. The positive predictive network was dominated by connections within the default mode network, with the left precuneus emerging as a core hub. In contrast, the negative predictive network mainly involved inter-network connections, particularly between the frontoparietal and sensorimotor networks. In an independent cohort of 27 children with ASD aged 1.25-8 years (mean age = 3.31 years), the positive-edge model showed a significant association with personal-social scores, whereas the negative-edge and combined models did not. These findings suggest that intrinsic large-scale brain network organization is associated with individual differences in social functioning in children with ASD, highlighting the potential of network-level approaches for characterizing neurodevelopmental heterogeneity and supporting future precision-oriented research.

relevance.reason: 用静息态功能连接预测ASD儿童社交功能个体差异，涉及社会认知的脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注孤独症谱系障碍儿童社会功能的个体差异能否由静息态功能连接预测，采用连接组预测建模分析孤独症儿童的功能磁共振数据，并以格里菲斯发育量表个人-社会分量表评估社会功能。结果显示，全脑功能连接能够显著预测个人-社会得分；正向预测网络以默认网络内部连接为主，左侧楔前叶为核心节点，负向预测网络则主要涉及网络间连接，尤其是额顶网络与感觉运动网络之间。在一个独立的孤独症儿童队列中，仅正向边模型与个人-社会得分显著相关，负向边模型和合并模型均未显示显著关联。作者据此认为，内在大规模脑网络组织与孤独症儿童社会功能的个体差异相关，网络层面的方法有助于刻画神经发育异质性，但相关结果尚不能说明因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: A comparative study of modified suanzaoren decoction versus estazolam in chronic insomnia disorder: Clinical outcomes and thalamocortical network changes.
papers.authors: Wang R, Han Y, Chen L, Lv D, Yao P, Guo Z, Guo W.
papers.abstract: Chronic insomnia disorder (CID) is associated with widespread abnormalities in thalamic functional connectivity (FC). For CID patients with the yin-deficiency and fire-excess syndrome, Modified Suanzaoren Decoction (MSZRD) and estazolam are common treatments, but their longitudinal associations with thalamic networks remain unclear. This study was a non-randomized, patient-preference controlled trial. Eighty-two CID patients with yin-deficiency and fire-excess syndrome received a 6-week treatment with either MSZRD or estazolam based on preference. Additionally, 54 healthy controls (HCs) were recruited for baseline comparison. Clinical scales, polysomnography, and resting-state fMRI data were collected pre- and post-treatment. Using the Human Brainnetome Atlas, the thalamus was parcellated into eight subregions. We examined baseline group differences and longitudinal FC changes, and identified genes associated with the baseline FC alterations for enrichment analysis. At baseline, CID patients showed significantly increased FC in pathways involving the medial pre-frontal thalamus, posterior parietal thalamus, lateral pre-frontal thalamus, and caudal temporal thalamus with multiple cortical regions. After treatment, the MSZRD group showed greater improvement than the estazolam group on subjective and objective measures. While FC decreased in the MSZRD group between the left occipital thalamus and right middle frontal gyrus, and between the right occipital thalamus and right angular gyrus, it increased in the estazolam group for these connections. Enrichment analysis of genes associated with baseline FC alterations identified pathways related to synaptic organization, cytoskeletal stability, and metabolism. These findings provide preliminary evidence that CID is associated with enhanced thalamocortical connectivity consistent with the thalamus-centric hyperarousal model, and that MSZRD and estazolam show different clinical and neural correlates. However, due to the non-randomized design and baseline FC differences, these findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation in future randomized mechanistic studies.

relevance.reason: 研究慢性失眠患者丘脑-皮层静息态功能连接及治疗前后变化，涉及脑网络组织与疾病相关脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较改良酸枣仁汤与艾司唑仑治疗阴虚火旺型慢性失眠障碍的临床结局及丘脑皮层网络变化，采用非随机、患者偏好对照设计，结合临床量表、多导睡眠监测和静息态功能磁共振，并纳入健康对照作基线比较。基线时患者丘脑多个亚区与皮层区域的功能连接增强，符合以丘脑为中心的高唤醒模型；治疗后改良酸枣仁汤组在主客观指标上改善优于艾司唑仑组，且两药在部分丘脑皮层连接上变化方向相反。作者提示，受非随机设计和基线连接差异限制，结果仅为初步、假设生成性的，尚需随机机制研究验证。

papers.title: Rightward saccades distort the scaffold of spatial working memory in ADHD.
papers.authors: Moussaoui S, Frost A, Niemeier M.
papers.abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is typically characterized by executive dysfunction, yet emerging evidence points to spatially asymmetrical features of cognition. We examined whether transsaccadic working memory (tWM), the mechanism that integrates visual and motor signals across eye movements, shows directional vulnerability in ADHD. Participants with ADHD completed a spatial tWM task in which memory arrays (one or three items) were presented before leftward, rightward, or fixation trials, and repositioned a probe to the remembered target location. For comparison, data from a previously tested neurotypical sample were included in group-level analyses. Errors were decomposed into systematic and unsystematic components. Compared to controls, ADHD participants showed a modest but reliable rightward-saccade disadvantage, with greater systematic distortions after rightward than leftward eye movements. Saccades disrupted working memory in both groups, but the typical load-dependent increase in unsystematic error observed in neurotypical participants was absent in ADHD. Two complementary interpretations may account for this asymmetry. The integration-imbalance hypothesis attributes it to weakened right-hemisphere contributions to spatial working memory, which impair integration of left-hemisphere oculomotor and right-hemisphere spatial signals during rightward saccades. Alternatively, the anchoring-disruption hypothesis suggests that rightward eye movements destabilize the spatial scaffold anchoring remembered locations, producing geometric distortions without increased error. Together, these findings identify a direction-specific fragility of visuomotor-cognitive coupling in ADHD not explained by general capacity limits. More broadly, they reveal a partial neglect-like pattern of transsaccadic vulnerability: selective impairment for rightward saccades without a left-field deficit, highlighting the utility of oculomotor paradigms for revealing hidden spatial asymmetries in neurocognitive function.

relevance.reason: 研究ADHD患者跨眼动空间工作记忆的方向性不对称，涉及空间工作记忆与半球偏侧化机制，属认知与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）者在跨眼动空间工作记忆中的方向性脆弱，比较ADHD参与者与既往测试的神经典型样本在左向、右向及注视条件下的空间记忆误差，并将误差分解为系统性与非系统性成分。结果显示，ADHD组在右向眼动后出现幅度不大但稳定的劣势，系统性空间扭曲较左向眼动更明显；两组眼动均干扰工作记忆，但神经典型者随记忆负荷增加的非系统性误差上升在ADHD组中未出现。作者据此提出整合失衡与锚定破坏两种解释，认为这反映右向眼动特异的视运动—认知耦合脆弱，而非一般容量限制，并提示类似忽视的方向性模式。

papers.title: Longitudinal associations of screen time with brain development and expressive language skills in early childhood.
papers.authors: Choi EJ, Nichols ES, Tomfohr-Madsen L, Giesbrecht GF, Manning KY, Lebel CA, Duerden EG.
papers.abstract: Screen-based media may reduce reciprocal social interactions that support expressive language development, but little is known about how early language abilities, later screen use, and brain structure are related during toddlerhood. We examined 70 toddlers with structural magnetic resonance imaging and standardized developmental assessments at age 2, along with parent-reported screen time at ages 2 and 3. Greater weekday and weekend screen time at age 2 were associated with poorer concurrent expressive language skills. Right pars triangularis volume did not explain additional variance in these cross-sectional associations. Longitudinally, right pars triangularis volume moderated the association between expressive language skills at age 2 and screen time at age 3. Among toddlers with relatively smaller right pars triangularis volumes, poorer expressive language skills were associated with greater subsequent weekday and weekend screen time. These findings support guidance to limit screen use during toddlerhood, a sensitive window for language and brain development.

relevance.reason: 研究幼儿屏幕时间与表达性语言及右侧三角部灰质体积的关联，涉及语言脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注幼儿期屏幕使用、脑结构与表达性语言能力之间的关系，对幼儿在2岁时进行结构磁共振成像和标准化发育评估，并收集2岁和3岁时的家长报告屏幕时间。结果发现，2岁时工作日和周末屏幕时间较多与同期表达性语言能力较差相关，而右侧三角部体积并未解释这一横断面关联的额外变异。纵向来看，右侧三角部体积调节了2岁表达性语言能力与3岁屏幕时间之间的关联：在右侧三角部体积相对较小的幼儿中，2岁语言能力较差者随后工作日和周末屏幕时间更多。作者据此支持限制幼儿期屏幕使用的建议，并强调这是语言和脑发育的敏感窗口；但上述关联为观察性结果，不能直接推断屏幕使用导致语言或脑结构变化。

papers.title: Diffusion MRI processing in the HEALthy Brain and Child Development study: Innovations and applications.
papers.authors: Cieslak M, Irfanoglu MO, Meisler SL, Salo T, Raikes AC, Cook PA, Chung AW, Lee EG, Li R, Li X, Pecheva D, Fair DA, Smyser CD, Harms MP, Landman BA, Wisnowski JL, Huang H, Alexander AL, Satterthwaite TD.
papers.abstract: The landmark ongoing HEALthy Brain and Child Development (HBCD) study will longitudinally chart brain development in a large sample (projected n = 7200) of infants through age 10 years with multimodal neuroimaging that includes an advanced diffusion MRI (dMRI) acquisition. Here, we detail advances in dMRI image processing developed for HBCD, incorporated into the widely used QSIPrep pipeline. Major changes to preprocessing include improvements in infant brain extraction, distortion correction, and normalization to infant-specific templates. Additionally, we describe a new software package - QSIRecon - that yields rich derived data including diverse maps of tissue microstructure as well as person-specific white matter bundles. Using dMRI data from a subset of the HBCD 1.0 release where age information was available (n = 529 sessions across two time points), we observe critical improvements in data quality with preprocessing and see expected developmental patterns. Moving forward, the publicly-available data from HBCD will rapidly grow to become the largest study of brain development in infancy and early childhood using dMRI. QSIPrep and QSIRecon are openly available and can be applied to other infant and pediatric dMRI datasets.

relevance.reason: 该研究开发婴幼儿扩散MRI处理流程并刻画白质微结构与纤维束的发育模式，属脑结构与发育。

papers.summary_zh: 本文介绍为HBCD纵向婴儿脑发育研究开发的扩散MRI处理流程改进，包括婴儿脑提取、畸变校正和婴儿模板配准的优化，以及新软件包QSIRecon，可生成组织微结构图谱和个体化白质纤维束。作者利用HBCD 1.0发布中部分有年龄信息的数据进行验证，发现预处理提升了数据质量，并观察到符合预期的发育模式。这些公开可用的工具可推广至其他婴幼儿扩散MRI数据集，但摘要未报告具体效应量或临床意义。

papers.title: Caffeine Consumption and Adolescent Mental Health: The Role of Sleep and Brain Structure.
papers.authors: Zheng J, Rakesh D.
papers.journal: Biological psychiatry. Cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging
papers.abstract: Background Caffeine is a widely consumed psychoactive substance, with use beginning during adolescence, a sensitive period of neurodevelopment. Despite its widespread, unregulated use, links between caffeine consumption and adolescent brain structure and mental health remain poorly understood. Methods We examined the association between caffeine intake and brain structure in 9632 adolescents aged 9-11 years. Caffeine consumption (intake of coffee, tea and soft drinks) and mental health were assessed via self-report. Cortical thickness and surface area were derived from structural MRI scans. Linear mixed-effects models tested associations between caffeine intake and brain measures. Structural equation modeling was used to test whether sleep duration and brain structure mediated the association between caffeine intake and mental health outcomes assessed at the 6-month and 18-month follow-up. Results Higher total caffeine intake was associated with lower total cortical surface area (B=-0.03,SE=0.01,p=.001) and lower surface area in 22 regions across four lobes, driven largely by soft drink consumption, with some additional associations emerging for coffee and espresso intake with cortical thickness. All associations were evident at consumption levels as low as one cup per week. Shorter sleep duration and lower surface area sequentially mediated the association between higher caffeine intake and greater mental health problems in the future. Conclusion Findings highlight the need for evidence-based guidelines on adolescent caffeine consumption to support neurodevelopment and mental health.

relevance.reason: 研究青少年咖啡因摄入与皮质表面积/厚度及心理健康的关系，涉及脑结构与发育，符合结构-功能及认知发育范畴。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于近万名9至11岁青少年的自我报告咖啡因摄入量、结构磁共振脑影像及随访心理健康数据，考察咖啡因摄入与青少年脑结构和心理健康之间的关联，并用中介模型检验睡眠时长与脑结构的作用。结果显示，咖啡因摄入越多，皮层总表面积及多个脑区表面积越小，这一关联主要来自软饮料，咖啡和浓缩咖啡摄入还与皮层厚度存在部分关联，且每周一杯的低摄入水平即可观察到。更重要的是，较短睡眠时长与较小皮层表面积依次中介了较高咖啡因摄入与日后更多心理健康问题之间的关联。作者据此强调，需要为青少年咖啡因消费制定循证指南，以支持其神经发育和心理健康；但该研究为观察性关联，尚不能确立因果。

papers.title: Impact of sedation on the reliability of magnetoencephalographic language mapping in pediatric epilepsy.
papers.authors: Song T, Song RR, Bodden C, Deleon R, Cordova J, Huang M, Calley C.
papers.abstract: Objective Magnetoencephalography (MEG) language mapping in pediatric epilepsy frequently requires sedation, which may alter cortical physiology and compromise the reliability of language lateralization. We hypothesized that sedation disrupts coupling between early auditory processing and higher order language networks, reducing the interpretability of laterality metrics. Methods Sixty-nine pediatric patients undergoing presurgical MEG evaluation were analyzed, including 32 nonsedated and 37 sedated participants. Auditory evoked field responses were quantified using the M200/M100 amplitude ratio and interhemispheric asymmetry. Language laterality indices (LIs) were derived from a continuous recognition memory paradigm, and source localization was performed using Fast-VESTAL. Results Sedation preferentially suppressed late auditory responses, reflected by a significant reduction in the M200/M100 ratio (p < .001) and increased interindividual variability. Despite preserved early sensory responses, auditory-language coupling was numerically attenuated under sedation. Notably, low M200/M100 ratios were frequently associated with highly lateralized LI values, suggesting reduced physiological reliability and the potential for "false certainty" in language lateralization. Source imaging demonstrated preserved primary auditory cortical activity with reduced recruitment of higher order association networks in sedated participants. Significance Sedation compromises the physiological reliability of MEG language lateralization by disrupting late auditory and association-level processing. The M200/M100 ratio provides a practical physiological marker for identifying cases in which laterality results should be interpreted with caution. These findings support a physiology-informed framework for improving the clinical interpretation of MEG language mapping in sedated pediatric patients, with direct implications for presurgical planning in pediatric epilepsy.

relevance.reason: 研究镇静对儿童癫痫患者MEG语言偏侧化及听觉-语言网络耦合的影响，属语言神经机制与癫痫术前脑组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注镇静是否会影响儿童癫痫术前脑磁图语言定位的可靠性，比较了镇静与非镇静患儿在听觉诱发反应和语言偏侧化指标上的差异。结果显示，镇静主要压制较晚的听觉反应，使M200/M100比值降低且个体差异增大，同时高级联合网络参与减少；低比值常伴随高度偏侧化的语言指数，提示这种偏侧化可能并不反映可靠的生理状态。作者据此提出，M200/M100比值可作为识别需谨慎解读偏侧化结果的实用生理标记，以改进镇静患儿脑磁图语言定位的临床解释。

papers.title: Cross-state stability and maturational similarity of the social brain connectome in children and adolescents
papers.authors: Lee J, Eilbott J, Kelly C, Todd R, Vanderwal T.
papers.abstract: The intra-individual stability of functional connectivity (FC) across two or more scans and the inter-individual similarity of FC patterns relative to peers capture developmental variability in functional brain organization. Despite their different referents, these measures are strongly coupled at the whole brain level; however, it remains unclear whether this relationship emerges in development, whether it extends to the social brain, and whether it differs by sex. Based on the importance of social development in this age range, we hypothesized that known developmental relationships and sex-specific effects would be more pronounced in the social brain relative to the whole brain. Using a large psychiatrically enriched sample of 769 youth ages 6-21 (female N = 327, mean age = 12.27 years), we computed FC during rest and movie-watching scans and quantified stability across scans as well as similarity to mature subjects (n=36) within each condition. We then tested whether sex-dependent age relationships were captured by these measures or by the strength of their coupling. Our results showed that cross-state stability and maturational similarity are strongly coupled in development, and that this coupling is enhanced in the social brain relative to the whole brain. Furthermore, the strength of stability-similarity coupling increased as a function of age in females, while males showed the opposite effect. When assessing relationships between age and each FC measure independently, no individual effects were significant after FDR correction. However, our multivariate age-prediction models fared much better, demonstrating that edgewise stability and maturational similarity measures can capture spatially heterogeneous developmental effects that are lost when collapsing across edges. Together, these results support the emerging idea that the degree of FC stability across scans is related to how closely an individual’s functional architecture aligns to a shared template. Here, we newly show that this stability-similarity coupling is stronger in the social brain and varies with age in sex-specific ways. Future longitudinal work is needed to establish whether these cross-sectional relationships also characterize within-person developmental change.

relevance.reason: 研究儿童青少年社会脑功能连接组在静息与电影观看下的跨状态稳定性及发育相似性，属社会认知脑网络发育与自然刺激情境脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童青少年社会脑功能连接组在跨扫描状态下的稳定性与向成熟模式趋近的相似性之间的关系，并检验这种关系是否随年龄和性别变化。研究基于大样本青少年在静息和观影条件下的功能连接，计算个体跨状态稳定性及其与成熟被试的相似性。结果显示，稳定性与成熟相似性在发育中紧密耦合，且社会脑中的耦合强于全脑；女性中这种耦合随年龄增强，男性则相反。逐边分析未发现各指标与年龄的独立关联，但多变量模型能捕捉空间异质的发育效应。作者据此提出，功能连接的跨扫描稳定性与个体功能架构接近共享模板的程度相关，并强调需纵向研究验证这些横断面关系是否反映个体内发育变化。

papers.title: Virtual Brain Modelling Reveals Altered Network Dynamics and Predicts Symptom Severity in Schizophrenia: Relevance to Antipsychotic Treatment Response and Resistance
papers.authors: Vitacca M, Pischedda D, Ciccarelli M, Pontillo G, De Simone G, Cocozza S, Ćipranić F, Monteverdi A, Fusar-Poli P, Gandini Wheeler-Kingshott CAM, Palesi F, de Bartolomeis A, D’Angelo E.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia (SZ) is a heterogeneous disorder characterized by positive, negative, cognitive and disorganisation symptoms, with pleomorphic phenotype and poorly understood aetiology. Dopamine dysregulation represents the most replicated in vivo pathophysiology finding. However, accumulating evidence suggests altered large-scale brain connectivity and excitation/inhibition balance disruption. While quantifying these alterations would help clarify SZ neurophysiology and guide therapy, single-patient identification remains impractical. This is particularly relevant for treatment-resistant SZ (TRS) whose pathophysiology remains unclear. Methods Using virtual brain modelling, we simulated large-scale brain dynamics from functional and structural MRI data in 43 healthy controls and 33 SZ patients, stratified into TRS and non-TRS. We used the Wong-Wang model to derive four network parameters reflecting GABAergic and NMDA receptor-mediated glutamatergic transmission: global coupling (G), local inhibitory (J i ) and excitatory (J NMDA ) coupling, and recurrent excitation (w + ). We performed simulations in the whole brain and in resting-state networks, compared model parameters between groups and tested their association with Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale (PANSS) scores. Results Compared to non-TRS, TRS patients showed increased J NMDA and decreased w + at the whole-brain level, increased J NMDA and G in the dorsal attention network, lower G in the limbic network and increased w + in the visual network. Moreover, J i in the default mode network predicted negative symptom severity while J NMDA in the limbic and ventral attention networks predicted total PANSS scores and disorganisation. Conclusions These findings suggest that TRS is characterized by network-specific alterations in excitation/inhibition profiles and support the use of personalised multiscale modelling to identify symptom biomarkers.

relevance.reason: 基于精神分裂症患者结构/功能MRI的虚拟脑建模，揭示网络兴奋/抑制动力学改变并关联症状，属脑疾病机理与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症尤其是难治性患者的脑网络兴奋/抑制失衡问题，利用虚拟脑建模，从功能与结构磁共振数据模拟大规模脑动力学，并估计反映GABA能与NMDA能传递的网络参数。结果显示，与非难治性患者相比，难治性患者在全局及多个静息态网络中表现出兴奋/抑制参数的特异性改变，且默认网络、边缘网络和腹侧注意网络的部分参数与阴性症状、总体症状及紊乱症状的严重程度相关。作者据此认为，难治性精神分裂症具有网络特异的兴奋/抑制改变，个体化多尺度建模有望用于识别症状生物标志物；这些关联属于预测性发现，尚不能说明因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Biologically inspired alignment reveals distributed and directionally asymmetric correspondence between rat and human cortices
papers.authors: Dong X, Luo Q, Cai A, Jin Z, Mu C, Wang F, Shan H.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Rodent models enable causal interrogation of brain circuits, but translating their systems-level organization to humans requires correspondence beyond one-to-one anatomical homology. Guided by the view that cortical areas are characterized by their relationships within distributed functional networks, we developed BrainMapping, a biologically inspired framework for aligning rat and human cortex using resting-state functional MRI. The framework combined a shared representation with optimal transport to derive probabilistic, bidirectional maps. These alignments revealed distributed, many-to-many correspondences that generalized to held-out subjects and preserved functional connectivity architecture, cortical gradients, and graph topology. Organizational preservation was directionally asymmetric. Human-to-rat mapping preserved organization more uniformly across rat cortical systems, whereas rat-to-human mapping showed stronger preservation in human association-related networks than in primary sensory and motor networks. The maps recovered literature-consistent default-mode and salience-system correspondences and generated testable non-canonical predictions. These findings provide a framework for expressing rat functional organization in human functional-network coordinates.

relevance.reason: 利用静息态fMRI对齐大鼠与人脑皮层功能网络，揭示分布式功能组织对应关系，属跨物种人脑功能网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出BrainMapping框架，利用静息态功能磁共振数据，将大鼠与人类皮层在分布式功能网络层面进行对齐，而非依赖一对一的解剖同源关系。结果显示，两者之间存在分布式的多对多对应关系，这些对应能泛化到留出个体，并保留功能连接结构、皮层梯度和图拓扑特征。组织结构的保留呈现方向不对称：人到大鼠的映射在大鼠各皮层系统中保留得更为均匀，而大鼠到人的映射在人类联合相关网络中保留得更好，在初级感觉和运动网络中则较弱。这些映射还复现了与文献一致的默认网络和突显系统对应，并给出可检验的非经典预测，为用人类功能网络坐标表达大鼠功能组织提供了框架。

papers.title: Differential subcortical-cortical circuit reorganization in autism and ADHD
papers.authors: Zhou G, Xie K, Ngo A, Ding R, Cabalo DG, Wang Y, Smith M, Nakamura M, Royer J, Serediuc N, Toussaint PJ, Mottron L, Martino AD, Milham MP, Hong S, Evans AC, Bernhardt BC.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) often co-occur and share symptoms as well as genetic risk factors. While subcortical-cortical networks have been implicated in both conditions, particularly involving thalamic and striatal circuits, patterns of shared and diverging disruptions remain unclear. Here we integrated resting-state functional connectivity (FC) and regression dynamic causal modeling (rDCM) across a transdiagnostic multi-site cohort. We used statistical group comparisons and individualized normative deviation mapping to map network deviations in ASD and ADHD relative to neurotypical controls and against one another. Multivariate associative techniques examined associations to clinical and cognitive phenotypes. Our transdiagnostic analyses revealed significant differentiation of ASD and ADHD across subcortical-cortical circuits. While ASD was characterized by widespread thalamocortical hyperconnectivity and bidirectional elevated coupling across thalamic subdivisions, ADHD exhibited a focal pattern of striatocortical disruption, anchored predominantly within the caudate. Multivariate analyses identified shared and disorder-specific brain-behavior associations. Across both conditions, aberrant striatocortical signaling was associated with reduced overall intelligence measures. Clinically, ASD-related thalamocortical connectivity disruptions mapped onto generalized cognitive impairment, whereas ADHD-related subcortical alterations tracked hyperactive and inattentive symptom dimensions. Our findings differentiate ASD and ADHD through distinct patterns of functional and directional subcortical-cortical dysregulations.

relevance.reason: 以ASD与ADHD患者为对象，用静息态功能连接与动态因果模型揭示皮层下-皮层环路重组及其与认知/症状的关联，属脑疾病机理与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）与注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）在皮层下-皮层环路中是否存在共享及分化的异常模式，整合静息态功能连接与回归动态因果模型，在多站点跨诊断队列中比较两组相对神经典型对照及彼此的偏差。结果显示，ASD以广泛的丘脑-皮层功能连接增强及丘脑各亚区间的双向耦合升高为特征，ADHD则表现为以尾状核为主的局灶性纹状体-皮层环路紊乱，提示两者在皮层下-皮层环路上存在可区分的功能与方向性失调。多变量分析还发现共享和疾病特异的脑-行为关联：纹状体-皮层信号异常与整体智力水平降低相关，ASD相关丘脑-皮层连接异常对应一般性认知受损，而ADHD相关皮层下改变则与多动和注意不集中症状维度相关。这些结果支持将两种障碍区分为不同的环路失调模式，但关联性发现尚不能说明因果或治疗效应。

papers.title: Beyond High-Amplitude Events: Amplitude-Resolved Spatial and Temporal ICA Representations in fMRI
papers.authors: Vu D, Calhoun V.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Functional MRI analyses commonly reduce high-dimensional brain activity using predefined spatial summaries, such as region-of-interest (ROI) averages, or temporally selective representations, such as co-activation patterns (CAPs) and high-amplitude events. These approaches provide useful summaries but do not explicitly characterize information distribution across the continuous magnitude of spatial and temporal network expression. We introduce an amplitude-resolved framework for systematically interrogating this continuum using independent component analysis (ICA). Resting-state fMRI data in the FBIRN dataset were decomposed using spatially-constrained ICA with NeuroMark. For the temporal representation, time points were stratified according to global ICA amplitude and frequency bands, with functional network connectivity (FNC) estimated for each amplitude range. For the spatial representation, we introduce an approach that stratifies voxels according to ICA loading magnitude and generates amplitude-specific spatial similarity matrices. Linear support vector machine (SVM) classification of schizophrenia (SZ) and healthy control (HC) participants was used to probe the information retained by each representation. Discriminative information varied non-monotonically across amplitude: intermediate ranges frequently matched or exceeded the highest amplitudes, while combinations of amplitude ranges further improved classification. These findings demonstrate that informative fMRI structure is distributed across the ICA expression continuum and motivate representations that complement fixed ROI summaries and high-amplitude approaches.

relevance.reason: 静息态fMRI的ICA振幅分辨表征方法研究，并用于精神分裂症分类，涉及自发脑网络组织与疾病相关表征。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种按幅度分层的独立成分分析框架，用静息态fMRI数据分别考察空间和时间网络表达在不同幅度区间上的信息分布，并以精神分裂症患者与健康对照的分类表现检验各层表示所保留的判别信息。结果显示，判别信息随幅度呈非单调变化，中等幅度区间常与最高幅度相当甚至更优，而多个幅度区间的组合还能进一步提升分类表现。作者据此指出，有信息量的fMRI结构分布在ICA表达的整个连续幅度范围内，提示需要发展能补充固定ROI汇总和高幅度事件方法的表示方式。

papers.title: Language-associated brain representations covary with disruption of selfhood under psilocybin
papers.authors: Cooper G, Stoliker D, Astl Delgado VS, Blackburne G, Novelli L, Green DW, Das R, Razi A, Skipper JI.
papers.abstract: Language helps organise experience into an idiosyncratic, temporally extended sense of self. We therefore used fMRI to investigate whether greater similarity between subjects in the activity of language-associated brain regions accompanied psilocybin-induced loss of selfhood using fMRI. Participants heard music and viewed moving clouds at baseline and after 19 mg psilocybin. At each brain location and time point, we tested whether similarity increased with each pair’s summed rank on the Ego Dissolution Inventory (EDI; N=43). We grouped independent components of these associations by time course and decoded each group’s map with Neurosynth. Elementary visual imagery (SI; N=49) and baseline activity served as comparators. Under psilocybin, one group formed a distributed, left-lateralised frontotemporal network matching the Neurosynth language map (r=.382, spatial-null p<.001, q=.003), nearly twice the largest comparator estimate (SI: r=.208, p=.004, q=.028; baseline: r≤.12). In exploratory analyses, resting-state connectivity of this network decreased with posterior visual cortex and increased with thalamic and frontal regions. Participants with higher EDI scores showed larger changes (ρ=.455, Bonferroni-adjusted p=.048; SI: ρ=.008), most strongly for items describing loss of ego or identity (ρ=.43–.51; other items, ρ=.22–.33). We propose that language-associated systems incorporate each person’s semantic and autobiographical context into experience, and that disrupting them contributes to loss of ego and identity.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究语言相关脑区表征与裸盖菇素致自我消解的关系，涉及语言网络、自我认知及自然刺激与静息连接。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用fMRI考察裸盖菇素引起的自我感丧失是否伴随语言相关脑区活动在个体间相似性的变化：参与者在基线和服药后听音乐、观看移动云朵，并分析这种相似性与自我消解量表得分的关系。结果显示，服药后出现一个与语言网络图谱匹配的左侧化额颞分布式网络，其相似性明显高于视觉表象和基线对照；该网络与后部视觉皮层的静息连接减弱，与丘脑和额叶区域的连接增强，且自我消解得分越高者变化越大，尤以描述自我或身份丧失的条目最为突出。作者据此提出，语言相关系统将个人的语义和自传体背景纳入体验，其受扰动可能促成自我与身份的消解；相关分析属探索性，尚不能确立因果。

papers.title: White matter differences in adults with developmental language disorder
papers.authors: Abbott N, Banel S, Cler GJ.
papers.abstract: Developmental language disorder is a highly common yet underdiagnosed neurodevelopmental disorder which impacts receptive and/or expressive language abilities and cannot be attributed to another etiology such as hearing loss or a lack of early exposure to language. There is very little research into the brain differences that characterize developmental language disorder, especially in adult populations In this study, we used diffusion MRI to determine whether adults with DLD show differences in white matter microstructure of the brain when compared to adults with typical language. Participants included 23 adults identified as meeting criteria for developmental language disorder, as well as a group of 26 adults with typical language. White matter microstructure was examined with fractional anisotropy via diffusion tensor imaging and precise biophysical models of intra-axonal signal fraction and orientation coherence via the Standard Model of diffusion imaging, using tractometry to evaluate microstructure differences along white matter tracts. Analysis showed reduced myelin integrity in DLD in the corpus callosum, but increased myelin integrity in the left superior longitudinal fasciculus. It is yet unclear whether differences exist in childhood and are retained into adulthood, are a result of different language environments during childhood, or are a result of behavioral and neural compensation.

relevance.reason: 用扩散MRI比较成人发展性语言障碍与典型语言者的白质微结构，直接涉及语言功能的结构基础及神经发育障碍机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注成人发展性语言障碍（DLD）是否存在脑白质微结构差异，采用弥散MRI比较了DLD成人与典型语言成人的白质纤维束特征。结果显示，DLD组在胼胝体处髓鞘完整性降低，而左侧上纵束的髓鞘完整性反而升高，提示白质差异并非单一方向的普遍异常。作者指出，目前尚不清楚这些差异是童年期已存在并延续至成年，还是源于童年语言环境不同或行为与神经代偿的结果，因此相关发现仍需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Cellular senescence changes and their association with brain structure in schizophrenia and major depressive disorder
papers.authors: Okada N, Seitz-Holland J, Ikegame T, Omileke F, Kiyota M, Shoji E, Mori S, Morita S, Koshiyama D, Satomura Y, Koike S, JINDE S, Yagishita S, Kamiya K, Abe O, Shenton M, Kubicki M, Kasai K.
papers.abstract: Abstract Individuals with schizophrenia (SZ) and major depressive disorder (MDD) may experience accelerated biological aging, potentially linked to cellular senescence and the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). While the SASP index has been reported to be elevated in MDD, its status in SZ and its relationship with brain structure remain unclear. This study investigated whether the SASP index, a composite biomarker-based measure, is elevated in SZ and MDD, and examined its associations with brain-predicted age difference (brain-PAD) and regional brain morphology across SZ, MDD, and healthy controls (HCs). A total of 119 subjects (29 individuals with SZ, 40 individuals with MDD, and 50 HCs) underwent both peripheral blood collection and MRI scanning. First, across all subjects, the effects of diagnostic groups on SASP indices were assessed. Second, associations between age-adjusted SASP indices and brain-PAD were examined within each diagnostic group. Third, exploratory analyses tested associations between SASP indices and subcortical volumes as well as cortical thickness and surface area in each diagnostic group. We found a significant main effect of diagnostic group on SASP indices and significantly elevated SASP indices in both SZ and MDD. Although no significant associations were observed between SASP indices and brain-PAD in any diagnostic group, negative associations were identified in SZ between SASP indices and the surface area of the left transverse temporal gyrus and the right inferior frontal gyrus pars triangularis, regions that play pivotal roles in auditory and language processing alterations observed in SZ. These findings suggest that SASP-related processes may contribute to the neural underpinnings of SZ through localized, rather than global, alterations in brain structure.

relevance.reason: 在精神分裂症和抑郁症患者中考察细胞衰老标志与脑结构形态的关联，属脑疾病机理与结构-功能范畴。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较精神分裂症患者、重性抑郁障碍患者与健康对照者的衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）综合指标，并考察其与脑预测年龄差及局部脑形态的关系。结果发现，两种患者组的SASP指标均显著高于健康对照，但该指标与脑预测年龄差在任何组中均无显著关联。在精神分裂症患者中，SASP指标与左侧颞横回及右侧额下回三角部皮层表面积呈负相关，这些区域与听觉和语言加工有关。作者据此提出，SASP相关过程可能通过局部而非全局的脑结构改变，参与精神分裂症的神经基础；相关发现尚属关联性，不能推断因果。

papers.title: Beyond Gray Matter: White Matter Functional Network Signatures of Major Depressive Disorder Track Symptom Severity
papers.authors: Calhoun V, Sridhar M, Baker B.
papers.abstract: Abstract Resting-state neuroimaging studies in major depressive disorder (MDD) have consistently identified abnormalities across large-scale gray matter (GM) networks, including the default mode, salience, and sensorimotor systems. Although prior work has primarily focused on GM, evidence suggests that white matter (WM) hemodynamic signals are meaningful and reliable, supporting an active role for WM in brain function. A key gap remains in understanding WM functional network connectivity (FNC) and spectral characteristics in MDD. We used resting-state fMRI scans from the MDD-DIRECT phase II study, comprising 1,944 participants across 13 sites, to examine WM FNC and spectral characteristics in individuals with MDD and healthy controls using a spatially constrained independent component analysis (ICA) framework. This hybrid framework leverages ICA’s ability to identify spatially robust, functionally meaningful brain networks guided by replicable spatial priors to examine WM (1) FNC differences and (2) spectral power alterations between MDD and healthy participants. MDD was characterized by reduced long-range integrative connectivity alongside increased localized and limbic–sensorimotor coupling within WM networks, highlighting a systems-level imbalance in neural communication that may underlie core cognitive, affective, and somatic symptoms of depression. We also observed reduced low-frequency spectral power within frontal and subcortical WM systems involved in cognitive control, emotional regulation, and decision-making. Notably, both functional and spectral alterations were associated with clinical measures of depression and anxiety, with opposing associations observed for frontal connectivity patterns. Studying WM function alongside GM may provide a more comprehensive understanding of functional pathology in depression.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fMRI分析抑郁症患者白质功能网络连接与频谱特征，并关联症状，涉及白质功能信号、脑网络组织及疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍中白质功能网络连接与频谱特征是否异常，利用静息态功能磁共振数据，在白质空间先验引导下用独立成分分析比较患者与健康对照。结果显示，患者白质网络表现为长程整合连接减弱、局部及边缘系统—感觉运动耦合增强，提示系统层面的神经通讯失衡；同时，参与认知控制、情绪调节和决策的额叶及皮层下白质低频功率降低。这些功能与频谱改变同抑郁和焦虑的临床测量相关，且额叶连接模式呈现方向相反的关联。作者认为，结合白质与灰质功能有助于更全面地理解抑郁的功能病理，但相关发现尚属关联层面。

papers.title: Frequency-Specific Age Associations in EEG Microstate Dynamics Across the Adult Lifespan
papers.authors: Sanjar K, Tarailis P, Griskova-Bulanova I.
papers.abstract: Abstract EEG microstates are conventionally derived from broadband signals, although their temporal dynamics may differ across frequency ranges. Whether age associations in conventional voltage microstates are similarly frequency specific remains unclear. We examined resting-state EEG from 60 healthy adults aged 20–78 years and derived microstates separately from broadband (1–30 Hz), delta (1–4 Hz), theta (4–8 Hz), alpha (8–12 Hz), and beta (15–30 Hz) activity. The number of microstates was selected independently for each band using the Krzanowski–Lai criterion, yielding four classes for broadband, delta, alpha, and beta, and five for theta. Age associations were tested for duration, occurrence, coverage, global explained variance, observed transition probabilities, and transitions adjusted for those expected from class prevalence, with false-discovery-rate correction. Age associations showed a marked spectral dependence. Of 84 state-level tests, 13 survived correction: one in broadband, six in delta, one in theta, none in alpha, and five in beta. In delta, increasing age was associated with greater expression of MS B and reduced expression of MS C across duration, occurrence, and coverage. In beta, age was associated with greater MS A expression and reduced MS C expression. All significant state-level associations remained after adjustment for sex, education, and band-specific spectral power. Eight observed transition associations survived correction, all in broadband and delta, but only three remained after accounting for transitions expected from state prevalence. These findings indicate that age-related variation in EEG microstate dynamics is strongly frequency-specific and is expressed primarily through redistribution of state expression rather than through widespread alteration of transition preference. Frequency-resolved microstate analysis, hence, reveals age associations that are not evident in conventional broadband analysis.

relevance.reason: 研究成人静息态EEG微状态随年龄的频率特异性动态变化，属静息态脑活动组织与脑老化可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察健康成人静息态脑电微状态的年龄关联是否随频段而异，分别从宽带及delta、theta、alpha、beta频段提取微状态，并检验其多项动态指标与年龄的关系。结果显示年龄关联具有明显的频谱依赖性：显著结果主要集中在delta和beta频段，表现为不同微状态表达量的此消彼长，而非转移偏好的普遍改变；这些关联在控制性别、教育程度和频段功率后仍存在。作者据此指出，分频段分析能揭示传统宽带分析未显现的年龄差异，提示微状态动态的年龄变化需结合频率成分理解。

papers.title: Rapid parameter-efficient calibration for cross-session intracortical speech decoding across multiple datasets
papers.authors: Roy D, Tabassum F, Mozumder R.
papers.abstract: Abstract Intracortical speech brain–computer interfaces (BCIs) can restore communication for people who cannot speak, but longitudinal neural variability can degrade decoding across sessions. We implemented a parameter-efficient cross-session calibration framework using separate recurrent connectionist temporal classification (CTC) decoders for two public intracortical speech datasets (T12 and T15). Adaptation was restricted to a 256 × 256 affine transformation and bias at the neural input, while the recurrent encoder and CTC classifier remained frozen. Sessions were split chronologically; the calibration protocol was selected only on T12 validation sessions, frozen before later T12 testing, and transferred unchanged to T15. Only 65,792 parameters (<0.05% of either model) were updated using 40 or 80 labeled trials. On T12, macro phoneme error rate improved by 11.37% and 15.51%, with all six held-out sessions improving under all three seeds. On T15, improvements were 2.72% and 10.05%, revealing greater session dependence. Extending prior work on high-performance and rapidly calibrating speech neuroprostheses, this study tests a fixed lightweight calibration rule across two independent datasets under a validation-locked protocol. These findings provide a leakage-resistant cross-dataset evaluation of rapid longitudinal recalibration and show that input-space adaptation can recover a substantial, but not universal, component of cross-session mismatch.

relevance.reason: 研究颅内语音脑机接口的跨会话解码校准，直接涉及人脑言语产出神经信号的解码与表征稳定性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对皮层内语音脑机接口在跨会话使用中因神经信号变化而解码性能下降的问题，提出一种参数高效的校准框架，并在两个公开数据集上检验其效果。方法上，作者冻结循环编码器和CTC分类器，仅用少量标注试次更新神经输入端的仿射变换和偏置，且校准方案先在一个数据集上选定并锁定，再原样迁移到另一数据集。结果显示，该校准在两个数据集上均能改善音素错误率，但改善幅度因会话而异，说明输入空间适配只能恢复跨会话失配中的一部分而非全部。作者据此强调，这是一种避免信息泄漏的跨数据集评估，支持轻量校准的实用价值，同时保留了其效果不具普遍性的限定。

papers.title: Effects of Metformin on Resting-State EEG and Associations with Adaptive Behaviors in Fragile X Syndrome
papers.authors: Lippé S, Buckser R, Davoudi S, Arutiunian V, Knoth ISK, Thurman A, Bélanger A, Martin C, Proteau-Lemieux M, Santos E, Rubanarayana K, Pham T, Whitlock K, Bennett J, Tassone F, Kim K, Biag H, Hessl D, Schneider A, Abbeduto L, Jacquemont S, Bolduc F, Hagerman R.
papers.abstract: Abstract Metformin has emerged as a candidate drug for Fragile X Syndrome (FXS) after promising results in animal studies and small-scale trials. A three-site registered clinical trial (RCT) demonstrated effects of metformin on behavioral symptoms in FXS in participants aged 6–11. Resting state electroencephalography (RS-EEG) was also collected during the RCT. We present results from analyses of RS-EEG and associated adaptive behavior measures. We observed significant metformin treatment effects on EEG measures associated with cortical excitation/inhibition balance (periodic gamma), brain maturation (periodic alpha), and signal complexity. Significantly affected EEG measures moved toward values associated with typical development. We also observed associations between more typical EEG activity and improved adaptive behavior scores in the treatment group. Additional significant effects and associations were observed when considering only participants without molecular mosaic. Results confirm metformin’s potential as a treatment option and encourage further research into its effects on functional brain activity.

relevance.reason: 脆性X综合征药物试验中分析静息态EEG与皮层兴奋/抑制平衡及适应行为关联，属脑疾病神经机制与静息活动研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于一项多中心注册临床试验，分析二甲双胍对6至11岁脆性X综合征儿童静息态脑电及适应性行为的影响。结果显示，二甲双胍显著改变了与皮层兴奋/抑制平衡、脑成熟和信号复杂度相关的脑电指标，且这些变化朝向典型发育的方向；在治疗组中，更典型的脑电活动与适应性行为评分的改善相关。仅纳入无分子嵌合体的参与者时，还观察到其他显著效应和关联。作者认为这些结果支持二甲双胍作为潜在治疗选择，并提示需进一步研究其对脑功能活动的作用。

papers.title: Uncovering Latent Cognitive, Metacognitive, and Neural Bases of Problem-Solving Deficits in Children with Developmental Dyscalculia.
papers.authors: Lasnick OHM, Park Y, Mistry P, Menon V.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Developmental dyscalculia (DD) affects 7-10% of children and is characterized by persistent difficulties in arithmetic problem-solving, which depends on the dynamic interplay between cognitive and metacognitive control processes governing strategy execution and selection. Conventional behavioral and neuroimaging approaches do not simultaneously quantify these latent processes and link them to distributed neural mechanisms, leaving the neurocognitive and metacognitive underpinnings of DD insufficiently characterized. We integrated Bayesian computational modeling with whole-brain decoding to uncover cognitive, metacognitive, and neural bases of problem-solving deficits in DD using a sample of 68 children aged 8-10 years (38 female). Children with DD showed deficits across all problem-solving strategies (counting, retrieval, and decomposition), indicating reduced strategy execution efficiency. They also exhibited significant metacognitive impairments: longer baseline switching times between strategies, reduced sensitivity to problem difficulty, and lower adaptivity in selecting optimal strategies. Whole-brain Elastic Net decoding accurately distinguished DD from TA peers based on distributed activation patterns across frontoparietal cortex, hippocampus, and ventral-visual regions, whereas univariate approaches did not. Linear multivariate brain-behavioral analyses and nonlinear transformer-based predictions converged in showing that these distributed signatures predicted counting efficiency and switching sensitivity. Notably, brain-behavior relations reversed in direction between groups, positive in TA children but negative in DD, most strikingly in the hippocampus. These findings demonstrate that arithmetic difficulties in DD arise from deficits in both strategy execution efficiency and metacognitive control, reflecting an altered mapping between distributed neural activity, and highlight the power of integrating computational modeling with brain-wide decoding to understand learning disabilities.

relevance.reason: 该研究以发展性计算障碍儿童为对象，结合计算建模与全脑解码，揭示其问题解决策略执行与元认知控制的认知及分布式神经基础，属于脑疾病认知机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注发展性计算障碍儿童算术解题困难背后的认知、元认知与神经基础，将贝叶斯计算建模与全脑解码结合，考察8至10岁儿童在策略执行与选择上的表现。结果显示，计算障碍儿童在计数、提取和分解等策略上均表现出执行效率下降，同时存在元认知缺陷，包括策略切换的基线时间更长、对题目难度不够敏感以及选择最优策略的适应性较低。全脑解码能依据额顶皮层、海马和腹侧视觉区的分布式激活模式区分计算障碍儿童与典型发展同伴，且这些神经特征可预测计数效率与切换敏感性；值得注意的是，脑与行为的关系在两组间方向相反，海马区尤为明显。作者据此认为，计算障碍的算术困难同时源于策略执行效率与元认知控制两方面，并反映分布式神经活动与行为之间映射关系的改变。

papers.title: Time<sup>2</sup>: A Framework for the Neural Dynamics of Visual Perception.
papers.authors: Caplette L, Gosselin F.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Whenever we look at an object, we seem to perceive it immediately. However, this is not the case for two reasons. First, it takes hundreds of milliseconds for the brain to process visual information reaching the retina. Second, perceiving an object requires fixating it for some duration-typically hundreds of milliseconds-during which the retina continuously receives new visual information. These facts together imply that visual information is both processed and received through time. These two temporal facets of perception, which we term processing time and stimulus time, are often conflated in the literature, and rarely considered together in experiments. Here, we argue that, to obtain a more complete portrait of visual perception and further constrain models of vision, it is essential to consider and measure both temporal facets simultaneously. We present a new method designed to do so that is based on reverse correlation: Time2 We show that this method allows us to precisely characterize many neural phenomena, including rhythmic perception, predictive processing, and coarse-to-fine sampling.

relevance.reason: 提出视觉感知神经动力学框架，讨论时间维度上的视觉加工与预测处理机制，属感知神经机制理论框架。

papers.summary_zh: 该文指出，视觉感知涉及两个常被混为一谈的时间维度：大脑处理视觉信息所需的加工时间，以及视网膜在注视期间持续接收新信息的刺激时间。作者提出，要更完整地刻画视觉感知并约束视觉模型，实验中有必要同时考虑和测量这两个时间维度，并为此介绍了一种基于反向相关的新方法Time²。摘要称该方法可精确刻画节律性感知、预测性加工和由粗到细采样等多种神经现象，但未报告具体实验结果或实证数据，因此其实际效用仍有待验证。

papers.title: Voluntary movement initiation is associated with cardiac input in Libet's task.
papers.authors: Germanova K, Studenova A, Bredikhin D, Gippert M, Kapralov N, Klucharev V, Villringer A, Herrojo Ruiz M, Nikulin V.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: ​​The relationship between motor intention and initiation of voluntary movement remains a fundamental topic in neuroscience, originating from the seminal framework of B. Libet, introduced in 1983. Libet's paradigm significantly influenced discussions on intentionality, motor control, and free will. However, methodological critiques continue to challenge its interpretations, specifically the accuracy and validity of the 'urge to move' phenomenon. One understudied factor in this debate is the potential influence of interoceptive signals-such as cardiac activity-in shaping the experience of motor intention and movement initiation. In our study, we addressed this gap by examining whether cardiac signals modulate participants' experience of the 'urge to move', using behavioural and electrophysiological measures in 39 healthy human participants (17 males and 22 females) performing Libet's task.
