Crucially, when participants were asked to follow the 'urge to move', their button press timings were predominantly aligned with the diastolic phase of the cardiac cycle, indicating cardiac modulation of movement initiation. However, analysing heart evoked potential (HEP) amplitudes as a measure of cardiac input perception, we observed no differences in HEP amplitudes associated with changes in introspective demands during the task in both source and sensor spaces. Our results suggest that implicit perception of cardiac signals biases voluntary action initiation in Libet's task, independently of cortical interoceptive markers. These findings have implications for models of motor preparation, intentionality, and the bodily basis of voluntary action, challenging conventional interpretations of motor intention and informing debates on volition and interoception.Significance Statement Our study provides evidence that implicit perception of cardiac signals influences movement initiation in Libet's task. We demonstrate, for the first time, that when attending to the 'urge to move', participants tended to initiate voluntary movements during the diastolic phase of the cardiac cycle. These findings challenge traditional views on factors affecting motor initiation in Libet's task, suggesting the relevance of interoceptive processing. By highlighting the role of cardiac input in experiencing motor intention, our findings expand on existing debates on volition, agency, and free will, further underscoring the importance of integrating bodily signals into these theoretical frameworks.

relevance.reason: 研究心脏内感受信号对随意运动发起（Libet任务）的调节，结合行为与EEG/HEP，属运动意图与内感受的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注Libet任务中随意运动的发起是否受心跳等内感受信号影响，采用行为与脑电测量考察健康参与者在关注“想动”冲动时的按键时机及心脏诱发电位。结果显示，参与者的按键时间主要落在心动周期的舒张期，提示对心脏信号的隐性感知会偏向运动发起；但心脏诱发电位幅度并未随任务内省要求变化，说明这一效应可能不依赖皮层层面的内感受标记。作者据此认为，身体信号可能参与塑造运动意图与随意动作的发起，对传统运动准备和自由意志解释构成挑战，但相关发现仍属关联性证据，其机制和临床意义尚待进一步验证。

papers.title: Dynamic Reduction of Neural Uncertainty Shapes Perceptual Decisions in a Bayes-Optimal Manner.
papers.authors: Rangelov D, Bitzer S, Mattingley JB.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Fast and accurate decisions are fundamental for adaptive behavior. Theories of decision-making posit that evidence in favor of different choices is gradually accumulated until a critical value is reached. It remains unclear, however, which aspects of the neural code get updated during evidence accumulation. Here we investigated whether evidence accumulation relies on a gradual increase in the precision of neural representations of sensory input (i.e., a decrease in neural uncertainty). Healthy human volunteers (N = 32, 24 females) discriminated global motion direction over a patch of moving dots, and their brain activity was recorded using electroencephalography. Time-resolved neural uncertainty was estimated using multivariate feature-specific analyses of brain activity. Behavioral measures were modeled using iterative Bayesian inference (BI) either on its own (i.e., the full model) or by swapping free model parameters with neural uncertainty estimates derived from brain recordings. The neurally restricted model was further refitted using randomly shuffled neural uncertainty. The full model and the unshuffled neural model yielded very good and comparable fits to the data, whereas the shuffled neural model yielded worse fits. Taken together, the findings reveal that the brain relies on reducing neural uncertainty during decision-making. They also provide neurobiological support for BI as a fundamental computational mechanism in support of decision-making.

relevance.reason: 用EEG研究人类知觉决策中神经不确定性动态降低与证据累积的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注决策过程中证据累积时神经编码究竟哪一层面被更新，让健康志愿者辨别运动点阵的整体运动方向，并用脑电记录其大脑活动，结合多变量分析方法估计随时间变化的神经不确定性。结果显示，用真实的神经不确定性估计替换贝叶斯推断模型中的自由参数后，模型对行为的拟合与完整模型相当，而打乱神经不确定性后拟合变差，说明大脑在决策中依赖神经表征精度的逐步提高，即神经不确定性的降低，并为迭代贝叶斯推断作为决策的基本计算机制提供了神经生物学支持。

papers.title: Individualized Network Topography in Pre-adolescent Children and Adults Using Naturalistic Precision fMRI.
papers.authors: Rai S, Godfrey KJ, Graff K, Tansey R, Merrikh D, Yin S, Feigelis M, Demeter DV, Vanderwal T, Greene DJ, Bray S.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Group-averaged network definitions, commonly used in developmental functional connectivity research, limit our understanding of how network topography may change with age and can lead to inaccurate estimates of age effects on intra- and inter-network functional connectivity. Here, we collected a precision fMRI dataset from 24 parent-child pairs (children 6-8 years, 13 females; adults 33-47 years, 12 females) during passive video viewing and derived individual template-matched functional network maps from 60 min of motion-censored data per participant. Overall, large-scale network architecture was broadly shared between children and adults, with no age effects observed for network-level surface area, few age differences in network boundaries, and generally lower assignment confidence in children. Considering interindividual similarity in network topography, association networks showed stronger within-family similarity and no overall effect of age on similarity of networks between pairs of individuals. We further asked how individualized network definitions might impact estimates of age effects on dense functional connectivity. While all approaches pointed to greater within-network functional connectivity in adults, we found that individualized approaches had larger age effects and lower sensitivity to head motion. Together, our results suggest that, relative to adults, preadolescent children show reduced network assignment confidence and weaker within-network connectivity but limited differences in network borders and size and underscore the value of individualized mapping for improving topographic reliability and increasing sensitivity to age effects.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用自然视频观看的精准fMRI，考察儿童与成人个体化功能网络拓扑及发育差异，属于脑网络组织与发育的认知神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用自然观看视频的精准fMRI数据，为24对亲子（6至8岁儿童与33至47岁成人）构建个体化功能网络图谱，考察网络拓扑是否随年龄变化，以及个体化定义如何影响年龄效应估计。结果显示，儿童与成人的大规模网络架构大体共享，网络面积无年龄差异，边界差异很少，但儿童网络归属置信度较低；成人网络内连接更强。作者指出，个体化图谱可提高拓扑可靠性并更敏感地检出年龄效应，同时提示组平均定义可能低估发育差异。

papers.title: Late Cross-Modal Biases in Neural Spatial Representations Revealed by EEG Decoding.
papers.authors: Buhmann Z, Robinson AK, Mattingley JB, Rideaux R.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: During audiovisual perception, spatial information from vision and audition is combined, often producing biases such as the ventriloquist effect. While these interactions are well documented behaviorally, it remains unclear when cross-modal information begins to alter modality-specific spatial representations in the brain. Here we used cross-generalized inverted encoding modeling of electroencephalography (EEG) data to track the temporal evolution of spatial representations during a spatial ventriloquist task. Human participants (both sexes) localized audiovisual stimuli with horizontally offset auditory and visual components. Decoders trained on unisensory EEG responses were applied to audiovisual trials to estimate whether and when spatial representations of one modality were biased toward the other. Behaviorally, participants integrated cues but showed slight visual overweighting. Neural decoding revealed robust spatial representations for both modalities, with early unisensory encoding remaining unaffected by cross-modal input. Cross-modal biases emerged only later (from ∼200 ms onward), within a generalized representational window, and occurred sequentially: auditory representations were biased earlier than visual. These findings indicate that multisensory spatial integration arises via recurrent feedback during later processing stages, while early sensory-specific representations remain independent, providing a neural basis for the temporal dynamics underlying the ventriloquist effect.

relevance.reason: 用EEG解码追踪视听空间表征的跨模态整合时间动态，属感知/多感觉整合的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注视听空间信息何时开始改变大脑中各自通道的空间表征，采用脑电数据的跨泛化逆向编码建模，在空间腹语者任务中追踪人类被试对水平错位视听刺激的空间编码过程。结果显示，两种通道均有稳定的空间表征，早期单通道编码不受另一通道输入影响；跨通道偏向约在200毫秒后才出现，且听觉表征先于视觉表征受到偏向。作者据此认为，多感觉空间整合依赖较晚阶段的递归反馈，而早期感觉特异性表征保持相对独立，这为腹语者效应的时间动态提供了神经层面的解释。

papers.title: A Parietal Grid-Like Code Rotates with Cognitive Maps But Lags Rapid Behavioral Transfer.
papers.authors: Yu LQ, Vaidya AR, Akhmetzhanova AA, Bruinsma S, Nassar MR.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: The neural grid code has been proposed to provide a mechanism for generalization and transfer of relational knowledge between situations enabling rapid adaptation of behavior in novel circumstances. However, to date, very little is known about the dynamics with which grid representations change at context transitions or how such dynamics relate to downstream behavioral adaptation. Here we tested whether grid representations measured with fMRI rotate to match behavioral goals at context transitions and whether such rotations underlie knowledge transfer. Human participants (25 females and 23 males) performed a task that included unsignaled state changes at which the position of multiple target locations abruptly and synchronously rotated by the same degree. After state changes, participants were able to leverage the relative positions of the targets to rapidly infer locations, even novel ones, constituting a form of zero-shot transfer. We observed a cognitive grid-like code in the right posterior parietal cortex with a consistent phase angle that rotated with the relative positions of the targets. However, this rotation was too slow to account for rapid improvements in performance after a state change, and instead these improvements were more closely related to representations of the identity and location of spatial targets in the frontoparietal and orbitofrontal cortex, respectively. Our results highlight the ability of humans to rapidly transfer knowledge and demonstrate that a parietal grid-like code rotates into behaviorally relevant reference frames but indicate that alternate neural mechanisms support rapid knowledge transfer.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究人脑右侧后顶叶网格样编码随认知地图旋转及其与行为迁移的关系，属空间认知与学习的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨网格样神经编码能否在情境转换时旋转以匹配行为目标，并解释快速的知识迁移。被试完成包含无提示状态变化的空间任务，状态变化时多个目标位置同步旋转；结果发现右侧后顶叶皮层存在认知网格样编码，其相位角随目标相对位置旋转，但旋转速度过慢，无法解释状态变化后行为的快速改善。快速改善反而更与额顶叶和眶额皮层中目标身份及位置的表征相关。作者据此指出，人类能快速迁移关系知识，顶叶网格样编码虽会转入行为相关的参照框架，但快速迁移可能依赖其他神经机制。

papers.title: Passive Language Mapping With High-Gamma Modulations.
papers.authors: Ervin B, Asano E, Crone NE.
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neurophysiology : official publication of the American Electroencephalographic Society
papers.abstract: Summary Passive language mapping using high-gamma modulation (HGM) has emerged as a valuable tool in both presurgical evaluation for epilepsy and neuroscientific discovery. HGM mapping leverages task-related synchronization in high-gamma frequencies to identify language areas without the risks associated with electrical stimulation mapping. This review outlines the principles and techniques used in the field of HGM-based mapping, including electrode types, referencing schemes, power analysis, and localization techniques. We survey a range of cognitive tasks-speech production, auditory processing, reading, and memory-that elicit language-related HGM responses and discuss their relevance to comprehensive language mapping. We examine perspectives on methodologic challenges, including artifact management, variability across patients, and spatial sampling. We assess validation studies comparing HGM with electrical stimulation mapping and neuropsychological outcomes, noting HGM's unique role in identifying language cortex in pediatric and cognitively impaired populations. Finally, we speculate on the future directions of the field, including integration with corticocortical evoked potentials and the potential for HGM-informed speech synthesis. As the field matures, HGM mapping is poised to contribute to improved clinical outcomes and enhance our understanding of the dynamics and development of the human language network.

relevance.reason: 综述颅内高γ调制被动语言映射，用于癫痫术前语言区定位并探讨人语言网络机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了基于高伽马调制（HGM）的被动语言映射在癫痫术前评估和神经科学研究中的应用，介绍了电极类型、参考方案、功率分析与定位等技术原理，并回顾了言语产生、听觉加工、阅读和记忆等能诱发语言相关HGM反应的认知任务。文章讨论了伪迹管理、患者间变异和空间采样等方法学挑战，并评估了HGM与电刺激映射及神经心理学结果的对照验证研究，指出HGM在儿童和认知受损人群中识别语言皮层的独特作用。作者还展望了与皮层-皮层诱发电位整合及基于HGM的语音合成等方向，认为随着领域成熟，HGM映射有望改善临床结局并加深对人语言网络动态与发育的理解。

papers.title: Multimodal Evidence for Large-scale Network Imbalance in Etomidate Use Disorder.
papers.authors: Le J, Wang X, Tang Y, Chen H, Chen X, Wang X, Tang Y, Zhao L, Zhao L, Shen H, Huang Q, Liao Z.
papers.abstract: Background Etomidate use disorder (EUD) is an escalating public health issue in East and Southeast Asia, yet its neuroimaging features remain poorly understood. This study used simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to examine multimodal functional connectivity alterations in individuals with EUD. Methods A total of 54 individuals with EUD and 46 healthy controls (HCs) were recruited and underwent simultaneous resting-state EEG and fNIRS recordings. Psychological dimensions including impulsivity, aggression, and craving were evaluated using standardized and validated scales. Source-level EEG functional connectivity and fNIRS hemodynamic connectivity were analyzed to identify group differences. Associations between altered connectivity features and clinical measures were examined within the EUD group. Machine learning analyses were conducted as exploratory assessments of the discriminative information contained in multimodal connectivity features. Results In unadjusted exploratory analyses of BIS-11 and BPAQ subscales, the EUD group showed higher cognitive impulsivity, non-planning impulsivity, physical aggression, anger and self-directed aggression (t=2.32 to 4.54, p<0.05), but lower motor impulsivity, compared with HCs. Source-level EEG analysis revealed significant group differences only in the delta band, with reduced large-scale connectivity in EUD involving default mode, dorsal attention, visual and sensorimotor systems. fNIRS analysis showed reduced hemodynamic connectivity across multiple frontal subregions and motor-related areas. Weaker connectivity between the primary motor cortex and the triangular part of the inferior frontal gyrus was associated with stronger negative reinforcement craving (rho=-0.471, p_FDR<0.05). Exploratory machine learning analysis showed preliminary discriminative performance, with the random forest model producing the numerically highest test-set AUC (0.80) in this particular data split. Conclusions Convergent EEG-fNIRS findings suggest delta-band network decoupling and reduced frontal hemodynamic connectivity as multimodal neural features of EUD. These findings provide preliminary evidence for the neural mechanisms of EUD and may inform future objective assessment and treatment-monitoring studies.

relevance.reason: 以依托咪酯使用障碍患者为对象，用静息态EEG-fNIRS多模态连接分析揭示大规模网络解耦，属脑疾病机理与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注依托咪酯使用障碍（EUD）者的多模态脑功能连接改变，采用同步静息态脑电与功能性近红外光谱，比较EUD组与健康对照，并考察连接特征与冲动、攻击和渴求等心理指标的关系。结果显示，EUD组在脑电源层面仅delta频段出现大范围连接减弱，涉及默认模式、背侧注意、视觉和感觉运动系统；近红外则显示多个额叶子区及运动相关区域的血流动力学连接下降。初级运动皮层与额下回三角部之间较弱的连接与更强的负强化渴求相关，探索性机器学习也显示出初步的区分能力。作者据此提出，delta频段网络解耦和额叶血流动力学连接降低可能是EUD的多模态神经特征，但相关结果尚属初步，不能直接推及临床评估或治疗效果。

papers.title: Explainable fMRI decoding reveals neurobiological signatures of emotional arousal complementary to traditional analyses.
papers.authors: Agostinho D, Borra D, Castelo-Branco M, Simões M.
papers.abstract: Objective. Understanding how emotional arousal is represented in the brain is fundamental for elucidating affective regulation and its alterations in autism spectrum disorder. Classical neuroimaging approaches, such as the general linear model (GLM), have provided important insights into emotional processing. However, the extent to which data-driven decoding and traditional model-based analyses provide complementary information about emotional arousal remains unclear.Approach. We introduce an explainable artificial intelligence framework that combines the lightweight functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoder (fMRINet) with Deep Learning Important FeaTures to derive data-driven neurobiological signatures of emotional arousal. The framework enables interpretation of spatiotemporal neural contributions during emotional processing. We applied the framework to fMRI data acquired while neurotypically and autistic participants viewed naturalistic emotional videos and compared the resulting signatures with categorical and parametric GLM analyses.Main results. The framework identified distinct spatiotemporal neurobiological signatures associated with emotional arousal. Neurotypical participants engaged a distributed perceptual-limbic-prefrontal network under high arousal and frontoparietal executive regions under low arousal. In contrast, autistic participants exhibited a more spatially restricted and posterior-biased pattern under high arousal, with reduced ventromedial prefrontal and limbic contributions, while low-arousal patterns resembled typically developing, suggesting preserved executive mechanisms during low-arousal processing. The GLM analyses revealed partly convergent and partly distinct findings: categorical GLM detected no significant group differences, whereas parametric GLM identified widespread cortical-subcortical modulation in neurotypical individuals and cerebellar-restricted effects in autistic, consistent with compensatory reliance on motor-timing circuits.Significance . The proposed framework provides an interpretable, data-driven perspective on emotional processing and reveals neurobiologically plausible patterns consistent with existing literature. Together, the explainable decoding and GLM results highlight complementary aspects of emotional arousal processing, suggesting that explainable decoding approaches may provide additional insights alongside traditional model-based neuroimaging analyses.

relevance.reason: 用可解释fMRI解码研究情绪唤醒的神经表征，并比较自闭症与典型人群，属情绪认知的脑机制及自然刺激加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个可解释的fMRI解码框架，将轻量解码器与特征归因方法结合，用于刻画情绪唤醒的神经表征，并与传统GLM分析进行比较。结果发现，高唤醒下神经典型参与者调动分布式的知觉—边缘—前额网络，而孤独症参与者表现为更局限、偏后部的模式，腹内侧前额与边缘系统贡献减弱；低唤醒下两组模式相近。分类GLM未检出组间差异，参数GLM则显示神经典型者广泛的皮层—皮层下调制与孤独症者局限于小脑的效应。作者认为，可解释解码与传统分析提供互补信息，但相关模式尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Nine minutes is enough: An accelerated fMRI protocol for reliable connectivity mapping in healthy young adults.
papers.authors: Falkowski A, Szwed K.
papers.abstract: Introduction Resting‑state fMRI is widely used to map brain connectivity, yet the field lacks a clear, data‑driven standard for acquisition duration. We compared traditional Single‑Band (SB) imaging with an accelerated Multiband factor 4 (MB4) protocol to identify a time‑efficient approach for capturing stable network topology. Methods Twenty‑five healthy young adults completed two sessions one month apart, each including counterbalanced 13‑minute SB and MB4 scans. Test-retest reliability was evaluated across multiple durations using Portrait Divergence, a multiscale graph‑theoretic metric. Supplementary analyses compared Portrait Divergence with the field-standard Intraclass Correlation Coefficient, assessed robustness across preprocessing pipelines and parcellation schemes, and examined MB4's ability to capture both cortical and subcortical connectivity. Results MB4 consistently outperformed SB across all tested durations, with peak topological stability at 9 minutes. Stability declined beyond this point, likely due to cumulative motion artefacts. Supplementary analyses confirmed MB4's robustness across preprocessing strategies and atlas choices and demonstrated effective whole‑brain coverage. Conclusions In healthy young adults, MB4 captures network topology more effectively than SB and reaches peak stability at 9 minutes before declining, challenging the assumption that longer scans are always better. These findings require validation in clinical, paediatric, and geriatric cohorts.

relevance.reason: 比较静息态fMRI采集时长对健康成人脑连接网络拓扑稳定性的影响，属静息态脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了传统单频段与加速多频段（MB4）静息态fMRI采集方案在健康年轻成人中映射脑连接拓扑的可靠性，以确定更高效的采集时长。结果显示，MB4在各测试时长下均优于单频段方案，网络拓扑稳定性在约9分钟时达到峰值，此后反而下降，可能与累积的头动伪影有关；补充分析表明该结果在不同预处理流程和脑图谱下较为稳健，并能覆盖全脑皮层与皮层下连接。作者据此提出，更长的扫描未必更好，但这一结论仍需在临床、儿童和老年人群中验证。

papers.title: Technological interventions in dyslexia: a neurobiological perspective of language learning.
papers.authors: R V MS, Ponniah RJ.
papers.abstract: Objective Developmental dyslexia is a neurodevelopmental language learning disorder characterised by persistent difficulty in phonological processing and fluent word recognition. To address these challenges, a range of interventions has been developed to support reading acquisition and fluency. These interventions include a promising field of technological aids that cater to a broader audience. However, the limited understanding of the neurobiological effects of technological interventions restricts significant evaluation of their effectiveness. The paper examines the influence of technological interventions on the neural mechanisms that support reading in individuals with developmental dyslexia. Methods This narrative review maintains methodological precision by focusing exclusively on literature that bridges the gap between instructional technology and its neurobiological outcomes, offering an integrated analysis of behavioural and neurobiological shifts in literacy development. Impact The findings suggest that the technological interventions enhance phonological processing efficiency by strengthening neurocognitive networks and promoting compensatory activation patterns. However, these results cannot be widely generalised due to the inconsistencies in intervention design and methodological rigour. Thus, to take a closer look at the efficacy of technological interventions, this paper aims to offer a comprehensive neurobiological review of the effects of interventions and assistive technologies, highlighting the neural and behavioural outcomes while pointing to unresolved questions for future investigation.

relevance.reason: 综述技术干预对阅读障碍者语言学习神经机制的影响，聚焦阅读的神经认知网络与代偿激活。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦技术类干预对发展性阅读障碍者阅读相关神经机制的影响，梳理了将教学技术与神经生物学结果相衔接的文献，并整合分析读写发展中的行为与神经变化。作者指出，这些干预可能通过增强神经认知网络和促进补偿性激活模式来提高语音加工效率，但干预设计和方法严谨性不一致使结果难以广泛推广。文章据此强调，需更系统地评估技术干预的神经与行为效果，并留下待解问题供后续研究。

papers.title: Osteocalcin and impaired cerebral resting-state functional connectivity in postmenopausal osteoporosis: a pilot case-control study.
papers.authors: Pickering ME, Morel V, Pereira B, Pickering G, Chapurlat R, Tournadre A, Chassain C, Sontheimer A.
papers.abstract: Purpose Postmenopausal osteoporosis and circulating osteocalcin have been suggested to influence brain function. Objectives aim to explore associations between brain network resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) connectivity, bone status, and circulating osteocalcin with the hypothesis of an impairment of the bone-brain axis in osteoporosis. Methods This pilot fMRI case-control study included postmenopausal osteoporosis women and matched healthy volunteers, and took place in University Hospital, Clermont-Fd, France. Endpoints were the comparisons between cases and controls of intra- and internetworks connectivity and correlations with bone mineral density (BMD) and osteocalcin. Results Twenty women with osteoporosis and ten matched healthy volunteers were included. Salience, visual and language intranetwork connectivity were all decreased compared to controls (False Discovery Rate (FDR)-corrected p = 0.006, 0.0132 and 0.0199, respectively). Internetwork connectivity was also impaired. For visual network, with three regions of the default mode (p-FDR = 0.0265, 0.0296 and 0.0265) and one with dorsal attention network (p-FDR = 0.0296), and for salience, with dorsal attention networks (p-FDR = 0.0494). Circulating osteocalcin correlated with connectivity between right anterior insula (salience network) and bilateral intraparietal sulci (dorsal attention network) (p-FDR = 0.0145 right side, p-FDR = 0.0421 left side). BMD correlated with connectivity between left regions of the dorsal attention and language networks (p-FDR = 0.0164). Conclusion This pilot study suggests possible impairment of brain connectivity and compensatory protective mechanisms/maladaptive mechanisms in postmenopausal osteoporosis. It also unveils that lower osteocalcin concentrations and BMD may be associated with altered cerebral connectivity, confirming animal studies, and providing preliminary findings for further research.

relevance.reason: 研究绝经后骨质疏松患者静息态网络内/间功能连接改变及其与骨代谢指标关联，属脑疾病/状态下的静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 这项初步的病例对照研究探讨绝经后骨质疏松女性的静息态脑网络功能连接是否改变，以及其与骨密度和循环骨钙素水平的关联。结果显示，与健康对照相比，骨质疏松女性在显著性、视觉和语言网络内的连接均下降，网络间连接也出现受损，涉及默认模式、背侧注意等网络。循环骨钙素和骨密度分别与特定网络间连接相关，提示较低的骨钙素和骨密度可能与脑连接改变有关。作者据此提出绝经后骨质疏松中可能存在骨-脑轴受损及代偿或适应不良机制，但样本量小、设计为初步探索，相关发现尚不能说明因果关系，需进一步研究验证。

papers.title: Examinations of the heterogeneity in the structural brain connectome in schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Zhao S, Jin Q, Wang Z, Liu MY, Liu M, Zhao JN, Xu Y, Zhang YH, Wu WJ, Wu D, Liu Y, Wei Y, Cui LB.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a heterogeneous disorder characterized by widespread brain dysconnectivity, yet it remains unclear whether variable structural dysconnectivity patterns reflect biologically and clinically meaningful subtypes. Methods We recruited 105 SCZ patients and 97 healthy controls, collecting magnetic resonance imaging, clinical assessment, and laboratory test data. Double generalized linear models were first applied to estimate group differences in the mean and inter-individual variability of structural connectivity between SCZ and controls. Subsequently, nonnegative matrix factorization was used to identify SCZ subtypes according to dysconnectivity profiles. Results We observed a significantly altered subnetwork that exhibited increased inter-individual variability in SCZ, with its connections and regions predominantly enriched in the ventral-attention, frontal-parietal, and default-mode networks that support higher-order cognition. Connectivity-derived subtype analysis grouped patients into two subtypes, with subtype-II tending to show more severe positive symptoms (t = 2.272, nominal P = 0.025), a lower neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio (t = -2.383, nominal P = 0.025), a better treatment response (t = 2.366, nominal P = 0.021), and greater short-term symptom improvement (t = 3.509, nominal P = 0.006) within the olanzapine monotherapy subgroup. This subtype also demonstrated distinct neuroanatomical features, including a subtype-specific cortical thickness change pattern unrelated to SCZ or bipolar disorder, as well as subtype-specific brain epicenters, such as left posterior cingulate and rostral middle frontal regions. Conclusions Our study demonstrates increased inter-individual variability in the structural connectome of SCZ and highlights the potential of connectome-based subtyping approaches for characterizing disease heterogeneity related to pathophysiological processes.

relevance.reason: 以结构连接组异质性划分精神分裂症亚型，涉及脑网络组织与皮层厚度改变，属脑疾病机理与结构功能研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症患者结构脑连接组是否存在具有生物学和临床意义的异质性亚型，对患者与健康对照的磁共振成像、临床评估和实验室数据进行比较，并结合连接组特征进行分型。结果显示，患者在一个涉及高级认知相关网络的子网络中表现出更大的个体间连接变异，并可据此分为两个亚型；其中Ⅱ型在奥氮平单药治疗下症状改善更明显、治疗反应更好，同时具有该亚型特异的皮层厚度模式和脑枢纽区域。作者认为，这提示结构连接组的个体差异有助于刻画精神分裂症的疾病异质性，但亚型与临床特征的关系仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Rhythmic nasal air-puff as a potential noninvasive brain stimulation approach for stabilizing integrated brain network states.
papers.authors: Mohammadi S, Hossein-Zadeh GA, Raoufy MR.
papers.abstract: Breathing modulates neural oscillations and large-scale brain network organization, partly through mechanical stimulation of olfactory sensory neurons (OSNs). To investigate the mechanosensory contribution of olfactory input, we compared rhythmic, odorless nasal air-puff stimulation (~0.2 Hz) with oral breathing during resting-state fMRI in healthy adults (n = 21). Dynamic functional connectivity was analyzed using a hidden Markov model (HMM) applied to BOLD fluctuations centered on the stimulation frequency. Four recurrent brain states were identified, spanning a continuum from highly segregated to globally integrated configurations. Relative to oral breathing, nasal air-puff stimulation increased the fractional occupancy and lifetime of the integrated state characterized by higher global and local efficiency and lower modularity, reduced the overall switching rate, and selectively reshaped transition probabilities away from fragmented configurations. These effects partially reproduced key features observed during natural nasal breathing in our prior work, suggesting that rhythmic mechanosensory activation of OSNs contributes to the stabilization of integrated large-scale brain states. The findings support a respiration-entrained framework in which olfactory input contributes to the organization and temporal stability of large-scale brain networks.

relevance.reason: 在健康成人静息态fMRI中考察节律性鼻部气流刺激对大规模脑网络动态状态组织的影响，属自发活动与网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康成人中比较了节律性无气味鼻腔气流刺激与经口呼吸时的静息态脑活动，用隐马尔可夫模型分析以刺激频率为中心的动态功能连接。结果识别出从高度分离到全局整合的四种反复出现的脑状态；相比经口呼吸，鼻腔气流刺激提高了整合状态的出现比例和持续时间，降低了整体状态切换率，并改变了状态间的转换概率。作者认为，节律性机械感觉激活可能有助于稳定大规模整合性脑网络状态，但这一解释基于与既往自然鼻呼吸观察的部分吻合，尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Ventral striatal and caudate contributions to episodic retrieval.
papers.authors: Sommer T, Bierbrauer A, Gamer M, Wagner AD.
papers.abstract: Striatal activity during episodic memory retrieval is a robust phenomenon observed across various stimulus types and experimental paradigms. Previous research suggests that the ventral striatum and the caudate contribute differentially to retrieval processes: ventral striatal activity is posited to vary with the intrinsic reward of successful retrieval, whereas caudate activity is attributed to effortful cognitive control. The present fMRI study aimed to test the overarching hypothesis that these striatal subregions make distinct contributions to episodic retrieval and to further specify their functional roles. To this end, we employed a word-picture paired-associates learning paradigm in which words served as cues in two consecutive cued-recall tests that were separated by 24 h. Participants indicated the specificity of their associative memories, enabling characterization of striatal response profiles as a function of associative memory specificity and treatment of memory specificity as a proxy for the intrinsic reward associated with retrieval success. Rather than being not readily compatible with a role of the caudate in effortful post-retrieval control, the results suggest that elevated caudate activity during successful recall reflects pre-retrieval control or involuntary orienting to salient mnemonic information. In contrast, rather than reflect intrinsic reward itself, ventral striatal activity varied with the discrepancy between expected and actual intrinsic reward elicited by retrieval outcomes-that is, a metacognitive reward prediction error. Moreover, ventral striatum signaled the relevance of retrieved information and modulated its re-encoding to facilitate future retrievals.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究考察腹侧纹状体和尾状核在情景记忆提取中的功能分工，属记忆与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用词—图片配对联想学习任务结合fMRI，考察情景记忆提取时腹侧纹状体与尾状核是否承担不同功能。结果并不支持尾状核参与提取后努力控制的原有解释，而提示成功回忆时尾状核活动增强更可能反映提取前控制或对显著记忆信息的非自主朝向。腹侧纹状体活动则并非直接反映内在奖赏本身，而是随预期与实际内在奖赏之间的差异变化，即一种元认知奖赏预测误差；它还表征提取信息的相关性，并调节其再编码以利于后续提取。这些发现细化了纹状体亚区在情景提取中的功能分工。

papers.title: Semantic working memory supports phrasal planning: Evidence from acute stroke.
papers.authors: Zahn R, Dial H, Schnur T, Martin R.
papers.abstract: This study examined the contribution of semantic and phonological working memory (WM) to lexical-semantic planning during language production for individuals tested acutely after left-hemisphere stroke. Participants completed tasks assessing phrase and sentence production, single-word retrieval, semantic and phonological WM, and single-word input processing. Using a constrained production paradigm that manipulated structure (phrase vs. sentence) and number of adjectival modifiers (one vs. two), we found that semantic WM capacity, indexed by performance on a category probe task, predicted accuracy in producing phrases containing multiple content words, even after controlling for single-word processing abilities. In contrast, phonological WM capacity, indexed by performance on a digit matching span task, did not relate to production accuracy. The relation to semantic WM was specific to the condition with the largest number of content words within a phrase (two-adjective noun phrase). These findings support the contention that lexical-semantic planning occurs phrase by phrase and is constrained by the capacity of a semantic maintenance buffer that supports activation and maintenance of multiple lexical-semantic representations prior to articulation. In contrast, phonological planning appears to operate within a narrower window that makes few demands on phonological WM. The results converge with prior neuropsychological evidence linking semantic WM to phrase-level planning and further imply that the phrase serves as the default scope of lexical-semantic encoding in production. Implications for models of WM and language production are discussed.

relevance.reason: 研究左半球卒中后语义工作记忆对短语产出中词汇语义规划的贡献，涉及语言产出与工作记忆的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在左半球卒中急性期考察语义与语音工作记忆对语言产出中词汇语义规划的贡献，采用控制性短语和句子产出任务，并结合单词提取与输入加工等测量。结果显示，语义工作记忆容量能预测含多个内容词的短语产出准确性，且在控制单词加工能力后仍成立；这一关联主要出现在内容词最多的双形容词名词短语条件，而语音工作记忆与产出准确性无关。作者据此认为，词汇语义规划以短语为单位进行，并受语义维持缓冲容量的约束，语音规划的作用窗口则较窄、对语音工作记忆需求有限。

papers.title: Highly replicable multisite patterns of adolescent white matter maturation.
papers.authors: Meisler SL, Cieslak M, Bagautdinova J, Hendrickson TJ, Pandhi T, Chen AA, Hillman N, Radhakrishnan H, Salo T, Feczko E, Weldon KB, McCollum R, Fayzullobekova B, Moore LA, Sisk LM, Davatzikos C, Huang H, Avelar-Pereira B, Caffarra S, Chang K, Cook PA, Flook EA, Gomez T, Grotheer M, Hagen MP, Huque ZM, Karipidis II, Keller AS, Kruper J, Luo AC, Macedo B, Mehta K, Mitchell JL, Pines AR, Pritschet L, Rauland A, Roy E, Sevchik BL, Shafiei G, Singleton SP, Stone HL, Sun KY, Sydnor VJ, Tong TT, Yablonski M, Yeatman JD, Rokem A, Shinohara RT, Fair DA, Satterthwaite TD.
papers.abstract: Adolescent brain development is difficult to study at scale because diffusion MRI (dMRI) measures are sensitive to technical variability across scanning environments. The Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study is the largest US-based longitudinal neuroimaging study of adolescent brain maturation. We present ABCD-Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) Community Collection (ABCC) release 3.1.0, a curated resource of more than 24,000 fully processed human ABCD dMRI datasets from participants aged 8-17 years. ABCC provides processed images, nuanced image quality metrics, advanced microstructural measures, and person-specific white matter bundle tractography. Across 62 bundles, measures of diffusion restriction and non-Gaussianity-including intracellular volume fraction from neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging (NODDI), mean kurtosis tensor from diffusion kurtosis imaging (DKI), and return-to-origin probability from mean apparent propagator (MAP)-MRI-were more sensitive to development and more robust to variation in image quality than tensor-derived measures. Longitudinal harmonization of microstructural features with ComBat-GAMM markedly improved the cross-vendor generalizability of developmental effects. Together, ABCC accelerates reproducible, rigorous research on adolescent white matter development.

relevance.reason: 该资源提供青少年白质微结构与纤维束追踪数据，并报告白质成熟指标，直接涉及脑结构发育。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究围绕青少年脑白质发育在跨扫描环境下难以大规模可重复测量的问题，整理并发布了包含8至17岁参与者逾两万套完整处理弥散MRI数据的ABCC资源，并提供图像质量指标、微结构指标和个体化白质纤维束追踪结果。作者在多个白质纤维束中比较不同弥散指标的发育敏感性与图像质量稳健性，发现基于扩散限制和非高斯性的微结构指标比张量衍生指标更敏感、更稳健；结合纵向协调处理后，跨厂商发育效应的可推广性明显提高。这些结果提示，该资源与相应指标有助于推动青少年白质发育研究走向可重复和严谨，但摘要未报告具体发育效应的大小或临床意义。

papers.title: Microstructural changes in prefrontal-cingulate networks following bilateral dorsomedial prefrontal cortex-targeted intermittent theta-burst stimulation in treatment-resistant depression: A diffusion tensor imaging study.
papers.authors: Ersungur Çelik EB, Poyraz BÇ, Arslan S, Kargın OA.
papers.abstract: Intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) is a transcranial magnetic stimulation protocol used in treatment-resistant depression (TRD), yet its effects on brain structural connectivity remain incompletely understood. The dorsomedial prefrontal cortex (dmPFC), a key node within emotion regulation networks, has emerged as a promising therapeutic target. This study investigated white matter microstructural changes associated with bilateral dmPFC-targeted iTBS and their relationship with treatment response. A total of 21 patients with TRD and 32 healthy controls were included. Diffusion tensor imaging was acquired in all participants and repeated in patients after a full course of dmPFC-targeted iTBS. Analyses focused on longitudinal changes in white matter microstructure within prefrontal-cingulate-limbic pathways, group differences, and their associations with changes in depressive symptom severity. Correction for multiple comparisons was applied throughout. iTBS treatment was associated with a significant reduction in depressive symptoms. At the microstructural level, a post-treatment increase in fractional anisotropy was observed in a left prefrontal-cingulate pathway. Notably, changes in several pathways showed associations with clinical improvement. The tract-level findings were significant under tract-wise FDR correction but did not survive correction across all tract-metric comparisons, and are therefore interpreted as exploratory. Baseline microstructural properties within orbitofrontal-subgenual cingulate connections were also related to treatment response. These findings indicate tract-specific changes in diffusion metrics within prefrontal-cingulate-limbic pathways over the course of dmPFC-targeted iTBS. Given the modest sample size and the absence of a sham-controlled comparison, the results should be regarded as exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and require confirmation in larger, sham-controlled studies.

relevance.reason: 该研究在难治性抑郁症患者中考察dmPFC靶向iTBS前后前额-扣带-边缘白质微结构变化及其与症状改善的关系，属于以脑疾病为工具理解脑结构与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨双侧背内侧前额叶靶向间歇性θ爆发刺激治疗难治性抑郁症后，前额叶-扣带回-边缘通路白质微结构的变化及其与疗效的关系，采用弥散张量成像对患者治疗前后进行追踪并与健康对照比较。治疗后抑郁症状显著减轻，左侧前额叶-扣带回通路各向异性分数升高，部分通路的变化与临床改善相关，基线眶额-膝下扣带回连接特征也与治疗反应有关。不过这些通路层面的结果仅在通路内多重比较校正下显著，未能在全部通路-指标比较的校正中存活，且样本量有限、缺少假刺激对照，作者将其定位为探索性和假设生成性的初步发现，需更大规模对照研究验证。

papers.title: Differences in neurovascular coupling in patients with major depressive disorder: Evidence from simultaneous resting-state EEG-fNIRS.
papers.authors: Yan F, Wang X, Zhao Y, Yang S, Wang Z.
papers.abstract: Neurovascular coupling (NVC), the relationship between neural activity and cerebral hemodynamic responses, remains poorly understood in major depressive disorder (MDD). To investigate alterations in NVC associated with depressive symptom severity, we simultaneously recorded resting-state electroencephalography (rsEEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) in 206 participants, including 134 patients with MDD and 72 healthy controls stratified by age to disentangle disease-related alterations from age-associated effects. NVC in the prefrontal cortex (PFC) was characterized by the consistency and temporal lag between spontaneous electrophysiological peaks and corresponding hemodynamic responses. We found that age significantly enhances the NVC consistency (p < 0.05), whereas this relationship was altered in patients with MDD during both the oxygen-consumption phase and the subsequent hemodynamic compensation phase. Furthermore, among patients with MDD, the strength of this consistency decreased more significantly with greater illness severity (partial r = -0.336, p = 0.0601). These findings suggest that changes in neurovascular coupling effects are strongly associated with the severity of depression. By leveraging wearable neuroimaging techniques, this study provides multimodal evidence for altered neurovascular coupling in depression and highlights its potential as a biomarker for disease monitoring and recovery trajectories.

relevance.reason: 以静息态EEG-fNIRS同步记录考察抑郁症患者前额叶神经血管耦合改变，属脑疾病机理与静息态脑组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍患者的神经血管耦合是否发生改变，以及这种改变与抑郁症状严重程度的关系。作者同步采集静息态脑电和功能性近红外光谱数据，以评估前额叶自发神经活动峰值与血流动力学反应之间的一致性和时间滞后。结果显示，年龄会增强神经血管耦合的一致性，而患者在该耦合的氧消耗阶段和随后的血流动力学补偿阶段均表现出不同于健康对照的模式；在患者内部，症状越重，这种一致性越弱。作者据此认为，神经血管耦合的改变与抑郁严重程度相关，并提示其作为疾病监测与恢复轨迹生物标志物的可能性，但相关分析结果本身尚不足以确立因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: The role of neighborhood socioeconomic environment in the association between glycemic control and the developing brain.
papers.authors: Chandra A, Hsu E, Luo S.
papers.abstract: Metabolic health and socioeconomic environments may jointly shape neurodevelopment during adolescence, a sensitive period of brain maturation. This cross-sectional study investigated overall and neighborhood socioeconomic deprivation moderated associations between glycemic control and brain structure in youth. Data were analyzed from 705 healthy 10-13-year-olds participating in the Adolescent Brain and Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study® across 21 sites in the United States. Glycemic control was assessed using hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), brain structure was evaluated via magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and neighborhood deprivation was measured with the Area Deprivation Index (ADI). Mixed-effects models examined associations between HbA1c and brain structural measures while controlling for sociodemographic covariates, with additional analyses stratified by ADI tertiles. Higher HbA1c was associated with lower mean cortical thickness and smaller total cortical gray matter volume. Each one percent increase in HbA1c corresponded to a 0.024 mm reduction in mean cortical thickness and a 9,611 mm3 reduction in total cortical gray matter volume. Regionally, higher HbA1c was associated with thinner cortex and smaller gray matter volumes primarily within frontal, cingulate and occipital areas. Exploratory analysis found that higher HbA1c was associated with lower total cortical gray matter volume among youth living in medium and high ADI neighborhoods, but not low ADI neighborhoods, whereas higher HbA1c was associated with lower mean cortical thickness only among youth living in high ADI neighborhoods. These findings highlight the interplay between metabolic health and neighborhood deprivation, supporting a model in which socioeconomic disadvantage may magnify the neurodevelopmental impact of metabolic variation, even within the non-diabetic range.

relevance.reason: 研究青少年血糖控制与社会经济环境对脑结构（皮层厚度、灰质体积）的关联，属脑发育与结构-功能范畴。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察青少年血糖控制与脑结构的关系，以及社区社会经济剥夺是否调节这一关联，数据来自美国ABCD研究中10至13岁健康青少年的糖化血红蛋白、磁共振脑结构指标和区域剥夺指数。结果显示，糖化血红蛋白越高，平均皮层厚度越薄、总皮层灰质体积越小，且这种关联主要体现在额叶、扣带和枕叶区域。探索性分析进一步提示，血糖控制与皮层灰质体积的关联在中、高剥夺社区青少年中更明显，而与平均皮层厚度的关联仅在高剥夺社区中显现。作者据此提出，社会经济劣势可能放大代谢差异对青春期脑发育的影响，即使在非糖尿病范围内也是如此；但研究为横断面设计，相关结果不能直接解释为因果或临床效应。

papers.title: Resting-State EEG Microstate Dynamics and their Associations with Acclimatization Index and Serum Albumin in Healthy Adults with Chronic High-Altitude Exposure.
papers.authors: Yong Y, Cheng J, Xu J, Li H, Ma H, Wang N.
papers.abstract: High-altitude hypoxia has been examined with conventional electroencephalography (EEG), event-related potentials, and neuroimaging, but its association with millisecond-scale resting-state EEG microstate dynamics and peripheral physiology remains unclear. We studied healthy adults including 124 low-altitude (LA) participants (50 men, 74 women) and 174 high-altitude (HA) participants (42 men, 132 women; age 28.05 ± 8.59 years; age unavailable for LA). Coverage, duration, global explained variance (GEV), occurrence, and transition probabilities were extracted for four canonical microstates. LA-HA differences were tested using unadjusted linear models; within-HA associations among the high-altitude acclimatization index (AAI), serum albumin, and Microstate A-related indicators were examined using covariate-adjusted regressions and exploratory bootstrapped mediation analyses. Compared with LA participants, HA participants showed increased Microstate A duration and GEV, decreased occurrence, and unchanged coverage, together with reduced Microstate B-related indicators, enhanced Microstate C-related indicators, and increased A→B and A→C transitions. Within HA participants, AAI was negatively associated with serum albumin, and exploratory mediation analyses indicated indirect associations between AAI and Coverage A, Occurrence A, GEV A, and Microstate A-originating transitions through serum albumin. These findings suggest that chronic high-altitude exposure is associated with resting-state EEG microstate reorganization in healthy adults and that acclimatization-related individual differences may be linked to Microstate A dynamics through serum albumin-related peripheral status.

relevance.reason: 研究慢性高原暴露健康成人静息态EEG微状态动力学改变，属人脑自发活动/网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注慢性高原暴露是否与健康成人静息态脑电微状态的毫秒级动态及外周生理指标相关，比较了低海拔与高海拔健康成人的四种经典微状态指标，并在高海拔组内分析高原适应指数、血清白蛋白与微状态A相关指标的关系。结果显示，高海拔组微状态A的持续时间和全局解释方差增加、出现次数减少，微状态B相关指标减弱、微状态C相关指标增强，且A向B、A向C的转换增多。高海拔组内，高原适应指数与血清白蛋白呈负相关，探索性中介分析提示血清白蛋白可能承载适应指数与微状态A动态之间的间接关联。作者据此认为，慢性高原暴露与静息态脑电微状态重组相关，个体适应差异可能通过血清白蛋白相关的外周状态与微状态A动态相联系；这些关联尚属探索性，不能作因果解读。

papers.title: Impaired visual-motor integration function in children with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: potential neural correlates from resting-state fNIRS.
papers.authors: Wang W, Qian H, Dong M, Pan M, Li H, Yue X, Si F, Liu L, Qian Q.
papers.abstract: Visual-motor integration (VMI) impairment is common in Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), yet its underlying neurobiological basis remains unclear. This study aimed to explore the characteristics of VMI in children with ADHD and its statistical role in the association between functional connectivity (FC) and core symptoms. A total of 332 children with ADHD and 103 healthy controls (HC) completed the Beery-Buktenica Developmental Test of Visual-Motor Integration (Beery VMI). Group comparisons and dimensional correlation analyses were performed to explore the VMI characteristics of children with ADHD. Subsequently, 127 children with ADHD and 91 HC children underwent resting-state functional near-infrared spectroscopy. Mediation analyses were performed to investigate the role of VMI in the relationship between atypical FC and core symptoms of ADHD. Children with ADHD exhibited deficits in VMI performance, with 28.92% showing abnormal VMI. VMI was negatively correlated with core ADHD symptoms. At the network level, VMI showed significant statistical indirect associations in the relationship between FC of DMN-DMN, DMN-DAN, and DMN-VAN networks and inattention symptoms, and between FC of the DMN-DAN networks and hyperactivity/impulsivity symptoms. At the channel level, VMI was also indirectly associated with FC of the left superior frontal gyrus (SFG)-right middle occipital gyrus (MOG) and ADHD core symptoms. Children with ADHD have deficits in VMI, and poorer VMI performance is associated with greater severity of core ADHD symptoms. Altered intra- and inter- network FC of the DMN may represent a potential neural correlate of VMI impairment in ADHD.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fNIRS考察ADHD儿童视运动整合缺陷及其与脑功能连接和症状的关联，涉及认知与脑疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）儿童的视觉—运动整合功能及其与脑功能连接和核心症状的关系，采用行为测评结合静息态功能近红外光谱，并做中介分析。结果显示，ADHD儿童存在视觉—运动整合缺陷，且该表现与核心症状严重程度相关；默认网络内部及默认网络与注意、腹侧注意网络之间的功能连接，以及部分额—枕通道连接，与核心症状的关联在统计上可由视觉—运动整合间接解释。作者据此提出，默认网络功能连接的改变可能是ADHD儿童视觉—运动整合受损的潜在神经相关因素，但中介结果只反映统计关联，不能说明因果。

papers.title: Limited sex-specific structural alterations across common epilepsies: A worldwide ENIGMA study.
papers.authors: Wen H, Wan B, Gholipour T, Xie K, Chen J, Serio B, Hettwer MD, Alvim MKM, Arienzo D, João RB, Bauer T, Bernasconi A, Bernasconi N, Bonanni P, Caligiuri ME, Cendes F, Christin R, Concha L, Dascal A, Boyd ED, Devinsky O, Focke NKN, Fortunato F, Galovic M, Gambardella A, Guerrini R, Hatton SN, Iliza M, Inati S, Ives-Deliperi V, Juster RP, Kleen JK, Koubeissi MZ, Labate A, Larivière S, Law M, Lenge M, Meletti S, Moloney PB, Naish M, Ngo A, O'Brien TJ, Pana R, Panzeri S, Pardoe H, Rauf EHU, Riva A, Rodríguez-Cruces R, Royer J, Rüber T, Sahlas E, Scárdua-Silva L, Schubert KM, Sepeta LN, Severino M, Sinclair B, Soltanian-Zadeh H, Stoub T, Striano P, Thomopoulos SI, Valientes NV, Vaudano AE, Vivash L, Yasuda CL, Thompson PM, Sisodiya SM, McDonald CR, Bernhardt BC, Valk SL.
papers.abstract: Objective Epilepsy is characterized by widespread cortical and subcortical structural alterations beyond the epileptic zone. Importantly, the clinical manifestation of epilepsy, including seizure types, psychiatric comorbidities, and treatment responses, has been shown to differ between sexes. However, sex differences in structural alterations in epilepsy are seldomly reported in neuroimaging studies, partly due to limited sample sizes and single-center designs. We therefore tested whether epilepsy-related structural alterations differ between males and females, and whether the associations between structural measures and clinical characteristics vary by sex. Methods We analyzed clinician-assigned biological sex differences in common epilepsies and their related clinical variables using structural neuroimaging biomarkers in an international multicenter cohort of 1253 epilepsy patients and 1077 healthy controls. We studied cortical thickness and subcortical volume in temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) and genetic generalized epilepsy (GGE). Results Both male and female patients with TLE showed widespread cortical and subcortical alterations in sex-stratified analyses, whereas GGE showed more extensive alterations in female patients and only subtle alterations in male patients. However, no significant sex-by-diagnosis interactions were identified in either the TLE (t = -2.153 to 1.705, all pFDR >.05) or GGE (t = -1.797 to 2.774, all pFDR >.05) cohort. Likewise, no significant interactions were found between sex and age at onset (tTLE = -1.835 to 1.092, tGGE = -2.394 to 1.392, all pFDR >.05) or disease duration (tTLE = -2.643 to 2.048, tGGE = -1.234 to 2.017, all pFDR >.05) in either patient group. Significance Overall, although sex differences in behavioral and clinical outcomes of epilepsy have been consistently reported in previous studies, our results indicate that sex-related clinical differences in epilepsy are not strongly captured by macroscale structural magnetic resonance imaging measures, and may instead arise from hormonal, neurochemical, or functional-network mechanisms.

relevance.reason: 该研究以癫痫患者为对象，用结构MRI考察皮质厚度和皮质下体积改变及性别差异，属于以脑疾病理解脑结构组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于国际多中心的结构磁共振数据，考察常见癫痫患者的大脑皮层厚度和皮层下体积改变是否存在性别差异，以及这些结构指标与临床特征的关系是否随性别不同。按性别分层分析时，颞叶癫痫男女患者均呈现较广泛的结构改变，而遗传性全面性癫痫的改变主要在女性患者中更明显，男性患者仅有轻微改变；但两种癫痫中均未发现显著的性别与诊断交互作用，性别与发病年龄、病程之间也没有显著交互。作者据此认为，既往报道的癫痫临床和行为结局的性别差异，并未在宏观结构影像指标上明显体现，可能更多来自激素、神经化学或功能网络层面的机制。

papers.title: Hemispheric Asymmetry of Neuroimaging Biomarkers in Early Onset Alzheimer's Disease: Clinical and Cognitive Outcomes.
papers.authors: Ziontz J, Blazhenets G, Visani A, Chiotis K, Maiti P, Lin Z, Hills AR, Yballa C, Rocha S, Shankar R, Sturm VE, Vemuri P, Hammers DB, Eloyan A, Carrillo MC, Dickerson BC, Apostolova LG, Rabinovici GD, La Joie R, LEADS Consortium.
papers.abstract: Objective Individuals diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease (AD) often exhibit amyloid, tau, and atrophy predominantly in the left or right hemisphere, but group-level analyses typically ignore inter-individual variability and changing asymmetry patterns when averaging data across participants in phenotypically diverse cohorts. Methods We examined left/right hemispheric asymmetry in amyloid positron emission tomography (PET), tau PET, and cortical atrophy in sporadic early-onset AD from 585 deeply phenotyped individuals across 2 cohorts to investigate its clinical correlates. For each imaging biomarker, we computed a global asymmetry index reflecting left/right hemisphere signal difference, and an analogous asymmetry value for PET/magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) voxels. We examined clinical and cognitive correlates of this asymmetry across phenotypes cross-sectionally and longitudinally in a subset of 218 participants. Results Both left and right asymmetry were common for all clinical phenotypes and was correlated between imaging biomarkers. Asymmetry patterns varied spatially within phenotypes, and asymmetry in tau PET and MRI volumes was related to hemisphere-dependent cognitive deficits and neuropsychiatric symptoms. Longitudinal analyses revealed stable amyloid PET asymmetry, decreasing tau PET asymmetry, and increasing MRI volume asymmetry. Interpretation Hemispheric asymmetry is common in early onset AD and correlates with clinical outcomes. Our longitudinal findings suggest a time-lagged asymmetry peak in amyloid, then tau, then atrophy. Taken together, our results position asymmetry as an important feature of AD heterogeneity, as it provides insight into disease mechanisms and trajectories. ANN NEUROL 2026.

relevance.reason: 研究早发性AD患者左右半球淀粉样蛋白、tau和皮层萎缩不对称及其与认知缺陷的关联，属脑疾病中脑组织与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早发性阿尔茨海默病中淀粉样蛋白PET、tau PET与皮层萎缩的左右半球不对称性，以及这种不对称与临床和认知表现的关系。作者在两个队列中对深度表型个体计算全局不对称指数，并在部分参与者中做横断面和纵向分析。结果显示，左右不对称在各临床表型中都很常见，且不同影像标志物的不对称彼此相关；tau PET和MRI体积的不对称与半球相关的认知缺陷和神经精神症状有关。纵向上，淀粉样蛋白PET不对称保持稳定，tau PET不对称下降，而MRI体积不对称上升，提示不对称可能依次在淀粉样蛋白、tau和萎缩阶段达到高峰。作者据此认为，不对称是早发性AD异质性的重要特征，有助于理解疾病机制和轨迹。

papers.title: Linking anterior cingulate sulcal variability to attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder behavior
papers.authors: Hadveck RF, Paras A, Anctil M, Martinez E, Gallardo CM, Maboudian SA, Willbrand EH, Weiner KS.
papers.abstract: Background The anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) is consistently implicated in attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). ACC variability, including its most variable structure, the paracingulate sulcus (PCGS), has been known since the late 1800s, and since then, has been linked to cognitive control, impulsivity, and psychiatric conditions comorbid with ADHD, including autism spectrum disorder and schizophrenia. Yet, the role of the PCGS in ADHD remains unexamined at the individual level. Methods We characterized PCGS incidence, asymmetry, and morphology in 247 children and adolescents (144 ADHD: 10.9 ± 2.73 years old, 75% male; 103 neurotypical: 12.2 ± 3.17 years old, 50% male) from the ADHD-200 dataset. The PCGS was manually identified in FreeSurfer cortical surface reconstructions. Morphometric measures, including sulcal length, depth, and cortical thickness, were extracted and normalized to hemisphere-wide variables. Between-group analyses tested whether PCGS presence, asymmetry, and quantitative morphology differed by diagnosis, while behavioral analyses examined associations with inattention, hyperactivity-impulsivity, and cognitive measures. Age and gender were included as covariates. Results Analyses revealed that, in both NT and ADHD individuals, there was significant leftward asymmetry in PCGS presence. Between groups, the PCGS was less likely to be present in individuals with ADHD in the left hemisphere. Leftward PCGS absence was also associated with significantly higher ADHD index and hyperactivity-impulsivity scores. Conclusions These findings advance understanding of how early neurodevelopmental variation in cortical folding may serve as a structural intermediary between genetic liability and the behavioral expression of ADHD.

relevance.reason: 研究ADHD儿童前扣带沟形态变异与注意/多动行为及认知控制的关联，属脑结构变异与精神疾病认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注前扣带沟形态变异，尤其是旁扣带沟（PCGS）的出现、不对称性和形态，是否与注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）及其行为表现相关。作者在儿童和青少年中手工识别脑皮层表面的PCGS，并比较ADHD组与神经典型组，同时分析其与注意不集中、多动冲动及认知测量的关联。结果显示，两组均存在PCGS出现的左侧不对称，但ADHD个体左半球PCGS更不易出现；左侧PCGS缺失还与更高的ADHD指数和多动冲动评分相关。作者据此提出，早期皮层折叠变异可能是遗传易感性与ADHD行为表达之间的结构中介，但这一解释仍属关联性推断。

papers.title: Thoughts and cortical responses are shaped by the type of change at event boundaries
papers.authors: Ketcheson S, Wallace RS, Zhou SS, Hardikar S, Mulholland B, Chitiz L, Gallivan J, Leech R, Smallwood J, Jefferies E, Wammes JD.
papers.abstract: Continuous experience is divided into discrete and meaningful events, but different kinds of event transitions may shape thought and brain activity in different ways. We examined how perceived event boundaries relate to visual, auditory, and semantic features, ongoing thought, and large-scale cortical states during movie-watching. We combined three independent samples who viewed the same eight movie clips, aligning these measures to a shared stimulus timeline: One marked event boundaries, one reported ongoing thought, and one was scanned with fMRI. Whole-brain spatial correlations showed that event boundaries correlated positively with visual change and negatively with auditory change, but not with any thought pattern. Time-resolved analyses showed that boundaries were associated with a reduction in distracted thoughts and brain states positioned toward visual processing. Clustering boundaries by movie feature change profile identified visual, semantic, interruption, and narrative boundary types. All four types showed a shift toward visual processing in the brain, but their other associations differed. Visual boundaries were associated with less distraction, semantic boundaries with thoughts related to past experience and prior knowledge, and narrative boundaries with more detailed and deliberate thoughts. Visual and semantic boundaries also showed distinct shifts in brain state that were not apparent in the other two types. These findings suggest that event boundaries mark a set of state shifts in ongoing experience, with a shared reorientation toward visual processing and changes in thought and brain state that vary with the type of transition.

relevance.reason: 看电影时事件边界类型与皮层状态及思维变化的关系，属自然刺激下脑加工研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察观影时感知到的事件边界如何与影片的视听及语义特征、ongoing thought（ ongoing thought）和大脑状态相关联，将三个独立样本分别提供的边界标记、思维报告和fMRI数据对齐到同一刺激时间线。全脑空间相关显示，事件边界与视觉变化正相关、与听觉变化负相关，但与任何思维模式均无相关；时间分辨分析则表明边界伴随分心思维减少和大脑状态向视觉加工偏移。按影片特征变化对边界聚类可区分视觉、语义、中断和叙事四类，四类均出现向视觉加工的脑状态偏移，但其余关联不同：视觉边界对应较少分心，语义边界对应与过去经验和先验知识相关的思维，叙事边界对应更细致、更有意的思维，视觉与语义边界还表现出另两类未见的大脑状态转变。作者据此认为，事件边界标志着持续体验中的一系列状态转换，其中向视觉加工的重新定向较为共同，而思维和脑状态的变化随转换类型而异。

papers.title: Neurite Complexity and Plasticity Markers Track Synaptic Vesicle Density in the Living Human Brain: A Multimodal PET-MRI-EEG Study
papers.authors: Agnorelli C, Peill J, Kurtin DL, Mallon O, Sawicka G, Shatalina E, Godfrey K, Murphy R, Ahmad K, Oestreich LKL, Sumner R, Alberti M, Wall M, Ertl N, Searle G, Clarke M, Zhou K, Osugo M, Sarem U, Weiss B, Greenway K, Jauhar S, Fagiolini A, Carhart-Harris R, Matthews PM, Rabiner E, Nutt D, Erritzoe D.
papers.abstract: Neuroplasticity, the brain's capacity to reorganise its structure and function, is a transdiagnostic feature across psychiatric and neurodegenerative diseases and a putative mechanism of action for pharmacological interventions. [11C]-UCBJ positron emission tomography (PET), which quantifies synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A (SV2A) density, offers the most direct in vivo measure of human synaptic density, but its relationship to complementary, more scalable neuroimaging measures of structural and functional plasticity remains uncharacterised. We combined [11C]-UCBJ PET, diffusion weighted imaging (DWI/NODDI), resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), and electroencephalography (EEG)-based sensory tasks (roving mismatch negativity, MMN; visual long-term potentiation, vLTP) in 18 healthy volunteers to test the relationship between synaptic terminal SV2A density and complementary structural and functional neuroplasticity measures, and whether these relationships were reproducible following pharmacological challenge with ketamine (n = 11) or N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT; n = 7). There were no statistically significant differences in PET-derived SV2A binding potential (BPND), DWI-derived neurite orientation dispersion (ODI) and structural weighted degree (SWD), EEG-derived MMN repetition suppression, and late-phase vLTP P2 potentiation, 1 to 8 days following DMT and ketamine exposure compared to baseline. BPND was coupled with ODI across cortical regions before and after pharmacological challenge, and this relationship was tighter within visual, attentional, and frontoparietal control brain networks. SWD showed a weaker, more spatially restricted association with BPND, primarily in regions belonging to the limbic and visual brain networks, but was not replicated post-drug. No consistent association was found between BPND and functional weighted degree (FWD), derived from rs-fMRI, at baseline or after pharmacological challenge. Frontotemporal BPND was positively associated with MMN repetition suppression (r = 0.61), and occipital BPND with late-phase vLTP P2 potentiation (r = 0.54), with the MMN-BPND association replicating after pharmacological challenge (r = 0.49). These findings link synaptic terminal SV2A density in the living human brain to neurite architecture and the capacity for short-term and Hebbian-like long-term synaptic plasticity, while dissociating these relationships from generic functional connectivity and magnitude of sensory-evoked responses. These data provide cross-modal validation for DWI- and EEG-derived measures as biological indices and surrogate measures of human synaptic plasticity.

relevance.reason: 该研究在活体人脑中结合PET、扩散MRI和EEG，考察突触密度与神经突结构及可塑性指标的关系，属于结构-功能耦合与可塑性机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康志愿者中结合[11C]-UCBJ PET、扩散加权成像、静息态功能磁共振和脑电感觉任务，考察活体人脑突触小泡蛋白SV2A密度与结构、功能可塑性指标的关系，并在氯胺酮或DMT给药后检验可重复性。结果显示，SV2A结合电位与皮层神经突取向弥散度在给药前后均相关，且在视觉、注意和额顶控制网络内更紧密；与结构加权度的关联较弱且给药后未重复，与静息态功能加权度则无一致关联。额颞叶SV2A结合与MMN重复抑制、枕叶SV2A结合与晚期视觉长时程增强正相关，前者在给药后仍可重复。作者据此认为，突触密度与神经突构筑及短期和Hebbian样长时程可塑性相关，而与一般功能连接和感觉诱发反应幅度相分离，为DWI和脑电指标作为突触可塑性替代指标提供了跨模态支持。

papers.title: Discrete cortico-hippocampal circuit states underlie mood state transitions in depression
papers.authors: Elbau IG, Lee AM, Chang M, Anderson E, Nilchian P, Victoria L, Manfredi N, Gallagher N, Iatckova V, Sabetfakhri N, Alvarez J, Slepneva N, Summerville I, Chou J, Johnson M, Ho C, Goldwaser E, Rossi J, Khambhati A, Allawalla A, Astudillo Maya D, Moia S, Caballero-Gaudes C, Aloysi A, Murrough J, Gunning FM, Zebley B, Power JD, Williams N, Grosenick L, Chang E, Sellers KK, Krystal A, Lynch CJ, Liston C.
papers.abstract: The hippocampus has long been implicated in depression, yet the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Leveraging precision functional mapping in densely sampled individuals and large cross-sectional cohorts, and validating key results in direct intracranial EEG recordings from the human brain, we show that hippocampal connectivity alternates between two discrete and opposing network states on the order of minutes: one dominated by default mode network (DMN) coupling and another by sensorimotor system (SM) coupling. This dynamic switching is a fundamental property of hippocampal function in both healthy brains and in major depressive disorder (MDD). In MDD, this equilibrium is disrupted, such that the DMN-dominant state is overrepresented. In densely sampled individuals, hippocampus-DMN coupling tracks symptom fluctuations over time and normalizes after electroconvulsive therapy (ECT), which drives switches in hippocampal connectivity away from the DMN-dominant state and toward the SM-dominant state—an effect that was closely linked to a positive treatment response. Direct intracranial recordings in patients with MDD identified analogous fluctuations in hippocampal–DMN theta synchrony, which tracks symptom fluctuations over hours and days. Together, these findings identify a dynamic cortico-hippocampal mechanism underlying depression and indicate that successful neuromodulation treatments such as ECT act in part by restoring a dynamic equilibrium in hippocampal network connectivity.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑海马-皮层网络状态动态切换及其在抑郁症中的失衡与治疗恢复，涉及自发网络组织与疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注海马连接异常如何与抑郁症状波动相关联，结合密集采样个体的精准功能成像、大样本横断面队列以及人脑颅内脑电记录进行分析。研究发现，海马连接在默认模式网络主导与感觉运动系统主导两种离散网络状态之间以分钟尺度交替，这一动态切换在健康人和重性抑郁障碍患者中均存在；但在抑郁状态下，默认模式网络主导状态被过度代表，平衡遭到破坏。在密集采样个体中，海马与默认模式网络的耦合随症状波动而变化，并在电休克治疗后趋于正常，治疗促使连接从默认模式网络主导转向感觉运动系统主导，且这一转变与治疗反应良好密切相关；颅内记录也显示海马-默认模式网络theta同步存在类似波动，并随数小时至数天的症状变化而变化。作者据此提出，抑郁涉及皮层-海马环路的动态失衡，而电休克等成功神经调控治疗的部分作用可能在于恢复这种动态平衡。

papers.title: BrainPT, a Cognitive Mini-Game App for Short-Form Video Use in Young Adults: Neural and Behavioral Pilot Study
papers.authors: Jeong Y, Kim C, Ha S, Choi S, Han S.
papers.abstract: Background Short-form video elicits a stimulus-driven, passive neural state, yet existing interventions target time of use alone and cannot show whether the mechanism of cognitive control has changed. Objective This pilot study developed BrainPT, a mini-game-based cognitive intervention, and evaluated whether a single insertion alters the neural state during short-form viewing (Study 1) and whether repeated use improves behavioral self-regulation (Study 2). Methods Study 1 used a within-subject design (n=9) in which electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) were recorded in the same session across short-form viewing, a single BrainPT set, and goal-directed tasks. Study 2 used a nonrandomized 2-week pretest-posttest design comparing an experimental group that used BrainPT daily (n=13) with a control group (n=8). Both visits followed the same in-laboratory protocol, and app logs and self-report indices were collected over the intervention period. Results In Study 1, short-form viewing was accompanied by prefrontal deactivation: EEG power fell below baseline in all four bands and most in alpha (−1.72 dB, P =.01; q =.054 after correction). Prefrontal activation was opposite in sign between the goal-directed tasks and viewing (+0.180 vs −0.093, P =.002), and the viewing block immediately after a BrainPT insertion exceeded the block before it (+0.110 vs −0.093, P =.02). The same condition ordering appeared in an independent preintervention sample (n=18). In Study 2, daily short-form use fell from 143.5 to 50.9 min in the experimental group and rose from 104.8 to 132.9 min in the control group, a between-group difference in change of 120.7 min ( P =.004). The Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale did not differ between groups ( P =.39), and no neural index separated the groups after 2 weeks. Conclusions A single insertion produced a measurable neural change: prefrontal state during the viewing that followed moved toward the goal-directed task. After 2 weeks of use that neural difference was not detectable between groups although behavior differed, so repeated use may act through the momentary state during viewing rather than by reorganizing the resting state. Both samples were small and nonrandomized, the primary outcome was self-reported, and the analyses were exploratory and not preregistered, so these estimates require confirmation in a preregistered randomized trial with objectively logged use. Trial Registration Clinical Research Information Service (CRIS), Republic of Korea, KCT0012762; https://cris.nih.go.kr

relevance.reason: 用EEG/fNIRS记录短视频观看及插入小游戏后的前额叶神经状态变化，属自然刺激下认知控制的脑活动研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究开发了名为BrainPT的小游戏式认知干预，并分两部分检验其作用：研究1在同一次实验中对少量年轻成人同步记录脑电和近红外脑功能成像，比较短视频观看、单次BrainPT插入与目标导向任务下的前额叶状态；研究2采用非随机两周前后测设计，比较每日使用BrainPT的实验组与对照组。研究1发现，观看短视频时前额叶活动低于基线，而目标导向任务下方向相反；单次插入BrainPT后，随后观看短视频时的前额叶状态向目标导向任务方向偏移，这一条件顺序也在独立的干预前样本中重现。研究2中实验组每日短视频使用时间下降而对照组上升，但两组在注意自评量表上无差异，两周后也未发现可区分两组的神经指标。作者据此推测，重复使用可能主要通过改变观看时的即时状态而非重组静息状态起作用；由于样本小、非随机、主要结果为自报且分析为探索性，这些估计仍需预注册随机试验验证。

papers.title: The role of world knowledge in sentence comprehension under working-memory constraints: An fMRI study
papers.authors: Emura R, Jeong H, Kawachi Y, Komuro R, Koizumi M.
papers.abstract: Introduction Comprehension of thematic roles, i.e., “who did what to whom,” relies on limited cognitive resources, and constraints on these resources can alter the use of plausibility information derived from world knowledge. Although sentence-processing studies have described how plausibility information constrains interpretation, it remains unclear how this process is supported by the architecture of working memory. This study examines whether the phonological loop, one of the components of working memory, contributes to thematic-role processing based on world knowledge. Methods Using articulatory suppression and functional magnetic resonance imaging, we examined whether constraining the function of the phonological loop modulates behavioral and neural responses to sentences in which syntactically assigned thematic roles are plausible or implausible given world knowledge. To constrain the phonological loop, we manipulated the task: a single task and a dual task involving concurrent articulation. Results We found no significant interaction between task and plausibility, although equivalence analyses did not provide evidence for the absence of a plausibility effect during articulation. In contrast, a robust main effect of thematic-role plausibility was observed: implausible sentences elicited greater activation than plausible sentences in the left inferior frontal gyrus (LIFG) and medial superior frontal gyrus (mSFG) at the whole-brain level, and in both the pars triangularis and pars orbitalis of the LIFG in the ROI analyses. Discussion These findings provide no conclusive evidence that constraining the phonological loop substantially modulates the use of world knowledge in comprehension of thematic roles, while also leaving open the possibility of a smaller task-dependent effect. At the same time, the robust neural responses to implausibility indicate that the LIFG and mSFG consistently contribute to the processing of plausibility information derived from world knowledge.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究句子主题角色理解中世界知识合理性加工的脑机制，涉及LIFG等语言相关脑区及工作记忆约束。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注工作记忆中的语音环路是否参与基于世界知识的题元角色合理性加工，采用发音抑制任务结合功能磁共振成像，比较单任务与并发发音双任务下被试对合理或不合理句子的行为与神经反应。结果未发现任务与合理性的显著交互，等价性分析也未证明发音条件下合理性效应消失，因此不能断定限制语音环路会明显改变世界知识的使用，但也不能排除存在较小任务依赖效应的可能。与此同时，合理性主效应稳健：不合理句子在左额下回和内侧上额回等区域引发更强激活，提示这些区域持续参与基于世界知识的合理性信息加工。

papers.title: Neural Representation of Chinese Word Classes: An ALE Meta-Analysis of Noun and Verb Processing.
papers.authors: Luo X, Deng Y, Sun Y.
papers.abstract: Whether nouns and verbs rely on distinct neural systems remains debated, particularly in Chinese, which has limited inflectional morphology and flexible word-class use. We used activation likelihood estimation in GingerALE 3.0.2 to synthesize task-based fMRI/PET studies identified from three databases. Twenty-three publications contributed 28 experiment-level contrast entries. The primary analyses compared 8 noun-versus-baseline and 15 verb-versus-baseline entries, using a pooled 23-entry reference; the original mixed inputs of 9 noun-associated and 19 verb-associated entries were retained as additional analyses. Input maps used cluster-level family-wise error inference at p = 0.05, and final between-set contrasts used p = 0.05 with a 200 mm3 minimum cluster size. Noun-related convergence was concentrated in the left parietal region, whereas verb-related convergence involved frontal and posterior regions. The primary comparison identified greater noun-related convergence in the left parietal and right claustral/insular regions and greater verb-related convergence in bilateral frontal and right posterior regions. The baseline-only conjunction yielded no suprathreshold cluster, while the additional analyses showed a broadly comparable pattern. Together, these findings support partly differentiated neural processing of nouns and verbs in Chinese.

relevance.reason: 该元分析综合fMRI/PET研究，揭示中文名词与动词加工的差异化脑区收敛，直接涉及语言类别的神经表征。

papers.summary_zh: 该元分析整合基于任务的功能磁共振与正电子发射断层成像研究，考察汉语名词和动词加工是否依赖不同的神经基础。结果显示，名词相关激活更集中于左侧顶叶，动词相关激活则涉及额叶和后部区域；直接比较进一步发现名词在左侧顶叶及右侧屏状核/岛叶区域汇聚更强，动词在双侧额叶和右侧后部区域汇聚更强。仅基于基线的联合分析未得到超过阈值的簇，补充分析呈现大致相似的模式。作者据此认为，汉语名词和动词的神经加工存在部分分化，但这一结论来自文献层面的激活汇聚，而非直接的因果证据。

papers.title: The late positive component in recognition memory is linked to mnemonic evidence accumulation.
papers.authors: Sun J, Feuerriegel D, Nightingale M, Osth AF.
papers.abstract: Recognising objects from memory requires an integration of sensory and mnemonic information. This process has been theorised to occur via a stochastic evidence accumulation process implemented within the parietal cortex. Recent electroencephalographic (EEG) evidence indicates that the widely studied parietal Late Positive Component (LPC) shows characteristics of such a mnemonic accumulation signal. Here, we formally investigated this hypothesis using generative computational modelling that links a trial-level memory strength variable in the Diffusion Decision Model (DDM) with LPC amplitudes prior to the time of the decision. We recorded EEG from 24 participants making recognition judgements based on either studied or novel words. Each participant completed up to three testing sessions. We replicated recent findings that the LPC ramps up and peaks around the time of the decision and corresponding motor response. LPC amplitudes also covaried with accuracy and response time, as expected of a neural correlate of memory strength. By fitting DDMs to LPC amplitudes and behavioural data using specialised neural network tools, we demonstrate that LPC amplitudes are selectively associated with the rate of evidence accumulation, signifying memory strength. This association was stronger for previously studied words compared to novel words, and strongest at the time window immediately prior to the recognition decision. Our findings, therefore, recast the LPC as a neural signature of mnemonic strength linked to the rate of evidence accumulation during recognition memory decisions.

relevance.reason: 用EEG和计算模型研究再认记忆的证据累积神经信号，属记忆认知的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究检验了再认记忆中 parietal Late Positive Component（LPC）是否反映记忆证据的随机累积过程。研究者记录被试进行词汇再认判断时的脑电，并用生成式计算建模将扩散决策模型中的试次水平记忆强度与决策前 LPC 波幅联系起来。结果显示，LPC 在决策和运动反应前后逐渐上升并达到峰值，其波幅随正确率和反应时变化；建模进一步表明 LPC 波幅选择性对应证据累积速率，即记忆强度，且这种关联在学过的词上更强、在再认决策前的时间窗内最明显。作者据此将 LPC 重新解释为与再认决策中证据累积速率相联系的记忆强度神经标志。

papers.title: Openness to experience modulates the neural dynamics of semantic processing.
papers.authors: Li B, Huang CM, Lin Q, Huang HW.
papers.abstract: Personality fundamentally shapes language processing, yet the neurocognitive mechanisms underlying this relationship remain poorly understood. Openness to experience (Openness), as measured by the NEO Five-Factor Inventory (NEO-FFI), has been associated with enhanced creativity and engagement with novel semantic information. This study examined how openness modulates the neural dynamics of semantic processing using event-related potentials (ERPs) during a semantic category verification task. Participants evaluated category relatedness across the four levels of semantic structure, including high typicality (HT), low typicality (LT), related violations (RV), and nonrelated violations (NRV). Neural responses exhibited the expected graded pattern, with N400 amplitudes becoming more negative as semantic relatedness decreased. Critically, higher Openness was associated with greater N400 differentiation between related and nonrelated violations, an effect uniquely predicted by Openness beyond the remaining four personality traits. Follow-up analyses revealed that this differentiation was primarily driven by enhanced N400 responses to nonrelated violations rather than by reduced responses to related violations. This pattern is inconsistent with a simple facilitation account in which higher Openness uniformly eases semantic processing. Instead, it suggests that Openness is associated with heightened sensitivity to semantic mismatch or more sustained semantic evaluation when incoming information is incompatible with an activated context. Behavioral performance was comparable across participants; the observed neural differences were not accompanied by detectable differences in task success. Together, these findings establish that Openness is systematically related to variation in the neural dynamics of semantic processing, while highlighting the need to clarify the underlying cognitive mechanisms and contributions of other individual differences.

relevance.reason: ERP研究考察人格开放性如何调节语义加工的神经动态（N400），直接涉及语言语义加工的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察开放性人格如何调节语义加工的电生理动态，采用语义类别验证任务并记录事件相关电位，比较不同语义关联水平下的神经反应。结果发现，语义关联性越低，N400波幅越负，呈预期的梯度模式；开放性较高者对相关违反与非相关违反之间的N400差异更大，且这一效应在其余四种人格特质之外仍由开放性独立预测。后续分析显示，该差异主要来自对非相关违反的N400反应增强，而非对相关违反的反应减弱，因而不支持开放性普遍促进语义加工的简单解释，更可能反映对语义不匹配的敏感性提高或语义评估更持续。行为表现在各参与者间相当，神经差异未伴随可检测的任务成绩差异，作者据此强调仍需厘清其认知机制及其他个体差异的作用。

papers.title: Default mode network mechanisms of trait rumination in treatment-resistant depression and rTMS: evidence from source-localized EEG.
papers.authors: Chu SA, Valles TE, Citrenbaum CC, Leuchter MK, Shamas M, Leuchter AF, Corlier J.
papers.abstract: Background Rumination is a transdiagnostic feature of multiple psychiatric disorders and is a critical risk factor for more severe episodes and poor treatment outcomes in treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) ameliorates both depressive and ruminative symptoms in TRD. While prior literature has linked rumination to abnormal default mode network (DMN) connectivity, the electrophysiological correlates of rumination in the DMN are not well understood. Methods Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) data were examined in a cohort of 66 TRD subjects who underwent 30 sessions of rTMS treatment for TRD administered to left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). We employed source-localization and calculated four metrics of functional connectivity (Amplitude Envelope Correlation [AEC], weighted Phase Lag Index [wPLI], magnitude-squared coherence, and Spectral Correlation Coefficient [SCC]) across five frequency bands within the DMN to identify the neural correlates of rumination in TRD. Correction for multiple comparisons was performed using the Network Based Statistic (NBS). Results Baseline severity of rumination and depression were positively correlated, but AEC alpha band connectivity was positively associated only with baseline rumination severity and not depression. Rumination severity prior to treatment was not associated with any other connectivity metric. Severity of rumination and depression decreased following rTMS treatment, but alpha AEC connectivity did not charge after 30 sessions of rTMS treatment. Conclusion Higher DMN connectivity, as measured by alpha-band AEC, is a stable trait-like neurophysiological marker of rumination that is not significantly affected by rTMS administered to left DLPFC.

relevance.reason: 以源定位静息态EEG研究难治性抑郁反刍思维与默认网络功能连接，涉及认知-情绪机制及脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注难治性抑郁症中反刍思维与默认模式网络电生理特征的关系，以及重复经颅磁刺激治疗对其的影响。研究对接受左侧背外侧前额叶rTMS治疗的难治性抑郁症患者进行静息态脑电溯源分析，计算默认模式网络内多个频段的功能连接指标。结果发现，基线反刍严重程度与抑郁严重程度正相关，但仅alpha频段的振幅包络相关连接与基线反刍严重程度正相关，而与抑郁无关；其他连接指标均无此关联。治疗后反刍和抑郁症状均减轻，但该alpha频段连接未随治疗改变。作者据此认为，较高的默认模式网络alpha频段连接可能是反刍思维一种稳定的、特质样的神经生理标记，且不受左侧背外侧前额叶rTMS的显著影响。

papers.title: Neurophysiological signatures underlying preserved lexical-semantic proficiency in healthy aging.
papers.authors: Nurmi P, Ala-Salomäki H, Renvall H, Liljeström M.
papers.abstract: Although semantic cognition remains behaviorally stable with age, neuroimaging studies report age-related alterations in response to semantic context.
