To address these inconsistent findings, we combined behavioral and magnetoencephalography (MEG) measures and examined the neural mechanisms underlying lexical-semantic processing in healthy aging. Forty-six Finnish-speaking adults across younger (22 - 32 years) and older (62 - 69 years) cohorts performed a semantic congruency judgment task on word pairs. Both age groups performed the task with high accuracy, with older adults responding faster than younger. While task performance was retained in older adults, MEG revealed a shift in the neural activation patterns with advancing age. Younger participants exhibited the canonical N400 effect in the left temporal cortex 300 - 400 ms post-stimulus, followed by a late semantic effect, whereas older adults showed less pronounced congruency effects, and the activation distribution was shifted toward frontal and bilateral regions. Despite the absence of the canonical N400 effect in older participants, multivariate time-resolved decoding demonstrated that the congruency effect was decodable from the MEG activation patterns in both groups from ~300 ms post-stimulus, indicating preserved sensitivity to congruency with age. Decoding performance further correlated with response times, suggesting that greater neural separation between semantic concepts, indicated by higher decodability, is associated with rapid decision-making. Critically, age groups were distinguishable based on their neural responses 300 - 800 ms post-stimulus, indicating a functional reorganization of semantic processing in older adults. Overall, our findings suggest that healthy aging involves a reconfiguration of neural systems associated with preserved semantic proficiency, despite broader age-related cognitive changes.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究健康老化中词汇-语义加工的神经机制与功能重组，属语言与脑及认知老化。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究结合行为测量与脑磁图，考察健康老龄化中词汇语义加工保持稳定的神经机制。行为上两组均能准确完成任务，老年人反应更快；但脑磁图显示，老年人虽缺乏典型的N400效应，语义一致性信息仍可从约300毫秒起的激活模式中解码，且解码表现与反应时相关。研究还发现两年龄组的神经反应在刺激后300至800毫秒可区分，提示老年人语义加工存在功能重组，从而在更广泛的认知变化背景下维持语义能力。

papers.title: Dual-mode dynamics in hippocampal populations enable rapid and precise spatial coding.
papers.authors: Ren M, Feng S, Chen Q, Lin L, Xu J.
papers.abstract: Hippocampal spatial representations emerge within minutes of first exposure to novel environments, challenging models based solely on gradual synaptic plasticity. Here, we show that CA1 spatial coding is organized according to a dual-mode architecture comprising a pre-organized backbone and an experience-dependent component. Backbone cells expressing immediately emerging place fields form a stable spatial scaffold and dominate positional decoding from the first traversal, whereas experience-dependent cells bearing gradually emerging fields are progressively incorporated to refine spatial representations. Analyses of ensemble activity further reveal that offline dynamics prospectively organize future spatial coding. In backbone cells, latent tuning aligns with their future place fields prior to task engagement, while in experience-dependent cells this alignment strengthens before overt place-field expression. Together, these findings identify a dual-mode organization of hippocampal populations in which offline dynamics pre-organize network activity to enable rapid and precise spatial coding in novel environments.

relevance.reason: 研究海马CA1空间编码群体动态，属空间认知神经机制，但摘要未明确研究对象是人脑还是动物（啮齿类海马研究常见），无法确定是否符合人脑边界。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨海马空间表征为何能在初次接触新环境后迅速形成，并记录CA1群体活动，提出空间编码由两部分构成：一部分是预先组织、在首次探索时即出现位置野的“骨架”细胞，它们构成稳定的空间支架并主导位置解码；另一部分是随经验逐渐出现位置野的细胞，被逐步纳入以细化空间表征。对群体活动的分析还显示，离线动态具有前瞻性组织作用：骨架细胞的潜在调谐在任务前已与其未来位置野对齐，经验依赖细胞的这种对齐则在位置野显现前增强。作者据此认为，海马群体通过离线动态预先组织网络活动，从而支持新环境中的快速、精确空间编码。

papers.title: Diffusion MRI assessment of white matter microstructure and free-water fraction in drug-naïve children with SeLECTS.
papers.authors: Zhou X, Chen Y, Luo Y, Kuang Y, Deng C, Lai H.
papers.abstract: Background Self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (SeLECTS) is a common childhood-onset focal epilepsy syndrome. Although seizures are typically self-limited, some children may show neurodevelopmental or cognitive vulnerability. Diffusion MRI may provide insight into white matter alterations in SeLECTS. Objective To evaluate white matter diffusion differences in newly diagnosed, drug-naïve children with SeLECTS using tract-based spatial statistics (TBSS) and white matter free-water fraction (FW-WM), and to explore within-patient associations with selected seizure-related and cognitive variables. Methods Fifty-three newly diagnosed, drug-naïve children with SeLECTS and 53 healthy controls with a similar age and sex distribution were prospectively enrolled in this cross-sectional case-control study. Diffusion MRI was acquired at 3.0 T, and white matter diffusion differences were assessed using TBSS and FW-WM analyses. Voxelwise between-group differences in fractional anisotropy (FA) were tested with age and sex as covariates and corrected using threshold-free cluster enhancement-based family-wise error correction. FW-WM was compared between groups using age- and sex-adjusted general linear models, with additional adjustment for years of education in a sensitivity analysis. Exploratory within-patient associations between imaging measures and selected clinical or cognitive variables were assessed using partial Spearman correlations with false-discovery-rate correction. Results Children with SeLECTS showed lower FA than healthy controls in multiple TBSS-defined white matter regions after correction for multiple comparisons, mainly involving commissural, projection, and association pathways. No between-group differences in mean, axial, or radial diffusivity survived correction for multiple comparisons. FW-WM was higher in the SeLECTS group after adjustment for age and sex (adjusted mean difference = 0.0085; 95% CI, 0.0023-0.0147; P = 0.008), with similar results after additional adjustment for education. In exploratory cluster-level analyses, mean FA in a left-sided cluster involving the posterior internal capsule, posterior thalamic radiation, and sagittal stratum was inversely associated with disease duration after FDR correction (r = -0.413; P = 0.003; q = 0.010). No imaging-cognition or within-patient FW-WM-FA association survived FDR correction. Conclusions Newly diagnosed, drug-naïve children with SeLECTS showed white matter diffusion differences, including lower FA in distributed TBSS-defined regions and higher FW-WM. These findings support diffusion MRI-based characterization of white matter alterations at diagnosis, before antiseizure treatment. Longitudinal studies are needed to clarify their clinical and developmental relevance.

relevance.reason: 在未用药SeLECTS患儿中采用扩散MRI评估白质微结构与游离水分数，属脑疾病相关的白质结构研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面病例对照研究考察了初诊未用药的SeLECTS患儿白质微结构是否存在弥散MRI可见的差异，并与年龄性别分布相近的健康儿童比较，采用基于纤维束的空间统计和自由水分数分析。结果显示，患儿在多个白质区域各向异性分数低于对照组，且平均自由水分数更高，而平均、轴向和径向弥散系数未见组间差异。探索性分析中，左侧一簇区域的平均各向异性分数与病程呈负相关，但影像与认知指标及自由水分数与各向异性分数之间未见经校正的关联。作者认为这些发现支持在抗癫痫治疗前用弥散MRI刻画白质改变，其临床和发育意义仍需纵向研究澄清。

papers.title: Neural Circuits of Social Behavior in Autism Spectrum Disorder: From Mechanism to Intervention.
papers.authors: O'Reilly Sparks KC, Pedapati EV.
papers.abstract: Introduction Difficulties in social communication and interaction are core diagnostic features of autism spectrum disorder (ASD), yet interventions targeting these difficulties have modest and variable effects. Understanding mechanistically distinct contributions to social behaviors may identify new therapeutic opportunities. Methods This narrative review integrates human neuroimaging studies, supporting rodent circuit neuroscience, clinical intervention research, and developmental studies. We organize the findings into four overlapping functional-computational domains and relate these domains to the Research Domain Criteria Social Processes framework. Results The four domains are: (1) Social Reward and Social Interest, encompassing the incentive and hedonic value of social contact and motivation to engage; (2) Social Memory and Social-Affective Value, encompassing recognition of familiar individuals and learned affective or motivational associations; (3) Social Cue Perception, Action Representation, and Social Prediction/Timing, encompassing the processing and forecasting of dynamic social information; and (4) Higher-Order Social Cognition and Model Updating, encompassing mental-state inference and the updating of person-specific social models. Because these domains are not independent, interactions among reward, memory, cue processing, prediction, and higher-order inference create multiple possible developmental entry points, such that early differences in one process may alter experience-dependent learning in others. Evidence for specific causal cascades remains preliminary and requires longitudinal testing. Conclusions A circuit-and-development framework may improve hypothesis generation, domain-specific phenotyping, target-engagement assessment, and mechanism-aligned outcomes. Clinical translation, however, requires caution. Biomarkers should be validated as predictors of treatment response, cascade models should be tested longitudinally, and interventions should combine mechanism-informed targets with behavioral support that promotes generalization to daily life.

relevance.reason: 综述整合人脑影像与环路证据，提出自闭症社会行为（奖赏、记忆、线索感知、高阶社会认知）的神经环路与发育框架，属社会认知神经机制及脑疾病机理。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕自闭症谱系障碍社交困难的神经机制与干预展开，整合人类神经影像、啮齿类环路研究、临床干预及发育研究，将社交行为归纳为社交奖赏与兴趣、社交记忆与情感价值、社交线索感知与预测、高阶社会认知与模型更新四个相互重叠的功能—计算域，并与RDoC社交过程框架对应。作者指出，这些域彼此交互，早期某一过程的差异可能通过经验依赖学习影响其他过程，形成多个可能的发育入口；但具体因果级联的证据仍属初步，需纵向检验。文章认为，环路与发育框架有助于假设生成、域特异性表型刻画、靶点参与评估和机制对齐的结局设计，但临床转化须谨慎：生物标志物需验证为治疗反应预测因子，级联模型需纵向检验，干预应将机制靶点与促进日常泛化的行为支持结合。

papers.title: Altered frontal and dorsal hemodynamic engagement during mandarin aspiration processing in post-stroke aphasia: an fNIRS study.
papers.authors: Cheng J, Ren T, Liu Y, Ma Y, Luo M, Zhou F, Wang Y, Chen A, Lu C.
papers.abstract: Auditory and speech-perception difficulties are common in post-stroke aphasia (PSA), but cortical responses during passive listening to Mandarin speech remain underexplored. Seventeen Mandarin-speaking individuals with PSA and 18 matched healthy controls listened to auditory oddball blocks containing /ba/ standards and /pa/ deviants during functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). Although these syllables instantiate an aspiration contrast strongly cued by voice onset time (VOT), standard and deviant trials were combined within a single block-level condition. The resulting measures therefore indexed activation during speech-containing blocks relative to silent inter-block intervals rather than phonemic discrimination, categorization, or VOT-specific processing. Seven theory-driven channels covering bilateral auditory, sensorimotor, inferior frontal, and dorsolateral prefrontal regions were analyzed using three HbO indices: β coefficient, peak amplitude, and temporal centroid. The PSA group showed an overall reduction in task-related HbO activation, reflected by a significant Group effect for the β coefficient. Peak amplitude also showed significant Group and Group × Channel effects, although no individual channel remained significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Temporal centroid showed no significant group or interaction effects. These findings provide preliminary evidence for reduced block-evoked cortical recruitment during passive auditory exposure to Mandarin speech sounds in PSA. Because the analysis did not include a direct standard-deviant or active auditory control comparison, the findings do not establish a selective impairment of phonemic discrimination, categorization, or VOT processing. Because patients were assessed 6-7 months after stroke onset, the activation differences may reflect both persistent impairment and recovery-related reorganization during the early chronic stage.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS比较卒中后失语患者与健康人对普通话语音被动聆听的皮层血流动力学反应，涉及语言听觉加工及失语脑重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注卒中后失语（PSA）患者被动聆听普通话语音时的皮层血流动力学反应，并与健康对照比较。17名普通话使用者PSA患者和18名匹配健康对照在fNIRS下聆听含/ba/标准音与/pa/偏差音的听觉oddball组块，分析双侧听觉、感觉运动、额下及背外侧前额叶等7个理论驱动通道的HbO指标。结果显示PSA组任务相关HbO激活总体降低（β系数存在显著组效应），峰幅也有显著组效应和组×通道交互，但多重比较校正后无单个通道显著；时间重心无显著组或交互效应。作者指出，由于未做标准-偏差或主动听觉对照比较，不能据此认定音位辨别、范畴化或VOT加工的选择性损伤；且患者于卒中后6至7个月评估，差异可能同时反映持续损害与早期慢性期的恢复性重组。

papers.title: Evidence that intrinsic brain connectivity moderates the association between gait and neurocognitive function in people living with HIV.
papers.authors: Ipser JC, Smuts S, Gouse H, Freeman C, Stein DJ, Joska J.
papers.abstract: Globally, a substantial proportion of the approximately 40 million people living with HIV (PLWH) experience some degree of HIV-associated brain injury (HABI), which is often linked to accentuated or accelerated aging in this clinical population. We set out to test the hypothesis that gait speed is associated with cognitive deficits in middle-aged PLWH in a low-middle income (LMIC) setting, and that this is comparable to what is seen in much older healthy adults. In addition, we sought to identify, as a potential marker of HABI, intrinsic functional brain connectivity abnormalities that moderate the association between gait and cognitive function in PLWH. Thirty-nine participants (17 HIV + and 22 HIV-, mean age = 39 +-8.99 years) were recruited from a community health centre in Cape Town. Bivariate and multiple linear regression models compared PLWH and controls with respect to associations between gait speed and neurocognitive domain scores, with relations between these factors and functional connectivity of seven resting state networks assessed within a multivariate regression modelling framework. We found that slower gait speed in PLWH was associated with lower global neurocognitive scores (t = -3.12; p < 0.008), and that this association was replicated in a large public domain cohort of healthy older adults. Moreover, intrinsic connectivity of the frontoparietal network in PLWH was a significant predictor of both gait speed and executive function, a finding that may implicate impaired compensatory mechanisms in this patient population. Our findings underscore the potential utility of gait tests in screening for HABI in PLWH in low resourced settings.

relevance.reason: 研究HIV感染者步速与认知关联及静息态网络连接调节，涉及脑功能连接与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨中年HIV感染者中步速与认知功能的关系，并检验内在功能脑连接是否调节这一关联。研究在开普敦社区招募HIV感染者和对照者，比较步速与神经认知得分的关联，并在多变量回归中评估七个静息态网络功能连接的作用。结果显示，感染者步速越慢，整体神经认知得分越低，这一关联在健康老年人公共队列中也能重现；额顶网络连接可预测步速和执行功能，提示该人群可能存在代偿机制受损。作者认为步态测试或有助于资源有限地区筛查HIV相关脑损伤，但样本较小，结论仍需更大研究验证。

papers.title: Robust and replicable effects of ageing on resting-state brain electrophysiology measured with MEG.
papers.authors: Quinn AJ, Pitt J, Kohl O, Gohil C, van Es MWJ, Nobre AC, Woolrich MW.
papers.abstract: Non-invasive recordings of brain electrophysiology provide credible insights into decline in neuronal functioning with age. New approaches are required to translate these results into compelling clinical metrics and meet the global challenge of preserving brain health in ageing. Changes in neuronal dynamics with ageing are observable in the power spectra of EEG and MEG recordings. Highly promising candidates for electrophysiological markers have been identified, but progress is hindered by substantial methodological variability across studies. This makes it challenging to establish a clear consensus on the frequency, location, and direction of any single reported effect within the larger body of research. We estimate a full-frequency whole-head profile of the ageing effect on eyes-closed resting-state MEG using the GLM-Spectrum. This data representation is easily sharable, facilitates meta-analyses, and provides a framework for estimating statistical power of age effects for future study planning. We use this to show that the effect of age replicates across open-access MEG datasets and is robust to modelling of common covariates. Distinct components within the full-frequency profile have different effect sizes, indicating that sample-size planning for ageing effects must consider the specific features of interest. The frequency profile of ageing is strongly robust to a range of common covariates and partially robust to modelling of grey matter volume. We establish that what seems a well-powered study may become underpowered when analyses target an age effect that is linearly separable from an age-relevant covariate such as grey matter volume. These results provide a pathway towards formal comparison and assessment of candidate markers for brain health in ageing.

relevance.reason: 研究闭眼静息态MEG脑电频谱随年龄变化的可重复效应，属人脑自发活动与功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注衰老如何影响静息态脑电生理，并试图解决既往研究因方法差异大而难以形成一致结论的问题。作者用一般线性模型谱方法估计闭眼静息态MEG的全频段全头衰老效应剖面，发现该效应在多个公开数据集中可重复，且对常见协变量的建模较为稳健。全频剖面中不同成分的效应量不同，提示规划样本量时需针对具体特征；同时，若目标效应与灰质体积等年龄相关协变量线性可分，原本看似有足够统计效力的研究可能效力不足。这些结果为候选脑健康标志物的正式比较与评估提供了途径。

papers.title: Physics-informed neural networks for subject-specific recovery of travelling-wave structure in resting-state fMRI
papers.authors: Pouya TL, Sotero RC.
papers.abstract: Resting-state BOLD fluctuations show reproducible spatiotemporal propagation that is not accounted for by conventional zero-lag functional connectivity. Travelling wave analyses based on phase gradients or statistical decomposition have problems when multiple wave generators overlap or when wave origins have to be localized. This work introduces a wave-informed physics-informed neural network that represents the parcellated BOLD signal as a superposition of seven spatially extended damped travelling wave generators, each periodically re-excited at its own characteristic frequency and fixed at initialization to one of the seven canonical Schaefer resting-state networks. A soft anatomical prior derived from each subject’s diffusion-tensor structural connectivity is included to encode the hypothesis that white-matter pathways constrain wave direction. The pipeline is validated on synthetic data by three simulation studies, creating the operating envelope, and then applied to 41 cognitively normal participants of the ADNI 3 cohort. A within-subject ablation showed that mean alignment between recovered wave directions and underlying white-matter geometry increased by a small but statistically detectable amount when using the structural prior (one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, p = 0.026), with exploratory network-level effects most evident in the visual, dorsal-attention, and salience/ventral-attention networks. The contribution is a network-anchored parametric inverse method returning subject-specific propagation descriptors from short resting-state scans.

relevance.reason: 从静息态fMRI恢复受试者特异行波结构，并用扩散结构连接约束波方向，属静息脑组织与结构-功能关系研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对静息态BOLD信号中常规零滞后功能连接无法解释的时空传播现象，提出一种波信息物理约束神经网络，将分区BOLD信号建模为七个空间扩展阻尼行波发生器的叠加，并引入基于个体弥散张量结构连接的软解剖先验，以检验白质通路约束波方向的假设。方法先在合成数据上通过模拟研究确定适用边界，再应用于认知正常参与者。受试者内消融显示，加入结构先验后，恢复的波方向与白质几何的平均对齐度出现小幅但可统计检测的提升，探索性网络层面效应主要见于视觉、背侧注意和突显/腹侧注意网络。作者将其定位为一种网络锚定的参数化反演方法，可从短时静息态扫描中返回个体特异的传播描述符。

papers.title: Mapping the neural basis of the perception of "flow of time": interval timing and mental time travel in the human brain.
papers.authors: Ochi R, Kawamura M.
papers.abstract: Although neurodegenerative diseases and brain injuries have been reported to impair the perception of "the flow of time," the underlying neural mechanisms remain uncertain. We examined symptoms related to interval timing and mental time travel, two neuropsychological phenomena associated with the perception of the flow of time that have been relatively well characterized. In addition, we reviewed the current evidence and proposed a potential underlying brain mechanism.

relevance.reason: 综述时间知觉与心理时间旅行的脑机制，属除语言外的认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该文关注“时间流动感”知觉的神经基础，指出尽管神经退行性疾病和脑损伤已被报告会损害这种知觉，其机制仍不明确。作者考察了间期计时与心理时间旅行这两种与该知觉相关、且已有较好刻画的现象，并结合对现有证据的梳理，提出一个可能的潜在脑机制。文章属于综述性工作，并未报告新的实验数据，因此其结论是机制假设而非因果验证。

papers.title: Aging and Hearing Loss in Emotional Prosody Processing: Divergent Neural Adaptation and Behavioral Performance
papers.authors: Lin Y, Lu Y, Ding H, Zhang Y.
papers.abstract: Emotional prosody perception is vulnerable in later adulthood, yet the contributions of central aging and peripheral hearing loss remain unclear. Across two experiments, we combined event-related potentials (ERPs) , time-frequency analyses and behavioral measures to examine how aging and hearing sensitvity shape emotional prosody processing. Experiment 1 used acoustically matched speech and nonspeech stimuli in a passive oddball paradigm to assess preattentive processing. Experiment 2 examined explicit emotion identification and implicit stimulus judgment to evaluate goal-directed performance and its associations with neural responses. Aging was associated with reduced neural differentiation between emotions and lower behavioral efficiency, alongside enhanced P3a amplitude. Older adults also responded more slowly than younger adults during emotion identification. Hearing sensitivity showed no significant main effect on accuracy or reaction time, despite associations with delayed early neural processing and stronger theta- and alpha-band activity. Hearing-related neural effects were most evident in older adults and varied across emotions and stimulus types. Brain–behavior associations were selective: reduced mismatch negativity (MMN) was associated with slower responses during stimulus identification, whereas longer MMN latencies were associated with lower accuracy and slower responses during emotion identification. These findings indicate that aging and hearing loss have distinct yet interacting associations with emotional prosody processing, with neural responses not necessarily corresponding to behavioral performance. We propose an “asymmetric adaptation” account in which neural responses to degraded auditory input reorganize selectively across processing stages and contexts, potentially explaining this neural-behavioral divergence and informing more sensitive assessment of socioemotional communication in later adulthood.

relevance.reason: 研究老年与听力损失对情绪韵律言语加工的ERP神经机制及脑行为关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注老年期情感韵律加工中中枢老化与外周听力损失各自的作用，结合脑电事件相关电位、时频分析和行为测量，用被动oddball任务和情绪识别任务分别考察前注意加工与目标导向表现。结果显示，老化与情绪间神经区分减弱、行为效率下降及P3a波幅增强相关，老年人在情绪识别时反应更慢；听力敏感度对准确率和反应时无显著主效应，却与早期神经加工延迟及更强的theta、alpha活动相关，且这类效应在老年人中更明显并随情绪和刺激类型变化。脑与行为的关系具有选择性，MMN波幅降低与刺激识别变慢相关，MMN潜伏期延长则与情绪识别准确率降低和反应变慢相关。作者据此提出“非对称适应”解释，认为对退化听觉输入的神经反应会在不同加工阶段和情境中选择性重组，神经反应未必对应行为表现，这或有助于更敏感地评估老年期社会情绪沟通。

papers.title: Associations Between Resting-State EEG Delta-band Activity at Selected Parietal Electrodes and Cognitive Changes Following Transcutaneous Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation in Patients with Mild Cognitive Impairment: An Exploratory Analysis.
papers.authors: Wang L, Ouyang H, Zhang J, Lu X, Zhang S, Zhao Y, Liang Y, Hao L, Wang Y, Rong P.
papers.abstract: Introduction Transcutaneous auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation (taVNS) may improve cognition in Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), but its electrophysiological correlates remain unclear. We explored whether parietal delta-band changes were associated with cognitive changes following taVNS. Methods This exploratory secondary analysis included 26 participants with MCI from a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (taVNS, n = 14; sham, n = 12) who had valid resting-state EEG data at baseline and Week 24. Absolute and relative 1-3 Hz delta power at Pz, P1, P2, and P5 were analyzed using repeated-measures ANOVA and EEG-cognitive correlations with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction. Results Absolute delta power showed significant time effects at all four electrodes after FDR correction (all q = 0.008). Relative delta power at Pz showed an uncorrected group effect (F = 5.007, p = 0.035; q = 0.218). In the taVNS group, MoCA-B improvement was positively associated with relative delta-power changes at P1, P2, and P5 (r = 0.629-0.652, p = 0.012-0.016), whereas AVLTN7 improvement was negatively associated with absolute delta-power changes across Pz, P1, P2, and P5 (coefficients = -0.418 to -0.613, p = 0.020-0.048). Although these correlations did not reach statistical significance after correction for multiple comparisons, they showed a relatively consistent direction across multiple electrodes. Discussion Relative and absolute delta power may reflect complementary aspects of spectral modulation. The convergent cross-electrode associations provide preliminary EEG evidence linked to cognitive response to taVNS. Conclusion Parietal delta-band power may represent a candidate electrophysiological marker of cognitive change following taVNS in MCI. These exploratory findings support further validation of predefined EEG biomarkers in larger, prospectively powered studies. Clinical trial registration http://www.chictr.org.cn (ID: ChiCTR2000038868).

relevance.reason: 研究MCI患者静息态EEG顶叶delta活动与taVNS后认知变化的关系，涉及人脑自发活动与认知的神经关联。

papers.summary_zh: 这项探索性二次分析基于一项随机双盲假刺激对照试验，考察轻度认知障碍患者在接受经皮耳迷走神经刺激后，顶区静息态脑电δ频段活动与认知变化之间是否存在关联。分析纳入26名有基线和第24周有效脑电数据的患者，比较Pz、P1、P2、P5电极的绝对与相对δ功率，并与认知测验变化做相关分析。结果显示，绝对δ功率在四个电极上均存在时间效应；在刺激组中，MoCA-B改善与P1、P2、P5的相对δ功率变化呈正相关，而AVLTN7改善与各电极绝对δ功率变化呈负相关，方向在多个电极间较为一致，但这些相关经多重比较校正后未达显著。作者据此认为，顶区δ频段功率可能是反映taVNS后认知变化的候选脑电标志物，但结论仅为初步，尚需更大规模、预先设定指标的研究验证。

papers.title: TMS-EEG Investigation of Cortical Activity Induced by Individualized rTMS in Patients with Prolonged Disorders of Consciousness
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Yan X, Zhu Z, Du J, Cao L, Song W, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To establish an individualized repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) target selection protocol based on resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) directed functional connectivity for patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness (pDoC), and to explore the underlying electrophysiological mechanisms using transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with EEG (TMS-EEG). Methods We enrolled 42 pDoC patients and randomly assigned to an individualized rTMS group, a conventional rTMS group, and a sham stimulation group. The individualized rTMS group selected the target with stronger directed functional connectivity between F3 and Pz as the stimulation site based on Granger causality analysis. The conventional rTMS group received random stimulation at either F3 or Pz. Both active groups received 10 sessions of high-frequency rTMS over 10 consecutive days, while the sham group underwent sham stimulation. Behavioral improvement and cortical connectivity were assessed before and after treatment using the Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (CRS-R) and TMS-EEG, respectively. Results CRS-R scores significantly increased in both the individualized and conventional rTMS groups ( p < 0.05), whereas no significant improvement was observed in the sham group ( p > 0.05). TMS-EEG analysis demonstrated that the amplitudes of N100 and P180 components significantly increased post-treatment in both active groups ( p < 0.05), with no statistically significant changes in the sham group ( p > 0.05). Global mean field amplitude (GMFA) significantly increased post-treatment in both active groups ( p < 0.05). Specifically, significant increases were found in the 1-100 ms and 101–200 ms time windows post-treatment in both active groups ( p < 0.05). Additionally, the individualized rTMS group showed a significant increase in the 201–300 ms window ( p < 0.05), which was not observed in the conventional group ( p > 0.05). No significant differences were found in the sham group across any time windows (1-100 ms, 101–200 ms, 201–300 ms, 301–400 ms, 401–500 ms; p > 0.05). Correlation analyses indicated that the change in CRS-R score positively correlated with the change in N100 amplitude in both the individualized ( r = 0.82, p < 0.001) and conventional ( r = 0.79, p = 0.001) treatment groups. Similarly, the change in CRS-R score positively correlated with the change in P180 amplitude in the individualized ( r = 0.77, p = 0.0002) and conventional ( r = 0.62, p = 0.025) groups. Conclusion Individualized rTMS based on resting-state EEG directed functional connectivity is more effective in promoting consciousness recovery in pDoC patients. Compared to conventional rTMS, this approach may better facilitate the sustained propagation of post-stimulation cortical activity along residual consciousness networks and promote integration during middle-to-late stages. This study provides preliminary evidence supporting the transition of neuromodulation therapy for pDoC from fixed-target interventions to individualized precision regulation. Trial registration: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05682248. Ethics approval : Ethics Committee of Xuanwu Hospital, 2022[022].

relevance.reason: 以TMS-EEG研究意识障碍患者rTMS后皮层活动与意识恢复，涉及意识神经机制及静息EEG功能连接指导的个体化调控。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对迁延性意识障碍患者，比较基于静息态脑电有向功能连接选取个体化靶点的高频rTMS与常规固定靶点rTMS及假刺激的效果，并借助TMS-EEG考察皮层活动的变化。结果显示，个体化与常规rTMS组的意识行为评分均较治疗前提高，假刺激组未见明显改善；两组的N100、P180成分及全局平均场幅值也出现上升，且个体化组在较晚时间窗的皮层活动增强更为明显。行为改善与诱发电位幅值变化呈正相关。作者据此认为，个体化rTMS可能更有助于促进意识恢复，并推动刺激后皮层活动沿残余意识网络持续传播，但相关证据仍属初步，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Enhanced pitch perception in early blind individuals and musicians is due to reduced internal noise.
papers.authors: Park WJ, Awad J, Fine I.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Although it is commonly assumed that early blind individuals have enhanced pitch perception, the literature to date has been contradictory. We measured performance on two tasks known to recruit early versus late stages of auditory frequency tuning in early blind and sighted human adults of both sexes with matched years of musical training. The two groups showed equivalent performance on a tone detection in notched-noise task that assesses cochlear frequency selectivity. In contrast, early blind individuals showed enhanced performance in a pitch discrimination task thought to be mediated by cortical mechanisms. Computational modeling revealed that this enhancement was best explained by reduced internal noise rather than narrower frequency tuning, with both blindness and years of musical training predicting a reduction in internal noise. These findings identify internal noise as a key factor in experience-driven auditory plasticity as a result of both musical experience and early blindness.Significance Statement For centuries, early blindness has been associated with superior auditory abilities. Here we find that the enhanced pitch perception in early blind individuals is best explained by reduced internal noise at higher levels of auditory processing, rather than sharper frequency tuning. Years of musical training similarly resulted in lower internal noise, suggesting a shared mechanism through which experience improves auditory perception. These findings identify internal noise reduction as a key component of experience-dependent auditory plasticity.

relevance.reason: 研究早期失明与音乐训练对人听觉音高知觉及皮层机制的可塑性影响，属感知与经验驱动脑可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对早期失明者音高知觉是否增强这一存在争议的问题，比较了早期失明与视力正常成人在两类听觉任务上的表现，两组音乐训练年限相匹配。结果显示，两组在评估耳蜗频率选择性的任务上表现相当，而早期失明者在被认为由皮层机制介导的音高辨别任务上表现更好。计算建模表明，这一优势更适合用内部噪声降低而非频率调谐变窄来解释，失明和音乐训练年限均能预测内部噪声的减少。作者据此认为，内部噪声降低是音乐经验和早期失明共同驱动的听觉经验可塑性中的关键因素。

papers.title: Identification of letters distorted by physiologically-inspired spatial scrambling.
papers.authors: Zhu RX, Baldwin AS.
papers.abstract: In the geniculostriate pathway of the human visual system, neuronal projections carry signals from a particular retinal locus in parallel from one anatomical area to the next. Imprecision in the fidelity of these projections would place constraints on the ability of the system to perform tasks requiring positional information. We investigated the impact that "spatial scrambling" between stages would have on visual performance. We consider two stages in a simple canonical model of the early visual cortex where scrambling might occur: either the input to the first orientation-tuned mechanisms (analogous to V1 simple cells), or the output from those mechanisms. These are referred as "subcortical" (SCS) and "cortical scrambling" (CS). We developed a wavelet decomposition and resynthesis algorithm to mimic these effects, and measured human performance in letter identification affected by the two types of scrambling. Our results showed SCS and CS have distinguishable effects on both perceived noisiness of letters and letter identification threshold. Comparing human performance against a suite of pre-trained and custom convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that were trained on the scrambled stimuli, relative efficiency (calculated from the ratio of human:CNN thresholds) is higher for CS than SCS. However, in modelling human inefficiency by reducing the proportion of wavelets available to the CNNs, humans are less efficient in CS than SCS. These differences in efficiencies show humans are better at processing orientation redundant stimuli (CS) than orientation noisy stimuli (SCS). We hypothesize this reflects differences in integration properties at the input and output stages of simple cells in the cortex.

relevance.reason: 研究人类视觉皮层早期空间编码与字母识别行为，涉及人脑视觉加工机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早期视觉通路中投射的空间精度若出现“空间扰乱”，会如何影响位置信息相关的视觉任务。作者用基于小波的分解与重合成算法，模拟发生在朝向调谐机制输入（皮层下扰乱）和输出（皮层扰乱）两个阶段的空间扰乱，并测量人类被试在字母识别中的表现。结果显示，两类扰乱对字母主观噪声感和识别阈限的影响可区分；与在扰乱刺激上训练的卷积神经网络比较时，人类在皮层扰乱条件下的相对效率高于皮层下扰乱，但以减少可用小波比例来建模人类低效时，皮层扰乱下的人类效率反而更低。作者据此推测，人脑处理朝向冗余刺激优于朝向噪声刺激，可能反映皮层简单细胞输入与输出阶段整合特性的差异。

papers.title: Microglial dynamics associate with the spatial pattern of tau deposition in early Alzheimer's disease.
papers.authors: Öchsner M, Brendel M, Franzmeier N, Trappmann L, Zaganjori M, Ersoezlue E, Kurz C, Haeckert J, Utecht J, Schirge PM, Papazov B, Pogarell O, Janowitz D, Buerger K, Ewers M, Palleis C, Weidinger E, Biechele G, Schuster S, Finze A, Eckenweber F, Rupprecht R, Rominger A, Goldhardt O, Grimmer T, Keeser D, Stoecklein S, Dietrich O, Bartenstein P, Levin J, Höglinger G, Perneczky R, Rauchmann BS.
papers.abstract: Background Neuroinflammation is implicated in Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathogenesis, yet how changes in TSPO PET signal are associated with tau deposition, and how brain network architecture shapes this relationship remain poorly understood. Methods We conducted a prospective, multimodal neuroimaging study in 56 participants: 35 amyloid-positive individuals across the AD spectrum (ADS) and 21 amyloid-negative healthy controls (HC). Amyloid status was classified primarily by CSF Aβ42/Aβ40 and, when eligible CSF was unavailable, by baseline amyloid PET. Participants underwent TSPO PET using [18 F]GE-180 and resting-state fMRI at baseline. A longitudinal subgroup additionally underwent follow-up tau PET using [18 F]PI-2620 (n = 24) and repeat TSPO PET (n = 18) approximately 18 months later. Results Baseline TSPO did not differ significantly between groups. Baseline TSPO was associated with regional tau in both groups; the reciprocal association between tau and TSPO change was numerically weaker in AD, but this group difference was not statistically significant. Connectivity to baseline-TSPO epicenters was associated with higher tau in both groups, whereas connectivity to TSPO-change epicenters was associated with lower tau in AD but not controls (group-by-connectivity interaction p < 0.001, participant-level slope difference p = 0.012), a dissociation replicated in independent participants. Conclusion These findings suggest that connectivity to established versus emerging TSPO epicenters carries distinct spatial information about tau in the AD spectrum, a pattern shaped by functional brain connectivity and absent in healthy controls. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06224920).

relevance.reason: 在AD谱系人群中结合TSPO PET、tau PET与静息态功能连接，考察脑网络结构如何塑造神经炎症与tau沉积的空间关系，属脑疾病机理与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在淀粉样蛋白阳性AD谱系个体与淀粉样蛋白阴性健康对照中，结合TSPO PET、静息态fMRI及纵向tau PET，考察微胶质活动与tau沉积的空间关系及脑网络连接的作用。基线TSPO在两组间无显著差异，但与区域tau相关；与基线TSPO中心连接度高的区域tau更高，而与TSPO变化中心连接度高的区域tau更低，后者仅在AD谱系中出现，且该分离在独立参与者中重复。作者据此提出，已建立与新兴TSPO中心所承载的tau空间信息不同，这一模式受功能连接塑造，在健康对照中未见。

papers.title: Zero Echo Time Functional MRI in Humans: Technical Demonstration and Proof-of-Concept.
papers.authors: Ozen AC, Liu S, Ilbey S, Bock M, Emir U, Shih YI.
papers.abstract: Conventional EPI-based fMRI relies on the BOLD contrast to map activity changes, but is limited by high acoustic noise, susceptibility artifacts, and distortion near air-tissue interfaces. Ultra-short and zero-echo-time (ZTE) sequences have gained considerable attention in animal fMRI studies due to their robustness against susceptibility effects, low acoustic noise, and ability to capture signal sources distinct from those of conventional BOLD imaging. In this study, we present a feasibility-level proof-of-concept technical demonstration of ZTE-based fMRI in humans at 3T, while maintaining many of the advantages observed in preclinical studies. Phantom measurements demonstrate that the ZTE protocol is sensitive to oxygenation-related T1 changes at 3T, supporting its feasibility for detecting related functional signals. In five healthy volunteers, task-based visual stimulation and finger tapping experiments elicited activation in primary visual and motor cortices, respectively, using the ZTE sequence, demonstrating proof-of-concept feasibility in this small cohort. Resting-state components with spatial patterns consistent with canonical visual and sensorimotor networks were identified using independent component analysis in the same cohort. Compared to BOLD-EPI, ZTE showed significantly reduced acoustic noise and was largely insensitive to susceptibility-induced signal loss in this feasibility study. While this work represents our initial experience using ZTE for human fMRI at 3T, the presented results will motivate future studies to refine and extend this approach to explore complementary functional contrast mechanisms.

relevance.reason: 在人体3T上实现零回波时间功能MRI，报告视觉/运动任务激活与静息网络，属功能信号与结构/采集机制相关的人脑功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在3T人体磁共振上对零回波时间（ZTE）功能成像做了可行性层面的技术验证，属于概念验证性技术演示。体模测量显示该序列对氧合相关的T1变化敏感；在健康志愿者中，视觉刺激和手指敲击任务分别引起初级视觉和运动皮层激活，静息态独立成分分析也得到与经典视觉、感觉运动网络空间模式相符的成分。与BOLD-EPI相比，ZTE的声学噪声明显更低，且在本研究中基本不受磁化率导致的信号丢失影响。作者强调这只是初步经验，结果旨在推动后续研究完善该方法并探索互补的功能对比机制。

papers.title: Venlafaxine modulates white matter integrity in dorsal and ventral language pathways after subcortical stroke: a longitudinal TBSS study.
papers.authors: Li C, Liu L, Wang L, Zhang W, Liu L, Xie Q, Liu Y.
papers.abstract: Background Subcortical aphasia results from disrupted cortico-subcortical language networks after left-hemispheric infarction. Venlafaxine, an SNRI, may accelerate language recovery, but its effects on white matter plasticity remain unclear. We used diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and tract-based spatial statistics (TBSS) to assess early venlafaxine effects on dorsal and ventral language pathways in subacute stroke. Methods Thirty-two patients with first-ever left subcortical infarction and mild-to-moderate aphasia were randomized to venlafaxine (n=16; 75 mg/day, day 7-week 4) or control (n=16). DTI was acquired at 30±7 and 90±7 days post-stroke. TBSS compared fractional anisotropy (FA) in language-related tracts using permutation testing with TFCE (corrected p<0.05). . Results At Visit 2, venlafaxine recipients had higher FA in right superior longitudinal fasciculus/arcuate fasciculus (SLF/AF), bilateral inferior fronto-occipital fasciculi (IFOF), and left inferior longitudinal fasciculus (ILF), but lower FA in left SLF and uncinate fasciculus (UF). At Visit 3, FA increases extended to SLF/AF and UF, yielding bilateral dorsal and ventral enhancement; only right ILF FA decreased. FA changes positively correlated with aphasia quotient, spontaneous language fluency, and picture-naming improvements. . Conclusion Early venlafaxine induces biphasic white matter remodeling: initial contralesional and bilateral ventral enhancement, followed by bilateral integration, suggesting optimized language network reorganization.

relevance.reason: 纵向DTI/TBSS研究卒中后失语患者语言通路白质完整性与药物诱导的可塑性，并关联语言功能改善。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注亚急性期皮层下卒中后早期使用文拉法辛是否会影响语言相关白质通路的结构可塑性，将首次左侧皮层下梗死并伴轻中度失语的患者随机分为文拉法辛组与对照组，用弥散张量成像和基于纤维束的空间统计比较语言相关纤维束的各向异性。结果显示，用药后白质变化呈双相模式：较早时对侧及双侧腹侧通路各向异性升高，而左侧背侧通路和钩束反而降低；随访至较晚时间点，升高扩展至双侧背侧与腹侧通路，仅右侧下纵束下降。各向异性变化与失语商、自发言语流畅性和图片命名改善呈正相关，作者据此提出早期文拉法辛可能促进语言网络重组，但相关关系不等同于疗效因果。

papers.title: Heterochronicity shapes brain network formation.
papers.authors: Poli F, Oldham S, Mousley A, Bullmore ET, Vértes PE, Astle DE.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Brain network formation unfolds on a nonuniform developmental timetable, with different cortical regions generating connections at different developmental phases. Generative network models (GNMs) aim to uncover the principles underpinning the organization of connectomes by creating synthetic networks according to simple computational rules. These models capture the connectome's topology, operationalized here as the cumulative distributions of network metrics (e.g., modularity, small-worldness, rich-club structure). However, GNMs typically ignore the differential timing of connectivity formation, and by omitting this temporal programme they often misplace topological features in physical space. Here, we add a heterochronous growth term to GNMs and use a model fitness function that weighs topology and topography equally. Topography refers to the spatial embedding of the network-the actual anatomical positions of the axonal tracts. With these advances, we can generate synthetic networks that more faithfully reproduce the spatial layout of diffusion-MRI connectomes from two independent adult cohorts. Compared with classical, temporally agnostic models, heterochronous simulations improve model fit, accurately locate cortical hubs and modules across individuals, and converge on a single caudal-to-rostral gradient of brain maturation. Overall, integrating heterochronicity makes GNMs more faithful to brain development, and allows for better identification of individual differences in network formation.

relevance.reason: 用扩散MRI连接组与生成网络模型研究脑网络形成的时间异质性及拓扑-空间嵌入，属结构连接与脑组织形成机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成网络模型在构建脑连接组时忽略连接形成时间差异的问题，并在模型中引入异时性生长项，同时以拓扑结构和空间位置并重的适应度函数进行模拟。结果显示，与不考虑时间的经典模型相比，异时性模拟能更忠实地再现两个独立成人队列扩散磁共振连接组的空间布局，更准确地定位个体皮层枢纽和模块，并收敛到一条从尾侧到头侧的脑成熟梯度。作者认为，纳入异时性使生成网络模型更贴近脑发育过程，也有助于识别网络形成中的个体差异。

papers.title: Striatal network dysfunction underlying speech impairment in early Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Rogers CP, Mournet S, Gallea C, Biondetti E, Mangone G, Sambin S, Chougar L, Villain N, Gaurav R, Arnulf I, Habert MO, Petrovska-Delacrétaz D, Corvol JC, Benali H, Vidailhet M, Lehéricy S, Jeancolas L.
papers.abstract: The pathophysiology underlying Parkinson's disease (PD) speech impairments and its potential sex differences remain unclear. We investigated sex-specific alterations in speech and striato-cortical networks in 104 patients with early PD (68M/36F), and 44 healthy controls (23M/21F), using quantitative speech markers and multimodal neuroimaging. Speech features related to prosody, phonation, articulation, fluency, and rhythm, were extracted from voice recordings; striatal dopaminergic loss was quantified using DaT-SPECT, and functional connectivity between striatal and cortical language networks was analyzed with resting-state fMRI. Results showed that PD-related speech impairments were more pronounced in males. Functional connectivity was globally reduced in PD, but female patients exhibited higher caudate-cortical connectivity. In males, speech deficits were associated with both dopaminergic loss and connectivity disruption, whereas in females, only connectivity changes were involved. These findings revealed sex-specific pathophysiological mechanisms in early PD speech disorders, emphasizing the need for sex-stratified approaches in research and clinical practice.

relevance.reason: 研究早期帕金森病言语障碍与纹状体-皮层语言网络连接及多巴胺丢失的关系，涉及语言产出机制和脑疾病重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早期帕金森病言语障碍背后的纹状体网络机制及其可能的性别差异，结合语音定量指标、多模态神经影像和纹状体多巴胺能损失测量，比较了早期患者与健康对照。结果显示，患者的言语障碍在男性中更明显，纹状体与皮层语言网络的功能连接在患者中整体下降，但女性患者尾状核与皮层的连接相对更高。进一步看，男性患者的言语缺陷同时与多巴胺能损失和连接异常相关，女性患者则仅与连接改变相关。作者据此提出早期帕金森病言语障碍存在性别特异的病理生理机制，并强调研究与临床实践宜采用按性别分层的方法。

papers.title: Sleep forms flexible context representations in toddlers.
papers.authors: Bastian L, Kurz EM, Gutjahr L, Noack H, Born J.
papers.abstract: Sleep consolidates episodic memory through a hippocampus-dependent process in adults. Whether and how sleep supports memory consolidation during early life, when hippocampal function is immature, remains unclear. Here, we examined effects of sleep on the consolidation of spatial context, a core component of episodic memory, in toddlers aged 2-3 years. Toddlers were familiarized with two spatial contexts, followed by a ~ 90-min nap or equivalent wake period. Afterwards, using a hide-and-seek game we tested their ability to relocate toys within these contexts. Only after post-familiarization sleep, toddlers showed significant context memory and formed stronger associations between toys and specific contexts compared to wakefulness. Contextual memory was positively correlated with spindle density and slow oscillation-spindle phase-amplitude coupling during non-rapid eye movement sleep. Here, we show that, despite hippocampal immaturity, memory effects in the sleeping toddler's brain are accompanied by thalamo-cortical oscillatory dynamics that are also implicated in adult memory consolidation.

relevance.reason: 研究幼儿睡眠对空间情境记忆巩固的影响，并关联睡眠纺锤波等脑振荡活动，属学习记忆的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察睡眠是否以及如何支持幼儿对空间情境的记忆巩固，以2至3岁幼儿为对象，让他们熟悉两个空间情境后经历小睡或等长清醒期，再用捉迷藏游戏测试其在该情境中找回玩具的能力。结果显示，只有在小睡之后，幼儿才表现出显著的情境记忆，并形成更强的玩具与特定情境之间的关联；这种情境记忆还与睡眠中的纺锤波密度及慢振荡—纺锤波相位—振幅耦合呈正相关。作者据此指出，尽管幼儿海马功能尚不成熟，睡眠中的记忆效应仍伴随与成人记忆巩固相关的丘脑—皮层振荡活动，提示早期睡眠可能通过类似的振荡机制支持灵活的情境表征。

papers.title: Abnormal resting-state EEG microstates correlate with objective sleep parameters in insomnia disorder.
papers.authors: Wu Q, Weng L, Lei X.
papers.abstract: Background Insomnia is a common sleep disorder, and Electroencephalogram (EEG) microstates, which mirror transient cerebral cortical functional activity, are linked to sleep disorder pathophysiology. The microstate characteristics in insomnia patients and correlations with objective sleep parameters remain to be further explored. Method This study enrolled 45 insomnia disorder (ID) patients and 48 healthy controls (HC), collecting awake resting-state EEG for microstate analysis; 27 ID and 13 H C participants additionally completed overnight polysomnography (PSG), and exploratory correlation analyses of microstate and PSG data performed for the ID group. Results Compared with HC, ID patients had markedly shorter duration of microstate A and B, higher occurrence and contribution of microstate C, and reduced duration, occurrence and contribution of microstate D (p < 0.05). ID patients also showed significantly lower transition probabilities of A→D, B→D, D→A and D→B (p < 0.01), and higher probabilities of A→C, B→C, C→A and C→B (p < 0.05). Correlation analyses revealed that in the ID, microstate D occurrence was negatively correlated with rapid eye movement sleep proportion (REM Sleep%, r = -0.427, p = 0.026) and positively correlated with non-rapid eye movement sleep stage 1 proportion (S1%, r = 0.385, p = 0.047). Conclusion ID patients present significant abnormalities in EEG microstates, and the occurrence of microstate D is correlated with objective sleep indicators of PSG. These findings suggest that EEG microstate parameters may reflect abnormalities in the sleep architecture of ID and may provide references for analyzing the cortical hyperarousal mechanism of chronic insomnia, constructing objective assessment schemes, and developing targeted neuroregulation interventions.

relevance.reason: 研究失眠患者清醒静息态EEG微状态及其与睡眠结构的相关，反映皮层功能活动与疾病相关脑组织异常。

papers.summary_zh: 本研究比较失眠障碍患者与健康对照的清醒静息态脑电微状态特征，并对部分失眠患者结合整夜多导睡眠图做探索性相关分析。结果发现，失眠患者的微状态A、B持续时间缩短，微状态C的出现率和贡献率升高，微状态D的持续时间、出现率和贡献率降低，且涉及D的转换概率下降、涉及C的转换概率升高。在失眠患者中，微状态D的出现率与快速眼动睡眠比例负相关、与浅睡期比例正相关。作者据此认为，脑电微状态参数或可反映失眠患者的睡眠结构异常，为理解慢性失眠的皮层过度觉醒机制及构建客观评估方案提供线索，但相关结果尚属探索性，不能直接推及临床干预效果。

papers.title: Neurovisceral model of social anxiety disorder: An integrative review.
papers.authors: Eriksson MJ, Schmidt LA.
papers.abstract: Social anxiety involves persistent fear of negative evaluation that causes significant distress or avoidance in social situations and, when lasting at least six months with meaningful impairment across life domains, meets diagnostic criteria for social anxiety disorder (SAD). The origins and maintenance of SAD have been described by disparate models as dysregulation of central and peripheral networks involved in emotion regulation and threat appraisal. However, studies integrating central and peripheral levels of analysis remain scarce and lack integration, leaving our understanding of the neurobiology of SAD fragmented. Here we review these models and extant evidence. This review proposes an integrated neurovisceral model in which SAD reflects context-sensitive dysregulation among cortical regulation, limbic threat signaling, insular interoception, vagal and autonomic regulation, cardiac flexibility, HPA-axis output, and behavior. Genetic liability and behavioral inhibition are conceptualized as probabilistic influences on threat sensitivity and regulatory capacity. While environmental experience, developmental timing, sex-related factors, and stress sensitization shape the calibration of these systems. The model predicts heterogeneity along activation threshold, response magnitude, recovery, and central-peripheral coordination, which may give rise to acute hyperreactive, persistent sensitized/inflexible, and compromised/blunted SAD configurations. The model also generates testable predictions for longitudinal, multimodal research, and supports profile-sensitive approaches to assessment and treatment.

relevance.reason: 综述提出社交焦虑障碍的神经内脏整合模型，涉及皮层调节、边缘系统威胁信号、岛叶内感受等脑机制，属情绪/社会认知与精神疾病脑机理。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合了以往关于社交焦虑障碍中枢与外周网络失调的多种模型，提出一个神经内脏整合模型，将皮层调节、边缘系统威胁信号、岛叶内感受、迷走与自主神经调节、心脏灵活性、HPA轴输出及行为纳入同一框架。作者将遗传易感性和行为抑制视为对威胁敏感性与调节能力的概率性影响，环境经验、发育时机、性别相关因素和应激敏化则塑造这些系统的校准。模型据此预测社交焦虑障碍在激活阈值、反应幅度、恢复和中枢-外周协调上存在异质性，可能形成急性高反应、持续敏化/僵化及受损/钝化等不同配置，并为纵向多模态研究和分型评估与治疗提供可检验的预测。

papers.title: Genomic structural equation modeling of impulsivity and risk-taking traits reveals three latent factors associated with brain structure and development.
papers.authors: Shishikura M, Liu L, Yu E, Zhu R, Vilar-Ribó L, Cupertino RB, Palmer AA, Sanchez-Roige S, Vainik U, Morys F, Gan-Or Z, Misic B, Dagher A.
papers.journal: Biological psychiatry. Cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging
papers.abstract: Background Impulsivity is a multifaceted transdiagnostic trait that emerges in childhood. Research has identified genetic loci and brain systems associated with different facets of impulsivity and risk-taking. However, how these genetic underpinnings overlap across different facets, and how they are associated with brain development during childhood remain unknown. Methods Using genomic structural equation modeling on 17 impulsivity and risk-taking traits, we identified latent factors capturing underlying genetic architecture. We then calculated polygenic scores for these factors using Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study data (N = 4,142) and examined their associations with brain structure, development, and behavior in children aged 9-14 years. Finally, we tested whether socioeconomic status modulated the associations between latent polygenic scores and brain structures. Results We identified three distinct genetic latent factors, which we label lack of self-control, reward drive, and sensation seeking. In children, polygenic scores for the three factors showed associations with partly differentiated brain patterns: lack of self-control associated with reduced prefrontal cortical thickness, reward drive with increased subcortical cellular density, and sensation seeking with increased cortical surface area and white matter integrity. Longitudinally, lack of self-control predicted variation in white matter development. We found little evidence that socioeconomic factors modulated associations between polygenic scores and brain structure. Conclusions Using genome-wide association study data of European genetic ancestry samples, we identified three genetically distinct dimensions of impulsivity and risk-taking. These genetic predispositions showed association with brain structure as early as ages 9-10, with limited evidence that these associations varied across socioeconomic context.

relevance.reason: 研究冲动性与冒险特质的遗传因子与儿童脑结构、白质发育及皮层形态的关联，属认知特质与脑结构/发育机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注冲动性与冒险倾向不同侧面背后的遗传结构是否重叠，以及这些遗传倾向与儿童脑发育的关系。作者用基因组结构方程模型分析多项冲动性和冒险相关特质，识别出缺乏自我控制、奖赏驱动和感觉寻求三个遗传潜在因子，并在儿童样本中计算其多基因评分，考察与脑结构、发育和行为的关联。结果显示，三个因子对应部分分化的脑模式：缺乏自我控制与前额叶皮层厚度降低相关，奖赏驱动与皮层下细胞密度增加相关，感觉寻求与皮层表面积和白质完整性增加相关；纵向看，缺乏自我控制还预测白质发育差异。研究几乎未发现社会经济因素调节这些关联的证据，提示这些遗传倾向在儿童早期即与脑结构相关，且这种关联在不同社会经济背景下较为一致。

papers.title: Excitation-Inhibition Balance and Fronto-Limbic Connectivity Distinguish TMS Treatment Outcomes in Refractory Depression.
papers.authors: Momi D, Wang Z, Oveisi MP, Kadak K, Bastiaens SP, Lissemore JI, Noda Y, Downar J, Rodriguez FV, Strafella R, Daskalakis ZJ, Zrenner C, Zomorrodi R, Rolle CE, Saggar M, Williams N, Keller CJ, Blumberger DM, Voineskos D, Griffiths JD.
papers.abstract: Background Intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) targeting the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) is effective for treatment-resistant depression, but outcomes remain variable. The neurophysiological mechanisms underlying response remain poorly understood, limiting precision neuromodulation. Methods We combined transcranial magnetic stimulation with electroencephalography (TMS-EEG) and connectome-based Jansen-Rit neural mass modeling to investigate the mechanistic basis of treatment efficacy in 90 patients with treatment-resistant depression. Individualized whole-brain models were fitted to pre- and post-iTBS TMS-evoked potentials, yielding subject-specific estimates of synaptic connectivity, excitation-inhibition (E/I) balance, and cortical dynamics. Brain states were defined by singular value decomposition of the model's population activity, and partial least squares analysis with nested cross-validation identified the brain-state pattern distinguishing responders from non-responders. Results We identified two neurophysiological signatures associated with treatment response. First, responders showed greater post-treatment reductions in 3-10 Hz oscillatory power, driven by shifts in E/I balance toward greater inhibitory control through reduced excitatory drive and increased inhibitory-to-pyramidal connectivity. Second, a pre-treatment brain state characterized by opposite-polarity dynamics between subgenual anterior cingulate cortex (sgACC) and left DLPFC distinguished responders from non-responders, consistent with prior fMRI findings on frontolimbic anticorrelation. Neural trajectory analysis further revealed greater dynamical reorganization and increased attractor stability in responders following treatment. Conclusions These findings provide a neurophysiologically-informed framework linking iTBS treatment efficacy to specific changes in cortical E/I balance and frontolimbic circuit dynamics, pointing toward candidate markers that, with subject-specific structural connectivity and independent validation, may inform personalized neuromodulation approaches in treatment-resistant depression.

relevance.reason: 以难治性抑郁患者为对象，用TMS-EEG与神经质量模型揭示iTBS疗效相关的E/I平衡和额边缘环路动态，属脑疾病神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注难治性抑郁症患者接受左侧背外侧前额叶间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）后疗效差异的神经生理机制，结合TMS-EEG与基于连接组的Jansen-Rit神经质量建模，对患者治疗前后的诱发电位进行个体化全脑建模。结果显示，应答者治疗后3-10 Hz振荡功率下降更明显，这与兴奋-抑制平衡向抑制性控制增强偏移有关；治疗前以sgACC与左侧DLPFC反极性动态为特征的大脑状态也能区分应答者与非应答者，与既往额边缘系统反相关的fMRI发现一致。轨迹分析还提示应答者治疗后出现更大的动态重组和吸引子稳定性提升。作者据此提出将iTBS疗效与皮层兴奋-抑制平衡及额边缘环路动态变化联系起来的框架，并指出这些候选标记在结合个体结构连接和独立验证后，或可服务于个体化神经调控，但目前尚属机制层面的发现。

papers.title: Individual susceptibility to disgust modulates neural and systemic immune responses to virtual infections.
papers.authors: Born M, Akselrod M, Trabanelli S, Girondini M, Papadopoulou G, Vanoni G, Cornu A, Bertoni T, Jandus C, Serino A.
papers.abstract: Disgust is a key psychological mechanism for avoiding pathogen exposure and constitutes a central component of the behavioral immune system. While disgust is thought to reduce infection risk through avoidance, it remains unclear how individual differences in disgust sensitivity shape downstream neuroimmune responses to perceived pathogen threats. Here, we show that lower disgust sensitivity is associated with stronger activation of type 1 innate lymphoid cells during exposure to infectious, compared with neutral, avatars in virtual reality. Disgust sensitivity further correlated with circulating signaling factors involved in immune regulation, including hormones related to the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, and eicosanoids. Linear models incorporating disgust sensitivity and threat exposure predicted these signaling factors, which in turn enabled accurate prediction of type 1 innate lymphoid cells responses using a pretrained neural network. Recreating this putative pathway, we were able to predict immune responses solely by disgust scores. Additionally, resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging revealed that exposure to infectious avatars altered hypothalamic connectivity with brain regions involved in visual processing, peripersonal space representation, and social cognition, and these effects were modulated by individual disgust sensitivity. Together, these findings suggest that disgust sensitivity modulates multiple levels of the neuroimmune response to perceived pathogen threats. Across two complementary experiments, our results are consistent with a model linking sensory threat detection, hypothalamic signaling, and systemic immune activation. Rather than uniformly amplifying immune responses, higher disgust sensitivity appears to bias pathogen defense toward neural processing, whereas lower disgust sensitivity is associated with stronger physiological immune activation.

relevance.reason: 研究厌恶敏感性如何调节虚拟感染暴露下的下丘脑静息态功能连接及神经免疫反应，属情绪/威胁加工的脑机制与静息网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨个体厌恶敏感度如何影响面对虚拟病原威胁时的神经与免疫反应，结合虚拟现实暴露、静息态功能磁共振成像和免疫指标测量开展了两项互补实验。结果显示，厌恶敏感度较低者在观看感染性虚拟形象时，1型固有淋巴样细胞活化更强；厌恶敏感度还与HPA轴相关激素和类花生酸等循环信号因子相关，这些因子可进一步预测免疫细胞反应，仅凭厌恶评分即可预测免疫反应。感染性形象还改变了下丘脑与视觉加工、近身空间表征和社会认知相关脑区的连接，且受厌恶敏感度调节。作者据此提出，较高的厌恶敏感度可能使病原防御更多偏向神经加工，而较低者则伴随更强的生理免疫激活，而非免疫反应被普遍放大。

papers.title: Toddler EEG power reflects behavioral social engagement state during naturalistic parent-child interaction.
papers.authors: Manning BL, Roberts MY, Wakschlag LS, Norton ES.
papers.abstract: Social engagement is a critical process for children's language and social development and is altered in neurodevelopmental conditions such as autism. Although previous EEG studies have investigated correlates of children's social development in closely controlled experimental studies, few studies have examined how the brain reflects meaningful behavioral states, such as social engagement, within naturalistic parent-child interaction. This study collected EEG from typically developing toddlers of varying language ability and their parent (n = 49, 24-44 months) during the Social EEG paradigm; dyads completed contexts of dyadic interaction (book reading and puzzle play) and baseline (movie watching) during EEG recording. Videos of the interaction session were coded for social engagement using moment-by-moment behavioral coding and applied to the EEG data. As predicted, child EEG alpha power decreased (p < .001) and theta power increased (p = .01) during social engagement relative to baseline movie engagement. Further, the same pattern was replicated in an independent sample (n = 24, 25-47 months) including children diagnosed with autism, who showed the same pattern of power. These results demonstrate for the first time that EEG power is associated with naturally occurring moments of parent-child social engagement across a range of social/linguistic abilities and ages. This opens avenues for study of more naturalistic and meaningful developmental constructs.

relevance.reason: 在自然亲子互动中记录幼儿EEG，发现社交参与状态与alpha/theta功率变化相关，属自然情境下社会认知的脑活动研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注幼儿在与父母自然互动时，大脑活动能否反映其当下的社会参与状态。研究者对语言能力各异的幼儿及其父母在阅读、拼图等互动情境和看电影的基线情境中同步记录脑电，并用逐刻行为编码标出社会参与时刻。结果显示，相较于基线，幼儿在社会参与时脑电α功率下降、θ功率上升，这一模式在包含自闭症诊断幼儿的独立样本中同样出现。作者据此认为，脑电功率与自然发生的亲子社会参与时刻相关，为在更贴近日常的情境中研究发展性构念提供了可能。

papers.title: Revisiting cortical language and praxis representations in males and females.
papers.authors: Kanert J, Króliczak G.
papers.abstract: Although the past few decades have seen numerous researchers questioning the nature of sex differences in cognition, the answers remain surprisingly unclear. For example, there is evidence against the long-standing hypothesis that women have more bilateral language representation than men. Indeed, the nature and extent of sex differences in language representation remain largely controversial. So are potential sex differences in praxis representation. In this study, functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data obtained from 64 females and 61 males during word generation and tool use pantomime were analyzed. The majority of participants had typically organized functions. Whole-brain activity maps and laterality indices (LIs) from regions of interest (ROIs) were examined, using both voxel count and signal intensity. The fMRI results for the language task indicated significantly different activity only for a small region within the female's left occipital cortex. Additional exploratory statistical analysis revealed some, but weak evidence for significant sex difference in the lateralization of the fusiform gyrus. Meanwhile, the statistical analysis of LIs obtained during the praxis task, as well as the whole-brain activity contrasts suggested no sex differences in praxis representation. Moreover, the results from both tasks did not differ depending on the LI calculation method, despite voxel-count based LIs being consistently larger than those based on signal intensity. In conclusion, this study provides new insights into sex differences in cognitive functions, challenging the long-standing assumptions about their nature and extent.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI比较男女在词语生成和工具使用模仿任务中的皮层语言与运用表征及偏侧化，直接研究人脑语言和认知功能的性别差异。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能磁共振成像考察男女在词语生成和工具使用模仿任务中的皮层语言与运用表征是否存在性别差异，并比较了基于体素计数和信号强度的偏侧化指标。结果显示，多数参与者功能组织典型，语言任务中仅女性左侧枕叶皮层一小区域活动存在显著性别差异，梭状回偏侧化的性别差异证据也很弱；运用任务的全脑活动和偏侧化指标均未显示性别差异，且两种偏侧化计算方法所得结论一致。作者据此认为，结果对关于性别差异性质和程度的长期假设提出了挑战。

papers.title: From Contrasts to Representations: Rethinking fMRI Approaches for Cortico-Cerebellar Networks.
papers.authors: Irving CN, King M, LeBel A.
papers.abstract: The relationship between the cerebellum and cerebrum remains poorly understood in the neuroimaging literature, despite decades of functional magnetic resonance (fMRI) research. In this opinion article, we argue that this gap reflects fundamental methodological constraints rather than merely a lack of scientific interest. We first discuss challenges in acquiring fMRI data and analysis, with an emphasis on the cerebellum. We then critically evaluate the most common analysis approaches including functional connectivity, univariate contrasts, multivariate pattern analysis, and encoding models, examining the contributions and limitations of each to identify and quantify cortico-cerebellar networks. Through the lens of language processing, we briefly review how these approaches have been applied to characterize cortico-cerebellar networks underlying cognitive function. We conclude by proposing that encoding model frameworks, combined with ecologically valid naturalistic paradigms, offer advantages that can help resolve longstanding debates about cortico-cerebellar network function and organization.

relevance.reason: 方法学观点文章，讨论fMRI分析如何刻画小脑-大脑网络，并以语言加工为例，涉及脑网络组织与自然范式。

papers.summary_zh: 这篇观点文章讨论为何数十年fMRI研究后小脑与大脑的关系仍不清楚，认为主要障碍来自方法学限制而非研究兴趣不足。作者评述功能连接、单变量对比、多变量模式分析和编码模型等常见分析途径在识别与量化皮层—小脑网络时的贡献和局限，并以语言加工为例说明这些方法的应用情况。作者提出，编码模型框架结合生态效度较高的自然范式更有助于厘清该网络的功能与组织，从而推进相关长期争论。

papers.title: Reduced structural connectivity in age-related hearing loss aligns with the sensory deprivation theory.
papers.authors: Boons JHC, De Luca A, Dingemanse G, Vinke EJ, Kremer B, Vernooij MW, Goedegebure A.
papers.abstract: Age-related hearing loss (ARHL) may contribute to cognitive decline through structural degeneration and brain reorganization, as posited by the sensory deprivation theory. These processes can be characterized by topological changes, such as strengthening and weakening of structural connections between brain regions. Stronger connections are more relevant to reorganization, as reorganization is thought to support speech processing by recruiting additional brain networks as a compensatory mechanism. We investigated connectivity changes associated with ARHL to improve the understanding of the sensory deprivation theory. Similar to the lateralization of speech processing, we hypothesized that structural reorganization associated with ARHL would be most evident in the left hemisphere. We assessed whole-brain structural connectivity using 1.5 Tesla diffusion-weighted MRI and structural T1 images in 2402 participants (median age = 66.1 years, females = 54.7%) from the population-based Rotterdam Study. Pure-tone audiometry was performed, and pure-tone averages (PTAs), for different frequency ranges including PTAlow (250-1000 Hz) and PTAall (250-8000 Hz), were determined for the better-hearing ear to reflect ARHL. ARHL was primarily associated with weaker connections involving frontal and subcortical gray matter regions. Contrary to our hypothesis, no lateralization in the connectivity alterations was observed. PTAlow and PTAall yielded the strongest associations, likely driven by low-frequency hearing thresholds. Adjusting for cardiovascular risk factors attenuated associations, especially for PTAlow . In conclusion, the findings contradict the hypothesized compensatory structural reorganization expected from the neural effects of sensory deprivation. While the observed weaker connectivity aligns with the sensory deprivation theory, the results also suggest cardiovascular health as a common risk factor.

relevance.reason: 用扩散MRI研究年龄相关听力损失的全脑结构连接改变，涉及感觉剥夺与脑重组机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于鹿特丹研究人群的弥散加权与结构MRI及纯音测听数据，考察年龄相关听力损失与全脑结构连接的关系，以检验感觉剥夺理论。结果显示，听力损失主要与涉及额叶和皮层下灰质区域的较弱连接相关，且未出现假设中的左半球偏侧化；低频听力阈值相关的关联最强，校正心血管风险因素后关联减弱。作者认为，较弱的连接符合感觉剥夺理论，但未支持补偿性结构重组，并提示心血管健康可能是共同风险因素。

papers.title: Scalp Topography of Event-Related Potentials Reveals Differences in Audiovisual Speech Processing in Autistic and Non-Autistic Children.
papers.authors: Dunham-Carr K, Feldman JI, Simon DM, Wallace MT, Murray MM, Woynaroski TG.
papers.journal: Journal of autism and developmental disorders
papers.abstract: Purpose In our prior work, conventional event-related potential (ERP) responses to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech were found to explain variance in language abilities in autistic and non-autistic children but failed to differentiate autistic children from non-autistic children. This study extends previous ERP analyses of responses to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech in autistic and non-autistic school-aged children to investigate group and condition differences in the strength and topography of the ERP based on data-driven, reference-independent metrics that overcome limitations of conventional ERP analyses. Methods Extant ERP data from 50 5-12-year-old children (25 per group, matched at the group level on age and sex assigned at birth) recorded during a passive task of listening and watching videos of auditory-only and audiovisual speech syllables were analyzed for differences in ERP strength and topography, quantified via global field power (GFP) and global map dissimilarity (GMD), respectively. Results GFP was significantly reduced for audiovisual compared to auditory-only speech at 245-275 ms post-stimulus. Groups differed in GMD of the ERPs reflecting the difference in response to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech at 139-170 ms post-stimulus, wherein microstates suggested predominantly differential occipital electrode responses. Conclusions The benefits of audiovisual integration manifest as a facilitation effect (reduced signal strength of the ERP response to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech) across autistic and non-autistic children. Autistic children also display different patterns of activation underlying ERPs in response to audiovisual versus auditory-only speech relative to non-autistic children. Topographic ERP analyses show promise for advancing our understanding of audiovisual speech processing in autism.

relevance.reason: 用EEG ERP地形图比较孤独症与非孤独症儿童视听言语加工差异，直接涉及言语感知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析自闭症与非自闭症学龄儿童在视听与纯听觉言语刺激下的脑电事件相关电位，采用不依赖参考电极的数据驱动指标刻画其强度与头皮分布。结果发现，两组儿童在视听条件下均出现约245至275毫秒的电位强度降低，提示视听整合带来易化效应；但两组在反映视听与纯听觉差异的电位地形上于约139至170毫秒出现差异，微状态分析提示差异主要涉及枕区电极反应。作者认为，地形学分析有助于揭示自闭症儿童视听言语加工的不同激活模式，但其临床意义尚待进一步研究。

papers.title: Fixed-Sequence OFF-to-ON Differences in Low-Beta State Dynamics in Parkinson's Disease: A Paired Source-Space Resting-State EEG Study.
papers.authors: Wang H, Cheng Y, Wu G, Du X, Fan H, Yan J, Du G.
papers.abstract: Resting-state EEG studies in Parkinson's disease (PD) have largely emphasized static power or connectivity, whereas fixed-sequence OFF-to-ON session differences may also involve the temporal organization of network states. Paired source-space evidence under such fixed acquisition protocols remains limited. We analyzed 64-channel eyes-closed resting-state EEG in 39 patients with PD contributing paired OFF/ON recordings for the prespecified 90 s primary analysis; 24 also contributed paired 178 s recordings for duration robustness. After individual MRI-based source reconstruction, low-beta (13-20 Hz) dynamic amplitude-envelope connectivity was computed with 2 s windows. Primary endpoints were switching rate (SR) and normalized Shannon entropy (H); fractional occupancy (FO_path) and mean dwell time (MDT_path) of an internally defined OFF-dominant state were prespecified secondary conditional endpoints and are interpreted only as conditional summaries. PD-only linear mixed-effects models quantified the fixed-sequence OFF-to-ON session contrast; medication state and session order were necessarily collinear. In the 90 s analysis, the later ON session showed higher SR (β = 3.3224, Holm p = 0.00406) and H (β = 0.06781, Holm p = 0.000749) than the earlier OFF session. FO_path (β = -0.09167, Holm p = 1.08 × 10⁻⁵) and MDT_path (β = -1.05171, Holm p = 0.00524) were lower in the later ON session. The 178 s reanalysis preserved the same directions, although SR and especially MDT_path were more parameter-sensitive across sensitivity analyses. The fixed OFF-then-ON protocol was associated with reproducible within-subject differences in low-beta state dynamics, with the strongest evidence arising from SR and H. Because medication state was perfectly collinear with session order, these findings cannot distinguish medication-specific effects from order-, time-, vigilance-, fatigue-, or adaptation-related influences. FO_path and MDT_path remain conditional summaries tied to an internally defined OFF-dominant state, and MDT was less stable in the 178 s and OFF-only sensitivity analyses.

relevance.reason: 研究帕金森病患者静息态EEG低beta网络状态的时间动态组织，属静息态脑网络动态研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病患者在固定先OFF后ON的采集顺序下，静息态脑电低beta频段网络状态的时间组织是否出现可重复的个体内差异。作者对患者进行基于个体MRI的源空间重建，计算低beta动态振幅包络连接，并以状态切换率和归一化香农熵为主要指标。结果发现，较晚的ON session切换率和熵均高于较早的OFF session，预设的OFF优势状态占据比例和平均停留时间则较低，延长记录的重分析方向一致。由于用药状态与session顺序完全共线，这些差异无法区分药物特异性效应与顺序、时间、警觉、疲劳或适应等因素的影响，相关状态指标也只是内部定义下的条件性总结。

papers.title: Hemispheric Complementarity is Associated with Distinct Functional and Structural Brain Profiles
papers.authors: Labache L, Beyh A, Cooper R, Parkes L, Holmes AJ.
papers.abstract: Hemispheric specialization is thought to follow a principle of complementarity, with homotopic functions such as language and attention lateralizing to opposite hemispheres, yet its consistency across individuals and relevance for cognition remain unclear. Using multimodal neuroimaging and twin-family data from 987 Human Connectome Project participants, we identified three sustained attentional lateralization phenotypes (right, left, bilateral) that were independent of handedness, differed by sex, and tracked broad shifts in brain organization, with bilateral individuals showing stronger intrahemispheric and homotopic connectivity. Examining attention and language revealed three multidomain profiles (crowded, mixed, split) reflecting whether functions colocalize within or are distributed across hemispheres. Mixed organization was linked to higher planum polare myelination, whereas crowded organization showed higher fiber density connectivity across dorsal attention–default network. Both phenotypes were heritable, yet neither predicted cognitive performance. These findings reveal a brain organization in which specialization emerges from flexible, heritable patterns linking function, structural connectivity, and myeloarchitecture.

relevance.reason: 研究半球互补性与注意/语言偏侧化及白质髓鞘、结构连接的关系，属认知偏侧化和结构-功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大脑半球互补性组织在个体间是否一致，以及它与认知的关系，利用多模态神经影像和双生子家系数据，考察注意与语言功能的偏侧化模式。作者识别出右偏、左偏和双侧三类持续性注意偏侧化表型，它们与利手无关、存在性别差异，并伴随脑组织方式的整体变化；在注意与语言的多域组合上，又区分出功能同侧聚集、混合分布和分侧分布等模式，这些模式分别与不同的髓鞘化和纤维连接特征相关。两类组织表型均具遗传性，但都未预测认知表现，提示半球特化可能来自连接功能、结构连接与髓鞘构筑的可遗传而灵活的组织方式，而非直接决定认知能力。

papers.title: rpSTS Stimulation Disrupts Shared Neural Responses to Social Content during Naturalistic Viewing
papers.authors: Thompson JC, Marsh C, Kakalec P, Rawlings K, Roy R.
papers.abstract: Shared understanding of common experiences can foster feelings of social closeness and friendship, and help us understand those experiences. Recent work has suggested that patterns of neural activity shared across individuals, especially throughout the default mode network, may underlie shared representations. Here we used repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) and functional magnetic resonance imaging during movie watching to show that shared neural patterns to common experiences rely on the encoding of social information from the environment by the right posterior superior temporal sulcus (rpSTS). An encoding model of movie features showed that rTMS selectively degraded social feature encoding in rpSTS, leaving low-level visual encoding in early visual cortex intact. Using natural language processing (NLP)-based analysis, we found that rpSTS stimulation was associated with reduced memory and intersubject pattern similarity across DMN and limbic networks during scenes central to the movie narrative. Projecting scene embeddings onto NLP-based concept axes revealed reductions in memory and neural pattern similarity for scenes conveying helplessness and empathy following rTMS. These findings provide causal evidence that the rpSTS is a key region that encodes shared social information into common neural representations, and suggest that disrupting its input leads DMN representations to become idiosyncratic.

relevance.reason: 用rTMS与fMRI在电影观看中因果检验rpSTS对社会信息编码及跨被试神经相似性的作用，属自然刺激下社会认知脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨共同经历下的共享神经表征是否依赖右侧后颞上沟（rpSTS）对社会信息的编码，采用重复经颅磁刺激结合功能磁共振成像，让被试在观看电影时接受刺激。结果显示，刺激选择性地削弱了rpSTS对社会特征的编码，而早期视觉皮层的低层视觉编码未受影响；在电影叙事核心场景中，刺激还与记忆表现及默认网络和边缘网络个体间神经模式相似性的下降相关，且这种下降集中在传达无助与共情等内容的场景上。作者据此提出因果性证据，认为rpSTS是将共享社会信息编码为共同神经表征的关键区域，干扰其输入会使默认网络表征趋于个体化。

papers.title: Attention warps visual-semantic representations across the human cerebellum
papers.authors: LeBel A, Visconti di Oleggio Castello M, Gallant JL, Ivry RB.
papers.abstract: Humans effortlessly shift their attention between objects and events in the environment. These attentional shifts modulate the representation of information in many regions of the cerebral cortex, including those that represent visual-semantic information. Based on recent evidence that the cerebellum also represents semantic information, we hypothesized that attention would also shift semantic representations in the cerebellum. To test this hypothesis, we used fMRI to measure brain activity while participants watched naturalistic movie clips and were instructed to attend to either people or vehicles. We used a voxelwise encoding model framework to recover visual-semantic representations in the cerebral cortex and cerebellum under the two conditions, and quantified the direction and magnitude of visual-semantic tuning shifts between conditions. Attention to different semantic categories had a large effect on visual-semantic tuning in the cerebellum. Representations in some regions shifted toward the attended category, and representations in other regions shifted away from the attended category. Within cerebellar regions that best represent visual-semantic information, the tuning shifts were most pronounced in Crus I and II and in lobule VI. Further, the magnitude of attentional tuning shifts was greater in the cerebellum than in the cerebral cortex, particularly for tuning shifts towards the attended category. These differences suggest that attentional modulation in the cerebellum is different than in the cerebral cortex and may not solely be driven by cerebral inputs.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究考察注意如何调制小脑视觉-语义表征，涉及注意的神经机制及小脑表征组织，并使用自然电影刺激。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注注意如何改变小脑中的视觉-语义表征。研究者让被试观看自然电影片段并分别注意人或车辆，用fMRI结合体素级编码模型比较两种条件下皮层和小脑的视觉-语义调谐变化。结果显示，注意不同语义类别会大幅改变小脑的视觉-语义调谐，部分区域的表征向被注意类别偏移，另一些区域则偏离该类别，其中Crus I、Crus II和小脑叶VI的变化最明显。小脑的注意调谐变化幅度大于大脑皮层，尤其向被注意类别的偏移更突出，提示小脑的注意调制可能不完全依赖皮层输入。

papers.title: Latent Brain-Symptom Dimensions Characterize Heterogeneity in Clinical High Risk for Psychosis
papers.authors: Feng J, Genon S, Eickhoff SB, Li F, Jiang L, Wang Y, Dong D.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Clinical high risk (CHR) for psychosis is characterized by substantial heterogeneity in symptoms, functioning, and outcomes. Although distributed resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC) abnormalities have been reported, it remains unclear whether this heterogeneity can be organized into consistent multivariate brain-symptom dimensions and clinically meaningful subgroups. METHODS: We analyzed RSFC and 34 clinical variables from 701 CHR participants in the Accelerating Medicines Partnership Schizophrenia Program (AMP SCZ). Partial least squares analysis identified latent brain-symptom dimensions, which were further examined using transcriptomic annotation, independent psychosocial and cognitive measures, hierarchical clustering, and Month 2 follow-up data. RESULTS: Two significant brain-symptom dimensions emerged. The first reflected general psychopathology and was associated with somatomotor-salience and higher-order connectivity, with enrichment for genes related to neuronal development. The second, capturing symptom differentiation, spanned negative/internalizing features with psychobehavioral overactivation and involved cerebellar-thalamic-somatomotor circuitry, with enrichment for genes related to synaptic signaling. These dimensions showed dissociable associations with broader psychosocial and cognitive measures, and their loading patterns were substantially reproducible at Month 2. Clustering based on these dimensions identified two biotypes with distinct clinical and connectivity profiles that remained broadly similar at Month 2 despite divergent short-term RSFC changes. CONCLUSIONS: These findings support complementary dimensional and categorical representations of CHR heterogeneity that link clinical variation with distributed brain connectivity and molecular signatures, while demonstrating short-term reproducibility of the identified dimensions and divergent RSFC changes across biotypes. This multilevel framework may help characterize biologically meaningful variation in psychosis risk.
