relevance.reason: 研究精神病临床高危人群的静息态功能连接与症状维度，属脑疾病机理与静息网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神病临床高危人群在症状与功能上的异质性，能否用一致的多变量脑-症状维度来组织，并据此划分有临床意义的亚组。作者分析了该人群的静息态功能连接与多项临床变量，用偏最小二乘分析提取出两个显著的脑-症状维度：一个反映一般精神病理，涉及感觉运动-突显及高级连接，并富集神经发育相关基因；另一个刻画症状分化，涵盖阴性/内化特征与心理行为过度激活，涉及小脑-丘脑-感觉运动环路，富集突触信号相关基因。两个维度与心理社会和认知测量的关联可分离，其载荷模式在短期随访中基本可重现；基于维度聚类得到两种生物型，临床与连接特征不同，短期功能连接变化方向亦不同。作者认为这支持对高危异质性同时作维度和分类刻画，但结论限于关联与短期可重复性，未涉及治疗或临床预测效用。

papers.title: A representation of the visual environment in the human basolateral amygdala supports learning and choice
papers.authors: Jang G, Riels K, Aberman E, Tao G, Kragel PA.
papers.abstract: Animals continuously transform sensory inputs into representations that guide behavior. Although the amygdala is a brain structure critical for learning and choice, how natural sensory experience is represented within this circuit remains unknown. Here, we identify a representation of the visual environment in the human basolateral amygdala (BLA) that contains information relevant for learning and choice. Using image-computable encoding models trained on responses to naturalistic videos, we recover a continuous, low-dimensional representation of visual experience in the BLA. The representation generalizes across individuals and independent datasets and prospectively predicts BLA responses to novel visual stimuli generated through closed-loop image synthesis. Signals derived from the representation also informed reinforcement-learning models of human choice. Together, these findings show that the human BLA organizes complex visual experience into a structured representation that can support learning and flexible behavioral responses.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑基底外侧杏仁核对自然视觉环境的表征及其支持学习与选择，属认知神经机制与自然刺激加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类基底外侧杏仁核如何表征自然视觉经验，并考察这种表征是否与学习和选择有关。作者用基于自然视频反应训练的、可由图像计算的编码模型，在人类基底外侧杏仁核中恢复出一个连续的低维视觉环境表征。该表征能跨个体和独立数据集泛化，并可前瞻性预测对新合成视觉刺激的杏仁核反应；由该表征导出的信号还能为人类选择的强化学习模型提供信息。结果表明，人类基底外侧杏仁核将复杂视觉经验组织成结构化表征，可能支持学习与灵活的行为反应。

papers.title: Modulation of the speed of Intrinsic Alpha Frequency (IAF) with tACS modulates variability of illusory speech perception
papers.authors: Deb S, Bhunia D, Singh VAV, Muralidharan V, Roy D.
papers.abstract: Navigating the world requires our brains to constantly process a massive influx of information from the environment. One of the most remarkable yet complex feats the human brain performs daily is speech perception. It is a multifaceted, hierarchical process that relies heavily on the integration of auditory and visual cues, particularly in noisy environments. Neural integration of these streams is hypothesized to depend on temporal mechanisms governed by individual alpha frequency (IAF, 8-12 Hz), which serves as a key neural correlate of the temporal binding window (TBW). While IAF has been linked to multisensory integration, its role in shaping multisensory illusions remains largely unexplored. Here, we tested this directly using transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) to modulate occipital activity during multisensory conflict. In a two-day protocol involving 27 healthy participants, resting-state EEG was recorded to determine IAF. On Day 2, participants then performed a multisensory speech task involving congruent (pa/, /ta/, /ka/) and incongruent McGurk stimuli (auditory /pa/, visual /ka/), both at baseline and during tACS applied at IAF and offset frequencies (IAF ± 2 Hz) over occipital electrodes. While accuracy for congruent syllables remained high across conditions, results revealed that tACS significantly reduced the perception of illusory /ta/ percepts during McGurk trials. Finally, using a phenomenological model based on Kuramoto oscillators, we provided a mechanistic explanation for the percentage of illusory responses observed across participants under the influence of tACS at IAF and offsets. This study highlights the potential for targeted neuromodulatory interventions to influence multisensory processing in clinical or professional settings.

relevance.reason: 用tACS调控枕区alpha频率并记录静息EEG，考察其对McGurk多感觉言语幻觉感知的影响，直接涉及言语感知的神经振荡机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨个体α频率（IAF）是否以及如何影响多感官言语错觉，采用枕区tACS调控健康参与者的脑活动，并结合静息态脑电与McGurk言语任务进行检验。结果显示，一致音节的识别在各条件下保持较高水平，而tACS显著降低了对McGurk冲突刺激的虚幻/ta/知觉；作者还用基于Kuramoto振子的现象学模型解释了不同刺激频率下虚幻反应比例的变化。研究提示，针对IAF的神经调控可能影响多感官整合，并为临床或专业场景中的干预提供了初步线索，但实际应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: FMR1 Perturbations Disrupt Sensory Corticostriatal Circuits and Mitochondrial Energetics in Fragile X Syndrome
papers.authors: Yan Y, Li D, Yuan J, Feng D, Chang J, Zhang F, Xiong M, Jiang Y, Yan B, Xu Q, Li R, He Y, Liu P, Shao M, Shen M.
papers.abstract: Fragile X syndrome (FXS) features sensory, social, and cognitive dysfunction, but how fragile X messenger ribonucleoprotein 1 (FMR1) deficiency disrupts sensory corticostriatal circuitry and whether distinct FMR1 perturbations converge on shared cellular mechanisms remain incompletely defined. We integrated diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in individuals with FXS and Fmr1-knockout (KO) mice with projection-defined calcium recording, bidirectional optogenetic manipulation, primary somatosensory cortex (S1)-targeted expression of three patient-associated FMR1 missense variants, regional transcriptomics, and optical manipulation of mitochondrial energetic state. Individuals with FXS exhibited disrupted sensory corticostriatal structural connectivity, with mouse analyses further localizing abnormalities to S1–striatal pathways. Fmr1 deficiency impaired recruitment of the S1–dorsomedial striatum (DMS) pathway during social interaction, and projection-specific manipulation demonstrated that S1–DMS dysfunction contributes to social and cognitive deficits. Three patient-associated FMR1 variants, I234T, E329G, and R586Q, converged on social behavioral deficits, which were improved by S1–DMS activation. Transcriptomic analyses revealed convergent oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS)-related mitochondrial remodeling in S1 and DMS across Fmr1 deficiency and variant models. Systemic treatment with the mitochondria-targeted antioxidant MitoQ attenuated novel-location-recognition, social-interaction, and social-novelty deficits in Fmr1 -KO mice. Moreover, mt-EcGAPR-based Mitochondrial OptoEnergetic Activation (Mito-OptoEA) enhanced mitochondrial energetic state in S1 and improved novel-location recognition and sociability in both Fmr1 -KO and I234T models. Together, these findings define a sensory corticostriatal circuit–metabolic framework for FXS in which S1–DMS circuit dysfunction and convergent mitochondrial energetic abnormalities contribute to FMR1 -related social and cognitive phenotypes.

relevance.reason: 以脆性X综合征患者扩散MRI结合小鼠模型，研究感觉皮层-纹状体结构连接与认知/社交障碍机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注FMR1缺陷如何破坏感觉皮层-纹状体环路，以及不同FMR1扰动是否汇聚到共同的细胞机制。作者结合FXS患者扩散磁共振成像、Fmr1敲除小鼠的投射特异性钙记录与光遗传操作、患者相关错义变体在S1的表达、转录组学及线粒体能量状态操控，发现患者存在感觉皮层-纹状体结构连接异常，小鼠分析进一步定位到S1-背内侧纹状体通路。该通路在社交互动中招募受损，其功能障碍参与社交和认知缺陷；三种患者变体均导致社交行为缺陷，激活该通路可改善。转录组分析显示S1和DMS存在汇聚的氧化磷酸化相关线粒体重塑，线粒体靶向抗氧化剂和光遗传增强线粒体能量状态均能改善小鼠的行为缺陷。这些结果提示S1-DMS环路功能障碍与线粒体能量异常共同贡献于FXS相关表型。

papers.title: Mapping reward processing circuits: the orbitofrontal-nucleus accumbens white matter pathways and their associations to psychopathological traits
papers.authors: Mezzano S, Saini F, Orbecchi V, Fernández-Borkel T, Raghavan M, Irfanoglu M, Beyh A, Dell’Acqua F.
papers.abstract: Dysfunctions in reward circuits, including projections from the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) to the nucleus accumbens (NAcc), have been implicated in psychopathology. The OFC is functionally divided into the medial OFC (mOFC), which processes rewards, and the lateral OFC (lOFC), which responds to non-reward or punishment stimuli. We investigated the structural connectivity of the lOFC-NAcc and mOFC-NAcc pathways and their associations with psychopathological traits using tractography-defined ROI analysis. Diffusion-weighted imaging data from 165 participants (aged 22 - 35, 53% male) in the Human Connectome Project (HCP) were analysed using spherical deconvolution tractography. MegaTrack, a novel tool, enabled tract segmentation via a single manual dissection mapped back to native space. Virtual dissection identified four bilateral pathways connecting the lOFC and mOFC to the NAcc, from which fractional anisotropy (FA) was extracted, and an lOFC/mOFC ratio was computed. Psychopathological traits were measured using HCP Achenbach Adult Self-Report scores. The lOFC-NAcc pathway showed positive associations with psychopathology and the mOFC-NAcc pathway negative associations. The lOFC/mOFC ratio emerged as a stronger predictor than individual pathways, with significant associations for depression, somatic problems, anti-social personality traits, and inattention. Effects were lateralized to the left hemisphere. These findings show that the lOFC-NAcc and mOFC-NAcc pathways can be structurally separated with tractography and display opposing correlations with psychopathological traits in a healthy population. Their ratio may index reward-processing dysfunction, and future research should test whether it is sensitive to dysfunction in clinical populations.

relevance.reason: 用弥散成像追踪眶额-伏隔核白质通路并关联奖赏加工相关心理病理特质，属白质结构与奖赏认知的关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注眶额皮层至伏隔核的奖赏通路结构连接是否与精神病理特质相关，利用弥散加权成像和纤维束追踪，在健康成人中分别重建了外侧与内侧眶额-伏隔核通路，并计算两者各向异性比值。结果显示，外侧通路与精神病理特质呈正相关，内侧通路呈负相关，且两者比值比单条通路更能预测抑郁、躯体问题、反社会人格特质和注意力不足，效应偏向左半球。作者据此提出，该比值或可反映奖赏加工功能异常，但其对临床人群的敏感性尚待检验。

papers.title: Spoken language comprehension relies on context-dependent neural weighting of syntax and prosody
papers.authors: Coopmans CW, Martin AE.
papers.abstract: Comprehending spoken language requires extracting syntactic structure and meaning from a continuous acoustic signal. Psycholinguistic evidence points to a key role for prosody in this process. However, because interactions between prosody and syntax are typically demonstrated using carefully controlled sentence constructions, it remains unclear whether such interactions constitute a general, default property of spoken language processing. Addressing this question requires naturalistic, broad-coverage data. Here, we combined experimental psycholinguistics with naturalistic neuroscience to investigate the joint neural encoding of syntax and prosody in MEG recordings of 26 participants (19 female) listening to narrative speech. Linguistic annotations revealed that strong prosodic boundaries tend to coincide with syntactic phrase closures, and that the strength of prosodic boundaries scales with the number of phrases closed. Using time-resolved regression with temporal response functions, we modeled how these features relate to delta-band neural activity during continuous speech processing. Our results reveal a bidirectional interaction between syntax and prosody. Prosodic marking modulates the neural processing of syntax, with phrase closures being encoded more strongly when accompanied by strong prosodic boundaries. Conversely, syntactic structure shapes prosodic encoding, such that boundary strength is neurally encoded primarily at points of syntactic phrase closure. These findings demonstrate that syntax and prosody are encoded not independently, but in a context-dependent and mutually constraining manner, highlighting their joint role in guiding structure building during naturalistic spoken language comprehension. Significance statement How the brain transforms continuous sensory stimulation into structured representations is a central question in cognitive neuroscience. Spoken language comprehension provides a particularly compelling case: as the acoustic signal alone underdetermines linguistic meaning, the brain must integrate bottom-up sensory information with top-down linguistic knowledge, such as syntax. Here, we recorded brain activity during audiobook listening to examine how syntax and prosody jointly shape neural responses to narrative speech. We find evidence for a bidirectional neural interaction: prosody modulates the neural encoding of syntax, and syntactic context shapes the neural encoding of prosody. These findings suggest that the brain flexibly integrates bottom-up and top-down information depending on how informative each cue is for extracting structured meaning from naturalistic speech.

relevance.reason: 用MEG记录自然叙事语音聆听，考察句法与韵律的联合神经编码及交互，属语言神经机制与自然刺激脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然叙事语音理解中句法与韵律是否以及如何共同影响神经活动，结合心理语言学实验与脑磁图记录，让被试聆听有声书并借助时间分辨回归建模连续语音下的神经响应。结果显示二者存在双向交互：强韵律边界会增强句法短语闭合的神经编码，而韵律边界强度也主要在句法短语闭合处被神经编码，说明句法与韵律并非独立加工，而是以依赖语境、相互约束的方式共同参与结构构建。这一发现提示，在自然语音理解中，大脑会依据各线索的信息量灵活整合自下而上与自上而下的信息。

papers.title: Whole-brain receptor markers and hub excitabilities determine acute and long-term outcomes in stroke
papers.authors: Schulte J, Vohryzek J, Monge i Asensio M, Zamora-López G, Patow G, Sanz Perl Y, Corbetta M, Deco G.
papers.abstract: Following a stroke, changes in receptor systems have been observed that may influence the excitability of affected brain regions and drive recovery trajectories. Translating results from animal studies to patients remains a major challenge, and while imaging modalities have provided a wealth of findings, a mechanistic link between local receptor systems and observed imaging data is still missing. To bridge this gap, we built patient-specific digital twins with their own neuromodulatory profiles: we integrated 19 receptor and transporter density maps into a mechanistic whole-brain model, and estimated their influence on cortical excitability for each stroke patient and how these systems subsequently explain recovery trajectories. We found that distinct receptor profiles modulated excitability in perilesional versus non-perilesional tissue. Favourable acute motor outcomes were most strongly explained by increased inhibition mediated by non-perilesional GABA-A receptors, together with enhanced excitability driven by cannabinoid, histaminergic, and noradrenergic systems. For acute language outcomes, we identified receptor signatures that, together with motor findings, formed two cross-domain clusters linking excitability to either better or poorer performance. Remarkably, structurally highly connected hubs played a key role: their acute excitability explained cognitive and language deficits and predicted language recovery at one year. Together, our results establish a mechanistic link between receptor-specific modulation of cortical excitability and behavioural recovery, highlighting potential targets for pharmacological and non-invasive therapeutic interventions.

relevance.reason: 以卒中患者个体化全脑模型整合受体密度图，将皮层兴奋性与语言/认知缺损及恢复联系起来，属脑损伤后认知与语言机制及结构-功能研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注卒中后局部受体系统如何通过调节皮层兴奋性影响急性表现与长期恢复，并针对动物结果难以转化到患者的问题，构建了整合多种受体与转运体密度图谱的患者个体化全脑数字孪生模型。结果显示，不同受体谱对病灶周围与非病灶周围组织兴奋性的调节方式不同：急性运动结局较好主要与非病灶区GABA-A受体介导的抑制增强，以及大麻素、组胺能和去甲肾上腺素能系统驱动的兴奋性提升相关；语言结局则呈现与运动结果相连的跨域受体特征。结构高度连接的枢纽区，其急性兴奋性可解释认知与语言缺损，并预测一年后的语言恢复。作者据此提出受体特异性兴奋性调节与行为恢复之间的机制联系，并指出潜在的药物与非侵入性干预靶点，但相关结论仍属模型推断，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Global statistical constraint and local partner-sensitive inference support dynamic, open-ended verbal coordination
papers.authors: Zhang T, Shaw DJ, Zhou S, Zhu L, Lu C.
papers.abstract: Effective verbal communication requires individuals to align their communicative intentions through the precise use of utterances, yet how this is achieved in dynamic, open-ended communication remains unclear. Combining predictive deep language models (DLMs) with cognitive computational modeling, we tested a computational division of labor between context-sensitive global constraint on the utterance space and partner-sensitive local adjustment of selection priorities. We formalized local adjustment using an active-inference-inspired updating rule within a statistical– pragmatic hybrid model. Thirty dyads performed a dynamic, open-ended collaborative word-generation task during functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning. Interlocutors converged in their lexical choices, and lexical alignment was best explained by a hybrid model integrating contextual selection priors with interaction-specific local adjustment among the models tested. This hybrid process formed a dynamic hypothesis landscape comprising a global semantic search region and local selection priorities. Critically, interaction did not simply reduce uncertainty: within individuals, the hypothesis space of global semantic search progressively narrowed while local uncertainty among plausible alternatives increased; between partners, both global hypothesis space and local selection became increasingly aligned, with alignment of local selection priorities most strongly predicting subsequent lexical alignment. The contribution of local adjustment was stronger during precise verbal communication than in the control tasks. Neural analyses further identified correlates of the local adjustment process: temporoparietal and anterior temporal regions supported partner-related inference and semantic prediction error, respectively, and their activity during thinking predicted subsequent inferior frontal activity associated with self-updating during speaking. The participant’s own hypothesis landscape was also represented in the left inferior parietal–supramarginal cortex. The main findings generalized across language models and an independent Czech dataset. Together, these findings reveal that alignment in open-ended communication emerges from complementary statistical and pragmatic computations, providing a framework for understanding human and human–AI communication.

relevance.reason: fNIRS超扫描研究考察开放式言语交流中词汇对齐的神经机制，涉及语义预测、伙伴推断及语言相关脑区活动。

papers.title: Mechanical Digitorum Sensory Stimulation Enhances Hemiplegic Upper Limb Motor Function in Stroke Patients by Increasing Cortical Excitability and Functional Connectivity
papers.authors: Huang W, Zhang H, Yu J, Ma Y, Li Q, Wu R, Yao Y, Zhang S, Hong Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Relieving flexor spasticity, enhancing extensor strength, and improving hand function in patients with stroke remain significant clinical challenges. Mechanical Digitorum Sensory Stimulation (MDSS), a novel therapy that applies precise mechanical pressure to the affected fingers, may address these issues; however, its effects and mechanisms have not been thoroughly studied. Methods Sixty convalescent patients with post-stroke hemiplegia were randomly assigned to a Control group (conventional rehabilitation + sham MDSS) or an MDSS group (conventional rehabilitation + MDSS) for 3–4 weeks. Muscle spasticity, strength, upper-limb motor function, and activities of daily living were assessed using the Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS), Manual Muscle Testing (MMT), Fugl-Meyer Assessment–Upper Extremity (FMA-UE), and Modified Barthel Index (MBI), respectively. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) was used to measure oxyhemoglobin (HbO) concentrations in regions of interest (ROIs) during the resting state (RS) and task state (TS; i.e., MDSS) to evaluate cortical excitability and functional connectivity (FC) by calculating correlations of HbO concentration changes between specific ROIs. Results After the intervention, the MDSS group showed significantly lower MAS scores for all finger flexors ( P < 0.001) and significantly higher MMT scores for all finger extensors, as well as higher FMA-UE and MBI scores ( P < 0.01) compared with the Control group. Regarding cortical excitability, increases in HbO concentration were higher in most ROIs in the MDSS group than in the Control group, including 10 ROIs (83.33%) during RS and 11 ROIs (91.67%) during TS. Moreover, increases in FC across all ROI-to-ROI pairs were greater in the MDSS group than in the Control group during both RS and TS. Conclusions MDSS effectively alleviates flexor spasticity, enhances extensor strength, and improves upper-limb motor function in patients with stroke. These effects are associated with enhanced cortical excitability and strengthened functional connectivity, supporting MDSS as a promising rehabilitation strategy for hemiparetic hand recovery. Trial registration The study protocol was registered in the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (Website https//www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.html?proj=176575 Registration Number ChiCTR2200063792)

papers.title: Arachidonic and docosahexaenoic acid supplementation affects white matter microstructure in preterm infants.
papers.authors: Gunnarsdottir G, Maximov II, Geier OM, Nordvik T, Ramm-Pettersen A, Stiris T, Moltu SJ, Pfeiffer HCV.
papers.abstract: Arachidonic acid and docosahexaenoic acid are long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids that serve as key structural components of neuronal cell membranes and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. They accumulate most rapidly during the third trimester of pregnancy, leaving very preterm infants deprived at birth. We conducted a double-blind randomized controlled trial comparing arachidonic and docosahexaenoic acid supplementation to medium chain triglycerides oil and assessed effects on white matter maturation using advanced diffusion imaging techniques. We used tract-based spatial statistics to localize significant changes across major tracts. Diffusion kurtosis imaging and Bayesian rotation invariant approach were applied to describe white matter microstructure within the intra- and extra-axonal water compartments enabling a more detailed characterization of tissue changes. These advanced diffusion MRI data were acquired at term-equivalent age for 64 infants born before 29 weeks of gestation, including 33 in the supplemented group and 31 in the control group. We identified significantly higher fractional anisotropy and lower radial diffusivity in several white matter regions in the supplemented group, mostly pronounced in areas that myelinate early. There were no significant differences in diffusion kurtosis imaging metrics between the two groups, but the Bayesian rotational invariant approach revealed several significant differences. This might illustrate a different developmental trajectory in the supplemented group compared to the control group. Applying advanced diffusion models can potentially provide a deeper understanding of early brain development and facilitate opportunities for early detection and intervention for preterm children.

papers.title: Postnatal corpus callosum microstructural deviations are linked to neurobehavioral outcomes in preterm infants.
papers.authors: Wang W, Yang L, Wu K, Li S, Peng S, Gong G.
papers.abstract: The neonatal period surrounding term represents a critical window for corpus callosum (CC) maturation, when axonal growth, pre-myelination, and fiber organization rapidly advance to support emerging motor and cognitive functions, yet preterm birth disrupts this process with unclear mechanisms and long-term consequences. To address this gap, we employed a normative modeling framework, based on a large term-born cohort, to characterize segment-specific CC developmental trajectories and then quantify individual deviations in preterm infants at term-equivalent age (TEA). Preterm infants exhibited selective CC microstructural abnormalities-most pronounced in the genu, anterior body, and splenium-while midsagittal area remained within normative limits. Using partial least squares correlation, we examined associations with neurobehavioral outcomes during toddler period and identified a multivariate brain-behavior coupling unique to the preterm cohort. Specifically, higher gross motor and cognitive scores but lower fine motor score were linked to a coordinated CC profile of increased anisotropy, higher splenial neurite density, reduced diffusivity, and lower genu orientation dispersion. This relationship was absent in term-born controls. These findings suggest that microstructure-informed deviation mapping at TEA may be sensitive to subtle CC alterations that are not apparent on macrostructural measures and are associated with later functional outcomes. This sensitivity to subtle and outcome-related variation highlights the value of this approach as a complement to conventional imaging, and lays the groundwork for future efforts to characterize early white matter development and identify preterm infants at elevated neurodevelopmental risk.

papers.title: Gray matter abnormalities associated with long-term opium use: A voxel-based morphometry study.
papers.authors: Ebrahimi MN, Pourrahimi A, Amiri H.
papers.abstract: Background Chronic raw opium use can result in opioid use disorder (OUD). Although voxel-based morphometry (VBM) studies have demonstrated decreased gray matter volume (GMV) in heroin-induced OUD, the structural impacts of long-term raw opium consumption remain poorly understood. This study investigated GMV alterations in men with opium-induced OUD and their association with use duration. Methods High-resolution T1-weighted MRI scans were acquired from 28 men with opium-induced OUD (mean use duration 17.89 ± 5.85 years) receiving opium tincture maintenance and 25 age- and education-matched healthy male controls. Whole-brain VBM (CAT12/SPM12) was controlled for age, total intracranial volume, and nicotine use. Analysis used a voxel-level uncorrected threshold of p < 0.05 with cluster-level FDR correction (p < 0.05), along with stricter thresholds (uncorrected p < 0.001, TFCE with FWE), and small-volume correction (SVC). Partial correlation and multiple linear regression investigated clinical associations. Results Whole-brain analysis identified a left-hemisphere cluster of reduced GMV (cluster-level FDR-corrected p = 0.009). No clusters survived p < 0.001 or TFCE with FWE correction. Reductions in the left insula, inferior frontal gyrus, and parahippocampal gyrus remained significant after SVC. Left insula GMV was negatively associated with duration of opium use (partial r = -0.45, p = 0.027; β = -0.48, p = 0.027 in regression). Conclusion Prolonged raw opium use is associated with decreased GMV in areas involved in craving and impulse control. Given that the whole-brain findings were not confirmed by more stringent statistical approaches, the results should be considered exploratory and necessitate replication in larger samples.

papers.title: Using the aperiodic slope across learning to predict sleep-based memory consolidation
papers.authors: Anesbury A, Caldwell HB, Lushington K, Al Safadi M, Chatburn A.
papers.abstract: Homeostatic mechanisms adjust synaptic strengths to regulate neuronal activity across wake-sleep cycles. Although sleep supports memory consolidation, limited research has explored how sleep-induced homeostatic changes influence memory outcomes in humans. The EEG-derived aperiodic slope (1/f) could be a candidate measure of homeostatic memory processes through its reflection of neural excitation-inhibition balance. In this study, 27 participants learned object-word pairs, and completed an immediate recognition test before either a nap or equivalent wakeful period. Resting-state EEG was recorded, both before and after learning and the interval, to derive changes in aperiodic slope values. A delayed recognition test then assessed whether changes in the aperiodic slope (i.e., homeostatic activity) across learning and the interval predicted memory accuracy and N400 amplitude, an index of stimulus expectancy and recognition. Our study found evidence to suggest homeostatic renormalisation, for the nap condition only, indicated by a shift towards inhibition across sleep which was inversely related to the slope change across learning. Although the aperiodic slope change across the nap and wake intervals did not predict delayed memory accuracy, a shift towards inhibition during learning was beneficial for memory accuracy, only in the nap condition. Similarly, a shift towards inhibition across learning, followed by a shift towards excitation in the nap condition, predicted reduced N400 amplitudes. This suggests that homeostatic renormalisation across the nap influenced model updating and stimulus expectancy. This study provides evidence for a link between synaptic homeostatic processes and memory consolidation, emphasising the importance of encoding-related aperiodic activity in this relationship.

papers.title: Maturational constraints on tracking of temporal attention in infant language acquisition.
papers.authors: Snijders TM, Menn K.
papers.abstract: Children are active learners: they selectively attend to important information. Rhythmic neural tracking of speech is central to active language learning. This chapter evaluates recent research showing that neural oscillations in the infant brain synchronise with the rhythm of speech, tracking it at different frequencies. This process predicts word segmentation and later language abilities. We argue that rhythmic neural speech tracking reflects infants’ attention to specific parts of the speech signal (e.g., stressed syllables), and simultaneously acts as a core mechanism for maximising temporal attention onto those parts. Rhythmic neural tracking of speech puts a constraint on neural processing, which maximises the uptake of relevant information from the noisy multimodal environment. We hypothesise this to be influenced by neural maturation. We end by evaluating the implications of this proposal for language acquisition research, and discuss how differences in neural maturation relate to variance in language development in autism.

papers.title: Interaction of physical fitness and resting state functional connectivity on global cognitive function in older adults with mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Gu Y, Liu-Ambrose T, Falck RS, Nagamatsu LS, Tam RC, Hsiung GR, Ten Brinke L, Bullock A, Grant S, Hsu CL.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMild cognitive impairment (MCI) represents a prodromal stage of Alzheimer's disease. Physical fitness, including cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular strength, is associated with cognitive function in older adults. Resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) is also linked to cognitive function; however, whether physical fitness modifies the association between rsFC and cognitive function remains unclear.ObjectiveTo examine associations of cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular strength with rsFC and their interaction on global cognitive function in older adults with MCI.MethodsA cross-sectional study of 95 older adults with MCI. Cardiorespiratory fitness was estimated by the 400-m walk; muscular strength was indexed using grip strength measured by hand dynamometer. Global cognitive function was indexed by the 13-item Alzheimer's Disease Assessment Scale-Cognitive (ADAS-Cog-13). Using the Yeo 7-network atlas, we computed rsFC within and between seven canonical networks. Significant rsFC-fitness associations were entered into moderation analyses (X = rsFC, Y = ADAS-Cog-13) with cardiorespiratory fitness or grip strength as moderator, adjusted for covariates. Simple slopes were examined at ±1 SD from the mean of moderator.ResultsParticipants had a mean age of 73.49 years, and 53.7% were female. Cardiorespiratory fitness interacted with rsFC in relation to ADAS-Cog-13, whereas grip strength did not. Specifically, greater limbic-visual (standardized b = -0.22, p = 0.009), limbic-somatomotor (b = -0.20, p = 0.049), and limbic-ventral attention (b = -0.19, p = 0.020) rsFC were associated with better global cognitive function among individuals with higher cardiorespiratory fitness.ConclusionsHigher between-network rsFC is generally associated with worse cognitive function. Thus, higher cardiorespiratory fitness may attenuate the negative association between higher between-network rsFC and global cognitive function in MCI.

papers.title: The role of white matter microstructure in the association between childhood maltreatment and adult post-traumatic symptoms.
papers.authors: Berger L, Rojczyk P, Seitz-Holland J, Zhang F, Pankatz L, Sollmann N, Kaufmann E, Carrington H, Puri T, Coleman MJ, Pasternak O, Bouix S, Rathi Y, Cetin-Karayumak S, O'Donnell LJ, Falkai P, George MS, McAllister TW, Zafonte R, Stein MB, Shenton ME, Koerte IK.
papers.abstract: Childhood maltreatment (CM) is a risk factor for adult post-traumatic symptoms and white matter (WM) alterations. It remains unknown how WM microstructure is affected alongside two common military conditions, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI). Data from 299 participants (53% male, 35.69 ± 12.23 years of age) of the Injury and Traumatic Stress (INTRuST) clinical consortium was analyzed. The study included 56 individuals with PTSD (41 with comorbid mTBI), 107 with mTBI, and 136 controls (no PTSD and/or mTBI). Diffusion parameters (mean, axial, and radial diffusivity, MD, AD, RD; fractional anisotropy, FA) in major WM tracts were extracted from diffusion MRI. CM was assessed using the Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ). Multiple regression models examined associations between CM severity and WM diffusion. Moderation analyses assessed the effect of PTSD and/or mTBI on these associations. Mediation analyses examined how WM diffusion affects the associations between CM and both PTSD and post-concussive symptom severity. Greater CM severity was associated with lower MD and AD, independent of PTSD and/or mTBI. WM diffusion, particularly in the corpus callosum and the superior longitudinal fasciculus, mediated the associations between CM severity and both PTSD (MD bab = 0.022, AD bab = 0.019-0.034) and post-concussive symptoms (MD bab = 0.028-0.040, AD bab = 0.032-0.047). Findings suggest that WM alterations are more strongly associated with CM itself than with either PTSD and/or mTBI. Mediating effects in regions critical for sensory integration highlight the role of WM microstructure as a neurobiological pathway through which CM might predispose to post-traumatic symptoms.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注童年虐待经历、白质微结构与成人创伤后症状之间的关系，并考察创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）和轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）是否影响这一关联。研究分析了临床联盟参与者的弥散磁共振指标、童年创伤问卷及症状评估，用回归、调节和中介模型检验关联。结果显示，童年虐待越严重，白质平均弥散率和轴向弥散率越低，这一关联不依赖PTSD或mTBI；胼胝体和上纵束等区域的白质弥散还在童年虐待与PTSD及脑震荡后症状之间起中介作用。作者据此认为，白质改变与童年虐待本身的联系强于与PTSD或mTBI的联系，白质微结构可能是童年虐待易化后续创伤症状的一条神经生物学路径。

papers.title: Sex differences in functional connectivity in individuals with internet gaming disorder: a resting-state fMRI Study.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Xu X, Cui S, Dong GH.
papers.abstract: Objective Sex differences may help explain the heterogeneity of internet gaming disorder (IGD), but their neural basis remains unclear. This study examined sex-related alterations in functional connectivity (FC) in IGD. Methods 373 participants (85 males with IGD, 62 females with IGD, 141 male recreational game users [RGUs], and 85 female RGUs) underwent resting-state fMRI. The study used a 2 (group: IGD/RGU) × 2 (sex: male/female) between-subjects design. ReHo and FC were analyzed under this design with age as a covariate. ReHo interaction clusters served as seed ROIs for whole-brain FC analyses, followed by simple effect analyses for significant FC interactions. Results ReHo showed significant sex-by-group interactions in the bilateral postcentral gyrus, right middle cingulate cortex, and right fusiform gyrus. Seed-based FC showed significant interactions involving these regions. Simple effects indicated that, relative to same-sex RGUs, males with IGD predominantly showed lower FC, whereas females with IGD more often showed higher FC in connections involving perceptual processing, sensorimotor integration, behavioral regulation, self-related processing, and executive control. Conclusions IGD-related brain functional abnormalities may exhibit sex differences across multiple inter-regional FC patterns, providing new evidence for the sex-related heterogeneity in IGD. Given the cross-sectional design, these findings reflect associations rather than causal effects.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注网络游戏障碍（IGD）者功能连接改变是否存在性别差异，以解释该障碍的异质性。研究纳入IGD与娱乐性游戏使用者男女共373人，采集静息态fMRI，采用2（组别）×2（性别）设计分析局部一致性与全脑功能连接。结果显示，多个感觉运动、视觉及执行控制相关区域存在显著的性别与组别交互：相对于同性别娱乐性游戏使用者，男性IGD者多表现为连接降低，女性IGD者则更多表现为连接升高。作者认为，IGD相关脑功能异常在多种区域间连接模式上呈现性别差异，为IGD的性别相关异质性提供了新证据；但研究为横断面设计，结果反映的是关联而非因果。

papers.title: Using data-driven, lesion-symptom mapping to study the relationship between neural and theoretical components of numeracy.
papers.authors: Duricy E, Durisko C, Fiez JA.
papers.abstract: Numeracy, the ability to understand and manipulate numbers, is a crucial foundational ability for many daily life skills. Numeracy tasks have been categorized using different taxonomic approaches, and understanding of the relationship between tasks categories and neural models of numeracy remains poor. In this study, we use the lesion method to address this key gap. The study employs a data-driven approach with support vector regression lesion-symptom mapping (SVR-LSM) of extracted factors from two left hemisphere chronic stroke survivor datasets: one with data from a battery of math and language tests (N = 100) and the other with data from the EC301 math battery (N = 64). We find that our data best support a separation of number tasks requiring verbal vs. magnitude number knowledge, aligning with a broad theme that emerges across theories in different variations. This is supported by distinct neuroanatomical correlates that link verbal coding of number to the language-centered regions including left perisylvian area and insula, and that link magnitude coding to the parietal lobe, as described in prior models. Our findings indicate that these two different sources of representation variously contribute to a range of math tasks, including different types of arithmetic calculation tasks, in ways which cannot be cleanly defined by one singular theoretical model of math cognition.

relevance.reason: 采用病损-症状映射研究数感任务与左半球脑区关系，发现言语编码数字对应左外侧裂周区/岛叶，涉及语言相关脑机制与结构-功能映射。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注数感任务分类与脑损伤部位之间的关系，采用数据驱动的支持向量回归损伤-症状映射，分析两组左半球慢性卒中幸存者的数学与语言测验数据。结果显示，数据最支持将数字任务区分为依赖言语编码与依赖数量大小知识两类：言语编码对应左侧外侧裂周区及岛叶等语言相关区域，数量编码对应顶叶，这与既有模型相符。作者据此指出，这两类表征以不同方式参与多种数学任务（包括不同类型的算术计算），其贡献模式无法由单一数学认知理论模型清晰界定。

papers.title: EEG Microstates are Not Associated with Psychotic Symptoms, Neurocognitive Domains or Psychosocial Functioning in Adolescents and Young Adults with Clinical High Risk for Psychosis.
papers.authors: Liebrand M, Wedekind C, Katsarakis A, Diezig S, Michel C, Schultze-Lutter F, Kaess M, Hubl D, Koenig T, Kindler J.
papers.abstract: EEG microstates are brief and discrete topographic patterns of electrical brain activity. Microstates last for 60-120 milliseconds, are thought to represent transient, quasi-stable neural networks, and traditionally four distinct classes (A-D) are distinguished. One of the core concepts of present neuroscience is that neuroimaging is able to capture meaningful networks of brain activity, which can be translated into specific cognitive functions. Following this idea, each microstate might correspond to specific core brain functions. Importantly, these cognitive functions are impaired in mental disorders. Clinical high-risk (CHR) refers to a state associated with an increased risk of developing psychosis. Previous research has demonstrated consistent microstate alterations in CHR individuals (especially in class D), as well as in psychosis. However, the neurobiological and functional meaning of microstate alterations in CHR populations is still elusive. Since the CHR state is associated with reduced neurocognition (e.g., processing speed, verbal memory, executive functions) in combination with specific clinical symptoms and impairments in psychosocial functioning, relationships between resting-state microstates and these domains were examined in a large cross-sectional cohort of CHR individuals (n = 100). Contrary to our expectations, no significant correlations were found for these clinical measures. The finding suggests that while microstate parameters may differ between CHR individuals and controls, these alterations do not seem to directly reflect the neurobiology of clinical symptoms or neurocognitive and psychosocial functions. EEG microstate deviations as candidate trait biomarker therefore require further investigation and validation in longitudinal studies to establish their stability and predictive value.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在临床高危精神病（CHR）青少年和年轻成人中考察静息态脑电微状态是否与精神病性症状、神经认知领域及心理社会功能相关。作者采用横断面设计，对较大样本的CHR个体进行脑电微状态分析与上述临床测量，结果未发现显著相关，与预期不符。作者据此指出，微状态参数虽可能在CHR个体与对照之间存在差异，但这些改变似乎并不直接反映临床症状、神经认知或心理社会功能的神经生物学基础；微状态偏离作为候选特质生物标志物仍需纵向研究进一步验证其稳定性和预测价值。

papers.title: Cerebellar Network Organization in Parkinson's Disease: Functional Connectivity across Motor and Cognitive Circuits.
papers.authors: Lin CR, Magalhães TNC, Yonce SS, Rampalli I, Mahabir R, Bernard JA, and the Parkinson's Precision Medicine Initiative.
papers.journal: Movement disorders : official journal of the Movement Disorder Society
papers.abstract: Background The cerebellum is increasingly recognized as a key contributor to cognitive reserve and network organization in Parkinson's disease (PD). However, the relationship of cerebello-cortical and cerebello-basal ganglia connectivity with cognitive status and nigrostriatal integrity remains incompletely understood. Methods Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data from 172 participants with PD in the Parkinson's Precision Medicine Initiative were analyzed. Cerebello-basal ganglia and cerebello-cortical connectivity were investigated using region of interest (ROI)-to-ROI and seed-to-voxel approaches. Cerebellar connectivity was examined in relation to cognitive status, age, disease duration, motor severity, dopaminergic medication exposure, and contralateral putaminal striatal binding ratio (SBR). Results PD participants demonstrated robust positive cerebello-basal ganglia connectivity, particularly between lobule VI/vermis VI and the pallidum. Greater age was associated with widespread reductions in cerebello-basal ganglia coupling. Longer disease duration was associated with stronger connectivity within cerebellar and basal ganglia circuits, and among cognitively unimpaired participants, stronger lobule V connectivity with temporal regions. After adjustment for contralateral putaminal SBR, cognitively unimpaired participants generally demonstrated greater connectivity between left cerebellar regions and frontal networks, whereas cognitively impaired participants showed greater connectivity from posterior cerebellar and vermal regions, including regions implicated in cognitive processing, to temporal, parahippocampal, occipital, parietal, and somatosensory regions. Conclusions Cerebellar functional connectivity in PD shows region-specific differences across cognitive status rather than uniform network loss with cognitive impairment. These findings support further investigation of cerebellar functional connectivity as a candidate biomarker of cognitive resilience and network adaptation in PD. © 2026 The Author(s). papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于帕金森病患者的静息态功能磁共振数据，考察小脑与基底节、小脑与皮层之间的功能连接，并分析其与认知状态、年龄、病程及多巴胺能系统完整性的关系。结果显示，患者小脑与基底节（尤其小脑叶VI/蚓部VI与苍白球）存在稳定的正连接；年龄增长与这类连接普遍减弱相关，病程较长则与更强的小脑及基底节环路内连接相关。校正纹状体多巴胺摄取后，认知未受损者更多表现为左侧小脑与额叶网络的连接增强，而认知受损者则表现为后部小脑和蚓部区域向颞叶、海马旁回、枕叶、顶叶及躯体感觉区的连接增强。作者据此指出，帕金森病中的小脑功能连接随认知状态呈现区域特异性差异，而非认知受损时网络连接的普遍丧失，并认为其作为认知韧性与网络适应候选标志物值得进一步研究。

papers.title: Microstructural heterogeneity of white-matter aging and its age-dependent coupling to cognition
papers.authors: Chin R, Hu X, Ranieri J, Kim J, Oh H.
papers.abstract: Brain white matter (WM) microstructure undergoes extensive changes with age, yet the regional and cellular heterogeneity of age-related WM alterations and their impact on cognition remain unclear. Leveraging Neurite Orientation Dispersion and Density Imaging (NODDI), an advanced microstructural modelling to capture specific WM cellular properties, we investigated age-dependent relationships between advanced microstructural markers and cognitive performance, indexed by six cognitive domains derived from principal component analysis. Using a suite of standard diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and NODDI techniques in eighty-six cognitively normal adults (Young: n=33, Older: n=53), we show that age group differences are widespread across whole brain white matter, with converging region-based and voxel-level evidence implicating commissural, association, and limbic pathways. Older adults exhibited significant and widespread reductions in global fractional anisotropy (FA) and neurite density index (NDI), concomitant with increases in mean diffusivity (MD), orientation density index (ODI), and free water fraction (FWF). Critically, age moderated WM-cognition associations in a domain- and tract-specific manner: younger adults exhibited stronger coupling between commissural and association tract microstructure and language and visual memory, whereas older adults showed greater dependence on projection and limbic tracts for executive and language function. The observed age-dependent coupling between specific microstructural metrics and cognition underscores the value of advanced diffusion models for capturing heterogeneity in brain aging, reveals age-specific biomarkers of cognitive health. These patterns align with phylogenetic and ontogenetic patterns of white matter vulnerability in callosal, long-range association, and limbic pathways, and suggest cellular specificity in white matter changes associated with cognitive decline. Significance Statement Aging affects brain white matter in complex and regionally specific ways, yet the biological bases of these changes and their relevance to cognition remain challenging to disentangle. Using multi-parameter diffusion MRI modeling, we found that age-related decline follows organized spatial patterns, with the greatest vulnerability in long-range association, callosal, and limbic pathways. These regional effects arise from distinct microstructural processes, including widespread extracellular alterations and more localized changes in neurite density and fiber organization. The strength and direction of white matter–cognition relationships differ between younger and older adults, revealing age-dependent shifts in how brain structural connections support behavior. Together, these findings identify biologically meaningful dimensions of white-matter vulnerability that may explain individual differences in cognitive aging.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注白质微结构的衰老变化是否存在区域与细胞层面的异质性，以及这些变化与认知的关系是否随年龄而不同。作者用多参数扩散磁共振建模，在认知正常成人中比较年轻与年长组的白质微结构指标，并考察其与多个认知域表现的关联。结果显示，衰老相关的白质差异在全脑广泛存在，尤其集中于连合、长程联络和边缘通路，且涉及细胞外改变、神经突密度和纤维组织等不同微结构过程。更重要的是，白质与认知的关联在年龄组间呈现领域和纤维束特异的差异：年轻人中连合与联络通路微结构同语言和视觉记忆联系更强，年长者中投射与边缘通路对执行和语言功能更为重要。作者据此指出，这些结果揭示了白质脆弱性的生物学维度，并提示与认知健康相关的年龄特异性标志物；但作为横断面关联证据，尚不能说明因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: Sex Differences in Human Subcortical Anatomy are Robust and Replicable in Adulthood, Already Evident Prepubertally, and Aligned with Sex Chromosomal and Gonadal Influences
papers.authors: Lee HM, Liu S, Lalonde FM, Clasen L, Guma E, DeCasien A, Moraczewski D, Thomas A, Lerch JP, Devenyi GA, Chakravarty MM, Berman KF, Delaney A, Raznahan A.
papers.abstract: The existence and mechanistic bases of sex effects on human subcortical anatomy remain unclear. To address these gaps, we combined structural neuroimaging of sex differences in subcortical volume and shape across three independent cohorts (combined N=2,886) with neuroimaging maps of sex chromosomal and endocrine effects from three clinical cohorts (combined N=313, including sex chromosome aneuploidies and isolated gonadotropin-releasing hormone deficiency). We found that human subcortical anatomy shows focal sex differences of moderate-strong effect size during young adulthood (male-biased surface area overlying lateral/ventral putamen and pallidum, nucleus accumbens, ventral posterior complex of thalamus, anterior hippocampus, and medial and central nuclei of amygdala; female-biased surface area overlying caudate head, posterior/dorsal pallidum, mediodorsal, lateral dorsal, lateral geniculate, and medial geniculate nuclei of thalamus, posterior hippocampus, and basolateral and lateral nuclei of amygdala). These regional sex differences show strong within-sample reproducibility at modest sample sizes (N≥200) and are replicable in a fully independent mid-adulthood cohort. Strikingly, we find that the topography of adult subcortical sex differences is already established by pre/early puberty (age 9 years), and the same holds for cortical sex differences. Comparison with neuroimaging data from rare disorder cohorts reveals that subcortical sex differences show a statistically significant spatial and directional congruence with the anatomical effects of X-chromosome dosage in the striatum and effects of testicular hormones in the amygdala. Together, these findings provide a reference map for the fine-grained spatial patterning of sex differences in adult subcortical shape, demonstrating its replicability, establishment before pubertal progression, and spatial concordance with potentially causal sex chromosomal and gonadal effects.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类皮层下结构是否存在稳定的性别差异及其与性染色体和性腺激素的关系，结合三个独立队列的结构磁共振数据与性染色体异常、促性腺激素释放激素缺乏等临床队列的影像图谱进行分析。结果显示，成年期皮层下体积和形状存在中等至较强效应的局灶性性别差异，这些差异在较小样本中即可重复，并在独立中年队列中再现，且在青春期前（约9岁）已基本成形，皮层性别差异亦然。进一步比较提示，皮层下性别差异的空间模式与X染色体剂量在纹状体、睾丸激素在杏仁核的解剖效应在方向和空间上显著一致，为理解性别差异的早期建立及潜在机制提供了参考图谱，但相关一致性不等于因果证据。

papers.title: How auditory rhythm perception shapes speech production: The influence of neural synchronization and rhythmic patterns.
papers.authors: Tan C, Yan Q, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Auditory rhythm perception facilitates language processing, yet it remains unclear how neural synchronization to external rhythms contributes to speech production. The present study examined whether individual differences in neural synchronization modulate rhythmic priming effects during speech production and whether such effects depend on the rhythmic structure of the target utterance. Eighty-six native Mandarin speakers performed a speech production task involving two four-syllable rhythmic patterns as targets: the dominant [2+2] pattern (boundary after the second syllable) and the less common [1+3] pattern (boundary after the first syllable). Each target was preceded by a rhythmically congruent or incongruent pure-tone prime. Neural synchronization to the primes was quantified using cerebral-acoustic coherence (CACoh) between EEG activity and the temporal envelope of the auditory rhythms, and rhythmic priming was assessed using response latencies. K-means clustering of CACoh measures identified two participant groups characterized by relatively high and low levels of neural synchronization. Behavioral analyses revealed a significant Group × Target Type interaction. For the less common [1+3] pattern, low synchronizers exhibited reliable rhythmic priming, whereas high synchronizers showed little or no priming benefit. In contrast, priming effects for the dominant [2+2] pattern were modest and comparable across groups. Furthermore, higher theta-band CACoh was associated with smaller priming effects for [1+3] targets, indicating that stronger neural synchronization predicted reduced behavioral facilitation. These findings suggest that the influence of auditory rhythm on speech production depends jointly on individual neural synchronization capacity and the rhythmic structure of the planned utterance. The results provide new evidence that auditory-motor interactions in speech production are shaped by both listener-specific and utterance-specific factors.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察个体神经同步差异如何调节听觉节律对言语产生的启动效应，以及这种调节是否随目标句的节律结构而变化。86名母语为普通话的参与者完成四音节言语产生任务，目标为常见的[2+2]和较少见的[1+3]两种节律模式，并记录脑电与纯音节律包络的脑-声耦合及反应时。结果发现，神经同步水平与目标类型存在交互：对较少见的[1+3]模式，低同步组表现出明显的节律启动，而高同步组几乎没有获益；对常见的[2+2]模式，两组的启动效应都较小且相近。此外，较高的theta频段脑-声耦合与[1+3]目标更小的启动效应相关。作者据此认为，听觉节律对言语产生的影响同时取决于个体神经同步能力和计划话语的节律结构，提示言语产生中的听觉-运动交互受听者特征与话语特征共同塑造。

papers.title: Case Report: An MDT-guided multimodal protocol for large-area stroke plateau - integrating neuromodulation with multimodal assessment.
papers.authors: Wu XL, Xia XQ, Ye CQ, Wang YL, Li XZ, Liu LX, Hang FB, Liu JS, Song YC, Zhang Y, Du XX.
papers.abstract: Objective This case report investigates the feasibility and potential value of an individualized precision rehabilitation protocol for large-area stroke, integrating multimodal neuromodulation under the guidance of a multidisciplinary team (MDT) and dynamic assessment. Methods A 38-year-old male with right hemiplegia and global aphasia following large left hemispheric infarction underwent an 8-month MDT-managed program. A closed-loop "assess-decide-intervene-re-assess" framework was implemented, featuring periodic multimodal evaluations (clinical scales, DTI, fMRI, EEG, 3D gait analysis). The intervention dynamically combined conventional therapy with staged neuromodulation: repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) for aphasia and intermittent Theta Burst Stimulation (iTBS) for motor disorder, Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)-robotic training and task-oriented Virtual Reality (VR) for upper limb function, and biomechanical correction with custom insoles based on gait analysis. Results Notable functional improvements were observed: LOTCA increased by 16 points, CRRCAE subscale improved by 60%-90%, FMA increased from 20 to 56, FMA-B reached 12, and MBI improved from 40 to 91. Neuroimaging revealed increased fractional anisotropy (FA) in the corpus callosum and right corticospinal tract, and elevated ALFF/ReHo in right frontal-temporal areas. Event-related desynchronization (ERD) decreased during BCI training, and gait parameters improved. Conclusion In this patient with large-area stroke who showed limited response to conventional rehabilitation, an MDT-guided, dynamically adjusted multimodal intervention was temporally associated with concurrent recovery across cognitive, language, motor, and daily living domains. The concomitant neural changes suggest possible trans-hemispheric network reorganization. These observations are hypothesis-generating and, while limited by the single-case design, provide a preliminary rationale for future investigations into precision neurorehabilitation approaches in similar complex cases. Clinical trial registration ChiCTR2300069203.
