papers.summary_zh: 本病例报告针对大面积脑梗死后常规康复反应有限的患者，采用多学科团队指导、动态评估驱动的个体化多模态神经调控方案，并观察其可行性与潜在价值。经过约8个月的闭环“评估—决策—干预—再评估”流程，患者在认知、语言、运动和日常生活能力等多个维度均出现明显改善，影像与电生理指标也提示跨半球网络重组可能同步发生。作者强调，这些变化仅为时间上的伴随关系，单例设计无法确立因果，结果属于假设生成性质，为今后在类似复杂病例中探索精准神经康复提供了初步依据。

papers.title: Molecular mechanisms underpinning cognitive reserve and resilience.
papers.authors: Chen A, Bhuvaneshwaran S, Akkara Y, Burke T, Perneczky R, Sastre M.
papers.abstract: The concept of cognitive reserve (CR) and resilience originates from clinicopathological observations that amyloid-β deposition, tau pathology and neurodegeneration do not uniformly translate into clinical dementia, highlighting inter-individual differences in the brain's capacity to tolerate pathology. Although CR and resilience lack a single accepted definition, they broadly describe the ability to maintain cognition in the presence of age-related or pathological brain changes. This review synthesises current molecular, cellular, and brain network mechanisms of cognitive reserve and critically examines key controversies. We also identify convergent biological pathways across multiple levels of organisation. Available evidence implicates that CR is not attributable to a single factor but reflects interactions among environmental exposures, genetic background, epigenetic regulation, cellular homeostasis, glial function, and large-scale brain network organisation. Lifestyle factors are associated with reduced pathology accumulation, preserved brain structure, and maintenance of cognition despite pathology, depending on the mechanism and outcome considered and are understood to exert their effects through epigenetic modulation of neuroplasticity, neurotrophic signalling, metabolic regulation, and inflammatory pathways. At the cellular level, preservation of dendritic spine integrity, synaptic signalling balance, mitochondrial energetic flexibility, and adult hippocampal neurogenesis supports efficient circuit function under pathological stress. Glial cells play central roles in mediating adaptive plasticity, neuroinflammatory control, and metabolic support, with dysregulation accelerating cognitive decline. Collectively, these findings frame CR as an emergent property of coordinated biological processes operating across molecular, cellular, and network scales, with important implications for developing reserve-enhancing therapeutic and lifestyle-based interventions that complement traditional pathology-focused approaches.

relevance.reason: 综述认知储备的分子、细胞与大规模脑网络机制，涉及脑组织与认知维持。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕认知储备与韧性展开，梳理了分子、细胞和脑网络层面的相关机制，并讨论了该领域的主要争议。作者指出，现有证据不支持将认知储备归因于单一因素，而更可能是环境暴露、遗传背景、表观遗传调控、细胞稳态、胶质细胞功能与大规模脑网络组织之间相互作用的结果；生活方式因素则可能通过表观遗传调节神经可塑性、神经营养信号、代谢和炎症通路发挥作用。细胞层面，树突棘完整性、突触信号平衡、线粒体能量灵活性和成年海马神经发生被认为支持病理压力下的环路功能，胶质细胞则参与适应性可塑性、神经炎症控制和代谢支持。综述据此将认知储备视为跨尺度协同生物过程的涌现属性，并提示其对开发补充传统病理干预的储备增强策略的意义。

papers.title: MBB-AVR: a mind-brain-body dataset with dynamic affective states in immersive virtual reality
papers.authors: Fourcade A, Ciston AB, Roellecke L, de Mooij J, Leos H, Villringer A, Carletto S, Malandrone F, Gaebler M.
papers.abstract: We present MindBrainBody-AffectiveVR (MBB-AVR), a multimodal dataset capturing continuous affective experience and both central and peripheral physiological responses during naturalistic emotional stimulation in immersive virtual reality. Forty-seven healthy adults (24 female, 22 male, 1 non-binary; age = 27.1 ± 5.4) viewed a 23-minute stereoscopic 360° video sequence, composed of computer-generated, language-free content designed to elicit high affective variability over time, presented via a head-mounted display (HTC Vive Pro Eye). While immersed, participants continuously rated their momentary valence and arousal using a previously validated rating tool with real-time visual feedback. Synchronized recordings include 64-channel EEG, ECG, respiration, photoplethysmography, galvanic skin response, and head and eye tracking with pupillometry. Participants additionally completed questionnaires including interoceptive sensibility and alexithymia. The dataset is organized following the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) and includes extracted low-level audio and video features of the stimulus. It may support research on the temporal dynamics of affect, multimodal physiological correlates of emotion, and affective computing. The dataset is available at https://gin.g-node.org/fourcade_a/mbb-avr.

relevance.reason: 该数据集在沉浸式VR自然刺激中同步采集EEG等中枢生理信号与连续情绪体验，可用于情绪动态的脑机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该数据集研究在沉浸式虚拟现实中呈现自然主义情绪刺激时，如何同步采集连续情感体验与中枢、外周生理反应。47名健康成人观看约23分钟的立体360°视频，并实时连续评定效价和唤醒度，同时记录脑电、心电、呼吸、皮电、眼动与瞳孔等多种信号，另收集内感受敏感性和述情障碍问卷。数据按BIDS组织并附刺激的低层音视频特征，可用于情感时间动态、情绪的多模态生理关联及情感计算研究。

papers.title: fMRI hyperscanning reveals widespread neural coupling during natural conversations
papers.authors: Mwilambwe-Tshilobo L, Tsoi L, Speer S, Zada Z, Burns SM, Falk EB, Tamir D.
papers.abstract: Conversation is one of the most powerful tools that people have for building and maintaining social connections. How does conversation bring two minds together? Here we tracked the neural dynamics between dyads during real-time conversation using fMRI hyperscanning, where both people were scanned simultaneously, to explore whether and how conversation aligns brains. Dyads engaged in natural, free-flowing conversation as they co-constructed the content of their dialogue. In a control condition, partners read aloud scripted dialogue from another dyad’s conversation, preserving the turn-taking structure while removing the co-construction. To examine neural alignment, we compared whole-brain intersubject correlation between partners in each condition, assessing both synchronous and predictive neural dynamics. Results showed that naturalistic conversation led to significant widespread neural alignment across brain regions implicated in attention, audition, affect, executive control, and social cognition, compared to scripted conversation. Temporally refined analyses showed that during naturalistic conversation, relative to scripted conversation, both speakers and listeners anticipated each other within a short temporal window, with brain activity preceding their partner’s in the same neural systems. These findings show that live, turn-taking conversations align neural activity well beyond passive or asynchronous communication, providing a foundation for future research examining how spontaneous, co-constructed dialogue allows people to communicate effectively.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI超扫描研究自然对话中双脑神经耦合，涉及语言交流与社会认知的实时脑间对齐机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用fMRI超扫描同时记录成对参与者在自然即兴对话和朗读他人脚本对话时的脑活动，比较两种条件下双方的全脑人际相关，并区分同步与预测性的神经动态。结果显示，自然对话比脚本对话引发更广泛的神经对齐，涉及注意、听觉、情绪、执行控制和社会认知等系统；时间分析还表明，说者和听者会在短时间窗内相互预测，其脑活动先于对方。作者据此认为，实时、轮流且共同建构的对话能使双方神经活动对齐，其范围超出被动或非同步交流，为理解自发对话如何支持有效沟通提供了基础。

papers.title: Increasing cerebellar beta rhythms shifts cerebral oscillatory signatures of context-driven language processing
papers.authors: Ambichler S, Portier T, Piai V, Klaus J.
papers.abstract: While there is growing consensus that the cerebellum is part of the cerebrally centred network underlying language processing, the direct nature of its contribution to comprehension and production remains unknown. In particular, while both processes require lexical access, production additionally involves motor processes linked to articulatory planning, which has fuelled the view that the cerebellum is primarily involved in motor control in language production. Cortically, both lexical access and articulatory planning are known to be driven by alpha-beta power decreases. To disentangle cerebellar involvement in language, this study investigated the modulatory effect of transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) over the right cerebellum on context-driven language comprehension and production. In a cross-over, double-blind, sham-controlled within-participants design, 32 healthy volunteers received 20 minutes of 20-Hz tACS (2 mA peak-to-peak) targeting the right posterior cerebellum. Immediately afterwards, they performed a context-driven language task while EEG was recorded from 32 channels. In the task, visually presented lead-in sentences creating a constraining or unconstraining context were followed by a picture depicting the final word of the sentence. Participants were instructed to name the picture (production) or judge its animacy (comprehension). Responses became slower overall following active compared to sham tACS, and this increase was more pronounced in the comprehension task. In line with previous work, reliable context-related oscillatory power decreases were observed in response to the context manipulation, but exhibited a different pattern across tasks and stimulation conditions. For production, beta-centred power decreases following sham shifted to temporally and spatially extended alpha power decreases following active tACS. By contrast, alpha-centred power decreases following sham tACS in the comprehension task increased following active tACS. Increasing beta activity in the right posterior cerebellum thus affected early stages of context-driven language processing linked to lexical access in both language domains. The stimulation-induced spectral, spatial and temporal shifts suggest recruitment of alternative cortical resources as a consequence of cerebellar network modulation. This interpretation is consistent with the cerebellum functioning as a network node coordinating temporal dynamics across distributed language regions.

relevance.reason: 研究右侧小脑tACS对语境驱动语言理解与产出的影响，记录EEG并报告皮层振荡变化，直接探讨小脑在语言加工中的网络作用。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨右侧小脑是否以及如何参与语境驱动的语言理解与产出，采用交叉、双盲、假刺激对照设计，对健康志愿者右侧后小脑施加20 Hz经颅交流电刺激，并在刺激后同步记录脑电完成语言任务。结果显示，主动刺激后整体反应变慢，且理解任务中的变慢更明显；语境操作仍引起可靠的振荡功率下降，但其任务与刺激条件下的模式不同：产出任务中，假刺激下以beta为中心的功率下降在主动刺激后转为时间与空间上更延展的alpha功率下降，而理解任务中原本以alpha为中心的下降在主动刺激后增强。作者据此认为，提高右侧后小脑beta活动影响了两个语言领域中与词汇通达相关的早期语境加工阶段，刺激诱发的频谱、空间和时间变化提示小脑网络调制后大脑皮层动用了替代资源，这与小脑作为协调分布式语言网络时间动态的节点这一解释相符。

papers.title: Neural Correlates of Beat Processing in Infancy and Their Association With Later Grammar Development: Evidence for the Atypical Rhythm Risk Hypothesis
papers.authors: Ladanyi E, Nayak S, Bush CT, Wang Y, Woynaroski TG, Lense MD, Leonard MK, Gordon RL.
papers.abstract: Infants show evidence of beat processing from birth, but its neural correlates in infancy remain poorly understood. Moreover, although rhythm and grammar abilities are closely linked in older (school-aged) children, it is not known whether individual differences in infant beat processing lay the foundations for those associations. This longitudinal EEG study examined neural correlates of beat processing in 6–12-month-old infants (N=37) and their relation to sentence comprehension skills in the same children at 4 years. We analyzed infants’ evoked time–frequency responses to rhythmic tone–tone–rest sequences presented in physically accented conditions and in inferred-beat conditions, in which accents were removed after an initial exposure phase.. Analyses revealed a significant increase in power to physically accented beats (9–24 Hz, p < .001). Individual differences in this response were positively associated with receptive grammar performance at age 4, assessed with the TROG-2 (r = .48, p = .005), and remained significant after controlling for infant age, parent education, and home music environment (β = .45, p = .011). The inferred beat effect was not related to later sentence comprehension performance. These findings indicate that infant neural activity tracks beat structure, with neural correlates broadly similar to those reported in adults, and that early neural sensitivity to beat is associated with later grammar development, supporting the Atypical Rhythm Risk Hypothesis.

relevance.reason: 纵向EEG研究考察婴儿节拍加工的神经相关及其与后续语法发展的关联，直接涉及语言（语法）发展的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察6至12个月婴儿的节拍加工神经相关活动，以及这些活动是否与同一批儿童4岁时的句子理解能力相关，采用纵向脑电分析婴儿对节奏声音序列的诱发时频响应。结果显示，婴儿对物理重音节拍出现明显的神经功率增强，且这一反应的个体差异与4岁时的接受性语法成绩呈正相关，在控制婴儿年龄、父母教育和家庭音乐环境后仍成立；而对推断节拍的效应则与后来的句子理解无关。作者据此认为，婴儿神经活动能够追踪节拍结构，其模式与成人报道大致相似，早期对节拍的神经敏感性可能与后续语法发展相关，从而为“非典型节律风险假说”提供支持。需注意这是纵向关联证据，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Music-Based Interventions for Cognition and Brain Health: the ARM framework
papers.authors: Loui P, Peelle JE, Grahn JA.
papers.abstract: Music-based interventions (MBIs) have shown promise in addressing cognitive, motor, and language impairments across neurological and neurodevelopmental conditions. Despite an increasing number of controlled studies that have assessed the potential rehabilitative effects of music, neural mechanisms underlying therapeutic benefits remain poorly understood. Here we present the ARM framework: a neurobiologically-informed model integrating three key systems: Auditory processing networks that encode temporal and spectral features; Reward circuitry activated by musical pleasure and prediction, and Motor systems engaged through auditory-motor coupling and rhythmic entrainment. We examine how specific MBIs leverage these systems to varying degrees and show how understanding these mechanisms is essential for predicting individual treatment response, personalizing interventions, and developing next-generation therapeutic approaches that optimize engagement of specific neural systems.

relevance.reason: 提出音乐干预的神经生物学框架，整合听觉、奖赏与运动系统并讨论语言障碍，涉及人脑认知与语言加工机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一个名为ARM的神经生物学框架，用以解释音乐干预为何可能改善认知、运动和语言功能。框架整合三个系统：编码时间与频谱特征的听觉加工网络、由音乐愉悦和预测激活的奖赏回路，以及通过听觉—运动耦合和节律同步参与的运动系统。作者据此讨论不同音乐干预对这三个系统的依赖程度不同，并认为理解这些机制对于预测个体治疗反应、实现干预个体化以及开发更有针对性地调动特定神经系统的下一代疗法十分关键。文章属于框架性论述，摘要未报告原始实验数据。

papers.title: Revisiting post-stimulus theta activity: evidence for a broadband rather than narrowband spectral origin.
papers.authors: Vanneau T, Quiquempoix M, Voytek B, Gyurkovics M, Molholm S.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: The aperiodic, 1/f-like component of electrophysiological activity is increasingly recognized as a meaningful feature of neural function rather than background noise. Meanwhile, many EEG studies interpret transient post-stimulus changes in oscillatory power as signatures of attention, salience, or cognitive control. Such interpretations typically depend on baseline normalization, which assumes aperiodic activity remains stable from pre- to post-stimulus periods. Using high-density EEG from typically developing children, we tested this assumption across two paradigms: an audiovisual simple reaction-time task (n = 36, 19 males and 17 females) and a visual oddball task (n = 38, 20 males and 18 females). In each, conventional spectral analyses were compared with analyses that explicitly modeled and removed aperiodic activity in both windows. Across tasks, stimulus onset produced robust increases in aperiodic exponent and offset, indicating systematic 1/f changes. In the audiovisual task these were modality-specific, with central, parieto-occipital, or combined topographies by stimulus type. They diminished but persisted after ERP removal, suggesting they were not fully explained by phase-locked activity. Critically, once aperiodic activity was accounted for, the apparent theta increase was largely abolished in both tasks, including the canonical fronto-central enhancement to infrequent targets. The conventional method also overestimated beta desynchronization, especially in the induced signal, indicating a spurious consequence of spectral slope steepening. By contrast, alpha desynchronization remained robust and was enhanced, reflecting genuine suppression. Together, these findings suggest many conventional time-frequency effects, particularly apparent theta synchronization, may reflect stimulus-driven aperiodic changes rather than robust narrowband changes, challenging core assumptions of these analyses.Significance statement Frequency-domain neural activity comprises both narrowband oscillations and broadband aperiodic activity. Conventional time-frequency analyses use baseline normalization to isolate oscillatory responses, implicitly assuming that aperiodic activity remains stable following stimulus onset. Across two EEG paradigms, we show that stimulus presentation systematically alters aperiodic activity in a sensory- and attention-dependent manner. These changes can produce apparent increases in theta-band power that do not reflect genuine narrowband oscillations and can exaggerate beta desynchronization. In contrast, alpha desynchronization remained robust after accounting for aperiodic activity. These findings demonstrate that stimulus-related aperiodic changes can substantially influence conventional time-frequency measures and should be explicitly considered when interpreting post-stimulus oscillatory responses.

relevance.reason: 用高密度EEG在儿童中揭示刺激后theta功率变化实为宽带非周期活动改变，涉及注意/认知控制的频谱机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究重新审视了刺激后theta活动的频谱来源，利用典型发育儿童的高密度脑电图，在视听简单反应时和视觉oddball两项任务中比较了常规时频分析与显式建模并去除非周期活动后的结果。研究发现，刺激呈现会系统性地改变非周期成分的指数和偏移，且这种变化具有感觉通道和注意依赖性；在控制非周期活动后，两项任务中原本明显的theta功率增加基本消失，包括对罕见靶刺激的经典额中央增强，常规方法还高估了beta去同步化。相比之下，alpha去同步化在控制后依然稳健甚至更明显。作者据此指出，许多常规时频效应尤其是表观的theta同步可能反映刺激驱动的宽带非周期变化而非真正的窄带振荡，提示解释刺激后振荡反应时需明确考虑非周期活动的影响。

papers.title: Insights into temporal and spatial dynamics of short association fiber formation in the human fetal brain.
papers.authors: Li B, Krsnik Ž, Pierotich L, Kostović I, Warfield SK, Grant PE, Karimi D.
papers.abstract: Short association fibers (SAFs) form the local scaffold of cortical connectivity and support early functional specialization. However, their development before birth remains largely unknown. Using fetal diffusion magnetic resonance imaging from the Developing Human Connectome Project and histology from the Zagreb Collection of human brains, we present an in utero reconstruction of SAF pathways in the human brain. We tracked their volumetric and microstructural developmental trajectories in 243 fetuses spanning a critical period of connectome formation. We found that SAFs emerge before sulcal folding, initially as flat, loosely arranged pathways along the subplate-white matter interface, and later reorganize into coherent U-shaped bundles. Their maturation followed a sensorimotor-to-association gradient, paralleling cortical development. Nonlinear, bundle-specific trajectories captured multiphasic maturation, with subplate dynamics preceding increases in axonal coherence and early myelination. These findings reveal how the brain's local wiring is established during prenatal development and provide insight into the origins of individual variability.

relevance.reason: 利用胎儿扩散MRI和组织学重建人脑短联络纤维发育轨迹，属白质纤维束与脑结构发育研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人胎儿大脑短联络纤维在出生前如何形成，结合胎儿弥散磁共振成像与组织学资料重建其宫内发育路径。作者追踪短联络纤维的体积与微结构轨迹，发现其在脑沟折叠前即出现，起初沿皮质下板与白质交界松散排列，后重组为连贯U形束，成熟顺序由感觉运动区向联合区推进。束特异性非线性轨迹显示多阶段成熟，皮质下板变化先于轴突连贯性提高和早期髓鞘化。这些结果揭示了产前局部连接的建立过程，并为个体差异起源提供线索。

papers.title: Altered Neurovascular Coupling in Obstructive Sleep Apnoea: Assessment via CBF-ALFF Spatial Coupling.
papers.authors: Liu H, Huang X, Gong S, Lu L, Wang Z, Li X, Liu B.
papers.abstract: Objectives To investigate alterations in CBF-ALFF spatial coupling in obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA). Methods Thirty-two patients with OSA and 32 healthy controls（HCs） matched for sex, age, and education background were recruited for this work. All participants received arterial spin labelling (ASL) and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) examinations. Cerebral blood flow (CBF) and amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) maps were derived from ASL and fMRI data, respectively. Between-group comparisons were performed to identify differences in ALFF, CBF, and CBF-ALFF coupling metrics. Subsequently, correlation analyses were conducted in OSA patients to investigate whether CBF/ALFF ratios derived from brain regions exhibiting significant group-level differences were associated with polysomnographic and clinical parameters. Results Patients with OSA exhibited reduced global spatial CBF-ALFF coupling relative to HCs. Regionally, decreased CBF/ALFF ratios were primarily observed in the left parahippocampal gyrus, whereas increased ratios were located mainly in the default mode network (DMN), including the left precuneus, right angular gyrus, and left inferior parietal lobule. Conclusions This study demonstrated disrupted spatial CBF-ALFF coupling in OSA patients. Such coupling alterations reflect broad OSA-associated pathophysiological changes, including but not limited to neurovascular dysfunction, offering new insights into the neuropathological mechanisms of OSA. Advances in knowledge Using combined BOLD and ASL imaging, this study provides the first characterization of both global and regional CBF-ALFF coupling alterations in OSA, revealing distinct uncoupling signatures in the DMN and medial temporal lobe that deepen our understanding of OSA-related neurovascular pathophysiology.

relevance.reason: 用静息态fMRI与ASL研究OSA患者脑血流-功能耦合改变，涉及自发活动与脑网络组织及疾病神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）患者的脑血流与自发神经活动之间的空间耦合是否发生改变，采用动脉自旋标记与静息态功能磁共振成像，比较OSA患者与健康对照的CBF-ALFF耦合指标。结果显示，OSA患者整体空间耦合降低，区域上左侧海马旁回的CBF/ALFF比值下降，而默认网络相关区域（左侧楔前叶、右侧角回、左侧顶下小叶）的比值升高。作者据此认为，这种耦合改变反映了OSA相关的神经血管功能异常等病理生理变化，为理解OSA的神经病理机制提供了线索；但该研究为横断面组间比较，相关结果尚不能说明因果关系或临床疗效。

papers.title: Understanding consciousness (biological and artificial) as a society of self-schemas.
papers.authors: Graziano MSA.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: This article argues that human cognition is more than the performance of functions such as memory, decision-making, and attention. The brain also builds schematic models of those cognitive functions and uses those models to monitor, predict, and partially control them. When you introspect, your understanding of who you are and what is happening inside of you is derived from those schematic, sometimes inaccurate, but generally useful models, rather than from the actual cognitive functions that are represented by those models. The proposal expands the previously proposed attention schema theory to a more general schema theory, in which the mind as we know it introspectively is a society of interacting self-schemas. The article focuses on five self-schemas including the attention schema (which is proposed to give us our intuitions about a conscious mind that takes possession of items in a vivid manner), a decision schema (which generates simplified, sometimes confabulated accounts of the decision-making process and gives us our intuitive understanding of agency and will), emotion schemas (which create complex interpretations of the physiological state of the body and provide us with our understanding of emotional experience), the body schema (which provides our understanding of who we are as physical beings), and personas (which give us our understanding of our emotional, social, and moral character, and act as a framework to guide our behavior). The article includes a discussion of how consciousness in a machine requires a similar suite of self-schemas used for similar functional purposes and may already be partially present.

relevance.reason: 提出自我图式社会理论解释意识与内省，涉及注意、决策、情绪等认知功能的脑内模型机制，属意识与认知神经机制的理论框架。

papers.summary_zh: 该文提出，人类认知不止是记忆、决策和注意等功能的执行，大脑还会为这些功能建立图式模型，并用其监控、预测和部分控制功能本身。作者将原有的注意图式理论扩展为更一般的图式理论，认为内省所知的“心智”是由多个相互作用的自我图式构成的社会，并重点讨论注意图式、决策图式、情绪图式、身体图式和人格面具五类自我图式如何分别塑造我们对意识、能动性与意志、情绪体验、身体自我以及情绪社会道德品格的直觉理解。文章进一步指出，机器若要具备意识，可能需要一套功能类似的自我图式，且这类图式在机器中可能已部分存在。

papers.title: White matter signatures of addiction diverge across opioids, cannabis and nicotine and predict impulsive choice in cannabis dependence.
papers.authors: Nkrumah RO, Wetzel L, Böhmer J, Eidenmueller K, Bach P, De Santis S, Walter H, Sommer WH, Ende G.
papers.abstract: White matter (WM) microstructure is implicated in the neurobiology of substance use disorders (SUDs), yet direct comparisons across substance-dependence syndromes remain scarce. It is also unclear whether WM abnormalities relate to impulsive decision-making and substance use severity. We performed a cross-sectional, dual-centre diffusion MRI study and quantified WM microstructure using diffusion tensor imaging and neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging in 87 individuals with SUDs (48 with cannabis dependence (CUD), 16 with opioid dependence (OUD), and 23 with nicotine dependence (NUD)) and 53 nonsmoking healthy controls. Whole-brain tract-based spatial statistics and tract-specific analyses of the middle longitudinal fasciculus (MLF), a temporo-parietal tract implicated in cognitive control and valuation, were performed. OUD and CUD exhibited convergent, widespread WM abnormalities characterised by reduced fractional anisotropy and increased mean diffusivity and orientation dispersion across fronto-temporo-parietal and limbic pathways, including the superior longitudinal fasciculus, arcuate fasciculus, cingulum, and MLF. In contrast, NUD showed more circumscribed alterations observed primarily in MD and localised mainly to anterior and callosal white matter regions. In CUD, higher MLF orientation dispersion was associated with steeper delay discounting (r = 0.41, p = 0.011). Moderated mediation analyses indicated that this association was indirectly driven by cannabis consumption, with asignificant conditional indirect effects observed only among daily users. No significant MLF-discounting associations were observed in OUD. Our findings reveal both shared and distinct WM alterations across SUDs and identify a link between MLF microstructure and impulsive choice in cannabis dependence.

relevance.reason: 扩散MRI比较不同物质依赖者白质微结构异常，并关联大麻依赖者的冲动决策，属以脑疾病理解认知与脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注不同物质依赖综合征的白质微结构改变是否共性与特异并存，以及这些改变是否与冲动决策和物质使用严重程度相关。作者对阿片类、大麻和尼古丁依赖者与健康对照进行横断面弥散磁共振成像，比较全脑及颞顶束路（含中纵束）的微结构指标。结果显示，阿片类与大麻依赖者表现出广泛重叠的白质异常，而尼古丁依赖者的改变更局限；在大麻依赖者中，中纵束取向弥散偏高与更陡的延迟折扣相关，且该关联似乎由大麻使用量间接驱动，仅在每日使用者中成立，阿片类依赖者中未见此关联。研究提示不同物质依赖既有共享也有特异的白质特征，并将中纵束微结构与大麻依赖中的冲动选择联系起来，但关联性结果尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: Mapping the psychosis spectrum - imaging neurosubtypes from multiscale functional network connectivity.
papers.authors: Ballem R, Andrés-Camazón P, Jensen KM, Bajracharya P, Díaz-Caneja CM, Bustillo JR, Turner JA, Fu Z, Tamminga CA, Clementz BA, Keshavan MS, Gershon ES, McDowell JE, Keedy SK, Ivleva EI, Hill SK, Pearlson GD, Chen J, Calhoun VD, Iraji A.
papers.abstract: Psychosis exhibits marked neurobiological heterogeneity that is not adequately captured by symptom-based diagnoses. Although prior efforts have identified subgroups, it remains unclear how latent disease variability manifests within the brain's multiscale intrinsic functional organization and whether these patterns can be leveraged to systematically identify biologically driven subtypes of psychosis. Here, we aim to identify Psychosis Imaging Neurosubtypes (PINs)-homogeneous subgroups defined solely from neurobiological features of brain function, independent of clinical or cognitive definitions, and whether these subgroups show meaningful phenotypic differentiation. Resting-state fMRI data from 2103 B-SNIP 1&2 participants were used to compute subject-specific multiscale functional network connectivity (msFNC). We then derived a low-dimensional neurobiological subspace, termed Latent Network Connectivity, which captured system-wide interconnected multiscale information across three components. Projections of probands msFNC onto this subspace revealed three PINs through unsupervised learning that spanned DSM diagnoses (Schizophrenia, Bipolar, Schizoaffective Disorder). Although defined purely from intrinsic neurobiology, PINs exhibited distinct cognitive, clinical, and connectivity profiles. PIN-1, the most cognitively impaired, showed Cerebellar-Subcortical and Visual-Sensorimotor hypoconnectivity, alongside Visual-Subcortical hyperconnectivity. Most cognitively preserved PIN-2 showed Visual-Subcortical, Subcortical-Sensorimotor, and Subcortical-Higher Cognition hypoconnectivity. PIN-3 exhibited intermediate cognition, showing Cerebellar-Subcortical hypoconnectivity alongside Cerebellar-Sensorimotor and Subcortical-Sensorimotor hyperconnectivity. Although covariate-adjusted analyses did not reveal significant clinical differences among PINs, exploratory analyses identified selective differences in YMDR, PANSS, and Age of Onset. Notably, 55% of relatives aligned with the same neurosubtype as their probands, a rate significantly higher than chance and than DSM-based alignment, suggesting potential heritability. Cognitive performance reliably aligns with distinct brain connectivity patterns, which are also evident in relatives, supporting their construct validity. Our PINs partially converged with previously reported BSNIP Biotypes with some correspondence (e.g. PIN1 with Biotype 1) but not with the other Biotypes, which were determined using integrated electrophysiological, cognitive, and oculomotor data, supporting convergent validity, while also indicating that intrinsic rsfMRI derived multiscale connectivity partitions psychosis heterogeneity somewhat differently from multimodal biomarker approaches. These findings underscore the limitations of DSM-based classifications in capturing the biological complexity of psychotic disorders and highlight the potential of imaging-based neurosubtypes to enhance our understanding of the psychosis spectrum.

relevance.reason: 用静息态fMRI多尺度功能网络连接对精神病谱系进行神经亚型划分，并关联认知与连接模式，属脑疾病异质性及静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神病谱系在神经生物学上的异质性，试图仅依据脑功能特征而非临床症状来识别同质的影像学神经亚型。作者利用静息态功能磁共振计算多尺度功能网络连接，并在低维潜在连接空间中用无监督学习划分亚型，考察这些亚型能否在认知、临床和连接模式上呈现有意义的差异。结果显示，所识别的三个亚型跨越精神分裂症、双相障碍和分裂情感性障碍等诊断，且认知表现与各自不同的连接模式相对应；亲属与患者亚型的一致率高于随机水平，提示可能存在遗传性。作者指出，基于诊断的分类难以充分反映精神病的生物学复杂性，而影像亚型与既往多模态生物标志物分型仅部分重合，说明不同方法对异质性的划分并不完全一致。

papers.title: Brain functional mediation of vitamin D and development in children with autism spectrum disorder.
papers.authors: Tian P, Yu X, Bai M, Bian B, Liu Z, Liang Y, Zhu X, Jia F, Li D.
papers.abstract: Background Children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) often present with developmental delays and brain functional abnormalities. Vitamin D is thought to play an important role in neurodevelopment and brain function, but its association with brain functional metrics in ASD remains unclear. This study aimed to examine the relationship between serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] levels, brain function, and developmental outcomes in children with ASD. Methods We included 207 children with ASD and 209 typically developing (TD) children. Serum 25(OH)D levels were measured in all participants. Clinical assessments and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) were conducted in the ASD group. Regional homogeneity (ReHo) and amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF) were used to characterize rs-fMRI metrics, and mediation analyses were performed to assess whether these measures mediated the relationship between 25(OH)D levels and developmental outcomes. Results Children with ASD showed significantly lower serum 25(OH)D levels compared with TD children. Among ASD children, higher 25(OH)D levels were associated with lower Childhood Autism Rating Scale (CARS) scores and better performance in multiple developmental domains. Mediation analyses revealed that ReHo in the left lingual gyrus and right fusiform gyrus significantly mediated the associations between 25(OH)D levels and specific developmental outcomes. Conclusions Children with ASD exhibited reduced serum 25(OH)D levels, and serum 25(OH)D levels were significantly associated with both clinical measures and specific rs-fMRI metrics within the ASD group. Specific brain functional metrics may play mediating roles in the associations between vitamin D status and developmental outcomes, providing insights into potential neurobiological pathways related to ASD.

relevance.reason: 以ASD儿童为对象，用静息态fMRI指标(ReHo/ALFF)中介维生素D与发育结局的关系，涉及脑功能组织与疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注孤独症谱系障碍（ASD）儿童血清维生素D水平与脑功能及发育结局之间的关系。研究比较了ASD儿童与典型发育儿童的维生素D水平，并在ASD组内结合静息态功能磁共振指标与临床发育评估进行中介分析。结果显示，ASD儿童维生素D水平较低，且其水平越高与孤独症症状评分越低、多个发育领域表现越好相关；左侧舌回和右侧梭状回的区域一致性在维生素D水平与部分发育结局之间起中介作用。作者据此提示特定脑功能指标可能参与维生素D状况与发育结局的关联，但这是横断面关联与中介模型的结果，不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Electric field strength, hippocampal volume change, and cognitive outcomes following electroconvulsive therapy: the role of sex and anatomy.
papers.authors: Biondi M, Ronold EH, Mossige I, Oltedal L, Ousdal OT, Abbott CC, Ødegaard KJ, Grüner R, Kessler U.
papers.abstract: Background Electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) induces hippocampal volume alterations, but the clinical significance of the volumetric change remains unclear. Greater electric field (EF) strength has been associated with increases in hippocampal volume and decline in cognitive performance following ECT, and this association might be moderated by individual-level variables, such as sex. Methods In this study, 29 patients with severe or treatment-resistant depression underwent right unilateral ECT. EF strength was simulated using ROAST, and hippocampal volumes were segmented with FreeSurfer. Cognitive performance was assessed pre- and post-ECT using a multidomain neuropsychological battery. Associations between EF strength, hippocampal volume change, and cognitive outcomes were analyzed, with sex as a moderator. Results At the group level, ECT reduced depressive symptom severity, without cognitive decline. Female patients exhibited higher EF strength in bilateral hippocampi, associated with smaller intracranial volumes and greater changes in the left hippocampal volume following ECT. Exploratory analyses indicated that higher EF strength and greater left hippocampal volume increase were linked to smaller improvement in verbal memory performance; moreover, a sex×volume interaction suggested opposite trends by sex, with volume increase correlating with greater improvement in males but smaller in females. Greater hippocampal volume change was also linked to lower consistency in autobiographical memory; however, post-hoc sensitivity analysis indicated that this association was outlier-driven and should be interpreted with caution. Conclusions Our findings suggest that individual anatomical variability influences the EF and may contribute to cognitive side effects following ECT. Awareness of anatomy-related EF differences may inform future research strategies for individualized treatment planning and cognitive monitoring.

relevance.reason: 研究ECT电场强度与海马体积变化及认知结局的关系，涉及脑结构与认知机制及抑郁症治疗中的脑可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨电休克治疗中电场强度、海马体积变化与认知结果的关系，并考察性别和个体解剖差异的作用。29名重性或难治性抑郁症患者接受右侧单侧电休克治疗，电场强度经模拟估算，海马体积通过影像分割获得，认知功能用多领域神经心理学测验在治疗前后评估。总体上抑郁症状减轻且未见认知下降；女性双侧海马电场强度更高，与较小的颅内体积及治疗后左侧海马体积变化更大相关。探索性分析显示，较高的电场强度和较大的左侧海马体积增加与言语记忆改善较小相关，且性别与体积变化存在交互，男性体积增加对应记忆改善更大、女性则更小；海马体积变化还与自传体记忆一致性较低相关，但事后敏感性分析提示该关联由离群值驱动，需谨慎解读。作者认为个体解剖差异会影响电场分布，并可能参与认知副作用，提示未来个体化治疗规划与认知监测可关注解剖相关的电场差异。

papers.title: Affective prosody and facial expression cues differentially augment spoken sentence and discourse comprehension for acute left and right hemisphere stroke survivors.
papers.authors: Tilton-Bolowsky VE, Durfee AZ, Bunker LD, You V, Kang J, Kim H, Hillis AE.
papers.abstract: Comprehension for spoken sentences and discourse is differentially impacted by left- (LH) and right-hemisphere (RH) brain damage, such as that caused by stroke. Comprehension deficits can have disabling effects on one's ability to process information, participate in everyday life, and create and maintain relationships. This cross-sectional, observational study evaluated differences in sentence- and discourse-level comprehension between LH and RH stroke survivors across different prosodic conditions and examined relationships between comprehension and damage to key LH and RH regions. Participants included 43 LH and 46 RH acute stroke survivors and 39 controls. All participants completed an in-house clinical assessment that included short passages presented in three conditions: neutral prosody, affective prosody, and affective prosody plus facial expression cues. Stroke survivors also completed magnetic resonance imaging. Consistent with expectations, stroke participants achieved lower comprehension accuracy than controls across conditions. LH participants' accuracy in the 'affective prosody plus facial expressions' condition was greater than in the neutral prosody condition, and total LH lesion volume was associated with performance. RH participants' accuracy in the 'affective prosody' and 'affective prosody plus facial expressions' conditions was greater than in the neutral prosody condition. Overall, both groups' scores increased linearly from Condition 1 to 3. None of the prespecified LH or RH brain regions were significantly associated with performance. Findings suggest that some acute LH and RH stroke survivors with comprehension deficits can benefit from affective prosody and facial expression cues, but different or additional cues may be needed for greatest benefit.

relevance.reason: 研究左/右半球卒中患者句子与语篇理解及情感韵律线索，涉及语言加工与脑损伤重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注左、右半球卒中后口语理解和语篇理解是否受情感韵律与面部表情线索的不同影响，采用横断面观察设计，比较左、右半球急性卒中幸存者与对照组在三种呈现条件下的理解成绩，并结合脑影像考察关键脑区损伤与成绩的关系。结果显示，卒中组整体理解正确率低于对照组；左半球卒中者在情感韵律加面部表情条件下成绩优于中性韵律条件，且总病灶体积与成绩相关；右半球卒中者在情感韵律及情感韵律加面部表情条件下均优于中性韵律条件，两组成绩随线索增加呈线性上升。预设的左右半球脑区均未与成绩显著相关。作者据此提示，部分存在理解缺陷的急性卒中幸存者可从情感韵律和面部表情线索中获益，但若要获得最大帮助，可能还需其他或额外线索。

papers.title: The roles of working memory and executive functioning in relational semantic processing tasks: Evidence from primary progressive aphasia.
papers.authors: Meyer AM, Snider SF, Faria AV, Tippett DC, Turkeltaub PE, Hillis AE, Friedman RB.
papers.abstract: Referential semantic processing tasks, such as word-picture matching (WPM), require the matching of stimuli that represent the same concept, while relational semantic processing tasks, such as Pyramids and Palm Trees (PPT), require the processing of relationships between concepts. Compared to referential tasks, relational tasks may be likely to place a greater demand on working memory and/or executive functioning. In the current study, we examined referential and relational semantic processing in all variants of primary progressive aphasia (PPA). We predicted that backward digit and spatial span tasks and/or Trails B would be significant predictors of accuracy on relational tasks, while similar tasks that place less significant demands on working memory or executive functioning, such as forward digit and spatial span tasks and Trails A, would not be significant predictors of accuracy on relational tasks. In behavioral regression analyses, neither backward span task was a significant predictor of accuracy on referential tasks, but accuracy on 5 out of 6 relational tasks was predicted by at least one backward span task. In a second set of behavioral analyses, neither Trails task was a significant predictor of accuracy on referential tasks. Conversely, accuracy on 5 out of 6 relational tasks was predicted by Trails B. In regression analyses involving grey matter volume, three ROIs (left middle temporal gyrus, left insula, right middle temporal pole) were significant positive predictors of accuracy on a referential task (Auditory WPM). The same three ROIs were significant positive predictors of accuracy on a relational task (PPT-Pictures), along with one additional ROI - the left pars triangularis. The findings of this study suggest that performance on relational semantic processing tasks is affected by working memory capacity and executive functioning, which are supported by the left pars triangularis.

relevance.reason: 研究原发性进行性失语患者的关系语义加工，结合工作记忆/执行功能行为测量与灰质体积分析，涉及语言语义、认知机制及脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以不同变异型原发性进行性失语患者为对象，考察指称性与关系性语义加工任务的表现差异，并检验工作记忆和执行功能对任务准确率的预测作用。行为回归分析显示，后向数字与空间广度任务及Trails B能预测多数关系性语义任务的准确率，却不能预测指称性任务；而工作记忆和执行功能需求较低的前向广度和Trails A则无此预测作用。灰质体积分析中，左侧三角部在关系性任务上额外成为显著正向预测区。作者据此认为，关系性语义加工任务的成绩受工作记忆容量和执行功能影响，左侧三角部可能为这些能力提供支持。

papers.title: Adolescent pragmatic development mirrors pragmatic individual differences in adulthood: An fMRI study.
papers.authors: Forbes Schieche C, Uddén J.
papers.abstract: Pragmatic development is still ongoing during adolescence. However, the developmental trajectory during this period is understudied and the underlying neural correlates of pragmatic development are unknown. In this study, we used an established fMRI paradigm contrasting indirect and direct speech acts in a newly acquired adolescent sample (n = 51) and a previously collected adult sample (n = 57). The adolescent sample was subdivided into Young (ages 13-15) and Mid (ages 16-18) groups and the adult sample (Old, ages 20-36) was split based on pragmatic skill level (established in separate behavioral tests). We observed age-related increases in activity in the posterior medial superior frontal gyrus, and a combination of age-related differences and adult individual differences in the dorsal aspects of the posterior cingulate cortex (dPCC). Both clusters were located outside the classic perisylvian language network. We interpret the dPCC findings in terms of its overlap with the Default Mode Network. Similar activity in the dPCC between adolescents and adults with lower pragmatic skill is consistent with a view that a delayed adolescent development may lead to persistent pragmatic difficulties in adulthood. The findings also indicate development towards context-specific processing. By studying adolescence, a presumably uniquely human extended developmental period, we provide a rare empirical angle on the question of which aspects of brain and cultural evolution contributed to the human communicative faculty.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究青少年语用（间接言语行为）发展的脑活动变化，涉及语言交流的神经机制与发育。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年语用能力发展及其神经关联，用fMRI比较间接与直接言语行为，并对比青少年与成人样本。结果显示，后内侧上额回活动随年龄增长而增强，后扣带皮层背侧则同时呈现年龄差异与成人个体差异，且两处均位于经典语言网络之外。作者据此推测，青少年语用发展与成人语用技能差异可能共享部分神经基础，发展延迟或与成人持续语用困难相关，并提示加工趋向情境特异化。

papers.title: Distinct brain network organization in asynchronous and synchronous motor observation and motor imagery: evidence from EEG functional connectivity, phase-amplitude coupling, and decoding.
papers.authors: Lian T, Tang M, Zhao R, Zhang Y, Zhang J, Cheng C, Han J.
papers.abstract: Motor observation and motor imagery (MOMI) has been increasingly utilized in motor learning and neurorehabilitation research; however, it remains unclear whether different temporal arrangements of observation and imagery are reflected in distinct brain network organization. Therefore, the present study investigated whether asynchronous and synchronous MOMI exhibit distinct network-level patterns during motor simulation. To isolate the effect of temporal organization while maintaining a constant motor task context, participants performed a basketball set-shot task, allowing comparison among asynchronous MOMI (A-MOMI), synchronous MOMI (S-MOMI), and motor imagery (MI). Phase-locking value (PLV)-based functional connectivity analyses revealed significant condition-related differences, predominantly within the theta, alpha, and beta frequency bands. Specifically, MI exhibited stronger theta-band functional connectivity during the early phase of the task, whereas A-MOMI demonstrated more sustained enhancement of alpha-band connectivity during the middle and later phases. Furthermore, coupling between theta phase and 12-16 Hz amplitude was stronger in A-MOMI compared to both S-MOMI and MI. Decoding analysis further indicated moderate separability among the three conditions, yielding an overall classification accuracy of 69.61%. A-MOMI achieved the highest classification accuracy (79.41%), followed by MI (73.53%) and S-MOMI (55.88%), reflecting differential discriminability among the conditions. Collectively, these findings provide network-level evidence that the temporal organization of observation and imagery shapes MOMI-related brain network organization, with implications for optimizing motor training protocols and EEG-based assessments of motor simulation states.

relevance.reason: 用EEG功能连接、相位-幅值耦合与解码比较异步/同步运动观察与想象时的人脑网络组织，属运动模拟的认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注动作观察与动作想象的不同时间安排（异步与同步）是否对应不同的大脑网络组织，让参与者在同一篮球定点投篮任务情境下完成异步动作观察与想象、同步动作观察与想象以及单纯动作想象，并用脑电功能连接、相位-幅值耦合和解码分析进行比较。结果显示，三种条件在theta、alpha和beta频段的功能连接上存在差异：单纯动作想象在任务早期theta连接更强，异步条件在中后期alpha连接增强更持久，且theta相位与12–16 Hz幅值的耦合在异步条件下强于同步条件和单纯想象。解码分析对三种条件仅呈中等区分度，其中异步条件最高、同步条件最低。作者据此认为，观察与想象的时间组织会影响动作模拟相关脑网络的组织方式，这为优化运动训练方案和基于脑电评估动作模拟状态提供了网络层面的线索，但相关发现尚属条件间差异，不能直接推及训练效果。

papers.title: Lateralized amyloid PET uptake and beta-band connectivity in relation to cognition in temporal lobe epilepsy.
papers.authors: Kong J, Kim HJ, So M, Lee I, Kim H, Kim YT, Kim HJ, Do S, Lim DK, Han JH, Kang SH, Pahk K, Kim JB.
papers.abstract: We examined focus-relative amyloid PET asymmetry and its associations with resting-state EEG connectivity and processing speed in mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (MTLE). Thirty adults with clinically assigned MTLE (19 right-focus, 11 left-focus) underwent 18 F-florapronol PET and resting-state EEG. Regional standardized uptake value ratios (SUVRs) and sensor-level weighted phase lag index (wPLI) were evaluated using paired comparisons, rank correlations and exploratory bootstrap indirect-association models. Cognitive data were available for 26 participants, including Digit Symbol Coding (DSC) for 25. Under the original analytical convention, mean medial temporal SUVR was 1.066 ipsilaterally and 1.013 contralaterally (difference 0.053, 95% CI [0.013, 0.093]; p = 0.011; Cohen's dz = 0.500). The contrast differed by focus side (interaction p = 0.002) and was 0.038 under source-table reconstruction (p = 0.075). Ipsilateral SUVR correlated with inter-hemispheric beta wPLI (ρ = 0.617, q = 0.034 across 240 tests). The intra-contralateral association (ρ = 0.536) did not survive this broader correction. Indirect estimates for Trail Making Test A (0.279, 95% bootstrap CI [0.043, 0.761]) and DSC (0.151, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.114, 0.476]) did not survive correction across 136 models. Regional medial temporal PET uptake was associated with beta-band scalp connectivity in this small cohort, while focus-side heterogeneity and labeling sensitivity limit a uniform ipsilateral interpretation. Processing-speed indirect associations were exploratory and did not establish compensation or causality. Replication with structural correction, longer EEG sampling and longitudinal cognitive follow-up is required.

relevance.reason: 以颞叶癫痫患者为对象，考察淀粉样PET偏侧摄取与静息EEG beta连接及认知的关系，属脑疾病中脑组织与功能连接研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在颞叶内侧癫痫成人中考察焦点侧相对的淀粉样蛋白PET摄取不对称，及其与静息态脑电连接和处理速度的关系，结合PET、脑电与认知测量进行分析。结果显示，内侧颞叶摄取在原始分析下存在同侧高于对侧的轻度不对称，但该对比受焦点侧影响，且重建分析后不再显著；同侧摄取与半球间β频段连接相关，而经多重校正后部分关联不再稳健。处理速度的间接关联仅为探索性，未通过校正，不能据此推断补偿作用或因果关系。作者强调样本小、焦点侧异质性和标记方法敏感性限制了统一解释，结论需重复验证。

papers.title: Relationships between speech-in-noise comprehension, lip reading ability and cortical speech tracking in talking avatars as well as natural talking heads.
papers.authors: Riegel J, Schüller A, Jehn C, Wißmann A, Zeiler S, Kolossa D, Reichenbach T.
papers.abstract: In noisy listening environments, visual cues from a speaker's face can significantly boost speech comprehension. The underlying audiovisual integration in the brain involves tracking of audiovisual speech features in the temporal lobe. Moreover, lip reading in silence is associated with tracking of the speech envelope in the low-delta frequency band (0.5-1 Hz). Recently, digital avatars have emerged that can support speech comprehension. Yet, it remains unclear how the human brain integrates such artificial visual signals with natural speech. Here, we employed magnetoencephalography (MEG) to measure the neural responses to a natural video, an avatar generated by deep neural networks, and a degraded video serving as a control. We demonstrate that the avatar can enhance speech-in-noise comprehension to a similar degree as the degraded video, although less than the natural video. We further identify a late response at 600 ms of the neural tracking in the high delta band (1-4 Hz) that predicts audiovisual speech comprehension. In contrast, we did not find the neural tracking in the theta band to be involved in audiovisual integration. Interestingly, we further found that neural tracking in the low delta band was related to silent lip-reading performance. Moreover, the tracking in the low delta band evoked by the avatars was much weaker and occurred earlier than that elicited by the other audiovisual stimuli. Our results show that audiovisual integration can take place even later than suggested in previous work and can index speech understanding. Additionally, the low delta band and the high delta band play distinct roles in visual-only and audiovisual speech processing, suggesting potential avenues for further boosting the abilities of avatars to support speech comprehension.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究自然视频与虚拟人说话头对语音噪声下理解的视听整合及皮层语音追踪机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑磁图考察人们在噪声中听语音时，自然说话视频、深度神经网络生成的头像视频和退化视频如何影响视听言语整合与理解。结果显示，头像与退化视频对噪声中言语理解的提升程度相近，但都弱于自然视频；高delta频段约600毫秒的晚期神经跟踪能够预测视听言语理解，而theta频段的跟踪未显示参与这一整合。低delta频段的跟踪则与无声唇读表现相关，且头像诱发的该频段反应更弱、出现更早。作者据此认为视听整合可能发生在比以往设想更晚的时间，并指出低、高delta频段分别在纯视觉和视听言语加工中扮演不同角色，这为改进头像支持言语理解的能力提供了线索。

papers.title: Altered hippocampal subfield functional connectivity and its association with back pain in axial spondyloarthritis: a multimodal neuroimaging study.
papers.authors: Xiong F, Luo Y, Liu Y, Lu F, Xue Y, Shen G, Wang Y, Wang W.
papers.abstract: To investigate hippocampal subfield volumes and resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) in patients with axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA), and to assess their clinical relevance. In this cross-sectional study, 39 patients with axSpA and 41 healthy controls (HCs) underwent 3-T structural T1-weighted and resting-state functional MRI. Hippocampal subfields were segmented using FreeSurfer, and seed-based rsFC maps were computed for 12 subfields per hemisphere. Group differences were assessed with general linear models (FDR-corrected) for volumes and permutation-based family-wise error correction with threshold-free cluster enhancement for rsFC. Partial correlations adjusted for age, sex, and education tested associations between rsFC and clinical parameters (FDR-corrected). No hippocampal subfield volume differed significantly between groups after FDR correction, although patients with axSpA showed nominally larger right CA4 and bilateral GC-ML-DG volumes. Increased rsFC between the left presubiculum and left precentral gyrus/supplementary motor area (PreCG/SMA) was observed in patients relative to HCs (permutation-based FWER-corrected p < 0.05). Presubiculum-PreCG/SMA rsFC was negatively associated with overall back pain (partial r = -0.52, p = 0.001, FDR-corrected q = 0.028), the only association surviving FDR correction across all clinical parameters. No significant associations were observed with inflammatory markers or disease activity indices. axSpA is associated with hippocampal-motor cortical connectivity, with increased presubiculum-PreCG/SMA rsFC linked to lower back pain severity, whereas hippocampal subfield volumes are largely preserved. These findings support reconceptualizing axSpA as a systemic disease with measurable central nervous system involvement and pain-related network reorganization. Clinical trials register number: ChiCTR2500111024 (October 23th 2025).

relevance.reason: 研究轴性脊柱关节炎患者海马亚区体积与静息态功能连接，并关联背痛，涉及人脑结构-功能及疼痛相关网络重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究比较了39名中轴型脊柱关节炎患者与41名健康对照的海马亚区体积及静息态功能连接，并检验其与临床指标的关系。结果显示，经多重比较校正后各组海马亚区体积无显著差异；患者左侧前下托与左侧中央前回/辅助运动区的功能连接增强，且该连接越强，整体背痛程度越低，这是唯一在校正后仍与临床参数相关的连接，而与炎症指标和疾病活动度无关。作者据此认为，中轴型脊柱关节炎可能伴有海马-运动皮层的疼痛相关网络重组，而海马亚区结构相对保留，提示应将本病视为具有可测量中枢神经系统受累的系统性疾病；但关联性结果尚不能说明因果或治疗效应。

papers.title: Greater temporo-occipital gray matter volume and frontoparietal cortical thickness in post-menopausal women: a UK Biobank study.
papers.authors: Tyrovolas S, Portella MJ, Usall J, Cambra-Martí MR, Callén A, Haro JM, Núñez C, Stephan-Otto C.
papers.abstract: Menopause is a critical transitional stage in women's lives, yet evidence on its impact on brain structure remains inconsistent, and large-sample neuroimaging studies are limited. Here, we applied whole-brain morphometry techniques to evaluate differences between pre- and post-menopausal women in terms of gray matter volume, cortical thickness and cortical gyrification. We processed and analyzed T1-weighted brain scans of 4098 women (1033 pre-menopausal; 3065 post-menopausal) from the UK Biobank. Post-menopausal women exhibited greater gray matter volume than pre-menopausal women primarily in the right temporal lobe, encompassing the amygdala and the hippocampus, and extending to the left temporal lobe and occipital regions. Post-menopausal women also exhibited greater cortical thickness in the frontal lobe and the supramarginal gyrus, whereas no differences in cortical gyrification were observed. These findings were consistent across multiple sensitivity analyses addressing age differences, peri-menopausal status, and other potential confounds. The spatial pattern of differences between post-menopausal and pre-menopausal women considerably overlaps with regions affected early in Alzheimer's disease, such as the medial temporal lobe and the supramarginal gyrus. Our findings of larger gray matter volume and greater cortical thickness in post-menopausal women may reflect compensatory mechanisms. Speculatively, these findings align with the biphasic model of brain structural changes in Alzheimer's disease. Further research with longitudinal designs is required to elucidate the exact mechanisms underlying the brain structural differences associated with menopause.

relevance.reason: 基于UK Biobank大样本T1结构像比较绝经前后女性灰质体积与皮层厚度差异，属脑结构组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于英国生物银行的大样本脑影像数据，比较绝经前与绝经后女性在灰质体积、皮层厚度和皮层脑回化上的全脑形态差异。结果显示，绝经后女性在右侧颞叶（含杏仁核和海马）及左侧颞叶和枕区灰质体积更大，额叶和缘上回皮层更厚，而皮层脑回化未见差异，且这些结果在针对年龄等混杂因素的多项敏感性分析中保持稳定。作者指出，这种差异的空间分布与阿尔茨海默病早期受累区域有相当重叠，推测较大的灰质体积和皮层厚度可能反映补偿机制，但强调这仅为推测，相关机制尚需纵向研究验证。

papers.title: Positive association between emotional intelligence and white matter integrity in the cingulum and superior longitudinal fasciculus in healthy Japanese adults.
papers.authors: Kokubun K, Nemoto K, Yamakawa Y.
papers.abstract: With the growing intensity of global competition, understanding employees' psychological awareness has become a vital aspect of organizational management. Among related constructs, emotional intelligence (EI) has drawn considerable interest, leading to a growing body of research linking EI to specific brain structures. Nevertheless, the association between EI and fractional anisotropy (FA), an index of white matter integrity, has not been thoroughly investigated. In this study, we examined the relationship between self-reported trait EI and FA using diffusion tensor imaging data from 292 healthy adults in Japan. Others' Emotion Appraisal was positively associated with FA in the cingulum, and Use of Emotions was positively associated with FA in the superior longitudinal fasciculus (SLF). These associations were small in magnitude and were robust to several sensitivity analyses; exploratory tract-specific associations did not survive correction for multiple comparisons. These findings suggest that self-perceived emotional competencies are associated with individual differences in white-matter microstructure in tracts implicated in socio-emotional and cognitive processes. Because the study is cross-sectional, the results do not establish causal direction and require replication in more diverse samples. Keywords: emotional intelligence; cingulum; fractional anisotropy; superior longitudinal fasciculus; diffusion tensor imaging.

relevance.reason: 该研究用扩散张量成像考察健康成人情绪智力与扣带束及上纵束白质微结构的关联，属于社会认知的脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自评特质情绪智力与白质完整性指标各向异性分数（FA）之间的关系，利用扩散张量成像数据对健康日本成年人进行了横断面分析。结果显示，他人情绪评估得分与扣带束FA呈正相关，情绪利用得分与上纵束FA呈正相关；这些关联幅度较小，但在多项敏感性分析下保持稳健，而探索性的分束关联未通过多重比较校正。作者据此提出，自感知的情绪能力可能与涉及社会情绪和认知过程的纤维束微结构个体差异有关，但横断面设计无法确定因果方向，结果仍需在更多样化样本中重复验证。

papers.title: Nociceptive responses and resting-state functional connectivity of the human midbrain tegmentum.
papers.authors: Cao A, Morris K, van der Heijden H, van Gool R, Gregory SR, Gonzalez-Heydrich J, Paech D, Berretta S, Upadhyay J.
papers.abstract: The rostromedial tegmental nucleus (RMTg) has been shown to inhibit midbrain dopaminergic centers through its GABAergic projections, and to be critical for regulating responses to aversive and rewarding stimuli. This nucleus has primarily been evaluated in rodents and non-human primates, while recent postmortem analysis of human brainstem tissue localized GABAergic cell clusters in the putative RMTg. The objectives of this preliminary investigation in healthy controls (HC) were to (i) define RMTg function during evoked thermal stimulation and the resting-state using 7T functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), and (ii) explore the expression of putative RMTg markers, µ-opioid receptors (OPMR1), nociceptin receptors (NOPR), and FOXP1 as well as tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) in the midbrain tegmentum. Relative to 40 °C stimuli, greater responses to 46 °C (normally noxious) in the putative RMTg as well as raphe nuclei, locus coeruleus, substantia nigra, thalamus, putamen, and anterior cingulate were observed. Resting-state 7T fMRI showed robust RMTg functional connectivity with components of mesocorticolimbic and nigrostriatal circuitry, thalamus, hippocampus, and cerebellar subdivision. In postmortem analyses, neurons immunolabeled for OPMR1, NOPR, and FOXP1 were detected in an area adjacent to the decussation of the superior cerebellar peduncle. These immune-positive neurons in the area of the putative RMTg were adjacent to intense TH immunoreactivity. This investigation provides novel evidence of activation of a distinct area within the human midbrain tegmentum, putatively identified as the RMTg, particularly during nociceptive processing in addition to its resting-state connectivity with the broader central nervous system. Further exploration of the human RMTg is warranted.

relevance.reason: 该研究在健康人脑中使用7T fMRI考察中脑被盖区对伤害性热刺激的反应及其静息态功能连接，属于感知与脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究在健康被试中结合7T功能磁共振与死后脑组织标记，考察人类中脑被盖吻内侧被盖核（RMTg）区域在热痛刺激和静息状态下的功能及其分子标记表达。结果显示，相比40 °C，46 °C（通常为伤害性）刺激在该推定RMTg及中缝核、蓝斑、黑质、丘脑等区域引起更强反应；静息态下该区域与中脑皮质边缘系统、黑质纹状体通路、丘脑、海马及小脑等存在功能连接。死后分析在推定RMTg区域检出表达µ-阿片受体、痛敏肽受体和FOXP1的神经元，且邻近强烈的酪氨酸羟化酶免疫反应。作者认为这为人类中脑被盖中一个可能对应RMTg的区域参与伤害性加工及其静息态连接提供了新证据，但属初步探索，仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Effects of cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia on cognitive and emotional functioning in adults with insomnia: behavioural and neuroimaging evidence
papers.authors: Gong K, Phillips E, Perrault AA, Borgetto F, Walsh NA, Reyt M, Maltezos A, Garneau J, Tarelli L, McGrath JJ, Savard J, Schwartz S, Gouin J, Dang-Vu TT.
papers.abstract: Study Objectives To characterize neural correlates of memory and emotion reactivity in individuals with insomnia disorder (INS) compared to good sleepers (GS) and to investigate associated short- and long-term changes following cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia (CBTi). Methods This randomized controlled trial included 56 INS and 20 GS. At baseline, participants underwent resting-state and task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging, including working memory, emotion reactivity, and face-name associative memory tasks. They filled out sleep diaries and self-report questionnaires about sleep, cognition, and emotions, and underwent in-lab polysomnography. Subsequently, participants with INS were randomized to either the 3-month treatment group (TX) or wait-list control group (WL). Both TX and WL groups repeated baseline assessments at three months post-randomization and completed sleep diaries and questionnaires one year after finishing CBTi. Results At baseline, the INS group reported higher insomnia severity, greater subjective cognitive impairment, and perceived sleep-related stimuli as more negative than GS. Contrasting with these subjective evaluations, no group differences were found in memory performance, task-based brain activity, or resting-state functional connectivity. At three months post-randomization and one-year follow-up, CBTi significantly improved subjective, but not objective, cognitive functioning and sleep in adults with INS. No significant treatment-related changes were observed in valence ratings of sleep images, task-based brain activity, or resting-state functional connectivity. Conclusions Beyond its primary role in improving insomnia symptoms, CBTi may have long-term benefits for individuals with INS who experience concerns about their cognitive functioning, even in the absence of objective changes in neural processing of cognitive and emotional tasks. Clinical trial Impact of Insomnia Treatment on Brain Responses During Resting-state and Cognitive Tasks. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04024787 ; https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04024787 Statement of Significance Insomnia disorder impairs sleep, cognitive, and emotional functioning, imposing a significant clinical burden and highlighting the need for effective interventions to address these impairments. Our study used self-reports, task performance, and neuroimaging techniques to comprehensively investigate the effectiveness of cognitive-behavioural therapy for insomnia on subjective and objective measures of sleep, cognitive, and emotional functions in adults with insomnia disorder. Our findings show that this treatment has long-lasting benefits on subjective, but not objective, cognitive functioning and sleep measures. No changes were found in valence ratings of sleep images, memory performance, or brain function. Future research should identify neural substrates and psychological processes underlying these subjective cognitive deficits as well as the dissociation between subjective and objective cognitive functioning in insomnia.

relevance.reason: 研究失眠患者工作记忆、情绪反应及静息态功能连接，并考察CBTi后脑功能变化，属认知与脑机制及静息态网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验比较了失眠障碍成人（INS）与睡眠良好者（GS）在记忆和情绪反应性上的神经相关特征，并考察认知行为疗法（CBTi）后的短期与长期变化。基线时，INS组报告失眠更重、主观认知损害更明显，且对睡眠相关刺激的负性评价更强；但在记忆表现、任务态脑活动和静息态功能连接上，两组未见差异。三个月及一年随访时，CBTi显著改善了INS成人的主观认知功能和睡眠，但客观指标未见相应改善，睡眠图片效价评分、任务态脑活动及静息态功能连接也无显著治疗相关变化。作者据此提示，CBTi可能对担忧自身认知功能的失眠者具有长期主观获益，即便认知与情绪任务的神经加工未见客观改变。

papers.title: Defining a subgroup within autism leads to potential enrichment criteria in investigational therapeutic development: Comparing resting state gamma band power to a fragile X syndrome reference sample
papers.authors: Westerkamp GC, Sarraf ST, Vanderklish P, Gargosky S, Elmaghraby R, Pedapati EV, Erickson CA.
papers.abstract: Background Elevated resting gamma power is a reproducible, robust neurophysiology marker across species in fragile X syndrome (FXS), a major known cause of autism spectrum disorders (ASD). In FXS, this neurophysiological phenotype is well described and particularly prominent in males harboring fully methylated full CGG repeat expansions [1,4,16–20]. However, gamma power evaluations in idiopathic ASD have yielded variable results. As a single-gene model of ASD, FXS hold promise to biologically model some of the autism spectrum. Exaggerated gamma power in FXS is thought to reflect increased cortical excitability, a common feature of ASD, and has been shown to correlate with symptoms in both human FXS individuals and the Fmr1 knockout mouse model of FXS [1,19,20]. A recent clinical trial of the BK channel positive modulator, Codabakalner, provided encouraging signs that normalization of gamma power in FXS may provide therapeutic benefit [14]. Interventional and biomarker studies in ASD provide support that this may also be the case in ASD [15]. We utilized gamma band power to evaluate neurophysiological overlap between ASD and FXS seeking to determine the prevalence and clinical characteristics of those with ASD who exhibit a FXS-like elevated resting state gamma phenotype. Methods This cross-sectional resting EEG analysis included 159 individuals with non-syndromic ASD and 41 males with fully methylated full mutation FXS. Relative gamma power was calculated as 30– 100 Hz power divided by 1–100 Hz power across 10–20-equivalent electrodes, excluding 55–65 Hz. We defined the cutoff for elevated resting gamma band power in ASD as relative gamma power of greater than or equal to the median minus one standard deviation of gamma power in our FXS male sample. Results A FXS-derived relative-gamma threshold of 0.185 or greater was met by 22% of participants with ASD (n=35). As expected, the mean ASD group resting state gamma was lower than the male FXS sample (p < 0.001). ASD participant threshold proportions by age group were 3/37 (8.1%) below 13 years, 9/50 (18.0%) age 13-18 years, and 23/72 (31.9%) in the 18+ years group. Within the ASD group, there were no observable clinical characteristics that readily differentiated participants with an elevated gamma phenotype from those without this phenotype. Conclusions Approximately one fifth of all participants and slightly over 30 percent of adults with ASD met the FXS-derived elevated resting gamma band power criterion. This represents the first investigation using a translational brain neurophysiology marker in a syndromic form of autism to parse a clinical idiopathic ASD sample to identify potential overlapping brain features. The results will work to support potential targeting of ASD subgroups in the future utilizing therapeutic approaches initially established in a single-gene form of developmental disability.

relevance.reason: 以静息态EEG gamma功率比较特发性ASD与脆性X综合征，探讨ASD亚组的脑神经生理特征，属静息脑活动与脑疾病机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用静息态脑电比较非综合征性自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）个体与脆性X综合征男性患者的伽马波段功率，试图找出ASD中具有类似脆性X综合征伽马功率升高特征的亚组。结果显示，约五分之一的ASD参与者达到了由脆性X综合征样本推导出的相对伽马功率阈值，且这一比例随年龄组升高，成年组略超三成；但ASD组内未见能区分该特征有无的明显临床特点。作者认为，这是首次用源自单基因自闭症的转化性神经生理指标来划分特发性ASD样本，提示部分ASD个体可能存在与脆性X综合征重叠的脑电特征，为未来针对ASD亚组的干预研究提供线索，但该特征与临床症状的关系及治疗意义尚待验证。

papers.title: Resting-State Functional Connectivity and Cognitive Performance in Long COVID: A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: O’Connor D, Watson E, Reich DL, Carnavali F, Mcveety M, Gwalani P, Wisnivesky JP, Becker JH.
papers.abstract: Cognitive impairment is a prevalent, disabling manifestation of Long COVID, but whether cognitive rehabilitation alters neural network organization is unknown. We examined whether a 12-week cognitive rehabilitation intervention modified resting-state connectivity within the central-executive (CEN), default-mode (DMN), and salience (SN) networks, and whether connectivity changes associated with cognitive performance. Participants were adults with prior SARS-CoV-2 infection, persistent Long COVID symptoms (≥3 months), and objectively confirmed mild-to-moderate cognitive impairment. Of 58 participants randomized, 39 (mean age 46.4; 69% women) completed neuroimaging (19 intervention, 20 control). The 12-week intervention combined virtual cognitive rehabilitation and small-group and individual sessions with computerized cognitive training. No significant group, time, or group-by-time interaction effects were observed for within- or between-network connectivity (all P > 0.22). Exploratory analyses identified nominal associations (P < 0.05) between connectivity changes and cognition; improved processing speed associated with increased CEN-DMN connectivity, greater SN-DMN connectivity associated with worse performance across processing speed, working memory, and executive function. None survived correction for multiple comparisons. Cognitive rehabilitation was not associated with detectable changes in resting-state network connectivity in long COVID–related cognitive impairment. SN-DMN connectivity may represent a marker of reduced network segregation underlying cognitive dysfunction, warranting study in larger, multimodal trials. Trial registration: NCT05498493 .

relevance.reason: 研究Long COVID认知障碍患者静息态网络连接与认知表现及康复干预的关系，涉及脑网络组织与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验考察为期12周、结合线上认知康复与计算机化认知训练的干预，能否改变长新冠伴轻中度认知障碍成人静息态下中央执行网络、默认模式网络和突显网络内部及网络间的连接，并检验连接变化与认知表现的关系。结果显示，干预组与对照组在网络连接上未见可检测的组间、时间或交互差异。探索性分析中，连接变化与认知成绩仅呈名义相关，例如加工速度改善与中央执行—默认模式连接增强相关，突显—默认模式连接增强则与多项认知表现较差相关，但均未通过多重比较校正。作者据此认为，认知康复未伴随可检测的静息态网络连接改变，突显—默认模式连接或可作为网络分离减弱、认知功能受损的候选标记，仍需更大规模的多模态研究验证。

papers.title: cyto7: an open, vertex-level cortical type atlas of the human cortex
papers.authors: Salvador R, Mercadal B, Castaldo F, García-Cabezas MÁ, Ruffini G.
papers.abstract: The cerebral cortex is organized along a gradient of laminar complexity, indexed principally by the emergence and granularity of layer IV and by the size of layer III neuron somata, and cortical types are the ordered categories along it. The Structural Model builds on that gradient to predict laminar connectivity, plasticity and disease vulnerability 1,2 . Existing digital cortical-type maps are area-level: they assign one type per classical area and cannot represent a type boundary that runs through an area. We release cyto7, an open, vertex-level, seven-type cortical-type atlas delineated on the fsaverage surface following the García-Cabezas protocol and revised by the protocol’s authors. We distribute the atlas with a reusable quality-control and support framework. A topological audit reports the map against four spatial rules that follow from cortical type analysis and the dual origin of the neocortex theory: neighbouring vertices differ by at most one type, the least complex cortex forms one continuous limbic belt, eulaminate II forms a single matrix enclosing a few holes, and eulaminate III and koniocortex form isolated islands. These were imposed during construction rather than tested, and the audit reports what imposing them cost. A vertex-wise benchmark against the existing area-level map, one type per von Economo–Koskinas area, shows exact agreement at 52.5% of vertices, with disagreement almost always a single level and concentrated inside the large, heterogeneous areas that a single areal label cannot resolve. Where the two maps disagree, cyto7’s label better matches the independent multimodal profile in 60.1% of pooled feature-by-vertex comparisons, against 46% under a rotation null and 54% under granularity-matched alternative partitions ( p = 0.020), the harder of the two. A per-vertex anatomical support score, computed from anatomy alone, states how strongly each hand-drawn label is backed by the anatomical evidence, and is deliberately not a calibrated error probability. We then validate cyto7 against independent brain measures not used to define it, under a spatial-autocorrelation (spin) null with FDR control. Intracortical myelin (T1w/T2w) increases, cortical thickness decreases, and the principal functional-connectivity gradient reverses along the type axis (all q ≲ 0.006). Source-reconstructed resting-state MEG dynamics also track the axis: the intrinsic timescale shortens toward koniocortex ( ρ ≈ − 0.46) and survives the null, as do the spectral centroid and the slow/fast band-power ratio, whereas the aperiodic 1/f exponent does not. The laminar marker genes are where cyto7 differs most from a quantisation of a continuous map: it shows a larger absolute correlation with the layer-IV marker RORB ( ρ = +0.78) and the layer-V marker FEZF2 ( − 0.59) than seven-level septiles of myelin, of the functional gradient or of a histological gradient, on four of five markers, while tying or losing to those septiles on the macroscale proxies. These are larger observed associations against three tested quantisations, not a test that the differences between maps are reliable, and they do not establish the accuracy of any individual boundary. Defined from anatomy alone, cyto7 recovers the sensorimotor-to-association hierarchy and, on these markers, some of the laminar signal underlying it. It is released with its full pipeline and an uncalibrated anatomical support score as a reusable substrate for structure–function and modelling studies.

papers.title: Contextualizing the polygenic basis of human brain shape
papers.authors: Casas-Riu J, Boeckx C.
papers.abstract: As the most recently evolved neuroanatomical trait of our species, our globular head shape (‘globularity’) constitutes a promising point of entry to probe possible associations between brain morphology and cognitive traits that may be distinctive of Homo sapiens . To shed additional light on the underlying biology of globularity and its cognitive consequences, we capitalize on data pairing genetic variation to brain shape differences from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans of 34,595 adults of European ancestry, and embed genome-wide associations of globularity within genetic variation underpinning up to 75 brain-related traits. Through extensive hypergeometric tests, we observe significant associations between globularity and white matter traits at the gene level, but stronger associations with cerebellar volume, ventricular size, and the fornix at the genomic variant level. Combining conjunctional false discovery rate (FDR) with genetic correlations, we notice homogeneously concordant relations between globularity and the volume of the brain ventricles, and homogeneously discordant relations with glymphatic function. We also unravel more selective, spatially organized relations between globularity and cerebellar volume, white matter connectivity and sulcal width. Spatial permutation tests reveal that sulcal width associations are systematically distributed along a sensorimotor-association gradient of cortical organization. Additionally, correlations of brain - and lifespan -wise gene expression patterns linked to globularity and the brain ventricles highlight recurrent associations with the pentose phosphate metabolic pathway. Finally, deploying an open repository of genetic variant age estimations and an extensive catalog of single nucleotide changes distinguishing hominins, we uncover a coincidence between the establishment of globularity and the time of emergence of modifications in the cerebrospinal fluid proteome. Overall, we provide a finer-grained genetic architecture for globularity, with novel biological associations to traits across evolutionary and developmental timescales, leading us to draw implications for the early development of cognitive networks but also for liabilities to neurodegeneration late in life.

papers.title: Spontaneous slow waves index multiple dimensions of recovery in Disorders of Consciousness
papers.authors: Ruyant Belabbas A, Boullet A, Manasova D, Le Coz A, Valente M, Lejeune F, Sitt JD, Naccache L, Rohaut B, Andrillon T.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Whether and how residual awareness is expressed in patients with Disorders of Consciousness (DoC) depends on the severity of brain damage and the transient functional state of the cortex at assessment. Classically, DoC are associated with electroencephalographic (EEG) slowing, marked by high-amplitude slow waves, even during the day. Yet, slow waves are also a hallmark of healthy sleep, where they are thought to serve restorative functions and to help maintain network homeostasis. Here, we asked whether slow waves in DoC can provide insights into the severity of cortical dysfunction or, conversely, into the preservation of residual awareness and recovery potential, by characterizing their spatial, temporal and morphological properties. We analyzed 256-channel EEG recorded during the ‘Local-Global’ auditory paradigm in 236 DoC patients, including 123 in Unresponsive Wakefulness Syndrome (UWS), 62 in a Minimally Conscious State minus (MCS-) and 29 in MCS plus (MCS+). High-amplitude slow waves were detected as local events, and their density, amplitude and slopes were quantified scalp-wide and channel-wise, by mean level and temporal variability across the recording. Slow-wave features were related to concurrent (Coma Recovery Scale-Revised - CRS-R, ‘Local-Global’ paradigm) and follow-up (one-year Glasgow Outcome Scale-Extended - GOS-E) assessments of consciousness and functional recovery. Associations with MRI-derived measures of cortical integrity and structural connectivity, and differences between anoxic and traumatic etiologies, were also examined. Slow waves were more frequent in less severe DoC patients (i.e., MCS) compared to UWS. Slow-wave slopes were also steeper frontally and increased at a faster rate in patients exhibiting higher levels of consciousness and/or markers of conscious access during the ‘Local-Global’ paradigm. More frequent and steeper slow waves at baseline further predicted recovery of consciousness and of functional independence at one year. At the individual level, slow-wave features classified states of consciousness above chance (AUC = 0.62 and 0.71 for MCS- and MCS+ versus UWS), whereas outcome prediction remained modest (0.56-0.58). These clinical associations had a structural basis: slow-wave occurrence was greater after traumatic than anoxic injury and scaled with the integrity of subcortico-cortical projection fibers and consciousness-related cortical networks. Contrary to the classical view of delta activity as a non-specific marker of impaired consciousness, prominent spontaneous slow waves indexed behavioral and neurophysiological signs of awareness and better recovery. Beyond reflecting a propensity for pathological bistability, they may also signal the integrity of the networks required to generate them, together with their residual capacity for dynamic regulation. Highlights Spontaneous slow waves were detected as discrete local events in 236 DoC patients, moving beyond time-averaged spectral measures of cortical slowing. Slow-wave properties carried diagnostic information about the state of consciousness, whether defined behaviorally (CRS-R) or neurophysiologically (conscious access to auditory information in ‘Local-Global’ ERP paradigm). Slow wave frequency and slope during the acute phase in the ICU predicted improvement of consciousness state and recovery of functional independence at one year. Within-session ‘fatigue-like’ temporal modulation of slow waves increased with the level of consciousness recovery, being more pronounced in MCS+ than in UWS and MCS-patients. Slow-wave expression scaled with subcortico-cortical fibers and cortical network integrity, and was greater after traumatic than anoxic injury, suggesting they signal preserved network integrity rather than damage alone.
