papers.title: The effects of temporal smoothing and interpolation on EEG microstate parameters, syntax, and our view of resting-state brain dynamics
papers.authors: von Wegner F, Hermann G, Tödt I, Todtenhaupt IK, Laufs H.
papers.abstract: Microstate analysis studies dynamic brain activity through a discrete representation of electroencephalographic (EEG) signals and their topography. While the body of literature describing findings in diverse experimental and clinical settings is growing rapidly, the effects of several core components of the microstate algorithm are still insufficiently understood. This study systematically investigates how two common temporal smoothing algorithms, parametric smoothing and GFP peak interpolation, influence a wide range of microstate sequence parameters, and how they shape the integrated picture of brain dynamics inferred from these metrics. We study eyes-closed resting-state EEG recordings from N = 201 healthy subjects from a public EEG database. For the elementary temporal metrics, we find that widening smoothing windows markedly increase microstate duration, reduce occurrence rates, but leave coverage mostly unaffected. In terms of simple syntax properties, smoothing windows above 30 ms yield an inconsistent picture with a memoryless, first-order Markov structure at short time scales, but a positive Hurst phenomenon suggestive of long-range correlations at long time scales. Evidence of asymmetry and non-equilibrium dynamics are suppressed by smoothing. At intermediate time scales, microstate periodicity was only observed up to a window size of 28 ms. Smoothing had a strong impact on the complexity metrics entropy rate and excess entropy, decreasing the former and increasing the latter. For most metrics, the effects of GFP peak interpolation were comparable to those of smoothing windows in the range between 28 ms and 44 ms. In conclusion, elementary and higher-order microstate parameters must be interpreted in the context of preprocessing, as many parameters change continuously with smoothing intensity. This limits the comparability of microstate parameters obtained with different preprocessing settings. Strong smoothing with a window size above 30 ms or GFP peak interpolation yields a fundamentally different picture of resting state brain dynamics, i.e. that of a memoryless, aperiodic, time-reversible first-order Markov chain. Since insights from other neurophysiological modalities suggest that time series memory and time-irreversibility are markers of normal brain activity, our recommendation is to avoid intense smoothing to minimize alterations of the initial sequences.

papers.title: Dual ecological-cultural pathways of sociocultural environment and resting state functional connectivity among Hispanic adolescents in the ABCD Study
papers.authors: Laird AR, Hampson CL, Lembo M, Bottenhorn KL, Sukumaran K, Cardenas-Iniguez C, Thompson E, Adise S, Sanchez M, Gonzalez R, Herting MM, Meca A.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hispanic Americans face persistent health disparities rooted in complex sociocultural and bioecodevelopmental dynamics. Identifying early neurodevelopmental trajectories that confer risk or resilience during adolescence is critical for developing targeted health equity interventions. Grounded in the NIMHD Research Framework and bioecodevelopmental theory, data from 12- to 14-year-old Hispanic adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study were analyzed (n=236). Partial least squares correlation (PLSC) was used to evaluate multivariate associations between sociocultural measures—spanning individual, family, and community levels—and resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) networks. Post hoc linear mixed-effects models examined how derived sociocultural-rsFC patterns predicted measures of physical and mental health, linking bioecodevelopmental patterns to adolescent well-being. PLSC revealed dual community- and family-level neural pathways of biological embedding, diverging from traditional nested bioecodevelopmental assumptions. The community pathway linked child opportunity and neighborhood disadvantage to connectivity across Cingulo-Opercular, Default, Dorsal Attention, Visual Networks. This community-rsFC profile was associated with lower respiratory functioning, reflecting an allostatic load marker of environmental stress. The family pathway linked caregiver ethnic identity and heritage acculturation to Default, Ventral Attention, Sensorimotor-Mouth, and Visual Networks connectivity, suggesting that the family system shapes neural systems underlying social attunement and identity formation. Structural community factors and familial culture impose distinct neurobiological demands on the adolescent connectome among Hispanic youth. Findings highlight respiratory health as a biological marker of environmental adversity and underscore the necessity of structural and culturally sustaining interventions to promote health equity among Hispanic youth.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ABCD研究中12至14岁西班牙裔青少年的数据，用偏最小二乘相关分析考察个体、家庭和社区层面的社会文化指标与静息态功能连接之间的多变量关联，并用混合效应模型检验由此得到的模式与身心健康的关系。结果发现两条并行的“生物嵌入”路径：社区路径将儿童机会和邻里劣势与多个网络连接联系起来，该连接特征与较低的呼吸功能相关，被视为环境压力的稳态负荷标志；家庭路径则将照护者民族认同和传统涵化与涉及社会调谐和身份形成的网络连接联系起来。作者据此指出，结构性社区因素与家庭文化对青少年连接组提出不同的神经生物学要求，并强调呼吸健康可作为环境不利的生物标志，以及结构性干预和文化支持性干预对促进健康公平的必要性。需注意这些是关联性发现，不能据此推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Research on dynamic functional connectivity and graph theoretic features of different motor subtypes in Parkinson's disease based on ICA.
papers.authors: Tang J, Gao S, Lv Y, Wang H, Liu Y, Zhou H, Yuan J, Lin X, Hu M, Cong Y, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Objective This study combined independent component analysis (ICA)-derived dynamic functional connectivity (dFNC) with dynamic graph theory analysis methods to analyze the changes in dFNC and dynamic graph theoretic indicators in different motor subtypes of Parkinson's disease (PD)-tremor-dominant (TD) subtype and postural instability/gait difficulty (PIGD) subtype-and healthy controls (HC). We aimed to explore the neural circuitry abnormal mechanisms and differences between the two subtypes. Methods Using a prospective observational study design, from January 2021 to May 2024 at Northern Jiangsu People's Hospital, we enrolled 36 diagnosed PD patients according to inclusion criteria-19 patients with PIGD subtype and 17 patients with TD subtype-along with 19 healthy subjects matched for age, sex, and education level. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), demographic information, and clinical motor function assessment data were collected from all participants. The ICA and dynamic functional network connectivity (dFNC) analysis were performed using the GIFT toolbox platform based on MATLAB. Combined with dynamic graph theory analysis, features such as characteristic path length, clustering coefficient, and node degree were extracted. The dFNC and dynamic graph theoretic indicators of the PIGD group, TD group, and HC group were compared horizontally to clarify the common and specific dynamic abnormalities of brain networks between the two subtypes. Results Nine functional brain networks were identified through ICA. Significant differences among the three groups were observed in five brain networks: auditory network, left frontoparietal network, right frontoparietal network, ventral attention network, and sensorimotor network. Based on network-to-network functional connectivity analysis using these nine functional brain networks, after strict FDR correction, only inter-network coupling strength between the auditory network and sensorimotor network showed significant group differences (T = 7.548, FDR-corrected p = 0.00137). Four recurring functional connectivity states were identified through dFNC analysis. Across all participants, State 2 and State 3 accounted for 38 and 23% of total time, respectively. PIGD patients tended to spend more time in these two low-connectivity states. In terms of temporal properties, only the occurrence frequency of state 4 showed significant differences among the three groups (F = 4.855, FDR-corrected p = 0.047). Post-hoc test results showed that HC groups were significantly higher than PIGD groups and presented a trend higher than TD groups, while there was no statistically significant difference between the two PD subtypes. One-way analysis of variance was performed on whole-brain node-to-node functional connectivity and graph theoretic attributes of the three groups; no significant differences were found after FDR correction. Conclusion Compared with the HC group, PD patients (both TD and PIGD groups) exhibited spatial distribution abnormalities in multiple brain networks. Nominally significant alterations suggestive of compensatory activation of the motor cortex were observed at the uncorrected statistical level, alongside weakened functional connectivity in specific networks.

papers.title: Tractography-Based Predictors of Poststroke Aphasia: A Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Narimani M, Kiani I, Ghorani H, Seraj P, Cho A, Tsang D, Lalwani K, Hillis A, Lakhani DA, Dmytriw AA, Hui F, Luna L, Yedavalli V.
papers.abstract: Background Poststroke aphasia is a common and disabling consequence of ischemic stroke, affecting communication and quality of life. Early identification of patients at risk is essential for prognosis and rehabilitation planning. Diffusion tractography has recently been used to map white matter pathways implicated in language processing and to evaluate their predictive value for poststroke aphasia. Purpose In this study, we aimed to evaluate the prognostic value of DTI characteristics of key white matter tracts. Data sources A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Embase, and Scopus until April 2025. Study selection We considered studies eligible if they used diffusion MRI tractography to assess structural language pathways in patients with stroke and investigated their association with poststroke aphasia occurrence or severity. Data analysis Extracted data included study characteristics, tractography methodology, language assessment tools, and key imaging findings, including tract specific diffusion metrics and tractography derived measures. Because of data insufficiency, qualitative synthesis was conducted. Data synthesis Twenty-one studies comprising 550 patients with poststroke aphasia were included. Participants were predominantly older adults, with mean/median ages generally in the late 50s to early 70s. Baseline NIHSS values were commonly in the ∼5-14 range. The timing of diffusion/DTI acquisition varied substantially, spanning hyperacute/acute imaging, early subacute assessments, and later evaluations in the chronic phase. Studies identified left arcuate fasciculus integrity, fractional anisotropy, axial diffusivity, or reconstruction status as the strongest single predictor of aphasia severity and recovery. Loss of arcuate fasciculus reconstruction was associated with markedly lower follow-up Western Aphasia Battery Aphasia Quotient. Ventral stream involvement added prognostic value in several studies. Right hemisphere contributions were inconsistent, although higher callosal anisotropy predicted comprehension gains in 1 cohort. Overall, tract specific microstructure improved prognostic models beyond lesion volume or NIHSS, accounting for an additional 12%-29% of outcome variance in several multivariate analyses. Limitations Methodologic variability limited cross-study comparability and precluded quantitative pooling and, as a result, generalizability. Conclusions Tractography provides valuable insights into the structural substrates of poststroke aphasia, with the arcuate fasciculus emerging as the most robust predictor. Standardization of tractography protocols and multicenter validation are needed before routine clinical translation.

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统检索并定性汇总了利用弥散磁共振纤维束成像评估卒中后失语结构语言通路预后价值的研究。纳入研究多显示，左侧弓状束的完整性、各向异性及重建状态是与失语严重程度和恢复相关的最稳健预测指标，腹侧通路可提供额外预后信息，右半球贡献则不一致；部分多变量分析中，纤维束特异性微结构指标在病灶体积或卒中量表之外改善了预后模型。作者同时指出，方法学差异限制了研究间可比性和结论推广，纤维束成像方案标准化及多中心验证仍是常规临床应用前的必要步骤。

papers.title: Energy landscape and dynamic state modeling for schizophrenia biomarker extraction in task-based fMRI.
papers.authors: Allen JD, Hong E, Choa FS.
papers.abstract: Task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) examines how the brain dynamically responds to cognitive and perceptual demands, offering complementary insight beyond traditional activation-based analyses in schizophrenia. Prior task-based fMRI studies have identified reduced functional connectivity within auditory and associated cortical areas. In this study, we investigated task-evoked functional connectivity and brain state dynamics in 25 healthy controls, 23 patients with schizophrenia experiencing auditory verbal hallucinations (AVH+), and 23 patients without hallucinations (AVH-). Participants completed multiple auditory paradigms, including word lists, sentence lists, and reverse speech. The most robust connectivity differences emerged during the word list task, where cluster-level analyses revealed distinct network interaction patterns differentiating controls, AVH + , and AVH-patients. Energy landscape modeling further demonstrated altered stability and organization of brain states in both patient groups, with the largest deviations observed in AVH+ individuals. These alterations point to dysregulated neural dynamics linked to hallucination vulnerability. Overall, the results show that task-based fMRI sensitively captures disruptions in functional connectivity and brain state stability relevant to auditory hallucinations, underscoring its value for characterizing network-level mechanisms underlying perceptual disturbances in schizophrenia.

papers.title: Scalp acupuncture coupled with speech-language therapy modulates the ventral-dorsal structural brain network in patients with post-stroke anomia: a randomized clinical and DTI neuroimaging trial.
papers.authors: Song J, Nan R, Ni J, Chai L, Zhang L, Wang M, Wang N, Lin B, Huang J.
papers.abstract: Background Scalp acupuncture (SA) is used as adjunctive rehabilitation for post-stroke aphasia, but its effect on naming recovery and structural language-network changes remains unclear. We evaluated SA coupled with speech-language therapy (SLT) in patients with post-stroke anomia and explored diffusion tensor imaging markers of ventral-dorsal structural language networks. Methods This randomized controlled trial recruited 85 patients with post-stroke anomia and randomly assigned them to SA or control. Both groups received conventional stroke treatment and SLT; the SA group additionally received scalp acupuncture synchronously with SLT during needle retention. Treatment was delivered once daily, 5 days/week for 4 weeks. The primary outcome was WAB naming total score. Diffusion tensor imaging assessed white matter integrity and topological properties before and after treatment. Results Compared to the control group, the SA group showed greater improvements in the WAB naming total score (P = 0.009), object naming, sentence completion, responsive speech, BNT spontaneous naming, and SAQOL-39 communication. In the ventral-dorsal structural network, the SA group showed smaller changes in the area under the curve (AUC) of small-worldness properties (P = 0.008) and normalized clustering coefficient (P = 0.017), and greater changes in clustering coefficient and local efficiency. In the SA group, the change in small-worldness was negatively correlated with the change in the WAB naming total score (r = -0.451, P = 0.027). The SA group also showed smaller axial diffusivity (AD) changes in the left uncinate fasciculus (P = 0.003, Bonferroni corrected), which correlated negatively with the WAB naming total score change (r = -0.440, P = 0.031). Exploratory adjusted regression showed that SA-group assignment was associated with greater naming improvement after adjustment for baseline naming and clinical covariates. Conclusions SA coupled with SLT was associated with greater naming recovery in patients with post-stroke anomia. The benefit was accompanied by changes in structural language-network topology and white matter integrity, particularly involving the left UF. These findings support further evaluation of scalp acupuncture as an adjunct to language rehabilitation and suggest structural network plasticity as a relevant imaging correlate.
keywords: Ventral And Dorsal Structural Language Network

relevance.reason: 卒中后命名障碍患者语言康复伴随左侧钩束及语言结构网络拓扑可塑性，属语言机制与脑结构及疾病重组研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验纳入卒中后命名障碍患者，比较在言语语言治疗基础上同步加用头皮针与单纯言语语言治疗对命名恢复及腹侧-背侧结构语言网络的影响。结果显示，头皮针组在命名总分及多项命名相关指标上改善更明显，同时结构网络的拓扑属性和白质完整性出现组间差异，主要涉及左侧钩束，且部分网络指标变化与命名改善相关。作者据此认为，头皮针作为语言康复辅助手段与更好的命名恢复相关，结构网络可塑性可能是相应的影像学关联，但相关关系不等于因果，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: A randomized pilot trial of non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation: EEG activity and cognitive outcomes in cognitively normal older adults.
papers.authors: Cheng CH, Lu H.
papers.abstract: BackgroundGamma-frequency (40 Hz) sensory stimulation is a promising non-pharmacological approach for modulating neural activity and cognitive function in aging and Alzheimer's disease. However, conventional flickering stimulation is often poorly tolerated, and evidence for non-flickering approaches remains limited.ObjectiveTo evaluate the neurophysiological and cognitive effects of 4-week (28-session) non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation in cognitively normal older adults.MethodsIn this randomized, double-blind, active-controlled pilot trial, 33 cognitively normal older adults were assigned to receive either non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation (n = 17) or a 70 Hz active-controlled condition (n = 16) over four weeks. Per-protocol analyses were conducted in 29 participants who completed the intervention. Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) was acquired at baseline, immediately after the first intervention session, and after completion of the 4-week intervention. Neuropsychological assessments were performed at baseline and after the intervention. Prespecified primary outcomes were resting-state gamma-band power spectral density (PSD) and functional connectivity (FC).ResultsNo significant between-group differences were observed in resting-state gamma-band PSD or FC following either one-session or 28-session intervention. Unadjusted secondary analyses suggested potential improvements in selected episodic memory measures in the 40 Hz group. Exploratory analyses further identified a positive association between improvements in visuospatial memory and increases in occipital-temporal FC. Both interventions were well tolerated.ConclusionsA 28-session non-flickering 40 Hz light stimulation was well tolerated and may improve selected episodic memory measures in cognitively normal older adults. Although no measurable group-level EEG effects were observed, the exploratory cognitive findings warrant further investigation in larger randomized trials.ClinicalTrial.gov (ID: NCT06715995) https://clinicaltrials.gov/expert-search?term=NCT06715995.

papers.summary_zh: 该随机双盲主动对照预试验在认知正常的老年人中比较无闪烁40 Hz光刺激与70 Hz对照条件，评估四周干预对静息态脑电和认知的影响。预设主要指标即伽马频段功率谱密度和功能连接，在单次及28次干预后均未发现显著组间差异；未校正的次要分析提示40 Hz组部分情景记忆指标可能改善，探索性分析还发现视空间记忆改善与枕颞功能连接增加相关。两种干预耐受性均良好。作者据此认为无闪烁40 Hz光刺激安全可行，但脑电层面未见可测效应，认知方面的初步线索需在更大规模随机试验中验证。

papers.title: Neuroanatomical correlates of the CDT-14: A voxel-based morphometry study exploring incremental information beyond conventional clock drawing scores.
papers.authors: Sawada Y, Satoh T, Saba H, Kato Y, Kuwada T, Shima S, Murakami K, Sasaki M, Abe Y, Harano K.
papers.abstract: BackgroundThe Clock Drawing Test (CDT) is widely used for cognitive screening but lacks unified scoring standards and neuroanatomical validation.ObjectiveWe examined the neuroanatomical correlates and incremental validity beyond conventional CDT scoring of CDT-14, a psychometrically refined 14-item system with three subfactors (Circle, Numbering, and Hand), using voxel-based morphometry (VBM).MethodsWe analyzed 985 participants from a heterogeneous memory-clinic cohort. Whole-brain VBM compared CDT-14 total and subfactor scores with three conventional scoring systems. Models adjusted for age, sex, education level, and total intracranial volume. Incremental validity was assessed after controlling for a principal-component-derived conventional composite score, with sensitivity analyses adjusting for white matter lesion volume (WMLV).ResultsCDT-14 was associated with gray matter volume (GMV) in distributed clock-drawing regions, including the right anterior hippocampus, parahippocampal gyrus, bilateral precuneus, and prefrontal regions. Primary incremental analyses identified additional associations in bilateral ventral temporal, right occipito-temporal, and dorsal anterior cingulate regions after accounting for conventional CDT performance. These associations were attenuated after WMLV adjustment, and no clusters survived FWE correction in the WMLV-adjusted incremental model. Subfactor analyses suggested partially distinct but overlapping patterns involving frontostriatal and cingulate regions for Circle, thalamic and limbic-related regions for Numbering, and hippocampal, parietal, and occipital regions for Hand.ConclusionsCDT-14 showed cross-sectional GMV associations beyond conventional scoring in primary analyses. However, the incremental associations were not robust to WMLV adjustment at the FWE-corrected threshold and should be interpreted cautiously. Longitudinal, biomarker-informed, and externally validated studies are needed to establish predictive validity, disease specificity, and clinical utility.

relevance.reason: 用VBM考察画钟测验得分与灰质体积的神经解剖关联，属认知筛查任务的脑结构基础研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于记忆门诊的异质性队列，用基于体素的形态学分析考察CDT-14总分及各子因子得分与灰质体积的关联，并与三种传统时钟画钟评分系统比较。结果显示，CDT-14与右侧前海马、海马旁回、双侧楔前叶及前额叶等区域的灰质体积相关；在控制传统评分后，初步分析还发现双侧腹侧颞叶、右侧枕颞区和背侧前扣带等区域的额外关联。但校正白质病变体积后这些增量关联明显减弱，且无簇通过FWE校正，说明其增量效度尚不稳健，需谨慎解读，并需纵向和外部验证研究进一步确认。

papers.title: Topographical Patterns of Slow Wave Activity in Sleep Talking: An Exploratory Polysomnographic Investigation.
papers.authors: Pellegrini E, Camaioni M, Mangiaruga A, Pumo D, Alfonsi V, Annarumma L, Scarpelli S, Sanguineti C, Castelnovo A, De Gennaro L, D'Agostino A, Gorgoni M.
papers.abstract: Sleep talking (ST) is a parasomnia characterized by the utterance of unaware linguistic activations during sleep. Electrophysiological evidence is scarce, and it remains unclear whether local electroencephalographic (EEG) alterations characterize the sleep of STs outside of parasomnia episodes. Findings from NREM parasomnias suggest that local slow-wave activity (SWA) abnormalities may characterize a full night's sleep beyond behavioural manifestations. Accordingly, this study investigates SWA topography and the spatial distribution of the single SWA bins across sleep stages in a group of 12 young STs compared to 10 healthy controls (HCs) matched for sex and age, who underwent overnight laboratory polysomnographic recordings. The relationship between SWA pattern and parasomnia frequency was explored, and the overnight decline in SWA was examined to assess the potential impact of homeostatic processes. Our findings point to a peculiar SWA pattern characterized by a substantially stable central increase across sleep stages and a frontopolar decrease primarily in N2 sleep, suggesting a local and frequency-specific (≥ 1 Hz) SWA regulation in STs that may interact with homeostatic processes. These results provide new insights into the sleep electrophysiology of STs and shed light on trait-like regional alterations in SWA that may facilitate parasomnia events. Our findings align with the concept of local sleep, which posits that distinct cortical regions may simultaneously exhibit diverse functional states. In this view, different parasomnias may be characterized by specific SWA topographical patterns reflecting the peculiar behaviours enacted during sleep.

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究比较了12名年轻睡语者与10名性别年龄匹配的健康对照者的整夜多导睡眠图，考察睡语者在不发生睡语发作时是否也存在局部脑电改变，重点分析慢波活动的空间分布及其随睡眠阶段的变化。结果显示，睡语者表现出一种较稳定的慢波活动地形模式：中央区慢波活动在各睡眠阶段普遍偏高，而额极区活动主要于N2期降低，提示其慢波活动存在局部且频率特异的调控，并可能与稳态过程相互作用。作者据此认为，这类类似特质性的区域慢波改变可能为睡语事件的发生提供条件，也与“局部睡眠”的观点相符，即不同皮层区域可同时处于不同功能状态。

papers.title: Cholinergic contributions to speech-in-noise processing in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: McCaslin DL, Roytman S, NeCamp T, Berri B, Brown T, Barr J, Kanel P, Carli G, Bohnen N.
papers.abstract: Speech perception performance in challenging listening environments declines with age and is particularly impaired in Parkinson's disease, leading to communication difficulties and cognitive strain. Although peripheral hearing loss contributes to these deficits, dysfunction of the central cholinergic system may play a key role. Parkinson's disease is characterized by early and widespread cholinergic degeneration. Accordingly, further describing the contribution of cholinergic integrity to functional hearing may offer better insight into the mechanistic link between sensory and cognitive decline and inform targeted therapeutic approaches. Twenty-nine individuals with Parkinson's disease (20 men, nine women; age range 60-76 years) were enrolled in a cross-sectional study conducted at the University of Michigan Functional Neuroimaging, Cognitive and Mobility Laboratory. Participants completed pure-tone audiometry, tympanometry and Quick Speech-in-Noise testing to assess peripheral and functional hearing. Cholinergic system integrity was quantified using [18 F]-fluoroethoxybenzovesamicol [18 F]-FEOBV positron emission tomography imaging, and magnetic resonance imaging was used for anatomical co-registration. Statistical parametric mapping identified regions where cholinergic binding correlated with speech-in-noise performance after adjusting for high-frequency pure-tone average thresholds. Multiple regression and hierarchical model comparisons tested independent and interactive effects of peripheral hearing and cholinergic integrity. High-frequency pure-tone average explained 21.6% of the variance in Quick Speech-in-Noise signal-to-noise ratio loss [β = 0.494 (0.151-0.838), P = 0.006]. After adjustment for hearing thresholds, reduced [18 F]-FEOBV binding in auditory, thalamic, temporoparietal and cerebellar regions was significantly associated with greater signal-to-noise ratio loss (cluster-level family-wise error corrected P < 0.01). Cholinergic integrity accounted for an additional 27.5% of the variance beyond peripheral hearing [F = 15.596, P < 0.001; β = -0.533 (-0.811 to -0.256), P = 0.001]. An interaction between hearing thresholds and cholinergic integrity explained a further 12.7% of the variance (F = 9.671, P = 0.005), showing that higher cholinergic integrity mitigated the detrimental effects of hearing loss on speech-in-noise understanding. Observed effects were found to be independent of age and global cognition in the post hoc confounder regression analysis. Central cholinergic integrity is a major determinant of speech-in-noise performance in Parkinson's disease, acting both independently and interactively with peripheral hearing function. These findings indicate that speech-in-noise deficits may reflect early subcortical and cortical cholinergic dysfunction rather than only peripheral auditory decline. Recognition of this relationship underscores the potential for cholinergic-enhancing or neurostimulation-based therapies to improve communication and cognitive outcomes in neurodegenerative disorders.

relevance.reason: 该研究在帕金森病患者中结合PET与MRI，揭示中枢胆碱能系统完整性与噪声下言语感知表现的脑机制关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察帕金森病患者中枢胆碱能系统完整性与噪声下言语识别的关系，结合纯音测听、噪声下言语测试和胆碱能PET成像，在控制外周听力后分析脑内胆碱能结合与言语识别表现的联系。结果显示，外周高频听力损失只能解释部分表现差异，而听觉、丘脑、颞顶及小脑等区域胆碱能结合降低与噪声下言语识别变差独立相关，并额外解释相当一部分变异；听力损失与胆碱能完整性之间还存在交互作用，胆碱能完整性较高时听力损失的不利影响相对减弱。作者据此认为，帕金森病患者的噪声下言语困难可能不只源于外周听觉下降，还涉及中枢胆碱能功能失调，这为胆碱能增强或神经调控类干预提供了机制线索，但相关治疗潜力尚待干预研究验证。

papers.title: Tegmental atrophy in isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder: ex vivo MRI-informed in vivo imaging.
papers.authors: Hirose M, Yoshinaga K, Mori Y, Shima A, Sawamoto N, Wakasugi N, Imai H, Watanabe M, Beck G, Kajiyama Y, Nishiike U, Mochizuki H, Kawabata K, Hiraga K, Nakamura T, Katsuno M, Watanabe H, Hatano T, Kamagata K, Hattori N, Nishida A, Mukai Y, Minakawa EN, Takahashi Y, Takahashi R, Hanakawa T.
papers.abstract: Isolated rapid eye movement (REM) sleep behaviour disorder (iRBD) is an early-stage synucleinopathy characterized by brainstem pathology. In rodents, the pontine tegmentum contains a REM sleep centre, the sublaterodorsal nucleus, which expresses corticotropin-releasing hormone binding protein (CRHBP). While the involvement of brainstem pathophysiology is thus implicated in iRBD, its solid evidence remains scarce in humans due to the difficulty in identifying small brainstem nuclei with conventional MRI technology alone. Here, we aimed to detect tegmental atrophy in iRBD with voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis combined with a novel human brainstem atlas. Structural MRIs from 98 patients with iRBD and 114 controls were analysed to investigate grey matter volume using VBM. Our unique approach involved detailed assessments of the VBM results, guided by a high-resolution MRI-based atlas of the human brainstem. This brainstem atlas was founded on ex vivo MRI of 10 post-mortem human specimens. We validated it with CRHBP immunostaining, which aided in identifying putative REM sleep-regulating nuclei in humans. We applied this brainstem atlas to identify atrophy in specific brainstem regions in iRBD and correlate their volumes with clinical and polysomnographic measures. Voxel-based morphometry revealed a focal cluster of grey matter atrophy in the dorsal pontine tegmentum of iRBD patients, including the laterodorsal tegmental nucleus, ventral part (LDTgV) and the pedunculopontine tegmental nucleus (PTg). Our atlas-based analysis confirmed the LDTgV as the site of most conspicuous atrophy, revealing a significant volume reduction in iRBD patients compared with controls with a moderate effect size (Cohen's d = 0.44, Bonferroni-corrected P = 0.019). Furthermore, greater atrophy in the LDTgV and the PTg was associated with more severe autonomic dysfunction as measured by Scales for Outcomes in Parkinson's Disease-Autonomic dysfunction scores (partial r = -0.237, P = 0.021 and partial r = -0.236, P = 0.021, respectively). In 23 patients from whom quantitative polysomnographic data were available, LDTgV atrophy was correlated with the percentage ratio of REM sleep without atonia (partial r = -0.491, P = 0.028). Histological analysis confirmed that the LDTgV is selectively enriched with CRHBP-positive neurons, a putative marker for REM sleep-on neurons. We provided novel evidence for the involvement of LDTgV, the putative human homologue of the murine sublaterodorsal nucleus, in iRBD. The present findings advance our understanding of the neuroanatomical basis of iRBD and will contribute to the development of early biomarkers for α-synucleinopathies.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注孤立性快速眼动睡眠行为障碍（iRBD）是否存在脑干被盖萎缩，结合基于体素的形态学分析与经尸检标本MRI和CRHBP免疫染色验证的人脑干图谱，比较了患者与对照的结构MRI。结果发现患者背侧脑桥被盖出现局灶性灰质萎缩，图谱分析进一步确认背侧被盖核腹侧部（LDTgV）萎缩最明显，且该区域及脚桥被盖核的萎缩程度与自主神经功能障碍更严重相关，部分患者的LDTgV萎缩还与REM睡眠期肌张力缺失比例相关。作者据此提出LDTgV可能是小鼠亚背侧核的人类对应结构，为理解iRBD的神经解剖基础提供了证据，但相关关系不等于因果，其作为早期生物标志物的价值尚待验证。

papers.title: Anxiety sensitivity, psychological vulnerability, and brain volumes in borderline personality disorder.
papers.authors: Kılıçaslan AK, Uğur K, Sun T, Taşçı İ, Maçin G, Yıldız S.
papers.abstract: Aim This study compared AS, psychological vulnerability, and brain volumes in BPD and healthy controls and examined clinical-volumetric associations within BPD. Method Twenty-seven patients with BPD and 28 healthy controls completed the Anxiety Sensitivity Index-3 and the Psychological Vulnerability Scale. Three-dimensional T1-weighted images were acquired using a 1.5-Tesla MRI scanner, and regional volumes were calculated. Results In raw analyses, the BPD group had higher psychological vulnerability and total, cognitive, and social AS scores. After covariate adjustment, only social AS remained significant (p = 0.035). Bilateral putamen, anterior insula, caudate, nucleus accumbens, and total gray matter volumes were larger in the BPD group, persisting after adjustment (all p ≤ 0.018). Differences in left amygdala, posterior and total insula, posterior cingulate gyrus, and white matter volumes lost significance after adjustment. In the BPD group, posterior insula volumes were negatively correlated with total and social AS scores, remaining significant after controlling for confounders (r=-0.471 to -0.611; p = 0.004-0.036). Psychological vulnerability and cognitive AS were not associated with regional volumes. Conclusion Social AS may represent a specific dimension of BPD. Group-level differences in anterior insula and striatal volumes, together with dimensional associations between posterior insula volumes and AS, suggest distinct roles for insular subregions in BPD-related clinical and structural processes.

relevance.reason: 以BPD患者为对象，报告脑区灰质体积差异及与焦虑敏感性的结构-临床关联，属脑疾病结构机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了边缘型人格障碍患者与健康对照者的焦虑敏感性、心理脆弱性和脑区体积，并考察患者组内临床特征与脑体积的关联。结果发现，患者组心理脆弱感及焦虑敏感性总体、认知和社会维度得分均较高，但协变量调整后仅社会焦虑敏感性仍显著；双侧壳核、前岛叶、尾状核、伏隔核及总灰质体积也较大，且调整后仍存在。在患者组内，后岛叶体积与总体及社会焦虑敏感性呈负相关，心理脆弱感和认知焦虑敏感性则与脑区体积无关。作者据此认为，社会焦虑敏感性可能是边缘型人格障碍的一个特定维度，而前岛叶、纹状体体积的组间差异与后岛叶体积和焦虑敏感性的维度关联，提示岛叶亚区在该障碍的临床与结构过程中可能扮演不同角色。

papers.title: Intracerebral stimulation inducing emotions in SEEG: a systematic review.
papers.authors: Arrighi L, Bartolomei F, Pizzo F.
papers.abstract: Background Direct intracerebral electrical stimulation during SEEG offers a unique opportunity to explore the neural correlates of human emotional experience, yet data on stimulation-induced emotions remain scattered and no systematic review has specifically addressed this topic. Objective To systematically review subjective emotional responses induced by SEEG stimulation and characterize their anatomical distribution, valence, hemispheric lateralization, and relationship with stimulation parameters. Methods A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and ScienceDirect was conducted for studies published up to June 30, 2025. Data were extracted on stimulated regions, emotional valence, laterality, and stimulation parameters. Results Thirty-four publications (21 cohort studies, 13 clinical cases) were included, encompassing 2434 patients and 14,492 total stimulations, with only 3.0% inducing subjective emotional responses. Emotional effects were predominantly negative (78.1%). Temporo-mesial and temporo-basal regions were mainly associated with negative emotions, whereas cingulo-frontal and subcortical regions showed a significant overrepresentation of positive responses relative to the overall corpus distribution; the insula exhibited no preferential valence. Hemispheric asymmetries were largely non-significant. An exploratory analysis revealed a directional trend toward higher intensities for negative responses, which did not survive intra-study normalization; total delivered charge yielded heterogeneous results. Conclusion SEEG-induced emotional responses are rare but display region-dependent valence profiles. The relationship between stimulation parameters and emotional valence proved complex underscoring the need for prospective intra-patient titration studies. These findings contribute to a network-based understanding of stimulation-induced emotions with implications for affective neuromodulation.

relevance.reason: 系统综述SEEG颅内电刺激诱发情绪反应及其脑区分布与偏侧化，直接研究人脑情绪体验的神经基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统检索了立体脑电（SEEG）颅内电刺激诱发主观情绪反应的文献，旨在梳理这类反应在脑区分布、情绪效价、半球偏侧化及与刺激参数关系上的特征。纳入研究显示，刺激诱发情绪反应总体少见，且以负性情绪为主；颞内侧和颞底区域主要与负性情绪相关，扣带额叶及皮层下区域的正性反应相对整体分布明显偏多，岛叶则未见效价偏好，半球间不对称大多不显著。作者指出，刺激参数与情绪效价的关系较为复杂，探索性分析中负性反应对应更高刺激强度的趋势在组内标准化后不再成立，提示仍需前瞻性的患者内滴定研究，并据此讨论了对情绪神经调控和基于网络的理解的意义。

papers.title: The brain before the herd: Pre-Decision EEG prediction of herd-consistent investment choices among bilingual investors.
papers.authors: Loang OK, Jiyang H, Azar AS.
papers.abstract: This study examines whether pre-decision electroencephalographic (EEG) activity provides incremental information for explaining and predicting herd-consistent investment choices when social and fundamental signals conflict. A controlled 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 within-participant factorial experiment involving 80 English-Mandarin bilingual Chinese investors who met a predefined English-proficiency threshold equivalent to IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 80 and had prior experience in U.S. equity markets manipulated language, information format, social-media sentiment, and information consistency. Herd-consistent choice was conservatively defined as alignment with the social signal when it contradicted fundamental information. Behavioural and single-trial EEG responses were analysed using mixed-effects models, while machine-learning models were evaluated through nested participant-disjoint validation. The findings indicate that Mandarin-language presentation and short-form financial information are associated with greater conformity to social signals under informational conflict. Conflict between social and fundamental information also elicits stronger frontal-midline theta activity, consistent with heightened demands on cognitive control and conflict monitoring before choice. Pre-decision P300 and theta provide distinct predictive information beyond contextual and participant characteristics, indicating that attentional updating and conflict processing contribute differently to subsequent herd-consistent decisions. These findings support a process-based account of investment conformity in which information architecture, social influence, and pre-decision neurocognitive processing jointly shape herd-consistent choices.

relevance.reason: 研究双语投资者在语言操纵下决策前的EEG（额中线theta、P300）与从众选择，涉及语言呈现对认知控制/冲突监测的影响，属决策与语言加工的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在社会信号与基本面信息冲突时，决策前脑电活动能否为解释和预测从众一致的投资选择提供增量信息。80名中英双语中国投资者完成语言、信息格式、社交媒体情绪和信息一致性四因素被试内实验，行为与单试次脑电用混合效应模型分析，预测模型采用被试间嵌套验证。结果显示，普通话呈现和简短财务信息与更强的社会信号从众相关；社会与基本面信息冲突时额中线theta增强，提示决策前认知控制与冲突监测需求上升；决策前P300和theta在情境及个体特征之外提供独立预测信息，表明注意更新与冲突加工对后续从众选择的作用不同。作者据此提出，信息架构、社会影响与决策前神经认知加工共同塑造从众一致选择。

papers.title: Delirium after Aortic Arch Surgery with Hypothermic Circulatory Arrest: Clinical and Neuroimaging Insights from the GOT ICE Randomized Trial.
papers.authors: Hughes GC, Browndyke JN, Chen EP, Szeto WY, DiMaio JM, Brinkman WT, Markovic J, Gaca JG, Blumenthal JA, Karhausen JA, James ML, Yanez D, Li YJ, Mathew JP.
papers.abstract: Background Postoperative delirium (POD) is a complication of arch surgery with hypothermic circulatory arrest (HCA) and may contribute to long-term cognitive decline, but prospective data are limited. We examined its incidence, predictors, and neurocognitive and neuroimaging correlates. Methods The Cognitive Effects of Body Temperature During Hypothermic Circulatory Arrest trial compared deep versus moderate hypothermia during elective arch repair. Delirium was assessed preoperatively and on postoperative days 1-3 using the Confusion Assessment Method. Thirty-day outcomes, cognition, quality of life, and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging at 4 weeks and 1 year were compared by POD status. Results Of 269 patients with complete assessments, POD occurred in 34.6% and did not differ significantly between hypothermia groups (p=0.45). Patients with POD had higher stroke rates (9.7% vs 0.6%; p<0.001), prolonged ventilation (3.2% vs. 0%; p=0.017), and longer hospitalization (8.5 vs. 5.9 days; p<0.001). Affected patients had worse cognition and quality of life (p<0.001) at 30 days, with partial recovery at 1 year. Baseline imaging demonstrated reduced thalamo-cerebellar connectivity in patients who developed POD (p<0.01, p-FWE<0.05), with persistent abnormalities at 1-year. Higher baseline cognition and ejection fraction were protective against POD (OR<1), whereas longer antegrade cerebral perfusion time increased risk (OR 1.03; 95% CI, 1.005-1.05; p=0.019). Conclusions POD affects >one-third of patients after arch surgery with HCA and is associated with worse 30-day and 1-year cognitive outcomes with enduring imaging abnormalities. Reduced preoperative thalamo-cerebellar connectivity suggests a preexisting neural vulnerability, indicating that delirium may unmask rather than cause long-term cognitive decline.

relevance.reason: 以术后谵妄患者为对象，报告术前丘脑-小脑静息态功能连接降低与认知结局，涉及脑网络组织与认知易感性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于GOT ICE随机试验，考察主动脉弓手术联合深低温停循环后术后谵妄的发生率、预测因素及其与认知和神经影像的关联。结果显示，谵妄发生于约三分之一患者，且在深低温与中低温组间无显著差异；发生谵妄者卒中、通气延长和住院时间更差，30天认知与生活质量更差，1年时仅部分恢复。基线影像已显示丘脑-小脑连接降低并在1年后持续存在，作者据此认为谵妄可能揭示而非造成长期认知下降。

papers.title: Local repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) induces whole-brain functional dynamic remodeling.
papers.authors: Fan L, Li Y, Duan SQ, An S, Wu Y, Yao N, Zhu Q, Zhang M, Huang ZG, Zhang SP.
papers.abstract: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) is a proven tool to modulate brain functional dynamics and treat neurological and psychiatric diseases. However, it remains unclear how local rTMS affects whole-brain functional dynamics. Here, we investigated the stimulation effects of rTMS using two data-driven approaches. By constructing multi-layer networks from resting-state fMRI data acquired before and after 1 Hz stimulation over the left frontal (FRO-TMS) and occipital cortex (OCC-TMS), we found significantly decreased dynamic interaction after FRO-TMS. We further characterized whole-brain functional hierarchy by computing nonreversibility and observed a significantly flattened hierarchy after FRO-TMS, whereas OCC-TMS did not induce significant changes. We then systematically investigated the association between these distinct modulatory patterns and structural network organization by fitting a large-scale brain computational model. Using noise- and synchronization-based perturbation protocols, we found that the simulated perturbation distance correlated significantly with the local dominance and controllability of the stimulated node in the structural network, providing a potential mechanistic account for the empirical observations. Specifically, driving hub nodes induced relatively small perturbation distances, whereas driving weakly connected regions yielded larger distances. This study provides a heuristic strategy for modeling and optimizing stimulation protocols in noninvasive brain stimulation. Supplementary information The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s11571-026-10568-3.

relevance.reason: 研究局部rTMS对全脑静息态功能动态与层级组织的调控，并结合结构网络与计算模型解释，属脑网络组织与结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注局部重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）如何影响全脑功能动态，利用刺激前后静息态fMRI构建多层网络，并比较左侧额叶与枕叶皮层1 Hz刺激的效果。结果显示，额叶刺激后动态交互显著下降、全脑功能层级趋于平坦，而枕叶刺激未引起显著变化。作者进一步用大规模脑计算模型拟合结构网络组织，发现模拟扰动距离与受刺激节点在结构网络中的局部主导性和可控性相关，提示驱动枢纽节点与弱连接区域会产生不同扰动范围，为理解局部刺激引发全脑重塑及优化刺激方案提供了计算框架。

papers.title: A geometric rs-fMRI connectome descriptor reveals individual stability without robust autism group differences.
papers.authors: M S SP, A ST.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) has resisted reproducible case-control characterization in resting-state functional connectivity, leaving open whether reported group differences reflect genuine biology or methodological variability. We introduce a geometric framework that represents functional connectomes on the symmetric positive-definite Riemannian manifold and quantifies individual deviation as tangent-space dispersion, complemented by normative modeling of graph topology. Using the multi-site Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE I) cohort (N=1035 subjects), we evaluate this descriptor under stringent robustness conditions and report three findings. First, individual connectome geometry is a stable, individually unique descriptor. The magnitude of a subject's deviation is highly reliable across split halves (intraclass correlation ICC[Formula: see text]) but is dominated by an acquisition-site scale, whereas its high-dimensional shape identifies subjects within-session with 98.9% accuracy once that scale is removed. Second, the case-control difference in dispersion is null and, by two one-sided equivalence tests against Cohen's d = 0.2 , statistically equivalent to zero in all ABIDE I analysis cohorts (full cohort d = -0.007 , N = 1035 ; strict cohort d = +0.038 , N = 635 ); a nominal single-atlas effect (dispersion ratio 1.05, p = 0.046 ) does not survive multi-atlas reanalysis. Third, acquisition site explains 69% of dispersion variance while diagnosis explains 0.0001% ; deviations form no discrete subtypes and do not predict symptom severity (minimum p=0.15 across tested graph-deviation predictors). Geometric dispersion is therefore a reproducible, individually unique connectome descriptor but not a case-control biomarker of ASD, which helps to explain the inconsistency of connectomic findings in autism.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态功能连接组的几何描述符及其个体稳定性，并检验ASD组间差异，属静息态脑网络组织与脑疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种几何框架，将静息态功能连接组置于对称正定黎曼流形上，以切空间离散度量化个体偏离，并结合图拓扑的规范建模，在多站点ABIDE I队列中检验其稳健性。结果显示，个体连接组几何是稳定且个体特异的描述符，其偏离幅度在分半间高度可靠，但主要受采集站点尺度影响，去除该尺度后高维形状可在同一会话内高精度识别个体。病例对照的离散度差异为零，且在全部分析队列中统计等价于零；名义上的单图谱效应经多图谱重分析后不再成立。采集站点解释了大部分离散度方差，而诊断解释的方差极小，偏离也未形成离散亚型或预测症状严重程度。作者据此认为，几何离散度是可重复的个体连接组描述符，但不是ASD的病例对照生物标志物，这有助于解释自闭症连接组研究结果的不一致。

papers.title: Cerebellar Crus I and Crus II Structure and Excitation/Inhibition Balance in Autism Spectrum Disorder.
papers.authors: Hegarty JP, Komaki H, Gu M, Young K, Ogbonnaya N, Spielman DM, Hardan AY.
papers.journal: Journal of autism and developmental disorders
papers.abstract: Purpose Cerebro-cerebellar network dynamics are highly implicated in autism spectrum disorder (ASD), particularly the posterolateral cerebellar hemispheres. Cellular alterations in the cerebellum are also consistently reported in post-mortem research, suggesting potential impacts on the balance between excitatory glutamatergic (Glu) and inhibitory GABAergic signaling (E/I). Emerging evidence further indicates that the cerebellum supports multiple cognitive and behavioral domains associated with the diagnostic criteria for ASD. Methods The current study collected structural T1-weighted MRI and novel 1 H MR spectroscopy data (MEGA-SPECIAL) to examine neurometabolites of Glu and GABA from the cerebellar hemispheres of autistic (n=13) and neurotypical children (n =16). We also explored preliminary comparisons with autistic adolescents (n=7) and assessed relationships for social communication, restricted and repetitive behaviors, and sensory processing differences. Results Crus I and II were significantly thinner in autistic children compared to neurotypical children. While there were no significant group differences in the subset of participants with quality neurometabolite measurements, p > 0.05, there were salient relationships between E/I, cerebellar structure, and core ASD domains. Thinner Crus I grey matter and smaller Crus II volume were correlated with higher E/I, especially for Glu in left Crus I and right Crus II. Morphometric properties and E/I were also associated with self-injurious and other restricted and repetitive behaviors. Conclusion Our preliminary findings are limited by the small sample size but suggest a potential relationship between cerebellar structure, the balance of excitation-inhibition in cerebro-cerebellar networks, and the core domains of autism spectrum disorder.

relevance.reason: 该研究在自闭症儿童中采集小脑结构MRI与Glu/GABA波谱，考察小脑结构与兴奋/抑制平衡及ASD核心行为域的关系，属于以脑疾病理解脑结构与功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症谱系障碍中小脑后外侧半球的结构与兴奋/抑制平衡，采用结构MRI和磁共振波谱测量自闭症儿童与神经典型儿童的小脑 Crus I、Crus II 形态及谷氨酸、GABA 水平。结果显示，自闭症儿童 Crus I 和 Crus II 显著变薄；在神经代谢物测量质量合格的子样本中，兴奋/抑制平衡未见显著组间差异，但 Crus I 灰质较薄和 Crus II 体积较小与更高的兴奋/抑制比相关，尤其涉及左侧 Crus I 和右侧 Crus II 的谷氨酸。形态指标和兴奋/抑制平衡还与自我伤害及其他重复刻板行为相关。作者强调样本量小，结论属初步性质，提示小脑结构、兴奋/抑制平衡与自闭症核心域之间可能存在关联。
