papers.title: Multiscale structural MRI differences among collegiate American football players, cross-country runners, and non-athletes
papers.authors: Guchait A, Chen C, Muggleton NG.
papers.abstract: Structural differences observed in collision-sport athletes may reflect repetitive head-impact exposure, broader effects of athletic training, or pre-existing individual variation, making inclusion of a non-collision athlete group important for interpretation of any differences seen. Here, structural T1-weighted MRI data from 17 collegiate American football players, 16 cross-country runners, and 9 non-athletes were analyzed using FSL voxel-based morphometry (VBM), FIRST subcortical volumetry and vertex-wise shape analysis, and FAST whole-brain tissue segmentation. Spatial inference used permutation testing with threshold-free cluster enhancement and family-wise error correction, while scalar analyses used multiplicity-corrected procedures. FAST-derived absolute tissue volumes were also examined in a sensitivity analysis adjusting for FreeSurfer estimated total intracranial volume (eTIV). VBM showed recurrent brainstem-centered differences, with non-athletes showing greater local gray matter measures than both athlete groups, whereas football players showed greater brainstem measures than runners. FIRST vertex-wise analysis identified corrected differences involving the brainstem and selected subcortical structures, while no total FIRST structure volume survived false discovery rate correction. Unadjusted FAST analysis identified a CSF group effect, F (2, 24.38) = 11.46, p < .001, q = .001. After eTIV adjustment, the CSF group effect remained, F (2, 38) = 14.30, q < .001, and a white matter group effect was also identified, F (2, 38) = 9.59, q < .001; gray matter and total segmented tissue did not show corrected adjusted effects. These findings indicate that structural variation depends on anatomical scale, comparison group, and head-size adjustment and cannot be attributed uniquely to collision-sport exposure.

relevance.reason: 比较不同运动人群的T1结构MRI灰质、皮层下体积与组织分割差异，属人脑结构基础研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了大学美式橄榄球运动员、越野跑运动员和非运动员的结构性MRI差异，以区分碰撞运动暴露、运动训练与个体差异的可能影响。结果发现，差异主要集中在脑干区域：非运动员的局部灰质指标高于两类运动员，而橄榄球运动员的脑干指标高于跑者；皮层下结构的顶点形态分析也显示脑干及部分结构存在差异，但各结构总体积在多重校正后无显著组间差异。全脑组织分割中，脑脊液组效应在调整估计颅内体积前后均存在，调整后还出现白质组效应。作者据此指出，结构变异取决于解剖尺度、比较组和头围调整，不能单独归因于碰撞运动暴露。

papers.title: Latent Multidimensional Organization of White Matter Microstructural Aging: A Generative Adversarial Network Disentanglement Study in a Clinically Defined Reference Cohort.
papers.authors: Li Y, Gao H, Lin L, Xiong M.
papers.abstract: Background: White matter (WM) aging is commonly characterized as a largely unitary process of progressive microstructural decline, yet substantial interindividual variation suggests that this view may obscure distinct biological dimensions. Whether WM aging retains a multidimensional organization after minimizing variation attributable to overt clinical pathology remains unknown. Methods: We constructed a clinically defined aging reference cohort (CDAR; n = 17,310) from the UK Biobank (UKB) by excluding overt clinical pathology and analyzed 144 skeleton-based WM microstructural metrics. An additional 10,272 participants with overt clinical diagnoses were included for downstream association analyses, yielding a total analytic sample of 27,582. Surreal-GAN was applied to disentangle latent dimensions of WM aging, with reproducibility-based model selection and cross-sample and cross-sex validation. The biological relevance of the identified dimensions was evaluated through associations with cognitive, lifestyle, peripheral, and disease-related outcomes. Results: Three reproducible and coexisting dimensions of WM aging emerged, comprising distinct spatial configurations rather than a single diffuse aging axis. R1 displayed an anterior-vulnerable/posterior-preserved gradient, R2 reflected a widespread diffuse aging load, and R3 showed a dissociation between the limbic-frontal system and sensorimotor pathways. The three patterns exhibited good cross-sample (r = 0.887-0.935) and cross-sex (r = 0.891-0.937) reproducibility, with strong bilateral hemispheric correspondence (r > 0.86). All three patterns were associated with age but exhibited partially shared and partially independent associations with cognition, lifestyle factors, peripheral phenotypes, and disease risk. Conclusions: WM aging is not adequately captured by a single neuroanatomical process. Even after minimizing overt clinical pathology, it retains a reproducible multidimensional organization, with partially shared and partially independent phenotypic profiles across aging dimensions. These findings suggest that individual differences in WM aging reflect partially separable biological processes rather than variation along a single aging axis.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用UK Biobank数据解析人脑白质微结构老化的多维空间组织，并关联认知等表型，属于白质结构与认知意义研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在尽量排除明显临床病理后，白质老化是否仍呈现多维组织，并利用临床界定的参考队列和生成对抗网络解缠方法分析白质微结构指标。结果显示，白质老化可分解为三种可重复且共存的维度：前部易损、后部保留的梯度，广泛弥散的老化负荷，以及边缘—额叶系统与感觉运动通路之间的分离模式；这些模式在跨样本、跨性别和左右半球间均表现稳定。三种维度都与年龄相关，但与认知、生活方式、外周表型和疾病风险的关联既有共享也有独立之处，提示白质老化并非单一过程，个体差异可能反映部分可分离的生物学过程。

papers.title: Clinical and resting-state EEG changes following neurofeedback in adult refugees with persistent trauma-related symptoms: a transdiagnostic pre-post observational study.
papers.authors: Askovic M, Mascelloni M, Murdoch S, Aroche J, Hamlin ED, Harris AWF.
papers.abstract: Background Neurofeedback has shown promise as an adjunctive intervention for persistent trauma-related psychopathology, but its electrophysiological effects in refugees following war, torture, and forced displacement remain poorly understood. This study investigated changes in resting-state alpha electrophysiology during trauma treatment incorporating individualised neurofeedback and whether these changes related to clinical improvement. Methods This retrospective pre-post observational study included 53 adult refugees with persistent trauma-related symptoms who completed resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) before and after multidisciplinary treatment incorporating neurofeedback, trauma-focused counselling and pharmacotherapy. Participants received a mean of 38.7 neurofeedback sessions after remaining symptomatic despite previous treatment. Clinical improvement was assessed retrospectively using the Clinical Global Impression-Improvement (CGI-I) scale. Resting-state EEG analyses examined changes in global alpha amplitude, alpha reactivity, peak alpha frequency (PAF), and alpha coherence. Neurofeedback protocol implementation was characterised across 2,361 protocol applications, and secondary analyses examined electrophysiological differences between responders and non-responders and associations between electrophysiological and clinical change. Results Thirty-three participants (62.3%) demonstrated clinically meaningful improvement following multidisciplinary treatment incorporating neurofeedback. Resting-state EEG demonstrated increased global alpha amplitude (FDR-adjusted p = .018) and reduced occipital alpha reactivity (FDR-adjusted p = .013), whereas peak alpha frequency and alpha coherence did not change significantly following correction for multiple comparisons. Exploratory analyses suggested different patterns of eyes-open and eyes-closed alpha change in responders and non-responders; however, the difference between groups was not statistically significant (t(51) = 0.88, p = .381, d = 0.24). Changes in electrophysiological measures were not significantly associated with clinical improvement. Protocol analysis demonstrated variability in electrode placement, whereas reward frequencies remained clustered within the alpha range throughout treatment. Conclusions Individualised neurofeedback delivered within routine multidisciplinary care was associated with clinically meaningful improvement in two-thirds of refugees with persistent trauma-related psychopathology, alongside selective changes in resting-state alpha electrophysiology. These findings extend current understanding of the electrophysiological changes observed during treatment incorporating neurofeedback in a clinically complex refugee population. Although the retrospective observational design limits conclusions regarding causality, the findings support investigation of neurofeedback as an adjunctive intervention for refugees who remain symptomatic despite previous treatment and identify resting-state alpha reactivity as a promising electrophysiological measure of treatment-associated change.

relevance.reason: 研究创伤后难民神经反馈治疗前后静息态EEG alpha电生理变化，涉及脑自发活动与精神病理治疗相关脑改变。

papers.summary_zh: 本研究关注的是，在针对难民持续性创伤相关症状的多学科治疗中加入个体化神经反馈后，静息态α脑电活动是否发生变化，以及这些变化是否与临床改善相关。研究为回顾性前后观察设计，纳入53名成年难民，比较治疗前后的静息态脑电，并结合临床总体印象改善量表评估疗效。结果显示，约三分之二参与者的症状出现有临床意义的改善；脑电上可见全局α波幅升高、枕区α反应性降低，而峰α频率和α相干性未见显著变化。探索性分析未发现脑电变化与临床改善之间存在显著关联，应答者与非应答者之间的差异也不显著。作者指出，回顾性设计限制了因果推断，但α反应性可作为值得进一步研究的治疗相关脑电指标。

papers.title: Cortical surface morphometry changes following combined translingual neural stimulation with the portable neuromodulation stimulator and physical therapy in patients with mild-to-moderate traumatic brain injury: a pilot study.
papers.authors: Hou J, Hosseini T, Nair VA, Danilov Y, Kaczmarek K, Meyerand B, Tyler M, Prabhakaran V.
papers.abstract: Background Traumatic brain injury (TBI) often causes persistent balance and gait deficits, especially in mild-to-moderate TBI (mmTBI). Physical therapy is standard but often limited as a standalone treatment. Translingual neural stimulation (TLNS) is an emerging neuromodulation approach combining cranial nerve stimulation with targeted exercise to promote neuroplasticity and recovery. Its effects on cortical surface morphometry in mmTBI remain uninvestigated. Methods This secondary analysis used data from a completed clinical trial (NCT02158494). Nine chronic mmTBI patients underwent a two-week intervention combining TLNS (PoNS®) with targeted exercise training; no untreated, physical-therapy-only, or sham group was included. Balance and gait were assessed via the Sensory Organization Test (SOT) and Dynamic Gait Index (DGI) before and after the two-week in-lab phase. High-resolution T1-weighted MRI was acquired at both time points. Cortical thickness (CT), fractal dimensionality (FD), gyrification index (GI), and sulcal depth (SD) were analyzed using CAT12 with non-parametric permutation testing and TFCE correction. Results SOT and DGI scores improved significantly; due to the single-group design, these pre-post changes cannot be attributed to TLNS, physical therapy, or their combination. Widespread pre-post CT increases occurred in bilateral frontal, temporal, parietal, and cingulate regions. FD showed increases (precuneus, insula, and superior frontal gyrus) and decreases (lateral occipital, inferior temporal gyri). GI decreased in the left lingual gyrus; SD showed bidirectional changes. Exploratory correlations linked greater behavioral gains with smaller CT increases in right inferior temporal gyrus and right superior parietal lobule, and smaller FD increases in left precuneus; these were underpowered (N = 9), uncorrected, and hypothesis-generating only. Morphometric changes in either direction cannot be assumed to reflect beneficial neuroplasticity. Conclusion In this exploratory, single-group pilot study, cortical surface morphometric changes accompanied balance and gait improvements after combined TLNS plus physical therapy in mm TBI. Without a control group, causality cannot be determined. Findings are preliminary and support randomized, sham-controlled trials, ideally with a physical-therapy-only arm.

relevance.reason: 在轻中度创伤性脑损伤患者中结合神经调控与物理治疗，用T1 MRI分析皮层厚度、分形维数等形态学变化，属脑损伤后结构可塑性研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究分析轻度至中度创伤性脑损伤患者在接受经舌神经刺激联合物理治疗后，皮层表面形态学与平衡步态的变化，采用单组前后对照设计，结合行为评估与结构MRI形态学指标分析。结果显示平衡与步态评分显著改善，并伴随双侧额、颞、顶及扣带回皮层厚度增加，分形维度和沟深呈双向变化，脑回指数在局部下降。由于没有对照组，这些改善和形态学变化不能归因于经舌神经刺激、物理治疗或二者组合，形态学变化方向也不能假定反映有益神经可塑性；探索性相关结果样本量小且未校正，仅具假设生成意义。作者强调结论为初步性，需随机、假刺激对照并设单纯物理治疗组的研究验证。

papers.title: Voxelwise degree centrality alterations and cognitive performance in severe unilateral M1-segment middle cerebral artery stenosis with ipsilateral watershed infarction.
papers.authors: Huang Z, Liang X, Li L, Wei Y, Zhang Y, Wei W, Quan X, Li K, Yao K, Tang J, Zhang Y, Huang J, Zhang J.
papers.abstract: Purpose To characterize voxelwise degree centrality (DC) alterations and their exploratory clinical associations in severe unilateral M1-segment middle cerebral artery stenosis with ipsilateral watershed infarction. Methods This cross-sectional study included 40 patients with left-sided disease, 47 with right-sided disease, and 44 healthy controls. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging-derived weighted DC (r > 0.25) was compared using analysis of covariance with adjustment for educational attainment, Tukey-Kramer testing, and Gaussian random field-corrected patient-control contrasts (two-tailed voxel P < 0.001; cluster P < 0.05). Exploratory clinical associations were assessed using Spearman rank correlation. Results Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores differed among groups (P < 0.001), with both patient groups scoring lower than controls; Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) scores also differed (P < 0.001), with the left-sided group lowest, the right-sided group intermediate, and controls highest. The left-sided group showed lower DC predominantly in left temporal-opercular and postcentral-inferior parietal regions and higher DC in right medial/subcortical and posterior-midline regions; the largest lower-DC cluster peaked at MNI coordinates -48, -18, 39 (Z = -5.5420). The right-sided group showed lower DC in right putaminal/insular, temporal, and parietal-sensorimotor regions and higher DC in the left cerebellum; the largest lower-DC cluster peaked at MNI coordinates 48, -27, 36 (Z = -6.0021). In the right-sided group, exploratory nominal associations were observed between MMSE scores and DC in the left cerebellar, right superior temporal-pole, and right parietal-sensorimotor clusters (r = -0.300 to 0.421; nominal P = 0.003-0.040). No nominal cognitive-DC correlations were observed in the left-sided group, and no MoCA-DC correlations in the right-sided group. Conclusion Distributed DC alterations accompanied cognitive performance differences, with selective exploratory nominal MMSE associations in right-sided disease. DC may merit further evaluation as a candidate imaging feature of BOLD-based functional alterations associated with cognitive differences.

relevance.reason: 研究单侧大脑中动脉狭窄伴分水岭梗死患者静息态度中心性改变及其与认知表现的关联，属脑损伤后功能网络组织与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察重度单侧大脑中动脉M1段狭窄伴同侧分水岭梗死患者的全脑体素度中心性改变及其与认知表现的探索性关联，比较了左侧病变、右侧病变患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振加权度中心性。结果显示，两组患者的认知评分均低于对照，且左侧病变组最低；左侧病变组以左颞岛盖及中央后回-顶下区域度中心性降低为主，右侧病变组则见右侧壳核/岛叶、颞叶及顶叶感觉运动区降低、左侧小脑升高。仅右侧病变组观察到MMSE与少数脑区度中心性的名义相关，左侧病变组未见认知相关，提示度中心性可作为与认知差异相关的候选影像特征，但关联为探索性，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: Feasibility and Safety of Transcranial Focused Ultrasound on Language Impairment in a Patient with Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Case Report.
papers.authors: Yan C, Zhu G, Liang S, Zhao Y, Chen W, Xia Q, Jian J, Wang Z, Zhang B, Ao L.
papers.abstract: Background Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is defined by persistent difficulties with social communication and language, and a subset of children stay minimally verbal despite intensive interventions. The left amygdala and ventral-anterior superior temporal sulcus (STSva) form a key circuit for social-language integration, but how transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) might modulate in minimally verbal ASD has not been explored. Case presentation An 11-year-old minimally verbal ASD boy received 4 weeks of sequential tFUS stimulation (0.5 MHz). The treatment targeted the left amygdala and STSva, five times per week. Outcome assessments included the Mandarin Clinical Evaluation of Language for Preschoolers' Core Scale (MCELP-CS), Autism Behavior Checklist (ABC), and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) at pre-tFUS, post-tFUS, and a 4-week follow-up. The boy tolerated the intervention well, with no adverse events. Significant improvements in key language skills (vocabulary naming +10%, sentence structure imitation +22%) and reduced ASD symptoms (ABC language -40%, social interaction -26%) were observed post-tFUS and sustained at follow-up. fNIRS confirmed altered cortical activation and reorganized functional connectivity in language-related brain regions. Conclusion This single-case observational report describes acceptable tolerance to sequential tFUS targeting the left amygdala-STSva circuit in a minimally verbal child with ASD, alongside concomitant behavioural and neuroimaging changes. These preliminary observations provide descriptive, hypothesis-generating data for this circuit-directed intervention strategy and highlight the necessity of larger controlled trials to further evaluate its potential clinical utility.

relevance.reason: 单例ASD语言障碍儿童tFUS干预，报告语言行为改善及fNIRS语言相关脑区激活与功能连接重组，涉及语言神经机制与脑疾病可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告探讨经颅聚焦超声（tFUS）能否调节一名极少言语自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）男孩的语言相关脑环路，并观察其可行性与安全性。患儿接受为期四周、以左侧杏仁核与腹前颞上沟为靶点的序贯tFUS刺激，并在治疗前后及随访时进行语言量表、行为评估和功能近红外成像检查。结果显示患儿耐受良好、未见不良事件，词汇命名和句式模仿等语言表现有所改善，ASD相关语言与社交症状评分下降，随访时仍维持，影像也提示语言相关脑区激活与功能连接发生变化。作者强调这只是单例观察，相关变化不能视为因果或疗效证据，仅用于提出假设，仍需更大规模对照试验验证。

papers.title: The Eye-Brain Axis in High Myopia: From Retinal Deformation to Cortical Network Reorganization.
papers.authors: Yuan D, Yang W, Zhong H, Chen Q.
papers.abstract: High myopia is a major cause of irreversible visual impairment and is increasingly recognized as a condition involving interactions between ocular remodeling and central neural systems. This scoping review synthesizes current evidence on structural, functional, genetic, and regulatory links between the eye and brain in high myopia. We systematically searched PubMed and Web of Science from database inception to August 2026, identifying 54 eligible primary studies. The available evidence indicates that high myopia is associated with retinal and optic nerve abnormalities, altered white matter microstructure, occipital cortical changes, and functional reorganization across visual and higher-order brain networks. However, most neuroimaging evidence is cross-sectional, and Mendelian randomization analyses have not provided evidence for a clear causal effect of myopia on brain volumes. Genetic studies suggest modest overlap between refractive error and cognitive traits, whereas educational exposure appears to contribute causally to myopic refractive development. Experimental and observational evidence also supports reciprocal regulation of ocular growth through circadian, dopaminergic, autonomic, and behavioral pathways, although several proposed mechanisms remain incompletely established in humans. Overall, the eye-brain axis provides a useful integrative framework for understanding high myopia, but longitudinal and interventional studies are required to determine causal relationships and evaluate whether neural or behavioral targets can improve clinical outcomes.

relevance.reason: 综述高度近视者白质微结构、枕叶皮层及视觉与高级脑网络功能重组，属脑结构与功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦高度近视中眼与脑之间的结构、功能、遗传及调控联系，系统检索文献后纳入相关原始研究进行梳理。现有证据提示，高度近视与视网膜和视神经异常、白质微结构改变、枕叶皮层变化以及视觉和高级脑网络的功能重组相关，但多数神经影像证据为横断面设计，孟德尔随机化分析也未支持近视对脑容量存在明确因果作用。遗传研究显示屈光不正与认知特质仅有有限重叠，而教育暴露似乎对近视性屈光发展有因果贡献；实验和观察证据还支持昼夜节律、多巴胺能、自主神经及行为通路对眼轴生长的双向调控，但部分机制在人类中尚未完全确立。作者据此提出眼-脑轴可作为理解高度近视的整合框架，并强调需纵向和干预研究来厘清因果关系及神经或行为靶点能否改善临床结局。

papers.title: Corpus Callosum Macrostructure and Microstructure in Relation to Interhemispheric Cortical Thickness Symmetry
papers.authors: Assari S.
papers.abstract: Background: Although the corpus callosum is the principal commissure connecting the cerebral hemispheres, it remains unclear whether its macrostructure and microstructure are associated with greater structural symmetry between the hemispheres. Objective: To examine associations of callosal macrostructure and microstructure with left–right symmetry of cortical thickness in healthy developing children. Methods: In 8,131 children aged 9 to 10 from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (ABCD), we related 16 callosal measures to per-child hemispheric similarity indices computed across 75 paired cortical regions. Degree-of-symmetry indices are based on the mean absolute left-minus-right difference, reversed so that higher values denote greater symmetry; pattern indices express the correlation between the two hemispheric profiles. Results: All 16 callosal measures were positively associated with cortical thickness symmetry and 15 reached significance, the strongest at r = −.096. The probability that 16 measures would share a direction by chance is 3.1 × 10⁻⁵. Across 128 tests of callosal structure against hemispheric similarity, 51 reached significance against 6.4 expected. The yield was concentrated in magnitude indices rather than pattern indices. Conclusions: A larger and more myelinated corpus callosum accompanies hemispheres whose cortical thickness is more symmetrical. The association concerns the degree of symmetry rather than its regional pattern.

relevance.reason: 研究胼胝体宏观/微观结构与健康儿童左右半球皮层厚度对称性的关联，属脑结构-结构关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注胼胝体的大体结构与微观结构是否与健康发育儿童左右半球皮层厚度的对称性有关，利用大样本儿童影像数据，将多项胼胝体指标与逐人的半球相似性指数进行关联分析。结果显示，胼胝体各项指标普遍与皮层厚度对称程度呈正向关联，且这种关联主要体现在对称程度（幅度）上，而非半球间的区域模式；换言之，胼胝体较大、髓鞘化程度较高的儿童，其两半球皮层厚度也更为对称。作者据此认为，胼胝体结构可能与半球间结构对称的程度相伴随，但这是关联性证据，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: The Cost of Scrutiny: Subclinical Social Anxiety and Performance Context Reshape Frontal-Midline Theta Network Reconfigurations during Probabilistic Learning.
papers.authors: Liu H, van der Molen MJW.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Social anxiety is reliably characterized by biases toward avoidance and aversive learning. Frontal-midline theta (FM-theta) oscillations have been implicated as a key neural mechanism underlying these learning biases. Here, we combined a dynamic network neuroscience approach with computational modeling to investigate how FM-theta oscillatory activity coordinates large-scale functional network interactions on a trial-to-trial basis during feedback-guided learning. Additionally, we examined how these neural dynamics are associated with social anxiety across different social contexts. A sample of 146 human participants (124 female; mean age, 20.4 years) with varying levels of social anxiety completed a probabilistic selection task while performing alone and under scrutiny. Using non-negative matrix factorization, we identified two functional neural subgraphs supported by FM-theta. Frontoparietal connectivity increased following aversive outcomes and scaled with positive prediction errors, consistent with error-monitoring and belief-updating. Fronto-occipital connectivity scaled with prediction errors when participants performed alone but not under scrutiny, indicative of context-sensitive disruption of belief-updating. Participants with elevated social anxiety showed increased fronto-occipital connectivity, as well as stronger subgraph coupling, indexing cross-network integration. This latter effect facilitated learning of simple stimulus-reward associations but hampered learning of difficult stimulus-reward associations. Together, these findings reveal that social anxiety amplifies fronto-occipital FM-theta connectivity and cross-network integration, facilitating learning under low task demands while hampering learning under high task demands.

relevance.reason: 研究社会焦虑与表现情境如何调节额中线theta功能网络重组及概率学习，属情绪/学习与脑网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究结合动态网络神经科学与计算建模，考察额中线theta振荡如何在反馈引导的概率学习任务中逐试次协调大规模功能网络，并分析其与社交焦虑及不同社会情境的关联。结果识别出两个由额中线theta支持的子网络：额顶连接在厌恶结果后增强并随正性预测误差变化，符合错误监测与信念更新；额枕连接在独自完成任务时随预测误差变化，在被审视时则不再如此，提示情境会干扰信念更新。社交焦虑较高者额枕连接更强、子网络耦合更高，这种跨网络整合有利于简单刺激—奖励关联的学习，却妨碍较难关联的学习，说明社交焦虑的影响随任务需求而不同。

papers.title: Two Words Are Faster Than One: Neural Dynamics of Accelerated Meaning in Phrases.
papers.authors: Wang S, Kim S, Binder JR, Lin N, Pylkkänen L.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Although we increasingly understand how the brain processes phrase-level meaning, the role of semantic content remains underexplored. Recent models grounded in componential experiential features offer a principled framework for linking conceptual representation to the neurobiology of semantic composition. Here we used MEG to test whether experiential semantic features are retrieved and composed during two-word phrase comprehension and whether lexical and phrase-level representations show temporally overlapping or strictly serial activation. Participants (16 women, 12 men) read two-word phrases and their component words in a rapid parallel visual presentation paradigm, equating the temporal dimension of the two types of stimuli. The phrases spanned six linguistic relations. All words and phrases were independently rated on 65 experiential features across 14 experiential domains, and representational similarity analysis was used to relate neural and semantic structure. Rather than emerging after or in parallel with single-word meanings, phrase-level meanings arose earlier, outpacing single words in isolation. Phrasal contexts also elicited earlier activation of word-level meaning: a word such as "cake" showed semantic activation at ∼312 ms in isolation, but at ∼236 ms in "green cake." Experiential feature representations of both component words were detectable during phrase processing, with partially overlapping temporal windows. The magnitude of composition-related effects varied systematically across phrasal relation types and experiential domains. Together, these findings show that experiential semantic features are integrated during composition in ways that vary across phrasal relations and that combining words into phrases speeds semantic access, accelerating both phrase- and word-level meaning relative to isolated words.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究两词短语语义组合的时间动态，直接报告人脑语言语义加工机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑磁图考察两词短语理解中经验语义特征的提取与组合，并检验词汇与短语表征是时间重叠还是严格串行。结果显示，短语层意义比孤立单词意义出现得更早，短语语境也使词义激活提前，如“cake”在“green cake”中比单独出现时更早激活。组成词的特征表征在短语加工中可检出，时间窗部分重叠，组合效应随短语关系类型和经验域系统变化。这表明将词组合成短语会加速语义通达，且语义组合方式因关系类型而异。

papers.title: Evolutionary Reorganization of the Self-Processing Network across Primates.
papers.authors: Ruan J, Ma C, Qiao Y, Dong X, Qiu M, Klar P, Wang J, Fan L, Northoff G, Liu N.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Understanding the evolutionary origins of the structural substrates underlying self-processing is central to elucidating the neural basis of human cognition. Although self-related behaviors differ markedly across primates, the extent to which the underlying neural architecture is conserved or reorganized remains unclear. Here, we investigated shared and species-specific characteristics of the self-processing network (SPN) across humans (n = 46, 19 males), chimpanzees (n = 46, 18 males), and macaques (n = 43, 22 males) using a comparative connectomic framework. We mapped a meta-analysis-derived human SPN onto nonhuman primates within a shared homologous connectivity space defined by conserved white-matter tracts. We compared local microstructural properties and gene expression signatures between humans and macaques and further included chimpanzees as an intermediate evolutionary reference for large-scale structural connectivity. SPN regions exhibited highly similar myelin-sensitive contrast profiles in humans and macaques, accompanied by shared expression patterns of related genes, which were also enriched for human-accelerated brain genes. Large-scale connectivity revealed pronounced species differences, with chimpanzees occupying an intermediate position between humans and macaques. Importantly, evolutionary modifications of the SPN were domain-specific: interoceptive-processing subnetworks showed greater similarity between macaques and chimpanzees; exteroceptive-processing subnetworks showed closer correspondence between chimpanzees and humans; and mental-self-processing subnetworks exhibited greater interspecies differentiation. Moreover, these changes were accompanied by a progressive reorganization of network hubs from insular regions in macaques to cingulate regions in humans. Together, these findings reveal a scale-dependent evolutionary organization of SPN structural substrates and provide a framework for understanding the conservation and reorganization of self-processing architectures across primates.

relevance.reason: 比较人类、黑猩猩和猕猴的自我加工网络结构连接与微结构组织，涉及人脑结构组织及自我认知的进化基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自我加工网络的结构基础在灵长类进化中究竟保守还是重组，采用比较连接组框架，将基于元分析得到的人类自我加工网络映射到人类、黑猩猩和猕猴共有的同源连接空间中进行比较。结果显示，该网络的局部微结构特征及相关基因表达在人与猕猴间高度相似，但大规模连接存在明显物种差异，黑猩猩处于人与猕猴之间。更重要的是，进化改变具有领域特异性：内感受子网络在猕猴与黑猩猩间更接近，外感受子网络在黑猩猩与人间更接近，而心理自我子网络种间分化更大，网络枢纽也由猕猴的岛叶区域逐渐转向人类的扣带区域。作者据此提出，自我加工网络的结构基础呈现尺度依赖的进化组织方式。

papers.title: Flexible Modulation of Premotor mu Rhythm Waveform Shape Predicts Human Motor Sequence Learning.
papers.authors: Suresh T, Khatri U, Hussain SJ.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Motor sequence learning recruits a distributed sensorimotor network. Within this network, the premotor cortex (PMC) encodes and represents sequence information while the primary motor cortex (M1) executes movement sequences. Like M1, PMC neuronal populations exhibit mu (8-13 Hz) rhythms, which are typically nonsinusoidal. Previous studies showed that mu rhythm phase gates corticospinal transmission, sensitivity to LTP-like plasticity, and learning-related corticospinal plasticity. However, these studies treated mu peak and trough phases as discrete functional states and focused exclusively on M1. Here, we characterized mu phase-dependent mechanisms of motor sequence learning by measuring waveform shape, which is a more holistic measure that treats peak and trough phases as continuous components of the same oscillatory cycle. Using cycle-by-cycle analysis of resting EEG, we quantified the peak-trough symmetry of mu rhythms recorded over premotor regions during, before, and after healthy adults (25 females, 11 males) practiced a serial reaction time task containing a repeating, embedded sequence (sequence group) or no sequence (no-sequence group). As learning progressed, premotor mu rhythms became more symmetric in the sequence than the no-sequence group; these symmetry increases were also more positively correlated with skill acquisition in the sequence than the no-sequence group. Furthermore, premotor mu asymmetry before task exposure predicted sequence acquisition, such that participants with longer baseline trough phases acquired greater skill and showed larger learning-related increases in mu peak-trough symmetry. Overall, these findings provide first evidence that motor sequence learning reshapes premotor mu rhythms, consistent with learning-related redistribution of cortical excitability across the mu cycle.

relevance.reason: 研究健康成人运动序列学习与运动前区mu节律波形形状的关系，属学习与运动皮层的神经振荡机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察前运动皮层mu节律的波形形状是否与人类运动序列学习相关，用静息脑电的逐周期分析量化健康成人完成序列反应时任务前后mu节律的峰-谷对称性。结果显示，随着学习推进，序列组前运动mu节律比无序列组更趋对称，且这种对称性增加与技能获得的关联在序列组更正向；任务前的mu不对称性还能预测序列习得，基线谷相较长者学得更好、学习相关的对称性增幅也更大。作者据此认为，运动序列学习会重塑前运动mu节律，提示学习伴随mu周期内皮层兴奋性的重新分布；这属于预测性关联证据，尚不能说明因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Auditory- and Visual-Speech Evoked Activation of the Superior Temporal Gyrus Contralateral to the Cochlear Implant Predicts Speech Recognition Outcomes.
papers.authors: Peng T, Henshall KR, Esmaelpoor J, Haneman M, McDonald L, Shader MJ, Luke R, McKay CM.
papers.abstract: Objectives Speech recognition outcomes vary widely in cochlear implant recipients, but the reasons for this variability are not well explained by patient history factors alone. Neuroplastic reorganization after both deafness and cochlear implant switch-on can affect how new recipients adapt to electrical hearing. In this study, we evaluate the associations between speech recognition outcomes and stimulus-evoked activation of cortical language processing areas. Design Forty-three newly implanted post-lingually deaf adult cochlear implant recipients (17 female, mean age at implantation: 58.5 yr, SD: 14.4 yr) were recruited for the longitudinal study. Participants attended two research visits: the first conducted within 1 mo of device switch-on, and the second conducted 1 yr after device switch-on. At each visit, we evaluated speech recognition outcomes in noise and cortical activation using functional near-infrared spectroscopy during a passive listening task, during which a story was told in either an auditory- or visual-speech (lipreading) condition. Results We found consistent negative correlations between speech understanding outcomes at 1 yr and activation of the superior temporal gyrus at 1 mo in response to both auditory and visual speech. These associations were not observed for activation measured at 1 yr. Subgroup regression analysis revealed that these correlations were most consistently seen in the superior temporal gyrus contralateral to the cochlear implant. Activation in the superior temporal gyrus contralateral to the implant at 1 mo also explained additional variance in speech outcomes at 1 yr beyond clinical factors alone. However, longitudinal analysis showed no association between within-subject changes in activation and changes in speech understanding outcomes within this first year of implant use. Conclusions Our evidence highlights that neuroplastic changes which occur following adult-onset deafness play an important role in how cochlear implant recipients adapt to their devices after switch-on. The relationship between neuroimaging measures made within 1 mo after device switch-on and speech recognition outcomes at 1 yr can potentially enable triaging of recipients to improve clinical management of implant recipients.

relevance.reason: 研究人工耳蜗植入者听觉与视觉言语诱发颞上回激活与言语识别结局的关系，涉及言语加工脑区及成人耳聋后神经可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察成人语后聋人工耳蜗植入者开机早期的皮层语言区激活能否预测一年后的噪声下言语识别表现，采用纵向设计，在开机后一个月和一年分别用功能性近红外光谱记录被动听故事时的脑活动。结果显示，开机一个月时，对侧于植入侧的上颞回在听觉言语和视觉言语条件下的激活越强，一年后的言语理解成绩越差；这一关联在一年时不再出现，且个体内激活变化与言语成绩变化无关。作者认为，成人语后聋后的神经可塑性重组影响植入者对新设备的适应，早期影像指标或有助于对患者进行分诊，但相关关系不等于因果，其临床价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Synbiotic supplementation leads to gut microbiome communities with functional capacity linked to better brain white matter development in preterm infants.
papers.authors: Voulgari-Kokota A, Janson E, Heikamp de Jong I, Knol J, van Elburg R, van der Aa NE, Hortensius LM, Dudink J, de Theije CGM, Schipper L, Kozior M, van de Lagemaat M, Groenendaal F, van Bel F, Wildt-Grootendorst A, Drost-Verhoef S, Hennink A, Obihara CC, van Hillegersberg-Schilder JLAM, Dassel CM, Oudshoorn JH, Meijssen CB, de Boer IP, Illy KE, Claessens N, Viergever MA, Isgum I, Shetty S, Wopereis H, Benders M, Belzer C.
papers.abstract: Preterm birth, a major cause of brain injury, is often linked to dysregulated gut microbiome development. This association underscores microbial metabolic function as a modifiable target to support neurodevelopment. In this secondary analysis of data derived from a randomized controlled trial (Trial Registration: ISRCTN96620855), we tested whether daily nutritional supplementation with Bifidobacterium breve M-16V, short- and long-chain oligosaccharides, and L-glutamine could steer the gut microbiome of very and extremely preterm infants toward communities that support brain maturation. The gut microbiome was profiled with longitudinal shotgun metagenomics at nine time points during the intervention, which started at 48-72 h after birth and continued until 36 weeks postmenstrual age. Additionally, MRI scans were conducted when infants reached term-equivalent age to evaluate brain maturation. Supplementation promoted the early establishment of Bifidobacterium -rich communities in the test group, with enhanced capacity for amino acid biosynthesis and pyruvate fermentation towards acetate and lactate production. Integration of microbiome data with brain developmental markers post hoc showed that the same functions were markedly reduced in infants with delayed white-matter myelination. By integrating microbiome functional capacity profiling and evaluation of brain maturation via MRI, this study demonstrated that early microbial modulation could influence brain development, positioning the preterm gut microbiome as a clinically actionable target.

relevance.reason: 研究早产儿肠道微生物功能与MRI白质髓鞘化发育的关联，涉及脑白质结构发育，属结构-功能栏目。

papers.summary_zh: 这项研究基于一项随机对照试验的二次分析，探讨早产儿每日补充短双歧杆菌M-16V、寡糖和谷氨酰胺能否引导肠道菌群向支持脑成熟的方向发展；研究者用纵向宏基因组测序分析干预期间的菌群，并在婴儿达到足月等效年龄时用MRI评估脑成熟。结果显示，补充促进了双歧杆菌富集菌群的早期建立，并增强了氨基酸生物合成以及向乙酸和乳酸方向的丙酮酸发酵能力；事后整合分析发现，在白质髓鞘化延迟的婴儿中，这些功能明显减弱。作者据此认为，早期微生物调节可能影响脑发育，早产儿肠道菌群或可作为临床可干预的靶点，但相关证据来自二次分析和事后关联，尚不能确立因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Profile of Michael N. Shadlen.
papers.authors: Viegas J.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Neuroscientist and neurologist Michael N. Shadlen is a world leader in the neurobiology of decision-making, a field of study he helped establish. His research explores higher brain functions-memory retrieval, reasoning, and multitasking, among others-that he theorizes share underlying mechanisms. His work suggests that a holy grail of neuroscience-the "hard problem" of consciousness, or the mechanism(s) by which physical brain operations are translated into lived experiences-could be resolved. Shadlen's Inaugural Article explains what distinguishes conscious from nonconscious thought.

relevance.reason: 介绍神经科学家Shadlen关于决策、记忆提取、推理与意识神经机制的研究，属认知与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 这篇人物简介介绍神经科学家兼神经内科医生Michael N. Shadlen在决策神经生物学领域的工作，他参与奠定了这一研究方向。其研究考察记忆提取、推理和多任务处理等高级脑功能，并推测这些功能共享某些底层机制。文章还指出，他的工作提示意识这一“难问题”，即大脑的物理活动如何转化为主观体验，或许有可能得到解答，其就职论文则探讨了意识思维与非意识思维的区别。摘要未给出具体实验对象、方法或结果细节。

papers.title: Trait-relevant movies amplify neuroticism-associated brain responses.
papers.authors: Popp JL, Weiß M, Faskowitz J, Hilger K.
papers.abstract: High neuroticism is a risk factor for mental disorders. Understanding whether individuals share a common foundation in brain function underlying neuroticism is therefore an essential goal of neuroscience. We applied Inter-Subject Representational Similarity Analysis on data from 174 Human Connectome Project participants to investigate if their similarity in neuroticism is reflected in their similarity of fMRI-recorded brain activity during movie watching. To test behavioral personality theories that consider trait expression as dependent on situational context, we examined whether brain-trait representational similarity varied between trait-relevant and trait-irrelevant movie scenes (independently rated, N = 86). Higher neuroticism was associated with greater heterogeneity in brain responses, a pattern that was particularly pronounced during trait-relevant scenes. Our study informs dimensional conceptualizations of psychopathology viewing neuroticism as risk factor and extends behavioral personality theories to the level of brain function. Broadly, it highlights the value of naturalistic imaging and underscores the importance of stimulus selection when investigating brain-behavior associations.

relevance.reason: 用自然电影fMRI研究神经质人格特质相关的脑活动表征相似性，属人格/情绪相关认知与自然刺激脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注神经质是否存在共享的脑功能基础，以及这种脑—特质关联是否随情境变化。作者对174名人类连接组计划参与者在观看电影时的fMRI数据进行受试者间表征相似性分析，并用独立评定区分与特质相关和无关的场景。结果显示，神经质越高，脑反应在个体间越异质，这一模式在特质相关场景中尤为明显。作者据此认为，研究将行为人格理论延伸到脑功能层面，支持把神经质视为精神病理风险因素的维度化理解，同时提示自然情境成像中刺激选择对脑—行为关联研究的重要性。

papers.title: LSD reconfigures cortical dynamics through faster brain rhythms and increased fractal dimension.
papers.authors: Subramani V, Nest T, Pascarella A, Brunel J, Mantilla Ramos YJ, Harel Y, Muthukumaraswamy S, Carhart-Harris R, Lioi G, Farrugia N, Jerbi K.
papers.abstract: Lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) profoundly alters conscious experience, yet the electrophysiological mechanisms by which it reshapes neural dynamics remain incompletely understood. A hallmark of psychedelic states is widespread cortical desynchronization, typically inferred from reductions in spectral power, but whether such effects reflect genuine weakening of neural oscillations or are confounded by shifts in oscillatory peak frequencies remains unresolved. We combine source-resolved magnetoencephalography (MEG), spectral parameterization, temporal complexity metrics, and interpretable machine learning in an LSD versus placebo design, with and without music. We show that LSD induces robust, spatially structured increases in alpha and beta peak frequencies alongside genuine attenuation of oscillatory power, with partly dissociable cortical patterns. Beyond rhythmic activity, LSD is associated with flattening of the aperiodic 1/f spectral slope and increased neural signal fractality and complexity, preferentially affecting sensory, language, emotion, and imagery-related networks while sparing motor cortex. Machine-learning analyses identify peak-frequency shifts, aperiodic parameters, and complexity measures as key discriminators of the psychedelic state. Music does not robustly amplify these neural signatures and instead shows a trend toward attenuation. These findings provide an electrophysiological account of how LSD reorganizes large-scale human brain dynamics and highlight features that may differentiate its neural signature from other psychedelics.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究LSD改变人脑皮层振荡频率、非周期成分与信号复杂度，涉及意识状态与大规模脑动力学组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注LSD如何改变人脑大规模电生理动态，并试图厘清皮层去同步化究竟反映振荡真实减弱，还是受振荡峰值频率偏移干扰。作者结合源分辨脑磁图、频谱参数化、时间复杂性指标和可解释机器学习，在LSD与安慰剂对照（含音乐与无音乐条件）中比较神经活动。结果显示，LSD既使alpha和beta峰值频率升高，也真实降低振荡功率，两者皮层分布部分分离；同时非周期1/f斜率变平，信号分形维度和复杂性增加，主要涉及感觉、语言、情绪和想象相关网络，而运动皮层相对不受影响。机器学习表明峰值频率偏移、非周期参数和复杂性指标是区分迷幻状态的关键特征；音乐未稳健增强这些特征，反而呈减弱趋势。作者据此提出LSD通过更快脑节律和更高分形维度重组皮层动态，并提示这些特征或有助于区分其与其他迷幻药的神经印记。

papers.title: Molecular mechanisms of electroconvulsive therapy modulates excitation-inhibition balance in major depression disorder.
papers.authors: Yu X, Yang F, Shang W, Cheng B, Wang L, Xia X, Chen M, Tian Y, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Background The excitation-inhibition (E/I) imbalance is a major pathological characteristic of major depressive disorder (MDD). However, whether/how electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) modulates neuronal homeostasis or E/I balance in MDD and its molecular basis is still largely unknown. Methods In this study, longitudinal rs-fMRI data from 46 patients with MDD receiving ECT and 46 healthy controls were included. The Hurst index was used to characterize the E/I balance, and mixed-effects model was constructed to assess the interactive effects of ECT on the Hurst index and functional connectivity (FC). Moreover, spatial correlation analyses were conducted by integrating cortical myelination pattern, glucose metabolism distribution, neurotransmitter density maps, and transcriptomic data to reveal the underlying molecular basis. Results ECT significantly reduces the Hurst index in the middle cingulate cortex (MCC) and induces functional decoupling between the MCC and the posterior cingulate cortex. Furthermore, changes in the Hurst index were closely associated with cortical myelination, glucose metabolism, and the distribution maps of dopamine and histamine. Spatial transcriptomic association analysis revealed that genes regulating the effects of ECT on Hurst index or FC are specifically enriched in cell types such as excitatory neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes, and are primarily involved in biological processes including synaptic signal transduction, neuronal projection regulation, and glutamatergic synapses. Conclusion These findings suggest that ECT may regulate the processes of myelin remodelling through neurons and glial cells by influencing the expression levels of relevant genes, thereby modulating the E/I balance and functional network activity in a synergistic manner to improve depressive symptoms.

relevance.reason: 以抑郁症患者为对象，用纵向静息态fMRI研究ECT对兴奋-抑制平衡与功能连接的影响，并结合髓鞘、代谢与转录组空间关联，属脑疾病神经机制与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注电休克治疗是否以及如何调节重性抑郁障碍的兴奋-抑制平衡及其分子基础，纵向追踪患者治疗前后的静息态功能磁共振数据，并与健康对照比较，用Hurst指数刻画兴奋-抑制平衡。结果显示，电休克治疗显著降低中扣带皮层的Hurst指数，并引起该区与后扣带皮层之间的功能解耦；这些变化与皮层髓鞘化、葡萄糖代谢以及多巴胺和组胺分布相关。空间转录组关联分析进一步提示，相关基因富集于兴奋性神经元、星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞，涉及突触信号转导、神经投射调控和谷氨酸能突触等过程。作者据此推测，电休克治疗可能通过影响相关基因表达，经神经元和胶质细胞参与髓鞘重塑，协同调节兴奋-抑制平衡与功能网络活动，从而改善抑郁症状；这属于基于关联和空间转录组数据的机制推测，尚非因果验证。

papers.title: Every (slow) breath you take, every choice you make.
papers.authors: Kwon SJ, Dennis NJ, Delgado MR.
papers.abstract: Huang and colleagues investigated how slow-paced breathing shapes physiological and brain-related signals during financial decisions under risk. Their findings elucidate neurovisceral pathways linking prolonged exhalation to increased risk-taking, whereby heightened cardiac parasympathetic modulation increases reward sensitivity and neural activity in brain regions involved in valuation and interoception.

relevance.reason: 研究缓慢呼吸通过神经内脏通路影响风险决策及估值/内感受脑区活动，属决策与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: Huang等人考察了慢节奏呼吸如何在风险性金融决策中影响生理与脑相关信号。研究发现，延长呼气与更高的冒险倾向相关，其背后涉及一条神经内脏通路：心脏副交感调节增强会提高奖赏敏感性，并增强参与价值评估和内感受的脑区活动。该结果提示，呼吸相关的自主神经状态可能通过影响奖赏与内感受加工来调节风险决策，但摘要未说明因果方向及具体实验条件。

papers.title: Exploring the reconfiguration effects of physical fatigue on the gradient space of brain function based on EEG.
papers.authors: Yang G, Chi P, Zhao S.
papers.abstract: Objective This study examined how physical fatigue reorganizes the low-dimensional structure of EEG functional connectivity using three embedding approaches. Method Thirty male participants completed a Bruce treadmill test to exhaustion, with resting-state EEG recorded before and after exercise. Frequency-specific wPLI connectivity matrices were analyzed using PCA, Laplacian eigenmaps, and diffusion maps with common-reference alignment. Regional G1-G3 scores, G1-G2 displacement, λ1-λ3 eigenvalues, and their associations with exercise duration were assessed. Results PCA showed increased beta-band G1 scores over the central scalp region and decreased scores over the occipital region, together with reduced alpha-band G3 over the central region. LE showed increased theta-band G3 over the central region. PCA displacement exhibited a significant frequency band × scalp region interaction, driven by greater alpha-band occipital displacement. Theta-band λ1-λ3 increased with PCA but decreased with DM, whereas LE showed no significant eigenvalue changes. The PCA-derived beta-band central ΔG1 was positively correlated with exhaustive exercise duration (r = 0.50, p = 0.004). Conclusions Physical fatigue induces frequency-, region-, component-, and method-specific reorganization of the low-dimensional structure of scalp-level EEG functional connectivity. PCA was particularly sensitive to spatially differentiated gradient changes, while LE and DM captured complementary aspects of fatigue-related reorganization. The association between central beta-band ΔG1 and exercise duration further suggests potential behavioral relevance of gradient.

relevance.reason: 用静息EEG研究体力疲劳如何重组脑功能连接的低维梯度结构，属自发活动与功能网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电功能连接的低维嵌入方法，考察体力疲劳如何重组大脑功能梯度空间。30名男性完成力竭跑台测试，比较运动前后静息态脑电。结果显示，疲劳引起的梯度变化因频段、头皮区域、成分和嵌入方法而异：主成分分析对空间分化较敏感，拉普拉斯特征映射和扩散映射则捕捉到互补的重组特征；中央区β频段梯度变化还与力竭运动时长呈正相关，提示其可能具有行为相关性。

papers.title: Age-related compression of posterior cingulate-retrosplenial connectivity gradients and its association with allocentric navigation.
papers.authors: Liu J, Zhang Y, Xue Y, Yang Y, Zhao H, He Q, Liao C.
papers.abstract: Allocentric spatial navigation declines with age, but the underlying neural mechanisms remain unclear. The posterior cingulate/retrosplenial cortex (PCC/RSC) is an integrative navigation hub and is also among the earliest regions affected by aging. We investigated whether the PCC/RSC is organized along continuous functional connectivity gradients, and how these gradients relate to age and spatial navigation ability. Using an adult-lifespan sample from the Southwest University Adult Lifespan Dataset (SALD; n = 479; age range = 19-80 years), we characterized functional connectivity gradients within the PCC/RSC complex and examined their associations with age. Two dominant functional connectivity gradients (G1 and G2) were identified within the PCC/RSC complex. The ranges of both gradients decreased significantly with age. In an independent navigation sample comprising 19 younger and 19 older adults, participants underwent resting-state fMRI and task-based fMRI while performing an allocentric object-location memory task. We examined whether age-related gradient compression was also evident in this independent navigation sample and whether gradient range was associated with navigation performance. Older adults showed smaller task-state left G1, task-state right G2, and resting-state right G2 ranges, with the largest reduction in task-state left G1 (approximately 65%). Among older adults, greater task-state left G1 range was associated with lower drop error. These findings provide novel evidence that age-related compression of PCC/RSC functional organization is behaviorally relevant to allocentric navigation decline.

relevance.reason: 研究PCC/RSC功能连接梯度随年龄压缩及其与空间导航行为的关系，属认知老化与脑功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注衰老过程中异我中心空间导航能力下降的神经机制，考察后扣带/压后皮层（PCC/RSC）是否沿连续的功能连接梯度组织，以及这些梯度与年龄和导航表现的关系。作者在成人毕生样本中识别出两条主要功能连接梯度，发现其范围随年龄增长而缩小；在一个独立的导航样本中，老年人任务态和静息态下的梯度范围同样减小，其中任务态左侧梯度缩减最明显。在老年人中，任务态左侧梯度范围较大者导航误差较小，提示PCC/RSC功能组织的年龄相关压缩与异我中心导航衰退存在行为关联。

papers.title: Evolutionary conservation of MECP2 and its relevance to neuronal stability and behavioral adaptation.
papers.authors: Braun M, Tabach Y.
papers.abstract: MECP2 encodes a methyl-DNA-binding chromatin protein whose dosage is critical for nervous system function: loss-of-function variants cause Rett syndrome, whereas increased dosage causes MECP2 duplication syndrome. Despite extensive research on MECP2 in neurodevelopmental diseases, its unexplored evolutionary history, which we derived from comparative genomic analysis of hundreds of species, provides a novel evolutionary framework for understanding the profound consequences of MECP2 perturbation on brain and behavior. In this review, we analyze the phylogenetic profile of MECP2 and discuss how comparative, molecular, and developmental evidence supports the idea that MECP2 gained significant importance in vertebrate nervous systems. This is because broad CpG methylation, postnatal accumulation of neuronal non-CpG methylation, and long-lived post-mitotic circuits created a growing need for stable yet flexible interpretation of methylation states. We further discuss evidence that MECP2 is functionally anchored to a conserved chromatin-repression axis, particularly the NCoR/SMRT corepressor machinery, while also showing signs of more lineage-restricted integration with mammalian dosage-sensitive regulatory networks. We propose that MECP2 is best understood as a vertebrate-specialized regulator that helps preserve transcriptional homeostasis in mature neurons while allowing experience-dependent plasticity. This framework links methylome interpretation to behavioral adaptation and may help explain why MECP2 dysregulation produces such profound and dosage-sensitive consequences for brain function and behavior.

relevance.reason: 综述MECP2在脊椎动物神经系统中的作用，讨论其对成熟神经元转录稳态与经验依赖性可塑性的调控，涉及人脑可塑性机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述基于数百个物种的比较基因组分析，梳理MECP2的系统发育特征，并结合比较、分子与发育证据，探讨其进化历史如何解释该基因扰动对脑与行为的深远影响。作者提出，脊椎动物神经系统中广泛的CpG甲基化、出生后神经元非CpG甲基化的积累以及长寿命的出生后分裂后神经环路，共同增加了对甲基化状态进行稳定而灵活解读的需求，使MECP2在脊椎动物神经系统中获得重要地位。文章进一步指出，MECP2在功能上锚定于保守的染色质抑制轴（尤其是NCoR/SMRT辅阻遏物机制），同时表现出与哺乳动物剂量敏感调控网络更谱系局限的整合迹象。作者据此将MECP2理解为一种脊椎动物特化的调控因子，帮助成熟神经元维持转录稳态并保留经验依赖的可塑性，从而把甲基化组解读与行为适应联系起来，并可能解释MECP2失调为何对脑功能和行为产生如此深刻且剂量敏感的后果。

papers.title: Mapping reproducible brain-based depression stratification across clinical, cognitive, and neurotransmitter dimensions.
papers.authors: Colombo F, Fortaner-Uyà L, Cazzella T, Martone A, Monopoli C, Colombo C, Zanardi R, Carminati M, Fabbri C, Serretti A, Poletti S, Benedetti F, Vai B.
papers.abstract: Identifying reproducible brain-based stratifications across independent cohorts is critical for parsing heterogeneity in Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), yet robust profiles spanning micro- and macroscales remain poorly defined. We applied stability-based clustering to cortical thickness (CT) data from 1531 MDD individuals in UK Biobank (UKB), with replication in 144 inpatients from IRCCS San Raffaele Hospital (HSR). Two stable clusters emerged (normalized stability = 0.125) that generalized to a hold-out UKB sample with 96.5% accuracy (majority-cluster baseline = 59.5%). The clusters differed in widespread CT, largely reflected in global CT, with one showing cortical thinning, childhood trauma, and diabetes comorbidity. A two-cluster structure was independently replicated in HSR (normalized stability = 0.29), with a broadly similar cortical topography, although systematic CT differences between cohorts limited direct cross-cohort comparability. The clinical correlates identified in UKB did not replicate after correction for multiple comparisons. In UKB, mapping the CT differences between strata onto Neurosynth meta-analytic activation patterns revealed a ventral-dorsal gradient linked with emotion regulation, interoceptive, and motivational processes. Spatial correlations with 19 neurotransmitter receptors and transporters obtained from positron emission tomography identified the dopamine transporter as the dominant contributor in UKB, and the histamine H3 receptor in HSR. These findings provide a reproducible framework linking CT-based clusters in MDD to multiscale biological organization, although their clinical relevance warrants further investigation.

relevance.reason: 以抑郁症患者皮层厚度分型并映射到神经递质与功能网络，属脑疾病异质性及结构-功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍的脑结构分层能否在独立队列中稳定重现，并对英国生物银行抑郁个体的皮层厚度数据做稳定性聚类，在医院住院患者样本中进行重复验证。两个稳定亚型在留出样本中具有较高的归类一致性，主要差别体现在广泛的皮层厚度上，其中一个亚型表现为皮层变薄，并伴有童年创伤和糖尿病共病。该分层结构在独立样本中得到重复，皮层地形大体相似，但队列间系统性厚度差异限制了直接比较；英国生物银行中识别的临床相关因素经多重比较校正后未获重复。作者进一步将亚型间厚度差异对应到情绪调节、内感受和动机相关脑区模式，并发现与多种神经递质受体和转运体空间分布相关，但主导递质在两队列中不同。总体而言，研究提供了可重复的皮层厚度分层框架，其临床意义仍需进一步检验。

papers.title: The fetal heart-brain axis as a new frontier for long-term outcomes in children with congenital heart disease.
papers.authors: Hou S, Wang J, Mao B, Zhou Y, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Survival among children with congenital heart disease (CHD) has improved substantially with advances in prenatal screening, perioperative care and cardiac surgery. However, neurodevelopmental, cognitive-behavioural and health-related quality-of-life outcomes remain major determinants of long-term morbidity. Recent work using fetal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), fetal cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), Doppler haemodynamic assessment and placental studies suggests that CHD-related alterations in brain development do not arise solely after postnatal surgery or intensive care, but may already be present before birth. In normal fetal circulation, finely tuned coupling between the placenta, heart and brain preferentially directs oxygen-rich blood towards the cerebral and coronary circulations. Complex CHD can disrupt this streaming physiology, leading to reduced cerebral perfusion, oxygenation and metabolism. Placental dysfunction, genetic variation, inflammation and oxidative stress may further amplify heart-brain imbalance, making reduced brain volume, delayed white-matter maturation and abnormal brain-network development important intermediate phenotypes for later neurodevelopmental risk. This review discusses the normal physiology of the fetal heart-brain axis, mechanisms of fetal heart-brain-axis disruption in CHD, links with long-term outcomes, prenatal assessment tools and potential intervention strategies. We also identify key knowledge gaps and emphasise the need for multicentre longitudinal cohorts and multimodal prediction models, with the aim of shifting CHD care from cardiac repair alone towards continuous neuroprotection before and after birth.

papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦先天性心脏病（CHD）儿童长期神经发育结局，提出“胎儿心-脑轴”这一视角，梳理胎儿期心、脑与胎盘之间的血流耦合如何在CHD中被扰乱。作者综合胎儿MRI、胎儿心血管磁共振、多普勒血流评估和胎盘研究等证据指出，CHD相关的脑发育改变可能出生前就已存在，而非仅源于出生后手术或重症监护；脑灌注、氧合与代谢下降，加之胎盘功能异常、遗传变异、炎症和氧化应激，可能共同加剧心脑失衡，使脑体积减小、白质成熟延迟和脑网络发育异常成为日后神经发育风险的中介表型。文章据此讨论产前评估工具与潜在干预策略，并指出需开展多中心纵向队列和多模态预测模型研究，以推动CHD照护从单纯心脏修复转向出生前后的持续神经保护。

papers.title: Multidimensional semantic activation in children's discourse reading is associated with their reading ability.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Zhou W, Wang X, Huang L, Wang S, Lin N.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Around fourth grade, children transition from learning-to-read to reading-to-learn, yet how their multidimensional semantic representation during discourse reading differs from that of adults and relates to reading ability remains unclear. This study investigated multidimensional semantic activation in 42 fourth-to sixth-grade children (mean age 10.3 years) and 44 adults (mean age 25.1 years) during story reading using fMRI. Children were stratified by reading ability using inverse efficiency scores from comprehension questions. Semantic activation across six dimensions (visual, motor, social, emotional, spatial, temporal) was modeled using the Six Semantic Dimension Database. Results showed that high-reading-ability children exhibited significantly stronger temporal but weaker social semantic activation compared to adults, whereas low-reading-ability children showed adult-like patterns. Brain-behavior association analyses revealed that multidimensional semantic activation patterns were linked to reading performance in children (explaining 25.0% of variance), whereas no such relationship was evident in adults. Additionally, high-reading-ability children demonstrated enhanced activation in cognitive control networks relative to both low-ability peers and adults. These findings suggest that high-reading-ability children may strategically modulate multidimensional semantic processing through cognitive control to compensate for limited reading experience, highlighting the flexible, strategy-dependent nature of multidimensional semantic representation during developmental reading.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注小学中高年级儿童在语篇阅读中的多维语义激活是否与成人不同、又与阅读能力有何关联，用fMRI比较儿童与成人阅读故事时的语义加工，并按阅读能力对儿童分组。结果显示，高阅读能力儿童在时间维度上的语义激活强于成人、社会维度上弱于成人，而低阅读能力儿童的模式反而接近成人；多维语义激活模式与儿童阅读表现相关，在成人中未见这种关系，高阅读能力儿童还表现出更强的认知控制网络激活。作者据此推测，高阅读能力儿童可能借助认知控制策略性调节多维语义加工，以弥补阅读经验不足，提示发展期语义表征具有策略依赖的灵活性。

papers.title: Resting-state functional connectivity alterations and neurodevelopmental outcomes in neonates at high risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury.
papers.authors: Li Y, Peng C, Liu L, Niu F, Yang J, Ji Y, Hou X.
papers.abstract: Background High risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury during the neonatal period may disrupt early brain maturation, yet its impact on large-scale functional network organization and later neurodevelopment remains insufficiently understood. Methods Resting-state functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) was used to characterize cortical functional connectivity in neonates at high risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury and controls. Functional connectivity, multivariate pattern analysis, and graph-theoretical approaches were applied to examine group differences in network organization and their associations with developmental outcome. Results Compared with controls, high-risk neonates showed reduced functional connectivity predominantly within the frontoparietal network. Seed-based multivariate pattern analysis identified the left parietal lobe as the strongest discriminator between groups. Within the frontoparietal subnetwork, the high-risk group showed reduced clustering coefficient and increased global efficiency, suggesting reduced local segregation and atypical network reorganization. Clustering coefficient was positively associated with later Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ-3) scores in both groups, consistent with a general developmental relationship. In contrast, higher global efficiency and lower nodal clustering in the left prefrontal cortex were associated with poorer developmental outcomes only in the high-risk group. Conclusions Neonates at high risk of hypoxic-ischemic brain injury show early alterations in frontoparietal functional organization, some of which are associated with later neurodevelopment. Resting-state fNIRS-derived connectomic measures may therefore have potential for early risk characterization, although further validation in larger independent cohorts is needed.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注新生儿期缺氧缺血性脑损伤高风险是否会影响早期大规模功能网络组织及其后续神经发育，采用静息态功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）比较高风险新生儿与对照组的皮层功能连接，并结合多变量模式分析和图论方法考察网络组织差异及其与发育结局的关联。结果显示，高风险组的功能连接降低主要出现在额顶网络内，左侧顶叶在区分两组时贡献最大；额顶子网络内聚集系数降低而全局效率升高，提示局部分离减弱和非典型网络重组。聚集系数与两组 later ASQ-3 得分均呈正相关，而左前额叶皮层较高的全局效率和较低的节点聚集系数仅在高风险组与较差发育结局相关。作者认为，这些早期额顶功能组织改变部分与后续神经发育相关，fNIRS 连接组指标或有助于早期风险刻画，但尚需在更大独立队列中验证。

papers.title: A Hierarchical-Dynamic integration model for the formation of interpersonal neural synchrony during spoken communication.
papers.authors: Bai Y, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Interpersonal neural synchrony (INS) is widely observed during spoken communication, yet the cognitive and neural processes through which it emerges remain incompletely understood. This review synthesizes evidence on the functional significance, representational organization, and neural implementation of INS and proposes a Hierarchical-Dynamic Integration Model (HDIM) of its formation. HDIM conceptualizes INS as the cross-brain manifestation of ongoing coordination between two interdependent processes: multilevel linguistic alignment and contextual-intentional integration. The hierarchical organization of linguistic alignment encompasses functionally differentiated yet interacting phonological/prosodic, lexical-syntactic, semantic, and higher-order representational levels, without assuming a fixed bottom-up sequence. Its dynamicity arises from recurrent processes of prediction, imitation, and adaptation that continuously regulate interpersonal coordination as communication unfolds. At the neural level, HDIM proposes that linguistic alignment engages distributed bilateral language systems, whereas contextual-intentional integration recruits coordinated activity across language-related and social-cognitive/mentalizing systems. The model yields four empirically testable predictions concerning partial dissociation among representational levels, functional dependencies across levels, temporally differentiated yet interacting regulatory processes, and partner-sensitive integration of linguistic and non-linguistic information. We further identify uneven empirical support across components of the model, together with causal and methodological challenges and limitations in its current scope. We conclude by outlining priorities for causal and interaction-specific testing, computational formalization, and evaluation of the model's boundary conditions and generalizability across communicative contexts.

relevance.reason: 综述提出言语交流中人际神经同步形成的层级-动态整合模型，涉及语言对齐的多层级表征及语言与社会认知系统的神经实现，属语言与脑机制理论框架。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了口语交流中人际神经同步（INS）的形成机制，并提出层级-动态整合模型（HDIM）。作者将INS视为多层次语言对齐与情境-意图整合这两个相互依赖过程在脑间的协调表现，其中语言对齐涵盖功能分化又相互作用的语音/韵律、词汇-句法、语义及高阶表征层次，其动态性来自预测、模仿和适应的反复调节；神经层面上，语言对齐涉及双侧语言系统，情境-意图整合则调动语言相关系统与社会认知/心理化系统的协同活动。模型给出四条可检验预测，并指出各成分证据支持不均、因果推断和方法学挑战及适用范围局限，呼吁开展因果与互动特异性检验、计算形式化以及边界条件和跨情境推广性评估。

papers.title: Recall of overlearned speech in noise: Developmental ERP findings and an episodic buffer frame for culturally situated brain activity.
papers.authors: D'Angiulli A, Sheculski M, Morrow A.
papers.abstract: How does extensively practiced speech memory remain dependent on momentary sensory input, and how does this interaction shape brain activity during development? This perspective integrates exploratory behavioral and event-related potential (ERP) findings from a culturally situated spoken-sequence recognition paradigm with a working memory episodic-buffer account. We reanalyzed data from children and young adults who had memorized Quranic passages despite limited Arabic comprehension. Participants heard incomplete passages with or without static noise and selected the missing final word from phonologically plausible alternatives. Noise reduced recognition accuracy, and children generally responded more slowly. Descriptive ERP patterns revealed larger, more spatially distributed responses in children, spanning early auditory processing, mid-latency positivity, and later negative activity. We propose that recognition requires temporary binding of acoustic input, serial and rhythmic expectations, visual response cues, and consolidated sequence knowledge within an episodic buffer under executive control. Noise may impair perceptual fidelity and matching between transient input and stored representations. Developmental ERP differences may reflect representational coordination rather than neural efficiency. These preliminary findings motivate testable predictions concerning cross-modal congruence, familiarity, comprehension, and independently measured expertise. Culturally embedded learning practices provide informative contexts for examining interactions among working memory, long-term knowledge, and developing neural systems supporting cognition.

papers.summary_zh: 该视角文章将一项文化情境下的口语序列识别范式的探索性行为与事件相关电位（ERP）结果，与工作记忆的情景缓冲模型相结合，考察经过大量练习的语音记忆为何仍依赖当下感觉输入，以及这种交互在发育中如何体现。研究对象为已背诵古兰经段落但阿拉伯语理解有限的儿童和青年；他们听带或不带噪声的不完整段落，并从语音上合理的选项中选出缺失的末词。噪声降低了识别正确率，儿童总体反应更慢；描述性ERP显示儿童反应更大且空间分布更广，涉及早期听觉加工、中潜伏期正波和较晚的负波。作者据此提出，识别需要在执行控制下由情景缓冲临时绑定声学输入、序列与节奏预期、视觉反应线索及巩固的序列知识，噪声可能损害知觉保真度及输入与存储表征的匹配，发育差异或反映表征协调而非神经效率。这些初步发现尚属探索性，作者据此提出关于跨通道一致性、熟悉度、理解及独立测量专长的可检验预测。

papers.title: Cortical thickness signature of early-onset Alzheimer's disease across clinical stages and A/T1 biomarker profiles.
papers.authors: Zilioli A, Mohanty R, Rosenberg A, Matton A, Granberg T, Hagman G, Spallazzi M, Kivipelto M, Westman E.
papers.abstract: Background The cortical thinning signature of early-onset Alzheimer's disease (EOAD) is well established in dementia, but its emergence during earlier disease stages remains unclear. We investigated when it becomes detectable and whether it differs according to fluid amyloid and phosphorylated-tau (A/T1) biomarker profiles. Methods We studied 292 individuals <65 years who underwent 3T structural MRI and cerebrospinal fluid assessment of Aβ42/40 and p-tau181. Participants were classified as A-T1- subjective cognitive decline (SCD; reference group), A+T1-, or A+T1+. Cortical thickness and hippocampal volume were measured using FreeSurfer. EOAD signature regions were defined by comparing biomarker-confirmed AD dementia with the reference group and subsequently examined across A/T1 profiles in SCD and mild cognitive impairment (MCI). Brain-cognition associations were assessed. Results The cohort comprised 107 reference and 185 amyloid-positive participants (76 A+T1- and 109 A+T1+). EOAD dementia was characterized by marked cortical thinning in posterior parietal and lateral temporal regions. In MCI, cortical thinning was focal in A+T1-, but more extensive in A+T1+ who also showed hippocampal atrophy. At the SCD stage, focal thinning of the EOAD signature, precuneus, and banks of the superior temporal sulcus was observed in A+T1+, whereas no structural alterations were detected in A+T1-. Cortical thinning was associated with episodic and visuospatial memory performance in MCI, while no brain-cognition associations were observed in SCD. Conclusion EOAD-related cortical thinning is detectable before dementia and varies across A/T1 profiles, with combined amyloid and p-tau181 positivity associated with earlier and more extensive structural involvement.

papers.title: Neural substrates of knowledge integration: differential effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) on angular gyrus and ventrolateral prefrontal cortex.
papers.authors: Zhang X, Lochner M, Joseph K, Gilboa A.
papers.abstract: Background Humans develop extensive knowledge systems throughout their lives, which are continuously updated in response to new information. One way in which prior knowledge is updated is through semantic integration, where related semantic facts are integrated to support derivation of new information. Methods This study investigates how anodal high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) applied to the left angular gyrus (AG; Experiment 1) or to the left ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (vlPFC; Experiment 2) influences semantic integration and the derivation of novel information. In both studies, participants were first randomly assigned to a stimulation or sham group. Following the stimulation protocol, they were presented with a series of intermixed pairs of related facts and asked to rate their familiarity with each. Participants then completed a semantic integration test following a brief delay, answering questions about novel information that could be derived by integrating the related facts. Participants' integration scores (primary outcome) and their correlations with general intelligence (IQ) (secondary outcome) were measured. Building on exploratory findings from Experiment 1, Experiment 2 was pre-registered to test the impact of stimulation on the correlation between IQ and integration. Results There was no overall mean difference in integration scores between stimulation groups and their sham stimulation counterparts (all p s > 0.10). Stimulation to the left AG resulted in significantly lower variance in integration scores compared to sham stimulation (p < 0.05), reflecting fewer stimulation participants scoring very low on integration. Conversely, stimulation to the left vlPFC reduced the correlation between participants' IQ and their integration scores (p < 0.05). Conclusion Self-derivation of new knowledge is a complex, multifactorial process that was not uniquely enhanced by stimulation of the left AG or vlPFC. However, these regions appear to differentially modulate performance by reducing variability for lower-performing individuals (AG) or decoupling the dependence of performance on baseline cognitive capacity (vlPFC).

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察左侧角回和腹外侧前额叶的高清经颅直流电刺激如何影响语义整合与新信息推导，采用随机分组的真刺激与伪刺激对照，并在刺激后让参与者阅读相关事实对、进行整合测试。结果显示，两个脑区的刺激均未提高整合成绩的总体均值；但角回刺激降低了整合分数的个体差异，表现为极低分者减少，而腹外侧前额叶刺激则削弱了智商与整合成绩之间的关联。作者据此认为，新知识的自主推导是多因素过程，这两个脑区并非单独提升成绩，而是分别通过减少低表现者的波动、解耦成绩对基线认知能力的依赖来调节表现。

papers.title: Multiscale Network Disruption of Auditory-Language Circuits Underlying Auditory Hallucinations in Schizophrenia
papers.authors: Murphy AC, Martinez A, Chen Y, Avissar M, Yalçınkaya BH, Sanchez-Pena J, Patel GH, Javitt DC.
papers.abstract: Background Auditory verbal hallucinations (AVH) are among the most disabling symptoms of schizophrenia, yet the network-level mechanisms linking auditory dysfunction to hallucination severity remain poorly characterized, limiting targeted therapeutic development. Methods Using resting-state fMRI and high-resolution surface-based parcellation (HCP-MMP), we examined auditory-language functional connectivity and mesoscale network organization in 56 patients with schizophrenia and 22 healthy controls (primary dataset, N=78). Pairwise auditory-language connectivity associations with hallucination severity (PANSS P3) were examined alongside auditory network community structure, assortativity, hub organization, and routing efficiency. To further characterize these parcel-level findings at the vertex level, we applied a region-growing approach to identify auditory-frontal connectivity patterns maximally associated with severity. In silico perturbation analyses tested the causal role of belt cortex connectivity. Key findings were independently replicated in 93 patients from the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCP-EP), for a combined total of 171 participants. Results Auditory-language connectivity disruptions were concentrated in belt cortex and specifically implicated ventral what-stream connections, with a vertex-wise analysis converging on the same anatomy. Auditory network segregation scaled with hallucination severity, with belt cortex emerging as the primary integrative hub governing auditory-to-language routing efficiency. Perturbation analyses showed that strengthening earlier-hierarchy auditory regions reduced network segregation more than strengthening later-hierarchy regions. Reduced belt cortex coupling and elevated network segregation replicated independently in the HCP-EP sample. Conclusions Auditory network disorganization scales with hallucination severity and replicates across independent samples, with belt cortex as the critical locus of connectivity disruption and network integration failure, identifying it as a candidate neuromodulatory target.

papers.title: Thalamic Dysconnectivity and Negative Symptoms in Schizophrenia Spectrum Disorder
papers.authors: Kunitoki K, Adhikari BM, Ankeeta A, Gao S, Ma Y, Straub K, Dos Santos Alves Maria G, Pagán AF, Warner A, Du X, Kochunov P, Hong LE.
papers.abstract: Background and Hypothesis Negative symptoms in schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD) are associated with poor functional outcomes and reduced quality of life; however, effective treatments remain limited. A better understanding of the underlying brain mechanisms is needed to develop better treatments. Neuroimaging studies implicate multiple brain networks in negative symptoms, though findings remain heterogeneous, potentially reflecting the multidimensionality of both symptoms and brain networks. Larger, more systematic dissections are required to identify the key hub(s) underlying negative symptoms. Study Design Structural MRI data from 394 participants (210 SSD, 184 healthy controls [HC]) were analyzed to identify cortical thickness and subcortical volume demonstrating both SSD-HC differences and associations with negative symptoms measured by the Brief Negative Symptom Scale (BNSS). Regions meeting both criteria were selected as seeds for resting-state functional connectivity analyses in 143 SSD patients to examine association with negative symptoms and their subdomains. Study Results The thalamus was the only region demonstrating significant structural abnormalities both in SSD and an association with BNSS total score (p-FDR<0.05). Functional-network-defined thalamic subregions were subsequently examined. Several thalamic hypoconnectivities were significantly corresponded with negative symptoms, involving thalamic subregions associated with the cortical default mode, somatosensory, medial temporal, and dorsal attention networks (p=0.001, a corrected <0.05). Blunted affect showed the most extensive thalamic connectivity alterations, involving the striatum, cerebellum, and temporoparietal junction/superior temporal sulcus (TPJ- STS). Thalamic hypoconnectivity with TPJ-STS was also associated with overall negative symptoms and anhedonia. Conclusions This study identifies the thalamus as a central hub of negative symptom-related dysfunction in SSD and highlights specific thalamic subnetworks as potential targets for circuit-based interventions. Keyword: Schizophrenia, Negative Symptoms, Structural MRI, Functional Connectivity, Thalamus

papers.title: Late-Pregnancy Immune and Kynurenine Signatures Predict Postpartum Depression and Brain Morphology
papers.authors: Harrington YA, Shin HK, Milano C, Mauri MC, Marano A, Maggioni E, Squarcina L, Tassi E, Enrico P, Persico N, Conte G, Melloni EM, Agnoletto E, Spadini S, Lorenzi C, Nasini S, Dall’Acqua S, Comai S, Poletti S, Origoni M, Brambilla P, Benedetti F, Milano PPDINFLAME Study Group.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Pregnancy involves profound immune adaptations that may contribute to the development of postpartum depression (PPD); however, the relevant biomarkers and critical time window remain unclear. Therefore, we investigated whether third-trimester and postpartum cytokines and kynurenine pathway (KP) metabolites predict PPD and whether these biological signatures are related to postpartum brain morphology. Methods Circulating cytokines and KP metabolites were assessed in 140 pregnant women during the third trimester and postpartum. Partial least squares (PLS) regression models were used to identify multivariate biological profiles predictive of PPD, followed by classification and regression tree (CART) analyses to evaluate predictive performance. In a neuroimaging subsample (n=61), voxel-based morphometry examined associations among PPD status, significant PLS-derived components, selected individual biomarkers, and postpartum grey matter volume. Results A third-trimester cytokine signature including 21 cytokines significantly predicted PPD with high specificity. A third-trimester KP profile, driven primarily by the kynurenic acid/quinolinic acid ratio, also predicted PPD, and the combination of cytokine and KP components improved overall predictive performance to 93.3%. Postpartum biomarkers showed substantially weaker associations with PPD. The cytokine component was differentially associated with postpartum grey matter volume according to PPD status, with opposite associations observed in occipital regions between women who did and did not develop PPD. KP measures also showed distinct associations within sensorimotor regions based on PPD status Conclusions Late pregnancy immune-inflammatory alterations are associated with subsequent PPD and postpartum brain morphology, supporting the potential utility of pregnancy-derived biological signatures for identifying women at increased risk for PPD.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注妊娠期免疫与犬尿氨酸通路变化能否预测产后抑郁及其与产后脑形态的关系，在孕晚期和产后检测孕妇外周血细胞因子与犬尿氨酸代谢物，并结合部分参与者的脑影像分析。结果显示，孕晚期一组细胞因子特征可较特异地预测产后抑郁，以犬尿氨酸/喹啉酸比值为主的代谢特征同样具有预测作用，两者结合后整体预测表现进一步提升；相比之下，产后生物标志物与产后抑郁的关联明显较弱。细胞因子特征与产后灰质体积的关联因是否发生产后抑郁而异，代谢指标在感觉运动区的关联也有所不同。作者据此认为，孕晚期免疫炎症改变与后续产后抑郁及产后脑形态相关，提示孕期生物特征或有助于识别高风险孕妇，但预测价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Onset–Rime Orthographic Representations in Early Literacy Development: A Neural Link Between Spelling and Reading
papers.authors: Wang F, Hasak LR, Dewan V, McCandliss BD.
papers.abstract: Abstract Visual orthographic knowledge plays a critical role in early literacy development and may provide a shared foundation for reading and spelling, yet the nature of its underlying representations remains debated. Behavioral measures offer indirect evidence and may be influenced by other metalinguistic processes. It remains unclear whether beginning readers encode larger orthographic structures, such as onset–rime units, beyond individual letters and smaller letter combinations but below the whole-word level. It is also unknown whether neural sensitivity to these structures helps explain the relationship between spelling and reading. To address these questions, we used a fast periodic visual stimulation (FPVS) paradigm in first- and second-grade children to contrast pseudowords constructed with the typical ordering of onset followed by rime elements (i.e., onset–rime) against matched strings in which the same elements appeared in the reverse order (i.e., rime–onset). Neural sensitivity to on-set–rime orthographic structure was associated with both spelling ability and word-reading efficiency and, critically, statistically mediated the relationship between these two literacy skills. These relationships remained significant after controlling for age and removing influential observations, and sensitivity to onset–rime orthographic structure explained additional variance in word-reading efficiency beyond spelling ability and age. Together, these findings provide neurophysiological evidence for onset–rime structure as an important sublexical orthographic unit in beginning readers, highlighting its potential role in linking spelling with efficient word recognition during early reading development.
