papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注初学阅读的儿童是否在字母之上、整词之下编码了首音—韵脚这类较大的正字法结构，以及这种神经敏感性是否有助于解释拼写与阅读之间的关系。研究者用快速周期性视觉呈现范式，在一、二年级儿童中对比首音—韵脚顺序的假词与相同元素逆序的字符串。结果显示，对首音—韵脚正字法结构的神经敏感性与拼写能力和词读效率均相关，并在统计上中介了二者关系；控制年龄并剔除影响点后结果仍成立，且该敏感性在拼写能力和年龄之外还解释了词读效率的额外变异。作者据此认为，首音—韵脚结构可能是初学阅读者重要的亚词汇正字法单元，并可能连接拼写与高效单词识别。

papers.title: Resolution-aware spectral parameterization reveals robust context-dependent aperiodic EEG dynamics during real-world table tennis
papers.authors: Guchait A, Chen C, Muggleton NG.
papers.abstract: Mobile EEG can link neuroimaging to natural behavior, but effects recorded during movement, and sport in particular, are difficult to interpret because neural activity overlaps with signals from movement, muscle activity, and cable movement artifacts. We analyzed the OpenNeuro Real World Table Tennis dataset to test whether peri-hit spectral activity could be analyzed and how it differed between human-opponent and ball-machine play. Data from 25 participants comprising EEG, noise-layers, EMG and motion recordings was analyzed with pre-hit, impact, and post-hit windows. EEG power bands were residualized using trial-level root mean square from noise-layer, EMG, and motion/miscellaneous channels. Spectral parameterization modeled spectra as an aperiodic component plus periodic peaks. The principal short-window model was resolution-aware; sensitivity analyses reduced model complexity, used a 2.0-s peri-hit subwindow (−1.0 to +1.0 s), or disabled periodic fitting. Results showed residualized alpha and beta power was lower during ball-machine play, including pre-hit posterior alpha power. The clearest context difference was a higher ball-machine aperiodic exponent over posterior and parietal sensors, corresponding to a steeper broadband spectral slope. Posterior post-hit means were 0.451 and 0.606 for human-opponent and ball-machine play, respectively. A focal parietal effect persisted across specifications. The results support artifact-informed, resolution-aware spectral analysis as an effective approach for detecting robust spectral differences between naturalistic visuomotor contexts and suggest that EEG may provide useful information about the processes engaged by different practice environments, without establishing a single cognitive or physiological mechanism or demonstrating a training outcome.

papers.title: The Walking Brain: Mapping feature-specific cortical responses to naturally unfolding sensory experience in the real world
papers.authors: Altınkaynak M, Carlton LB, Topkoç E, Boas DA, Yücel MA.
papers.abstract: Understanding how the brain processes the everyday world is fundamental, yet laboratory paradigms exclude self-generated movement, unscripted events, and a continuously evolving multisensory environment. Wearable neuroimaging enables real-world measurement, but linking neural activity to uncontrolled sensory information remains challenging. Here, we extend a feature-based framework from naturalistic movie viewing to everyday behavior using wearable whole-head high-density fNIRS and participant-specific audiovisual recordings during movies and outdoor walking with no explicit task or scripted audiovisual sequence. Luminance- and sound-related cortical maps showed significant spatial correspondence, particularly in visual and auditory regions, whereas face-related correspondence was weaker. Luminance- and face-related maps were reproducible within individuals across repeated walks. Additional exploratory analysis demonstrated, to our knowledge, the first out-of-sample encoding of continuous environmental features during unconstrained real-world fNIRS, predicting cortical activity during held-out walking periods. Together, these findings establish a feature-based framework for linking cortical activity to naturally unfolding sensory experience in everyday behavior.

papers.title: Tri-Stream Disentangled Network with Adaptive Dual-Space Fusion for Electroencephalography-Based Image Reconstruction on THINGS-EEG2.
papers.authors: Zhou Y, Li J, Zhao K, Zhu H, Zhu L, Jiang H, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Reconstructing visual stimuli from non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) requires mapping short, noisy neural responses to meaningful visual representations despite limited spatial sampling. Existing EEG-to-image approaches employ diverse neural representations and generative strategies, necessitating reproducible workflows that disentangle structural and semantic contributions. This protocol presents the Tri-stream Disentangled Network (TDE-Net), a computational framework for EEG-based image reconstruction. The protocol uses preprocessed THINGS-EEG2 recordings and organizes EEG information into a raw EEG anchor, a sample-specific functional graph stream, and a multi-scale temporal semantic stream. The graph stream captures frequency-domain relationships among EEG channels via graph convolution and cross-trial contrastive learning, while the semantic stream extracts task-relevant features via adaptive spatial weighting and multi-scale temporal convolutions. Structural and semantic features are mapped separately to variational autoencoder (VAE) and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) latent spaces, combined using development-set-selected fusion weights, and decoded using Stable UnCLIP. Across 10 participants, TDE-Net achieved a mean CLIP pairwise identification accuracy of 0.8135, with complementary metrics demonstrating structural and feature-space correspondence. Ablation and representation-level analyses further characterized the contributions of individual streams. This protocol provides a reproducible framework for investigating complementary EEG representations and diffusion-based visual reconstruction.

papers.title: Auditory sustained potential as a biomarker of language functioning in children with autism and its implication in clinical trials.
papers.authors: Arutiunian V, Davoudi S, Gaougaou G, Knoth IS, Buckser R, Marcil V, Lippé S.
papers.abstract: Objective Most children with autism have language impairment, however, its neural mechanisms are not well understood. A potential biomarker associated with language in autism is a 40Hz Auditory Steady-State Response (ASSR) triggered by periodic click-trains which in electroencephalogram (EEG) evokes two types of responses - 40Hz steady-state gamma response (ASSR) and sustained potential (SP). Although these responses represent low-level auditory processing, they correspond to different stages of sound perception/analysis and are essential in processing of spectrally/temporally complex sounds. However, until now there were no studies focusing on the potentials of these responses in clinical trials. Methods The present open-label pilot study evaluated the effects of the probiotic beverage supplement Bio-K+ in children with autism (N = 19). Participants were assessed at three timepoints: T0 (baseline), T14 (14 weeks after intervention), and T22 (8 weeks after intervention, post-supplementation follow-up assessment), including EEG 40Hz ASSR and behavioral phenotyping. Results First, at T0 we showed a reduction of SP amplitude in children with autism compared to controls, and this reduction was associated with lower speech/language/communication scores. Second, the amplitude of SP became significantly more negative during the probiotic supplementation period and, by T14, was no longer significantly different from the observed in TD controls. Finally, these changes in the amplitude of SP were associated with improvement in speech/language/communication scores. Conclusions This study showed that the SP as well as its change was related specifically to speech/language/communication but not to other behavioral measures and has a potential to be used in future clinical trials.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自闭症儿童语言障碍的神经标记，以40Hz听觉稳态反应中的持续电位（SP）为切入点，在一项开放标签试点研究中结合脑电与行为评估，考察益生菌饮料补充前后的变化。基线时自闭症儿童的SP波幅低于对照组，且波幅降低与较差的语言交流得分相关；补充期间SP波幅变得更负，至第14周已与典型发育儿童无显著差异，且这一变化与语言交流得分的改善相关。作者指出SP及其变化特异性地对应语言交流而非其他行为指标，提示其有望用于未来临床试验，但作为小样本开放标签试点，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Gray matter volume moderates the effect of acute physical activity on cognitive load and relates to reading comprehension in adolescents: the Cogni-Action Project.
papers.authors: Cristi-Montero C, Martínez-Flores R, Supèr H, Sanchez-Martinez J, Solis-Urra P, Tari B, Ibáñez R, Herold F, Paas F, Mavilidi M, Zou L.
papers.abstract: Background Acute physical activity reduces cognitive load (CL) and improves reading comprehension; however, the role of gray matter volume in these effects is unknown. This study examined how gray matter volume moderates the effects of physical activity on cognitive load, and explored its association with reading comprehension. Methods A total of 13 male adolescents (aged 12-13 years), a neuroimaging subsample of a larger cohort, completed a randomized crossover trial that involved three energy-matched conditions: sedentary condition (SC), moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT), and cooperative high-intensity interval training (C-HIIT). We measured gray matter volume in the hippocampus, pars opercularis, and brainstem using MRI. The primary outcome cognitive load (pupil dilation) was analyzed using within-subject permutation with max-T correction and bootstrapping. Reading comprehension served as a secondary, exploratory outcome. Results Physical activity was a significant predictor of cognitive load (p < 0.001). Comprehension improved for the C-HIIT condition compared to SC; gray matter volume alone did not predict these results. Volume significantly moderated cognitive load in a region-specific pattern: hippocampal volume amplified the cognitive load increases associated with C-HIIT [β = 0.26, 95% CI (0.21, 0.30)], while pars opercularis and brainstem volumes reduced the cognitive load (β = -0.30 to -0.32, p < 0.001); C-HIIT resulted in the lowest absolute cognitive load. Reading comprehension was higher under C-HIIT compared to SC (g = 0.87) and MICT (g = 0.50), with gains exploratorily associated with the pars opercularis volume (rho = 0.53-0.59). Conclusion Gray matter volume influenced cognitive load through its interaction with physical activity modality, with C-HIIT producing the lowest cognitive load. Comprehension gains under C-HIIT were exploratorily associated with pars opercularis volume, suggesting that specific neuroanatomical characteristics may complement activity modality for cognitive benefits in school settings.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察青少年灰质体积是否调节急性体育活动对认知负荷的影响，并探索其与阅读理解的关系。13名男性青少年完成静坐、中等强度持续训练和合作性高强度间歇训练三种能量匹配条件的随机交叉试验，同时用MRI测量海马、岛盖部和脑干的灰质体积。结果显示，体育活动能显著预测认知负荷，且灰质体积的调节作用具有脑区特异性：海马体积放大了合作性高强度间歇训练相关的认知负荷上升，而岛盖部和脑干体积则降低了认知负荷；合作性高强度间歇训练条件下绝对认知负荷最低，阅读理解成绩也高于静坐和中等强度持续训练条件，其提升在探索性分析中与岛盖部体积相关。作者据此认为，灰质体积通过与活动方式的交互影响认知负荷，特定神经解剖特征可能补充活动方式对学业认知益处的贡献，但阅读理解相关结果仅为探索性，样本量小，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Hierarchical reorganization of cortical and cerebellar functional gradients in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Liu Q, Zheng Z, Zhang M, Zhou S, Cheng Q, Cui L, Mei S, Hou R, Chen T, Xiao Y, Meng F.
papers.abstract: Introduction Parkinson's disease (PD) is a common movement disorder with heterogeneous clinical manifestations, and its tremor-predominant presentations may overlap with essential tremor (ET), complicating clinical differentiation in some patients. Functional gradient analysis provides a continuous framework for characterizing macroscale brain hierarchical organization and may offer candidate imaging features for disease characterization. Methods We first investigated surface-based resting-state functional measures and cerebral perfusion in 50 patients with idiopathic PD and 33 healthy controls. We subsequently incorporated functional MRI data from 17 patients with ET to examine alterations in cortical and cerebellar functional gradients in PD and ET and to evaluate their potential utility for distinguishing the two disorders. Group comparisons, gradient range and variance analyses, network-level analyses, and multiclass support vector machine classification were performed. Results Patients with PD showed widespread abnormalities in both cortical and cerebellar Gradient 1 and Gradient 2, whereas patients with ET exhibited fewer cortical alterations and no significant cerebellar gradient abnormalities. At the group level, both PD and ET showed broader cortical gradient ranges; however, only PD demonstrated significantly increased individual-level gradient range and variance. Network-level analyses further revealed pronounced hierarchical redistribution between sensorimotor and higher-order associative systems in PD, while ET displayed relatively limited alterations. The combined use of cortical and cerebellar Gradient 1 and Gradient 2 features showed discriminatory performance within the present dataset, with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values of 1.000 for healthy controls, 0.960 for PD, and 0.889 for ET. Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) analysis indicated that both cerebral and cerebellar gradient features contributed to classification, with broader feature involvement in PD than in ET. Discussion These findings suggest that PD is characterized by extensive disruption of cortical-cerebellar functional hierarchy, exceeding the relatively limited alterations observed in ET. Functional gradients may therefore provide candidate imaging features for characterizing PD-related hierarchical reorganization and for exploratory differentiation of PD from ET.

relevance.reason: 研究帕金森病皮层-小脑功能梯度层级重组，属脑疾病与静息功能网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病（PD）与特发性震颤（ET）在皮层和小脑功能层级组织上的差异，采用静息态功能磁共振与脑灌注指标，并结合梯度分析与多类分类模型进行比较。结果显示，PD患者在皮层和小脑的多个功能梯度上均出现广泛异常，而ET患者的皮层改变较少，小脑梯度未见显著异常；PD还表现出个体层面梯度范围和变异的增加，以及感觉运动系统与高阶联合系统之间更明显的层级重分布。作者据此认为，PD涉及超出ET范围的广泛皮层—小脑功能层级破坏，功能梯度或可作为刻画PD层级重组并探索性区分PD与ET的候选影像特征；但分类表现仅基于本数据集，尚不能视为临床诊断效用。

papers.title: Efficacy of acupuncture for sleep disorders in amnestic mild cognitive impairment: a randomized controlled trial with fMRI.
papers.authors: Qiu D, Li R, Yang J, Ding L, Deng J, Liu Y, Zhang J.
papers.abstract: Objective To access the efficacy of acupuncture in improving sleep disorders in patients with amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment (aMCI) and to investigate its mechanisms. Methods Thirty aMCI patients with sleep disorders and fifteen healthy controls (HC) were enrolled. Patients were randomly assigned to verum acupuncture group (VA) or sham acupuncture group (SA) for a 12-week treatment. Assessments included the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), and resting-state Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI). Results At baseline, patients with aMCI exhibited aberrant brain activity in temporal, frontal, parietal, and cerebellar regions compared with HCs. After treatment, the VA group, but not the SA group, showed significant improvements in both MoCA and PSQI scores. Rs-fMRI analyses revealed significant VA-related changes in the amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) in the left calcarine sulcus and regional homogeneity (ReHo) in the cerebellar vermis. Changes in these imaging indicators were significantly correlated with changes in MoCA scores but not with changes in PSQI scores. Moreover, changes in MoCA scores were negatively correlated with changes in PSQI scores in the VA group (r = -0.536, p = 0.039). Conclusion Acupuncture could effectively improve sleep and cognitive function in aMCI patients. The treatment-related alterations in brain function may be associated with changes in the dermatome layer and the brain-cerebellar cortex circuitry. Clinical trial registration https://itmctr.ccebtcm.org.cn/mgt/search, Identifier ITMCTR2026000708.

relevance.reason: aMCI患者针刺治疗前后静息态fMRI脑活动改变与认知评分相关，涉及认知障碍的脑功能机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该随机对照试验考察针刺能否改善遗忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）患者的睡眠障碍及其脑功能机制，将患者分为真针刺组与假针刺组进行12周干预，并设健康对照，结合认知与睡眠量表及静息态功能磁共振评估。结果显示，真针刺组在认知和睡眠评分上均有显著改善，假针刺组则未见，且真针刺伴随左侧距状沟低频波动振幅和小脑蚓部局部一致性的变化。这些影像指标变化与认知评分变化相关，而与睡眠评分变化无关；真针刺组中认知与睡眠改善之间呈负相关。作者据此认为针刺可改善该类患者的睡眠与认知，相关脑功能改变可能涉及特定皮层及脑-小脑环路，但影像变化与睡眠改善缺乏对应关系，机制解释仍需谨慎。

papers.title: Resting-state microstate dynamics predict behavioral and neural efficiency during working memory processing in healthy aging
papers.authors: Frei V, Ebner NC, Maraver MJ, Treadway H, Kunath J, Rossi E.
papers.abstract: Abstract Working memory performance declines with age, yet substantial variability exists among cognitively healthy older adults. Although task-evoked electrophysiological responses such as the P300b are sensitive to working memory load, it remains unclear how they relate to stable characteristics of intrinsic brain organization and individual differences in working memory performance. We combined resting-state and task-based electroencephalography (EEG) to examine relationships among working memory performance, P300b amplitude, and resting-state microstate dynamics in 33 cognitively healthy older adults. Participants completed an eyes-closed resting-state recording followed by a visual 0-, 1-, and 2-back task. Behavioral performance (d’), target-evoked P300b amplitude, and canonical resting-state microstate parameters were quantified using linear mixed-effects models. Increasing working memory load produced significant reductions in both discrimination performance and P300b amplitude, confirming expected behavioral and neural modulation. However, load-related changes in P300b amplitude were not associated with behavioral modulation, and neither was absolute P300b amplitude. Resting-state microstate dynamics selectively predicted task outcomes. In particular, longer duration of microstate D was associated with poorer behavioral discrimination performance. Longer duration of microstate C, in contrast was not associated with task outcomes but with larger P300b amplitude. These findings suggest that although behavioral performance and P300b amplitude reflect common neural responses to increasing working memory demands, stable characteristics of intrinsic brain organization account for meaningful individual differences in neural responsiveness and cognitive performance. Resting-state EEG microstates may therefore provide complementary, perhaps highly sensitive biomarkers of cognitive functioning beyond conventional task-evoked measures in healthy aging.

relevance.reason: 研究健康老年人静息态EEG微状态动态与工作记忆行为及P300b的关系，涉及静息自发脑组织与认知功能的关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在认知健康的老年人中结合静息态与任务态脑电，考察工作记忆表现、P300b波幅与静息态微状态动态之间的关系。结果显示，工作记忆负荷增加会同时降低辨别表现和P300b波幅，但P300b的负荷相关变化及绝对波幅均与行为表现无关；静息态微状态则能选择性地预测任务结果，微状态D持续时间较长与行为辨别表现较差相关，微状态C持续时间较长虽与任务表现无关，却对应更大的P300b波幅。作者据此认为，行为表现与P300b波幅反映的是对工作记忆需求增加的共同神经反应，而内在脑组织的稳定特征可解释神经反应性和认知表现的个体差异，静息态脑电微状态或可作为传统任务诱发指标之外、对健康老化认知功能较为敏感的补充标志物。

papers.title: Mental health problems in pregnancy link maternal history of childhood maltreatment to altered newborn amygdala connectivity
papers.authors: Babineau V, Lee S, Zhang Z, Jiang Z, Werner E, Ginrich J, Posner J, Peterson B, Monk C.
papers.abstract: Abstract Childhood maltreatment affects 25% of the U.S. population and increases risk for psychopathology, including anxiety disorders, across generations. Before postnatal exposures, offspring with a mother who has a history of childhood maltreatment are born with greater functional connectivity in amygdala-prefrontal stress circuits. Similarly, maternal stress during pregnancy associates with both greater positive and greater inverse amygdala-prefrontal connectivity in infants in a sex-specific manner. Altered newborn amygdala-prefrontal circuits that support stress processing may reflect accelerated neural maturation. Prior studies on associations between maternal history of childhood maltreatment and newborn amygdala connectivity adjust for prenatal maternal stress yet have not examined whether these associations are mediated by prenatal maternal stress. Because history of childhood maltreatment strongly correlates with maternal mental health problems during pregnancy, including stress, depression, sleep problems, and pregnancy specific distress, we test whether these problems mediate the association between maternal history of childhood maltreatment and altered newborn amygdala-prefrontal connectivity. Participants (N = 59) report their history of childhood maltreatment and mental health symptoms in the 3rd trimester. We measure resting state functional connectivity using fMRI in infants (mean age = 3.15 ± 1.42 weeks). Prenatal maternal sleep problems mediate associations between maternal history of childhood maltreatment and infant’s amygdala connectivity in both sexes. Pregnancy specific distress mediates the associations in males. Overall, females show greater positive connectivity, whereas males show greater inverse connectivity; mediation findings are more consistent in males. Our study provides evidence that prenatal maternal mental health problems – particularly sleep problems and pregnancy specific distress – link maternal history of childhood maltreatment to newborn amygdala connectivity. These findings highlight modifiable prenatal factors for trauma-responsive intervention.

relevance.reason: 研究孕期母亲心理健康问题经新生儿静息态杏仁核-前额叶功能连接中介童年虐待史，属情绪/应激神经环路发育与静息功能连接组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察母亲童年期虐待史是否通过孕期心理健康问题与新生儿杏仁核-前额叶连接改变相关联。研究者在孕期第三 trimester 收集母亲童年虐待史与心理健康症状，并在婴儿出生后不久用静息态功能磁共振测量杏仁核连接。结果显示，孕期睡眠问题在男女婴儿中均中介这一关联，妊娠特异性痛苦则在男婴中起中介作用；女婴总体呈较强正向连接，男婴呈较强反向连接，中介结果在男婴中更一致。作者据此提出，孕期睡眠问题和妊娠特异性痛苦等可干预因素，可能是母亲童年创伤影响子代应激相关神经发育的途径，但研究为关联性设计，尚不能确立因果。

papers.title: Temporal dynamics of early somatosensory processing in goal-directed actions.
papers.authors: Fuehrer E, Voudouris D, Maurer LK, Fiehler K.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Tactile sensitivity is temporally modulated on a moving limb. Yet the neural mechanisms underlying this modulation remain unclear. Using electroencephalography, we examined the temporal dynamics of early somatosensory processing during goal-directed reaching. Participants (self-reported gender: 22 female, 16 male) reached for their unseen left hand while a brief standard vibration of a fixed intensity was applied to the moving right index finger in different movement phases. After each reach, participants compared this standard with a second comparison vibration of varying intensity applied to the sternum and judged which vibration felt stronger. The same task was performed at rest to account for individual differences. Psychophysical results revealed an overall reduction in tactile sensitivity during reaching compared to rest, with sensitivity transiently improving around maximum speed relative to the late movement phase. Consistent with the psychophysical data, the short-latency P45 component, originating in primary somatosensory cortex, was reduced during reaching but recovered around maximum speed. Lower P45 amplitudes were associated with lower tactile sensitivity measured behaviorally, suggesting that early somatosensory processing may contribute to the observed perceptual changes. This temporally specific modulation of tactile perception, together with corresponding changes at the early cortical stage, is consistent with the idea that the somatosensory system dynamically adapts its sensitivity to facilitate control of somatosensory-guided actions.Significance statement The perception of touch on a moving hand varies across movement phases, depending on the importance of somatosensory feedback for guiding the hand toward the movement target. Our results show that these changes in perception are associated with modulations in early brain activity. This indicates that the central nervous system adjusts touch processing in a time-sensitive manner at early processing stages, which may support goal-directed actions guided by somatosensory feedback.

relevance.reason: EEG研究目标导向伸手动作中早期躯体感觉皮层加工的时间动态，属感知-运动认知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨了目标导向的伸手动作中，触觉敏感性和早期躯体感觉加工如何随运动阶段变化。研究者用脑电记录参与者伸手触碰未见左手时，右食指在不同运动阶段接受振动刺激的早期皮层反应，并结合振动强度比较的行为判断，同时以静息状态作为个体差异的对照。结果显示，与静息相比，伸手过程中触觉敏感性整体下降，但在接近最大速度时相对后期阶段短暂回升；起源于初级躯体感觉皮层的短潜伏期P45成分也表现出相同模式，且P45波幅越低，行为测得的触觉敏感性越差。作者据此认为，躯体感觉系统会在早期加工阶段按时间需要动态调节触觉处理，以支持依赖触觉反馈的动作控制；不过这一关联性证据尚不能直接确立因果机制。

papers.title: EEG correlates of auditory rise time processing: A systematic review.
papers.authors: Manasevich V, Kostanian D, Rogachev A, Sysoeva O.
papers.abstract: Rise time (RT) is a critical acoustic feature of speech, implicated in typical and atypical language development. While a substantial amount of data has been accumulated on the neurophysiological evidence of RT processing across different conditions and groups of people, these data have not been systematized. This systematic review, conducted according to the PRISMA guidelines across PubMed, Web of Science and APA PsychInfo databases, focuses on studies that have investigated electroencephalographic (EEG) markers of RT sensitivity in humans. A total of 37 studies were identified that manipulated RT and examined different components of event-related potentials (ERPs), brainstem responses, and cortical rhythmic activity. The core finding is consistent across studies: RT prolongation reduces the amplitudes of brain responses and increases their latencies. However, the sensitivity of the EEG markers varied along the auditory hierarchy with the earliest components tracking subtle differences (a few tens of microseconds), while the later components coding the larger changes (up to 500 ms). Effects are further modulated by the experimental parameters, participant age, and speech-related problems, while limited pediatric research, considerable methodological heterogeneity and predominantly small sample sizes limit the clear conclusions on these modulations. Future research should prioritize understudied clinical populations and developmental ERP components such as P1 and N2, which are dominant in children.

relevance.reason: 系统综述人脑EEG对言语关键声学特征上升时间的加工标记，涉及听觉语言加工的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA规范系统梳理了37项通过脑电（包括事件相关电位、脑干反应和皮层节律活动）考察人类听觉上升时间敏感性的研究。核心发现较为一致：上升时间延长会降低脑反应幅度并延长其潜伏期；但不同脑电指标沿听觉通路的敏感性不同，越早的成分越能追踪细微变化，越晚的成分则对应更大的时间变化。这些效应还受实验参数、年龄和言语相关问题调节，而儿童研究有限、方法异质性大且样本量普遍偏小，使上述调节作用尚难定论。作者据此建议未来研究关注临床人群和儿童中占主导的P1、N2等发育期成分。

papers.title: Neural Representations of Perceptual Reorganization in the Musical Scale Illusion.
papers.authors: Choi A, Ham J, Lee K, Choi I.
papers.abstract: The auditory system organizes complex acoustic input into coherent perceptual streams, yet how neural responses relate to physical stimulus structure and reported perception when the two diverge remains unclear. We investigated perceptual reorganization using the scale illusion, in which interleaved tone sequences presented separately to the two ears are typically heard as continuous melodic streams.Thirty participants listened to illusory, zigzag, and continuous sequences during EEG recording and reported whether each sequence sounded continuous or zigzag. Temporal response function models characterized neural encoding and reconstruction of amplitude-envelope (envelope) and pitch-change magnitude features. We tested whether neural responses during illusory listening corresponded more closely to reference patterns associated with the physical zigzag structure or reported continuous organization. Illusory sequences were predominantly categorized as Continuous and elicited longer RTs than non-illusory sequences. Encoding models revealed delayed pitch-change magnitude responses in the illusory condition, whereas envelope latencies remained comparatively stable. For pitch-change magnitude, reconstruction correlations computed over the full sequence exceeded chance levels estimated separately for each reference, with higher correlations for the continuous reference. Envelope correlations exceeded neither chance level, despite a small relative preference for the zigzag reference. These findings show that neural response timing and relative correspondence with the tested reference patterns depend on the modeled feature during the scale illusion. The reconstruction result concerns correlations across complete sequences and does not establish continuous tracking of the perceived melody.

relevance.reason: 用EEG研究音阶错觉中听觉流分离的神经表征，属于感知组织与听觉认知的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电记录三十名参与者聆听音阶错觉序列时的神经反应，考察当声音的物理结构与实际听感不一致时，大脑活动更接近哪一方。结果显示，错觉序列多被听成连续旋律，其音高变化幅度的神经响应出现延迟，且整段序列的重建相关更偏向“连续”参照；而包络响应的潜伏期相对稳定，其重建相关未超过随机水平。作者据此指出，神经响应的时间特征及其与参照模式的对应关系取决于所建模的声音特征，但重建结果仅基于整段序列的相关，尚不能说明大脑在持续追踪被听到的旋律。

papers.title: Entropy of the resting state cortex in epilepsy.
papers.authors: Kaur K, O'Brien-Cairney J, Singh G, Upadhya M, Chakraborty A, Chandra SP, Prüss H, Kornau HC, Schmitz D, Woodhall G, Rosch R, Angelova M, Seri S, Tripathi M, Wright SK, Witton C.
papers.abstract: Epilepsy has long been conceptualized as a disorder in which aberrant brain dynamics extend beyond the epileptogenic zone. Evidence demonstrates that loss of entropy is a generic feature of pathological dynamics in the brain, including the ictal state. However, the impact of recurrent seizures on entropy in the interictal state remains unknown. Resting state magnetoencephalography (MEG) scans and resection masks of 32 individuals with epilepsy who had Engel I outcome post-surgery were retrospectively retrieved. Using co-registered FreeSurfer parcellations, we reconstructed the source localized MEG time series and computed sample entropy (SE) for 114 regions of interest. We then tested the association of entropy with the resected volume of the brain, and additional clinical variables including the age of seizure onset, seizure frequency and duration of epilepsy. To further understand the temporal relationship between seizure onset and entropy in the interictal state, we collected and computed SE for week-long electroencephalography traces from leucine-rich glioma inactivated 1 monoclonal antibody (LGI1-mAb) rodent models of autoimmune encephalitis (n = 5) and control rats (n = 5). We found that in individuals with epilepsy, a lower age of seizure onset was associated with lower mean SE of the whole cortex (Spearman's rho = 0.60,p < 0.001; partial correlation = 0.41,p = 0.021). Entropy did not differ between the resected and non-resected regions of the brain. Furthermore, in an exploratory analysis, LGI1-mAb treated rodents showed lower SE as compared to control rats, after the onset of seizures. Together, the results indicate that cortical entropy may serve as a marker of long-term alterations in cortical dynamics associated with recurrent seizures.

relevance.reason: 研究癫痫患者静息态MEG皮层熵改变及其与发作年龄关联，属脑疾病与静息脑动力学。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注癫痫患者发作间期静息态皮层熵是否改变，以及其与手术切除范围和临床变量的关系。作者回顾性分析癫痫患者的静息态脑磁图，并在自身免疫性脑炎大鼠模型中计算长程脑电的样本熵。结果显示，发病年龄越早，全皮层平均样本熵越低；切除区与非切除区的熵无差异，而模型鼠在癫痫发作后熵低于对照。作者据此认为，皮层熵可能反映反复发作相关的长期皮层动力学改变，但相关结果尚不能说明因果或直接用于临床。

papers.title: Reconnecting the disconnected forebrain: multimodal resting-state bold dynamics underlying zolpidem-induced arousal in incomplete Locked-in syndrome.
papers.authors: Machado C, Rodriguez-Rojas R, Sanchez JJ, Mualem R.
papers.abstract: Primary objective Zolpidem paradoxically restores behavioral responsiveness and communication in select patients with severe disorders of consciousness and profound motor deafferentation. While the anterior forebrain mesocircuit hypothesis attributes this awakening to central thalamic disinhibition, macroscopic network dynamics and lower brainstem gating remain under-characterized in locked-in syndrome (LIS). Methods and procedures A 45-year-old male with ventral pontine necrosis initially misdiagnosed as vegetative state/unresponsive wakefulness syndrome (VS/UWS) was formally identified with incomplete LIS through systematic ocular testing. Multimodal high-resolution MRI, deterministic diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) tractography, resting-state fMRI (before vs. after 10 mg oral zolpidem), dynamic sliding-window graph theory (45 s), infraslow BOLD spectral analysis (Slow-5: 0.010-0.027 Hz; Slow-4: 0.027-0.073 Hz), and seed-based thalamocortical coupling were acquired. Main outcomes and results DTI confirmed focal basis pontis transection with extensive preservation of supratentorial projection architecture. Baseline fMRI exhibited aberrant, unsegregated cross-network hyperconnectivity. Zolpidem restored canonical modular boundaries, pruned noisy long-range edges, induced focal BOLD reactivation in primary motor (M1) and precuneal cores, shifted power into the infraslow Slow-5 domain, and markedly augmented thalamocortical coupling (thalamo-precuneus: r = 0.18 to 0.61; striato-thalamus: r = 0.33 to 0.75). Conclusions Paradoxical awakening in incomplete LIS is underpinned by structural preservation of the supratentorial mantle. Beyond classical mesocircuit release, zolpidem engages brainstem gating structures, restoring modular segregation, infraslow frequency tuning, and cognitive-motor coupling.

relevance.reason: 单例不完全闭锁综合征患者用药前后静息态BOLD网络与丘脑皮层耦合研究，涉及脑损伤后意识/觉醒的脑网络重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一名被误诊为植物状态/无反应觉醒综合征、后经系统眼动检查确认为不完全闭锁综合征的患者为对象，结合多模态高分辨率MRI、弥散张量成像、静息态fMRI及动态图论与慢波频谱分析，考察唑吡坦诱导觉醒的宏观网络机制。结果显示，患者幕上投射结构广泛保留，基线存在异常且未分离的跨网络高连接；口服唑吡坦后模块边界恢复、长程噪声连接被修剪，初级运动区与楔前叶出现局部BOLD再激活，功率向极慢波频段转移，丘脑-皮层耦合明显增强。作者据此认为，此类矛盾性觉醒不仅涉及经典中脑环路释放，还涉及脑干门控结构对模块分离、极慢频率调谐和认知-运动耦合的恢复；但结论基于单例，尚不能推广为治疗证据。

papers.title: Human claustrum neurons encode uncertainty and prediction errors during aversive learning.
papers.authors: Hu M, Dalvit R, Medina-Pizarro M, Dougherty M, Zhou Y, Barreto-Nieves J, Obaid S, Afrasiyabi A, Krishnaswamy S, Kaye AP, Günel M, Krystal JH, Sheth KN, Gu X, Pittenger CP, Wise T, Damisah EC.
papers.abstract: Flexible behavior depends on continuous updating of internal models, yet the neural circuits coordinating this process remain poorly understood. The claustrum, which is reciprocally connected to nearly the entire neocortex, is uniquely positioned to influence cortical processing. Here we report single-neuron recordings from the human claustrum during aversive learning, with anterior cingulate cortex and amygdala recordings for comparison. Claustrum and anterior cingulate neurons displayed structured, task-related responses. Distinct subpopulations encoded stimulus onset and action-contingent outcomes, with outcome representations diverging between regions. Critically, both regions encoded model-derived latent variables, including uncertainty and prediction error, but with different temporal profiles; only the anterior cingulate carried uncertainty signals during the intertrial period, whereas both regions encoded uncertainty and prediction error during the active-avoidance period. By contrast, the amygdala showed minimal latent-variable modulation. These findings provide evidence that human claustrum neurons track higher-order cognitive variables not directly observable from sensory input and reveal dissociable roles for the claustrum and anterior cingulate cortex in tracking latent task states.

relevance.reason: 人脑屏状核单神经元记录，揭示厌恶学习中不确定性与预测误差等高级认知变量的编码，属学习与认知控制的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类屏状核在厌恶学习中的神经元活动，通过单神经元记录并与前扣带皮层、杏仁核作比较，考察这些脑区如何表征任务相关变量。结果显示，屏状核与前扣带皮层神经元对刺激出现和动作相关结果有结构化反应，且两区对结果的表征存在差异；更关键的是，两区都编码不确定性和预测误差等由模型推导的潜在变量，但时间特征不同——试次间期只有前扣带皮层携带不确定性信号，而在主动回避期两区均编码不确定性和预测误差。相比之下，杏仁核的潜在变量调制很弱。作者据此认为，人类屏状核神经元能追踪无法直接由感觉输入观察的高级认知变量，并提示屏状核与前扣带皮层在追踪潜在任务状态上角色可分离。

papers.title: Dissociable EEG microstate signatures of cognitive and response inhibition deficits in obsessive-compulsive disorder patients.
papers.authors: Zhu R, Wang D, Guo Q, Gao J, Wang A, Shi H, Fan R, Li Y, Zhang X.
papers.abstract: Background Inhibitory control deficits represent a core cognitive feature in patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), yet their neurophysiological mechanisms remain unclear. Electroencephalogram (EEG) microstates offer a novel framework for investigating large-scale brain network dynamics in psychiatric disorders. This cross-sectional study aimed to investigate EEG microstate dynamics in OCD patients and their relationships with cognitive and response inhibition. Methods A total of 91 OCD patients and 76 healthy controls were recruited. Participants completed an Emotional Stroop Task (EST) and a stop-signal task (SST). Resting-state EEG was recorded, and microstate parameters and transition probabilities were analyzed. Correlations between microstate parameters and inhibitory control performance were assessed. Results OCD patients exhibited significant deficits in both response inhibition and cognitive inhibition, with both types of deficits positively correlated with obsessive symptom severity. Microstate analysis revealed increased mean duration and time coverage of microstate A, but decreased mean duration, occurrence, and coverage of microstate C in OCD patients. Additionally, transition probabilities from microstates B and D to C were significantly elevated. Notably, the mean duration of microstate C was positively correlated with stop-signal reaction time (SSRT), while the occurrence of microstates C and D and the time coverage of microstate D were negatively correlated with the Stroop effect. Conclusions These findings reveal dissociable microstate mechanisms associated with distinct inhibitory dysfunction domains in OCD patients. Resting-state microstate dynamics may represent candidate neurobiological markers for cognitive subtype classification in OCD and may help inform the development of targeted therapeutic interventions.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注强迫症患者抑制控制缺陷的脑电微状态机制，比较患者与健康对照的静息态脑电微状态参数及其与情绪Stroop任务和停止信号任务表现的关系。结果发现，患者同时存在反应抑制和认知抑制缺陷，且两者均与强迫症状严重程度正相关；患者微状态A的持续时间和时间覆盖率增加，微状态C的持续时间、出现率和覆盖率降低，由B、D向C的转换概率升高。进一步分析显示，微状态C的持续时间与停止信号反应时正相关，而微状态C、D的出现率及微状态D的时间覆盖率与Stroop效应负相关，提示不同抑制功能缺陷对应可分离的微状态特征。作者据此提出，静息态微状态动态或可作为强迫症认知亚型分类的候选神经生物学标记，但相关关系尚不能说明因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Impact of prenatal cannabis exposure on offspring brain structure and function: a systematic review of MRI studies.
papers.authors: Karimi E, Safari Sabet A, Terplan M, Parsaei M.
papers.abstract: Aim Cannabis use during pregnancy has increased, raising concerns about potential effects on offspring brain development. The objective of this systematic review was to evaluate MRI-based evidence on the association between prenatal cannabis exposure (PCE) and offspring brain development across structural, diffusion, resting-state functional, and task-based functional MRI. Methods Following PRISMA guidelines, PubMed, Web of Science, and Embase were searched through September 4, 2026, for MRI studies comparing prenatally exposed offspring with non-exposed controls across any modality. Study quality was assessed using Joanna Briggs Institute tools, and certainty of evidence was evaluated using the GRADE framework. Results Eighteen studies (2004-2026) met inclusion criteria, with participants ranging from the fetal period to young adulthood. Structural MRI showed no consistent global brain-volume reductions, although some studies reported region-specific differences, particularly in frontal regions and intracranial-volume trajectories. Diffusion MRI identified alterations in selected white-matter pathways, including frontolimbic and corticostriatal tracts, but findings were inconsistent and not uniformly replicated. Resting-state functional MRI studies showed heterogeneous connectivity differences across hippocampal, salience, thalamic, and auditory networks, and task-based functional MRI studies reported variable reward- and executive-control activation, including some null findings. Overall certainty of evidence was low to very low because of risk of bias, inconsistency, imprecision, residual confounding, and methodological heterogeneity. Interpretation PCE may be associated with subtle, regionally specific differences in brain structure, microstructure, and function rather than consistent global abnormalities. However, structural MRI showed no consistent global abnormalities, diffusion MRI findings were inconsistent, and resting-state and task-based fMRI findings were heterogeneous. Causal interpretation remains limited by confounding, cohort overlap, exposure assessment, and methodological heterogeneity.

relevance.reason: 系统综述产前大麻暴露与子代脑结构、白质微结构及静息/任务态功能的MRI证据，核心为脑发育与脑组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了产前大麻暴露与子代脑发育关联的MRI证据，纳入结构、弥散、静息态和任务态功能MRI研究，比较暴露子代与未暴露对照。结果显示，结构MRI未见一致的全局脑体积下降，仅部分研究报告额叶等区域特异性差异；弥散MRI提示部分白质通路存在改变，但结果不一致且未普遍重复；静息态和任务态功能MRI分别呈现异质的网络连接差异与奖赏、执行控制激活差异，也包括阴性结果。作者据此认为，产前大麻暴露可能与细微、区域特异的脑结构与功能差异相关，而非一致的全局异常；受偏倚风险、结果不一致、残余混杂和方法异质性限制，证据确定性低至极低，因果解释仍有限。

papers.title: Temporal expectation triggers priority shifts in working memory that lead to forgetting.
papers.authors: Duan Z, Zhang Z, Lewis-Peacock JA.
papers.abstract: Working memory (WM) flexibly prioritizes task-relevant information over short intervals, serving as a critical gateway to long-term memory (LTM). However, how this dynamic prioritization influences what is ultimately retained in LTM remains unclear. Here, we investigated the long-term consequences of internally guided prioritization shifts within WM. Human participants (N = 20) encoded two items (a face and a scene) associated with short (1 s) and long (4 s) delays, where the face was probed after 1 s or not at all, and the scene was probed after 4 s only if the face was not tested. Using multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) of electroencephalography (EEG) data, we tracked fluctuations in neural representations of both memory items as participants redirected internal attention from one to the other across the delay period. Neural dynamics during reprioritization predicted LTM outcomes for the de-prioritized items. Specifically, forgetting was associated with a marked decrease in neural evidence for the deprioritized item, accompanied by a concurrent increase in neural evidence for the newly prioritized item. These findings demonstrate that temporal expectations shape neural dynamics of prioritization in WM that influence retention in LTM.

relevance.reason: 用EEG解码工作记忆内部注意重定向的神经表征动态及其对长时记忆保持的影响，属工作记忆与注意的神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察工作记忆内部注意优先级的动态转移如何影响信息最终能否进入长时记忆。参与者同时编码一个面孔和一个场景，并依据时间预期在不同延迟后接受测验；研究者用脑电数据的多变量模式分析追踪两个记忆项神经表征在延迟期内的起伏。结果显示，被降级项目的长时记忆遗忘与其神经证据明显减弱同时出现，而新获优先项目的神经证据相应增强，且重优先阶段的神经动态可预测降级项目的长时记忆结果。作者据此认为，时间预期塑造了工作记忆中优先级分配的神经动态，进而影响长时保持。

papers.title: Characterizing variability in resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rsfMRI) metrics: A normative modeling framework.
papers.authors: Amador-Tejada A, Danielli E, Noseworthy MD.
papers.abstract: Clinical adoption of new biomedical techniques depends on establishing reference values against which individual patients can be compared. In resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI), most biomarker research has relied on the case-control paradigm, whose underlying assumptions are often invalid as diseases are frequently heterogeneous, limiting biomarker generalizability. Normative modeling offers a complementary alternative by characterizing individual deviations against a reference population. However, in rsfMRI, normative modeling remains comparatively limited relative to case-control studies and has been applied almost exclusively to functional connectivity. We address these gaps by developing a spatial normative model of four rsfMRI metrics that capture complementary features of the blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signal across age and sex. Aggregating five public datasets yielded a sample of 1978 participants aged 10-30 years. For each of 110 grey matter regions, we computed amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF), fractional ALFF (fALFF), regional homogeneity (ReHo), and Hurst exponent. A machine-learning model based on hierarchical Bayesian regression with a non-Gaussian likelihood was fitted per metric, modeling non-linear age effects, sex, head motion parameters, and multi-site acquisition. Models were well calibrated across all four metrics, with fALFF showing the strongest predictive performance and Hurst exponent the weakest. Normative trajectories varied regionally: while the median of each distribution stayed bounded across regions, the spread was more variable. All four metrics showed predominantly negative slopes with age, indicating a decline over the age window. This work provides a normative reference across four rsfMRI metrics capturing distinct BOLD signal features, complementing the case-control paradigm and supporting individual-level inference.

relevance.reason: 该研究构建静息态fMRI指标（ALFF/fALFF/ReHo/Hurst）的规范模型，刻画BOLD信号随年龄和性别的区域化轨迹，属于人脑自发活动与功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对静息态功能磁共振缺乏个体化参照值的问题，构建了覆盖四个BOLD信号指标的空间规范模型，并整合多个公开数据集，在10至30岁人群中按脑区拟合年龄、性别、头动和多站点采集的影响。结果显示，四个指标的模型校准良好，其中fALFF预测表现最强、Hurst指数最弱；各指标分布的中位数在不同脑区间保持有界，但离散程度变化更大，且四个指标随年龄总体呈下降趋势。作者认为，这为捕捉不同BOLD信号特征的指标提供了规范参照，可补充病例对照范式并支持个体水平的推断，但模型性能与适用条件仍需在更广人群中检验。

papers.title: Extended high frequency hearing influences cortical response amplitudes to speech.
papers.authors: Donoso-San Martín R, Fink S, Dapper K, Gaudrain E, Başkent D, Verhulst S, Harasztosi C, Singer W, Malmierca MS, Siegel M, Dalhoff E, Wolpert SM, Braun C, Rüttiger L, Knipper M.
papers.abstract: Since young adults hear sounds up to 20 kHz, the loss of extended high-frequency hearing (EHF; above 8 kHz) is a hallmark of age-related hearing loss, often progressing from early lifetime. However, this deficit frequently goes undetected because routine clinical hearing tests and most hearing aids are currently mostly limited to 8 kHz. EHF hearing has been linked to deficits in speech perception in noise and to self-reported hearing. However, it remains elusive how EHF hearing influences speech intelligibility. Here we recorded neuromagnetic brain responses using magnetoencephalography (MEG) within a frequency-tagging speech paradigm designed to probe hierarchical levels of attention and memory-dependent speech processing and recognition. Auditory evoked field (AEF) responses were significantly reduced in both left and right brain hemispheres in individuals with impaired EHF hearing compared to those subjects with better EHF hearing. A gradual reinforcement of left-hemispheric AEF seen over age was not observed in young adults (19-29 y) with preserved EHF hearing. This was linked to stronger auditory brainstem responses (ABR), reflecting better neural synchronized auditory responses at stimulus onset. The reinforced left-hemispheric dominance in young adults with impaired EHF hearing, in contrast, was linked to lower ABRs. Our findings suggest that through its impact on stimulus-onset synchrony to phase locking of oscillations in the auditory cortex, sound energy above 8 kHz contributes to the intelligibility of speech. Together, the results highlight the need to reconsider EHF hearing in both audiological assessment and hearing-aid design.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究扩展高频听力对言语皮层反应的影响，涉及言语感知的听觉皮层机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注扩展高频（8 kHz以上）听力如何影响言语可懂度，用脑磁图结合频率标记言语范式记录青年成人的听觉诱发场反应，并比较扩展高频听力较好与受损者。结果显示，扩展高频听力受损者在左右半球的听觉诱发场反应均明显减弱；听力保留者随年龄出现的左半球反应渐进增强在此未出现，且与更强的听性脑干反应相关，而听力受损者的左半球优势增强则与较弱的听性脑干反应相关。作者据此提出，8 kHz以上的声音能量可能通过影响刺激起始时的神经同步和听觉皮层振荡的相位锁定，参与言语可懂度，并提示听力学评估和助听器设计需要重新考虑扩展高频听力。

papers.title: Resolving motion-position conflict: dorsal-ventral interactions during illusory jitter perception.
papers.authors: Zhou Y, Yamashita A, Nakayama R, Amano K.
papers.abstract: Motion-induced spatial conflict occurs when an isoluminant boundary moves smoothly near a moving luminance-defined boundary: observers perceive spatial jitter superimposed on the otherwise smooth trajectory, despite the absence of physical jitter. This phenomenon shows that perceived object location can fluctuate even when the retinal trajectory is smooth. Because motion-related and form-related visual information is processed across partially distinct dorsal and ventral visual systems, this phenomenon provides a model for examining cross-stream interactions. However, the cortical mechanisms underlying this illusion remain unclear. Here, we used functional MRI to test whether motion-induced spatial conflict is associated with dorsal-ventral network interactions by comparing an illusory jitter condition, a luminance-defined no-jitter control condition, and a physical-jitter control condition. Whole-brain analyses revealed widespread lower BOLD responses in the illusion condition relative to both control conditions, with overlapping effects involving the inferior parietal lobule (IPL) and inferotemporal cortex (IT). Critically, beta-series functional coupling between IPL and IT was enhanced during the illusion. An exploratory Granger-causality analysis further suggested an asymmetry in within-trial BOLD dynamics, with larger IPL→IT than IT→IPL Granger-predictive effects. Complementing these condition-level network effects, exploratory within-condition analyses provided supportive evidence that trial-wise regional activity within the IPL-IT network, most consistently in IPL, varied with subjective jitter perception under physically identical illusory trials. These findings suggest that motion-induced spatial conflict is associated with altered IPL-IT interactions, highlighting parietal-temporal coupling as a candidate network process involved in distortions of perceived object location.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究视错觉中背侧-腹侧视觉网络交互，属感知神经机制及功能网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注运动诱导的空间冲突错觉：当等亮度边界在运动亮度边界附近平滑移动时，观察者会看到并不存在的空间抖动，这为考察背侧与腹侧视觉通路的交互提供了模型。作者用功能磁共振比较错觉条件与两个控制条件，发现错觉条件下全脑多个区域血氧信号降低，其中顶下小叶（IPL）与颞下皮层（IT）存在重叠效应；同时IPL与IT之间的功能耦合在错觉时增强，探索性分析还提示IPL到IT的预测作用更强。研究者据此提出，IPL-IT交互改变可能与这种位置知觉扭曲有关，但相关结果尚属候选网络过程的证据。

papers.title: Task structure and construct validity in the neurobiology of trust: A systematic structural synthesis.
papers.authors: Bayat D, Shahraki Pour FZ, Wu Y, Krueger F.
papers.abstract: The neuroscience of interpersonal trust has expanded across functional magnetic resonance imaging, electroencephalography, functional near-infrared spectroscopy, pharmacology, genetics, physiology, and brain stimulation. Although this literature implicates distributed reward-, salience-, mentalizing-, and executive-control systems, findings are often difficult to compare because nominally similar Trust Game paradigms differ in their task architecture and analytic definition of trust. Here, we provided a PRISMA-guided systematic structural synthesis of 198 empirical studies comprising 200 experiments. Rather than conducting an effect-size or coordinate-based meta-analysis, we coded paradigm architecture, economic structure, temporal dynamics, trustee information, control conditions, participant populations, measurement modalities, and analytic strategies to characterize conditions relevant to neurobiological interpretation. Our synthesis showed that trust neuroscience is dominated by standard and binary Trust Game variants, simulated partners, limited explicit controls, and decision- and outcome-phase analyses. Exploratory contingency analyses identified associations among task architecture, measurement approach, and analytic operationalization without testing neurobiological effects. These features may emphasize different trust-related processes, including valuation of expected reciprocity, betrayal aversion under vulnerability, social inference about partner intentions, executive regulation, and feedback-based updating. We therefore propose a structural-computational alignment framework in which neurobiological findings can be interpreted relative to the task features and analytic contrasts under which they are observed. This framework reframes heterogeneity in trust neuroscience as a construct-validity problem rather than simple theoretical fragmentation. Explicit alignment among task design, inferred computation, analytic choices, and neurobiological measures may support a coherent mechanistic account of interpersonal trust.

relevance.reason: 系统综述人际信任的神经生物学任务结构与构念效度，涉及奖赏、凸显、心理化、执行控制等脑系统，属社会认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述通过PRISMA引导的系统性结构综合，编码了信任神经科学中实证研究的范式架构、经济结构、时间动态、被信任者信息、控制条件、被试群体、测量方式和分析策略，而非进行效应量或坐标元分析。综合显示，该领域以标准版和二元版信任博弈、模拟对手、有限显式控制以及决策与结果阶段分析为主；探索性列联分析仅发现任务架构、测量方法与分析操作化之间的关联，并未检验神经生物学效应。作者据此提出结构—计算对齐框架，主张将异质性重新理解为构念效度问题，并认为任务设计、推断计算、分析选择与神经生物学测量之间的显式对齐有助于形成连贯的人际信任机制解释。

papers.title: Longitudinal associations between screen time activities and working memory neural signatures in adolescents: Sex differences and contextual moderation.
papers.authors: Arekatla S, Barrows A, Cioffredi LA, Albaugh MD, Allgaier N, Allred M, Baranger D, Potter A, Garavan HP, Chaarani B.
papers.abstract: Introduction Adolescent screen media activity (SMA) has increased, yet its longitudinal associations with neurocognitive development and mental health remain unclear across activities and contexts. Methods This longitudinal cohort study used data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study (release 6.0) with four assessments (baseline, year 2, year 4, and year 6). Participants were recruited across 21 U.S. sites to reflect demographic diversity. Children with valid neuroimaging and behavioral data were included, adjusting for demographic, behavioral, and psychiatric confounders. Working memory (WM) neural signature (NS) scores were derived using elastic net classification of EN-back fMRI activation during 0-back and 2-back conditions. SMA included time spent video gaming, watching television, texting, and social media. Cognitive performance was measured using EN-back accuracy, and mental health symptoms using Child Behavior Checklist internalizing and externalizing scores. Moderation analyses examined family conflict, sleep disturbance, and physical activity. Results The analytic sample included 9931 participants (47.2% female). Higher NS scores were associated with better 0-back and 2-back accuracy. Greater video gaming, texting, and television watching were associated with lower NS scores. Sex-stratified analyses showed among males, more screen time was associated with lower NS scores, a multivariate measure of how separable neural activation patterns are between the 2-back and 0-back conditions. These associations were specific to the EN-back task and were adjusted for general cognitive ability. Higher degrees of family conflict increased the association between NS with texting, and video gaming and externalizing symptoms among males. Sleep disturbance and physical activity also moderated associations with internalizing and externalizing symptoms, with sex-specific patterns. Conclusions WM-related neural function was associated with cognitive performance and SMA engagement, differing by sex and environmental context, highlighting complex associations between neurocognitive development, media use, and mental health.

relevance.reason: 纵向研究屏幕活动与青少年工作记忆fMRI神经特征及行为表现的关联，属认知神经机制与脑发育。

papers.summary_zh: 该纵向队列研究基于ABCD数据，考察青少年不同屏幕活动与工作记忆神经特征之间的纵向关联，并检验性别差异及家庭冲突、睡眠和体育活动的调节作用。工作记忆神经特征由n-back任务脑激活模式经弹性网分类得出，得分越高对应0-back和2-back正确率越好。结果显示，电子游戏、发短信和看电视时间越多，神经特征得分越低，这一关联在男性中更明显，且为n-back任务所特有。家庭冲突、睡眠问题和体育活动还以性别特异的方式调节神经特征与内化和外化症状的关联。作者据此强调，青少年媒体使用、神经认知发展与心理健康之间的关系因性别和环境而异，但相关不等于因果。

papers.title: Puberty, not age, marks the start of adolescent brain structural remodeling.
papers.authors: Chad JA, Klukas OC, Ghasoub M, Lebel C.
papers.abstract: Many studies have shown that pubertal changes are associated with brain changes, but there lacks a clear understanding of what happens to the brain at puberty, and whether it opens the brain structural remodeling that characterizes adolescence. In this study, we used three longitudinal waves of structural MRI data from thousands of participants of the ABCD study aged 9-14 years to compare brain changes between age-matched children who had either reached or not reached a major pubertal milestone: menarche in females and fonarche (voice drop) in males. We found that only the children who had reached the milestone exhibited widespread contraction of cortical surface area and subcortical volume. The contraction was more pronounced in females, in line with previous evidence of how gonadal hormones regulate neuronal fine-tuning. Our findings suggest that reaching puberty, rather than reaching a particular age, begins the adolescent phase of structural brain development.

relevance.reason: 纵向结构MRI显示青春期里程碑而非年龄标志青少年脑结构重塑（皮质表面积与皮层下体积收缩）。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青春期大脑结构重塑究竟由年龄还是青春期启动所标志，利用ABCD研究中数千名9至14岁参与者的三轮纵向结构MRI数据，比较已达到与未达到关键青春期里程碑（女性月经初潮、男性变声）的同龄儿童。结果显示，只有已达到里程碑的儿童表现出广泛的皮层表面积和皮层下体积收缩，且女性更为明显。作者据此提出，进入青春期而非达到特定年龄，才开启青少年阶段的结构性脑发育。

papers.title: Developmental variation in resting-state EEG spectral correlates of response inhibition in children and adolescents.
papers.authors: Xu Y, Yang Z, Ouyang G, He Q, Xu M.
papers.abstract: Identifying electrophysiological markers of response inhibition in children and adolescents is of substantial importance. Although previous studies have examined associations between resting-state electroencephalography (rs-EEG) power and response inhibition, findings across frequency bands have been inconsistent, and evidence regarding band-ratio indices remains limited. To address these issues, the present study examined the associations between rs-EEG spectral indices and response inhibition in a large sample of 1654 children and adolescents aged 6-18 years, and further tested whether these associations varied as a function of age. Based on eyes-open rs-EEG recordings, relative power was extracted for the delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands, and three band-ratio indices were calculated: the theta/beta ratio (TBR), alpha/theta ratio (ATR), and beta/theta ratio (BTR). Response inhibition was assessed using the stop-signal task. Correlation analyses showed that higher delta power, theta power, and TBR were associated with poorer response inhibition, whereas higher alpha power, beta power, ATR, and BTR were associated with better response inhibition. Moderation analyses further indicated that age significantly moderated the associations of delta power, beta power, ATR, and BTR with response inhibition, whereas no significant age-moderating effects were observed for theta power, alpha power or TBR. Taken together, these findings suggest that the electrophysiological correlates of response inhibition are developmentally dynamic across childhood and adolescence. The present study provides a psychophysiological account of developmental variation in response inhibition and underscores the importance of age when interpreting resting-state EEG-behavior associations.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察儿童青少年静息态脑电频谱指标与反应抑制的关系，并检验这些关系是否随年龄变化；研究基于大样本静息态脑电记录提取各频段相对功率及频段比值，用停止信号任务评估反应抑制。结果显示，较高的delta、theta功率和theta/beta比值与较差的反应抑制相关，而较高的alpha、beta功率及alpha/theta、beta/theta比值与较好的反应抑制相关。年龄显著调节delta功率、beta功率及两个比值指标与反应抑制的关联，但对theta功率、alpha功率和theta/beta比值未见显著调节。作者据此认为，反应抑制的电生理相关在儿童青少年期具有发展动态性，解释静息态脑电与行为关联时需考虑年龄。

papers.title: Neurocognitive development and its relationship to brain structure and function: Findings from the ABCD study.
papers.authors: Banich MT, Smolker HR, Barch DM, Luciana M.
papers.abstract: This paper reviews findings on neurocognitive development provided by the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development® study to date. It explores the structure of cognitive processes during the late childhood to early adolescent developmental time frame as well as associations with brain regions and systems that may support such processes. Also reviewed are findings from a wide variety of cognitive processes including general cognitive abilities, memory, inhibitory control, risk and reward processing, language, non-verbal abilities, executive functioning, and cognitive flexibility. The relationships of these aspects of cognition are examined with regard to morphological features of both white and grey matter, and with regard to brain function, more specifically activation and connectivity measures derived from functional MRI, during rest and during tasks. Section summaries and potential future directions are provided at the end of each section. The paper concludes with broad lessons learned from the ABCD® study so far as well as consideration of how future exploration of the data could illuminate a variety of outstanding issues with regard to neurocognitive development.

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了青少年脑认知发展（ABCD）研究迄今关于神经认知发展的发现，关注童年晚期至青春期早期认知过程的结构及其与可能支持这些过程的脑区、脑系统的关联。文章涵盖一般认知能力、记忆、抑制控制、风险与奖赏加工、语言、非言语能力、执行功能和认知灵活性等多种认知过程，并考察这些认知方面与白质和灰质形态特征的关系，以及与静息和任务态功能磁共振所测激活和连接的关系。各节末尾给出小结和未来方向，全文最后总结已有教训，并讨论未来数据探索如何阐明神经认知发展中的若干未决问题。

papers.title: Association among white matter lesions, rsEEG rhythms, amyloid tau markers, and cognitive status in mild cognitive impairment patients.
papers.authors: Del Percio C, Lizio R, Noce G, Carpi M, Lopez S, Carducci F, De Bartolo M, Afragola AP, Soricelli A, Salvatore M, Giubilei F, Güntekin B, Yener G, Massa F, Arnaldi D, Famà F, Pardini M, Ferri R, Lanuzza B, Stocchi F, Vacca L, Coletti C, Infarinato F, Marziali S, Marizzoni M, Taylor JP, Hanoğlu L, Yırıkoğulları H, Frisoni GB, Cuoco S, Cappiello A, Barone P, Bonanni L, Biundo R, Cauzzo S, Fiorenzato E, Antonini A, De Pandis MF, D'Antonio F, Bruno G, Babiloni C.
papers.journal: Clinical neurophysiology : official journal of the International Federation of Clinical Neurophysiology
papers.abstract: Objective Abnormalities in posteriorly dominant resting-state eyes-closed electroencephalographic (rsEEG) alpha rhythms are associated with cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) tau neuropathology and Mini-Mental Status Examination (MMSE) score, reflecting global cognition, in patients with mild cognitive impairment due to Alzheimer's disease (MCI-AD). The present study examined the relationships between white matter cerebrovascular lesions (WMLs) and CSF amyloid-tau markers, posterior rsEEG alpha rhythms, and cognitive status in patients with MCI-AD versus those with mild cognitive impairment not due to Alzheimer's disease (MCI-noAD). Methods An international database provided clinical, demographic, CSF amyloid-tau, rsEEG, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) datasets for 68 MCI-AD and 44 MCI-noAD patients. The WMLs were segmented from T2-weighted and FLAIR MRI images. Cortical rsEEG sources at individual delta, theta, and alpha frequencies were estimated using eLORETA freeware. Results In MCI-AD patients, greater WMLs were not associated with increased AD neuropathology, greater alterations in rsEEG alpha or other source activities, or worse MMSE scores. In contrast, higher WMLs were associated with lower MMSE scores in patients with MCI-noAD. Conclusions These results suggest that WMLs had a limited role in prodromal AD, while it affects global cognitive status in patients with MCI-noAD. Significance These findings highlight the stage-dependent, region-specific, and pathology-specific nature of cerebrovascular-neurodegenerative interactions. The limited role of WMLs in MCI-AD may indicate that synergistic neurotoxic effects between vascular burden and AD pathology require more advanced disease stages or higher thresholds of vascular burden to manifest clinically.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了阿尔茨海默病所致轻度认知障碍（MCI-AD）与非阿尔茨海默病所致轻度认知障碍（MCI-noAD）患者，结合脑白质病变的MRI评估、脑脊液淀粉样蛋白- tau标志物、静息态脑电源活动及认知状态，考察白质脑血管病变与这些指标的关系。结果显示，在MCI-AD患者中，白质病变程度与AD神经病理负担、静息态alpha等源活动改变及整体认知表现均无关联；而在MCI-noAD患者中，白质病变较重者认知得分较低。作者据此认为，白质病变在AD前驱期作用有限，却与MCI-noAD的整体认知状态相关，并提示脑血管与神经退行性病变的交互可能具有阶段和病理类型依赖性，其临床显现或需更晚阶段或更高血管负担阈值。

papers.title: Structural connectivity between the retrosplenial cortex and hippocampus in the healthy human brain: A diffusion tensor tractography study.
papers.authors: Yun SH, Cho IH.
papers.abstract: Background/purpose The retrosplenial cortex (RSC) and hippocampus are important regions involved in spatial navigation by integrating vestibular information into spatial representations. Although functional interactions between these regions have been demonstrated, there is currently a lack of evidence regarding the structural connectivity between the RSC and hippocampus in the human brain. This study aimed to reconstruct and characterize a tractography-derived pathway between the RSC and hippocampus in healthy adults using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) tractography. Methods Thirty healthy adults were recruited. The seed region of interest (ROI) was defined in the RSC with reference to both sagittal and axial planes, and the target ROI was placed within the hippocampus on the axial plane. The structural characteristics, including fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity, and tract volume were analyzed. Results A tractography-derived RSC-hippocampal pathway was identified bilaterally in all participants. Conclusion This study characterized a tractography-derived RSC-hippocampal pathway in the healthy human brain. Our findings provide insight into RSC-hippocampal structural connectivity and suggest a potential structural substrate for interactions between these regions in spatial information processing.

relevance.reason: DTI纤维束成像重建健康人脑RSC-海马结构连接通路，属白质纤维束与结构连接研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注健康人脑中压后皮层与海马之间是否存在可重建的结构连接，采用弥散张量成像纤维束成像，在健康成人中设定压后皮层为种子区、海马为目标区进行追踪。结果显示，所有参与者双侧均可识别出一条压后皮层—海马纤维通路，并对其各向异性、平均弥散率和纤维束体积等结构特征进行了分析。作者据此指出，这为两区域间的结构连接提供了成像证据，并提示该通路可能是二者在空间信息处理中相互作用的潜在结构基础；但研究仅描述健康成人中的通路存在与特征，未涉及功能或临床效应。

papers.title: Domain-general multitasking strategy developed from language experience: Neurobehavioral evidence from student interpreters.
papers.authors: Yang C, Dong Y, Gao S, Hu M.
papers.abstract: Multitasking as a cognitive ability is significant, and yet few studies have investigated how to improve multitasking, especially by language experience. To investigate how language multitasking may enhance domain-general multitasking, this fMRI study compared interpreting students and matched bilingual controls in a non-linguistic dual-task (auditory Task 1, visual Task 2) and examined how their neural data may relate to behavioral performance. Behaviorally, interpreting students showed higher response-time costs in Task 1 but lower costs in Task 2, resulting in faster responses to dual-task trials. At the neural level, interpreting students exhibited greater dual-task-specific activation in the left postcentral gyrus, SMA, and cerebellum (areas subserving sensory processing, response selection, and motor-cognitive integration). Notably, greater engagement of these regions was correlated with greater Task 1 accuracy decrements in interpreting students but not in controls. These findings, together with slower Task 1 responses, indicate that interpreting students may have strategically activated task-set information from both tasks at trial onset. This strategy, while increasing load on motor-cognitive brain regions and coming at a cost to Task 1 performance, accelerated Task 2 responses by pre-activating subsequent task-set information. Hyperactivation was also observed in the left STG and bilateral MTG, with left STG activity negatively correlated with Task 2 time costs only in interpreting students, suggesting that interpreting may enhance recruitment of language-related networks for faster switching. The selectivity and consistency of these brain-behavior correlations demonstrate the significant effects of interpreting on domain-general multitasking, wherein interpreting students strategically trade initial response speed for overall efficiency.

relevance.reason: fMRI比较口译学生与双语对照在非语言双任务中的脑活动与行为，涉及语言经验对一般多任务及语言相关网络的影响。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语言经验能否提升跨领域的多任务能力，用fMRI比较了口译学生与匹配的双语控制组在非语言双任务中的表现及其与脑活动的关系。行为上，口译学生在任务一上反应时代价更高、在任务二上代价更低，双任务试次总体反应更快；脑层面，他们在左侧中央后回、辅助运动区和小脑等感觉加工、反应选择与运动—认知整合区域表现出更强的双任务特异性激活，且这些区域的参与程度与任务一正确率下降相关。作者据此推测，口译学生可能在试次开始时策略性地同时激活两个任务的任务集信息，以任务一成绩为代价预激活后续任务信息、加快任务二反应；语言相关网络的选择性参与也可能支持更快的切换。这些相关结果提示口译经验对一般多任务加工有影响，但并非因果或干预证据。

papers.title: Large-Scale Cerebellar-Cerebral Network Alterations Underlying Impaired Social Predictive Processing in Cerebellar Neurodegeneration.
papers.authors: Siciliano L, Urbini N, Olivito G, Pisu M, Tanieli M, Ciricugno A, Oldrati V, Giove F, Borgatti R, Cattaneo Z, Urgesi C, Leggio M.
papers.abstract: The cerebellum is a key node for detecting and adjusting social-prediction internal models. Yet social prediction has been scantly investigated in neurodegenerative cerebellar patients (CB). Thus, we examined CB social-prediction abilities and related cerebellar-cerebral networks, using tailored tasks and resting-state fMRI. Thirteen adult CB and twenty-six matched controls completed three computerized prediction tasks, where contextual priors activate specific internal models setting expectations which may influence recognition of ambiguous targets (emotion expressions, personality-traits, non-social objects). Accuracy and response times were analysed through 2 × 2 × 2 mixed-effects ANOVAs. A congruency index (CI) reflecting whether response was driven by contextual influence was derived from performance efficiency scores and analysed through a 2 × 2 mixed-effects ANOVA. Participants underwent 3T brain MRI, including T1-weighted and resting-state fMRI sequences. Posterior and vermian cerebellar lobules were chosen a-priori as regions of interest and used in a Seed-Based fMRI analysis examining cerebellar-cerebral functional connectivity (FC). FC values from patients' altered connectivity clusters were extracted and correlated with CIs. CB performed worse in the personality-traits task, showing higher reliance on contextual cues. Cerebellar-cerebral underconnectivity was found within networks involved in mentalizing and learning. In CB, higher CI in the personality-traits task, reflecting greater contextual influence and failure to revise behavioural responses, significantly correlated with right lobule VIII-right putamen underconnectivity. These findings indicate reduced flexibility in updating higher-order social predictions when contextual expectations conflict with incoming information, accompanied by altered cerebellar-cerebral FC. Exploratory findings further point to cerebellar-basal ganglia connectivity as a potentially relevant network component of predictive social cognition, warranting further investigation.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察小脑神经退行性变患者的社会预测能力及其与小脑—大脑网络的关系，采用定制预测任务和静息态功能磁共振成像，比较患者与匹配对照在情绪、人格特质和非社会对象判断中的表现。结果显示，患者在人格特质任务中表现更差，更依赖情境线索，并在涉及心理化与学习的网络中表现出小脑—大脑功能连接减弱；人格特质任务中情境影响更强、行为调整不足的倾向，与右侧小脑小叶VIII与右侧壳核间连接减弱相关。作者据此认为，当情境预期与输入信息冲突时，患者更新高阶社会预测的灵活性下降，并伴有小脑—大脑连接改变；探索性结果还提示小脑—基底节连接可能是预测性社会认知的相关网络成分，有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Integrating resting-state functional connectivity, mismatch negativity, and auditory steady-state responses reveals convergent neurophysiological biomarkers of schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Abdullah SS, Hameed TT, Baig MR, Nematov O, Sapaev I, Ismail SM, Bani Younes ZB, Arora V, Sharma R, Mohammadi Y, Khasawneh MAS.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia is a heterogeneous neuropsychiatric disorder characterized by abnormalities in large-scale brain connectivity, auditory prediction-error processing, and cortical gamma-band synchronization. Although resting-state electroencephalography (EEG), mismatch negativity (MMN), and auditory steady-state responses (ASSRs) have each been proposed as candidate biomarkers, they are often investigated separately, limiting the characterization of convergent neurophysiological abnormalities. This study evaluated whether integrating these complementary EEG paradigms could improve the biological characterization and predictive classification of schizophrenia within a unified multi-paradigm electrophysiological framework. A retrospective secondary analysis was performed using the publicly available African Schizophrenia EEG Dataset (ASZED), comprising 153 participants (76 individuals with schizophrenia and 77 healthy controls). Resting-state functional connectivity was quantified using the weighted Phase Lag Index and graph-theoretical analysis, while MMN peak amplitude, mean amplitude, latency, and 40-Hz ASSR gamma-band evoked power and inter-trial phase coherence were extracted as stimulus-evoked biomarkers. Multimodal classification was performed on 145 participants with complete resting-state, MMN, and ASSR recordings using a Graph Attention Network-based framework. Model interpretability was evaluated using SHAP and GNNExplainer, and predictive performance was assessed using nested stratified five-fold cross-validation with permutation testing. Participants with schizophrenia exhibited disrupted resting-state functional network organization, attenuated MMN responses, and impaired gamma-band synchronization compared with healthy controls. The integrated framework achieved the highest internally validated classification performance, with a balanced accuracy of 91.8% and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.96, exceeding the performance of the individual resting-state, MMN, and ASSR models within the matched complete-case cohort. Explainability analyses identified global efficiency, MMN peak amplitude, and ASSR inter-trial phase coherence as the most influential predictive features across validation folds. These findings indicate that resting-state connectivity, MMN, and ASSR provide complementary electrophysiological information that can be integrated into a coherent predictive representation of schizophrenia-related brain dysfunction. The findings should be interpreted as internally validated associations within a single public dataset rather than as evidence of clinically validated diagnostic biomarkers. Independent external validation and longitudinal studies will be required to determine whether these multi-paradigm EEG signatures have broader prognostic, treatment-response, or translational utility.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于公开数据集，将静息态功能连接、失匹配负波和听觉稳态反应三种脑电范式整合到一个多范式框架中，考察它们能否共同刻画精神分裂症的神经生理异常并提升分类表现。结果显示，精神分裂症患者在静息态网络组织、失匹配负波反应和伽马同步上均存在异常；整合模型的内部验证分类表现优于各单独模型，可解释性分析提示全局效率、失匹配负波峰幅和试次间相位一致性贡献较大。作者强调，这些结果只是单一公开数据集内的内部验证关联，并非临床验证的诊断标志物，仍需独立外部验证和纵向研究。

papers.title: The neurobiology of binge eating disorder: a systematic review of studies using functional magnetic resonance imaging.
papers.authors: Park JJ, Zhang K, Lee G, Potenza MN.
papers.abstract: Binge eating disorder (BED) is a prevalent public health concern associated with significant medical and psychosocial burden. To better understand the mechanisms underlying this concern, the present systematic review aimed to synthesize findings from resting-state and task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) studies of the neurobiology of BED. PubMed, MEDLINE, PsycInfo, Embase, and Web of Science were searched, the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal Tools were used, and the PRISMA guidelines were followed. The review identified 24 studies, comprising approximately 1,689 non-independent participants from an estimated 17 unique cohorts. These included task-based fMRI studies (n = 14), resting-state fMRI studies (n = 6), and BED treatment-outcome fMRI studies (n = 4). Key findings of the review included: (i) differences in neural responsivity to palatable food cues involving reward- and salience-related circuitry (e.g., orbitofrontal cortex, ventral striatum, and insula), alongside reduced recruitment of inhibitory-control regions during cognitive-control tasks; (ii) evidence suggesting reward-related differences in BED may be more food-specific than generalized across reward types, although some findings indicate broader frontostriatal hyporesponsivity during monetary reward processing; and, (iii) findings indicating that BED may share neurobiological overlap with, but remain distinguishable from, obesity and bulimia nervosa. However, these findings/interpretations are preliminary, given limitations in the current evidence base, including small samples, methodological heterogeneity, and the underrepresentation of males. Future neuroimaging studies should prioritize large-scale, longitudinal, efforts that include more representative (e.g., greater inclusion of males) and developmental (e.g., more children and adolescents) samples and consider socioenvironmental contexts relevant to BED. Such efforts may help inform individual-level personalized interventions.
