papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了暴食症神经生物学的功能磁共振成像研究，涵盖任务态、静息态及治疗结局三类。主要发现包括：暴食症患者对可口食物线索的奖赏与显著性相关环路反应存在差异，认知控制任务中抑制控制脑区招募减少；奖赏相关差异可能更多是食物特异性的，而非泛化的奖赏加工异常，但部分证据提示金钱奖赏加工中也存在额纹状体反应减弱。此外，暴食症与肥胖和神经性贪食症在神经生物学上既有重叠又可区分。作者强调这些结论仍属初步，受样本小、方法异质和男性代表性不足等限制，未来需大规模纵向研究并纳入更具代表性和发育阶段的样本。

papers.title: Shared Fine-Scale Functional Organization in the Human Subcortex Revealed by Connectivity Hyperalignment
papers.authors: Tu JC, Feilong M, Zhang Y, Gobbini MI, Haxby JV.
papers.abstract: Subcortical structures are central to cognition, emotion, and social processing, and their dysfunction underlies a wide range of neurological and psychiatric conditions. Yet subcortical fine-scale functional organization has remained largely inaccessible to group-level fMRI analysis: nuclei are small and low-SNR, and their functional topography varies idiosyncratically across individuals in ways that anatomical alignment cannot resolve. This idiosyncrasy carries real stakes. For example, deep brain stimulation targets with more variable functional connectivity across individuals show correspondingly less consistent clinical outcomes. Here we show that this seemingly idiosyncratic subcortical organization in fact reflects shared, fine-grained structure that can be recovered by modeling each individual’s connectivity in a common functional space (connectivity hyperalignment, CHA), rather than relying on anatomical correspondence. Applying CHA to fMRI data collected during naturalistic movie viewing, we found that aligning subcortical voxels by their cortical connectivity, rather than their anatomical location, sharply increased cross-subject correspondence in both stimulus-evoked response and connectivity profiles. Critically, this alignment sharpened rather than blurred local structure: neighboring voxels became more functionally distinct from one another, and cortical connectivity targets became substantially more decodable across subjects. These results indicate that human subcortical nuclei possess a common fine-scale functional architecture that is masked by anatomical variability but recoverable at the individual level. This reframes a central methodological constraint in subcortical neuroimaging: rather than trading spatial resolution for signal quality via smoothing, group-level analyses can achieve voxel-level precision by aligning function rather than anatomy, opening a path to studying cortical-subcortical circuit organization in greater detail.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑皮层下核团细尺度功能组织及其与皮层连接的对齐，属脑功能组织与结构-功能关系，采用自然电影观看fMRI。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注皮层下核团精细功能组织在群体fMRI分析中难以刻画的问题：核团体积小、信噪比低，且个体间功能拓扑差异无法靠解剖对齐解决。作者用连接性超对齐（CHA），在自然观影fMRI数据中按皮层连接而非解剖位置对齐皮层下体素。结果显示，对齐后个体间在刺激诱发反应和连接剖面上的对应性明显提高，且局部结构更清晰而非被模糊，相邻体素功能更可区分，皮层连接目标在个体间的可解码性也增强。这表明人类皮层下核团存在共有的精细功能架构，只是被解剖变异掩盖，并提示群体分析可通过按功能对齐获得体素级精度。

papers.title: An information-borrowing Bayesian method for inferring high-dimensional population-level brain connectivity from small samples
papers.authors: Pu Z, Zeng C, Ge S.
papers.abstract: Estimating population-level dependence between brain regions is challenging when the number of regions greatly exceeds the number of individuals. We introduce an information-borrowing generalized Bayesian method for high-dimensional covariance estimation from region-level brain measurements. A divide-and-conquer parameterization separates marginal variances from correlation calibrations: an empirical pilot correlation matrix–by default, obtained by standardizing a sample covariance matrix (SCM)–provides a reference structure that is adaptively calibrated through region-specific parameters shared across pairwise correlations, reducing the number of free parameters from O ( d 2 ) to O ( d ) ( d is the number of regions) while guaranteeing a positive-definite covariance through the inclusion of a ridge term. Horseshoe priors on the calibration parameters enable selective borrowing and shrinkage of pilot information. Under suitable conditions on pilot accuracy, we establish theoretical guarantees for covariance estimation while retaining scalability in ultra-high-dimensional settings via a low-rank likelihood representation and a Woodbury-accelerated Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm. Simulations showed lower estimation error than the SCM, bagging and iteratively refined principal orthogonal complement thresholding (POETRY). Applications to a semi-synthetic cortical-thickness and ADHD resting-state fMRI data revealed significant group differences in the default-mode–visual network and somatomotor network–limbic network blocks after Benjamini–Hochberg correction.

relevance.reason: 提出从脑区测量估计群体水平高维协方差/连接的方法，并应用于皮层厚度与ADHD静息态fMRI，报告默认-视觉及躯体运动-边缘网络组间差异，属脑结构与静息功能网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑区数量远多于个体数时难以估计群体水平脑区间依赖关系的问题，提出一种借用信息的广义贝叶斯高维协方差估计方法。方法将边际方差与相关校准分离，以试点相关矩阵为参照结构，通过区域共享的校准参数和马蹄先验实现选择性借用与收缩，并用低秩似然表示和加速采样保持超高维情形的可扩展性，同时给出协方差估计的理论保证。模拟显示其估计误差低于样本协方差矩阵、bagging和POETRY；在皮层厚度半合成数据与ADHD静息态fMRI数据中，经多重比较校正后发现默认网络—视觉网络及感觉运动网络—边缘网络区块存在显著组间差异。这些结果提示该方法可在小样本下支持群体脑连接推断，但组间差异属关联性发现，尚不涉及临床效用。

papers.title: Structural integrity moderates the cognitive bearing of dopamine clearance in aging
papers.authors: Esmaeili A, Preti G, Bittner N, Woodman MM, Caspers S, Hashemi M, Petkoski S, Marinazzo D, Jirsa V.
papers.abstract: Age-related cognitive decline in humans is well established, yet how neurobiological variations influence brain dynamics, and subsequently behavioral performance, remains insufficiently explored. Microscale accounts of cognitive aging revolve around attenuations in dopamine (DA) receptors and transporters (DAT). In contrast, macroscale accounts associate individual declines in cognitive performance with functional brain networks’ reorganization and white-matter tracts’ deterioration. We endeavor to bridge this gap with an amortized dopaminergic aging model (ADAM) which assembles aging brain twins by coupling dopaminergic modulation with structural connectomes to constrain emergent whole-brain dynamics. ADAM thereby augments established DAT decline with personalized estimates, through a reusable and generalizable estimator capable of disentangling neuromodulatory from structural contributions to age-related decline within each individual. To that end, we embed structural connectomes into a low-dimensional space exhibiting high reconstruction fidelity and —pseudonymized— individual identifiability. The spectrum of structural embeddings is subsequently updated with fMRI observations to estimate DA clearance timescales in 3,650 adults aged 36 to 95 years across five independent aging cohorts. Our analysis reveals an age-related elevation of DA clearance timescales. Critically, low performers exhibit elevated clearance in adults with marked structural degradation, and only within sliding age windows centred between 56 and 76 years. This supports a contribution of dopamine to aging, and reveals a structure- and age-conditional association between its clearance and cognitive performance. Our findings suggest that structural connectivity gates the macroscale reach of dopaminergic modulation, thus rendering the gain-control framework of neuromodulation mechanistically explicit across individuals and cohorts. ADAM therefore provides a biologically plausible framework that anchors interindividual variability in cognitive aging to perturbations in the dopaminergic system by learning cohort-scale mappings which can be shared across sites, establishing a transferable testbed for precision neuromodulation and future in-silico pharmacological trials.

relevance.reason: 结合结构连接组与多巴胺动力学建模，研究人类衰老中脑结构与神经调质对认知表现的交互作用。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种可 amortized 的多巴胺能老化模型（ADAM），将多巴胺调节与个体结构连接组耦合，用结构嵌入结合fMRI观测估计多巴胺清除时间尺度，并在多个独立老化队列的成年人中检验其与认知表现的关系。结果显示，多巴胺清除时间尺度随年龄升高；只有在结构退化明显且年龄处于特定滑动窗口内的成年人中，低认知表现者才表现出清除时间尺度升高。作者据此认为，结构连接可能限制多巴胺调节在宏观层面的作用范围，多巴胺清除与认知表现的关联受结构和年龄条件约束，而非普遍存在。

papers.title: Distinct EEG microstate signatures across different pain types
papers.authors: Rabiei P, Champagne A, Barrette L, Fakhry N, Massé-Alarie H, Coll M.
papers.abstract: Pain is associated with dynamic brain reorganization. Electroencephalographic microstates can characterize transient large-scale brain states, yet findings across pain studies are inconsistent. Two features may contribute: conditions have been studied in isolation, and analytical pipelines vary widely. We applied a harmonized analysis pipeline across three pain conditions: capsaicin-induced pain, assessed within participants against a pain-free baseline, and non-chronic and chronic back pain, each compared with matched controls. Using a five-minute resting-state electroencephalographic recordings we examined microstate topography, temporal expression and transition probabilities, and directly compared pain-related differences across pain states. We identified five microstates (A-E), corresponding to auditory, visual, salience, and attentional networks. Capsaicin pain showed increased expression of microstate C and reduced expression of microstates A, D and E. Transitions were redistributed towards microstate C, indicating a shift toward salience-related processing at the expense of sensory and attentional dynamics. In clinical back pain, effects were smaller and diverged by pain type: non-chronic back pain showed lower microstate C occurrence, opposite in direction to the capsaicin effect, whereas chronic back pain showed lower microstate D global explained variance, suggesting salience and attentional differences in clinical pain. Direct comparisons showed weaker pain-related increases in microstate C expression in both clinical back pain groups than capsaicin pain, with additional differences involving microstates A, D and E. These findings argue against a unitary EEG microstate signature of pain and instead reveal pain-type-specific patterns of large-scale brain dynamics, with microstate C providing the clearest distinction between experimental and clinical pain.

relevance.reason: 研究不同疼痛类型下静息态EEG微状态的大尺度脑动态组织差异，属静息态脑网络组织与感知/注意相关认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注不同疼痛状态是否具有一致的脑电微状态特征，并针对既往研究因条件孤立和分析流程不一而结果不一致的问题，采用统一分析流程比较了辣椒素诱导痛、非慢性背痛和慢性背痛。结果显示，辣椒素痛表现为微状态C表达增加、A、D、E表达减少，状态转换也偏向微状态C，提示显著性相关加工增强而感觉与注意动态受抑；临床背痛效应较小且方向分化，非慢性背痛微状态C反而降低，慢性背痛则表现为微状态D全局解释方差下降。作者据此认为不存在单一的疼痛微状态标志，疼痛类型决定了大尺度脑动态的不同模式，微状态C最能区分实验性痛与临床痛。

papers.title: Psychedelics Restructure the Global Workspace of Consciousness
papers.authors: Yousefi P, Shinozuka K, Vizeli P, Holze F, Becker AM, Müller F, Liechti ME, Hasler G, Rodríguez CI, Luppi A, Mediano PA.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Psychoactive drugs profoundly alter consciousness, but the neural mechanisms by which they do so remain poorly understood. Global workspace theory may provide a framework for investigating these mechanisms. The global workspace, a candidate neural substrate of consciousness, is a set of brain regions that integrate and disseminate information to the rest of the brain. According to a recent model, the integrators, or “gateways,” are characterized by synergistic interactions with other brain regions, while the disseminators, or “broadcasters,” exhibit redundant interactions. Here, we measured the effects of various psychoactive drugs, including “classic” psychedelics like LSD, mescaline, and psilocybin, “atypical” psychedelics (entactogens) like MDMA, and the stimulant D-amphetamine, on the global workspace. In a secondary analysis of resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data on all these drugs, we found that classic psychedelics are associated with significant increases in the number of gateways in the frontoparietal control and dorsal attention networks. Meanwhile, MDMA and amphetamine reduced the number of gateways in the visual and somatomotor networks. The regional topographies of both synergy and redundancy distinguished classic psychedelics from other drugs. Finally, drugs producing similar changes in synergy and redundancy also produced similar profiles of subjective effects. Overall, our findings provide the first direct evidence that psychedelics may alter the synergistic and redundant interactions that characterize the global workspace of consciousness.

relevance.reason: 研究经典致幻剂等药物对静息态fMRI全局工作空间（意识神经基础）协同/冗余交互的影响，属意识与脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注经典致幻剂等精神活性药物如何改变意识相关的全局工作空间，基于多类药物静息态功能磁共振数据的二次分析，考察脑区间协同与冗余交互所刻画的“门户”和“广播”结构。结果显示，经典致幻剂与额顶控制网络和背侧注意网络中门户数量增加相关，而MDMA和苯丙胺则减少视觉与躯体运动网络中的门户数量；协同与冗余的区域分布也能区分经典致幻剂与其他药物。作者还发现，在协同和冗余上产生相似变化的药物，其主观效应谱也相似，并据此提出致幻剂可能通过改变全局工作空间的协同与冗余交互而发挥作用，但这一证据仍属关联性观察。

papers.title: Communication as a Two-Person Neural Process: fNIRS Hyperscanning in Adults with and without Post-Stroke Aphasia
papers.authors: Magee G, Colwell J, Kelley S, Mohammad Y, Zhang Y, Boas D, Kiran S, Varkanitsa M, Meier E, Yücel M.
papers.abstract: Communication is inherently interactive, yet most neuroimaging studies examine individuals in isolation. Here, we used functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning to investigate interbrain synchrony (IBS) during naturalistic communication. In Study 1, 13 healthy familiar dyads completed Joint Singing, Joint Reading, and Picture Guessing tasks. IBS was quantified using wavelet transform coherence across bilateral frontal and temporoparietal regions. Joint Singing produced higher IBS than the other tasks in several regions, including the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and temporoparietal junction, and selected effects were greater in true than pseudo-dyads. In Study 2, we applied the same paradigm to five individuals with chronic post-stroke aphasia interacting with trained speech-language pathologists. IBS could be estimated in all dyads after lesion-informed channel exclusion, although regional coverage varied with lesion location. These findings demonstrate that fNIRS hyperscanning can capture task-dependent interpersonal neural coupling during spoken interaction and can be extended to communication involving individuals with aphasia. This approach provides a foundation for studying how neural coordination between communication partners relates to functional communication and partner-supported interaction.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS超扫描研究自然交流中的人际脑同步，并扩展到卒中后失语症患者与治疗师的交流，涉及语言交流的脑间耦合机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然交流中交流双方的大脑活动如何协调，采用功能性近红外光谱超扫描技术，在健康熟悉配对和慢性卒中后失语者与言语治疗师的配对中测量脑间同步。健康配对完成联合唱歌、联合朗读和看图猜词任务，结果显示联合唱歌在多个额叶和颞顶区域引起的脑间同步高于其他任务，部分效应在真实配对中强于伪配对。研究还将同一范式用于失语者交流配对，在排除病灶相关通道后仍能估计脑间同步，但区域覆盖随病灶位置而异。作者据此认为，该方法能捕捉口语互动中任务依赖的人际神经耦合，并可推广到失语者参与的交流研究，为考察交流伙伴间的神经协调与功能性沟通的关系提供基础。

papers.title: Lifespan Trajectories of Resting State Bipolar EEG Power
papers.authors: Chorlian DB, Kamarajan C, Meyers JL, Anokhin A, Pandey AK, Zhang J, Kinreich S, Porjesz B.
papers.abstract: Normative trajectories of resting state bipolar EEG power over the lifespan were derived from a sample of 5781 participants from the Collaborative Study on the Genetics of Alcoholism (COGA), a large multi site study, using 12,906 observations from ages 12 through 70. Trajectories were analyzed using the means, variances, and correlations of data in seven frequency bands (from low theta to high beta) and 24 bipolar channels obtained from 17 electrodes of the 10-20 system. In order to make the study more useful for understanding EEG in the general population, only subjects never having an alcohol use disorder (AUD) diagnosis were included in the study. Bipolar EEG data is derived from the differencing of the signals in adjacent electrodes, either in a lateral (left-right) or sagittal (anterior-posterior) orientation; each difference is called a channel. The power values for the individual observations were calculated by standard Fourier transform based methods. In all cases there are sharp decreases in EEG power from ages 12 to the early 20s after which there are number of divergent patterns: general increases in the beta frequencies, and mixed patterns of increase and subsequent decrease in the theta and alpha frequencies. In these characteristics the lifespan trajectories presented here are similar to the monopolar trajectories described in our previous study Chorlian et al. (2026). Sagittal and lateral bipolar trajectories are similar within each sex and between sexes; the primary difference is the much lower degree of regional difference in the sagittal trajectories as compared to the lateral trajectories. The pairwise inter-frequency (within channel) correlation trajectories between the four theta and alpha frequency bands and the four high alpha and beta frequency bands at each channel show striking sex differences unlike the corresponding monopolar correlations. There are a number of features in the bipolar power trajectories that suggest that the differencing procedure reduces not only local phase synchrony, but also effects of global and regional phase synchrony present in the monopolar data from which the bipolar signals are derived. The inter-frequency correlations at the individual channels are much higher in the bipolar data than the monopolar data, suggesting that global and regional phase synchrony components retained in the monopolar data have greater frequency specificity than the more purely local components in the bipolar data. Further analyses to examine many other features of the data will be undertaken in our subsequent work.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑静息态EEG功率的毕生发展轨迹及频率间相关，属自发活动与脑组织发育特征。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于大型多中心样本的静息态双极脑电数据，刻画了从青春期到成年晚期的毕生功率变化轨迹，并仅纳入从未被诊断为酒精使用障碍的参与者，以更贴近一般人群。结果显示，各频段功率在12岁至20岁出头均急剧下降，此后出现分化：β频段总体上升，θ和α频段则呈升降混合模式，整体与作者此前的单极导联结果相似。矢状与横向双极轨迹在同一性别内及两性间大体相近，主要差别是矢状轨迹的区域差异更小；而θ、α频段与高α、β频段之间的通道内频率间相关轨迹表现出明显的性别差异，这一点与单极数据不同。作者据此推测，双极差分不仅削弱局部相位同步，也削弱单极数据中的全局和区域相位同步成分，使双极数据的频率间相关更高，提示单极数据保留的同步成分具有更强的频率特异性。

papers.title: Functional near infrared spectroscopy-based dual-stream adaptive language mapping in adults with and without post-stroke aphasia
papers.authors: Meier E, Fletcher V, Hung C, Andraos EA, Ugent L, Wei G, Lin D, Yücel M.
papers.abstract: In aphasia, variability in lesion location and post-stroke network reorganization complicates efforts to identify the regions that support semantic versus phonological processing. In prior work, researchers have often examined these domains in separate patient cohorts, further limiting direct comparison of their neural substrates within aphasia. To address this gap, we investigated the degree of overlap and specialization within semantic and phonological networks in adults with and without aphasia and examined how neural activity relates to task performance and lesion profiles. Sixteen neurologically healthy adults and 15 participants with aphasia following left hemisphere stroke completed adaptive Semantic Matching and Rhyme Judgment tasks during functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) recording. Changes in oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin were measured within regions of interest, and activation was related to standardized task performance and damage to left ventral and dorsal language pathways in participants with aphasia. Controls showed largely distinct activation patterns consistent with prior fMRI findings: Semantic Matching preferentially recruited ventral stream regions, particularly left temporal cortex, whereas Rhyme Judgment more strongly recruited dorsal regions, including left inferior frontal and inferior parietal cortex. Participants with aphasia showed greater inter-individual variability and no clear group-level segregation of dorsal and ventral activity. Better Semantic Matching performance was associated with less left ventral stream damage and greater left dorsal activation, whereas better Rhyme Judgment performance was associated with lower right hemisphere ventral and dorsal activation. These findings suggest that post-stroke language performance reflects residual specialization, lesion-dependent constraints, and flexible recruitment of surviving tissue. Overall, fNIRS shows promise as an alternative to fMRI for language mapping in post-stroke aphasia, although replication in larger samples with more extensive cortical coverage is warranted.

relevance.reason: fNIRS研究失语症患者语义与音韵加工的双流神经基础及病灶/白质通路关系，属语言机制与脑损伤重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）结合自适应语义匹配和押韵判断任务，比较健康成人（16人）与左半球卒中后失语者（15人）在语义和语音加工中的脑区激活模式。健康组表现出与既往fMRI研究一致的分离模式：语义匹配主要激活左颞叶等腹侧通路区域，押韵判断则更强激活左额下回和顶下小叶等背侧区域；失语组个体差异更大，未出现清晰的腹侧/背侧分组分离。在失语者中，语义匹配成绩较好与左腹侧通路损伤较轻及左背侧激活较强相关，押韵判断成绩较好则与右半球腹侧和背侧激活较低相关。作者据此认为，卒中后语言表现反映了残余特化、病灶相关约束以及对存活组织的灵活募集，并提示fNIRS有望作为fMRI之外的语言映射替代手段，但尚需更大样本和更广皮层覆盖的研究验证。

papers.title: Transcutaneous vagus nerve stimulation during semantic verbal fluency tasks: a high-density diffuse optical tomography study.
papers.authors: Illingworth CH, Baig SS, Swalwell J, Holowacz M, Dorney SL, Burr SDL, Butters E, Blackburn D, Ali A, Majid A, Su L.
papers.abstract: Introduction Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) is a promising adjunct for post-stroke language recovery. There are no established biomarkers for the neuromodulatory effects of taVNS. High-density diffuse optical tomography (HD-DOT) offers a non-invasive marker of task-related cortical activation. We explore HD-DOT in determining the effects of taVNS during a semantic verbal fluency task (VFT). Methods Twenty-four healthy adult participants performed a semantic VFT in a block design, whilst HD-DOT was recorded across the bilateral prefrontal cortex. Participants received sham (earlobe) taVNS followed by active (tragus) taVNS. Statistical analysis was performed at a group level within condition (task-baseline) and between conditions (active taVNS vs. sham taVNS) using node-level and parcellation approaches. Results Twenty-one participants (87.5%) met the signal quality threshold. At the uncorrected level, significant increases in task-related activity were seen in the triangular part of the left inferior frontal gyrus, during both the active and sham taVNS. Correcting for multiple comparisons, significant increases were seen in the left lateral orbitofrontal cortex during sham stimulation. No significant differences in oxygenated haemoglobin concentration increase were seen between active and sham taVNS. Discussion Simultaneous recording of brain activity to taVNS during a semantic VFT was feasible and well tolerated. Task-related activation was seen in brain regions associated with language production and decision-making. Through this exploratory work, healthy adults do not demonstrate any significant enhancement of frontal cortical activation from taVNS. Future studies should combine whole-brain HD-DOT and taVNS in clinical cohorts.

relevance.reason: 用HD-DOT在健康成人语义言语流畅任务中记录额叶皮层激活，报告语言产出相关脑区活动及taVNS调控效果，属语言与认知的脑机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究考察经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）能否在语义言语流畅性任务中增强前额叶皮层激活，并检验用高密度弥散光学断层成像（HD-DOT）同步记录这一效应的可行性。健康成人先后接受假刺激与主动刺激，同时用HD-DOT记录双侧前额叶活动。结果显示，同步记录可行且耐受良好，任务相关激活出现在与语言产生和决策有关的区域；但在校正多重比较后，主动与假刺激之间未见氧合血红蛋白浓度增加的显著差异，即健康成人中未观察到taVNS对额叶皮层激活的明显增强。作者据此认为，该范式可用于后续在临床人群中结合全脑HD-DOT与taVNS的研究，但现有结果尚不能支持taVNS的临床疗效。

papers.title: The cerebellum in migraine: a narrative review of anatomical, imaging, and clinical evidence.
papers.authors: Zhang R, Huang J, Fan X, Hu W, Dong L, Zhou J.
papers.abstract: Migraine is usually framed through trigeminovascular pathways and interactions among the brainstem, hypothalamus, and cortex. The cerebellum has received less attention, although human studies place it within circuits that process trigeminal nociception and vestibular signals. This narrative review examines anatomical and experimental work together with imaging, genetic, and clinical studies, giving greatest weight to direct human migraine evidence. Repeated-measures imaging suggests that cerebellar connectivity changes across the migraine cycle, but the cohorts are small. Structural findings vary with analytic method, and population based testing does not show a general cerebellar deficit in common migraine. Evidence is more coherent in defined contexts: trigeminal stimulation recruits lobules VI/VIIIa and Crus I, vestibular migraine involves posterior cerebellar and wider vestibular-sensory networks, and treatment imaging shows cerebellar changes without localizing the site of CGRP-directed action. Findings in medication-overuse headache and familial hemiplegic migraine provide additional state-related and mechanistic clues. Taken together, the cerebellum is best viewed as a modulatory component of distributed migraine networks, with possible roles in sensory gain and vestibular integration. It is neither a demonstrated attack generator nor a validated treatment target. The next step is to test whether within-person cerebellar measures reproduce across attacks and whether intervention changes a prespecified circuit-level endpoint.

relevance.reason: 综述人脑偏头痛中小脑在感觉与视觉前庭网络中的功能连接、结构与临床证据，涉及脑网络组织与疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该叙述性综述重新审视小脑在偏头痛中的角色，综合解剖学、实验、影像、遗传和临床证据，并优先采纳直接来自人类偏头痛患者的研究。综述指出，重复测量影像提示小脑连接会随偏头痛周期变化，但相关队列规模较小；结构发现随分析方法而异，人群层面检测也未显示常见偏头痛存在普遍性小脑缺陷。证据在特定情境下更为一致：三叉神经刺激可募集特定小脑小叶，前庭性偏头痛涉及后部小脑及更广泛的前庭感觉网络，治疗影像可见小脑变化但未能定位CGRP靶向作用部位。作者据此认为，小脑更可能是偏头痛分布式网络中的调制成分，可能参与感觉增益和前庭整合，但既非已证实的发作发生器，也非经验证的治疗靶点。

papers.title: Loneliness is reflected in the sub-second temporal dynamics of the resting brain: an EEG microstate study
papers.authors: Ono K.
papers.abstract: Loneliness, a subjective state of perceived social isolation characterized by chronic social hypervigilance, is a profound risk factor for physical and mental health conditions. While functional neuroimaging studies link loneliness to altered salience network connectivity, the sub-second temporal dynamics of the resting lonely brain remain unexplored. We investigated the relationship between trait loneliness and resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) microstates. Sixty-one healthy young adults completed the UCLA Loneliness Scale and Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) and underwent 3-minute resting-state EEG recording. A criterion-based five-class microstate solution identified a topography corresponding to the canonical Class C/E, associated with both self-referential and salience-related processing. Higher loneliness scores were significantly associated with reduced Class C/E occurrence, which remained significant after controlling for depressive symptoms, age, and sex. Exploratory source localization revealed that lonelier individuals showed reduced current density in the middle cingulate cortex (MCC). These findings suggest that chronic social hypervigilance suppresses the spontaneous mobilization of the salience network at rest, with reduced MCC engagement reflecting a dispositional attenuation consistent with chronic relational threat.

relevance.reason: 研究孤独特质与静息态EEG微状态时间动态及扣带皮层源定位的关系，涉及静息脑网络组织与社会认知。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察特质孤独感与静息态脑电微状态亚秒级时间动态的关系，61名健康年轻成人完成孤独感与抑郁量表并接受短时静息脑电记录。结果发现，孤独感得分越高，与自我参照和凸显加工相关的Class C/E微状态出现次数越少，控制抑郁症状、年龄和性别后该关联仍显著；探索性源定位还显示更孤独者中扣带皮层电流密度降低。作者据此提出，慢性社会过度警觉可能抑制静息时凸显网络的自发动员，中扣带参与减弱或反映一种与长期关系威胁相符的倾向性衰减；这属于关联性发现，尚不能说明因果或临床意义。

papers.title: Resting-State QEEG Differences between Borderline and Antisocial Personality Disorders: A Supervised Machine Learning Approach
papers.authors: Ghalebin SSA, Bashrpoor S, Mikaeili N, Hajloo N, Gholipour F.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: Borderline personality disorder (BPD) and antisocial personality disorder (ASPD) pose substantial clinical challenges. Due to overlapping features such as impulsivity and emotional dysregulation, differential assessment between these conditions can be difficult. This study compared resting-state quantitative electroencephalography (QEEG) profiles between BPD and ASPD and examined whether supervised machine learning could distinguish the two groups based on neurophysiological features. Method Thirty age-, gender-, and education-matched participants (15 BPD, 15 ASPD) underwent eyes-closed resting-state EEG recording. After artifact removal, three minutes of clean data were retained for analysis. Absolute power spectra (1.0–30.0 Hz) across standard frequency bands were extracted from 19 channels. Seven classifiers were evaluated using stratified 10-fold cross-validation, with preprocessing performed within training folds to reduce data leakage. Results Univariate analyses revealed distinct regional electrophysiological patterns. Relative to the ASPD group, the BPD group showed higher absolute power across several frontal/frontopolar slow-wave measures, centro-parietal delta/theta measures, and temporal delta/theta measures, with additional between-group differences in selected alpha and beta features. Among the evaluated models, the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) showed the strongest internal cross-validated performance (accuracy = 89%, balanced accuracy = 92%, F1-score = 90%). Conclusion BPD and ASPD were associated with distinguishable resting-state QEEG patterns in this sample. These findings suggest that QEEG features, combined with supervised machine learning, may serve as candidate neurophysiological markers and as a potential adjunct to differential clinical assessment, pending replication in larger independent samples.

relevance.reason: 比较边缘型与反社会型人格障碍的静息态QEEG神经生理模式，属脑疾病机理与静息活动研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较边缘型人格障碍（BPD）与反社会型人格障碍（ASPD）患者的静息态定量脑电特征，并检验监督学习能否据此区分两组；两组各15人，在年龄、性别和教育程度上匹配，分析闭眼静息态脑电的绝对功率谱。单变量分析显示，BPD组在多个额区/额极慢波、中央-顶区delta/theta及颞区delta/theta指标上的绝对功率高于ASPD组，部分alpha和beta特征也存在组间差异。在评估的分类器中，多层感知机的内部交叉验证表现最好。作者认为，两组在本样本中呈现可区分的静息态脑电模式，脑电特征结合监督学习或可作为候选神经生理标记和临床鉴别评估的辅助手段，但尚需在更大独立样本中重复验证。

papers.title: A generalized scaling law reveals synchrony-driven reorganization of brain dynamics across human lifespan.
papers.authors: Saha S, Hens C, Chakraborty P, Kapitaniak T, Deco G, Banerjee A, Dana SK, Roy D.
papers.abstract: Ecological systems obey universal scaling laws such as Taylor's law, which links population variance to the sample mean. Whether other complex systems with integrated and segregated network topology, the human brain, in particular, follow analogous scaling laws, and how these laws behave under synchronized neural activity, remains unknown. To address this question, our initial attempt to implement the Taylor's law, has been hindered because neural signals at all measurement scales contain both positive and negative values, whereas Taylor's law was restricted to non-negative ecological data. To circumvent this limitation, we extend spatial Taylor's law by replacing the sample mean with the root-mean-square (RMS) of the measurements, and apply this generalized law to detrended multivariate neural time series. The detrending operation has been performed as a necessary step to remove the trends and temporal mean from the data. Within this framework, we address our next question how synchronous or coordinated activity of the brain network influences the scaling law. We quantify synchrony using a dedicated metric of functional coordination and show analytically, and via numerical simulations using multivariate Poisson, negative binomial, uniform and gamma distributions, that the scaling exponent is inversely related to synchrony. Applying this approach to human fMRI data from three large cohorts (N = 840, ages 18-88 years) reveals distinct age-related trajectories of the scaling exponent, with healthy aging characterized by a substantial synchrony-induced reduction in this exponent. The synchrony-scaling relationship remains stable during resting-state activity but progressively shifts during naturalistic tasks across the lifespan, and is pronounced in limbic, subcortical, and cerebellar subnetworks, indicating preservation at subnetwork levels. Finally, individuals with ADHD exhibit altered synchrony-scaling coupling, highlighting the potential clinical and translational utility of this generalized scaling metric.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑fMRI跨寿命的同步性与标度律重组，涉及静息与自然任务下脑网络动态组织，属静息/自然刺激与脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种广义缩放律，用均方根替代样本均值以适用于含正负值的神经信号，并考察同步活动如何影响缩放指数。解析推导与数值模拟显示，缩放指数与同步程度呈反向关系。应用于三个大型队列的人类功能磁共振数据后发现，缩放指数随年龄呈现不同轨迹，健康老化表现为同步诱导的指数明显下降；这种同步—缩放关系在静息态下保持稳定，但在自然任务中随生命周期逐步变化，并在边缘、皮层下和小脑等子网络中较为突出。注意缺陷多动障碍个体的同步—缩放耦合出现改变，提示该指标可能具有临床转化价值，但相关发现尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Moral and perceptual conflict processing are implemented by distinct brain activation and functional connectivity patterns.
papers.authors: Zhu R, Grueschow M, Moisa M, Liu C, Ruff CC.
papers.abstract: While humans resemble other primates in terms of motor and perceptual abilities, our behavior is uniquely characterized by morality-the ability to choose our actions based on specific ethical values. The evolutionary origins and neurobiological basis of moral behavior are debated intensely, with opposing proposals about whether moral decisions rely on domain-general decision-making neural circuitry (neural common currency hypothesis) or on unique neural processes that were shaped by evolutionary pressures associated with life in groups (social brain hypothesis). Here we examine the potential overlap between moral and perceptual decision-making, by combining functional magnetic resonance imaging with computational modeling of behavior in a novel task requiring human participants to make alternating moral and perceptual choices on identical stimuli. At the algorithmic level, we found that moral and perceptual choices were well fit by the same sequential sampling model, which allowed us to quantify and directly compare conflicts between the choice alternatives for both types of decision-making. At the implementational level, moral and perceptual choice conflicts were represented by distinct neural activity patterns; in fact, neural signals in some brain areas (e.g., temporoparietal junction) encoded the strength of the two types of conflict in opposite directions. Our findings suggest that while similar computational decision mechanisms underlie both moral and perceptual choices, their neural implementation is fundamentally different, supporting the social brain hypothesis.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究比较道德与知觉决策冲突的脑活动与功能连接模式，属社会认知/决策的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察道德决策与知觉决策是否依赖共同的神经机制，结合功能磁共振成像与计算建模，让被试对相同刺激交替做道德选择和知觉选择。行为层面，两类选择都能被同一序贯采样模型较好拟合，说明二者可能共享类似的计算机制；但在神经实现层面，两类选择冲突对应不同的脑活动模式，部分脑区甚至以相反方向编码两种冲突强度。作者据此认为，道德与知觉选择虽计算机制相近，神经实现却根本不同，这更支持社会脑假说而非神经通用货币假说。

papers.title: EEG-Based Inner Speech Decoding Using Phase-Locking and Spatial Features with a Dual-Branch Deep Learning Model
papers.authors: Elnoor M. Abdalla H, Basri H, Aris I, Yusof Khan AHK, Natarajan S, Adha MS, Abbasa WF, Zakaria SH, Al-Haddad SAR.
papers.abstract: Background: Decoding inner speech from electroencephalogram signals presents a promising direction for advancing brain-computer interface technologies. However, this remains a highly challenging task because of factors such as the inherently low signal-to-noise ratio, significant inter-subject variability, and the complex, non-stationary nature of neural activity captured in EEG data. Methods This study presents a novel classification framework that combines instantaneous phase-locking value and common spatial patterns for feature extraction. The dimensionality of the instantaneous phase-locking features was reduced using principal component analysis. The two feature types are processed independently using Recurrent Neural Networks and Deep Neural Networks and then concatenated for the final classification. The model was evaluated under both subject-dependent (S-d) and subject-independent (S-Ind) settings on two publicly available EEG dataset. The first dataset includes imagined speech from five individuals in two categories: social and numerical, while the second dataset includes inner speech from ten participants performing four Spanish-word commands. Results The proposed model demonstrated strong performance in the S-d setting, achieving average accuracies of 95.16 ± 3.50% for social words and 95.96 ± 2.40% for numerical words, with macro F1-scores exceeding 95.19%. For the second dataset, the mean S-d accuracy was 90.23 ± 10.61%, while S-Ind accuracies were 64.09 ± 3.20% and 52.19 ± 2.64% for the second and first datasets, respectively, highlighting the challenge of cross-subject generalization in EEG-based inner speech decoding. Notably, the proposed method outperformed previously reported approaches on both datasets, achieving relative improvements of up to 226.21%. Conclusion The proposed approach shows strong performance in subject-dependent inner speech decoding and provides additional validation across two publicly available EEG datasets with different participants and task configurations. While the method shows practical potential, the results also highlight the ongoing challenge of generalizing across individuals, motivating further evaluation on larger, more diverse, and multi-session datasets.

relevance.reason: 研究用EEG解码内隐言语（inner speech），直接涉及言语产出/语言加工的脑电特征与分类，属语言与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电信号解码内隐言语困难的问题，提出一种结合瞬时锁相值与共空间模式特征、并用双分支深度学习模型分类的框架，在两个公开脑电数据集上分别测试了被试依赖和被试独立两种设置。结果显示，被试依赖条件下分类表现较强，而跨被试条件下准确率明显下降，说明跨个体泛化仍是主要难点。作者据此认为，该方法在被试依赖的内隐言语解码上具有潜力，但尚需在更大、更多样和多 session 的数据上进一步验证。

papers.title: The Philadelphia Theta Burst Project: A novel fMRI-guided electric field modeling dataset with reliability metrics.
papers.authors: Gregory DF, Sun I, Teferi M, Gura H, Patel M, Casalvera A, Chandrashekar S, Lynch KG, Schultz DH, Jeyapratap A, Tate Q, Makhoul W, Deng ZD, Oathes DJ, Sheline YI, Balderston NL.
papers.abstract: Recent neuromodulation studies suggest that theta burst stimulation (TBS) applied to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) can influence neural circuits involved in cognitive control and emotion-related processing, with relevance for psychiatric disorders. However, large-scale datasets characterizing variability, reliability, and multimodal neural responses to TBS remain limited. To address this gap, we established the Philadelphia Theta Burst Project, a dataset of 100 healthy participants who completed 4 fMRI sessions following cumulatively increasing doses of intermittent or continuous TBS, with participants randomized to one protocol or the other. Each session includes multiband, multi-echo resting-state (16 minutes) and task-based fMRI (16 minutes) during a Sternberg working memory paradigm. TMS targeting was guided by task-evoked activation in the left dlPFC. Structural T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and diffusion-weighted imaging were also acquired. Here, we describe the dataset design, acquisition protocol, and data characteristics, and report initial measures of data quality and reliability. The completed dataset can be accessed at https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds008893, providing an open resource for future investigations of TBS mechanisms and individualized neuromodulation strategies.

relevance.reason: 该数据集采集了健康人dlPFC的TBS前后任务态与静息态fMRI及结构/扩散影像，可用于研究认知控制与神经调控机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该数据集研究旨在弥补间歇或连续θ爆发刺激（TBS）作用于背外侧前额叶后，个体差异、测量可靠性和多模态神经反应方面大规模数据不足的问题。研究招募健康参与者并随机分配至两种TBS方案之一，在累积递增剂量下完成多次fMRI会话，采集静息态与Sternberg工作记忆任务态功能影像，并结合结构像和弥散加权成像；刺激靶点由任务诱发激活引导。作者描述了数据集设计、采集流程与数据特征，并报告了初步的数据质量和可靠性指标，为后续研究TBS机制及个体化神经调控策略提供开放资源。需注意，该文是数据集描述，未报告TBS的临床疗效或因果效应。

papers.title: Time after time: neural codes of speech comprehension.
papers.authors: Gwilliams L.
papers.abstract: The acoustic signal of speech is fleeting and unfolds linearly; yet listeners must derive temporally extended and hierarchically organized linguistic structures to comprehend it. This article reviews evidence that the human brain transforms the transient auditory signal into neural representations that are persistent, parallel, and time-stamped. First, neural persistence allows information to remain available after it has disappeared from the acoustic input. Second, parallel encoding of recent inputs across multiple levels of language structure enables composition and interactions across the speech hierarchy. Third, dynamic neural representations encode both content and elapsed time, providing a flexible mechanism for preserving sequence order. Together, these representational properties reveal how the human brain transforms a continuously disappearing signal into temporally extended linguistic structures.

relevance.reason: 综述人脑将瞬时语音信号转化为持久、并行、带时间标记的神经表征以支持语言理解。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕人脑如何从转瞬即逝的语音信号中提取可延展、层级化的语言结构这一问题，梳理了相关神经表征证据。作者提出，大脑将短暂的听觉输入转化为持续、并行且带有时间标记的神经表征：持续性使信息在声学输入消失后仍可被利用，并行编码让不同语言层级的近期输入得以组合与交互，动态表征则同时编码内容与流逝时间，从而保留序列顺序。这些性质共同揭示了连续消失的信号如何被转化为时间上延展的语言结构。

papers.title: Brain and cognitive correlates of FKBP5: methylation patterns in schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Latorre-Guardia M, Almodóvar-Payá C, París-Gómez I, Guardiola-Ripoll M, Canales-Rodríguez E, Fuentes-Claramonte P, García-León MÁ, García-Ruiz B, Sotero-Moreno A, Guerrero-Pedraza A, Torres L, Salavert J, Sarró S, Penadés R, Arias B, Pomarol-Clotet E, Fatjó-Vilas M.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia (SZ) is a neurodevelopmental disorder influenced by genetic and environmental factors. The stress-related gene FKBP5 shows genetic, epigenetic, and expression variability associated with SZ. Although FKBP5 methylation has been related to brain structural changes in psychiatric conditions, its role in the cortical thinning and cognitive deficits distinctive of SZ remains unexplored. We examined whether case-control differences in FKBP5 methylation are associated with cortical thickness and cognitive performance. In a case-control study (35 SZ, 35 HC), we assessed FKBP5 methylation (EpiTYPER), cortical thickness (FreeSurfer), and intelligence quotient (IQ). A sparse PLS-DA approach identified a latent component (LC1) capturing methylation differences. We tested the effect of LC1 on cortical thickness (brain clusters showing group differences) and IQ scores, using linear regressions. Next, we examined the relationship among methylation, neuroanatomical, and cognitive changes through a mediation analysis. LC1 was associated with reduced cortical thickness in the right pars opercularis (β = -2.15, pFDR =0.011). Thickness in this region was positively associated with IQ (β = 35.14, p = 0.011), but there was no direct LC1-IQ association. Mediation analysis revealed a significant indirect effect of methylation on IQ via cortical thickness (ACME = -62.96, p = 0.046; ∼40% of the total effect), which was not significant after adjusting for diagnosis. Our results represent the first analysis of the effect of FKBP5 methylation on neuroanatomical and cognitive variability in SZ, highlighting that methylation-related differences associated with the disorder are connected to structural and cognitive alterations.

relevance.reason: 研究精神分裂症中FKBP5甲基化与右侧岛盖部皮质厚度及IQ的关联，涉及脑结构与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨精神分裂症中FKBP5甲基化差异是否与皮层厚度及认知表现相关，采用病例对照设计，比较患者与健康对照的FKBP5甲基化、皮层厚度和智商，并用稀疏偏最小二乘判别分析提取甲基化差异成分。结果显示，该甲基化成分与右侧岛盖部皮层变薄相关，而该区域厚度又与智商正相关；甲基化本身与智商无直接关联，中介分析提示甲基化可能通过皮层厚度间接影响智商，但校正诊断后该间接效应不再显著。作者称这是首次分析FKBP5甲基化与精神分裂症神经解剖和认知变异的关系，提示与该病相关的甲基化差异可能连系结构与认知改变，但关联性质及诊断因素的影响仍需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Brain structural covariance networks in co-occurring PTSD and alcohol use disorder: An ENIGMA PTSD and ENIGMA addiction working group collaboration.
papers.authors: Towers EE, Garavan HP, Dali G, Wannan C, Logge W, Haber P, Pancholi D, Juliano A, Hussain A, Haswell CC, Sun D, Baird CL, Olff M, Frijling JL, Veltman DJ, Koch SBJ, Nawjin L, van Zuiden M, Dennis EL, Tate DF, Cifu DX, Walker WC, Wilde EA, Baugh LA, Scholl JL, Simons RM, Simons JS, Magnotta VA, Fercho KA, van Holst RJ, Goudriaan AE, Li CR, Walter H, Claus ED, Witkiewitz K, Morey RA, Morley KC.
papers.abstract: High rates of comorbid posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and alcohol use disorder (AUD) may stem from a shared neurobiological basis; however, research exploring this overlap remains limited. We examined whole-brain structural covariance (SC) across PTSD, AUD, comorbid PTSD & AUD, trauma-exposed controls, and trauma-naïve controls to identify shared and unique SC profiles. Structural brain scans were acquired from individuals across 14 sites (N = 1565), and cortical thickness estimates were extracted to compute SC. Group differences in SC between pairs of cortical regions were examined using the Network-Based statistic and quantified using local and global graph theory (GT) measures. Clinical groups showed consistent alterations in SC compared with trauma-naïve controls, characterised by lower SC involving frontal regions, particularly the inferior frontal gyrus and frontal pole, which also demonstrated high centrality in local GT analyses. In contrast, higher SC was observed in temporal regions, with the fusiform gyrus consistently emerging as a central region. Comparisons involving PTSD & AUD also showed increased SC in occipital regions, suggesting a potentially distinct pattern of structural organization in this group. Global GT analyses demonstrated altered network organization in clinical groups, including increased clustering and path length, and reduced global efficiency relative to trauma-naïve controls. Local efficiency was increased in PTSD and PTSD & AUD, but not AUD alone. Together, these findings indicate that alterations in frontal and temporal regions are implicated across PTSD, AUD, and their comorbidity. However, the PTSD & AUD group also exhibited additional occipital lobe alterations, suggesting a broader distribution of structural covariance alterations in the comorbid group.

relevance.reason: 研究PTSD与酒精使用障碍共病及单病的皮层厚度结构协方差网络改变，属脑疾病中脑结构组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）与酒精使用障碍（AUD）共病是否具有共享的脑结构基础，利用多站点结构磁共振数据计算全脑结构协方差网络，比较PTSD、AUD、共病组及两类对照组的网络特征。结果发现，各临床组相对无创伤暴露对照均表现出一致的结构协方差改变：额叶（尤其额下回和额极）连接降低且局部网络中心性较高，颞叶（如梭状回）连接升高；共病组还额外出现枕叶连接升高，提示其结构组织模式可能更为广泛。全局图论指标显示临床组网络聚集性和路径长度增加、全局效率降低，局部效率仅在PTSD和共病组升高。作者据此认为，额颞区域改变为PTSD、AUD及其共病所共有，而枕叶改变可能是共病组特有的分布特征。

papers.title: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback of left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex to enhance emotional cognitive control: A randomized controlled trial.
papers.authors: McDermott TJ, Tsuchiyagaito A, Ramirez S, Cannon MJ, Akeman E, Touthang J, Kirlic N, Misaki M, Paulus MP, Aupperle RL.
papers.abstract: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback (rt-fMRI-nf) is an endogenous neuromodulation approach whereby individuals are taught to self-regulate their own neural activity in the moment. Cognitive control in emotional contexts is related to risk for or protection against mental health disorders, such as depression, anxiety, or posttraumatic stress disorder. The left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) has been shown to be centrally important in facilitating emotional cognitive control (ECC). Using a double-blind randomized controlled trial design, the present study tested a novel rt-fMRI-nf protocol to increase left dlPFC activity during ECC and improve ECC measured by self-report and behavioral task performance. Seventy healthy adult participants were enrolled and randomized to either active (n = 37; left dlPFC) or sham [n = 33; left postcentral gyrus (PCG)] neurofeedback. Linear mixed effects models tested for effects of time (practice/run 1/run 2/run 3/transfer), feedback target (active/sham), and their interaction on left dlPFC activity, left PCG activity, and ECC measures (self-report and behavior). Results showed a significant time-by-feedback interaction on left dlPFC activity (p = .031). This interaction was such that active feedback led to greater left dlPFC activity in run 1 (p = .030; d = .66) and run 2 (p = .042; d = .62), but not for run 3 nor the transfer run (when no feedback was provided). There were no significant effects of feedback on ECC measures. These findings demonstrate that rt-fMRI-nf had an initial but not a sustained effect on left dlPFC activity, providing evidence of neural target engagement. However, the lack of a sustained effect on neural activity nor any observed effects on ECC highlight the complexity of identifying the optimal design and dosing for novel rt-fMRI-nf protocols.

relevance.reason: 实时fMRI神经反馈调控左侧dlPFC情绪认知控制，属情绪/认知控制的神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用双盲随机对照设计，在健康成人中检验一种实时fMRI神经反馈方案能否提升左侧背外侧前额叶在情绪认知控制任务中的活动，并改善自评与行为任务表现。结果显示，主动反馈组在最初两次练习中左侧背外侧前额叶活动高于假反馈组，但这一差异在后续练习及无反馈的迁移阶段未能维持；情绪认知控制的自评和行为指标均未受到反馈的显著影响。作者据此认为，该方案实现了初步的神经靶点参与，但效果不持久，也未转化为情绪认知控制表现的改善，提示此类新方案在最优设计与剂量确定上仍存在复杂性。

papers.title: Addressing the between-group comparison problem: Detecting differences between correlation matrix populations due to single-variable perturbations for resting state fMRI.
papers.authors: Faran I, Peer M, Arzy S, Benjamini Y.
papers.abstract: Resting-state fMRI (RS-fMRI) has been known for decades as a promising method for evaluating cognitive and mental states, both in health and especially in disease, due to its ease of implementation as a short, standard MRI protocol. In clinical settings, a group of patients with a given disorder is typically compared to a group of healthy controls. This poses an inherent challenge of between-group comparison. We propose a new efficient model for characterizing changes to the temporal synchronization of brain activity measured using RS-fMRI between groups, summarized as individual correlation matrices. Our model posits that the between-group differences are the product of single-region effects describing the increase or decay of synchronization with the rest of the brain. This parsimonious model pools the correlation coefficients of each region with all others, and therefore can detect differences between groups even in small samples. Inference for this model accounts for the variability in individual correlation matrices, the within-group differences across individuals, and for the approximation error of the single-region model. This results in per-region estimates and confidence intervals for the parameters governing the difference between groups. In simulations, our model shows increased power to detect model-aligned alternatives compared with competing approaches. To demonstrate feasibility of the method in a clinical application, we use the model to analyze RS-fMRI correlation matrices in patients with transient global amnesia and healthy controls. Our model detects significant decreases in synchronization for the patient population in the amygdala after multiplicity correction as well as borderline decreases in memory-related brain regions that were not detected using mass-univariate tests without prior knowledge, suggesting its usefulness in the application of RS-fMRI in clinical settings.

relevance.reason: 提出并验证静息态fMRI组间相关矩阵比较模型，并在患者与健康对照的静息脑同步性上发现差异，属静息态脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对静息态fMRI研究中常见的组间比较问题，提出一种新的高效模型，用于刻画两组个体相关矩阵所反映的脑活动时间同步性差异。模型假设组间差异源于单脑区效应，即某一脑区与其余脑区同步性的增强或减弱，并通过汇总该脑区与所有其他脑区的相关系数来提高小样本下的检测能力，推断时考虑个体相关矩阵变异、组内个体差异及模型近似误差。模拟显示该模型对符合其假设的差异检测效力更高；在一项短暂性全面遗忘症患者与健康对照的分析中，模型在多重校正后发现患者杏仁核同步性显著下降，并在记忆相关脑区呈现边缘性下降，而这些变化未被无先验知识的质量单变量检验检出，提示该方法可能有助于静息态fMRI的临床应用。

papers.title: How does adolescent neurodevelopment impact substance use? The substance use neuroplasticity and peer (SNAP) model: A novel neurodevelopmental model of adolescent substance use.
papers.authors: Dash GF, Lichenstein SD, Cheng A, Prieto S, Rømer Thomsen K, Yip SW, Leventhal AM, Feldstein Ewing SW.
papers.abstract: Substance use among adolescents age 13-18 remains a significant societal concern, yet contemporary neuroscience models of addiction have been grounded in the chronic, cyclic stage model developed for adult presentations of substance use disorder (SUD). Relative to adults, adolescents exhibit distinct patterns of substance use, and many structural and functional findings garnered from studies of addiction in the adult brain have not been reliably observed or replicated in adolescent samples. Thus, contemporary models of adult addiction do not readily translate to adolescents, resulting in downstream developmental incongruities in how substance use is conceptualized, measured, and treated in this age group. Here, we present a review of the current state of human and preclinical models of neurobiological risk factors and mechanisms specific to substance use in adolescents. Grounded in this literature, we present the Substance use Neuroplasticity And Peer (SNAP) model, a novel neurodevelopmental model of adolescent substance use that captures the differentiated nature of substance use initiation and escalation in this high-need, yet undertreated population.

relevance.reason: 综述提出青少年物质使用的神经发育模型，聚焦脑发育与神经可塑性机制，属认知/脑发育及脑疾病机理。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述指出，现有成瘾神经科学模型多基于成人物质使用障碍的慢性循环阶段模型，而青少年在物质使用模式及脑结构与功能表现上与成人存在差异，成人模型难以直接套用于13至18岁人群，导致概念化、测量和干预上的错位。作者梳理了针对青少年物质使用神经生物学风险因素与机制的人体和临床前研究，并据此提出“物质使用神经可塑性与同伴（SNAP）模型”，用以刻画青少年物质使用启动与升级的差异化过程。该模型为理解这一高需求却治疗不足群体的神经发育机制提供了新框架，但其有效性仍待后续研究检验。

papers.title: Deep white-matter tracts link docosahexaenoic acid status to cognitive performance in human adolescents.
papers.authors: Figueroa-Vargas A, Valenzuela R, Soto-Icaza P, Zamorano F, Larraín C, Silva C, Guevara P, Navarrete S, Almagià A, Arancibia V, Barrera C, Ivanovic D, Billeke P.
papers.abstract: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) is a polyunsaturated fatty acid enriched in neuronal membranes and myelin, linked to cognitive performance. Yet, nutritional interventions show inconsistent cognitive benefits due to a limited understanding of the neural pathways connecting DHA status to human cognition. We studied 99 adolescents selected from both extremes of performance on a national scholastic examination. Participants completed assessments of intellectual ability, provided erythrocyte DHA samples, and underwent multimodal MRI. Using independent component analysis and Bayesian multivariate least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) models, we identified brain components jointly associated with DHA and cognition. Across four MRI modalities, a single deep white-matter component consistently emerged as the strongest shared pathway. Tract-resolved analyses highlighted predominant contributions from the fornix and thalamus-temporal fasciculus, with additional subcortical and cortical involvement. These components predicted cognitive measures beyond DHA and other fatty acids, outlining a plausible neural pathway through which a modifiable dietary factor relates to adolescent learning.

relevance.reason: 研究青少年DHA状态经深部白质纤维束与认知表现关联，属白质结构与认知的脑机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注红细胞DHA水平与青少年认知表现之间可能经由脑结构连接的中介路径，对象为按全国学业考试成绩两端选取的青少年，结合血液DHA测定与多模态MRI，用独立成分分析和贝叶斯多元LASSO寻找与DHA和认知共同相关的脑成分。结果显示，在四种MRI模态中，一个深部白质成分始终是最强的共享通路，其中穹窿和丘脑-颞束贡献突出，并伴有皮层下和皮层参与。这些成分对认知指标的预测超出DHA及其他脂肪酸，提示一条可改变的膳食因素与青少年学习相关的可能神经通路；但研究为横断面关联，不能据此推断因果或干预效果。

papers.title: Stage-specific contributions of dorsal and ventral premotor cortices to the acquisition of arbitrary visuomotor associations.
papers.authors: Turrini S, Amadori A, Arcara G, di Pellegrino G, Avenanti A.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: The acquisition and consolidation of arbitrary visuomotor mappings (AVMMs) engage premotor regions, yet the distinct contributions of the dorsal (PMd) and ventral (PMv) premotor cortices remain unclear. Here, we applied continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) immediately before AVMM learning to transiently disrupt PMd, PMv, or an occipital control site (V1) in 19 healthy young adults, using a within-subjects design. Participants learned arbitrary stimulus-response associations through trial-and-error feedback and completed a 24-h delayed recall test. Trial-by-trial accuracy and response times were modeled using state-space and Rescorla-Wagner frameworks to quantify learning dynamics, prediction errors, and stabilization across days. Disruption of both PMd and PMv slowed early acquisition of AVMMs to a comparable extent relative to V1. However, only PMd disruption additionally impaired next-day recall, rendering recall performance dependent on sleep quality and decoupled from learning-day performance, whereas recall following PMv disruption remained comparable to the control condition. These findings indicate that PMd, but not PMv, contributes to the stabilization of newly learned visuomotor associations, providing causal, stage-specific evidence for a functional dissociation within the human premotor cortex: PMd and PMv support early rule formation and exploratory learning, whereas only PMd contributes to subsequent stabilization of newly learned visuomotor associations. Furthermore, they emphasize the modulatory influence of sleep on memory retention when consolidation processes are compromised, advancing mechanistic models of premotor contributions to associative sensorimotor learning.

relevance.reason: 用cTBS干扰人脑前运动皮层，因果检验视运动联想学习的阶段特异性机制，属学习与脑区功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨背侧与腹侧前运动皮层在任意视运动联结学习中的不同作用，采用被试内设计，在健康年轻成人学习前用连续θ爆发刺激短暂干扰PMd、PMv或枕叶对照区，并结合逐试次行为建模分析学习动态与次日回忆。结果显示，干扰PMd和PMv均使早期学习变慢且程度相当，但只有PMd受干扰时次日回忆受损，且该回忆表现与睡眠质量相关、与学习当天表现脱钩；PMv受干扰后的回忆则与对照条件相当。作者据此提出，PMd和PMv共同支持早期规则形成与探索性学习，而只有PMd参与新学视运动联结的稳定化，并强调巩固过程受扰时睡眠对记忆保持的调节作用。

papers.title: Brain mechanisms supporting movement-evoked chronic low back pain: an observational brain imaging study.
papers.authors: Gianola M, Dean J, Chen C, Barrows D, Riegner G, Liu T, Zeidan F.
papers.abstract: Background Chronic low back pain (cLBP) is the most prevalent chronic pain condition and the leading cause of disability worldwide. Acute movement-evoked pain strongly predicts cLBP exacerbation, reflecting maladaptive amplification of nociceptive input, yet the neural mechanisms supporting movement-evoked cLBP flares remain poorly characterised. Methods A total of 114 participants with cLBP performed the cLBP-evoking leg raise test during perfusion-based arterial spin labelling functional MRI. Leg raise test-based pain intensity and unpleasantness ratings were assessed with an 11-point visual analogue scale (VAS; 0=no pain, 10=worst pain imaginable). The Brief Pain Inventory (BPI) measured chronic pain severity and interference. Whole-brain cerebral blood flow changes from supine to LRT and their relationship with VAS pain intensity were analysed. Analyses assessing default mode network-whole-brain resting-state functional connectivity supporting BPI severity were also conducted. Results The LRT significantly increased pain intensity by 23% (P<0.001) and unpleasantness by 26% (P<0.001). Compared with supine, movement-evoked pain increased cerebral blood flow in the medial prefrontal and posterior cingulate cortices, core default mode network nodes, and nociceptive centres including the thalamus, primary motor cortex corresponding to the back, and parietal operculum. Higher leg raise test-evoked pain intensity ratings were associated with greater superior parietal lobule, supramarginal, and bilateral sensorimotor cortical activity. Higher BPI pain severity was associated with stronger default mode network-somatosensory cortex (back representation) resting-state functional connectivity. Conclusions Unlike the default mode network deactivation characteristically observed during experimental pain provocation, movement-evoked cLBP reflects maladaptive coupling between self-referential (default mode network) and somatosensory (nociceptive) networks. These findings provide mechanistic insight into the neurobiological processes supporting cLBP flares. Clinical trial registration NCT03354585.

relevance.reason: 研究运动诱发慢性腰背痛的脑血流与静息态网络机制，涉及疼痛加工及DMN-躯体感觉网络耦合，属认知与脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注运动诱发慢性腰痛加重的脑机制，让慢性腰痛患者在灌注功能磁共振扫描中完成可诱发疼痛的抬腿试验，并分析全脑血流变化与疼痛评分的关系。结果发现，抬腿诱发的疼痛伴随内侧前额叶、后扣带等默认网络核心节点以及丘脑、对应背部的初级运动皮层等伤害性加工区域血流升高；抬腿诱发疼痛越强，感觉运动相关皮层活动越明显，而慢性疼痛严重程度越高，默认网络与躯体感觉皮层间的静息态功能连接越强。作者据此提出，与实验性疼痛通常引起默认网络去激活不同，运动诱发的慢性腰痛加重可能反映自我参照网络与躯体感觉伤害性网络之间的适应不良耦合，为理解腰痛发作提供了神经生物学线索。

papers.title: Sex-differences in resting state dorsolateral prefrontal cortex: comparing motion correction methods in resting state functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).
papers.authors: Jha A, Singh V.
papers.abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a low cost, non-invasive alternative for studies comparing task-based activity of prefrontal cortex regions for cognitive studies with clinical relevance. However, motion correction algorithms are a major source of methodological variability in fNIRS studies, obscuring neurobiological variability in prefrontal hemodynamic response and leading to irreproducible findings. Further, motion correction fNIRS studies disregard sex-differences in hemodynamic response at resting state dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, especially fewer studies are carried out in non-western population. Although resting state brain activity is used for comparing task-based hemodynamics changes especially in tasks that show consistent sex differences (working memory & decision-making tasks) and are associated with affective disorders. Hence, we examined sex-differences in signal variability across eight motion correction approaches and HbO-HbR correlation in fNIRS data of resting state dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Next, we investigated how right-lateralized resting state DLPFC activity relates with sex-differences in depression-anxiety scores. Resting-state fNIRS data were acquired from 99 healthy adults (47 males, Mean age: 19.75 ± 1.27) Depression-anxiety comorbidity was assessed using Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) and Beck Anxiety Inventory (BAI) scores. Raw fNIRs signals were processed through eight motion correction pipelines for comparing No Correction, PCA, tPCA, Spline, SplineSG, Wavelet, Hybrid (SplineSG + Wavelet), and TDDR. These were evaluated on peak/minima amplitudes (ΔHbO, ΔHbR, ΔHbT, ΔHbD), HbO-HbR correlation, and signal variability. Hybrid and TDDR motion correction methods yielded the strongest negative HbO-HbR correlation, and lowest signal variability. Independent of motion correction methods, women exhibited stronger HbO-HbR correlation and lower ΔHbO variability, while men showed higher ΔHbT peaks and ΔHbR minima. Sex differences in right-lateralized hemodynamic activity in resting state DLPFC was observed in the form of interaction of sex, depression-anxiety comorbidity and ΔHbD peaks put through motion correction methods. Results indicate that choice of motion correction algorithm might impact our understanding of sex-differences in hemodynamic activity in dorsolateral prefrontal cortex. Sex-differences in affective disposition might be evident even in resting state right-lateralized activity in DLPFC.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态DLPFC fNIRS血流动力学性别差异及与情绪评分关系，涉及静息脑活动与偏侧化。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察静息态背外侧前额叶的性别差异是否会随运动校正方法的选择而变化，并进一步分析右偏侧化活动与抑郁—焦虑得分的关系。研究采集健康成人静息态fNIRS数据，比较八种运动校正流程下的信号变异性、HbO-HbR相关及峰值/谷值幅度。结果显示，Hybrid与TDDR校正后HbO-HbR负相关最强、信号变异性最低；无论采用哪种校正方法，女性的HbO-HbR相关更强、ΔHbO变异性更低，男性则表现出更高的ΔHbT峰值和更低的ΔHbR谷值。右偏侧化血流动力学活动与性别、抑郁—焦虑共病及ΔHbD峰值之间存在交互。作者据此指出，运动校正算法的选择可能影响对前额叶血流活动性别差异的理解，而情感倾向相关的性别差异在静息态右偏侧化活动中即可能有所体现。

papers.title: External validation of an integrative model of functional impairment in early-stage behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD).
papers.authors: Chatzidimitriou E, Moraitou D, Ioannidis P, Aretouli E, Chen Y, Rosen HJ, Gorno-Tempini ML, Seeley WW, Miller BL, Rankin KP.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Functional decline in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) emerges early and significantly disrupts quality of life, yet its determinants remain incompletely understood. Integrative models capturing key disease manifestations may better explain its complexity but require validation in independent samples. This study aimed to examine whether a previously proposed model of functional impairment could be supported in a larger cohort and characterize the interrelationships among its cognitive, behavioral, personality, and neuroanatomical components. Methods A total of 146 individuals with mild-stage bvFTD underwent structural MRI, neuropsychological assessment, and informant-based evaluation of behavioral symptoms, personality traits, and functional status. Penalized Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression identified the strongest correlates of functional impairment (Functional Activities Questionnaire/FAQ), while structural equation modeling examined their interrelationships. Results LASSO identified conscientiousness, apathy, global cognition, executive functioning, sarcasm perception, and semantic verbal fluency as significant correlates of functional status. The resulting path model demonstrated excellent fit and supported both neural-cognitive and behavioral-personality pathways. Reduced right superior frontal gyrus volume was associated with poorer executive and global cognitive performance, and through these variables, with greater functional impairment. In parallel, apathy demonstrated both direct and indirect associations with functional decline through conscientiousness. Conclusions Two partially distinct yet complementary processes appear to contribute to functional impairment in bvFTD: one reflecting the impact of frontal neurodegeneration on cognitive abilities essential for independent functioning, and another involving motivational and personality changes that directly undermine everyday engagement, thereby providing support for a multidimensional model of functional disability in bvFTD.

relevance.reason: 以早期bvFTD患者为对象，用结构MRI和路径模型考察右侧额上回体积经认知功能影响日常功能，属脑疾病中脑结构与认知机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在独立样本中检验此前提出的早期行为变异型额颞叶痴呆（bvFTD）功能受损整合模型，对轻度阶段患者进行结构MRI、神经心理评估及知情者报告的行为、人格与功能评定，并用LASSO回归和结构方程模型分析功能状态的相关因素及其相互关系。结果识别出尽责性、淡漠、整体认知、执行功能、讽刺感知和语义言语流畅性与功能状态相关，路径模型支持神经-认知与行为-人格两条通路：右侧额上回体积减小与执行和整体认知表现较差相关，并经由这些变量与更严重的功能受损相连；淡漠则既直接也与经由尽责性的间接路径同功能下降相关。作者据此认为，bvFTD的功能受损可能由两个部分不同又互补的过程共同促成，分别涉及额叶神经退行对独立生活所需认知能力的影响，以及动机和人格改变对日常参与的削弱，从而为该病的多维功能残疾模型提供了支持。

papers.title: Distinct Patterns of Cortical Reorganisation Accompany Behaviour-Specific Development in Freely Behaving Infants
papers.authors: Burke CJ, de Zeeuw TJ, Grimm D, Hofer N, Jensen A, Mullin C, Karl JM.
papers.abstract: A central premise of developmental neuroscience is that mature behaviour emerges through reciprocal interactions between infants’ spontaneous actions, neural activity, and environmental experience. Yet, much human neuroimaging research relies on highly controlled, repetitive paradigms designed to minimize behavioural variability, obscuring the very brain-behaviour dynamics that drive developmental change. Here, we introduce a naturalistic functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) paradigm that exploits, rather than suppresses, natural variability in infants’ behaviour to investigate cortical changes associated with behavioural development. Continuous video coding of spontaneous infant behaviour was combined with finite impulse response (FIR) modelling to estimate behaviour-specific hemodynamic responses associated with reach-to-grasp, hand-to-mouth, and vocalization behaviours while accounting for temporally overlapping hemodynamic responses by treating extraneous behaviours as nuisance regressors. From 6 to 13 months of age, reach-to-grasp and vocalizations increased in frequency, while all three behaviours shortened in duration. Critically, developmental changes in cortical activation were behaviour-specific. During reach-to-grasp movements, bilateral posterior parietal activity decreased with age. In contrast, during hand-to-mouth and vocalizations, somatomotor and premotor activity increased with age. Cortical activity was also related to individual variation in the frequency and duration of these behaviours, indicating that cortical recruitment remained coupled to behavioural variation independent of age. These findings reveal behaviour-specific patterns of cortical reorganisation during infant development and establish a methodological framework for linking spontaneous behaviour to cortical activity in freely behaving infants. More broadly, this approach enables direct investigation of cortical development as it unfolds through naturalistic interactions among behaviour, neural activity, and experience. Significance Statement Continuous self-generated interactions with the environment play a critical role in driving infant brain development, yet neuroimaging research often examines infants while sleeping or in highly constrained and repetitive tasks. Here, we show that spontaneous infant behaviour can instead be leveraged to provide the temporal variability needed to resolve behaviour-specific cortical responses in freely behaving infants. By combining continuous behavioural coding with data-driven finite impulse response (FIR) modelling of overlapping hemodynamic responses, we identified behaviour-specific developmental differences in cortical recruitment without tightly constraining the infant’s behaviour. This novel approach expands developmental neuroimaging beyond sleeping or trial-based paradigms and demonstrates how naturally occurring behavioural variability can become a useful feature of fNIRS experimental design. More broadly, it generates new opportunities to directly test theories of neurobehavioural development in more ecologically valid settings.

relevance.reason: 用自然行为fNIRS研究婴儿自发运动与发声相关的皮层发育重组，属认知/运动脑发育与自然情境脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注婴儿自发行为与皮层活动在发展中的关系，采用自然情境下的功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）记录，结合连续视频行为编码和有限脉冲响应模型，在自由活动的婴儿中区分抓握、手到口和发声三类行为对应的血流动力学反应。结果显示，从6到13个月，抓握和发声频率增加、三类行为持续时间缩短，而皮层激活的变化具有行为特异性：抓握时双侧后顶叶活动随年龄下降，手到口和发声时躯体运动与前运动区活动随年龄上升；皮层活动还与个体行为频率和持续时间的差异相关，且这种关联不随年龄消失。作者据此提出，婴儿发展中的皮层重组按行为类型分化，并展示了利用自然行为变异性研究自由活动婴儿脑—行为联系的方法框架。

papers.title: Dispelling the Plateau Assumption: Case-Based Evidence for Language Recovery in Chronic-Post Stroke Aphasia
papers.authors: Chang EH, Laks AB, Shattuck K, DeMarco AT, Turkeltaub PE.
papers.abstract: Objective Recovery from post-stroke aphasia is traditionally thought to plateau within a year after stroke. As such, no studies have characterized long-term recovery using comprehensive behavioral assessment and longitudinal functional MRI. We sought to characterize behavioral and neuroplastic changes over nearly six years in a patient with chronic post-stroke aphasia. Methods A patient with chronic left hemisphere stroke underwent behavioral assessment and task-based fMRI at 9, 22, 33 and 71 months after stroke. Testing assessed auditory comprehension, semantic and phonological processing, naming, reading, spelling, motor speech, and executive function. Task-related activation during an adaptive semantic matching paradigm was quantified within language and semantic regions of interest. Results Behavior improved across multiple language domains. WAB-R Aphasia Quotient increased from 49.2 to 69.2, along with the large gains in word finding, connected speech, reading and spelling, whereas auditory comprehension remained relatively stable. fMRI demonstrated progressively increasing activation within left-hemisphere language regions, reaching normative range by the final assessment, along with increasing activation in semantic/executive regions. Discussion Recovery of language production abilities can continue for years after stroke, supported by neuroplastic changes in the brain. Neurologists should inform stroke survivors that aphasia recovery can continue indefinitely after stroke.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一位慢性左半球卒中后失语患者为对象，结合行为评估与任务态功能磁共振，追踪其卒中后近六年的语言表现与脑活动变化。结果显示，患者在词语提取、连贯言语、阅读和拼写等多个语言领域持续改善，失语商明显提高，而听觉理解相对稳定；同时左半球语言区及语义、执行相关区域的激活逐步增强，最终接近常模范围。作者据此指出，语言产生能力的恢复在卒中多年后仍可继续，并伴随神经可塑性变化，因此临床人员应告知卒中幸存者失语恢复可能长期持续。该结论来自单例个案证据，尚需更大样本验证。

papers.title: Larger Pre-Speech Auditory Modulation Is Associated With Smaller Corrective Responses To Auditory Errors
papers.authors: Basciano A, Chao S, Rogalsky C, Daliri A.
papers.abstract: Purpose During speech planning, the brain predicts the auditory consequences of its movements and modulates the auditory system—a process called pre-speech auditory modulation (PSAM). We investigated the link between PSAM and behavioral error correction and determined how aging influences these mechanisms. Methods Seventeen young adults (18–32 years) and 13 older adults (50–85 years) performed a speaking task involving auditory feedback perturbations and a silent reading control. We measured electrophysiological responses (N1/P2) to auditory probes during speech planning and correlated these modulations with the magnitude of participants’ subsequent behavioral corrective responses. Results Both groups showed significant modulation of N1 and P2. However, N1 modulation correlated with corrective responses only in young adults. Older adults showed reduced behavioral corrections and smaller, delayed P2 components. Despite these age-related behavioral differences and the loss of the modulation-correction correlation, older adults maintained modulation magnitudes comparable to those of younger adults. Conclusions N1 modulation serves as a neural index of the brain’s predictive processes during speech planning. Aging appears to selectively disrupt the integration of these signals into motor output rather than the internal generation of the predictions themselves.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察说话计划阶段的听觉预测性调制（PSAM）与随后对听觉误差的行为纠正之间的关系，并比较年轻人和老年人的差异。被试在听觉反馈受扰的说话任务和默读控制条件下完成测试，同时记录听觉探针诱发的电生理反应。结果显示，两组都出现N1和P2调制，但N1调制只在年轻成人中与纠正反应相关；老年人行为纠正减弱、P2成分更小且延迟，调制幅度却与年轻人相当。作者据此认为，N1调制可作为说话计划中预测过程的神经指标，而老化可能选择性地影响将预测信号整合进运动输出，而非预测本身的生成。

papers.title: Longitudinal Visual Recovery and Exploratory Neuroimaging Findings in Pediatric Deprivation Amblyopia Following Unilateral Congenital Cataract Extraction: A Prospective Cohort Study.
papers.authors: Ni S, Tang X, Li M, Li J, Leng F, Zheng P, Shi W, Li L.
papers.abstract: Objectives : Visual outcomes after unilateral congenital cataract (UCC) extraction remain variable, and the neuroanatomical changes accompanying subsequent visual improvement are poorly understood. This study characterized longitudinal changes in visual function and explored hemispheric asymmetry, longitudinal neuroimaging changes, and their associations with visual recovery in children after UCC extraction. Methods : This prospective observational cohort study enrolled 55 children aged 5 to <9 years with unilateral deprivation amblyopia receiving optical correction, passive occlusion, and dichoptic training. We analyzed 6-month changes in central visual field (CVF; mean sensitivity [MS], mean defect [MD]) and corrected distance visual acuity (CDVA). To assess structural alterations along the posterior visual pathways, a strictly controlled, exploratory subgroup of 18 right-handed patients (aged 5 to <8 years) with left-eye amblyopia underwent 3-Tesla (3T) MRI. Multiple comparisons in the neuroimaging and structure-function analyses were controlled using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) procedure. Results : At 6 months, CDVA and CVF improved significantly from baseline across all amblyopia severity groups (all p < 0.05). Greater CDVA improvement was associated with larger increases in MS (β = 3.36, 95% CI, 1.37 to 5.35; p = 0.001) and greater reductions in MD (β = -2.80, 95% CI, -4.82 to -0.79; p = 0.007). Exploratory longitudinal neuroimaging analyses showed decreases in ipsilateral secondary visual cortex (V2) volume (Cohen's d = -0.75, PFDR = 0.042) and cortical thickness (Cohen's d = -0.77, PFDR = 0.042). Interhemispheric differences in V2 and middle temporal visual area (MT) cortical thickness were also observed at the 6-month follow-up (all |Cohen's d| > 0.75, PFDR < 0.05). Nominal structure-function associations were observed for CVF and CDVA changes (all |r| > 0.54, all p < 0.05). No serious adverse events were observed. Conclusions: Children with unilateral deprivation amblyopia following UCC extraction showed improvements in CDVA and CVF over 6 months of routine care. CVF perimetry may provide complementary functional information during longitudinal assessment. Exploratory neuroimaging findings suggested potentially distinct structural correlates of CDVA and CVF recovery, requiring validation in larger controlled longitudinal studies to clarify the clinical significance of CVF and its associated neuroimaging changes.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究追踪单侧先天性白内障术后弱视儿童在常规治疗下视觉功能的纵向变化，并探索性地考察后视觉通路结构改变及其与视力恢复的关联。结果显示，患儿矫正远视力与中心视野在6个月内均较基线改善，且视力提升幅度与中心视野敏感度增加、缺损减少相关；探索性影像分析提示部分视觉皮层体积和厚度出现变化，并观察到两半球间差异，但结构-功能关联仅为初步发现。作者强调影像结果属探索性质，需更大规模对照研究验证，中心视野检查或可为纵向评估提供补充信息。

papers.title: Normative modeling of intrinsic brain activity reveals multiscale heterogeneity in autism spectrum disorder.
papers.authors: Guo X, Wang J, Wang Y, Zhou R, Gao L.
papers.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is characterized by profound clinical and biological heterogeneity, which limits the reproducibility and individual specificity of findings from traditional case-control studies. However, quantitative characterization of individualized patterns of spontaneous neural activity and their biological correlates remains limited in ASD. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data, including 349 individuals with ASD and 459 typical controls, from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange database were used to characterize spontaneous neural activity via the amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF). Non-negative matrix factorization was applied to extract latent functional factors from ALFF patterns. Normative modeling was then employed to construct normative trajectories and quantify individual-level deviations in ASD relative to typical development. Subsequently, clustering was utilized to identify neurobiological subtypes based on individualized deviation profiles, and representational similarity analysis was used to examine their clinical associations. Finally, spatial correlations with transcriptomic data, neurotransmitter maps, and cognitive functional domains were explored to delineate the multiscale biological correlates of functional factors. Five latent factors spanning socio-sensorimotor integration, action-related processing, executive control, emotional processing, and attentional processing domains were successfully identified, revealing two neurobiologically distinct subtypes of ASD. Subtype-specific associations were found between individualized functional deviation profiles and clinical symptoms. Furthermore, distinct spatial associations between functional factors and gene expression profiles as well as neurotransmitter systems were observed. This study maps individualized functional heterogeneity in ASD and provides multiscale insights into the biological correlates underlying functional alterations.
