papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注孤独症谱系障碍个体自发脑活动的异质性，利用静息态功能磁共振数据，以低频涨落振幅刻画活动模式，并通过规范建模量化个体相对于典型发育的偏离。研究从活动模式中提取出涵盖社会感觉运动整合、动作加工、执行控制、情绪和注意等领域的潜在功能因子，并据此识别出两种神经生物学上不同的孤独症亚型，亚型特异的个体偏离谱与临床症状相关。功能因子还与基因表达和神经递质系统呈现不同的空间关联。这些结果提示孤独症的自发脑活动异质性具有多尺度生物学对应，但相关发现属于关联性刻画，尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: RADIAL AND TANGENTIAL FIBER COMPONENTS IN HUMAN SUPERFICIAL WHITE MATTER AND THEIR ASSOCIATIONS WITH MACROSCALE FUNCTION
papers.authors: Hwang Y, Vavassori L, Bautin P, Rodriguez-Cruces R, Gaspar-Martinez E, Cabalo DG, Ngo A, Smith M, Leech R, Coronado-Leija R, Petit L, Avesani P, Sarubbo S, Evans AC, Concha L, Bernhardt BC.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The superficial white matter (SWM), a thin layer of white matter beneath the cortex, contains a complex arrangement of short- and long-range fiber systems that support communication between cortical regions. These fiber populations include subcortical U-shaped fibers (U-fibers) that predominantly follow a tangential trajectory along the gray matter-white matter interface and long-range fibers that extend more radially through the deeper white matter to connect distant cortical regions. Here, we developed a surface-based framework to dissociate radial and tangential fiber components within the human SWM and investigated their microstructural properties and functional relevance using in-vivo high-field MRI. These components were quantified using apparent fiber density (AFD), fractional anisotropy (FA), and mean diffusivity (MD). We further contextualized SWM fiber architecture by examining depth-dependent microstructural profiles and their relationship with normative patterns of cortical organization and hierarchical specialization. The anatomical assessment of the proposed fiber orientation separation was supported by tractography-based bundle analyses, while the anatomical accuracy of tractography reconstructions was confirmed through comparison with post-mortem white matter dissection data. To assess their functional relevance, the fiber predominance map derived from radial and tangential AFD was related to spatial patterns of functional variability across the cortex. Regions with greater radially oriented fiber contribution exhibited more gradual changes in functional similarity across geodesic distance, whereas tangentially oriented fiber-enriched regions showed more rapid local functional differentiation. These findings reveal distinct structural and functional signatures of radial and tangential SWM fiber components and provide a framework for investigating their contributions to cortical organization and functional specialization. SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT The human cerebral cortex is organized into specialized regions that support diverse functions, but the structural principles underlying this organization remain incompletely understood. The superficial white matter (SWM), a thin layer of white matter beneath the cortex, contains intermingled short- and long-range fiber systems that support communication between cortical regions. However, these fiber populations have remained difficult to characterize because they are closely intertwined within the SWM. By developing a reproducible framework for mapping and quantifying distinct SWM fiber systems, this work provides a foundation for systematic investigation of this complex compartment. Integration of multimodal datasets, together with open sharing of analytical tools and standardized features, promotes transparency, reproducibility, enabling future studies of how superficial connectivity supports brain organization.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了一套基于表面的框架，用于在活体高场MRI中区分人类浅层白质内沿切线方向走行的短程U形纤维与更偏径向走行的长程纤维，并结合纤维追踪和死后解剖数据检验了这种方向分离的解剖合理性。作者进一步将径向与切向纤维的相对优势图与皮层功能相似性随距离的变化联系起来，发现径向纤维较多的区域功能相似性随距离下降更平缓，而切向纤维富集的区域局部功能分化更快。这些结果提示浅层白质中不同走向的纤维系统对应着不同的皮层组织与功能特化模式，为后续研究浅层连接如何支撑脑组织提供了可重复的分析框架。

papers.title: MICROSTRUCTURAL ORGANIZATION OF CORTICO-SUBCORTICAL FUNCTIONAL CONVERGENCE
papers.authors: Verma P, Singh S, Dang S.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The human subcortex integrates information from distributed cortical regions through functionally organized cortico-subcortical systems. Using the publicly available MICA-MICs multimodal MRI dataset of 50 healthy adults, we characterized the microstructural organization of functionally converging cortical regions. First, using resting-state fMRI., we identified cortical regions converging on subcortical targets, including thalamic, basal ganglia, and subcortical limbic structures. Then, using depth-resolved quantitative T1 profiles, we constructed a convergence-restricted microstructural profile covariance matrix, followed by diffusion-map embedding. The first microstructural gradient predominantly differentiated primary and association cortex, whereas the second gradient showed target-related differentiation beyond differences in primary versus association cortex. Cytoarchitectural analysis further revealed target-related differences in cortical composition. Together, these findings reveal complementary dimensions of cortico-subcortical functional organization, spanning broad cortical hierarchy, target-related microstructural differentiation, and cytoarchitectural composition.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注与皮层下结构功能汇聚的皮层区域具有怎样的微结构组织。作者利用公开多模态MRI数据，在健康成人中先以静息态功能磁共振识别汇聚到丘脑、基底节和皮层下边缘结构的皮层区域，再结合深度分辨的定量T1剖面构建微结构协方差矩阵并做扩散映射嵌入。结果显示，第一微结构梯度主要区分初级皮层与联合皮层，第二梯度则体现出超出这一初级—联合差异的目标相关分化，细胞构筑分析也发现皮层组成随皮层下目标不同而存在差异。作者据此认为，皮层—皮层下功能组织包含皮层等级、目标相关微结构分化和细胞构筑组成等互补维度。

papers.title: Psychedelics and disorders of consciousness: a new frontier in neurotherapeutics.
papers.authors: Du X, Peng F, Wang X.
papers.abstract: Disorders of consciousness (DoC), including coma, unresponsive wakefulness syndrome (also known as vegetative state), and minimally conscious state, represent profound disruptions in awareness and responsiveness due to severe brain injury, with limited therapeutic options available. Recent advancements in neuroimaging have improved our ability to detect residual brain activity in DoC patients, but effective interventions remain elusive. Psychedelics like psilocybin, lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD), and N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT), which modulate brain network dynamics and enhance neural plasticity, have emerged as candidate pharmacological probes and potential therapeutic strategies for DoC. These substances primarily exert their effects through serotonin 2 A (5-HT2A ) receptor agonism, inducing widespread changes in cortical activity and connectivity, in contrast to the reduced connectivity typically seen in DoC. The entropic brain hypothesis suggests that psychedelics increase neural entropy, potentially fostering more flexible brain states that could facilitate recovery in DoC patients by restoring communication between isolated brain regions. While direct human feasibility evidence has recently emerged from initial pilot and case studies, controlled clinical evidence demonstrating sustained restoration of consciousness remains absent. Consequently, key challenges such as determining optimal dosing, safety, and ethical considerations must be addressed before clinical application. This perspective reviews the neurobiological mechanisms of psychedelics, their potential for treating DoC, and the clinical and methodological hurdles to overcome, emphasizing the need for interdisciplinary research to translate these ideas into effective therapies. Moreover, this exploration contributes to a deeper understanding of consciousness and its modulation through pharmacological means.

papers.summary_zh: 该视角文章讨论迷幻药能否作为意识障碍的候选神经治疗手段。作者梳理了裸盖菇素、LSD和DMT等主要通过5-HT2A受体激动调节脑网络动态与神经可塑性的机制，并借熵脑假说提出这类药物可能提高神经熵、恢复孤立脑区间的交流，从而与意识障碍中连接减弱的模式形成对照。文章指出，目前仅有初步试点和个案研究提示人体可行性，尚缺乏证明意识持续恢复的对照临床证据，给药剂量、安全性和伦理问题仍待解决，因此强调需跨学科研究推动其向有效疗法转化。

papers.title: Geometric reformatting of shared relational maps during flexible decisions.
papers.authors: Guan M, Liu J, Zhou Y, Wang X, Yang L, Li H.
papers.abstract: Adaptive behavior requires balancing generalization from past experience with the flexible selection of goal-relevant information. Cognitive maps provide a structured basis for this balance, yet how a stable relational map supports task-appropriate decision coordinates remains unclear. Combining fMRI with CNN-LSTM modeling, we show that a shared two-dimensional social map coexists with localized, goal-dependent geometric reformatting. A hippocampal-orbitofrontal/medial prefrontal network preserves a reusable 2D relational structure, whereas a frontoparietal control network expresses goal-aligned 1D decision projections. Crucially, these readouts show systematic geometric shaping along distinct functional axes. Representational stretching along a "congruent axis" was associated with redundant structure across dimensions, whereas goal-directed warping along a "task-relevant axis" selectively emphasized currently relevant information during decision conflict. This localized geometric reformatting was accompanied by dynamic hippocampus-insula-precuneus interactions. As similar patterns emerged spontaneously in recurrent networks, our findings support geometric reformatting as a complementary readout strategy through which a stable multidimensional relational map can be flexibly adapted to current decision demands.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究揭示海马-眶额/内侧前额网络维持共享关系图、额顶控制网络表达目标对齐决策投影，属决策与认知地图的脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨稳定的关系性认知地图如何支持灵活决策，结合fMRI与CNN-LSTM建模，考察共享二维社会地图与目标依赖的局部几何重构如何并存。结果显示，海马-眶额/内侧前额网络保留可复用的二维关系结构，而额顶控制网络表达与目标对齐的一维决策投影；沿不同功能轴出现系统性几何塑形，其中“一致轴”上的表征拉伸对应维度间冗余结构，“任务相关轴”上的目标导向扭曲则在决策冲突时选择性强调当前相关信息，并伴随海马-岛叶-楔前叶的动态交互。循环网络中自发出现的类似模式进一步支持几何重构作为一种补充性读出策略，使稳定的多维关系地图能够灵活适配当前决策需求。

papers.title: HD-tACS at 40 Hz improves consciousness and brain connectivity in prolonged disorders of consciousness: a randomized sham-controlled clinical trial.
papers.authors: Hu J, Mou C, Jiang X, Zhang L, Ling Y, Zhao J, Meng F, He F, Wang H, Peng F, Ning J, Gao J, Xu C, Xiao J, Zhao S, Yu J, Pan G, Luo B.
papers.abstract: Background Frequency-specific high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) may facilitate recovery in patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness (pDoC), but predictive biomarkers and mechanistic insights are limited. Objective To investigate the therapeutic efficacy of 40 Hz or 4 Hz HD-tACS in pDoC. Methods Sixty pDoC patients were randomized into four groups receiving 40 Hz or 4 Hz HD-tACS, each with a corresponding sham condition. Behavioral recovery was assessed via Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (CRS-R), network connectivity was analyzed with electroencephalography (EEG), and baseline 40 Hz auditory steady-state response (ASSR) was explored as a predictive biomarker. Results Five days of 40 Hz HD-tACS yielded greater improvements of total CRS-R scores than 4 Hz or sham, particularly in visual and arousal subscales. EEG revealed strengthened short- and long-range connectivity quantified by phase-locking value (PLV), correlating with behavioral gains. At six months, 37.5% of 40 Hz patients got a good outcome with Glasgow Outcome Scale-Extended (GOS-E) score ≥ 4, which was significantly higher than that observed in the sham group (P = 0.019). Higher baseline ASSR predicted stronger network enhancement and clinical improvement. Conclusions 40 Hz HD-tACS promotes recovery and network reorganization in pDoC. Baseline ASSR may provide complementary information for understanding individual variability in responses to frequency-specific neuromodulation.

papers.summary_zh: 该随机假对照临床试验探讨40 Hz与4 Hz高清经颅交流电刺激对迁延性意识障碍患者的疗效，并考察基线40 Hz听觉稳态反应能否预测反应。结果显示，五天40 Hz刺激在意识行为量表总分上的改善优于4 Hz和假刺激，尤其体现在视觉与觉醒相关条目；脑电相位锁定值所反映的短程与长程连接增强，且与行为改善相关。六个月随访时，40 Hz组获得较好结局的比例高于假刺激组，基线听觉稳态反应较高者网络增强和临床改善更明显。作者据此认为40 Hz刺激可促进该类患者恢复与网络重组，基线听觉稳态反应或有助于理解个体反应差异，但样本与随访规模有限，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The neural architecture of first-person moral choice: a demand-dependent working model.
papers.authors: Arrouet A, Chandler J, Laureys S, Hoyer RS.
papers.abstract: First-person moral choice may require the coordination of norm-relevant, self-relevant, affective, and outcome-related information. This narrative review integrates neuroimaging and electrophysiological evidence into a network-informed temporal working model organized around integrative demand: the extent to which multiple, potentially competing constraints must be represented and coordinated. The model distinguishes four candidate functional contributions: salience-related orienting, posterior default-mode/medial-temporal self-relevant situation construction, executive-control/frontoparietal comparison when competing rules, anticipated consequences, or response options must be actively maintained, and ventromedial-prefrontal value integration. Rather than forming a fixed cascade, these contributions may overlap, recur, and interact dynamically, with their relative involvement depending on task structure and integrative demand. Neuroimaging findings document task-dependent regional effects and, in a small number of studies, network interactions, while event-related potentials and oscillatory dynamics constrain the timing of salience-sensitive, conflict-sensitive, mnemonic, evaluative, and response-related processes. Together, these findings motivate a temporally structured but flexible account in which first-person moral choice emerges from changing coordination among domain-general processes rather than from a dedicated moral network or universal sequence. The model generates testable predictions for paradigms that manipulate integrative demand while controlling arousal, difficulty, and response requirements, and that combine event-specific electrophysiology with anatomically constrained connectivity measures. Together, these predictions provide a path toward testing how distributed neural dynamics contribute to first-person moral choice.

relevance.reason: 综述整合神经影像与电生理证据，构建第一人称道德选择的脑网络时间模型，涉及价值整合、执行控制等认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕第一人称道德选择所需的规范、自我、情感与结果信息的协调，整合神经影像与电生理证据，提出一个以“整合需求”为核心、具有时间结构的网络工作模型。模型区分了显著性定向、后部默认网络/内侧颞叶的自我相关情境建构、竞争规则或后果需主动维持时的额顶执行比较，以及腹内侧前额叶的价值整合四类候选功能；这些成分并非固定级联，而会随任务结构和整合需求重叠、反复并动态交互。作者据此认为，第一人称道德选择源于领域一般过程间不断变化的协调，而非专门的道德网络或普遍序列，并提出可操纵整合需求、控制唤醒与难度等因素的可检验预测。

papers.title: Maturation of cognitive control in the inferior frontal junction: A combined systematic review and coordinate-based fMRI meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Montford C, Hogeveen J.
papers.abstract: Cognitive control is fundamental to goal-directed behavior, and its protracted maturation is a hallmark of adolescent brain development. In adulthood, the inferior frontal junction (IFJ) is functionally characterized as a critical region for updating task representations to guide the implementation of cognitive control. Yet, how its domain-general control functions emerge and mature across development remains largely underexplored. Specifically, it is unclear whether IFJ's capacity for cognitive control enhances uniformly as a single construct, or if this region matures asynchronously for distinct control processes like inhibition, switching, and working memory. To address this gap, we conducted a combined systematic review and coordinate-based neuroimaging meta-analysis. Applying multilevel kernel density analyses to fMRI studies of inhibition, switching, and working memory in youth and adults, we synthesized data from 72 contrasts (779 foci; N = 1913). The results revealed a staggered developmental trajectory for IFJ recruitment during visually cued cognitive control paradigms. While adults showed consistent convergence of activation in IFJ across all three domains, youth exhibited robust bilateral IFJ convergence exclusively during inhibitory control tasks. This suggests inhibition may be a developmentally foundational process localized to this region earlier in the lifespan. Furthermore, adults demonstrated hemispheric specialization absent in youth: left IFJ was uniquely sensitive to switching and working memory in adults, but not in youth. Together, these findings support a model where IFJ does not mature as a static, monolithic node, but rather acts as a dynamic hub that integrates fractionated cognitive processes at different stages of development.

relevance.reason: 该研究通过fMRI元分析考察额下沟（IFJ）认知控制（抑制、切换、工作记忆）的发育成熟轨迹及半球偏侧化，直接涉及人脑认知控制机制与脑发育。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年认知控制成熟过程中额下沟（IFJ）的作用，采用系统综述结合基于坐标的fMRI元分析，整合了抑制、切换和工作记忆任务的脑成像数据。结果显示，成人的IFJ在三种认知控制领域均有一致激活，而青少年仅在抑制控制任务中表现出稳定的双侧IFJ激活，提示抑制可能是该区域较早成熟的基础性功能。此外，成人表现出青少年尚不具备的半球特化：左侧IFJ对切换和工作记忆更为敏感。作者据此提出，IFJ并非作为一个静态整体成熟，而是作为动态枢纽在不同发育阶段整合分化的认知过程。

papers.title: Unique local gradient-based functional fingerprints enable precisely identifying individual infants over ages.
papers.authors: Yuan X, Hu D, Cheng J, Wu Z, Wang L, Lin W, Li G.
papers.abstract: Brain functional connectivity (FC) exhibits individualized patterns that can serve as reliable "fingerprints" for identifying individual adults. However, the rapid and complex development of the infant brain poses significant challenges in establishing individualized, developmentally-robust functional fingerprints during infancy. In this study, we introduce a novel approach that captures fine-grained local gradients of FC derived from functional MRI, enabling precise characterization of unique subject-specific FC patterns. Our method achieved approximately 99% individual identification accuracy across longitudinal scans spanning infancy in 103 infants, substantially outperforming conventional connectome-based fingerprinting, which achieved approximately 70% accuracy. Importantly, these local gradient-based functional fingerprints, predominantly localized within association and sensory networks, were also modestly but significantly associated with infant cognitive performance. Together, these findings support the existence of individualized functional fingerprints that are stable across dynamic early brain development, offering new insights into the early development of functional individuality and its cognitive relevance.

relevance.reason: 利用婴儿fMRI功能连接局部梯度刻画个体化功能指纹，并关联认知表现，涉及脑功能组织与发育及认知意义。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注婴儿期大脑功能连接是否已具备可稳定识别个体的“指纹”，并提出基于功能磁共振数据提取局部功能连接梯度的方法来刻画个体特异的连接模式。在纵向扫描的婴儿中，这一方法的个体识别准确率明显高于传统基于连接组的指纹方法，且这些指纹主要分布于联合网络和感觉网络。研究还发现，指纹特征与婴儿认知表现存在小幅但显著的相关，提示早期脑功能组织已具有相对稳定的个体性，并可能与认知发展相关；但相关关系不等于因果，其临床意义尚待进一步验证。

papers.title: Cognitive state dependent enhancement of cognitive control with transcranial magnetic stimulation.
papers.authors: McInnes AN, Pipia VL, Maynard KL, Kalender G, Widge AS.
papers.abstract: Background Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) is an effective treatment for major depressive disorder (MDD), yet variability of therapeutic responses remains high. A key contributor to this variability may be state-dependent effects of brain stimulation, where activity in underlying circuits may shape the propagation of TMS-evoked activity. Thus, constraining the target circuits' state by engaging cognition may make TMS' effects more consistent. Objective We tested whether TMS' effects on cognitive control, a transdiagnostic construct implicated across psychiatric disorders and a putative mediator of TMS efficacy, are state-dependent. Methods Participants (N = 23) completed a behavioural assay of cognitive control before and after we delivered intermittent trains of rTMS to the prefrontal cortex (PFC). During rTMS, participants performed either a high PFC-demand cognitive control task (ActiveStaterTMS ), or performed a low PFC-demand perceptual discrimination task (ControlStaterTMS ). As a function of the behavioural state during stimulation, we assessed changes (relative to baseline) in downstream behavioural metrics of circuit function and neural indices of cognitive control measured from electroencephalography (EEG). We also examined TMS-evoked neural activity as a function of the behavioural state during stimulation via TMS-EEG. Results rTMS enhanced downstream readouts of cognitive control only when stimulation was delivered concurrent with the cognitive control task. In addition, after ActiveStaterTMS , but not ControlStaterTMS , the power of task-evoked theta band oscillatory activity was reduced relative to baseline. TMS-EEG data also showed enhanced TMS-evoked theta band oscillatory activity during the cognitive control task, relative to the perceptual one. Conclusion These findings demonstrate that TMS' effects on cognitive control are state-dependent, in which endogenous engagement of PFC-anchored networks can shape the magnitude and functional relevance of TMS-evoked activity and the associated modification of circuit function. Constraining cognitive states during TMS may therefore offer a framework to enhance the reliability of TMS' effects.

relevance.reason: 研究rTMS结合认知任务对前额叶认知控制及EEG theta振荡的影响，属认知控制神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨重复经颅磁刺激对认知控制的作用是否依赖刺激时的行为状态，以健康参与者为对象，比较在认知控制任务与低需求知觉任务期间施加前额叶刺激后的行为与脑电变化。结果显示，只有在刺激与认知控制任务同时进行时，下游认知控制表现才得到增强，且任务诱发的theta频段活动相对基线下降；脑电还显示认知控制任务期间刺激诱发的theta活动更强。作者据此认为，内源性参与前额叶网络可塑造刺激效应的幅度与功能相关性，提示在刺激时约束认知状态或有助于提高效应可靠性，但样本较小，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Inhibitory control and error processing in Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder: A mega-analysis of task-based fMRI data by the ENIGMA-OCD consortium.
papers.authors: Džinalija N, van den Heuvel OA, Simpson HB, Ivanov I, Araújo A, Balachander S, Beucke J, Brandeis D, Brem S, Bruin W, Buitelaar J, Castelo-Branco M, Choi S, Eng GK, Fitzsimmons SMDD, Fortea L, Fullana MA, Grützmann R, Hansen B, Huijser C, de Joode NT, Kathmann N, Kaufmann C, Kim M, Koch K, Kwon JS, Lim JX, Martinez-Zalacain I, Menchon JM, van de Mortel LA, Narayanaswamy JC, Ousdal OT, Postma TS, Rodriguez-Manrique D, van Rooij D, Shivakumar V, Soriano-Mas C, Stern ER, Thomopoulos SI, Thorsen AL, Vilajosana E, Walitza S, Waller L, van der Werf YD, van Wingen G, de Wit SJ, ENIGMA-OCD consortium, Stein DJ, Thompson PM, Vriend C, Veer IM.
papers.abstract: Objective Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is a chronic condition in which impaired inhibitory control and excessive error monitoring may contribute to maintenance of obsessions and compulsions. This mega-analysis investigates neural activation during response inhibition and error processing using adult (OCD=563; control=348) and child (OCD=83, control=114) data from the ENIGMA-OCD consortium and the ABCD study (probable OCD=343; control=361). Methods Individual participant data was uniformly processed using HALFpipe to extract statistical maps for response inhibition and error processing contrasts. Bayesian multilevel models were used to assess regional and whole-brain effects of OCD, and to examine the association between the OCD clinical profile and task-related activation. Results Across inhibitory control tasks, both OCD and control participants showed robust activation in regions implicated in response inhibition and error processing. During response inhibition, compared to controls, adults with OCD showed stronger somatomotor cortex activation, while children with OCD showed stronger occipital cortex activation. Children with probable OCD from the ABCD cohort showed weaker activity in the frontoparietal network in the anterior insula/frontal operculum region. During error processing, relative to controls, adults with OCD showed weaker activation in fronto-striatal regions, while children with OCD showed stronger activation in frontoparietal and attention networks. Greater OCD symptom severity was associated with weaker task-related activation in adults and stronger activation in children during response inhibition. Conclusion Case-control differences in brain activation during inhibitory control varied by age group and task contrast. Symptom severity emerged as the main clinical correlate of activation during inhibition, suggesting that inhibitory control deficits in OCD may be both state-dependent and developmentally specific.

relevance.reason: 该研究用任务态fMRI大样本分析强迫症患者抑制控制与错误加工的脑激活差异，直接探讨认知控制神经机制及脑疾病中的改变。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注强迫症患者在反应抑制和错误加工中的脑激活差异，汇总成人与儿童数据并统一处理后用贝叶斯多层模型分析。总体上患者与对照均能激活相关脑区，但差异随年龄和任务对比而变化：成人患者在反应抑制时躯体运动皮层激活更强，儿童患者则枕叶更强；错误加工时成人额纹状区激活较弱，儿童额顶与注意网络更强。反应抑制时，症状越重，成人激活越弱、儿童越强，提示抑制相关异常可能兼具状态依赖与发育特异性。

papers.title: Connection-Level Multi-Omics Reveals Cerebellar-Cortical Dysconnectivity and Divergent Molecular Signatures Across Major Psychiatric Disorders.
papers.authors: Diao Y, Huang Y, Zhu B, Guo M, Wang W, Li Z, Zhang X, Li K, Li W, Wang H, Zhou J, Li X, Wu F, Wu K.
papers.abstract: Background Understanding how disease-related connectome alterations relate to underlying molecular systems remains a major challenge in psychiatric disorders. Methods Here we introduce BrainNetAnno (https://brainnetanno.readthedocs.io/en/latest), an open-source framework for molecular annotation of brain network connections that extends multi-omics mapping from regional nodes to inter-regional edges. We applied this framework to resting-state functional connectivity data from a discovery cohort of 2,453 participants and an independent validation cohort of 442, including individuals with major depressive disorder, schizophrenia, generalized anxiety disorder, autism spectrum disorder, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, and healthy controls. Results Our analyses revealed a shared transdiagnostic abnormal connectivity pattern (STACP), characterized by cerebellar-cortical dysconnectivity, alongside distinct disorder-specific connectivity deviations (DSCDs) that exhibited structured inter-disorder relationships, including opposition, partial alignment, and near-orthogonality. These connectivity patterns were differentially associated with molecular systems, with mitochondrial phenotypes linked to the STACP and selected DSCDs, and neurotransmitter receptor/transporter profiles primarily associated with DSCDs. Conclusions These findings establish a robust, connection-level framework for linking large-scale connectome abnormalities to multi-omics molecular systems in psychiatric disorders.

relevance.reason: 利用静息态功能连接比较多种精神疾病的小脑-皮层连接异常，并映射到分子系统，属脑疾病连接组机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神疾病中脑连接异常与分子系统之间的关系，提出一个将多组学注释从脑区节点扩展到连接边的开源框架，并用于多种精神疾病患者和健康对照的静息态功能连接数据。分析发现一个跨诊断共享的异常连接模式，以丘脑-皮层连接异常为特征，同时各疾病还存在彼此呈对立、部分一致或近乎正交的特异性连接偏差。这些连接模式与分子系统的关联不同：线粒体表型主要与共享模式及部分特异性偏差相关，而神经递质受体和转运体谱主要与疾病特异性偏差相关。作者据此认为，该框架可将大规模连接组异常与多组学分子系统联系起来，但相关发现仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The role of social white matter tracts in susceptibility to phishing in aging.
papers.authors: Hung CC, Lin T, Lung TC, Faulkner R, Kennedy KM, Ebner NC.
papers.abstract: Vulnerability to fraud and financial exploitation among older adults is an increasing public health concern. Growing evidence supports that cognitive and socioemotional changes with age contribute to greater exploitation risk among older adults, while the neural mechanisms of heightened susceptibility to deception in aging are not well understood. Of note, white matter tracts are particularly impacted in aging and are likely implicated in deception detection. This study, for the first time, examined the extent to which age-related differences in white matter pathways subserving social cognition mediated susceptibility to email phishing, a potent, fast-evolving Internet deception threat. Fifty-one younger (21.82 ± 3.47 years) and 46 cognitively healthy older (68.87 ± 6.56 years) adults underwent diffusion-weighted imaging and completed the ecologically-valid PHishing Internet Task (PHIT), which provides a behavioral measure of real-life susceptibility to email phishing. Deterministic tractography-generated a priori tracts of interest included the cingulum, uncinate fasciculus (UF), anterior thalamic radiation (ATR), and superior longitudinal fasciculus-collectively referred to as "social white matter." White matter integrity metrics (i.e., mean diffusivity [MD] and fractional anisotropy [FA]) were extracted from these tracts. Regression-based mediation analyses controlling for sex, education, general cognition, and global MD and FA (separately) showed that both increased right ATR MD and decreased left UF FA partially mediated the effects of age group on phishing susceptibility (higher PHIT scores with greater age). These findings advance a social white matter-based account of age-related exploitation risk, shedding light on the neurobiology underlying social decision-making deficits in aging.

relevance.reason: 研究老年人社会认知相关白质纤维束与网络钓鱼易感性的关系，属社会决策的脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察老年人为何更易受网络钓鱼欺骗，并检验社会认知相关白质通路是否在其中起中介作用。研究比较了年轻人和认知健康的老年人，结合弥散加权成像与模拟真实邮件钓鱼的行为任务，测量白质完整性与受骗易感性。结果发现，右侧前丘脑辐射平均弥散率升高和左侧钩束各向异性降低，部分中介了年龄组与钓鱼易感性之间的关联，即年龄越大受骗得分越高。作者据此提出以社会白质为基础解释老年期受剥削风险，提示社会决策缺陷有其神经生物学基础；但中介仅为部分，且属横断关联，不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Sensory gamma entrainment in older adults with or without cognitive impairment: a systematic review and exploratory meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Hyun M, Park Y, Park SY, Kim KW.
papers.abstract: Gamma entrainment using sensory stimulation (GENUS) is a noninvasive approach under investigation in older adults with and without cognitive impairment, including Alzheimer's disease; however, human evidence remains scattered across structural, functional, biomarker, electrophysiological, and cognitive domains. We searched PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science for English-language articles published from January 2016 to December 2025, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines and a retrospectively registered PROSPERO protocol. Eligible studies evaluated non-invasive sensory gamma-frequency stimulation in adults aged ≥ 60 years, including Alzheimer's disease-spectrum and cognitively normal older adults, with quantitative outcomes reported in at least one relevant domain. Narrative synthesis was the primary approach, supplemented by an exploratory random-effects meta-analysis of hippocampal and ventricular volume change. Eight studies were included, spanning single-session to 6-month interventions. Findings were directionally favorable across domains but derived from small, heterogeneous studies with nonoverlapping outcomes. Fluid biomarker evidence was limited to exploratory immune-related findings from a single uncontrolled study. Controlled structural studies suggested possible attenuation of hippocampal atrophy, ventricular enlargement, and white matter decline. Functional connectivity findings suggested possible preservation of connectivity in Alzheimer's disease-relevant networks. Electroencephalography studies supported target engagement, with entrainment strength and propagation varying according to stimulation parameters and individual characteristics. Cognitive findings from small exploratory studies did not establish a consistent benefit. Exploratory pooled effects for ventricular and hippocampal volume change were favorable but not robust to conservative sensitivity analysis. Human evidence for GENUS is promising but preliminary and hypothesis-generating; larger, adequately powered, standardized trials are needed before firm efficacy conclusions can be drawn.

relevance.reason: 系统综述感觉伽马夹带对老年人脑结构、功能连接、EEG及认知的影响，涉及阿尔茨海默病相关脑网络与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述与探索性荟萃分析系统梳理了60岁及以上认知正常或存在认知障碍（含阿尔茨海默病谱系）的老年人中，非侵入性感觉伽马频率刺激（GENUS）在结构、功能、生物标志物、电生理和认知等多领域的证据。纳入研究从单次刺激到数月干预不等，结果在各领域方向上偏于有利，但多来自样本小、异质性高且结局不重叠的研究；受控结构研究提示可能减缓海马萎缩、脑室扩大和白质下降，功能连接结果提示相关网络连接可能得以保留，脑电研究支持刺激的靶向参与，而小型探索性认知研究未确立一致获益。作者强调，现有证据尚属初步且具假设生成性质，探索性合并效应在保守敏感性分析下并不稳健，需更大规模、标准化试验才能得出确切疗效结论。

papers.title: Mapping human visual contrast sensitivity and vision loss across the visual field with model-based fMRI.
papers.authors: Chow-Wing-Bom HT, Lisi M, Benson NC, Lygo-Frett F, Yu-Wai-Man P, Dick F, Maimon-Mor RO, Dekker TM.
papers.abstract: Peripheral vision is crucial for daily activities and quality of life, yet traditional measures of visual function like visual acuity primarily assess central vision. Visual field tests can evaluate peripheral vision but require extended focus and precise fixation, often challenging for patients with severe sight loss. Functional MRI (fMRI) with population receptive field (pRF) mapping offers a non-invasive way to map scotomas but relies on single contrast levels and accurate fixation. We developed an fMRI-based approach to measure contrast sensitivity across the visual field without requiring precise fixation. Combining large-field stimulation with varying spatial frequencies and contrast levels, and either pRF mapping or a structure-based retinotopic atlas, we modeled contrast sensitivity in the primary visual cortex (V1) over a large (40 deg) expanse of the visual field. In seven normally sighted participants, we characterized differences in V1 sensitivity across eccentricities and visual quadrants, finding reliable and reproducible patterns at individual and session levels. To test robustness to fixation variability, we investigated how varying levels of eye movement affected V1 sensitivity patterns in two participants: cortical sensitivity patterns were largely preserved despite eye movements, particularly at low spatial frequencies. This suggests our approach can accommodate several degrees of fixation instability, making it suitable for populations with unstable or biased fixation for whom visual field maps are harder to acquire behaviorally (e.g., patients with dense central scotoma or strabismus). Additionally, our method effectively visualized simulated and disease-linked sensitivity loss at the cortical level. Crucially, these results could be largely recovered using the structure-based retinotopic atlas, eliminating the need for pRF mapping and precise fixation, although with reduced sensitivity. This approach, integrating large-field stimulation with a retinotopic atlas, offers a promising tool for monitoring vision loss and recovery across a range of visual impairments, addressing a significant challenge in current clinical assessments.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI在V1建模视野对比敏感度并映射视觉丧失，属感知的神经机制与皮层功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了一种基于功能磁共振成像的方法，用于在无需精确注视的情况下测量整个视野的对比敏感度。作者结合大视野刺激、不同空间频率与对比度水平，并利用群体感受野映射或基于结构的视网膜拓扑图谱，在初级视觉皮层中建模对比敏感度。在正常视力参与者中，该方法能在个体和会话水平上稳定复现不同偏心度和象限的敏感度差异；眼动实验显示皮层敏感度模式在眼动下大体保留，尤其在高空间频率条件下，提示方法可容忍一定程度的注视不稳定。该方法还能在皮层层面可视化模拟的和疾病相关的敏感度丧失，且基于结构的图谱可在敏感度有所降低的前提下 largely 复现这些结果，从而省去群体感受野映射和精确注视的要求。作者认为，这一整合大视野刺激与视网膜拓扑图谱的方法有望用于监测多种视觉损伤中的视力丧失与恢复，但摘要未报告患者实验，临床应用潜力仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Translating functional brain activity between humans and monkeys
papers.authors: Braunlich K, Duyck M, Duffield S, Behel K, Baker C, Conway R.
papers.abstract: Comparing brain responses across species is essential for identifying models of human cognition and testing theories of brain evolution, but differences in brain size, measurement techniques, and signal dynamics make it challenging. Here we collected dense fMRI data in macaques and humans using the same movies, static-image sequences, and tasks, and developed a multivariate analysis method that aligns neural representations temporally and spatially. The resulting data-driven framework provides a quantitative translation of brain responses among individuals and between species. Using this framework, we uncovered a broadly conserved cross-species hierarchy of retinotopic visual areas and whole-brain correspondence. Yet within this structure, we found that higher-order macaque areas shared more information with lower-order human areas, particularly during movies, providing evidence of species differences. We also identified potential macaque precursors to human regions involved in high-level cognition, including theory-of-mind and reading. These results offer a blueprint for common representational principles across species.

relevance.reason: 用相同电影/任务fMRI比较人与猴脑表征，揭示跨物种视觉层级与高级认知区对应，涉及人脑功能组织与自然刺激加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在解决跨物种比较脑活动时因脑大小、测量技术和信号动态差异带来的困难，用相同电影、静态图像序列和任务采集猕猴与人类的密集fMRI数据，并开发了一种在时间和空间上对齐神经表征的多变量分析方法。由此建立的框架能定量翻译个体间及物种间的脑反应，揭示出视网膜拓扑视觉区及全脑对应关系上广泛保守的跨物种层级结构。但在此结构内，猕猴高级区域与人类低级区域共享更多信息，尤其在观看电影时，提示存在物种差异；研究还识别出人类心智理论和阅读相关区域可能的猕猴前体，为跨物种共同表征原则提供了参考蓝图。

papers.title: Prefrontal EEG Delta-Beta Coupling Marks Depressed State in Adult Siblings
papers.authors: Elhamiasl M, Li LY, Maldonado Osorio FA, Rappaport BI, Shankman SA, Alekseichuk I.
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is marked by disorganization in electrophysiological brain networks, yet it remains unclear whether such disorganization reflects the state-dependent pathological effects or a trait-like vulnerability. We analyzed resting-state electroencephalographic (EEG) delta-beta phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) in two sibling cohorts. Current-MDD families included individuals with current MDD and their currently unaffected siblings (n=36), and remitted-MDD families comprised individuals with remitted MDD and their lifetime unaffected siblings (n=110). Delta-beta high PAC was significantly elevated (p corr ≤0.05) over the left-medial frontal region in participants with current MDD relative to their unaffected siblings. In the remitted-MDD families, no significant differences were observed. Regrouping all individuals irrespective of family ties into current MDD, remitted MDD, and never-depressed controls confirmed significantly elevated frontal delta-beta high PAC at rest in the current-MDD subgroup compared to other subgroups. Overall, delta-beta high coupling reflects the depressive state rather than a trait-like or familial vulnerability.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态EEG考察抑郁症状态相关的额叶delta-beta相位-幅值耦合，属于情绪障碍的脑网络/自发活动组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注前额叶脑电delta-beta耦合究竟反映抑郁的状态性病理效应，还是类似特质的易感性。作者在两组同胞家庭中分析静息态脑电的delta-beta相位-幅值耦合，比较当前抑郁、缓解期抑郁及其未受累同胞。结果显示，当前抑郁者的左侧内侧额区高耦合显著高于其未受累同胞，而缓解期抑郁家庭中未见显著差异；将所有人按当前抑郁、缓解期抑郁和从未抑郁重新分组后，当前抑郁亚组额区静息态高耦合仍显著高于其他亚组。作者据此认为，delta-beta高耦合更多反映抑郁状态，而非特质性或家族易感性。

papers.title: Environmental predominance on brain structure and connectivity in language-related regions: a multimodal twin study in adolescence
papers.authors: Tassi E, Colli C, Peyvandi A, De Nardi L, Pansitta C, Busilacchi S, Siri FM, Delvecchio G, Maggioni E, Bonivento C, Mauri M, Fagnani C, Medda E, Nobile M, Brambilla P.
papers.abstract: Language alterations are recognized as early markers of psychopathological vulnerability, yet genetic and environmental factors underlying language-related brain regions remain unknown. We applied univariate twin analyses and risk-discordant comparisons to multimodal dataset from 31 healthy twin pairs (9–31 years) and 17 pairs discordant for psychopathological risk (10–27 years). Gray matter volume (GMV), cortical thickness (CT), and functional interactions, specifically effective connectivity (EC), were assessed in eight bilateral language-related regions, alongside linguistic, emotional-behavioural, temperamental, and personality-related phenotypes. In healthy twin pairs (27–31 pairs, depending on data completeness), genetic and environmental determinants were estimated for all phenotypes. In 17 pairs discordant for psychopathological risk, intra-pair neuroimaging differences were tested for association with psychopathological discordance and zygosity, and individual brain measures were compared across high-risk twins, their low-risk co-twins, and healthy controls. Environmental factors predominated in structural and functional brain variability, while genetic contributions were limited, region-specific. Narrative fluency and psychological traits showed stronger heritability. Findings converged on the right middle frontal gyrus, where GMV and CT alterations reflected non-shared environment and risk expression. Despite the small sample, preliminary results suggest neurobiological vulnerability in language networks arises from environmental rather than genetic factors, informing environmental susceptibility to adolescent mental illness.

relevance.reason: 双生子多模态研究考察语言相关脑区灰质体积、皮层厚度与有效连接的环境/遗传影响，直接涉及语言脑结构与功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语言相关脑区的结构与功能变异究竟由遗传还是环境因素主导，采用双生子设计结合单变量遗传分析和风险不一致配对比较，在健康双生子及精神病理性风险不一致的青少年与年轻成人中考察多个语言相关脑区的灰质体积、皮层厚度和有效连接。结果显示，这些结构和功能指标的可变性主要由环境因素解释，遗传贡献有限且具有脑区特异性；叙事流畅性与心理特质则有较强的遗传性。作者指出，右侧额中回的结构变化与非共享环境和风险表达相关，并据此初步提出语言网络的神经生物学易感性更多源于环境而非遗传，但样本量小，结论仍属初步。

papers.title: REM sleep EEG slowing signals basal forebrain integrity in older adults with subjective and mild cognitive impairment
papers.authors: Lam A, Espinosa N, Matar E, Cross N, Fripp J, Xia Y, André C, Coulson E, Taranto R, Grunstein R, D’Rozario AL, Naismith SL.
papers.abstract: The basal forebrain is an early site of pathology in Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Within this region, the nucleus basalis of Meynert (NbM) provides the primary cholinergic input to the neocortex and supports cortical activation during rapid eye movement (REM) sleep. REM electroencephalography (EEG) slowing is observed in older adults with AD and amnestic mild cognitive impairment (MCI). This study examined the relationship between REM EEG slowing and NbM volume, and whether it differed by cognitive status, sex or sleep apnea severity. Participants aged ≥60 years with subjective cognitive impairment or MCI underwent neuropsychological and medical assessments, polysomnography and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). REM EEG slowing was quantified as the ratio of delta and theta (<8Hz) to alpha, sigma and beta (8-32Hz) power. Bilateral NbM and Ch1-3 volume were derived from T1-weighted MRI images. Multiple linear regression and moderation analyses examined associations between REM EEG slowing and NbM volume, adjusting for age, sex, and sleep apnoea severity. To assess anatomical specificity, primary analyses were repeated using Ch1– 3 volume and non-REM EEG slowing. Exploratory analyses examined associations between NbM volume, sleep macroarchitecture, and memory. The sample comprised 116 participants (59.5% female; mean age = 70.5 years, 64.7% MCI). Greater REM EEG slowing was associated with smaller NbM volume (all p < 0.05), whereas no significant associations were observed with Ch1–3 volume and non-REM EEG slowing (all p > 0.05). Although moderation effects were not significant after FDR correction, within-group analyses suggested a stronger relationship in MCI. Smaller NbM volume was associated with longer sleep latency and poorer episodic memory (all p < 0.05). REM EEG slowing may reflect early NbM degeneration and provide a non-invasive biomarker of basal forebrain integrity in older adults with cognitive concerns, with findings showing anatomical specificity to the NbM and sleep-stage specificity to REM sleep. Longitudinal studies are required to establish its prognostic value.

relevance.reason: 研究REM睡眠EEG减慢与基底前脑NbM体积的关系，涉及认知障碍人群的脑结构与睡眠EEG功能标志物关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在60岁及以上有主观认知减退或轻度认知障碍的老年人中，考察快速眼动睡眠期脑电变慢与基底前脑Meynert基底核体积的关系，并结合多导睡眠监测与磁共振成像进行分析。结果显示，快速眼动睡眠期脑电变慢越明显，Meynert基底核体积越小，而这一关联未见于相邻的Ch1-3区域，也未见于非快速眼动睡眠期，提示其具有解剖和睡眠阶段的双重特异性。作者认为，这种脑电变慢可能反映Meynert基底核的早期退变，有望作为评估基底前脑完整性的无创指标；但该研究为横断面关联，其预后价值仍需纵向研究确认。

papers.title: Temporal organization of shared brain states characterizes heterogeneity in major depressive disorder
papers.authors: Pan C, Tu Y, Wang F, Lin K, Qiu S, Zhang W, the REST-meta-MDD Consortium.
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is biologically heterogeneous, but how this variability is expressed in the temporal organization of brain activity remains unclear. Using resting-state functional MRI from 2,225 participants, we applied hidden Markov modeling to identify recurrent brain states and quantify their temporal organization. Five states formed a shared repertoire across individuals with MDD and healthy controls, while MDD-related alterations were distributed across states, functional systems, and temporal properties. Within MDD, unsupervised clustering of state occupancy, persistence, and switching delineated two prototype neurodynamic architectures characterized by preferential deployment of ACS/VSS or MAS/DMS states within a preserved state repertoire and broadly similar transition backbone. The architectures showed different within-group brain–symptom associations and symptom-network patterns. Connectome transcriptome analyses organized architecture–state imaging patterns into three transcriptomic state families shared across architectures, and contrasting group-level deployment patterns were recovered in an independent MDD cohort. These findings suggest that MDD heterogeneity is expressed not only through spatially distributed neural alterations, but also through differences in how a common repertoire of recurrent brain states is organized over time.

relevance.reason: 用静息态fMRI隐马尔可夫模型刻画重性抑郁障碍脑状态时间组织异质性，属脑疾病机理与静息态网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍的生物学异质性如何体现在脑活动的时间组织上，利用静息态功能磁共振数据，通过隐马尔可夫模型识别反复出现的脑状态并量化其时间特征。结果显示，抑郁患者与健康对照共享五种脑状态，但抑郁相关改变分散于不同状态、功能系统和时间属性中；在患者内部，依据状态占用、持续和切换特征可聚类出两种神经动力学架构，二者在保留共同状态库和相似转换骨架的前提下偏好部署不同状态，并呈现不同的脑—症状关联和症状网络模式。连接组—转录组分析进一步将这些架构—状态影像模式归为三类转录组状态家族，并在独立抑郁队列中重现了相反的组水平部署模式。作者据此提出，抑郁异质性不仅表现为空间上分散的神经改变，也表现为共同脑状态库在时间组织方式上的差异。

papers.title: Causal event structure shapes convergent reactivation signatures in human cortex and language model
papers.authors: Zhang Z, Chen Y, Liu Q, Zhao X, Ding X, Fei X, Du J, Bao Y, Gao J, Huang X, Cai B, Liang X, Qin B, Liu T.
papers.abstract: Humans adapt to changing environments by understanding the latent causal structure of events, and modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit analogous abilities. However, elucidating how causal knowledge is represented and integrated in the human brain and in LLMs poses a substantial challenge for cognitive science. To address this, we combine topological analysis of representational manifolds with neuroscientific analyses of reactivation. We find that event-level causal relations modulate temporally structured neural reactivation in the human brain, particularly in the angular gyrus, precuneus and prefrontal cortex. By contrast, LLMs express these relations through positionally structured representational reactivation. Despite these differences, the resulting reactivation patterns exhibit similar intrinsic manifold structure across the two systems. Together, these findings suggest that the human brain and LLM share a common principle for organizing causal knowledge.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑与语言模型对事件因果结构的表征与重激活，报告角回、楔前叶、前额叶等脑区神经重激活，属语言/语义与认知表征机制比较。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑与大型语言模型如何表征和整合事件的因果结构，结合表征流形的拓扑分析与神经再激活分析，比较二者在加工事件级因果关系时的组织方式。结果显示，人脑中的因果关联会调节具有时间结构的神经再激活，涉及角回、楔前叶和前额叶等区域；语言模型则通过位置结构的表征再激活表达这些关系。尽管动态形式不同，两者最终形成的再激活模式具有相似的内在流形结构，提示人脑与语言模型在组织因果知识上可能共享某种共同原则。

papers.title: Electroencephalography research in neuropathic pain (Review).
papers.authors: Zhou L, Liao N, Wang H, Zhao J, Jiang H, Dang S, Yu S, Shu H, Chen X.
papers.abstract: Neuropathic pain (NP), arising from lesions or dysfunction of the somatosensory system, remains a major clinical challenge due to its subjective and multidimensional nature. Traditional pain assessments rely on self‑report scales, which lack objectivity and reproducibility. Electroencephalography (EEG), with its high temporal resolution and accessibility, provides a promising avenue for identifying candidate neurophysiological biomarkers of pain. The current narrative review integrates mechanistic insights and electrophysiological evidence to delineate EEG alterations in NP. Resting‑state θ increases and dominant‑frequency slowing are relatively recurrent in chronic NP, whereas α‑, β‑ and γ‑band findings remain heterogeneous. Network analyses further reveal aberrant prefrontal‑limbic and sensorimotor connectivity, as well as altered cross‑frequency coupling, but the direction and topology of these findings remain dependent on the patient population, recording configuration and analytical metric. Advances in computational EEG analysis, graph theory and machine learning are facilitating exploration of objective, individualized pain assessment frameworks. Emerging portable EEG and multimodal approaches may provide opportunities for future clinical translation. Overall, EEG offers a feasible and dynamic method to bridge subjective pain perception with measurable neurophysiological signatures, paving the way toward precision diagnostics and neuromodulation in NP.

relevance.reason: 综述神经病理性疼痛的EEG改变，涉及疼痛感知的脑振荡与网络机制，属感知/疼痛的神经机制及静息态网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕神经病理性疼痛缺乏客观评估工具这一问题，梳理了脑电图在识别疼痛神经生理标志物方面的证据。文章指出，慢性神经病理性疼痛中静息态θ活动增强和主导频率减慢较为一致，而α、β、γ频段的结果仍不一致；网络分析提示前额-边缘系统及感觉运动连接异常和跨频率耦合改变，但其方向与拓扑受患者群体、记录配置和分析指标影响。作者认为，计算分析、图论和机器学习的发展有助于探索客观、个体化的疼痛评估框架，便携脑电图和多模态方法可能为未来临床转化提供机会，但现有证据尚不足以支持临床应用。

papers.title: Longitudinal changes in resting-state EEG eyes-closed/open delta differentiation during an Antarctic expedition.
papers.authors: Yang W, Tian H, Xie G, Xu Y, Wang Q, Yin Y, Liu W, Jiang Y.
papers.abstract: Antarctic polar night brings extreme light deprivation, prolonged isolation and severe circadian disruption, yet longitudinal resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) signatures reflecting neurophysiological alterations in this harsh environment remain poorly characterized. In this exploratory longitudinal research, resting-state EEG recordings with eyes open (EO) and eyes closed (EC) were acquired from 16 Antarctic expeditioners at four mission stages: pre-departure, pre-polar-night, early post-polar-night, and austral summer. Linear mixed-effects models with false discovery rate correction were applied to analyze delta eyes-closed/open differentiation (the EC-EO delta log-power difference), delta sub-bands, aperiodic spectral features, entropy, EEG microstates and delta-band functional connectivity. The delta EC-EO difference exhibited consistent, progressively negative shifts in parietal, frontal, whole-brain and occipital regions across the expedition timeline, with the most pronounced shifts observed in recordings obtained during and after the polar-night period; this effect spanned all slow, mid and fast delta sub-bands. Secondary mild temporal variations were observed in aperiodic spectral metrics, occipital sample entropy and global delta connectivity, whereas EEG microstates displayed no significant longitudinal alterations. Collectively, the delta EC-EO difference emerges as a candidate EEG index of resting-state condition differentiation in the low-frequency range, pending validation in larger studies with synchronized behavioral, physiological, and environmental measures.

relevance.reason: 纵向静息态EEG研究南极极端环境下自发活动与睁闭眼状态差异，属静息态脑活动组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性纵向研究考察南极科考期间极端光照剥夺、长期隔离与昼夜节律紊乱环境下静息态脑电的变化，对16名队员在出发前、极夜前、极夜后早期和南半球夏季四个阶段采集睁眼与闭眼静息态脑电，并分析delta频段睁闭眼差异等指标。结果显示，顶叶、额叶、全脑和枕叶的delta睁闭眼差异随任务进程持续向负向偏移，在极夜期间及之后的记录中最为明显，且覆盖慢、中、快各delta子频段；非周期频谱指标、枕叶样本熵和全局delta连接仅有轻微时间变化，脑电微状态未见显著纵向改变。作者据此提出，delta睁闭眼差异可作为低频静息状态区分的一个候选脑电指标，但尚需在更大样本并结合行为、生理与环境同步测量的研究中验证。

papers.title: Structural and dynamic functional controllability: shared variance between network control metrics limits attribution to distinct domains of intelligence.
papers.authors: Ng J, Feusner JD, Hawco C.
papers.abstract: Introduction Fluid and crystallized intelligence have recently been hypothesized to reflect the brain network's capacity to facilitate transitions into hard-to-reach, high-energy states, measured via modal controllability, and easy-to-reach, low-energy states, measured via average controllability, respectively. Controllability is typically measured for the structural connectome, but dynamic functional connectivity may better capture temporally varying processes relevant to cognition. Methods Using data from the Human Connectome Project, we compared the prediction of crystallized and fluid intelligence from controllability metrics measured in both structural and dynamic functional connectivity. We hypothesized dynamic functional connectivity would outperform structural connectivity, and modal and average controllability would differentially predict fluid and crystallized intelligence. Results As expected, dynamic functional connectivity outperformed structural connectivity in predicting cognitive performance. However, modal and average controllability displayed similar predictive power for fluid and crystalized intelligence, and performed comparably to regional (or node) strength, a simpler graph metric reflecting the strength of immediate regional connections that strongly covaries with both controllability measures. Furthermore, controllability most strongly predicted general intelligence, the shared factor between crystallized and fluid intelligence. General intelligence was associated with higher average controllability (and greater node strength) in transmodal regions and higher modal controllability (and lower node strength) in unimodal regions in dynamic functional connectivity. Discussion These findings clarify how network control maps onto cognitive ability across the cortical hierarchy, while suggesting that shared variance between controllability metrics hinders specific attribution to crystallized and fluid intelligence, challenging prior hypotheses.

relevance.reason: 研究结构连接组与动态功能连接的可控性指标如何预测智力，属认知的脑网络组织与结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用人类连接组计划数据，比较结构连接与动态功能连接上的网络可控性指标对晶体智力和流体智力的预测能力，并检验模态可控性与平均可控性是否分别对应这两种智力。结果显示，动态功能连接整体上比结构连接更能预测认知表现，但两类可控性对晶体智力和流体智力的预测力相近，且与更简单的节点强度指标表现相当，说明这些指标间的共享方差限制了对不同智力成分的具体归因。可控性对一般智力（两种智力的共同因子）预测最强，并与跨模态区和单模态区呈现方向不同的关联，提示网络控制与认知能力的关系需放在皮层层级中理解。

papers.title: Neurovascular uncoupling in type 2 diabetes mellitus: multimodal MRI reveals the association between hippocampal and subcortical structures dysfunction and cognitive decline.
papers.authors: Chen W, Li M, Liu WV, Zheng Y, Zhang Z, Huang W, Huang S, Zhou H.
papers.abstract: Objective To investigate the efficiency of neurovascular coupling (NVC) in hippocampal and subcortical structures in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and its relations with cognition and glycemic control, and to characterize multimodal MRI features of T2DM-related cognitive decline. Methods Forty-nine T2DM patients and 43 healthy controls underwent montreal cognitive assessment (MoCA), digit span (DST), clock drawing (CDT), and fasting blood glucose (FBG)/glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) measurement. High-resolution T1-weighted structural images, three-dimensional arterial spin labeling (3D-ASL) perfusion images, and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) were acquired on a 3T scanner. Volumes, cerebral blood flow (CBF), fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF), regional homogeneity (ReHo), degree centrality (DC), and NVC were calculated for bilateral hippocampus, amygdala, anterior thalamus, caudate, nucleus accumbens, putamen, and globus pallidus. Partial correlations assessed associations between imaging metrics, glycemic parameters, and MoCA scores. Results T2DM had significantly lower MoCA (P < 0.05) but no differences in DST or CDT. Right anterior thalamic volume was reduced. CBF decreased in bilateral hippocampus, bilateral anterior thalamus, and right amygdala. ReHo reduced in right anterior thalamus and left amygdala. NVC decreased in left hippocampus and left amygdala. No basal ganglia differences were found. MoCA negatively correlated with FBG (r = -0.405) and positively with right thalamic volume (r = 0.311). HbA1c and FBG negatively correlated with left anterior thalamic CBF (r = -0.344 and -0.367, P < 0.05). Conclusions T2DM shows decreased perfusion, reduced regional synchronization, and neurovascular uncoupling in limbic-subcortical structures including hippocampus, anterior thalamus, amygdala, while basal ganglia motor circuits are preserved. Multimodal MRI metrics may provide imaging targets for early identification and intervention.

relevance.reason: 多模态MRI研究2型糖尿病患者的皮层下/海马结构与灌注、功能活动及神经血管耦合改变，并关联认知下降，涉及脑结构与功能组织及疾病相关认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注2型糖尿病患者的认知下降是否与海马及皮层下结构的神经血管耦合异常有关，采用多模态MRI结合认知量表和血糖指标，比较患者与健康对照。结果显示，患者总体认知评分较低，右侧前丘脑体积缩小，双侧海马、双侧前丘脑和右侧杏仁核血流灌注下降，右侧前丘脑和左侧杏仁核局部同步性减弱，左侧海马和左侧杏仁核出现神经血管解耦；基底节未见明显差异。认知评分与空腹血糖负相关、与右侧丘脑体积正相关，血糖指标与左侧前丘脑灌注负相关。作者据此提出，糖尿病相关认知下降可能涉及边缘-皮层下结构的灌注与耦合异常，而基底节运动环路相对保留，这些影像指标或有助于早期识别，但相关关系尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: Use of structure-function coupling to assess compensatory motor cortex flexibility and predict postoperative motor outcomes in patients with motor area gliomas.
papers.authors: Wang X, Yu T, Zhang X, Zhao X, Li M, Li H, Zuo Z, Cui Y, Ren X, Lin S, Zhou D.
papers.abstract: Objective The objective of this study was to investigate the mechanisms of motor compensation in glioma patients by quantifying both the structural decoupling index (SDI) value and the integrity of transcallosal white matter tracts. The authors aimed to evaluate their individual and combined utility in predicting long-term postoperative motor outcomes. Methods Seventy patients with motor area gliomas and 23 healthy controls were retrospectively included. All participants underwent preoperative 3T resting-state fMRI and diffusion MRI. The SDI value was computed using a graph signal processing approach to quantify the decoupling between functional activity and structural connectivity. White matter integrity and disconnection severity of the corpus callosum were assessed using TractSeg and tractography. Motor function was evaluated using the Medical Research Council scale preoperatively and at the 3-month follow-up. Statistical analyses included group comparisons, correlation analyses, and multivariate logistic regression to identify predictors of severe motor impairment (SMI). Results Glioma patients exhibited altered SDI values in motor-related regions, including the precentral gyrus and thalamus. A higher SDI value in the contralateral precentral gyrus was associated with better motor recovery (p = 0.00025), while greater disconnection severity in the anterior midbody of the corpus callosum (CC4) correlated with poorer motor function (p = 0.00041). Multivariate analysis identified IDH-wildtype status, higher CC4 disconnection severity, and lower contralateral precentral gyrus SDI value as independent predictors of SMI. A nomogram integrating these factors showed excellent predictive accuracy (C-index = 0.914). Conclusions The SDI captures adaptive functional decoupling in the contralateral motor cortex, which may be associated with compensatory mechanisms in glioma patients. Combined with callosal integrity, the SDI enhances the prediction of postoperative motor outcomes, offering a novel biomarker for preoperative risk stratification and personalized rehabilitation planning.

relevance.reason: 研究胶质瘤患者运动皮层结构-功能解耦与代偿可塑性，涉及脑网络组织及术后运动功能机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对运动区胶质瘤患者，用静息态功能磁共振与弥散磁共振计算结构解耦指数（SDI），并结合胼胝体白质纤维束完整性，考察二者对术后远期运动结局的预测价值。结果显示，患者运动相关脑区的SDI发生改变；对侧中央前回SDI较高与运动恢复较好相关，而胼胝体前中体部离断越严重，运动功能越差。多因素分析中，IDH野生型、胼胝体离断严重程度和对侧中央前回SDI共同预测严重运动障碍，整合这些因素的列线图预测准确性较高。作者认为，SDI可能反映对侧运动皮层的代偿性功能解耦，与胼胝体完整性结合有助于术前风险评估和康复规划；上述关联的因果性质尚不明确。

papers.title: Cortical development in patients with metopic craniosynostosis.
papers.authors: Tio PAE, Tjaberinga MC, Wijnbergen DC, Gaillard L, Dremmen MHG, Pleumeekers MM, van Veelen MC, Vrooman HA, Mathijssen IMJ.
papers.abstract: Objective Patients with metopic synostosis have an increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders, despite a minimal risk of intracranial hypertension. While mechanical constraint due to premature suture fusion has been proposed as a contributing factor, evidence suggests intrinsic brain malformations may play a more significant role. Cortical thickness, volume, and surface area alterations have been implicated in neurodevelopmental disorders, yet their role in metopic synostosis remains unclear. In this retrospective study, authors investigated whether these cortical parameters are altered in patients with metopic synostosis compared with those in healthy controls. Methods 3D T1-weighted MRI brain scans from patients 0-2 years of age with metopic synostosis were reviewed. Children born preterm or with a syndromic condition were excluded. MRI brain scans of patients and age-matched controls were processed using the Infant FreeSurfer pipeline to quantify cortical thickness, cortical volume, cortical surface area, and intracranial volume. Linear regression models adjusted for age, sex, and intracranial volume were used to compare global cortical thickness, cortical volume, and cortical surface area between the groups, with secondary analyses of these metrics at the lobular level. Results Sixty-four patients with metopic synostosis and 32 controls (median age at MRI 8.4 months [IQR 4.84] and 12.4 months [IQR 9.68], respectively) were eligible for inclusion. Patients with metopic synostosis had a significantly increased cortical surface area compared to that in controls (p = 0.029). No significant differences were found in global cortical thickness (p = 0.281) or total cortical volume (p = 0.141) between patients and controls. Conclusions Increased cortical surface area is observed in patients with metopic synostosis; however, there are no significant differences in cortical thickness and volume. Similar developmental trajectories have been observed in infants with neurodevelopmental disorders. These findings shift the focus from mechanical deformation to fundamental brain development pathways in patients with metopic synostosis.

relevance.reason: 研究颅缝早闭患儿皮层厚度、体积、表面积等脑结构发育改变，属脑发育与结构-功能范畴，并以脑发育异常理解神经发育障碍。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注额缝早闭患者是否存在皮层厚度、体积和表面积等皮层参数的改变，回顾性比较了0至2岁额缝早闭患儿与年龄匹配健康对照的3D T1加权脑MRI，并用婴儿FreeSurfer流程量化上述指标。结果显示，患儿整体皮层表面积较对照组显著增大，而整体皮层厚度和总皮层体积未见显著差异。作者据此认为，额缝早闭相关的神经发育风险可能更多与皮层表面积增大所反映的脑发育路径有关，而非单纯机械压迫；这一模式与神经发育障碍婴儿中观察到的发育轨迹相似，但研究为横断面关联，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Understanding Understanding: Reconnecting Theories of Human Semantic Knowledge.
papers.authors: Rogers TT.
papers.abstract: At the close of the twentieth century, human semantic memory was thought to be organized around dedicated, domain-specific modules operating independently of one another and of perception, action, and much of language. The intervening years have marked a transition toward a more holistic view in which semantics emerges from learned mappings among sensory, motor, and language representations, with recent work beginning to integrate semantic representation with theories of cognitive control and attention. This article reviews the reasons for this remarkable change in perspective, provides a snapshot of our current understanding of semantics in the mind and brain, and considers how this understanding may change in light of new innovations in artificial intelligence.

relevance.reason: 综述人脑语义知识的心理与脑组织理论，涉及语义表征与语言、感知运动映射，符合语言与认知神经机制框架。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了语义记忆理论从二十世纪末到近年的转变：语义知识曾被视为由彼此独立、且与知觉、动作和语言相对分离的专门领域模块组织，如今则转向更整体的观点，认为语义来自感觉、运动和语言表征之间习得的映射，近期研究还开始把语义表征与认知控制和注意理论结合起来。文章回顾了这一视角转变的原因，概述了当前对心智与大脑中语义的理解，并讨论了人工智能的新进展可能如何改变这种理解。

papers.title: Brain gray matter changes across chronic pain trajectories: MRI evidence from 35,000 individuals.
papers.authors: Zorina-Lichtenwalter K, Bango CI, Petre B, Rader L, Čeko M, Lindquist MA, Friedman NP, Wager TD.
papers.abstract: Abstract Chronic pain affects brain gray matter structure, but the magnitude, pattern, and reversibility of brain changes upon pain recovery remain unclear because of inconsistent findings from small-scale studies. We analyzed data from 35,052 UK Biobank participants who completed chronic pain assessments at 2 time points, approximately 9 years apart, evaluating pain lasting 3 months or more, across 8 body sites. Brain magnetic resonance imaging data were available from the second time point. Participants were grouped into 4 categories: Pain-free controls, New chronic pain, Persistent chronic pain, and Resolved chronic pain. We examined relationships between these categories and 313 brain-wide measures across cortical surface area, cortical thickness, and subcortical volume. New chronic pain was associated with surface area reductions in sensorimotor, temporo-parietal, and medial and lateral prefrontal cortices. Persistent chronic pain showed larger and more widespread area reductions and mixed changes in cortical thickness and subcortical volumes, including cerebellar atrophy and hypertrophy in the thalamus and basal ganglia. Resolved pain demonstrated reversibility of most brain changes, except sustained surface area reductions in the primary somatosensory cortex. No areas showed effects consistent with a predisposition to pain. Brain structural changes in chronic pain reflect adaptive neuroplasticity rather than irreversible damage or preexisting vulnerability. Most changes appear reversible with pain resolution, underscoring the importance of effective pain treatment to alleviate symptoms and support recovery of brain structure and function.

relevance.reason: 研究慢性疼痛轨迹与全脑灰质表面积、厚度及皮层下体积的关系，属于感知（疼痛）的脑结构基础与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于大型人群的脑磁共振数据，考察慢性疼痛不同转归轨迹与全脑灰质结构的关系，比较无痛、新发、持续和已缓解四类人群的皮层表面积、皮层厚度及皮层下体积。结果显示，新发慢性疼痛伴随感觉运动、颞顶及前额皮层表面积减小；持续疼痛者改变范围更广，并出现皮层厚度和皮层下体积的混合变化；疼痛缓解后多数改变可逆，仅初级躯体感觉皮层的表面积减小持续存在。作者据此认为，慢性疼痛的脑结构变化更符合适应性神经可塑性，而非不可逆损伤或疼痛易感性，且多数变化随疼痛缓解而恢复，提示有效镇痛治疗对脑结构恢复的意义。

papers.title: Electroconvulsive therapy shifting brain dynamics toward more adaptive and integrated states in treatment-resistant depression based on a hidden markov model.
papers.authors: Li T, Zhang L, Han Y, Guo Z, Yao P, Chen L, Yuan Y, Zhao J, Ou Y, Lv D, Guo W.
papers.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the American Society for Experimental NeuroTherapeutics
papers.abstract: Treatment-resistant depression (TRD) is characterized by persistent symptoms and poor response to conventional therapies, yet its dynamic neural mechanisms and treatment-related changes remain incompletely understood. This study applied a hidden Markov model (HMM) combined with neurotransmitter atlas mapping to investigate whole-brain spatiotemporal dynamics in TRD and their modulation by electroconvulsive therapy (ECT). Resting-state fMRI data were collected from 72 TRD patients (52 completing follow-up) and 63 healthy controls. HMM identified six recurring brain states defined by distinct patterns of functional connectivity and averaged functional activity. At baseline, TRD patients showed reduced occupancy and stability of globally coordinated states and increased engagement of subcortical-dominant states, indicating impaired global stability and disrupted cortical-subcortical balance. After ECT, clinical symptoms improved significantly, accompanied by increased occupancy of states characterized by higher activity within the default mode and frontoparietal networks, as well as a highly integrated whole-brain state. These changes suggest improved overall brain coordination and cortical engagement rather than full normalization of baseline abnormalities. In contrast, subcortical-dominant states persisted after treatment, consistent with trait-like features of TRD. Neurotransmitter mapping showed that treatment-responsive states were associated with serotonergic, dopaminergic, and glutamatergic systems, whereas persistent subcortical states were linked to noradrenergic and cholinergic markers. Overall, these findings suggest that ECT improves symptoms by shifting brain dynamics toward more adaptive and integrated states, rather than fully restoring baseline function. This dynamic perspective provides new insight into the neural mechanisms of TRD and its treatment.

relevance.reason: 研究难治性抑郁患者静息态fMRI全脑动态状态及ECT治疗后的脑网络重组，属脑疾病认知/网络机制与静息态脑组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注难治性抑郁症患者全脑时空动态及其受电休克治疗调节的机制，采用隐马尔可夫模型结合神经递质图谱映射，分析患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振数据。基线时患者整体协调状态的出现比例和稳定性下降，皮层下主导状态参与增多，提示全局稳定性受损及皮层—皮层下平衡紊乱；治疗后临床症状改善，默认网络和额顶网络活动较高的状态及高度整合的全脑状态出现增多，但皮层下主导状态持续存在。作者据此认为，电休克治疗是推动脑动态向更适应、更整合的状态转变，而非完全恢复正常，并将治疗响应相关状态与血清素、多巴胺和谷氨酸系统联系起来。

papers.title: A systematic review of the maturation of selected cortical auditory event-related potentials in passive paradigms: Developmental changes from infancy to early adulthood.
papers.authors: Martin I, Arora J, Hamill L, Cho E, Scanavini G, Radanovic A, Shaukat L, Hill NJ, Shah SA, Alkhoury L.
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers a unique window into the neural dynamics of cognition, particularly through event-related potentials (ERPs) that index sensory, attentional, and cognitive processes. EEG and ERP measures are widely used to study atypical neurodevelopment in children due to their sensitivity to disruptions caused by genetic and acquired brain disorders. We conducted a systematic review of the literature on the typical presentation of four core cortical auditory and language-related ERP components, extracted during passive paradigms, from infancy to early adulthood. These components reflect neural responses to the passive perception of discrete stimuli (N100), the automatic detection of deviant stimuli (Mismatch Negativity (MMN), sometimes in children referred to as the Mismatch Response (MMR)), the allocation of attention to deviant stimuli (P3a), and language processing of discrete stimuli (N400). Drawing from 61 studies, many of which reported on a single component within a specific age range, we chart developmental trajectories of ERP latencies, amplitudes, and scalp topographies. Across all components, latency tended to decrease with increasing age. Amplitude trajectories varied: N100 amplitude tended to decrease; MMN amplitude remained relatively stable or showed a slight decline; P3a amplitude typically increased during early childhood before decreasing in early school age; N400 amplitude consistently declined. Scalp topographical reports, among all components, revealed a shift toward increased focal activation with increasing age. Together, these findings provide a normative foundation for acoustic and auditory language processing in the context of the selected components in typical development, serving as a necessary reference point for understanding and assessing atypical development.

relevance.reason: 系统综述婴幼儿至成年早期被动范式下听觉及语言相关ERP成分的发育轨迹，涉及人脑听觉语言加工与注意的神经发育。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了婴儿期至成年早期被动范式下四种皮层听觉与语言相关ERP成分的典型发育表现，包括N100、失匹配负波（儿童中有时称失匹配反应）、P3a和N400，共纳入61项研究，其中不少仅报告特定年龄段内的单一成分。总体来看，各成分的潜伏期随年龄增长趋于缩短；波幅变化则因成分而异：N100波幅倾向下降，失匹配负波波幅相对稳定或略有降低，P3a波幅在幼儿期通常上升、学龄早期后下降，N400波幅持续降低。头皮地形报告还显示，随年龄增长激活趋于更加集中。作者据此勾勒出各成分的发育轨迹，为典型发育中的声学与听觉语言加工提供常模基础，并作为理解和评估非典型发育的参照。

papers.title: Altered neural prioritization of auditory information during cross-modal attention in children with ADHD.
papers.authors: Yang L, Wang Y, Yin W, Xu X, Yuan X, Yang H, Zhang S, Jiang S, Guo Y, Wang Y, Yang C, Zhou Y, Li D, Song Y, Dang CP.
papers.abstract: Efficient auditory attention requires prioritizing target over nontarget information. Although attention deficits are a core feature of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), the neural mechanisms underlying auditory prioritization during cross-modal attention remain unclear. We examined neural differentiation between target and nontarget auditory information in children with ADHD. Ninety-five school-aged children (mean age = 10.81 years), including 46 children with ADHD and 49 typically developing (TD) children, performed a visually cued auditory spatial attention task during electroencephalography (EEG) recording. Auditory selective attention was assessed using the N2-anterior-contralateral (N2ac) component and multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA). TD children showed enhanced MVPA decoding of target locations and reduced decoding of nontarget locations. Greater target-nontarget neural differentiation was associated with larger N2ac amplitudes. In contrast, children with ADHD showed reduced target lateralization, smaller N2ac amplitudes, weaker target decoding, and enhanced decoding of nontarget locations, resulting in diminished neural differentiation between relevant and irrelevant auditory information. Reduced target-related lateralization was associated with greater response-time variability, whereas reduced target decoding accuracy was linked to more severe hyperactivity-impulsivity symptoms. Together, these findings indicate that children with ADHD show altered neural prioritization of auditory information within a visually cued attention context. Altered neural prioritization was associated with behavioral variability and symptom severity, providing new insights into the neurocognitive mechanisms underlying attentional dysfunction in ADHD.

relevance.reason: EEG研究揭示ADHD儿童跨模态注意中听觉信息神经优先化的改变及其与症状的关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察ADHD儿童在跨通道注意中如何对听觉信息进行神经优先化，用脑电记录视觉线索引导的听觉空间注意任务。典型发育儿童对目标位置神经解码更强、对非目标解码较弱，目标与非目标区分明显；ADHD儿童目标侧化与解码减弱、非目标解码增强，二者神经区分下降。这种优先化异常与反应时变异性增大及多动冲动症状更重相关，提示其可能涉及ADHD注意功能障碍的神经认知机制。

papers.title: 40 Hz transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation enhances verbal free recall in healthy adults by modulating frontal theta oscillations.
papers.authors: Luo Y, Yin S, Chen L, Gao H, Zhao P, Wen H.
papers.abstract: Background Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) is a non-invasive neuromodulation approach that may influence memory-related brain activity. Theta oscillations are closely related to episodic memory processing, but it remains unclear whether taVNS modulates memory-related theta activity in a frequency-specific manner and how these effects change after stimulation. Objective This study investigated the sustained effects of 20 Hz and 40 Hz taVNS on free recall and resting-state EEG theta oscillations in healthy young adults. Methods Forty-four participants were enrolled in this randomized, single-blind, sham-controlled, three-arm parallel-group study. They were randomly assigned to the sham stimulation group, the 20 Hz taVNS group, or the 40 Hz taVNS group. Free recall performance was assessed before and after stimulation, and resting-state EEG was recorded at baseline and multiple time points after stimulation. Results The results showed that participants receiving 40 Hz taVNS exhibited better free recall performance than those receiving sham stimulation or 20 Hz stimulation. 40 Hz taVNS increased the relative power of theta waves, particularly in the frontal region. This enhancement was an immediate increase followed by a gradual decrease over time. Frontal theta activity and stimulation-induced theta changes were positively correlated with free recall performance. Furthermore, exploratory Bayesian mediation analysis supported a theta-dependent model. Conclusion This study suggests that 40 Hz taVNS may promote verbal free recall performance by inducing transient enhancement of frontal theta wave activity, providing preliminary evidence for the modulation of memory-related neural oscillations by frequency-specific taVNS.

relevance.reason: 研究40Hz耳迷走神经刺激通过调节额叶theta振荡增强健康成人言语自由回忆，涉及记忆的神经振荡机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康年轻成人中考察不同频率经皮耳迷走神经刺激对词语自由回忆及静息态脑电θ振荡的影响，采用随机、单盲、假刺激对照的三组设计，比较假刺激、20 Hz与40 Hz刺激。结果显示，仅40 Hz组在刺激后表现出优于假刺激组和20 Hz组的自由回忆成绩，并伴随额区θ相对功率的即时升高，随后逐渐回落；额区θ活动及其刺激诱发变化与回忆成绩正相关，探索性贝叶斯中介分析支持θ依赖模型。作者据此提出，40 Hz刺激可能通过短暂增强额区θ振荡促进词语自由回忆，为频率特异性调控记忆相关神经振荡提供了初步证据，但样本与设计仍属初步，尚不能推及临床疗效。

papers.title: Effects of regularization on the stability and behavioral relevance of VAR-based functional connectivity.
papers.authors: Masaoka K, Li R, Kasagi A, Matsui T.
papers.abstract: Vector autoregressive modeling (VAR) is a powerful method for estimating dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. However, VAR-based dFC can become unstable when only limited data are available. We compared multiple regularization approaches (PLS, PCA, Ridge, and Lasso) to examine whether they can stabilize VAR-based dFC without substantially compromising behaviorally relevant information. All regularization methods improved stability. Behavioral measure prediction improved and reached a level comparable to Pearson correlation-based FC, except Lasso. These findings suggest that regularized VAR-based dFC can provide behaviorally relevant information about temporal dynamics not represented in Pearson correlation-based FC.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态fMRI动态功能连接估计方法及其行为相关性，属静息态脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注向量自回归建模在静息态功能磁共振数据中估计动态功能连接时，因数据有限而出现不稳定的问题，并比较了偏最小二乘、主成分分析、Ridge和Lasso等正则化方法能否在稳定动态连接的同时保留与行为相关的信息。结果显示，各正则化方法均提升了稳定性；除Lasso外，行为指标的预测表现也有所改善，并达到与基于Pearson相关的功能连接相当的水平。作者据此认为，经正则化的VAR动态连接可提供Pearson相关功能连接未能体现的、与行为相关的时间动态信息。

papers.title: The neural architecture of social threat: A meta-analytic comparison of indirect and direct social threat.
papers.authors: Bonacina G, Wagels L, Habel U, Wilkin-Krug LCM, O'Leary A, Boccadoro S.
papers.abstract: Indirect and Direct Social Threat (IST and DST) are related but partially distinct forms of interpersonal adversity defined along two dimensions: threat perception, the explicitness and salience of harm, and behavioural reciprocity, the extent of bidirectional contingency and response opportunity. IST involves ambiguous or socially devaluing contexts with limited reciprocity, whereas DST entails overt hostility, clear antagonism, and reciprocal engagement. This distinction shows conceptual parallels with findings from rodent models of social interaction. We tested this framework using a coordinate-based Activation Likelihood Estimation (ALE) meta-analysis of human neuroimaging studies comprising 28 IST contrasts (N = 1081) and 28 DST contrasts (N = 855), with cluster-level family-wise error correction (p<.05). Findings were interpreted alongside passive and agonistic animal paradigms. Conjunction analysis identified shared spatial convergence in the left anterior insula (AI) extending into the inferior frontal gyrus (IFG), consistent with salience-detection and regulatory processes. ALE contrast analysis showed stronger convergence for DST than IST in the right AI, bilateral claustrum, and anterior and mid-cingulate cortices, regions implicated in motivational salience and action preparation; no clusters emerged for IST relative to DST. Predicted IST-specific convergence in the temporoparietal junction and posterior cingulate cortex, and DST-related convergence in the amygdala and ventral striatum, were not observed. This pattern is conceptually consistent with animal evidence associating reciprocal threat with defensive readiness and action selection. Overall, findings partially support the framework: threat perception and behavioural reciprocity may help organize neural responses to social threat, while correspondence with passive-agonistic animal models remains provisional.

relevance.reason: 对人脑社会威胁加工的ALE元分析，揭示直接/间接社会威胁的脑区汇聚差异，属社会认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该元分析比较间接与直接社会威胁的神经基础，基于人类影像研究坐标做激活似然估计，并参照动物被动与对抗范式解读。结果显示，两者在左侧前岛叶至额下回有共同汇聚，符合凸显检测与调节；直接威胁在右侧前岛叶、双侧屏状核及前中扣带皮层汇聚更强，这些区域涉及动机凸显与动作准备，而间接威胁未出现更强汇聚。作者预期中的颞顶联合区、后扣带、杏仁核和腹侧纹状体差异未获支持。总体而言，威胁感知与行为互惠性可部分组织社会威胁的神经反应，但与动物模型的对应仍是初步的。

papers.title: Frontal lead in preterm functional brain maturation.
papers.authors: Mader J, Hartmann M, Klebermass-Schrehof K, Werther T, Dressler A, Koren J, Kasprian G, Schmidbauer V, Fuiko R, Oberdorfer L, Pointner N, Berger A, Kluge T, Giordano V.
papers.abstract: Understanding how brain maturation unfolds in preterm neonates is critical for both neuroscience and clinical care. Structural MRI suggests that the frontal cortex develop late, yet EEG offers a direct window into functional activity that follows a different trajectory. We analysed 211 EEG recordings from 62 preterm neonates (25-40 weeks postmenstrual age, PMA) using convolutional neural networks trained on single channels to estimate functional brain age (FBA). We introduced the spatial difference in FBA (sd_FBA) metric, which quantifies the relative maturity of each channel compared with all others within a recording. sd_FBA revealed a consistent maturation gradient, frontal regions exhibited the highest sd_FBA, followed by central regions, whereas occipital and temporal regions showed lower values. With increasing PMA, central maturation converged with frontal values, while occipital regions remained significantly lower. Functional maturation in preterm infants follows a clear frontal-occipital gradient, in contrast to structural MRI findings. The sd_FBA metric provides a novel, normalized index for tracking regional maturation, offering a new tool to understand functional brain development and potentially improve neurodevelopmental risk stratification.

relevance.reason: 用早产儿EEG估计功能脑龄并揭示额-枕成熟梯度，属脑发育与功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产儿大脑功能成熟的空间顺序，用卷积神经网络从单通道脑电记录估计功能脑龄，并据此提出通道间功能脑龄差异指标，以刻画各脑区相对成熟度。结果显示，早产儿功能成熟呈现稳定的额区领先、枕颞区落后的梯度；随着月经后年龄增加，中央区逐渐接近额区水平，而枕区仍明显较低。作者指出，这一额-枕梯度与结构磁共振所提示的额叶发育较晚不同，该指标或有助于追踪区域功能成熟并辅助神经发育风险分层，但其临床价值仍需进一步验证。
