papers.title: Obstructive sleep apnea severity associates with reduced phase-lag index functional connectivity during N2 sleep.
papers.authors: Lee H, Lee E.
papers.abstract: Purpose Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is increasingly recognized as a risk factor for cognitive impairment and dementia. We investigated stage- and frequency-specific associations between OSA severity and both conventional spectral measures and phase-lag index (PLI)-based functional connectivity. Methods We retrospectively analyzed polysomnography data from 50 patients (mean age 51.7 ± 14.3 years, 70% male) diagnosed with OSA or primary snoring. Six-channel EEG data were analyzed using conventional spectral power ratios (alpha+beta/theta+delta) and PLI-based functional connectivity across delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands. Pearson correlations assessed associations between apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) and EEG parameters across wakefulness, N2 sleep, and REM sleep. Results Median AHI was 25.7 [IQR: 7.2-48.3]. Conventional spectral measures showed no significant AHI correlations in any sleep stage. PLI analysis revealed stage- and frequency-specific associations: during N2 sleep, AHI negatively correlated with delta-band PLI (r = -0.335, 95% CI -0.588 to -0.021, p = 0.037) and theta-band PLI (r = -0.326, 95% CI -0.582 to -0.012, p = 0.043). No significant associations were observed during wakefulness or REM sleep. Conclusion Functional connectivity analysis identified stage-specific associations with OSA severity that were not observed with conventional spectral measures, suggesting that PLI-based connectivity may provide complementary information on OSA-related neural network alterations.

relevance.reason: 研究OSA严重程度与睡眠EEG功能连接的关系，反映睡眠中脑网络组织改变，属认知相关脑网络机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）严重程度是否与不同睡眠阶段和频段的脑电功能连接相关，回顾性分析了50名确诊OSA或单纯打鼾患者的睡眠脑电数据，比较常规频谱指标与基于相位滞后指数的功能连接。结果显示，常规频谱指标在各睡眠阶段均与呼吸暂停低通气指数无显著相关；而在N2睡眠期，OSA严重程度越高，delta和theta频段的相位滞后指数连接越低，清醒期和REM期则未见此类关联。作者据此认为，基于相位滞后指数的功能连接可能提供常规频谱分析未捕捉到的、与OSA相关的神经网络改变信息，但这一关联性发现尚需进一步研究验证。

papers.title: Combined population and patient-specific brain networks predict electrical stimulation propagation
papers.authors: Lavelle SB, Ojemann WKS, Jaskir M, Zou Z, Aguila CA, Walsh K, Feys O, Zhou DJ, Davis KA, Litt B, Conrad EC, Sinha N.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Objective Cortico-cortical evoked potentials (CCEPs) are used during intracranial EEG (iEEG) monitoring to probe effective connectivity and guide epilepsy surgery. However, the factors governing spatial distribution and variability of stimulation-evoked responses across patients remain incompletely understood, making it difficult to distinguish physiological variation from pathological responses. We aimed to develop interpretable models of CCEP responses that integrate normative and patient-specific features, and to assess how these relationships are influenced by distance, brain-state, and epileptogenicity. Methods We analyzed single-pulse stimulation data from 34 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing stereo-EEG monitoring. Significant CCEP responses were defined using N1 peak amplitude. For each stimulation-response pair, we derived multimodal features capturing Euclidean distance, effective connectivity priors from F-TRACT, a published population atlas of CCEP response probabilities, normative structural connectivity and communication metrics, and patient-specific functional connectivity estimated from iEEG during baseline and pre-stimulation periods. Lasso-regularized logistic regression models were trained to predict response using leave-one-patient-out cross-validation, and feature importance was examined across spatial scales and seizure onset zone (SOZ) involvement. Results Performance to predict stimulation-evoked responses improved with the integration of multiple feature domains, with the full model achieving the highest accuracy (median AUC = 0.84). Feature relevance varied with spatial scale: short-range responses were dominated by distance and normative priors, whereas long-range responses depended strongly on patient-specific functional connectivity, especially when measured from pre-stimulation periods. Prediction errors were significantly higher for stimulation-response pairs within the SOZ, indicating deviations from normative connectivity-response relationships in epileptogenic networks. Significance CCEP responses reflect an interaction between spatial constraints, network architecture, and patient-specific brain state. Multimodal modeling of CCEPs provides a principled framework to interpret stimulation responses and may offer complementary markers for identifying epileptogenic networks during presurgical evaluation.

relevance.reason: 该研究以癫痫患者颅内电生理数据探究刺激诱发反应的空间分布与网络机制，涉及有效连接、结构先验与患者功能连接，属于脑网络组织及癫痫网络机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析药物难治性癫痫患者接受颅内脑电监测时的单脉冲电刺激数据，结合距离、群体图谱先验、结构连接及患者个体功能连接等多模态特征，建立可解释模型预测皮层-皮层诱发电位是否出现。结果显示，整合多类特征后预测表现最佳，且不同空间尺度下关键因素不同：短程反应更依赖距离和群体先验，长程反应更依赖患者个体功能连接，尤其是刺激前状态下的连接。研究还发现，位于致痫区内的刺激-反应对预测误差更高，提示致痫网络偏离了常规的连接-反应关系。作者据此认为，这类反应受空间约束、网络结构和患者脑状态共同影响，多模态建模有助于解释刺激反应，并可能为术前识别致痫网络提供补充线索。

papers.title: Person-specific intrinsic-timescale topographies persist from rest into sentence processing
papers.authors: Di Giovanni D, Toivonen I, Northoff G.
papers.abstract: Language processing does not occur in a vacuum. Language comprehension and production have its own temporal organization, and it unfolds against ongoing neural. We examined whether the base organization persists from rest into sentence processing, and we further examined how it relates to evoked responses and semantic decisions. Sentences crossed linguistic argument versus adjunct completions with semantic plausibility. Anomalies elicited a centroparietal late positivity from 600 to 900 ms (+0.628 µV, 95% CI 0.349–0.907). Channel-wise autocorrelation timescales formed person-specific topographies: own-person rest–task similarity exceeded mismatched-person similarity (Fisher-z advantage = 0.463, permutation P = 5.00 × 10 −6 ), identifying 78.6% of participants against 7.1% chance. The advantage survived Cz re-referencing and surface-Laplacian transformation. In separate ERP predictor tests, longer absolute task timescales accompanied a smaller anomaly effect (cross-fitted Spearman ρ = −0.486, Holm-adjusted P = 0.030). Stronger topographic continuity also accompanied greater anomaly-related decision slowing, although the behavioral association fell short of correction across six endpoints (ρ = 0.547, familywise P = 0.054). Supporting analyses evaluated larger eligible samples and an eyes-closed subset. The findings place persistent, person-specific temporal organization within sentence processing and link absolute task timescale to the neural response to semantic anomaly.

relevance.reason: 研究句子语义异常加工的ERP及静息态时间尺度地形图延续到语言任务，涉及语言神经机制与静息-任务组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察个体特异的静息态时间尺度拓扑能否延续到句子加工中，并分析其与语义异常诱发反应及语义判断的关系。研究比较静息与句子任务下的通道自相关时间尺度，发现同一被试的静息—任务相似性高于跨被试匹配，表明时间组织具有稳定的个体特异性；任务中绝对时间尺度越长，语义异常引发的晚期正波效应越小，拓扑连续性越强则异常相关判断越慢，但后者未通过多重校正。结果提示句子加工建立在持续存在的个体化时间组织之上，且该组织与语义异常的电生理和行为反应相关。

papers.title: Regional alignment with sex-typical brain architecture, maternal health and environmental enrichment predict psychiatric symptoms in early life
papers.authors: Petrican R, de Pascalis L, Mugatroyd C, Fallon V, Pendered S, Vaz T.
papers.abstract: Robust sex differences in brain morphology and function exist from birth onwards. While traditionally conceptualized as categorical, they were recently shown to be best described along a female-to-male continuum. Here, we probed the under-explored implications of this proposal for understanding early life vulnerability to psychiatric conditions with sex-biased prevalence. We analyzed environmental, clinical and resting state functional neuroimaging data from 411 participants in Developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP) and 214 children from the Oregon ADHD 1000 study. In the dHCP, we identified complementary patterns of neonatal alignment with sex-typical young adult architecture, which overlapped areas rich in nicotinic cholinergic receptors and predicted the same psychiatric symptoms across sexes in toddlerhood. Specifically, for association (compared to sensorimotor) areas, greater alignment with female-typical functional connectivity (FC) patterns foreshadowed higher anxiety, whereas greater alignment with male-typical FC patterns forecasted autism-related problems. The latter effect was weaker among toddlers with an older epigenetic age at birth and exposure to fewer maternal health problems, but greater environmental enrichment. In the independent child sample, patterns of alignment with sex-typical FC, overlapping those observed in neonates, distinguished a history of depression and generalized anxiety (greater alignment with female-typical FC) from a history of separation anxiety, behavioral problems and current ADHD (greater alignment with male-typical FC). Our study speaks to the psychiatric relevance of sex-related functional brain architecture from birth onwards, its value in identifying vulnerable youths and its promise in monitoring the success of environmental interventions.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用新生儿及儿童静息态功能连接，考察与性别典型脑功能架构的对齐模式如何预测早期精神症状，涉及脑功能组织与精神疾病易感性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨新生儿大脑功能连接与性别典型模式的吻合程度能否预示幼童期精神症状，分析了两个独立队列的环境、临床与静息态功能磁共振数据。结果显示，在联合皮层区域，与女性典型连接模式吻合度较高者日后焦虑更明显，与男性典型模式吻合度较高者则更多出现自闭症相关问题；后者在表观遗传年龄较大、母亲健康问题较少和环境丰富度较高的幼儿中较弱。独立儿童样本中，类似的吻合模式还能区分不同精神症状史。作者据此认为，性别相关的功能脑架构自出生起就与精神疾病易感性相关，或有助于识别脆弱儿童并监测环境干预效果。

papers.title: Higher-order topology uncovers the multidimensional dynamics of naturalistic emotion
papers.authors: Zaffina L, Diano M, Petruso F, Preti MG, Amico E, Morgenroth E, Petri G, Van De Ville D, Vuilleumier P, Santoro A.
papers.abstract: Emotions are thought to emerge from co-activation among distributed brain systems, yet traditional fMRI analyses typically examine localized responses and pairwise connections, potentially overlooking interactions among groups of regions. Here, we use time-resolved higher-order topology to characterize these group interactions during naturalistic viewing of 14 films totaling over 2.5 h, continuously annotated across 50 affective features. The homological scaffold, representing evolving group-level topology, most closely tracks recurrent emotional states and best predicts fine-grained affective profiles. This sensitivity diminishes when emotion is compressed into dimensions of valence, arousal, and power, where pairwise connectivity captures the dominant arousal signal. Across three independent datasets, arousal predictions transfer most robustly through pairwise connectivity, while the relative geometry of broad affective states remains conserved across film narratives despite poor valence generalization. These findings reveal complementary neural representations of emotion: higher-order topology captures fine-grained affective structure, whereas pairwise connectivity provides a portable readout of broad arousal.

relevance.reason: 研究自然观看电影时fMRI高阶拓扑与情绪状态的神经表征，属情绪认知机制与自然刺激脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然情境下情绪体验如何由分布式脑系统协同产生，并比较了传统成对连接分析与高阶拓扑刻画群体脑区交互的能力。作者利用时间分辨的高阶拓扑方法，分析受试者在观看多部电影时的fMRI信号，并将之与连续标注的多维情感特征对应。结果显示，反映群体层面拓扑演化的同调支架最能追踪反复出现的情绪状态，也最能预测细粒度情感剖面；但当情绪被压缩为效价、唤醒和支配等少数维度时，这种优势减弱，成对连接反而能捕捉主要的唤醒信号。跨数据集分析进一步表明，唤醒预测通过成对连接迁移最稳健，而广泛情绪状态的相对几何结构在不同影片叙事间保持守恒，效价泛化则较差。作者据此提出两类互补的情绪神经表征：高阶拓扑承载细粒度情感结构，成对连接提供可迁移的宽泛唤醒读出。

papers.title: White matter–cognition mapping in pediatric cancer survivors: a two-cohort NODDI-Bingham study
papers.authors: Nandi S, McKenna F, Henry S, Nayak S, Duong T.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Childhood cancer survivors (CS) treated with chemotherapy frequently experience long-term cognitive impairments, commonly referred to as CRCI. Whether these deficits reflect disrupted white matter microstructure, altered microstructure–cognition relationships, or both remains unclear. Here, we applied the NODDI-Bingham model, which quantifies neurite density (NDI), isotropic free water (ISO), and orientation dispersion along primary (ODIp), secondary (ODIs), and total (ODIt) fiber axes, to characterize biophysically specific white matter microstructure in CS and examine its relationship to cognition. Twenty-one pediatric cancer survivors and 21 age-matched healthy controls (HC) underwent multi-shell diffusion MRI. Voxel-wise NODDI-Bingham analyses were performed within JHU atlas regions. Group differences were tested by ANCOVA, and microstructure–cognition associations were examined with the NIH Toolbox Crystallized, Fluid, and Early Childhood composites using group-specific regressions. Confirmatory analyses were performed in an age-matched subsample of the HCP (n = 679). Notably, CS showed reduced NDI in the corona radiata, cerebral peduncles, and corpus callosum, with elevated ODIt and ODIp in the middle cerebellar peduncle, pathways that subserve processing speed and interhemispheric integration, cognitive domains among the most vulnerable in CRCI. Group-specific regressions revealed qualitatively different microstructure–cognition relationships: HC exhibited mixed positive and negative relationships across four of five metrics (138 clusters spanning approximately 305,000 voxels; peak Cohen’s d up to 3.00), whereas CS showed a predominantly uniformly negative pattern (67 clusters across 57,000 voxels), with no positive clusters for ISO, ODIt, ODIp, or ODIs, thus highlighting that reduced dispersion and extracellular free water are linked to better cognitive performance in CS. HCP analyses reproduced the HC pattern across all five metrics at proportionally smaller effect sizes, ruling out sample-size effects. NODDI-Bingham identifies two aspects of chemotherapy-related white matter pathology that standard diffusion metrics cannot resolve. First, pediatric cancer survivors show selective elevation of ODIp and ODIt in the cerebellar peduncles and reduced NDI in the corona radiata and corpus callosum, localizing group-level injury to specific fanning and neurite density signatures. Second, whereas in healthy controls white matter shows mixed positive and negative microstructure–cognition relationships, survivors retain only negative relationships for ODIp and ODIt and a diminished mixed pattern for NDI, such that in the chemotherapy-exposed brain, only reduced neurite density and increased primary-axis fanning relate to cognitive impairment. These findings implicate a biophysically specific restructuring of white matter–cognition relationships as a candidate mechanism for CRCI and support NODDI-Bingham as a targeted biomarker panel for monitoring and intervention trials. Abbreviated summary Nandi, McKenna et al. apply the NODDI-Bingham diffusion model to pediatric cancer survivors and controls, showing chemotherapy is linked to selective white matter changes and a restructuring of microstructure–cognition relationships. The findings position NODDI-Bingham as a candidate biomarker panel for tracking and treating cancer-related cognitive impairment.

relevance.reason: 该研究用扩散MRI刻画儿童癌症幸存者白质微结构与认知的关系，直接涉及人脑白质结构与认知功能耦合。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注接受化疗的儿童癌症幸存者是否存在白质微结构改变，以及微结构与认知的关系是否被重塑，采用NODDI-Bingham扩散模型比较幸存者与年龄匹配健康对照，并在HCP子样本中做验证。结果显示，幸存者在放射冠、大脑脚和胼胝体等区域神经突密度降低，小脑中脚的总取向弥散和主纤维轴取向弥散升高；更关键的是，健康对照的微结构与认知呈正负混合关联，而幸存者主要只剩负向关联，即取向弥散和细胞外自由水降低反而与更好认知表现相关。作者据此认为，化疗相关认知障碍可能涉及白质微结构与认知关系的生物物理特异性重构，而非单纯的组间差异。

papers.title: Assessing the Functional-Structural Reorganization of Connector Hubs in Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
papers.authors: Dascal A, Delaire É, Ngo A, Chen J, Sahlas E, Arafat T, Abdallah C, Mobarak-Abadi M, Royer J, Rodríguez-Cruces R, Bernasconi N, Bernasconi A, Pana R, Lee K, Bernhardt B, Grova C.
papers.abstract: Recent years have seen a rise in investigations on the organizational principles of brain networks in healthy and pathological conditions. Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is a compelling case as its focal pathology is accompanied by widespread network disruptions. However, how TLE affects functional connector hubs, regions supporting long-range and inter-network communication, remain poorly understood. We mapped connector hub reorganization in patients with TLE relative to healthy controls. Patients exhibited widespread connector hub reductions in the ipsilateral occipital, cingulate, precuneus and hippocampal regions as well as the bilateral pallidum. Hub reductions occurred alongside the emergence of new hubs in contralateral regions. We furthermore observed strong associations between hub reductions and microstructural alterations in subcortical structures and the hippocampus. These findings demonstrate widespread, asymmetric connector hub reorganization extending beyond the epileptogenic temporal lobe, revealing distinct patterns of network disruption and brain-wide reorganization.

relevance.reason: 研究颞叶癫痫患者连接枢纽的功能-结构重组，属脑疾病网络组织与结构功能耦合。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了颞叶癫痫患者与健康对照的功能连接枢纽组织，考察癫痫如何影响承担长程和跨网络通信的连接枢纽。结果显示，患者在同侧枕叶、扣带回、楔前叶、海马及双侧苍白球出现广泛的枢纽减少，同时在对侧出现新的枢纽，且枢纽减少与皮层下结构和海马的微结构改变密切相关。作者据此认为，颞叶癫痫伴随超出致痫颞叶的广泛且不对称的连接枢纽重组，提示网络破坏与全脑重组并存；相关分析本身不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Spatio-dynamical decomposition: Joint spatial and dynamical criteria for FMRI Blind source separation.
papers.authors: Wiafe S, Soleimani N, Adali T, Calhoun V.
papers.abstract: Blind source separation (BSS) recovers latent sources from observed mixtures. In brain imaging, sources occur in two domains, spatial and temporal, so a criterion applied in one leaves the other unconstrained. Independent component analysis, the most used BSS tool, exploits diversity such as non-Gaussianity and sample dependence, but in one domain at a time. Methods that use both domains apply the same criterion to each and weight them against each other. We propose spatio-dynamical decomposition (SDD), scoring maps by non-Gaussianity and timecourses by dynamical independence: how much each source's dynamics depend on the others. We normalize each score by how much it can improve on the data, eliminating the need for a weight. Across simulations and 130 naturalistic fMRI runs, SDD recovers sources distinguished by either maps or dynamics and reproduces both across disjoint episodes, while baselines trade off the two; map and timescale together also better predict stimulus tracking, with the largest gain for SDD. Together, these results show that separation is strongest when spatial and temporal domains each carry their own criterion.

relevance.reason: 提出并验证fMRI盲源分离新方法，在自然刺激fMRI数据中恢复空间与动态源并预测刺激追踪，属自然刺激下脑功能组织方法研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种名为时空动力学分解（SDD）的盲源分离方法，用于功能磁共振数据，核心思路是分别对空间图谱施加非高斯性判据、对时间过程施加动力学独立性判据，并按各自在数据上可改进的幅度归一化，从而免去两域之间的权重设定。在模拟数据和自然情境fMRI数据中，SDD能同时恢复仅靠空间图谱或仅靠时间动力学区分的源，并在不重叠的数据片段中重现这些源，而对照方法往往在两者之间取舍。作者还发现，结合图谱与时间尺度能更好地预测刺激追踪，其中SDD的提升最大，提示空间与时间各用其判据时分离效果最强。

papers.title: Multimodal MRI Clustering Reveals an Elevated Free-Water Biotype in Autism with Increased Social Symptoms
papers.authors: McKenna F, Hemmerling KJ, Nandi S, Molholm S, Zhu DC.
papers.abstract: Background Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is neurobiologically heterogeneous, and group comparisons may mask effects confined to subgroups. We tested whether distinct biotypes exist within ASD using unsupervised clustering of multimodal MRI. Methods We analyzed 149 participants with ASD and 129 typically developing (TD) controls from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (6 sites; age 5 to 64 years). Site-harmonized features comprised free water (FW), tissue anisotropy and diffusivity, diffusion tensor image analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS), cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) volumes and exploratory resting-state regional homogeneity. ASD participants were clustered with k-means using global (7 features) and regional (17 features) sets, with robustness tested by permutation and two further algorithms. TD participants were projected post hoc to test specificity. A composite imaging score was related to Social Responsiveness Scale (SRS) subscales, symptom severity and IQ using partial correlations with false discovery rate correction. Results Clustering identified an elevated free-water (EFW) biotype comprising approximately 10% of ASD participants, defined by markedly increased FW (d = +4.91 versus remaining ASD participants), reduced tissue anisotropy, reduced DTI-ALPS and enlarged ventricles. It was recovered across feature sets and algorithms (permutation p < .0001) and departed from TD norms, unlike the remaining ASD participants. The composite score correlated with social-perceptual and communicative SRS subscales, most strongly social awareness (r = +0.253, q = .026), but not with symptom severity or IQ. FW related to social motivation in children and adolescents (r = +0.287, q = .037) but not adults. Limitations Each person was scanned once, so we cannot tell whether these brain differences cause social difficulties or how they change with age. The subgroup was small, clinical data were incomplete, the sample was mostly male with a wide age range, and the findings await confirmation in an independent group. Free water can reflect inflammation, swelling or tissue loss, so its biological meaning remains uncertain. Conclusions We identify an ASD subgroup defined by extracellular fluid excess and altered white matter that is associated with greater social difficulties. If replicated, this signature may help stratify individuals with ASD in mechanistic studies and clinical trials.

relevance.reason: 以多模态MRI在自闭症患者中识别出与社交症状相关的自由水升高亚型，涉及白质微结构与脑组织改变，属脑疾病机理与结构-功能研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用多模态MRI的无监督聚类检验自闭症谱系障碍内部是否存在不同生物学亚型，并分析这些亚型与社交症状的关系。聚类识别出一个以细胞外游离水显著升高为特征的亚型，约占自闭症参与者的十分之一，同时伴有组织各向异性降低、类淋巴功能指标下降和脑室扩大；该亚型在不同特征集和算法下均可重现，且偏离典型发育人群的常态。其综合影像评分与社交知觉和沟通相关，尤其与社交觉察关联最强，但与总体症状严重程度和智商无关。作者指出，该亚型样本较小、每人仅扫描一次，尚不能判断脑差异是社交困难的原因还是结果，游离水的生物学含义也不确定，结论有待独立样本验证。

papers.title: Toward A Whole-Brain Interface Enabled by High-Resolution Surface Electrophysiology
papers.authors: Ho E, Barth K, Dister J, Srivastava A, Poole AJ, Claudi F, Lucas MV, Miller JS, Hettick M, Byun YW, Anushiravani R, Murphy M, Konrad P, Bhatia S, Adams G, Carte S, Ottonello D, Bederson J, Saez I, Kellner C, Tostaeva G, Kopell BH, Cummins DD, Ulkatan S, Ghatan S, Cajigas I, Pesaran B, Borges PG, Qureshi Q, Haggerty J, Wang Z, Crone N, Bettegowda C, Lehner K, Luo S, Angrick M, Greene R, Comair Y, Aronson JP, Lawton M, Prakash P, Lei T, Lee JH, Slutzky MW, Tate M, Paulk A, Dunn G, Grannan B, Serruya MD, Hines K, Wu C, Rosenwasser R, Berger A, Levy EI, Siddiqui AH, Riley J, Davies JM, Strauss J, Mager MJ, Mermel CH, Rapoport BI.
papers.abstract: The goal of building a whole-brain interface—capable of generating a real-time digital representation of the state of the entire central nervous system—has long been framed as a hardware challenge of recording simultaneously from ever-larger numbers of microelectrodes. Advances in high-resolution neural interfaces now enable electrophysiologic interaction with the human nervous system at spatial and temporal resolutions previously unattainable without disrupting tissue architecture or physiology. These capabilities create new opportunities for mechanistic neuroscience, neuroprosthetics, and precision-guided neurosurgery. With the advent of modern microelectrode array technology, however, the whole-brain interface has also become a data challenge. Rather than pursuing large-scale human brain recording purely through a single device placed in a single patient, we demonstrate here that systematic multi-subject aggregation, across brain regions and behavioral paradigms, in a common anatomical framework, can achieve something functionally similar to a whole-brain interface. Here we present an approach to a functional atlas of the human central nervous system derived from high-resolution surface electrophysiology recordings obtained in the first 70 patients implanted with an anatomically conformal, thin-film neural interface positioned in more than 100 locations. The atlas comprises >100,000 electrode deployments and catalogs placement across a broad range of neuroanatomic targets spanning the motor, sensory, language, auditory, and associative domains, as well as brainstem and spinal cord structures that have historically been difficult to access at high electrophysiologic resolution. Across participants, aggregated recordings reveal somatotopic organization, including digit representations that follow a lateral-to-medial ordering consistent with classical homuncular maps, with transitions between adjacent representations occurring over spatial scales of approximately 0.8–2.0 mm; canonical frequency-band signatures, such as movement-related beta-band suppression and focal high-gamma (70–200 Hz) increases during motor and speech behaviors; and task-modulated population dynamics in both evoked and spontaneous activity across cortical, brainstem, and spinal cord regions. These findings yield insight into patterns of mesoscale electrophysiological dynamics conserved across the entire human central nervous system, suggesting that fine-scale functional organization is preserved across individuals when aligned to common anatomical landmarks. We further demonstrate several applications of these high-resolution recordings, including real-time neural decoding from upper extremity motor cortex to enable real-time neuroprosthetic control, and from ventrolateral cortex to decode cortical correlates of spoken language, facial movements, and complex facial expressions of emotion, supporting initial feasibility of combined verbal and nonverbal communication interfaces. Together, these results establish a paradigm for approaching large-scale interfaces with the human brain, as well as a starting point for a scalable, extensible atlas of human electrophysiologic function designed to accelerate discovery across basic neuroscience, translational research, and clinical neurotechnology.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出，全脑接口不必依赖单一患者的大规模记录，而可通过在统一解剖框架下系统汇总多受试者的高分辨率表面电生理数据来实现类似功能。作者基于植入解剖贴合薄膜接口患者的记录构建功能图谱，覆盖运动、感觉、语言、听觉、联合皮层及脑干和脊髓等区域，汇总记录显示体感定位、典型频带特征以及任务调制下的群体活动，提示细尺度功能组织在个体间可经共同解剖标志对齐而保留。研究还展示了从运动皮层实时解码用于神经假体控制、以及从腹外侧皮层解码言语和面部相关信号的初步可行性，为可扩展的人脑电生理功能图谱提供了起点。

papers.title: Resting-State Functional Brain Connectivity and Neurodevelopmental Profiles in 3-Year-Olds with Congenital Heart Disease.
papers.authors: Savard C, Tremblay J, Provost S, Paquette N, Kessouri S, Roger K, Fourdain S, Doussau A, Vannasing P, Simard MN, Gallagher A.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives : Congenital heart disease (CHD) is associated with altered brain development and an increased risk of neurodevelopmental difficulties, particularly in more severe forms of the condition. Although alterations in functional brain connectivity have been reported before and after the first corrective surgery in early infancy, as well as in adulthood, little is known about their presentation in early childhood and their association with neurodevelopmental outcomes. This study aimed to characterize resting-state functional connectivity in 3-year-old children with moderate-to-severe CHD and to examine its associations with neurodevelopmental outcomes, including cognitive, language, and motor abilities. Methods: Twenty-five 3-year-old children with moderate-to-severe CHD and 28 age-matched healthy controls completed resting-state functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) analysis and a standardized neurodevelopmental assessment. Connectivity was compared across networks using a repeated-measures analysis of covariance (ANCOVA), then within each network separately, controlling for maternal socioeconomic status and with sex as a factor. Associations with neurodevelopmental measures were examined using hierarchical linear regressions adjusted for group, sex, and socioeconomic status, with connectivity-by-group interactions tested. Results: Children with moderate-to-severe CHD showed lower resting-state functional connectivity than controls specifically within the right fronto-temporal network, with no group differences in the four remaining networks, as well as poorer language performance. Greater inter-hemispheric functional connectivity was associated with fewer executive function difficulties and better overall motor performance across participants, and greater frontal connectivity with better motor coordination, with no significant differences in these associations between groups. Conclusions: Preschool-aged children with CHD show regionally circumscribed alterations in functional connectivity and language vulnerabilities, while the associations between connectivity and executive and motor functioning appear to extend across both CHD and typically developing children.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fNIRS比较先天性心脏病患儿与健康幼儿的功能连接，并关联语言、执行与运动能力，涉及脑网络组织与发育。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注中重度先天性心脏病（CHD）学龄前儿童静息态功能连接及其与神经发育表现的关系，纳入3岁CHD患儿与年龄匹配的健康对照，采用静息态功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）和标准化神经发育评估进行比较。结果显示，CHD儿童仅在右侧额颞网络表现出较低的功能连接，其余网络未见组间差异，同时语言表现较差。跨全部受试者，半球间功能连接更强与执行功能困难更少、整体运动表现更好相关，额部连接更强与运动协调更好相关，且这些关联在两组间无显著差异。作者据此认为，CHD学龄前儿童存在区域局限的功能连接改变和语言脆弱性，而连接与执行、运动功能之间的关联可能同样见于典型发育儿童。

papers.title: Insulin resistance-related metabolic burden, white matter microstructure, and cognitive change: the HABS-HD study.
papers.authors: Li H, Tian Z, Wang X, Gao W, She J, Health and Aging Brain Study (HABS-HD) Study Team, Health and Aging Brain Study (HABS-HD) Study Team .
papers.abstract: Background Insulin resistance-related metabolic burden is associated with cognitive aging, but the relevant white matter microstructural features remain unclear. We examined statistical indirect associations between metabolic indices and cognition through tract-level white matter measures, including associations with subsequent cognitive change. Methods Cross-sectional and longitudinal analyses used Health and Aging Brain Study-Health Disparities (HABS-HD) data. Exposures were the triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index and its composites with waist-to-height ratio (TyG-WHtR) and visceral adiposity index (TyG-VAI). Candidate mediators were axial and radial diffusivity (RD) in 32 white matter tracts; outcomes covered six cognitive domains. High-dimensional mediation analysis with within-model false discovery rate (FDR) correction selected candidate pathways, supplemented by model-level multiplicity analyses. Selection stability was assessed using 1,000 participant-level bootstrap samples. All candidates underwent longitudinal mixed-effects analysis, with indirect estimates calculated as baseline exposure-white matter coefficients multiplied by white matter-by-time coefficients. Intervals used 2,000 participant-level cluster bootstrap samples. Sensitivity analyses adjusted for white matter hyperintensity (WMH) volume and covariate-by-time interactions. Results Of 2,606 participants, 788 had two cognitive assessments a median of 2.17 years apart. Fourteen candidate pathways were selected, all involving RD and TyG or TyG-WHtR; 11 had 95% conditional Monte Carlo uncertainty intervals excluding zero. Two of 36 models met the supplementary model-level FDR criterion. Five longitudinal pathways had negative indirect estimates with 95% bootstrap intervals excluding zero: four involved right cingulum RD and processing speed or executive function, and one involved right superior corona radiata RD and processing speed. Four also met the FDR criterion for RD-by-time interactions. The TyG-WHtR-right cingulum RD-executive function indirect estimate was -0.0054 per year (95% bootstrap interval, -0.0110 to -0.0009). Selection frequencies ranged from 6.7% to 42.0%. After WMH and WMH-by-time adjustment, intervals excluded zero for two of these five pathways, decreasing to one with additional core covariate-by-time interactions. Conclusion Triglyceride-glucose index and TyG-WHtR showed statistical indirect associations with cognition through white matter RD, with some pathways associated with subsequent cognitive change. Limited selection stability and sensitivity to WMH and covariate-by-time adjustment warrant evaluation in independent cohorts.

relevance.reason: 研究胰岛素抵抗代谢负担经白质微结构（径向扩散率）与认知及认知变化的关联，属白质微结构与认知的结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于HABS-HD队列，考察胰岛素抵抗相关代谢负担是否通过白质微结构指标与认知及后续认知变化存在统计学间接关联。分析以甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数及其与腰高比、内脏脂肪指数的复合指标为暴露，以多个白质纤维束的弥散指标为候选中介，覆盖多个认知域，并结合横断面与纵向分析。结果筛选出若干以径向弥散度为核心的候选通路，其中部分纵向通路的间接估计区间不含零，主要涉及右侧扣带束与加工速度、执行功能，以及右侧放射冠上部与加工速度；但这些通路的筛选稳定性有限，且在调整白质高信号及协变量随时间变化后多数不再稳健。作者据此提示代谢负担与认知之间可能存在经由白质微结构的统计通路，同时强调结果尚需在独立队列中验证，不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Longitudinal white matter network reorganization after rTMS in first-episode schizophrenia: associations with sleep improvement.
papers.authors: Li Y, Liu W, Sun R, Zhu Y, Cai M, Zhao W.
papers.abstract: Background Sleep disturbances are highly prevalent in first-episode schizophrenia and are associated with poor clinical and functional outcomes. Although repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown therapeutic potential for insomnia and schizophrenia, its efficacy for sleep disturbances in first-episode schizophrenia remains insufficiently characterized, and the underlying white matter network mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to determine whether active rTMS improves sleep quality compared with sham stimulation and whether longitudinal white matter network reorganization is associated with treatment-related sleep improvement. Methods One hundred patients with first-episode schizophrenia were included in the final analysis and randomly assigned to receive active rTMS or sham stimulation over an 8-week intervention period. Subjective sleep quality was assessed using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), and objective sleep parameters were measured using wrist actigraphy. Diffusion tensor imaging was acquired at baseline and after treatment to construct individual white matter structural networks. Graph-theoretical metrics, nodal efficiency, and rich-club organization were examined. Linear mixed-effects models were used to evaluate group-by-time interaction effects, and correlation analyses were performed to examine associations between network changes and sleep improvement. Results Compared with sham stimulation, active rTMS produced greater improvements in subjective and objective sleep outcomes, including reduced PSQI scores, increased sleep efficiency, and decreased wake after sleep onset and sleep latency. Active rTMS was also associated with greater longitudinal increases in global efficiency, local efficiency, clustering coefficient, and nodal efficiency in prefrontal, default-mode, temporal, and salience-related regions. Rich-club connectivity increased more strongly after active rTMS than after sham stimulation, whereas feeder connectivity, normalized rich-club coefficient, and local connectivity did not show significant group-by-time interaction effects after FDR correction. In the active rTMS group, increases in rich-club connectivity were positively associated with improvements in actigraphy-derived sleep efficiency (r = 0.43, P = 0.002). Conclusions Active rTMS improved sleep quality more effectively than sham stimulation in patients with first-episode schizophrenia and was accompanied by longitudinal changes in DTI-derived white matter network organization. The association between increased rich-club connectivity and improved sleep efficiency suggests that hub-related network reorganization may represent a network-level correlate of rTMS-related sleep improvement.

relevance.reason: 研究首发精神分裂症rTMS后白质结构网络重组及其与睡眠改善的关联，属脑疾病中白质结构与可塑性机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注首发精神分裂症患者接受重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）后睡眠改善是否伴随白质结构网络的重组，将患者随机分为活性rTMS组与伪刺激组，结合睡眠量表、腕表活动记录和弥散张量成像进行纵向比较。结果显示，活性rTMS在主观和客观睡眠指标上的改善均优于伪刺激，同时伴随全局与局部网络效率、聚类系数及前额叶、默认网络、颞叶和突显相关区域节点效率的更明显提升，富俱乐部连接也增强更多。在活性组中，富俱乐部连接的增加与客观睡眠效率的改善呈正相关，提示枢纽相关的网络重组可能是rTMS改善睡眠的网络层面伴随特征；这一关联尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Dynamic reconfiguration of directed effective connectivity between attention networks and the default mode network in knee osteoarthritis: a combined resting-state and non-noxious thermal stimulation functional magnetic resonance imaging study.
papers.authors: Luo W, Zhou J, Cheng S, Dong X, Chen Y, Tang C, He W, Wang Z, Zeng F, Li Z, Liang F.
papers.abstract: Background Chronic pain is understood as a disturbance of large-scale brain-network organization involving systems that coordinate internally and externally oriented processing. In knee osteoarthritis (KOA), altered connectivity involving attention networks and the default mode network (DMN) has been reported, but directed organization and reconfiguration during non-noxious somatosensory input remain unclear. Methods In this cross-sectional neuroimaging study, 148 patients with KOA and 36 healthy controls (HCs) underwent resting-state fMRI followed by non-noxious knee thermal-stimulation fMRI. Directed effective connectivity (EC) was estimated separately for the resting-state and thermal-stimulation runs using regression dynamic causal modeling and summarized within the Yeo 7-network framework. Between-group analyses assessed directed network organization at rest and stimulation-related reconfiguration, defined as thermal-stimulation minus resting-state connectivity (ΔEC = ECthermal - ECrest). Network in-degree, out-degree, and exploratory clinical associations were examined. Results Compared with HC, KOA patients exhibited reduced directed inputs to the dorsal attention network (DAN) from multiple networks and increased directed drive toward the DMN at rest. During thermal stimulation, KOA patients showed greater increases in directed connectivity toward the DAN but attenuated DAN→DMN connectivity changes. Core edge-level effects were robust in sensitivity analyses. Degree analyses supported altered input-output profiles of the DAN and DMN. Exploratory associations with pain severity and functional impairment did not survive false-discovery-rate correction. Conclusions KOA was characterized by altered directed interactions between attention networks and the DMN at rest, together with atypical reconfiguration from rest to non-noxious somatosensory stimulation. These findings are consistent with altered coordination between externally oriented attention and internally oriented processing.

relevance.reason: 研究膝骨关节炎患者注意网络与默认网络的有向有效连接及热刺激下的重配置，属注意等认知网络组织与静息/刺激态脑网络研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面神经影像研究考察膝骨关节炎患者注意网络与默认模式网络之间的有向有效连接，以及非伤害性热刺激下这种连接如何重配置；患者与健康对照均接受静息态和膝关节热刺激fMRI，并用回归动态因果模型估计有效连接。结果显示，患者静息时多个网络对背侧注意网络的有向输入减少、对默认模式网络的驱动增强；热刺激时，指向背侧注意网络的连接增幅更大，而背侧注意网络到默认模式网络的连接变化减弱。作者据此认为，患者在外向注意与内向加工之间的协调存在异常，但探索性临床关联未通过多重比较校正，结论不宜作临床推断。

papers.title: Large-Scale and Local Functional Connectivity Changes following Psilocybin Administration in Methamphetamine Use Disorder.
papers.authors: Chaganti J, Siefried KJ, Vyakaranam VS, Acheson L, Brett J.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Methamphetamine (MA) use disorder is associated with widespread disruption of large-scale brain networks involved in cognitive control, attention, and salience processing. Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) provides a means to characterize these alterations; however, little is known about the capacity for functional network reorganization following targeted intervention. The purpose of this study was to evaluate changes in large-scale and local functional connectivity following psilocybin administration in individuals with MA use disorder. Materials and methods In this exploratory prospective longitudinal study, participants with MA use disorder underwent rs-fMRI before and after psilocybin administration alongside psychotherapy. Large-scale functional connectivity was assessed across canonical resting-state networks, including the default mode, salience, dorsal attention, and executive control networks. Local connectivity was evaluated using regional homogeneity (ReHo). Connectivity changes were examined in relation to clinical measures of MA use, craving, and psychological distress. Results Following intervention, reorganization of functional connectivity was observed within and between attentional, default mode, and salience networks. Improvements in network integration were accompanied by complementary shifts in local neural synchrony, with postintervention increases in ReHo observed within frontal and sensorimotor regions. Greater MA reductions in use were associated with recovery of frontostriatal and attentional connectivity, whereas reductions in psychological distress correlated with strengthened integration of attentional and prefrontal-striatal circuits. Conclusions Psilocybin administration was associated with measurable reorganization of both large-scale network connectivity and local functional coherence in individuals with MA use disorder. These findings provide preliminary evidence for the distributed nature of brain network dysfunction in stimulant addiction and support the potential utility of multimodal rs-fMRI metrics as imaging biomarkers of network-level plasticity.

relevance.reason: 在甲基苯丙胺使用障碍患者中考察裸盖菇素干预前后静息态大尺度与局部功能连接重组，属脑疾病相关的脑网络可塑性研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性纵向研究考察甲基苯丙胺使用障碍者在裸盖菇素给药并配合心理治疗后，大尺度与局部功能连接的变化。参与者接受静息态fMRI前后测，分析默认模式、突显、背侧注意和执行控制等网络间连接，并用局部一致性指标评估局部神经同步。结果显示，干预后注意、默认模式和突显网络内部及网络间出现连接重组，额叶和感觉运动区的局部一致性升高；甲基苯丙胺使用减少较多者伴随额纹状体与注意连接的恢复，心理痛苦减轻则与注意及前额-纹状体环路整合增强相关。作者据此认为，裸盖菇素给药与可测量的大尺度网络和局部功能一致性重组相关，为刺激物成瘾的分布式网络功能障碍提供了初步证据，并提示多模态静息态指标可能作为网络层面可塑性的影像标志物，但研究为探索性设计，相关发现尚不能说明因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Improved Reliability of Resting-State fMRI Connectivity Using Multi-Echo Acquisition: Implications for Personalized Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Targeting.
papers.authors: Hassanzadeh E, Tariq R, Palm S, Chiulli N, Lawson D, Khosravani S, Barbour T, Kong R, Yeo BTT, Fox MD, Siddiqi SH.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Multi-echo (ME) fMRI acquisition improves the separation of signal from noise relative to single-echo (SE). We tested whether this enhances the reliability of functional connectivity (FC), with a focus on personalizing transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) targets in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) in patients with depression. Materials and methods Resting-state fMRI scans were acquired from adult patients with major depression (20 women, 15 men) presenting for clinical TMS using either SE (n =21) or ME (n =31). Each subject's fMRI time-series was split in half, and voxelwise seed-based FC was computed for 100 general ROIs and for 2 TMS-specific ROIs: subgenual cingulate cortex (SGC) and a previously published depression circuit (DEP). Reliability was assessed using 1) spatial correlation between split-half connectivity maps and 2) intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) for each ROI's connectivity to the DLPFC. Results In general ROI analysis, ME showed significantly higher whole-brain split-half correlations than SE (P = .006) and higher ICC (ΔICC = 0.16; P = .03). In TMS-specific ROI analysis, ME showed higher split-half correlations for both the SGC-DLPFC (P = .04) and DEP-DLPFC (P = .01). TMS-specific ICC values were numerically higher for ME (SGC-DLPFC: 0.47; DEP-DLPFC: 0.75) than for SE (0.02 and 0.40, respectively), although these differences were not statistically significant. Conclusions ME fMRI improves general FC reliability over SE, with suggested advantages for TMS-specific measures. Future work is needed to determine whether these gains meaningfully improve TMS targeting.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态fMRI功能连接可靠性的采集方法改进，有明确脑网络组织测量发现，非纯算法性能测试。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在成年抑郁症患者中比较了多回波与单回波静息态fMRI采集对功能连接可靠性的影响，重点关注个体化经颅磁刺激靶点定位。结果显示，多回波采集在全脑通用感兴趣区的分半相关和组内相关系数上均优于单回波，在与背外侧前额叶相关的抑郁回路靶区上也表现出更高的分半相关；靶区组内相关系数数值上更高，但差异未达统计显著。作者据此认为多回波采集可提升一般功能连接可靠性，对TMS相关测量可能有优势，但这些改善能否真正优化TMS靶点定位尚需进一步研究。

papers.title: Microcephaly with Simplified Gyral Pattern in Children: Quantitative Morphometric Assessment on Brain MRI and Correlation with Clinical Outcome.
papers.authors: Chambers S, Esmeraldo MA, Kravutske Y, Haider L, Kasprian G, Geraldo AF, Soares BP.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Microcephaly with simplified gyral pattern (SGP) represents an often subtle subtype of malformation of cortical development that is commonly accompanied by epilepsy and neurodevelopmental delay. However, whether gyral simplification scales to reduced brain volume and whether MRI features predict clinical outcome still remain unclear. The aims of this study are therefore to apply a quantitative morphometric approach to distinguish a simplified gyral pattern from microcephaly-related effects and to correlate quantitative MRI-derived features with clinical outcome. Materials and methods From a single-center cohort of 34 patients with microcephaly and visually confirmed SGP (shallow sulci, normal cortical thickness), 18 subjects (mean age 7.1 ± 6.5 years) who fulfilled the eligibility criteria were retrospectively included for final analysis. Twenty-six age- and sex-matched healthy controls were included. GM/WM volumes (GMVs/WMVs) and surface-based measures were derived using FreeSurfer. Scaling corrections based on log-log robust regression and cortical folding analyses were subsequently analyzed. Principal component analyses clustered along morphometric phenotypes. ANCOVA, Kendall τ correlations, and logistic regression were applied to evaluate group differences and clinical outcome predictors. Results Compared with healthy controls, patients showed significantly reduced WMV, cortical surface area, local gyrification index (LGI) (all Q < 0.003), and mildly increased cortical thickness. Allometric modeling indicated that, although WMV and LGI scaled proportionally to total brain volume, cortical surface area was disproportionately reduced, suggesting deviation beyond microcephalic scaling. Spectral folding analysis showed loss of specifically macroscale (primary) folding power. Morphometric clustering separated 4 subtypes differing in cortical thickness and area, of which the cluster with the lowest surface area and LGI exhibited universal developmental delay and included both early deaths. Across the cohort, neurodevelopmental delay correlated negatively with surface area. Logistic regression suggested lower surface area, WMV, and LGI as predictors of adverse clinical outcome (Q < 0.02). Conclusions The presence of SGP may reflect additional disturbance of primary sulcation and tangential cortical expansion beyond scaling to microcephaly alone. Our results suggest reduced cortical surface area as a key morphometric marker and a strong MRI feature predictive of neurodevelopmental delay, underscoring the clinical value of quantitative morphometry for stratifying disease severity in microcephaly with an SGP.

relevance.reason: 该研究定量分析小头畸形伴简化脑回儿童的皮层形态与脑发育，并将MRI形态指标与神经发育结局关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对伴简化脑回模式的小头畸形患儿，用脑MRI定量形态学方法区分简化脑回本身与小头畸形导致的整体缩放效应，并分析影像特征与临床结局的关系。结果显示，患儿白质体积、皮层表面积和局部脑回化指数均降低，皮层厚度轻度增加；其中皮层表面积的减小超出小头畸形比例缩放所能解释的范围，并伴有宏观尺度折叠成分的丢失。形态学聚类可分出不同亚型，皮层表面积和局部脑回化指数最低的亚型均出现发育迟缓；表面积越小，神经发育迟缓越重，低表面积、低白质体积和低局部脑回化指数与不良临床结局相关。作者据此认为，简化脑回模式可能反映原发沟回形成和皮层切向扩张的额外异常，定量形态学有助于评估病情严重程度。

papers.title: Dynamic Semantic–Prosodic Integration in Emotional Speech Perception: From Channel Dominance to Precision-Weighted Predictive Coding
papers.authors: Lin Y, Zhang Y.
papers.abstract: Emotional speech is an important carrier of affective information in spoken communication. Its perception depends on the joint processing of emotional semantics and prosody, yet the relative contribution of these two information sources varies across individuals and contexts. However, a unified account is still lacking of why their processing weights change and how the brain dynamically adjusts them according to the reliability of incoming information. This review synthesizes evidence on emotional semantics and prosody, from relatively independent processing to interactive integration, and argues that their relationship is best understood in terms of dynamic weight allocation. On this basis, we propose a Precision-Weighted Predictive Coding Model (PW-PC), which integrates Bayesian inference, cue precision, and prediction error within a unified framework. The model assumes that semantic and prosodic information are continuously reweighted according to current evidence and its estimated precision, while incorporating sensory reliability, experience-based expectations, contextual diagnosticity, and reweighting flexibility. This framework shifts the focus of emotional speech research from identifying which channel dominates to explaining when, why, and how the brain dynamically reallocates weight across multiple affective information sources, thereby providing a unified theoretical perspective linking behavioral performance, neural dynamics, and computational mechanisms.

relevance.reason: 综述提出情绪语音中语义与韵律整合的预测编码理论框架，直接涉及言语感知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了情绪言语知觉中情绪语义与韵律从相对独立加工走向交互整合的证据，认为二者关系更适合用动态权重分配来理解，而非固定由某一通道主导。作者据此提出精度加权预测编码模型，将贝叶斯推断、线索精度与预测误差纳入统一框架，假设语义和韵律信息会依据当前证据及其估计精度被持续重新加权，并受感觉可靠性、经验预期、情境诊断性和重加权灵活性的约束。文章由此把研究重点从判断哪一通道占优转向解释大脑何时、为何以及如何动态调整多类情绪信息的权重，为连接行为表现、神经动态与计算机制提供了统一的理论视角。

papers.title: Modality-Independent Core Brain Network for Language as Proved by Sign Language
papers.authors: Trettenbrein PC, Meister N, Slivac K, Finkbeiner TA, Steinbach M, Friederici AD, Zaccarella E.
papers.abstract: The human brain has the capacity to automatically compute the grammatical relations ofwords in sentences, be they spoken or written. This species-specific ability for syntax lies atthe core of our capacity for language and is primarily subserved by a left-hemispheric fronto-temporal network consisting of the posterior inferior frontal gyrus (pIFG), as well as theposterior middle temporal gyrus and superior temporal sulcus (pMTG/STS). To date, itremains unclear whether this core network for syntactic processing identified for spoken andwritten language in hearing people also holds for the processing of the grammatical structureof a natural sign language in deaf people. Using functional magnetic resonance imaging, asign language paradigm that systematically varied the presence of syntactic and lexical-semantic information, and meta-analytically defined functional regions-of-interests derivedfrom a large dataset of syntactic processing in hearing non-signers, we demonstrate that deafnative signers of German Sign Language (DGS) also recruit left pIFG and pMTG/STS forcomputing grammatical relations in sign language—indicating the universality of the corelanguage network. These findings suggest that the human brain evolved a dedicated neuralnetwork for processing the grammatical structure of natural languages independent oflanguage modality, which flexibly interacts with different externalization systems dependingon the modality of language use.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注听觉人群口语和书面语中已识别的左半球额颞句法核心网络，是否同样适用于聋人加工自然手语的语法结构。研究者用功能磁共振成像，结合系统变化句法与词汇语义信息的手语范式，并采用基于听觉非手语者句法加工数据定义的感兴趣区，考察以德国手语为母语的聋人。结果显示，这些聋人手语者也招募左侧后部额下回和后部颞中回/颞上沟来计算手语中的语法关系，提示核心语言网络具有跨语言通道的普遍性。作者据此认为，人脑演化出了独立于语言通道、专门加工自然语言语法结构的神经网络，该网络会依语言使用通道与不同外化系统灵活互动。

papers.title: Functional Neuroanatomy of Sign Language Production: An ALE Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Wiernik L, Friederici AD, Emmorey K, Trettenbrein PC.
papers.abstract: Sign languages are natural languages expressed by a distinct set of linguistic articulators: the hands, face, and body. Several neuroimaging studies of the neural substrates underlying sign production have observed the recruitment of brain regions previously identified as being involved in speech production, despite the difference in production channels. However, no prior work has provided a statistical synthesis of this available literature. Here, we report a pre-registered meta-analysis of the published positron emission tomography (PET) and functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) literature on sign language production (N experiments = 15, N participants = 168). Combining an Activation Likelihood Estimation (ALE) approach with jackknife re-sampling to validate the robustness of our findings, we identify four clusters consistently associated with the production of single signs across studies in the literature located in (1) left inferior frontal gyrus including BA 45 and extending into (2) left anterior insula, (3) the left superior frontal gyrus, and (4) the medial and right cerebellum. Meta-analytic connectivity modelling using data from a large-scale database of neuroimaging studies confirmed that the IFG, insula, and SFG clusters observed for sign language production are also recruited for spoken language production and comprehension. Moreover, our results also highlight the importance of the cerebellum during sign production and indicate modality-dependent convergence patterns in cerebellar subregions. In sum, our findings complement prior work on sign language comprehension and spoken language production, suggesting substantial overlap in the neural substrates of language processing and production-related mechanisms between sign and spoken language.

papers.title: The Ambiguity Advantage in Hemispheric Specialization and Interhemispheric Cooperation: A Central and Lateralized Lexical Decision Study of Homonym Recognition
papers.authors: Hwang J, Kim S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Previous studies demonstrate that homonyms with multiple unrelated meanings are recognized faster and more accurately than unambiguous words, a phenomenon termed the ambiguity advantage. However, how the left and right cerebral hemispheres contribute to this facilitation remains unclear. To address this, the present study investigated hemispheric specialization and interhemispheric cooperation across two lexical decision task (LDT) experiments using homonymous and unambiguous words. Experiment 1 measured response times and accuracy in central vision. Experiment 2 applied a divided visual field (DVF) paradigm across left (LVF), right (RVF), and bilateral (BVF) visual field conditions, evaluating three derived behavioral indices: the ambiguity advantage, the right visual field advantage (RVFA), and the bilateral redundancy gain (BRG). In Experiment 1, homonymous words were processed significantly faster and more accurately than unambiguous controls. In Experiment 2, the LVF/RH condition yielded a significantly greater ambiguity advantage in accuracy than the RVF/LH condition. Furthermore, the RVFA was more pronounced for unambiguous words, whereas the BRG was significantly larger for homonyms. These findings indicate that the right hemisphere excels in utilizing the "blend state" of co-activated meanings as a familiarity cue during lexical decisions. Furthermore, cumulative experience with unrelated meanings across diverse contexts may strengthen bihemispheric network interactions, potentially establishing distributed transcortical cell assemblies as the neural foundation for an amplified BRG.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注歧义词（多义词）识别中的“歧义优势”如何由左右半球分工与半球间协作实现，采用中央视野和分视野词汇判断任务比较多义词与无歧义词的行为表现。结果发现，多义词在中央视野下识别更快更准；分视野条件下，左视野/右半球在正确率上的歧义优势更强，而无歧义词的右视野优势更明显，多义词的双侧冗余增益也更大。作者据此推测，右半球可能把多个共激活意义的“混合状态”当作熟悉性线索，而跨语境积累的多重意义经验或可强化双半球网络互动，为更强的双侧协作提供神经基础。

papers.title: Hippocampal volume and white matter impairments in patients with congenital adrenal hyperplasia.
papers.authors: Savoia A, Kancsar D, Nordenström A, Van't Westeinde A, Lajic S.
papers.journal: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism
papers.abstract: Context Patients with congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) have lifelong imbalances in adrenal hormones that may result in changes in structure and function of the brain that can impair cognitive performance. The hippocampus might be especially sensitive to cortisol and androgen disturbances but has not been systematically investigated in this patient group. Objective In this study, we assessed hippocampal subfield volumes, mean diffusivity, and resting-state functional connectivity along with memory performance in patients with CAH and healthy controls using structural magnetic resonance imaging. Design Cohort study; patients were recruited and tested as part of the PREDEX study. Setting Single research institute. Participants Twenty-nine patients with CAH (20 females, 9 males) and 33 healthy controls (19 females, 14 males). Intervention(s) No intervention was performed. Main outcome measure(s) Hippocampal subfield volumes, mean diffusivity, resting-state functional connectivity, and memory performance. Results Patients with CAH had reduced left CA4 and left and right subiculum volumes. In the group by sex interaction analyses, males presented higher mean diffusivity in left CA3 and CA4 compared to controls. When looking at males and females separately, it was identified that females had reduced volumes of the bilateral subiculum, CA1, and left CA3 and CA4. Hippocampal structural alterations were not associated with memory performance. Conclusions Patients with CAH had structural alterations in several hippocampal subfield volumes, but there might be a discrepancy between males and females in sensitivity to white or gray matter impairments. The findings warrant further investigation into sex-specific differences in treatment sensitivity to optimize brain health in both men and women with CAH.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注先天性肾上腺皮质增生症（CAH）患者的海马亚区体积、白质微结构、静息态功能连接与记忆表现，采用结构磁共振成像比较患者与健康对照。结果显示，患者左侧CA4及双侧下托体积减小；按性别分析时，男性患者左侧CA3和CA4的平均弥散率高于对照，女性患者则表现为双侧下托、CA1及左侧CA3和CA4体积减小，提示男女在灰质或白质受损敏感性上可能存在差异。海马结构改变与记忆表现未见关联，作者据此强调需进一步研究性别特异的治疗敏感性，以维护CAH患者的脑健康。

papers.title: Decoding object categories from electroencephalography during free viewing reveals early information evolution compared to passive viewing.
papers.authors: Auerbach-Asch CR, Vishne G, Wertheimer O, Deouell LY.
papers.abstract: Object processing is central to visual perception, and its neural substrates inform cognitive and computational models of vision. Electroencephalographic (EEG) research has increasingly adopted multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) to decode distributed neural representations, moving beyond average signal changes and predefined electrodes. Yet, most MVPA studies use passive viewing paradigms that constrain eye movements and evoke brain activity by external stimuli presentation, creating an artificial dissociation between perception and action. Here, we examine object category representations during active vision by combining MVPA with a deconvolution method for overlapping fixation-related responses. By decoding category information from single fixations, we compare the temporal dynamics of object processing between free viewing (active) and rapid serial visual presentation (passive) conditions. We find that categorical information, across multiple levels of abstraction, can be decoded from individual fixations during natural viewing, and that object representations generalize across passive and active conditions. Notably, representational dynamics time-locked to fixation onset emerge earlier than those time-locked to stimulus onset. We discuss the possibility that object processing begins parafoveally, aligned with saccade onset, rather than foveally at fixation. Thus, information about what and when to expect new information, available in free viewing, facilitates processing. These findings underscore the importance of studying vision in naturalistic settings and highlight key methodological considerations for combining MVPA with deconvolution in overlapping neural data. Object processing is fundamental to visual perception and to cognitive and computational models of vision. Although MVPA has advanced EEG research by enabling the decoding of distributed neural representations with high temporal precision, it has been applied primarily in passive viewing paradigms that constrain natural eye movements. The current study bridges the gap between passive and active vision research by combining MVPA with overlap deconvolution to decode object category information from EEG during natural fixations in free viewing. This approach reveals that category-specific representations emerge earlier in active viewing, likely reflecting processing that begins during saccade planning or execution. The findings underscore the importance of studying vision under ecologically valid conditions and introduce a novel methodological framework for capturing neural dynamics during active perception.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然观看与被动观看下物体类别加工的时间动态差异，将多变量模式分析与重叠注视相关反应的解卷积方法结合，从脑电中解码单个注视期间的类别信息。结果显示，自然观看中单个注视即可解码多层次的类别信息，且物体表征能在被动与主动条件间泛化；值得注意的是，锁定于注视起始的表征动态比锁定于刺激呈现的更早出现。作者据此提出，物体加工可能在副中央凹、与眼跳起始对齐时便已开始，而非在注视时于中央凹启动，自由观看中关于“看什么、何时期待新信息”的可用信息因而促进了加工。这些发现强调了在自然情境中研究视觉的重要性，也提示了将多变量模式分析与解卷积结合处理重叠神经数据时的方法学考量。

papers.title: Dual Mechanisms of Impaired Visual Processing in Glaucoma: Insights From Resting-State and Task-Related EEG.
papers.authors: Mei X, Chen L, Chan LH, Lyu A, Tsang C, Leung C, Thompson B, Cheong AMY.
papers.abstract: Purpose To examine both resting-state and task-related electroencephalography (EEG) changes associated with visual processing in glaucoma. Methods Thirty glaucoma patients (mean age, 63 ± 8.26 years; visual field mean deviation, -15.41 ± 6.34 dB) and 28 age-matched controls (62.86 ± 9.19 years) underwent resting-state EEG for 3 minutes under eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions. Alpha suppression, calculated as the difference between conditions, was assessed as a measure of cognitive state transition capacity. Visual evoked potentials (VEPs) were recorded using a 64-channel EEG system during a checkerboard reversal task under monocular and binocular viewing. Results Resting-state EEG revealed that significantly reduced alpha suppression was highly specific to a high-alpha subband (10.0-12.9 Hz; P < 0.001), and low-alpha (7.0-9.9 Hz) modulation remained intact in the glaucoma group. Task-related EEG showed delayed latency and reduced amplitude in both P100 and N75-P100 components in the glaucoma group, indicating impaired visual processing. Effect size analysis indicated that P100 amplitude and N75-P100 latency showed the largest group differences, highlighting these as the most prominent cortical changes. Notably, alpha suppression deficits showed no significant correlation with glaucoma severity or VEP parameters, suggesting distinct neurophysiological mechanisms beyond direct visual pathway damage. Conclusions Both resting-state and task-related EEG measures differed between the glaucoma and control groups, indicating alterations in cortical activity and visual-pathway responses. Specifically, the localized high alpha modulation deficit suggests altered top-down visual network dynamics in glaucoma.

papers.title: Diagnostic Images for Mild Cognitive Impairment Are Sensitive to Alzheimer's Disease Biomarkers and Reveal Abnormal Scene Processing.
papers.authors: Bai Y, Peters O, Freiesleben SD, Fenski F, Priller J, Spruth EJ, Schneider A, Fliessbach K, Wiltfang J, Bartels C, Rostamzadeh A, Glanz W, Teipel S, Kilimann I, Laske C, Spottke A, Roy-Kluth N, Brosseron F, Wagner M, Frommann I, Lüsebrink F, Ramirez A, Dechent P, Hetzer S, Scheffler K, Yakupov R, Jessen F, Düzel E, Bainbridge WA.
papers.abstract: Research on visual episodic memory impairment in Alzheimer's disease often focuses on memory processes rather than the specific content of the images being remembered. We previously showed that patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), a transitional stage that may precede Alzheimer's disease, can memorize certain images well, indicating that episodic memory is not uniformly impaired. Conversely, other specific images could not be memorized by MCI patients and were instead diagnostic for distinguishing MCI from healthy older adults. In this study, we investigate whether poor memory for these diagnostic images relates to impaired neural processing in specific brain regions and Alzheimer's biomarker pathology. We assessed 64 healthy controls and 48 MCI participants from the DZNE Longitudinal Cognitive Impairment and Dementia Study. Participants performed a visual scene memory task during fMRI and provided cerebrospinal fluid biomarker data for amyloid and tau. Diagnostic images demonstrated significantly larger behavior-biomarker correlations (total tau, phospho-tau, Aβ42/Aβ40, and Aβ42/phospho-tau) compared with nondiagnostic images. This suggests memory for these specific diagnostic images is more affected by Alzheimer's disease pathology. The fMRI data revealed an interaction effect between group membership (healthy control/MCI) and image diagnosticity (diagnostic/nondiagnostic). MCI participants exhibited higher activation in scene-processing regions (parahippocampal place area, retrosplenial cortex, and occipital place area) for diagnostic compared with nondiagnostic images. Healthy controls, however, showed no processing differences between diagnostic and nondiagnostic images. These findings suggest MCI individuals may engage in inefficiently heightened encoding activation for diagnostic images. Our results show that special "diagnostic" images exist that can reliably reveal underlying amyloid and tau pathology alongside altered neural activity in scene regions.
