Training with contingent feedback significantly enhanced upregulation capacity across all hippocampal subfields compared with the sham protocol, and this effect was absent in the untargeted yet functionally connected entorhinal cortex. Across both studies, successful hippocampal upregulation was associated with co-activation of medial temporal and default-mode network regions. Additionally, successful hippocampal upregulation during later training runs was associated with multivariate pattern shifts in this hippocampal-upregulation network at event boundaries during subsequent movie viewing, suggesting that neurofeedback training may alter boundary-related neural representations during naturalistic experience. These findings reveal that contingent hippocampal feedback can facilitate the acquisition of self-neuromodulation via mental strategies, with potential implications for interventions targeting hippocampus-dependent functions.

relevance.reason: 实时fMRI神经反馈训练人自我调节海马活动，并考察训练后电影观看中事件边界表征变化，涉及学习可塑性与自然刺激脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人能否通过自我生成的心理状态在单次训练内上调海马活动，并比较了实时fMRI神经反馈与接受相同任务指令但无海马相关反馈的对照方案。结果显示，只有与海马状态波动相关的反馈才有助于识别或精炼有效的认知策略，反馈训练提升了所有海马亚区的上调能力，而功能相连但未作为靶点的内嗅皮层未见同样效果。成功的海马上调伴随内侧颞叶和默认模式网络区域共同激活，且后续训练中的成功上调与自然观影时事件边界处该网络的多变量模式变化相关，提示反馈训练可能改变自然体验中的边界相关神经表征。

papers.title: Serotonin biology as a basis for explaining psychedelic drug action.
papers.authors: Knox CA, Li-Wu A, Kwan AC.
papers.abstract: Psychedelics exert their effects primarily through the serotonergic system. Like the endogenous neuromodulator, the drugs bind to many serotonin receptor subtypes. However, their receptor selectivity profiles and spatiotemporal patterns of action differ from those of serotonin and vary across compounds. In this review, we summarize studies that have established roles for serotonin in three domains: reward learning, visual processing, and cerebrovascular function. We contrast the neurophysiological and behavioral consequences of endogenous serotonin release with those produced by exogenous psychedelic administration. We propose that several major effects of psychedelics can be understood as perturbations to serotonergic signaling, while also noting some drug actions that remain difficult to explain by existing serotonin biology. Viewing psychedelic drug action through the lens of serotonin provides a mechanistic framework for linking molecular pharmacology to circuit dynamics and behavior.

relevance.reason: 综述血清素在奖赏学习、视觉加工和脑血管功能中的作用，涉及神经机制但摘要未明确以人脑为对象，且含脑血管功能。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述以血清素系统为切入点，梳理了血清素在奖赏学习、视觉加工和脑血管功能三个领域中的作用，并对比内源性血清素释放与外源性致幻剂给药在神经生理和行为层面的不同后果。作者提出，致幻剂的若干主要效应可理解为对血清素信号的扰动，但同时也指出，部分药物作用仍难以用现有血清素生物学解释。文章认为，从血清素视角审视致幻剂作用，可为连接分子药理学、环路动态与行为提供机制框架。

papers.title: Integrative EEG/fMRI evidence for a multi-scale network underlying self-face and personal-object recognition.
papers.authors: Kotlewska I, Panek B, Bielski K, Asanowicz D.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: The sense of ownership of our faces and possessions shapes our visual perception. While the neural basis of self-face recognition has been well-studied, the neural basis of recognizing personally owned objects remains poorly understood. The main aim of this study was to investigate brain activity underlying self-face and personal object recognition, with a particular focus on the extent to which the ownership processing can be characterized as either domain-general and/or stimulus-specific. We first review the relevant literature and then report findings from two experiments - one using EEG and the other fMRI - in which the same 30 participants categorized images of faces and objects as either "mine" or "others". EEG results revealed ownership-related visuo-midfrontal activity, reflected in event-related potentials (visual P1 and N170, and midfrontal N150 and SMN), frequency-specific inter-source phase coherence (in theta band), and brain-wide time-frequency power dynamics (in alpha, beta, and theta bands). fMRI results identified ownership-related activity in four right hemisphere regions: the inferior temporal gyrus, middle frontal gyrus, inferior frontal gyrus, and superior parietal lobule; each of which formed distinct ownership-related subnetworks. The findings support "a hybrid model" in which stimulus-specific visual pathways (e.g., face-sensitive regions) interact with domain-general frontal activity encoding self-relevance. This integrative evidence clarifies how a dynamic, multi-scale network underlying ownership perception is constructed across time, frequency, and brain space.

relevance.reason: 该研究用EEG/fMRI考察自我面孔与个人物品识别的多尺度脑网络，涉及自我相关加工和额叶-视觉通路交互。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自我面孔与个人物品识别背后的脑活动，重点考察所有权加工在多大程度上是领域通用的、又在多大程度上具有刺激特异性。作者先梳理相关文献，再对同一批被试开展脑电和功能磁共振两个实验，让其判断面孔和物品图片属于“我的”还是“他人的”。脑电结果发现与所有权相关的视觉—中额叶活动，以及跨源相位相干和全脑时频功率动态；功能磁共振则识别出右半球四个与所有权相关的区域，并各自构成不同的子网络。作者据此提出混合模型：刺激特异的视觉通路与编码自我相关性的领域通用额叶活动相互作用，共同构成跨时间、频率和脑空间的动态多尺度网络。

papers.title: Attentional control predicts procrastination through cognitive reappraisal: Behavioral mediation and connectome-based predictive modeling evidences.
papers.authors: Xiong M, Zhang X, Zhang R, Yin Y, Feng T.
papers.abstract: Theories and empirical studies have consistently shown a negative association between attentional control and procrastination. However, the cognitive and neural basis underlying this association remain unclear. To address these questions, we integrated resting-state functional MRI with measures of attentional control, cognitive reappraisal, and procrastination across a discovery dataset (N = 302) and a held-out validation dataset (N = 104). The behavioral results showed that attentional control negatively predicted procrastination, and this association was mediated by cognitive reappraisal. At the neural level, connectome-based predictive modeling (CPM) revealed that functional connectivity between the medial frontal, fronto-parietal, limbic, and motor/sensory networks positively predicted attentional control. More importantly, mediation analyses showed that cognitive reappraisal mediated the association between attentional-control-related neural networks and procrastination. These findings provide the first evidence that the association between attentional control and procrastination is related to cognitive and neural processes involving cognitive reappraisal.

relevance.reason: 用静息态功能连接预测注意控制并中介拖延，涉及注意与情绪调节的脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注注意控制与拖延之间的关联及其认知和神经基础，结合静息态功能磁共振与注意控制、认知重评和拖延的行为测量，在发现数据集和独立验证数据集中进行分析。行为结果显示，注意控制负向预测拖延，且这一关联由认知重评中介；基于连接组的预测建模进一步发现，内侧额叶、额顶、边缘及运动/感觉网络之间的功能连接正向预测注意控制，而认知重评也中介了注意控制相关神经网络与拖延之间的关联。作者据此认为，注意控制与拖延的关联涉及以认知重评为核心的认知与神经过程，但这一结论基于关联与预测分析，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Generalized Linear Mixed Models for Changepoint Analysis of Biomedical Time Series Data.
papers.authors: Fiecas M, Killick R, Cullen K.
papers.abstract: Changepoint analysis for time series data identifies the time points for which properties about the data shift. In this paper, we are motivated by two distinct types of biomedical time series data: digital health monitoring and neuroimaging. The neuroimaging study consists of multivariate time series obtained from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). The digital health monitoring data consists of binary univariate time series observed within an individual throughout the day across multiple days of activity. The goal of the analysis is to model how physical activity changes within a day over a period of 56 days. The goal in the analysis of that data is to determine the association between dynamic functional connectivity (dFC), which is the interaction between different brain regions and how this interaction changes over time, and severity of non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI). In this paper, we leverage the framework of generalized linear mixed models to incorporate structure that is present in biomedical time series data for changepoint analysis. This structure could be, for example, the repeated measures of the time series data within an individual across multiple days or the interconnected community structure of brain networks. We embed the mixed model in a dynamic programming algorithm for detecting multiple changepoints. We evaluate the performance of our proposed method across several scenarios using simulations. Finally, we show the utility of our proposed method on our two distinct motivating applications.

relevance.reason: 方法学论文，以静息态fMRI动态功能连接为应用示例，但摘要未报告具体脑组织发现，主要贡献为统计模型与模拟。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对生物医学时间序列中的变点分析问题，提出将广义线性混合模型嵌入动态规划算法，以纳入个体多日重复测量或脑网络社区结构等数据固有结构，并用模拟评估方法性能。作者将方法应用于两类数据：数字健康监测中个体多日体力活动的日内变化，以及静息态功能磁共振得到的动态功能连接与非自杀性自伤严重程度之间的关联。研究重点在于方法框架的构建与演示，而非确立因果或临床效果。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Mediation Analysis With Network Mediators: Applications to Pediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
papers.authors: Wang JX, Lu ZH, Reddick WE, Conklin HM, Glass JO, Jacola L, Onar-Thomas A, Jeha S, Cheng C, Zhou X, Li Y.
papers.abstract: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) is the most common childhood cancer, with survivors frequently experiencing long-term neurocognitive morbidities. Here, we utilize the TOTXVI clinical trial data to elucidate the mechanisms underlying treatment-related neurocognitive side effects in pediatric ALL patients by incorporating brain connectivity network data. To enable such analysis, we propose a high-dimensional mediation analysis method with a novel network mediation structural shrinkage (NMSS) prior, which is particularly suited for analyzing high-dimensional brain structural connectivity network data that serve as mediators. Our method is capable of addressing the structural dependencies of brain connectivity networks including sparsity, effective degrees of nodes, and modularity, yielding accurate estimates of the high-dimensional coefficients and mediation effects. We demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed NMSS method through simulation studies and apply it to the TOTXVI data, revealing significant mediation effects of brain connectivity on visual processing speed directed by IT intensity. The findings shed light on the potential of targeted interventions to mitigate neurocognitive deficits in pediatric ALL survivors.

relevance.reason: 该研究以儿童ALL患者的结构连接网络为中介，分析治疗相关神经认知（视觉加工速度）的脑网络机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）患者治疗相关神经认知副作用，提出一种带网络中介结构收缩（NMSS）先验的高维中介分析方法，用于处理作为中介变量的脑结构连接网络数据。方法通过刻画网络的稀疏性、节点有效度和模块化等结构依赖，提高高维系数与中介效应的估计精度，并在模拟研究中验证了其有效性。应用于TOTXVI临床试验数据后，分析显示脑连接在IT强度与视觉加工速度之间起显著中介作用，提示针对相关脑网络通路的干预可能有助于减轻ALL幸存者的神经认知缺陷。

papers.title: MRI Characterization of Structural Brain Abnormalities in NGLY1 Deficiency.
papers.authors: Dennis EL, Zhu L, Mueller WF, Cook JW, Morrison G, Wilsey M, Dant R, Dwight S, Lee KJ.
papers.journal: International journal of developmental neuroscience : the official journal of the International Society for Developmental Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Background and objectives NGLY1 (N-Glycanase 1) deficiency is an ultrarare autosomal recessive disorder affecting ~165 patients worldwide, characterized by developmental delay, hyperkinetic movement disorders and shortened life expectancy. Despite its severe neurological manifestations, comprehensive neuroimaging characterization has been limited to case reports and small descriptive studies. Our objective was to investigate alterations in brain morphology in patients with NGLY1 deficiency and determine whether these metrics associate with clinical phenotypes. Methods This case series analysed real-world MRI scans performed on 11 patients with molecularly diagnosed NGLY1 deficiency between 1999 and 2023 at sites across the globe. Ages ranged from 2 to 19 years at scan time (five female and six male). Cortical and subcortical morphology, including subcortical volume and cortical thickness, surface area, volume and curvature, was measured with three-dimensional T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. Z scores were calculated using normative models from CentileBrain for patients > 3 years old or custom models for patients < 3 years old. Clinical phenotypes were matched to Human Phenotype Ontology codes. Results Sixteen scans from 11 patients met quality criteria for analysis. Both age groups (under and over 3 years old) showed significantly reduced subcortical volumes, particularly in bilateral thalamus and putamen. Younger patients demonstrated widespread reductions in cortical surface area, volume and curvature, indicating altered gyrification patterns. Older patients showed thinner dorsal and thicker ventral cortical regions with limited surface area reductions. Thalamic volume reduction in older patients correlated with gait disturbance, dysphagia and EEG abnormalities, with additional cortical associations with sleep and hearing abnormalities. Seizure presence in younger patients correlated with altered cortical thickness, surface area and curvature patterns. Discussion NGLY1 deficiency is associated with pervasive alterations in brain development affecting both subcortical and cortical morphology. Age-dependent patterns of cortical alterations indicate disrupted neurodevelopmental trajectories that may reflect impaired neuronal migration and/or altered synaptic pruning. Correlations with clinical variables suggest that these measures may serve as useful biomarkers for tracking disease progression and/or treatment efficacy. These findings provide a comprehensive neuroimaging characterization of NGLY1 Deficiency and establish a foundation for understanding brain structure-function relationships in this ultrarare disorder.

relevance.reason: 对罕见神经发育障碍患者进行MRI脑形态分析，报告皮层/皮层下结构改变及其与临床表型关联，属脑发育与疾病机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该病例系列研究分析了11名分子确诊的NGLY1缺陷患者在全球多中心获得的真实世界MRI扫描，用三维T1加权成像测量皮层与皮层下形态，并与临床表型对照。结果显示，患者皮层下体积普遍减小，尤以双侧丘脑和壳核明显；年幼患者皮层表面积、体积和曲率广泛降低，提示脑回化模式异常，年长患者则表现为背侧皮层变薄、腹侧变厚而表面积减少有限。年长患者丘脑体积减小与步态障碍、吞咽困难和脑电异常相关，年幼患者癫痫与皮层厚度、表面积和曲率改变相关。作者认为该病涉及皮层与皮层下脑发育的广泛改变，年龄依赖的皮层模式提示神经发育轨迹受扰，这些指标或可作为追踪疾病进展和治疗效果的候选生物标志物，但相关结果尚属关联性发现。

papers.title: Cortical Motor Hierarchy Disruption Is Associated With Functional Status in Early Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
papers.authors: Luan J, Yun Y, Jiao Y, Wang Y, Ma M, Shan D, Wang H, Ji X, Tang Y, Li J, Zhan Z, Sun X, Gao N, Lin P, Yan C, Sun X, Yu D, Liu S, Liu F.
papers.journal: Journal of cachexia, sarcopenia and muscle
papers.abstract: Background Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a devastating neuromuscular disease characterised by progressive muscle wasting and functional decline. Although cortical motor network disruption is a hallmark of ALS, the large-scale functional hierarchy alterations and their underlying molecular mechanisms in the early stage of the disease (ALS-ES) remain poorly understood. We aimed to characterise cortical gradient changes in early-stage ALS and to examine their neurochemical and transcriptomic correlates, as well as their cross-sectional associations with clinical functional status. Methods We recruited 97 patients with early-stage ALS, all at King's stage 1 and 94 healthy controls with comparable age and sex distributions. The ALS-ES group included 65 women and had a median ALSFRS-R score of 40 (IQR, 37-44). Resting-state fMRI was used to construct the principal functional gradient. We integrated neurochemical maps of 19 neurotransmitter receptors/transporters, and transcriptomic data from the Allen Human Brain Atlas. Partial least squares (PLS) regression and cell-type enrichment analysis were employed to identify molecular correlates of gradient alterations. Results Compared with HCs, ALS-ES patients exhibited a significant spatial contraction of the principal gradient. Specifically, gradient values significantly increased in the somatomotor network (SMN; t = 3.670, pFDR = 0.001) and decreased in the default mode network (DMN; t = -4.124, pFDR < 0.001). Within the ALS-ES group, higher SMN gradient values were associated with lower ALSFRS-R scores, whereas higher DMN gradient values were associated with higher ALSFRS-R scores. These macroscale alterations showed spatial correspondence with normative 5-HT4 receptor and norepinephrine transporter maps. PLS analysis identified a primary gene set (PLS1+) enriched in oligodendrocytes and mitochondrial functions (pFDR < 0.05), whereas the negative set (PLS1-) was associated with astrocytes, GABAergic neurons and RNA splicing pathways. Chromosome-level analysis revealed significant enrichment of PLS1- genes on chromosomes 5 and 16 (p < 0.05). Conclusions Early-stage ALS is characterised by a collapsed cortical functional hierarchy centred on the motor-somatosensory axis. These alterations were spatially associated with normative neurochemical maps and distinct transcriptomic annotations related to energy metabolism and RNA processing. These findings identify cross-sectional cortical functional-hierarchy alterations associated with functional status in early-stage ALS and provide a multi-scale framework for investigating their neurochemical and transcriptomic correlates.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fMRI刻画早期ALS患者皮层功能梯度改变及其与功能状态的关系，属于脑疾病与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早期肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者大脑皮层运动功能层级的大尺度改变及其分子关联，比较了早期患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振主梯度，并结合神经递质受体图谱和转录组数据进行分析。结果显示，患者的主梯度出现空间收缩，感觉运动网络梯度值升高、默认网络梯度值降低，且这两个方向的梯度值与临床功能评分分别呈负、正关联。这些改变在空间上与5-HT4受体和去甲肾上腺素转运体分布对应，相关基因集分别富集于少突胶质细胞与线粒体功能，以及星形胶质细胞、GABA能神经元和RNA剪接通路。作者据此提出，早期ALS以运动-躯体感觉轴为中心的功能层级塌缩为特征，但相关分析为横断面关联，不能说明因果或治疗效应。

papers.title: Association Between Gray Matter Microstructure and Glucose Metabolism in Older Adults With Cognitive Decline: A Multimodal Imaging Study.
papers.authors: Canna A, De Rosa AP, Nicolai E, Salvatore E, Cavaliere C, Di Cecca A, Migliaccio M, Alfano V, Pappatà S, Aiello M, Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative.
papers.abstract: Cortical glucose hypometabolism is a well-established early marker of neurodegeneration in dementia, mainly reflecting neuronal and synaptic dysfunction. Its relationship with underlying microstructural alterations remains unclear. Here, we combined multi-shell diffusion microstructural and [18 F]-FDG PET data to investigate the possible association between regional cerebral glucose metabolism and microstructural integrity in patients with cognitive decline. Subjects from two independent datasets, an in-house dataset of 65 cognitively impaired patients from a memory-clinic cohort and a cognitively impaired cohort retrieved from the ADNI database (advanced ADNI3 protocol), underwent [18 F]-FDG PET and MRI scanning. Multiple linear regression models were used to evaluate regional associations between glucose metabolism and gray matter microstructure, as measured by NODDI-derived metrics, namely neurite density index (NDI) and orientation dispersion index (ODI). Global spatial associations between metabolic and microstructural-derived maps were investigated via spin tests. Regional analysis showed widespread significant positive associations between glucose consumption and ODI across the cortex and subcortex. In both datasets, the global spatial association between NODDI and metabolism showed the ODI being significantly correlated with glucose metabolism (ρ = 0.36, pspin < 0.001 for the in-house dataset; ρ = 0.54, pspin < 0.001 for the ADNI dataset). Our findings provide new evidence that regional glucose metabolism in cognitive decline is positively associated with alterations in microstructural organization, as reflected by decreased neurite complexity. The significant association suggests that microstructural alterations may parallel the metabolic deficits characteristic of neurodegenerative diseases, pointing to a link between microstructural properties and neuronal metabolic dysfunction.

relevance.reason: 该研究在认知衰退患者中结合扩散微结构与FDG-PET，考察灰质微结构组织与葡萄糖代谢的关联，属于脑结构与功能耦合及脑疾病机理。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注认知衰退老年人中灰质微结构与脑区葡萄糖代谢之间的关系，结合多壳扩散成像指标与[18F]-FDG PET，在两个独立认知受损队列中分析二者的区域及全局空间关联。区域分析显示，葡萄糖消耗与反映神经突方向离散度的ODI在皮层和皮层下广泛呈正相关；全局空间分析中，ODI与葡萄糖代谢显著相关，且这一结果在两个数据集中一致。作者据此认为，认知衰退中的区域葡萄糖代谢与神经突复杂度降低所反映的微结构组织改变相伴随，提示微结构变化可能与神经退行性疾病的代谢缺陷并行，但这一关联本身并不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Functional Imaging of Hippocampal Layers Using VASO and BOLD on the Next Generation (NexGen) 7T Scanner.
papers.authors: Häkkinen S, Beckett A, Walker E, Huber L, Feinberg DA.
papers.abstract: Spatial accuracy and venous biases are a central concern in mesoscale fMRI, with subcortical brain regions facing additional challenges due to lower sensitivity, high physiological noise, and complicated vasculature. Here, we optimized CBV VASO on the NexGen 7T scanner for layer-specific investigations of the human hippocampus. Both VASO and BOLD (from the same acquisition) detected significant hippocampal activation during an established autobiographical memory task. At the macroscale, activation patterns converged, showing pronounced memory task activation in the anterior hippocampus and consistent engagement across the frontoparietal neocortex. At the laminar scale, however, differences in depth-dependent profiles emerged within the subiculum: BOLD exhibited a pronounced bias toward the inner layers, consistent with the known venous drainage pattern in the subfield. Finally, the optimized effective TR of 3.2 s allowed exploratory study of retrieval stages and neocortical functional connectivity, which both supported hippocampal anterior-posterior dissociation using either VASO or BOLD. Thus, hippocampal fMRI allows mapping layer function with high accuracy and can provide deeper insights into a number of neuropsychological phenomena and disorders.

relevance.reason: 在7T下用VASO/BOLD对人海马进行分层功能成像，揭示记忆任务激活的层状分布差异。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在NexGen 7T扫描仪上优化了基于脑血容量（CBV）的VASO序列，并与BOLD对比，用于人脑海马的分层功能成像。在自传体记忆任务中，两种方法均检测到海马显著激活，宏观激活模式趋同，表现为前海马激活明显并伴随额顶新皮层的参与；但在亚层尺度上，两者在穹窿下托出现深度依赖的差异，BOLD偏向内层，与已知静脉引流模式一致。作者据此认为，海马fMRI能够较准确地绘制分层功能，并可能为相关神经心理现象和疾病研究提供线索。

papers.title: Decoding Graded Grip-Force Intensity From fMRI Data Reveals a Transformation From Abstract to Effector- and Movement-Specific Codes Prior to Execution.
papers.authors: Caccialupi G, Schmidt TT, Blankenburg F.
papers.abstract: Motor planning entails a progressive transformation of neural representations - from abstract motor goals, which represent intended action-outcomes independent of any particular effector (i.e., the body part executing the action), to effector-specific movement plans. Functional MRI (fMRI) studies have shown that parametric variations in parietal activity patterns reflect the encoding of intended force-intensities in effector-specific regions, even before detailed movement parameters are specified. However, how these intended force-intensities are initially represented in an abstract, effector-independent format and subsequently transformed into effector- and movement-specific plans remains unclear. To address this, human-participants performed a delayed grip-force task during fMRI. They first prepared two of four possible force-intensities, then received a cue indicating which hand should apply which force, and finally executed both grips simultaneously. Using time-resolved support vector regression (SVR) combined with a searchlight approach, we identified brain-regions that parametrically code grip-force intensities across two 6-s delay periods. During the first delay, above-chance decoding was observed in a medial section of the posterior parietal cortex spanning the precuneus and superior parietal lobule (PCu/SPL), whereas during the second delay it emerged in effector-specific regions, including the contralateral intraparietal sulcus (pIPS/aIPS), primary somatosensory cortex (S1), dorsal premotor cortex (PMd), and supplementary motor area (SMA). Cross-decoding confirmed effector-independent coding in the PCu/SPL, while cross-temporal generalization revealed stable representations in the contralateral IPS and PMd from the second delay through execution. Together, these findings indicate a progressive transformation from abstract representations of intended force-intensity in the PCu/SPL to effector- and movement-specific plans in the IPS and PMd.

relevance.reason: fMRI解码人类运动计划中握力强度表征从抽象到效应器特异编码的转化，属运动认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注运动准备中意图性握力强度如何从抽象目标转化为具体动作计划。研究者让人类被试在fMRI延迟握力任务中先准备两种力强度，再根据提示确定用手并执行，并用时间分辨的支持向量回归结合探照灯分析追踪两个延迟阶段的编码。结果发现，第一延迟阶段后顶叶皮层内侧（楔前叶与上顶叶小叶）能解码握力强度且具有效应器独立性，第二延迟阶段则转为对侧顶内沟、初级体感皮层、背侧前运动皮层和辅助运动区等效应器特异区域；跨时间泛化显示对侧顶内沟和背侧前运动皮层的表征从第二延迟持续到执行。作者据此提出，意图力强度先以抽象形式表征，随后逐步转化为效应器和动作特异的计划。

papers.title: Lobular and Voxel-Wise Genetic Influences on Cerebellar Gray Matter Volume and Associations With Social and Trait Anxiety in Twins.
papers.authors: Yildiz-Ahola T, Kastrati G, Fransson P, Åhs F, Furmark T, Manzouri A, Timmann D, Månsson KNT, Rosén J.
papers.abstract: The cerebellum supports motor, cognitive, and affective functions, but the spatial pattern of genetic influence on its morphology and its relevance to anxiety traits remains unclear. Using structural MRI data from monozygotic and dizygotic twins (298 participants), we estimated additive genetic and environmental contributions to cerebellar gray matter volume at lobular and voxel scales. Monozygotic twins showed higher intra-pair correlations than dizygotic twins across cerebellar regions, indicating genetic influence with marked spatial heterogeneity: effects were strongest in posterior and vermal lobules (notably lobule IX, Crus I/II, and vermis VII-VIII) and more moderate in anterior motor-related lobules; cerebellar white matter also showed strong genetic influence. Voxel-wise mapping confirmed this pattern and revealed within-lobule heterogeneity not captured by lobular averaging, with additive genetic factors explaining ~45% of voxel-level variance and minimal shared environmental effects. Social (measured via the Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale-Self Report; LSAS-SR) and trait (State-Trait Anxiety Inventory; STAI-T) anxiety were substantially heritable, whereas phenotypic, genetic, and unique environmental correlations with cerebellar volumes were small and did not survive multiple-comparisons correction. These results show that genetic influence on cerebellar structure is strongly spatially heterogeneous and scale-dependent, whereas associations between cerebellar gray matter volume and anxiety severity are weak in this non-clinical adult sample.

relevance.reason: 双生子结构MRI研究小脑灰质体积的遗传影响及其与焦虑特质的关联，涉及脑结构组织与情绪认知表型。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用同卵与异卵双胞胎的结构磁共振数据，考察小脑灰质体积在脑叶和体素尺度上的遗传与环境贡献，并检验其与社交焦虑和特质焦虑的关联。结果显示，小脑结构受遗传影响且空间分布明显不均，后叶和蚓部某些区域以及小脑白质的遗传效应较强，前部运动相关脑叶相对较弱；体素分析还揭示了脑叶内部未被平均化掩盖的异质性，加性遗传因素可解释约四成五的体素水平变异，共享环境作用很小。社交焦虑和特质焦虑本身具有较高遗传度，但其与小脑体积在表型、遗传和独特环境层面的相关都较弱，且未通过多重比较校正。作者据此认为，小脑结构的遗传影响具有明显的空间异质性和尺度依赖性，而在这一非临床成人样本中，小脑灰质体积与焦虑严重程度的关系并不强。

papers.title: Multimodal Brain Graph Analysis for Uncovering Path-Based Biomarkers in Schizophrenia: Integrating Static and Dynamic Approaches.
papers.authors: Falakshahi H, Rokham H, Mathalon DH, Ford JM, Mueller BA, Preda A, van Erp TGM, Turner JA, Pearlson G, Calhoun VD.
papers.abstract: Analyzing multimodal brain networks offers new insights into the mechanisms of brain disorders. However, most studies focus on unimodal networks or use global/local graph metrics, often missing critical information about disrupted pathways. In this study, we propose a novel framework for estimating static and dynamic multimodal brain graphs by integrating time-resolved functional network connectivity (FNC) and gray matter features using a Gaussian graphical model. We then apply a path-based graph theory analysis to identify connectors and disconnectors, edges that respectively introduce or eliminate paths in the patient graph compared to controls. Our findings in schizophrenia reveal several edges linked to missing or additional paths, indicating network disruptions that are undetectable using unimodal or pairwise analyses. These disrupted pathways span both within- and cross-modal connections, particularly involving regions like the middle temporal gyrus and cerebellum. This work demonstrates the value of multimodal integration and emphasizes the importance of moving beyond individual edge-level analysis when characterizing disease-related network alterations. Our path-centric approach provides a complementary view of brain connectivity disruption and identifies candidate path-based markers of schizophrenia that warrant validation in independent datasets.

relevance.reason: 以精神分裂症患者为对象，整合功能连接与灰质特征的多模态脑图分析，揭示网络通路中断机制，属脑疾病机理与结构-功能组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对精神分裂症，提出一个整合静态与动态多模态脑图的框架，将时间分辨的功能网络连接与灰质特征结合，并采用基于路径的图论分析来识别患者图中相比对照组引入或消除路径的连接边与断开边。结果显示，若干与路径缺失或增加相关的边涉及模态内和跨模态连接，尤其涉及颞中回和小脑等区域，这些网络异常在单模态或逐对分析中难以发现。作者据此强调多模态整合及超越单条边层面分析的价值，认为基于路径的方法可补充刻画脑连接破坏，并提供有待独立数据验证的精神分裂症候选路径标记。

papers.title: Major Depressive Disorder With Non-Suicidal Self-Injury in Adolescents: Altered Morphological Inverse Divergence Gradient in Brain Structure and Gene Expression Patterns.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Hu X, Wang W, Wang J, Li H, Wan Y, Zhu J, Liu F, Tao S, Wang D, Lin X, Zhang Y, Zhang H, Gong Y.
papers.abstract: Adolescents with major depressive disorder (MDD) and non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) face serious challenges to their mental and physical health. The development of this condition is influenced by genetic, environmental, and brain development factors. In this study, we used the Morphometric Inverse Divergence Gradient Network (MIND-Gd) for the first time to explore brain structural network abnormalities and their transcriptional mechanisms in adolescents with MDD and NSSI. A total of 241 adolescents with MDD participated in this study. Among them, 134 had NSSI, while 107 did not. Using high-resolution T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), we constructed the principal MIND gradient network. This network reflects the similarity of cortical morphology between different brain regions. The results showed that adolescents with NSSI had higher MIND gradient values in the left caudal middle frontal gyrus and bilateral inferior temporal gyri. In contrast, lower values were observed in the left lingual gyrus and right superior parietal lobule. These structural changes were spatially correlated with functional alterations in the dorsal attention network. Further analysis revealed that these differences were linked to the distribution of nine types of neurotransmitter receptors, including 5-HT1A, GABAa, glutamate, and dopamine. Partial least squares regression analysis (PLS) was also conducted. The first component (PLS1) explained 39.53% of the spatial variance in MIND-Gd. This analysis identified key genes related to NSSI, such as GABRA5 and MGST1. Enrichment analysis showed that PLS1+ genes were involved in synaptic signaling, neurodevelopment, and mood disorder pathways. These genes were enriched in astrocytes and cortical layers I, II, and V. On the other hand, PLS1- genes were linked to chromatin regulation and cytoskeletal metabolism. These genes were mainly expressed in Cortical Layers III and IV. In conclusion, adolescents with MDD and NSSI show specific abnormalities in brain structural gradients. These abnormalities are closely related to neurotransmitter receptor distributions and gene expression patterns. The findings provide multi-level evidence for understanding the neurobiological mechanisms of NSSI.

relevance.reason: 以青少年MDD伴NSSI患者为对象，用T1结构MRI构建皮层形态梯度网络并关联基因表达，研究脑结构组织异常，属脑疾病机理与结构-功能。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注伴非自杀性自伤的青少年重性抑郁障碍患者，采用高分辨率结构磁共振构建反映皮层形态相似性的MIND梯度网络，比较伴与不伴非自杀性自伤者的脑结构梯度差异。结果显示，伴自伤者在左尾侧中额回和双侧颞下回梯度值较高，在左舌回和右顶上小叶较低，这些差异在空间上与背侧注意网络的功能改变相关，并与多种神经递质受体分布及特定基因表达模式相联系，涉及突触信号、神经发育和情绪障碍相关通路。作者据此认为，伴非自杀性自伤的青少年抑郁患者存在特定的脑结构梯度异常，为理解其神经生物学机制提供了多层面线索，但相关发现尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Individualised Structural and Functional Frontostriatal Connectivity Mapping in Adult ADHD.
papers.authors: Tolonen T, Laine M, Alho K, Leppämäki S, Tani P, Koski A, Salmi J, Roine T.
papers.abstract: Abundant research from early neurocognitive models to recent mega-analyses has highlighted the central role of frontostriatal circuits in attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). However, it remains unclear which specific aspects of functionally organised frontostriatal loops are affected by ADHD and how these disruptions differ across individuals in light of the disorder's marked heterogeneity. We investigated frontostriatal connectivity in individualised circuits in 40 adults with ADHD and 36 neurotypical controls using a multimodal dataset that included diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), as well as functional MRI during working memory updating, resting state, and a naturalistic attention task. Compared with the neurotypical controls, the adults with ADHD exhibited reduced structural connectivity strength in a tract originating from left orbital prefrontal areas. However, structural results did not reproduce in control analyses using different thresholds in individual formation of regions of interest. Functional data revealed weaker connectivity in the ADHD group during verbal and visuospatial working memory tasks in circuits connecting the striatum with the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, motor regions, and orbitofrontal cortex, while no group differences were found during resting state or the naturalistic task. Comparisons with atlas-based analyses highlighted the precision of individualised connectivity mapping. Together, these findings suggest that frontostriatal functional connectivity aberrancies in ADHD are driven by striatum-dependent cognitive processes such as working memory, and that precise mapping of frontostriatal pathways can be achieved through individualised connectivity mapping.

relevance.reason: 以ADHD成人多模态MRI研究额纹状体个体化结构与功能连接，涉及工作记忆的神经机制及脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注成人注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）中额纹状体环路的具体异常及其个体差异，采用个体化连接映射，结合弥散磁共振成像和工作记忆、静息态及自然注意任务的功能磁共振数据，比较了成人ADHD与神经典型对照。结果发现，ADHD组在言语和视空间工作记忆任务中，纹状体与背外侧前额叶、运动区及眶额皮层的功能连接较弱，而静息态和自然注意任务中未见组间差异；结构连接方面虽在左侧眶额前额起源的纤维束上观察到减弱，但该结果在不同阈值下未能重复。作者据此认为，ADHD的额纹状体功能连接异常主要与工作记忆等依赖纹状体的认知过程相关，并强调个体化映射能更精确地刻画这些通路。

papers.title: Unveiling Functional-Metabolic Synergy in the Healthy Brain: Multivariate Integration of Dynamic [<sup>18</sup>F]FDG-PET and Resting-State fMRI.
papers.authors: Tarricone C, Vallini G, Baron G, Facca M, Silvestri E, Volpi T, Vlassenko AG, Goyal MS, Bertoldo A.
papers.abstract: Despite accounting for only 2% of body weight, the human brain requires significant amounts of glucose, even at rest, underscoring the importance of functional-metabolic relationships. Previous studies revealed moderate associations between resting-state fMRI functional connectivity (FC) and local metabolism via [18 F]FDG-PET, yet much remains to be understood, particularly regarding their coupling between functional and metabolic networks. To this end, we employed multivariate Partial Least Squares Correlation (PLSC) to investigate the functional-metabolic relationship at both nodal and network levels. From dynamic [18 F]FDG-PET data we estimated parameters describing glucose metabolism-delivery rate (K1 ), phosphorylation rate (k3 ), and fractional uptake (Ki )-and generated within-individual metabolic connectivity (MC) networks. FC was derived from fMRI data filtered into two frequency bands and summarized as region-wise strength to capture nodal characteristics. Our findings revealed that glucose delivery is linked with FC strength, particularly when fMRI signal frequencies include greater hemodynamic contributions. Even stronger functional-metabolic coupling occurs at the network level in the low-frequency fMRI band, with higher MC between sensory/attention and transmodal networks supporting stronger FC within sensory/attention areas. By leveraging PLSC, this work deepens our understanding of the functional-metabolic synergy in the healthy brain, providing new insights into its organization.

relevance.reason: 研究健康人脑静息态功能连接与葡萄糖代谢网络的多变量耦合，揭示脑功能-代谢组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注健康大脑中功能连接与葡萄糖代谢之间的关系，采用多变量偏最小二乘相关方法，整合动态[18F]FDG-PET估计的代谢参数与静息态fMRI功能连接，在节点和网络两个层面考察二者的耦合。结果显示，葡萄糖递送与功能连接强度相关，且这种联系在fMRI信号包含较多血流动力学贡献时更明显；在网络层面，低频fMRI频段的耦合更强，感觉/注意网络与跨模态网络之间较高的代谢连接对应感觉/注意区域内更强的功能连接。作者认为，这有助于理解健康大脑功能-代谢协同的组织方式，但结论基于关联分析，未涉及因果或临床效应。

papers.title: The Emotional Experience of Time: Effects of Anxiety and Interoceptive Ability on Temporal Perception.
papers.authors: Lapomarda G, Fracasso A, Morawetz C, Grecucci A, Melcher D.
papers.abstract: Our experience of time is deeply shaped by emotional and bodily states. Anxiety is known to distort our temporal perception, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we tested whether interoception links anxiety to variability in timing. Thirty participants underwent fMRI while performing a temporal reproduction task within a modified Threat of Scream paradigm. Safe and Threat blocks alternated, with aversive screams unpredictably delivered during Threat blocks. Screams reliably increased subjective anxiety and engaged salience and limbic regions, including the amygdala, hippocampus, and insula. Despite these affective and neural responses, Threat did not produce systematic changes in temporal accuracy. Instead, individuals with higher interoceptive accuracy tended to preserve reproduction accuracy under elevated anxiety, implicating an interoceptive contribution to anxiety-related variability in timing. At the neural level, reproduction compared with the encoding phase increased activity in sensorimotor and parietal regions, with engagement of the insula, cingulate, and striato-thalamic regions in the Safe context. Under Threat, the same contrast encompassed a more circumscribed set of sensorimotor and parietal regions, and screams robustly recruited a salience-limbic-temporal network relative to both non-emotional tones. Together, these findings suggest that individual differences in interoceptive accuracy may moderate the relationship between anxiety and temporal reproduction, and characterize the neural response to threat during a timing task.

relevance.reason: 研究焦虑与内感受能力对时间知觉的影响及其fMRI神经机制，属情绪/感知的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察焦虑是否通过内感受能力影响时间知觉，30名参与者在改良的“尖叫威胁”范式中完成时间复制任务并接受fMRI扫描，安全与威胁条件交替，威胁条件下不可预测地呈现令人不适的尖叫声。尖叫声确实提高了主观焦虑并激活了显著性和边缘系统区域，但威胁条件并未系统性地改变时间复制准确性；相反，内感受准确性较高的个体在焦虑升高时更倾向于保持复制准确性，提示内感受可能调节焦虑与计时变异性之间的关系。神经层面，复制相较编码阶段在感觉运动和顶叶区域活动增强，安全情境下还涉及岛叶、扣带及纹状体-丘脑区域，而威胁情境下这一对比涉及的区域更为局限。作者据此提出，内感受准确性的个体差异可能缓和焦虑与时间复制之间的关系，并刻画了计时任务中面对威胁时的神经反应。

papers.title: Orbitofrontal and Medial Frontal Gray Matter Volumes Are Associated With Hyperactivity Traits in 2548 Nonclinical Adults.
papers.authors: Putra HA, Park K.
papers.abstract: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) traits vary continuously across the general population, yet whether the frontal structural correlates established in clinical ADHD extend to trait variation in nonclinical adults is unknown. Based on meta-analytic evidence, we hypothesized that orbitofrontal gray matter volumes would be negatively associated with hyperactivity traits in 2548 nonclinical Japanese adults (1488 males, 1060 females; aged 23-76 years) who underwent structural MRI and completed the Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale. Regional gray matter volumes of 61 bilateral-averaged regions were tested against inattention, hyperactive motor, and hyperactive verbal trait subscales using partial correlations controlling for age and sex, with false discovery rate (FDR) correction. Five associations survived correction, all linking smaller orbital or medial frontal volumes to higher hyperactivity: medial frontal cortex with hyperactive motor and hyperactive verbal traits, and anterior orbital gyrus, lateral orbital gyrus, and orbital inferior frontal gyrus with hyperactive verbal traits (r = -0.070 to -0.078). The effect sizes were within the range reported for clinical ADHD by the ENIGMA consortium, and secondary analyses found no evidence that bilateral averaging concealed an additional hemisphere-specific association. The findings were robust across sensitivity and permutation analyses. Inattention showed no FDR-significant associations, with Bayesian and equivalence analyses supporting near-null effects at the benchmarked magnitude for most regions. Brain volumes did not improve individual-level prediction of trait scores. These findings identify small orbitofrontal and medial frontal volume associations with hyperactivity along the adult ADHD trait continuum and provide a foundational nonclinical baseline for clinical and transdiagnostic studies of ADHD traits.

relevance.reason: 在非临床成人中考察眶额与内侧额叶灰质体积与多动特质的关联，属于脑结构与认知/行为特质的结构基础研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在非临床成年人群中检验了额叶灰质体积是否与注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）特质相关，基于结构磁共振成像和成人ADHD自评量表，分析了双侧平均的区域灰质体积与注意缺陷、多动运动和多动言语特质的关系。结果显示，较小的内侧额叶体积与较高的多动运动和言语特质相关，较小的眶额皮层若干区域体积与较高的多动言语特质相关，效应量较小，与临床ADHD研究报告的范围相当；注意缺陷特质则未见经校正的显著关联，贝叶斯和等效性分析多支持接近零效应。作者指出，这些关联反映的是成人ADHD特质连续体上的小幅结构差异，脑体积并不能改善个体水平的特质预测，结果为临床和跨诊断研究提供了非临床基线。

papers.title: Static and Dynamic Resting-State fMRI Connectivity Show Frequency-Resolved Associations With Intracranial EEG Connectivity.
papers.authors: Rashnavadi T, Sabaroedin K, Wilson W, Pittman DJ, Federico P, Levan P.
papers.abstract: Resting-state functional connectivity (FC) derived from functional MRI (fMRI) is widely used to characterize brain functional organization, yet its electrophysiological basis remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigated how electrophysiological connectivity relates to both static and dynamic fMRI connectivity using simultaneous intracranial EEG (icEEG)-fMRI recordings from 48 adults with focal epilepsy. Linear mixed-effects models were applied to sampled electrode-pair connections to examine frequency-resolved associations between band-limited icEEG connectivity and corresponding fMRI FC within non-epileptogenic brain regions. Time-averaged icEEG connectivity was robustly associated with spatial variation in static fMRI connectivity across sampled connections and frequency bands, with strongest effects in the beta and low-gamma ranges. At the window level, dynamic fMRI connectivity showed significant positive associations with window-specific icEEG FC deviations in the alpha, beta, and low-gamma bands. Exploratory spatial stratification suggested that cross-modal coupling varied across clinically sampled frontal, temporal, and insular region pairs, and the main findings remained robust after motion-control analyses. Together, these findings indicate that resting-state fMRI connectivity is associated with both average electrophysiological coupling across sampled connections and window-level fluctuations in electrophysiological connectivity, with the strongest primary band-wise evidence observed in the alpha, beta, and low-gamma ranges.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态fMRI功能连接与颅内电生理连接的频率分辨关系，揭示人脑自发活动与功能组织的电生理基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用48名局灶性癫痫成人的同步颅内脑电与功能磁共振记录，考察静息态功能磁共振连接的电生理基础，分析频段特异的颅内脑电连接与静态及动态功能磁共振连接的关系。结果显示，时间平均的颅内脑电连接与静态功能磁共振连接的空间变化稳健相关，beta和低gamma频段效应最强；在时间窗水平上，动态功能磁共振连接与alpha、beta和低gamma频段的窗口特异颅内脑电连接偏差呈正相关。探索性空间分层提示这种跨模态耦合在额、颞和岛叶区域对之间有所不同，主要结果在运动控制分析后仍稳健。这些发现表明静息态功能磁共振连接既反映采样连接上的平均电生理耦合，也反映其窗口水平的波动，但相关关系不等于因果，且研究对象为癫痫患者，结果向健康人群的推广需谨慎。

papers.title: Brain Dynamics Underlying Reaching Movements Under Uncertainty.
papers.authors: Liu N, Zabicki A, Fink GR, Mengotti P, Vossel S.
papers.abstract: Motor responses are influenced by inferred predictability, but it remains unclear how uncertainty, or its inverse, precision, is encoded within motor control networks. In this study, we combined computational modeling of reaching movement response speed with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). We used a cueing paradigm with changing cue predictability (~50%, ~70%, and ~90%) to test how predictive inference about left/right reaching responses affected cortical activity and network connectivity in 28 healthy young adults. Behavioral results showed that the response speed differences between invalid and valid cueing increased with a higher model-derived probability that the cue will be valid. The fMRI results revealed that activity in the bilateral intraparietal sulcus (IPS), the caudal part of dorsal premotor cortex (cPMd), and the cerebellum increased with higher uncertainty during valid trials. Moreover, the activation in the premotor cortex, bilateral inferior parietal lobe (IPL), IPS, and temporoparietal cortex was enhanced when reaching to invalidly cued targets (i.e., during motor reprogramming). Dynamic causal modeling revealed that uncertainty increased the connectivity from left to right IPS, from left IPS to cPMd, and from cPMd to primary motor cortex (M1) during valid trials. Motor reprogramming during invalid trials increased the coupling between bilateral IPL and strengthened pathways from IPL to M1 and from IPS to PMd, while decreasing connectivity from right to left IPS. These findings provide the first evidence of uncertainty-dependent network dynamics during reaching movements in the human brain and shed light on distinct neural mechanisms underlying precision-dependent motor control and motor reprogramming, with potential implications for psychiatric and neurological disorders characterized by aberrant precision control.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑在不确定条件下伸够运动的fMRI脑活动与网络连接机制，属运动认知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究结合计算建模与功能磁共振成像，用不同预测有效性的线索提示范式考察健康年轻人在左右伸手反应中如何编码不确定性。行为结果显示，线索无效与有效之间的反应速度差异随模型推断的线索有效概率升高而增大；影像结果则表明，有效试次中双侧顶内沟、背侧前运动皮层尾部和小脑的活动随不确定性升高而增强，无效试次需要运动重编程时前运动皮层、双侧顶下小叶、顶内沟及颞顶皮层活动增强。动态因果建模进一步显示，不确定性改变了有效试次中从左到右顶内沟、左侧顶内沟到前运动皮层及前运动皮层到初级运动皮层的连接，而运动重编程则增强双侧顶下小叶间耦合及顶下小叶到初级运动皮层、顶内沟到前运动皮层的通路，同时减弱从右到左顶内沟的连接。作者据此提出，伸手运动中的网络动态受不确定性调节，精度依赖的运动控制与运动重编程可能涉及不同的神经机制。

papers.title: A Wavelet-Based Framework for Mapping Long Memory in Resting-State fMRI: Age-Related Changes in the Hippocampus From the ADHD-200 Dataset.
papers.authors: Shahhosseini Y, Beaulac C, Nathoo FS, Miranda MF.
papers.abstract: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) time series are known to exhibit long-range temporal dependencies that challenge traditional modeling approaches. In this study, we propose a novel computational pipeline to characterize and interpret these dependencies using a long-memory (LM) framework, which captures the slow, power-law decay of autocorrelation in resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) signals. The pipeline involves voxelwise estimation of LM parameters via a wavelet-based Bayesian method, yielding spatial maps that reflect temporal dependence across the brain. These maps are then projected onto a lower-dimensional space via a composite basis and are then related to individual-level covariates through group-level regression. We applied this framework to the ADHD-200 dataset. Analysis identified a significant positive association between age and the long-memory parameter in the hippocampus after adjusting for ADHD symptom severity and medication status. After accounting for acquisition site, the estimated effect sizes were attenuated and no longer reached statistical significance, although the spatial pattern was largely preserved, with the strongest estimated effects remaining localized to the same anatomical regions. These findings suggest a relationship between long-range temporal dependence and developmental changes in memory-related brain regions while highlighting the influence of acquisition-site variability on effect magnitude and statistical significance. Overall, the proposed methodology enables detailed mapping of intrinsic temporal dynamics in rs-fMRI and offers new insights into the relationship between functional signal memory and brain development.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态fMRI长程时间依赖的空间映射及其与年龄相关的海马发育变化，属自发活动与脑发育机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一套基于小波贝叶斯估计的长记忆分析流程，用于刻画静息态fMRI信号自相关的缓慢幂律衰减，并将体素级参数映射到低维空间后与个体变量做组水平回归。作者将其应用于ADHD-200数据集，发现校正ADHD症状严重程度和用药状态后，年龄与海马长记忆参数呈正相关；但进一步校正采集站点后，效应量减弱且不再具有统计显著性，空间模式基本保留，最强效应仍集中于相同解剖区域。结果提示长程时间依赖可能与记忆相关脑区的发育变化有关，同时强调采集站点变异会影响效应大小与显著性，相关发现尚不能作因果或临床解读。

papers.title: Growth of White Matter Signal Aberrations and Cortical Changes in Men and Women: A 9-Year Multiple-Time-Point Longitudinal MRI Study in Older Adults.
papers.authors: Håberg AK, Reitlo LS, Vangberg TR.
papers.abstract: In aging, white matter hyperintensities (WMH) or white matter signal aberrations (WMSA), a proxy for cerebral small vessel disease, are the most common age-related finding on brain MRI scans, with women reported to have a greater burden. Previous studies found that WMH/WMSA were linked to lower cortical volume and thickness. However, no study has investigated the connection between WMSA and both cortical thickness and area using multiple assessments over 9 years. We hypothesized that increasing WMSA was associated with a decrease in both cortical thickness and area over time, compounding the age-typical decrease, and that the effect was more pronounced in women than men. Our cohort consisted of 104 older adults from the general population, born between 1936 and 1942, scanned at the same 3T scanner at baseline (mean age 72.4 years), and followed up at 1-, 3-, 5, and 9 years. We analyzed the 3D MPRAGE scans in FreeSurfer's longitudinal pipeline and extracted the volume of WMSA, cortical thickness and area, grey matter-white matter intensity ratio, plus hippocampal and intracranial volume. Linear mixed-effects models included the interaction between sex and WMSA on cortical thickness and area, and hippocampal volume. We also performed sex-specific analyses. Finally, complete case and sensitivity analyses with known confounders were run. In both men and women, baseline WMSA volume was 3.6 cm3 (95% CI, 2.1-6.2), followed by an average annual growth rate of 7.2% (95% CI, 6.1-8.3). Increasing WMSA over time was associated with accelerated cortical thinning. In men, the association between WMSA and cortical thinning was more pronounced and present in more lobes than in women, despite similar WMSA volume and growth in both sexes. In the lobes with accelerated cortical thinning, increasing WMSA was also associated with an increase in cortical area present only in men. The sex-specific analyses revealed even more pronounced differences in the relationships between WMSA growth and cortical features over time. The changes in cortex associated with WMSA volume were superimposed on the changes related to aging in both sexes. Change in WMSA over time was not directly associated with change in hippocampal volume. Complete case and sensitivity analyses supported the main findings. Thus, contrary to our hypothesis, WMSA change over 9 years was connected to greater cortical thinning alongside a surprising increase in cortical area in men, despite men and women having similar WMSA volume and growth. Our results underscore the presence of marked sex differences in cortical plasticity in the aging brain in the presence of WMSA. WMSA, the most common age-related proxy for small vessel disease, contributed significantly and above that related to aging, to cortical changes, more so in men than women.

relevance.reason: 纵向MRI研究白质信号异常与皮层厚度/面积变化的关系，属脑结构与老化可塑性，报告性别差异。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于同一批社区老年人在9年间的多次脑MRI扫描，考察白质信号异常（WMSA）随时间的增长与皮层厚度、面积变化的关系，并检验性别差异。结果显示，WMSA体积随时间增加与皮层变薄加速相关，且这种关联在男性中更明显、涉及更多脑叶；在出现皮层加速变薄的脑叶中，WMSA增加还伴随皮层面积增大，但仅见于男性。尽管男女WMSA体积和增长速度相近，WMSA相关皮层变化仍叠加于正常老化之上，且WMSA变化与海马体积变化无直接关联。作者据此强调，老年大脑在WMSA存在下的皮层可塑性存在明显性别差异，WMSA对皮层变化的贡献超出一般老化，且在男性中更强。

papers.title: Investigating the Neural Bases of Egocentric Spatial Reference Frame After Right-Hemisphere Stroke: Brain Lesions and Disconnectome Analyses of Subjective Straight Ahead and Longitudinal Body Axis Misperception.
papers.authors: Painchaud S, Duche Q, Allart E, Leplaideur S, Bannier E, Bonan I.
papers.abstract: Spatial cognition impairments have been shown to reduce autonomy, partly due to alterations in the egocentric spatial reference frame. However, little is known about the neural substrates underlying these impairments, particularly in terms of structural connectivity. We aimed to investigate the neural bases of two complementary components of the egocentric spatial reference frame by analysing both lesion locations and probabilities of white matter disconnection. Fifty-seven individuals with right-hemispheric strokes were included. Egocentric spatial representation was assessed using the subjective straight ahead (SSA) and the longitudinal body axis (LBA). Voxel-based lesion-symptom mapping and disconnectome analyses using BCBtoolkit were performed to study the relationship between SSA and LBA misperceptions, lesion location, and probabilities of white matter disconnection. SSA and LBA misperceptions were associated with partially dissociable neural patterns. SSA misperception was mainly associated with right parieto-frontal lesions and with an exploratory association involving the posterior corpus callosum. In contrast, LBA misperception was associated with right temporo-occipital lesions and disconnections involving the right inferior longitudinal fasciculus, right cingulum fasciculus, posterior corpus callosum, and right inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus. These exploratory findings suggest that SSA and LBA misperceptions, although assessed in the same egocentric reference system, rely on distinct neural substrates. SSA may place greater demands on action-oriented spatial processing in extracorporeal space, whereas LBA may rely more strongly on cross-modal integration between an internal body-centred representation of the longitudinal body axis and a visual cue. Assessing both tasks may help improve the characterisation and rehabilitation of spatial cognition impairments after right-hemisphere stroke. Trial Registration Number and Date of Registration: The original study was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Poitiers-France III West No. 051216. The trial was registered before first inclusion (NCT01677091).

relevance.reason: 右半球卒中后自我中心空间参考框架的病灶与白质断连分析，揭示空间认知的脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注右半球卒中后自我中心空间参照框架损伤的神经基础，对57名右半球卒中患者的主观正前方（SSA）和身体纵轴（LBA）误判进行行为评估，并结合基于体素的病灶-症状映射与白质断连分析。结果显示，两种误判对应部分可分离的神经模式：SSA误判主要与右侧顶额叶病灶相关，并探索性地涉及胼胝体后部；LBA误判则与右侧颞枕叶病灶及右侧下纵束、扣带束、胼胝体后部和右侧下额枕束的断连相关。作者据此提出，同一自我中心参照系统内的两项任务可能依赖不同神经基础，SSA或更依赖体外空间的动作导向加工，LBA或更依赖身体纵轴内部表征与视觉线索的跨模态整合，并认为联合评估两项任务有助于改善右半球卒中后空间认知障碍的刻画与康复。上述关联为探索性发现，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: Do You Match What I Match? A Systematic Review of Over 20 Years of the Emotional Face Matching Task Reveals Vast Inconsistencies in Design and Implementation.
papers.authors: Savage HS, Schlüter L, Russo R, Leaning I, Beckmann CF, Marquand AF.
papers.abstract: We performed a systematic review of over 20 years of literature that implemented a variant of the emotional face matching task (EFMT). We aimed to quantify the heterogeneity in tasks used across studies, and to summarise the regions reported as activated when participants match the target face stimuli, as compared to matching the control stimuli, within and between patients with a mental health diagnosis and unaffected controls. Our results highlight the vast heterogeneity in all aspects of task design and implementation across studies. Our high-level synthesis of brain regions activated broadly confirms the involvement of the amygdala during emotional face matching, but shows that an increase in amygdala activation is inconsistent both within and across mental health conditions. We further highlight increased activation within the cingulate cortex as a transdiagnostic alteration (vs. controls) during emotional face matching. We introduce solutions to address the challenge of heterogeneity, including a standard version of the EFMT and applicable statistical methods, and provide recommendations for the field to progress our understanding of emotional face processing.

relevance.reason: 系统综述情绪面孔匹配任务的脑区激活，涉及情绪加工神经机制及精神疾病患者与对照的脑激活差异。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了二十余年间采用情绪面孔匹配任务（EFMT）的文献，旨在量化不同研究在任务设计与实施上的异质性，并汇总参与者匹配目标面孔相较于对照刺激时报告激活的脑区，同时比较心理健康诊断患者与未受影响对照之间的异同。结果显示，各研究在任务设计与实施的各个方面差异极大；对脑区激活的高层整合虽大体确认了杏仁核在情绪面孔匹配中的参与，但杏仁核激活升高在各类心理健康状况内部及之间均不一致，而扣带皮层激活升高则表现为跨诊断的改变。作者据此提出采用标准化EFMT版本和适用统计方法等应对异质性的方案，并为该领域后续研究提供建议。

papers.title: Inside a Programmer's Brain: Dissociating Code and Language Comprehension Networks Using a Novel fMRI-ESM Protocol.
papers.authors: Cepero-Escribano V, León-Cabrera P, Gasa-Roqué A, Otazu X, Fernandez-Coello A, Naval-Baudin P, Camins À, Rico I, Gabarros A, Rodriguez-Fornells A, Cerda-Company X.
papers.abstract: Code comprehension and natural language share structural similarities but engage partially distinct neural systems. While language predominantly recruits the classical perisylvian language network, code comprehension has been linked to the multiple-demand system, associated with mathematical thinking and problem solving. We report the case of a professional software engineer with an IDH-mutant astrocytoma in the left middle frontal gyrus, a region where these networks converge. To address the potential risk of impairing computer programming abilities during surgery, we implemented a personalized protocol combining fMRI and intraoperative electrical stimulation mapping (ESM), extending the standard language assessment with a Code comprehension task. Intraoperative mapping identified sites in the left inferior frontal cortex that were functionally relevant to the Code comprehension task but were not identified during standard object-naming mapping. Complete tumor resection was achieved while preserving these critical regions, with the patient showing intact post-operative language and programming performances. This single case study suggests that individualized Code comprehension mapping may identify functionally relevant sites not detected by standard object-naming mapping, supporting the potential clinical value of tailored fMRI-ESM protocols for preserving higher-order cognitive functions in neurosurgical patients.

relevance.reason: 单例术中电刺激与fMRI比较代码理解与语言网络，报告左额下皮层功能定位，涉及语言与高级认知的脑组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一名左额中回患IDH突变型星形细胞瘤的职业软件工程师为对象，结合fMRI与术中电刺激映射，在标准语言评估之外加入代码理解任务，以探讨代码理解与自然语言是否依赖部分不同的神经网络。术中映射在左额下回发现了一些与代码理解任务功能相关、但标准物体命名映射未能识别的位点；在完整切除肿瘤并保留这些区域后，患者术后语言与编程表现均保持完好。作者据此认为，个体化的代码理解映射可能发现标准命名映射遗漏的功能相关区域，提示定制fMRI-ESM方案在神经外科中保护高级认知功能方面具有潜在临床价值；但这是单例研究，结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Charting the Normal Development of Structural Brain Connectivity in Utero Using Diffusion MRI.
papers.authors: Karimi D, Li B, Taymourtash A, Jaimes C, Grant PE, Warfield SK.
papers.abstract: Understanding the structural connectivity of the human brain during fetal life is critical for uncovering the early foundations of neural function and vulnerability to developmental disorders. Diffusion-weighted MRI (dMRI) enables non-invasive mapping of white matter pathways and construction of the brain's structural connectome, but its application to the fetal brain has been limited by data scarcity and technical difficulties in analyzing fetal dMRI data. Here, we present the largest study to date of in utero brain connectivity, analyzing high-quality dMRI data from 198 fetuses between 22 and 37 gestational weeks from the Developing Human Connectome Project. We employed advanced fetal-specific tools for brain segmentation and parcellation, and used ensemble tractography to encourage more complete reconstruction of various white matter tracts. For connection weighting, we relied on the notion of fiber bundle capacity. We reconstructed individual structural connectomes and characterized the developmental trajectories. Graph-theoretical analysis revealed consistent increases in integration and segregation metrics over gestation, while bootstrapping confirmed the robustness of nodal and edge-wise developmental patterns. Furthermore, we proposed a novel method for constructing age-specific connectome templates based on aggregation of individual subject connectomes. The new method follows an optimization-based approach to ensure that the connectome templates closely represent individual subject connectomes, are temporally consistent, and proportionally preserve short and long connections. Our analysis shows that this approach is superior to spatial alignment and averaging of the data in image space, with the resulting connectome templates supporting accurate prediction of the gestational age of individual fetuses (mean error = 0.90±0.81 weeks). In summary, this study provides robust normative benchmarks for fetal brain structural connectivity and demonstrates that connectome-based measures capture meaningful developmental signatures, offering a framework for future studies of early brain development.

relevance.reason: 该研究用扩散MRI描绘胎儿脑白质结构连接组的发育轨迹，属于人脑结构连接与脑发育的结构-功能基础研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用扩散MRI数据，对胎儿期大脑结构连接组的发育轨迹进行了刻画，并提出了构建年龄特异性连接组模板的新方法。分析显示，随着妊娠推进，脑网络的整合与分离指标持续上升，节点和连接层面的发育模式具有稳健性；基于个体连接组聚合的优化模板优于图像空间对齐平均，并能较准确地预测胎龄。这些结果为胎儿脑结构连接提供了正常发育基准，表明连接组指标能捕捉有意义的发育特征，但预测精度和临床应用价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: DTI-ALPS Primarily Reflects White Matter Diffusion Dispersion and Microstructural Heterogeneity in Neurodegeneration: Insights From Multi-Modal MRI.
papers.authors: Sacchi L, Farruggio G, Bocca G, Carandini T, De Riz M, Ghezzi L, Pintus M, Pietroboni A, Boffa G, Scola E, Triulzi F, Bozzali M, Galimberti D, Cercignani M, Arighi A.
papers.abstract: The glymphatic system facilitates clearance of metabolic waste and pathological proteins from the brain, and its dysfunction has been implicated in neurodegenerative disease. The diffusion tensor imaging-analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) has been proposed as a non-invasive MRI marker of glymphatic flow, although its biological specificity remains uncertain. This study aimed to identify the determinants of DTI-ALPS and evaluate whether it primarily reflects white-matter (WM) microstructure rather than glymphatic flow in the context of neurodegeneration. We examined 100 individuals referred to the Memory Clinic of the Policlinico Hospital in Milan for suspected dementia. All participants underwent a 3T-MRI protocol including 3D-T1-weighted and 3D-FLAIR imaging, double-shell diffusion-weighted imaging (b = 1000/2000 s/mm2 ), and multi-echo gradient-echo sequences for quantitative susceptibility mapping. Within standard DTI-ALPS ROIs, we extracted DTI-ALPS values together with fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), and mode of anisotropy (MA) at both b-values, as well as neurite orientation and density imaging (NODDI) metrics, particularly the orientation dispersion index (ODI). WM microstructure was further characterized using the T1/FLAIR ratio and diamagnetic component of susceptibility (DCS). DTI-ALPS correlated inversely with MA (r = -0.84 at b = 1000; r = -0.86 at b = 2000) and positively with ODI (r = 0.73). Moderate correlations with the T1/FLAIR ratio and DCS supported sensitivity to WM alterations. Factor analysis indicated that DTI-ALPS clustered with MA and ODI rather than forming a distinct factor, suggesting that DTI-ALPS primarily reflects WM diffusion dispersion and heterogeneity rather than glymphatic flow in the context of neurodegeneration.

relevance.reason: 多模态MRI研究DTI-ALPS指标在神经退行性变中主要反映白质扩散离散度与微结构异质性，属白质微结构与功能指标关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在疑似痴呆的记忆门诊转诊人群中，结合多模态MRI考察DTI-ALPS这一常用类淋巴流标志物的生物学决定因素。结果显示，DTI-ALPS与各向异性模式指标呈强负相关、与神经突方向离散指数呈正相关，并与白质微结构改变指标存在中等关联；因子分析中它与这些白质指标归为同一因子，而非独立因子。作者据此认为，在神经退行性背景下，DTI-ALPS主要反映白质扩散离散度和微结构异质性，而非类淋巴流，提示将其直接解释为类淋巴清除功能需谨慎。

papers.title: Age-Related Changes in E/I Balance Estimated With Hurst Exponent and Links With Developmental Skills in Preschool Children.
papers.authors: Chen B, Boxberger A, Mahmalji J, Arantes de Oliveira Campos G, Herrera M, Linke A, Fishman I.
papers.abstract: Cortical excitation-inhibition (E/I) balance regulates sensitive periods of plasticity and is critical for brain development. Yet, neuroimaging studies characterizing E/I dynamics in early childhood are rare. The Hurst exponent (H), derived from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), provides a noninvasive proxy for E/I balance. We investigated age-related changes in H using longitudinal rs-fMRI from 55 typically developing children aged 1.5-5 years (78 sessions during natural sleep). Linear mixed-effects models revealed significant age-related increases in H, signifying greater inhibition or more balanced E/I, in three right-hemisphere regions: inferior frontal gyrus (IFG) pars opercularis and triangularis, and middle temporal pole. Whole-brain maps showed positive age effects across most cortical areas, though the most robust increases occurred in higher order association cortices rather than primary sensory regions, consistent with hierarchical network maturation. Higher H in right IFG opercular was associated with better expressive language skills and fewer behavioral/emotional problems, controlling for age and sex. These findings suggest that E/I balance maturation during toddlerhood and preschool years is most pronounced in regions supporting language development and cognitive control. Our results characterized normative developmental trajectories of H during an important neurodevelopmental window and its associations with emerging behavioral competencies, potentially informing future investigations of atypical E/I maturation in neurodevelopmental disorders.

relevance.reason: 纵向静息态fMRI研究幼儿E/I平衡发育及其与语言和行为能力的关联，涉及脑发育与功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注幼儿期皮层兴奋—抑制平衡的发育变化，利用纵向静息态功能磁共振数据，以Hurst指数作为兴奋—抑制平衡的无创代理指标，追踪通常发育儿童在1.5至5岁间的变化。结果显示，Hurst指数随年龄增长而升高，提示抑制增强或兴奋—抑制更趋平衡，这一趋势在多数皮层区域可见，并在高级联合皮层比初级感觉区更明显，符合层级网络成熟的特点。右侧额下回岛盖部的Hurst指数较高还与更好的表达性语言能力和较少的行为情绪问题相关。作者据此认为，兴奋—抑制平衡的成熟在支持语言发展和认知控制的区域尤为突出，为理解非典型兴奋—抑制发育提供了参考，但相关结果尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Connectivity-Guided Individualized iTBS of the Posterior Parietal Cortex in Enduring Anorexia Nervosa: Network-Level Target Engagement and Multimodal Response in a Single Case.
papers.authors: Collantoni E, Gentili S, Menardi A, Vallesi A, Librizzi G, Tenconi E, Serino A, Risso G, Olivo D, Sambataro F, Favaro A, Meregalli V.
papers.abstract: Aims Anorexia nervosa (AN) is a severe, often enduring disorder with scarce biological treatments, largely unable to address its core implicit features: habit-like food restriction and body-experience disturbances. We report a single-case application of resting-state connectivity-guided intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) to the posterior parietal cortex (PPC), a hub for body representation, peripersonal space, and affordance-based action. Methods A 31-year-old woman with 12 years of treatment-resistant restricting AN, enrolled in an ongoing sham-controlled feasibility trial, underwent 20 active iTBS sessions to an individualized left-PPC site maximally coupled with a body-representation × affordance reference network, assessed at baseline, post-treatment, and four-month follow-up. Results The protocol was fully feasible and well tolerated, without significant adverse events. Clinical change was gradual, with most of the weight gain occurring after the stimulation period: BMI rose from 15.65 to 16.01 at four-month follow-up and 16.40 over subsequent clinical follow-up. Blinded global improvement was minimal; anxiety fell below threshold, whereas eating-disorder and body-shape scores remained at floor. Target-reference connectivity increased in the a priori direction, toward the healthy-control mean. Exploratory measures changed heterogeneously, only partly tracking engagement. Conclusion This case supports the feasibility and mechanistic plausibility of individualized parietal targeting in enduring AN, motivating a controlled trial to test its efficacy. Trial registration The parent trial is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07106645).

relevance.reason: 单例研究以静息态连接引导的iTBS靶向顶叶，报告网络层面靶点参与及与身体表征相关的脑连接变化，属脑疾病神经调控与脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究报告了一例病程长达12年、治疗抵抗的 restricting 型神经性厌食症患者，接受基于静息态功能连接引导的个体化左侧后顶叶皮层间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS），并在基线、治疗后及四个月随访时评估。方案完全可行且耐受良好，无显著不良事件；临床变化缓慢，体重增加主要出现在刺激期之后，盲法总体改善轻微，焦虑降至阈值以下，而进食障碍和体形评分仍处于最低水平。靶点与参考网络的功能连接按预期方向增强，向健康对照均值靠拢，但探索性指标变化异质、仅部分与靶点 engagement 同步。作者认为该个案支持个体化顶叶靶向在难治性厌食症中的可行性和机制合理性，但尚不能据此推断疗效，需开展对照试验验证。

papers.title: Residual Language Abilities Correlate With Diagnosis and Prognosis in Patients With Disorders of Consciousness.
papers.authors: Xu C, Gao J, Zheng J, Yu J, Gao J, Li J, Ding N, Luo B.
papers.abstract: Background Evaluating residual consciousness and predicting outcomes in unresponsive patients pose significant clinical challenges. Language assessment is crucial for these patients, and language-based EEG paradigms have shown promise in aiding diagnosis and prognosis in patients with disorders of consciousness (DoC). However, current language-based EEG paradigms either require higher-order cognitive functions, thereby misidentifying some conscious patients as unconscious, or rely on automatic processing, which fails to capture residual consciousness in DoC. Methods Newly developed, simple phrase sequences combined with neural frequency tagging were used to explore a language paradigm tailored to a critical processing threshold. This paradigm was designed to reflect the dynamic process of consciousness in DoC, while requiring minimal cognitive load. Results Our results showed that significant phrase-level EEG responses were observed in healthy subjects, MCS patients, and UWS patients in three conditions. Neural tracking of phrase structure showed a progressive decrease across three groups (healthy > MCS > UWS). Among the UWS patients, 52.38% (11 out of 21) and among the MCS patients, 45.83% (11 out of 24) exhibited significant ITPC at the syllable rate in at least one of the three conditions. Additionally, 38.10% (8 out of 21) of UWS patients and 33.33% (8 out of 24) of MCS patients demonstrated significant ITPC at the phrase rate. The language paradigm performance in this study was superior to that of other paradigms in detecting the proportion of residual language ability in DoC patients. Furthermore, cortical tracking at the phrase rate significantly correlated with 12-month outcomes and effectively classified patients according to their 12-month prognosis. Conclusions The simplified language assessment demonstrates strong potential to detect residual language ability in DoC patients and could potentially be used to detect residual consciousness and determine prognosis in unresponsive patients.

relevance.reason: 用EEG神经频率标记考察意识障碍患者残余语言加工，报告短语结构神经追踪与诊断/预后关联，涉及语言机制及脑损伤后认知组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对意识障碍患者残余意识评估与预后预测的临床难题，采用简单短语序列结合神经频率追踪的脑电范式，考察健康人、微意识状态（MCS）患者和植物状态（UWS）患者对短语结构的神经追踪。结果显示，短语结构的神经追踪在三组间呈健康人、MCS、UWS依次递减，部分UWS和MCS患者仍在音节率和短语率上表现出显著响应，且该范式检测残余语言能力的比例优于其他范式。短语率皮层追踪与12个月结局显著相关，并能据此对患者预后进行分类，提示简化语言评估有望用于检测残余语言能力、辅助判断意识水平与预后。

papers.title: The Role of Glymphatic Clearance in Affective Decision-Making in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury.
papers.authors: Wang H, Zhang J, Pan R, Ye X, Wang R, Lv K, Yu Y, Li Q, Zhang T, Wu D, Zhang D, Tian Y.
papers.abstract: Background Adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) frequently exhibit severe sleep disturbances and heterogeneous cognitive impairments, yet the underlying neurophysiological basis remains unclear. The glymphatic system, a sleep-dependent macroscopic clearance network, is critical for metabolic waste removal and neurocognitive homeostasis. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the physiological role of glymphatic function in linking sleep burden to distinct cognitive performances in adolescents with NSSI. Methods We assessed 44 NSSI adolescents and 33 healthy controls (HCs). Using resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), glymphatic function was quantified by calculating the coupling strength between global blood-oxygen-level-dependent (gBOLD) signals and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) flow. To capture the heterogeneity in their cognitive profiles, we evaluated "hot" affective decision-making via the Iowa Gambling Task (IGT) and "cold" executive function via the Wisconsin Card Sorting Test (WCST). Subjective sleep quality was assessed using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI). Results In the NSSI group, poorer sleep quality was positively correlated with stronger gBOLD-CSF coupling (r = 0.317, p = 0.036), and stronger gBOLD-CSF coupling predicted better IGT performance, especially during the high-load strategy phase (Block 3) (r = 0.447, p = 0.002). Furthermore, glymphatic function fully mediated the relationship between sleep quality and affective decision-making performance (indirect effect = 0.682, 95% CI [0.062, 1.515]). Interaction analyses confirmed this physiological-behavioral coupling was disease-specific (present only in NSSI; interaction p = 0.011) and domain-specific (supporting "hot" affective cognition rather than "cold" executive function). Conclusions In NSSI adolescents, sleep-associated glymphatic upregulation reflects a stress-induced compensatory response. This mechanism domain-specifically preserves high-load affective decision-making against severe psychopathological stress. These findings highlight brain metabolic clearance as a novel physiological target for bolstering cognitive resilience in high-risk youth.

relevance.reason: 以NSSI青少年为对象，用静息态gBOLD-CSF耦合量化类淋巴功能并关联情绪决策，属脑疾病人群的认知与静息脑组织机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注非自杀性自伤青少年的睡眠负担、类淋巴清除功能与认知表现之间的关系，比较了自伤青少年与健康对照，并用静息态功能磁共振测量脑血氧信号与脑脊液流动的耦合强度，同时评估睡眠质量及情感决策和执行功能。结果显示，在自伤组中睡眠质量越差，该耦合越强，而耦合越强则情感决策表现越好，且类淋巴功能完全中介了睡眠质量与情感决策之间的联系；这种关联仅见于自伤组，并主要指向情感性而非执行性认知。作者据此提出，睡眠相关的类淋巴功能上调可能是一种应激补偿反应，在特定认知领域维护高负荷下的情感决策，但这一解释基于横断面关联，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Conventional MRI Markers and Cognitive Dysfunction in Multiple Sclerosis: An Exploratory Pilot Study.
papers.authors: Khorshidian F, Aghamollaii V, Noroozian M, Rassa S.
papers.abstract: Background Cognitive impairment is a common and disabling manifestation of multiple sclerosis (MS), yet its structural correlates remain incompletely understood in routine clinical practice. Although advanced neuroimaging has improved our understanding of the underlying mechanisms, its limited accessibility restricts widespread clinical implementation. We aimed to investigate whether conventional MRI markers are associated with domain-specific cognitive impairment in patients with MS. Methods In this exploratory cross-sectional study, 25 adults with clinically confirmed multiple sclerosis underwent cognitive assessment using the standard Persian Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), version 7.1, and conventional 1.5-T brain MRI. Conventional MRI measures included lesion burden, lesion topography, and visually rated cortical atrophy. Associations between MRI markers and MoCA-derived cognitive domains were assessed using Spearman rank correlation with false discovery rate adjustment for multiple testing. Findings Twenty-five patients with clinically confirmed MS completed cognitive and MRI assessments. Mean age was 42.4 ± 9.1 years, 56% were women, and the mean MoCA score was 22 ± 7. Periventricular (88%) and juxtacortical/cortical (84%) lesions were the most frequent MRI findings, total T2/FLAIR lesion burden showed only weak correlations with cognitive performance (ρ range -0.02 to 0.29; all FDR-adjusted p > 0.65). The largest lesion-based association was observed between infratentorial lesions and concentration (ρ = -0.48, unadjusted p = 0.018; FDR-adjusted p = 0.405). Among atrophy measures, GCA showed the strongest association with visuospatial performance (ρ = 0.51, unadjusted p = 0.012; FDR-adjusted p = 0.405), with additional moderate trends for concentration (ρ = 0.40, p = 0.052) and executive function (ρ = 0.40, p = 0.052). No MRI marker remained statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Interpretation Although no MRI-cognitive association remained statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons, several unadjusted associations showed moderate effect sizes and may warrant further investigation. The strongest exploratory associations involved infratentorial lesions and concentration (ρ = -0.48) and global cortical atrophy and visuospatial performance (ρ = 0.51). The absence of consistent relationships between overall lesion burden or individual regional MRI markers and cognitive performance suggests that focal structural measures alone may not fully capture the neural substrates of cognitive dysfunction in MS. This pattern provides a rationale for further investigation of distributed, network-level mechanisms of cognitive dysfunction, while the present findings should be considered hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory. Conventional MRI may therefore provide complementary structural information in the clinical assessment of cognitive dysfunction in MS. Larger, adequately powered studies using comprehensive neuropsychological assessment and quantitative, network-sensitive MRI measures are needed to determine whether these observed patterns are reproducible and clinically meaningful.

relevance.reason: 该研究探讨多发性硬化患者常规MRI结构标志物与认知域损伤的关联，属于以脑疾病理解认知与脑结构基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性横断面研究考察多发性硬化患者的常规MRI标志物是否与特定认知域损害相关，对患者进行认知评估和常规脑MRI检查，并分析病灶负荷、病灶部位及皮层萎缩与认知表现的关系。总体上，T2/FLAIR病灶总负荷与认知表现仅呈弱相关，多项未校正分析中幕下病灶与注意力、全局皮层萎缩与视空间表现呈现中等效应，但经多重比较校正后没有任何MRI标志物与认知的关联保持统计学显著。作者据此认为，这些结果只能用于提出假设，提示仅靠局灶性结构指标可能不足以解释多发性硬化中的认知障碍，后续需更大样本、采用全面神经心理评估和网络敏感MRI测量的研究加以验证。

papers.title: Multi-Metric EEG Connectivity and Graph Analysis Reveal Altered Resting-State Networks in Major Depressive Disorder.
papers.authors: Rose SJ, Imon AHMR, Bushra R, Ahmed N, Warid MTH.
papers.abstract: Purpose EEG functional-connectivity studies in major depressive disorder (MDD) have produced inconsistent findings, partly because different estimators capture distinct aspects of neural coupling. We implemented a multi-metric resting-state EEG approach combining linear, phase-based, nonlinear, and graph-theoretical measures to characterize frequency-dependent sensor-level connectivity alterations and identify sensor-level network patterns relevant to depression-related dysconnectivity. Method Resting-state EEG from 30 DSM-IV MDD participants and 28 healthy controls was analyzed using a 19-channel 10-20 montage. After MNE-Python preprocessing, including filtering, ICA-based artifact removal, current source density (CSD) transformation, and symmetric orthogonalization, coherence, PLV, PLI, and MI were computed across theta, alpha, and beta bands. Edge-wise differences were tested using Brunner-Munzel with Holm correction, confirmed with Westfall-Young maxT correction, and summarized using Hedges' g and graph measures. Finding MDD showed frequency- and metric-dependent sensor-level connectivity alterations. Theta coherence, PLV, and PLI were dominated by lower connectivity across frontal-to-posterior, fronto-central, temporal/posterior-temporal, parieto-occipital, and central-to-occipital sensor pairs, whereas theta MI showed few increased frontal/fronto-temporal effects. Alpha findings were more selective, with mainly lower coherence and PLV across frontopolar/frontal-to-central, fronto-midline, and posterior links, while alpha MI showed a limited mixed pattern. In beta, coherence, PLV, and PLI showed sparse robust reductions, whereas beta MI showed widespread increased statistical dependence. Graph-theoretical summaries at 20% proportional density showed mainly lower mean weighted strength and global efficiency in theta- and alpha-band networks. Conclusion These findings indicate frequency- and metric-dependent resting-state EEG sensor-level connectivity alterations in MDD. The dominant pattern was lower theta/alpha connectivity across distributed sensor pairs, alongside increased beta MI-based dependence. The results provide corrected, effect-size-informed evidence of altered inter-sensor coordination without establishing dysfunction of specific cortical regions or named networks. This framework may support future hypothesis-driven research in independent, clinically annotated, higher-density EEG or multimodal datasets.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态EEG多指标连接与图论分析揭示抑郁症患者脑网络组织改变，属脑疾病与静息网络研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对重性抑郁障碍患者静息态脑电功能连接研究结果不一致的问题，采用多指标脑电连接与图论分析，比较患者与健康对照在多个频段上的感觉器层面连接模式。结果显示，改变具有频率和指标依赖性：theta和alpha频段以多个分布传感器对之间连接降低为主，beta频段则在部分指标上呈现连接降低、在互信息指标上呈现广泛升高，图论指标也提示theta和alpha网络整体强度与全局效率偏低。作者据此认为，抑郁障碍表现为跨传感器协调的改变，但尚不能据此确定特定皮层区域或命名网络的功能障碍，相关发现仍需在独立、临床信息更完整的高密度脑电或多模态数据中验证。
