papers.title: Normative Modeling of Molecular-Enriched Functional Connectivity for Detecting Deviations from Healthy Brain Aging
papers.authors: Pinamonti M, Moretto M, Pieperhoff L, Arunachalam P, Barkhof F, Wink AM, Lorenzini L, Veronese M.
papers.abstract: Introduction Inter-individual variability in adult brain aging can obscure early pathological alterations and is only partly represented by population-average or scalar brain-aging measures. We combined Receptor-Enriched Analysis of functional Connectivity by Targets (REACT) with normative modeling (NM) to derive spatially resolved, molecularly informed deviation scores for dopamine transporter (DAT)-, norepinephrine transporter (NET)-, and serotonin transporter (SERT)-enriched resting-state functional connectivity (FC). We first evaluated whether these normative models could be transferred to independently processed external data through local calibration and then explored whether the resulting deviation profiles differed with cerebral amyloid burden in cognitively unimpaired older adults. Methods Hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR) models with a sinh–arcsinh likelihood (SHASHb) were estimated separately for 204 cortical molecular-enriched FC features in 4,152 healthy adults (18.0–89.8 years) from seven publicly available neuroimaging datasets and evaluated in a held-out healthy test set. Pretrained models were locally adapted to three Amyloid Imaging to Prevent Alzheimer’s Disease Prognostic and Natural History Study (AMYPAD-PNHS) acquisition batches using cognitively unimpaired, amyloid-negative participants (global Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) = 0; Centiloid (CL) < 10). The independent primary comparison contrasted participants with intermediate amyloid burden (10 ≤ CL < 30; n = 111) and amyloid-positive participants (CL ≥ 30; n = 66); secondary analyses tested linear associations with continuous CL within participants with CL ≥ 10. Results Of 204 normative reference models, 199 (97.5%) met the predefined diagnostic criteria; median held-out explained variance (EXPV) was 0.174. Of 612 feature-by-batch transfers, 541 (88.4%) met the strict transfer-diagnostic criteria. In the primary false discovery rate (FDR)-controlled regional analysis, DAT-enriched right caudal middle frontal cortex showed lower locally standardized deviation scores in the intermediate-amyloid-burden group than in the amyloid-positive group (adjusted difference = −0.582, q = 0.016). DAT extreme-deviation burden was also greater in the intermediate-amyloid-burden group (difference = 0.032, q = 0.044). The right frontal effect was reproduced with model-native scores across the three acquisition batches (pooled standardized effect = −0.698, q = 0.010). No NET- or SERT-enriched regional difference between these two groups survived FDR-correction, and no regional or subject-level linear association with continuous CL values survived FDR-correction in the CL ≥ 10 group. Conclusion NM can provide spatially resolved reference distributions of molecular-enriched FC that are deployable in independently processed external data when local adaptation, calibration, and feature-level transfer diagnostics are incorporated. The AMYPAD-PNHS application identified modest, spatially selective, and molecular-system-specific categorical differences during a cognitively unimpaired stage of amyloid accumulation, while continuous analyses within CL ≥ 10 did not support linear association. These findings support a methodological basis for distributed application of molecular-enriched normative models and motivate independent and longitudinal evaluation of their biological relevance. Key Points Hierarchical normative models characterized 204 regional DAT-, NET-, and SERT-enriched FC features across 4,152 healthy adults; 199/204 models met the predefined normative-reference-model diagnostic criteria. Local hierarchical adaptation enabled the pretrained normative models to be applied to independently processed AMYPAD-PNHS data without centralized reprocessing of the target raw images or explicit feature-level harmonization; 541/612 feature–batch transfers met the strict transfer criteria. In cognitively unimpaired AMYPAD-PNHS participants, the exploratory amyloid application identified a spatially selective DAT-enriched right frontal difference and greater DAT extreme-deviation burden in the intermediate-amyloid-burden group than in the amyloid-positive group. No FDR-corrected regional NET or SERT differences between these groups and no FDR-corrected linear associations with continuous CL were identified.

relevance.reason: 基于静息态功能连接构建分子富集规范模型，并在认知未受损老年人中考察淀粉样蛋白负荷相关的连接偏差，涉及人脑网络组织与阿尔茨海默病早期机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究将受体富集功能连接分析与规范建模结合，为多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素和血清素转运体富集的静息态功能连接建立空间分辨的参考分布，并在独立处理的外部数据中检验其可迁移性。多数模型通过预设诊断标准，经本地校准后大部分特征与批次的迁移也达标。在认知未受损的老年人中，探索性分析发现中等淀粉样负荷组与淀粉样阳性组之间存在空间选择性的多巴胺转运体富集右额叶差异，但未发现去甲肾上腺素或血清素富集区域差异，连续淀粉样负荷的线性关联也未通过校正。作者据此认为该方法可为分子富集规范模型的分布式应用提供方法学基础，其生物学意义仍需独立和纵向验证。

papers.title: The development of slow and fast theta oscillations in the human brain
papers.authors: Cross ZR, Gray SM, Dede AJO, Rivera YM, Yin Q, Vahidi P, Rau EMB, Cyr C, Holubecki AM, Asano E, McManus OK, Sattar S, Saez I, Girgis F, King-Stephens D, Weber PB, Laxer KD, Schuele SU, Wu JY, Lam SK, Raskin JS, Shaikhouni A, Brunner P, Roland JL, Braga RM, Knight RT, Ofen N, Johnson EL.
papers.abstract: Theta oscillations are pivotal for attention and memory, with developmental shifts in theta activity and connectivity tracking memory ability across the lifespan. Building on initial evidence that the theta band separates into slow and fast sub-bands across development within the medial temporal lobe (MTL) and the prefrontal cortex (PFC), this preregistered study ( https://osf.io/gsru7 ) characterized the frequencies of slow (∼1.5–4.5 Hz) and fast (∼4.5–9.0 Hz) theta oscillations across the brain in a large developmental cohort. We analyzed intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from widespread brain regions in 101 children and adults (5.93-54.00 years, 63 males; n electrodes = 5691) using task-based (attention to to-be-remembered visual stimuli) and task-free (resting-state) data. We reveal distinct slow and fast theta oscillations in all regions and identify a spatial gradient in both frequency ranges, with slow theta oscillations speeding up and fast theta oscillations slowing down from posterior to anterior regions. The dissociation between slow and fast theta frequencies peaks during young adulthood, mirroring the developmental trajectory of attention and memory. In the hippocampus and PFC, attentional state (task-based, task-free) modulated age effects, and individual differences in task-based slow theta frequencies predicted individual differences in memory performance, linking the development of slow theta oscillations to the development of memory. Gray matter volume was not associated with age- or task-related differences in theta frequencies, suggesting that the development of theta oscillations is independent of regional brain structure. This study establishes developmental trajectories of slow and fast theta oscillations in localized brain regions and links the maturation of hippocampal and PFC slow theta oscillations to the development of attention and memory.

relevance.reason: 该研究用颅内脑电刻画儿童至成人慢/快θ振荡的脑区发育轨迹，并关联注意与记忆，涉及脑发育、认知机制及静息/任务状态比较。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑慢θ与快θ振荡在发育过程中的变化及其与注意和记忆的关系，分析了儿童至成人的颅内脑电记录，涵盖任务态与静息态数据。结果显示，全脑各区域均可区分慢θ和快θ，两者频率沿前后方向呈现空间梯度，且这种分离在成年早期最为明显，与注意和记忆的发育轨迹相呼应。在海马和前额叶，注意状态会调节年龄效应，任务态慢θ频率的个体差异还能预测记忆表现；而灰质体积与θ频率的年龄或任务相关差异无关，提示θ振荡发育可能独立于区域脑结构。作者据此将海马和前额叶慢θ的成熟与注意、记忆的发展联系起来。

papers.title: Beta bursts carry a graded signal of semantic updating during naturalistic narrative comprehension
papers.authors: Goldstein A, Caspi Y.
papers.abstract: Comprehending a narrative requires continuously updating a model of the discourse, and beta-band activity is thought to signal when that model should be held versus changed. Whether beta also grades how much to update, and whether that index is carried by discrete bursts beyond sustained power, is unknown for naturalistic comprehension. We recorded MEG from 61 human participants (22 men, 39 women) while they listened to naturalistic Hebrew narratives, detected beta bursts in the continuous signal, and quantified the semantic shift between successive sentences from sentence embeddings. Beta burst rate decreased after sentence boundaries, and regression-based deconvolution separated a pre-onset maintenance phase from a graded post-onset response whose magnitude scaled with semantic shift (peak ∼0.9 s). This response was independent of lexical surprisal, the acoustic envelope, and referent introduction, largely robust to dependency structure, though it shared variance with propositional quantity. Burst occurrence carried a component of the effect beyond the accompanying amplitude change: applying that change as a pure gain to each participant’s envelope and re-running the identical detection predicts only 75% of the observed burst-rate reduction (excess p = .038), the effect survived an amplitude-invariant threshold, and a Poisson model reproduced it as a graded reduction in burst-initiation rate. The effect held in both participant groups, which heard differently framed narratives, and was decisively supported (BF10 > 250). Beta bursts thus provide a graded signal of semantic updating during continuous comprehension, expressed in the rate of burst occurrence over and above the accompanying change in sustained power. Significance Statement Comprehending speech requires continuously updating an internal model of the unfolding discourse, but how the brain signals how much to update is unclear. Beta activity is thought to maintain the current cognitive state; we show that during natural story listening, the rate of brief beta bursts decreases at sentence transitions in proportion to how much the meaning shifts, consistent with a graded “how-much-to-update” signal rather than a binary boundary flag. Converging analyses show the effect is expressed in how often bursts occur, by more than the accompanying change in sustained beta power can explain, extending the transient-beta-burst framework to naturalistic language. The signal appears automatic and tied to linguistic structure rather than to subjective event segmentation.

relevance.reason: 用MEG记录自然叙事理解中beta爆发率随语义更新量分级变化，直接研究语言语义加工的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然叙事理解中β活动能否不仅标记“是否更新”，还反映“更新多少”。研究者记录健康被试听希伯来语叙事时的脑磁图，检测β爆发并结合句间语义变化量分析。结果显示，句子边界后β爆发率下降，且边界后反应幅度随语义变化量分级变化，这一效应不能由词汇意外性、声学包络或指称引入解释，也超出持续功率变化所能说明的部分；作者据此认为β爆发率携带连续理解中分级语义更新的信号。

papers.title: Social attention and coordinated movement produce dissociable spectral and network changes during dyadic improvisational dance
papers.authors: DeLauder RM, Tasnim N, Aychman M, Gahagan M, Purevtugs J, Newpol J, Frank R, Grizzell G, Nobriga G, Rose S, Basso JC.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dance is increasingly delivered as an intervention for social and affective functioning, but a live dyadic encounter confounds several distinct ingredients — social attention, verbal engagement, coordinated movement, and in-the-moment generation — so its neural effects cannot be assigned to any one of them. We recorded dual-brain mobile EEG from adult human participants of both sexes (16 female, 2 male) and a dance instructor across six five-minute conditions that vary these ingredients independently: solitary rest, direct eye gaze, conversation, teacher-led and participant-led mirroring, and free improvisation, with concurrent head-mounted accelerometry. Referencing each condition to eye gaze — socially engaging but nearly motionless — rather than to solitary rest partitioned the response. The components proved dissociable. Nonverbal social attention alone reorganized the power spectrum, flattening the aperiodic exponent (g = −0.97) and desynchronizing alpha-band oscillations (g = −0.90), while leaving inter-regional connectivity unchanged (amplitude g = +0.15; phase g = +0.11). Verbal engagement added high-frequency amplitude coupling (g = +2.61) without further spectral change. Coordinated movement added a decrease in theta/alpha coupling involving the frontoparietal-control network (g = −0.59), the signature of an externally directed state, alongside a further spectral shift (g = −0.61). Movement-vigor covariates, corticokinematic coherence, and aperiodic-adjusted power indicated that the spectral effects were cortical rather than myogenic. Four weeks of improvisational dance training increased empathic responsiveness to others’ distress relative to a movie control (g = 0.82). Coordinated social movement thus acts on the brain componentially, with mutual attention rather than motor load establishing the engaged state.

relevance.reason: 双人即兴舞蹈中社会注意与协调运动对人脑EEG频谱和网络连接的分离性影响。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用双人移动脑电同步记录舞者与舞蹈教师的互动，试图把现场双人舞蹈中混杂的社会注意、言语交流、协调运动和即时生成拆分开来。以有社交参与但几乎不动的直视条件为参照，作者发现这些成分对脑活动的影响可以分离：非言语社会注意单独改变功率谱并降低alpha振荡，却不改变脑区间连接；言语交流增加高频幅值耦合；协调运动则降低涉及额顶控制网络的theta/alpha耦合，并带来进一步的频谱变化。作者据此提出，协调性社会运动对脑的影响是成分化的，建立投入状态的是相互注意而非运动负荷；此外，四周即兴舞蹈训练还提高了对他人痛苦的共情反应。这些结果提示舞蹈干预的不同要素可能对应不同神经机制，但训练效果来自与电影对照的比较，尚不能等同于临床疗效。

papers.title: Resting state EEG microstates: is a new FORM all you need?
papers.authors: Corsi L, Liuzzi P, Oddo CM, Mannini A.
papers.abstract: Introduction Before asking which microstate an EEG sample belongs to, there is a simpler question: can it look like a microstate at all? Yet a winning correlation mixes three different properties: how microstate-like the scalp field is, where it lies within that geometry, and how well the available templates represent that direction. We asked whether a fixed geometry, independent of any microstate solution, could explain common structure of microstate maps, constrain how strongly EEG patterns can match them, and describe that structure in interpretable terms. Methods We introduce First-Order spherical haRMonic (FORM), projecting normalized scalp topographies onto a fixed three-dimensional subspace defined only by sensor geometry. Direction describes field geometry; projection norm, ρ, measures FORM conformity and the maximum correlation attainable by any FORM topography. We tested simulations, literature templates, and 374 recordings from 187 LEMON participants. Results FORM captured canonical microstate geometry despite being defined a priori of a microstate solution: FORM explained energy ρ 2 was 0.990-0.998 for five meta-microstates and 0.966-0.986 for pooled LEMON maps. Across 313 literature templates, FORM angular distances preserved their independently derived organization (Spearman ρ = 0.987). In continuous EEG, FORM conformity explained a median 74.4% of within-subject variance in winning-template correlation, versus 21.7% for GFP. As independently estimated dictionaries increased from K = 1 to K = 12, the median fitted fraction of the FORM ceiling rose from 0.613 to 0.970. Discussion FORM places an a priori continuous geometry beneath discrete microstate labels. It separates properties intrinsic to the scalp field - whether it is microstate-like and where it lies within that geometry - from how well the chosen template dictionary represents it. FORM therefore provides an interpretable, clustering-independent reference for assignment strength, template comparison and continuous microstate dynamics.

relevance.reason: 提出基于头皮几何的静息态EEG微状态地形分析方法，并报告其解释微状态几何与模板匹配的结构性发现。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个仅由传感器几何决定、独立于任何微状态解的固定三维球谐子空间（FORM），用来检验头皮电场在多大程度上“像”微状态，并把电场本身的几何属性与模板字典的表示能力区分开。作者用模拟、文献模板和真实静息态脑电数据验证：FORM能解释典型微状态图谱的大部分能量，并保持文献模板间独立得出的组织关系；在连续脑电中，FORM符合度比全局场强更能解释个体内模板匹配相关性的变异，且随着字典规模增大，实际拟合逐渐接近FORM给出的上限。作者据此认为，FORM为微状态归属强度、模板比较和连续微状态动态提供了一个可解释、不依赖聚类的参照。

papers.title: SILICA-SNC: FROM STREAMLINES TO NETWORKS
papers.authors: Wu L, Calhoun V.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Whole brain tractography contains rich trajectory-level information about white matter organization, yet conventional structural connectomes capture only part of it. We introduce Structural Network Coupling (SNC), a network representation enabled by SILICA (Streamline Independent Component Analysis). SILICA decomposes tractography into structural source components and their streamline-specific loading profiles, while SNC characterizes relationships among these components through their shared trajectory expression. The resulting component-level network retains direct correspondence to the underlying white-matter pathways and supports network visualization and graph-based analysis. SNC produced anatomically interpretable coupling among trajectory-resolved white-matter components and revealed a highly organized group architecture that independently recapitulated commissural, projection, and association systems. It also showed strong hemispheric segregation and structured cross-system coupling, and was highly stable across split-half samples. SNC extends SILICA from trajectory decomposition to network-level organization and provides a flexible framework for future structural and multimodal network analysis.

relevance.reason: 提出基于全脑纤维束成像的白质结构网络表征方法，揭示白质通路的网络组织与半球分离，属结构连接与脑组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种名为SILICA-SNC的结构网络表征方法，旨在弥补传统结构连接组对全脑纤维束轨迹信息利用不足的问题。方法上，SILICA将纤维束追踪分解为结构源成分及其轨迹载荷，SNC则通过成分间共享的轨迹表达刻画这些成分之间的关系，使成分级网络仍与底层白质通路直接对应。结果显示，SNC能在轨迹分辨的白质成分间产生解剖上可解释的耦合，并独立重现连合、投射和联络系统的高度组织化群体架构，同时表现出明显的半球分离和结构化的跨系统耦合，且在分半样本间高度稳定。这些发现表明，SNC将SILICA从轨迹分解拓展到网络层面，为后续结构与多模态网络分析提供了灵活框架。

papers.title: Association of the Schizophrenia Risk Locus rs10866912 with Cerebral Volumes, Diet, and Psychosis in the UK Biobank.
papers.authors: Jankowski L, Periyasamy S, Youssef P, John S, Forthman KL, Kuplicki R, Giacomotto J, Smith H, McLean D, Raghavan V, Thara R, Paulus M, Mowry B.
papers.abstract: Background Leading schizophrenia GWAS signals require evaluation of their pathological significance across diverse ancestries. rs10866912 reached genome-wide significance in our Indian ancestry GWAS of schizophrenia; its risk allele reduces expression of NAPRT, the rate-limiting enzyme in the brain's principal NAD+-synthesis pathway, giving a single mechanistic basis for testing associations with brain structure, dietary niacin intake, and psychosis risk. We evaluated this SNP in a large European ancestry population for associations with regional brain volumes, niacin-rich food consumption, and psychotic disorder diagnosis. Methods Of approximately 500,000 UK Biobank participants, 36,492 met study criteria of European ancestry, brain MRI examination, and dietary questionnaire completion. Risk-allele count was regressed on each of 174 phenotypes-139 regional gray matter volumes, 26 psychological and 9 dietary variables-with age, sex, and BMI as covariates. Volumes were log-transformed and adjusted for total gray matter volume by residualization, and Bonferroni and false discovery rate corrections were applied within each domain. Results Risk-allele count was negatively associated with gray matter volume in the left pallidum (β = -0.0143, p = 0.00016; Bonferroni-significant) and left caudate (β = -0.0142, p = 0.00038; FDR-significant), with the contralateral homologues in the same direction at nominal significance. No dietary or psychological variable survived correction. Nominally significant associations included increased wheat consumption and fewer years spent vegetarian, both implying higher dietary niacin. The association with a diagnosis of psychotic disorder, nominally significant in linear regression, was not significant when the binary outcome was re-examined by logistic regression (OR = 1.36, 95% CI 0.997-1.85, p = 0.053). Conclusions The risk allele is associated with reduced pallidal and caudate gray matter volume in a large general-population sample, in a direction consistent with observations in unmedicated patients once antipsychotic effects are allowed for. The dietary and psychiatric associations are exploratory and warrant further study of the relationship between this locus, circulating niacin, and psychotic disorder.

relevance.reason: 在UK Biobank人脑MRI中检验精神分裂症风险位点与基底节灰质体积的关联，属脑结构与疾病机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在英国生物银行中检验精神分裂症风险位点rs10866912的携带情况与脑区灰质体积、膳食烟酸摄入及精神病性障碍诊断的关联，分析对象为具有欧洲血统、完成脑MRI和膳食问卷的参与者。结果显示，风险等位基因数量与左侧苍白球和左侧尾状核灰质体积降低相关，对侧同源结构呈同方向但仅名义显著；膳食和心理变量均未通过多重校正，精神病性障碍诊断在线性回归中名义显著，但改用逻辑回归后不再显著。作者认为，该位点与基底节灰质体积的关联方向与未用药患者观察一致，而膳食与精神症状方面的结果仍属探索性，需进一步研究该位点、循环烟酸与精神病性障碍之间的关系。

papers.title: Changes in Diffusion MRI-Based White Matter Metrics After a Dance Intervention in Individuals with Substance Use Disorders-A Pilot Study.
papers.authors: Kannonier A, Stornig S, Koschutnig K, Unterrainer HF, Klepits P, Fink A.
papers.abstract: Objectives : The present study examined the effects of a three-week dance intervention on diffusion MRI-based white matter metrics in a sample of individuals diagnosed with substance use disorder (SUD; F19.2). Methods : The intervention was carried out in an inpatient rehabilitation facility twice a week. Participants were partly randomized into two groups, one intervention group and one treatment-as-usual group, which did not differ in terms of substitution or other psychiatric medications. Both groups underwent an MRI assessment at baseline and after the intervention, using diffusion-weighted imaging. Results : Analysis of MRI diffusion data revealed significant effects in the intervention group relative to the treatment-as-usual group, particularly within white matter networks associated with sensorimotor functions, with the most pronounced changes in the cerebellum. Conclusions : These findings suggest that learning a new motor skill may induce white matter changes in the brain in individuals with SUDs.

papers.summary_zh: 这项初步研究考察了三周舞蹈干预对物质使用障碍患者基于弥散MRI的白质指标的影响，采用部分随机分组，将住院康复中的参与者分为舞蹈干预组和照常治疗组，并在干预前后进行弥散加权成像评估。结果显示，与照常治疗组相比，干预组在感觉运动相关白质网络中出现了显著变化，其中小脑的变化最为明显。作者据此推测，学习新的运动技能可能促使物质使用障碍患者的大脑白质发生改变；但作为初步研究，这一解释仍需更大样本和更严谨的设计加以验证。

papers.title: Occupational neurotoxicant exposures, cognitive reserve, and brain aging: a scoping review.
papers.authors: Leton N, Bayley S.
papers.abstract: Background Occupational neurotoxicant exposure may contribute to cognitive decline, neurological dysfunction, and brain aging. However, the role of cognitive reserve in explaining differences in cognitive and neurological outcomes among exposed workers remains insufficiently characterized. Objective This scoping review aimed to map evidence linking occupational neurotoxicant exposure with cognitive reserve or brain aging outcomes in adults, characterize exposure categories, cognitive reserve operationalizations, and neuroimaging methodologies, and identify evidence gaps. Methods Searches were conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, and APA PsycInfo for English-language studies published from January 2011 onward. The review followed Joanna Briggs Institute guidance for scoping reviews and PRISMA-ScR reporting standards. Eligible studies examined adult populations with occupational neurotoxicant exposure and cognitive reserve or brain aging outcomes. Results Sixteen studies met the inclusion criteria. Exposure categories included aluminum, lead, combustion-related exposures, organic solvents, and mixed-metal exposures. Cross-sectional and case-control designs predominated, and biological monitoring was the most frequently used exposure assessment approach. Cognitive decline or impairment was the most common brain aging outcome, while neuroimaging studies identified functional connectivity, white matter, cortical thickness, and brain volume alterations. Six studies did not explicitly operationalize cognitive reserve; among the remaining studies, approaches included educational attainment, biological susceptibility factors, and neuroimaging-based measures of brain structure or function. China was the most represented country, while evidence from other low- and middle-income regions remained limited. Conclusion Diverse occupational neurotoxicant exposures were associated with adverse cognitive and neurological findings relevant to brain aging, although causality cannot be established. Cognitive reserve remains inconsistently examined, and neuroimaging measures should not be interpreted as direct measures of cognitive reserve. Future research should prioritize longitudinal studies integrating repeated exposure assessment, cognitive evaluation, multidimensional cognitive reserve measures, and multimodal neuroimaging.

relevance.reason: 综述职业神经毒物暴露与认知衰退及脑老化影像改变（功能连接、白质、皮层厚度、脑体积）的关系，涉及认知与脑结构功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该范围综述梳理了职业性神经毒物暴露与认知储备及脑老化结局之间的证据，纳入的研究对象为有职业暴露的成年人，暴露类别涉及铝、铅、燃烧相关暴露、有机溶剂和混合金属等。多数研究采用横断面或病例对照设计，常见结局是认知下降或损害，神经影像研究报告了功能连接、白质、皮层厚度和脑体积的改变。作者指出，这些暴露与不良认知和神经学表现相关，但无法据此确立因果关系；认知储备的界定不一致，部分研究未明确操作化，且神经影像指标不应被直接视为认知储备的测量。综述据此强调，未来需要纵向研究，整合重复暴露评估、认知评价、多维认知储备测量和多模态神经影像。

papers.title: Controlled deep breathing technique intervention effects on resting EEG, subjective psychological distress, and executive function performance in young adults.
papers.authors: Ivgi O, Meiron O.
papers.abstract: Controlled breathing techniques have been widely investigated for their role in emotional regulation; however, their effects on resting-state neural oscillatory activity and psychological distress remain insufficiently characterized. The present study examined whether a Controlled Deep Breathing Technique (CDBT) intervention modulates resting-state electroencephalographic (EEG) activity and subjective psychological distress in healthy adults. Forty healthy adults (ages 18 to 40 years) were randomly assigned to an experimental (CDBT) or control (natural breathing) intervention group for 20 min. Resting-state quantitative EEG (qEEG) was recorded before and after the intervention under eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions. Behavioral measures included assessments of subjective psychological distress and executive functioning. qEEG analyses during resting-state focused on alpha/beta power ratios at frontal and parietal electrodes. Results showed a significant increase in alpha/beta ratios in the experimental group compared with the control group, particularly during the eyes-closed condition and at parietal electrodes. The experimental group also showed significant reductions in psychological distress scores and improvements in executive functioning measures, whereas no significant changes were observed in the control group. These findings suggest that CDBT may modulate frontoparietal oscillatory dynamics associated with relaxed mental states and improved executive functioning, providing preliminary evidence that CDBT may influence emotional regulation and cognitive control in healthy adults.

relevance.reason: 研究深呼吸干预对健康成人静息态EEG振荡及执行功能的影响，报告了脑电振荡与认知控制机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察控制性深呼吸技术干预能否调节健康成人的静息态脑电活动与主观心理困扰，将健康成人随机分入深呼吸干预组或自然呼吸对照组，并在干预前后记录静息态定量脑电，同时评估心理困扰与执行功能。结果显示，干预组额顶区alpha/beta功率比升高，闭眼和顶区条件下尤为明显，心理困扰评分下降、执行功能表现改善，而对照组未见显著变化。作者据此提出，控制性深呼吸可能调节与放松状态和执行功能相关的额顶振荡动态，为健康成人情绪调节与认知控制提供了初步证据，但样本和设计仍属初步，尚不能推断临床效果。

papers.title: Dynamic EEG network responses to acupuncture stimulation in patients with stroke: a neurophysiological study.
papers.authors: Tan J, Zhao J, Zhang C, Fan X.
papers.abstract: Objective Acupuncture may modulate brain activity through effects on the central nervous system. This study aimed to investigate short-term changes in spontaneous EEG activity and functional connectivity during acupuncture in patients with stroke using multichannel electroencephalography (EEG). Methods Multichannel EEG recordings were collected at three stages: before acupuncture, during acupuncture, and after acupuncture. Acupuncture was applied at Jianyu, Quchi, and Waiguan. EEG activity was evaluated using power spectral density (PSD) analysis. Functional connectivity was assessed using the weighted phase lag index (wPLI). Functional brain networks were constructed for different frequency bands. Graph theory analysis was used to examine clustering coefficient and global efficiency across different network sparsities. Results Power spectral density analysis showed significant stage-related changes in delta, theta, and alpha relative power, but not in beta power. Delta relative power decreased during acupuncture and partially recovered after acupuncture, but remained comparable to the pre-acupuncture level. Theta relative power increased during acupuncture and then decreased after acupuncture, with the post-acupuncture level lower than the pre-acupuncture level. Alpha relative power increased during acupuncture and decreased after acupuncture, but remained higher than the pre-acupuncture level. Whole-brain average wPLI showed a decrease in the delta band and an increase in the alpha band during acupuncture. No significant stage-related changes were observed in the theta-band average wPLI after correction for multiple comparisons. Graph-theoretical measures, including clustering coefficient and global efficiency, did not show statistically significant stage-related changes at the selected sparsity. Conclusion Acupuncture was associated with short-term, frequency-dependent changes in spontaneous EEG activity and functional connectivity in patients with stroke. The observed changes were mainly reflected in spectral power and whole-brain average wPLI, while changes in overall network topology were not statistically supported. These findings provide preliminary neurophysiological evidence for the brain response to acupuncture stimulation.

relevance.reason: 研究卒中患者针刺时自发EEG功率与功能连接变化，属脑疾病人群的脑活动/网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨脑卒中患者在接受针灸刺激时自发脑电活动与功能连接是否出现短期变化，采用多通道脑电记录针灸前、中、后三个阶段，并用功率谱密度和加权相位滞后指数分析。结果显示，变化具有频率依赖性：针灸中delta相对功率下降、theta和alpha相对功率上升，针灸后各频段呈现不同程度的回落或恢复；全脑平均功能连接在delta频段下降、alpha频段上升，而聚类系数和全局效率等网络拓扑指标未见统计学支持的阶段性变化。作者据此认为，针灸相关的脑反应主要体现在频谱功率和全脑平均连接上，而非整体网络拓扑，为针灸刺激的神经生理效应提供了初步证据。

papers.title: Brain functional mechanisms of acupuncture treatment for early-stage non-tremor Parkinson's disease: a resting-state fMRI study.
papers.authors: Qin Y, Liu R, Liu R.
papers.abstract: Objective To observe the modulatory effects of acupuncture in early-stage non-tremor Parkinson's disease (PD) patients using resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), and to determine the correlation between its changes and clinical indicators. Methods This observational study included 35 patients with early Parkinson's disease who received multi-target acupuncture treatment combined with regular levodopa therapy (twice weekly for 12 weeks) in the traditional Chinese medicine department. They were classified as the observation group and the study period was from January 2023 to December 2024. The observation group received acupuncture and underwent rs-fMRI scanning at baseline and post-treatment. A healthy control group underwent a single rs-fMRI scan at baseline. Post-treatment imaging and clinical data from the observation group were compared with those of the healthy control group. Primary outcomes were changes in rs-fMRI-derived degree centrality (DC), functional connectivity (FC), and fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF). Secondary outcomes included clinical scale improvements and correlations between imaging metrics and clinical scores. Results After treatment, the observation group showed significant improvements in MDS-UPDRS-III, MoCA, 10MWT, TUG, and PDQ-39 scores (all p < 0.001). However, all indicators except MoCA remained significantly different after treatment (p < 0.001). fMRI analyses revealed significant post-treatment decreases in right precuneus DC and its FC with the left precuneus (both p < 0.001), the fALFF in medial superior frontal gyrus/anterior cingulate cortex increased(p < 0.001). The change (post-treatment minus pre-treatment) in right precuneus DC was positively correlated with the change (post-treatment minus pre-treatment) in MDS-UPDRS-III scores (r = 0.343, p = 0.043) and negatively correlated with the change (post-treatment minus pre-treatment) in MoCA scores (r = -0.533, p < 0.001). Conclusion Acupuncture treatment was associated with improvements in motor function, walking speed, and cognition in early-stage non-tremor PD, with potential mechanisms involving downregulated precuneus DC/FC and enhanced local activity. Furthermore, the change in right precuneus DC, which correlated significantly with both motor and cognitive improvements, may serve as a potential neuroimaging biomarker for treatment-induced clinical recovery.

relevance.reason: 以早期帕金森病患者为对象，用静息态fMRI考察针刺治疗相关的脑功能网络改变及其与运动/认知改善的关联，属脑疾病认知与脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以静息态功能磁共振观察针刺对早期非震颤型帕金森病的调节作用，纳入接受多靶点针刺联合常规左旋多巴治疗的患者，并与健康对照的基线影像及临床资料进行比较。治疗后患者运动症状、步行速度、认知与生活质量量表评分均有改善，影像上表现为右侧楔前叶度中心性及其与左侧楔前叶的功能连接下降、内侧额上回/前扣带皮层低频涨落振幅升高。右侧楔前叶度中心性的变化与运动评分变化正相关、与认知评分变化负相关，提示楔前叶度中心性可能作为反映治疗相关临床恢复的潜在神经影像标志物；但该研究为观察性设计，相关结果不能直接推断因果或疗效机制。

papers.title: Effects of single-modality sensory stimulation on brain function in patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness: a near-infrared spectroscopy-based study.
papers.authors: Zhang J, Zhou B, Tian H, Ma T, Cai S, Ren X, Fan Y, Zhang G, Su M.
papers.abstract: Objective To explore the effects of four single-modality sensory stimulations on the brain functional networks in patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness (pDOC), and to clarify the correlation between different sensory stimulations and the improvement of patients' consciousness level, so as to provide references for clinical treatment and rehabilitation of pDOC patients. Methods A prospective, multicenter, randomized controlled trial design was adopted. A total of 57 patients with pDOC were enrolled and divided into visual stimulation group, auditory stimulation group, olfactory-gustatory stimulation group, somatosensory-nocieptive stimulation group, and control group. The intervention duration of each group was 15 min. Behavioral assessments were performed using the Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (CRS-R) and Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS). Combined with functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), hemodynamic parameters and brain functional connectivity were detected. Changes in brain function and consciousness level before and after different sensory stimulation interventions were evaluated. Results Visual, auditory and olfactory-gustatory stimulations induced significant and robust alterations in cerebral activity across most detected channels (p < 0.001), while the cerebral response to somatosensory-nocieptive stimulation was relatively limited (p < 0.05). At the channel activation level, viewing family photographs in visual stimulation, light music, personalized music and family voice calling in auditory stimulation, and acetic acid stimulation in olfactory-gustatory stimulation significantly activated the corresponding brain regions (p < 0.05). At the brain functional connectivity level, viewing family photographs markedly enhanced functional connectivity within visual-related brain regions (p < 0.05); ethanol stimulation improved functional connectivity of olfactory-gustatory brain regions (p < 0.05). Conclusion Single-modality sensory stimulation elicits acute cerebral activation in pDOC patients, which is superior to conventional rehabilitation alone. Visual and auditory stimulations exert significantly better intervention effects than olfactory-gustatory and somatosensory-nocieptive stimulations. Among olfactory-gustatory interventions, acetic acid stimulation produces prominent brain region activation, and ethanol enhances functional connectivity of related brain regions. Both can serve as an effective supplementary intervention for pDOC patients with visual and auditory dysfunction, and possess important value for further research and clinical application in the management of pDOC.

papers.title: Microstructural changes in deep gray nuclei following electroconvulsive therapy.
papers.authors: Filippi CG, Leung MY, Ulug AM, Zavaliangos-Petropulu A, Watts R.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) is efficacious for the treatment of major depressive disorder. However, its underlying mechanism of action remains debated and may involve neurogenesis, changes in axon/synaptic density or glial cells. Restriction spectrum imaging (RSI) is an MRI technique that can resolve subvoxel microstructure, separating intracellular water from extracellular water, which can be further partitioned into hindered and free water. This technique can be used to determine whether ECT affects cellular microstructure through changes in signal contributions. In the present study, we aim to determine how RSI metrics change following ECT and whether these metrics correlate with clinical improvement. Methods RSI analysis of the Perturbation of Depression Connectome (PDC 1.0) diffusion MRI data for healthy control and predominantly right unilateral ECT patients. MRI studies were undertaken at baseline, 1-week post-treatment and 3-months post ECT (follow-up). Results Following ECT, right-sided RSI metrics changed in cortical and subcortical brain regions including right amygdala and right hippocampus between baseline and post-treatment. The hindered water compartment increased, the free water compartment decreased, and the intracellular compartment was unchanged. Post-treatment, volume increased in the amygdala and hippocampus, which partially resolved at follow-up, while right amygdala extracellular indices persisted. Changes in clinical symptoms did not clearly relate to volumetric or diffusion changes. Conclusions RSI provides imaging biomarkers that suggest extracellular water shifts with corresponding volume changes to be the predominant effect of ECT. Transient and longer-term changes in glymphatic flow may be one of the contributing, underlying mechanisms of action for ECT.

papers.title: Sex-Specific Regional Brain Morphometric Correlates of Neighborhood Socioeconomic Disadvantage in Clinical Neuroimaging.
papers.authors: Willbrand EH, Vazquez LA, Fromandi MB, Frautschi PC, Powell TB, Yu JJ.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Neighborhood-level socioeconomic disadvantage is associated with adverse brain morphometry, yet whether these associations differ by biological sex remain opaque. Here, we investigated sex-specific associations between the area deprivation index and brain morphometry derived from routine clinical MRI in a real-world clinical population. Materials and methods Intracranial volume-normalized regional brain volumes were extracted from T1-weighted MRI examinations performed in 2,863 consecutive clinical patients (median age 54 years [IQR 38-68]; 61.2% female) at a single academic medical center and associated community partners using an automated atlas-based segmentation pipeline. Exploratory factor analysis was applied to 131 regional brain volumes to identify latent neuroanatomical morphometric networks. Sex-stratified and interaction linear regression models examined associations between area deprivation index national percentile rank and each factor score, adjusting for age, with correction for multiple comparisons. Results Factor analysis identified five neuroanatomical morphometric networks: cerebellar (ML1), frontal/executive (ML2), subcortical-ventricular (ML3), medial temporal/limbic (ML4), and posterior cortical/visual (ML5). In male patients (n = 1,112), linear regressions revealed that greater neighborhood-level socioeconomic disadvantage was significantly associated with lower factor scores on the cerebellar (β = -0.006, 95% CI [-0.009, -0.003], P < .001), medial temporal/limbic (β = -0.004, 95% CI [-0.007, -0.001], P = .01), and frontal/executive (β = -0.004, 95% CI [-0.007, -0.0004], P = .04) networks. No significant associations were observed in female patients (all P s ≥ .61). The interaction analysis was significant only for the cerebellar network (β = -0.005, 95% CI [-0.009, -0.001], P = .01; all other P s ≥ .07). Conclusions In a real-world clinical population, neighborhood-level socioeconomic disadvantage was associated with lower regional brain volumes across cerebellar, frontal/executive, and medial temporal/limbic neuroanatomical morphometric networks in male but not female patients; the cerebellar network was the only network to remain significant in interaction models. These findings suggest that the neuroanatomical correlates of neighborhood disadvantage may be sex-specific, and that sex-stratified analyses may be necessary to fully characterize the relationship between the social exposome and brain morphometry in clinical neuroimaging research.

papers.title: Multivariate Resting-State EEG Organization in Autism: Shared Age-Related Structure and Diagnostic Context Dependent IQ Associations
papers.authors: WANG Y, Wang Y, Chan S.
papers.abstract: Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) studies of autism have often sought categoricaldifferentiation between autistic and typical neurodevelopmental groups, with limited stabilityacross features or classifiers. A neurodiversity-informed perspective views autism as part ofhuman neurodevelopmental variation, while recognizing associated disability and support needs.In this view, overlap between autistic and non-autistic EEG distributions is not merelyclassification noise, but may reflect shared dimensions of neural organization. A complementaryquestion arise is whether position along these dimensions has different functional meaning acrossdiagnostic contexts. We conducted an exploratory secondary analysis of 726 eyes-open resting-state EEG features previously extracted in a published multi-site autism EEG study, with a finalanalytic sample of 767 children and adolescents: 344 controls (CON), 347 participants classifiedby the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule as Autistic Disorder (ADOS-A), and 76classified as Autism Spectrum (ADOS-S). Principal component analysis was applied once to thepooled sample without including age, sex, IQ, or diagnostic group. The dominant component(PC1) was interpreted post hoc by examining its EEG feature loading pattern, its association withchronological age, the consistency of this age association across diagnostic groups, and theconcentration of age-related variance across components. We then tested whether age-adjustedposition on this component was differentially associated with general cognitive performance(i.e., IQ) across groups. PC1 explained 15.94% of feature variance and was characterized by thestrongest positive loadings on delta-band power and the strongest negative loadings on sampleentropy. PC1 showed a significant negative association with chronological age (𝑟 = −0.846,𝑝 < .001), indicating that older age was associated with relatively lower delta power and highersample entropy along this component, consistent with previously reported developmental EEGchanges. Age-related EEG variance was concentrated primarily on PC1 rather than onsubsequent components, supporting its interpretation as a shared age-related EEG dimension.After removing PC1’s linear association with age, residual PC1 scores (PC1r) were negativelyassociated with IQ within the ADOS-A group (𝑏 = −0.612, 𝑝 < .001), but not within thecontrol or ADOS-S groups. Pairwise slope contrasts indicated that this association wassignificantly more negative in ADOS-A than in CON, whereas ADOS-A vs. ADOS-S andADOS-S vs. CON contrasts were not significant. These findings shift emphasis from categoricalEEG abnormality toward individual variation within a broadly shared age-related EEGorganization, in which brain–cognition coupling depends on diagnostic context.

papers.title: Chronic Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Burden and Acute Infarction in Relation to Functional Brain Network Efficiency: A Cross-Sectional Resting-State fMRI Study
papers.authors: Gao Y, Lu C, Liu Y, Zhao Y, Zheng L, Gu Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Chronic cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) and acute infarction frequently coexist, but their respective relationships with functional network integration remain uncertain. We examined whether cumulative CSVD burden and clinical acute infarction were independently associated with resting-state functional global efficiency and explored which lesion phenotypes and anatomical regions showed the strongest associations. Methods This hospital-based cross-sectional study included 166 patients aged 45 years or older with suspected cerebrovascular disease. Automated multisequence MRI segmentation quantified white matter hyperintensities, recent small subcortical infarcts, lacunes, perivascular spaces, and cerebral microbleeds. Resting-state functional networks were constructed using a 90-region anatomical parcellation, with global efficiency prespecified as the primary outcome. HC3 heteroskedasticity-robust multivariable linear regression adjusted for age, sex, hypertension, diabetes mellitus, mean framewise displacement, and clinical acute infarction. Regional markers were jointly evaluated within each lesion family, with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Results Higher total CSVD burden was independently associated with lower global efficiency (B per 1-point increase = − 0.0055, 95% CI: −0.0086 − 0.0024; P < 0.001), whereas clinical acute infarction was not (B = 0.0008, 95% CI: −0.0071–0.0087; P = 0.850). The lacune regional block explained an additional 9.27% of variance (robust P = 0.00195). Parietal lacunes (B=-0.0130, FDR q = 0.026) and deep lacunes (B=-0.0132, FDR q = 0.021) were independently associated with lower global efficiency. Regional cerebral microbleed, perivascular-space, and white-matter-hyperintensity blocks were not statistically significant. Conclusions Greater cumulative CSVD burden, particularly parietal and deep lacunes, was associated with impaired functional network integration, whereas clinical acute infarction showed no independent association in this cohort. These cross-sectional findings identify anatomically informative correlates but do not establish causal or temporal relationships.

papers.title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Resting-State Criticality as a Neurophysiological Marker of Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) Performance in People with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) and Healthy Participants
papers.authors: Settgast T, Shriki O, Northoff G, Zilio F, Borgheai SB, Shahriari Y, Kübler A.
papers.abstract: Abstract This exploratory study investigates the relationship between resting-state brain dynamics (EEG) and subsequent brain-computer interface (BCI) performance in people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and healthy participants. Grounded in the critical brain hypothesis, we examined whether neurophysiological markers of criticality in resting-state EEG correlate with subsequent BCI performance. We analyzed neuronal avalanche dynamics, multiscale criticality measures, the spectral slope, and Lempel-Ziv complexity across two datasets: a longitudinal single-case study of a person in the locked-in state after a disease history with ALS (Dataset 1) and longitudinal data from 5 people with ALS and single sessions from 6 healthy participants (Dataset 2). Neuronal avalanche dynamics, the spectral slope, and Lempel-Ziv complexity consistently correlated with subsequent BCI performance in people with ALS. Conversely, healthy participants showed inverted correlation patterns for the neuronal avalanche dynamics. While group comparisons were not statistically significant, effect size analyses indicated supercritical brain dynamics in people with ALS. We integrate these findings into the B-ARC (BCI-Aptitude through Resting-State Criticality) framework proposing an inverted U-shaped relationship between the proximity of resting-state brain activity to criticality and BCI control. In this framework, healthy participants approach the critical optimum from a subcritical regime, while people with ALS appear to approach it from a putatively supercritical regime characterized by cortical hyperexcitability. These findings and the proposed framework provide potential resting-state predictors of BCI aptitude in people with ALS and may inform the detection of so-called Windows of Consciousness .

papers.title: Intrinsic timescale develops hierarchically from sensorimotor to association cortex in youth and stabilizes in adulthood.
papers.authors: Shafiei G, Bagautdinova J, Sydnor VJ, Bassett DS, Barch DM, Cieslak M, Fan Y, Flook E, Franco AR, Kiar G, Luo AC, Milham MP, Parkes L, Salo T, Somerville LH, Tong TT, Shinohara RT, Satterthwaite TD.
papers.abstract: Intrinsic timescale is a commonly used measure of spontaneous neural dynamics that quantifies the temporal window of processing of neuronal populations. Intrinsic timescale displays a hierarchical cortical organization across multiple species and imaging modalities, with shorter timescales in sensorimotor cortex compared to association cortex. However, less is known about how intrinsic timescale evolves during human brain development and whether its cortical maturation patterns generalize to independent developmental samples. Here we estimate the intrinsic timescale in two independent cross-sectional datasets of youth (HCPD: n = 565; HBN: n = 729; age range 8-22 years) and investigate its neurodevelopmental patterns. We find that developmental patterns in the intrinsic timescale follow a hierarchical pattern that recapitulates an axis spanning sensorimotor to association cortices (S-A axis). Our analysis of an independent healthy young adult dataset (HCPYA: n = 973, age range 22-37 years) underscores the specificity of these developmental findings, suggesting that the intrinsic timescale develops along the S-A axis in youth and stabilizes in adulthood. Together, these results reveal convergence between major axes of cortical organization and development, highlighting intrinsic timescale as a principled marker of hierarchical brain maturation in youth.

papers.title: Cerebellar Theta-Burst Stimulation Induces Distinct Functional Connectivity Patterns in Post-Stroke Aphasia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
papers.authors: Wang X, Xu X, Wang D, Huang G, Zheng K, Chen C, Jiang D, Gao F, Ren C, Zhao Z.
papers.abstract: Background Recent studies have identified the right cerebellar Crus I (rCrus I) as a promising target for rTMS in improving language rehabilitation. However, it remains unclear whether continuous theta burst stimulation (cTBS) over the rCrus I improves language outcomes in patients with subacute post-stroke aphasia (PSA). Objective To determine whether inhibitory cTBS over rCrus I improves language recovery in PSA and to explore underlying functional connectivity (FC) mechanisms. Methods Fifty-one PSA patients were randomized to receive either real cTBS (n = 25) or sham stimulation (n = 26) over rCrus I (10 sessions, 2 weeks) combined with speech-language therapy (SLT). Language assessments (WAB-AQ, BNT, BDAE) and resting-state fMRI were conducted before and after the intervention. Results Both groups showed significant language improvement post-intervention. No significant interaction was found for WAB-AQ (P = .058), but a significant interaction was observed for repetition (P = .034), favoring cTBS. Resting-state fMRI showed altered connectivity between rCrus I and right temporo-occipital regions, with FC changes negatively correlated with language gains in the cTBS group. Exploratory subgroup analyses identified 2 distinct FC response patterns (FC-increase and FC-decrease), indicating heterogeneous cerebello-cortical and intra-cerebellar connectivity modulation across participants. Conclusions Cerebellar cTBS did not confer a significant overall benefit on language recovery in PSA, but selectively improved repetition performance, suggesting domain-specific effects. Functional imaging indicated that rCrus I-centered connectivity changes were associated with behavioral outcomes, with marked inter-individual variability. These findings support a modulatory role of cerebellar cTBS on language networks, warranting further validation in larger, well-powered studies. Trial registration This trial was registered under the China Clinical Trial Registry (Registration No. ChiCTR2100049828).
