papers.title: Oxygen extraction fraction mapping between normal cognition and mild cognitive impairment in older adults using quantitative BOLD.
papers.authors: Le LNN, Wheeler GJ, Blockley NP, Fletcher E, Jung Y, Farias SET, Gavett B, DeCarli C, Fan AP.
papers.abstract: Oxygen extraction fraction (OEF) represents the proportion of oxygen utilized by the brain from the blood and is a sensitive biomarker in understanding the vascular interplay between oxygen supply and demand. Alterations in OEF are increasingly recognized in normal aging and the pathophysiology of many neurological disorders, including Alzheimer's disease and cognitive impairment. Here, we aimed to assess regional OEF MRI in older adults and investigate its relationship with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and normal aging using a Variational Bayesian quantitative BOLD (qBOLD) framework. The qBOLD model leverages a biophysical relationship between OEF, deoxygenated blood volume (DBV), and the reversible transverse relaxation rate (R2 ' ) to extract parameter values from asymmetric spin echo (ASE) MRI scans. The reliability of these parameter estimates was enhanced by Variational Bayesian inference, which incorporates prior distributions that we optimized in numerical simulation. We then applied this model to a cohort of older adults (N = 70) from the Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) at the University of California, Davis, including 58 cognitively normal (CN) and 12 amnestic mild cognitive impaired (MCI) participants. Our findings revealed a trend of elevated OEF across many cortical brain regions in the MCI group. Additionally, we identified regional positive associations between OEF and age in the MCI group, significantly in the left inferior parietal region ( β=0.88±0.23, T=3.75, P=0.0004 ). Furthermore, the relationship between OEF and episodic memory in the right parahippocampal region differed significantly between two diagnostic groups (negative for CN and positive for MCI) ( β=0.09±0.02, T=3.77, P=0.0004 ). This work adopts a novel qBOLD MRI framework for studying OEF changes in cognitive impairment as a potential biomarker for monitoring pathophysiology in aging and dementia.

relevance.reason: 研究老年人MCI与正常认知的脑氧摄取分数MRI，并关联情景记忆，涉及认知障碍的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注老年人脑氧摄取分数（OEF）与轻度认知障碍及正常衰老的关系，采用变分贝叶斯定量BOLD框架从非对称自旋回波MRI中估计区域OEF，并比较认知正常老年人与遗忘型轻度认知障碍参与者。结果显示，轻度认知障碍组多个皮层区域的OEF呈升高趋势，且该组OEF与年龄在部分区域呈正相关；OEF与情景记忆的关联在右侧海马旁区域因诊断组别而方向不同。作者认为，这一框架有望用于监测衰老和痴呆相关病理生理变化，但上述结果属于关联性发现，尚不能说明OEF变化与认知障碍之间存在因果关系。

papers.title: Language Access and Hemispheric Specialization: A Network Neuroscience Framework for Typical and Atypical Language Development.
papers.authors: Bortfeld H.
papers.abstract: Neural plasticity in early life underpins the emergence of hemispheric specialization, including left-lateralized networks commonly involved in language. In typical development, neural organization becomes progressively more efficient and specialized across hemispheres, with trajectories shaped by early sensory input and linked to later language outcomes. Because human neuroimaging evidence supports a role for language experience across sensory modalities in shaping neural organization, early sensorineural hearing loss provides a model system for disentangling how sensory and language environments independently influence experience-dependent plasticity. Even when overall brain organization is preserved, early sensory deprivation is associated with altered developmental trajectories of hemispheric specialization. Critically, sensory deprivation does not inevitably result in atypical language or neural development, underscoring an important theoretical distinction between auditory and language deprivation. This review integrates findings from neural, behavioral, and clinical research to propose a framework for understanding how early sensory and language experiences shape language-related developmental outcomes.

relevance.reason: 综述提出语言经验与感觉输入如何塑造半球特化及语言相关脑网络发育的理论框架，涉及人脑偏侧化与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕早期经验如何塑造语言相关半球偏侧化这一问题，整合神经、行为与临床研究，提出一个理解典型与非典型语言发展的网络神经科学框架。作者指出，典型发展中脑组织逐渐变得更高效、更专门化，其轨迹受早期感觉输入影响并与日后语言结果相关；早期感音神经性听力损失则被用作区分感觉环境与语言环境各自作用的模型。综述强调，即使整体脑组织保持，早期感觉剥夺仍与半球专门化的发展轨迹改变有关，但感觉剥夺并不必然导致非典型的语言或神经发展，因此需要区分听觉剥夺与语言剥夺。

papers.title: Reproducible cortical links between functional hierarchy, structure, and metabolism.
papers.authors: Tomasi D, Volkow ND.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Large-scale functional connectivity gradients provide a compact description of cortical organization, capturing hierarchical transitions from unimodal sensory systems to transmodal association cortex. Although these gradients have become a central framework for studying macroscale brain organization, it remains unclear whether they systematically map onto regional cortical biology. Here we show that functional gradient position robustly predicts cortical thickness and regional glucose metabolism, measured with MRI and FDG-PET respectively. Modeling parcelwise cortical thickness and glucose metabolism as linear combinations of signed and amplitude components along functional gradients explained substantial variance in both measures across individuals, with signed gradient terms improving prediction in every subject. These relationships generalized across scanning sessions and independent cohorts and remained significant under spatial permutation testing. Gradient-based models outperformed classical graph-theoretic connectivity metrics, whereas nonlinear extensions did not improve performance. Cortical myelin was selectively associated with the signed component of the principal gradient, without an amplitude effect, and this pattern replicated across developmental, adult, and aging cohorts, supporting a microstructural basis for gradient-cortical thickness coupling. In contrast, gradient associations with glucose metabolism remained largely intact after controlling for myelination, indicating additional biological determinants. These findings establish functional gradients as a reproducible framework linking cortical hierarchy to structure and metabolism.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑皮层功能梯度与皮层厚度、代谢、髓鞘的结构-功能耦合关系，属脑组织与结构功能映射。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大规模功能连接梯度能否系统对应皮层厚度、葡萄糖代谢等区域皮层生物学特征，并结合MRI与FDG-PET数据，将各脑区的皮层厚度和葡萄糖代谢建模为功能梯度上带符号成分与幅度成分的线性组合。结果显示，梯度位置能稳定预测这两项指标，带符号梯度项在每名个体中都改善预测，且该关系可跨扫描场次和独立队列复现；梯度模型优于经典图论连接指标，非线性扩展未带来提升。皮层髓鞘仅与主梯度的带符号成分相关，而控制髓鞘后梯度与葡萄糖代谢的关联仍基本保留，提示后者还受其他生物因素影响。作者据此认为，功能梯度可作为连接皮层层级与结构、代谢的可复现框架。

papers.title: Functional brain networks underlying approach-avoidance conflict processing in humans and rats.
papers.authors: Stewart NR, Valenzano SL, Zhang J, Chu S, Wu Z, Khiabani Javid J, Lee ACH, Ito R.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Our ability to arbitrate between competing approach and avoidance motivations is thought to be an emergent property, arising from the coordinated activity of functional brain networks. Parallel lines of investigation in human and rodent research have identified candidate hub regions supporting approach-avoidance conflict (AAC) behavior, namely the anterior (ventral) hippocampus and prefrontal cortex; yet, a cross-species elucidation of the network dynamics supporting learned conflict processing has yet to be demonstrated. Here, we sought to bridge this translational gap by conducting a functional network analysis in humans and rats from brain-wide neural activity generated by learned motivational conflict. We found that the anterior hippocampus in humans and ventral hippocampus in rats occupied highly central hub-like positions in the network and were highly integrated with extrinsic functional communities. The insula, particularly the posterior insula in rats, was also identified as a putative cross-species hub. Finally, we identified shifts in network topology based on individual differences and sex in conflict preference. Our findings provide evidence for conserved network dynamics, particularly at the regional scale, supporting AAC processing in humans and rats.

relevance.reason: 研究人类与大鼠趋避冲突加工的全脑功能网络组织，属决策/情绪认知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类与大鼠在习得性趋避冲突加工中是否存在跨物种共有的功能脑网络组织，并分别基于全脑神经活动开展功能网络分析。结果显示，人类前海马与大鼠腹侧海马在网络中处于高度中心性的枢纽位置，并与外部功能社区高度整合；岛叶（尤其大鼠后岛叶）也被识别为潜在的跨物种枢纽。此外，网络拓扑会随个体在冲突偏好上的差异及性别而发生变化。作者据此认为，支持趋避冲突加工的网络动态在区域尺度上具有跨物种保守性，但相关结论来自网络层面的关联分析，尚不涉及因果或干预效应。

papers.title: A neural architecture for imagined and overt speech motor dynamics.
papers.authors: Zhao Z, Wang Z, Liu Y, Qian Y, Yin Y, Gao X, Yuan B, Tong SX, Tian X, Chen G, Li Y, Lu J, Wu J.
papers.abstract: Mental imagery is a hallmark of human cognition, yet its neural mechanisms remain poorly understood. Speech imagery (the internal simulation of speech without overt articulation) has been proposed to partially share substrates with speech production, but its spatiotemporal dynamics remain controversial. Here, we leveraged high-resolution electrocorticography to investigate shared and modality-specific coding of articulatory kinematic trajectories during speech imagery and articulation. Linear modeling revealed robust articulatory kinematic trajectories encoding in frontoparietal cortex across modalities. Supramodal populations across middle premotor, subcentral and postcentral-supramarginal regions exhibited spatiotemporal stability during integrative planning. In contrast, modality-specific populations for speech imagery and articulation were somatotopically interleaved in primary sensorimotor cortex, revealing a distinct spatiotemporal organization. We further developed a generalized decoding framework that achieved high prediction accuracy for speech imagery (median 80.4%; chance 16.7%), comparable to speech articulation (78.3%). These findings uncover a somato-cognitive organization linking supramodal planning with modality-specific representations, informing imagery-based brain-computer interfaces.

relevance.reason: 用颅内电生理研究言语想象与发声的发音运动编码及共享/模态特异神经组织，属语言产出机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用高分辨率皮层脑电记录，考察言语想象与出声发音时构音运动轨迹的共享和模态特异性编码。线性建模显示，额顶叶皮层在两种模态下均能稳健编码构音运动轨迹；中前运动区、皮层下区和中央后-缘上回区域的跨模态群体在整合规划阶段表现出时空稳定性，而言语想象和发音各自的模态特异性群体则在初级感觉运动皮层内按躯体定位交错分布。作者据此提出一种连接跨模态规划与模态特异性表征的躯体-认知组织方式，并开发出对言语想象预测准确率接近出声发音的通用解码框架，为基于想象脑机接口提供参考。

papers.title: Double-blind, randomized clinical trial targeting theta oscillations with transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) for cognitive control in male methamphetamine patients.
papers.authors: Tian Y, Jiang L, Gang X, Chen M, Tang S, Wang X, Zhang X, Wang D.
papers.abstract: Methamphetamine use disorder is associated with significant cognitive control deficits, and effective treatments remain limited. Frontal midline theta (FM-theta) oscillations are implicated in cognitive control, but whether theta-frequency transcranial alternating current stimulation (theta-tACS) can improve proactive and reactive control in this population remains unclear. This study initially enrolled 68 male participants diagnosed with methamphetamine use disorder according to DSM-5 criteria. Among them, 56 individuals completed all study procedures and were included in the final analysis. Cognitive control was assessed using a conditional stop-signal task with concurrent EEG recording. The stimulation protocol comprised 15 consecutive daily sessions, during which participants received either active theta-tACS or sham stimulation (2 mA, FCz - Pz montage) in a double-blind design. Following the 15-day theta-tACS stimulation, patients exhibited a significant improvement in preparation cost (p = 0.001) and an increased inhibition rate (p = 0.003). EEG analyses showed that tACS selectively enhanced late-stage proactive control-related theta power (p = 0.026), without significantly modulating theta activity associated with reactive control (p > 0.05). Importantly, the tACS stimulation restored the functional coupling between FM-theta activity and proactive control performance (p = 0.04), and baseline late-stage theta power at T0 positively predicted improvement in preparation cost (ΔT1 - T0) during proactive control (p = 0.01). Finally, a mediation analysis revealed that the tACS-induced improvement in inhibition rate was mediated by the enhanced preparation cost. These findings suggested theta-tACS enhances proactive control by restoring the functional coupling between FM-theta activity and proactive control, which in turn triggers a cascading improvement in reactive control.

relevance.reason: 以甲基苯丙胺使用障碍患者为对象，用EEG结合theta-tACS考察认知控制（前摄/反应性抑制）的额中线theta振荡机制，属认知神经机制与脑疾病研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该随机双盲临床试验考察了以额中线theta振荡为靶点的经颅交流电刺激能否改善男性甲基苯丙胺使用障碍患者的认知控制，采用条件停止信号任务并结合脑电记录，比较连续多日真刺激与伪刺激的效果。结果显示，真刺激组在准备代价和抑制率上均有改善，脑电上表现为选择性地增强与晚期主动控制相关的theta功率，而未显著调节与反应性控制相关的theta活动；同时，刺激恢复了额中线theta活动与主动控制表现之间的功能耦合，基线晚期theta功率还能正向预测准备代价的改善。中介分析进一步提示，抑制率的提升由准备代价的改善所中介，作者据此认为theta刺激通过恢复上述功能耦合增强主动控制，并由此带动反应性控制的连锁改善。

papers.title: Disrupted cortical hierarchy and delayed connectome-based propagation in the functional connectome of schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Joo SW, Lee J.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia is associated with widespread abnormalities in large-scale brain organization; however, the mechanisms linking altered cortical hierarchy to disrupted neural communication and clinical symptoms remain unclear. By integrating functional connectivity gradient analysis and stepwise functional connectivity (SFC), we aimed to clarify how alterations in cortical hierarchy translate into disrupted connectome-based propagation in schizophrenia. Methods Resting-state functional MRI data from 820 participants (310 healthy controls and 510 patients with schizophrenia) were analyzed across multiple cohorts. Cortical hierarchy was characterized using functional connectivity gradients, focusing on the principal unimodal-transmodal gradient (G1). Connectome-based propagation was examined using SFC, with step counts indexing propagation efficiency across predefined hierarchical levels. Associations with clinical symptoms were assessed, including mediation analyses. Results Global cortical hierarchy was preserved in schizophrenia; however, selective alterations were evident. Patients with schizophrenia showed significantly reduced G1 values in the dorsal attention network (DAN), with regional alterations primarily localized to dorsal attention and somatomotor regions. SFC analysis revealed delayed propagation toward higher-order association networks in schizophrenia, reflected by increased step counts to intermediate and transmodal hierarchical levels. Among patients with illness duration <5 years, delayed propagation to higher hierarchical levels was associated with greater positive and negative symptom severity. Mediation analyses demonstrated that delayed propagation significantly mediated the relationship between DAN hierarchical positioning and clinical symptoms. Conclusions These findings suggest that schizophrenia is characterized by selective disruption of cortical hierarchy within attentional control systems, leading to impaired large-scale connectome-based propagation that links cortical organization to clinical symptoms.

relevance.reason: 用静息态fMRI研究精神分裂症患者皮层层级与连接组传播改变及其与症状的关系，属脑疾病认知/网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症中皮层层级改变如何与神经通讯障碍及临床症状相联系，基于静息态功能磁共振数据，结合功能连接梯度分析与逐步功能连接，考察了患者皮层层级组织及连接组传播特征。结果显示，患者整体皮层层级基本保留，但背侧注意网络等区域出现选择性改变；向高阶联合网络的连接组传播延迟，表现为到达中间和跨模态层级所需步数增加。在病程较短的患者中，这种传播延迟与更严重的阳性及阴性症状相关，并中介了背侧注意网络层级位置与临床症状之间的关系。作者据此提出，注意控制系统内皮层层级的选择性破坏可能通过损害大规模连接组传播而连接皮层组织与临床症状，但这一中介关系仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Metabolic and microstructural brain alterations associated with occupational blast exposure.
papers.authors: Song C, Rhodes CS, Lippa SM, Yeh PH, Powell JR, Pickett TC.
papers.abstract: Repeated occupational exposure to low-level blast may pose a risk to the neurological health of service members. To date, no studies have specifically investigated the effects of such repetitive exposure using fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET). This study aims to characterize cerebral metabolic alterations associated with occupational blast exposure, accounting for confounding factors such as posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms and aging. Male service members with chronic mild TBI (mTBI) were categorized into high-risk (HR; n = 204) and low-risk (LR; n = 68) blast exposure groups based on their military occupational specialty. FDG-PET and diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) data were analyzed using region-of-interest (ROI) and voxelwise methods. Statistical models included age and PTSD symptom severity as covariates. Compared to the LR group, ROI analyses revealed higher FDG uptake in the left pallidum, caudate, and ventrolateral prefrontal cortex in the HR group. These elevations in metabolic activity may reflect compensatory mechanisms in response to neurophysiological disruption following blast exposure. Voxelwise analysis showed lower FDG uptake in the HR group within white matter, predominantly in the right hemisphere, including the corpus callosum, anterior thalamic radiation, inferior and superior longitudinal fasciculi. Corresponding DTI findings showed higher fractional anisotropy (p = 0.0025) and axial diffusivity (p = 0.024) in these regions. Furthermore, leftward metabolic lateralization was observed in the pallidum, with the HR group (Cohen's d = 1.36, 95% CI [1.14, 1.57]) exhibiting greater metabolic asymmetry than the LR group (Cohen's d = 1.16, 95% CI [0.79, 1.51]). Findings from this study reveal metabolic and microstructural alterations associated with occupational blast exposure in service members with mTBI.

relevance.reason: 以FDG-PET与DTI研究爆炸暴露相关脑代谢、白质微结构及偏侧化改变，属脑损伤后脑组织与功能重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重复性职业性爆炸暴露是否与慢性轻度创伤性脑损伤军人的脑代谢改变有关，并纳入年龄和创伤后应激症状作为协变量，采用FDG-PET与弥散张量成像进行分析。结果显示，高风险暴露组在左侧苍白球、尾状核和腹外侧前额皮质的葡萄糖摄取较高，作者认为这可能反映爆炸暴露后神经生理紊乱的补偿机制；而在白质区域，高风险组摄取较低，主要位于右半球，并伴有相应区域各向异性与轴向弥散升高。研究还观察到苍白球的代谢左偏，高风险组的不对称程度更大。总体而言，这些发现提示职业性爆炸暴露与脑代谢及微结构改变相关，但属于关联性观察，尚不能说明因果关系或临床疗效。

papers.title: White matter microstructural integrity in SeLECTS: a diffusion tensor imaging study of cognitive and behavioral correlates.
papers.authors: Olculu CB, Yilmaz S, Kose S, Ozalay O, Kan OY, Tokmak SH, Islamli J, Kanmaz S, Kitis O, Ozbaran B, Tekgul H.
papers.abstract: Objective To investigate white-matter microstructure in children with self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (SeLECTS) using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI). Methods This comparative cohort included 26 patients with SeLECTS and 23 age-matched healthy controls. White-matter microstructure was analyzed using a multimodal approach, combining DTI (TRACULA-based tractography) with electroencephalography (EEG), neuropsychological, and psychiatric assessments. Cognitive and behavioral functions were assessed using the Bender-Visual-Motor-Gestalt Test (BVMG), Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children-Fourth Edition, Trail Making Test, verbal fluency test, Behavior Rating Inventory of Executive Function (BRIEF), and Turgay-ADHD scale. DTI data were acquired on a 3.0-T-MRI scanner. Group differences in DTI parameters and exploratory associations between DTI metrics-fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), axial diffusivity (AD), and radial diffusivity (RD) -and neuropsychological or behavioral measures were examined. Results SeLECTS patients demonstrated nominally lower FA values in the superior longitudinal fasciculus (SLF) and arcuate fasciculus (AF) compared with controls. Nominal associations were observed between BVMG rotation and perseveration errors and FA values in the corpus callosum body. Although full-scale intelligence quotient was lower in the patient group, subscale differences were not significant. Nominal associations were also observed between BRIEF Organization of Materials scores and DTI measures, including FA and RD in the corpus callosum. However, none of the tract-behavior associations remained statistically significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Conclusion This study identified nominal differences in white-matter microstructure and exploratory tract-behavior associations in children with SeLECTS using a multimodal approach (DTI, EEG, and neuropsychological tests). These tract-behavior associations should be considered hypothesis-generating. Integrating DTI with neuropsychological assessments may help identify potential cognitive and behavioral correlates of SeLECTS and inform future longitudinal research.

relevance.reason: 研究SeLECTS患儿白质微结构与认知行为关联，属脑疾病中白质结构与功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用弥散张量成像（DTI）结合脑电和神经心理评估，比较了伴中央颞区棘波的儿童自限性癫痫（SeLECTS）患儿与年龄匹配健康儿童的白质微结构，并探索其与认知行为表现的关系。结果显示，患儿在上纵束和弓状束的分数各向异性仅呈名义上的降低，视觉运动测验的旋转与持续错误、执行功能量表的材料组织得分也与部分白质指标存在名义关联；但经多重比较校正后，这些纤维束与行为之间的关联均不再显著。作者据此强调，这些探索性关联只能用于生成假设，提示将DTI与神经心理评估结合或有助于识别SeLECTS可能的认知行为相关因素，并需纵向研究进一步验证。

papers.title: Only the real deal? Actual vs. virtual nature exposure and their effects on affect and cortical hemodynamics in health and major depression.
papers.authors: Kramer M, Winhard M, Gatermann S, Juckel G, Mavrogiorgou P.
papers.abstract: Exposure to natural environments promotes mental health, but access is often limited. Virtual nature-based interventions may offer an alternative, yet direct comparisons of their affective and neurobiological effects with actual nature remain scarce, particularly in depression. To elucidate these effects, thirty-two patients with major depressive disorder and thirty-two healthy controls participated in a quasi-experimental comparison of 10-minute natural and urban exposure in actual or virtual reality (immersive 360° videos via head-mounted display). Actual-exposure data were obtained from an earlier cohort and virtual-exposure data from subsequently recruited participants, with pseudorandom assignment to nature versus urban exposure within each modality. Affective and psychological outcomes were assessed using standardized questionnaires, cortical hemodynamics using portable functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), and salivary cortisol as a stress marker. We found that both actual and virtual nature induced positive psychological effects, but only actual nature significantly reduced negative affect. We observed significant region-dependent differences in cortical hemodynamics, with exploratory analyses suggesting reduced dynamics during actual nature exposure in prefrontal and temporal regions, which however did not survive multiplicity correction. Cortisol showed no differential nature-versus-urban trajectories. Exploratory analyses suggested that the affective benefits of virtual nature correlated with the subjective sense of presence. Effects did not significantly differ by diagnostic status. However, given the modest sample size, these findings should be regarded as exploratory. They provide preliminary evidence that actual nature exerts differential effects on affect and cortical hemodynamic responses, while optimizing presence may enhance the efficacy of virtual nature-based interventions.

relevance.reason: 比较真实与虚拟自然暴露对抑郁患者及健康人情绪与皮层血流动力学的影响，属自然刺激情境下的人脑加工研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较真实与虚拟自然环境暴露对情绪和皮层血流动力学的影响，并考察这些效应在重性抑郁患者与健康对照间是否存在差异。参与者分别接受自然或城市环境的真实暴露或沉浸式虚拟现实暴露，结合问卷、便携式近红外光谱和唾液皮质醇进行测量。结果显示，真实与虚拟自然都能带来积极心理效应，但只有真实自然显著降低负性情绪；皮层血流动力学存在区域依赖差异，探索性分析提示真实自然暴露时前额叶和颞叶活动减弱，但该结果未通过多重比较校正，皮质醇也未表现出自然与城市环境间的差异轨迹。虚拟自然的情绪收益与主观临场感相关，效应未随诊断状态显著变化。作者强调样本量有限，结论应视为探索性，并提示提升临场感可能增强虚拟自然干预的效果。

papers.title: Heterogeneous neuroimaging findings in obsessive-compulsive disorder converge to a common brain network using coordinate network mapping.
papers.authors: Yan H, Han Y, Guo W, Guo W, Cao H.
papers.journal: Neurotherapeutics : the journal of the American Society for Experimental NeuroTherapeutics
papers.abstract: Neuroimaging studies in obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) have yielded heterogeneous findings, limiting efforts to localize OCD to specific brain regions or networks. This study applied coordinate network mapping (CNM) to test whether these distributed abnormalities converge onto a common brain network and to explore the biological substrates of this network through associations with neurotransmitter systems. We systematically reviewed and extracted coordinates of significant clusters from 66 Gy matter volume (GMV) and resting-state activity studies involving 3123 patients with OCD and 3116 healthy controls. Using CNM and functional connectome data from 1000 healthy individuals, we identified brain networks functionally connected to these abnormalities. Spatial correlations were examined between identified networks and 19 types of neurotransmitter maps acquired from over 1000 healthy subjects. The GMV and resting-state activity findings in OCD both converged to a common, functionally connected brain network involving the striatum, thalamus, cingulate, supplementary motor area, insula, and inferior frontal and superior temporal gyri. The identified networks derived from the two neuroimaging modalities were significantly correlated with the N-Methyl-D-Aspartate (NMDA) receptor distribution (r = 0.551 and r = 0.541, respectively; p < 0.001). Findings were robust across different methodological parameters and demonstrated good test-retest reliability. This study identifies a robust and reproducible brain network underlying the heterogeneous neuroimaging abnormalities in OCD, helping to interpret previous inconsistencies. Furthermore, the alignment of this network with the cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical circuitry and NMDA receptor distribution underscores its biological and clinical relevance, thereby illuminating potential targets for future neuromodulation and pharmacological interventions.

relevance.reason: 该研究以强迫症患者为对象，用坐标网络映射揭示其灰质体积与静息活动异常汇聚到共同脑网络，并关联神经递质分布，属于以脑疾病理解脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对强迫症神经影像结果分散、难以定位到特定脑区或网络的问题，采用坐标网络映射方法，整合灰质体积与静息态活动研究的异常坐标，检验这些异质性改变是否汇聚到同一功能网络。结果显示，两类影像发现均收敛于一个涉及纹状体、丘脑、扣带、辅助运动区、岛叶及额下回和颞上回的共同网络，且该网络与NMDA受体分布显著相关，结果在不同方法参数下较稳健并具有较好的重测信度。作者据此认为，这一可重复的网络有助于解释既往不一致，并与皮质-纹状体-丘脑-皮质环路及NMDA受体分布相吻合，为未来神经调控和药物干预提示了潜在靶点；这些关联性发现尚不等同于临床疗效证据。

papers.title: Functional organization of the perirhinal cortex in natural scene processing and memory.
papers.authors: Bai Y, Coutanche MN.
papers.abstract: The perirhinal cortex (PRC) has long been implicated in object perception and recognition memory; however, its role in processing complex natural scenes and its internal functional organization are not well understood. In the current study, we investigated the relationship between object- and scene-related visual feature (faces, bodies, and place) representations in PRC and the visual cortex, and the spatial pattern within PRC for visual processing and memory. Utilizing fMRI data from a continuous recognition task involving natural scenes (from the Natural Scenes Dataset), we first quantified the trial-by-trial decoding accuracy for visual features across distributed visual cortical regions and within the PRC. Our results demonstrate that multivariate pattern feature decodability in the PRC increase significantly when visual features are broadly represented across distributed regions in visual cortex. The PRC exhibited a robust subsequent memory effect, though the memory outcome was not directly predicted by the level of distributed visual feature representation. Critically, left PRC showed a posterior bias for the multivariate decoding of the place feature. Vertex-level univariate analyses uncovered a posterior bias for face-feature-driven vertices and an anterior bias for memory-driven vertices, which is more consistent in the right PRC. Together, these findings suggest that the PRC may play a flexible role in scene processing that extends beyond object representation and highlights an anterior-posterior functional gradient within the human PRC that supports perceptual or mnemonic processes.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究人脑鼻周皮层在自然场景加工与记忆中的功能组织及前后梯度，涉及感知与记忆的神经机制和功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注内嗅皮层（PRC）在复杂自然场景加工与记忆中的功能组织，利用自然场景数据集中的连续识别任务fMRI数据，逐试次解码面孔、身体和场景等视觉特征，并考察PRC内部的空间模式。结果显示，当视觉特征在分布式视觉皮层中被广泛表征时，PRC的多变量特征可解码性显著提高；PRC表现出稳健的后续记忆效应，但记忆成绩并不直接由分布式视觉特征表征水平预测。左侧PRC对场景特征解码呈后部偏向，顶点水平分析还发现面孔特征驱动偏向后方、记忆驱动偏向前方，这一梯度在右侧PRC更一致。作者据此认为，PRC在场景加工中可能具有超出物体表征的灵活作用，并存在支持知觉或记忆过程的前后功能梯度。

papers.title: Sulcal depth is correlated with phonological encoding during language processing in Broca's area.
papers.authors: Salgado-Pineda P, Barbosa L, Olmo-Encabo PD, de la Fuente AF, Aquino-Servín A, Inarejos Clemente EJ, McKenna PJ, Fuentes-Claramonte P, Pomarol-Clotet E.
papers.abstract: Background Language relies on a left-lateralized fronto-temporal network whose functional organization likely reflects structural factors that emerge early in neurodevelopment. One such factor is sulcal depth, which has been proposed as a key anatomical marker of functional specialization. Here, we investigated potential structure-function relationships with respect to phonological encoding, a core linguistic process linking lexical representations and articulatory planning. Methods Thirty-two healthy adults performed a rhyming judgment task, known to be sensitive to phonological coding, during fMRI. Activation during task performance was related to cortical morphology derived from structural MRI in the same subjects, focusing on sulcal depth and other standard measures (i.e. cortical volume, surface area and thickness). Results Rhyming task performance elicited predominantely left-lateralized activation in the inferior frontal cortex and other regions including the precentral, postcentral, supramarginal, and superior temporal cortex, as well as the supplementary motor area, the middle cingulate and calcarine cortex, the left cerebellum and the basal ganglia. A cluster in the left inferior frontal gyrus (pars opercularis, a subregion of Broca's area) showed a significant association between sulcal depth and activation during the rhyming task. No associations were observed for other regions or for other structural measures. Discussion These findings raise the possibility that phonological encoding may have an origin in early-emerging cortical folding patterns and support the view that core language functions are scaffolded by genetically driven neurodevelopmental processes.

relevance.reason: 研究押韵任务中左侧Broca区沟深与语音编码激活的结构-功能关联，直接涉及语言脑机制与皮层形态。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察语音编码这一连接词汇表征与发音规划的核心语言过程是否与皮层形态相关，32名健康成人在fMRI下完成押韵判断任务，并将任务激活与同一批被试的结构MRI皮层指标（重点为沟深）相联系。押韵任务主要引起左侧化激活，涉及额下皮层及多个感觉运动、颞顶和皮层下区域；其中左侧额下回岛盖部（Broca区的一个亚区）的沟深与任务激活显著相关，其他脑区及其他结构指标均未见此类关联。作者据此提出，语音编码可能植根于早期形成的皮层折叠模式，支持核心语言功能由遗传驱动的神经发育过程所支撑的观点；这属于结构-功能关联证据，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Agency as prediction: A cortico-subcortical framework.
papers.authors: Kaltwasser L, Hamker F.
papers.abstract: Agency refers to the experience and attribution of control over one's own actions and their consequences. However, the brain's solution to agency has so far not been discovered. Intentional binding, long considered an implicit measure of agency, does not primarily reflect the binding of a voluntary action and its sensory outcome. Instead, emerging evidence suggests that it arises from multisensory integration of causally related events. Moreover, attempts to localize the neural basis of agency have not yielded consistent results. We propose that the key explaining agency lies in predictive mechanisms of basic motor-outcome and event learning fundamental to brain function and outline a subcortical network centered on the intralaminar thalamic nuclei and their projections to the basal ganglia and associated cortical regions. This framework provides a biologically grounded account of a gated predictive selection mechanism that may constitute low-level processes underlying higher-level attributions of agency.

relevance.reason: 提出以丘脑板内核-基底节-皮层预测机制解释控制感（agency）的神经框架，属社会/认知的脑机制理论。

papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕大脑如何产生和控制感这一未解问题，提出一个以预测机制为核心的皮层-皮层下框架。作者指出，长期被视为控制感内隐指标的意向性绑定，主要反映的是对因果相关事件的多感觉整合，而非自愿动作与其感觉结果的绑定；以往对控制感神经基础的定位研究也未得到一致结果。据此，作者将控制感的关键归于基本的运动-结果预测和事件学习，并勾勒出一个以丘脑板内核为中心、向基底节及相关皮层区域投射的皮层下网络，认为其中存在门控式的预测选择机制，可能构成高层控制感归因背后的低层过程。该框架属于理论性论述，其神经机制尚待实证检验。

papers.title: Frequency-specific gyro-sulcal functional differentiation in preterm neonates: Sulcal dominance and gene expression correlates.
papers.authors: Mao W, Ou X, Huang W, Jin X, Kendrick K, Jiang X.
papers.abstract: Preterm birth affects up to 10.6% of neonates and increases neurodevelopmental risks, yet functional brain alterations remain poorly understood. Using resting-state fMRI data from 437 neonates and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network, this study investigated frequency-specific functional differences between gyri and sulci across three groups: preterm-born neonates scanned at preterm age, preterm-born neonates scanned at term-equivalent age, and term-born neonates scanned at term age. Associations with gene expression were examined. Group differences in the model-derived frequency characteristics were observed predominantly in the frontal lobe across all frequency bands, and in the temporal and parietal lobes at high frequencies. These differences were more pronounced for sulcal than gyral characteristics, and sulcal dominance was more spatially extensive in neonates scanned at term-equivalent age than in preterm neonates scanned before term-equivalent age. Furthermore, model-derived gyro-sulcal frequency characteristics were significantly associated with regional cortical gene-expression patterns. This study bridges frequency-specific brain imaging with cortical gene expression, highlighting the prominent contribution of sulcal-related frequency characteristics to the observed group differences. These findings reveal regional associations between gyro-sulcal frequency characteristics and gene expression and suggest their potential relevance for early risk assessment, which requires further validation.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用静息态fMRI分析早产儿脑沟与脑回的功能分化及其与基因表达的关系，属于人脑功能组织与结构功能耦合研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产对新生儿脑功能的影响，用静息态fMRI结合一维卷积神经网络，比较早产儿在早产矫正年龄、早产儿在足月等效年龄以及足月儿三组的脑回—脑沟功能频率特征，并考察其与皮层基因表达的关系。结果显示，组间差异主要集中在额叶，高频段还涉及颞叶和顶叶；这些差异在脑沟特征上比脑回特征更明显，且足月等效年龄扫描的早产儿中脑沟优势的空间范围更广。模型得到的脑回—脑沟频率特征还与区域皮层基因表达模式显著相关。作者据此强调脑沟相关频率特征对组间差异的主要贡献，并提示其或可用于早期风险评估，但明确需要进一步验证。

papers.title: Language prediction in multimodal contexts: The contribution of iconic gestures to anticipatory sentence comprehension.
papers.authors: Hintz F, Emmendorfer AK, Strauß A, Khoe YH, Moonen L, Holler J.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Evidence shows listeners predict upcoming words, and iconic gestures in face-to-face dialogue often precede their spoken referents. A recent framework proposes that early-onset gestures can pre-activate the meaning of upcoming nouns. This pre-registered EEG study tested this proposal. 81 Dutch adults watched videos of an actress producing discourses ending with a target noun. The noun was either predictable or not from the discourse. Each noun was paired with an iconic gesture whose stroke began either 520 msec (earlier) or 130 msec (later) before the noun. Discourse predictability produced the hypothesized post-target N400 reduction for predictable versus non-predictable items (H1). In the pre-target window, earlier gestures in non-predictable discourses elicited more negative amplitudes than in predictable discourses (H2a), suggesting that earlier gestures modulated neural responses when predictability was low. No comparable interaction was found for the opposite contrast (early-predictable vs late-predictable & late-non-predictable; H2c). In the post-target window, earlier gestures yielded a modest N400-like positivity relative to late gestures (H2e), but the interaction between gesture timing and discourse predictability (H2f) was not supported. A follow-up indicated that, in non-predictable discourses, later gestures produced a larger N400 than earlier gestures. Thus, the data confirm H1 and support H2a (and partially H2e), while H2c and H2f were not supported, suggesting that when speakers produce monologic discourses, earlier iconic gestures can aid anticipatory processing when linguistic predictions are weak, but their effect is limited and context-dependent. Together with the exploratory follow-up, the findings highlight a nuanced role of the influence of gesture timing on comprehension.

relevance.reason: EEG研究考察标志性手势时间对句子预测加工的神经机制，属语言与脑。

papers.summary_zh: 该预注册脑电研究考察象似性手势出现的时间能否帮助听者在多模态语境中预测即将出现的名词，81名荷兰成年被试观看女演员讲述语篇并伴随手势的视频。结果显示，语篇可预测性本身降低了目标词后的N400，支持言语预测；在目标词出现前，当语篇可预测性低时，较早出现的手势比可预测语境下引发更负的波幅，说明手势时机在预测较弱时调节了神经反应。目标词后较早手势仅带来轻微的类N400正波，手势时机与语篇可预测性的交互未获支持，后续分析提示不可预测语篇中较晚手势的N400更大。作者据此认为，较早的象似性手势能在语言预测较弱时辅助预期加工，但作用有限且依赖语境。

papers.title: Default mode network functional connectivity is associated with intention interference in healthy aging.
papers.authors: Liang TJ, Huang SM, Tu MC, Kuo LW, Yang JJ, Hsu YH.
papers.abstract: Prospective memory (PM), the ability to fulfil an intended action, is important in daily life. However, completed intentions can interfere with subsequent behaviors, known as the aftereffect. The neural basis of this phenomenon remains unclear, particularly from a network perspective. Based on cognitive theories, the present study aimed to examine the underlying neural mechanisms, focusing on the default mode network (DMN) and the frontoparietal network (FPN) to resolve previously inconsistent findings. Thirty-six middle-to-older adults completed a memory-for-intention task, with outdated cues assessing aftereffects through commission errors and prolonged reaction time. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data were used to calculate functional connectivity (FC) between regions of interest within the DMN and the FPN. The results showed that FC between the left superior frontal gyrus and right middle temporal pole was associated with the late aftereffect reflected by prolonged reaction time. No significant associations were found within the FPN. The findings highlight the role of intrinsic connectivity in the DMN, suggesting that task disengagement and self-referential processing may contribute to the unintended activation of completed intentions, supporting the spontaneous retrieval account in the dual mechanism theory.

relevance.reason: 研究健康老化中前瞻记忆后效应的静息态DMN/FPN功能连接基础，属认知与静息网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注健康中老年人完成前瞻记忆意图后，旧意图仍干扰后续行为这一“后效应”的神经基础，并比较默认模式网络与额顶网络的作用。36名中老年被试完成记忆意图任务，同时采集静息态功能磁共振数据，计算网络内功能连接。结果显示，默认模式网络内左侧额上回与右侧颞极中部的功能连接与反应时延长所反映的较晚后效应相关，而额顶网络内未见显著关联。作者据此认为，默认模式网络的内在连接可能通过任务脱离和自我参照加工促成已完成意图的非预期激活，为双机制理论中的自发提取观点提供了支持；但这是关联性发现，尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: The mediating effect of neuroticism on the association between brain signal variability in the prefrontal cortex and depression among healthy individuals.
papers.authors: Lu F, Pang Y, Li T, Liu M, Jia C, Gao J, Luo W, Yu Y, Wang L, Tang Q, Cui Q, Gao Q, He Z, Chen H.
papers.abstract: The personality trait of neuroticism has been recognized as a risk factor for depression. Research into the interplay between brain activity, neuroticism, and subclinical depressive symptoms could potentially uncover biomarkers capable of predicting the onset of depression. Brain intrinsic signal variability, a measure of system flexibility, is related to lifespan development, cognitive performance, and mental health disorders. Despite its importance, the link between signal variability and both neuroticism and depression has not been previously explored. This study, therefore, sought to investigate the correlation between brain signal variability, neuroticism, and depressive symptoms in individuals without clinical depression. The resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data were collected from 103 healthy right-handed individuals (63 males, 40 females; mean age 24.73 ± 8.34 years). Neuroticism and subclinical depressive symptoms were assessed by Eysenck Personality Questionnaire and Zung Self-Rating Depression Scale, respectively. To quantify brain signal variability, voxel-wise mean-squared successive difference (MSSD) was calculated. A mediation analysis was subsequently performed to explore the interrelationships among signal variability, neuroticism, and depressive symptoms. Neuroticism showed a significant negative correlation with MSSD in several brain regions, including the medial prefrontal cortex (MPFC), dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC), precentral gyrus, angular gyrus, and middle temporal gyrus. Additionally, MSSD in the MPFC and dlPFC were negatively associated with depressive symptoms, with neuroticism mediating this relationship. In sum, neuroticism and depressive symptoms were associated with reduced signal variability in the PFC regions. These effects suggested that dysfunctional activity within the PFC regions is linked to the etiology of depression, mediated by individual differences in neuroticism.

relevance.reason: 研究健康人静息态前额叶信号变异性与神经质及亚临床抑郁症状的关系，涉及情绪相关脑活动机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察健康个体静息态脑信号变异性、神经质与亚临床抑郁症状之间的关系，并检验神经质是否在其中起中介作用。研究者采集健康右利手参与者的静息态功能磁共振数据，以MSSD量化信号变异性，并结合神经质和抑郁症状量表得分进行中介分析。结果发现，神经质与内侧前额叶、背外侧前额叶等多个脑区的信号变异性呈负相关，且内侧和背外侧前额叶的变异性与抑郁症状负相关，神经质中介了这一关联。作者据此提出，前额叶区域信号变异性降低可能与神经质个体差异及抑郁易感性有关，但该研究为健康人群中的相关性分析，尚不能说明因果关系或临床应用价值。

papers.title: Improving DASH adherence after midlife promotes better late-life cognition and brain health: the SG70 Study
papers.authors: NG EKK, Lai JS, Ji F, Goh YLB, Chia PSQ, Loh WL, Tham JSY, Fong S, Koh W, Zhou JH.
papers.abstract: Healthier dietary patterns reduce cognitive impairment risks, but whether diet improvement after mid-life can benefit cognition and brain health, and how brain measures mediate diet-cognition associations, remain unclear, as few studies had long-term diet records alongside detailed neuroimaging and cognitive measures. We assessed adherence to the Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) in 892 SG70 participants, nested within the Singapore Chinese Health Study, between 1993-2025. Adherence during midlife (44-55 years) and early elderhood (61-73 years) were related to seven cognitive domains, brain morphometry, white matter hyperintensities (WMH), and free-water markers measured in late life (68-82 years). Higher adherence at both mid-life stages was associated with better verbal memory. Higher mid-life adherence was associated with greater white matter volume in association tracts, whereas higher early-elderhood adherence was associated with lower free water (frontal and occipital) and lower WMH (basal ganglia and anterior periventricular). Moreover, white matter volume and free water mediated the diet-verbal memory associations at their respective midlife stages. Importantly, participants with improved mid-to-late life diet trajectories showed better late-life verbal memory and brain health than those with persistently low adherence. Overall, ensuring mid-life diet quality and improving post-midlife diet may promote cognitive resilience through structural reserve and neurovascular health.

relevance.reason: 研究中年饮食依从性与晚年认知及白质结构/自由水的关系，并检验脑结构中介，属认知与脑结构机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于新加坡华人健康研究中的SG70队列，考察中年及老年早期坚持DASH饮食是否与晚年认知和脑健康相关，以及脑结构指标是否在其中起中介作用。结果显示，两个中年阶段依从性较高均与更好的言语记忆相关；中年期依从性与联合纤维束白质体积较大相关，老年早期依从性则与额叶和枕叶自由水较低、基底节及前部脑室周围白质高信号较少相关，且白质体积和自由水分别中介相应阶段的饮食与言语记忆关联。中年至晚年饮食改善者的晚年言语记忆和脑健康优于持续低依从者，提示中年饮食质量及此后改善可能通过结构储备和神经血管健康促进认知韧性。

papers.title: Spiral brain dynamics track the temporal unfolding of subjective intensity during the N,N -dimethyltryptamine experience
papers.authors: Sawicka G, Martínez-Marín M, Timmermann C, Carhart-Harris R, Kringelbach M, Sanz-Perl Y, Vohryzek J, Deco G.
papers.abstract: Psychedelic compounds such as N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT) induce rapid and profound changes in conscious experience, requiring neuroimaging measures that capture how brain dynamics evolve across space and time. Emerging evidence suggests that rotational (vortex-like) dynamics may contribute to the coordination of large-scale neural activity. Here, we introduce two vorticity-based metrics; spiral vorticity (SV) and spatial spiral vorticity dispersion (SSVD), to quantify the rotational organization and spatial heterogeneity of large-scale cortical phase dynamics. Using fMRI data acquired under placebo and DMT in a within-subject design, we assessed these measures globally, across resting-state networks, and regionally to examine their relationship to subjective intensity. DMT increased SV and SSVD and reduced temporal irreversibility, indicating stronger rotational organization, greater spatial heterogeneity, and altered directional structure of cortical dynamics. Effects were non-uniform across functional systems, with the largest changes in default mode, visual, frontoparietal, and dorsal attention networks. Both vorticity measures tracked the temporal evolution of subjective intensity globally, while network-level analyses revealed spatially heterogeneous brain–experience coupling. Spatiotemporally resolved analyses further showed that the strongest reorganization of spiral dynamics emerged during offset and recovery rather than at peak subjective intensity. These findings identify spiral dynamics as a time-resolved neural signature of the DMT experience. By quantifying the rotational structure and spatial heterogeneity of cortical phase flow, vorticity-based measures provide a framework for linking large-scale brain dynamics to evolving subjective experience.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注DMT体验中主观强度随时间展开的神经动力学基础，提出基于涡度的指标来量化皮层相位动力学的旋转组织与空间异质性，并利用同一批被试在安慰剂和DMT条件下的fMRI数据，在全局、网络和区域层面考察这些指标与主观强度的关系。结果显示，DMT增强了旋转组织和空间异质性，并改变了动力学的方向结构，且效应在不同功能系统间并不均匀。两种涡度指标在全局层面能追踪主观强度的时间演变，而网络层面的脑—体验耦合呈现空间异质性；时空分辨分析还表明，螺旋动力学最明显的重组出现在体验消退与恢复阶段，而非主观强度峰值时。作者据此认为，螺旋动力学可作为DMT体验的时间分辨神经标志，涡度指标为连接大规模脑动力学与动态主观体验提供了框架。

papers.title: Enhanced cortical tracking of unfamiliar languages in both monolinguals and bilinguals
papers.authors: Zheng Q, Ahmed F, Chopra A, Lau BK.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Humans routinely encounter speech in languages they have never heard, yet how the brain responds to such input and whether bilingual experience shapes this response remains unknown. Here, we used electroencephalography (EEG) and temporal response function (TRF) modeling to examine cortical tracking of the speech envelope in 24 English-monolingual and 24 English-Mandarin bilingual adults. Participants listened to naturally produced continuous speech in three languages: English (familiar to all), Mandarin (familiar to bilinguals only), and Vietnamese (unfamiliar to all). We report two main findings. First, both monolinguals and bilinguals showed enhanced cortical tracking for unfamiliar relative to familiar languages, evidenced by higher EEG prediction accuracy (PA). Monolinguals showed enhanced tracking for both Mandarin and Vietnamese, whereas bilinguals showed enhancement only for Vietnamese, consistent with Mandarin being a familiar language for this group. This finding suggests that enhanced cortical encoding of unfamiliar speech is a general property of the listening brain, not a signature of listening to a non-native language or reduced language proficiency. Second, bilinguals strikingly showed stronger cortical tracking than monolinguals overall, in both PA and TRF peak weights, with the TRF peak weight advantage present across all three languages, suggesting a difference in how bilingual experience shapes the neural encoding of speech. These findings have implications for understanding how the brain navigates the linguistic diversity of everyday life in an increasingly global, multilingual world. SIGNIFICANT STATEMENT More than half the world speaks more than one language, and most people regularly hear speech they cannot understand. How the brain responds to such speech, and whether bilingualism matters, is unclear. We recorded brain activity from monolingual and bilingual adults listening to familiar and unfamiliar speech. Both groups showed enhanced tracking of unfamiliar speech compared to familiar speech and bilinguals showed stronger tracking than monolinguals overall, suggesting a potential difference in how bilingual brains process speech. These findings advance our understanding of how the brain navigates speech in a multilingual world.

relevance.reason: 用EEG/TRF比较单语与双语者对熟悉/不熟悉语言连续语音包络的皮层追踪，直接报告语言经验对言语听觉编码的影响。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电和时域响应函数建模，考察单语与双语成人聆听熟悉和不熟悉语言连续语音时皮层对语音包络的追踪。结果发现，单语者和双语者对不熟悉语言的追踪均强于熟悉语言，说明这种增强并非仅由非母语或语言熟练度降低所致；同时，双语者在整体追踪强度上高于单语者，且这一优势跨三种语言存在，提示双语经验可能改变语音的神经编码方式。

papers.title: Musical Instrument Practice as Sensorimotor and Motor-Cognitive Skill Training in Healthy Aging.
papers.authors: Greco G, Desantis D, Cataldi S, Fischetti F.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Playing a musical instrument requires precisely timed movements, bimanual or interlimb coordination, visuomotor mapping, auditory and somatosensory feedback, sequence learning, prediction, and executive regulation. This narrative review synthesizes motor, cognitive, and neuroplastic adaptations associated with active instrumental practice in predominantly healthy adults aged 60 years or older, interpreting practice as a complex sensorimotor and motor-cognitive skill activity. Methods: English-language literature from January 2016 through August 2026 was searched in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science Core Collection, supplemented by Google Scholar and citation chasing. Randomized and controlled interventions were prioritized, with longitudinal and observational evidence used contextually; earlier studies were included selectively for seminal or mechanistic context. Results: Direct motor evidence was less abundant than cognitive evidence. Both piano and mallet-percussion programs improved task-proximal bimanual synchronization, and one large active-control trial found greater improvement in untrained unimanual fine-motor control after one year of piano practice. Selective near transfer to continuation timing was also reported, whereas evidence for generalized dexterity, gait, balance, lower-limb coordination, and everyday motor function remained limited or mixed. Cognitive effects were selective, particularly for processing speed, verbal fluency or switching, and some working-memory measures. Neuroplastic findings included cortical-thickness increase, relative structural preservation, altered auditory-motor connectivity, reduced task activation, and oscillatory modulation. Conclusions: Instrumental practice may provide an engaging and adaptable form of sensorimotor and motor-cognitive skill practice in healthy aging, but broad transfer and neuroprotection are not established. Future trials should quantify skill acquisition, dose, retention, and transfer and compare instrument-specific demands.

relevance.reason: 综述老年人乐器练习的感觉运动/运动认知技能训练及皮层厚度、听觉-运动连接等脑可塑性证据。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了60岁以上健康老年人主动练习乐器与运动、认知及神经可塑性变化之间的关系，将乐器练习视为一种复杂的感知运动与运动认知技能活动，检索并优先纳入随机对照干预研究。结果显示，运动方面的直接证据少于认知方面：钢琴和打击乐训练可改善与任务接近的双 manual 同步，一年钢琴练习在未训练的单手精细运动控制上优于主动对照，但向一般灵巧性、步态、平衡和日常运动功能的迁移证据有限或混杂；认知效应也具选择性，主要涉及加工速度、言语流畅性或切换及部分工作记忆指标。神经可塑性方面报告了皮层厚度增加、结构相对保留、听觉-运动连接改变及任务激活降低等。作者强调，乐器练习可能为健康老龄化提供有吸引力的技能训练形式，但广泛迁移和神经保护作用尚未确立。

papers.title: Enhancing structural to functional brain network prediction using topological graph learning.
papers.authors: Rajakaruna SNK, Dey AK, Chatterjee S.
papers.abstract: Introduction Understanding the relationship between structural and functional brain connectivity remains a fundamental challenge in network neuroscience. While structural connectivity constrains neural interactions, functional connectivity emerges from complex, nonlinear dynamics that are not fully explained by anatomical wiring alone. Existing graph-based and deep learning approaches often focus on pairwise relationships, thereby overlooking higher-order topological organization in brain networks. Methods We propose TopoGCN, a topology-informed graph convolutional network that integrates topological data analysis (TDA) into structure-function prediction. Persistent homology is used to extract multiscale topological features from structural connectomes, which are incorporated as node-level inputs. Additionally, a topology-aware loss function is incorporated to enforce preservation of higher-order structures in predicted functional networks. The model is evaluated on Human Connectome Project data (n = 998) using both edge-wise metrics and topological measures, including motif distributions, Betti curves, and Wasserstein distances between persistence diagrams. Results TopoGCN achieves competitive accuracy in reconstructing functional connectivity while significantly improving the preservation of higher-order network organization. Compared to state-of-the-art models, it yields lower KL divergence for node strength and motif distributions, and smaller Wasserstein distances between persistence diagrams, indicating better recovery of multiscale topological structures. Furthermore, hypothesis tests on Betti curves show no significant differences between observed and predicted networks, demonstrating strong agreement in both connected-component and cycle-based topology. Discussion Our findings show that incorporating persistent-homology information into graph learning improves the modeling of structure-function relationships in the human brain. By preserving multiscale topological features beyond pairwise connections, TopoGCN provides an improved framework for topology-aware connectome prediction and offers new opportunities for studying brain organization and individual variability.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑结构连接预测功能连接，纳入白质结构连接与功能网络耦合，属结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何从结构连接预测功能连接，指出现有图学习和深度学习方法多聚焦成对关系，忽略脑网络的高阶拓扑组织。作者提出TopoGCN，将拓扑数据分析中的持续同调提取的多尺度拓扑特征作为节点输入，并引入拓扑感知损失函数，在人类连接组计划数据上以边级指标和多种拓扑指标评估。结果显示，该模型在重建功能连接上具有竞争力，同时明显更好地保留高阶网络组织，在节点强度和模体分布上的KL散度更低，持续同调图之间的Wasserstein距离更小，Betti曲线检验也未显示观测网络与预测网络存在显著差异。作者据此认为，将持续同调信息纳入图学习可改进结构—功能关系的建模，为拓扑感知的连接组预测提供框架。

papers.title: Subregion-specific temporal lobe EEG signatures in amnestic mild cognitive impairment: Evidence from high-density EEG.
papers.authors: Wen S, Liu J, Wang J, Mao L, Zhang Q, Wang X, Ding J.
papers.abstract: BackgroundAmnestic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI), a prodromal stage associated with an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease (AD), is characterized by early neural network dysfunction. The temporal lobe is among the earliest affected regions, yet conventional electroencephalography (EEG) provides limited information regarding subregional electrophysiological alterations.ObjectiveTo characterize temporal-subregional electrophysiological features in aMCI using high-density EEG (HD-EEG).MethodsFifty-five individuals with aMCI and 35 cognitively normal controls underwent neuropsychological assessment and resting-state 128-channel HD-EEG recording. Spectral power was quantified across the whole temporal lobe and its anterior, middle, and posterior subregions. Group differences were assessed using Welch's t-tests and Mann-Whitney U tests. Associations between EEG measures and cognitive performance were examined using Spearman correlation analyses. Exploratory receiver operating characteristic (ROC) and multivariable classification analyses were performed to evaluate discriminatory performance.ResultsCompared with controls, individuals with aMCI showed significantly poorer cognitive performance. HD-EEG analyses revealed increased gamma-band activity across bilateral temporal subregions, whereas elevated delta power and theta/beta ratios were primarily localized to right temporal subregions. Right temporal delta activity was negatively associated with memory performance. Connectivity analyses demonstrated enhanced fast-frequency coupling involving temporal regions, with particularly evident alterations in the left posterior temporal subregion. Classification analyses showed that gamma-band measures derived from left temporal subregions achieved discriminatory performance comparable to conventional whole-temporal measures.ConclusionsHD-EEG identified subregion-specific temporal-lobe electrophysiological alterations in aMCI. Temporal-subregional EEG profiling may provide additional electrophysiological information beyond conventional whole-lobe analyses and improve the characterization of aMCI-related neural alterations.

relevance.reason: 以高密度静息态EEG刻画aMCI患者颞叶亚区电生理改变及其与记忆的关联，属脑疾病认知机制与静息活动研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注遗忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）患者颞叶各亚区的电生理特征，采用高密度静息态脑电结合神经心理评估，比较aMCI组与认知正常对照组的频谱功率及连接差异。结果显示，aMCI患者双侧颞叶各亚区γ活动普遍升高，而δ功率和θ/β比值的升高主要局限于右侧颞叶亚区，且右侧颞叶δ活动与记忆表现呈负相关；颞叶相关快速频率耦合增强，以左后颞亚区尤为明显。基于左颞亚区γ指标的分类表现与常规全颞叶指标相当。作者据此认为，颞叶亚区水平的脑电刻画可提供超出全颞叶分析的电生理信息，有助于更细致地描述aMCI相关神经改变；这些发现属组间关联与探索性分类结果，尚不能直接推及临床诊断或治疗。

papers.title: Synergistic effects of cerebrovascular reactivity and gray matter volume on executive function in aging.
papers.authors: Zhang J, Jia X, Zhang Y, Wang Q, Liu P, Jia X, Yang Q.
papers.abstract: BackgroundAge-related impairments in cerebrovascular reactivity (CVR) and gray matter volume (GMV) both contribute to cognitive decline, yet their regional interplay and joint impact on cognition remain unclear.ObjectiveTo investigate how CVR and GMV are coupled and interact regionally to influence cognition in normal aging.MethodsWe examined 181 healthy younger adults (18-34 years) and 120 older adults (60-89 years). CVR and GMV (% intracranial volume) in major brain lobes were quantified using resting-state multi-echo functional MRI and structural MRI, respectively. Age-related alterations were defined by standardizing older adults' values relative to the younger group. Spearman correlations, linear regression models, and interaction analyses were performed.ResultsCVR and GMV were not significantly correlated across frontal, temporal, parietal, or occipital lobes (ρ: -0.15 to -0.06; all p > 0.05). However, significant CVR × GMV interaction effects on executive function were found in parietal and occipital lobes (p -interaction=0.015 and 0.026). In the occipital lobe, compared with the "low CVR decline + low GMV loss" group, "high CVR decline + low GMV loss" (β=-0.47, p = 0.004) and "high CVR decline + high GMV loss" (β=-0.60, p < 0.001), but not "low CVR decline + high GMV loss" (β=-0.23, p = 0.127), were significantly associated with poorer executive function.ConclusionsCVR and GMV interacted to support executive function in parietal and occipital lobes. Occipital CVR decline linked to poorer executive performance irrespective of GMV status. These findings highlight the importance of multi-modal, cross-scale assessments and suggest CVR as a sensitive marker of executive decline beyond structural measures alone.

relevance.reason: 研究正常老化中脑血管反应性与灰质体积的交互对执行功能的影响，涉及脑结构与功能耦合及认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察正常衰老过程中脑血管反应性与灰质体积在脑区层面如何耦合并共同影响认知，比较了健康年轻人和老年人，用静息态多回波功能磁共振与结构磁共振分别量化各脑叶的脑血管反应性和灰质体积。结果显示，两者在额、颞、顶、枕叶均无显著相关，但在顶叶和枕叶存在对执行功能的显著交互作用；在枕叶，脑血管反应性下降明显者执行功能较差，且这一关联不随灰质体积丢失程度而改变。作者据此认为，脑血管反应性可作为超出结构指标的执行功能衰退敏感标记，并强调多模态、跨尺度评估的意义。

papers.title: Sub-second and multi-second dopamine dynamics underlie variability in human time perception.
papers.authors: Sadibolova R, DiMarco EK, Jiang A, Maas B, Tatter SB, Laxton AW, Kishida KT, Terhune DB.
papers.abstract: Aberrant interval timing in the millisecond-to-second range is a consistent feature of neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders involving striatal dysfunction, yet its neurochemical substrates in the human brain remain poorly characterised. Striatal dopamine has long been implicated in temporal processing, but evidence from animal models and human pharmacological studies has proved difficult to reconcile, in part because endogenous dopamine dynamics in humans have been inaccessible at relevant timescales. Patients with Parkinson's disease (N=5, 62-73 years; two women) completed a temporal bisection task (300 trials), judging whether visual stimulus intervals (500-1100 ms) were closer to a learned short (500 ms) or long (1100 ms) reference. Dopamine and serotonin concentrations were measured in the caudate nucleus during awake deep brain stimulation surgery using fast-scan cyclic voltammetry. Elastic net machine-learning models trained on in vitro voltammetry data were applied to human recordings to derive dopamine and serotonin time series at 10 Hz. We used cluster-based permutation analysis to identify stimulus-aligned time windows in which dopamine or serotonin differed between short and long judgements, and entered mean concentrations from these windows as predictors of temporal performance in trial-level hierarchical mixed-effects models. Slower, steady-state dopaminergic and serotonergic tone, quantified as the mean concentration within successive multi-minute periods, was also assessed as a predictor of temporal behaviour. Finally, behavioural performance was compared with a healthy control cohort (N=17, 50-66 years; seven women). Elevated phasic dopamine (625-670 ms after stimulus onset) increased the likelihood of short judgements and was associated with reduced temporal overestimation bias. This association was independent of objective clock time, with the identical analysis yielding non-significant results for the short versus the long stimulus intervals. By contrast, tonic dopamine levels covaried with sensitivity in discriminating stimulus intervals (temporal precision). Lower tonic dopamine was associated with poorer temporal precision both within patients over the experimental session and in patients relative to healthy controls. No corresponding effects were observed for serotonin, indicating dopamine specificity across phasic and tonic timescales. By resolving endogenous striatal dopamine with sub-second precision during conscious human behaviour, this study links temporally distinct dopaminergic dynamics to dissociable aspects of timing behaviour in Parkinson's disease. This challenges accounts of dopamine as a single modulatory influence and situates these findings within the literature on dissociable effects of phasic and tonic dopaminergic signalling, reconciling discrepancies between human and animal evidence and advancing understanding of the neurochemical basis of human time perception.

relevance.reason: 在人类帕金森病患者清醒手术中记录纹状体多巴胺/血清素动态，并将其与时间知觉行为（时距判断）关联，属于感知/时间加工神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨人类纹状体多巴胺动态是否以及如何对应时间知觉的不同方面，在帕金森病患者清醒深部脑刺激手术中记录尾状核多巴胺和血清素浓度，并结合时间二分任务与机器学习建模分析。结果显示，刺激后数百毫秒内的相位性多巴胺升高使被试更倾向作出“短”判断，并减弱时间高估偏差，且该关联不依赖客观时钟时间；而多分钟尺度的紧张性多巴胺水平则与区分刺激间隔的精度相关，紧张性多巴胺较低者时间精度较差。血清素未见对应效应，提示上述关系具有多巴胺特异性。作者据此提出，相位性与紧张性多巴胺分别对应时间知觉中可分离的成分，而非单一调节作用。

papers.title: Longitudinal adaptations in neural and behavioral systems following hearing restoration using cochlear implants.
papers.authors: Mo S, Alain C, Dimitrijevic A.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Cochlear implants (CIs) restore hearing in people with severe-to-profound hearing loss, but how behavioral and neural adaptations unfold after implantation remains unclear, particularly during continuous speech processing. Most longitudinal studies of postimplant plasticity have used simple auditory stimuli, limiting insight into continuous-speech processing in complex environments. We followed 19 newly implanted adult CI users at activation and at 3, 6, and 12 mo after activation. At each session, participants completed speech recognition testing in quiet and noise, a spatial triple-digit test, hearing-related quality-of-life measures, and electroencephalography during an ecologically valid continuous-speech selective-attention task with competing distractors. Neural analyses focused on temporal response functions to task-relevant and task-irrelevant speech envelopes and changes in scalp field topography. Speech recognition improved over time, and spatial-separation benefits emerged by 6 mo. Neural tracking of task-relevant speech was stronger and emerged earlier than tracking of task-irrelevant speech, and scalp topographies changed significantly across sessions. Stronger task-relevant neural tracking was associated with better speech recognition, better spatial listening, and higher quality of life. The largest behavioral and neural gains occurred early after activation and plateaued by approximately 6 mo. These findings provide a functionally relevant account of postimplant adaptation and establish longitudinal continuous-speech neural tracking as a useful framework for studying rehabilitation after sensory restoration.

relevance.reason: 纵向追踪人工耳蜗植入者连续言语选择性注意的EEG神经跟踪与行为适应，直接涉及听觉语言加工及注意机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究追踪新植入人工耳蜗的成人用户，在开机时及随后数月用连续语音选择性注意任务结合脑电，考察行为与神经适应如何随时间展开。结果显示，言语识别随使用时间改善，空间分离带来的聆听获益在约6个月时出现；对任务相关语音的神经追踪强于且早于对干扰语音的追踪，头皮地形也随 sessions 变化。任务相关神经追踪越强，言语识别、空间聆听和生活质量越好，且行为与神经获益多在开机后早期最大、约6个月后趋于平台。作者据此认为，连续语音神经追踪可作为研究感觉恢复后康复过程的框架。

papers.title: Identifying a structural brain network for social anxiety: connectome-based predictive modeling and network analyses in a transdiagnostic sample.
papers.authors: Meinert H, Gruber M, Brügge EDE, Brüwer L, Sindermann L, Winter A, Slump TM, Breuer F, Schrammen E, Meinert S, Goltermann J, Grotegerd D, Repple J, Redlich R, Bonnekoh LM, Bauer J, Dannlowski U, Böhnlein J, Leehr EJ.
papers.abstract: Trait social anxiety (SA) is continuous and can manifest across the entire spectrum of mental health, from subclinical levels in healthy controls to burdensome manifestations in major depressive disorder and finally full-blown disorders like social anxiety disorder (SAD). Although it has been proposed that SA is associated with deviations in the structural connectome, there is little research on the SA spectrum and its relation to abnormalities in brain structural networks. In this study, we aim to identify a structural brain network for SA across diagnostic groups using a transdiagnostic sample and connectome-based predictive modeling (CPM) to provide insight on neurostructural underpinnings of the SA spectrum. We collected magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical data of N = 160 participants across an SA spectrum. Diffusion-weighted and T1-weighted structural images were used to reconstruct each participant's structural connectome. We applied CPM to identify a structural brain network that predicts SA across diagnostic groups. We further analyzed the structural connectome to investigate hubs and differences in global graph metrics between participants with and without SAD (noSAD n = 96, SAD n = 64). CPM revealed a brain network with 46 edges predicting SA across the SA spectrum with mean r = 0.141 (CI = [0.12, 0.2], p = 0.003). Hubs were located in the left pericalcarine, inferior-parietal, superior-parietal, right lateral-occipital cortex and pars orbitalis. This study provides first evidence for a shared neurobiological foundation of SA across diagnostic groups and points towards a transdiagnostic relevance of SA and the related brain network.

relevance.reason: 用扩散与结构MRI构建结构连接组，识别预测社交焦虑谱系的结构脑网络，涉及情绪/社会认知的脑结构基础及跨诊断精神疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注特质社交焦虑是否具有跨诊断共享的结构脑网络基础，采用跨诊断样本，结合弥散加权与T1加权影像重建结构连接组，并用基于连接组的预测建模（CPM）识别可预测社交焦虑的网络。结果显示，一个包含46条边的结构网络能够跨诊断组预测社交焦虑，预测相关虽显著但强度较弱，提示该网络与社交焦虑谱系存在关联而非因果或临床效用证据。网络枢纽主要位于左侧距状沟周围、顶下、顶上皮层及右侧外侧枕叶和眶部。作者据此提出，社交焦虑在不同诊断群体间可能共享神经结构基础，并强调其跨诊断相关性。

papers.title: Decoupling of local activity and interhemispheric connectivity in late mild cognitive impairment: A resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging study.
papers.authors: Jin Z, Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative.
papers.abstract: Objective Mild cognitive impairment (MCI), a high-risk precursor to Alzheimer's disease, progresses through early (EMCI) and late (LMCI) stages. While distinct functional brain alterations between EMCI and LMCI have been reported, differences in regional brain activity and interhemispheric functional connectivity during resting-state remain incompletely characterized. The aim of the study was to systematically assess the differences in resting-state brain functional alterations between the LMCI patients and EMCI patients. Method We assessed resting-state functional alterations in EMCI and LMCI using fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) and voxel-mirrored homotopic connectivity (VMHC). Data from 35 EMCI patients, 28 LMCI patients, and 37 individuals with normal cognition were analyzed from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative-Phase 2. Results Compared to EMCI patients, LMCI patients exhibited increased fALFF in the left inferior temporal gyrus and left precentral gyrus, alongside decreased VMHC in the anterior cerebellar lobe and posterior cingulate cortex. Among MCI patients, Montreal Cognitive Assessment scores showed a significant negative correlation with fALFF in the left inferior temporal gyrus/left precentral gyrus but a significant positive correlation with VMHC in the anterior cerebellar lobe/posterior cingulate cortex. Conclusions These findings suggest that elevated regional activity (fALFF) may represent a compensatory mechanism, while reduced interhemispheric connectivity (VMHC) reflects a neuropathological basis underlying progression from EMCI to LMCI.
