relevance.reason: 以静息态fMRI比较晚发MCI与早期MCI的局部活动与半球间连接改变，属脑疾病中认知衰退的脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注轻度认知障碍早期与晚期阶段在静息状态下局部脑活动与半球间功能连接的差异，基于静息态功能磁共振数据比较了早期患者、晚期患者与认知正常者的fALFF和VMHC。结果发现，相比早期患者，晚期患者左侧颞下回和左侧中央前回的局部活动增强，而小脑前叶和后扣带皮层的半球间连接减弱；在轻度认知障碍患者中，认知评分与前者呈负相关、与后者呈正相关。作者据此提出，局部活动升高可能反映补偿机制，而半球间连接下降则可能构成从早期向晚期进展的神经病理基础，但相关分析本身不足以确立因果。

papers.title: Resting-State Functional Connectivity After Acquired Brain Injury: Patterns of Network Disruption, Reorganisation, and Recovery - A Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Gannison L, Firdaus MH, Nayaranan V.
papers.abstract: Background Resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) provides a non-invasive method for assessing intrinsic connectivity changes associated with neurological recovery. This systematic review evaluated patterns of functional connectivity change after acquired brain injury (ABI), with a focus on network disruption, reorganisation, and recovery-related change. Methods A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 recommendations using a Population-Intervention-Outcome framework. PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar were searched for studies published between January 2010 and March 2026 examining rs-fMRI connectivity following ABI. Screening was performed independently by two reviewers, and eligible studies were appraised using Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools. Narrative synthesis was undertaken to evaluate connectivity disruption, compensatory reorganisation, and recovery-related network changes. Results Twenty studies were included, predominantly involving stroke and traumatic brain injury populations. rs-fMRI identified alterations in functional connectivity, spontaneous activity, hub organisation, and network efficiency associated with motor, cognitive, behavioural, language, and consciousness outcomes. Only one included study directly evaluated functional connectivity following cranioplasty, providing limited evidence of recovery-related changes in default mode and whole-brain network organisation. Conclusion Resting-state fMRI demonstrates heterogeneous patterns of network disruption, reorganisation, and recovery-related connectivity change following ABI. These findings support the use of rs-fMRI as a research tool for characterising network-level recovery, while further prospective longitudinal studies using standardised imaging and outcome measures are needed to establish its clinical utility.

relevance.reason: 系统综述静息态功能连接在获得性脑损伤后的网络破坏、重组与恢复，涉及脑网络组织与损伤后可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA 2020框架系统检索并叙述性整合了获得性脑损伤后静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）连接研究，纳入的研究以卒中和创伤性脑损伤人群为主。结果显示，rs-fMRI可捕捉到功能连接、自发活动、枢纽组织和网络效率的改变，这些改变与运动、认知、行为、语言及意识结局相关，但网络破坏、重组与恢复相关变化呈现异质性。仅有一项研究直接评估颅骨修补术后的功能连接，恢复相关证据有限。作者认为rs-fMRI可作为刻画网络层面恢复的研究工具，其临床效用仍需标准化影像与结局指标的前瞻性纵向研究确立。

papers.title: Resting-state functional connectivity in adolescents with binge eating disorder: An exploratory null study.
papers.authors: Arslan B, Ercan O, Arslan S, Tarakçıoğlu MC, Koyuncu Z, Öz A, Sarıahmetoğlu ÖF, Güneş Kaya D, Kırlangıç B, Seçen Yazıcı M, Serdengeçti N, Gemici E, Kadak MT.
papers.abstract: Objective Binge eating disorder (BED) commonly emerges during adolescence, yet little is known about intrinsic brain network function in this developmental period. This study examined resting-state functional connectivity (FC) in adolescents with BED. Method 19 adolescents with BED and 20 sex-, age-, and BMI Z-score-matched controls (12-18 years) underwent resting-state fMRI. FC was examined using an exploratory ROI-to-ROI analysis, and eating disorder symptoms were assessed using the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). Results No between-group differences in ROI-to-ROI functional connectivity survived false discovery rate correction for multiple comparisons. Discussion No robust alterations in resting-state FC were identified in adolescents with BED compared with healthy controls. However, given the modest sample size and limited temporal sampling, subtle connectivity differences cannot be excluded.

relevance.reason: 研究青少年暴食障碍患者静息态功能连接，属脑疾病与静息态脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究考察青少年暴食障碍患者静息态功能连接是否存在改变，比较了暴食障碍青少年与在性别、年龄和BMI Z分数上匹配的对照组，并采集静息态fMRI及进食障碍症状问卷。经多重比较校正后，未发现两组在感兴趣区之间的功能连接上存在差异。作者据此认为，未识别出稳健的静息态功能连接改变，但受样本量较小和时间采样有限的制约，不能排除细微连接差异的可能。

papers.title: Superposition of distinct psychotic and affective axes explains affective psychosis: evidence from cross-diagnostic connectomics.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Wang F, Zhong M, Zhang M, Yang J, Liu Z, Yang J, Palaniyappan L.
papers.abstract: Background Whether affective and non-affective psychoses reflect a severity continuum or distinct neurobiological mechanisms remains unresolved. We compared whole-brain and subnetwork efficiency across this spectrum. Methods Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data were analyzed from 78 patients with affective psychosis, 197 with non-affective psychosis, 164 with non-psychotic primary affective disorders, and 165 healthy controls. Graph analysis quantified whole-brain and subnetwork global and local efficiency. We tested symptom and cognitive associations and performed sensitivity analyses stratifying schizophrenia by depressive-symptom status and affective psychosis by diagnosis. Results Non-affective psychosis showed lower whole-brain efficiency than controls and both affective groups, and lower sensory/somatomotor efficiency than controls. Conversely, whole-brain efficiency was preserved in both affective groups; affective psychosis showed higher cingulo-opercular, dorsal attention, and salience network efficiency, whereas the non-psychotic affective group showed higher dorsal attention and salience network efficiency. Sensitivity analyses identified shared increases in dorsal attention global efficiency and salience network local efficiency across psychotic major depression and psychotic bipolar disorder, and reduced sensory/somatomotor efficiency in schizophrenia regardless of depressive-symptom status. After false discovery rate correction, higher default mode network efficiency was associated with Positive Symptoms, while higher whole-brain, cingulo-opercular, salience, and sensory/somatomotor efficiency was associated with Activation symptoms; no cognitive associations survived correction. Conclusion These opposing, subgroup-robust patterns favor a dichotomous-mechanism framework comprising an affective axis of increased control-network efficiency and a psychosis axis of whole-brain and sensorimotor inefficiency. Affective psychosis predominantly expresses the affective axis with a partial shift toward the psychosis axis profile.

relevance.reason: 用静息态功能连接组比较情感性与非情感性精神病谱系的脑网络效率，属脑疾病机理与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究想厘清情感性精神病与非情感性精神病究竟属于同一严重度连续谱，还是对应不同的神经机制，为此比较了不同诊断组静息态脑功能网络的整体与子网络效率。结果显示，非情感性精神病患者整体网络效率低于健康对照和两个情感障碍组，感觉运动网络效率也偏低；两个情感障碍组的整体效率则保持正常，并表现出控制相关网络效率升高，情感性精神病还兼有向精神病性特征偏移的迹象。作者据此提出情感轴与精神病性轴并存的二分机制框架，并提示情感性精神病主要表达情感轴特征。相关分析属关联性结果，不能据此推断因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Sleep and participation in extracurricular activities moderate associations between low SES and brain structure and functional connectivity.
papers.authors: Tinch J, Thomson P, Rakesh D.
papers.abstract: Household and neighborhood socioeconomic status (SES) have consistently been associated with both brain structure and functional connectivity in adolescence. However, there is considerable heterogeneity in brain outcomes among youth from disadvantaged backgrounds, which suggests that other factors-including aspects of one's lifestyle-likely play a role by moderating these associations. In a large sample of ~10,000 early adolescents from the baseline assessment of the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study (aged 9-10 years), we tested whether sleep and participation in physical and non-physical extracurricular activities moderate associations of household and neighborhood disadvantage with brain structure and functional connectivity. Higher sleep duration was linked to weaker associations between both household and neighborhood disadvantage and a range of structural and functional brain measures, whereas extracurricular engagement had more selective moderating effects on the structure of sensory regions. Our findings identify sleep duration and extracurricular engagement as markers of variability in SES-brain associations, underscoring the need for longitudinal and intervention studies to determine whether these factors can mitigate disparities in brain outcomes among youth from disadvantaged backgrounds.

relevance.reason: 研究青少年低SES与脑结构及功能连接的关联，并考察睡眠/课外活动对脑发育的调节，属脑发育与结构功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于约一万名9至10岁早期青少年的大样本基线数据，考察睡眠时长与课外活动参与是否调节家庭和社区社会经济劣势与脑结构及功能连接之间的关联。结果显示，睡眠时间较长时，家庭与社区劣势同多种脑结构和功能指标的关联均较弱；课外活动参与的调节作用则较为局限，主要体现在感觉相关区域的结构上。作者据此将睡眠和课外活动视为社会经济地位与脑发育关联个体差异的标志，但强调这些是横断关联，能否缓解不利背景青少年的脑发育差异仍需纵向和干预研究检验。

papers.title: How right dorsomedial lesions lead to neglect: A functional network-level framework.
papers.authors: Grande E, Baldassarre A, Committeri G, Bartolo A, Esposito V, Ciavarro M.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Spatial neglect-a disorder characterized by impaired exploration of contralesional space-has only recently been reported following lesions to dorsomedial regions of the right hemisphere. Consequently, the mechanisms underlying the occurrence of neglect in this context remain largely unexplored. Here, we investigated whether alterations in functional connectivity could account for this phenomenon by longitudinally assessing resting-state fMRI in a patient before and after tumor resection. A 71-year-old male underwent resection of an oligodendroglioma involving the right superior frontal gyrus and cingulum. Neuropsychological assessment and resting-state fMRI were acquired before and after surgery. Peripersonal and personal neglect were assessed with two different cancellation tests and the Comb and Razor Test (CRT). System Segregation (SyS), i.e., the balance of within and between network functional connectivity, was computed at both whole-brain and network-specific levels and compared with 20 age-matched healthy controls using Crawford's modified t-test. While no sign of neglect was observed preoperatively, the patient exhibited both peripersonal and personal neglect after surgery. Compared to controls, postoperative data revealed a significant reduction in whole-brain SyS (p < .001). At the network level, the ventral attention network (VAN) showed preserved segregation preoperatively but a marked postoperative decrease (p < .001). These findings show, for the first time, that the clinical manifestation of neglect after right dorsomedial regions may be explained by lesion-induced alterations in large-scale functional connectivity. In particular, reduced VAN segregation may reflect impaired functional differentiation underlying deficits in spatial attention, thereby shedding light on the mechanisms underlying dorsomedial lesions neglect presentation.

relevance.reason: 纵向静息态fMRI单病例研究，探讨右背内侧病灶经功能网络分离改变导致空间忽视的机制，涉及注意网络组织与脑损伤后重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨右侧背内侧区域病变为何会引发空间忽视，通过纵向追踪一名接受右侧额上回及扣带区肿瘤切除术的患者，结合神经心理学评估与静息态功能磁共振，并与健康对照比较。结果显示，患者术前未见忽视，术后出现个人及近身空间忽视，同时全脑系统分离度显著下降，腹侧注意网络在术前保持分离、术后明显降低。作者据此提出，背内侧病变后的忽视表现可能与大规模功能连接改变有关，尤其是腹侧注意网络分离度降低所反映的功能分化受损，或可解释空间注意缺陷。该研究为个案设计，相关机制仍属初步推断。

papers.title: Ketamine Alters Tuning of Neural and Behavioral Spatial Working Memory Precision.
papers.authors: Rahmati M, Moujaes F, Suljic NP, Ji JL, Berkovitch L, Lee K, Fonteneau C, Schleifer CH, Adkinson BD, Savic A, Santamauro N, Tamayo Z, Diehl C, Kolobaric A, Flynn M, Camarro T, Curtis CE, Repovš G, Fineberg SK, Morgan PT, Preller KH, Krystal JH, Murray JD, Cho YT, Anticevic A.
papers.abstract: Background Working memory (WM) is a key element of cognition that depends on accurate internal representation of stimuli and often impaired in psychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia. Prior human neuropharmacological studies with ketamine suggest that glutamate N-methyl-D-aspartate receptors (NMDARs) are critical for spatial WM (sWM), with NMDAR antagonism attenuating task-evoked neural activation and reducing WM accuracy. Animal studies, at the cellular level, and cortical microcircuit models hypothesize that NMDAR antagonism impairs sWM by decreasing the specificity of neuronal responses to spatial locations through broadened spatial tuning. Testing the relevance of this mechanism in humans remains a vital gap in our understanding of sWM and is critical for designing better treatments for WM impairments. Methods To overcome the challenges of measuring neuronal responses invasively in humans, we combined pharmacological manipulation and computational fMRI to show that ketamine broadens neural spatial tuning in healthy adults (N=40). Specifically, we modeled population neuron-level representations, rather than traditionally examined changes in blood oxygen level dependent (BOLD) activation. Results Broader neural tuning across visual perception and WM networks was linked to poorer sWM performance under ketamine, implicating tuning changes in sWM deficits. Furthermore, ketamine-induced changes in tuning, compared to the overall magnitude of BOLD activation, were more consistent across individuals and brain regions, suggesting a collective effect of ketamine on neural tuning across spatially-selective regions. Conclusions These findings provide the first empirical evidence linking altered neuronal tuning to NMDAR antagonism and sWM impairments in humans, advancing a mechanistic understanding of glutamatergic mechanisms underlying sWM and related deficits in neuropsychiatric disorders.

relevance.reason: 在健康人用fMRI与计算建模研究氯胺酮对空间工作记忆神经调谐的影响，属工作记忆的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注谷氨酸NMDAR拮抗如何影响人类空间工作记忆，在健康成人中结合药物操纵与计算fMRI，建模群体神经元水平的空间表征而非仅看BOLD激活幅度。结果显示，氯胺酮使视觉知觉与工作记忆网络中的神经空间调谐变宽，且调谐变宽与空间工作记忆表现变差相关，提示调谐改变可能参与工作记忆缺陷。作者还指出，相比BOLD激活总体幅度，氯胺酮引起的调谐变化在个体和脑区之间更为一致，提示其对空间选择性区域具有较普遍的调谐影响。该研究为NMDAR拮抗、神经元调谐改变与人类空间工作记忆损伤之间的联系提供了初步实证证据，但相关机制结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Analysis of the influence of gradual changes in matrix sentence similarity on neural envelope tracking
papers.authors: Habersetzer T, Meyer BT, Radeloff A.
papers.abstract: Neural tracking of speech is a well-established phenomenon in neuroscience. However, for speech signals with a fixed structure, significant correlations between speech envelopes and neurophysiological representations occur even for unheard sentences. We exploit a structured speech-in-noise matrix hearing test (Oldenburger Sentence Test, OLSA) to systematically quantify the relationship between acoustic sentence similarity and neural tracking. Simultaneous magnetoencephalography (MEG) and 76-channel electroencephalography (EEG) data, including 16 channels positioned directly around the ears (ear-EEG), were recorded from 21 young adults with normal hearing during the presentation of clean-speech audiobooks and OLSA sentences at six signal-to-noise ratios. A linear decoder trained on audiobooks reconstructed OLSA sentence envelopes. Reconstruction accuracies were compared using a linear mixed model across heard (matched) and unheard (mismatched) sentences of varying acoustic similarity. Significant reconstruction accuracies were achieved across MEG, EEG, and ear-EEG for both matched and mismatched sentences. For mismatched sentences, these accuracies gradually increased with their acoustic similarity to the heard speech data. The high similarity between sentences, which is especially prominent in matrix tests, can cause significant spurious tracking for mismatched stimuli. This effect can reach levels comparable to those of matched sentences and can be mistaken for true neural tracking. Robust neural tracking across modalities further supported the established viability of ear-EEG compared to whole-head systems.

relevance.reason: 用MEG/EEG研究言语包络神经追踪与句子声学相似性的关系，属言语感知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语音包络的神经追踪是否会被句子间的声学相似性所混淆，利用结构化的矩阵听辨测试材料，结合脑磁图、头皮脑电和耳周脑电记录正常听力年轻成人聆听不同信噪比语句时的反应，并用基于有声书训练的线性解码器重建语句包络。结果显示，无论听到与否，各模态都能获得显著的重建准确率；对于未听到的句子，其重建准确率会随与已听语音的声学相似性升高而逐渐上升，在矩阵测试这类句子高度相似的材料中甚至可接近已听句子的水平。作者据此指出，这种由相似性带来的虚假追踪可能被误认为真实的神经追踪，而耳周脑电与全头系统结果的一致性也支持其作为可行记录方式。

papers.title: Resting-State Functional Connectivity in Antipsychotic-Naïve First-Episode Psychosis: A Systematic Review of Network Alterations and Preprocessing Heterogeneity
papers.authors: Ihsan A, Ather, Radua J.
papers.abstract: Resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC) abnormalities are central to characterising brain network dysfunction in first-episode psychosis (FEP), yet biomarker development remains limited by an incomplete understanding of connectivity heterogeneity. This systematic review synthesised 75 studies investigating RSFC in antipsychotic-naïve FEP across five functional network domains and one developmental subgroup. Antipsychotic-naïve FEP was consistently associated with hypoconnectivity within the default mode, salience, frontostriatal, cerebello-thalamo-cortical, and hippocampal networks. Exploratory analyses examined whether global signal regression (GSR) and motion-correction stringency were associated with differences in reported connectivity direction. Motion-control stringency showed no significant association with connectivity direction, indicating that the hypoconnectivity finding was not attributable to motion-related artefact; GSR use was strongly confounded with geographic origin, precluding independent assessment of its association with connectivity direction. Notably, no included study employed within-study preprocessing sensitivity analyses, and cross-national harmonisation efforts remain minimal. Future research should prioritise within-study GSR sensitivity analyses, establish test–retest reliability and external classifier validation for RSFC biomarkers, adopt harmonised preprocessing conventions, and systematically explore sources of directional heterogeneity across preprocessing strata to enable robust cross-national biomarker synthesis. Keywords: Connectomics; global signal regression; motion artefact; thalamocortical dysconnectivity; salience network; default mode network.

relevance.reason: 系统综述抗精神病药未治疗首发精神病患者静息态功能连接网络异常，属脑疾病网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了未用药首发精神病患者在静息态功能连接上的异常证据，整合了默认模式、突显、额纹状体、小脑-丘脑-皮层及海马网络等多个功能域的研究。总体来看，这些网络内部一致表现为连接减弱，且探索性分析提示该结果不能简单归因于头动伪影；全局信号回归的使用与地理来源高度混杂，无法独立评估其影响。作者据此指出，现有研究普遍缺乏研究内的预处理敏感性分析，跨国数据协调也很有限，未来需在统一预处理、重测信度和外部验证等方面推进，才能支持稳健的生物标志物整合。

papers.title: Stereopsis deficits and visual-network functional connectivity changes in patients with schizophrenia.
papers.authors: Wang YM, Zhu ZH, Xie YS, Bie QW, Yin XY, Hou WL, Yang Q, Bian W, Yu X, Hui L.
papers.abstract: Background Schizophrenia is characterized by disruptions in large-scale brain networks, yet the specific relationship between visual-network connectivity and perceptual deficits such as impaired stereopsis remains unclear. We hypothesized that patients with schizophrenia would exhibit poorer stereoscopic acuity and altered connectivity between visual regions and higher-order integration systems. Methods We investigated whole-brain functional connectivity using resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging in 89 patients with chronic schizophrenia and 88 healthy controls, focusing on 31 visual-network seeds defined by the Power-264 atlas. Group differences and regression models were assessed using pooled voxel-wise false discovery rate (FDR) correction across all seed maps. Supplementary pooled cluster-level FDR analyses were performed to further evaluate connectivity associations with stereopsis, PANSS symptom dimensions, and diagnosis-by-stereopsis interactions. Results Patients with schizophrenia showed poorer stereopsis and abnormal connectivity patterns within visual networks. Increased connectivity with thalamic and striatal regions and widespread reduced connectivity involving sensorimotor, temporal, insular, and frontal regions were identified after voxel-wise FDR correction. Supplementary cluster-level analyses revealed symptom-related connectivity patterns and between-group differences in stereopsis-connectivity relationships involving calcarine and lingual regions with frontal and temporal areas. These relationships showed more negative slopes in healthy controls and comparatively more positive slopes in patients with schizophrenia. Conclusions Patients with schizophrenia exhibited robust visual-network dysconnectivity and impaired stereopsis. Differences in stereopsis-connectivity relationships between groups suggest altered integration between early visual regions and higher-order processing systems in schizophrenia. Although requiring independent replication, stereopsis assessment may provide a clinically accessible approach for characterizing visual perceptual dysfunction.

relevance.reason: 研究精神分裂症患者立体视觉缺陷与静息态视觉网络功能连接改变，属感知认知的脑网络机制与脑疾病研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以慢性精神分裂症患者与健康对照为对象，用静息态功能磁共振考察视觉网络功能连接与立体视锐度受损之间的关系。结果显示，患者立体视功能更差，视觉网络内部及与丘脑、纹状体等区域的连接异常，并伴有感觉运动、颞叶、岛叶和额叶等多处连接减弱；补充分析还发现，患者与健康对照在立体视与连接关系上的斜率方向不同，提示早期视觉区与高阶整合系统之间的整合可能发生改变。作者认为，立体视评估或可作为刻画视觉知觉功能障碍的临床可行途径，但相关发现仍需独立重复验证。

papers.title: Resting-state functional and spectral alterations underlying cognitive decline in biomarker-confirmed Alzheimer's disease: A systematic review.
papers.authors: Alfonsín S, Chino B, de Frutos Lucas J, Delgado-Losada ML, Ojeda N, Maestú F.
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is characterized by progressive cognitive decline associated with synaptic and large-scale network dysfunction. Resting-state alterations may provide functional correlates of AD pathology, but associations among intrinsic brain activity, biomarkers, and domain-specific cognition have not been systematically integrated across spectral and connectivity frameworks. We systematically reviewed PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science through May 2025 (PROSPERO CRD42024575913). Thirty studies (N = 5898) examining resting-state EEG, MEG, or fMRI, AD biomarkers, and cognition were synthesized following SWiM guidance. Across studies, resting-state alterations showed converging associations with amyloid and tau measures from CSF, PET, and plasma. Five of six electrophysiological studies reported increased delta/theta activity and three of six reduced alpha/beta activity, supporting neural slowing. Greater low-frequency activity was generally associated with poorer global cognition and episodic memory, whereas reduced higher-frequency activity was linked to poorer attention and processing speed. Among 21 connectivity studies, 10 reported hyperconnectivity and 13 hypoconnectivity, with non-mutually exclusive categories. Hyperconnectivity, particularly within medial and anterior temporal circuits, was more frequent in earlier-stage groups and showed heterogeneous cognitive associations, including poorer and better-preserved performance. Broader hypoconnectivity across posterior default mode, medial temporal-posterior medial, and frontoparietal networks was more prominent in later-stage groups and more consistently associated with poorer global cognition, episodic memory, and executive function. These findings support spectral slowing and stage-related network reorganization as functional correlates of cognitive impairment in biomarker-characterized AD. However, 25 of 30 studies were cross-sectional; therefore, these connectivity patterns should not be interpreted as a demonstrated within-person trajectory.

relevance.reason: 系统综述静息态EEG/MEG/fMRI活动与连接改变及其与AD认知衰退的关联，涉及自发脑活动、网络组织与疾病中认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了经生物标志物确认的阿尔茨海默病中静息态脑活动改变与认知衰退的关系，整合了脑电、脑磁图和功能磁共振研究，并对照脑脊液、PET和血浆中的淀粉样蛋白与tau指标。总体上，电生理研究多报告低频活动增强、高频活动减弱，呈现神经活动减慢；低频活动增强通常与整体认知和情景记忆较差相关，高频活动减弱则与注意和加工速度较差相关。连接性研究结果不一：内侧及前颞回路的高连接在较早阶段更常见，认知关联异质；后部默认网络、内侧颞叶-后内侧及额顶网络的低连接在较晚阶段更突出，且更一致地对应较差的整体认知、情景记忆和执行功能。作者据此认为，频谱减慢和随疾病阶段变化的网络重组是认知损害的功能相关特征，但多数研究为横断面设计，这些连接模式不能解释为已证实的个体内演变轨迹。

papers.title: Boundary conditions for cortical speech tracking as an objective speech-in-noise marker: a three-dataset MEG/EEG benchmark.
papers.authors: Guo L, Li Y, Wang J, Feng Y, Wu B, Xu Y.
papers.abstract: Objective electrophysiological markers are often proposed for speech-in-noise assessment, but their validation targets are not always explicit: a marker may calibrate with intelligibility, distinguish acoustic conditions, decode attention, or predict an individual speech reception threshold (SRT). We used three public MEG/EEG datasets to test these endpoints within one validation framework. In MEG-SCANS (22 normal-hearing listeners), delta-band sentence-level envelope reconstruction increased with target intelligibility (Friedman chi-square=31.27, p = 8.3e-6). However, individual curves were rarely strictly monotonic (1/22 participants), and fitted neurometric SRTs showed limited agreement with a 50% intelligibility SNR proxy (r = 0.29, p = 0.20; RMSE=2.57 dB). In the Etard/Reichenbach EEG dataset, strict leave-one-part-out decoding confirmed delta-band sensitivity to clean versus babble speech in English (p = 0.0013) and Dutch (p = 7.1e-6), with stronger target- than distractor-envelope tracking. In ds-eeg-snhl, attended speech was tracked more strongly than ignored speech (p = 6.0e-21), hearing-impaired listeners showed enhanced tracking, and the audiogram-adjusted association with SRT persisted when age was omitted. Yet EEG markers produced only small and model-dependent cross-validated predictive gains. The benchmark therefore distinguishes design-manageable constraints from construct-level non-specificity: cortical speech tracking generalizes as a group-level, condition-sensitive and attention-sensitive marker, whereas individual neurometric SRT translation remains protocol-dependent.

relevance.reason: 用MEG/EEG研究听觉言语包络追踪与噪声中言语理解、注意的神经机制，属语言与脑及注意加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用三个公开的MEG/EEG数据集，在同一验证框架下检验皮层语音追踪能否作为噪声中言语评估的客观标记，分别考察其与可懂度、声学条件区分、注意解码及个体言语接收阈值的关联。结果显示，句子层面包络重建随目标可懂度升高而增强，但个体曲线很少严格单调，拟合出的神经测量阈值与行为阈值一致性有限；该指标能稳定区分清晰与嘈杂语音、追踪被注意语音，听力受损者追踪更强，但对个体阈值的跨验证预测增益较小且依赖模型。作者据此认为，皮层语音追踪可作为群体水平、对条件和注意敏感的标记，而向个体神经测量阈值的转化仍受协议制约。

papers.title: Toward selective vowel-tone integration in non-tonal L2 learners of Mandarin: Evidence from MMN additivity.
papers.authors: Mao Y, Li M, Cai X.
papers.abstract: Syllable perception requires the continuous integration of segmental (consonants and vowels) and suprasegmental (lexical tones) information. While native listeners of tonal languages exhibit pre-attentive integration of these dimensions, it remains unclear whether non-tonal second language (L2) learners can develop such integration through L2 experience. The present study employed electroencephalogram (EEG) to record mismatch negativity (MMN) responses in a passive oddball paradigm, investigating the perceptual integration of consonants, vowels, and tones. Twenty-four native Mandarin listeners (L1 group) and fifteen non-tonal L2 learners of Mandarin (L2 group) were recruited. Stimuli included a standard syllable (/da1/), three single-deviants (/ga1/, /du1/, /da4/), and three double-deviants (/gu1/, /ga4/, /du4/). MMN additivity analyses compared original double-deviant MMN amplitudes against the sum of corresponding single-deviant MMN amplitudes. The L1 group exhibited robust sub-additive MMN patterns across all double-deviant combinations (consonant-vowel [CV], consonant-tone [CT], and vowel-tone [VT]), demonstrating integrated processing across all phonological dimensions. The L2 group showed delayed MMN peak latencies and reduced pre-attentive sensitivity to single consonant and single tone deviations. Crucially, they exhibited additivity for CV and CT combinations (independent processing), but a selective sub-additive trend for the VT combination, which we interpret as preliminary evidence for vowel-tone integration. These findings provide tentative support for the TTRACE model and refine the dimensional transfer hypothesis, suggesting that non-tonal L1 biases may be partially overcome through L2 experience when phonological dimensions share tight acoustic proximity within the syllable nucleus (i.e., vowel-tone integration). Non-tonal L2 learners display a developmental pattern rooted in acoustic salience and bottom-up physical binding.

relevance.reason: 用EEG MMN研究母语者与非声调二语学习者对音节辅音、元音、声调的预注意整合，直接涉及言语感知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电失匹配负波（MMN）加性分析，考察母语为非声调语言的汉语二语学习者能否将辅音、元音和声调整合为整体感知。母语者对各维度组合均表现出整合加工，而学习者对辅音和声调的自动前注意敏感性较弱、MMN峰潜伏期延迟，辅音-元音和辅音-声调组合呈独立加工，仅在元音-声调组合上出现亚加性趋势。作者据此认为，这为元音-声调整合提供了初步证据，提示当语音维度在音节核心内声学上紧密相邻时，非声调母语带来的加工偏向可能部分被二语经验克服，但该解释仍是初步的。

papers.title: Real-space navigation in patients with focal epilepsy underpins the prominent role of the hippocampus for allocentric navigation in humans.
papers.authors: Grabova D, Kaufmann E, Pradhan C, Rémi J, Vollmar C, Masouris I, Wlasich E, Kustermann J, Zwergal A, Schöberl F.
papers.abstract: Background An in-depth assessment of spatial navigation in patient cohorts with focal brain disorders may inform about the functional topography of underlying brain networks. The aim of the current study was to investigate the role of the right and left hippocampi on recombining novel routes in a real-space environment as a correlate for allocentric navigation abilities in patients with focal epilepsies. Methods In a single-center approach, adults with unifocal epilepsy were prospectively recruited from the tertiary epilepsy center at LMU Munich. 16 patients with right-sided mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (rTLE), 16 with left-sided mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (lTLE), 15 with frontal lobe epilepsy (FLE), and 24 age-matched healthy controls conducted a real-space navigation paradigm that required recognition of familiar routes and recombination of novel routes. Visual exploration behavior and navigation trajectories were documented by a gaze-controlled head-fixed camera and analyzed post hoc across groups and navigation conditions. Results Epilepsy patients (mean age 40.7 years) performed significantly worse in finding navigation targets than controls (p<0.001). Age, duration of epilepsy, and structural brain lesions affected navigation performance. After correcting for confounders, rTLE patients showed significantly inferior performance compared to FLE, especially for recombined novel routes. lTLE patients were impaired mainly on recombined novel routes. rTLE patients spent more time at crossroads and used shortcuts less often than controls. Conclusion This study supports the hippocampus as a major hub for human goal-oriented navigation in real environments, with right hippocampal dysfunction particularly impairing allocentric navigation and creation of novel routes.

relevance.reason: 以局灶性癫痫患者为工具，研究左右海马在真实空间导航与异我中心导航中的因果性作用，属空间认知脑机制与脑疾病认知重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨左右侧海马在局灶性癫痫患者真实空间导航中的作用，采用单中心前瞻性设计，让右侧或左侧颞叶内侧癫痫、额叶癫痫患者及年龄匹配的健康对照完成需识别熟悉路线和重组新路线的真实空间导航任务，并用眼动控制的头戴相机记录视觉探索与行进轨迹。结果显示，癫痫患者整体寻找导航目标的表现差于对照，年龄、病程和结构性病灶也影响成绩；校正混杂因素后，右侧颞叶内侧癫痫患者在重组新路线上的表现明显差于额叶癫痫患者，左侧颞叶内侧癫痫患者则主要在重组新路线上受损，右侧患者还更多在路口停留、较少使用捷径。作者据此认为海马是人类真实环境中目标导向导航的关键枢纽，右侧海马功能异常尤其损害异我中心导航和新路线生成。

papers.title: Impaired cortical encoding of prosodic prominence in single multisyllabic words for adults with dyslexia
papers.authors: Keshavarzi M, Moore BCJ, Goswami U.
papers.abstract: Developmental dyslexia is associated with impaired cortical tracking of continuous speech and difficulties in perceiving within-word prosodic structure in children and adults. For adults and continuous speech, both low-frequency delta- and theta-band impairments and high-frequency gamma- and beta-band differences are found. To date, perceptual difficulties with intra-word prosody have not been studied in direct relation to neural speech encoding. Here neurotypical adults and adults with dyslexia listened to multisyllabic words. EEG was recorded, and cortical encoding was quantified using temporal response function (TRF) modelling. Four speech representations were explored: lexical stress pattern (intra-word prosodic prominence), the low-frequency speech envelope, word onsets and syllable onsets. Adults with dyslexia showed significantly reduced encoding of intra-word prosodic prominence (delta band) and of the speech envelope (delta and theta bands). In contrast, encoding of word and syllable onsets was preserved. Pinpointing delta-band cortical tracking as central to encoding intra-word prosodic prominence opens new avenues for research.

relevance.reason: 用EEG-TRF比较阅读障碍成人对多音节词韵律重音的皮层编码，直接研究言语韵律加工的神经机制及障碍。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察发展性阅读障碍成人对多音节单词内部韵律结构的皮层编码是否受损，让神经典型成人与阅读障碍成人听多音节词并记录脑电，用时间响应函数模型量化皮层编码。结果显示，阅读障碍成人对词内韵律凸显（delta频段）和语音包络（delta与theta频段）的编码显著减弱，而对词首和音节起始的编码保持完好。作者据此指出，delta频段皮层追踪可能是编码词内韵律凸显的核心环节，为理解阅读障碍的词内韵律感知困难提供了神经层面的线索。

papers.title: Goals Drive Adaptive Analysis of Linguistic Features During Reading
papers.authors: Alex P, Schwarz J, Tatler BW, Konopka A, Klimovich-Gray A.
papers.abstract: Reading behaviour is sensitive to contextual demands. For example, when reading to study or answer questions, readers strategically allocate more attention to goal-relevant sections, read slower, and regress more frequently to extract specific information based on task demands. This suggests that readers flexibly adapt their strategies according to goals and situational constraints. However, the neurocognitive mechanisms supporting this flexibility remain unclear. To test this, we combined eye-tracking with EEG during naturalistic reading and examined how short-term reading goals modulated the neural tracking of hierarchical linguistic features at the orthographic (orthographic neighbourhood size), lexical (word frequency), and contextual-semantic (Surprisal) levels. Forty native English speakers read narratives in three goal conditions: Baseline (no goal), Proofreading (detect spelling errors), and Comprehension (attend to content). Fixation-aligned word-level EEG activity was modelled using multivariate temporal response function to estimate the strength of feature-specific neural tracking. Orthographic tracking was significantly enhanced during Proofreading relative to Baseline, and predicted better Proofreading accuracy. Conversely, stronger frequency tracking predicted better Comprehension accuracy. Contextual-semantic tracking was not modulated by task goal. These findings suggest that reading goals selectively bias neural processing towards linguistic features (sublexical vs. lexical) that support successful task performance, providing evidence for short-term functional plasticity in linguistic processing and supporting a flexible predictive processing account of goal-directed reading.

relevance.reason: 用EEG结合眼动研究自然阅读中目标如何调节正字法、词汇和语义特征的神经追踪，属语言加工与认知控制的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察短期阅读目标如何调节自然阅读中对不同层级语言特征的神经追踪，结合眼动与脑电记录，让母语者分别在无目标、校对拼写和理解内容三种条件下阅读叙事文本。结果显示，校对目标增强了正字法层面的神经追踪，且这种增强预测了更高的校对准确率；词频追踪更强则预测更好的内容理解成绩；语境语义追踪未受目标调节。作者据此认为，阅读目标会选择性地将神经加工偏向有助于完成当前任务的语言特征，体现了语言加工中的短期功能可塑性，并支持目标导向阅读的灵活预测加工解释。

papers.title: Parents’ neural dynamics in response to their children’s speech
papers.authors: Elmlinger SL, Rosenberg E, Jaffe-Dax S, Nencheva ML, Lee C, Kosie JE, Lew-Williams C.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The development of speech in human children is a protracted process that depends on social experience. From early life, young children produce vocalizations in the presence of others, which affords unique opportunities for feedback about how to communicate successfully. However, for feedback to happen, young children’s speech needs to effect change in the brains of their caregivers. Using dual-brain functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to measure real-time communication between caregivers and their 2-to 3-year-old children ( n = 56), we found that children’s vocalizations selectively modulated caregivers’ brain activity. Parents’ brains showed a rapid response to children’s production of speech that was communicatively advanced (multiword utterances) vs. less advanced (babble). The findings imply that if part of learning to talk is figuring out how to get your communication partner to listen, then early conversations likely present continuous opportunities for feedback that guide children toward advances in spoken language.

relevance.reason: 用双脑fNIRS测量照料者听幼儿言语时的实时脑反应，属言语感知与交流的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注幼儿发声能否实时影响照护者的大脑活动，并采用双脑功能性近红外光谱同步测量照护者与2至3岁幼儿交流时的脑反应。结果显示，幼儿发声会选择性地调节照护者脑活动：相比咿呀声，照护者对多词话语这类交流更成熟的发声表现出快速反应。作者据此提出，早期对话可能为幼儿提供持续反馈，帮助其学习如何让交流对象倾听，从而推动口语发展；但这一含义属于解释性推论，尚不能说明因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Neurocognitive Indices of Long COVID: Dysregulated Engagement of Inhibitory Control and Oscillatory Slowing.
papers.authors: White DR, Parker KS, Marinkovic K.
papers.abstract: Persistent neurocognitive symptoms, such as "brain fog", insomnia, or fatigue, are prevalent in PASC (post-acute sequelae of COVID-19, "Long COVID"), even after mild acute illness. However, evidence for the neural underpinnings of cognitive dysregulation and altered spontaneous neural activity is inadequate. EEG data were acquired during an inhibitory Go/NoGo task and wakeful rest from young, otherwise healthy adults with PASC approximately six months after recovery from mild COVID-19. Neurobehavioral indices were computed for correct and erroneous trials, resting state, and the questionnaire battery, and compared with a matched control (CONT) group of individuals not exposed to COVID-19. The PASC group reported higher cognitive difficulties, anxiety, depression, and sleep problems, consistent with the known symptomatic pattern. Despite intact task performance, neural indices indicated altered engagement of cognitive control in the PASC group on both correct and error trials, which was associated with less efficient responding. Moreover, co-oscillatory synchrony trended toward dysregulation during error commission in the PASC group. Altered neural indices of inhibitory control marginally correlated with spontaneous oscillatory slowing, potentially suggesting shared basic mechanisms. The overall pattern of PASC symptoms, altered neural activity during inhibitory control, and oscillatory slowing, is indicative of the core neural dysfunction characterizing PASC.

relevance.reason: 该研究用EEG考察Long COVID患者抑制控制任务与静息态振荡活动，报告认知控制相关神经指标改变。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注轻症新冠康复后仍持续出现“脑雾”、失眠或疲劳等症状的年轻健康成人，用脑电记录其在抑制性Go/NoGo任务和清醒静息下的活动，并与未感染新冠的匹配对照组比较。尽管PASC组任务表现基本完整，但其在正确与错误试次上的神经指标均显示认知控制投入发生改变，且与反应效率下降相关；错误反应时的共振荡同步也呈失调趋势。抑制控制的神经指标改变与自发振荡减慢存在边缘相关，提示二者可能共享基础机制。作者认为，症状模式、抑制控制相关神经活动改变与振荡减慢共同构成PASC的核心神经功能失调特征。

papers.title: When Vision Disagrees with Language: Private and Population-Level Color Knowledge in Red–Green Dichromacy
papers.authors: Lu J, Xiong Z, Yuan P, Wang X, Bi Y.
papers.abstract: Human concepts are shaped by two distinct information sources: private sensorimotor experience and socially transmitted knowledge mainly conveyed through language in an abstract symbolic form. Because information geometry in these sources is largely aligned, their relative contributions to conceptual representation are difficult to disentangle. We exploit a group-level dissociation, in which the alignment between sensory color geometry and population-level language structure diverges systematically (red–green dichromacy vs. trichromacy), and a model-level dissociation (object-color geometry derived from large language models vs. from image-based sensory models), to disentangle vision and language contributions to object knowledge. Sensory color geometry differed behaviorally and neurally between dichromats and trichromats, yet behavioral object-color representations converged across groups and corresponded robustly with language-derived geometry. LadATL consistently expressed language-derived geometry across tasks and groups, whereas LpFG showed a group-dependent representational profile in the chromatic-object task: trichromats showed relatively greater correspondence with sensory-derived geometry, whereas dichromats retained correspondence with both geometries. Dichromats also showed stronger intrinsic connectivity of LadATL with LpFG and EVC. These findings reveal how the brain flexibly draws on sensory evidence and socially transmitted knowledge to maintain population-aligned conceptual representations across heterogeneous sensory experiences.

relevance.reason: 研究语言/语义知识与感觉经验如何共同塑造人脑物体颜色概念表征，涉及左前颞叶等语言区及内在连接。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用红绿色觉异常者与正常三色觉者在颜色感觉几何与群体语言结构对齐程度上的系统性差异，并结合大语言模型与图像模型两种几何来源，试图分离视觉经验与语言知识对物体颜色概念的贡献。行为与神经层面，两组的感觉颜色几何确实不同，但物体颜色表征在行为上趋同，且与语言推导出的几何稳健对应；LadATL在各任务和两组中均稳定表达语言几何，而LpFG在颜色物体任务中表现出组别依赖的表征模式。作者据此认为，大脑能灵活整合感觉证据与社会传递的知识，在感觉经验异质的情况下维持与群体一致的概念表征。

papers.title: Progressive degeneration of the fornix beyond normal aging in temporal lobe epilepsy: A 10-year longitudinal diffusion imaging study.
papers.authors: Mao L, Cai Y, Zhang Q, Luo W, Wang X, Sun W, Ding J.
papers.abstract: Objective Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is increasingly recognized as a network disorder involving widespread structural abnormalities beyond the seizure focus. However, it remains unclear whether white matter alterations in TLE reflect static injury or progressive degeneration beyond normal aging. We aimed to characterize long-term trajectories of limbic microstructural alterations in patients with unilateral TLE using longitudinal diffusion tensor imaging. Methods Sixteen patients with unilateral TLE and 15 age- and sex-matched healthy controls underwent diffusion tensor imaging at baseline and approximately 10-year follow-up. Fractional anisotropy (FA) alterations were assessed using tract-based spatial statistics. Longitudinal tract-specific changes were further evaluated using mixed-design ANOVA and correlation analyses with disease duration. Cognitive performance was assessed using the Mini-Mental State Examination and Montreal Cognitive Assessment. Results Over 10 years, patients with TLE showed significant FA reductions in the fornix and corpus callosum (PFWE < 0.05), whereas healthy controls showed no significant longitudinal changes. The most pronounced alterations involved the fornix body and columns, with significant Group × Time interactions in the unadjusted analyses and a robust interaction in fornix Cluster 1 after age adjustment; an age-adjusted interaction was also observed in the corpus callosum. Greater longitudinal fornix FA decline was associated with longer disease duration (r = 0.570, P = 0.021) and remained significant after adjustment for age (partial r = 0.503, P = 0.046). Exploratory analyses also showed a nominal association between reduced fornix FA and poorer orientation performance (r = 0.592, unadjusted P = 0.016), although this association did not survive FDR correction. Significance TLE shows progressive white matter degeneration beyond normal aging, with preferential involvement of the fornix. Greater longitudinal fornix FA decline with longer disease duration supports preferential vulnerability of hippocampal output pathways.

relevance.reason: 纵向扩散成像显示颞叶癫痫患者穹窿进行性白质退变，属脑疾病中白质结构与认知关联研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注颞叶癫痫患者脑白质改变究竟反映静态损伤还是超出正常衰老的进行性退变，对单侧颞叶癫痫患者与年龄性别匹配的健康对照在基线和约十年后分别进行弥散张量成像，并分析穹窿等纤维束的纵向变化。结果显示，患者穹窿和胼胝体的各向异性分数在十年间明显下降，而健康对照未见显著纵向变化，其中穹窿体部和柱部受累最突出；穹窿各向异性分数下降越多，病程越长，这一关联在调整年龄后仍存在。作者据此认为，颞叶癫痫存在超出正常衰老的进行性白质退变，且穹窿优先受累，提示海马输出通路可能具有选择性易损性；探索性分析中穹窿改变与定向表现的关联未通过多重校正，尚不能视为确定结论。

papers.title: Early posttrauma disruptions within default mode network connectivity predict PTSD symptom trajectories: evidence from a longitudinal mega-analysis.
papers.authors: Lokshina Y, Sheynin J, Ben-Zion Z, Nickelsen T, Xie H, Hendler T, Shalev AY, Wang X, Liberzon I.
papers.abstract: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a chronic psychiatric disorder associated with functional impairment and health burden. Evidence highlights the role of large-scale neural network disruptions, within and between the Default Mode Network (DMN) and Salience Network (SN), in PTSD pathophysiology, and early alterations in these networks may serve as biomarkers for predicting PTSD symptom trajectories and guiding early interventions. This longitudinal mega-analysis integrated resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) data from two trauma-exposed cohorts (Tel Aviv and Toledo), collected within the first month posttrauma. Seed-based rsFC analyses focused on DMN regions (hippocampus, ventromedial prefrontal cortex [vmPFC], posterior cingulate cortex) and SN regions (amygdala, insula, dorsal anterior cingulate cortex [dACC]). PTSD symptoms were assessed at 12- to 14-month follow-up using the Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale (CAPS-5) and PTSD Checklist (PCL-5). Early posttrauma reductions in within-DMN connectivity, particularly between the hippocampus and rostral ACC/vmPFC, mPFC, and inferior parietal lobe, were associated with greater PTSD symptom severity at annual follow-up. Decreased connectivity between the DMN and visual cortex (calcarine) was also linked to more severe symptoms. Decreased DMN-SN connectivity, specifically between the amygdala and rostral ACC/vmPFC, was linked to more severe symptoms at follow-up, adding to a complex picture of the relationship between networks. Early disruptions in within-DMN connectivity emerged as the most consistent neural correlate of later PTSD symptom severity. These findings underscore a central role of within-DMN dysfunction in PTSD pathophysiology, reflecting deficits in context processing governed by hippocampus-mPFC circuitry. Identifying these early neural markers may guide targeted interventions to prevent chronic PTSD.

relevance.reason: 纵向研究创伤后早期静息态DMN/SN功能连接预测PTSD症状轨迹，以脑网络组织理解精神疾病机理。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注创伤后早期静息态功能连接能否预测后续创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）症状的严重程度，整合了两个创伤暴露队列在创伤后一个月内采集的功能磁共振数据，并以默认网络（DMN）和突显网络内部及之间的连接为分析重点。随访约一年后的症状评估显示，创伤后早期DMN内部连接降低，尤其是海马与内侧前额叶等区域之间的连接减弱，与随访时更严重的PTSD症状相关；DMN与视觉皮层以及DMN与突显网络之间的连接降低也与症状较重有关。作者认为，DMN内部连接紊乱是后续症状最一致的神经关联，可能反映海马-内侧前额叶环路参与的情境加工缺陷，但这些关联的预测价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Symptom correlates of white matter pathology in borderline personality disorder: A narrative review of a structured pubmed search.
papers.authors: Chamoun J, Nasrallah HA.
papers.abstract: Background Borderline personality disorder (BPD) is a common psychiatric illness with a significant burden of disease. Using diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), researchers have demonstrated shared patterns of white matter pathology across BPD patients. White matter changes have mapped onto prominent symptoms of BPD as well. We have conducted this review to examine recent literature on white matter findings in BPD and the correlating significant symptoms. Methods A literature search was conducted on the Pubmed database in alignment with PRISMA guidelines. Relevant articles published from April 2018 - May 2026 surrounding BPD and DTI findings were included. Results 8 studies were included in the final review. BPD subjects displayed significant white matter pathology across multiple brain regions, with the corpus callosum, differing regions around the cingulate cortex and superior longitudinal fasciculus being recurrent findings. Correlates to symptomatology were noted as well, with the corpus callosum's relationship with anxiety and the relevance of the triple network's white matter connectivity to suicidal and aggressive behavior being of special interest. Discussion BPD is associated with significant white matter pathology across multiple brain regions, with symptoms correlating to impaired white matter in specific areas. Further prospective studies should be done to evaluate the ability of DTI to predict psychological and behavioral disturbances.

relevance.reason: 综述BPD患者白质病理（胼胝体、扣带、上纵束）及其与症状的关联，属脑疾病中白质结构与认知/行为症状映射。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述基于PubMed结构化检索，梳理了边缘型人格障碍患者弥散张量成像所显示的白质病理及其与症状的关联。纳入研究反复报告胼胝体、扣带皮层周围区域及上纵束等部位存在白质异常，其中胼胝体改变与焦虑相关，三重网络的白质连接则与自杀和攻击行为有关。作者据此指出，边缘型人格障碍涉及多脑区白质病理，特定区域的白质受损与相应症状相关，但这类关联尚不能说明因果关系，未来需前瞻性研究检验弥散张量成像能否预测心理与行为异常。

papers.title: Suanzaoren decoction and estazolam improve insomnia symptoms by altering insular subregional functional connectivity in chronic insomnia disorder.
papers.authors: Li T, Han Y, Yan H, Guo Z, Ou Y, Yao P, Chen L, Yuan Y, Zhao J, Lv D, Guo W.
papers.abstract: Chronic insomnia disorder (CID) is characterized by dysregulation of the insula, a key hub integrating emotional, cognitive, and autonomic processes. This study investigated insular subregional functional connectivity (FC) abnormalities in CID, longitudinal FC modulation following treatment with Suanzaoren Decoction (SZRD) or estazolam, and the associated molecular signatures. We recruited 82 patients with CID and 80 healthy controls. Patients underwent clinical assessments and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging at baseline and after six weeks of treatment. Twelve insular subregions were defined as seeds for whole-brain FC analyses. Longitudinal treatment effects were examined using mixed-effects models. Spatial correlations between FC alterations and gene expression maps from the Allen Human Brain Atlas were analyzed. At baseline, CID patients exhibited increased FC between the hypergranular insula and the opercular part of the left inferior frontal gyrus (IFG). Following treatment, both the SZRD and estazolam groups showed enhanced FC between the left hypergranular insula and the bilateral anterior cingulate cortex, and between the right dorsal agranular insula and the right mid/posterior cingulate cortex. Estazolam treatment was further associated with decreased FC between the left dorsal agranular insula and the left cerebellar lobule VI, and increased FC with the bilateral precuneus. Gene enrichment analysis indicated that the identified genes were significantly involved in fatty acid transport, neuronal ensheathment, and early endosome localization. CID is characterized by aberrant insular-IFG connectivity. Both SZRD and estazolam effectively modulate the insular subregional FC, and functional alterations are linked to specific transcriptomic profiles.

relevance.reason: 研究慢性失眠患者岛叶子区静息态功能连接异常及治疗后的纵向调制，属脑疾病相关的静息态网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察慢性失眠障碍患者岛叶亚区功能连接的异常，以及酸枣仁汤或艾司唑仑治疗六周后这些连接如何变化，并分析其与基因表达图谱的空间关联。结果显示，患者基线时岛叶高颗粒亚区与左额下岛盖部连接增强；两种治疗均使左侧高颗粒岛叶与双侧前扣带回、右侧背侧无颗粒岛叶与右侧中后扣带回的连接增强，艾司唑仑还伴随其他岛叶亚区连接的改变。作者认为两种疗法均可调节岛叶亚区功能连接，且这些改变与特定转录组特征相关，但相关分析本身不能说明因果。

papers.title: Implementation and validation of a clinically compatible four-shell diffusion MRI protocol for ischemic stroke research.
papers.authors: Gourieux E, Pietras J, Delphin A, Legris L, Krainik A, Detante O, Jaillard A, RESSTORE-1b group.
papers.abstract: Advanced multi-shell diffusion MRI enables microstructural modeling beyond conventional tensor metrics but remains underutilized in clinical stroke research. Within the multicenter RESSTORE clinical trial, we implemented a clinically compatible four-shell diffusion protocol optimized for 3T scanners (10-minute acquisition time) and developed a fully reproducible open-source processing pipeline, implemented within a BIDS-compatible framework, including preprocessing, diffusion tensor modeling, NODDI fitting, tractography, tractometry, and atlas-based extraction. The protocol was first evaluated in twelve healthy volunteers (HV), including a test-retest reliability assessment in six participants. It was subsequently applied in twelve patients 7 days after ischemic stroke. Microstructural metrics including FA, ODI and NDI were compared between stroke patients and HV to assess acquisition and processing pipeline feasibility and to evaluate the metric-specific ability to detect lesion-related microstructural alterations. Reliability metrics demonstrated stable parameter estimation for ODI, FA and NDI. Interhemispheric and between-group comparisons revealed significant differences for ODI and FA, whereas NDI, despite good reliability, did not show significant differences between HV and stroke patients in this dataset.

relevance.reason: 在缺血性卒中患者与健康人中验证多壳扩散MRI协议，比较白质微结构指标（FA、ODI、NDI），属白质微结构与结构成像方法研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在RESSTORE多中心临床试验框架下，搭建了一套适用于临床的3T四壳层扩散MRI采集方案（约10分钟）及配套的开源可复现处理流程，并在健康志愿者中评估其重测可靠性，随后将其用于缺血性卒中患者。结果显示，ODI、FA和NDI的参数估计较为稳定；患者与健康人之间在ODI和FA上存在显著差异，而可靠性良好的NDI在本数据集中未显示出组间差异。这表明该方案在卒中研究中具有可行性，同时不同微结构指标对病灶相关改变的敏感程度并不一致。

papers.title: Intrinsic functional architecture predicts remote motor cortical excitability changes induced by intermittent theta-burst stimulation.
papers.authors: Chen Y, Zheng Z, Liu F, Cai H, Chu T, Luo S, Li Z, Zhu C.
papers.abstract: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) modulates cortical excitability both locally and remotely through connected regions. However, how intrinsic functional architecture influences these remote effects remains unclear. Leveraging multi-site stimulation (targeting the left primary motor cortex [M1], dorsal premotor cortex, and caudal inferior parietal lobule) combined with resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging, we investigate whether intrinsic functional architecture predicts rTMS-induced changes in contralateral M1 excitability. While group-level effects were absent, individual variability in excitability changes was significantly predicted by functional characteristics. When the engaged network of stimulated region is sensorimotor network, resting-state functional connectivity between the stimulated region and the right M1 significantly predicts excitability changes, moderated by within-network interactions. Otherwise, exploratory analysis found associations with network topological properties rather than direct coupling. These findings provide preliminary insights into rTMS neuromodulation and may inform future development of personalized treatments (e.g., for post-stroke motor rehabilitation), yet require further investigation in clinical populations.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态内在功能架构如何预测TMS诱导的对侧运动皮层兴奋性变化，涉及人脑功能网络组织与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大脑内在功能架构能否预测间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）引起的远端运动皮层兴奋性变化。研究对左侧初级运动皮层、背侧前运动皮层及尾侧下顶小叶实施多部位刺激，并结合静息态功能磁共振成像，考察对侧初级运动皮层兴奋性的改变。结果显示，组水平上未见效应，但个体间兴奋性变化可由功能特征显著预测：当受刺激区域所涉网络为感觉运动网络时，该区域与右侧初级运动皮层的静息态功能连接可预测兴奋性变化，并受网络内相互作用的调节；探索性分析则发现其他情况下与网络拓扑属性相关而非直接耦合。作者认为这些结果仅为iTBS神经调控提供了初步线索，或有助于未来个性化治疗（如卒中后运动康复）的开发，但仍需在临床人群中进一步验证。

papers.title: How punishment sensitivity affects delay discounting: The mediating role of functional connectivity between the left dorsal medial prefrontal cortex and right postcentral gyrus.
papers.authors: Ren Y, Shao T, Zhao H, Huang J, Yang C, Xiong Z, Shen H, Zhang Z, Liu Y, Feng T, Feng P.
papers.abstract: Punishment sensitivity refers to an individual's tendency to perceive and respond to punishment and other negative outcomes. Delay discounting refers to that an individual tends to devalue the subjective worth of future rewards as the waiting time increases. Previous findings suggest that punishment sensitivity may be related to delay discounting, but direct evidence for this association and the neural mechanisms underlying this relationship remain unclear. To address this question, we combined behavioral measurements, voxel-based morphometry (VBM), resting-state fMRI, and mediation analysis to investigate their brain-behavior mechanisms. Behaviorally, punishment sensitivity negatively correlated with delay discounting. Furthermore, VBM analysis found that the gray matter volume (GMV) of the left dorsal medial prefrontal cortex (dmPFC_L) is positively associated with punishment sensitivity, and neuroimaging results revealed that the functional connectivity between the dmPFC_L and the right postcentral gyrus (PCG_R) was positively associated with punishment sensitivity. More critically, mediation analysis showed that this functional connectivity exhibited a partial mediation with a statistical suppressor effect in the association with delay discounting. These results suggest that the functional connectivity between the dmPFC_L and PCG_R may represent a neural correlate of this association, providing new insights and a neurobiological interpretation for this association.

relevance.reason: 研究惩罚敏感性与延迟折扣的脑结构（VBM灰质体积）和静息态功能连接机制，属决策/奖赏认知的脑基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注惩罚敏感性与延迟折扣之间的关系及其神经机制，结合行为测量、基于体素的形态学分析、静息态功能磁共振成像与中介分析进行考察。行为结果显示，惩罚敏感性越高，延迟折扣倾向越低。影像分析发现，左侧背内侧前额叶皮层与右侧中央后回之间的功能连接与惩罚敏感性正相关，且该连接在惩罚敏感性与延迟折扣的关联中起部分中介作用，并伴有统计抑制效应。作者据此认为，这一功能连接可能是连接惩罚敏感性与延迟折扣的神经相关物，为理解二者关系提供了神经生物学解释；但作为横断面关联分析，尚不能据此推断因果或临床应用。

papers.title: Morphosyntactic processing of complex nonwords in sentence context: An ERP study.
papers.authors: Rossetto A, Popov S, Flütsch-Keravec S, Beyersmann E.
papers.abstract: The current study aimed to understand morphosyntactic processing of suffixes in sentence context. We employed Event-Related Potentials (ERPs) to assess how the morphosyntactic features carried by suffixes are integrated in the syntactic structure of the sentence during reading. Three types of sentences were tested: (1) sentences including non-stem+suffix nonwords embedded in syntactically congruent positions (She may selkify everybody by tomorrow); (2) sentences with non-stem+suffix nonwords in syntactically incongruent positions (She wore her selkify all day); and (3) sentences with the same syntactic structure as condition 1 and non-stem+non-suffix nonwords (She may selkert everybody by tomorrow). In addition, a control condition with the same syntactic structure as condition 2 and non-stem+non-suffix nonwords (She wore her selkert all day) was included to counterbalance the experimental stimuli. Participants silently read the sentences while the EEG signal was recorded. A significant effect of suffix status was detected in the 100-300 ms, 300-500 ms, 500-700 ms, and 700-900 ms time windows, with larger positive amplitudes for non-suffixes than suffixes. Moreover, a significantly larger P600 was found in the 500-700 ms time window for incongruent than congruent stimuli. The results demonstrate recognition of (non)word suffix in sentence context, in line with decompositional accounts of morphological processing, and highlight the importance of suffixes in morphosyntactic sentence analysis.

relevance.reason: 用ERP研究句子语境中后缀形态句法加工，直接涉及人脑语言加工机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用事件相关电位考察读者在句子语境中如何加工非词后缀所携带的形态句法信息，参与者默读含不同后缀与非后缀非词的句子，同时记录脑电。结果显示，后缀状态在多个时间窗内引起波幅差异，非后缀比后缀诱发更大的正向波；句法不一致的刺激则在较晚时间窗诱发更大的P600。作者据此认为，读者在句子语境中能识别非词是否带后缀，这支持形态加工的分解观点，并提示后缀在句子形态句法分析中具有重要作用。

papers.title: "When the word ends, the story begins": word offsets improve encoding of natural speech in a MEG study.
papers.authors: Ovakimian A, Korotkov N, Soghoyan G, Sysoeva O, Martynova O.
papers.abstract: The segmentation of continuous speech into words was investigated using the temporal response function (TRF) approach for source-space magnetoencephalography (MEG) signals from 54 participants. Although the onset of words has been extensively studied, the contribution of their offset remains unclear. Acoustic and semantic predictors were used to test the relative contribution of word onsets and offsets to the processing of natural speech in the auditory temporal cortex. Circular shifting of word onsets and offsets significantly reduced predictive power (p < 0.001 for both). The corrupted word onset model showed a greater reduction in the predictive performance (p < 0.001). Both effects were localised to the left middle temporal gyrus (MTG) and the right banks of the superior temporal sulcus (STS). Additionally, removing the word offset predictor from the model significantly reduced predictive performance, indicating incremental word offset timing information beyond word onset and the remaining control predictors. These findings demonstrate the significant, albeit unequal, contribution of word onsets and offsets to the neural encoding of natural speech.

relevance.reason: 用MEG研究自然语音中词起始与词结束时间对听觉颞叶神经编码的贡献，属语言感知与自然语音加工的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用时间响应函数方法分析脑磁图数据，考察自然连续语音中词起始与词结束信息对听觉皮层语音编码的贡献。结果发现，打乱词起始或词结束的时间都会显著削弱模型的预测能力，其中词起始受损带来的预测下降更大，说明两者作用并不对等；在同时纳入词起始和其他控制变量的情况下，词结束时间仍提供额外的预测信息。两种效应均定位于左侧颞中回和右侧颞上沟岸。作者据此认为，词起始和词结束都参与自然语音的神经编码，但贡献程度不同。

papers.title: Thalamocortical white matter microstructure and cognition following mild traumatic brain injury: A fixel-based analysis.
papers.authors: Baird M, Seal ML, Beare R, Yang JY, Anderson JFI.
papers.abstract: The thalamus, an essential hub for cognitive integration across distributed brain networks, has emerged as a key structure implicated in mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI). However, while white matter microstructural injury is considered a core pathophysiological substrate of mTBI, few studies have examined thalamocortical microstructure following injury. The present study applied an advanced diffusion MRI-based white matter microstructural model, fixel-based analysis (FBA), to examine thalamocortical white matter microstructure and its associations with cognitive performance at approximately two-months following mTBI. The final analysed dataset included 39 mTBI patients and 28 trauma control (TC) patients aged 18-60 years, who were recruited following hospital admission for physical injury. Participants completed a range of cognitive tests and an MRI protocol including diffusion weighted sequences at 6-12 weeks following injury. Thalamocortical tracts were delineated bilaterally using the TractSeg algorithm, an automated white matter bundle segmentation tool. While whole-brain FBA showed no statistically significant differences in fixel metrics between groups, tract-based analyses showed that mTBI was associated with reduced fibre density (FD) of the right thalamo-precentral (BF10 = 6.849), right thalamo-parietal (BF10 = 3.708) and left thalamo-precentral (BF10 = 1.276) tracts. Despite these structural differences, the groups were comparable with respect to performance on cognitive tests. However, models with interaction effects indicated that associations between thalamocortical FD and cognitive performance differed between groups, most frequently on measures of processing speed and attention. Together, these findings indicate at this stage of recovery, changes in white matter microstructure are detectable in thalamocortical tracts, and that structure-cognition relationships may differ between mTBI and TC groups even in the absence of objective cognitive impairment.

relevance.reason: 扩散MRI纤维束微结构与认知关联，研究mTBI后丘脑皮层白质结构-认知关系，属结构功能、认知与脑损伤机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注轻度创伤性脑损伤后丘脑皮层白质微结构及其与认知表现的关系，采用基于纤维束的弥散MRI分析（FBA），比较了伤后约两个月的mTBI患者与创伤对照组。全脑分析未发现组间差异，但纤维束分析显示mTBI组右侧丘脑-中央前回、右侧丘脑-顶叶及左侧丘脑-中央前回的纤维密度降低。尽管存在这些结构差异，两组认知测试表现相当；交互模型则提示丘脑皮层纤维密度与认知表现（尤其是加工速度和注意力）的关联在两组间有所不同。作者据此认为，在该恢复阶段丘脑皮层白质微结构变化已可检测，且结构-认知关系可能在无明显客观认知损害时即出现组间差异。

papers.title: Does the stria of Gennari integrity reflect acquired visual field defects?
papers.authors: Roelofzen C, Porro GL, van Genderen MM, Bergsma DP, Petridou N, Dumoulin SO, Fracasso A.
papers.abstract: Visual input reaches the primary visual cortex (V1) at the stria of Gennari, a band of highly myelinated fibers at the level of layer IV. Damage to the visual pathways can cause visual field defects (scotomas) that prevent visual input from reaching V1. Here, we evaluate whether the stria of Gennari degrades in the absence of visual input. Using 7 Tesla MRI, we investigate the integrity of the stria of Gennari in case of acquired homonymous visual field defects, in particular hemianopia: the loss of vision in half of the visual field. These visual field defects allow us to compare stria of Gennari integrity between the two hemispheres within the same participant, i.e., the hemisphere that is deprived of visual input (affected hemisphere) versus the hemisphere receiving visual information (unaffected hemisphere). Therefore, we focus on cases of acquired blindness following damage between the optic chiasm and V1. We quantify the stria of Gennari integrity both by measuring the T1-weighted intensity at the middle of cortical depth and using a modeling approach that captures T1-weighted intensity variations across cortical depth. Our results show that the stria of Gennari remains intact in both the affected and unaffected hemisphere, suggesting that the stria of Gennari integrity is not altered in the absence of visual input.

papers.title: Re-evaluating impaired consciousness in temporal lobe epilepsy: The role of language dominance and network reorganization.
papers.authors: Stepponat R, Berger M, Schäfer L, Flamm L, Kollndorfer K, Bonelli S, Kasprian G, Pataraia E, Fischmeister FPS.
papers.abstract: Objective Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) frequently affects clinically-classified ictal consciousness, which the 2025 International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE) classification operationalizes through clinical assessment of awareness and responsiveness. It remains uncertain whether the spatial lateralization between the seizure-onset zone and the language-dominant hemisphere is associated with this classification. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 40 adults with TLE who underwent video-electroencephalography (EEG) evaluation and language-task functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). Seizures were classified as focal with preserved consciousness (FPC) or focal with impaired consciousness (FIC). Patients were grouped as ipsilateral (seizure onset ipsilateral to language dominance) or contralateral. The primary analysis utilized Bayesian beta-binomial estimation, alongside secondary whole-brain functional network connectivity (FNC) comparisons. Results Of 40 patients, 27 (67.5%) experienced FIC and 13 (32.5%) experienced FPC. FIC occurred in 86.7% of ipsilateral (13/15) patients compared to 56.0% of contralateral (14/25) patients. Bayesian estimation yielded a 97.4% posterior probability of a directional association between ipsilateral onset and a higher rate of FIC, although the magnitude carries considerable uncertainty (posterior median odds ratio [OR] = 4.10, 95% credible interval [CI]: .98-21.20). Absolute laterality index did not differ between FIC and FPC groups (Mann-Whitney U = 230, p = .115). Compared with healthy controls, FPC patients showed widespread FNC differences, whereas no significant control differences were detected in FIC patients. However, direct FIC-FPC comparisons did not reveal significant global task-evoked FNC differences. Significance Bayesian estimation supported an association between ipsilateral seizure onset relative to the language-dominant hemisphere and a higher probability of FIC classification. The absence of detectable task-evoked FNC differences between FIC and FPC patients did not provide evidence for clearly separable interictal language-network architectures.

papers.title: An fMRI dysmaturity signature in preterm neonates: Responsiveness of brain areas and its relation to newborn brain development
papers.authors: Attenni M, Vinci GV, Scattoni ML.
papers.abstract: Early brain development is intrinsically dynamic, yet most neonatal resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) studies rely on static and symmetric measures of functional connectivity. Here, we investigated whether response-based metrics can capture latent dynamical organization of the neonatal brain. We analysed rs-fMRI data from the Developing Human Connectome Project ( n = 714). Using a statistical-physics framework grounded in the fluctuation–dissipation theorem, we estimated intrinsic pairwise response functions between 46 cortical and subcortical grey-matter regions, enabling quantification of regional responsiveness and response duration. Response-based measures differed markedly from conventional functional connectivity and predicted gestational age at birth from a single scan. Preterm infants showed reduced responsiveness and shorter response persistence compared with term-born neonates. Importantly, directed analyses revealed a developmental reorganization of driver–listener roles across the brain, with preterm infants preserving the regional ordering of the term hierarchy but expressing it at approximately half amplitude. These findings reveal that intrinsic responsiveness captures a previously underappreciated dynamical dimension of neonatal brain organization and provides sensitive markers of neurodevelopmental maturity. Response-based metrics may offer a principled framework for detecting early network dysmaturation following preterm birth. They further indicate that prematurity does not reorganize the directed hierarchy of the neonatal connectome so much as arrest its expansion.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用发展人类连接组计划的静息态功能磁共振数据，基于涨落耗散定理估计皮层与皮层下灰质区域间的内在响应函数，考察早产新生儿脑动力组织是否可用基于响应的指标刻画。结果显示，这类响应指标明显不同于常规功能连接，并能由单次扫描预测出生胎龄；与足月新生儿相比，早产儿区域响应性降低、响应持续时间缩短。定向分析进一步发现，早产儿保留了足月儿脑内驱动—接收层级中的区域排序，但整体幅度约为后者一半，提示早产更多是延缓而非重组这一有向层级。作者据此认为，内在响应性反映了新生儿脑组织中此前被忽视的动力维度，可作为神经发育成熟度的敏感标志，并可能为识别早产后的早期网络发育不良提供框架。

papers.title: Multidimensional semantic representations emerge from multi-frequency representational similarity learning
papers.authors: Frisby SL, Cox CR, Halai AD, Shimotake A, Kikuchi T, Kobayashi K, Kuneida T, Arakawa Y, Ikeda A, Matsumoto R, Rogers TT, Lambon Ralph MA.
papers.abstract: Current theories of semantic representation are agnostic about how fine-grained neurophysiological activity corresponds to representation of multidimensional semantic information. By applying an innovative multivariate technique (representational similarity learning; RSL), we adjudicated three hypotheses: (1) that multidimensional semantic structure is represented within a single frequency range (e.g., gamma/high gamma); (2) that each semantic dimension is independently represented within a different frequency range; and (3) that multidimensional semantic information is “transfrequency” (at least some information emerges only when multiple frequencies are considered together). RSL was applied to time-frequency power and phase data extracted from electrocorticography (ECoG) grid electrodes on the surface of human ventral anterior temporal lobe (vATL). We found significant decoding of graded, multidimensional semantic information from a wide range of frequencies (4 – 200 Hz), but not from individual frequency bands, providing clear evidence that multidimensional semantic information is coded in a transfrequency fashion.

papers.title: Divergence in neurodivergent brains: mapping the relationship between developmental trajectories in functional connectivity and clinical outcomes
papers.authors: Saljoughi S, Lyons K, Heffer T, Ebrahimi M, Stevenson R, Stojanoski B.
papers.abstract: Brain network development differs between neurodivergent (ND) and neurotypical (NT) youth, but its developmental trajectory, and relationship to clinical outcomes, remains unclear. We examined age-related changes in functional network connectivity and clinical symptoms in 861 participants (5–21 years) from the Healthy Brain Network, including NT youth and those with Neurodevelopmental Disorders (NDDs) and generalized anxiety disorder (GAD). Functional connectivity during movie-watching was modeled using generalized additive models across eight large-scale networks to characterize nonlinear developmental trajectories. Divergence in connectivity profiles between ND and NT groups first emerged during late childhood and were largest during adolescence. Importantly, divergence in connectivity patterns followed a similar trajectory path, but preceded, divergence in clinical outcomes. These findings identify adolescence as a sensitive period when differences in patterns of brain activity and clinical differences become increasingly pronounced, highlighting a potential window for targeted intervention.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注神经发育差异青少年的脑功能网络连接随年龄变化的轨迹及其与临床症状的关系，利用电影观看时的功能连接数据，对神经典型青少年以及神经发育障碍和广泛性焦虑障碍青少年进行非线性发展建模。结果显示，神经发育差异组与神经典型组之间的连接模式差异在童年晚期开始出现，并在青春期最为明显；连接模式的差异沿相似轨迹发展，但先于临床症状差异出现。作者据此指出青春期可能是脑活动模式差异与临床差异日益突出的敏感时期，并提示这一阶段可能成为针对性干预的潜在窗口。

papers.title: When tigers are not animals: The neural disappearance of animacy as a function of linguistic structure
papers.authors: Krogh SM, Pylkkänen L.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In language, not only do sentence meanings depend on how words are structured together, but word meanings also depend on their roles in the structure. While we have some understanding of how the brain grasps complex meanings built from simpler parts, we know far less about how linguistic structure reshapes the meanings of the words themselves. Here we used magnetoencephalography (29 human participants: 16 women, 9 men, 4 nonbinary) to track the neural dynamics of animacy, a fundamental semantic feature that guides conceptual organization. Regardless of how animacy was operationalized (as discrete semantic categories or more abstractly), the same pattern emerged: When word-level animacy conflicted with the structural context, it disappeared from the word’s neural representation. Our findings show how compositional processes rapidly reconfigure neural traces of word meanings, allowing phrase-level meanings to even override word-level features. SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT When we use the word tiger, it evokes the nonlinguistic concept of a tiger and allows us to convey the meaning of a wild striped feline. Here, we asked whether the neural signatures of words are stable when used across different structural positions: Is tiger the same animal in valley tiger and tiger valley ? We found that phrase-level animacy dictates the content of neural representations to an extent where individual word meanings are effectively masked, providing evidence that words do not have a one-to-one mapping in the brain. By showing that not even basic word meanings are impermeable to linguistic structure, our study highlights the inherent tension arising from combining stable concepts during real-time language processing.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑磁图追踪人在理解短语时“生命性”这一基本语义特征的神经动态，考察词义在句法结构中是否保持稳定。结果显示，无论把生命性操作化为离散语义类别还是更抽象的形式，只要词本身的生命性与结构语境冲突，该特征就会从词的神经表征中消失。作者据此指出，组合加工会迅速重塑词义的神经痕迹，短语层面的意义甚至可以覆盖词层面的特征，说明词义在大脑中并非与概念一一对应，而会随语言结构被重新配置。

papers.title: Brain age prediction from structural and functional connectivity across the lifespan using connectome-based predictive modeling
papers.authors: McCusker MC, Dadashkarimi J, Sun H, Rosenblatt M, Dai W, Scheinost D.
papers.abstract: Brain maturation and aging are characterized by widespread changes in structural and functional brain organization. The extent to which these modalities capture shared versus distinct signatures of lifespan development and aging remains unclear. In this study, we applied connectome-based predictive modeling (CPM) to connectomes derived from diffusion MRI and resting-state functional MRI in Human Connectome Project Development, Young Adult, Aging, and combined Lifespan cohorts to predict chronological age. Both structural and functional connectomes significantly predicted age across cohorts, demonstrating that age-related information is distributed throughout whole-brain connectivity patterns. Prediction performance varied across lifespan stages, with generally stronger performance in the Development, Aging, and Lifespan cohorts than in Young Adulthood. Structural and functional models produced significantly correlated predicted ages in several cohorts, indicating shared age-related information across modalities. Structural-functional convergence analyses revealed limited and variable correspondence between modality-specific predictive features, suggesting that structural and functional connectomes capture both shared and complementary aspects of brain maturation and aging. Network-level analyses demonstrated that age-predictive information was distributed across canonical brain networks, including cerebellar, frontoparietal, salience, somatomotor, and subcortical networks, with patterns varying across cohorts and modalities. Multimodal CPM improved prediction relative to unimodal models in several cohorts, supporting the complementary contribution of structural and functional connectivity to age prediction. Cross-cohort, cross-sex, and cross-modality analyses further characterized the generalizability and shared information of predictive models across lifespan stages, sexes, and imaging modalities. This work demonstrates the utility of CPM for characterizing distributed structural and functional connectivity patterns associated with chronological age across the lifespan and provides a foundation for future studies of individual variability in brain maturation and aging.

relevance.reason: 用扩散MRI结构连接与静息态功能连接预测年龄，揭示全脑结构-功能连接组织随发育与老化的分布式模式，属结构与功能组织及静息网络研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用连接组预测模型（CPM）分别基于弥散MRI结构连接和静息态功能连接预测多个生命周期队列的年龄，考察两种模态所携带的年龄信息是共享还是各自独立。结果显示，结构与功能连接组均能显著预测年龄，说明年龄相关信息分布在全脑连接模式中；预测表现随生命阶段而异，在发育、衰老及合并生命周期队列中通常优于青年队列。两种模态的预测年龄在部分队列中显著相关，提示存在共享的年龄信息，但模态特异性预测特征之间的对应有限且不稳定，网络层面的年龄预测信息也随队列和模态呈现不同分布。多模态模型在部分队列中优于单模态模型，支持结构与功能连接的互补贡献。作者据此认为CPM可用于刻画贯穿生命周期的分布式连接模式，并为后续研究个体差异奠定基础。

papers.title: Multimodal Neurorehabilitation Including Auditory EEG Neurofeedback: A Proof of Concept Tested After Resection of a Giant Olfactory Groove Meningioma.
papers.authors: Romita A, Spina RP, Li Volsi N, Cacciapaglia C, Manippa V, Schiavariello MC, Soleto L, Fiore P, Speranzon L, De Trane S, Taurisano P, Lagravinese G.
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Patients undergoing resection of large olfactory groove meningiomas may present with persistent cognitive, behavioral, motor, and functional impairments. Evidence regarding EEG neurofeedback as part of postoperative neurorehabilitation remains preliminary. This case report describes the feasibility and associated clinical and neurophysiological changes in a sensory-adapted multimodal rehabilitation program. Methods: A 53-year-old man underwent emergency resection of a giant olfactory groove meningioma and subsequently completed 20 inpatient rehabilitation sessions over four weeks. Each session included auditory SMR/theta EEG neurofeedback at Cz, individualized cognitive training, and physiotherapy. Neuropsychological, emotional, functional, and mobility outcomes were assessed before and after treatment. EEG outcomes included longitudinal single-channel recordings acquired during neurofeedback sessions and 19-channel resting-state recordings obtained under eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions before and after the program. Spectral power, spectral ratios, and weighted phase-lag index connectivity were analyzed descriptively. Results: Reliable or measurement-based improvements were observed in global cognition, executive functioning, immediate and delayed verbal recall, total and cognitive functional independence, and mobility. Across the 20 neurofeedback sessions, the conservative primary analysis retained 9936 of 10,261 epochs and showed reduced theta activity, increased SMR and beta activity, increased SMR/theta, and reduced theta/total-beta. Resting-state EEG showed lower relative theta power and higher SMR, beta-1, and beta-2 power under both recording conditions. Connectivity changes included reduced theta and posterior alpha coupling together with increased SMR connectivity across fronto-central and parieto-occipital networks. Conclusions: Sensory-adapted EEG neurofeedback was feasible within an intensive multimodal rehabilitation program and was accompanied by concurrent cognitive, functional, and neurophysiological changes. Because of the single-case, uncontrolled, multimodal design, the findings cannot establish treatment-specific efficacy and should be considered hypothesis-generating.

relevance.reason: 单例报告脑膜瘤切除后听觉EEG神经反馈康复，报告认知改善及静息态EEG频谱与连接变化，涉及人脑认知与静息网络组织。
