papers.title: Distinct Nodal Centrality and Connectivity Profiles Underlying Independent and Interdependent Self-Construal: A Graph-Theoretical Resting-State fMRI Study.
papers.authors: Xiao Z, Xiao X, Lu J, Yang Z, Jia Y, Zheng Y.
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Self-construal-the extent to which the self is construed as autonomous from or connected with others-shapes cognition and social behavior, yet its system-level neural architecture remains poorly understood. This study examined whether independent and interdependent self-construal are associated with distinct patterns of nodal centrality and connectivity in the resting brain and whether these patterns covary with in-group favoritism. Methods Graph-theoretical analyses were applied to resting-state fMRI data from 67 college students. Degree centrality (DC) was the primary analysis; seed-based static functional connectivity (sFC) and dynamic functional connectivity variability (FCV) from DC-derived seeds served as exploratory follow-ups. In-group favoritism was assessed with a minimal-group point-allocation task. Results Independent self-construal was positively associated with DC in the left inferior occipital gyrus and right lingual gyrus; exploratory sFC linked these occipital seeds to frontal, temporal, and parietal regions, with greater exploratory FCV in their coupling with frontoparietal control areas. Interdependent self-construal was positively associated with DC in the medial prefrontal cortex and thalamus, with exploratory sFC to occipital, temporal, and insular regions but no significant FCV effects. The self-construal difference score yielded convergent DC results and was negatively associated with in-group favoritism; occipital-postcentral coupling was positively associated with in-group favoritism in an exploratory correlation. Conclusions Independent and interdependent self-construal are associated with distinct nodal centrality profiles, linking independence to occipital perceptual hubs and interdependence to medial prefrontal-thalamic hubs. Exploratory connectivity analyses extend these findings to the coupling of these hubs with distributed brain regions and to in-group favoritism.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fMRI图论分析考察自我建构（社会认知）的脑网络节点中心性与连接模式。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察独立型与互依型自我建构是否对应静息态脑网络中不同的节点中心性和连接模式，并对67名大学生进行图论分析，以度中心性为主，辅以种子点功能连接和动态连接变异性探索。结果显示，独立型自我建构与左侧枕下回和右侧舌回的度中心性正相关，互依型则与内侧前额叶和丘脑的度中心性正相关；探索性连接分析进一步将这些节点与额顶、颞、枕及岛叶等区域联系起来，且仅独立型相关节点表现出与额顶控制区的动态连接变异性。自我建构差异分数与度中心性结果一致，并与内群体偏好负相关，枕叶-中央后回耦合则在内群体偏好上呈探索性正相关。作者据此提出，独立型更偏向枕叶知觉枢纽，互依型更偏向内侧前额叶-丘脑枢纽，但连接与内群体偏好的关联仍属探索性，不能作因果解读。

papers.title: Metabolic dysfunction associates with neuroimaging measures of brain structure and connectivity.
papers.authors: Green ZD, O'Bryant SE, Johnson LA, Burns JM, Vidoni ED, Morris JK.
papers.abstract: Introduction Metabolic syndrome (MetS) and insulin resistance are established risk factors for Alzheimer's disease (AD) and have been linked to alterations in brain structure and function, including within the Default Mode Network (DMN). Methods Here, we examined associations between metabolic dysfunction, brain structure, and DMN functional connectivity using data from the Health and Aging Brain Study: Health Disparities (HABS-HD) cohort. Participants were classified as being cognitively unimpaired (CU; n = 1,045; mean age = 66.1 years; 65% female), or having mild cognitive impairment (MCI; n = 186; mean age = 66.5 years; 52% female) or dementia (n = 76; mean age = 69.0 years; 47% female). Results Across diagnostic groups, cortical thickness in AD-vulnerable regions varied by both cognitive status and HbA1c grouping, with the strongest effects observed in the CU cohort. HbA1c grouping was also associated with white matter microstructure, including stepwise reduc tions in fractional anisotropy of the anterior corona radiata across glycemic cat egories (normoglycemia > prediabetes > diabetes) in CU individuals. Functional connectivity of the posterior DMN (pDMN) showed main effects of both cognitive status and HbA1c grouping. Using a continuous index of cardiometabolic risk (MetS-Z), pDMN connectivity decreased linearly with increasing cardiometabolic burden in the CU cohort, whereas other DMN subnetworks exhibited positive associations with MetS-Z. Discussion These findings suggest network-specific associations between cardiometabolic risk and DMN organization that are detectable in indi viduals with MCI, a clinical state preceding dementia, as well as in some degree within cognitively unimpaired individuals. Longitudinal analyses are needed to determine whether metabolic dysfunction predicts divergent trajectories of DMN connectivity over time.

relevance.reason: 研究代谢异常与皮层厚度、白质微结构及默认网络功能连接的关联，属脑结构与功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于HABS-HD队列，考察代谢功能障碍与脑结构及默认模式网络功能连接之间的关联，并按认知状态分组比较。结果显示，在阿尔茨海默病易感脑区，皮层厚度随认知状态和糖化血红蛋白分组而变化，在认知未受损者中效应最明显；糖化血红蛋白分组也与白质微结构相关，认知未受损者的前放射冠各向异性随血糖状况恶化呈阶梯式下降。后部默认模式网络连接同时受认知状态和糖化血红蛋白分组影响，且在认知未受损者中，随着心血管代谢风险指数升高，该亚网络连接线性下降，而其他默认模式网络亚网络呈正向关联。作者据此提出，心血管代谢风险与默认模式网络组织之间存在网络特异性的关联，这种关联在轻度认知障碍阶段即可检出，在部分认知未受损者中也有一定体现；代谢功能障碍能否预测默认模式网络连接的长期分化轨迹，尚需纵向研究确认。

papers.title: How Meaning Shapes a Rule: Neural Signatures of Morphological Learning and Generalization
papers.authors: Azar M, Marantz A.
papers.abstract: Rule generalization is one of the most useful tools our mind uses to facilitate learning. In language, we apply it to connect what words mean to what they are made of, such as their suffixes. This is a morphosemantic relation, and it helps us process words we already know and easily acquire new words by composing their meaning. How is this relation acquired, and how does it manifest into generalization for understanding new words? In this study, we investigated the brain basis of these questions through an English-based artificial language study, where learners read sentences to learn a suffix-meaning relation of new words like “thinkle”. Words were either meaningful (places or things) or had no clear meaning. Each suffix family had majority and minority meaning words that participants had to keep track of for testing. For meaningful words in training, we found that higher performance scores predicted higher selective engagement in the left inferior frontal gyrus, specifically the pars triangularis and pars opercularis. In testing, both learned and generalized words, both increased lateral prefrontal cortex engagement. Meanwhile, words with no clear meaning had a much more diffuse brain engagement, recruiting bilateral temporoparietal regions. This resembles the processing of abstract words from previous literature. We found no difference between majority and minority meaning words, especially with the variance in participants’ performance strategies, but found differences in what predicted significant brain activity based on strategy difference. This study grounds itself in the reality of word and affixal semantics with previous research on language learning and universals. Ultimately, it lends a learning paradigm that resembles natural language learning across many languages to carefully investigate its brain basis, while addressing an understudied aspect of rule generalization: ambiguity.

relevance.reason: 研究人工语言中形态-语义规则学习与泛化的脑基础，报告左额下回等语言相关脑区活动。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用基于英语的人工语言学习任务，考察学习者如何习得词缀与词义之间的形态—语义关系，并将其推广到新词。结果显示，学习有明确意义的词时，成绩越好，左侧额下回（特别是三角部和岛盖部）的选择性参与越强；测试阶段，无论学过的词还是推广到的新词，都伴随外侧前额叶活动增强。而无明确意义的词则引发更弥散的脑活动，涉及双侧颞顶区域，作者认为这与以往抽象词加工的表现相似。研究未发现多数义与少数义词之间的差异，但提示不同学习策略对应不同的脑活动预测模式。作者据此强调，规则推广中的歧义问题值得进一步研究。

papers.title: The meaning and interpretation of ALFF and fALFF
papers.authors: Gore J, Lee T, Li M, Boschen WW, Schilling KG, Anderson AW, Ding Z, Gao Y.
papers.abstract: Abstract The amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (ALFF) and its fractional counterpart (fALFF) are widely reported measures of resting-state fMRI signals, but their precise physiological interpretation has not been established. We derive expressions for ALFF and fALFF using a closed-form hemodynamic transfer function which allows the resting-state BOLD spectrum to be expressed explicitly in terms of cerebral blood volume, venous transit time, oxygen extraction and the coupling between flow and oxygen consumption. We demonstrate that ALFF and fALFF do not reflect the same physiological phenomena. ALFF can be related to baseline metabolism via a power law, whereas fALFF is a bounded, saturating function that in practice largely reflects signal-to-noise ratio. fALFF is confined to lie between and , where is the fraction of the available signal bandwidth chosen for analysis and is the fraction of true BOLD signal power falling in it. Every reported fALFF value must lie between two bounds that are determined by the acquisition protocol as well as the hemodynamic response function. Both limits change with the acquisition parameters without changes in neural function, so, for example, fALFF is not comparable across studies that differ in repetition time or scan length. We evaluate the sensitivity of each measure to baseline metabolism, and show in an appendix that the alternative convention, in which Fourier amplitudes rather than powers are summed, gives different bounds and a stronger dependence on repetition time. We also examine how fALFF and ALFF behave when when signal fluctuations arise from fluctuations in vascular parameters without any accompanying metabolic change.

relevance.reason: 该文解析静息态fMRI的ALFF/fALFF生理意义，属于静息态自发活动信号机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对静息态fMRI中ALFF与fALFF的生理含义尚不明确这一问题，借助闭式血流动力学传递函数，将BOLD频谱与脑血容量、静脉通过时间、氧摄取及血流—氧耗耦合联系起来。分析表明两者反映的并非同一生理现象：ALFF可通过幂律与基线代谢相关，而fALFF是有界饱和函数，实际更多反映信噪比，且其取值受采集协议和血流动力学响应函数共同限定的上下界约束。作者据此指出，采集参数变化即可改变这些界限，因此重复时间或扫描时长不同的研究之间fALFF不可直接比较，并进一步考察了两项指标对基线代谢的敏感性及血管参数波动情形下的表现。

papers.title: Brain-inspired cascaded EEG speech decoding with conformal calibration and adaptive exit: simulation validation and five-stage real-data assessment
papers.authors: chen d.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Online EEG-based speech decoding faces dual challenges: limited computational resources for real-time deployment, and unreliable early-exit decisions when models underestimate their own errors (silent dropping of speech segments). Existing deep decoding models lack statistically rigorous uncertainty quantification, and the exchangeability assumption of conformal prediction— commonly used for calibration—is questionable for strongly auto-correlated neural signals. Systematic evidence on when and why conformal guarantees fail on real EEG, and whether online repair is feasible, remains scarce. New method We propose a brain-inspired three-tier cascaded decoding architecture (linear baseline → MLP residual corrections), equipped with pinball quantile error heads (τ = 0.75) for conservative error estimation, split-conformal temperature calibration with a block-wise variant to mitigate exchangeability violation, and an adaptive exit controller that decouples computational budget (ρ- quantile) from precision safety (κ· ˆe ≤ ϵ). For online distribution shifts, we implement Gibbs–Candès adaptive conformal inference (ACI) to dynamically adjust κ without relying on error-head quality. The framework is validated through simulation and a five-stage real-data assessment on OpenNeuro ds004279 (3 subjects, speech-perception EEG), plus an extended three-method cross-validation (temporal TRF, CCA lag scan, word-onset ERP permutation) to adjudicate millisecond-scale speech tracking. Results Simulation confirms conformal coverage at 84.5% (target 85%), exit rate anchored at 39.5%±0.6%, and 18 non-dominated Pareto solutions all outperforming the full-run baseline. On square-wave event labels, coverage remains 85.0% across four scenarios, and adaptive exit beats both full-run and baseline in 3/3 subjects. Switching to real audio envelopes increases label information 3.4-fold (|r| 0.057→0.194) but collapses coverage to 7–29%. Block-conformal root-cause analysis identifies six-fold κ drift across subjects, strongly coupled to error-head calibration failure. ACI repairs coverage to ∼99% in 2/3 subjects (including one with negative calibration correlation), while the remaining case is diagnosed as “uncalibratable” due to test-segment error-structure collapse, necessitating data-quality gating. Extended experiment shows that crude pipelines yield all-negative results from dual technical failures (drift artifact, ERD normalization failure); after official preprocessing alignment, word-boundary β/γ ERD emerges (group p = 0.028, 3/9 individual significant) and temporal CCA shows group significance (t = 5.24, p = 0.0004) despite individual r < 0.03, while band-power CCA significance (p = 0.0065) is falsified as segment-level coupling artifact. Comparison with existing methods Unlike conventional deep decoders (CNNs, LSTMs) and recent attention-based models that provide only point estimates without uncertainty bounds, our framework delivers distribution-free coverage guarantees via conformal calibration. The adaptive exit mechanism offers flexible speed-accuracy trade-offs absent in fixed-architecture models. Critically, ACI maintains validity even when error-head ranking fails—a property not achievable by static conformal approaches. Our five-stage negative-result trajectory (including coverage collapse and rootcause diagnosis) provides an applicability boundary map for conformal prediction on real neural data, which prior studies have not systematically documented. The extended three-method cross-validation further reveals that band-power CCA, commonly used in the literature, can produce false positives due to segment-level coupling, whereas temporal CCA and word-onset ERP provide more reliable group-level speech-tracking signals. Conclusions The proposed cascaded framework with conformal calibration and adaptive exit is validated both in simulation and real-EEG scenarios, with ACI effectively repairing coverage under distribution shifts. The deployable profile defaults to TRF linear regression + ACI + quality gating, with cascaded MLP reserved for high-signal-to-noise conditions. The extended experiment establishes a methodological baseline requiring full preprocessing-chain alignment, temporal features, and threemethod cross-validation for speech-tracking studies. All code and results are released open-source for reproducible research.

relevance.reason: 该研究基于真实人脑EEG进行语音解码并考察言语感知的神经追踪机制，属于语言与脑的电生理研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种受大脑启发的三级级联脑电解码架构，结合分位数误差头、分裂共形校准与自适应退出控制，并在仿真和OpenNeuro真实语音感知脑电数据上分五阶段检验其在线解码表现。仿真中校准覆盖率接近目标、自适应退出优于全程运行；但改用真实音频包络后标签信息增加而覆盖率骤降至7%–29%，块共形分析将原因指向误差头校准失败与受试间漂移，自适应共形推断可在多数受试者中修复覆盖率，剩余一例因测试段误差结构崩溃被判为不可校准，需数据质量门控。扩展交叉验证还提示常用频带功率CCA可能因分段耦合产生假阳性，而时间CCA与词起始事件相关电位提供更可靠的群体层面语音追踪信号，作者据此建议默认采用线性回归加自适应校准与质量门控的可部署方案。

papers.title: rTMS renews long-tract myelination to improve AD cognitive function predicted by baseline myelin and E-field
papers.authors: Zhu Z, Xu J, Wu N, Su Q, Zhu S, Jiang J, Zhang G, Wang L, Lin H.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Alzheimer's disease (AD) is more than a neuronal disease, as myelin damage actively drives its pathogenesis. Maintaining myelin integrity during aging may delay the progression of AD. Myelin repair is an emerging strategy for AD treatment; however, whether rTMS can drive myelin remodeling through neuronal excitation remains unclear. Methods AD patients received rTMS targeting the left DLPFC. Myelin-sensitive white matter measures were assessed pre- and post-treatment. Functional connectivity (FC) changes within and between the cognitive networks were evaluated. Baseline myelin characteristics and individualized E-field modeling were used to predict clinical response. Results rTMS increased myelin content (MyC) in several left-hemisphere white matter tracts, particularly the superior fronto-occipital fasciculus (SFOF), superior corona radiata, and cingulum (Cohen’s d = 0.59 ,0.57, 0.59, separately). These changes were associated with enhanced CEN-SN cross-network, interhemispheric CEN, and intra-CEN connectivity enhancements, contributing to clinical improvement (correlations between MOCA and MyC of SFOF_L (R = 0.56, p < 0.01)). Baseline MyC of SFOF-L and E-field jointly predicted post-treatment cognitive outcomes, with the strongest MoCA model explaining 44.4% of the adjusted variance and outperformed either metric alone. No direct correlation was found between myelin increase and E-field, highlighting the constraining role of structural reserve. Conclusions This study reveals a myelin-mediated mechanism of rTMS action in AD, demonstrating the potential of promoting myelination as a novel therapeutic strategy for alleviating AD-related cognitive impairment. These findings support individualized biological dosing combining E-field modeling and myelin features of key tracts to identify the E-field threshold that triggers myelin remodeling, replacing traditional physical dose measures.

relevance.reason: 该研究在AD患者中考察rTMS后白质髓鞘变化与认知网络连接及认知改善的关系，涉及脑结构支持功能及疾病脑可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）能否通过神经元兴奋驱动阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者的髓鞘重塑，对AD患者左侧背外侧前额叶施加rTMS，并结合髓鞘敏感的白质指标、认知网络功能连接及个体化电场建模进行分析。结果显示，rTMS提高了左侧半球多个白质束的髓鞘含量，这些变化与认知网络内及网络间连接的增强相关，并伴随认知改善；基线髓鞘特征与电场可共同预测治疗后认知结局，联合模型的解释力优于单一指标，但髓鞘增加与电场之间未见直接相关，提示结构储备的约束作用。作者据此提出，髓鞘介导可能是rTMS改善AD认知的机制之一，并支持将电场建模与关键白质束髓鞘特征结合用于个体化生物剂量设定。

papers.title: Thalamocortical correlates of sleep spindle and slow oscillation dysfunction in Lewy body disorders
papers.authors: Matar E, Anderson J, Churchill L, Konuri A, Ignatavicius A, Cho G, Lam A, Naismith S, D'Rozario A, Grunstein R, Lewis S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Sleep disturbances are pervasive in Lewy body disorders (LBD), but their neurophysiological basis remains unclear. Non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep offers an objective window into thalamocortical circuit function, minimally confounded by the motor and cognitive fluctuations of wake. Sleep spindles, slow oscillations (SOs) and their coupling reflect complementary aspects of this system, and may be differentially affected in LBD. We characterised NREM microarchitecture in 109 participants (55 controls, 32 Parkinson's disease [PD], 22 dementia with Lewy bodies [DLB]), quantifying spindle density and morphology, SOs, spindle–SO coupling and spectral power, and related these to thalamic volumes and cortical thickness in the 77 participants with MRI, adjusting for age and sex. Macroarchitecture was broadly similar between groups. Slow and fast spindle densities were reduced in LBD and lowest in DLB (all p FDR <0.05), with PD reductions more prominent for fast spindles. Additionally, DLB showed reduced central and occipital SO density (p FDR ≤0.018), altered slow spindle–SO coupling, and increased frontal beta power (p FDR =0.004). Within LBD, reduced thalamic volume was associated with lower spindle density and weaker slow spindle–SO coupling. These dissociable abnormalities of spindle generation and thalamocortical coordination support sleep EEG as an accessible physiological readout of circuit dysfunction in LBD.

relevance.reason: 研究Lewy体病患者睡眠纺锤波/慢振荡与丘脑体积、皮层厚度的关系，揭示丘脑皮层环路功能障碍，属脑疾病认知/脑网络机制与结构-功能关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注路易体谱系疾病（包括帕金森病和路易体痴呆）中睡眠纺锤波与慢振荡异常及其丘脑皮层基础，对参与者进行非快速眼动睡眠脑电微结构分析，并结合丘脑体积和皮层厚度测量。结果发现各组睡眠宏观结构大致相似，但路易体谱系疾病患者睡眠纺锤波密度降低，路易体痴呆最明显，且其慢振荡密度、纺锤波-慢振荡耦合及额区beta功率也出现改变；在患者中，丘脑体积较小与纺锤波密度较低和耦合较弱相关。作者认为，这些可分离的异常提示睡眠脑电或可作为反映路易体谱系疾病丘脑皮层环路功能障碍的生理指标，但相关发现尚不能说明因果关系或临床效用。

papers.title: High-frequency stimulation-induced secondary hyperalgesia shifts temporal order judgment and increases precuneus nodal degree in healthy adults.
papers.authors: Morikawa Y, Osumi M.
papers.abstract: Pain can influence attention and other higher-order cognitive processes. In experimental settings, acute pain has been linked to attentional prioritization of the painful body region. However, conventional experimental pain models often rely on brief, phasic nociceptive stimuli and are therefore less suited to examining spatial attention during a sustained, experimentally induced sensitized state. In this study, we examined whether high-frequency stimulation (HFS)-induced secondary hyperalgesia, as a model of acute experimental sensitization, was associated with changes in temporal order judgment (TOJ) and resting-state EEG-derived measures in healthy adults. Sixteen healthy adults (mean age, 28.5 years; seven women) underwent HFS of the forearm to induce secondary hyperalgesia. Spatial attention was assessed using a TOJ task, and resting-state EEG data were analyzed using source-level graph-theoretical measures. HFS increased pinprick pain sensitivity in the surrounding skin adjacent to the stimulation site. TOJ performance showed a significant shift in the point of subjective simultaneity (PSS) toward the HFS-treated side, indicating an attentional bias independent of subjective pain intensity. EEG analysis revealed a significant increase in nodal degree in the bilateral precuneus in the theta band, and this change was positively correlated with the PSS shift (ρ = 0.53, p = 0.036). These findings suggest that both behavioral attentional bias and short-term changes in resting-state EEG-derived measures can accompany acute experimentally induced sensitization. The present results should be interpreted within the scope of the HFS model as reflecting short-term modulation during an acute sensitized state rather than chronic pain-like reorganization.

relevance.reason: 研究实验性致敏状态下空间注意的时间顺序判断偏移及静息态EEG楔前叶节点度变化，属注意与静息脑网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在健康成人中考察高频电刺激诱发的继发性痛觉过敏是否伴随时间顺序判断和静息态脑电指标的变化，以探索持续敏化状态下空间注意的改变。结果显示，刺激提高了刺激部位周围皮肤的针刺痛敏，时间顺序判断的主观同时点向受刺激侧偏移，提示注意偏向，且这一偏移与主观疼痛强度无关；同时，双侧楔前叶theta频段的节点度升高，并与该偏移呈正相关。作者据此认为，急性实验性敏化可同时伴随行为层面的注意偏向和静息态脑电指标的短期改变，但强调这些结果限于高频刺激模型下的短期调制，不能等同于慢性疼痛样的重组。

papers.title: Role of the left intraparietal sulcus in the comprehension of action intensity described in sentences.
papers.authors: Shibata H, Takahashi K, Niida M, Ogawa K.
papers.abstract: From an embodied cognition perspective, semantic processing is assumed to involve sensorimotor representations. The present study used functional magnetic resonance imaging to investigate whether comprehension of action intensity described in sentences is associated with neural representations shared with action execution, particularly those related to grip force. In the execution task, participants gripped their right hand with either high or low force. In the language task, participants evaluated the action intensity described in the sentences. We examined four regions of interest (ROIs): the left primary somatosensory cortex, left primary motor cortex, left dorsal premotor cortex, and the left intraparietal sulcus (LIPS). Multivoxel pattern analysis was used to assess whether intensity information could be decoded within and across tasks. In the execution task, intensity differences were reliably decoded from multivoxel activity patterns across all four regions. In the language task, significant decoding of intensity was observed only in the LIPS. Cross-classification between the execution and language tasks did not reach significance in the primary analysis across the four regions and was associated with low effect sizes. However, exploratory analyses using smaller ROIs revealed significant cross-decoding and moderate effect sizes in the LIPS. These findings suggest that the comprehension of action intensity is associated with higher-level intensity-related representations rather than with neural representations that are closely tied to low-level motor execution. Overall, the results do not support strong embodied accounts, which assume the direct reinstatement of low-level motor execution processes during language comprehension. However, these findings suggest that partially shared higher-level representations of intensity may exist between action execution and language processing.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI解码句子中动作强度的语义加工，涉及左顶内沟等脑区，属语言语义与感觉运动表征的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能磁共振成像考察句子中动作强度的理解是否与动作执行共享神经表征，参与者分别完成握力执行任务和句子动作强度判断任务，并对四个感兴趣区做多体素模式分析。结果发现，执行任务中四个区域都能可靠解码强度差异，而语言任务中只有左侧顶内沟显著解码；执行与语言任务的交叉分类在主分析中未达显著，仅在左侧顶内沟的探索性小区域分析中出现显著交叉解码。作者据此认为，动作强度理解更多关联较高级的强度表征，而非与低级运动执行紧密相连的表征，因此结果不支持语言理解直接重现低级运动过程的强具身观点，但提示执行与语言之间可能存在部分共享的高级强度表征。

papers.title: Distinct Thalamostriatal Functional Network Dysregulation in Comorbid Insomnia and Sleep Apnea.
papers.authors: Kim D, Kim S, Kim E, Kim S, Joo EY.
papers.abstract: Study objectives Comorbid insomnia and sleep apnea (COMISA) is a prevalent and clinically challenging phenotype, yet the neural substrates distinguishing it from isolated obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) remain elusive. We employed a multimodal graph theoretical approach to identify the structural and functional network patterns associated with the COMISA phenotype. Methods We analyzed 124 male participants (45 controls, 58 OSA, and 21 COMISA). Structural covariance networks were derived from regional gray matter volume data, and functional networks from resting-state fMRI. Graph metrics-including strength, clustering coefficient (CC), efficiency, and closeness centrality (CloC)-were quantified for weighted, undirected networks to assess global and nodal topological properties. Results Functional network analysis revealed significant global hyper-connectivity in both patient groups compared to controls. Crucially, COMISA demonstrated a distinct functional pattern compared to OSA, characterized by significantly elevated nodal metrics (CC and CloC) within thalamostriatal circuits, specifically involving the bilateral thalamus and putamen. Exploratory analyses across the cohort suggested possible positive associations between these nodal metrics and the severity of insomnia and depressive symptoms. In contrast, structural covariance networks showed no significant group differences, indicating a dissociation between the two modalities. Conclusions Our findings suggest that COMISA presents a distinct functional pattern, which is consistent with circuit-level dysregulation, specifically within the thalamostriatal axis. This subcortical pattern within arousal-modulating circuits offers a potential pathophysiological explanation for the clinical complexity and treatment resistance frequently observed in COMISA.

relevance.reason: 以静息态fMRI和图论分析比较COMISA与OSA患者丘脑纹状体功能网络拓扑改变，涉及睡眠/觉醒相关脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注失眠与睡眠呼吸暂停共病（COMISA）区别于单纯阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）的神经基础，对男性参与者比较了基于灰质体积的结构协方差网络与静息态功能网络的多模态图论指标。结果显示，两类患者的功能网络均表现出整体连接增强，而COMISA在丘脑-纹状体环路（双侧丘脑和壳核）的节点指标进一步升高，形成区别于OSA的功能模式；结构协方差网络则未见组间差异，提示两种模态间的分离。探索性分析提示这些节点指标可能与失眠和抑郁症状的严重程度存在正相关，但该关联尚属初步。作者据此提出，COMISA可能对应丘脑-纹状体轴这一觉醒调节环路的功能失调，为理解其临床复杂性和治疗抵抗提供了可能的病理生理解释。

papers.title: Independent basal ganglia neural populations encode speech production and ambient-noise levels.
papers.authors: Bullock L, Vissani M, Bush A, Kim JS, Holt LL, Fiez J, Turner RS, Herrington TM, Schweitzer JS, Guenther FH, Richardson RM.
papers.abstract: The basal ganglia's (BG) contribution to motor control is thought to involve invigorating movement based on environmental constraints, yet this has primarily been studied in the limb system. We hypothesized that the BG similarly regulate the respiratory and articulatory systems during speech. We recorded local field potentials and single-unit activity from the subthalamic nucleus (STN) and globus pallidus (GP) in humans during a speech task where the Lombard Effect was used to modulate environmental constraints. GP and STN exhibited distinct temporal profiles during speech production. Neither region robustly encoded produced speech intensity. Instead, neural populations tracked ambient background noise levels, even during baseline, with high decoding accuracy. The ambient-noise-modulated sites were an independent population from speech-modulated sites. We theorize that the code is leveraged in downstream BG-cortical loop nodes to invigorate speech oro-motor gestures and co-speech manual limb gestures, both of which respond to ambient noise levels to maintain high-fidelity communication.

relevance.reason: 人类基底节颅内电生理记录揭示言语产出与背景噪声的独立神经群体编码。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注基底神经节在言语产生中是否像在肢体运动中那样依据环境约束调节运动，为此在人类执行言语任务时记录了丘脑底核与苍白球的局部场电位和单细胞活动，并用Lombard效应改变环境噪声条件。结果显示，两个区域在言语产生时呈现不同的时间活动模式，但都未稳健编码实际说出的语音强度；相反，神经群体追踪环境背景噪声水平，即使在基线阶段也能以较高准确度解码。受环境噪声调制的位点与受言语调制的位点属于相互独立的群体。作者据此推测，这一噪声相关编码可能被下游的基底神经节—皮层环路节点用来增强言语口部运动以及伴随言语的手部动作，从而在噪声环境中维持有效交流。

papers.title: MRI-guided navigated TMS protocol for language production lateralization in right- and left-handed individuals.
papers.authors: Cano-Melle C, Lluesma-Martín M, Narganes-Pineda C, Ramírez-Guerrero JJ, Chica AB, Avila C.
papers.abstract: Hemispheric language lateralization has been assessed using various neuroimaging techniques in both basic research and clinical settings. The use of transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) for this purpose, however, has shown low to moderate concordance with other neuroimaging techniques, particularly in cases of atypical lateralization and when studying the right hemisphere. The present study aimed to develop an MRI-guided navigated TMS protocol based on a verb-generation task to identify optimal conditions for determining language lateralization. Thirty healthy participants were classified into three groups according to hemispheric dominance during the verb-generation task: right-handers with left-hemisphere dominance, left-handers with left-hemisphere dominance, and left-handers with right-hemisphere dominance. TMS was applied at four predetermined locations within the inferior frontal gyrus while participants performed a picture-based verb generation task outside the scanner. Results showed a larger proportion of error responses when TMS was applied to the dominant language hemisphere, as defined by fMRI, across all groups. Concordance values between fMRI and TMS language lateralization ranged from 89 % to 100 %. Naming times were slower when the dominant hemisphere was stimulated, but only in the left-handed group. Trials more likely to induce TMS-related errors were characterized by longer reaction times, a greater number of response options, lower word frequency, and the absence of a clearly dominant response. These findings support the reliability of the proposed navigated TMS protocol for individual-level assessment of language lateralization during verb generation task as well as identify task-related conditions that increase the likelihood of verbal errors following TMS interference.

relevance.reason: 用MRI导航TMS结合动词生成任务评估健康人语言偏侧化，属语言功能的脑组织与偏侧化研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在开发一套基于动词生成任务的MRI引导导航TMS方案，以确定判断语言偏侧化的适宜条件，并在健康右利手和左利手个体中检验其与fMRI结果的一致性。结果显示，无论哪一组，当TMS作用于fMRI判定的优势语言半球时，错误反应比例都更高，两种方法的一致性较高；刺激优势半球后命名变慢主要见于左利手组。研究还发现，反应时较长、可选答案较多、词频较低且缺乏明显优势反应的试次更容易出现TMS相关错误。作者认为，该方案有望用于个体水平的语言偏侧化评估，同时提示任务特征会影响干扰后言语错误的发生。

papers.title: Perturbational signature of the somato-cognitive action network in human primary motor cortex.
papers.authors: Mancuso M, Maccarrone D, Ruocco G, Collura A, Pellegrini S, Spampinato D, Belvisi D, Berardelli A, Conte A, Leodori G.
papers.abstract: Introduction Functional-MRI evidence recently identified inter-effector regions in the primary motor cortex that show preferential connectivity with the action mode network (AMN), constituting the somato-cognitive action network (SCAN). Direct causal evidence for the functional engagement of these regions remains limited. Aim Here, we investigated the perturbational neural response of one inter-effector region using transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with electroencephalography (TMS-EEG). Methods Sixteen healthy participants underwent recording of transcranial evoked potentials from the first dorsal interosseus, tibialis anterior, and the inter-effector region between them, which was identified with TMS motor mapping. Results Differences between conditions were assessed using cluster-based permutation testing and general linear modeling. Inter-effector-specific TMS-EEG activity was observed at approximately 42 ms post-stimulation, partially involving regions of the AMN. Discussion and conclusion Our findings provide the first perturbational characterization of inter-effector regions in human M1 and identify TMS-EEG markers that enable probing of SCAN functional organization.

relevance.reason: 用TMS-EEG研究人初级运动皮层inter-effector区及SCAN网络的功能组织，属认知相关脑网络与结构功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注初级运动皮层中与动作模式网络相连的“效应器间”区域（构成躯体-认知动作网络，SCAN）是否具有直接的因果性功能参与，此前证据主要来自功能磁共振连接分析。作者对健康参与者采用经颅磁刺激结合脑电，比较刺激手部、腿部代表区与效应器间区域所诱发的皮层反应。结果显示，刺激效应器间区域后约42毫秒出现该区域特异的脑电活动，并部分涉及动作模式网络相关区域。作者据此认为，这是对人初级运动皮层效应器间区域的首次扰动性刻画，并提出了可用于探测SCAN功能组织的TMS-EEG标记；但研究规模有限，这些标记的适用性和临床意义尚待进一步验证。

papers.title: Resting-state EEG dissociates heartbeat counting from heart-rate discrimination: Cortical signal entropy tracks counting accuracy, default-mode connectivity tracks exteroceptive discrimination.
papers.authors: Kang JC, Park HJ, Yoon H.
papers.abstract: Bidirectional communication between the heart and the brain shapes emotion, self-regulation, and adaptive behaviour, yet how the brain's intrinsic organisation supports cardiac interoception remains unclear. Two assays dominate the literature - heartbeat counting (HBC) and heart-rate discrimination (HRD) - but whether they engage separable resting-brain networks at high spatial density is untested. We analysed 256-channel resting EEG from 47 healthy adults (5 min eyes-open, 5 min eyes-closed) with the Schandry HBC task (Schandry, 1981; Garfinkel et al., 2015) and the psychophysical HRD task (Legrand et al., 2022), which includes a tone-versus-tone exteroceptive control block. Source-space connectivity was evaluated with the network-based statistic (NBS), complemented by modified multi-scale sample entropy. HBC accuracy was unrelated to HRD sensitivity in either modality (d', slope), though it covaried with the HRD interoceptive threshold, which indexes bias rather than precision (ρ= +0.41, p = .004), a parameter that indexes bias rather than precision. Entropy yielded the most robust association: higher eyes-closed source-space sample entropy co-occurred with better HBC accuracy across a broad multi-network cortical mantle (50 of 100 parcels at q<0.05); no other behaviour produced an FDR-significant parcel. This entropy-accuracy association survived adjustment for alpha power and the aperiodic (1/f) exponent, and all headline associations were unchanged after controlling pulse-derived heart rate and heart-rate variability and after excluding reversed responders identified by influence diagnostics. NBS returned four family-wise-significant subnetworks. Three were anchored on default-mode parcels but tracked d' in the exteroceptive rather than the interoceptive block; the fourth, a disjoint theta-band dorsal-attention-somatosensory cluster, tracked HBC awareness. Because 128 NBS families were screened and the reported clusters re-test a pre-selected subset of them, the yield of significant clusters does not clearly exceed chance expectation; the connectivity results are therefore reported as hypothesis-generating. The findings support a behavioural and neural dissociation between HBC and HRD and caution against pooling them as interchangeable indices of interoceptive accuracy.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态EEG网络组织与心跳内感受准确性/辨别的关系，属静息态脑网络与内感受认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析健康成人静息态高密度脑电，考察心跳计数与心率辨别两种内感受任务是否依赖可分离的静息脑网络。行为上，心跳计数准确性与心率辨别敏感性不相关，仅与后者中反映偏差而非精度的内感受阈值共变。最稳健的神经关联是闭眼时皮层信号熵越高、心跳计数越准确，且该关联在控制多种生理与信号因素后仍存在；连接性分析得到的显著子网络主要涉及默认网络等，但作者指出这些结果可能未明显超出随机预期，仅作假设生成。研究据此支持两种任务在行为与神经上的分离，并提醒不宜将其混为内感受准确性的等价指标。

papers.title: Disrupted interhemispheric functional connectivity between the bilateral precentral gyri and associated transcriptomic signatures in acute basal ganglia ischemic stroke.
papers.authors: Jiang X, Lu S, Liu Y, Lu Q, Huang Y, Liu J, Liang Z.
papers.abstract: Acute basal ganglia ischemic stroke (BGIS) often leads to motor dysfunction, but the mechanisms of functional reorganization, particularly the underlying molecular basis, remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the local and global functional reorganization patterns and their molecular correlates in acute BGIS. Resting-state fMRI data were acquired from 59 patients with acute BGIS and 35 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HCs). Regional homogeneity (ReHo) and seed-based functional connectivity (FC) analyses were used to assess local and global brain connectivity, respectively. We identified a key classification feature using support vector machine (SVM) and logistic regression (LR) models combined with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis, which was then spatially associated with Allen Human Brain Atlas (AHBA) transcriptomic data via partial least squares (PLS) regression, followed by functional enrichment analysis. Compared with HCs, BGIS patients demonstrated decreased ReHo in the bilateral precentral gyri, along with reduced interhemispheric FC between these two regions. The SVM and LR models effectively distinguished patients from HCs (AUCs = 0.877 and 0.868, respectively), with SHAP analysis identifying this reduced interhemispheric FC as the top discriminative feature. This key FC feature further showed a positive correlation with motor function. Genes spatially associated with this feature were enriched in synaptic function, ion transport, and energy metabolism. These findings highlight impaired interhemispheric FC between the bilateral precentral gyri and its associated transcriptomic signatures in acute BGIS, providing insights into the neurobiological basis of post-stroke motor dysfunction.

relevance.reason: 急性基底节卒中患者静息态fMRI显示双侧中央前回间半球功能连接降低并与运动功能相关，属卒中后脑功能重组与认知运动机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注急性基底节区缺血性卒中后脑功能重组及其分子基础，比较患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振指标，并结合机器学习分类与转录组数据关联分析。结果显示，患者双侧中央前回局部一致性下降，两区间半球间功能连接减弱，且该连接特征对区分患者与对照贡献最大，并与运动功能呈正相关；与之空间相关的基因主要富集于突触功能、离子转运和能量代谢。作者据此提示，双侧中央前回间半球连接受损及其转录组特征可能参与卒中后运动功能障碍的神经生物学基础，但相关发现尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Differential cross-modal functional plasticity in deaf individuals: A meta-analysis of neuroimaging studies.
papers.authors: Zuo X, Li G, Wang Z, Peng P, Dong C, Wang S.
papers.abstract: A manifest condition of brain plasticity is cross-modal plasticity in deafness, wherein auditory-deprived cortices are recruited by intact sensory modalities. While cross-modal plasticity is well documented, the underlying principles remain debated, centering on the functional change and functional preservation principles. To quantitatively evaluate these principles, we conducted the largest coordinate-based meta-analysis to date, synthesizing 47 studies (801 deaf and 880 hearing participants) spanning linguistic and non-linguistic tasks. Deaf individuals exhibited consistent cross-modal activation in the bilateral superior temporal gyrus (STG). The left anterior STG was selectively recruited during linguistic tasks, consistent with preserved language function, whereas the left posterior and right STG were engaged across both task types, suggesting a shift toward domain-general visual processing. Cross-modal activation was lateralized, with linguistic tasks engaging the left STG and non-linguistic tasks the right. These findings support a differential cross-modal plasticity framework, wherein functional preservation and change coexist across distinct STG subregions.

relevance.reason: 该元分析综合脑成像研究，揭示失聪者颞上回跨模态激活的任务依赖性偏侧化，涉及语言功能保留与一般视觉加工重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该元分析整合了聋人与听力正常者在语言和非语言任务中的脑成像研究，旨在检验跨模态可塑性究竟体现功能改变还是功能保留。结果显示，聋人在双侧颞上回出现一致的跨模态激活：左侧前部颞上回仅在语言任务中被募集，符合语言功能保留；而左侧后部与右侧颞上回在两类任务中均被激活，提示其转向领域一般的视觉加工。激活还表现出偏侧化，语言任务偏左、非语言任务偏右。作者据此提出差异化跨模态可塑性框架，认为功能保留与功能改变可在颞上回不同亚区并存。

papers.title: Anxiety and self-control mediate the association between sleep quality and procrastination: Behavioral and neural evidence.
papers.authors: Zhuang X, Zhang X, Yin Y, Su T, Xu T, Feng T.
papers.journal: International journal of psychophysiology : official journal of the International Organization of Psychophysiology
papers.abstract: Poor sleep quality is a prevalent issue linked to higher procrastination, which not only impairs academic and work functioning but also adversely affects mental and physical health. However, the psychological and neural basis underlying this association remain unclear. In this study, 1163 participants were initially assessed with self-report measures of sleep quality, procrastination, anxiety, and self-control and resting-state fMRI to examine the behavioral and neural correlates of the association between sleep quality and procrastination. After questionnaire and MRI quality control, 1079 participants were included in the final analyses. Elastic net regression revealed distinct functional connectivity patterns centered on the default mode network and prefrontal control regions, including the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, medial prefrontal cortex, and anterior cingulate cortex, which significantly predicted poorer sleep quality. Furthermore, parallel mediation analyses indicated that anxiety and self-control statistically mediated the association between sleep quality and procrastination, and that composite brain network strength also showed an indirect association with procrastination involving these same behavioral pathways. Integrating these behavioral and neuroimaging findings, our results indicate that poor sleep quality is associated with atypical patterns of connectivity within prefrontal and default mode systems, which may be consistent with the proposed role of diminished psychological resources in emotion regulation and executive control. Guided by the conservation of resources model, this multi-level framework provides an integrated perspective on the psychological and neural basis of the relationship between sleep quality and procrastination, thereby providing potentially relevant directions for future intervention research.

relevance.reason: 用静息态fMRI考察睡眠质量与拖延关联的脑功能连接基础，涉及前额控制与默认网络及焦虑/自控中介，属认知与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察睡眠质量与拖延行为关联背后的心理和神经基础，对千余名参与者施测睡眠质量、拖延、焦虑与自我控制问卷并采集静息态功能磁共振数据。弹性网回归显示，以默认模式网络和前额控制区（含背外侧前额叶、内侧前额叶和前扣带）为中心的功能连接模式能预测较差的睡眠质量；平行中介分析则表明，焦虑和自我控制从统计上中介了睡眠质量与拖延的关联，复合脑网络强度也经同样的行为路径与拖延存在间接关联。作者据此提出，睡眠质量差与 prefrontal 及默认模式系统内的非典型连接模式相关，这可能与情绪调节和执行控制所需心理资源下降相符，并在资源保存模型下构建了多层次解释框架。需注意这些结果来自横断面关联与中介分析，不能据此推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Sex differences in the associations between symptom severity, social cognition, and connectivity between default mode sub-networks in alcohol use disorder.
papers.authors: Cohen-Gilbert JE, Waters A, Chernyak S, Janes AC, Killgore WDS, Greenfield SF, Silveri MM, Nickerson LD.
papers.abstract: Background The default mode network (DMN) fractionates into well-established sub-networks that play pivotal roles in social cognition. Prefrontal nodes of DMN sub-networks are vulnerable to alcohol neurotoxicity, which may impair social function in individuals with alcohol use disorder (AUD). The current study examines interacting effects of AUD and sex on the relationship between social cognition and connectivity between DMN sub-networks. Methods Matched groups of males and females without (matched control: MC) and with (AUD) a lifetime diagnosis of AUD (N = 156; n = 39/group) were selected from the Human Connectome Project. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data (~58min/participant) were used to compute functional connectivity between four DMN sub-networks: anterior dorsomedial (aDMN), ventromedial (vmDMN), medial temporal lobe (mtlDMN), and posterior (pDMN). Interacting effects of sex, AUD diagnosis/symptoms, and composite social cognition scores on between-network connectivity were assessed via non-parametric permutation testing. Results Connectivity between aDMN-mtlDMN (AUDcor =.016) and vmDMN-pDMN (AUD>MC, pcor =.030) differed between AUD and MC. Social cognition was associated with aDMN-vmDMN connectivity (pcor =.003), with the relationship being moderated by sex, AUD-status and severity; males and females with mild AUD showed associations between aDMN-vmDMN connectivity and social cognition that were opposite to their matched counterparts. In individuals with greater symptom severity, associations between connectivity and social cognition were absent. Conclusion This study provides evidence for possible network connectivity-based mechanisms underpinning social cognition alterations in males and females with AUD. Findings show significant sex differences in these potential vulnerabilities, emerging at mild-to-moderate symptom severity, suggesting sex-specific treatment considerations are warranted.

relevance.reason: 研究酒精使用障碍男女患者静息态默认网络亚网络连接与社会认知的关联，涉及脑网络组织与疾病相关认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于人类连接组计划中无酒精使用障碍（AUD）与有AUD终生诊断的男女匹配组，用静息态功能磁共振计算默认网络四个子网络间的功能连接，考察性别、AUD诊断及症状严重程度与社会认知如何共同影响这些连接。结果显示，AUD组与对照组在部分子网络连接上存在差异；社会认知与特定子网络连接相关，且这一关系受性别、AUD状态和严重程度调节，轻症男女AUD者的关联方向与各自匹配对照相反，症状较重者则未见该关联。作者据此提出，这些连接模式可能是男女AUD者社会认知改变的潜在机制，且性别差异在轻中度症状时已出现，提示治疗考虑需区分性别。

papers.title: Decoding the time course of intonation planning.
papers.authors: Erden H, Chen Y, Meyer AS, van der Burght CL.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: The temporal relationship between sentence-level intonation planning and word-level phonological encoding remains poorly understood. Prosody-first accounts predict that an abstract intonation frame is established before lexical information is retrieved, whereas prosody-last accounts predict that intonation is encoded after lexical information. The present study used EEG combined with time-resolved multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) to investigate when intonation planning occurs relative to other levels of linguistic encoding during spoken word production. Thirty native Dutch speakers named pictures of simple nouns using two different intonation contours, as either questions or exclamations. The target words were disyllabic Dutch nouns that varied in animacy, lexical stress, and manner and place of articulation of the first phoneme. Intonation became decodable after animacy and around the same time as place of articulation. Exploratory analyses revealed that intonation decoding emerged earlier for words with word-final than word-initial stress, suggesting that the temporal profile of intonation planning is shaped by the word's stress pattern. On a methodological level, these findings demonstrate that intonation planning is neurally decodable in an overt production context using EEG. The implications for theories of language production are that sentence-level and word-level prosody closely interact and evolve together during planning rather than being encoded independently.

relevance.reason: 用EEG解码言语产出中语调规划的时间进程，直接研究语言产出与韵律编码的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注句子层面的语调规划相对于词汇层面语音编码发生在何时，以检验“语调先行”与“语调在后”两种理论预测。研究者让母语为荷兰语的被试在看图说出双音节名词时分别使用疑问句和感叹句两种语调，并用脑电结合时间分辨的多变量模式分析追踪语调信息的可解码时程。结果显示，语调信息在生命性信息之后才可解码，与首音素发音部位的时间大致相当；探索性分析还提示，词末重音词的语调解码早于词首重音词，说明语调规划的时间进程受词的轻重音模式影响。作者据此认为，句子层面与词汇层面的韵律在规划中密切互动、共同展开，而非彼此独立编码，并指出该范式可在实际发声情境中用脑电追踪语调规划。

papers.title: RAAS/HPA axis abnormalities and hypothalamic connectivity in hypertension: A multimodal MRI study.
papers.authors: Huang RR, Lu JJ, Li JH, Ma J, Wu JJ, Jin J, Li JL, Meng FL, Fu DY, Hua XY, Xu JG.
papers.abstract: Background Hypertension is associated with brain remodeling and an increased risk of cognitive impairment. Although endocrine hormones play a central role in blood pressure regulation, how endocrine abnormalities are associated with brain network reorganization and cognitive function in hypertensive populations remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate whether renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) and hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis abnormalities are associated with distinct multimodal brain alterations and cognitive profiles in hypertension. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 47 hypertensive adults underwent endocrine profiling, neuropsychological assessment, and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) and T1-weighted structural MRI on a 3.0 T scanner. Image analyses included amplitude of Low-Frequency Fluctuations (ALFF), Voxel-based Morphometry (VBM), and hypothalamic seed-based Functional Connectivity (FC). Based on plasma levels of angiotensin II (Ang II), adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), and aldosterone (ALD), patients were classified as endocrine-abnormal hypertension (EH; n = 20) or non-endocrine hypertension (NEH; n = 27). Group differences and endocrine-imaging associations were examined. Results Compared with the NEH group, the EH group showed poorer performance on memory and language measures. The EH group also showed reduced ALFF in frontal regions and increased ALFF in the cerebellum, together with reduced gray matter volume in posterior cortical regions. Hypothalamic seed-to-voxel FC was reduced in the EH group with frontal, temporal, and occipital cortical regions and increased with cerebellar regions. In whole-sample analyses, hypothalamic-vermal connectivity was negatively associated with global cognition and language performance, cerebellar ALFF was negatively associated with episodic memory performance, and right superior frontal gyrus ALFF was negatively associated with circulating ALD levels. Conclusions Endocrine abnormalities in hypertension are associated with a distinct pattern of brain alterations characterized by prefrontal hypofunction, posterior cortical gray matter reductions, and altered hypothalamic-cortical and hypothalamic-cerebellar connectivity, accompanied by poorer performance on memory and language measures. These findings suggest that hypertensive patients with endocrine abnormalities may represent a subgroup with greater brain and cognitive vulnerability.

relevance.reason: 该研究以高血压患者为对象，用静息态fMRI和结构MRI考察下丘脑连接、灰质体积与记忆/语言表现的关系，涉及脑网络组织与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该横断面研究考察高血压患者中肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统与下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴异常是否与不同的多模态脑改变和认知表现相关，47名高血压成人接受了内分泌检测、神经心理评估及静息态功能与结构MRI，并按激素水平分为内分泌异常组和非内分泌异常组。结果显示，内分泌异常组在记忆和语言测验上表现更差，并呈现额叶自发活动降低、小脑活动升高、后部皮层灰质体积减小，以及下丘脑与额颞枕皮层连接减弱、与小脑连接增强的模式。全样本分析中，下丘脑与小脑蚓部连接、小脑活动及右侧额上回活动分别与整体认知和语言、情景记忆及醛固酮水平呈负相关。作者据此提出，伴内分泌异常的高血压患者可能是脑与认知易感性更高的亚组，但横断面关联不能说明因果。

papers.title: Women's Brain Health in the Era of Precision Neuroimaging.
papers.authors: Murata EM, Grotzinger H, Martínez-García M, Heller C, Carmona S, Shanmugan S, Pritschet L, Jacobs EG.
papers.abstract: The mammalian brain is dynamically shaped by endocrine rhythms, yet the field of human neuroscience has historically studied the brain in isolation from these biological signals. This review synthesizes evidence from dense-sampling studies that probe endocrine-nervous system coupling over major steroid hormone transitions, including the menstrual cycle and pregnancy. We highlight ways in which precision imaging may be uniquely equipped to elucidate the neurobiological underpinnings of why hormonal transition periods are major inflection points for the emergence of mood disorders. Dense-sampling designs are also poised to resolve major gaps in our basic understanding of brain-hormone coupling during the onset and cessation of reproductive function. The next era of precision neuroimaging will benefit from integrating dense-sampling approaches over hormonal transitions with personalized functional mapping methods to resolve how hormone rhythms shape individual-specific brain organization, laying the foundation for precise models of women's brain health across the lifespan.

papers.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦人类神经科学长期将大脑与内分泌信号割裂研究的问题，梳理了密集采样研究在月经周期和妊娠等主要类固醇激素转变期探测内分泌—神经系统耦合的证据。作者指出，激素转变期是心境障碍出现的关键节点，而精准影像有望揭示其神经生物学基础；密集采样设计也有助于弥补对生殖功能启动与停止期间脑—激素耦合基本认识的不足。文章提出，未来精准神经影像应将激素转变期的密集采样与个体化功能映射相结合，以解析激素节律如何塑造个体特异性的脑组织，为跨生命周期的女性脑健康精准模型奠定基础。

papers.title: A shared EEG signal for the maintenance of visually and linguistically evoked objects: theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling.
papers.authors: Leong W, Altmann GTM.
papers.abstract: How do our brains represent events in language? Recent work has shown that when we comprehend state-change events, multiple representations corresponding to different states of an object are simultaneously activated. As the sentence unfolds and the object is cued for retrieval, areas of the brain associated with representational conflict show greater activation in proportion to how dissimilar the object-states are to each other. Before being retrieved, however, these object-states have to be actively maintained in the brain. What are the neural mechanisms by which we do so? Across two EEG experiments, we present evidence that, during sentence processing, the maintenance of multiple object-states in state-change events is supported by a neural signal that has been frequently linked to visual working memory: left temporal theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling.

relevance.reason: EEG研究揭示句子理解中维持多个客体状态的theta-gamma耦合机制，涉及语言加工与工作记忆。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注句子理解中多个客体状态如何在被提取前得到主动维持，并检验这种维持是否依赖一种常与视觉工作记忆相联系的神经信号。两项脑电实验显示，左颞叶的theta-gamma相位-幅值耦合在句子加工过程中支持状态变化事件里多个客体状态的维持。作者据此提出，视觉工作记忆中所见的这一耦合信号可能同样参与语言诱发的客体状态维持，提示视觉与语言事件表征的维持或共享部分神经机制。

papers.title: Automated Tractography of Corticospinal and Corticoreticular Projections Originating From Brodmann Area 44 in Patients With Mild Stroke.
papers.authors: Koyama T, Mochizuki M, Uchiyama Y.
papers.abstract: Background Although upper-limb motor recovery after stroke is strongly linked to the integrity of the primary corticospinal tract, alternative descending motor pathways originating from secondary motor-related cortical areas, such as Brodmann area 44 (BA44; Broca's area), may also contribute to functional recovery. This study aimed to establish a practical automated diffusion-tensor tractography protocol to evaluate the microstructural properties of corticospinal and corticoreticular projections (CS-P and CR-P) originating from BA44 in patients with mild stroke who achieved favorable motor outcomes. Methods We retrospectively investigated patients with first-ever, unilateral thalamic or putaminal hemorrhagic stroke who achieved complete independence in activities of daily living and a Brunnstrom Recovery Stage of ≥5 in both the upper and lower limbs at discharge. Diffusion-tensor imaging was performed during the second week of hospitalization using a 3.0-T MRI scanner (MAGNETOM Trio; Siemens, Erlangen, Germany). The CS-P and CR-P were reconstructed using an automated tractography pipeline, with the cerebral peduncle and gigantocellular reticular nucleus serving as seed regions, respectively, and BA44 serving as the target region. Interhemispheric differences in fractional anisotropy (FA) values between the lesioned and non-lesioned hemispheres were evaluated using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test. Results A total of 14 patients were enrolled. Both the CS-P and CR-P originating from BA44 were successfully reconstructed in all subjects. FA values in the lesioned hemisphere were significantly lower than those in the non-lesioned hemisphere for both the CS-P (median (IQR): 0.484 (0.452-0.514) vs. 0.508 (0.474-0.531), S = 39.5, P = 0.011) and the CR-P (0.442 (0.410-0.462) vs. 0.463 (0.446-0.474), S = 31.5, P = 0.049). Conclusions Automated diffusion-tensor tractography can reliably detect microstructural alterations in alternative descending motor pathways originating from BA44, even in patients with mild stroke and favorable motor outcomes. This neuroimaging protocol offers a practical and clinically viable approach for assessing neural reorganization in stroke rehabilitation.

relevance.reason: 研究卒中患者BA44起源的皮质脊髓/网状投射纤维束微结构，属白质结构与脑损伤后重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对轻度卒中后运动恢复良好的患者，建立了一套自动化弥散张量纤维束成像流程，用于重建起源于BA44的皮质脊髓投射和皮质网状投射，并比较病灶侧与非病灶侧的各向异性分数。结果显示，所有患者的两类投射均能成功重建，且病灶侧各向异性分数均低于非病灶侧。作者据此认为，该自动化方法可稳定检出BA44来源的替代性下行运动通路的微结构改变，为评估卒中康复中的神经重组提供了可行的影像学手段；但研究为回顾性设计、样本量小，且仅反映微结构差异，尚不能说明其与功能恢复的因果关系。

papers.title: Microbes on the Mind: Multi-modal Neuroimaging Reveals Gut-Brain Axes in Infants
papers.authors: Li T, Yang Y, Cho S, Howell BR, Wu Z, Yin W, Elison JT, Huynh KM, Ahmad S, Yap P, Li G, Wang L, Zhu H, Lin W, UNC/UMN Baby Connectome Project Consortium.
papers.abstract: The gut microbiome undergoes rapid maturation after birth and has been associated with cognition and mental health, yet its relation to early brain development remains poorly defined. We analyzed 223 typically developing children aged 0–3 years with multimodal MRI and paired fecal shotgun metagenomics. Microbiome-wide association analyses identified associations with cortical morphology, white-matter microstructure, and functional connectivity. Ridge-regularized canonical correlation analysis identified two principal covariance patterns: a structural–metabolic mode and a functional–taxonomic mode. Sparse canonical partial least squares recovered the principal CCA score and phenotype patterns within the same sample. Longitudinal canonical-score slopes were not significantly correlated; in autoregressive cross-lag models, however, neuroimaging CCA1 scores predicted microbiome CCA1 scores 1–6 months later. These results indicate cross-domain covariance and temporal ordering within the measured windows but do not establish causality.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注婴儿期肠道微生物组与早期脑发育之间的关系，对0至3岁典型发育儿童同时采集多模态MRI和粪便宏基因组数据，用微生物组关联分析和正则化典型相关分析考察两者的协变结构。分析识别出两个主要的协变模式，分别偏重结构与代谢、功能与菌群分类，并在同一样本内用稀疏方法复现了主要得分与表型模式。纵向分析未发现典型得分斜率之间的显著相关，但自回归交叉滞后模型显示神经影像得分可预测1至6个月后的微生物组得分。作者据此认为，在所测时间窗内存在跨领域协变和时间先后顺序，但并不能据此确立因果关系。

papers.title: Comparing serial and parallel language input: Shared neural representations with distinct encoding strengths
papers.authors: Krogh SM, Pylkkänen L.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Language can be experienced in highly serial form, as in speech, or in fully parallel form, as in text, yet how our brains adapt to differences in seriality is not understood. Here, we held modality constant (visual) and examined whether processing mechanisms underlying grammaticality detection are similar under Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP) and Rapid Parallel Visual Presentation (RPVP). To identify shared neural representations of grammaticality, we trained a classifier on magnetoencephalography (MEG) responses to grammatical and ungrammatical three-word phrases in one presentation mode and tested its generalization to the other. Behaviorally, accuracy was higher and reaction times faster for grammatical vs. ungrammatical phrases across presentation modes. Neurally, cross-presentation decoding revealed shared representations of grammaticality at word 2 across train-test directions—albeit with different latencies and durations—and an early shared representation at word 3 when trained on RPVP. We take the bidirectional representations at word 2 to capture distinct but presentation-invariant combinatorial processes and the asymmetry at word 3 as reflecting stronger global structure encoding in RPVP.

relevance.reason: 用MEG比较串行与并行呈现下语法性检测的共享神经表征，直接研究语言句法加工机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在视觉通道下比较了快速序列视觉呈现（RSVP）与快速并行视觉呈现（RPVP）两种语言输入方式，考察语法性检测背后的加工机制是否相似。研究者用脑磁图记录三词短语的神经反应，训练分类器区分合乎语法与不合语法的短语，并检验其能否跨呈现方式泛化。行为上两种方式均表现为合乎语法短语准确率更高、反应更快；神经层面则在第二个词处发现跨呈现方式共享的语法性表征，但潜伏期和持续时间不同，第三个词处仅在以RPVP训练时出现早期共享表征。作者据此认为，第二个词处的双向表征反映了与呈现方式无关的组合加工，而第三个词处的不对称则提示RPVP对整体结构的编码更强。

papers.title: No tiger in plastic tiger: Local linguistic context alters the neural representations of individual words
papers.authors: Krogh SM, Pylkkänen L.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Language is vastly ambiguous, yet in context our brains resolve ambiguity effortlessly. This is particularly evident at the lexical level: Although most words can convey a wide range of related meanings, humans rapidly and automatically select the one appropriate for the context. We investigated the neural mechanisms underlying this process by focusing on a case where, intuitively, one meaning appears more basic than another: nouns describing animate entities, such as tiger , which can also refer to representations of those entities when combined with a material modifier, as in plastic tiger . Using magnetoencephalography, we decoded animacy from neural signals and found that even in such cases, our approach revealed no evidence that the tiger in plastic tiger is represented as a sentient animal in any stage of processing. Instead, phrase-level animacy— plastic tiger as inanimate—was decodable as early as 210 ms post-stimulus onset and persisted for several hundred milliseconds. These findings challenge theories assuming a shift from a basic sense of a word to a more derived one, highlighting instead the role of compositional context in shaping word meanings. Highlights Phrases like plastic tiger have conflicting word- and phrase-level animacy features. Using MEG, we found clear evidence for phrase-level animacy encoding at 210 ms. In contrast, word-level animacy was never detectable for animacy-mismatch phrases. Word meanings are thus not stable entities but shaped by compositional context.

relevance.reason: MEG解码显示短语语境在210ms即塑造单词语义表征，属语言语义加工的神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑磁图考察短语语境如何影响单个词义的神经表征，以“plastic tiger”这类词级与短语级生命性相冲突的表达为切入点，尝试从神经信号中解码生命性信息。结果显示，在加工的任何阶段都未发现“tiger”被表征为有生命的动物；相反，短语层面的无生命含义在刺激呈现后约210毫秒即可被解码，并持续数百毫秒。作者据此认为，词义并非稳定实体，而是由组合语境塑造，这对假定词义从基本义向派生义转换的理论构成挑战。

papers.title: Distinct experience-dependent reorganization of rhythmic syllable tracking in 6-month-old term and preterm infants
papers.authors: Rambosson I, Benis D, Barcos-Munoz F, Kabdebon C, Ceravolo L, Grandjean D, Filippa M.
papers.abstract: Preterm birth is associated with an increased risk of later language difficulties, yet whether and how prematurity alters the brain’s ability to track the rhythmic structure of speech has remained understudied. Using EEG, we tracked neural entrainment to delta- and theta-rate syllable sequences produced by the infant’s mother or an unfamiliar speaker in term and preterm 6-month-old infants, modeling how oscillatory responses evolved over the course of a testing session. Term infants progressively strengthened frequency-matched delta tuning over bilateral frontal regions; preterm infants did not. This divergence took two distinct forms: a change in frequency selectivity over left frontal channels, where term infants sharpened and preterm infants blurred, and a shift in band weighting in other regions. The frontal delta difference emerged only for the unfamiliar speaker. Preterm birth thus alters how frequency-specific tuning is refined during exposure, identifying a candidate neural pathway with implications for early language learning.

relevance.reason: 用EEG比较足月与早产6月龄婴儿对言语音节序列的神经夹带，报告额区delta调谐的经验依赖性重组，属语言听觉加工及脑发育可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早产是否改变婴儿追踪言语节奏结构的能力，用脑电记录6月龄足月与早产儿聆听母亲或陌生说话人产生的音节序列时，对delta和theta频段振荡的响应如何随测试进程变化。结果显示，足月儿在双侧额区逐渐增强与刺激频率匹配的delta调谐，早产儿则没有出现这种增强；这种差异表现为左额通道频率选择性的变化（足月儿变锐、早产儿变模糊）以及其他区域频段权重的转移，且额区delta差异仅见于陌生说话人条件。作者据此认为，早产改变了暴露过程中频率特异性调谐的精细化方式，并提示这可能是一条与早期语言学习相关的候选神经通路。

papers.title: Altered Dopamine-Linked Striatal Hemodynamic Latency in Early Psychosis
papers.authors: Mopuru R, Elliott BL, Hoffman LJ, Ellman LM, Olson IR, Ballard IC.
papers.abstract: Importance Psychosis is strongly associated with striatal dopamine dysfunction, but noninvasive measures that capture variation in dopamine remain limited. Hemodynamic latency, which quantifies the timing of low-frequency blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) fluctuations, may provide a way to indirectly probe dopamine dysfunction in psychosis. Objective To determine whether striatal hemodynamic latency differs between individuals with early psychosis (EP) and healthy control (HC) participants and whether latency is associated with positive or negative symptom severity. Design Cross-sectional analysis of resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data from the Human Connectome Project (HCP)-EP dataset. Setting Multisite study at 4 sites using 3T Siemens Prisma MRI scanners. Participants 105 individuals with EP and 55 HC participants with usable resting-state fMRI and hemodynamic latency data. Exposure EP status. Main Outcomes and Measures Voxel-wise hemodynamic latency was estimated using RapidTide and summarized within 6 striatal regions: nucleus accumbens core and shell, anterior and posterior caudate and putamen. Group differences were evaluated using linear mixed-effects models accounting for region and subject-level random effects and controlling for age, sex, and mean framewise displacement. Positive symptoms were measured using the Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale positive subscale; negative symptoms using the Clinical Assessment Interview for Negative Symptoms. Associations with symptoms were assessed using nested linear regressions within the EP group. Results Latency was significantly lower in the dorsal than ventral striatum in HC and EP, with a greater difference in EP ( b= -119.46 ms, SE=52.16, p= .022). Follow-up six-subregion models found significant main effects of group F (1,156.55)=7.79, p =.006, and region F (5,2760)=187.99; p < .001, but no group-by-region interaction F (5,2760)=1.74; p =.121. Region-specific contrasts showed lower latency in EP in the anterior caudate ( p =.014), posterior caudate ( p< .001), anterior putamen ( p =.007), and posterior putamen ( p =.029), but not NAc core or shell. Striatal latency was not significantly associated with positive or negative symptom severity among participants with EP. Conclusions and Relevance EP was associated with broadly reduced striatal hemodynamic latency, with the strongest differences in the caudate and putamen. Altered striatal latency in psychosis warrants further evaluation as a noninvasive indirect marker of striatal pathophysiology linked to dopamine. Key Points Question Is striatal hemodynamic latency, a novel indirect correlate of dopamine physiology, altered in individuals with early psychosis? Findings In this cross-sectional study of 105 individuals with early psychosis and 55 healthy comparison participants, early psychosis was associated with significantly lower striatal hemodynamic latency. Differences were observed in the dorsal striatum (caudate and putamen), whereas ventral striatal (nucleus accumbens) latency did not significantly differ between groups. Meaning These findings support further evaluation of striatal hemodynamic latency as a noninvasive, indirect marker of dopamine-linked physiology in early psychosis

relevance.reason: 研究早期精神病患者静息态fMRI纹状体血流动力学潜伏期改变，属脑疾病机制与静息态脑组织发现。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注早期精神病患者纹状体的血流动力学延迟是否与健康人不同，以及这种延迟是否与阳性或阴性症状严重程度相关。研究基于静息态功能磁共振数据，比较早期精神病组与健康对照组在纹状体各亚区的延迟差异。结果显示，早期精神病组纹状体延迟总体偏低，差异主要体现在背侧纹状体的尾状核和壳核，而腹侧伏隔核未见显著组间差异；在患者组内，纹状体延迟与阳性或阴性症状严重程度没有显著关联。作者认为，这一改变值得作为与多巴胺相关的纹状体病理生理的非侵入性间接指标进一步评估，但现有横断面关联不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: Postnatal sensorimotor experience causally shapes hemispheric specialization across motor and language networks
papers.authors: Liu Y, Sun J, Zhao L, Chen L, Wang L.
papers.abstract: The functional organization of the human brain is shaped by the interplay between innate constraints and postnatal experience. Hemispheric specialization, as a fundamental organizing principle of brain function, raises unresolved questions about how postnatal experience shapes lateralization and importantly, whether different lateralized cognitive systems develop through shared or independent mechanisms. We leveraged a natural experiment in individuals with obstetric brachial plexus injury (OBPI) in the right upper limb, resulting in lifelong left-hand dominance dissociated from the typical predisposition, to address these questions. Using functional MRI experiments during manual motor tasks, we found that altered hand-use experience selectively reshaped hemispheric organization in higher-order frontoparietal motor regions. Specifically, individuals with right OBPI showed reduced left-hemisphere dominance and rightward reorganization of abstract, hand-independent action representations relative to controls and individuals with left-side OBPI, whereas primary sensorimotor and subcortical regions preserved their canonical lateralizedl organization. Strikingly, experience-dependent motor reorganization extended beyond the motor system individuals with right OBPI exhibited reduced left lateralization of the language network in Broca’s area (BA44) during sentence listening. Crucially, language lateralization in BA44 covaried with the left lateralization of frontal motor areas, particularly for the compensatory, functional left hand. These findings demonstrate that postnatal bodily experience shapes the developmental emergence of hemispheric specialization, specifically in higher-order motor and language networks, and revealed coordinated organization between action and language systems.

relevance.reason: 利用右臂丛神经损伤自然实验结合fMRI，发现产后感觉运动经验因果性重塑运动与语言网络（Broca区BA44）的偏侧化，并揭示动作与语言系统的协同组织。

papers.title: Major depressive disorder recurrence and medication status shape brain network topology
papers.authors: Castilla-Jiménez JF, Díaz-Patiño JC, Enriquez-Geppert S, van Tol M, Barrios FA, the DIRECT Consortium, Alcauter S.
papers.abstract: Introduction Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a highly prevalent and disabling psychiatric disorder. Human neuroimaging studies increasingly frame its neurobiological substrate in terms of alterations of large-scale brain network organization. Resting-state fMRI findings broadly align with this view, yet remaining highly heterogeneous, reflecting both clinical and analytic variability. Predominant approaches largely characterize functional organization in terms of pairwise relationships between regions, which may limit the ability to capture more global features of brain organization associated with depression and its course. Here we use novel methods from Topological Data Analysis to provide new perspectives on these brain-behavior associations Objectives The main objective of this study was to determine whether whole-brain topological descriptors of functional connectivity capture alterations associated with MDD. In particular, we examined whether these features vary along clinically relevant dimensions of heterogeneity, focusing on illness course (single-episode vs. recurrent MDD) and current antidepressant medication status. To this end, we analyzed the area under the curve (AUC) of the zeroth and first Betti numbers (B₀ and B₁), which index global network integration and higher-order cycle structure across scales, respectively. Methods Neuroimaging (resting state fMRI) and phenotypic data were obtained from 1,490 participants (776 individuals with MDD and 714 never-depressed controls) included in the REST-meta-MDD project of the DIRECT consortium. Functional connectivity matrices were computed using Pearson correlations between regions defined by the Power-264 atlas and harmonized across sites using CovBat. Topological Data Analysis was applied to characterize whole-brain network organization across connectivity thresholds using B₀ and B₁ curves and their areas under the curve (AUC). B₁ associated cycle counts and their coarse anatomical configurations were further examined. Group differences and effects of illness course and medication status were assessed using multiple linear and generalized linear regression models. Results Compared with controls, individuals with MDD showed significantly higher B₀ AUC, indicating altered global integration profiles across connectivity thresholds. B₀ AUC did not differ by illness course, illness duration, or symptom severity. In contrast, B₁ AUC showed a graded increase across illness courses, with the highest values observed in recurrent depression. This effect was driven by an increased number of one-dimensional cycles rather than greater cycle persistence. Medication status further modulated B₁ alterations, with elevated values observed in unmedicated single-episode and medicated recurrent MDD. Anatomical decomposition revealed that higher-order alterations were primarily driven by inter-network configurations spanning multiple large-scale functional systems. Discussion These findings indicate that MDD is associated with altered multiscale functional organization, combining less compact global integration with an increased prevalence of cross-network hole-defining cycles, with these features varying systematically with illness course and current medication, suggesting that topology-informed measures capture clinically relevant variability in brain organization in depression.

papers.title: Classical music in cognitive rehabilitation: Three case studies of spatial neglect
papers.authors: Zeineldin R, Takamura Y, Chea M, Naccache L, Bayen E, Toba MN, Bartolomeo P.
papers.abstract: Chronic spatial neglect after right-hemisphere stroke reflects network dysfunction, with recovery influenced by structural connectivity. Music recruits coordinated bi-hemispheric activity and may promote interhemispheric communication after stroke. Following our pilot study in post-stroke aphasia, we asked whether classical music modulates connectivity and behavior in chronic neglect. Three patients completed a crossover protocol comparing two weeks of daily audiovisual classical music with an audiobook control, with neglect, mood, quality-of-life, diffusion MRI, and resting-state high-density EEG measures. All showed right superior longitudinal fasciculus II disconnection with preserved callosal pathways. In N2, line bisection shifted leftward across all five lines after music, together with increased posterior interhemispheric theta-band weighted symbolic mutual information (wSMI), then deteriorated into the pathological range after the audiobook, without mood improvement. N1 showed mixed behavioral effects, with mood and quality of life improving after music. N3 showed no significant spatial improvement and worsened mood after music. These heterogeneous responses motivate larger studies of connectional predictors. The findings support the feasibility of classical music as an adjunct to neglect rehabilitation and suggest that cognitive changes may occur independently of mood, while the audiobook cannot be considered an inert control.

papers.title: The balance of local and distributed excitation shapes brain stability and reflects aging- and Alzheimer’s disease-related alterations
papers.authors: Park Y, Kim S, Park H, Satterthwaite TD, Bernhardt BC, Park B.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human brain function emerges from the interplay between recurrent local activity and distributed inter-regional interactions. However, a biologically interpretable framework for quantifying this balance between the two factors at the whole-brain level remains lacking. Here, we extended an established biophysical model to quantify inter-regional excitation and newly introduced the recurrent ratio (R-ratio), a measure of the relative balance between intra- and inter-regional excitation. Dynamical analyses showed that an optimal R-ratio supports a trade-off between network stability and flexibility. Applying this framework to healthy aging and Alzheimer’s disease revealed progressively increased R-ratios with advancing age and disease severity. In healthy individuals, higher R-ratios were associated with age-related alterations in brain morphology, molecular pathology, and cognitive function, whereas Alzheimer’s disease was characterized by increased R-ratios accompanied by reduced dynamical persistence. Together, these findings establish the R-ratio as a biologically interpretable marker of whole-brain excitation balance and demonstrate its utility for linking biophysical mechanisms with large-scale brain dynamics, aging, and neurodegeneration.

papers.title: EEG Functional Connectivity Reveals Accelerated Brain Aging in Young Adults with Cognitive Deficits and Mental Health Conditions
papers.authors: Phang C, Miao G, Cai L, Rao H, Du J.
papers.abstract: The discrepancy between chronological age and predicted brain age, derived from neuroimaging data, serves as a biomarker for neurological health. However, the exact electroencephalography (EEG) mechanisms contributing to the variation of brain age are yet to be understood. This paper comprehensively investigated the relationship between brain age estimated from EEG-based functional connectivity and cognitive or mental manifestations of healthy adults. A mean absolute error (MAE) of 5.97 and R-squared ( R 2 ) of 0.85 were reported for training data, while an MAE of 10.73 and R 2 of 0.56 were reported for the prediction data. Increased brain age was found to be negatively related to the scores of memory and attention tasks. Most young adults (19 of 26) suffering from mental symptoms such as addictions, depression, phobia, and anorexia nervosa demonstrated higher brain age than their chronological age. Alcohol consumption was also significantly correlated to the difference between brain and chronological ages. The functional connectivity of frontal and central motor regions was found to be most distinguishing between individuals with high and low brain ages. These brain regions were significantly correlated with brain age but not chronological age, suggesting a relatively stronger relationship with biological age. Ablation studies further confirmed the importance of the frontal brain and all bands EEG in the prediction of brain age. This work advances the understanding of EEG mechanisms contributing to brain age and could provide an interpretation for physiological or psychological conditions associated with brain age.
