papers.title: Neuromodulation for post-stroke aphasia rehabilitation: established cortical stimulation and emerging network-based targets.
papers.authors: De Luca M, Federico G, Rigatti D, Gigliotta O, Marangolo P.
papers.abstract: Post-stroke aphasia is a disabling disorder of language and communication for which speech-language therapy remains the standard of care. Because behavioural treatment yields variable gains and many people retain chronic communication limitations, non-invasive neuromodulation has been investigated to increase the responsiveness of residual language networks to therapy. This narrative review critically integrates evidence available through July 2026 for repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS), theta-burst stimulation, transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), and emerging approaches targeting the cerebellum, spinal sensorimotor pathways, and cellular metabolism. Recent meta-analyses support small-to-moderate average benefits of adjunctive cortical stimulation, especially for naming, but these estimates coexist with marked heterogeneity, small trials and incomplete evidence for generalisation, durability, functional communication, and quality of life. Recent randomised studies illustrate the value of pairing stimulation with a defined learning task and of using lesion, tract, functional-connectivity, or hemodynamic information to select targets and predict response. Cerebellar tDCS, transcutaneous spinal direct current stimulation, transcranial alternating current stimulation, and transcranial photobiomodulation are conceptually attractive but remain investigational because the clinical evidence is limited, inconsistent, or based on uncontrolled and proof-of-concept studies. Across modalities, serious adverse events are uncommon when contemporary screening and dosing guidance are followed, although stroke-specific comorbidity and seizure risk require trained supervision. Neuromodulation should therefore be viewed as a potentially useful, state-dependent amplifier of speech-language therapy rather than a replacement for it. Progress towards routine care will require adequately powered multisite trials, preregistered patient-level stratification, treatment-fidelity reporting, ecologically valid outcomes, longer follow-up, and direct comparisons of personalised with fixed protocols.

relevance.reason: 综述卒中后失语症的神经调控与残余语言网络，涉及语言康复的脑机制与靶点选择。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合了截至近期关于重复经颅磁刺激、θ爆发刺激和经颅直流电刺激等非侵入性神经调控用于卒中后失语康复的证据，并讨论了以小脑、脊髓感觉运动通路和细胞代谢为靶点的新兴方向。作者指出，近期荟萃分析支持辅助性皮层刺激对命名等语言功能有中小幅度的平均获益，但相关证据异质性明显、试验规模偏小，对泛化、持久性、功能性交流和生活质量的证据仍不完整。近期随机研究提示，将刺激与明确的学习任务配对，并利用病灶、纤维束、功能连接或血流动力学信息选择靶点和预测反应，可能更有价值；而小脑刺激等新兴方法仍处于研究阶段。作者强调，神经调控应被视为依赖状态的言语语言治疗增效手段而非替代，其常规应用仍需更大规模的多中心试验和更规范的分层与结局评估。

papers.title: Optimal sensor set for MEG-based spontaneous and intended speech decoding toward practical communication.
papers.authors: Alba Diaz PA, Kwon J, Berstis K, Weed M, Ferrari P, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Introduction Neural speech decoding has demonstrated great potential as an alternative to current brain-computer interface (BCI) spellers, enabling a faster, more natural way of communication for patients who have lost voluntary abilities, including speech. Most neural speech decoding studies have focused on decoding cued speech, in which participants are presented with visual or auditory signals before producing imagined or overt speech. Only a few recent studies have investigated the decoding of spontaneous and intended speech without external cues using neural activity acquired from a full-scalp clinical magnetoencephalography (MEG) system. With recent advances in MEG technology, including optically pumped magnetometers (OPMs) and nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center (NV-diamond) magnetometers, MEG is emerging as a next-generation wearable system for practical speech BCIs. However, it remains unclear how many sensors are needed, where to place them, and what sampling frequency is optimal for wearable MEG devices that require cost-effective, computationally efficient operation. Methods In this study, we addressed these gaps by using a forward selection algorithm to find an optimal subset of sensors for spontaneous intended and overt speech decoding and by evaluating decoding performance across different frequency bands. Support vector machine and random forest were used as the classifiers in these experiments. Results Our results indicate that only a small number of sensors (7-8 on average, with a maximum of fewer than 24) are sufficient to achieve decoding performance comparable to that obtained using the whole scalp (more than 200) sensors. In addition, we observed that the Lower High-Gamma (62-125 Hz) band yielded the best performance in some settings, although not statistically significantly higher than other bands in all settings. Discussion These findings suggest that future wearable MEG devices may not need the whole-scalp sensor set and should support a sampling rate of at least 250 Hz, while 500 Hz is also encouraged, if possible. In summary, these findings provide practical insights for MEG-based BCIs for communication.

relevance.reason: 研究基于MEG解码自发与意图言语，涉及言语产出神经机制及传感器/频带对解码的影响，属语言与脑及功能信号采集。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注面向实用语音脑机接口的可穿戴脑磁图设备需要多少传感器、如何布置以及何种采样频率才合适，利用前向选择算法为自发意图言语和出声言语的解码筛选最优传感器子集，并比较不同频段的解码表现。结果显示，仅用少量传感器即可达到与全头皮大量传感器相当的解码效果；Lower High-Gamma频段在部分设置下表现最好，但并非在所有设置下都显著优于其他频段。作者据此认为，未来可穿戴脑磁图设备未必需要全头皮传感器，采样率至少应支持250 Hz，条件允许时500 Hz更佳，为脑磁图语音脑机接口的实用化提供了参考。

papers.title: Euphemisms modulate the neural processing of norm violations.
papers.authors: Gorodnicheva Y, Monahhova E, Bekim A, Shen Q, Klucharev V.
papers.abstract: Euphemisms are commonly used in media to soften or obscure the severity of unethical or controversial actions. The present study explored the neural correlates underlying the processing of euphemized vignettes portraying norm violations. We recorded event-related potentials (ERPs) and collected behavioral severity ratings while participants (n = 38) read vignettes describing the same norm-violating events framed with euphemized, non-euphemized or control critical words. Behaviorally, participants rated norm violations as significantly less severe when described with euphemisms. At the neurophysiological level, non-euphemized critical words evoked significantly larger P600 amplitudes than euphemized words, whereas no reliable modulation was observed on the N400 component. Previous ERP studies have linked the N400 to the detection of semantic and normative incongruities, whereas the P600 has been associated with later integrative processes and evaluative reappraisal during language comprehension. These results suggest that euphemisms primarily modulate late-stage evaluative reappraisal and integration of norm violations, rather than early lexico-semantic detection.

relevance.reason: 用ERP研究委婉语如何调节违规事件语言理解的神经加工，涉及语义整合与评价重评，属语言与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察委婉语如何影响人们对违反规范行为的神经加工，让参与者阅读用委婉、非委婉或中性关键词描述同一违规事件的短文，同时记录事件相关电位并收集严重程度评分。行为结果显示，用委婉语描述时，参与者对违规严重程度的评分明显更低；神经层面，非委婉关键词诱发的P600波幅显著大于委婉词，而N400未见可靠调制。作者据此认为，委婉语主要作用于语言理解后期对违规行为的评价性重新评估与整合，而非早期词汇语义层面的违和检测。

papers.title: Brain-heart coupling in tourette syndrome: a precision functional mapping study of discordant siblings.
papers.authors: Ali SA, Demeter DV, Baim AR, Ahern J, Ben Ahn JH, Chang SE, Koithan EM, Park S, Smarr BL, Greene DJ.
papers.abstract: Tourette syndrome (TS) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by motor and vocal tics that are modulated by internal physiological state and interoceptive state, including premonitory urges and associated changes in short-timescale parasympathetic variability. Since tic expression is thought to be linked to fluctuations in autonomic state, understanding how brain networks integrate physiological signals may provide insight into the neural mechanisms contributing to tic generation and suppression. In recent years, there has been increasing interest in understanding interactions between the brain and autonomic physiology, given their shared central role in shaping cognition, emotion, and behavior. Methodological advances have enabled the study of brain-heart coupling, yet much of this work has focused on static or region-based approaches, limiting insight into how autonomic fluctuations are integrated within dynamic, large-scale brain networks. Here, we examined time-resolved brain-heart interactions using densely sampled resting-state fMRI data and concurrent pulse oximetry in two sibling pairs (n = 4) discordant for Tourette syndrome (TS). Using two targeted network analyses organized around interoceptive/urge awareness and inhibitory control/action regulation processes, we quantified coupling between pulse-derived RMSSD and between-network functional connectivity using sliding-window analyses and Bayesian linear mixed-effects models. We observed marked individual variability in functional network organization and autonomic measures. The most consistent observation was a pattern of opposing coupling directions between individuals with and without TS: those with TS showed positive associations between pulse-derived RMSSD with connectivity between internal-state and attentional networks, as well as among action-related systems, while unaffected siblings showed positive associations along broader integrative pathways linking internal-state and action-control networks. These preliminary findings generate hypotheses regarding individualized patterns of brain-heart coupling in TS and illustrate the potential value of integrating individualized network mapping with time-resolved physiological measures in clinical populations.

relevance.reason: 以抽动秽语综合征患者为对象，用静息态fMRI与脉搏血氧同步研究脑-心耦合及内感受/动作调控网络组织，属脑疾病认知机制与静息态网络研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注图雷特综合征中大脑网络与自主神经生理信号如何耦合，采用密集采样的静息态功能磁共振与同步脉搏血氧测量，对两对图雷特综合征不一致的同胞进行个体化精准功能网络分析。结果显示，个体间功能网络组织和自主神经指标差异明显，但最一致的观察是患病与未患病个体呈现相反的耦合方向：患病者的心率变异性指标与内部状态—注意网络及动作相关系统之间的连接呈正相关，而未患病同胞则在连接内部状态与动作控制的更广泛整合通路上呈正相关。作者将这些初步发现定位为生成性假设，提示个体化网络映射结合时间分辨生理测量可能有助于理解图雷特综合征中脑—心耦合的个体差异，尚不能据此推断因果或临床效果。

papers.title: A high-precision synchronization and centroid-based framework for single-trial decoding of perceived natural speech.
papers.authors: Olivares CY, Schettini N.
papers.abstract: Decoding natural speech from EEG is constrained by low signal-to-noise ratios, commonly addressed through event-related potential (ERP) grand averaging. However, this approach acts as a low-pass filter, obscuring trial-to-trial variability and high-frequency neural dynamics. To overcome these limitations, we propose an open-box, FPGA-synchronized framework for single-trial EEG analysis of Spanish vowels (/a/, /i/, /u/). The proposed architecture enforces sub-millisecond hardware determinism, eliminating software-induced temporal jitter and enabling robust extraction of high-frequency oscillatory features, including the Gamma band, without relying on averaged ERPs. This synchronization framework facilitates the separation of early exogenous sensory responses from late endogenous cognitive processing, while comprehensive ablation studies were performed to evaluate the effect of software-induced jitter on decoding performance. Results showed that introducing simulated jitter degraded classification performance to theoretical chance levels (33.20%), confirming hardware synchronization as a strict prerequisite for reliable single-trial decoding. The framework was further validated using a Centroid-PCA-SVM pipeline operating on a 16-channel spatial subset. Using the full proposed architecture, a grand mean classification accuracy of 67.70% was achieved, substantially exceeding the theoretical chance level of 33.33%. The across-participant mean of the maximum fold accuracies reached 83.00%, with individual validation folds achieving up to 90.00%. In contrast, zero-calibration leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) generalization remained at chance level (33.08%; κpooled = -0.0036), indicating limited cross-participant transferability and highlighting the current need for participant-specific calibration or alignment. Overall, these findings demonstrate that hardware-deterministic EEG acquisition enables the recovery of robust trial-by-trial brain dynamics that are typically obscured by conventional averaging approaches. By combining precise synchronization with low-latency algorithmic inference, the proposed framework establishes a foundation for real-time neural decoding and represents a stepping stone for practical brain-computer interfaces and advanced clinical monitoring applications.

relevance.reason: 该研究用EEG单试次解码自然语音（西班牙语元音），报告了人脑言语感知的神经动力学与解码机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电解码自然语音时信噪比低、传统平均化处理掩盖单试次变异的问题，提出一套基于硬件同步与质心分类的单试次解码框架，并以西班牙语元音为对象进行验证。结果显示，硬件级同步是可靠单试次解码的前提，模拟时间抖动会使分类性能降至理论随机水平；在完整框架下，受试者内分类准确率明显高于随机水平，但零校准的跨被试泛化仍停留在随机水平，说明当前仍需被试特异性校准或对齐。作者据此认为，硬件确定性采集有助于恢复被平均化掩盖的逐试次脑动态，为实时神经解码及脑机接口应用奠定基础。

papers.title: Structurally restricted message-passing within shallow architectures for explainable network-level brain decoding on small cohorts.
papers.authors: Marques Dos Santos JD, Ramos MB, Reis LP, Marques Dos Santos JP, Direito B.
papers.abstract: Introduction Applying artificial intelligence to functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has advanced the modelling of neural activity, but deep architectures such as graph neural networks (GNNs) require large samples, limiting their use in the small cohorts typical of task-based fMRI. Shallow neural networks (SNNs) are robust with few samples but treat brain regions independently, overlooking the brain's network organization. We propose a structurally constrained message-passing framework that integrates diffusion-based structural connectivity, from a previously published group connectome, with region-level fMRI signals in a shallow architecture. Methods The task is a binary classification of individual video trials as mentalizing or random, decoded from the fMRI response, in a Theory of Mind paradigm from the Human Connectome Project Young Adult dataset (30 subjects) under subject-wise 3-fold cross-validation. Two shallow classifiers are compared on the same data: the baseline classifies each trial from the regional fMRI signals as independent inputs, whereas the proposed model first applies one message-passing step, replacing each region's signal with a structurally connected combination of its neighbors' signals, so that classification operates at the level of anatomically defined networks. Interpretability is assessed using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations). Results Across folds, the proposed model matches the baseline (mean retrained accuracy 85.1%; 84.7% on the shared partition), the accuracy lost to pruning being recovered by retraining in every fold. The magnitude of the inputs' contributions is reproducible across folds, whereas their direction is not. Only about a quarter of the consistently retained inputs also preserve their sign, so a cross-fold sign-consistency criterion is applied to retain reliable explanations. This identifies seven networks contributing robustly to the mentalizing class, located in the temporo-parietal junction, inferior parietal, and medial temporal cortices and overlapping a literature-based mentalizing map (overlap coefficient 0.383). Within these networks, Cohen's D ranks the relative signal magnitude of the constituent regions. Discussion Overall, structural constraints improve biological interpretability without compromising classification performance, while cross-validation establishes which explanations are stable, offering a compact and interpretable approach to network-level brain decoding in small cohorts and a basis that may be applied to connectivity disorders.

relevance.reason: 将扩散结构连接约束与fMRI信号结合解码心理化任务，报告脑网络层面表征与结构-功能整合，属社会认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种结构受限的消息传递框架，将扩散式结构连接与区域fMRI信号结合于浅层网络，用于小样本下的网络级脑解码，并在心智化任务中与逐区域独立输入的基线分类器比较。结果显示，所提模型分类表现与基线相当，结构约束未损害解码性能；输入贡献的幅度可跨折复现，但方向不稳定，因此作者用跨折符号一致性筛选可靠解释，识别出若干稳定贡献于心智化类别的网络，并与文献中的心智化图谱部分重叠。作者据此认为，结构约束在保持分类表现的同时提升了生物学可解释性，为小队列网络级解码提供了紧凑且可解释的途径，并可能为连接障碍研究提供基础。

papers.title: Writing is thinking: toward a neuropsychological model of scientific writing as knowledge construction.
papers.authors: Ríos-Flórez JA, Muñoz-Giraldo AJ, Rodríguez Bustamante A, Castañeda-Quirama T.
papers.abstract: Scientific writing has historically been conceptualized as a communicative act-the registration of knowledge elaborated through independent cognitive processes. This article challenges that assumption and proposes that scientific writing constitutes an active neurocognitive system of knowledge construction and a privileged domain for metacognitive self-regulation in advanced learning contexts. We present the Integrated Neuropsychological Model of Scientific Writing (MNIEC), a theoretical framework integrating four neurocognitive systems-the Constructive Executive System (CES), the Extended Working Memory System (EWMS), the Semantic Simulation System (SSS), and the Epistemological Metacognitive Monitoring System (EMMS)-within a unified functional architecture. The central mechanism is the Epistemological Construction Cycle (ECC), a recursive five-phase process-conceptual activation, working memory simulation, symbolic externalization, metacognitive evaluation, and conceptual reorganization-through which scientific writing can function as an active mechanism of knowledge construction, particularly when recursive metacognitive evaluation and conceptual reorganization are engaged. The model integrates evidence from executive function neuropsychology, working memory architecture, large-scale brain network dynamics, epistemological metacognition, and predictive coding, grounded in five nuclear principles. Four testable hypotheses and experimental paradigms are derived. Implications are discussed for metacognitive training in scientific education, academic impostor syndrome, and the cognitive impact of large language models. The MNIEC proposes a neuropsychological framework for a systematic research agenda on scientific writing as metacognitive knowledge construction.

relevance.reason: 提出科学写作作为知识建构的神经心理学理论模型，整合执行、工作记忆、语义模拟与元认知系统，属语言产出与认知机制的理论框架。

papers.summary_zh: 该文挑战“科学写作只是把独立认知过程产出的知识记录下来的交流行为”这一传统看法，提出科学写作本身构成一个主动的知识建构神经认知系统。作者构建了整合神经心理学模型（MNIEC），将建构性执行、扩展工作记忆、语义模拟和认识论元认知监控四个系统纳入统一功能架构，核心是包含概念激活、工作记忆模拟、符号外化、元认知评估与概念重组五个阶段的递归循环，认为当递归的元认知评估和概念重组被调动时，写作才成为知识建构的主动机制。该模型整合了执行功能、工作记忆、大规模脑网络动力学、认识论元认知和预测编码等证据，并据此提出可检验假设和实验范式，讨论了对科学教育中的元认知训练、学术冒名顶替感及大语言模型认知影响的启示。需注意，这是理论框架而非实证研究，其假设尚待检验。

papers.title: Structure and function of corpus callosum modified by common variation in the ROBO1 gene
papers.authors: Rinne N, Sahari E, Tolonen T, Einarsdóttir E, Salmitaival J, Alho K, Kere J, Wikman P.
papers.abstract: The corpus callosum (CC) connects the cerebral hemispheres and enables interhemispheric communication that supports numerous cognitive functions, including reading. ROBO1, a dyslexia susceptibility gene involved in axonal midline crossing, has previously been associated with CC structure, but its relationship with the functional organisation of cerebral reading networks remains unclear. Here, we examined associations between ROBO1 variation, CC structure, reading-related brain function, and reading performance in 178 typically reading adolescents and young adults. Variation across five ROBO1 single nucleotide polymorphisms was summarised using principal component analysis. The resulting PC1 score was examined in relation to fractional anisotropy (FA) and tract count across five CC subdivisions, as well as reading-related activation and functional connectivity in cortical regions connected by these pathways. A greater number of rare alleles across the examined variants was associated with lower FA in the central, middle posterior, and posterior CC. ROBO1 variation was also associated with activation in cortical regions corresponding to the endpoints of the CC tracts, as well as with reading-related functional connectivity between these endpoint regions and clusters in the left temporoparietal cortex and right temporal pole. However, neither ROBO1 variation nor CC structure explained reading performance, suggesting that ROBO1 may contribute to individual differences in the structure and function of interhemispheric language networks even in the absence of measurable behavioural differences.

relevance.reason: 研究ROBO1变异与胼胝体结构及阅读相关脑功能/功能连接的关系，涉及语言网络的结构-功能基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在典型阅读发展的青少年和年轻成人中，考察了阅读障碍易感基因ROBO1的常见变异与胼胝体结构、阅读相关脑功能及阅读表现之间的关系，用主成分分析概括多个单核苷酸多态性变异，并结合弥散张量成像与功能成像指标进行分析。结果显示，携带更多罕见等位基因与胼胝体中央、中后及后部亚区的各向异性降低相关；ROBO1变异还对应胼胝体纤维端点所在皮层的激活，以及这些端点区域与左颞顶皮层、右颞极之间的阅读相关功能连接。不过，ROBO1变异和胼胝体结构均未解释阅读表现，提示该基因可能参与半球间语言网络结构与功能的个体差异，而这种差异未必伴随可测量的行为变化。

papers.title: Reduced EEG Complexity and Its Association with Social Communication in Adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Multiscale Entropy Study
papers.authors: Naoe T, Shikauchi Y, Itahashi T, Tanaka K, Okimura T, Hashimoto R, Ohta H, Sato Y, Nakamura M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Brain functions emerge from temporally organized neural dynamics, and an appropriate level of neural complexity may support flexible information processing. Electroencephalographic (EEG) studies using multiscale entropy (MSE), which quantifies signal complexity across multiple temporal scales, have reported reduced MSE at longer scales in individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). However, most evidence comes from studies of infant and child samples, leaving adult data scarce, and the associations between reduced MSE, clinical symptoms, and social information processing are insufficiently understood. Methods We recorded and analyzed EEG data from adults with ASD (n = 47) and typically developing (TD) controls (n = 40) during eyes-closed rest and two movie viewing conditions: Inscapes , comprising dynamically changing abstract visual patterns, and Partly Cloudy , an emotionally engaging animated social narrative. Group and condition effects were assessed using cluster-based permutation tests, and associations between MSE and Social Affect (SA) scores from the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule, Second Edition (ADOS-2), as well as group differences in event-related MSE changes, were examined using linear mixed-effects models. Results Across conditions, adults with ASD showed lower MSE at longer scales (τ = 16–30), corresponding to effective sampling rates of 12.50–6.67 Hz in the coarse-grained time series, than TD adults. Longer-scale MSE within the ASD–TD difference cluster was negatively associated with ADOS-2 SA scores across diagnostic groups. The difference in event-related MSE change between Social and Non-Social conditions, comparing empathic-pain and mentalizing events in Partly Cloudy with temporally matched non-social windows in Inscapes , was smaller in ASD participants than in TD participants. No significant difference between Social and Non-Social windows was observed among ASD participants, whereas TD participants showed significantly greater MSE change during Social than Non-Social windows. Limitations: This study used a modest sample without an independent replication cohort, and the short event windows limited the precision of the MSE estimation. Conclusions Reduced longer-scale MSE extends to adults with ASD and is associated with higher ADOS-2 SA scores across diagnostic groups. Event-related findings further suggest attenuated differentiation of longer-scale MSE between socially relevant and matched non-social windows in ASD.

relevance.reason: 研究成人自闭症静息与电影观看时EEG复杂度及其与社会认知加工的关联，涉及脑动力学与疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注成人自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）者的大脑信号复杂度是否降低，以及这种降低与社交沟通症状和社交信息加工的关系。研究者采集ASD成人与典型发育成人在闭眼静息及观看抽象动态画面、情感性社交动画时的脑电数据，用多尺度熵衡量不同时间尺度上的信号复杂度。结果显示，ASD成人在较长尺度上的多尺度熵整体低于典型发育者，且该差异范围内较长尺度的熵值与跨诊断组的ADOS-2社交情感得分呈负相关。事件相关分析还提示，典型发育者在社交相关窗口的熵变化明显大于匹配的非社交窗口，而ASD者未见这种差异，组间差异也较小，说明ASD成人对社交与非社交情境的较长尺度熵区分有所减弱。作者指出样本量有限且缺乏独立重复队列，短事件窗口也限制了熵估计的精度。

papers.title: Accelerated Theta Burst Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation to Treat Anorexia Nervosa
papers.authors: Gorrell S, Ray S, Lambert D, Mehta A, Slepneva N, Khim S, Sugrue LP, Lee AM.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Anorexia nervosa (AN) has among the highest mortality rates of all psychiatric disorders. No evidence-based treatments have demonstrated efficacy in adults with AN, and many youth retain severe symptoms even after receiving first-line psychotherapy. Models of eating pathology highlighting the compulsive and habitual nature of AN implicate excessive orbitofrontal cortex (OFC) activity as a potential circuit-based target for neuromodulation. Methods We conducted an open-label accelerated inhibitory theta burst stimulation (TBS) transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) targeting right frontopolar-OFC (FP/OFC) to treat AN paired with pre-/post- functional magnetic resonance imaging (NCT06138782). Results All study participants ( N = 15) completed TMS with no severe adverse events with four subjects being lost to follow up at one month. The primary outcome measures, Eating Disorder Evaluation (EDE) global scores, were significantly decreased at one-month post-treatment compared to baseline ( n = 11; p =.031, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). There was a significant reduction in OCD symptoms as measured by the Y-BOCS-I ( p =.020, Wilcoxon signed-rank test) and depressive symptoms as measured by the MADRS before and after treatment ( p =.002, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). Improvement in Y-BOCS-I positively correlated with improvement in EDE global scores (r = 0.68, Pearson; p =.021, permutations test). We found that the FP/OFC TMS target site, a component of the default mode network (DMN), strongly connected with both the frontal and posterior nodes of the network. Following our accelerated TBS TMS protocol, there was a significant reduction in connectivity between the FP/OFC TMS target and the posterior node of the DMN in the precuneus and a significant reduction in intra-network DMN connectivity ( p =.005, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). The magnitude of the decrease in functional connectivity between the FP/OFC and posterior DMN node was correlated with the degree of improvement in the EDE global score ( p =.026, permutation test). Conclusions Findings suggest that hyperactive DMN circuitry in AN can be targeted using non-invasive neuromodulation to reduce eating disorder symptoms.

relevance.reason: 以神经调控靶向DMN并报告AN患者治疗前后静息功能连接变化及其与症状改善的关联，属脑疾病脑网络机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该开放标签研究探讨加速抑制性θ爆发刺激经颅磁刺激靶向右额极-眶额皮层治疗神经性厌食症是否可行并伴随症状与脑连接改变，15名参与者完成治疗且无严重不良事件。治疗后一个月，完成随访者的进食障碍评估全局分显著下降，强迫和抑郁症状也减轻，且强迫症状改善与进食障碍症状改善相关。影像上，靶点与默认网络后部节点的连接及网络内连接均下降，连接下降幅度与症状改善相关。作者据此提出，默认网络环路过度活跃可能是可调控靶点，但开放标签设计尚不能确立因果或疗效。

papers.title: Preserved Alcohol Cue Salience Despite Olfactory Dysfunction Is Associated with Multimodal Alterations in Olfactory–Reward Networks
papers.authors: Agarwal K, Kothekar R, Bassi T, Roy R, Jebel A, Majumdar S, Ahlawat J, Sarkar S, Balhara YPS, Sharma A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Chronic alcohol consumption is associated with olfactory dysfunction, but the neurobiological mechanisms linking impaired olfactory function with alcohol cue responsiveness remain unclear. Ninety-eight alcohol consumers underwent objective olfactory assessment, a behavioral odor-cue task, structural MRI, fixel-based diffusion MRI, and proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS), and were classified as having normal olfactory function (threshold–discrimination score ≥ 16; n = 54) or olfactory dysfunction (score < 16; n = 44). Greater alcohol consumption was associated with poorer olfactory function (r = − 0.28, p < 0.01). Despite olfactory dysfunction, familiarity with alcohol beverage odors was preserved, while alcohol cue-induced craving was greater at the highest alcohol concentration (42.8%; β = 0.67, p = 0.04). Compared to participants with normal olfactory function, those with olfactory dysfunction showed lower cognitive performance (Cohen's d = − 0.58, pFDR = 0.02), smaller thalamic and amygdala volumes (d = − 0.70 and − 0.67, p FDR = 0.01), reduced superior thalamic radiation fibre cross-section (d = − 1.30, p FDR < 0.001), and lower prefrontal glutamate concentration (d = − 0.78, p FDR = 0.01). The neurometabolite (MRS) composite was associated with alcohol consumption (β = 0.52, p < 0.01) and significantly mediated the association between olfactory dysfunction and alcohol consumption. Chronic alcohol consumption is thus associated with impaired olfactory function and coordinated neurometabolic, gray matter, and white matter alterations within an olfactory–reward network. Preserved familiarity and craving responses to alcohol-related odors despite impaired olfactory function suggest selective maintenance of alcohol cue salience and highlight olfactory dysfunction as a potential behavioral marker of alcohol-related brain dysfunction.

papers.title: Cycle-by-Cycle Respiration Waveforms Are Coupled with the Shape of Neural Oscillations.
papers.authors: Kosik-Rose E, Zhou G, Sheriff A, Rosenow JM, Schuele SU, Oluigbo CO, Teti SA, Koubeissi M, Mowla MR, Rhone AE, Kumar S, Dlouhy B, Zelano C, Voytek B.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Beyond sustaining life, breathing is a vital physiological rhythm that shapes cognition, perception, emotional regulation, and mental health. Breathing has a direct effect on neuronal excitability and is coupled to neural oscillations across a variety of brain regions. Notably, both respiration and neural oscillations are asymmetric and not perfectly rhythmic: for example, every breath has a different shape and duration and is interspersed with variable pauses. Here, we examined the coupling between breathing and the brain by quantifying the nonsinusoidal features of each breath and comparing it to the shape of each corresponding neural oscillation cycle. By leveraging invasive human brain recordings from 16 participants (8 female, 8 male), we found respiration-neural waveform coupling on a breath-by-breath, cycle-by-cycle basis across limbic and cortical forebrain regions. For decades, the dominant perspective on cognition and mental health have focused on the brain, but recent work is highlighting the importance of brain-body interactions. Our results show that the coupling between breathing and neural activity is much richer than previously appreciated, and our approach opens new avenues for studying these peripheral-to-central nervous system interactions in a more robust, temporally precise manner.

papers.title: Functional Distinctions between the Auditory Cortex and Frontoparietal Network in the Encoding of Speech Features.
papers.authors: Ou Y, Kay KN, Oxenham AJ.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Neural representations of acoustic features that are key to speech perception have been studied extensively within the auditory cortex (AC), but their representations in higher-order cortical regions remain poorly understood. This study investigates the cortical encoding of three acoustic features in spoken vowels to delineate the functional distinctions across different cortical regions. We used ultra-high-field functional magnetic resonance imaging while human participants of both sexes listened to vowels and were asked to identify three aspects: vowel identity (probing spectral content), speaker identity (probing primarily fundamental frequency), and pitch glide direction (probing spectrotemporal modulation). Three brain regions exhibited selectivity to these features: the AC, premotor cortex (PMC), and the intraparietal sulcus (IPS). The AC demonstrated an encoding hierarchy across features, with significantly stronger encoding robustness for vowel identity than for speaker identity or pitch glide direction. In contrast, both the PMC and IPS showed uniform encoding robustness across all three features, likely reflecting their equal relevance for the identification task. Furthermore, during silent trials when participants were queried about the identity of the prior sound, AC showed no activity, whereas the PMC and IPS exhibited robust activation that was modulated by behavioral performance. These findings indicate functionally distinct roles between sensory and higher-order cortical regions: the stimulus-driven AC encodes feature-specific acoustic information, whereas the domain-general frontoparietal network performs task-relevant cognitive processing that supports goal-directed behavior.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑对言语声学特征的皮层编码，比较听觉皮层与额顶网络在言语加工中的功能分工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语音关键声学特征在大脑皮层中的编码方式，比较听觉皮层与高级皮层区域的功能分工。研究者用超高场功能磁共振成像，让参与者在听元音时分别判断元音身份、说话者身份和音高滑动方向。结果发现，听觉皮层对元音身份特征的编码明显强于其他特征，呈现特征间的编码层级；而前运动皮层和顶内沟对三类特征的编码强度相近，可能反映这些特征对当前判断任务同等重要。在无声音、仅要求回忆先前声音的试次中，听觉皮层无明显活动，前运动皮层和顶内沟则出现与行为表现相关的激活。作者据此认为，由刺激驱动的听觉皮层负责编码特定声学信息，而领域一般性的额顶网络承担任务相关的认知加工，支持目标导向行为。

papers.title: Resolving the Abstract-Concrete Paradox in the Angular Gyrus: A Multimethod Investigation.
papers.authors: Chiou R, Branzi FM, Jefferies E.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Despite its well-established role in memory-guided cognition, whether and how the angular gyrus (AG) contributes to semantic processing remains unresolved. Connectomic work links the AG to abstract mentation, yet neuroimaging studies paradoxically show greater AG engagement for concrete than abstract semantics. To address this discrepancy, we conducted a multimethod investigation integrating neurostimulation, neuroimaging, and experience sampling across five studies (127 human participants; 53 males; 74 females). Using the contrast between concrete and abstract semantics as a diagnostic test case, we show that this apparent contradiction reflects multiple interacting neurocognitive factors shaping the AG's functional repertoire. In Study 1, causal disruption of the AG disproportionately impaired abstract semantics and temporary retention of task-relevant information, demonstrating its role in abstract and memory-guided cognition. In Study 2, the apparent concreteness effect was abolished after controlling for performance speed/accuracy, indicating that AG activity is more strongly associated with low-demand mental states than semantic concreteness. In Study 3, the AG showed enhanced functional coupling with regions in the semantic network for abstract words, suggesting sustained integration with the semantic system despite reduced activation. In Study 4, experience sampling showed that concrete words are associated with experiences of mental imagery and automaticity, providing a phenomenological account of heightened AG engagement under low-demand states. Finally, Study 5 clarified how baseline choices influence the interpretation and polarity of AG activity. Together, these findings show that AG engagement is best understood along a continuum of memory-guided cognition, clarifying when and why this region supports abstract versus concrete semantics across situations.

relevance.reason: 多方法研究角回在抽象与具体语义加工及记忆引导认知中的作用，直接涉及人脑语言语义机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对角回在语义加工中作用的一个矛盾现象展开：连接组研究将其与抽象思维相联系，而神经影像却常见具体语义引发更强角回活动。作者整合神经调控、神经影像与经验采样等多种方法，以具体与抽象语义的对比为切入点，提出这一矛盾源于多种神经认知因素的交互。结果显示，因果性干扰角回会不成比例地损害抽象语义及任务相关信息的短暂保持；控制反应速度与正确率后，表面的具体性效应消失，角回活动更多与低需求心理状态相关；抽象词条件下角回与语义网络的功能耦合增强；具体词则伴随心理意象和自动化体验。作者据此认为，角回参与应沿记忆引导认知的连续体来理解，这有助于说明其在何种情境下支持抽象或具体语义。

papers.title: A Scoping Review of Neurobiological and Brain Structural Alterations Following Child Exposure to Intimate Partner Violence.
papers.authors: Gregorini C, Sacchi C, De Carli P.
papers.abstract: Intimate partner violence (IPV) is one global issue that can lead to neurobiological consequences and affect brain development across the lifetime. However, evidence is scattered across domains and age groups, making it difficult to map the breadth of empirical findings regarding exposure to IPV. This scoping review aimed to map existing evidence in relation to the neuorbiological mechanisms and brain structural outcomes in child exposed to IPV, extending the focus to the potential stability of such consequences in adulthood. Searches were conducted in Scopus, PubMed, PsycINFO, and Web of Science for studies published between 2000 and 2025. Eligible studies included peer-reviewed quantitative research reporting measures of neurobiological mechanisms (stress physiology, inflammatory or cellular markers, autonomic or neurochemical profiles, genetic or epigenetic indicators), and brain development (structural or functional neuroimaging outcomes) related to child exposed to IPV and retrospectively in adults. After screening 2,514 records, 62 studies met the inclusion criteria and were organized by sample characteristics and outcome domains. Findings have shown that the largest body of evidence concerns stress-related biological mechanisms, with reports of significant alterations in hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis functioning, inflammatory processes, and related physiological systems. Neuroimaging studies also demonstrated substantial convergence, with most reporting trauma-related alterations in frontolimbic circuitry, white matter integrity, developmental brain, and functional connectivity. In conclusion, this scoping review reveals the overall neurobiological and brain structural consequences associated with child exposure to IPV and points out the need for further preventive interventions and treatment strategies.

papers.summary_zh: 该综述旨在梳理儿童期暴露于亲密伴侣暴力后神经生物学机制与脑结构结局的现有证据，并将关注延伸至成年期的潜在持续性。作者检索多个数据库后纳入相关定量研究，按样本特征和结局领域进行整理。结果显示，证据最集中于应激相关生物学机制，涉及下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴功能、炎症过程及相关生理系统的改变；神经影像研究也较为一致地报告了额边缘环路、白质完整性、发育中脑及功能连接方面的创伤相关改变。综述据此指出需进一步开展预防干预与治疗策略研究。

papers.title: Neural integration of affective prosodic and semantic cues in non-literal forms of speech understanding.
papers.authors: Wittmann A, Ceravolo L, Mayr A, Grandjean D.
papers.abstract: Emotions in speech are conveyed through both semantics and prosody-voice 'melody', yet how listeners integrate these cues in the brain remains unclear. We investigated non-literal forms of speech, such as irony and sarcasm, where understanding beyond literal meaning relies on the dynamic interplay between affective prosodic and semantic cues, alongside the theory of mind (ToM). We used functional magnetic resonance imaging while participants listened to short dialogues between two characters, which varied in prosody and semantics to convey either literal or non-literal meanings. Behaviorally, semantics and prosody interacted in shaping participants' evaluations, although the data suggest a prosody dominance effect. Non-literal speech engaged a distributed network, including the bilateral inferior frontal gyrus, temporal speech regions, and ToM areas, with ROI analyses revealing heterogeneous prosody-semantics integration profiles across regions and tasks. Taken together, our data clarify the behavioral and neural underpinnings of the integration of prosody and semantics in non-literal speech and open new avenues in this field.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究言语中韵律与语义整合理解非字面语言的神经机制，涉及语言加工及心理理论脑网络。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注听者理解反讽、讽刺等非字面言语时，大脑如何整合情感韵律与语义线索。研究者让被试听语义和韵律变化、表达字面或非字面含义的短对话，同时用功能磁共振成像记录脑活动。行为结果显示语义与韵律共同影响被试评价，但数据提示韵律可能占主导；非字面言语则调动了包括双侧额下回、颞叶言语区和心理理论相关区域在内的分布式网络，且各区域、各任务中韵律与语义的整合模式并不一致。这些结果有助于理解非字面言语中韵律—语义整合的行为与神经基础，但摘要未说明因果机制或临床应用。

papers.title: Medial temporal default mode network selectively encodes autobiographical visual imagery.
papers.authors: Anderson AJ, Turnbull A, Lin FV.
papers.abstract: The human brain's capacity to imagine visual scenes from memory is thought to rely on the medial temporal subsystem of the default mode network (MT-DMN), yet the neural codes supporting this ability remain poorly understood. We combined functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) with vision and language artificial intelligence models to characterize neural codes during autobiographical imagination. Fifty participants imagined reexperiencing 20 natural scenarios while undergoing fMRI when cued by generic text prompts (e.g., wedding, exercising, and driving). Individual scenes were modeled using Stable Diffusion to generate personalized synthetic images from verbal descriptions of the scenarios imagined, collected beforehand. These depictions were then transformed into image recognition network hidden state representations. Representational similarity analysis revealed that the MT-DMN encoded the participant-specific representational structure of image representations, even when controlling for semantic features derived from a large language model. This effect was absent in other brain networks and during reading without active imagination, identifying the MT-DMN as a core substrate for the visual reconstruction of autobiographical experiences.

papers.title: Effect of Donepezil on Speech Recognition in Adult Cochlear Implant Users: A Pilot Randomized Clinical Trial.
papers.authors: Kunnath AJ, Moberly AC, Wallace MT, Newhouse PA, Gifford RH.
papers.abstract: Objectives Speech recognition outcomes following cochlear implantation vary widely among users, potentially due to differences in neuroplasticity. The cholinergic system plays a critical role in cortical reorganization and sensory learning; yet, its potential to enhance auditory plasticity in cochlear implant (CI) users has not been explored. The aim of this study is to investigate the effects of donepezil, a cholinergic agonist, on speech perception and cortical plasticity in adults with CIs. Design This pilot randomized clinical trial was conducted at a single tertiary academic center from April 2023 to December 2024. Adult CI recipients with a postlingual onset of deafness and at least 6 months of device experience were eligible for inclusion. Participants were randomized to oral donepezil 5 mg (DPZ) or placebo (PL) daily for 90 days. Both groups were encouraged to increase their daily device use during the study. The primary outcome measure was the change in consonant-nucleus-consonant word recognition scores for the implanted ear. Secondary outcomes included binaural word recognition, sentence recognition in quiet, signal to noise ratio loss for sentence recognition in noise, and questionnaires related to hearing satisfaction, listening fatigue, and quality of life. The questionnaires included the Speech, Spatial, and Quality of Hearing Scale, Vanderbilt Fatigue Scale, and CI Quality of Life Profile. Cortical plasticity was assessed using functional near-infrared spectroscopy. Results Thirteen experienced CI users were enrolled in this pilot study, with nine completing the 90-day protocol and included in the group descriptive analyses (DPZ: n = 4, PL: n = 5). Four participants (45%) were female, and the median age was 68 years. All study participants increased their device use, with a mean increase of 3.1 hr per day in both groups. Donepezil treatment was associated with a 14.5-point increase in mean CI-only consonant-nucleus-consonant word recognition, surpassing the 10-point threshold for clinical significance, whereas the placebo group decreased by 0.8 points (d = 0.88). Binaural word recognition, sentence recognition, and speech-in-noise performance also improved in the DPZ group relative to PL. Subjective measures showed greater improvements in speech perception (Speech, Spatial, and Quality of Hearing Scale) and reduced listening fatigue (Vanderbilt Fatigue Scale) in the DPZ group, while CI-related quality of life was similar between groups. Neuroimaging analyses revealed significant Group × Time interaction effects, with DPZ increasing left frontal cortex activation during a speech-in-noise task (β = 3.721, p < 0.001). Conclusions These findings provide preliminary evidence that cholinergic enhancement with donepezil may improve speech perception and facilitate neuroplasticity in multisensory and cognitive brain regions in CI users. In addition, the neuroimaging analyses support cholinergic-induced neuroplasticity with DPZ treatment. While this pilot study was underpowered to determine the clinical efficacy of donepezil, pharmacological interventions like donepezil represent a promising novel approach to optimizing CI outcomes, and we offer recommendations for future clinical trials in this population.
