papers.summary_zh: 这项初步随机临床试验探讨胆碱能激动剂多奈哌齐能否改善成人人工耳蜗使用者的言语识别，并借助功能近红外光谱观察皮层可塑性；受试者被随机分配接受多奈哌齐或安慰剂，同时被鼓励增加每日设备使用。完成方案者的描述性分析显示，多奈哌齐组的单侧人工耳蜗词识别平均提升超过临床意义阈值，而安慰剂组略有下降；双耳词识别、句子识别及噪声下言语表现也相对改善，主观言语感知和聆听疲劳亦有改善，但人工耳蜗相关生活质量两组相近。影像分析提示多奈哌齐组在噪声下言语任务中左侧额叶激活增加，作者据此认为结果提供了胆碱能增强可能促进言语感知和神经可塑性的初步证据，但强调该初步研究样本量不足以判定临床疗效。

papers.title: Functional reorganization of motor subcircuits in Parkinson's disease.
papers.authors: Theofanopoulou C, Bajaj N, Muñoz Sánchez A, Crosson B, Wolf SL, Krishnamurthy V, McGregor KM, Hackney ME.
papers.abstract: Parkinson's disease disrupts motor control across multiple body parts, yet the neural mechanisms underlying these impairments remain incompletely defined. We compared resting-state functional connectivity in people with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease scanned in the OFF-medication state (n = 58) and neurotypical older adults (n = 24), focusing on regions implicated in internally generated and externally generated movement pathways. For our analysis, we leveraged the reproducible NeuroMark independent component template and motor effector-specific mapping of primary motor cortex. Our results reveal both increased and decreased connectivity patterns in Parkinson's disease: primary motor cortex subregions associated with control of the leg, hand, and larynx showed robust increases in connectivity exclusively with cerebellar territories, particularly Crus II and Lobules VIIIa/VIIIb. The postcentral gyrus (primary somatosensory cortex) showed primarily increased connectivity with cerebellar regions and the insula. In contrast, the caudate nucleus displayed a mixed profile, with increased connectivity to the superior temporal gyrus and decreased connectivity to the superior medial frontal gyrus and cerebellar Crus II. A post hoc brain-behaviour analysis further suggested that reduced connectivity between the caudate and superior medial frontal gyrus may be associated with greater overall disease severity. Our motor effector-specific analysis of disease severity scores in people with Parkinson's disease revealed mild impairments across all categories (leg, hand, larynx) but disproportionately greater hand-related deficits, suggesting that some of the observed primary motor cortex connectivity differences may be influenced by these behavioural asymmetries. These anatomically precise, effector-specific alterations suggest compensatory recruitment of cerebellar circuits in Parkinson's disease and provide a framework for targeting motor subcircuits in rehabilitation, including dance-based interventions.

relevance.reason: 研究帕金森病患者静息态运动皮层亚区功能连接重组，属疾病中脑网络组织与运动控制机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病运动控制受损的神经机制，比较了轻中度患者在停药状态下的静息态功能连接与神经典型老年人的差异，并按初级运动皮层对应的腿、手、喉等运动效应区进行分析。结果显示，患者初级运动皮层各亚区与多个小脑区域（尤其Crus II及VIIIa/VIIIb小叶）的连接增强，中央后回与部分小脑区域及岛叶的连接也以增强为主；而尾状核则呈混合模式，与颞上回连接增强，与内侧上额回及小脑Crus II连接减弱。事后脑—行为分析提示，尾状核与内侧上额回连接减弱可能与整体疾病严重程度较高相关。作者据此提出，这些效应区特异的连接改变可能反映小脑环路的代偿性募集，并为针对运动亚环路的康复干预提供了参考框架。

papers.title: Lifespan single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the human prefrontal cortex.
papers.authors: Yang H, Clarence T, Scott MR, Wang X, N M P, Pjanic M, Venkatesh S, Hong A, Casey C, Murphy SR, Shao Z, Alvia M, Argyriou S, Yu AK, PsychAD Consortium, Tsankova NM, Auluck PK, Marenco S, Haroutunian V, Voloudakis G, Bendl J, McClung CA, Lee D, Fullard JF, Hoffman GE, Girdhar K, Roussos P.
papers.abstract: The human brain undergoes profound changes from early development through late adulthood, shaping cognition, behaviour and vulnerability to disease1,2 . Understanding how these changes are organized within specific brain regions and cell types is essential for interpreting normal ageing and its relationship to psychiatric and neurodegenerative disorders. The dorsolateral prefrontal cortex has a central role in higher cognitive functions and is particularly sensitive to age-related decline3 , yet its cellular and molecular programs across the human lifespan remain poorly defined. Most existing studies4-7 have focused on restricted age ranges or disease-affected brains, limiting the ability to distinguish normative developmental and ageing trajectories from pathological processes. Consequently, a comprehensive, lifespan-resolved reference of cellular states in the human prefrontal cortex has been lacking. Here, using a single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas spanning the human lifespan, we show that the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex exhibits non-linear, cell-type-specific transcriptional trajectories characterized by dynamic remodelling during development, relative stability in midlife and selective molecular reactivation in late adulthood. We identify distinct neuronal and glial programs, including early-life neuronal resilience pathways and late-life glial programs associated with immune activation, stress responses and circadian reorganization. These programs are anatomically organized across cortical layers and grey-white matter domains, revealing coordinated spatial and molecular changes. Together, these findings provide a framework for understanding how cellular programs transition from resilience to vulnerability in the human cortex and establish a foundation for interpreting age-related cognitive decline and disease risk.

relevance.reason: 该研究构建了人前额叶皮层跨生命周期的单细胞转录组图谱，揭示与高级认知功能相关的细胞类型特异性发育与衰老轨迹及皮层分层空间组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类背外侧前额叶皮层在生命周期中的细胞与分子变化，利用覆盖全生命周期的单核转录组图谱，刻画不同细胞类型的转录轨迹。结果显示，该区域呈现非线性的、细胞类型特异的轨迹：发育期动态重塑，中年相对稳定，晚年出现选择性分子再激活；神经元和胶质细胞各有不同程序，晚年胶质程序与免疫激活、应激反应和昼夜节律重组相关，并在皮层分层及灰白质区域形成空间组织。这些发现为理解细胞程序如何从韧性转向脆弱性、以及解释年龄相关认知衰退和疾病风险提供了参照框架。

papers.title: Resilience beyond diagnosis: prospective neural correlates of better-than-expected outcomes in depression.
papers.authors: Hammes V, Brosch K, Usemann P, David FS, Scherer H, Schmitter C, Bauer J, Borgers T, Flinkenflügel K, Grotegerd D, Leehr EJ, Meinert S, Stein F, Teutenberg L, Thomas-Odenthal F, Dannlowski U, Hahn T, Jamalabadi H, Jansen A, Miller R, Nenadić I, Straube B, Stroh A, Kircher T, Alexander N.
papers.abstract: Resilience, the ability to adapt positively in the face of adversity, is shaped by combined influences of risk and protective factors. Previous neuroimaging studies on resilience have predominantly focused on single factors, often operationalizing resilience dichotomously as the absence of psychiatric disorders despite adversity. In this prospective magnetic resonance imaging study, we defined resilience as "better-than-expected" depressive symptom severity (Hamilton Depression Rating Scale) relative to cumulative risk across 22 risk and protective variables. Using ridge-regularized regression in N = 1804 participants (955 healthy, 849 depressed) from the Marburg-Münster Affective Disorders Cohort Study, we predicted symptom severity and derived residuals as measures of resilience. Residuals were then used to predict gray matter volume (GMV) and cortical thickness at baseline (T1) and two-year follow-up (T2; N = 808). This approach was complemented by extreme-group comparisons of resilient (better-than-expected outcome) and vulnerable (worse-than-expected outcome) individuals. Cumulative risk explained 49.6% of variance in depressive symptoms at T1 and 40.1% at T2. Residual scores showed moderate temporal stability (r = 0.32, p < 0.001). Region-of-interest and whole-brain analyses revealed no morphometric associations with resilience at T1. In contrast, higher resilience at T1 predicted lower GMV in the left inferior orbitofrontal gyrus (IOFG) and temporal pole at T2 (ROI, pFWE(peak) <0.001, rpartial = 0.18), with no changes in cortical thickness. Taken together, resilience to cumulative risk, defined as better-than-expected depressive symptom severity, was not associated with immediate brain structural differences. However, prospective analyses revealed smaller GMV in the IOFG and temporal pole over time, potentially reflecting greater neural efficiency or delayed biological costs.

relevance.reason: 以抑郁症患者为对象，前瞻性分析韧性（优于预期症状结局）与灰质体积/皮层厚度的关联，属脑疾病中脑结构变化与适应机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究把韧性操作化为相对于累积风险而言“好于预期”的抑郁症状严重程度，在抑郁与健康人群组成的前瞻性队列中结合风险因素建模与结构磁共振成像，考察韧性与脑形态的关联。结果发现，累积风险能解释相当部分的症状变异，韧性评分具有一定跨时间稳定性，但基线时未见韧性与脑形态相关；而基线韧性较高者两年后左侧眶额下回和颞极灰质体积较小，皮层厚度无变化。作者据此提出，这种随时间出现的体积减小可能反映更高的神经效率或延迟的生物学代价，而非即时的结构差异。

papers.title: Hyperband versus conventional resting-state fMRI in young adults with high-risk substance use: A within-participant comparison of default mode network measures.
papers.authors: Elsayed M, McIntyre-Wood C, Belisario KL, Sharma B, MacKillop J.
papers.abstract: Background Accelerated resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) may reduce scan time and participant burden, but whether shortened acquisitions preserve functional connectivity profiles and clinical associations remains unclear. This study compared hyperband and conventional acquisitions in characterizing default mode network (DMN) connectivity and associations with substance use. Methods A community sample of 108 young adults with recent heavy substance use (59.93% female; mean age = 20.58 ± 1.13) completed a 9-minute conventional scan and a 4.5-minute hyperband scan. DMN connectivity was assessed using ROI-to-ROI analyses and graph-theory metrics. Substance use measures included cannabis use severity (CUDIT), urine tetrahydrocannabinol positivity (THC+), and hazardous drinking (AUDIT). Results Quality-control metrics did not differ between acquisitions. Conventional rs-fMRI showed higher connectivity between bilateral lateral parietal regions and between the posterior cingulate cortex and left lateral parietal cortex, although overall patterns were comparable. Agreement between acquisitions was low (mean ICC = 0.358 ± 0.123). Graph-theory metrics showed few differences, but most ICCs were non-significant. Nominal associations with substance use were inconsistent across acquisitions. Conclusions Hyperband and conventional rs-fMRI produced similar group-level DMN patterns, but hyperband acquisitions did not reliably preserve individual-level estimates or substance use associations, suggesting hyperband rs-fMRI data should not be assumed as equivalent or readily harmonizable.

relevance.reason: 比较两种静息态fMRI采集在默认网络连接上的表现，属静息态功能网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在近期大量使用物质的年轻社区人群中，比较了加速的hyperband静息态fMRI与常规采集在刻画默认模式网络连接及物质使用关联上的表现。两种采集的质量控制指标无差异，组水平的默认模式网络模式总体相近，但常规采集在部分区域间显示出更高的连接。更关键的是，两种采集在个体水平上的估计一致性较低，与物质使用指标的关联也不一致。作者据此指出，hyperband虽能缩短扫描时间，但并不能可靠保留个体水平的连接估计和物质使用关联，其数据不宜被直接视为与常规采集等价或易于整合。

papers.title: Multiscale alterations of intrinsic neural timescales in anterior ischemic optic neuropathy.
papers.authors: Zhang XN, Zhang XL, He YZ, Chen F, Huang X.
papers.abstract: Background Anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (AION) is primarily an optic nerve disorder, but loss of visual afferent input may also be associated with cortical reorganization. Intrinsic neural timescale (INT), derived from resting-state fMRI, indexes the temporal persistence of BOLD activity. We examined whether AION is associated with altered cortical INT and whether the spatial pattern of these alterations aligns with normative molecular and neurochemical architecture. Methods Resting-state fMRI data were analyzed from 30 patients with AION and 25 healthy controls. Voxel-wise INT was estimated from the autocorrelation of BOLD signals, and group differences were tested using Gaussian random field correction. Exploratory network-level comparisons were performed without multiple-comparison correction. Spatial associations with Allen Human Brain Atlas gene expression and PET-derived neurotransmitter maps were assessed using partial least squares regression and spatial permutation tests, respectively. Results Compared with healthy controls, patients with AION showed lower INT in the bilateral calcarine cortex, with no regions showing higher INT. Exploratory uncorrected network comparisons yielded lower estimates in the auditory and anterior attention networks. The regional INT contrast aligned with normative transcriptional gradients enriched for synaptic and neuronal processes and with the spatial distributions of several neurotransmitter receptor systems. Conclusions AION was associated with a focal reduction in calcarine INT under the primary operational definition used in this study. Normative transcriptomic and receptor maps provided biological context for the spatial pattern but did not establish patient-specific molecular changes or causal mechanisms.

relevance.reason: 研究前部缺血性视神经病变患者静息态fMRI内在神经时间尺度改变及皮层重组，涉及视觉输入丧失后的脑功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注前部缺血性视神经病变（AION）是否伴随皮层内在神经时间尺度（INT）的改变，并分析这种改变的空间模式是否与规范分子和神经化学架构相符。研究基于静息态fMRI比较AION患者与健康对照的体素级INT，发现患者双侧距状皮层INT降低，未发现INT升高的区域；探索性网络比较还提示听觉网络和前注意网络的估计值较低。作者指出，这些区域差异与富含突触和神经元过程的转录梯度及若干神经递质受体系统的空间分布相吻合，但强调规范图谱仅提供生物学背景，不能据此确立患者特异的分子变化或因果机制。

papers.title: The modulatory effect of spatial frequency on audiovisual emotional integration: An ERP study.
papers.authors: Wu F, Hao T, Wang W, Yang J, Zhao X, Wang M.
papers.abstract: Although the brain integrates multisensory inputs to assess emotions, the temporal neural dynamics of audiovisual affective processing for spatial frequency-modulated facial expression have yet to be clarified. Here, we employed event-related potentials to explore this issue. Participants performed an emotion categorization task, in which they judged happy, neutral, and fearful faces filtered into broad spatial frequency (BSF), high spatial frequency (HSF), or low spatial frequency (LSF) conditions, with stimuli presented in visual and audiovisual modalities. Behavioral results showed that the audiovisual facilitative effect depended on SF, being most pronounced for HSF and attenuated for BSF or LSF. Electrophysiological results revealed a threat-driven audiovisual emotion-perception process at the early sensory stage, whereby audiovisual enhancement was modulated by SF across emotions. At the P1 and N170 components, fearful stimuli elicited the strongest audiovisual enhancement across all SFs; neutral stimuli showed significant enhancement under both HSF and LSF, whereas happy stimuli exhibited facilitation exclusively at the P1 component under HSF conditions. In contrast, the early posterior negativity (EPN) audiovisual effect was sensitive to happy and neutral faces under BSF and LSF conditions. The late positive potential (LPP) revealed that audiovisual enhancement was interactively modulated by SF and emotion, with selective enhancement observed for happy faces under BSF, neutral faces under HSF, and fearful faces under both HSF and LSF conditions. These findings suggest that audiovisual emotion integration is tuned to distinctive SF contents across different emotional stimuli at different temporal processing stages, with early prioritization for threat-related stimuli.

relevance.reason: 用ERP研究视听情绪整合的神经时间动态，属情绪与社会认知的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用事件相关电位考察空间频率如何调节视听情绪整合，参与者对经过不同空间频率滤波的高兴、中性和恐惧面孔做情绪分类。行为结果显示视听促进效应依赖空间频率，在高空间频率下最明显，在宽频和低空间频率下减弱。电生理结果显示，早期阶段恐惧刺激在各空间频率下都引发最强的视听增强，而晚期阶段空间频率与情绪交互调节视听增强，不同情绪在不同频率条件下表现出选择性增强。作者据此认为，视听情绪整合在不同加工阶段会随情绪刺激所侧重的空间频率内容而变化，早期优先处理威胁相关刺激。

papers.title: Dissociable prefrontal dynamics and evidence accumulation in experiential versus material value-based decisions: insights from fNIRS and computational modeling.
papers.authors: Zhang C, Xu S.
papers.abstract: Value-based decisions often require the integration of information that is not directly observable but internally constructed from memory, simulation, and affective processes. Although previous research has extensively examined valuation for options with explicit attributes, less is known about how such internally generated information influences the dynamics of evidence accumulation and its neural implementation. In this study, we integrated functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) with Hierarchical Drift Diffusion Modeling (HDDM) to examine decision processes in experiential versus material contexts, which differ in their reliance on internally constructed versus externally specified value information. Behaviorally, experiential choices were associated with higher willingness to upgrade and reduced sensitivity to price. Computationally, HDDM revealed that this preference was driven by a drift bias toward upgrading, while decision thresholds remained stable. At the neural level, fNIRS showed increased activation in a prefrontal network including the frontopolar cortex (FPC), inferior frontal gyrus (IFG), and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) during experiential evaluation. Dynamic causal modeling (DCM) further indicated condition-dependent modulation of intrinsic connectivity within dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, characterized by reduced self-inhibitory coupling. Together, these findings suggest that differences in value construction are associated with systematic variation in the efficiency of evidence accumulation and with corresponding changes in prefrontal functional dynamics. The observed links between drift rate, prefrontal dynamics, and individual differences in subjective effort and evaluation strategies provide a coherent bridge between computational mechanisms and their neural substrates, offering a network-level account of how internally generated information is integrated during value-based decision-making.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS和计算建模研究价值决策的证据累积与前额叶动态，属决策神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注当价值信息需要由记忆、模拟和情感过程在内部构建时，决策的证据累积过程及其前额叶神经基础如何变化。作者用功能近红外成像结合分层漂移扩散模型，比较体验性与物质性两类价值情境下的选择。行为上，体验性选择表现出更强的升级意愿和对价格较不敏感；计算建模显示这主要来自朝向升级的漂移偏置，而决策阈值保持稳定。神经层面，体验性评估时前额叶网络活动增强，动态因果建模还提示背外侧前额叶内在连接出现条件依赖的调制。作者据此认为，价值构建方式的差异与证据累积效率及前额叶功能动态的系统性变化相关，并将漂移率、前额叶动态与主观努力和评估策略的个体差异联系起来。

papers.title: Automated MRI-based parcellation of a putative core auditory region in individual human Heschl's gyrus.
papers.authors: Namgung JY, Byeon K, Poeppel D, Park H, Lee HS, Park BY.
papers.abstract: The human auditory cortex exhibits substantial anatomical variability, making precise individual-level delineation challenging. Although recent advances in imaging and machine learning techniques have enabled the delineation of approximate boundaries of the human primary auditory cortex, existing approaches often fail to adequately capture individual anatomical variability. Here, we propose an openly accessible, fully automated MRI-based pipeline for identifying a putative core auditory region within Heschl's gyrus by integrating intracortical myelin estimates with cortical curvature. A data-driven clustering algorithm was used to identify highly myelinated regions, and curvature-based constraints were subsequently applied to refine their anatomical boundaries. The resulting parcellations exhibited high myelin-related contrast and accommodated duplicated Heschl's gyri in the examined examples, illustrating their application to complex individual anatomical configurations. Comparative analyses of myelin-only and curvature-constrained definitions demonstrated that the curvature-constrained parcellation showed greater overlap with atlas-defined A1 and TE1.0 and stronger structural connectivity with the medial geniculate body of the thalamus as well as medial and lateral belt areas. Seed-based functional connectivity analyses further revealed connectivity patterns associated with auditory and multisensory functions that were consistent with previous literature. These findings support the parcellated region as an anatomically informed, MRI-based operational definition of a putative core auditory region. Although tonotopic validation remains necessary to establish the correspondence between parcellated boundaries and functionally defined auditory core areas, the proposed approach provides a reproducible framework for investigating the structural and functional organization of Heschl's gyrus at the individual level.

relevance.reason: 提出基于MRI的个体化Heschl回核心听觉区自动分割，结合髓鞘与曲率并验证结构连接和功能连接，属人脑结构-功能组织与听觉感知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人类听觉皮层解剖变异大、个体水平精确勾画困难的问题，提出一套公开可用的全自动MRI流程，结合皮层内髓鞘估计与皮层曲率，在个体Heschl's gyrus内识别假定的核心听觉区。该流程先用数据驱动聚类找出高髓鞘化区域，再以曲率约束细化边界，所得分区髓鞘对比明显，并能适应重复出现的Heschl's gyrus等复杂构型。与仅用髓鞘的定义相比，加入曲率约束的分区与图谱定义的A1和TE1.0重叠更多，与丘脑内侧膝状体及内外侧带区的结构连接更强，种子点功能连接也呈现与听觉及多感觉功能相符的模式。作者据此将该分区视为基于MRI、兼顾解剖信息的核心听觉区操作性定义，但指出其与功能定义核心区的对应仍需音调拓扑验证。

papers.title: Distinct neural networks for experiential and descriptive representations of natural hazard risk.
papers.authors: Fujimi T, Kochiyama T, Sato W.
papers.abstract: Environmental risks are communicated through experiential formats, such as pictures, videos, and virtual reality simulations, and descriptive formats, such as hazard maps and graphs, yet the neural systems engaged by these formats remain unclear. We acquired functional magnetic resonance imaging data from 45 healthy adults while they viewed first-person three-dimensional computer-generated flood videos and official flood maps, along with matched non-flood controls, in a within-subject 2 × 2 factorial design. Participants rated subjective fear after each stimulus. Neural responses were characterized using whole-brain general linear model analyses, anatomically defined region-of-interest analyses, and group independent component analysis. Flood videos produced a greater flood-related increase in subjective fear than flood maps. Relative to maps, videos elicited stronger flood-related responses in bilateral occipito-temporal and temporo-parietal cortices, sensorimotor and cingulate regions, pulvinar nuclei, and the cerebellum; the region-of-interest analysis further revealed greater right amygdala activation. In contrast, flood maps showed greater flood-related responses in bilateral frontal and parietal regions, including dorsolateral prefrontal and intraparietal areas commonly implicated in cognitive control and symbolic-spatial processing. Independent component analysis indicated that the video-favoring interaction was predominantly expressed in a single component overlapping regions commonly associated with perceptual and salience processing, whereas the map-favoring interaction was distributed across multiple components, including components resembling frontoparietal control networks. Taken together, these regional and network-level differences were broadly consistent with the hypothesized distinction between experiential and descriptive risk processing. The two formats may therefore offer complementary routes for flood-risk communication.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI比较体验式视频与描述式地图引发的恐惧与认知控制脑网络，属情绪与认知加工的神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注洪灾风险的不同呈现方式是否对应不同的神经加工系统，让健康成人在观看第一人称三维洪水视频和官方洪水地图（并设匹配的非洪水对照）时接受功能磁共振成像，并在每次刺激后评定主观恐惧。结果显示，洪水视频比洪水地图引发更强的恐惧上升，并在双侧枕颞、颞顶、感觉运动与扣带区域、丘脑枕核及小脑产生更强的洪水相关反应，右侧杏仁核也更强；洪水地图则在双侧额顶区域（包括背外侧前额叶和顶内区）反应更强。独立成分分析进一步表明，视频优势效应主要集中于一个重叠于知觉与显著性加工区域的成分，而地图优势效应分布于多个成分，其中包括类似额顶控制网络的成分。作者认为，这些区域和网络层面的差异大体符合体验式与描述式风险加工的区分，两种格式或可为洪水风险传播提供互补途径。

papers.title: Concurrent alterations in brain hemispheric asymmetry of structural and functional networks in single-sided deafness.
papers.authors: Jiao S, Qiao Y, Liu Q, Zhu M, Guo H, Shang Y.
papers.abstract: Brain asymmetry of structure and function, which is critical for high-level cognitive abilities, is influenced by the information received and processed in the two hemispheres. Single-sided deafness (SSD) is a prevalent clinical condition, representing an extreme case of partial sensory deprivation. However, how unilateral hearing loss affects brain hemispheric asymmetry remains poorly understood. To address this issue, we recruited 35 postlingual-onset long-term SSD patients (19/16 left/right SSD) and 18 normal hearing controls, collected their structural (diffusion tensor imaging) and resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data, performed deterministic fiber tractography and functional connectivity analysis to construct white matter structural and resting-state functional networks, and examined plastic alterations in their topological asymmetry across multiscale hierarchical networks (i.e., global, modular, and nodal networks). Our results revealed a rightward shift in hemispheric asymmetry for both structural and functional networks after unilateral hearing deprivation, particularly in patients with right SSD, which was related to an increase in topological properties of the right hemisphere (RH), suggesting improved connection efficiency of the RH. Moreover, in-depth modular and nodal analyses revealed that reorganized global asymmetry was driven mainly by altered asymmetry in sensory and multisensory integration areas (i.e., the temporal lobe, the occipital lobe, and subcortical nuclei). Together, these findings indicate that SSD induces concurrent reorganization in brain asymmetry of both structural and functional networks. Furthermore, these findings suggest that more efficient utilization of the nondominant RH may be an important compensatory pattern after partial sensory deprivation.

relevance.reason: 研究单侧耳聋者结构网络与静息态功能网络的半球不对称重组，涉及感觉剥夺后的脑组织与可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注单侧听力剥夺如何影响大脑结构与功能网络半球不对称性，比较了语后长期单侧耳聋患者与听力正常对照的结构和静息态功能网络。结果显示，单侧听力剥夺后结构与功能网络的不对称性均向右侧偏移，在右侧耳聋患者中尤为明显，并与右半球拓扑属性增强相关，提示右半球连接效率提高。模块和节点层面的分析进一步表明，整体不对称重组主要源于颞叶、枕叶及皮层下核团等感觉与多感觉整合区域的不对称改变。作者据此认为，单侧耳聋会引发结构与功能网络不对称性的同步重组，更高效地利用非优势右半球可能是部分感觉剥夺后的一种重要代偿模式。

papers.title: From normative values to pain assessment models: A large-scale study of laser-evoked brain responses.
papers.authors: Zhuang Y, Zhang L, Yu Y, Liu X, Geng X, Hu L.
papers.abstract: Accurately assessing pain remains challenging due to its inherently subjective nature, highlighting the need for normative and objective neural indicators to support pain diagnosis. Using large-scale electroencephalography (EEG) datasets (N = 936), the present study establishes normative values for laser-evoked brain responses (LEP) and develops a predictive model of perceived pain intensity. Three major findings emerged. First, we characterized the typical EEG features elicited by nociceptive laser stimuli and constructed their normative reference ranges using normative modeling. Second, within a linear mixed-effects model framework, subjective pain ratings were reliably predicted by LEP features, each of which demonstrated distinct predictive contributions. Third, multilevel parallel mediation analyses demonstrated that N1, N2, and P2 amplitudes, N2 latency, as well as the magnitude of γ-band event-related synchronization (γ-ERS) serve as key neural mediators linking stimulus intensity to subjective pain perception. Collectively, these results elucidate how different EEG features encode variability in pain perception and provide a normative neurophysiological foundation for future pain research and clinical applications.

relevance.reason: 研究激光诱发电位EEG特征如何编码疼痛感知，属感知（疼痛）神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于大规模脑电数据集，旨在建立激光诱发电位（LEP）的常模参考值，并构建能够预测主观疼痛强度的模型。研究刻画了伤害性激光刺激诱发的典型脑电特征及其常模范围，并在线性混合效应模型框架下发现LEP特征可可靠预测主观疼痛评分，各特征贡献不同。中介分析进一步显示，N1、N2、P2波幅、N2潜伏期及γ频段事件相关同步幅度是连接刺激强度与主观疼痛感知的关键神经中介。这些结果揭示了不同脑电特征如何编码疼痛感知的个体差异，并为疼痛研究和临床应用提供了神经生理学常模基础。

papers.title: fNIRS in autism neuroscience: From replication to discovery.
papers.authors: Zhao Y, Li Z, He S.
papers.abstract: Studying the neural basis of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) has long been hampered by a mismatch: core social features unfold during interaction, whereas standard neuroimaging commonly relies on isolated, scanner-based environments. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) partly addresses this mismatch. It is portable, more tolerant of moderate movement than fMRI, and compatible with live social interaction, although it remains sensitive to optode motion and systemic physiology and is restricted primarily to superficial cortex. This narrative review examines three contributions of fNIRS to ASD neuroscience: access to developmental populations that are difficult to study with fMRI; dyadic paradigms that measure neural coordination during live interaction; and integration with behavioral, gaze, autonomic, and electrophysiological signals. We then review wearable and naturalistic systems, machine-learning-based classification, and applications across related neurodevelopmental conditions, while critically appraising small samples, task heterogeneity, and preprocessing variability. Among the 25 reports examined in detail, no classification model had been evaluated in an independent external ASD cohort. Eleven reports linked an fNIRS-derived measure to a clinical, behavioral, or developmental outcome through at least one statistically significant association. These associations were generally exploratory, cross-sectional, and not independently validated. The evidence therefore supports fNIRS as a research tool for cortical hemodynamic measurement, while specific fNIRS-derived patterns of regional activation or connectivity have yet to be validated as biomarkers. Priorities include longitudinal multi-site cohorts, physiologically informed preprocessing, population-specific motion validation, independent model testing, and direct linkage of neural measures to developmental or treatment outcomes.

relevance.reason: 综述fNIRS在自闭症社会互动神经机制研究中的应用，涉及活体互动中的神经协调与皮层血流动力学测量，属社会认知与自然情境脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）在孤独症神经科学中的三类应用：接触难以用fMRI研究的发育人群、在真实互动中测量双人神经协调，以及与其他行为、眼动、自主神经和电生理信号结合。作者还评述了可穿戴与自然情境系统、基于机器学习的分类及相关神经发育状况中的应用，并指出小样本、任务异质性和预处理差异等问题。在详细考察的报告中，尚无分类模型在独立外部孤独症队列中验证，部分fNIRS指标与临床或行为结果的关联多为探索性、横断面且未经独立验证。因此，fNIRS目前更适合作为研究工具，其特定激活或连接模式尚不能作为生物标志物。

papers.title: Salient affective scenes compete with concurrent visual responses in the absence of task demands.
papers.authors: Mirifar A, Ayomen E, Engle H, Gilbert F, Melville G, Hammes E, Lee A, Mathews CA, Keil A.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Visual attention systems of the human brain resolve competition between concurrent inputs by prioritizing information that is relevant to an observer's goals, motives, and biological states. Research shows that concurrent distractors-especially emotionally salient stimuli-reduce task performance and visual responses to task cues. In many naturalistic viewing situations however, there are multiple competing cues with no obvious demarcation between task and distractor. The present study examined whether viewing two overlapping task-irrelevant stimulus streams produces emotion-dependent competition in visual cortex. Steady-state visual evoked potential (ssVEP) frequency tagging independently quantified visuocortical activity elicited by a picture (6.7 Hz) stream that overlapped with a central fixation-cross flickering at 15 Hz. We replicated established interference effects within the picture stream, showing that rapidly changing emotionally salient (pleasant and unpleasant) pictures elicited a strong reduction in the 6.7 Hz ssVEP envelope relative to neutral pictures. The 15 Hz ssVEP to the flickering fixation cross paralleled these findings, being more attenuated when competing with emotional, compared to neutral pictures. Change-point analyses indicated that competition latency varied with picture saliency, occurring earlier for pleasant and unpleasant than for neutral streams. Together, the present study suggests that visuocortical mass activity displays emotion-modulated competition effects in the absence of task demands.

relevance.reason: 用ssVEP频率标记研究人视觉皮层中情绪显著刺激与竞争性视觉输入的注意竞争机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在没有明确任务要求时，同时呈现的视觉输入是否会在视觉皮层产生情绪依赖的竞争。研究者用稳态视觉诱发电位频率标记，分别测量重叠呈现的图片流与中央注视十字所诱发的视皮层活动。结果发现，快速变化的情绪性（愉快和不愉快）图片相比中性图片，会明显压低图片流诱发的反应；注视十字的反应也在与情绪图片竞争时受到更强削弱，且情绪图片引发的竞争出现得更早。作者据此认为，即使没有任务需求，视皮层群体活动也会表现出受情绪调节的竞争效应。

papers.title: Neural connectivity patterns associated with high-altitude residence duration: An exploratory cross-validated multimodal MRI study.
papers.authors: Guan F, Xie W, Wang F, Ma H, Li Y, Zhang Y, Peng K.
papers.abstract: Living at high altitudes (HA) poses challenges to the brain due to hypobaric hypoxia. However, most neuroimaging studies have focused on group-level comparisons, leaving the brain features associated with individual differences in HA residence duration incompletely characterized. We therefore used a data-driven, individualized, multimodal machine learning framework for exploratory cross-validated association analysis to estimate individuals' HA residence duration after adjustment for age and gender. The analysis included 217 healthy migrants at HA and incorporated whole-brain anatomical morphometry, structural connectivity (SC), and functional connectivity (FC). Resting-state FC showed the highest estimate-target correlation among the unimodal models (r = 0.34, permutation p = 0.01, out-of-sample predictive R² = -0.15, MAE = 41.04 months, RMSE = 52.39 months). Combining FC and SC produced a numerically higher r and lower MAE and RMSE (r = 0.36, permutation p = 0.01, out-of-sample predictive R² = 0.00, MAE = 38.37 months, RMSE = 48.86 months) than FC alone, but the difference in correlation was not statistically significant. The FC model thus showed a statistically significant but modest cross-validated association with the residualized target, but its accuracy was insufficient to support clinical prediction or monitoring of HA residence duration. Meanwhile, FC within the somatomotor network (SMN) showed a positive contribution to model estimation, while FC between the SMN and the default mode network (DMN) showed a negative contribution. Positive contributions were observed for SC between the DMN and the frontoparietal network and for FC between the DMN and the dorsal attention network. SC between the thalamus and the posterior superior temporal sulcus (pSTS) showed a positive contribution to model estimation. Whether these residence-duration-associated connectivity patterns reflect within-person changes over time requires longitudinal investigation. As no behavioral validation was performed in this study, the functional significance of these connectivity patterns remains to be determined.

relevance.reason: 用多模态MRI（结构连接、静息态功能连接）研究高海拔居住时长相关的脑连接模式，属脑结构与功能组织及静息网络研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注高海拔居住时长与个体脑连接特征之间的关系，采用探索性交叉验证的多模态机器学习框架，对健康高海拔移民的全脑形态、结构连接和功能连接进行分析，以估计其居住时长。静息态功能连接与居住时长的关联在统计上显著但幅度有限，且预测精度不足以支持临床预测或监测；功能连接与结构连接结合后数值上略有改善，但差异不显著。感觉运动网络内部功能连接及部分默认模式网络相关连接对估计有正向贡献，感觉运动网络与默认模式网络之间的功能连接则为负向贡献。作者强调这些关联模式是否反映个体随时间的变化尚需纵向研究，其功能意义也有待行为学验证。

papers.title: The physiology of mental representations: from single neurons to circuits.
papers.authors: Constantinidis C, Everling S, Treue S, Wong RK, Wang M, Yang S, Martinez-Trujillo J.
papers.abstract: Mental representations enable the brain to transcend the immediacy of sensory input and operate on internal models of the world. Working memory (WM) provides the neural substrate that maintains, manipulates, and accesses these representations over behaviorally relevant timescales. Early studies identified persistent neuronal activity in the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) as a key mechanism supporting WM, arising from specialized recurrent microcircuits in which excitatory and inhibitory interactions sustain information in the absence of external stimulation. Subsequent research has revealed a richer and more diverse set of mechanisms underlying WM representations. Depending on task demands, cognitive state, and behavioral context, information can be encoded through persistent activity, oscillations, activity-silent synaptic processes, and temporally structured neural sequences. These representational formats emerge from canonical cortical microcircuits composed of excitatory and inhibitory neurons whose physiological properties vary across brain regions. Interactions between WM, attention, and executive control ensure that internal representations are selectively maintained, updated, and flexibly deployed to guide reasoning, planning, and decision-making. At a broader systems level, WM representations distributed across prefrontal, association and sensory cortices may occupy low-dimensional neural manifolds whose geometry defines the content of conscious access, allowing memories, goals, and imagined scenarios to enter awareness even in the absence of sensory input. Together, current evidence suggests that WM representations are emergent properties of recurrent, hierarchical neural networks whose dynamics are continuously shaped by context, experience, and behavioral demands, providing a flexible neural architecture for adaptive cognition and conscious thought.

relevance.reason: 综述工作记忆心理表征的神经机制，涵盖前额叶持续活动、振荡、突触过程及皮层网络组织，属认知与脑。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕心理表征的生理基础展开，重点讨论工作记忆如何在行为相关的时间尺度上维持、操作和提取内部信息。文章指出，早期研究将背外侧前额叶的持续神经元活动视为工作记忆的关键机制，而后续证据显示，信息还可通过振荡、活动静默的突触过程和时序性神经序列等多种形式编码，具体格式取决于任务需求、认知状态和行为情境。作者进一步提出，这些表征源于兴奋性与抑制性神经元构成的皮层微环路，并可能分布于前额叶、联合皮层和感觉皮层，以低维神经流形的几何结构界定意识通达的内容；工作记忆与注意、执行控制的交互则保证内部表征被选择性维持、更新和灵活调用。整体上，综述将工作记忆表征视为递归层级网络随情境、经验和行为需求不断塑造的涌现属性，为理解适应性认知和意识思维提供了灵活架构。

papers.title: Aging of lexical selection and phonological encoding in Chinese spoken word production: An EEG study.
papers.authors: Xing Z, Yang Q, Zhang Q.
papers.abstract: Using a picture-word interference paradigm combined with electroencephalography (EEG), this study investigated how healthy aging affects the temporal dynamics of lexical selection and phonological encoding during spoken word production. Younger and older adults named pictures while word frequency, syllable frequency, and phonological relatedness between targets and distractors were systematically manipulated. Behaviorally, older adults exhibited larger word frequency and syllable frequency effects but reduced phonological facilitation relative to younger adults, indicating age-related changes in both lexical and phonological processing. ERP analyses revealed stage-dependent age differences across successive stages of lexical selection, phonological encoding, and phonetic encoding. Although both groups showed sensitivity to lexical frequency, older adults exhibited reduced and temporally altered neural sensitivity to lexical frequency during early and intermediate processing, alongside increased influence of phonological distractors. Both groups continued to exhibit lexical-phonological interactions during later phonetic encoding. ERP decoding and temporal generalization analyses revealed relatively preserved word-frequency representations across age groups, whereas syllable-frequency and phonological-facilitation representations emerged later and were less temporally stable in older adults. These findings indicate that healthy aging affects both lexical and phonological processing, with more pronounced alterations in the timing and temporal stability of phonological representations. Age-related differences extended across multiple stages of spoken word production. The pattern of increased sensitivity to phonological competition and reduced stability of phonological representations is consistent with the inhibitory deficit hypothesis and the transmission deficit hypothesis, respectively, suggesting that age-related changes in spoken word production arise from both less efficient phonological transmission and reduced control over competing phonological information.

relevance.reason: 用EEG研究汉语口语产生中词汇选择与音韵编码的老化，报告语言加工阶段与神经表征变化。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用图词干扰范式结合脑电，考察健康老化如何影响汉语口语产生中词汇选择与语音编码的时间进程。行为上，老年人词频和音节频率效应更大、语音促进减弱；脑电显示老化差异贯穿词汇选择、语音编码和音位编码多个阶段，老年人对词频的神经敏感性降低且时序改变，语音表征出现更晚、时间稳定性更差。作者认为，这些变化分别与抑制缺陷假说和传递缺陷假说相符，提示口语产生老化既源于语音传递效率下降，也源于对竞争语音信息控制减弱。

papers.title: Hemimegalencephaly with accelerated myelination in the affected hemisphere.
papers.authors: Bermúdez LMO, Vergara JCM, Torres O.
papers.abstract: Hemimegalencephaly is an uncommon malformation of cortical development characterized by congenital enlargement and dysplasia of part or all of one cerebral hemisphere. It usually presents in early life with developmental delay, hemiparesis, and drug-resistant seizures. We report the case of a 7-month-old boy with recurrent seizures beginning in the neonatal period. Electroencephalography demonstrated slow spike-and-wave discharges arising from the left frontotemporal region and propagating to the ipsilateral centroparietal region. Brain MRI showed enlargement of the left cerebral hemisphere, thickened and dysmorphic gyri predominantly in the frontal lobe, ventricular asymmetry, and an aberrant left midsagittal fiber tract located beneath the corpus callosum. The involved white matter showed visually advanced myelination for age, manifested by relatively increased T1-weighted signal and decreased T2-weighted signal compared with the expected myelination pattern at 7 months. These findings are consistent with left hemimegalencephaly with accelerated myelination. This case illustrates a recognizable MRI pattern that may support early diagnosis in infants with epilepsy, while emphasizing that the relationship between epileptic activity and accelerated myelination remains associative rather than causal in a single-patient report.

relevance.reason: 单病例报告半侧巨脑畸形的脑结构异常（白质髓鞘化加速、异常纤维束）与癫痫，涉及脑发育与结构组织，符合结构-功能和脑疾病机理。

papers.summary_zh: 本文报告一例7个月大男婴的病例，其自新生儿期起反复癫痫发作，脑电图显示左侧额颞区慢棘慢波放电并向同侧中央顶区扩散。脑MRI显示左大脑半球增大、以额叶为主的脑回增厚且形态异常、脑室不对称，以及胼胝体下方的异常左中线纤维束；受累白质髓鞘化程度在视觉上超前于同龄预期，表现为T1信号相对增高、T2信号相对降低。作者据此判断为左侧巨脑回畸形伴髓鞘化加速，并指出这种可识别的MRI模式或有助于癫痫婴儿的早期诊断，但单例报告中癫痫活动与髓鞘化加速之间仅为关联，不能推断因果关系。

papers.title: Case Report: Sustained Cognitive Improvement and Reversible Brain Hypoperfusion in the Context of Posterior Fossa Arachnoid Cyst Shunting Procedure in KBG Syndrome.
papers.authors: Fabre A, Cuny ML, Fillon L, Boisgontier J, Ouss L, Cabet S, Dangouloff-Ros V, Saitovitch A, Puget S, Munnich A, Zilbovicius M, Boddaert N.
papers.abstract: KBG syndrome is a genetic syndrome characterized by developmental delay, mild autism spectrum disorder (ASD), variable cognitive disorders and distinctive craniofacial and skeletal features. Posterior fossa arachnoid cysts (PFACs) have been reported in this condition as in other syndromic forms of ASD, but their impact remains uncertain. Here, we report a ten-year follow-up of a patient with KBG syndrome and PFAC shunted for progressive cyst enlargement and his clinical symptoms, who showed important cognitive and behavior improvement post-drainage. Preoperative neuropsychological assessment revealed severe ASD, heterogeneous cognitive profile with below-average IQ (82, average ≥90), slow processing speed (66, cut-off <70), prominent executive function and memory impairments but normal verbal index and working memory. Whole-brain arterial spin labelling MRI showed a markedly reduced cerebral blood flow in the left superior temporal sulcus (STS), a key region for social cognition. Eighteen-month post cystoperitoneal shunt, cyst volume had decreased (34 vs 10 mL), STS perfusion was no longer different from controls and high cognitive improvements were observed (IQ: +1SD, verbal index: +2SD, executive functions planning and flexibility: +3SD, emotional regulation: +1SD, verbal memory: +3SD). At 22 years, autistic traits had decreased, cognitive gains persisted and executive functions progressed again. Visual-motor processing speed, theory of mind and fine motor skills remained low. Resting-state functional MRI seeded from STS showed strengthened temporal connectivity and diffusion imaging revealed increased fibre density in the left temporal lobe. The parallel trajectories of behavioural and neuroimaging improvements may suggest that PFAC surgery could have enabled functional reorganisation within temporal networks in addition to therapeutic interventions, supporting improved cognitive and social outcomes. These results suggest a possible role of the posterior fossa in modulating neurodevelopmental outcomes in ASD-related genetic conditions.

relevance.reason: 单病例随访报告KBG综合征伴后颅窝囊肿分流后认知改善及STS灌注、颞叶连接与纤维密度变化，涉及脑组织与认知/社会认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告追踪一名合并小脑幕下蛛网膜囊肿的KBG综合征患者，因囊肿进行性增大而接受囊肿腹腔分流术，并结合神经心理评估与脑灌注、功能和弥散成像观察其长期变化。分流后囊肿缩小，左侧颞上沟灌注恢复至与对照无差异，认知与行为评分明显改善，自闭特质减少，部分获益在随访多年后仍持续，但视觉运动加工速度、心理理论和精细运动仍偏低。作者认为，行为与影像改善的平行轨迹提示手术可能促进了颞叶网络的功能重组，但这是单例观察，不能据此推断因果关系或临床疗效。

papers.title: Altered default mode, limbic, and dorsal attention network connectivity after negative mood induction in problematic internet use.
papers.authors: Tunalı Aslan S, Kıcıklar S, Fırat Z, Ekinci G, Hamamcı A.
papers.abstract: Problematic internet use is associated with emotion regulation difficulties, and negative mood states are known to trigger such use. However, how negative mood dynamically modulates large-scale brain network connectivity in individuals with problematic internet use remains unclear. This study investigated functional connectivity alterations following negative mood induction using independent component analysis.Twenty individuals with problematic internet use and twenty matched healthy controls underwent resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging before and after negative mood induction. Group-level independent component analysis identified intrinsic brain networks, and a 2 × 2 mixed-design compared within-network connectivity alterations between groups. Two-stage cluster-extent thresholding was employed (voxel-level p < .001 uncorrected; cluster-level FDR p < .05).Mood induction successfully elevated negative affect in both groups. Participants with problematic internet use showed differential connectivity alterations versus controls in four networks: prefrontal-parietal and temporo-sensorimotor subdivisions of Default Mode Network B, Limbic Network B, and Dorsal Attention Network B. The prefrontal-parietal Default Mode and Dorsal Attention effects were robust to non-parametric permutation testing, whereas the temporo-sensorimotor and limbic effects were preliminary. Alterations included increased orbitofrontal-subcallosal and decreased paracingulate-superior frontal connectivity (prefrontal-parietal Default Mode), reduced occipital connectivity (temporo-sensorimotor Default Mode), increased posterior temporal connectivity (Limbic), and decreased frontal pole with increased precuneus connectivity (Dorsal Attention).Problematic internet use is associated with mood-dependent alterations in default mode, limbic, and dorsal attention network connectivity. These network alterations are consistent with emotion regulation deficit models and suggest interventions targeting emotion regulation and prefrontal cognitive control may address neural mechanisms underlying mood-driven internet use.

relevance.reason: 研究问题性网络使用者在负性情绪诱导前后静息态大尺度脑网络连接变化，涉及情绪调节与注意网络的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察问题性网络使用者在负性情绪诱发后大尺度脑网络连接如何动态变化，采用独立成分分析比较问题性网络使用组与匹配健康对照在情绪诱发前后的静息态功能磁共振连接。结果发现，两组负性情绪均被成功诱发，但问题性网络使用组在默认网络、边缘网络和背侧注意网络的若干子网络中表现出与对照组不同的连接改变，其中前额-顶叶默认网络和背侧注意网络效应较稳健，颞-感觉运动默认网络和边缘网络效应仅为初步。作者认为这些情绪依赖的网络改变与情绪调节缺陷模型相符，并提示针对情绪调节和前额认知控制的干预可能触及情绪驱动网络使用的神经机制，但相关发现尚属关联性，临床应用需谨慎。

papers.title: Neurovascular dysfunction in cerebral small vessel disease: impact on cognition and depression using arterial spin labeling and resting-state fMRI.
papers.authors: Zeng P, Luo D, Zeng B, Li B, Peng Y, Xiang Y, Nie L, Li Y.
papers.abstract: To investigate the neurovascular coupling (NVC) differences in cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) with or without cognitive impairment, using arterial transit time corrected cerebral blood flow, dynamic and static regional homogeneity, and explore underlying mechanisms through stepwise multiple linear regression and mediation analysis. Sixty-five CSVD patients and 36 healthy controls underwent resting-state fMRI and arterial spin labeling imaging. Cerebral blood flow, dynamic and static regional homogeneity, and NVC metrics were calculated. Cognitive, depression, and anxiety assessments were conducted. Stepwise multiple linear regression and mediation analysis were performed to understand the relationship between CSVD pathology and cognition status. Altered NVC was mainly distributed in the prefrontal cortex and basal ganglia. Reduced cross-voxel-correlation-coefficients within the whole brain in CSVD were observed. Positive predictors for cognition score included NVC-related metrics in default mode network, precentral gyrus, the whole gray matter and education. Finally, mediation analysis revealed the role of NVC in the relationship between depression and cognitive performance. NVC dysfunction is observed in CSVD. NVC-related abnormality in default mode network, precentral gyrus, the whole gray matter, and education level contribute to global cognition in CSVD. NVC may mediate depression and global cognition.

relevance.reason: 研究脑小血管病患者的静息态fMRI与灌注成像，考察神经血管耦合与认知、抑郁的关系，涉及脑网络组织与疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注脑小血管病（CSVD）患者的神经血管耦合（NVC）异常及其与认知和抑郁的关系，采用动脉自旋标记与静息态功能磁共振成像，比较CSVD患者与健康对照，并分析NVC指标与认知评分的关联。结果显示，NVC改变主要见于前额叶皮层和基底节，患者全脑跨体素相关系数降低；默认网络、中央前回及全灰质的NVC相关指标和教育水平正向预测整体认知，中介分析提示NVC可能在抑郁与整体认知之间起中介作用。作者据此认为，CSVD存在NVC功能障碍，相关异常与教育因素共同关联整体认知，NVC或可解释抑郁对认知的影响，但上述关系来自横断面关联与中介模型，尚不能推断因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: Persistent postural-perceptual dizziness (PPPD): the most common cause of chronic dizziness.
papers.authors: Horii A, Yagi C, Kimura A.
papers.abstract: Persistent postural- perceptual dizziness (PPPD) is a functional disorder that is the most frequent cause of chronic dizziness. Diagnostic criteria for PPPD were published by Bárány Society in 2017 and were then included in the International Classification of Diseases, 11th revision (ICD-11). Core symptoms are dizziness, unsteadiness or non-spinning vertigo, lasting more than three months. Persistent symptoms occur without specific provocation, but are exacerbated by upright posture/walking, active or passive motion, and exposure to moving or complex visual stimuli. An acute or episodic vestibular disorder often precedes the onset of PPPD, but conventional vestibular function tests typically show normal results. Studies using resting-state functional MRI have revealed that functional connectivity between the vestibular cortex and visual areas were low, while that between the somatosensory and visual areas was high, suggesting sensory upweighting of visual and somatosensory information. Such central changes have been shown to associate with peripheral hyper-responsiveness as demonstrated by visual stimulus-loaded posturography and head-roll tilt subjective visual vertical testing, which detects visual and neck proprioceptive hypersensitivity, respectively. As a result, symptoms are exacerbated by visual stimulation or somatosensory input associated with body motion. After visual stimulation, gaze stability remains reduced, which would account for the prolonged dizziness induced by visual stimuli. Pharmacological treatments using serotonergic anti-depressants, vestibular rehabilitation, and cognitive behavioral therapy have been shown favorable effects; however, they are not always effective for all patients. There is an urgent need to establish novel treatments tailored to the pathophysiology of PPPD, i.e., sensory upweighting of visual/somatosensory inputs.

relevance.reason: 以PPPD患者静息态fMRI功能连接改变探讨慢性头晕的脑网络机制，属脑疾病认知/感知机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕持续性姿势-知觉性头晕（PPPD）这一功能性障碍展开，指出它是慢性头晕最常见的原因，其核心症状为持续数月、无特定诱因却可被直立行走、自身或被动运动及复杂视觉刺激加重的头晕与不稳感，且常规前庭功能检查多属正常。静息态功能磁共振研究提示，患者前庭皮层与视觉区的功能连接偏低，而躯体感觉与视觉区连接偏高，作者据此认为这反映了视觉与躯体感觉信息被上调加权，并与视觉负荷姿势描记和头倾斜主观视觉垂直测试所显示的外周高反应性相关，从而解释视觉或体动相关刺激为何加重症状及视觉刺激后凝视稳定性下降。治疗方面，作者提到含血清素能抗抑郁药、前庭康复和认知行为治疗有一定效果但并非对所有患者有效，并呼吁针对这一感觉加权异常的病理生理开发新疗法。

papers.title: A stereoencephalography study of internal speech.
papers.authors: Naumov AV, Soghoyan GA, Makarova AV, Syrov NV, Skripnikov AA, Kustov YV, Sufianov AA, Lebedev MA.
papers.abstract: With advances in intracranial recording techniques, converting speech-related brain activity into commands for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) is becoming increasingly feasible. In this study, we explored the utility of stereoencephalography (sEEG) for decoding covert and overt speech in humans. sEEG data were collected from 11 epilepsy patients undergoing presurgical monitoring, while they performed a set of speech tasks-overt speech, articulated speech, and imagined (inner) speech, as well as a handwriting task. Time- and frequency-domain analyses revealed that each speech condition elicited distinct spectral modulations, particularly in the alpha (8-12 Hz) and gamma (50-80 Hz) bands across temporal and frontal regions. Inner speech exhibited reduced and delayed activation in key motor and language-related areas, distinguishing it from both overt and articulated speech. In contrast, handwriting evoked a different activity pattern, marked by gamma desynchronization and more sustained alpha increases. A machine learning classifier achieved an average accuracy of 72% in distinguishing the three speech conditions based on their neural spectral profiles. These findings show that imagined speech is neurally the most distinct compared to the other speech tasks and demonstrate that sEEG can reliably detect the transitions between internal and overt forms of speech. This work contributes to the development of multimodal BCIs capable of decoding covert language representations, with implications for restoring communication in individuals with severe motor or speech impairments. Supplementary information The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s11571-026-10554-9.

relevance.reason: 颅内sEEG记录人脑在默读/内隐言语与出声言语时的频谱活动，报告语言相关脑区激活差异，属语言产出神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用立体脑电（sEEG）记录接受术前监测的癫痫患者在执行出声、发音、想象（内隐）言语及书写任务时的脑活动，考察不同言语形式在神经频谱上的可区分性。时间与频域分析显示，各言语条件在颞叶和额叶的alpha与gamma频段呈现不同调制模式；内隐言语在关键运动和语言相关脑区的激活更弱且更延迟，因而与出声和发音言语明显不同，书写则表现为gamma去同步和更持续的alpha增强。基于频谱特征的分类器能以约七成平均准确率区分三种言语条件，提示内隐言语在神经层面最为独特，sEEG可较可靠地检测内隐与出声言语之间的转换。作者据此认为，这为解码内隐语言表征的多模态脑机接口提供了依据，并可能有助于严重运动或言语障碍者的沟通恢复。

papers.title: Age-Related Changes in Spontaneous Brain Dynamics Revealed by Resting-State Magnetoencephalography.
papers.authors: Dai Z, Gu Y, Lee TMC.
papers.abstract: Spontaneous neuronal oscillations support large-scale brain communication and are sensitive to adult aging, yet how their moment-to-moment dynamics change across the adult lifespan and relate to cognition remains unclear. Here, we used resting-state magnetoencephalography (MEG) and time-delay embedded hidden Markov modelling to characterize transient oscillatory brain states in 617 healthy adults aged 18-88 years. Aging was associated with a frequency- and region-specific reorganization of spontaneous activity, characterized by increased anterior delta/theta power and reduced posterior alpha and sensorimotor beta power. At the network level, older adults showed lower fractional occupancy of a posterior state dominated by alpha activity. Within this posterior state, stronger alpha-band connectivity was modestly associated with better Addenbrooke's Cognitive Examination-Revised (ACE-R) performance, suggesting that posterior alpha coupling is related to individual differences in global cognitive performance as captured by this measure. Together, these findings reveal subtle age-related differences in spontaneous brain dynamics across the adult lifespan, including a posterior-to-anterior redistribution of state occupancy. Rather than establishing a clinical biomarker or a general marker of cognitive aging, the present results identify posterior alpha connectivity as a behaviorally relevant resting-state MEG feature that warrants further validation in longitudinal and multimodal studies.

relevance.reason: 用静息态MEG研究成人一生中自发脑振荡动态与年龄及认知的关系，属静息态脑网络组织与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注成人一生中自发脑振荡的瞬时动态如何随年龄变化并与认知相关，利用静息态脑磁图和时间延迟嵌入隐马尔可夫模型刻画健康成人的短暂振荡脑状态。结果显示，衰老伴随频率和区域特异的自发活动重组，表现为前部delta/theta功率升高、后部alpha和感觉运动beta功率降低；网络层面上，老年人处于以alpha活动为主的后部状态的时间比例更低，呈现状态占用由后向前转移的趋势。在该后部状态内，较强的alpha频段连接与整体认知表现仅有适度关联，提示后部alpha耦合可能与个体认知差异有关，但作者强调这并非临床生物标志物或认知老化的普遍指标，仍需纵向和多模态研究验证。

papers.title: Frequency-Specific EEG burst dynamics in Parkinson's Disease and freezing of gait.
papers.authors: Leedom M, Pallab MRA, Bharmauria V, Flouty O, Stuart S, Mancini M, Singh A.
papers.abstract: Background Parkinson's disease (PD) disrupts motor networks, but conventional EEG spectral analyses may miss the transient, burst-like structure of pathological oscillations. Freezing of gait (FOG) is a disabling and poorly understood gait disturbance that may involve altered cognitive-motor control. This study aims to determine whether resting-state electroencephalography burst dynamics provide frequency-specific markers of PD and FOG. Methods Resting-state EEG was analyzed from 237 participants across three study sites, including 88 healthy controls and 149 individuals with PD assessed in the clinically defined ON-medication state. Participants with PD were also classified as having FOG (PDFOG +) or not having FOG (PDFOG -). Analyses were harmonized across sites using 11 common EEG channels. Burst dynamics were quantified in theta, alpha, low-beta, and high-beta bands using amplitude-envelope thresholding. Primary analyses focused on low- and high-beta burst dynamics at mid-frontal lead for healthy controls vs PD comparisons, and theta, low-beta, and high-beta burst dynamics for healthy control, PDFOG-, and PDFOG+ comparisons. FOG severity associations were examined using a study site-standardized FOGQ z-scores. Results People with PD showed altered low-beta burst timing, characterized by more frequent, but shorter low-beta bursts compared with healthy controls. These effects were evident at the mid-frontal region and supported by exploratory topographic maps. In three-group analyses, low-beta burst rate and duration differed across groups, but adjusted PD-only models did not support robust PDFOG+ vs PDFOG- differences. In contrast, FOG severity was most consistently associated with theta amplitude-related burst metrics. Conclusions Resting-state EEG burst dynamics reveal dissociable oscillatory signatures in PD. Low-beta burst timing abnormalities reflect general PD-related motor network dysfunction, whereas theta burst amplitude may relate to FOG severity and cognitive-motor network burden.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究分析帕金森病患者静息态脑电的爆发式振荡动态，考察其能否作为区分帕金森病及冻结步态的频段特异性标记。结果显示，患者在中额区出现低β频段爆发时序改变，表现为爆发更频繁但持续时间更短，提示这一异常反映帕金森病相关的普遍运动网络功能障碍；而冻结步态严重程度则与θ频段爆发幅度指标关联更一致，可能反映认知-运动网络负荷。研究未发现冻结步态有无两组间稳健的低β爆发差异，作者据此认为两类振荡特征可分离，但相关发现仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Diagnosis of an Arachnoid Cyst in a Patient Presenting With Uncommon Depressive Symptoms: Case Report.
papers.authors: Arias-Hidalgo R, Ortuño F, Solís-Barquero SM, Fernández-Seara M, de Eulate RG, Yarkin A.
papers.abstract: Arachnoid cysts are most commonly asymptomatic and usually do not need any active treatment. Currently, psychiatric symptoms are seldom taken into consideration during treatment evaluations in this patient population. We present this case of a young man who was treated in our hospital for signs of depression. Due to his atypical presentation, we decided to perform a brain MRI, which detected the presence of an arachnoid cyst located in the right insular region. A further diffusion tensor imaging tractography study was performed, which showed variations in the fractional anisotropy asymmetry indexes. Our case supports the notion that arachnoid cysts can induce different psychiatric conditions, even in the absence of alterations in the neurological examination. Furthermore, it supports the importance of ordering brain imaging studies to rule out the presence of arachnoid cysts, especially if the clinical manifestations and/or age of presentation are unusual. In light of the knowledge of functional neuroanatomy, there is a need for more neuroimaging studies in order to clarify the mechanisms by which certain brain-occupying lesions can induce structural and functional changes.

papers.title: Retinotopic coding organizes the interaction between internally and externally oriented brain networks.
papers.authors: Steel A, Angeli PA, Robertson C.
papers.abstract: The human brain seamlessly integrates internally generated thoughts with incoming sensory information, yet the large-scale networks that support these functions - the internal default network (DN) and external dorsal attention network (dATN) - are traditionally viewed as functionally independent. This raises a crucial question: how does the brain integrate information across these seemingly noninteractive systems? Here, using densely sampled 7T fMRI, individualized resting-state parcellations, and voxel-wise population-receptive-field mapping, we show that these internal/external networks are more interlocked than previously thought. Spontaneous DN and dATN activity during rest is uncorrelated at the network level. However, voxel-scale functional coupling across networks is shaped by the latent visual field preferences of individual voxels in each network, as measured during independent retinotopic mapping. Voxels that share visual field preferences exhibit stronger spontaneous coupling than those with divergent preferences. These retinotopically specific interactions are bivalent: DN voxels with negative (suppressive) visual response amplitudes are anticorrelated with matched (positive) dATN voxels, while those DN voxels with positive response amplitudes are positively correlated. Thus, distinct subpopulations of visually tuned DN voxels participate in spatially specific interactions with the dATN. Further, retinotopic coding is intrinsic to the DN, persisting even during periods when the DN signal is elevated. These findings reveal a latent, voxel-level architecture of retinotopically grounded interactions between the DN and dATN. Taken together, our results suggest that retinotopic coding underpins the dynamic coordination of perception and thought in the human brain.

relevance.reason: 用7T静息态fMRI和视网膜拓扑映射揭示默认网络与背侧注意网络间基于视野偏好的体素级功能耦合，属静息态网络组织与认知网络交互研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注默认网络与背侧注意网络这两个通常被视为功能独立的内外朝向系统如何在脑内实现信息整合。作者用高密度7T fMRI结合个体化静息态分区和体素级群体感受野映射发现，两网络在整体水平上的自发活动并不相关，但体素尺度上的功能耦合受各体素视觉野偏好调节：视觉野偏好相近的体素自发耦合更强。这种视网膜拓扑特异的交互具有双价性，即视觉反应为抑制性的默认网络体素与匹配的注意网络体素呈负相关，而反应为正的体素则呈正相关，提示存在参与空间特异交互的亚群。作者还指出视网膜拓扑编码是默认网络的内在属性，在信号升高时仍持续存在，据此提出这种潜在架构支撑感知与思维的动态协调。

papers.title: Brain Mechanisms of Lexicality in Bilingual Emotion Processing
papers.authors: Xiao C, Liu J, Zhang Y, Lyu W, Desai RH, Feilong M.
papers.abstract: Understanding how native speakers and second language (L2) learners process language differently is fundamental to theories of language acquisition, comprehension, and use. A central debate in this literature concerns the inconsistent findings in emotional prosody processing between native speakers and L2 learners, partly attributable to stimulus lexicality: some studies use real words, whereas others use pseudowords. To resolve this discrepancy, we measured fMRI responses in 15 native speakers and 15 L2 learners while they listened to Mandarin real-word and pseudoword stimuli. Both groups engaged in overlapping auditory, cognitive, and affective regions, including the auditory cortex, inferior frontal cortex, superior temporal cortex, and the temporoparietal junction. However, the two groups showed distinct responses depending on lexicality: native speakers showed stronger recruitment of temporal regions for pseudowords, whereas L2 learners showed greater frontoparietal activation for real words. These patterns were consistent across positive and negative prosody conditions. Furthermore, among L2 learners, higher proficiency was associated with greater frontal activation for real words, but not pseudowords. Together, these findings demonstrate that the differences between native speakers and L2 learners depend critically on stimulus lexicality, highlighting the role of lexicality in bilingual emotion processing.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注母语者与第二语言学习者在情绪韵律加工上的差异是否受刺激词汇性影响，用fMRI比较两组听普通话真词和假词时的脑反应。两组都激活了听觉、认知和情感相关区域，但词汇性调节了组间差异：母语者对假词更多招募颞叶区域，二语学习者对真词则表现出更强的额顶激活，且这一模式在正、负性韵律条件下一致。在二语学习者中，语言水平越高，真词条件下的额叶激活越强，假词条件则无此关联。作者据此认为，母语者与二语学习者的差异关键取决于刺激是否为真词，词汇性在双语情绪加工中起重要作用。

papers.title: Dimensional and Categorical Predictors of Theory of Mind Network Activation: A transdiagnostic fMRI Study in Psychiatric Inpatients
papers.authors: Nagel PM, Hefner S, Said-Yürekli S, Freinhofer D, Winds K, Aichhorn W, Kronbichler M, Kronbichler L.
papers.abstract: Socio-cognitive alterations are widely observed across different psychiatric conditions, yet it remains unclear whether these deficits map onto distinct diagnostic categories or represent a shared transdiagnostic phenotype, driven by dimensional psychopathological symptom severity.This study evaluates Theory of Mind (ToM) network activation during a naturalistic functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) movie paradigm in 313 participants, including 91 healthy controls and 222 psychiatric inpatients across five distinct diagnostic clusters (substance use, schizophrenia spectrum, affective, anxiety, and personality disorders). Frequentist analyses revealed decreased ToM-selective activity in psychiatric patients, compared to controls across all ToM regions of interest (ROIs). No significant difference emerged between diagnostic groups, but ROI activation correlated negatively with Adult Self-Report (ASR) scales ( Total Problems, Internalising, Externalising ). Subsequent Bayesian analysis of covariance (ANCOVAs) consistently favoured models that excluded traditional categorical diagnoses, suggesting that dimensional measures, especially Total Problems and Internalising, provided substantially greater predictive utility for ToM-related regional brain activation. Our findings challenge traditional categorical classifications in neurobiological research as they suggest that atypical mentalising might reflect a shared transdiagnostic vulnerability. Highlights Reduced Theory of Mind specific activation in psychiatric inpatients presents as a shared, transdiagnostic feature. Theory of Mind specific activation shows no disorder-specific patterns across five distinct clinical diagnostic clusters. Bayesian analyses consistently favour continuous psychopathology dimensions over categorical classifications in predicting Theory of Mind specific activation

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神科住院患者的心智化（Theory of Mind）网络活动究竟对应不同诊断类别，还是反映由症状严重程度驱动的跨诊断共同特征。研究纳入健康对照和五类精神科住院患者，用自然情境fMRI电影范式测量心智化相关脑区激活。结果显示，患者在所有心智化感兴趣区的选择性活动均低于对照，但各诊断组之间没有显著差异；这些脑区激活与成人自评量表的总体问题、内化和外化得分呈负相关，贝叶斯分析也更支持用连续症状维度而非传统诊断类别来预测激活。作者据此认为，非典型心智化可能是一种跨诊断的共同易感特征，并据此对神经生物学研究中的分类诊断提出质疑。

papers.title: Latent transdiagnostic dimensions linking sleep and psychopathology map onto distinct connectome-wide networks
papers.authors: Kou Y, Jin X, Lei X, Dong D, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Sleep disturbance is common and clinically consequential across mental disorders. Yet its transdiagnostic role remains difficult to interpret because sleep is often reduced to a global score and psychiatric symptoms to diagnosis-specific outcomes. Here, we leveraged the YaleNeuroConnect cohort to test whether subjective sleep components align with separable dimensions of symptom-related features and connectome-wide organization. We applied canonical correlation analysis to seven Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index components and 55 clinical, affective, cognitive and interpersonal measures in 260 diagnostically diverse subjects, and mapped the resulting dimensions onto resting-state functional connectivity using network-based statistics. We identified two sleep-psychopathology dimensions. The dominant and cross-validated dimension linked widespread subjective sleep disturbance, especially daytime dysfunction, to general symptom burden, including global severity, perceived stress and fatigue. This dimension was expressed in reduced coupling between the default mode network and frontoparietal and cerebellar systems, reduced cerebellar-subcortical coupling, and stronger coupling between the somatomotor network and higher-order systems. A second, more circumscribed dimension linked shorter sleep duration and prolonged sleep latency to lower self-assurance and positive affect, together with heightened affective and perceptual sensitivity. This dimension showed stronger coupling between cerebellar and dorsal attention systems, together with weaker coupling between the default mode network and attention or cerebellar systems. These findings suggest that sleep is not merely a comorbid symptom, but a multidimensional organizing feature of transdiagnostic psychopathology. Distinguishing broad sleep-related distress from sleep-initiation and sensitivity profiles may help refine brain-based stratification and identify sleep dimensions relevant to intervention.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注睡眠困扰在多种精神障碍之间是否具有跨诊断的组织作用，利用耶鲁NeuroConnect队列中诊断多样被试的静息态功能连接数据，将主观睡眠成分与临床、情感、认知及人际测量联系起来。分析得到两个睡眠—精神病理维度：主要且经交叉验证的维度把广泛的主观睡眠紊乱（尤其日间功能障碍）与总体症状负担相连，并对应默认网络与额顶、小脑系统耦合减弱等连接模式；第二个维度则把睡眠时长较短、入睡潜伏期较长与自信和积极情感较低、情感与知觉敏感性较高相连，涉及小脑—背侧注意系统耦合增强等模式。作者据此提出，睡眠不只是共病症状，而是跨诊断精神病理的多维组织特征，区分广泛的睡眠相关痛苦与入睡及敏感性特征可能有助于基于脑的分层和干预。

papers.title: Reduced Neural Convergence and Reorganized Paranoia-Related Representations During Ambiguous Social Narrative Processing in Schizophrenia
papers.authors: Zhang L, Xu B, Deng A, Feng J, Hou Y, Guo S, Zhou F, Wang Y, Liao J, Dong D.
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia may involve a fundamental disruption in the ability to construct a shared understanding of social reality, yet conventional neuroimaging studies have largely examined social cognition using simplified and highly structured paradigms that may not capture how individuals interpret complex and ambiguous interpersonal events in everyday life. Using an ecologically valid naturalistic fMRI paradigm, we examined shared and paranoia-related neural representations during ambiguous social narrative processing in 38 patients with schizophrenia and 46 healthy controls. Intersubject correlation was used to quantify neural convergence across individuals, whereas intersubject representational similarity analysis was used to examine how individual differences in paranoid ideation were reflected in neural representations. Compared with healthy controls, patients with schizophrenia showed reduced neural convergence within distributed systems supporting social inference, contextual integration, and salience attribution, including temporoparietal, temporal, insular, and inferior frontal regions. Furthermore, paranoid ideation was associated with altered neural representational structure. In healthy controls, higher paranoia was linked to reduced neural similarity across social-cognitive and affective regions, suggesting reduced convergence toward shared interpretations of ambiguous social information. In schizophrenia, paranoia-related representations showed sparse within-group associations but elevated patient–control differences across a distributed social-affective circuit, indicating a reorganization rather than a simple amplification of paranoia-related processing. Together, these findings demonstrate that schizophrenia involves both impaired alignment of neural responses during shared social meaning construction and organization of paranoia-related representations, providing an ecologically grounded framework for understanding abnormal social inference in psychosis.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注精神分裂症患者在处理模糊社交叙事时，能否形成与他人共享的社会理解，并考察偏执观念如何体现在神经表征中。研究采用自然情境fMRI范式，比较患者与健康对照者，用受试者间相关量化个体间神经趋同，用受试者间表征相似性分析考察偏执观念与神经表征的关系。结果发现，患者在社会推断、情境整合和显著性归因相关脑区上的神经趋同降低；偏执观念在两组中呈现不同的表征结构：健康对照者偏执越高，社会认知与情感脑区的神经相似性越低，而患者则表现为组内关联稀疏、患者与对照差异广泛升高，提示偏执相关加工发生了重组而非简单增强。作者据此认为，精神分裂症既涉及共享社会意义建构时神经反应对齐的受损，也涉及偏执相关表征的组织改变，为理解精神病性异常社会推断提供了贴近日常情境的框架。

papers.title: Bilateral Angular Gyrus 810-nm Transcranial Near-Infrared Stimulation Reshapes Brain Network: Ameliorate Alzheimer's Disease Cognitive Deficits.
papers.authors: Ma X, Yan F, Liu Z, He S, Liu L, Liang J, Yuan M, Wang S, Qu S, Yang S, Gao Y, Qiu H, Li Y, Yang C, Li Y, Li T, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Objective: To investigate the clinical efficacy and neural mechanisms of targeted 810-nm transcranial near-infrared stimulation (tNIRS) over the bilateral angular gyrus in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Impact Statement: We provide the first clinical evidence that targeted tNIRS ameliorates AD cognitive deficits by dynamically reconfiguring large-scale brain networks, establishing a precise, mechanistic neuromodulation strategy. Introduction: While tNIRS shows potential for AD, conventional whole-brain irradiation lacks anatomical precision and yields inconsistent outcomes. Resolving these elusive network-level mechanisms requires targeted stimulation paradigms. Methods: In a randomized, sham-controlled trial, 36 biomarker-confirmed AD patients received 810-nm tNIRS targeted at the bilateral angular gyrus or sham stimulation (20 min/side daily, 15 d). Baseline and post-intervention neuropsychological assessments, resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), and transcranial magnetic stimulation-electroencephalography (TMS-EEG) were utilized to decode cognitive improvements and network dynamics. Results: Targeted tNIRS obviously improved cognition, memory, language, attention, and executive functions while reducing neuropsychiatric symptoms. fMRI revealed enhanced intra-network connectivity within the default mode network (DMN) and promoted functional synergy between the DMN, dorsal attention, frontoparietal, and limbic networks. TMS-EEG demonstrated enhanced information flow and dynamic nodal reconfiguration, specifically boosting prefrontal and temporo-occipital activation. Conclusion: Bilateral angular gyrus targeted tNIRS may effectively mitigate AD cognitive impairment potentially through modulation of functional connectivity and adaptively reconfiguring higher-order cognitive networks, serving as a highly promising clinical neuromodulation therapy.

papers.title: Kinestesia: the prefrontal EEG response to a cognitive-motor intervention is graded by baseline cognitive status.
papers.authors: Bosch-Bayard JF, Guerrero-Sauzameda J, Navarrete-Torres L, Aguilar-Fabre L, Rodriguez-Valdes RF, Bosch-Bayard RI, Martinez-Finkelstein A, Castro-Luna G, Chiarenza GA.
papers.abstract: Background This is a companion neurophysiological study (N = 19) to a recently published exploratory pilot of the Kinestesia intervention - combining therapeutic videogames, rhythmic gait, and sensory stimulation - in older adults spanning the cognitively healthy (HC, n = 10) to mild cognitive impairment (MCI, n = 9) spectrum. That paper, published in Archives of Gerontology and Geriatrics, reported BH-corrected behavioural gains; here we ask whether the resting-state electrocortical response is graded by baseline cognitive status. Methods Resting-state EEG was recorded before and after 30 sessions in 19 participants (9 MCI, MoCA < 26; 10 HC, MoCA 26-29). Age-referenced Z-scores were computed for eleven pre-specified clinical EEG indices using the Harmonized Functional EEG Derived Phenotypes normative pipeline (HarFEDPNorms). The primary analysis treated the 19 participants as a single sample and correlated baseline MoCA with the pre-to-post change in each index (Spearman ρ), with Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) FDR correction. We assessed robustness to educational attainment using partial correlation. Results Eight of the eleven pre-specified indices showed a BH-corrected continuous association with baseline MoCA. The strongest were the Engagement Index (EI) and the Alpha/Beta Ratio (ABR) at Fp2 (EI: ρ = +0.704, q = 0.008; ABR: ρ = -0.687, q = 0.008): higher baseline cognitive status was associated with greater prefrontal activation after the intervention, and lower status with the reverse. MoCA and education were substantially correlated at the sample level (r = 0.596; 36% shared variance, driven by the HC/MCI contrast), and the primary prefrontal effect (EI Fp2) remained significant after adjusting for education (partial ρ = 0.50, p = 0.033). Conclusion In this small, uncontrolled sample, the electrocortical response to Kinestesia was graded by baseline cognitive status, with a robust prefrontal engagement effect (EI and ABR at Fp2; BH q < 0.01). Findings are exploratory and hypothesis-generating, pending a randomised controlled trial. The HarFEDPNorms pipeline offers a device-independent framework for individualised EEG tracking in intervention research.

papers.title: The orbitofrontal-anterior temporal network complements the attention network for where to look in social situations.
papers.authors: Marek N, Meghanathan RN, Pollmann S.
papers.abstract: Human neuroimaging experiments have consistently found dorsal and ventral attention networks subserving spatial shifts of covert attention or eye movements. However, these experiments used abstract, artificial stimuli for better experimental stimulus control and clearly defined instructions about where to attend or what to search for. This clearly is not an adequate model of eye movement control in natural environments full of semantic and social information. Here, we show that during movie viewing, activation of the dorsal and ventral attention networks was complemented by activation patterns in orbitofrontal and anterior temporal cortex, previously not implicated in human eye movement control, supporting individual decisions where to look. This effect was largely driven by looking at faces. We compared similarity relationships between eye fixation patterns on the one hand and brain activity patterns on the other hand in human participants of either sex. Searching for between-scenes changes in activation patterns that mirrored changes in fixation patterns, we were able to identify the attention networks defined by previous experiments with artificial stimuli. In contrast, interindividual differences in fixation patterns, indicative of endogenous decisions about where to look, were mirrored by activation pattern differences in orbitofrontal and anterior temporal cortex, particularly for scenes presenting faces. Thus, we could precisely replicate the role of the attention networks in a more natural viewing environment. Crucially, we also showed that previous lab experiments, lacking the complexity of free viewing in a naturalistic environment, overlooked the importance of the orbitofrontal - anterior temporal network for individual differences in active vision. Our findings show that the orbitofrontal - anterior temporal network needs to be considered in studies of active vision, particularly in social situations.Significance Statement Human attention networks have been replicated in a naturalistic setting. The attention networks could be mapped by comparing the similarity of fixation patterns and local brain activation patterns between scenes of a movie. In contrast, searching for brain activation reflecting interindividual differences in fixation patterns yielded an orbitofrontal-anterior temporal network. This network showed the highest similarity of fixation and brain activation patterns during scens containing faces, in line with its known function for social communication.
