papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注2型糖尿病患者的脑白质与皮层灰质微结构改变，采用自由水校正的弥散MRI，并结合白质骨架和灰质骨架的空间统计方法，比较患者与健康对照的弥散指标及其与空腹血糖、认知表现的关系。结果显示，患者在白质和灰质骨架均存在广泛的弥散异常，表现为自由水校正后各向异性降低、弥散率升高，而估计的自由水分数未见全骨架范围的组间差异，提示这些异常在排除自由水影响后仍然存在。相关性分析中，较高的空腹血糖与部分白质区域自由水分数升高及皮层灰质弥散增高相关，较低的认知评分则与更广泛的白质和灰质弥散异常相关；这些均为关联性结果，不能直接推断因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis on early adversity and resting-state EEG from infancy to adolescence
papers.authors: Brown HM, Hart E, Rico-Picó J, Gray KN, Chen M, Troller-Renfree SV.
papers.abstract: Early adversity is theorized to alter brain activity detectable via resting-state electroencephalography (EEG), positioning it as a scalable tool in creating a global biomarker of brain health. Yet, the consistency of the association between adversity and EEG across the pediatric literature is unclear. We systematically reviewed 34 papers (N = 4245 EEG recordings) and meta-analytically synthesized 19 papers (N = 2669 EEG recordings, 228 effect sizes) on the association between early adversity and resting-state EEG power. Using a Correlated and Hierarchical Effects Model, we found a small, yet robust association (r = −0.086, 95% CI [−0.132, −0.040]) that withstood sensitivity analyses, publication bias correction, and was comparable for both correlational and randomized controlled trial designs. We found power (absolute, relative) significantly moderated the association, though adversity type, frequency band, resting-state EEG procedure, developmental life stage at EEG, and study design did not. The systematic review revealed a similar pattern of findings while also highlighting inconsistent reporting practices. This robust but modest effect suggests adversity is measurably linked to brain activity. However, with substantial unaccounted for heterogeneity and inconsistent reporting practices, EEG's promise as a scalable biomarker will depend as much on methodological standardization as on further biological characterization.

relevance.reason: 系统综述与元分析考察早期逆境与儿童青少年静息态EEG功率的关联，属静息脑活动与脑发育研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过系统综述与元分析，检验早期逆境与儿童青少年静息态脑电功率之间关联的一致性。作者整合多项脑电记录后发现，早期逆境与静息态脑电功率存在虽小但稳健的负向关联，该关联在不同研究设计与敏感性分析下基本成立；功率类型会调节这一关联，而逆境类型、频段、记录流程、发育阶段和研究设计未见显著调节。系统综述呈现相似模式，同时暴露出报告规范不一致的问题。作者据此指出，脑电作为可扩展脑健康标志物的潜力，既取决于进一步的生物学刻画，也取决于方法学标准化。

papers.title: Prolonged Transcortical Mixed Aphasia Following Awake Glioma Resection: Functional Language Network Disruption Associated with Persistent Epileptiform Activity.
papers.authors: Kawaguchi M, Fujioka Y, Mukae N, Yanagida M, Fujise M, Watanabe E, Sakata A, Hatae R, Yamada T, Kuwabara K, Shigeto H, Yoshimoto K.
papers.abstract: Aphasia occurring after tumor resection in the language-dominant hemisphere is commonly interpreted as a consequence of irreversible structural injury. In awake craniotomy, intraoperative language mapping enables real-time functional monitoring and is expected to reduce the risk of postoperative aphasia. However, postoperative language impairment is not always attributable to structural damage alone, and functional network disturbances may also contribute. We report a case of prolonged aphasia following awake glioma resection in the dominant hemisphere, in which epileptiform activity was suspected to underlie a prolonged functional disruption of the language network. Intraoperative language mapping confirmed preserved language function throughout tumor resection. However, during the late intraoperative phase, stimulation-induced after-discharges were observed on electroencephalography, followed by the emergence of unstable language output. Postoperatively, severe aphasia persisted despite the absence of new ischemic or hemorrhagic lesions on neuroimaging. Serial electroencephalography demonstrated sustained epileptiform activity within the interictal-ictal continuum, raising concern for possible aphasic status epilepticus. Detailed language assessment revealed severe impairment of spontaneous speech and auditory comprehension, with relative preservation of repetition, reading aloud, and writing. This pattern was consistent with transcortical mixed aphasia, classically described as isolation of the speech area, suggesting functional disconnection of the language network despite anatomical preservation of core language cortices. Although electroencephalographic abnormalities gradually attenuated with antiseizure treatment, language impairment remained prolonged. Prolonged aphasia after awake glioma resection may reflect potentially reversible language network disconnection associated with persistent epileptiform activity rather than structural injury alone, supported by SLTA-confirmed recovery at 6 months.

relevance.reason: 清醒胶质瘤切除术后持续失语病例，结合术中语言映射与EEG，探讨癫痫样活动导致语言网络功能性断连而非结构损伤。

papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告关注清醒状态下切除优势半球胶质瘤后出现的持续性失语，术中语言定位显示肿瘤切除全程语言功能保留，但术后期出现刺激诱发的后放电及语言输出不稳定。术后影像未见新的缺血或出血病灶，系列脑电图却显示持续癫痫样活动，语言评估呈经皮质混合性失语，提示核心语言皮层解剖保留而语言网络功能连接中断。作者据此提出，此类术后失语可能与持续癫痫样活动相关的可逆性网络失连接有关，而非仅由结构性损伤造成；抗癫痫治疗后脑电图异常逐渐减轻，语言障碍仍持续较久，6个月时评估确认恢复。

papers.title: Study on Segmental Alterations in Brain White Matter Fibers in Children with Sensorineural Hearing Loss Using Automated Fiber Quantification
papers.authors: Sun N, Cui W, Chen B, Yu Y, Wang S.
papers.abstract: Abstract This study aims to use automated fiber quantification (AFQ) based on diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) to identify segments of white matter fiber tracts with damage in children with congenital sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL) and to analyze differences in these damaged segments between the group aged ≤ 3 years and the group aged > 3 years. In addition, this study analyzes the segments of white matter damage in the cochlear implant prognosis subgroup to explore their clinical significance as potential imaging markers of postoperative treatment outcomes. Clinical and imaging data for 63 patients with SNHL and 56 healthy controls (HCS) were collected. AFQ was used to track whole-brain white matter tracts in each participant, and each tract was segmented into 100 equally spaced nodes. DTI metrics including fractional anisotropy (FA) were calculated at each node. Compared with HCS, FA values were significantly reduced in many white matter tracts of SNHL patients. Differences were observed between the two age groups, suggesting changes in auditory compensation patterns among children with hearing loss at different ages. AFQ can precisely and accurately identify damage to white matter fiber tracts in the brains of patients with SNHL. Regions including nodes 13 and 26 of the left cingulum cingulate (CGC_L), nodes 52–55 of the left inferior longitudinal fasciculus (ILF_L), and nodes 61–67 of the superior longitudinal fasciculus (SLF_L) are potential imaging biomarkers for predicting postoperative hearing recovery in children with SNHL.

relevance.reason: 用DTI/AFQ研究先天性感音神经性聋儿童脑白质纤维束分段微结构改变及其与听觉代偿和术后恢复的关系，属脑结构-功能与脑疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于弥散张量成像，用自动纤维量化方法追踪并分段分析先天性感音神经性听力损失儿童与健康对照者的全脑白质纤维束，比较各节点各向异性等指标。结果显示，患儿多条白质纤维束的各向异性值明显降低，且≤3岁与>3岁组之间存在差异，提示不同年龄听力损失儿童的听觉补偿模式可能不同。作者进一步指出，左侧扣带束、下纵束和上纵束的特定节点段或可作为预测患儿人工耳蜗术后听力恢复的潜在影像标志物，但这一临床意义仍需后续验证。

papers.title: Functional Brain Connectivity Changes Following Vestibular Rehabilitation in Persistent Postural-Perceptual Dizziness: A Single-Case Resting-State fMRI Study
papers.authors: Adachi K, Tanaka S, Sakai N.
papers.abstract: Background: Persistent postural-perceptual dizziness (PPPD) is a chronic functional vestibular disorder characterized by persistent dizziness, and unsteadiness. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) has identified dysfunction in vestibular, visual, somatosensory, spatial cognitive, and emotional networks in PPPD. Although vestibular rehabilitation has demonstrated efficacy in PPPD, its effects on these dysfunctional neural networks remain unclear. Case: A 37-year-old woman with PPPD had experienced recurrent rotational vertigo approximately every 6 months followed by persistent non-spinning dizziness. Assessment: Baseline assessment showed severe dizziness-related disability (Dizziness Handicap Inventory (DHI) score: 66) and depressive symptoms (Self-Rating Depression Scale (SDS): 40). Posturography demonstrated increased sway with eyes-closed, whereas video head impulse testing revealed no significant abnormalities. Rs-fMRI was also performed, and functional connectivity was analyzed using SPM12 and the CONN toolbox with a region-of-interest-to-region-of-interest approach. Outcome: After 8 weeks of vestibular rehabilitation sessions, DHI and SDS scores improved from 66 to 16, and from 40 to 27, respectively. Posturographic measures, including sway area, sway velocity, and Romberg ratio also improved. Resting-state functional connectivity analysis demonstrated significantly reduced connectivity between the right hippocampus and left frontal pole after false discovery rate correction. At the uncorrected exploratory level, connectivity decreased between the right anterior parahippocampal cortex and right angular gyrus but increased between the right parieto-insular vestibular cortex and right lingual gyrus. Conclusion: Clinical improvement following vestibular rehabilitation coincided with changes in PPPD-related functional connectivity, particularly reduced connectivity between the right hippocampus and left frontal pole. This finding may reflect anxiety-related mood changes in spatial cognitive processing.

papers.summary_zh: 该个案研究关注持续性姿势-知觉性头晕（PPPD）患者接受前庭康复后，脑功能连接是否随之改变，采用静息态功能磁共振成像在康复前后进行对比。经过一段时间的前庭康复，患者的头晕相关失能与抑郁症状评分以及姿势描记指标均有改善；功能连接分析显示右侧海马与左侧额极之间的连接显著降低，探索性分析还提示海马旁回、角回、前庭皮层与舌回等区域间存在连接变化。作者认为，临床改善与前庭康复伴随的功能连接改变同时出现，其中海马-额极连接降低可能与空间认知加工中的焦虑相关情绪变化有关；但作为单例研究，这些关联不能说明康复导致了上述神经改变。

papers.title: Inflammation is associated with altered functional connectivity of the cingulate cortex in individuals with subthreshold depression.
papers.authors: Qi Z, Chen P, Chen G, Luo Z, Zhang S, Jiang L, Tang G, Huang L, Tao Q, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Subthreshold depression (StD) represents a critical prodromal phase that often precedes clinical depression. Identifying biological indicators during this stage is essential for the prophylaxis of major depressive disorder. The present study investigated the interplay between serum pro-inflammatory cytokines, functional connectivity (FC) within subregions of the cingulate cortex (CC), and psychometric profiles in an StD cohort. The study included 126 participants with StD and 104 healthy controls. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging data, psychological assessments [Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale (CES-D), 24-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAMD-24), Hamilton Anxiety Scale (HAMA), Ruminative Responses Scale (RRS)], and serum pro-inflammatory cytokine levels [tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β), IL-6, and IL-17] were collected. The StD group exhibited increased FC in three specific circuits: The left middle CC (MCC) to the bilateral caudate nucleus (CN); the left supracallosal anterior CC (supACC) to the bilateral anterior cerebellar lobe; the right supACC to the right superior frontal gyrus (SFG). Furthermore, serum concentrations of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-17 were significantly increased. FC between the left MCC and bilateral CN was associated with CES-D and RRS scores, whereas FC between the right supACC and right SFG was associated with HAMA scores. Interaction between IL-1β and FC in the right supACC-SFG circuit was independently associated with HAMA scores, whereas interaction between IL-17 and FC in the same circuit independently predicted RRS scores. The statistical interaction between IL-1β and IL-17 levels and right supACC-SFG FC is associated with anxiety and rumination symptoms in StD, which may indicate an increased risk of progression to major depression. These findings underscore the significance of neuroimmune associations in subthreshold depression.

relevance.reason: 研究阈下抑郁者静息态扣带回亚区功能连接及其与炎症、症状的关联，涉及情绪相关脑网络组织与抑郁前驱期机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阈下抑郁个体中血清促炎细胞因子、扣带回皮层亚区功能连接与心理测量特征之间的关系，比较了阈下抑郁组与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振数据、心理评估和细胞因子水平。结果发现，阈下抑郁组在左侧扣带中皮层与双侧尾状核、左侧胼胝体上扣带前皮层与小脑前叶、右侧扣带前皮层与右侧额上回等环路中功能连接增强，同时TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-17水平升高；部分连接与抑郁、反刍或焦虑评分相关，且IL-1β、IL-17与右侧扣带前皮层-额上回连接的统计交互分别与焦虑和反刍症状相关。作者据此提出，这种神经免疫关联可能提示阈下抑郁向重性抑郁进展的风险，但相关结果尚属关联性发现。

papers.title: Investigating hierarchical control among functional networks disrupted by opioid use disorder using effective connectivity.
papers.authors: Austin B, Kurtin DL, Herlinger K, Hayes A, Hand LJ, Fonville L, Hill RG, Nutt DJ, Lingford-Hughes AR, Paterson LM.
papers.abstract: Opioid use disorder (OUD) poses a significant public health challenge. Developing a better understanding of the brain mechanisms and potential markers of OUD would facilitate the development of therapeutic interventions. While we recently showed that between-network connectivity is disrupted in people with OUD compared with healthy controls, it remains unclear what mechanisms may drive these disruptions and how dysfunctional interactions propagate across large-scale functional networks. To advance the mechanistic understanding of the disrupted processes in OUD, this study used Effective Connectivity (EC) to quantify disrupted hierarchical control among functional networks governing cognition, attention, and reward. We also explored whether whole-brain patterns of EC were effective markers to distinguish people with severe OUD from controls. We hypothesized that the ventromedial network (VMN) would drive dysfunction in cognitive and attentional networks in people with OUD. Task-fMRI data were collected from healthy controls (HC; n = 22) and OUD participants on methadone maintenance treatment (OUD; n = 25), during a heroin cue reactivity (CR) and monetary incentive delay (MID) task. Following brain parcellation (214 regions) and network assignment (7 functional networks), EC was quantified using large-scale nonlinear Granger causality. Dimensionality reduction was performed using uniform manifold approximation and projection, followed by hierarchical density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise to assess whether EC patterns could form clusters corresponding to group labels. Contrary to our hypothesis, the VMN did not drive dysfunction in cognitive and attentional networks. Instead, edges with significantly stronger EC in HC vs. OUD participants were within and between the control, somatomotor, and default mode networks. EC patterns were unable to form distinct clusters that corresponded to clinical groups; instead, clusters separated by task. Little evidence was found that disrupted VMN-mediated reward drove dysregulated whole-brain function in OUD.

relevance.reason: 研究阿片使用障碍患者认知、注意与奖赏网络间层级控制的有效连接改变，属脑疾病认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阿片使用障碍（OUD）中功能网络间层级控制为何受损，以及有效连接模式能否区分患者与健康对照。作者采集健康对照与接受美沙酮维持治疗的OUD参与者在海洛因线索反应和金钱激励延迟任务中的任务态fMRI数据，划分脑区与功能网络后，用非线性格兰杰因果量化有效连接，并借助降维和聚类考察连接模式能否对应临床分组。结果与假设相反：腹内侧网络并未驱动认知和注意网络的功能障碍；健康对照连接更强的主要是控制、躯体运动和默认模式网络内部及之间的连接。有效连接模式未能按临床分组形成聚类，而是主要按任务分开，说明OUD中由腹内侧网络介导的奖赏通路受损驱动全脑功能失调的证据有限。

papers.title: Functional specialisation across the first five years of life: A longitudinal characterisation of social perception with fNIRS.
papers.authors: Benerradi J, Bulgarelli C, Mbye E, Blanco B, Touray E, McCann S, Milosavljevic B, Moore SE, Elwell CE, Blasi A, Lloyd-Fox S.
papers.abstract: Research in typically developing infants has shown robust and consistent brain activation to social versus non-social visual and auditory stimuli in a network of brain regions, including the inferior frontal, anterior temporal, and posterior superior temporal cortex. However, large-scale, longitudinal neuroimaging studies across early childhood, particularly in low- and middle-income countries, are rare, yet important, given that they offer a powerful means of capturing within-person changes in neurodevelopment and identifying targets for intervention and support. Here, we investigated brain responses to social perception longitudinally across the first 5 years of life of participants in The Gambia with functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) within the Brain Imaging for Global Health (BRIGHT) Project. We found that social visual stimuli elicited a selective right posterior temporal response across all six age points studied here (5, 8, 12, 18, 24 months and 3-5 years of age), with concurrent selective left responses at four of the six time points (5, 8, 18 months and 3-5 years of age). Inferior frontal regions showed brain activation at multiple ages, with the youngest (5 months) and oldest (24 months to 3-5 years) time points evidencing more widespread frontal social visual responses. Conversely, auditory social stimuli elicited a significantly stronger and more prolonged response than auditory non-social stimuli across all six age points from 5 months to 3-5 years across a range of frontal and temporal areas. Finally, from individual infant trajectories of brain activation, we identified different profiles of age-dependent specialization to auditory social stimuli, with some specializing earlier than others. Future work could take advantage of such profiles to investigate the effects of adversity and resilience factors on neurodevelopment.

relevance.reason: 纵向fNIRS研究婴幼儿社会感知的脑功能偏侧化与发育特化，属社会认知的脑发育机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在冈比亚追踪同一批儿童从婴儿期到5岁的脑反应，用功能性近红外光谱考察对社会性与非社会性视觉、听觉刺激的加工。结果显示，社会性视觉刺激在全部六个年龄点都引起右侧后颞叶的选择性反应，部分年龄点还伴有左侧反应；额下区在多个年龄点激活，且最早和最晚年龄点的额叶反应更广泛。社会性听觉刺激则在所有年龄点引起比非社会性听觉刺激更强、更持久的额颞区反应。作者还从个体发展轨迹中识别出听觉社会性加工专门化早晚不同的模式，提示早期神经发育存在个体差异，未来可用于探讨逆境与韧性因素的影响。

papers.title: Emergent multiscale organisation of neural dynamics fragments in anaesthesia.
papers.authors: Milinkovic B, Seth AK, Barnett L, Carter O, Andrillon T.
papers.abstract: Conscious experience depends on the coordinated activity of neural processes that span multiple scales: from synapses to whole-brain dynamics. A recently introduced measure, dynamical independence (DI), identifies, characterises, and quantifies these multi-scale relationships using an information-theoretic dimensionality reduction approach. Here, we use DI to examine changes in the emergent dynamical organisation in the human brain under three pharmacologically distinct anaesthetic interventions (propofol, xenon, ketamine). Applied to source-reconstructed electroencephalography (EEG), our analysis reveals that propofol and xenon, anaesthetics that abolish conscious report, exhibit more emergent but highly variable dynamic structure, indicating fragmented macroscopic dynamical organisation. Ketamine, which preserves dream-like phenomenology, shows a different pattern relative to wakefulness: reduced overall emergence yet a partial preservation of the macroscopic structure. Further exploratory analyses revealed spatially localised source-level contributions to emergent dynamical structure, highlighting regional variations. Together, our results highlight drug-induced reconfigurations of emergent dynamical structure relative to wakefulness, dissociate the amount of emergence from the organisation of emergent dynamics, and caution against equating emergence with level of consciousness. Consequently, we suggest that wakeful conscious processing depends not only on integration between neural components within a single scale, but also on integration across scales, broadening currently held assumptions of putative signatures of consciousness.

relevance.reason: 研究麻醉下人类EEG多尺度神经动力学组织与意识状态的关系，属意识神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用基于信息论降维的动态独立性指标，分析人在丙泊酚、氙气和氯胺酮三种麻醉干预下源重建脑电的多尺度动态组织变化。结果显示，能消除意识报告的丙泊酚和氙气使宏观动态结构更趋涌现但高度多变，提示宏观组织碎片化；保留梦境样体验的氯胺酮则整体涌现程度降低，却部分保留了宏观结构。作者据此区分涌现程度与涌现动态的组织方式，提醒不能将涌现等同于意识水平，并提出清醒意识加工可能不仅依赖单一尺度内的整合，也依赖跨尺度整合。

papers.title: Human fMRI at 11.7T: Assessing feasibility, stability, and reliability on the Iseult scanner.
papers.authors: Obriot J, Amor Z, Serger M, Stirnberg R, Ehses P, Riedel M, Stöcker T, Prüssmann KP, Gunamony S, Chu S, Amadon A, Vignaud A, Gras V, Meyniel F, Mauconduit F, Le Ster C, Boulant N.
papers.abstract: Ultra-high-field magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) promises major gains in blood oxygen level dependent (BOLD) sensitivity but introduces severe challenges such as RF field inhomogeneity, B0 field inhomogeneity, motion and vibration-induced field variations. We report the first whole-brain resting-state and task-based fMRI experiments at 11.7T. A 3D-EPI sequence was optimized using tailored parallel-transmit RF pulses, gradient reshaping to suppress vibration-induced B0 fluctuations, and prospective motion correction using servo navigation combined with retrospective phase equalization (PEERS). Four participants were scanned at 11.7T with whole-brain 1.2 mm isotropic resolution with servo navigation and PEERS that considerably reduced residual motion and increased temporal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The Default Mode Network in resting state could be detected and a physiological-noise-dominated regime was identified. Four additional but different participants were scanned at 7T for tSNR comparison and validation of the protocol, data quality, and processing pipeline. Task-based fMRI likewise was conducted at 11.7T and yielded robust, spatially specific activations across motor, visual, mathematical, and language networks, again with improved sensitivity and cleaner BOLD responses when using servo navigation and PEERS. These results demonstrate the feasibility and reliability of whole-brain human fMRI at 11.7T and constitute a first-quality control milestone to further increase resolution at that field strength.

relevance.reason: 在11.7T下开展人脑全脑静息态与任务态fMRI，检测默认网络并报告任务激活，属脑功能组织与成像可行性研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在11.7T Iseult扫描仪上首次开展全脑静息态与任务态fMRI实验，通过优化3D-EPI序列并结合并行发射射频脉冲、梯度重塑以及伺服导航与回顾性相位均衡，评估超高场下fMRI的可行性、稳定性和可靠性。结果显示，这些校正手段明显减少残余运动并提升时间信噪比，静息态下可检测到默认模式网络，任务态下在运动、视觉、数学和语言网络中均获得稳健且空间特异的激活，且校正后BOLD响应更干净、灵敏度更高。作者据此认为，11.7T全脑人fMRI具备可行性和可靠性，为在该场强下进一步提高分辨率提供了初步质量控制依据。

papers.title: Subregional Functional Connectivity of the Precuneus as a Preclinical Biomarker in Alzheimer's Disease.
papers.authors: Aponte C, Jimenez-Marín A, Razkin M, Gómez JFO, Erramuzpe A, Diez I, Aguillón-Niño D, Tobón C, Cortés JM.
papers.abstract: Introduction The precuneus (Pc) is a central hub integrating diverse brain functions, and it is early involved in Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathophysiology, yet its subregional vulnerability remains poorly understood. This study aims to delineate the differential involvement and vulnerability of these subdivisions in the early stages of AD. Methods We conducted a resting-state FC analysis of Pc subregions in 32 cognitively unimpaired carriers of the PSEN1 E280A mutation compared to 25 noncarriers using seed-based analyses. Results As compared to noncarriers, we found that the group of asymptotic carriers had increased connectivity from the 7Am subregion toward the entorhinal cortex, superior temporal gyrus, insula-operculum, dlPFC, and somatosensory areas. Moreover, the POS2 subregion significantly decreased connectivity with the anterior insula and dlPFC. Higher MoCA scores correlated with increased connectivity within and between the Pc and frontoparietal networks. Discussion These results reveal distinct patterns of early functional reorganization and support the subregional Pc analysis in identifying sensitive biomarkers for preclinical AD, often overlooked in conventional whole-region analyses.

relevance.reason: 研究临床前阿尔茨海默病携带者楔前叶亚区静息态功能连接改变，属脑疾病早期功能重组与静息网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注阿尔茨海默病临床前期楔前叶各亚区的功能连接变化，以携带PSEN1 E280A突变但认知未受损者为对象，与未携带者比较静息态功能连接。结果显示，携带者楔前叶7Am亚区与内嗅皮层、颞上回、岛盖、背外侧前额叶及躯体感觉区的连接增强，而POS2亚区与前岛叶和背外侧前额叶的连接减弱；较高的MoCA得分与楔前叶及额顶网络内部和之间连接增强相关。作者认为，这提示临床前期已出现亚区特异的早期功能重组，亚区水平分析可能比常规全区域分析更敏感地识别临床前期AD生物标志物，但相关发现尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Behavioral and Cortical Responses to Frequency Changes in Vowel-Like Stimuli in Listeners With Normal and Impaired Hearing.
papers.authors: Rekswinkel M, Kressner AA, Hjortkjær J, Undurraga JA.
papers.abstract: Objectives This study proposes a new method for detecting cortical responses to formant frequency changes using the auditory change complex (ACC). These can be used as a proxy for discrimination performance between spectral characteristics of vowels. Design We generated two sets of vowel-like stimuli, each of which contained four sinusoids with carrier frequencies chosen to correspond to the first three formants of the vowels/u/ and/i/, respectively. During EEG recordings, the second formant (F2) frequency changed in different step sizes to evoke an ACC response. We collected responses for both a hearing-impaired group (10 participants) and a control group with normal hearing (9 participants) and furthermore compared these to a behavioral measure of formant frequency discrimination. Results The size of the change in the frequency of the F2 formant, as well as the presence of hearing impairment, significantly affected the ACC response. Larger frequency changes produced larger ACC response amplitudes, specifically for the/u/ stimuli with more lower-frequency content. Responses tended to be lower overall for the hearing-impaired participants. Moreover, the ACC magnitude was correlated with behavioral formant discrimination thresholds. Conclusions Taken altogether, these results lend support to the use of an ACC paradigm to assess frequency discrimination abilities objectively with speech-like stimuli. This study shows reliable responses as well as correlation with behavioral discrimination, which highlight the paradigm's potential suitability for clinical purposes.

relevance.reason: 用EEG听觉变化复合波考察元音样刺激共振峰频率变化的皮层反应，属言语听觉感知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种基于听觉变化复合波（ACC）的方法，用类元音刺激中第二共振峰频率的变化来客观探测皮层反应，并比较听力受损者与正常听力者的表现，同时与行为辨别阈值对照。结果显示，频率变化幅度和听力受损均显著影响ACC反应：变化越大反应越强，尤其在低频成分较多的/u/刺激中更明显；听力受损组的反应总体偏小。ACC幅度还与行为共振峰辨别阈值相关，提示该范式有望用于以类言语刺激客观评估频率辨别能力，并具备临床应用的潜力。

papers.title: Behaviorally-relevant features of observed actions dominate cortical representational geometry in natural vision.
papers.authors: Han J, Chauhan V, Philip R, Taylor MK, Jung H, Halchenko YO, Gobbini MI, Haxby JV, Nastase SA.
papers.abstract: We effortlessly extract behaviorally relevant information from dynamic visual input to understand the actions of others. Here, we compare behavioral judgments of action meaning against other models capturing semantic and visual features. We measured brain activity using fMRI while participants viewed 90 video clips depicting social and nonsocial actions in real-world contexts. Using arrangement tasks, we developed two behavioral models capturing judgments of action meaning (transitive purpose, social content), as well as three control models capturing judgments of visual content (people, objects, scene). We compared these models with semantic models based on word embeddings and visual models based on gaze and motion energy. Behavioral models of action meaning outperformed models of visual content, semantics, and low-level visual features across much of cortex. Transitivity and sociality captured large portions of unique variance throughout the action observation network, extending into regions not typically associated with action perception, such as ventral temporal cortex.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究自然视觉中观察动作时皮层表征几何，属社会认知/动作感知的神经表征，且使用自然视频刺激。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然观看动态动作视频时，大脑皮层表征几何主要由什么信息塑造。研究者用fMRI记录参与者观看真实情境中社会性与非社会性动作视频时的大脑活动，并将基于行为判断构建的动作意义模型（及传递性、社会性维度）与视觉内容、语义和低层视觉特征模型进行比较。结果显示，动作意义模型在大部分皮层区域优于其他模型，传递性和社会性在动作观察网络中占据独特方差，并延伸至腹侧颞叶等通常不与动作知觉关联的区域，提示行为相关的动作意义是自然视觉下皮层表征组织的重要主导因素。

papers.title: Prefrontal hemodynamic alterations during resting state and stroop interference in cognitively healthy older adults with high plasma pTau-217 levels.
papers.authors: Al-Ezzi A, Wee CP, Wu X, Astraea N, Kleinman MT, Mack W, Kloner RA, Arakaki X.
papers.abstract: Plasma phosphorylated tau-217 (pTau-217) has emerged as a sensitive biomarker for early Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathology, including the cognitively healthy (CH) stage when compensatory frontal activity has been reported. This study focused on hemodynamic changes measured using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) in the prefrontal cortex (PFC) in CH older adults. The fNIRS data from 41 CH older adults during resting state, as well as during a color-word Stroop interference task were analyzed. Primary measures included oxyhemoglobin (HbO) responses at left lateral, left medium, right medium, and right lateral PFC regions, exploratory measures included heart rate, Weighted Phase Lag Index (wPLI) for functional connectivity (FC), and correlation between HbO and heart rate (HR) to assess heart-brain coupling. The study revealed that compared to low tertile group, individuals with high tertile pTau-217 exhibited slower response times during the task and region-specific hemodynamic changes - reduced HbO during eyes-open rest (FDR-adjusted p = 0.037) but increased activation during Stroop congruent trials (False Discovery Rate (FDR)-adjusted p < 0.0001), which are supported by sensitivity analysis. Additionally, high tertile pTau-217 group showed strong positive correlation between post-task HR and right-lateral prefrontal HbO (ρ = 0.85, p < 0.001) versus a negative correlation in the low tertile group (ρ = -0.55, p = 0.043) and attenuated interhemispheric synchronization by FC (measured by wPLI), particularly during eyes-open resting state. Overall, the primary findings demonstrate pTau-217-associated differences in prefrontal hemodynamic responses, while the exploratory heart-brain coupling and FC findings are hypothesis-generating and require independent validation. Larger and more diverse cohorts are needed to confirm and generalize these findings.

relevance.reason: 该研究用fNIRS考察认知健康老年人前额叶在静息态和Stroop干扰任务中的血流动力学改变，涉及注意执行控制与静息脑活动组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注血浆pTau-217水平较高的认知健康老年人在前额叶血流动力学上是否已有差异，用功能性近红外光谱比较了静息态和色词Stroop干扰任务中的反应。结果显示，与低水平组相比，高水平组任务反应更慢，睁眼静息时前额叶氧合血红蛋白反应降低，而在Stroop一致试次中激活反而增强；探索性分析还提示该组任务后心率与右侧前额叶氧合血红蛋白呈强正相关，两半球间功能连接同步性减弱。作者指出，心脑耦合和功能连接结果仅具假设生成性质，需独立验证，这些差异能否用于早期识别仍待更大、更多样化的人群确认。

papers.title: Default mode network functional connectivity following treatment with conventional antidepressants and (es)ketamine in major depressive disorder: A systematic review.
papers.authors: Lima Constantino J, de Jager JE, Nuninga JO, Kamphuis J, Schoevers RA, van Dalfsen JH.
papers.abstract: Antidepressant treatments, including conventional antidepressants and (es)ketamine, may reverse default mode network (DMN) resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) alterations related to major depressive disorder (MDD). Despite these agents having distinct initial action mechanisms, both likely share downstream effects that lead to structural and functional adaptations in MDD-related neural circuits. Examining the effects of these agents on DMN rsFC can provide insights into network-level effects, advance understanding of network-level mechanisms of treatment response, and generate hypotheses regarding potential neurobiological differences between MDD and treatment-resistant depression populations. A systematic search was performed to retrieve studies investigating changes in DMN rsFC following treatment with conventional antidepressants and (es)ketamine in MDD, including the association with clinical outcomes. Nineteen studies were included, 13 administered conventional antidepressants (N = 546), and six intravenous ketamine (N = 247). Conventional antidepressants were associated with heterogeneous changes in DMN rsFC, some of which related to clinical improvements. Conversely, ketamine mostly related with reductions in DMN rsFC, particularly in DMN-limbic connectivity. While interpretations of current findings are limited by heterogeneity in study populations, treatment regimens, and timing assessments, findings suggest that these agents exhibit mostly distinct patterns of DMN modulation, and that differential effects on DMN rsFC associate with clinical improvements.

relevance.reason: 系统综述抗抑郁药与氯胺酮治疗后重性抑郁障碍患者静息态默认网络功能连接变化，属脑疾病与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统检索了重性抑郁障碍患者在接受常规抗抑郁药或(艾)氯胺酮治疗后默认模式网络静息态功能连接变化的研究，并关注这些变化与临床结局的关联。纳入的研究显示，常规抗抑郁药相关的默认模式网络功能连接变化方向不一、异质性较大，其中部分变化与症状改善有关；而氯胺酮则多表现为默认模式网络功能连接下降，尤其在与边缘系统的连接上。作者指出，受研究人群、治疗方案和评估时点差异的限制，现有证据的解释力有限，但结果提示两类药物对默认模式网络的调节模式大多不同，且这种差异化的连接变化与临床改善相关。

papers.title: Bilingualism modulates baseline brain-cognition relationships in aging: Evidence from the HABS-HD cohort.
papers.authors: Xia L, Vidal-Pineiro D, Meeker KL, Henson R.
papers.abstract: Bilingualism has been proposed to confer advantages in cognitive aging, yet the neural mechanisms underlying any such advantages remain debated. In a pre-registered analysis of cross-sectional and longitudinal data from elders in the HABS-HD cohort, we asked whether bilingualism is associated with three measures of brain structure (total brain volume, hippocampal volume and white-matter lesions) and/or moderates the relationship between brain structure and two measures of cognition (executive function and episodic memory). Overall, we found no significant differences between bilinguals and monolinguals in their baseline brain structure or subsequent change in brain structure, suggesting that a life of bilingualism was not clearly associated with Brain Reserve or Brain Maintenance in old age. In baseline analyses, bilingualism moderated the relationship between total brain volume and executive function, and between hippocampal volume and episodic memory, such that these cognitive functions were less dependent on these brain measures in bilinguals, consistent with the concept of Cognitive Reserve. However, any effect of bilingualism on longitudinal associations between brain-change slopes and cognitive-change slopes did not reach significance, suggesting that bilingualism-related Cognitive Reserve may be limited to baseline differences. Further, exploratory analyses showed that the effects of bilingualism on hippocampal volume, and on its relationship with episodic memory, might differ according to clinical dementia status. In summary, our findings suggest that bilingualism is associated with altered baseline brain-cognition relationships, rather than with preservation of brain structure.

relevance.reason: 研究双语经验如何调节脑结构（总体脑体积、海马体积、白质病变）与执行功能/情景记忆的关系，涉及语言经验与脑结构-认知耦合。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于HABS-HD队列的横断面与纵向数据，考察双语经历是否与老年人脑结构及其变化相关，以及是否调节脑结构与认知之间的关系。结果显示，双语者与单语者在基线脑结构及后续脑结构变化上并无明显差异，提示双语生活并未清晰体现为脑储备或脑维护。基线分析中，双语经历调节了总脑容量与执行功能、海马体积与情景记忆之间的关联，使双语者的这些认知功能相对更少依赖相应脑指标，符合认知储备概念；但双语对脑变化斜率与认知变化斜率之间纵向关联的影响未达显著，相关认知储备可能仅限于基线差异。探索性分析还提示，双语对海马体积及其与情景记忆关系的影响可能因临床痴呆状态而异。总体而言，双语经历与基线脑—认知关系的改变相关，而非脑结构的保持。

papers.title: Beyond executive dysfunction: The precuneus as an introspective monitoring hub for driving safety.
papers.authors: Park K.
papers.abstract: Unsafe driving is a public health concern, yet its neural basis in the general population remains poorly understood. Research on attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) traditionally attributes crash risk to executive dysfunction and fronto-striatal abnormalities, but these models do not explain unsafe driving among healthy individuals. Here, we synthesize structural and functional neuroimaging evidence to propose a precuneus-centered framework of driving safety. Reduced precuneus gray matter volume is associated with ADHD trait dimensions and crash history in healthy adults, while functional neuroimaging indicates precuneus involvement during driving-related hazard appraisal. Together, these findings suggest that crash vulnerability may be associated with impaired metacognitive awareness of internal states rather than primary executive deficits. The framework proposes that introspective monitoring may facilitate subsequent executive regulation, while recognizing that this temporal ordering remains a conceptual hypothesis. By conceptualizing the precuneus as an introspective monitoring hub within a broader distributed neurocognitive network, this framework links default mode network research with safety-critical behavior and offers a neurobiological perspective on driving risk.

relevance.reason: 综述提出以楔前叶为中心的驾驶安全神经框架，涉及内省监控、默认网络与灰质结构，属认知与脑结构功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该文针对一般人群中不安全驾驶的神经基础尚不清楚这一问题，梳理结构与功能神经影像证据，提出以楔前叶为核心的驾驶安全框架。作者指出，健康成人楔前叶灰质体积减小与ADHD特质维度及事故史相关，功能影像也显示楔前叶参与驾驶相关危险评估；据此认为事故易感性可能更多关联于对自身内部状态的内省觉察受损，而非原发性执行功能缺陷。框架提出内省监测或有助于后续执行调节，但明确承认这一时间顺序仍属概念性假设，并将楔前叶定位为更广泛分布式网络中的内省监测枢纽。

papers.title: Altered hemispheric lateralization of speech-related cortical activity in unilateral severe hearing loss: an fMRI study.
papers.authors: Yamamoto K, Kawashima Y, Tateishi U, Tsutsumi T.
papers.abstract: Background Severe unilateral hearing loss is often managed conservatively after initial treatment because hearing in the contralateral ear is preserved. However, patients frequently experience difficulties in speech perception, particularly in noisy environments, that are not fully captured by conventional audiological assessments. Because central auditory pathways project predominantly to the contralateral hemisphere and speech processing is typically left-lateralized, input from the right ear may reach the left-hemispheric speech areas more directly. This anatomical and functional asymmetry suggests that the side of hearing loss could differentially affect speech-related cortical processing. Objective This study aimed to investigate cortical activity during speech perception in severe postlingual unilateral hearing loss and examine the effects of ear-specific input on hemispheric lateralization. Methods Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) was performed in individuals with severe unilateral hearing loss (right- and left-sided) and in normal-hearing controls during a speech perception task. Auditory stimuli (monosyllables and pure tones) were presented binaurally. Region-of-interest analyses were conducted for the primary auditory cortex (transverse temporal gyrus, TTG) and the superior temporal gyrus (STG). The mean activation and laterality indices were compared between the groups. Results No significant intergroup differences were observed in the primary auditory cortex. In contrast, STG activity was significantly reduced in patients with unilateral hearing loss compared to controls, particularly in the right-sided hearing loss group. The hemispherical lateralization of STG activity was altered, with increased leftward dominance observed in the left-sided hearing loss group. Conclusion Unilateral hearing loss affects higher-order speech-related cortical processing rather than primary auditory responses. The observed changes in STG activity and lateralization suggest that ear-specific auditory input influences the cortical organization. These findings are consistent with the concept of a right-ear advantage and provide neurophysiological insights into speech perception difficulties in unilateral hearing loss.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究单侧听力损失者言语感知时STG活动与半球偏侧化改变，直接涉及语言加工的脑组织与偏侧化。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能磁共振成像考察重度单侧感音神经性听力损失者在言语感知任务中的皮层活动，比较右侧、左侧听力损失者与正常听力对照，关注初级听皮层和颞上回。结果显示初级听皮层未见明显组间差异，而颞上回活动在患者中降低，右侧听力损失组尤为明显；左侧听力损失组的颞上回偏侧化发生改变，左侧优势增强。作者据此认为，单侧听力损失主要影响较高级的言语相关皮层加工而非初级听觉反应，耳别特异的输入会影响皮层组织方式，这与右耳优势的概念相符，并为理解此类患者的言语感知困难提供了神经生理线索。

papers.title: Reduced information sharing within the orienting network predicts intelligence in late childhood.
papers.authors: Lucero B, Lanfranco RC, Muñoz-Quezada MT, Saracini C, Canales-Johnson A.
papers.abstract: Understanding how intelligence emerges from the developing brain remains a central question in developmental cognitive neuroscience. While prior work has linked intelligence to regional activation and structural maturation, less is known about how the efficiency of distributed functional networks contributes to cognitive ability during childhood. We examined 38 children aged 11-14 years as they performed the Attention Network Test (ANT) while undergoing electroencephalography (EEG). Attentional network engagement was characterised using cue-locked event-related potentials (ERPs), frontal midline theta power during conflict processing, and weighted Symbolic Mutual Information (wSMI) to quantify nonlinear information sharing across distributed networks. Canonical electrophysiological signatures of alerting, orienting, and conflict processing were robustly replicated. However, only distributed nonlinear connectivity within the orienting network predicted Full-Scale IQ (FS-IQ). Specifically, reduced information sharing during spatial orienting was associated with higher intelligence scores, whereas local ERP and theta measures showed no reliable associations. These findings suggest that intelligence in late childhood is linked not to greater neural activation, but to more efficient network-level coordination within task-relevant attentional systems. Our results extend the neural efficiency hypothesis into a developmental framework and highlight nonlinear connectivity as a sensitive marker of cognitive maturation.

relevance.reason: 用EEG研究儿童注意定向网络的信息共享与智力的关系，属注意与脑网络组织的认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童晚期分布式功能网络的协调效率如何与智力相关，让11至14岁儿童在执行注意网络任务时接受脑电记录，并结合事件相关电位、额中线theta功率与加权符号互信息分析注意网络的参与情况。结果发现警觉、定向和冲突加工的电生理特征均得到稳定重现，但只有定向网络内的分布式非线性连接能够预测全量表智商：空间定向过程中信息共享越少，智力分数越高，而局部事件相关电位和theta指标未见可靠关联。作者据此认为，儿童晚期的智力更多与任务相关注意系统内更高效的网络层面协调有关，而非更强的神经激活，并将神经效率假说延伸到发展框架中，提示非线性连接可作为认知成熟的敏感指标。

papers.title: Resting-state and picture-naming EEG reveal aberrant connectomes and outcome-associated dysfunctomes in Cantonese post-stroke aphasia: A multi-frequency exploratory analysis.
papers.authors: Cheung CY, Kong AP.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Post-stroke aphasia (PSA) is increasingly understood as a network disorder, yet its electrophysiological connectome has been characterized almost exclusively in stress-timed Indo-European languages, and rarely with phase-locking connectivity sampled across multiple frequency bands and recording states in the same cohort. We acquired 61-channel resting-state and overt picture-naming EEG in 31 chronic Cantonese-speaking individuals with aphasia and 14 demographically matched neurologically healthy controls, computed surface-Laplacian-transformed phase-locking-value connectivity in six canonical frequency bands (delta, theta, alpha, low-beta, high-beta, low-gamma), and used Network-based Statistic to identify within-group aberrant naming engagement subnetworks, between-group aberrant subnetwork, and outcome-associated dysfunctomes (subnetworks associated with seven clinical outcomes). Best-supported band × state dysfunctomes were identified through cross-band Akaike model comparison. Results showed that HC and PWA relied on qualitatively different oscillatory subnetworks to shift from rest into naming, with PWA displacing engagement into right-hemisphere and domain-general frontal regions and failing to disengage central alpha. Between-group contrasts highlighted slow-wave-dominant hyperconnective subnetworks in the canonical left temporal regions, reflecting passive cortical dysfunction. Outcome-associated dysfunctomes identified resting-state alpha as the best-fitting candidate for overall aphasia severity, spontaneous speech fluency and informativeness, overall naming, and confrontation naming, and resting-state low-beta as the best-fitting candidate for auditory comprehension. Together, the disrupted naming-engagement subnetworks and peri-lesional slow-wave aberrant connectomes offer mechanistic markers of aphasia-related network reorganization, while the resting-state alpha and low-beta dysfunctomes provide candidate targets to guide outcome-specific precision neuromodulation for PSA.

relevance.reason: 研究粤语卒中后失语症患者静息态与图片命名EEG连接组，涉及语言网络重组及与失语结局相关的脑功能连接异常。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注粤语卒中后失语症患者的电生理连接组，采集静息态与图片命名任务脑电，比较患者与健康对照在不同频段的相位锁定连接。结果显示，两组从静息转入命名时依赖不同的振荡子网络：患者将参与资源转向右半球和一般性额区，且未能退出中央区alpha活动；组间对比还发现左颞区以慢波为主的超连接子网络。与结局相关的分析提示，静息态alpha最适合对应整体失语严重度、自发语言流畅性与信息量及命名表现，静息态低beta则最适合对应听觉理解。作者据此将这些异常连接模式视为失语网络重组的机制标记，并将相应静息态频段视为结局特异的精准神经调控候选靶点，但研究为探索性分析，相关发现尚不能直接推及治疗效应。

papers.title: Hand movement fMRI-lateralization and white matter motor tract quantification for handedness groups.
papers.authors: Neumann N, Domin M, Lotze M.
papers.abstract: Handedness is the preference for one upper limb side generalized across different sensorimotor skills and strong population-level right-handedness is especially pronounced in humans. The lateralization of functional representations in the primary motor cortex for unilateral upper limb movements depends on task complexity (e.g., simple tapping movements versus sequential finger movements) and brain morphology (e.g., quantification of the pyramidal tract and transcallosal connectivity). Previous studies investigating lateralization differences between right- and left-handed individuals did not consider these two main drivers of lateralization. Therefore, we investigated the functional lateralization of upper limb movements of varying complexity, alongside white matter quantification, in 26 right-handed and 26 left-handed healthy volunteers. We were particularly interested in possible differences in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) lateralization between the groups, as well as possible associations between white matter tract quantification and fMRI activation. Our study replicated prior findings on the impact of increasing demand on decreasing lateralization of the primary motor cortex (M1). White matter quantification of the corticospinal tract and the callosal fibers originating in M1 were comparable for both groups and were not associated with performance or fMRI-lateralization. For simple movements, fMRI lateralization between handedness groups was comparable, independent of the hand used (dominant or non-dominant). However, for more complex movements of the non-dominant hand, ipsilateral activation was stronger in right-handers. This finding supports the model for a possibly higher need to suppress the dominant hemisphere from executing mirror movements in right-handed participants.

relevance.reason: 研究利手组手部运动fMRI偏侧化及白质运动纤维束量化，涉及运动皮层功能偏侧化与结构-功能关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察不同利手健康者在不同复杂度上肢运动中的初级运动皮层功能偏侧化，并结合白质纤维束量化分析。结果重复了既往发现：运动需求增加时M1偏侧化降低；两组皮质脊髓束和源自M1的胼胝体纤维量化相当，且与行为表现或fMRI偏侧化无关联。简单运动时两组偏侧化相近，与用哪只手无关；但非优势手执行较复杂运动时，右利手者的同侧激活更强，作者据此推测右利手者可能更需要抑制优势半球产生镜像运动。

papers.title: Larger language models better align with neural representations of natural language.
papers.authors: Hong Z, Wang H, Zada Z, Gazula H, Turner D, Aubrey B, Niekerken L, Doyle W, Devore S, Dugan P, Friedman D, Devinsky O, Flinker A, Hasson U, Nastase S, Goldstein AY.
papers.abstract: Recent research has used large language models (LLMs) to study the neural basis of naturalistic language processing in the human brain. LLMs have rapidly grown in complexity, leading to improved language processing capabilities. Here, we utilized several families of transformer-based LLMs to investigate the relationship between model size and their ability to capture linguistic information in the human brain. Crucially, a subset of LLMs were trained on a fixed training set, enabling us to dissociate model size from architecture and training set size. We used electrocorticography (ECoG) to measure neural activity in epilepsy patients while they listened to a 30 min naturalistic audio story. We fit electrode-wise encoding models using contextual embeddings extracted from each hidden layer of the LLMs to predict word-level neural signals. In line with prior work, we found that larger LLMs better capture the structure of natural language and better predict neural activity. We also found a logarithmic relationship where the encoding performance peaks in relatively earlier layers as model size increases. We also observed variations in the best-performing layer across different brain regions, corresponding to an organized language processing hierarchy.

relevance.reason: 用ECoG记录癫痫患者听自然故事时脑活动，比较LLM大小与脑语言表征的编码预测，报告脑区层级组织，属语言神经机制与自然刺激研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用多组基于Transformer的大语言模型，考察模型规模与其捕捉人脑自然语言加工信息能力之间的关系；其中部分模型在固定训练集上训练，从而将模型规模与架构、训练集大小区分开。研究以癫痫患者的皮层脑电活动为神经数据，记录其聆听自然叙事音频时的反应，并用各隐藏层上下文嵌入拟合电极级编码模型来预测词汇层面的神经信号。结果显示，更大的模型能更好地刻画自然语言结构，也更准确地预测神经活动；随着模型规模增大，编码表现峰值出现在相对更早的层，且最佳层在不同脑区存在差异，对应有组织的语言加工层级。这些结果提示，模型规模与语言神经表征的匹配程度相关，但属于预测性关联，不能理解为因果或临床效果。

papers.title: Unravelling the genetic basis of stuttering: GWAS meta-analysis highlights link with rare speech disorders
papers.authors: Jackson VE, Shin JJ, Horton S, Boyce JO, Eising E, van Reyk O, Parker R, Thompson-Lake DG, Evans M, Beilby J, Below JE, Boomsma DI, Bridges E, Corfield EC, Franken MJ, Gordon SD, Havdahl A, Koenraads SP, Kraft SJ, Luciano M, Moen G, Mountford HS, Musial A, Pennell CE, Polikowsky HG, Pool R, Rebattu VA, Rimfeld K, Scartozzi AC, Pourcain BS, Szilagyi IA, Valand SB, Viljoen KZ, Wang CA, Whitehouse AJ, Wren YE, van Bergen E, Gillespie NA, Vogel AP, Scheffer IE, Hildebrand MS, Sadleir LG, Liégeois F, Reilly S, Fisher SE, Martin NG, Morgan AT, Bahlo M.
papers.abstract: Background Developmental stuttering affects up to 11% of children globally, with around one-fifth developing a persistent lifelong stutter. Twin and family studies indicate a strong genetic contribution and comorbidity with other heritable traits. Despite efforts to investigate the common genetic architecture of stuttering, much of variation contributing to clinically ascertained stuttering, persistence and recovery remains uncharacterised. Methods We performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) meta-analysis of stuttering across 18 cohorts (6,096 cases, 81,629 controls) of European ancestries, with secondary analyses of stuttering persistence and sex-stratified GWAS. Findings No variant reached genome-wide significance in the primary meta-analysis, but 24 loci showed suggestive association (p<1×10⁻⁵), with SNP-based heritability estimated at h²≈0·26. FLAMES-prioritised genes at suggestive loci overlapped with those previously implicated in childhood apraxia of speech, including PTBP2 , KIRREL3 , CAMTA1 , GRIN2A , and SETBP1 , with significant enrichment for apraxia-associated genes overall (p=1×10⁻⁴). Meta-analysis with an independent self-reported stuttering GWAS identified a genome-wide significant association at MPPED2 and gene-level convergence at CAMTA1 and PTBP2 . A polygenic risk score derived from this independent GWAS was associated with stuttering susceptibility and severity within clinically ascertained cases. Partitioned heritability analysis pointed to enrichment in conserved regulatory regions, and integration with imaging data highlighted motor circuitry including decreased pallidum volume and cerebellar and white-matter microstructural differences. Interpretation Our findings support common variant associations in stuttering converging on genes implicated in speech and neurodevelopmental conditions, pointing to basal ganglia–cerebellar motor circuits as central to speech motor control. Funding Australian National Health and Medical Research Council. Research in context Evidence before this study We searched PubMed for genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of stuttering, using terms including “stuttering,” “stammering,” and “genome-wide association,” for studies prior to July 2026, with no language restriction. Prior GWAS of stuttering are limited. The International Stuttering Project combined clinically ascertained and self-reported cases with population controls and identified one genome-wide significant locus near SSUH2 and 15 loci at suggestive significance. Another study investigating predicted stuttering within Vanderbilt’s Electronic Health Records, identified one locus surpassing genome-wide significance near CYRIA . A larger GWAS using self-reported stuttering status identified 57 genome-wide significant loci. Twin and family studies estimate stuttering heritability at 0·42–0·85, and rare variant studies have implicated genes including GNPTAB , GNPTG , NAGPA , AP4E1 , PPID , and ZBTB20 in familial persistent stuttering, but it remains unclear whether these genes are also relevant to common genetic variation in the general population. Added value of this study We conducted the largest GWAS meta-analysis of stuttering to combine clinically ascertained cases with population-based cohorts, comprising 18 cohorts, 6,096 cases, and 81,629 controls. Unlike prior studies based solely on self-report, many of our ascertained cases had detailed phenotyping including measures of persistence and quantitative severity, allowing us to examine genetic overlap between stuttering onset, persistence, and severity. We identified suggestive genetic loci that converge with genes previously implicated in a rare, severe motor speech disorder (childhood apraxia of speech), and found that combining our data with the independent, previous GWAS of self-reported stuttering identified a genome-wide significant association. We further used imaging genetics approaches to link genetic risk for stuttering to specific brain regions and circuits involved in motor control, and used evolutionary genomic analyses to show that stuttering-associated regions are enriched in ancient, conserved parts of the genome. Implications of all the available evidence Our findings suggest that common genetic variation contributing to stuttering converges on the same genes and brain circuits implicated in rare, severe speech disorders. This strengthens the case that stuttering, at least in part, shares a biological basis with other neurodevelopmental and speech-motor conditions, and points to the basal ganglia– cerebellar motor circuit as a promising target for future mechanistic research. For clinicians and people who stutter, these findings do not yet have direct treatment implications, but they lay groundwork for better understanding why stuttering persists in some individuals and not others, and highlight the value of collecting detailed speech and language phenotypes in future large-scale genetic studies.

relevance.reason: 研究口吃（言语产出障碍）的遗传基础，并通过影像遗传学将风险与基底节-小脑运动环路及白质微结构差异联系起来，涉及言语运动控制及脑结构与功能。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过跨多个队列的GWAS荟萃分析，考察口吃的常见遗传基础，并分析其持续性与严重程度的遗传关联。主分析未发现全基因组显著位点，但提示性位点所对应的基因与儿童言语失用症相关基因重叠，且与独立的自报口吃GWAS合并后出现显著关联。遗传风险评分与临床病例中的口吃易感性和严重程度相关，影像遗传分析还指向基底节—小脑运动环路。作者认为，口吃至少部分与其他言语和神经发育障碍共享生物学基础，但这些发现尚无直接治疗意义。

papers.title: Content-Sensitive Linguistic Representations in the Human Multiple-Demand Network
papers.authors: Havin M, Meshulam M, Karidi T, Tikochinski R, Hasson U, Goldstein A.
papers.abstract: Neuroimaging dissociates specialized language regions from the domain-general multiple-demand (MD) network, yet the functional contribution of MD regions to language processing remains unresolved. Because MD recruitment during linguistic tasks is conventionally attributed to domain-general cognitive load, prior research has largely prioritized activation magnitude over representational content. Consequently, it remains unclear whether MD cortices function merely as nonspecific amplifiers of effort or actively encode fine-grained linguistic structures. Here we show that the MD network reliably encodes content-sensitive linguistic representations during naturalistic comprehension independently of peak cognitive demand. Using a voxelwise encoding framework with architecturally identical language models trained on distinct semantic domains (BERT and SciBERT) across three naturalistic fMRI datasets, we find that multiple-demand regions track linguistic structure during both high-demand scientific lectures and low-demand narratives. Furthermore, comparative analyses reveal that these representations are sensitive to domain-specific semantic regularities rather than surface-level form alone. Finally, by evaluating relative model alignment alongside the language network, we demonstrate that the representational balance between these two systems shifts dynamically as a function of task context and domain relevance, revealing a complementary division of labor. Together, these findings reframe the multiple-demand network from a purely extrinsic control mechanism into an active, content-sensitive component of a distributed semantic architecture.

relevance.reason: 用自然情境fMRI和语言模型比较，揭示多需求网络编码内容敏感的语言表征，涉及语言加工与一般认知网络的表征分工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注域一般性的多需求网络在语言加工中究竟只起非特异性调控作用，还是也编码具体的语言内容。作者用体素级编码框架，在自然语言理解条件下比较了在不同语义领域训练的架构相同的语言模型与脑活动的对应关系。结果显示，多需求网络在高认知负荷的科学讲座和低负荷的叙事中都能稳定追踪语言结构，且其表征对领域特异的语义规律敏感，而不只是反映表层形式。与语言网络的相对模型对齐比较进一步表明，两个系统之间的表征平衡会随任务情境和领域相关性动态变化，提示二者存在互补分工。作者据此认为，多需求网络不只是外在的控制机制，也是分布式语义架构中具有内容敏感性的组成部分。

papers.title: Test-Retest Reproducibility of Single- and Cross-Population White Matter Atlases in Diffusion MRI Tractography
papers.authors: Li Y, Wang X, Sun J, Zhang W, Wu Y, Yin L, Chen Y, Rathi Y, Makris N, O’Donnell LJ, Zhang F.
papers.abstract: Diffusion MRI tractography enables noninvasive mapping of white matter fiber tracts. Atlasbased white matter parcellation supports automated tract identification by assigning individual streamlines to atlas-defined clusters and anatomical tract labels. Because clustering-based white matter atlases are constructed from cohort-specific tractography data, they capture common white matter organization represented in the atlas-construction population. Although major white matter anatomy is shared across populations, subtle population-related anatomical variability may influence atlas representation and test-retest correspondence. Therefore, the reproducibility and cross-population generalizability of tractography-based white matter atlases are important considerations for quantitative neuroimaging studies. In this study, we evaluated whether incorporating cross-population anatomical variability during atlas construction improves test-retest reproducibility. To do so, we compared a single-population ORG atlas constructed from a Western cohort with the cross-population East-West White Matter Atlas constructed from both Eastern and Western cohorts. Test-retest diffusion MRI scans from the Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP-YA) dataset and the Connectivity-based Brain Imaging Research Database (C-BIRD) were analyzed as independent Western and Eastern test-retest cohorts, respectively. Whole-brain tractography was reconstructed for each dMRI scan and parcellated using both atlases. Reproducibility was assessed using tract detection rate at both cluster level and anatomical tract level, weighted Dice coefficient, and the relative difference of mean fractional anisotropy (FA). Both atlases showed stable tract detection across test-retest scans in both cohorts. Compared with the ORG atlas, the East-West White Matter Atlas achieved higher overall spatial overlap and lower test-retest variability in mean FA, although atlas performance varied across individual tracts. These findings suggest that integrating crosspopulation information during atlas construction improves the reproducibility and generalizability of white matter atlas mapping across independent populations and imaging protocols.

relevance.reason: 研究扩散MRI纤维束追踪白质图谱的可重复性与跨人群泛化，属白质结构与成像方法学，但未涉及认知或功能意义。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注基于扩散MRI纤维束成像的白质图谱在重测中的可重复性，以及纳入跨人群解剖变异能否提升这一可重复性。作者用单一人群构建的ORG图谱与融合东西方队列的East-West白质图谱，分别对西方和东方独立重测队列的纤维束进行分区，并比较追踪检出、空间重叠与平均FA的重测差异。结果显示，两套图谱在两类队列中均能稳定检出纤维束；East-West图谱总体空间重叠更高、平均FA的重测波动更小，但具体纤维束的表现并不一致。作者据此认为，构建图谱时整合跨人群信息有助于提高白质图谱映射在独立人群和成像协议间的可重复性与泛化性。

papers.title: Integrative multimodal framework combining undercarboxylated osteocalcin and medial prefrontal cortex morphometry for prediction of cognitive decline in osteoporosis: a machine learning study.
papers.authors: Tong X, Zhou Y, Cao Y, Han C.
papers.abstract: Objective This study investigates the mechanistic link between age-related osteoporosis (OP) and cognitive decline, with a particular emphasis on the neuroprotective role of undercarboxylated osteocalcin (ucOC)-the biologically active form of osteocalcin-and its influence on brain structural integrity and cognitive performance. We further explored the translational potential of integrating neuroimaging features, and machine learning algorithms to develop predictive models for early identification of cognitive deterioration in OP patients. Methods We conducted a comprehensive voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis across two independent datasets. Voxel-wise comparisons between OP patients and healthy controls were performed to characterize grey matter volume (GMV) alterations. Correlation and mediation analyses were subsequently employed to elucidate the relationships among serum ucOC levels, GMV, and cognitive function. Brain regions exhibiting significant mediation effects were identified as ucOC-associated neuroimaging biomarkers in Dataset 1, and their GMV values were used as fixed features to develop machine-learning models for predicting 1-year cognitive decline in OP patients in the independent Dataset 2, evaluated through a leakage-free leave-one-out cross-validation procedure. Results OP patients exhibited significantly lower Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) scores and reduced GMV in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) relative to healthy controls. Notably, serum ucOC, but not carboxylated osteocalcin (cOC), demonstrated significant positive correlations with both MoCA scores and mPFC GMV in OP patients. Mediation analysis further confirmed that mPFC GMV statistically mediates the relationship between ucOC and cognitive function. Machine-learning models integrating mPFC GMV achieved good discriminative performance in leakage-free validation in Dataset 2 (XGBoost: AUC = 0.84, 95% CI [0.79, 0.88]), classifying OP patients at elevated risk of cognitive decline over a 1-year follow-up period. Conclusion Our study establishes undercarboxylated osteocalcin (ucOC) as a mechanistically relevant, circulating biomarker of cognitive resilience in osteoporosis, and identifies medial prefrontal cortex grey matter volume (mPFC GMV) as its structural neuroimaging correlate for ucOC. Importantly, XGBoost yields a promising predictive framework that achieved good discriminative accuracy for 1-year cognitive decline risk.

relevance.reason: 研究骨质疏松患者内侧前额叶灰质体积与认知功能的关系及其作为认知下降预测标志，涉及人脑结构-认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨骨质疏松与认知衰退之间的机制联系，重点考察未羧化骨钙素（ucOC）对脑结构完整性和认知表现的影响，并评估整合神经影像特征与机器学习预测认知下降的可行性。基于两个独立数据集，作者比较了骨质疏松患者与健康对照的灰质体积，并结合相关与中介分析及机器学习建模。结果显示，患者的内侧前额叶皮层灰质体积和认知评分均较低，血清ucOC（而非羧化骨钙素）与二者呈正相关，且内侧前额叶灰质体积在ucOC与认知功能之间起统计中介作用。以该脑区灰质体积为特征构建的模型在独立数据集中对一年内认知下降风险具有较好的区分表现。作者据此提出ucOC可作为骨质疏松中认知韧性的循环生物标志物，内侧前额叶灰质体积为其结构性影像相关指标，但预测框架的临床价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Abnormal coordination of executive control network and default mode network in cognitive impairment after deep nuclei intracerebral hemorrhage.
papers.authors: Fan X, Lei Y, Deng Y, Xiang Y, Sun C, Yu X, Zhang J, Li C, Chen P.
papers.abstract: Objective This study investigated the macroscopic neural mechanisms of cognitive impairment after Deep Nuclei Intracerebral Hemorrhage (DNICH) from the dimensions of brain activity and brain networks, and further identified characteristic fingerprints of cognitive representation. Method Patients with cognitive impairment after DNICH and healthy controls (HC) were prospectively and consecutively enrolled. Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) data and the cognitive scale Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) were collected. Spontaneous brain activity measured by fractional Amplitude of Low-Frequency Fluctuations (fALFF) was used to identify hub brain regions of cognitive representation, which were then used as Regions of Interest (ROI) for Functional Connectivity (FC) analysis, in order to investigate the potential mechanisms after DNICH cognitive impairment and identify characteristic fingerprints for distinguishing patients with dementia (dementia was defined as MMSE ≤ 17). Result This study enrolled 139 patients with DNICH and 100 HC. There were no significant differences in baseline characteristics including age, gender, years of education, height, and weight between the two groups. Hematomas were predominantly located in the bilateral basal ganglia, more commonly on the left side, with varying degrees of thalamic and white matter involvement. Whole-brain zfALFF analysis showed that MMSE scores were significantly correlated with zfALFF values in brain regions including right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (R-DLPFC) and posterior cingulate cortex (PCC), with R-DLPFC positively correlated and PCC negatively correlated with cognition (AlphaSim correction, p < 0.01; cluster size >19). In addition, FC within the executive control network (ECN) and default mode network (DMN) was abnormally altered in patients with cognitive impairment and was closely associated with cognitive function (r = -0.29-0.51). FC fingerprints demonstrated stable predictive ability for dementia status (AUC = 0.70-0.73). Conclusion Abnormal coordination of intra-network and inter-network FC of ECN and DMN may represent a shared neural mechanism of cognitive impairment after DNICH. Modulating FC between these hub brain regions (R-DLPFC and PCC) may provide new therapeutic strategies for cognitive recovery after DNICH.

relevance.reason: 研究深部核团脑出血后认知障碍患者的静息态fMRI，发现执行控制网络与默认网络功能连接异常并与认知相关，属脑损伤后认知与网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨深部核团脑出血后认知障碍的宏观神经机制，比较患者与健康对照的静息态功能磁共振指标及认知量表得分，并以自发活动定位关键脑区后分析功能连接。结果显示，患者执行控制网络与默认模式网络内部及网络间的功能连接出现异常，且与认知功能相关；基于连接特征对痴呆状态的判别具有中等且较稳定的预测能力。作者据此提出，这两个网络协调异常可能是深部核团脑出血后认知障碍的共同神经机制，调节相关枢纽脑区间连接或为认知恢复提供潜在干预方向，但这仍属关联性发现，尚非治疗证据。

papers.title: Attenuated sensorimotor hemodynamic responses and altered cortical dynamics during passive proprioceptive-related stimulation after stroke: a multidimensional fNIRS study.
papers.authors: Sun H, Fu Q, Jiang Y, Zhu G.
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to use functional near-infrared spectroscopy to investigate abnormalities in cortical activity and dynamic network mechanisms associated with proprioceptive processing after stroke. We integrated conventional hemodynamic features, latent-state organization, directed connectivity, and recovery-phase complexity analyses to explore multidimensional changes in cortical dynamics. Methods Patients with stroke and healthy controls underwent baseline motor and sensory assessments and completed a block-designed proprioceptive task during fNIRS recording, consisting of six alternating 30-s stimulation and 30-s rest periods. After preprocessing, ROI-level oxygenated hemoglobin (HbO) time series were extracted. Conventional temporal features included area under the curve (AUC), onset latency, peak amplitude, post-stimulus residual activation, recovery slope, and time-to-peak. Latent state analysis was performed using a Gaussian mixture model to derive fractional occupancy (FO), mean dwell time (MDT), and transition characteristics. Directed connectivity during prestimulus, stimulation, and recovery phases was assessed using a sliding-window multivariate autoregressive model with partial directed coherence (PDC). Recovery-phase dynamics were further quantified using sample entropy, mean multiscale entropy, recurrence rate (RR), determinism (DET), and mean diagonal line length (Lmean). Results A total of 62 participants, including 30 patients with stroke and 32 healthy controls, underwent a passive thumb movement task during fNIRS recording. Conventional HbO analysis showed that between-group differences were mainly confined to the left sensorimotor cortex, where the stroke group differed significantly from healthy controls in AUC (p = 0.023), peak amplitude (p = 0.003), and recovery slope (p = 0.018). No other ROI showed significant between-group differences, although marginal trends were observed in the right prefrontal and right sensorimotor cortices. Latent state analysis identified six states. Healthy controls more frequently occupied State 1 and State 5, whereas the stroke group more frequently occupied State 3 and State 6, and showed longer MDT in State 2 and State 3. Directed connectivity analysis revealed phase-dependent shifts in both groups, with the stroke group showing stronger prefrontal-sensorimotor reorganization across prestimulus, stimulation, and recovery phases. Recovery-phase complexity analysis demonstrated significantly higher global RR, DET, and Lmean in the stroke group, whereas sample entropy and mean multiscale entropy did not remain significant after correction. ROI-level complexity differences did not survive multiple-comparison correction. Conclusion Abnormal proprioceptive processing after stroke is characterized not only by altered local activation, but also by dynamic state shifts, phase-specific reorganization of information flow, and increased regularity with reduced flexibility during recovery.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS研究卒中后本体感觉加工相关的感觉运动皮层血流动力学与动态网络重组，属脑疾病认知机制与功能组织。

papers.title: Evaluating the compatibility of predictive coding as a model of linguistic predictability effects in reading.
papers.authors: Copeland A, Payne BR.
papers.abstract: Emerging work suggests that the computational architecture of predictive coding (PC), widely studied in visual perception, may be an appropriate model for understanding predictability effects in real-time reading (i. e., the influence of a preceding sentence context on current word processing via putative anticipatory mechanisms). We evaluated four hypotheses derived from PC models focused on: (1) bottom-up prediction error, (2) top-down sensory prediction, (3) biological plausibility, and (4) hierarchical inference. We argue that many empirical effects of predictability during reading are generally consistent with PC model hypotheses, such as ERP N400 context effects and facilitated recognition and reading times, while others are challenging to reconcile, such as the frontal positivity ERP effect to plausible prediction violations and emerging work examining brain-behavior dynamics in natural reading. Overall, we suggest that while PC applied to linguistic processing has some important explanatory utility, it likely does not reflect the sole core mechanism of the language architecture.

relevance.reason: 评估预测编码作为阅读中语言可预测性效应的模型，讨论N400等脑电成分与语言加工机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该文评估预测编码模型能否解释阅读中的语言可预测性效应，即前文语境如何通过预期机制影响当前词汇加工。作者围绕自下而上的预测误差、自上而下的感觉预测、生物合理性和层级推断四项假设展开论证，认为N400语境效应以及识别和阅读时间的促进等结果与预测编码基本相符，但合理预测违反引发的额区正波、自然阅读中脑与行为动态等证据较难纳入该框架。作者据此指出，预测编码对语言加工具有一定解释力，但可能并非语言架构的唯一核心机制。

papers.title: How Meaning Shapes a Rule: Neural Signatures of Morphological Learning and Generalization
papers.authors: Azar M, Marantz A.
papers.abstract: Rule generalization is one of the most useful tools our mind uses to facilitate learning. In language, we apply it to connect what words mean to what they are made of, such as their suffixes. This is a morphosemantic relation, and it helps us process words we already know and easily acquire new words by composing their meaning. How is this relation acquired, and how does it manifest into generalization for understanding new words? In this study, we investigated the brain basis of these questions through an English-based artificial language study, where learners read sentences to learn a suffix-meaning relation of new words like “thinkle”. Words were either meaningful (places or things) or had no clear meaning. Each suffix family had majority and minority meaning words that participants had to keep track of for testing. For meaningful words in training, we found that higher performance scores predicted higher selective engagement in the left inferior frontal gyrus, specifically the pars triangularis and pars opercularis. In testing, both learned and generalized words, both increased lateral prefrontal cortex engagement. Meanwhile, words with no clear meaning had a much more diffuse brain engagement, recruiting bilateral temporoparietal regions. This resembles the processing of abstract words from previous literature. We found no difference between majority and minority meaning words, especially with the variance in participants’ performance strategies, but found differences in what predicted significant brain activity based on strategy difference. This study grounds itself in the reality of word and affixal semantics with previous research on language learning and universals. Ultimately, it lends a learning paradigm that resembles natural language learning across many languages to carefully investigate its brain basis, while addressing an understudied aspect of rule generalization: ambiguity.

relevance.reason: 研究人工语言中语素-语义规则学习与泛化的脑基础，报告左额下回等语言相关脑区参与。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用基于英语的人工语言学习任务，考察学习者如何习得词缀与词义之间的形态—语义关系，并将其推广到新词。结果发现，学习有明确意义的词时，成绩越好，左侧额下回（特别是三角部和岛盖部）的选择性参与越强；测试阶段，无论学过的词还是推广到的新词，都伴随外侧前额叶参与增强。而无明确意义的词则引发更弥散的双侧颞顶区域活动，类似以往对抽象词加工的观察。研究未发现多数义与少数义词之间的差异，但预测显著脑活动的因素随学习者策略不同而变化。作者据此强调，规则推广中的歧义问题值得进一步关注。

papers.title: Taking the speaker’s perspective? Investigating quantifier and implicature processing in an AI-language training paradigm using EEG-VR
papers.authors: Spychalska M, Reimer L, Dijkhuis M, Hagoort P.
papers.abstract: Interpreting speaker meaning requires taking into account the speaker’s epistemic perspective, i.e., their access to relevant information. The extent to which listeners integrate this perspective during comprehension is known as the perspective-taking problem. We present the first EEG study to investigate the role of perspective-taking in the processing of quantifiers and scalar implicatures. Using immersive virtual reality, we asked participants to assist an AI, represented by a virtual agent, in learning to use quantifiers appropriately. Critically, the agent had limited access to the reference domain compared to the participant.Our results show that when the speaker’s information access is restricted, listeners initially process the semantic content of quantified statements from an egocentric perspective. Effects of the speaker’s perspective emerge only later, reflected in a sustained anterior negativity. For pragmatically ambiguous sentences containing ``some", we observe neither an effect of speaker perspective nor evidence for scalar implicature processing. We argue that contexts requiring consideration of the speaker’s knowledge primarily support Gricean, weak implicatures, which are computed relatively late as post-propositional inferences.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电结合沉浸式虚拟现实，考察听者在理解数量词和级差隐含意义时是否采纳说话者的知识视角。参与者协助一个信息获取受限的虚拟AI代理学习使用数量词。结果显示，当说话者掌握的信息有限时，听者最初从自我视角加工数量陈述的语义内容，说话者视角的影响出现较晚，表现为持续的前部负波；而对含“some”的语用歧义句，既未发现说话者视角效应，也未发现级差隐含意义加工的迹象。作者据此认为，需要考虑说话者知识的语境主要支持较晚计算的后命题性弱隐含意义。

papers.title: Predictive coding unifies neural and behavioral signatures of contextual facilitation
papers.authors: Nour Eddine S, Yacovone A, Kuperberg GR.
papers.abstract: During comprehension, words that are primed or predictable are processed more quickly and elicit smaller N400 responses than words that are less consistent with their preceding context. Although these behavioral and neural effects are both commonly interpreted as evidence of facilitated processing, they have typically been explained within different computational frameworks that impose seemingly conflicting constraints: behavioral facilitation requires more activity to accumulate over expected representations, allowing a decision threshold to be reached earlier, whereas N400 facilitation requires less neural activity to be generated overall. Here, we show that an implemented model of predictive coding provides a unified mechanistic account of both phenomena and, in doing so, resolves three longstanding puzzles. First, it explains how facilitated processing can simultaneously produce faster behavioral responses and reduced neural activity: expected representations accumulate activity more rapidly in state units while generating less activity in error units. Second, an asymmetry between top-down priors and bottom-up evidence allows context to pre-activate multiple lexical candidates without inducing premature competition or misprediction costs. Third, it reconciles apparently conflicting claims about the timing of contextual facilitation by showing that behavioral and neural measures can reflect different phases along a single continuous trajectory of lexico-semantic processing, rather than distinct processing stages.

relevance.reason: 用预测编码模型统一解释语境促进词汇语义加工的行为与N400神经指标，涉及语言理解的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对语境促进效应中行为反应加快与N400波幅减小看似矛盾的问题，采用可实现的预测编码模型进行机制解释。模型表明，预期表征在状态单元中更快累积活动，同时在误差单元中产生更少活动，从而统一了行为促进与神经活动降低。自上而下先验与自下而上证据之间的不对称性，使语境能预先激活多个词汇候选而不引发过早竞争或错误预测代价；行为与神经指标也可反映同一词汇语义加工轨迹的不同阶段，而非不同加工阶段。这为长期存在的三个争议提供了统一解释。

papers.title: MDD-Explorer: A Multi-scale Visual Evolution Framework for Dynamic Functional Connectivity in Depression
papers.authors: Li S, Cheng Z, Chen L, Xu H.
papers.abstract: Abstract Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) is a prevalent psychiatric condition whose symptoms have been associated with time-varying changes in the statistical relationships among distributed brain regions, a property referred to as dynamic functional connectivity (dFC). However, the large sample sizes and high dimensionality of modern dFC datasets make it difficult for cliniciansto extract useful findings. We present MDD-Explorer, a multi-scale visualanalytics framework for examining dFC in large clinical cohorts. The systemcombines unsupervised state-transition modeling with a coordinated set ofinteractive visualizations. It allows users to navigate three analyticalscales: a macroscopic cohort view for comparing state transition probabilities and dwell times between patient and control groups, amesoscopic timeline view for tracking how each subject's brain statechanges over the scanning session, and a microscopic 3D connectome viewthat places high-dimensional connectivity features in their anatomical context. We demonstrate MDD-Explorer on a resting-state fMRI dataset of 1,642 subjects with 140 time steps per subject. Through case studies and expert feedback, we show that the framework supports the identification of MDD-associated patterns, such as reduced flexibility in switching between brain states and localized abnormalities in specific neural circuits, and that these patterns can be related to clinical interpretations.

relevance.reason: 基于静息态fMRI动态功能连接分析抑郁症患者脑状态转换与网络组织异常。

papers.title: Simultaneous metabolic–functional coupling topology in disorders of consciousness
papers.authors: Xu L, He C, Sun Y, Ge Q, Xie Y, Chen X, Geng X, Ai L, Wang K, Li X, He J, Laureys S, Song M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Consciousness depends on coordinated cerebral metabolism and intrinsic brain activity, yet the spatial organization of this neurometabolic coupling across consciousness states remains incompletely understood. We studied 29 patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness (12 MCS, 17 UWS) and 10 preserved-consciousness clinical reference participants using simultaneous PET/MR-derived 18 F-FDG PET and resting-state fMRI data. PET-derived Z-standardized FDG uptake and fMRI-derived regional homogeneity (ReHo) and fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) were first compared between MCS and UWS. Cross-modal coupling was then quantified at two levels: within-subject whole-brain spatial coupling and group-level voxel-wise coupling topology. Z-standardized FDG uptake, ReHo, and fALFF showed distinct MCS–UWS difference topographies, whereas whole-brain coupling magnitude did not differ between MCS and UWS for any modality pair. Exploratory voxel-wise analyses identified candidate coupling patterns involving dorsal parietal, posterior midline, occipital, anterior insular, sensorimotor, and cerebellar territories, although none survived FDR or max-statistic FWER correction. These findings do not establish a independently validated clinical biomarker, but suggest that metabolic–functional relationships in prolonged disorders of consciousness may be spatially heterogeneous and not adequately characterized by a single whole-brain coupling measure, providing candidate topographies for future independent replication.
