papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告描述一名接受腰麻下膝关节镜手术的63岁女性，在右美托咪定辅助镇静期间出现短暂获得性言语不流畅，表现为起音困难、重复首音和音节延长，而意识、理解、命名及构音均保留。神经查体除言语异常外无局灶体征，脑影像未见急性梗死或主要颅内血管异常，症状在停药后出现并于约97分钟后自行完全缓解，随访期内未复发。作者指出，单例无法确立因果关系，但右美托咪定对言语相关神经网络的调节可能是解释之一，尤其见于存在基底节异常基础的患者；围术期新发言语异常仍应首先排除急性脑血管事件。

papers.title: Visual-Semantic Tuning across the Cortex Shifts between Tasks.
papers.authors: Zhang T, Gallant JL.
papers.abstract: Attention is a powerful mechanism that dynamically optimizes brain representations to prioritize behaviorally relevant information. While previous studies focusing on single tasks have demonstrated that attention shifts tuning toward attended targets, real-world behavior often requires humans to switch between tasks with different demands. How does visual-semantic tuning in the human brain shift to support the behavioral demands of different naturalistic tasks? To investigate this question, we used voxelwise encoding models to explore how visual-semantic tuning across the human cerebral cortex shifts between two naturalistic human fMRI experiments that used distinct tasks, movie-watching (five male participants) and active navigation (six participants, three male, three female). Results show that visual-semantic tuning in the cortex differed substantially between experiments. Principal component analysis reveals that during navigation, tuning shifts increase the representation of vehicles and traffic signs compared with movie-watching and that these shifts are localized to distinct functional networks. These tuning shifts reconfigure the human brain's representations of object categories based on their behavioral relevance. These findings suggest that visual-semantic tuning in the brain dynamically shifts toward task-relevant information across naturalistic tasks, optimizing functional representations to achieve diverse behavioral goals.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI编码模型比较电影观看与主动导航任务中皮层视觉-语义调谐的任务依赖性变化。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑皮层的视觉—语义调谐如何在任务切换时发生改变，采用体素级编码模型比较了观看电影和主动导航两种自然情境下fMRI实验中的调谐模式。结果显示，两种实验间的皮层调谐存在明显差异；主成分分析进一步表明，导航时调谐向车辆和交通标志等任务相关物体类别偏移，且这些偏移集中在不同的功能网络上。作者据此认为，视觉—语义调谐会随任务需求动态偏向行为相关信息，从而按行为相关性重构物体类别的脑表征，以支持多样化的行为目标。

papers.title: An exploratory fNIRS study on directional asymmetry in segmental discrimination: Lateral-rhotic (/la-ra/) and labial-dorsal (/ba-ga/) contrasts tested in 5- and 9-month-old Japanese infants.
papers.authors: Akimoto Y, Takahasi M, Yamane N, Shibata N, Tsui RK, Mazuka R.
papers.abstract: Directional asymmetry refers to the order-dependent difference in segmental discrimination; however, its underlying cortical mechanisms remain unclear. This exploratory study used near-infrared spectroscopy to measure hemodynamic responses in 5- and 9-month-old Japanese infants (N = 30 [14 girls, 16 boys] and N = 40 [16 girls, 24 boys], respectively) to the lateral-rhotic /la-ra/ and labial-dorsal /ba-ga/ contrasts and to examine whether directional asymmetry was observed. Post hoc analysis revealed significant directional asymmetry for the /la-ra/ contrast in 5-month-old infants, characterized by decreased oxyhemoglobin levels in the right middle-anterior temporal channels, specifically for the /ra/-to-/la/ change. This localized response in the middle portion of the superior temporal gyrus, a region associated with tracking acoustic properties, suggests that infants at this age may rely on acoustic-level processing rather than on fully established phonological categories. This relative deactivation, observed in 5-month-olds but not in 9-month-olds and in the direction that appeared more difficult to discriminate, suggests a potential association between discrimination difficulty and the hemodynamic response. Specifically, the acoustic complexity of the /ra/ standard stimuli could have imposed a higher computational load, potentially leading to incomplete encoding during the baseline periods. This incomplete processing may have elevated hemodynamic activity, thereby resulting in a relative decrease in response to the subsequent change to /la/ stimuli. This phenomenon aligns with the perceptual space learning account, in which hemodynamic activity potentially reflects the computational load involved in the continuous calibration of an infant's developing perceptual space. Future studies should directly assess this hypothesis.

relevance.reason: fNIRS测量婴儿语音对比辨别时的颞叶血流动力学偏侧化，属言语感知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究用近红外光谱测量5个月和9个月日本婴儿对/la-ra/与/ba-ga/两组音段对比的血流动力学反应，考察是否存在方向性不对称。结果仅在5个月组的/la-ra/对比中发现显著方向性不对称：由/ra/变为/la/时，右侧颞中前部通道氧合血红蛋白下降，作者将其定位于与追踪声学属性相关的中部颞上回。这一相对去激活未见于9个月组，且出现在辨别似乎更困难的方向上，提示辨别难度可能与血流动力学反应相关：/ra/标准刺激的声学复杂性可能带来更高计算负荷，使基线期编码不完整、活动升高，从而在随后变为/la/时表现为相对下降。作者认为这与知觉空间学习解释相符，但强调仅为潜在关联，相关假设仍需未来研究直接检验。

papers.title: A dual-fMRI investigation of interpersonal emotion regulation: Predicting strategy selection and implementation success from effective brain connectivity.
papers.authors: Ngombe N, Czekóová K, Gajdoš M, Kessler K, Brázdil M, Shamay-Tsoory S, Shaw DJ.
papers.abstract: Inter-personal emotion regulation (ER) is the social process whereby one individual (a "Regulator") assists another (the "Target") in regulating their emotional state. Despite the importance of inter-personal ER for maintaining well-being, very little is known about the neurocognitive mechanisms that support this process. In the present study, we performed functional magnetic resonance imaging on 23 pairs of Regulators and Targets whilst they engaged in a novel task designed to capture the two stages of inter-personal ER: the Regulator's selection of an ER strategy to recommend and its subsequent implementation by an affiliate Target. This paradigm allowed us to investigate the brain systems supporting both stages of the inter-personal process and identify personality characteristics that might influence the inter-personal dynamic through these neurocognitive mechanisms. Results revealed largely overlapping patterns of brain response during Regulators' selections and Targets' implementation of ER strategies, encompassing medial and lateral prefrontal and temporo-parietal cortices. Moreover, by applying behavioural Dynamic Causal Modelling to the behavioural and brain data acquired during the task, we identified patterns of effective connectivity among these brain regions from which we could accurately estimate Regulators' selections and their effectiveness in down-regulating Targets' emotional responses. Lastly, certain network connections and the effectiveness of Regulators' selections in down-regulating Targets' emotion states were associated with two dissociable styles of self-directed (intra-personal) ER: failure- and decision-related action control.

relevance.reason: 双fMRI研究人际情绪调节的神经认知机制，涉及前额叶-颞顶网络及有效连接预测策略选择与实施。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人际情绪调节中调节者选择策略与目标者执行策略这两个阶段的神经认知机制，采用双人同步功能磁共振成像，让调节者与目标者配对完成一项新任务。结果显示，两个阶段主要涉及重叠的内侧与外侧前额叶及颞顶皮层反应；基于行为动态因果模型，研究者还能从这些脑区间的有效连接模式较准确地估计调节者的策略选择及其下调目标者情绪的效果。此外，部分网络连接和调节者下调目标者情绪的效果，与自我情绪调节中两种可分离的行动控制风格相关。这些发现提示人际情绪调节的策略选择与实施可能依赖共享且可预测的脑网络动态，但相关结果尚属关联性证据，不能直接推及临床干预。

papers.title: Altered EEG-derived functional brain states in Parkinson's disease with mild cognitive impairment.
papers.authors: Wang Y, Zhang Z, Wang J, Jiang Z, She L, Pan Y, Liu C.
papers.abstract: The neurobiological mechanism underpinning cognitive impairment in Parkinson's disease remains poorly understood, although it increasingly points to aberrant spatiotemporal switching among large-scale network configurations. Leveraging the high temporal resolution of source-reconstructed EEG, we characterized these microstate alterations and their direct coupling with cognitive performance. This study used an enhanced Leading eigenvector dynamics analysis framework on source-reconstructed EEG data to probe the temporal properties and transition dynamics of brain functional states in Parkinson's disease patients with and without mild cognitive impairment. EEG signals were projected into source space via individual MRI-constrained source imaging, producing time series from 400 cortical regions. Recurring brain states were identified based on instantaneous phase coherence. We computed each state occupancy rate, state duration, and transition probabilities in both Parkinson's disease patients with and without mild cognitive impairment groups. Correlations with Montreal Cognitive Assessment scores were assessed. By identifying four recurrent brain states (states A-D), Parkinson's disease patients with mild cognitive impairment exhibited increased state occupancy rate and state duration in state B and decreased engagement in state D. In addition, transitions into state D from other states were significantly diminished in the mild cognitive impairment group. Crucially, both the temporal expression and kinetic accessibility of state D were positively correlated with Montreal Cognitive Assessment scores, suggesting that this integrated configuration underpins high-order cognitive function and may serve as a neural marker of cognitive resilience in Parkinson's disease. Cognitive deterioration in Parkinson's disease is fundamentally associated with disrupted brain state dynamics, marked by a pathological hyper-convergence towards state B and a systemic attrition of state D. These alterations likely reflect impaired attentional control and network rigidity, and may serve as dynamic biomarkers and therapeutic targets for Parkinson's disease-related cognitive decline.

relevance.reason: 用源重建EEG研究帕金森病轻度认知障碍患者脑功能状态动态及其与认知评分的关联，属认知障碍的脑网络机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病伴轻度认知障碍患者的大尺度脑网络状态动态，利用源重建脑电结合改进的领先特征向量动态分析框架，识别反复出现的脑功能状态并考察其时间特征、转换概率与认知表现的关联。结果发现，伴轻度认知障碍的患者在某一状态上占据比例和持续时间增加，而在另一整合性状态上的参与减少，且向该状态的转换明显减弱；后者的时间表达与转换可达性均与认知评分正相关。作者据此认为，帕金森病认知退化与脑状态动态紊乱有关，表现为向某一状态的病理性过度集中和另一状态的系统性衰减，可能反映注意控制受损与网络僵化，并有望作为动态标志物和干预靶点。

papers.title: Facial palsy reveals the sensorimotor contribution to facial-emotion recognition.
papers.authors: Sessa P, Schiano Lomoriello A, Quettier T, Maffei A, Costa S, Nichele M, Ferrari PF.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Although recognizing emotions from facial expressions appears effortless, the field is divided between vision-based accounts, which posit matching to learned visual templates, and embodied accounts, which posit recruitment of facial motor circuits. We propose an ambiguity-gated, developmentally calibrated architecture in which the recognition system draws on sensorimotor information primarily when visual evidence is insufficient, with early motor experience proposed to shape the threshold and gain of this contribution. We tested this model across three studies (N = 185) integrating dynamic prototypical and nonprototypical expressions, congenital (Moebius syndrome) and acquired facial palsy, and standardized severity grading (Sunnybrook Facial Grading System; SFGS). Neurotypical adults (N = 117) confirmed a robust prototypicality-dependent cost on recognition. Both congenital (N = 15) and acquired (N = 19) cohorts showed severity-performance coupling for nonprototypical expressions, consistent with shared reliance on sensorimotor information when visual evidence is insufficient; only the Moebius cohort showed this coupling also for prototypical expressions, consistent with undercalibrated visual templates following lifelong atypical facial motor experience. Exploratory electroencephalography (EEG) revealed reduced sensorimotor-face-network functional connectivity in Moebius, consistent with altered cross-route integration. Reanalysis of an independent dataset of ultra-ambiguous static morphs replicated severity-performance coupling and revealed Moebius-control mean differences only under high perceptual demand. Together, the findings provide strong behavioral support for an ambiguity-gated, developmentally calibrated architecture and motivate direct tests of how developmental motor experience shapes when-and how strongly-the recognition system draws on sensorimotor information.

relevance.reason: 研究面瘫患者面部情绪识别的感觉运动贡献及EEG功能连接，属社会认知/情绪加工的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个“歧义门控、发育校准”的架构，认为面部情绪识别主要在视觉证据不足时才依赖感觉运动信息，而早期运动经验会塑造这一贡献的阈值和增益。作者整合动态典型与非典型表情、先天性与获得性面瘫及面瘫严重度分级进行检验：健康成人对非典型表情的识别明显更差；两类面瘫群体均表现出严重度与识别表现的关联，且主要见于非典型表情，提示视觉证据不足时共同依赖感觉运动信息；先天组在典型表情上也出现该关联，被解释为长期异常面部运动经验导致视觉模板校准不足。探索性脑电还提示先天组感觉运动—面部网络功能连接降低。总体上，结果从行为层面支持该架构，但脑电与独立数据重分析仅为探索性，尚需直接检验发育运动经验如何影响感觉运动信息被调用的时机与强度。

papers.title: Human tau pathology is associated with lonely, nontraveling slow waves linked to memory impairment.
papers.authors: Sharon O, Chen X, Dude J, Westphal J, Brown C, Shah VD, Ju YS, Jagust WJ, Walker MP.
papers.abstract: Memory markedly declines with age, exaggerated in those with Alzheimer's disease, yet the mechanisms are still not resolved. Here we show that frontal lobe tau pathology in humans is associated with impaired en masse unity and cortical traveling propagation of nonrapid eye movement slow waves, linked to impaired memory retention. We elucidate these findings using positron-emission tomography tau brain imaging, and then replicate and extend them using Alzheimer's disease pathology markers derived from cerebrospinal fluid in an independent clinical cohort. Thus, tau-associated memory deficits are not wholly direct but indirectly linked to consequential 'lonely', nontraveling slow-wave events.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑tau病理与慢波传播及记忆保持的关系，涉及记忆的神经机制和阿尔茨海默病认知损伤。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨了人类额叶tau病理与记忆衰退之间的关系，核心方法为tau正电子发射断层成像，并在独立临床队列中用脑脊液阿尔茨海默病病理标志物进行重复和扩展。结果显示，tau病理与睡眠非快速眼动慢波的群体一致性和皮层传播受损相关，而这种“孤立”、不传播的慢波事件又与记忆保持受损相关。作者据此提出，tau相关的记忆缺陷并非完全直接产生，而可能间接地通过这类异常慢波事件起作用；不过该关联性发现尚不能确立因果，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Brain structural and functional alterations in body dysmorphic disorder patients seeking cosmetic surgery: A resting-state multimodal MRI study.
papers.authors: Zhao Z, Lu X, Ma Z, Pan Y, Huang J, Yu Z, Liu J.
papers.abstract: Background Body dysmorphic disorder (BDD) is prevalent in cosmetic surgery populations, but its neurobiological mechanisms remain unclear. Objective To identify brain functional and structural alterations in BDD using multimodal MRI. Methods Twenty BDD patients and 20 healthy controls were recruited. After quality control, 16 per group were included in final analyses. ALFF, ReHo, functional connectivity (FC), VBM, and SBM analyses were performed, with correlations to clinical severity. Results BDD patients showed increased ALFF in right cerebellar lobule VIII and increased ReHo in left cerebellar lobule VIII. FC revealed enhanced mPFC-rectus gyrus connectivity and reduced PCC connectivity with left inferior parietal lobule and right midcingulate cortex. Exploratory structural analyses suggested increased gray matter in left middle occipital gyrus, decreased cerebellar/parietal volumes, altered white matter, cortical thickening in left pars triangularis, thinning in left inferior parietal lobule, and gyrification changes, but these did not survive multiple-comparison correction and require independent replication. Left inferior parietal cortical thickness positively correlated with BDD severity. Conclusions BDD involves abnormalities in default mode, cerebellar-cortical, and visual processing networks, providing preliminary neurobiological insights into BDD. These group-level findings are exploratory and do not yet support individual-level applications. Given the modest sample size, replication in larger cohorts is required.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态多模态MRI比较躯体变形障碍患者与健康人的脑功能与结构改变，属于脑疾病机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以寻求整形手术的躯体变形障碍患者为对象，结合静息态功能与结构MRI，考察其脑功能与结构改变及其与症状严重度的关系。功能分析显示，患者小脑VIII小叶的ALFF和ReHo升高，默认网络相关连接出现增强与减弱并存的变化；探索性结构分析提示枕叶、小脑、顶叶及白质存在差异，但这些结果未通过多重比较校正，需独立重复验证。左侧顶下小叶皮层厚度与症状严重度呈正相关。作者据此认为，躯体变形障碍涉及默认网络、小脑-皮层及视觉加工网络的异常，但强调这些组水平结果仍属初步探索，样本量有限，尚不支持个体层面的应用。

papers.title: Validating the neurobiological model of obsessive-compulsive disorder: a brain entropy study using resting-state fMRI.
papers.authors: Kim S, Lee SW, Woo S, Chang Y, Hoe HS, Lee SJ.
papers.abstract: Background and hypothesis Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) has been consistently associated with dysfunction within the cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical (CSTC) circuits. Brain entropy (BEN) is a nonlinear measure of the complexity and irregularity of neural signals, including blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) time series. Although OCD has been extensively studied using conventional resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) metrics, alterations in intrinsic temporal complexity remain unclear. We investigated BEN alterations in OCD and their associations with OCD symptoms. Study design Sixty-seven patients with OCD and 60 healthy controls underwent rs-fMRI. BEN maps were computed using sample entropy and compared between groups. Associations between regional BEN and OCD-related clinical measures were examined using correlation analyses. Study results Patients with OCD showed increased BEN in CSTC regions, including the orbitofrontal cortex, caudate, and thalamus, and in extra-CSTC regions, including the superior temporal gyrus (STG) and middle cingulate cortex (FDR-corrected p < .05). Within the OCD group, higher BEN was associated with DOCS total scores in the right thalamus (r = 0.380), contamination symptoms in the left caudate (r = 0.382), unacceptable thoughts in the right thalamus (r = 0.429), and importance/control of thoughts scores in the right STG (r = 0.384; all FDR-adjusted p = .023). Conclusions BEN revealed OCD-related alterations across both CSTC and extra-CSTC regions, with regional BEN associated with specific symptom dimensions and obsessive beliefs. BEN appeared to capture alterations particularly in subcortical and midline structures, providing complementary information beyond conventional rs-fMRI measures and offering a new perspective on the neural mechanisms underlying OCD.

relevance.reason: 以静息态fMRI脑熵比较强迫症患者与健康人，揭示CSTC及额外区域神经信号复杂度改变并与症状相关，属脑疾病机理与静息活动组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以静息态功能磁共振比较强迫症患者与健康对照的脑熵（一种刻画神经信号复杂性与不规则性的非线性指标），考察强迫症相关脑区信号复杂度的改变及其与症状的联系。结果显示，患者眶额皮层、尾状核、丘脑等皮层-纹状体-丘脑-皮层环路区域以及颞上回、中扣带皮层等环路外区域的脑熵升高；在患者组内，部分区域的脑熵与症状总评分、污染症状、不可接受想法及思维重要性与控制信念等维度相关。作者认为，脑熵能捕捉皮层下与中线结构的改变，为理解强迫症的神经机制提供常规静息态指标之外的补充视角；这些关联属相关性质，尚不能说明因果或临床效用。

papers.title: White matter hyperintensities and the structural connectome: a network perspective on clinical heterogeneity.
papers.authors: Mazini B, Seguin C, Lv J, Erus G, Wen J, Mito R, Davatzikos C, Hagmann P, Zalesky A, Tian YE.
papers.abstract: White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are common radiological findings with diverse clinical outcomes, including absence of clinical symptom, cognitive decline and dementia. One potential explanation for these differences is that WMH could differentially disrupt specific white matter tracts and lead to alterations in structural brain networks. We included participants from the UK Biobank who had available information on WMH volume and divided them into three groups: healthy controls (HC), individuals at risk for cerebral small vessel disease (RcSVD) and individuals with dementia. We assessed alterations in structural connectivity in RcSVD and dementia groups relative to the HC group, and examined whether the alteration in structural connectivity is associated with WMH volumes. To further investigate the extent to which between-group differences in structural connectivity can be explained by the location of WMH, we mapped WMH-specific disconnectivity matrices for every individual and compared them with the alterations in structural connectivity identified. We found a widespread disruption of structural brain networks, both in RcSVD and dementia group, compared to HC. We showed that these disruptions can be partially explained by individual differences in WMH's volume and location. Moreover, we found that WMH are more strongly associated with RcSVD-related structural connectivity changes (average r = -0.32) than with those implicated in dementia (average r = -0.03). This suggest that WMH may impact structural brain network through different pathways in RcSVD and dementia. Our work underscores the important role of WMH lesions in disrupting structural brain networks in RcSVD and dementia, offering insights into the varying clinical impacts of WMH.

relevance.reason: 研究白质高信号病灶位置对结构性脑网络连接的破坏，并比较小血管病风险与痴呆患者的结构连接改变，属脑疾病中的脑网络组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注白质高信号为何在临床上表现各异，基于英国生物银行参与者的白质高信号体积信息，比较健康对照、脑小血管病风险人群和痴呆患者的结构连接改变，并将个体白质高信号位置映射为断连矩阵加以对照。结果显示，风险人群和痴呆患者均存在广泛的结构网络破坏，这些破坏可部分由白质高信号体积和位置的个体差异解释；白质高信号与风险人群的结构连接改变关联更强，而与痴呆相关改变关联较弱。作者据此提出，白质高信号可能通过不同路径影响两类人群的结构网络，强调其在网络破坏中的作用，为理解白质高信号临床影响的差异提供了线索。

papers.title: The neural mechanisms of short-term changes in semantic interpretation following cross-cultural interaction.
papers.authors: Zhou S, Xu X, Zhou F, He X, Zhai Y, Long Y, Lei Y, Li H, Lu C.
papers.abstract: Cultural mindsets are profiles of loosely related, culturally shaped cognitive tendencies expressed across different aspects of cognitive processing, from visual attention to semantic interpretation. These tendencies develop through cultural experience and interpersonal interaction. However, whether cross-cultural interaction can induce short-term changes in specific culturally shaped cognitive tendencies, and in which aspects of cognitive processing these changes are expressed, remains unknown. In this study, Chinese learners interacted with either a US instructor (cross-cultural interaction condition) or a Chinese instructor (within-cultural interaction condition), and then independently watched an ambiguous geometric animation under concurrent fNIRS and eye-tracking recording, followed by a verbal recall task in which they described their interpretations of the animation. We assessed visual-attention processing through gaze-allocation patterns and semantic understanding through interpretations expressed in verbal recall. The results showed that cross-cultural interaction changed learners' semantic interpretations. At the neural level, cross-cultural interaction reduced inter-subject correlation (ISC) in the left posterior middle temporal gyrus (pMTG), and inter-subject representational similarity analysis (IS-RSA) showed that pMTG neural-response similarity was associated with semantic-interpretation similarity. Furthermore, moderation analysis revealed that perceived communication quality moderated the association between instructors' analytic-holistic tendencies and learners' short-term change in pMTG ISC, particularly for the causality dimension. These findings provide neurocognitive evidence that cross-cultural interaction can induce short-term changes in specific aspects of culturally shaped cognitive processing, with the clearest changes occurring in semantic interpretation in the present task.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS研究跨文化互动后语义解释的短期变化及左侧pMTG神经表征相似性，涉及语义加工脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 本研究探讨跨文化互动能否在短期内改变文化塑造的认知倾向，以及这种改变体现在哪些加工层面。中国学习者在与美国或中国教师互动后，独立观看模糊几何动画，同时接受fNIRS和眼动记录，并完成口头回忆任务。结果显示，跨文化互动改变了学习者的语义解释，而未明显改变视觉注意分配；左后颞中回的人际间相关降低，且该脑区反应相似性与语义解释相似性相关。调节分析进一步表明，感知到的沟通质量调节教师分析—整体倾向与学习者该脑区人际间相关短期变化之间的关系，尤其在因果性维度上。作者据此认为，跨文化互动可在特定层面引起文化塑造认知加工的短期变化，本任务中最清晰的变化出现在语义解释上。

papers.title: Brain dynamics and creativity: Investigating the relationship between 1/f patterns of the resting-state EEG and divergent thinking.
papers.authors: Teng J, Montoya GAL, Liu T, Kaur Y, Ouyang G, Herrmann CS, Hildebrandt A.
papers.abstract: Alpha oscillatory activity has been extensively studied in relation to divergent thinking and other cognitive functions. However, EEG power spectra also contain a broadband aperiodic component that is superimposed with periodic oscillatory activity, and the functional relevance of this component for creativity remains poorly understood. The present study aimed to disentangle periodic alpha activity from the aperiodic spectral background and examine their relationships with divergent thinking, with working memory included as a cognitively relevant comparison construct. We investigated the relationship between the resting-state EEG activity and the performance on a battery of divergent thinking and working memory tasks in a sample of N = 91 individuals. To distinguish alpha-band activity from the aperiodic spectral background, we applied the Fitting Oscillations and One Over F (FOOOF) algorithm. We then used the Structural After Measurement (SAM) approach to explore latent associations between brain signal parameters and two facets of divergent thinking (i.e., fluency and originality), as well as working memory. The results showed that estimated alpha power was positively associated with working memory in both eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions. In the eyes-open condition, estimated alpha power showed a small positive association with fluency, whereas the aperiodic exponent (1/f slope) showed a small negative association with fluency; neither association reached conventional statistical significance. No resting-state EEG parameter was significantly associated with originality. These findings highlight the value of separating periodic and aperiodic spectral components and suggest that links between resting-state aperiodic activity and divergent thinking warrant further investigation.

relevance.reason: 研究静息态EEG非周期成分与发散思维、工作记忆的关联，属认知与静息脑活动组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注静息态脑电中周期性α活动与非周期性频谱背景（1/f斜率）是否分别与发散思维和工作记忆相关，并使用FOOOF算法将两者分离后考察其潜在关联。结果显示，估计的α功率在睁眼和闭眼条件下均与工作记忆呈正相关；而在发散思维方面，仅见α功率与流畅性呈小幅正相关、1/f斜率与流畅性呈小幅负相关，且均未达到常规统计显著性，原创性则与任何静息态脑电参数均无显著关联。作者据此强调区分周期性与非周期性频谱成分的必要性，并认为静息态非周期性活动与发散思维之间的联系尚需进一步研究。

papers.title: Multivariate decoding of EEG reveals key spatial and temporal distinctions in perception and valuation.
papers.authors: Bachman MD, HajiHosseini A, Cho H, Nemrodov D, Nestor A, Hutcherson CA.
papers.abstract: Decisions often require the integration of multiple considerations or attributes. Yet despite considerable research, debate continues about the neural mechanisms underlying the calculation of individual attribute values. One key question centers on whether attribute values are computed solely within the valuation network or also within perceptual regions specialized for identifying specific attributes. While each account makes distinct predictions concerning when attribute value signals should emerge, these hypotheses remain untested. To this end, we investigated when attribute-specific valuation emerges relative to earlier perceptual and later integrated value processes. Participants first learned to associate different face and color stimuli with specific monetary payoffs. They then made choices based on these reward-associated attributes in a multi-attribute decision making task, during which we recorded participants' EEG activity. Using multivariate classification analyses, we found that perceptual representations could be decoded early and in parallel, but that attribute value decoding emerged in a more sequential manner, followed by evidence of integrated value representations. Spatially, perceptual representations were most distinct, with attribute value representations demonstrating closer alignment with integrated value than their respective perceptual components. Importantly, attribute values amplified their perceptual representations, but only after the emergence of the integrated value representation, suggesting a post hoc attentional selection mechanism. Collectively, our findings shed new light on prior work and highlight with clearer temporal precision the evolution from perceptual to evaluative to decisional computations.

relevance.reason: 用EEG多变量解码研究多属性决策中知觉表征与价值表征的时空动态，属决策与感知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注多属性决策中单个属性价值何时、在何处被计算，是仅发生在估值网络内，还是也涉及专门加工特定属性的知觉区域。研究者让参与者先学习面孔和颜色刺激与金钱收益的关联，再完成基于这些属性的多属性决策任务，同时记录脑电并用多变量分类分析神经表征。结果显示，知觉表征出现较早且可并行解码，属性价值表征则更呈序列式出现，随后才出现整合价值表征；属性价值表征在空间上更接近整合价值而非各自的知觉成分。属性价值会增强其知觉表征，但这只发生在整合价值表征出现之后，提示一种事后注意选择机制。作者据此强调从知觉到评价再到决策计算的动态演进。

papers.title: Static and dynamic functional network alterations associated with endurance training.
papers.authors: Zhao B, Wei L, Zhao G, Zhang Q, Bai X, Jin H, Chen S, Yan S.
papers.abstract: Long-term endurance training is associated with widespread changes in brain organization, but how these changes manifest in large-scale networks across different temporal scales remains unclear. We combined static functional connectivity analysis with dynamic multilayer network modeling to examine resting-state fMRI data from 25 endurance athletes and 31 matched controls. At the static level, athletes exhibited significantly enhanced within-network functional connectivity in the sensorimotor, salience, cingulo-opercular, and auditory networks, together with reduced system segregation of the frontoparietal network. At the dynamic level, none of the between-group differences in flexibility, promiscuity, cohesion, or disjointedness survived correction for multiple comparisons. In exploratory analyses at uncorrected thresholds, several between-group patterns emerged, including reduced flexibility in the subcortical network, increased promiscuity in the sensorimotor network, and reduced disjointedness in the visual and auditory networks. Several static network measures and selected dynamic measures were also associated with cumulative training exposure across individuals. Overall, the statistically supported findings indicate that endurance training is primarily associated with strengthened baseline functional integration within motor, salience, and cognitive-control systems. The exploratory dynamic analyses further suggest potential differences in the temporal organization of large-scale functional networks, providing hypotheses for future investigation.

relevance.reason: 研究耐力训练者静息态fMRI大尺度功能网络组织与动态变化，属静息态脑网络组织及运动相关可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注长期耐力训练如何在不同时间尺度上体现于大规模脑网络，结合静态功能连接分析与动态多层网络建模，比较耐力运动员与匹配对照的静息态fMRI数据。静态层面，运动员在感觉运动、突显、扣带-岛盖及听觉网络内的功能连接增强，同时额顶网络的系统分离度降低；动态层面，灵活性、混杂性、凝聚性和离散性等组间差异均未通过多重比较校正，仅在未校正的探索性分析中出现若干模式，且部分静态与动态指标与个体累积训练暴露相关。作者据此认为，有统计支持的发现主要指向耐力训练与运动、突显和认知控制系统中基线功能整合增强相关，而动态结果仅提示大尺度网络时间组织可能存在差异，需未来研究检验。

papers.title: Waves of control: An ER(S)P study to explore the neural dynamics of proactive and reactive stability.
papers.authors: Viviani G, Visalli A, Montefinese M, Di Pietro I, Ruz M, Vallesi A, Ambrosini E.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Cognitive stability, the ability to maintain task focus while facing distractions, is a core component of cognitive control. According to the Dual Mechanisms of Control model, stability can be implemented proactively, through anticipatory goal maintenance, or reactively, through transient, conflict-triggered adjustments. However, their neural dynamics remain debated, mainly due to the limited temporal resolution of fMRI and to EEG designs that fail to disentangle different forms of stability. Here, we recorded EEG while 40 participants performed a spatial Stroop task to dissociate predictive proactive stability, induced by list-wide proportion congruency (LWPC), and predictive reactive stability, induced by item-specific proportion congruency (ISPC). Moreover, using response-locked analyses, we exploratively probed the late, corrective form of reactive stability engaged after conflict detection. Using a state-of-the-art analytical approach combining trial-level Bayesian estimates of the manipulated variables with multilevel modeling, we isolated these predictive mechanisms from low-level confounds like contingency. The analyses of event-related potentials and time-frequency activity revealed neural signatures of proactive stability, including anticipatory pre-stimulus modulations and a systematic reduction of post-stimulus conflict-related activity. In contrast, no reliable neural evidence for predictive reactive stability was observed once contingency was controlled. Importantly, response-locked analyses revealed distinct late neural markers compatible with a corrective reactive stability mechanism engaged to resolve conflict when predictive mechanisms failed. Together, these findings provide clear electrophysiological evidence for predictive proactive stability neural mechanisms, while failing to reveal those of ISPC-dependent predictive reactive stability. Moreover, exploratory analyses provided insights into late corrective reactive stability neural mechanisms, engaged when predictive mechanisms failed.

relevance.reason: 用EEG研究认知控制中主动与反应性稳定性的神经动态，属注意/执行控制的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注认知稳定性在主动与反应两种控制形式下的神经动态，让40名被试完成空间Stroop任务并记录脑电，结合试次水平的贝叶斯估计与多层模型分离预测性机制。结果显示，由列表整体一致性比例诱发的预测性主动稳定性具有明确的神经标志，包括刺激前准备性调制和刺激后冲突相关活动的系统性降低；而在控制关联性混淆后，未观察到由项目特异性一致性比例诱发的预测性反应稳定性的可靠神经证据。锁反应分析还发现与冲突后纠正性反应稳定性相符的晚期神经标记，提示预测机制失效时该机制参与冲突解决。作者据此强调主动稳定性的电生理证据，同时对预测性反应稳定性的存在持保留态度。

papers.title: Time-frequency EEG markers of word boundaries in speech production.
papers.authors: Eustace SD, Guediche S, Brasiello L, Rocha M, Correia JM.
papers.abstract: Speech production requires orchestration of multiple brain systems that support the unfolding of the spoken message across hierarchical linguistic levels, such as phonemes, syllables, words or phrases. Transitions between linguistic levels are critical for connected speech production, yet the neural dynamics of, for example, syllable-level and word-level transitions remain unknown. In this electroencephalography (EEG) study, we use time-frequency analysis and source localization to determine differences between word-boundary and within-word syllable transitions. To this end, pseudoword pairs comprising a total of six consonant-vowel (CV) syllables with different word-boundary positions were used. Adults produced the pseudoword pairs at the pace of a visual metronome, such that syllables were uttered at matching times independently of their relative positions. Accordingly, target syllables could reference either within-word or between-word syllabic transitions, while other linguistic properties, including articulation, stress patterns, co-articulation or prosody were matched. EEG time-frequency analyses of neural sources revealed sensitivity to hierarchical structure. Sources in left and right inferior frontal lobes, as well as left superior temporal lobe were differentially recruited when producing the same syllables, in the same utterance position, but under different pseudoword boundary contexts. The right inferior frontal source showed extensive time-frequency modulation in word transitions that included elevated event-related synchronization across theta and beta oscillations. Alpha suppression was found in the left superior temporal lobe, possibly related to increased sensory prediction at word onset. Despite efforts to control speech pace and syllable acoustics across conditions, small residual differences in timing and acoustic properties were observed.

relevance.reason: 用EEG时频与源定位研究言语产出中词边界与音节转换的神经动态，报告左/右额下及左颞上源差异，属语言产出神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注连续言语产出中词边界与词内音节过渡的神经动态差异，用脑电时频分析和源定位比较成人在相同节奏下朗读不同词边界位置假词对时的反应。结果显示，左、右额下回及左颞上回等脑源对层级结构敏感：相同音节、相同话语位置在不同词边界情境下被差异性地调用，右额下回在词过渡中表现出跨theta和beta振荡的时频调制增强，左颞上回则出现alpha抑制，可能与词起始处增强的感觉预测有关。作者指出，尽管控制了语速和音节声学特征，时间与声学属性仍有少量残余差异，因此这些脑电标记与词边界的对应关系需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Scale-Dependent Development of Neural Signal Complexity and its Association with Working Memory in Childhood.
papers.authors: Han J, Liang L, Ding J, Zhao J, Li X.
papers.abstract: Neural development during childhood involves progressive reorganization of brain dynamics across multiple temporal scales. The present study examined developmental differences in neural signal complexity, indexed by modified multiscale entropy (mMSE), in 253 typically developing children aged 3-9 years. Resting-state EEG was analyzed across 20 temporal scales spanning approximately 4-80 ms, and age-related differences were assessed using linear mixed-effects models with sex included as a covariate. Results showed systematic age-related increases in neural signal complexity, with developmental effects varying across individual temporal scales and scalp regions. Although positive age-related effects were observed across multiple scales, their magnitude differed across temporal resolutions, indicating a scale-dependent pattern of neural maturation. In addition, regional mMSE values showed positive associations with short-term working memory capacity, with significant effects observed in frontal, occipital, and temporal regions across multiple temporal scales.Together, these findings indicate that childhood brain maturation is characterized by scale-dependent increases in neural temporal complexity that are associated with the development of working memory.

relevance.reason: 研究儿童静息态EEG信号复杂度随年龄发育及其与工作记忆的关联，涉及脑发育与认知的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童期神经信号复杂性随年龄发展的变化及其与工作记忆的关系，分析了3至9岁典型发育儿童的静息态脑电，并在多个时间尺度上计算多尺度熵。结果显示，神经信号复杂性随年龄增长而上升，但不同时间尺度和头皮区域的效应大小并不一致，呈现出尺度依赖的成熟模式。此外，部分区域的信号复杂性与短时工作记忆容量呈正相关，提示儿童脑成熟过程中时间复杂性的尺度依赖性增长可能与工作记忆发展相关；但这一关联并不等同于因果或干预效果。

papers.title: What Static Connectivity Misses: Dynamic Alpha-Band Brain Network States in First-Episode Psychosis.
papers.authors: Aubonnet R, Hassan M, Gargiulo P, Seri S, Di Lorenzo G.
papers.abstract: This study investigates resting-state EEG alpha-band connectivity in first-episode psychosis (FEP) using a novel dynamic connectivity pipeline and examines its relationship with cognitive functioning and psychopathological scores. Data from 78 individuals with FEP and 60 healthy controls (CTR) were analyzed. Source estimation was performed using eLORETA, and connectivity was quantified with the weighted phase-lag index. Static connectivity matrices were assessed using graph theory and edge-wise metrics. Dynamic connectivity matrices were clustered into five distinct brain network states (BNS) using a modified k-means algorithm, from which temporal and graph theory metrics were extracted. Static connectivity metrics revealed lower alpha connectivity in FEP than in controls. The dynamic approach identified reduced variability in the characteristic path length within the default mode network-associated BNS 1 in FEP, suggesting diminished adaptive modulation of functional integration. Subgroup analysis by medication status uncovered distinct BNS signatures for medicated and unmedicated FEP. BNS metrics were correlated with social cognition measures in CTR and with positive formal thought disorder in FEP, whereas static metrics showed no such associations. These findings suggest that relative to static connectivity metrics, dynamic connectivity provides non-redundant information and underscores the impact of medication on neural dynamics in psychosis.

relevance.reason: 研究首发精神病患者静息态EEG动态α网络状态及其与社会认知、思维障碍的关联，属脑疾病认知/网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以静息态脑电α频段连接为切入点，比较首发精神病患者与健康对照，并考察连接特征与认知功能和精神病理评分的关系。静态分析显示患者α连接整体低于对照；动态分析进一步发现，患者在与默认网络相关的脑网络状态中特征路径长度的变异性降低，提示其功能整合的适应性调节减弱。按用药状态分组后，用药与未用药患者呈现不同的网络状态特征，且动态指标与对照的社会认知、患者的阳性形式思维障碍相关，静态指标则未见此类关联。作者据此认为，动态连接能提供静态指标之外的非冗余信息，并强调用药对精神病神经动力学的影响。

papers.title: Brain functional dynamics linked to depression and anxiety: cross-sectional and longitudinal associations over 9 years
papers.authors: Lopez JG, Van Wingen G, Jansen R, Labus J, Penninx BW.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) co-activation patterns (CAPs) capture recurrent whole-brain states that may index neurobiological substrates of affective psychopathology, but whether their temporal dynamics co-evolve with symptom severity over the naturalistic long-term course of depression and anxiety remains unknown. Methods We examined rs-fMRI and clinical data from 340 participants of the NESDA neuroimaging cohort [228 with major depression (MDD) and/or an anxiety disorder (AFF), 112 controls (CTR)] collected at baseline (Y0), 2-year (Y2), and 9-year (Y9) follow-up. Four CAPs were identified, internally validated, externally replicated against an independent dataset, and quantified by dwell time (time spent of each brain CAP) and entries (initiation of each CAP). These metrics were related to depression symptomatology (IDS score), anxiety (BAI), and fear (FQ) severity at two levels: cross-sectionally, between subjects and groups, and longitudinally, through within-person associations between changes in CAP expression and changes in symptoms severity. Results At baseline, attention–somatomotor (AT-SM CAP ) dwell time was negatively associated with depression severity in controls (rho = −0.29, q < 0.05), an association absent in individuals with AFF ( rho = 0.09, q = 0.79;). Longitudinally, group-level CAP trajectories did not differ between AFF and CTR, but within-person changes in frontoparietal–default-mode (FP-DM CAP ) dwell time tracked changes in depression severity exclusively in AFF (Y2→Y9: rho = 0.47, q = 0.04). Patients whose FP-DM CAP dwell time increased were those whose depression failed to improve. Conclusions CAP dwell time carried clinical meaning at two levels: AT-SM CAP distinguished health from illness at baseline, while FP-DM CAP dwell time indexed within-person illness course over nine years. Because FP-DM CAP co-activates frontoparietal control with default-mode regions implicated in rumination, its rebound in dwell time may reflect a shift toward perseverative self-referential processing in patients who fail to remit. These findings position CAP dwell-time–symptom coupling as a neurobiologically grounded, individually resolved marker of naturalistic illness course relevant to precision psychiatry.

relevance.reason: 该研究用静息态fMRI共激活模式动态追踪抑郁焦虑症状的纵向变化，涉及脑网络组织与精神疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于静息态fMRI共激活模式（CAP），考察其时间动态是否与抑郁和焦虑症状在自然长期病程中共同变化，比较了患者组与对照组在基线和多年随访中的表现。结果显示，基线时注意—感觉运动CAP的停留时间与对照组抑郁严重度呈负相关，而这一关联在患者中未出现；纵向看，组间CAP轨迹无差异，但仅在患者中，额顶—默认网络CAP停留时间的个体内变化与抑郁严重度变化同步，停留时间增加者抑郁未见改善。作者据此提出，不同CAP的停留时间在横断面和纵向层面分别承载临床意义，额顶—默认网络CAP的回升可能反映未缓解患者转向反复的自我参照加工，提示其作为个体化病程标记的潜力，但相关发现仍属关联性证据。

papers.title: Cortical microarchitecture supports preadolescent functional brain network connectivity
papers.authors: Bottenhorn KL, Sukumaran K, Morrel J, Cardenas-Iniguez C, Herting MM.
papers.abstract: A century ago, Brodmann suggested that local cortical microarchitecture dictates function, yet modern structure– function mapping overwhelmingly focuses on white matter macroarchitecture. Here, we reframe structure-function coupling by linking gray matter microarchitecture and macroscale connectomics, demonstrating how gray matter cellular and neurite density are linked to functional network organization in preadolescents. By applying partial least squares correlation to cortical microarchitecture (i.e., cellular and neurite density) estimates from diffusion MRI and network connectivity estimates from functional MRI, in 6,320 children ages 9-11 years from the U.S.-wide Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, we identified several principles of structure-function coupling. First, we found that functional connectivity is associated with one dominant and global pattern of cellular density differences explaining nearly 80% of shared variance, but by several patterns of neurite density differences. Second, we found similar gradients of sensorimotor network connectivity related to this dominant cellular density pattern and the secondary, rostro-caudal neurite density pattern (explaining 17% of shared variance). Third, we found a profile of attention network connectivity associated with the primary neurite density pattern (44% of shared variance) and the secondary, rostro-caudal cellular density pattern (5% of shared variance). Altogether, this work suggests that cellular density (i.e., neuronal cell bodies, support cells) across cortex largely supports a sensorimotor network connectivity gradient. Conversely, there are several connectivity-related patterns of neurite density (i.e., axons, dendrites) across cortex, providing a glimpse into how local neurite connectivity may differentially support long-range functional connectivity of sensorimotor networks and attention networks.

relevance.reason: 该研究将儿童皮层灰质微结构与功能网络连接耦合，直接探讨脑结构对功能组织的约束，属结构-功能栏目，并涉及注意网络。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年前期皮层灰质微结构（细胞密度与神经突密度）如何与宏观功能网络连接相对应，利用扩散MRI和功能MRI数据，对大规模儿童样本采用偏最小二乘相关分析。结果发现，功能连接主要与一个全局性的细胞密度模式相关，该模式解释了大部分共享变异，而神经突密度则对应多个连接模式；感觉运动网络连接与主导细胞密度模式及次级神经突密度模式呈现相似梯度，注意网络连接则主要与主导神经突密度模式相关。作者据此提出，皮层细胞密度大体支持感觉运动网络连接的梯度组织，而神经突密度的多种模式可能差异化地支撑感觉运动与注意网络的长程功能连接。

papers.title: Hippocampal and cortical oscillations support the encoding of event memories during movie watching
papers.authors: Silva M, Wu X, Sabio M, Conde-Blanco E, Roldan P, Donaire A, Carreño M, Fuentemilla L, Baldassano C, Jacobs J.
papers.abstract: Remembering temporally-extended experiences requires integrating information over time into coherent event representations that can be stored and later retrieved. Oscillatory dynamics may provide a flexible mechanism to support these operations by coordinating communication across regions and organizing neural activity in time. Yet most evidence for the oscillatory basis of episodic encoding comes from discrete-stimulus paradigms, leaving unclear whether these mechanisms can help organize memory during continuous experience. Using iEEG recorded while participants watched a 50-min film, we measured how power, synchrony and phase alignment support memory formation at the beginning, middle, and end of the events. At event onset, remembered events showed reduced gamma power with increased hippocampal–frontal synchrony, indicating that successful events begin with transient long-range coordination rather than heightened local processing. Within an event, memory was predicted by the direction of change, with recalled events showing increases in temporal gamma power and hippocampal–temporal gamma synchrony, consistent with the progressive binding of incoming information into a developing event representation. At the end of an event, memory was supported by an increase in hippocampal theta power and a phase resetting. Temporal gamma power was likewise elevated and hippocampal–temporal gamma synchrony increased, suggesting that information bound locally over the course of the event might be transmitted to the hippocampus as the event closes. Frontal beta power decreased at the same moment, consistent with disruption of the outgoing event model. Naturalistic memory formation therefore does not rest on a sustained encoding state, but on the appropriate temporal coordination and stability of oscillatory states across brain regions and event phases, in which stable oscillatory states support ongoing representation while transient, boundary-driven reorganization of hippocampal–cortical networks switches the system between consolidating the completed event and encoding the next.

relevance.reason: 用iEEG记录被试观看电影时的脑振荡活动，研究连续自然体验中事件记忆编码的海马-皮层协调机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究利用颅内脑电记录参与者观看长片电影时的脑活动，考察连续自然体验中事件记忆编码的振荡机制。结果显示，记忆形成并非依赖持续稳定的编码状态，而是随事件阶段变化：事件开始时，被记住的事件伴随局部伽马功率下降和跨区长程同步增强；事件进行中，记忆与伽马功率及海马—颞叶同步的变化方向相关，反映信息逐步绑定；事件结束时，海马theta功率升高并出现相位重置，同时额叶beta功率下降，提示完成事件向下一事件的切换。作者据此认为，自然情境下的记忆编码依赖不同脑区振荡状态在事件各阶段间的适时协调与重组。

papers.title: Talking Brains: Neonatal Aperiodic Activity in Resting State EEG Relates to Later Communicative Abilities
papers.authors: Reimann-Ayiköz M, Ameen MS, Reisenberger E, Florea C, Preiß J, Angerer M, Schabus M, Roehm D, Heib D, Männel C.
papers.abstract: Communicative abilities acquired over the first year of life are foundational for language development. Understanding the neural mechanisms underlying these abilities can explain individual differences and improve predictions of later language outcomes. While prior research on neural markers of language development has focused predominantly on oscillatory neural activity, the underlying aperiodic component of the neural signal may provide further insights into cortical maturation by indirectly reflecting variation in neural excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance. In neurodevelopmental conditions, both reduced and elevated aperiodic activity are linked to atypical development, and initial evidence from at-risk cohorts also relates aperiodic activity to language outcome. Moving beyond clinical populations, the present study examined whether aperiodic activity during neonatal resting-state EEG relates to 12-month communicative abilities in typically developing infants. Aperiodic offset and exponent were extracted from resting-state EEG recorded two weeks after birth in n = 50 neonates using the FOOOF algorithm. At 12 months, communicative abilities were assessed with the parent-report CSBS-DP Infant-Toddler Checklist. Quadratic regression analyses showed an inverted U-shaped relationship between the neonatal aperiodic exponent and communicative abilities: both lower and higher exponent values were associated with poorer outcomes, with intermediate values linked to better abilities. No robust association was found for the offset. These findings suggest that aperiodic activity captures variability in early communicative development, with an optimum at intermediate levels, consistent with a balanced E/I state. The scope of aperiodic brain activity as a developmental marker may thus extend beyond clinical populations to predicting communicative development in healthy infants.

relevance.reason: 新生儿静息态EEG非周期活动与12个月交流/语言能力关联，涉及脑发育与语言功能基础。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察新生儿静息态脑电的非周期活动能否预测其后的沟通能力发展，对足月健康新生儿在出生两周时记录脑电并提取非周期偏移与指数，至12个月时用家长报告量表评估沟通能力。结果显示，非周期指数与后续沟通能力呈倒U形关系：指数偏低或偏高均对应较差表现，中间水平对应较好能力，而偏移未见稳定关联。作者据此认为，非周期活动可能间接反映兴奋/抑制平衡，其作为发育标记的适用范围或可延伸至健康婴儿的沟通发展预测，但这一关联并非因果，且样本与随访范围有限。

papers.title: Diffusion tensor imaging measurements for computer-aided diagnosis of autism: derived data from ABIDE II.
papers.authors: Cardenas-Hernandez NA, Perez-Diaz M, García-Ramó KB, Valdés Hernández MDC.
papers.abstract: Advancing the understanding of neuroimaging biomarkers in neurodevelopmental research requires structured, well-documented datasets to support reproducibility and comparative analyses. This dataset comprises diffusion MRI-derived measurements from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE II) database-fractional anisotropy (FA), axial diffusivity (AD), mean diffusivity (MD), and radial diffusivity (RD)-across multiple brain regions for both ASD and control groups, associated with unique image identifiers. Data were generated using standardized image acquisition and computational processing pipelines, resulting in uniformly processed and reproducible quantitative region-specific metrics to facilitate cross-sectional comparative studies. The dataset is structured with explicit metadata, detailed variable descriptions, and complete case records to support programmatic access and automated workflows. Data visualization and harmonization codes accompany the dataset. This resource enables the investigation of white matter microstructural properties in relation to autism through different analytical approaches, including hypothesis testing, machine learning, and meta-analyses. The structured format and transparent documentation promote its reuse in other neuroimaging studies. FAIR2 Data Portal: https://www.doi.org/10.71728/senscience.dbrh-5zc8.

papers.summary_zh: 该数据集整理自ABIDE II数据库，提供孤独症谱系障碍组与对照组在多个脑区的弥散MRI衍生指标（各向异性、轴向扩散率、平均扩散率和径向扩散率），并配有标准化采集与处理流程、明确元数据及可视化与协调代码。其核心价值在于形成统一处理、可复现的区域特异性定量数据，便于开展横断面比较，支持假设检验、机器学习和荟萃分析等分析路径，用于考察白质微结构特征与孤独症的关系。作为数据资源而非原始实验研究，它本身不报告诊断效能或组间差异结论，主要意义是促进数据复用与可重复研究。

papers.title: The more, the better? Behavioral and neural correlates of frequent and infrequent vowel exposure
papers.authors: Tsuji S, Fikkert P, MINAGAWA Y, Dupoux E, Filippin L, Versteegh M, Hagoort P, Cristia A.
papers.abstract: A central assumption in the perceptual attunement literature holds that exposure to a speech sound contrast leads to improvement in native speech sound processing. However, whether the amount of exposure matters for this process has not been put to a direct test. We elucidated indicators of frequency-dependent perceptual attunement by comparing 5-8-month-old Dutch infants’ discrimination of tokens containing a highly frequent [hɪt-he:t] and a highly infrequent [hʏt-hø:t] native vowel contrast as well as a non-native [hɛt-hæt] vowel contrast in a behavioral visual habituation paradigm (Experiment 1). Infants discriminated both native contrasts similarly well, but did not discriminate the non-nativecontrast. We sought further evidence for subtle differences in the processing of the two native contrasts using near-infrared spectroscopy and a within-participant design (Experiment 2). The neuroimaging data did not provide additional evidence that responses to native contrasts are modulated by frequency of exposure. These results suggest that even large differences in exposure to a native contrast may not directly translate to behavioral and neural indicators of perceptual attunement, raising the possibility that frequency of exposure does not influence improvements in discriminating native contrasts.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS和行为习惯化范式考察婴儿母语元音对比感知与暴露频率的神经相关，属言语感知的神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以5至8个月大的荷兰语婴儿为对象，结合行为视觉习惯化范式与近红外光谱技术，考察接触频率是否影响婴儿对母语语音对比的知觉调适。结果发现，婴儿对高频和低频母语元音对比的辨别表现相近，却无法辨别非母语对比；神经影像数据也未显示母语对比反应受接触频率调节。作者据此指出，即便母语对比的接触量差异很大，也未必直接转化为行为或神经层面的知觉调适指标，提示接触频率可能并不影响母语对比辨别能力的提升。

papers.title: mstsa: A Python Library for Information-Theoretic and Statistical Analysis of EEG Microstate Sequences
papers.authors: VON WEGNER F.
papers.abstract: EEG microstate analysis decomposes a multichannel EEG recording into a discrete symbolic time series: each sample is assigned to one of a small number of voltage topography templates, the microstate maps, typically at sampling rates of 100–500 Hz (Lehmann et al., 1998; Michel & Koenig, 2018; Pascual-Marqui et al., 1995). Back-fitting the templates into the original EEG dataset yields a symbolic time series, the microstate sequence. Many research questions address the temporal structure of these sequences, such as: time series memory (Markovianity), autocorrelations including persistence and long-range correlations, measures of syntax and complexity, and comparison against certain null models.mstsa (Microstate Time Series Analysis) is a Python library that addresses these questions. It provides a comprehensive set of information-theoretic, Markov-chain, and statistical tools for the analysis of discrete symbolic sequences, with EEG microstate data as the primary application.

papers.title: Reduced theta-gamma coupling during real-world episodic encoding
papers.authors: Taheritorbati A, O'Connor J, Silito T, Klamer K, Kress S, Allahdad N, Musial JA, Rollingson J, Craig j, Gregoire M, Ekstrand C.
papers.abstract: Episodic memories are rarely formed under the controlled, simplified conditions typical of laboratory research. They are built from continuous, embodied experiences unfolding in real time and real space. We examined how theta-gamma phase amplitude coupling (PAC), a candidate neural signature of encoding demand, differs when an experience is encountered in a live setting rather than an approximately matched screen-based version. 62 healthy young adults encoded an identical narrative vignette, presented either as a live theatrical performance or as a two-dimensional (2D) video recording, while high-density EEG was recorded. Coupling between frontal theta and parietal gamma activity was computed during encoding as an index of this cross-frequency coordination, and free-recall memory was assessed immediately after. Real-world encoding was associated with significantly lower frontal theta to parietal gamma PAC than 2D encoding, even though recall performance did not differ between conditions. PAC positively predicted recall only in the 2D condition, with no equivalent relationship emerging for Real-world encoding. In the Real-world condition, PAC was negatively correlated with general cognitive ability, suggesting that higher cognitive functioning requires less cross-frequency coordination during naturalistic encoding. Together, these findings position theta-gamma PAC as a compensatory neural mechanism, recruited more heavily when the encoding environment provides less external structure. This suggests that real-world experiences may place a lighter coordination burden on the encoding brain, consistent with a compensatory account of theta-gamma PAC.

relevance.reason: 用高密度EEG比较真实剧场与2D视频中情景编码的theta-gamma耦合，属自然情境下记忆编码的脑机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察真实场景与屏幕呈现下情景记忆编码时额叶theta—顶叶gamma相位振幅耦合的差异，62名健康年轻成人观看同一叙事片段，分别以现场戏剧或二维视频呈现，同时记录高密度脑电并测试自由回忆。结果发现，真实场景编码的耦合显著低于二维条件，但两种条件的回忆成绩无差异；耦合仅在二维条件中正向预测回忆，在真实场景中则与一般认知能力负相关。作者据此提出，theta—gamma耦合可能是一种补偿性神经机制，当编码环境提供的外部结构较少时被更多调用，真实世界体验对编码脑的协调负担可能更轻。

papers.title: From brain networks to the patient-environment system in clinical neuroimaging
papers.authors: corredor d, Carriere M, Vallet A, GASTELUM M, Raja V, Eustache F, guillery b.
papers.abstract: Despite substantial advances in clinical neuroimaging, its impact on defining and treatingpsychiatric disorders remains limited. Current approaches in clinical brain imaging framepsychiatric disorders as dysfunctions of brain-based information processing. Here, wepropose a shift in this explanatory focus, from how aberrant neural processes generatemaladaptive behavior to the brain's participation in the dynamics of the patient–environment system. Drawing on organism-environment approaches, we conceptualizebehavior as emerging from context-dependent coordinated interactions among brain,body, and environment. Within this framework, we conceptualize psychiatric disordersas excessive stability or flexibility in patient-environment dynamics that impair thepatient's capacity to adapt to changing situations. After examining the ontologicalcommitments of current clinical neuroimaging and recasting psychiatric disorders interms of patient–environment dynamics, we outline concrete strategies foroperationalizing this framework. These progress from combining ecological momentaryassessment with neuroimaging, to naturalistic brain and body imaging that jointly tracksneural, bodily, and environmental dynamics, and finally to explicit dynamical models ofthe patient–environment system in which maladaptive stability or flexibility can beformally defined and identified. By making these dynamics measurable, we aim to turn aconceptual reframing into a concrete empirical program, recasting the brain not as theseat of psychiatric disorders but as one participant in the patient–environment dynamics.

papers.title: Mood stability and change map onto distinct insula-centered networks
papers.authors: Danan N, Ramot M, Keren H.
papers.abstract: Mood is changing continuously even when external events are minimal. These spontaneous mood dynamics may reveal how the brain maintains and modifies affective states. Yet mood is typically studied in response to external input, leaving the neural basis of spontaneous mood changes largely unknown. Here, we combined repeated mood sampling with functional neural connectivity across two resting-state fMRI sessions separated by several weeks to identify the neural systems associated with different spontaneous mood dynamics. Our most robust finding was that stronger insula-striatal connectivity was associated with greater mood stability. Additional analyses revealed that stronger connectivity within an insula-cingulo-frontal network was associated with greater spontaneous mood decline, while reduced insula-frontal connectivity was associated with higher depressive symptoms. Together, these findings suggest that distinct insula-centered functional networks are differentially associated with affective stability and affective updating and change, providing a neural framework for spontaneous mood dynamics and their relation to depressive symptoms.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在没有明显外部事件时情绪仍持续波动的神经基础，将重复情绪采样与相隔数周的功能连接测量结合，考察自发情绪动态与脑网络的关系。最稳健的发现是，岛叶与纹状体之间连接较强时情绪更稳定；进一步分析显示，岛叶-扣带-额叶网络内部连接较强与情绪自发下降更多相关，而岛叶-额叶连接减弱则与抑郁症状较重相关。作者据此提出，以岛叶为中心的不同功能网络分别对应情绪的稳定与更新变化，为理解自发情绪动态及其与抑郁症状的关系提供了神经框架；这些均为关联性结果，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Connectome hierarchy de-differentiation relates to motor severity and to glymphatic-related imaging measures in drug-naïve Parkinson's disease
papers.authors: Yan¹ L, Xing¹ Y, Zhou¹ H, Liu² W, Li¹ J, Hu³ X, Guan⁴ X, Liu¹ W.
papers.abstract: Abstract Cortical function is organised along a principal connectome gradient spanning primary sensory to transmodal association systems, but whether this hierarchy is altered in Parkinson’s disease (PD), and whether it relates to imaging measures of the brain’s fluid environment, is unknown. In 472 participants scanned at a single site (310 drug-naïve PD, 162 healthy controls), voxel-wise connectome gradients were derived by diffusion-map embedding and hierarchy de-differentiation was indexed by alignment-independent between-network segregation and gradient dispersion. Within patients, lower sensory-to-transmodal segregation was associated with higher MDS-UPDRS-III (visual–control β=−0.21, 95% CI −0.33 to −0.09, p_FDR=0.005, n=301) and with higher Hoehn–Yahr stage, each feature explaining about 4% of the variance. De-differentiation was coupled to weaker global BOLD–CSF coupling (r=0.22, n=302, p_FDR=0.015 under the most conservative single-family correction), and at trend level to DTI-ALPS and perivascular-space morphology. These three glymphatic-related measures were near-independent of one another (|r|≤0.09), so their concordance is convergent rather than redundant. Associations persisted after adjustment for gray-matter volume, were unchanged across gradient-construction parameters and embedding alignment and replicated in an independent cohort (PD n=61). Baseline segregation was associated with subsequent MDS-UPDRS-III change (n=73, exploratory). Hierarchy de-differentiation is thus a within-disease correlate of motor severity; these cross-sectional associations identify a coherent set of relationships rather than a demonstrated pathway.
