papers.summary_zh: 该研究在单中心纳入药物初治帕金森病患者与健康对照，用弥散图嵌入从功能连接中提取皮层连接组梯度，考察感觉—跨模态层级是否去分化，并检验其与运动严重程度及类淋巴相关影像指标的关系。结果显示，患者网络间分离度越低，运动症状评分和Hoehn–Yahr分期越高，但各仅解释约4%的方差；去分化还与较弱的全局BOLD—脑脊液耦合相关，并与DTI-ALPS及血管周围间隙形态呈趋势性关联，这些类淋巴指标彼此近乎独立，提示结果具有汇聚性而非冗余。作者强调，这些横断面关联只表明层级去分化是疾病内与运动严重度相伴的特征，并不能证明因果通路或临床效用。

papers.title: Seeing Like a Brain: Predicting Subject-Specific EEG Responses to Natural Visual Stimuli
papers.authors: Peng H, Yang J, Bai B.
papers.abstract: Abstract Predicting how natural visual stimuli evoke individualized neural dynamics is a fundamental challenge in cognitive neuroscience and brain–computer interfacing. Here, we present an open-source framework that directly predicts subject-specific, whole-head electroencephalography (EEG) responses from natural images. The model combines a visual encoder, EEG decoder and multi-scale dilated temporal refinement to generate 63-channel, time-resolved responses, with multi-objective training jointly constraining temporal, spectral and semantic consistency. Evaluation across 10 subjects and unseen test concepts demonstrates robust zero-shot prediction, with particularly strong fidelity over occipital regions. The predicted EEG preserves early visual components, spectral characteristics and image-related representational geometry while enabling millisecond-scale inference. Cross-dataset validation reproduces the main spatiotemporal, spectral and semantic trends in subjects with reliable stimulus information, and ablation analyses reveal complementary contributions of the model components and staged optimization. These results establish an efficient forward model linking natural images to individualized EEG responses and provide a scalable framework for studying visual neural dynamics and evaluating brain-like visual representations.

relevance.reason: 该研究以自然图像为刺激，预测个体化全头EEG视觉响应，直接涉及人脑自然视觉加工与神经动态。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个开源框架，尝试直接从自然图像预测个体化的全头脑电响应，以检验能否在未见过的图像概念上重建受试者特异的视觉神经动态。模型结合视觉编码器、脑电解码器和多尺度时间细化，并通过时间、频谱与语义一致性的联合约束进行训练。在多名受试者上的评估显示，模型对未见概念具有一定零样本预测能力，枕区保真度较高，预测信号保留了早期视觉成分、频谱特征和与图像相关的表征几何；跨数据集验证在刺激信息可靠的受试者中重现了主要趋势。作者据此将该框架定位为连接自然图像与个体化脑电响应的前向模型，但其预测精度仍受受试者和刺激条件限制，尚不能等同于临床或脑机接口应用。

papers.title: Social approach-avoidance conflict: Behavioural, emotional, and neural correlates along a depression-social anxiety spectrum.
papers.authors: Cervantes Constantino F, Acuña A, Fernandez C, Guillen M, Mendaro L, Brandani A, Morales S, Pérez A, Mattos J, Cuña E, García-Fontes M, Cabana Á, Armony JL, Gaebler M, Gradin VB.
papers.abstract: Approach-avoidance conflict, in which the same option entails both rewarding and aversive consequences, has been proposed as a key process in internalizing disorders such as depression and social anxiety. Yet, human paradigms that model approach-avoidance conflict and link it to brain function remain scarce. In particular, it has been emphasized the need for studying this conflict in social contexts. We developed a Social Approach-Avoidance Conflict (SAAC) task that involved a social evaluative demand manipulation, and combined it with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) in 135 young adults. On each trial, participants decided whether to accept a variable reward at the cost of increasing the presence of more or less demanding judges in a future public speaking evaluation, or to avoid and receive a minimal default reward. Depression and social anxiety (D-SA) symptoms were summarized into a single continuous dimension derived from principal component analysis of psychological questionnaires. Behaviourally, higher payments increased approach, whereas higher judge ranks increased negative affect and avoidance. Higher D-SA scores were associated with reduced positive and heightened negative emotional responses to higher-rank judges, stronger preferences for low-rank judges, and greater avoidance of high-rank judges. Neurally, increasing judge rank recruited the dmPFC/dACC during approach decisions, and higher D-SA symptoms were associated with stronger responses in these regions. Increasing payment during approach engaged dmPFC/vmPFC, PCC, and posterior insula, and these reward-related responses were attenuated at higher D-SA levels. In conclusion, internalizing symptoms of depression and social anxiety are associated with a bias in emotional and behavioural responses when a reward competes with a social evaluative threat. At the neural level, internalizing symptoms were associated with an enhanced aversive/conflict signalling in the dmPFC/dACC, and with reduced reward-related activity. Findings shed light on the mechanisms underlying costly social avoidance in internalizing disorders.

relevance.reason: 该研究用fMRI考察抑郁-社交焦虑谱系中社会趋避冲突的神经相关，涉及情绪、决策与精神症状的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了社会趋避冲突任务并结合功能磁共振成像，考察抑郁—社交焦虑症状维度与社交评价情境下趋避决策的行为、情绪和神经关联。行为上，较高报酬促进趋近，而更高等级评委引发更强负性情绪和回避；症状得分较高者对高等级评委的正性情绪更弱、负性情绪更强，更偏好低等级评委并更回避高等级评委。神经层面，评委等级升高在趋近决策中招募dmPFC/dACC，症状较高者该反应更强；报酬相关反应涉及dmPFC/vmPFC等区域，但在症状较高者中减弱。作者据此认为，内化症状与奖赏和社交评价威胁竞争时的情绪行为偏向相关，并伴随冲突/厌恶信号增强和奖赏相关活动减弱。

papers.title: Spatial covariance of mGluR5 density and structural degeneration in behavioral variant frontotemporal degeneration.
papers.authors: Matyi MA, Pecsok MK, Olm CA, Radhakrishnan H, Dratch L, Van Deerlin VM, Rhodes E, Phillips JS, Cook PA, Gee JC, Irwin DJ, McMillan CT, Roalf D, Massimo L.
papers.abstract: Post-mortem human brain tissue and in vivo imaging studies of behavioral variant frontotemporal degeneration (bvFTD) suggest that metabotropic glutamate receptors (mGluR) may be vulnerable to the disease process. However, these studies lack evidence demonstrating how loss of mGluR relates to clinical features of bvFTD, hindering efforts to identify appropriate therapeutic strategies. Thus, we leveraged existing normative receptor density maps, and a large cohort of individuals with bvFTD to elucidate relationships among structural degeneration, glutamatergic receptor density, and clinical features. We obtained receptor density maps from the neuromaps repository, which contains positron emission tomography-derived receptor maps across many neurotransmitter systems, including mGluR5 and N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA). We quantified the spatial covariance of structural degeneration and glutamate receptor density maps in 106 individuals with bvFTD and 165 cognitively unimpaired (CU) individuals. Covariance of each participant's regional cortical volumes and normative receptor density in each region of the Schaefer 100 (7 network) parcellation was computed. Negative covariance indicates a high spatial correspondence such that regions with greater structural degeneration also have high receptor density. Within bvFTD, we tested whether greater spatial covariance of structural degeneration and receptor density maps were associated with disease stage and severity, executive function, and neuropsychiatric symptoms. Comparing bvFTD with CU, we observed significant spatial covariance of structural degeneration and mGluR5, but not NMDA. In bvFTD, greater covariance of structural degeneration and mGluR5 maps was associated with more advanced disease stage (p = .003) and severity (p < .001), and worse category (p < .001) and letter-guided (p < .001) fluency and digit span backward (p = .0257) but not neuropsychiatric symptom severity. Neurodegeneration in bvFTD appears to preferentially affect cortical regions with higher normative mGluR5 density, as reflected by spatial covariance between structural degeneration and mGluR5 maps in a clinically well-characterized cross-sectional cohort. Furthermore, greater covariance of mGluR5 density and structural degeneration with both disease severity and executive dysfunction elucidates potential neural mechanisms of core clinical features of bvFTD. Future work examining in vivo glutamate could provide further insight into the natural history of glutamate dysfunction in bvFTD, facilitating testing of glutamatergic therapies.

relevance.reason: 该研究在bvFTD患者中分析皮层结构退变与mGluR5受体密度图谱的空间协变及其与执行功能的关系，属于以脑疾病理解认知与脑组织机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注行为变异型额颞叶变性（bvFTD）中结构退变与谷氨酸受体密度的空间对应关系，利用现有受体密度图谱和bvFTD与认知正常个体的结构性影像数据，计算皮层区域体积与mGluR5、NMDA受体密度的空间协方差。结果显示，bvFTD患者的结构退变与mGluR5密度图存在显著空间协方差，而与NMDA无关，提示退变更倾向于累及mGluR5密度较高的皮层区域。在bvFTD组内，这种协方差越大，疾病分期越晚、严重度越高，执行功能表现也越差，但与神经精神症状严重度无关。作者据此提出，mGluR5密度与结构退变的对应可能参与bvFTD核心临床特征的形成，并指出未来需在体谷氨酸研究加以验证。

papers.title: Immune proteomic associations with indices of cortical development in 5-year-old children.
papers.authors: Barron A, Rosberg A, Tuulari JJ, Lukkarinen M, Merisaari H, Silver E, Kumpulainen V, Copeland A, Saukko E, Dickens AM, Oresic M, Hyötylainen T, Karlsson L, Karlsson H, Wigley ILCM, Pulli EP.
papers.abstract: The immune system has emerged as a critical factor influencing neurodevelopment in offspring. While this is increasingly well-studied in the context of maternal immune activation (MIA), the relationship between postnatal immune activation and brain development in childhood is far less studied. In the current study, we performed targeted immune proteomics to analyse 356 inflammation-associated proteins and examine whether peripheral immune physiology is associated with multimodal neuroimaging metrics, brain growth centiles, and cortical microstructure, in 5-year-old children. We included 101 typically developing children with immune proteomics and multimodal neuroimaging data covering structural and diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) that was modelled with FSL's linked independent component analysis (FLICA) to yield 10 multimodal brain components. For a subset of the analyses utilising immune proteomics and structural brain growth centile data, the sample size was 126 children. We observed consistent negative associations between serum immune proteins and both grey matter volume growth and global cortical thickness; for the latter, associations were statistically significant after false discovery rate correction for CXCL10, IL17A, and LILRB4. Similarly, many immune proteins were associated with increased mean diffusivity across the cortex, most notably LAMP3, NCR1, SIGLEC1, FASLG, and CXCL10 in the right medial orbitofrontal cortex. Collectively, these findings provide the first characterisation of the relationship between immune physiology and brain structure in children, and demonstrate notable associations with global cerebrocortical development. This should be extended by future studies with larger samples and multiple sampling.

relevance.reason: 研究5岁儿童外周免疫蛋白与灰质体积、皮层厚度及皮层微结构（扩散MRI）的关联，属脑结构与发育的生物学关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童期（而非仅孕期）外周免疫状态是否与大脑皮层发育相关，对5岁典型发育儿童同时开展靶向免疫蛋白质组学检测与结构及弥散磁共振成像，并用多模态成分分析考察二者联系。结果显示，多种炎症相关血清蛋白与灰质体积增长和整体皮层厚度呈一致的负相关，部分蛋白还与皮层平均弥散率升高相关，提示免疫生理与儿童皮层宏观及微观结构发育存在关联。作者强调这只是初步刻画，相关不等于因果，尚需更大样本和多次采样验证。

papers.title: Connectivity changes underlying recovery from pure alexia: a Korean single-case study.
papers.authors: Na Y, Hwang YM, Pyun SB.
papers.abstract: Pure alexia (PA) is an isolated reading impairment following brain damage, yet the mechanisms underlying reading recovery remain unclear. We present a Korean patient with PA following a posterior cerebral artery infarction who showed severe impairment in Hangul reading despite preserved writing and spoken language, with substantial recovery of sentence-level reading within six months. Structural and functional connectivity were investigated using diffusion tensor tractography (DTT) and functional connectivity (FC) analyses. DTT revealed degeneration of affected white matter tracts, including the forceps major, inferior longitudinal fasciculus and inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus. Interhemispheric FC was significantly lower than that of healthy controls (HCs) across perilesional regions. In contrast, FC between the left angular gyrus and perilesional regions differed significantly from HCs at specific follow-up time points during behavioral recovery. These findings suggest that functional reorganization of distributed reading networks may support behavioral recovery despite persistent structural disconnection.

relevance.reason: 单例纯失读症患者阅读恢复的脑结构与功能连接研究，直接涉及阅读网络重组及白质纤维束。

papers.summary_zh: 该单例研究追踪一名后大脑动脉梗死所致纯失读症的韩语患者，结合弥散张量纤维束成像与功能连接分析，考察其阅读恢复的 connectivity 基础。患者书写与口语相对保留，韩文阅读严重受损，但句级阅读在数月内明显恢复。影像显示受累白质束存在退变，病灶周围区域半球间功能连接低于健康对照；而左侧角回与病灶周围区域的功能连接在行为恢复的特定随访时点与对照不同。作者据此提出，尽管结构连接持续中断，分布式阅读网络的功能重组可能支持阅读行为恢复，但单例设计使因果推断受限。

papers.title: Differentiation of frontolimbic functional connectivity from birth to early adulthood links with adversity exposure and cognition.
papers.authors: Kim W, Whittle S, Zalesky A, Tian YE.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.abstract: Frontolimbic circuits connecting the frontal cortex with the amygdala and the hippocampus are critical for emotion and learning. These connections undergo major changes throughout childhood and adolescence, yet the principles guiding their maturation remain unclear. Analyzing large developmental cohorts, we show that fronto-hippocampus connectivity develops rapidly in early childhood and stabilizes thereafter. In contrast, fronto-amygdala connectivity becomes progressively differentiated from fronto-hippocampus connectivity, with development most pronounced during adolescence. This entailed hippocampus and amygdala respectively becoming preferentially tethered to association-related regions and sensorimotor-related regions. Greater adversity exposure was associated with more differentiated fronto-amygdala connectivity for a given age. Higher cognitive ability was associated with less differentiated fronto-hippocampus connectivity. These findings suggest that frontolimbic connectivity development follows a principle of differentiation, with circuit-specific timing and sensitivity to stress and learning. This work provides a foundation for understanding typical and atypical frontolimbic circuitry development from birth to emerging adulthood.

relevance.reason: 研究人脑额边缘系统功能连接从出生到成年的发育分化及其与逆境和认知的关系，属认知发育与脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注连接额叶与杏仁核、海马的前额-边缘环路在童年至成年早期如何成熟，并分析大型发育队列的脑功能连接数据。结果显示，额叶-海马连接在幼儿期快速发育后趋于稳定，而额叶-杏仁核连接则逐渐与额叶-海马连接分化，这一分化在青春期最为明显，并伴随海马和杏仁核分别更倾向连接联合皮层与感觉运动相关区域。研究还发现，同等年龄下逆境暴露较多者额叶-杏仁核连接分化程度更高，认知能力较高者额叶-海马连接分化程度较低。作者据此提出，前额-边缘连接发育遵循分化原则，不同环路的时间进程及其对压力和学习的敏感性各异，这为理解该环路的典型与非典型发育提供了基础。

papers.title: Rapid changes in risk attitudes originate from Bayesian inference on parietal magnitude representations.
papers.authors: de Hollander G, Grueschow M, Hennel F, Ruff CC.
papers.abstract: Risk attitudes-the willingness to accept uncertainty for larger potential rewards-are often treated as a stable individual trait, yet people's risky choices change markedly across contexts and even across repetitions of identical decisions. Here we show, using modelling and neuroimaging, that such rapid changes emerge from Bayesian inference on noisy magnitude representations in parietal cortex. Participants underwent fMRI while choosing between safe and risky options that are either held in working memory or shown on screen. Options held in working memory are noisier and more prone to central-tendency biases, so relatively small payoffs are overestimated and large payoffs underestimated, shifting choices between risk-seeking and risk aversion. A computational model of payoff perception captures these effects mechanistically. Numerical population-receptive-field modelling shows that when intraparietal payoff representations are noisier, choices are less consistent and less risk-neutral. Thus, risk attitudes and their contextual variability can be rooted in perceptual inference on parietal magnitude representations.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI和计算模型研究风险态度快速变化的顶叶数量表征与贝叶斯推断机制，属决策与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注风险态度为何会在不同情境甚至相同决策重复出现时快速变化，结合计算建模与fMRI，让参与者在工作记忆保持或屏幕呈现的安全与风险选项间做选择。结果显示，工作记忆中的选项表征噪声更大、更易受中心趋势偏差影响，使较小收益被高估、较大收益被低估，从而在寻求风险与规避风险之间摆动；收益感知的计算模型从机制上解释了这一效应，数值群体感受野建模进一步表明顶内收益表征噪声越大，选择越不一致、越偏离风险中性。作者据此认为，风险态度及其情境变异性可根植于顶叶数量表征上的知觉推断。

papers.title: Valuation as a bridge between aesthetics and creativity.
papers.authors: Vartanian O, Skov M, Nadal M, Chatterjee A.
papers.abstract: Evidence shows that aesthetic evaluations are underpinned by mechanisms in the reward system that compute value for objects of interest. In turn, recent behavioral, computational, and neuroimaging evidence suggests that creativity involves a similar valuation process, as people generate and evaluate the originality and adequacy of their ideas-two standard criteria of creativity. These findings suggest that creativity and aesthetic evaluation may be supported by a domain-general mechanism for computing subjective value. We offer a proposal in which creators' value computations are conveyed by the structure and content of their works and recovered during aesthetic evaluation through shared reward-system mechanisms and associated processes. On this view, creating and appreciating are two related expressions of a shared value-based process.

relevance.reason: 提出审美评价与创造性共享奖赏系统价值计算的领域一般性神经机制框架，涉及人脑认知加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该文提出，审美评价与创造力可能共享一个基于价值的领域一般性机制。作者整合行为、计算与神经影像证据指出，审美评价依赖奖赏系统对对象价值进行计算，而创造过程同样涉及对想法原创性与适当性的生成和评估，二者都包含主观价值计算。据此，作者提出创作者的价值计算体现在作品的结构与内容中，欣赏者则通过共享的奖赏系统机制及相关过程在审美评价中恢复这些价值，从而将创造与欣赏视为同一价值过程的两种相关表达。该文属于理论性论述，摘要未报告新的实证数据。

papers.title: Shared and disorder-specific functional alterations in generalized anxiety disorder and major depressive disorder.
papers.authors: Wang T, Cui S, Zheng M, Li Y, Xie T, Zhu DM.
papers.abstract: Background Generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) and major depressive disorder (MDD) show substantial clinical overlap, yet their shared and disorder-specific intrinsic functional abnormalities remain unclear. This study examined regional brain activity and whole-brain functional integration in GAD and MDD using resting-state fMRI. Methods Forty-two GAD patients, 43 MDD patients, and 83 healthy controls underwent resting-state fMRI. ALFF and FCS were calculated to assess regional spontaneous activity and whole-brain functional integration, respectively. Group differences were tested using voxel-wise ANCOVA controlling for age, sex, education, and frame-wise displacement. Partial correlations examined associations with clinical symptoms. Results Both patient groups showed decreased ALFF in a cluster spanning the left precuneus and right cuneus, with lower ALFF in GAD than in MDD. Both groups also showed decreased FCS in the bilateral lingual gyri, right middle occipital gyrus, and left postcentral gyrus, and increased FCS in the right inferior frontal gyrus. GAD showed lower FCS in the left lingual gyrus than MDD. Conclusions GAD and MDD showed shared functional alterations in posterior cortical, visual, somatosensory, and frontal regions, while GAD exhibited lower ALFF and FCS in specific posterior cortical regions than MDD.

relevance.reason: 用静息态fMRI比较GAD与MDD患者局部自发活动与全脑功能整合，属脑疾病功能网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注广泛性焦虑障碍（GAD）与重性抑郁障碍（MDD）共有的和各自特异的静息态脑功能异常，比较了两组患者与健康对照的区域自发活动（ALFF）和全脑功能整合（FCS）。结果发现，两组患者均在后部皮层、视觉、躯体感觉及额叶区域表现出功能改变，其中部分指标在GAD中比MDD更低，提示GAD在特定后部皮层区域的活动与整合减弱更为明显。作者据此认为，两种障碍既存在共享的功能基础，也存在与诊断相关的差异，但这些组间差异与临床症状的关联仍需进一步明确。

papers.title: The neural basis of punishment sensitivity and cognitive reappraisal: Evidence from functional connectivity between the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and right precuneus.
papers.authors: Liu Y, Zhao H, Huang J, Yang C, Xiong Z, Shen H, Ren Y, Zhang Z, Feng T, Feng P.
papers.abstract: Punishment sensitivity refers to an individual's tendency to perceive and respond to punishment and other negative signals. Cognitive reappraisal is an emotion regulation strategy through which individuals modify their emotional responses by altering their evaluation of a situation. Previous studies have confirmed a negative correlation between punishment sensitivity and cognitive reappraisal ability; the neural mechanisms linking these two constructs remain unclear. To investigate this association, the present study integrated behavioral measurements, voxel-based morphometry (VBM), resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC), and mediation analysis in a sample of 357 healthy university students. Behavioral results revealed a negative correlation between punishment sensitivity and cognitive reappraisal. VBM analysis showed that punishment sensitivity was positively associated with gray matter volume in the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC). RSFC analysis further demonstrated that the functional connectivity between the right dlPFC and the right precuneus was positively correlated with punishment sensitivity. Mediation analysis revealed that this functional connectivity exhibited a statistical suppression effect on the relationship between punishment sensitivity and cognitive reappraisal, as indicated by opposing directions of the direct and indirect effects. These findings suggest that dlPFC-precuneus functional connectivity may serve as a neural correlate linking punishment sensitivity to cognitive reappraisal, providing new insights into the neurobiological basis of this association.

relevance.reason: 研究惩罚敏感性与认知重评的脑结构（VBM灰质体积）和静息态功能连接基础，涉及情绪调节与执行控制脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注惩罚敏感性与认知重评能力之间负相关背后的神经机制，在健康大学生中结合行为测量、基于体素的形态学分析、静息态功能连接和中介分析进行考察。结果发现，惩罚敏感性与右侧背外侧前额叶灰质体积正相关，且该区域与右侧楔前叶的功能连接也与惩罚敏感性正相关。中介分析显示，这一功能连接对惩罚敏感性与认知重评的关系表现出统计抑制效应，直接与间接效应方向相反。作者据此提出，右侧背外侧前额叶与楔前叶的功能连接可能是连接惩罚敏感性与认知重评的神经相关因素，为理解二者关系提供了神经生物学线索。

papers.title: Co-Occurring Social Reward and Social Threat Elicits Conflict-Related Neural Activation.
papers.authors: Solan S, Truchan E, Rothlein D, Jagger-Rickels A, DeGutis J, Esterman M, Evans TC.
papers.abstract: Facial expressions often exhibit variations in social reward (happiness), social threat (anger), or social reward-threat conflict (co-occurring happiness and anger) and previous research demonstrates that core approach and avoidance motivation systems are highly sensitive to these variations. Moreover, social reward-threat conflict distinctly modulates approach and avoidance motivation compared to isolated variations in social reward or social threat, which plays a particularly pronounced role in social behavior. However, no neuroimaging research has elucidated the extent to which social reward-threat conflict may differentially modulate neural activation compared to isolated variations in social reward or social threat. To address this issue, 29 adults completed an fMRI study to directly compare neural activation patterns elicited by variations in social reward-threat conflict, social reward, or social threat. At the motivational level, social reward-threat conflict elicited opposing modulation of both approach and avoidance motivation. At the neural level, social reward-threat conflict also elicited conflict-related patterns of neural activation within regions commonly implicated in conflict monitoring including the pre-SMA, dACC, right anterior insula, and right vlPFC. Thus, co-occurring variations in social reward and social threat modulates neural regions involved in conflict processing, which may ultimately yield mechanistic insights into social behavior.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究考察社会奖赏-威胁冲突对社会认知相关冲突监测脑区激活的调节。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注同时出现的社交奖赏与社交威胁线索（即奖赏—威胁冲突）是否会比单一奖赏或单一威胁引发不同的神经活动。29名成人完成fMRI任务，直接比较三类表情变化诱发的激活模式。结果显示，奖赏—威胁冲突在动机层面同时反向调节趋近与回避动机，在神经层面则招募了与冲突监测相关的区域，包括pre-SMA、dACC、右侧前岛叶和右侧vlPFC。作者据此认为，奖赏与威胁线索并存会调动冲突加工相关的脑区，这可能为理解社交行为提供机制线索；但研究为小样本实验，结论尚属初步，未涉及临床干预效果。

papers.title: Simulating the unreal: Neural mechanisms of counterfactual comprehension.
papers.authors: Jia C, Xu X.
papers.abstract: Counterfactual reasoning-the ability to construct scenarios that contradict known facts-is central to complex human cognition. However, little is known about how such reasoning unfolds in languages like Mandarin Chinese, which lack explicit morphological markers for counterfactuality. In this study, we used a discourse-based manipulation with tightly controlled syntactic and lexical features to examine the neural mechanisms of Mandarin counterfactual comprehension via functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). Activation and graph-theoretical analyses revealed that counterfactuals, compared to hypothetical and causal statements, elicited greater right PoCG activation and higher degree centrality/nodal efficiency in PreCG/PoCG regions, alongside increased engagement of the left inferior frontal gyrus (IFG). Inter-subject representational similarity analysis (IS-RSA) and cluster-based analyses further indicated associations with individual differences in working memory (WM) and theory of mind (ToM), respectively, with WM supporting dual representation and ToM facilitating higher-level inferencing. Together, these findings provide converging evidence for the Mental Simulation Hypothesis: counterfactual comprehension recruits embodied sensorimotor processes to simulate unreal events, particularly in the absence of overt grammatical cues. By integrating individual-difference measures with network-level analyses, this study advances our understanding of the neural architecture of counterfactual thinking and raises questions about how grammatical marking may shape counterfactual processing across languages.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS研究汉语反事实句理解的语言神经机制，涉及语义/语篇加工及工作记忆、心理理论等认知过程。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察缺乏显性语法标记的汉语中反事实理解如何展开，用基于语篇的操纵结合功能近红外成像记录脑活动。与假设句和因果句相比，反事实句在右侧中央后回引起更强激活，并在中央前回/中央后回表现出更高的网络中心性和节点效率，同时左侧额下回参与增强。个体差异分析提示工作记忆与心理理论分别关联于双重表征和更高层推理，作者据此支持心理模拟假说：反事实理解会调动具身感觉运动过程来模拟非真实事件，尤其在缺少显性语法线索时。

papers.title: Beyond white matter topology: cortical geometry shapes the spatial pattern of face-processing plasticity following auditory deprivation.
papers.authors: Cao F, Peng P, Chen K, Yang S, Nie Y, Wang Z, Li J, Wang S.
papers.abstract: The human brain can adapt its function in response to experience, and such plasticity mediates the influence of individual experience on cognition and behavior. Traditional accounts propose that functional brain plasticity is primarily driven by the rerouting of white matter fiber networks, that is, topological connectivity. However, accumulating evidence that intrinsic geometric features constrain neural dynamics raises the possibility that brain plasticity may also be shaped by cortical geometry. Yet, direct empirical support for this hypothesis remains scarce. Here, we combined a multivariate analytical framework with multimodal neuroimaging to examine how white matter topology and cortical geometry jointly constrain the group-level spatial pattern of face-processing plasticity following congenital auditory deprivation. Our results showed that auditory deprivation-induced functional plasticity primarily exhibited a spatial pattern of outward expansion from the core regions of the pre-existing face-processing network. Both white matter topology and cortical geometry were associated with the spatial distribution of this group-level plasticity map, with cortical geometry explaining a modest but greater portion of its spatial variance than topological connectivity. Whole-brain eigenmode analysis further showed greater alignment of face-processing activation with geometric eigenmodes in deaf participants at intermediate spatial scales, with no comparable differences for connectome eigenmodes. Moreover, cross-group predictive analyses indicated that structure-function associations involving topological and geometric properties can partially generalize across sensory experience. Taken together, these findings suggest that cortical geometry, as one component of the structural scaffold, contributes to the spatial organization of group-level functional plasticity alongside white matter topology, consistent with complementary structural constraints on its spatial pattern.

relevance.reason: 研究先天听觉剥夺后面孔加工可塑性的空间模式，结合白质拓扑与皮层几何约束，属认知可塑性与结构-功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注先天听觉剥夺后，面孔加工功能可塑性在脑内的空间分布由什么结构因素约束，并结合多变量分析与多模态神经影像，比较白质拓扑连接和皮层几何的作用。结果显示，这种可塑性主要表现为从既有面孔加工网络核心区向外扩展；白质拓扑和皮层几何都与该群体水平可塑性图谱的空间分布相关，其中皮层几何解释的空间方差略多。全脑本征模式分析还提示，在中等空间尺度上，聋被试的面孔加工激活与几何本征模式更对齐，而连接组本征模式未见可比差异。作者据此认为，皮层几何与白质拓扑共同构成对功能可塑性空间格局的互补性结构约束，但相关分析不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Functionally relevant and reliable brain stimulation targets for enhancement of novel word-learning.
papers.authors: Kocataş H, Abdelmotaleb M, Caisachana Guevara LM, Niemann F, Shahbabaie A, Malinowski R, Riemann S, Hayek D, Antonenko D, Rodriguez-Fornells A, Flöel A, Meinzer M.
papers.abstract: Linking word-forms and their meanings is central to language learning. Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) has shown potential to enhance this process, but with variable effects. This study aimed to identify reliable and functionally relevant tDCS target brain regions to enhance novel-word learning and assess test-retest reliability (TRR) of behavioral and imaging outcomes. Twenty healthy individuals completed two functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) sessions using parallel task versions. Participants learned picture-pseudoword associations across six blocks. Learning was analyzed using linear-mixed-models. Whole-brain and region-of-interest (ROI) analyses examined learning-related activity changes and their behavioral relevance. TRR was assessed using intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs). Participants successfully acquired the novel-word forms, indexed by increased accuracy and faster latency across stages. Behavioral outcomes showed good-to-excellent TRR. The task elicited robust language-learning related activity and activity changes across stages were correlated with learning success. Task-related activity was variable, but voxels within significant clusters (∼81%) and most ROIs showed moderate-to-excellent consistency. Power analyses confirmed a sufficient sample size for detecting the reported ICCs. Current modeling suggested that focal-tDCS can induce neurophysiologically relevant current intensity in potential target regions (V/m: Left Inferior Frontal Gyrus=0.19, Temporoparietal Junction=0.28, Supplementary Motor Area=0.11). Hence, we identified accessible, reliable and functionally relevant cortical targets for enhancing novel-word learning. TRR results support the paradigms' usefulness for concurrent tDCS-fMRI research. Our study also outlines a path towards optimization of brain stimulation studies by implementing an empirically informed approach for selecting reliable and relevant target regions and implementation of reliable experimental and imaging paradigms.

relevance.reason: 研究新词学习（语言学习）的fMRI脑活动变化及tDCS靶区，报告语言学习相关脑区与行为关联，属语言与脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在识别能可靠增强新词学习的经颅直流电刺激靶区，并评估行为与影像指标的重测信度。20名健康参与者在两次功能磁共振成像中完成图片—假词配对学习任务，结果显示学习表现随阶段提升且信度良好，学习相关脑活动变化与学习成效相关，多数感兴趣区和显著簇内体素具有中等至优良的一致性。电流建模提示左侧额下回、颞顶交界和辅助运动区等候选靶区可获得神经生理相关电流强度。作者据此认为这些靶区兼具可及性、可靠性和功能相关性，相关范式可用于同步刺激—成像研究，并为优化脑刺激研究提供了依据。

papers.title: A nonlinear reward after-effect of cognitive effort expenditure.
papers.authors: Liu L, Xue L, Tang R, Zheng Y.
papers.abstract: Effort is widely viewed as a cost that diminishes the appeal of rewards, yet people sometimes value outcomes more when they have worked hard to obtain them. This paradox in the reward after-effect of effort expenditure persists because nearly all studies compare only two effort levels, implicitly assuming a monotonic effort-value function. We tested whether this function is nonlinear by recording EEG from 40 healthy adults (20 females) who performed a cognitive effort task with five parametrically varied effort levels to earn monetary rewards. Gain-related neural responses followed a U-shaped function across effort levels, decreasing from low to intermediate effort and rebounding from intermediate to high effort. The P3 and delta oscillations captured the full nonlinear profile, whereas theta oscillations tracked only the descending limb and the reward positivity only the ascending limb. Moreover, individual differences in effort avoidance, independently measured by a demand-selection task, amplified the U-shaped curvature of gain-related delta power, with high-effort-avoidance individuals exhibiting a steeper nonlinear profile. These findings help reconcile the effort paradox, suggesting that effort discounting and effort enhancement are complementary segments of a single nonlinear valuation function and challenging purely monotonic accounts of the reward after-effect of effort expenditure.

relevance.reason: 用EEG记录健康成人认知努力与奖赏加工的非线性神经反应，属认知（奖赏/努力）神经机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究检验认知努力对奖赏加工的影响是否呈非线性，而非以往多数研究默认的单调关系。40名健康成人完成含五个参数化努力水平的认知努力任务以获取金钱奖赏，同时记录脑电。结果显示，与收益相关的神经反应随努力水平呈U形变化：由低到中等努力时下降，由中等到高努力时回升；P3和delta振荡反映了完整的非线性曲线，theta振荡只追踪下降段，奖赏正波只追踪上升段。个体在独立需求选择任务中表现出的努力回避倾向越强，收益相关delta功率的U形弯曲越明显。作者据此认为，努力折扣与努力增强可能是同一非线性价值函数的互补片段，这对纯粹单调的解释构成挑战。

papers.title: A generalizable OPM-MEG framework for time-resolved language decoding during natural speech production.
papers.authors: Xu Y, Zhang Y, Peng Y, Yan B, Wu Z, Ding M, Chen L.
papers.abstract: Non-invasive decoding of rapidly evolving cognitive and motor states is limited by trade-offs between temporal precision, spatial fidelity and tolerance to natural movement. We present a modality-matched benchmarking framework that evaluates optically pumped magnetometer magnetoencephalography (OPM-MEG) against electroencephalography (EEG) during visually cued overt speech production. Ten native Mandarin speakers produced six isolated vowel rhymes (100 repetitions per class) while OPM-MEG and EEG were recorded under the same task. We compared six feature representations and five classifiers using time-resolved decoding, temporal generalization, pairwise classification, and source-space searchlight analyses. Decoding remained near chance before stimulus onset and increased after onset. In the principal common spatial patterns (CSP) analysis, exact paired cluster-mass permutation tests identified significant OPM-MEG > EEG clusters for all five classifiers within 150-500 ms. Averaged across classifiers over 150-500 ms, CSP was the strongest feature representation (57.9% for OPM-MEG and 55.0% for EEG). Across features, linear support vector machine (Linear SVM) achieved the highest mean accuracy (56.4% and 54.1%, respectively). CSP with Linear SVM was the best feature-classifier combination, yielding mean accuracies of 60.3% for OPM-MEG and 56.7% for EEG; late peak accuracies reached 63.0% and 60.1%, respectively. Temporal-generalization matrices were dominated by a narrow main diagonal, with limited off-diagonal generalization (50.7-52.1%), indicating predominantly time-specific discriminative information. In the pairwise analysis, CSP with Linear SVM achieved a mean accuracy of 60.1%, and /i/ versus /u/ reached a maximum of 61.2%. Exploratory source-space searchlight analysis identified time-evolving cortical parcels with above-chance local decoding from 100 to 450 ms, whereas no parcel reached significance at 0 or 50 ms; these patterns do not directly establish activation or coherent functional-network recruitment. These results support OPM-MEG as a high-resolution non-invasive platform for time-resolved decoding and provide practical guidance for feature and classifier selection in speech-related neuroimaging and brain-computer interface studies.

relevance.reason: 比较OPM-MEG与EEG在自然言语产出中的时间分辨解码，报告言语运动/语音加工的皮层时空信息，属语言与脑及功能信号研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了OPM-MEG与EEG在自然发声任务中对语言相关脑活动的解码能力，十名母语者完成视觉提示的元音发声，同时接受两种模态记录。结果显示，刺激后150至500毫秒内OPM-MEG的解码准确率显著高于EEG，且以共空间模式特征配合线性支持向量机表现最佳；时间泛化矩阵以主对角线为主，说明判别信息主要具有时间特异性。源空间探索性分析还发现局部解码能力随时间演变，但作者强调这些模式不能直接等同于激活或功能网络募集。总体上，研究支持OPM-MEG作为高时间分辨率的无创解码平台，并为语音相关神经影像和脑机接口研究中的特征与分类器选择提供了参考。

papers.title: Differential effects of iTBS over domain-general and language-specific brain regions on rule learning.
papers.authors: Ren L, Lv M, Wang X, Schwieter JW, Fu S, Liu H.
papers.abstract: Rule learning relies on both domain-general and language-specific neural systems, but how these systems interact during learning remains unclear. Guided by the variability-stability-flexibility (VSF) model, we combined intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) with fMRI to examine the effects of modulating the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (R DLPFC; a domain-general brain area) and left inferior frontal gyrus (L IFG; a language-specific brain area) during phase-structured word- and symbol-rule learning. Two groups of individuals received active iTBS, either over the R DLPFC or L IFG. A third group received sham iTBS over the vertex. Behaviorally, both active iTBS groups outperformed the sham group, with accuracy improving across phases. Full factorial and ROI analysis revealed phase-dependent activation shifts for both active iTBS groups, with performance improving across phases. Generalized Psychophysiological Interaction (gPPI) analyses showed that active iTBS applied over the R DLPFC enhanced large-scale network integration, while iTBS over the L IFG strengthened focal language-network specialization during word learning and promoted cross-system coordination during symbol learning. Dynamic Causal Modeling (DCM) demonstrated that active iTBS accelerated transitions from exploratory to flexible states, optimizing phase-dependent information flow. These findings suggest that successful rule learning arises from dynamic interactions between domain-general and language-specific neural mechanisms and that iTBS can selectively optimize these processes.

relevance.reason: 用iTBS调控语言特异脑区（L IFG）与一般领域脑区，结合fMRI/gPPI/DCM考察规则学习的脑网络动态与语言机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察一般领域与语言特异脑区在规则学习中的交互作用，将间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）与功能磁共振成像结合，分别调控右侧背外侧前额叶和左侧额下回，并设置假刺激组进行比较。行为结果显示，两个主动刺激组的规则学习成绩均优于假刺激组，且随学习阶段推进而提高。影像分析表明，刺激右侧背外侧前额叶增强了大规模网络整合，刺激左侧额下回则强化了词汇学习中的语言网络特化，并在符号学习中促进跨系统协调；有效连接分析还提示主动刺激加快了从探索状态向灵活状态的转变。作者据此认为，成功的规则学习依赖一般领域与语言特异神经机制的动态互动，而iTBS能够选择性地优化这些过程。

papers.title: Pubertal maturation, genetic variation, and ventral striatal development in adolescence: An integrative framework.
papers.authors: Phadke AM, Dai J.
papers.abstract: Adolescence represents a critical period marked by profound changes in social contexts, biological maturation, neural reorganization, social-cognitive functioning, and the onset of psychopathology. During this sensitive window, developmental outcomes become increasingly heterogeneous. Intertwined processes, including genetic influences, pubertal maturation, and neurodevelopment, likely contribute to this variation. However, research on adolescent development in the past decades has often examined genetic variation, puberty, and neurodevelopment in isolation, with limited integration of how genetic and pubertal processes may interact to shape the developing brain. This is particularly important for understanding the ventral striatum (VS), which is sensitive to genetic and pubertal modulation and underlies a broad range of behaviors, including salient motivation, risk-taking, substance use, peer influence susceptibility, and psychopathology. In this review, we synthesized evidence from developmental neuroscience, neuroendocrinology, and behavioral genetics to propose a Gene-Puberty-Brain Cascade framework focused on VS development. We reviewed evidence that VS structure, activation, and network undergo significant reorganization during adolescence and are associated with both pubertal and genetic variation. Building on evidence that genetic variation is closely related to pubertal development (e.g., onset, timing, tempo, hormonal sensitivity, and stage), we argue that genetic and pubertal processes may dynamically interact to shape VS development, which underlies heterogeneity in adolescent development. Finally, we highlight how researchers can leverage large-scale longitudinal cohorts (e.g., ABCD), advanced longitudinal and statistical models, and multimodal computational neuroimaging frameworks to understand this process. This integrative framework offers a developmentally grounded understanding of how gene-puberty interplay may contribute to heterogeneity in adolescent development.

relevance.reason: 综述提出基因-青春期-脑级联框架，聚焦腹侧纹状体在青春期的结构、激活与网络重组及其与奖赏动机等认知行为的关联，属脑发育与结构功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合发展神经科学、神经内分泌学和行为遗传学证据，提出以腹侧纹状体发育为核心的“基因—青春期—脑级联”框架。作者梳理指出，腹侧纹状体的结构、激活和网络在青春期经历显著重组，并与青春期进程和遗传变异相关；由于遗传变异与青春期启动、时序、节奏、激素敏感性和阶段密切相关，二者可能动态交互塑造腹侧纹状体发育，进而解释青少年发展的异质性。文章还建议利用大规模纵向队列、纵向统计模型和多模态计算神经影像框架推进这一方向，属于整合性综述而非原始实验。

papers.title: Comparative analysis of striatal subregions in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia and late-life schizophrenia: A multimodal MRI study.
papers.authors: Li H, Zhang X, Yao M, Li T, Pan G, Wang H.
papers.abstract: Objective Behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) and schizophrenia share similar clinical manifestations, cognitive profiles and overlapping brain lesions. The striatal subregions play critical roles in both disorders, yet relevant comparative investigations remain limited. This study aimed to explore the distinct neural mechanisms between bvFTD and late-life schizophrenia by comparing striatal subregional structure, function and spatial correlations of neurotransmitters. Methods A total of 36 patients with bvFTD, 21 patients with late-life schizophrenia and 56 healthy comparison group were enrolled. All participants underwent neurocognitive assessment, behavioral evaluation and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Voxel-Based Morphometry and Resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC) analyses based on the Human Brainnetome Atlas. Partial correlation analysis was performed to evaluate the associations of imaging metrics with neuropsychological and behavioral measures. JuSpace was used to compare RSFC-neurotransmitter spatial correlation differences between bvFTD and schizophrenia groups. Results A graded reduction in gray matter volume was observed across most striatal subregions: the bvFTD group showed the smallest volume, then the schizophrenia group. Both bvFTD and schizophrenia groups exhibited similar RSFC in the right nucleus accumbens and bilateral dorsolateral putamen. Specifically, the bvFTD group presented unique aberrant intra-striatal functional connectivity, including connections between the left nucleus accumbens and right putamen, as well as between the left dorsal caudate nucleus and left ventral caudate. Significant partial correlations were detected: Hamilton Depression Rating Scale scores negatively correlated with bilateral dorsal caudate volume in the schizophrenia group. Additionally, the bvFTD group exhibited lower spatial correlations between RSFC and the density maps of 5-HT₆, α4β2, M1 , mGluR5 and D₂ receptors, compared with the schizophrenia group. Conclusions These findings suggest similar striatal impairment patterns but divergent underlying neural mechanisms in bvFTD and schizophrenia, offering new insights into the neural circuits of clinical phenotypes and the pathophysiological basis of the two disorders.

relevance.reason: 比较两种脑疾病患者纹状体亚区灰质体积与静息态功能连接，属以脑疾病理解脑结构与功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较行为变异型额颞叶痴呆（bvFTD）与晚发性精神分裂症患者在纹状体亚区的结构与功能差异，纳入两组患者及健康对照组，结合多模态MRI、神经认知与行为评估，并分析功能连接与神经递质空间分布的相关性。结果显示，两组纹状体灰质体积呈梯度下降，bvFTD组最低、精神分裂症组居中；二者在右侧伏隔核和双侧背外侧壳核表现出相似的功能连接模式，但bvFTD组另有独特的纹状体内连接异常。bvFTD组功能连接与多种受体密度图的空间相关性也低于精神分裂症组。作者据此认为，两种疾病存在相似的纹状体损伤模式，但潜在神经机制不同，为理解其临床表型相关神经环路及病理生理基础提供了线索。

papers.title: EEG resting-state gamma power as a potential biomarker of excitation / inhibition imbalance in autism: Evidence from the Autism Biomarkers Consortium for Clinical Trials.
papers.authors: Arutiunian V, Sugar CA, Naples A, Santhosh M, Levin AR, Borland H, Benton J, Bernier RA, Chawarska K, Dawson G, Dziura J, Hellemann G, Faja S, Jeste S, Kleinhans N, Sabatos-DeVito M, Şentürk D, Shic F, McPartland JC, Webb SJ.
papers.journal: European neuropsychopharmacology : the journal of the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology
papers.abstract: Identification of neural biomarkers is one of the central challenges in autism research as they could significantly advance our understanding of the brain mechanisms of symptom trajectories, serve as objective markers in clinical trials (e.g., for subgrouping children, or use for prognostic relationship), and lead to targeted treatment development. The Autism Biomarkers Consortium for Clinical Trials (ABCCT) is a naturalistic longitudinal study assessing a set of candidate electroencephalographic (EEG) biomarkers, their change over time, utility for group discrimination, and relation to clinical phenotype. Here, we focused on one of the ABCCT biomarkers - resting-state gamma-band neural activity - as a measure of excitation-inhibition balance, which is considered a key neurophysiological mechanism in autism. A total of 1597 EEGs were analyzed resulting in 399 autistic children and typically developing (TD) peers with resting-state EEG and behavioral measures at four timepoints: baseline, +6 weeks, +6 months, and +4 years. The results revealed a significantly increased gamma power in autistic children, suggesting an excitation-inhibition imbalance. This elevation was longitudinally associated with lower non-verbal IQ and memory for faces. Finally, males had higher gamma power in comparison to females and gamma power decreased with age in both groups. The study demonstrates that resting-state gamma power is related to cognitive ability across ages and timepoints of our study in autistic youth.

relevance.reason: 以自闭症儿童静息态EEG gamma功率为兴奋/抑制平衡指标，并关联非言语IQ与面孔记忆等认知能力，属脑疾病机制与静息态脑活动研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于自闭症生物标志物联盟的纵向数据，考察静息态γ波段活动能否作为兴奋/抑制平衡的脑电标志物，并比较自闭症儿童与典型发育同伴。结果显示，自闭症儿童的γ功率显著升高，提示兴奋/抑制失衡；这种升高在纵向随访中与较低的非言语智商和面孔记忆相关，且男性γ功率高于女性、两组γ功率均随年龄下降。作者据此认为，静息态γ功率与自闭症青少年的认知能力相关，但摘要未说明其作为临床生物标志物的诊断或预后效用。

papers.title: A systematic review of structural brain differences in school-aged children born preterm.
papers.authors: Coward E, Mckinnon K, Richardson H, Fletcher-Watson S.
papers.abstract: Preterm birth (<37 weeks' gestation) is commonly associated with adverse developmental outcomes, many of which correlate with structural brain differences. Differences in brain structure exist between preterm and term-born neonates/babies at term-equivalent age; however, it remains to be determined whether these differences persist in childhood. Two databases, EMBASE and Ovid MEDLINE, were searched to identify all publications using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to measure differences in brain structure between preterm and term-born children at 6-10 years old and associated perinatal risk factors. A risk of bias assessment was performed using the ROBINS-E tool. 23 articles were included that reported MRI data from prospective, longitudinal cohort studies. Preterm children showed smaller global and regional tissue volumes and altered white matter microstructure compared to term-born controls. These associations were more pronounced for those born at a lower gestational age and in the presence of perinatal brain injury. Across studies, structural brain differences had varied associations with neurodevelopmental outcomes. Furthermore, this review highlights that there is a clear lack of prospective, longitudinal studies reporting on the association between preterm birth and MRI differences at school age.

relevance.reason: 系统综述早产儿童学龄期脑结构差异（体积、白质微结构）及其与神经发育结局关联，属脑发育与结构基础研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统检索并评估了采用磁共振成像比较6至10岁早产儿童与足月儿童脑结构差异的前瞻性纵向队列研究，共纳入23篇文献。结果显示，早产儿童整体及局部组织体积较小、白质微结构异常，这些差异在出生胎龄更低或伴有围产期脑损伤的儿童中更明显；各研究中脑结构差异与神经发育结局的关联并不一致。作者据此指出，目前仍缺乏针对早产与学龄期脑结构差异关联的前瞻性纵向研究。

papers.title: Early differences in neural adaptation to written words before reading instruction in dyslexia.
papers.authors: Banaszkiewicz A, Chyl-Tanaś K, Górecka H, Zielińska K, Redeł A, Szukało A, Dębska A, Jednoróg K.
papers.abstract: Reduced neural adaptation has been proposed as a neurophysiological characteristic of dyslexia, but it remains unclear whether such differences precede reading acquisition or emerge as a consequence of limited reading experience. Prior studies have focused on literate individuals, limiting developmental inferences. In this preregistered longitudinal fMRI study, children oversampled for dyslexia risk were scanned in kindergarten (prior to formal reading instruction) and again in third grade. Using the rapid adaptation paradigm, we examined neural adaptation to written words, false fonts, faces, houses and objects. Analyses focused on whole-brain effects and predefined regions of interest (ROI), including ventral occipito-temporal cortex (vOT). Dyslexic and control groups were case-control matched on age and reading skill at kindergarten. In ROI analyses, children who later developed dyslexia compared to controls showed reduced neural adaptation to written words in the left vOT already in kindergarten, despite matched pre-reading skills. This result was confirmed in individually-defined ROI analyses and was restricted to the anterior part of the vOT. The group difference remained stable across development. Across the full kindergarten sample (N = 59), adaptation to words in left vOT was modestly associated with prereading skills, including phonological awareness. No robust group differences were observed at the whole-brain level or for non-linguistic visual categories. These findings indicate small, region-specific differences in neural adaptation to print that are detectable prior to formal reading instruction. The absence of whole-brain effects and for non-linguistic visual categories suggests that neural adaptation differences in dyslexia are localized and domain-specific.

relevance.reason: 纵向fMRI研究阅读障碍高危儿童在阅读教学前对书面词的神经适应差异，涉及左侧vOT的视觉词形加工机制。

papers.title: Distinct oscillatory neural rhythms support representational precision and confidence in working memory.
papers.authors: Di Y, An X, Li HH.
papers.abstract: Working memory enables the maintenance of information to guide behavior, yet its representations are inherently noisy and variable. To act effectively, observers must track the uncertainty of their own memory. However, the neural mechanisms supporting uncertainty representations in working memory remain poorly understood, particularly at the level of neural dynamics. Here, we combined electroencephalography (EEG) with a spatial visual working memory task that elicited trial-by-trial uncertainty reports to investigate how oscillatory activity encodes memory uncertainty. We identified two forms of uncertainty supported by distinct oscillatory neural activity. Using a probabilistic encoding-decoding model, we found that memory content can be reconstructed from alpha-band activity and that the precision of these representations predicts subsequent uncertainty reports, consistent with probabilistic mnemonic representations. In parallel, beta-band activity contained a scalar, magnitude-based representation of uncertainty. This signal exhibited slow, persistent dynamics across task epochs and tracked uncertainty reports for both the current and previous trials. Together, these findings show that the human brain multiplexes two forms of memory uncertainty, representational precision and a scalar confidence signal, across distinct oscillatory rhythms, providing a neural dynamical account of metacognitive access to working memory.

relevance.reason: EEG研究揭示工作记忆不确定性表征的振荡神经机制，属认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注工作记忆中的不确定性如何在神经振荡活动中得到表征，结合脑电记录与要求逐试次报告不确定性的空间视觉工作记忆任务进行考察。作者发现，记忆内容可从alpha频段活动中重建，其表征精度能预测随后报告的不确定性，提示存在概率性的记忆表征；与此同时，beta频段活动携带一种基于量级的标量不确定性信号，该信号在任务各阶段持续存在，并同时追踪当前与前一试次的不确定性报告。作者据此提出，人脑通过不同振荡节律分别承载表征精度与标量信心信号这两种记忆不确定性，为元认知通达工作记忆提供了神经动力学层面的解释。

papers.title: Beyond "more synchrony": Frequency- and phase-specific effects of fronto-parietal theta tACS in enhancing episodic memory.
papers.authors: Aktürk T, Sack AT.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Theta oscillations support episodic memory and long-range communication between prefrontal and parietal regions. Transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) offers a way to test how theta dynamics influence memory. In our previous work, stimulation 1 Hz below the individual theta frequency (ITF-1) improved episodic memory, and this improvement was correlated with changes in fronto-parietal connectivity. Here, we tested whether dual-site fronto-parietal theta tACS produces frequency- and phase-specific aftereffects on episodic memory and theta-network dynamics. Neurotypical adults (N = 42) were assigned to ITF-1 or ITF+1 groups, with ITF estimated from pre-tACS resting-state EEG. Participants completed three counterbalanced sessions of dual-site tACS over left prefrontal and posterior-parietal locations: in-phase, anti-phase, and sham. Pre- and post-stimulation assessments included episodic memory measures, namely free recall and temporal order judgment (TOJ) with confidence ratings, as well as EEG recordings. TOJ accuracy showed a significant Session × Group interaction, driven by greater improvement in ITF-1 than ITF+1 following anti-phase stimulation. In ITF-1, confidence-accuracy discrimination (metacognitive separation) decreased after in-phase relative to anti-phase and sham. Resting-state, but not event-related, theta connectivity showed an anti-phase-specific divergence in fronto-parietal coupling, increasing in ITF-1 and decreasing in ITF+1. Within ITF-1 anti-phase, larger increases in resting-state fronto-parietal connectivity were associated with greater TOJ gains. These findings indicate phase-, frequency, and state-specific modulation of episodic memory and fronto-parietal theta networks by tACS. While the behavioral advantage of lower-frequency stimulation aligned with our hypothesis, the selective benefit of anti-phase stimulation suggests a more flexible, task-dependent reconfiguration of long-range connectivity rather than a uniform increase in synchrony.

relevance.reason: 研究额顶theta振荡tACS对情景记忆及额顶连接的影响，涉及人脑记忆网络与功能连接机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察额顶叶θ经颅交流电刺激（tACS）对情景记忆的影响是否随刺激频率和相位而异，并检验其与θ网络动态的关系。研究以神经典型成人为对象，比较个体θ频率上下偏移两种频率条件，并在同相、反相和伪刺激下结合情景记忆任务与脑电记录。结果显示，反相刺激下较低频率组的时序顺序判断改善更大；反相刺激还使静息态额顶叶θ连接在两组间出现方向相反的变化，且该变化与记忆改善相关，而同相刺激下元认知辨别有所下降。作者据此认为，tACS对记忆和额顶叶θ网络的作用具有相位、频率和状态特异性，反相刺激的益处更可能反映长程连接的任务依赖性重组，而非同步性的普遍增强。

papers.title: Beyond dual hubs: Task and aging shape taxonomic and thematic semantic relationships in the human brain.
papers.authors: Kuhnke P, Martin S, Chapman CA, Hartwigsen G.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Semantic knowledge about concepts and their relationships is central to human cognition. Taxonomic relationships link concepts belonging to the same category (e.g. dog and bear), while thematic relationships connect concepts co-occurring in the same events (e.g. dog and leash). The dual-hub theory proposes that taxonomic relations preferentially engage the anterior temporal lobe (ATL), whereas thematic relations preferentially involve the temporo-parietal cortex (TPC). However, it remains unclear whether taxonomic and thematic representations depend on the concurrent task and how they change with aging. The present fMRI study addressed these gaps by jointly investigating the effects of semantic relationship, task, and age on semantic processing. 41 young and 34 older adults performed taxonomic and thematic judgments on picture pairs that were taxonomically related, thematically related, or unrelated. Our results do not support the dual-hub theory: Both TPC and ATL preferentially responded to thematic over taxonomic relationships. Moreover, their activity was task-dependent. Semantic control regions flexibly responded to task-relevant semantic relations, while inhibiting task-irrelevant relations. Finally, aging was associated with a decline in domain-general and domain-specific semantic control, more bilateral ATL engagement, as well as behavioral and neural shifts from taxonomic towards thematic processing. Increased thematic activity was associated with higher accuracy but slower responses. These findings support accounts of age-related neural dedifferentiation and semanticization: Older adults require increased cognitive resources to maintain accuracy at a high level, but this comes at the cost of efficiency.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究语义关系（分类/主题）的脑表征及任务与老化影响，直接涉及语义加工的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用fMRI考察语义关系类型、任务与年龄如何共同影响语义加工，让年轻人和老年人对图片对做分类学或主题关系判断。结果不支持双枢纽理论：颞顶皮层和前颞叶都更偏好主题关系，且活动随任务变化，语义控制区会灵活处理任务相关关系并抑制无关关系。老化则表现为语义控制下降、前颞叶参与更双侧化，以及行为和神经层面向主题加工的偏移；主题活动增强与准确率更高但反应更慢相关，作者据此用神经去分化和语义化来解释老年人维持成绩所付出的效率代价。

papers.title: Dystextia due to impairment in spatial operation on a smartphone: A case report.
papers.authors: Hayakawa H, Hatakeyama M, Otsuki M, Takahashi T, Tsuboguchi S, Ishiguro T, Ishihara T, Onodera O.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Smartphone texting has become indispensable in modern life. Although dystextia (texting disability) has been reported, dystextia without aphasia or other cognitive impairment remains rare, and its pathophysiology is not fully understood. In Japanese text entry, the consonant is selected first on the screen, and the vowel is then determined by slide direction. Thus, accurate text input likely requires a sequence of processes, including segmentation of morae into consonants and vowels, followed by the spatial operation corresponding to each. Here, we report a patient with dystextia associated with impaired key-position and slide-direction processing. A 57-year-old right-handed Japanese woman developed difficulty with texting. Standard neuropsychological testing showed no aphasia, agraphia, or other cognitive impairment except for apraxia of speech and mild attention/executive dysfunction. Accordingly, dystextia was diagnosed. In addition, the patient had difficulty identifying keys corresponding to consonants and the slide direction corresponding to vowels. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a subcortical infarction in the left cerebral hemisphere. Single-photon emission tomography showed hypoperfusion, including in the left dorsolateral frontal lobe. The left frontal lobe is thought to contribute to spatial operations on digital devices. Therefore, diaschisis of the left dorsolateral frontal lobe secondary to the subcortical lesion may be associated with impairment of key-position and flick-direction processing, which may have contributed to dystextia in this patient.

papers.summary_zh: 该病例报告关注一例不伴失语或其他明显认知障碍的智能手机输入障碍（dystextia），患者为一名57岁右利手日本女性，因 texting 困难就诊，神经心理测评除言语失用和轻度注意/执行功能减退外未见失语、失写等异常。作者进一步发现，患者难以识别辅音对应的按键位置和元音对应的滑动方向，即日文输入所需的空间操作环节受损。影像学提示左半球皮层下梗死，并伴包括左侧背外侧额叶在内的灌注减低；作者据此推测，皮层下病灶继发的左侧背外侧额叶功能联系障碍可能影响按键位置与滑动方向加工，从而参与该患者的输入障碍。上述关联来自单例观察，机制解释仍属推测。

papers.title: Grounding meaning in social and emotional experience: Challenges and opportunities.
papers.authors: Solana P.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: Within the broader debate on how the mind and brain represent meaning, multiple representation theories have positioned social and emotional experience, along with their underlying neural systems, as key sources for concept grounding. In this article, I review the current evidence for this proposal and discuss several conceptual and methodological challenges, including the limited capacity of behavioral evidence to support this view, the difficulties associated with interpreting neuroimaging findings, the need for stronger causal evidence, and the importance of adopting open science practices. I argue that these limitations converge on a common concern: in their current form, many findings taken to support multiple representation theories of socio-affective grounding do not provide sufficiently diagnostic evidence to empirically adjudicate between them and competing accounts of semantic representation. In response, I outline a set of methodological recommendations and underexplored ideas that may help refine the theoretical framework, generate more decisive tests, and guide future research.

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕社会与情绪经验是否为概念意义提供基础这一问题，梳理了多重表征理论的相关证据。作者指出，现有行为证据的支持力有限，神经影像结果难以解释，且缺乏更强的因果证据，开放科学实践也有待加强；这些局限共同导致许多被视为支持社会—情绪 grounding 的发现，尚不足以在多重表征理论与竞争性语义表征理论之间做出判别。为此，文章提出若干方法学建议和尚未充分探索的思路，以期完善理论框架、设计更具决定性的检验并引导后续研究。

papers.title: Associations between chronic placental inflammation, fetal brain development and later autism traits.
papers.authors: Menu I, Ji L, Chen B, Bhatia T, Duffy M, Trapaga S, Jacques SM, Qureshi F, Eggebrecht A, Wheelock MD, Trentacosta CJ, Thomason ME.
papers.abstract: Prenatal inflammation is a recognized risk factor for autism spectrum disorder (ASD), but the neural pathways linking in utero immune exposure to later outcomes remain unclear. We examined whether chronic placental inflammation (CPI), a sustained immune response within the placenta, is associated with fetal brain functional connectivity differences and later ASD traits. A cohort of 105 pregnant individuals (85.7% African American/Black, 1.0% Asian American, 4.8% Bi-racial, 4.8% White, 1.0% Other, 2.9% Missing) underwent fetal resting-state fMRI between 24 and 38 weeks' gestation. After delivery, placental tissues were evaluated by expert pathologists for CPI lesions. Fetuses exposed to CPI (n = 44) showed significant differences in resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC) compared to non-exposed fetuses (n = 61) across ten network pairs, with the greatest effects in prefrontal, cerebellar, visual, and motor regions. These connectivity differences were associated with behavioral outcomes: cerebellar-medial visual RSFC was the strongest prenatal predictor of ASD traits at age 3. An exploratory structural equation modeling indicated that CPI was associated with reduced cerebellum-medial visual RSFC, which was associated with higher ASD trait scores, though the indirect pathway did not reach statistical significance. This study provides the first human evidence that chronic placental inflammation is associated with large-scale fetal brain network differences that are also associated with autism traits, suggesting that prenatal immune activity may be relevant to neurodevelopmental trajectories.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察孕期慢性胎盘炎症是否与胎儿脑功能连接差异及日后自闭症特质相关。孕妇在孕中晚期接受胎儿静息态功能磁共振扫描，分娩后由病理专家评估胎盘组织中的慢性炎症病变。暴露于慢性胎盘炎症的胎儿在多个网络间的功能连接上与未暴露胎儿存在差异，涉及前额叶、小脑、视觉和运动等区域；其中小脑与内侧视觉区的连接是3岁时自闭症特质最强的产前预测指标。探索性结构方程模型提示，慢性胎盘炎症与这一连接减弱相关，而连接减弱又与更高的自闭症特质得分相关，但间接路径未达统计显著。作者据此认为，这是首个人类证据，表明慢性胎盘炎症与胎儿大规模脑网络差异相关，而这些差异又与自闭症特质相关，提示孕期免疫活动可能与神经发育轨迹有关；由于为关联性设计且间接效应不显著，尚不能推断因果。

papers.title: Developmental reorganization of functional and structural connectivity in children's language networks is consistent with interactive specialization.
papers.authors: Mattie D, Peña-Castillo L, Levman J.
papers.abstract: Interactive Specialization hypothesizes that brain regions initially have poorly defined roles and gradually specialize through interactions with the environment and other brain regions during postnatal development. The mechanisms underlying language acquisition are without consensus, split between innate maturation and experience-dependent theories. We analyzed a four-year longitudinal dataset of children aged 5, 7, and 9, which included developmental surveys, psychoeducational tests, fMRI, and diffusion-weighted imaging data. We observed evidence of increased functional integration over time, with region-specific improvements in brain network efficiency and functional activity correlations changing substantially. Notably, the functional coupling between the left and right cerebral white matter regions changed significantly across this age window (z=-2.99,p=0.003), declining from a strong correlation of task-related BOLD activity at age 5 (ρ=0.85) to a substantially weaker correlation by age 9 (ρ=0.21). Within language-associated networks, relay-involved tracts were consistently longer than non-relay tracts (p<0.0001 at each age) and this gap widened between ages 5 and 9, whereas no comparable difference or developmental trend was observed in non-language networks, indicating a network-specific reconfiguration toward a more economical wiring configuration. While findings support the theory of interactive specialization, no direct link was found between daily activities and either language outcomes or network efficiency, and associations with standardized language ability were small and mixed in direction.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于儿童纵向影像数据，考察语言网络功能与结构连接在发育中的重组，以检验交互特化理论。结果显示，随时间推移脑网络功能整合增强，左右半球白质区域间任务相关活动的功能耦合明显减弱；语言相关网络中参与中继的纤维束更长，且这一差距随年龄扩大，而非语言网络未见类似模式，提示语言网络向更经济的布线配置重组。不过，日常活动与语言表现或网络效率之间未发现直接联系，与标准化语言能力的关联也较弱且方向不一，因此结果虽与交互特化相符，支持仍有限。

papers.title: The Effect of AoA-L2 on Functional Network Dynamics in Bilinguals.
papers.authors: Yang Y, Gao Z, Yang L, Jiang Y, Zeng H, Wang N, Liu X.
papers.abstract: Bilingual experiences have been shown to induce functional and structural neuroplasticity, yet how the age of second language acquisition (AoA-L2) shapes the functional network dynamics remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the effect of AoA-L2 on the temporal properties of dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) states and the variability of dFC and functional network topological organization in bilinguals by using resting-state fMRI data. Compared with late bilinguals, early bilinguals spent a greater proportion of time in sparsely connected states within the subcortical and ventral attention networks and exhibited greater variability of dFC involving multiple systems, including auditory, frontoparietal, subcortical, and attentional networks. In addition, the L2 proficiency was positively associated with the variability of dFC between the cingulo-opercular and default mode networks but negatively associated with the variability of dFC between the frontoparietal and visual networks. These findings suggest that AoA-L2 modulates the temporal flexibility of functional network organization, providing novel perspectives on the functional neuroplasticity induced by bilingualism.

papers.title: Periventricular and Perivascular-Space Diffusion MRI Measures, Amyloid Abnormality, and Executive Decline in the Alzheimer's Disease Continuum: A Longitudinal Study.
papers.authors: Chen C, Gu J, Hu Q, Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, Zhang J.
papers.journal: Journal of magnetic resonance imaging : JMRI
papers.abstract: Background Amyloid abnormality is a defining component of Alzheimer disease (AD) biology but does not fully account for variation in executive-function decline, which may also reflect white matter and periventricular injury. Purpose To compare periventricular diffusivity (PVeD), diffusion tensor image analysis along the perivascular space (ALPS), and G-Along Perivascular Space (G-ALPS), an algebraic variation of ALPS, as diffusion MRI measures in relation to amyloid abnormality and longitudinal executive-function decline. Study type Retrospective. Population The imaging-baseline cohort included 1190 participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) (70.6 ± 7.5 years; 666 female, 524 male). The primary analytic sample included 302 participants (70.6 ± 6.1 years; 168 female, 134 male). Field strength/sequence 3 T/diffusion-weighted spin-echo echo-planar imaging and 3D T1-weighted inversion-prepared gradient-echo imaging. Assessment PVeD, ALPS, and G-ALPS were evaluated in relation to cerebrospinal fluid Aβ42, amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) Centiloid, structural MRI measures, white matter hyperintensity (WMH), and longitudinal Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative Executive Function composite (ADNI-EF). Statistical tests Group comparisons, regression, longitudinal models, and bootstrap indirect-effect analyses with Benjamini-Hochberg correction were performed. Results All three diffusion MRI measures differed across diagnostic groups, with mean values of PVeD, ALPS, and G-ALPS showing lower levels in dementia than cognitively normal participants (PVeD: 0.456 ± 0.048 vs. 0.430 ± 0.047; ALPS: 1.291 ± 0.188 vs. 1.163 ± 0.186; G-ALPS: 1.757 ± 0.512 vs. 1.393 ± 0.467). G-ALPS showed the most consistent association with ADNI-EF trajectory (β = 0.031, 95% CI: 0.003-0.059). Exploratory models identified statistical indirect effects involving inverted CSF Aβ42, ADNI-EF decline, and PVeD (-0.0518), ALPS (-0.0407), or G-ALPS (-0.0460); all survived Benjamini-Hochberg correction, with a corresponding G-ALPS effect for amyloid PET Centiloid (-0.0169). Data conclusion Periventricular and perivascular-space diffusion MRI measures were associated with amyloid abnormality and executive-function decline, mainly in cognitively normal and mild cognitive impairment participants. Evidence level 3. Technical efficacy Stage 2.

papers.title: Human single-neuron recordings reveal population coding of attentional dynamics during naturalistic movie viewing
papers.authors: Cerquetella C, Qasim SE.
papers.abstract: Our eyes move constantly. Where they land is shaped by internal cognitive state, making eye movements a rare, non-invasive window onto that state. However, how moment-to-moment eye-movements map onto human neural population activity during naturalistic viewing remains poorly characterized. We analyzed a public intracranial dataset in which 14 neurosurgical patients watched an eight-minute movie during simultaneous eye-tracking and neuronal activity recording. Single-neuron activity from 814 neurons across anterior cingulate cortex, pre-supplementary motor area, amygdala, hippocampus, and ventromedial prefrontal cortex was pooled into a single distributed population and related to a joint eye-movement state comprising pupil size, saccade rate and fixation duration. Using a cross-validated, multivariate analysis of population activity we found group-level coupling between the neural population and the joint eye-movement state (mean held-out canonical r = 0.145; one-sample t-test p = 0.0003; 9 of 14 subjects individually significant). The coupling was carried principally by saccade dynamics (r = 0.141) and pupil size (r = 0.094), with fixation duration contributing only marginally (r = 0.041). At the single-neuron level the picture differed: more neurons were eye-coupled than expected by chance, yet so weakly that almost none survived correction for multiple comparisons. Read out jointly, the same weakly coupled cells cohered into one reliable population dimension, and no single region’s removal significantly reduced it. This pattern is more consistent with a distributed, redundant organization than with a small set of strongly coupled cells. In summary, eye-tracking offers a non-invasive window onto population-level neural states in humans.

relevance.reason: 颅内单神经元记录揭示自然电影观看中注意动态（眼动状态）的分布式群体编码，属自然刺激下的人脑认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注自然观看电影时眼动指标能否反映人脑群体神经活动，分析了神经外科患者观看影片期间同步记录的眼动与颅内神经元活动，并将多个脑区的单神经元活动汇总为分布式群体信号，与由瞳孔大小、扫视率和注视时长构成的联合眼动状态做交叉验证的多变量关联。结果显示，群体神经活动与联合眼动状态存在组水平耦合，主要由扫视动态和瞳孔大小贡献，注视时长作用很小；单神经元层面虽有不少细胞与眼动相关，但相关很弱，几乎都未通过多重比较校正，而将这些弱相关细胞联合读出时却形成一个可靠的群体维度，且移除任一脑区均未显著削弱该维度。作者据此认为，这更符合分布式、冗余的编码组织，而非少数强耦合细胞，并提示眼动追踪可作为观察人类群体水平神经状态的非侵入窗口。

papers.title: Diffusion MR Microscopy of the Human Hippocampus at 50 μm Resolution at 14.1 T for 3D Virtual Histology
papers.authors: Shen Y, Yu Z, Zhu Q, Zhao Z, Wang P, Yin Y, Jiang P, Wang C, Kong X, Zhang J, Wu D.
papers.abstract: Bridging the gap between macroscopic neuroimaging and microscopic histology remains a challenge in neuroscience. Here, we present a technical feasibility study of diffusion MR microscopy (dMRM) in the ex vivo human hippocampus using a 14.1 T ultrahigh-field MRI system. Mid-hippocampal blocks from control and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) patients were acquired at 50 × 50 × 100 µm³, representing, to our knowledge, the highest resolution reported for human brain diffusion MRI. At a spatial scale approaching cellular dimensions, dMRM maps and tractography showed close correspondence with immunohistological markers of axons and dendrites. The acquired data delineated six hippocampal laminae, distinguished the inner and outer molecular layers, and preserved short, lamina-specific trajectories that became attenuated or blurred at 100 µm resolution. Tractography further depicted the major components of the hippocampal tri-synaptic circuit—the perforant path, mossy fibers, and Schaffer collaterals in 3D. In the AD specimen, dMRM revealed reduced laminar contrast, local discontinuities, and altered radial and tangential fibers that were paralleled by pathological staining. With the 3D nondestructive characterization of human brain microstructure and circuitry, ex vivo dMRM showed its potential toward the goal of 3D virtual histology.

relevance.reason: 该研究以超高场扩散MRI显微成像刻画人海马微结构、层状结构与三突触环路纤维轨迹，属脑结构组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该技术可行性研究在14.1 T超高场系统上对离体人海马组织进行扩散磁共振显微成像，以接近细胞尺度的分辨率获取图像并与免疫组织学标记对照。结果显示，该方法能分辨海马六个层板及内、外分子层，保留在较低分辨率下被削弱或模糊的短程层板特异纤维轨迹，并在三维中呈现三突触环路的主要通路；在阿尔茨海默病标本中，层板对比下降、局部不连续及纤维改变与病理染色所见相平行。作者据此认为，离体扩散磁共振显微成像有望用于人脑微结构和环路的无损三维表征，服务于三维虚拟组织学目标，但该研究仍属技术可行性验证。

papers.title: Naturalistic narrative listening reveals a core brain network for detecting moral information
papers.authors: Klincewicz M, Collin SH.
papers.abstract: Moral cognition is a complex process, which recruits a wide range of mechanisms. It is not clear whether any of them reliably reflects moral content in the stimulus. We set out to test whether a specific mechanism of moral content representation and/or detection exists, and where it is, if it exists. To that end we used uniand multi-variate analyses, including inter-subject pattern correlation, on functional MRI recordings of people listening to naturalistic narratives with moral content. We discovered a core brain network for detecting moral content, which prominently involves the TPJ, MTG/STG, among other regions. Moral content is reliably detected across narratives and participants, independent of instructions to do so, prominently involving the TPJ that functions as a detector. We identify specific regions for moral features, such as vices/virtues. Our methods and results open a path to further understand how the brain processes specific features of moral content.

relevance.reason: 用自然叙事fMRI研究道德信息检测的脑网络与区域表征，属社会认知神经机制且为自然刺激范式。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑是否存在稳定表征和检测道德内容的特定机制，并利用功能磁共振记录被试聆听含道德内容的自然叙事，结合单变量与多变量分析（包括被试间模式相关）进行考察。结果显示，一个以颞顶联合区、颞中回和颞上回等为核心节点的脑网络能够可靠地检测道德内容，这种检测在不同叙事和被试间均较稳定，且不依赖是否被要求关注道德信息，其中颞顶联合区突出表现为检测器。研究还识别出与恶行、美德等具体道德特征相关的区域，为理解大脑如何加工道德内容的具体特征提供了线索。

papers.title: Functionally Informed Hand Knob Reveals Structural Connectome Differences in Motor-Eloquent Tumours.
papers.authors: Prakashvel S, Sinosi F, Ferrari L, Fayez F, Patel S, Chowdhury YA, Perera A, Kalyal N, Awan M, Diaz-Baamonde A, Mirallave-Pescador A, Ashkan K, Bhangoo R, Vergani F, Lavrador JP.
papers.abstract: Background: Brain tumours impose complex, spatially heterogeneous disturbances on neural circuits that extend far beyond the immediate lesion site. While gross anatomical displacement of the cortico-spinal tract (CST) has been extensively studied, the topological reorganization of the functionally informed structural connectome-and its dependence on tumour molecular phenotype-remains incompletely understood. Objectives: This study aimed to characterize upper-limb functionally informed network topology in brain tumour patients, identify histological and molecular patterns of structural reorganization at the cortical and subcortical level, and determine the impact on neurophysiological parameters. Methods: Forty-eight patients with supratentorial motor-eloquent tumours (MET's) underwent diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) as part of their preoperative motor mapping. Connectivity matrices based on streamline passing counts were extracted from 426 nodes of the HCPex atlas using DSI Studio® upon seeding the structural connectome in the motor hotspot (best motor response) for the functional area of the upper limb identified using preoperative navigated transcranial magnetic stimulation (nTMS). Paired-sample t -tests compared tumour versus healthy hemispheres across network topology metrics. The impact of nTMS-derived excitability metrics-interhemispheric resting motor threshold ratio (iRMTr) and cortical silent period (CSP)-and tumour histological and molecular characteristics on the connectome was assessed. Results: The global network topology of the tumour hemisphere was preserved when compared to the healthy baseline hemisphere across all tumour types (p > 0.05). Subcortical analysis revealed significant hyper-connectivity in the tumour hemisphere, with elevated degree, strength, clustering coefficient, local efficiency, and eigenvector centrality (p < 0.05). Basal ganglia motor loop degree was increased in the tumour hemisphere (mean 7.37 versus 5.19; p = 0.0009). IDH-mutant tumours generated significantly more topologically organized compensatory networks than IDH-wildtype tumours (Clustering Coefficient 0.345 versus 0.273; p = 0.018). Of the cortical nodes on the side of the tumour, significant hyper-connectivity was seen in the supplementary motor area (p = 0.0011), premotor cortex (Area 6), with increased connection seen in 6 mp (medial premotor at p =0.0033) and 6 d (dorsal premotor at p = 0.025) and primary somatosensory cortex (p = 0.027). The presence of the tumour induced significant changes across all three domains: loss of CST volume (p < 0.001), prolongation of the cortical silent period indicative of intracortical inhibition (p < 0.0001), with significant prolongation in glioblastoma versus an oligodendroglioma. Conclusions: Brain tumours significantly impact the upper limb-centred structural connectome. While global network topology is preserved, tumours induce substantial subcortical and basal ganglia network reorganization by inducing compensatory hyper-connectivity. These findings suggest that structural connectomics offers a novel framework for non-invasive tumour characterization and surgical planning.

relevance.reason: 研究运动区肿瘤患者的结构连接组重组及其与皮层兴奋性关系，属脑结构-功能与脑疾病机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以48例幕上运动功能区肿瘤患者为对象，结合术前导航经颅磁刺激定位的上肢运动热点与弥散加权成像，构建以功能热点为种子的结构连接组，比较肿瘤侧与健康侧的网络拓扑，并考察肿瘤组织学和分子特征及神经生理指标与连接组变化的关系。结果显示，肿瘤侧全局网络拓扑基本保留，但皮层下出现显著超连接，基底节运动环路连接增强，辅助运动区、前运动区和初级感觉皮层等节点连接升高；IDH突变型肿瘤较野生型形成更有拓扑组织的代偿网络。肿瘤还伴随皮质脊髓束体积下降和皮质静息期延长，提示皮层内抑制改变。作者据此认为，结构连接组学可为肿瘤的无创刻画和手术规划提供参考框架，但相关发现属组间关联，尚不能直接推及治疗效应。

papers.title: Eye-tracking studies on developmental language disorder: a systematic review.
papers.authors: Liu Z, Jiang Q.
papers.abstract: Developmental language disorder (DLD) is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by persistent difficulties in language acquisition and processing. While traditional behavioral and neurophysiological methods have provided valuable insights, eye-tracking has emerged as a powerful tool for capturing real-time cognitive processing during language comprehension. However, evidence from eye-tracking studies in DLD remains underrepresented and fragmented across linguistic domains and experimental paradigms. This systematic review synthesizes 33 empirical studies and examines how eye-tracking has been used to investigate real-time language processing in children with DLD. The review focuses on three key dimensions: (a) cognitive-linguistic domains addressed, (b) paradigms and eye-movement metrics employed, and (c) recurring processing differences between children with DLD and typically developing (TD) counterparts. The synthesis reveals three broadly consistent processing patterns in DLD: slower processing efficiency, reduced predictive processing, and increased reliance on semantic cues over morphosyntactic information. These patterns suggest that language difficulties in DLD are not solely attributable to representational deficits but are closely linked to inefficiencies in real-time integration and competition resolution during language processing. By consolidating findings across paradigms, this review provides a cognitively grounded account of DLD and highlights the role of eye-tracking in uncovering underlying processing mechanisms. Implications for theoretical models of language processing and future methodological directions are discussed.

relevance.reason: 系统综述用眼动追踪考察发展性语言障碍儿童实时语言加工机制，聚焦语言认知加工而非仅行为筛查。
