papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨视觉拥挤中的视野不对称究竟是拥挤的普遍属性，还是仅见于熟悉字母的识别。作者在三个实验中分别测量拉丁字母、视觉特征匹配的伪字母、Landolt方块和面孔图标在左右视野的拥挤距离，发现只有字母的拥挤距离在右视野显著更小，且这一不对称在字母上强于其他刺激，即使目标字母被不熟悉的伪字母包围仍然存在。替换错误模式和个体间相关进一步支持了刺激特异性机制。作者据此提出，阅读经验可能强化左半球语言区与左半球视觉皮层的连接，形成对右视野空间调谐更精细的字母加工机制。

papers.title: Dynamic Functional Connectivity of Amygdala and Hippocampus in Posttraumatic Stress Disorder: A Multi-Site Study of the ENIGMA PTSD Consortium
papers.authors: Sun D, Group EPW.
papers.abstract: Abstract The amygdala and hippocampus are central to neural models of posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), yet their dynamic functional interactions with distributed brain networks remain poorly characterized, particularly in large, diverse samples. We analyzed resting-state functional MRI data from the ENIGMA PTSD Working Group, comprising 2,721 participants from 32 international sites: 1,017 individuals with PTSD (38.6 ± 15.2 years; 52.0% female) and 1,704 controls (38.4 ± 17.1 years; 45.8% female; 78.6% trauma-exposed). After standardized preprocessing with HALFpipe , we computed dynamic functional connectivity (DFC) as the standard deviation of functional connectivity across sliding windows (window length = 40 seconds, overlap = 50%) for bilateral amygdala and hippocampal seeds across 1,726 seed-to-parcel connections spanning cortical, subcortical, and cerebellar regions. Linear mixed-effects models through IBMMA tested the effect of PTSD diagnosis across all connections, and within significant connections, secondary analyses examined modulation by sex, age, index trauma, depression severity, and childhood trauma severity, along with associations with overall PTSD symptom severity and symptom clusters (B–E). All findings survived false discovery rate correction ( q < .05). Individuals with PTSD compared to controls showed greater DFC between the seeds and 22 regions spanning control, salience/ventral attention, dorsal attention, somatomotor, default mode, and visual networks. Case-control differences were moderated by sex and present in males only. PTSD severity and symptom clusters were positively associated with most of the connections. These findings indicate that PTSD is accompanied by greater temporal variability in connectivity between amygdala and hippocampal seeds and widespread brain networks.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）中杏仁核与海马和全脑网络之间动态功能连接的改变，利用ENIGMA PTSD联盟多站点静息态功能磁共振数据，以滑动窗口计算动态连接并与对照组比较。结果显示，PTSD患者这两个种子区与多个涉及控制、凸显/腹侧注意、背侧注意、感觉运动、默认模式及视觉网络的区域之间动态连接变异性更高，且这种病例对照差异仅见于男性；PTSD严重程度及多数症状簇与这些连接呈正相关。作者据此认为，PTSD伴随杏仁核和海马与广泛脑网络连接的时间变异性增强，但该发现来自横断面组间关联，尚不能说明因果或临床疗效。

papers.title: From localized to long-range: functional connectivity alterations in mild to moderate chronic low back pain patients.
papers.authors: Hu HJ, Wang LY, Deng JY, Lin Y, Ding ZX, Tang X, Zhu YD, Ge XH, Zhang H, Yu L, Zhang LQ.
papers.journal: Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery
papers.abstract: Background Mild pain can influence brain function, yet its central neurobiological mechanisms in chronic low back pain (CLBP) remain insufficiently defined. This study aimed to quantitatively evaluate localized and long-range functional connectivity (FC) alterations in patients with mild to moderate CLBP using static/dynamic regional homogeneity (sReHo/dReHo) and seed-based FC, and to assess their statistical relationships with clinical pain and psychological metrics. Methods A total of 55 mild to moderate CLBP patients and 39 healthy controls (HCs) underwent 3.0 T resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) and clinical assessments, including Visual Analogue Scale (VAS), Short-Form of the McGill Pain Questionnaire (SF-MPQ), Self-Rating Anxiety Scale (SAS), Self-Rating Depression Scale (SDS), and Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI). sReHo and dReHo (sliding window =50 TRs, step size =5 TRs) maps were computed to identify abnormal localized brain regions. Brain regions showing significant group differences were selected as seeds (6-mm spherical regions of interest, ROIs) for whole-brain FC analysis. Statistical comparisons were corrected using Gaussian random field (GRF) theory (voxel-level P<0.005, cluster-level P<0.05). Partial correlation analyses were used to control for age, sex, education, and head motion (Bonferroni-corrected threshold P<0.007). Results Compared with HCs, patients exhibited significantly reduced sReHo in the third cerebellar vermis (peak t=-4.253, GRF P<0.05), alongside reduced dReHo in the right parahippocampal gyrus (t=-4.796, GRF P<0.05) and left inferior temporal gyrus (t=-3.935, GRF P<0.05). Seed-based FC analysis revealed decreased connectivity between the third cerebellar vermis and right hippocampus (t=-4.678, GRF P<0.05), and increased connectivity between the left inferior temporal gyrus and left pallidus (t=4.441, GRF P<0.05). Patients showed significantly higher SAS anxiety scores (25.15±5.01 vs. 23.08±2.18, P=0.008). Correlation analyses demonstrated that sReHo in the third cerebellar vermis was negatively correlated with SAS scores (r=-0.384, P=0.005), whereas FC between the left inferior temporal gyrus and left pallidus was positively correlated with SF-MPQ sensory (r=0.381, P=0.006), affective (r=0.386, P=0.005), and total scores (r=0.445, P=0.001). Conclusions Patients with mild to moderate CLBP exhibit distinct localized and long-range FC alterations within cerebello-hippocampal and cortico-basal ganglia pathways. These neurofunctional changes may contribute to the integration of subjective pain dimensions and comorbid anxiety. Combining static/dynamic ReHo with seed-based FC provides complementary neurobiological insight into how low-intensity chronic pain may affect the central nervous system and highlights the importance of early clinical recognition.
keywords: Mild To Moderate Chronic Low Back Pain

relevance.reason: 研究轻中度慢性腰痛患者静息态局部与长程功能连接改变及其与疼痛/焦虑的关系，属人脑自发活动与网络组织及疼痛情绪认知加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对轻中度慢性腰痛患者，结合静态与动态局部一致性及种子点功能连接，考察其局部与长程功能连接改变及其与疼痛、心理指标的关系。结果发现，患者小脑蚓部、海马旁回及颞下回等区域的局部一致性降低，小脑蚓部与海马连接减弱，而颞下回与苍白球连接增强；小脑蚓部局部一致性与焦虑评分负相关，颞下回-苍白球连接则与疼痛感觉、情感及总分正相关。作者认为，小脑-海马及皮层-基底节通路的功能改变可能参与主观疼痛维度与焦虑的整合，提示低强度慢性疼痛对中枢神经系统的影响值得早期关注。

papers.title: Rapid cortical mapping with cross-participant encoding models.
papers.authors: Tang J, Huth AG.
papers.abstract: Voxelwise encoding models trained on functional MRI data can produce detailed maps of cortical organization. However, voxelwise encoding models must be trained on many hours of brain responses from each participant, limiting clinical applications. In this study, we introduce a cross-participant modeling framework for rapid cortical mapping. In this framework, voxelwise encoding models are trained on many hours of brain responses from previously scanned reference participants, and then transferred to a new participant by aligning brain responses using a small set of stimuli. We evaluated cross-participant encoding models on linguistic semantic mapping, non-linguistic semantic mapping, and auditory mapping. In each case, we found that cross-participant encoding models had more accurate selectivity estimates and prediction performance than within-participant encoding models trained on the same amount of data from the new participant. We also found that cross-participant encoding models improved with the amount of data from each reference participant and the number of reference participants. These results demonstrate that cross-participant modeling can substantially reduce the amount of data required for detailed cortical mapping, which may facilitate new clinical applications of functional neuroimaging.

relevance.reason: 用跨被试fMRI编码模型绘制皮层组织图，评估语言语义、非语言语义与听觉映射，属人脑功能组织与语言/认知表征研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对逐体素编码模型需为每位参与者采集大量fMRI数据、难以用于临床的问题，提出跨参与者建模框架：先用既往参考参与者的长时间脑反应训练模型，再借助少量刺激对齐，将模型迁移到新参与者。作者在语言语义、非语言语义和听觉映射三类任务上评估，发现跨参与者模型在新参与者数据量相同时，选择性和预测表现均优于其自身训练的模型，且随参考参与者数据量和人数增加而改善。结果表明，该方法可大幅减少详细皮层映射所需的数据量，有望推动功能神经影像的新临床应用。

papers.title: Conscious vision: investigating visual hallucination awareness in Lewy body disease.
papers.authors: Conti D, Accinni T, Teghil A, Ffytche D, Zazzaro G, Panigutti M, Bechi Gabrielli G, Suppa A, Fiorelli M, Caramia F, Bruno G, Guariglia C, D'Antonio F.
papers.abstract: Visual awareness includes the ability to distinguish internally generated sensory experience from veridical percepts derived from the external world. Visual hallucinations (VHs) are an example of internally generated experience with important clinical implications and are common in Lewy body disease (LBD), with some patients aware of their hallucinations and others not. The awareness difference between LBD patients provides an opportunity to study the neural and neuropsychological mechanisms of hallucination awareness (VH-awareness). We hypothesized that VH-awareness would be associated with functional brain alterations in terms of resting-state functional connectivity (rs-FC) within and between cerebral systems involved in VH (intra-/inter-network rs-FC). In this cross-sectional study, we focused on visual association areas and networks (VIS) engaged in prediction errors (PEs) and reality monitoring, comparing LBD patients with preserved awareness of VH (VH-aware) to those with impaired awareness of VH (VH-unaware). Compared to the VH-aware group, the VH-unaware group showed reduced rs-FC between the VIS and PE in the right hemisphere, with no differences in rs-FC within each individual system. This suggests that VH-unawareness in LBD might reflect disruptions in implicit, online awareness processes and, specifically, may depend on impaired functional coupling between the brain regions providing perceptual contents to the hallucinatory experience and those evaluating its congruency with internal predictions. Furthermore, VH-unaware patients exhibited deficits in executive functioning, aligning with altered PE mechanisms and visuoperceptual abilities, which may represent the primary dysfunction defining VH content. Although preliminary, our findings provide a foundation for further investigations into VH-awareness in LBD and a model of visual awareness set within a general framework of perception, hallucination and consciousness. Future research will need to explore the proposed awareness model in diverse clinical populations to further unveil the mechanisms and wider clinical implications of one of the most distinctive aspects of brain function.

relevance.reason: 研究路易体病患者视幻觉觉察的静息态功能连接与执行功能机制，涉及意识/感知的脑网络组织及疾病相关脑改变。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注路易体病患者对自身视幻觉是否具有觉察，并比较有觉察与无觉察两组患者在静息态功能连接上的差异。结果显示，无觉察组在右半球视觉联合区与参与预测误差处理的系统之间连接减弱，而各系统内部连接未见差异；无觉察组还表现出执行功能缺陷。作者据此提出，视幻觉无觉察可能反映隐性的在线觉察过程受损，尤其依赖提供幻觉 perceptual 内容的脑区与评估其与内部预测一致性的脑区之间耦合异常，但强调结果尚属初步，需在更多临床人群中验证。

papers.title: Reproducible human reward imaging phenotypes exhibit differential sensitivity to dopamine D2 receptor antagonism.
papers.authors: Sambuco N, Lupo A, Hawkins PCT, Selvaggi P, Antonucci LA, Bertolino A, Blasi G, Di Palo P, Grassi L, Grasso D, Homan P, Leggio GM, Massari F, Monteleone AM, Osugo M, Passiatore R, Raio A, Rampino A, Banaschewski T, Barker GJ, Bokde ALW, Brühl R, Desrivières S, Flor H, Garavan H, Gowland P, Grigis A, Heinz A, Martinot JL, Martinot MP, Artiges E, Nees F, Orfanos DP, Poustka L, Smolka MN, Holz N, Vaidya N, Walter H, Whelan R, Schumann G, IMAGEN Consortium, Apulian Network on Risk for Psychosis, Howes OD, Mehta MA, Pergola G.
papers.abstract: Human reward processing varies along cue-centric and outcome-centric axes, but the mechanistic basis of individual variation in incentive salience attribution remains incompletely characterized. Here we show, using fMRI across five cohorts (N-total = 1251; N1 = 890; N2 = 245; N3 = 34; N4 = 48; N5 = 34), two reproducible imaging phenotypes mirroring sign- and goal-tracking (ST-like, GT-like). ST-like individuals showed dominant ventral striatal responses to reward-anticipation cues and sustained incentive salience attribution; GT-like individuals showed heightened responses to reward outcomes. This distinction was replicable across sites and independent samples. Single-dose and repeated-dose D2 /D3 antagonism (risperidone, haloperidol, amisulpride) selectively reduced anticipatory ventral striatal activity in ST, with single-dose antagonism additionally producing a parallel drop in self-reported energy. Instead, D2 /D3 partial agonism (aripiprazole) increased anticipatory and reduced outcome-phase responses in GT. In a psychosis cohort, antipsychotic D2 affinity was associated with blunted anticipatory signals and higher negative symptom burden, offering a neuroimaging-driven basis for stratifying patients and predicting response to dopaminergic agents.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究揭示人类奖赏加工的可重复神经表型及其对多巴胺D2受体拮抗的敏感性，属奖赏神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人类奖赏加工中线索导向与结果导向的个体差异是否有可重复的影像表型及其对多巴胺D2受体药物的敏感性，基于多个独立队列的功能磁共振数据识别出两类可重复表型。类线索追踪者主要在线索预期阶段表现出较强的腹侧纹状体反应，类结果追踪者对奖赏结果反应更强，这一区分在不同站点和样本中可重复。D2/D3拮抗剂选择性降低前者的预期性腹侧纹状体活动，部分激动剂则在后者中产生相反方向的变化；在精神病性障碍队列中，药物D2亲和性与预期信号减弱及阴性症状负担相关，提示该分型或有助于预测多巴胺能药物反应，但尚属关联性证据。

papers.title: Severe PTSD symptoms magnify episodic memory-encoding deficits and amygdala-ACC attenuation during unpredictable threat in male combat veterans.
papers.authors: Aberg KC, Efrati S, Idan S, Merzbach R, Paz R, Doenyas-Barak K.
papers.abstract: PTSD is marked by atypical coupling between emotion and learning, yet it remains unclear how threat that is situational (the presence of potential danger) shapes episodic memory. We investigated whether unpredictability-driven threat alters incidental memory formation as a function of PTSD symptom severity (PTSDss). Sixty male combat veterans underwent fMRI scanning during incidental encoding of everyday objects presented under unpredictable threat (U), predictable threat (P), or no threat (N). Threat was operationalized as potential exposure to a highly aversive sound. An unexpected recognition test followed 90 min later. We related memory (hit rates), subjective anxiety, and encoding-related BOLD activity to PTSDss assessed with CAPS-5. Greater PTSDss predicted heightened anxiety and poorer memory for items specifically presented under unpredictable threat. While amygdala and dorsal anterior cingulate activity during encoding tracked overall memory success, these responses were attenuated with increasing PTSDss in the U condition. By linking unpredictable threat to both behavioral and neural markers of disrupted episodic memory encoding, the study helps explain how memory-related symptoms may develop and persist in PTSD.

relevance.reason: 研究PTSD症状严重程度如何调节不可预测威胁下情景记忆编码的脑活动（杏仁核-前扣带），属脑疾病相关的认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察情境性威胁（尤其是不可预测威胁）如何影响情景记忆编码，以及这一过程是否随创伤后应激障碍症状严重程度而变化。男性退伍军人在功能磁共振扫描中完成日常物品的 incidental 编码任务，物品分别出现在不可预测威胁、可预测威胁或无威胁条件下，随后进行意外再认测验。结果显示，症状越重，焦虑越高，且仅在不可预测威胁下对物品的记忆越差；编码期杏仁核与前扣带活动虽与总体记忆成绩相关，但在不可预测威胁下随症状加重而减弱。作者据此认为，不可预测威胁下的记忆编码行为与神经标记受损，可能有助于解释PTSD中记忆相关症状的形成与持续。

papers.title: Longitudinal NODDI-DTI assessment of brain recovery following CPAP in obstructive sleep apnea: Tissue-compartment changes in white and gray matter.
papers.authors: Shiraishi T, Murakawa-Hirachi T, Nogami K, Ohgidani M, Natsuaki M, Nishihara M, Kunitake Y, Tateishi H, Matsushima J, Kunitake H, Orihashi R, Kojima R, Oishi J, Kikuchi J, Nagahama C, Takada K, Hirano M, Shiba S, Fukai A, Tomonari A, Inayoshi D, Node K, Monji A, Mizoguchi Y.
papers.abstract: Objectives Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) can partially reverse brain abnormalities associated with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), but the biological substrates underlying this recovery remain unclear. We investigated whether diffusion MRI could identify tissue-compartment changes associated with brain recovery following CPAP. Methods Thirteen adults with OSA underwent paired brain MRI before and after 3 months of CPAP treatment. Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging (NODDI) were analyzed using tract-based spatial statistics (TBSS; n = 13) and gray matter-based spatial statistics (GBSS; n = 10). Exploratory region-of-interest (ROI) analyses were performed across 102 Gy matter regions. Voxel-wise analyses used permutation-based inference with threshold-free cluster enhancement and family-wise error (FWE) correction. Results CPAP produced three coordinated white matter changes that survived FWE correction: FA increased in 7 of 10 examined tracts, restricted to the left hemisphere; AD increased bilaterally across all 10 tracts; and ODI decreased bilaterally across all 10 tracts. No significant changes were detected in RD, MD, NDI, or FWF within white matter. In gray matter, FWE-corrected analysis identified increased FA in the right cerebellar Crus II and decreased FWF in the left medial orbitofrontal cortex. Exploratory ROI analysis suggested widespread cortical microstructural changes and distinct diffusivity patterns in subcortical regions, with changes concentrated within default mode and salience networks. AHI was significantly reduced following CPAP, and HAMD scores improved. Conclusions CPAP-induced brain recovery was characterized by coordinated, tissue-specific diffusion changes after 3 months of treatment. The combination of DTI and NODDI identified orientation-dispersion changes that are not captured by conventional DTI, while the absence of RD and NDI changes suggests that early recovery may precede detectable remyelination or neurite-density changes. These findings support NODDI-based tissue-compartment imaging as a promising approach for investigating the biological basis of brain recovery following CPAP in OSA.

relevance.reason: 纵向扩散MRI/NODDI研究OSA患者CPAP后白质与灰质微结构恢复，属脑疾病治疗相关的脑结构可塑性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨持续气道正压通气（CPAP）治疗阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停后脑恢复的组织层面机制，对患者治疗前后进行扩散MRI，结合DTI与NODDI分析白质和灰质微结构。结果显示，治疗3个月后白质出现协调的组织特异性变化：部分纤维束各向异性分数升高且局限于左半球，轴向扩散双侧升高，方向离散度指数双侧降低，而径向扩散、平均扩散率及神经突密度指数未见显著变化；灰质中亦发现局部各向异性分数与自由水分数改变。作者认为，这些方向离散变化是常规DTI难以捕捉的，而径向扩散和神经突密度指标无变化提示早期恢复可能先于可检测的髓鞘再生或神经突密度改变，支持基于NODDI的组织分区成像用于研究CPAP后脑恢复的生物学基础。

papers.title: Cortical thickness and functional connectivity in occipitotemporal and frontal regions are critical for Chinese children's reading development.
papers.authors: Ding J, Chen S, Wang J, Feng C, Allan E, Li S.
papers.abstract: Learning to read is one of the most important missions in child development. Understanding the neural basis of this process supports the early diagnosis and intervention of reading difficulties in children. Most neuroscience studies on children's reading development are based on alphabetic languages. Chinese is a logographic language with different linguistic features. However, it remains unclear how structural and intrinsic functional network measures jointly characterize Chinese children's reading development and its change over time. In this study, we addressed this question using the Chinese Color Nest Project dataset, which included 184 children's cross-sectional and longitudinal reading tests and multimodal MRI images between 6 and 14 years old. We found that cortical thickness and functional connectivity in the bilateral frontal and occipital lobes were associated with Chinese children's reading development. Among these relations, only the reading-related functional connectivity between frontal lobes was moderated by age. In the prediction model, both the frontal and occipital lobes' structure and function predicted children's reading performance cross-sectionally, while mainly the occipital lobe contributed to reading performance longitudinally. In summary, using a large and multimodal dataset, this study systematically revealed the unique neural substrates of Chinese children's reading development. These findings contribute to an enhanced understanding of neural differences shaped by culture and language, providing insights for new targeted interventions for reading difficulties among Chinese children.

relevance.reason: 研究汉语儿童阅读发展的皮层厚度与功能连接神经基础，属语言与脑结构功能关系。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注汉语儿童阅读发展的神经基础，利用中国儿童脑发育队列的多模态MRI与横纵向阅读测验数据，考察皮层厚度和功能连接如何共同刻画阅读发展及其随时间的变化。结果显示，双侧额叶和枕叶的皮层厚度与功能连接均与阅读发展相关，其中仅额叶间与阅读相关的功能连接受年龄调节；横向上额叶和枕叶的结构与功能均能预测阅读表现，纵向上则主要由枕叶贡献。作者据此指出，这揭示了汉语儿童阅读发展独特的神经基础，有助于理解文化与语言塑造的神经差异，并为阅读困难干预提供线索。

papers.title: Principal spatiotemporal pattern mapping detects brain activity partially decoupled with task timing.
papers.authors: Xie R, Wang Z, Li L, Guo S, Zhang X, Feng X, Yang Z, Liu Y, Lui S, Zhao Y, Wu M.
papers.abstract: Neural activity arises from interactions between bottom-up sensory inputs and top-down information process, and thus may not be strictly time-locked to external task stimuli in function MRI (fMRI). Such temporal decoupling between stimuli and neural responses challenges the generalized linear model (GLM) that assumes fMRI signals as a convolution of a prior hemodynamic response function (HRF) with task timings, potentially leading to incomplete detections of task-evoked brain activations. To address this issue, we developed an HRF-model-free framework that detects task-evoked brain activations by capturing spatiotemporal pattern of fMRI signals within functional topography in the brain. Using this framework, we investigated neural dynamics of participants engaged in Human Connectome Project (HCP) emotion tasks. We identified neural activations in prefrontal subregions that exhibit partial temporal decoupling from task timing, rendering them undetectable by the GLM. These activations are likely driven by implicit events emerging from top-down information processes following the reception of external stimuli. Together, these findings suggest that task-evoked neural dynamics are shaped not only by externally events but also by autonomous cognitive process, underscoring the complex and interactive nature of brain function and highlighting the need for new analytical frameworks for task-based fMRI.

relevance.reason: 开发无HRF模型的任务fMRI分析方法，检测到与任务时序部分解耦的前额叶激活，反映自上而下认知加工，属认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对功能磁共振中神经活动可能与任务刺激时间不完全锁定的问题，指出常用的广义线性模型因预设血流动力学响应函数，可能漏检这类任务诱发激活。作者开发了一种不依赖该响应函数模型的框架，通过捕捉脑内功能拓扑中的时空模式来检测激活，并将其用于分析参与者在情绪任务中的神经动态。结果显示，前额叶部分亚区存在与任务时间部分解耦的激活，这些激活无法被广义线性模型检出，可能由外部刺激后自上而下的信息处理所引发的内隐事件驱动。作者据此认为，任务诱发的神经动态既受外部事件塑造，也受自主认知过程影响，提示需要新的分析框架来研究任务态功能磁共振数据。

papers.title: Hierarchical gist representation of events in human brain during naturalistic stimuli.
papers.authors: Li K, Ren P, Liu Q, Zhang Z, Li S, Li Z, Sun L, Ding X, Liang X.
papers.abstract: The neural mechanisms underlying the brain's representation of event gist remain poorly understood. In this study, we investigate the neural architecture and computational principles governing the hierarchical representation of event gist in the human brain. Using an integrative approach that combines natural language processing with fMRI data from narrative listening, we extracted semantic event gist vectors from texts and aligned them with neural responses through representational similarity analysis. This analysis revealed that the brain's representation of event gist follows a functional hierarchy. Specifically, brain regions can be categorized into four functional levels based on their temporal preference for narrative information processing: from the Fine-grained level representing sentence-level event gist, to the Medium-Fine and Medium-Coarse levels integrating cross-sentence event gist, ultimately reaching the Coarse level constructing long-range narrative gist. Using lagged inter-subject functional connectivity (lag-ISFC), we further characterized the temporal lag structure across this hierarchical organization, revealing a systematic offset pattern consistent with the temporal hierarchy. To explore the computational principles underlying these hierarchical patterns, we implemented long short-term memory (LSTM) and convolutional neural network (CNN) models to map fine-scale to coarse-scale regional dynamics. The results revealed that LSTM models outperformed CNNs in capturing the hierarchical processing of narrative events across gist-representing brain regions, with deeper LSTM hidden layers corresponding more closely with higher-order cortical activity. Perturbation of LSTM hidden states further revealed that lower-layer representations are computationally upstream of higher-layer ones, and that deep hidden states are specifically required for correspondence with Coarse-grained regions. These findings, obtained within a brain-to-brain modeling framework that characterizes the fine-to-coarse cortical transformation directly, identify sustained recurrent state integration as a candidate computational property of intra-cortical hierarchical transformation during naturalistic narrative processing.

relevance.reason: 用fMRI和叙事聆听研究人脑事件要旨的层级语义表征及皮层时间层级，属语言/语篇理解与自然刺激脑加工。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑在自然叙事中如何表征事件要点（gist），结合自然语言处理与fMRI数据，用表征相似性分析考察其神经层级结构。结果显示，事件要点表征呈功能层级：从偏重句子级要点的细粒度水平，到整合跨句要点的中细、中粗水平，直至构建长程叙事要点的粗粒度水平，且各层级间存在与时间层级一致的系统性滞后偏移。基于LSTM与CNN的建模进一步表明，LSTM更能刻画这种由细到粗的转换，深层隐状态与高阶皮层活动及粗粒度区域对应更紧密，提示持续性的循环状态整合可能是皮层内层级转换的候选计算机制。

papers.title: Addressing fusiform gyrus dysfunction in schizophrenia, theory of mind, and implications for antipsychotics' response and resistance: A systematic review and critical appraisal.
papers.authors: Ciccarelli M, Mazza B, Nasti A, Iannotta F, Caiazza C, Matrone M, Gaudieri V, De Simone G, Vellucci L, Fornaro M, Iasevoli F, Barone A, de Bartolomeis A.
papers.abstract: Background The Fusiform Gyrus (FG), a brain region relevant for the interaction between cognitive processes and emotional behavior, especially emotion recognition and interpretation of social cues, has been linked to the pathophysiology of schizophrenia conceptualized as a disorder of aberrant synaptic function and brain connectivity as well as characterized by disruptions in thought processes, perceptions, emotional responsiveness, and Theory of Mind (ToM). Disrupted FG connectivity has been reported in schizophrenia; however, no systematic review has addressed this issue in a comprehensive and critical manner. Methods We conducted a systematic review of PubMed, Embase, and Scopus from database inception to February 2026 following PRISMA guidelines. We included peer-reviewed neuroimaging studies using functional magnetic resonance imaging to assess functional connectivity or task-related activation of the FG in patients with schizophrenia compared with healthy controls. Results We identified 2765 articles from different sources. After duplicate removal, 959 articles were screened at the title-abstract level, 269 articles were reviewed for full-texts, and 86 eligible articles were included. Across fMRI studies, the FG emerged as a central node of dysconnectivity. Drug-naïve patients showed heterogeneous FG alterations, with increased local activity and network centrality reported in some studies and reduced interhemispheric and functional connectivity in others, alongside reduced FG activation on visual, affective, and sensory tasks reported more broadly across schizophrenia samples. First-episode psychosis patients were characterized by FG hypoconnectivity associated with negative symptoms and socio-cognitive impairment. Treatment-responsive patients demonstrated partial normalization or modulation of fusiform connectivity and network centrality following antipsychotic treatment. In contrast, treatment-resistant schizophrenia patients showed persistent hypoactivation and reduced connectivity, correlating with cognitive deficits and negative symptoms. Conclusions The FG appears to function as a dynamic, state-sensitive hub underlying perceptual, emotional, and cognitive disturbances in schizophrenia, in line with impaired ToM.

relevance.reason: 系统综述精神分裂症患者梭状回功能连接与任务激活，涉及社会认知/心理理论及脑网络组织，属脑疾病机理研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了精神分裂症患者梭状回功能连接与任务激活的功能磁共振研究，并与健康对照比较，以评估梭状回功能障碍及其与心理理论缺损和抗精神病药反应的关系。纳入研究显示，梭状回处于连接异常的核心位置：未用药患者表现不一，既有局部活动和网络中心性升高，也有半球间及功能连接下降；视觉、情绪和感觉任务中的梭状回激活减弱在患者中较为普遍。首发精神病患者以梭状回连接不足为主，并与阴性症状和社会认知损害相关；治疗有效者用药后连接和网络中心性部分恢复或受到调节，而难治性患者则持续存在激活不足和连接下降，且与认知缺陷和阴性症状相关。作者据此认为，梭状回可能是一个对状态敏感的动态枢纽，参与精神分裂症感知、情绪和认知障碍，并与心理理论受损相一致；上述关联多来自横断面比较，尚不能说明因果或治疗效应。

papers.title: Relationship between Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia, Corpus Callosum Microstructure at Term-Equivalent Age, and Neurodevelopment at Age 2 Years in Infants Born Preterm.
papers.authors: Nelson KA, Kojima K, Sri A, Altaye M, Parikh NA, Cincinnati Infant Neurodevelopment Early Prediction Study (CINEPS) Investigators.
papers.abstract: Objective To describe changes in fractional anisotropy (FA) of the corpus callosum (CC) and neurodevelopmental outcomes in infants born preterm at or less than 32 weeks' gestational age with bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD). Study design In this prospective regional cohort study, 392 infants born preterm underwent diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) at term-corrected age and were invited for standardized motor, cognitive, and language developmental testing (Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development, Third Edition [Bayley-III]) at 2 years' corrected age. We used automated tractography software to segment the CC into 7 subsegments and calculate FA, a measure of dMRI brain microstructure. We performed multivariable linear regression analyses to examine associations between BPD severity and FA values, and between BPD and Bayley-III scores, adjusting for confounders. Mediation analysis assessed whether FA values mediated the relationship between BPD and Bayley scores. Results Of 392 infants, 227 (57.9%) had no BPD, 91 (23.2%) grade 1, 56 (14.3%) grade 2, and 18 (4.6%) grade 3. Of the same 392 infants, 245 had usable dMRI scans, and 341 (87%) returned for Bayley-III testing. In multivariable analyses, higher BPD grades were associated with lower FA in the posterior midbody and isthmus of the CC (both Q ≤ 0.005). Infants with higher grades of BPD also had lower Bayley-III cognitive (P = .016), language (P = .019), and motor (P < .001) scores. CC microstructure partially mediated the association between BPD severity and cognitive outcome (posterior midbody, 12.7% of the total effect; P = .026), although mediated effects were modest and most did not reach statistical significance. The direct effect of BPD persisted throughout. Conclusions In our regional preterm cohort, greater BPD severity was linked to poorer neurodevelopment, and this relationship was partially mediated by aberrant CC development, although the mediation effect was modest.

relevance.reason: 早产儿胼胝体微结构与2岁认知/语言/运动发育的关联，属脑结构支持认知发育的研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该前瞻性区域队列研究关注胎龄不超过32周的早产儿，探讨支气管肺发育不良（BPD）严重程度与足月矫正年龄时胼胝体微结构及2岁矫正年龄神经发育之间的关系。研究者对早产儿在足月矫正年龄进行弥散磁共振成像，将胼胝体分为7个亚段并计算各段各向异性分数，随后在2岁时用Bayley量表评估运动、认知和语言发育。结果显示，BPD等级越高，胼胝体后部中体和峡部的各向异性分数越低，2岁时的认知、语言和运动得分也越差；胼胝体微结构仅部分中介BPD严重程度与认知结局之间的关联，中介效应较小且多数未达统计学显著，BPD的直接效应始终存在。作者据此认为，BPD越严重与神经发育结局越差相关，胼胝体发育异常可能参与其中，但作用有限。

papers.title: Peripheral immune-metabolic markers and quantitative EEG in drug-naïve first-episode mania: A case-control study.
papers.authors: Bisgin E, Yesilkaya UH, Serbetci F, Gica S, Ipekcioglu D.
papers.abstract: Background Inflammation is implicated in bipolar disorder and quantitative EEG (QEEG) measures cortical oscillatory activity, but the two have not been examined together in first-episode mania. Methods Sixty drug-naïve inpatients with a first manic episode (DSM-5) and sixty age- and sex-matched healthy controls were enrolled. Peripheral inflammatory measures, including the monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR), C-reactive protein and albumin, were obtained from routine blood tests, and resting eyes-open EEG absolute spectral power was computed across five cortical regions and four bands. Groups were compared with Mann-Whitney U tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and within-patient inflammation-QEEG associations examined by hierarchical regression adjusted for age, education and sex. Results Patients had higher monocyte counts (q = 0.004), higher MLR (q = 0.003) and lower albumin (q = 0.045) than controls. Absolute spectral power was higher in patients in 9 of 20 region × band cells, all surviving correction. Within patients, lower albumin was associated with higher frontal (β = -0.42, p = 0.006) and central (β = -0.44, p = 0.003) beta power, persisting after adjustment for smoking and log-transformation. Across all 20 cells with correction, these were the strongest associations but did not survive (minimum q = 0.17). Conclusions First-episode drug-naïve mania is accompanied by an immune-metabolic shift and broad cortical oscillatory change. The albumin-beta association is exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and requires replication. Limitations include the single-centre cross-sectional design, modest sample size, and an inflammatory panel restricted to routine measures.

relevance.reason: 研究首发躁狂患者静息态EEG皮层振荡活动及其与外周免疫代谢指标的关联，以患者为工具探讨脑功能组织改变。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究在未用药的首发躁狂患者与年龄性别匹配的健康对照之间，同时考察外周免疫代谢指标与静息态定量脑电频谱功率，以探讨两者在首发躁狂中的关系。结果发现，患者单核细胞计数和单核细胞/淋巴细胞比值升高、白蛋白降低，且多个脑区与频段的绝对频谱功率高于对照。在患者内部，较低白蛋白与较高的额区和中央区β功率相关，但经多重校正后这一关联未保持显著，作者将其视为探索性、有待重复的假设生成结果。

papers.title: Reading in adolescents with hearing loss: Slower responses despite neural sensitivity to morphosyntax.
papers.authors: Straus J, Ockelmann J, Bolt E, Elmer S, Giroud N.
papers.abstract: Adolescents with hearing loss (HL) often display difficulties in written language processing, yet the contribution of morphosyntax remains uncertain. We examined written German morphosyntax in adolescents with HL, most of whom used cochlear implants, relative to monolingual and multilingual hearing controls. Participants completed a minimal two-word grammaticality-judgment task designed to reduce sentence-level working-memory demands while EEG was recorded at the onset of the second word. Accuracy was near ceiling, but the HL group responded more slowly than both hearing comparison groups, and higher working-memory scores were associated with better accuracy within the HL group. In unified ERP models, incongruent pairs elicited overall N400 and P600 effects without interactions with group or construction. Earlier components showed no reliable HL-specific violation pattern. Under these low working-memory demands, later neural responses to minimal agreement violations were detectable at the sample level, while the HL group showed slower behavioral responding and a within-group association between working memory and accuracy.

relevance.reason: 研究听障青少年书面语言形态句法加工的EEG神经响应，属语言与脑机制，并涉及工作记忆与语言表现的关联。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察听力损失青少年在书面语言中加工形态句法的能力，比较他们与单语及多语健听对照组在最小两词语法判断任务中的表现，并同步记录脑电。结果显示，听力损失组正确率接近天花板，但反应慢于两个健听组；组内工作记忆得分越高，正确率越好。不一致词对在组水平诱发N400和P600效应，且未与组别或句式结构交互，早期成分也未出现听力损失组特有的违规模式。作者据此认为，在较低工作记忆负荷下，形态句法违规的晚期神经反应仍可检测到，而听力损失青少年的困难更多体现在反应速度上，工作记忆可能在其中起作用。

papers.title: An FA-based hybrid DTI-mixture model for multi-fiber reconstruction in diffusion MRI.
papers.authors: Puri A, Kumar S.
papers.abstract: Objective This study proposes a hybrid diffusion MRI reconstruction framework combining Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI) and the multi-compartment non-central Wishart (MNCW) mixture model. The proposed framework uses an empirically selected fractional anisotropy (FA) threshold of 0.75 as a heuristic to distinguish between single- and multi-fiber voxels, enabling adaptive selection of the most appropriate reconstruction model for each voxel. Materials and methods Synthetic diffusion MRI datasets containing single-, two-, and three-fiber configurations were generated using 82 diffusion-sensitizing gradient directions with Rician noise. Voxels with FA ≥ 0.75 were reconstructed using DTI, while voxels with FA < 0.75 were analyzed using the MNCW model. Angular error and clustering behavior were evaluated under different thresholds. The method was further validated using rat optic chiasm and human brain datasets. Results The proposed framework reduced incorrect single-fiber detections and produced fewer disoriented voxels in complex fiber configurations compared with the conventional mixture model. A clustering threshold of 17 ∘ provided stable reconstruction without merging distinct fibers. Real data experiments demonstrated anatomically consistent reconstruction of white matter structures. Discussion The hybrid framework improves orientation estimation by selectively applying mixture modeling only in voxels likely to contain multiple fibers, reducing over-segmentation, improving stability, and lowering computational complexity.

relevance.reason: 提出并验证用于人脑白质多纤维重建的扩散MRI混合模型，属白质微结构与纤维束成像方法。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一种结合扩散张量成像（DTI）与多隔室非中心Wishart混合模型的混合扩散MRI重建框架，以经验选取的FA阈值区分单纤维与多纤维体素，从而为每个体素自适应选择重建模型。研究用含单、双、三纤维构型的合成数据及大鼠视交叉和人脑数据评估，结果显示该框架相比传统混合模型减少了错误的单纤维检测，在复杂纤维构型中产生更少的定向错误体素，聚类阈值可稳定重建而不合并不同纤维，真实数据重建与解剖结构一致。作者认为，仅在可能含多纤维的体素中应用混合建模，可改善方向估计、减少过度分割、提高稳定性并降低计算复杂度。

papers.title: Mapping without tasks: resting-state fMRI for motor and language localization in neuro-oncology.
papers.authors: Mahmoud E, Ashraf TAE, Abdelsattar NK, Nada A.
papers.abstract: Purpose Presurgical functional mapping is essential for maximizing tumor resection while preserving motor and language function. While task-based fMRI (tb-fMRI) is the current non-invasive standard, its utility is substantially limited in patients with aphasia, paresis, or cognitive impairment who cannot comply with active paradigms. Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) offers a task-free alternative, yet its spatial fidelity and clinical validity compared to task-based methods remain under rigorous evaluation. Methods In this prospective study, we evaluated 12 patients with histologically confirmed brain tumors who underwent rs-fMRI and tb-fMRI for preoperative sensorimotor and language mapping. Motor mapping utilized a bilateral finger tapping block-design paradigm. Language mapping utilized three distinct task paradigms (Silent Word Generation, Rhyming, and Synonym). Spatial concordance was quantified using Dice Similarity Coefficients (DSC), Jaccard Indices, and Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis. Results rs-fMRI demonstrated fair to moderate spatial concordance with tb-fMRI. For motor mapping, the mean DSC was 0.62 ± 0.08 with high specificity (0.93 ± 0.02). In the language domain, rs-fMRI showed the highest concordance with the Silent Word Generation task (DSC 0.63 ± 0.11). Notably, rs-fMRI exhibited superior signal stability, with significantly fewer motion-censored volumes compared to language task paradigms (p < 0.01). While rs-fMRI demonstrated moderate sensitivity (~ 0.62), it achieved high specificity (0.93-0.94) across all domains however the moderate sensitivity indicates that functionally important regions may remain undetected. Conclusions In this preliminary single-center study, rs-fMRI demonstrates fair to moderate spatial concordance with tb-fMRI and high specificity in delineating core eloquent cortex, though with moderate sensitivity that may leave functionally important regions undetected. The study provides hypothesis-generating evidence supporting the integration of rs-fMRI into multimodal presurgical workflows for neuro-oncology patients who cannot comply with task-based paradigms.

relevance.reason: 比较静息态fMRI与任务态fMRI在脑肿瘤患者语言与运动皮层定位中的空间一致性，涉及人脑语言功能组织与静息网络。

papers.summary_zh: 该前瞻性单中心研究在脑肿瘤患者术前比较了静息态fMRI与任务态fMRI在感觉运动和语言定位上的空间一致性，关注无法配合任务范式的患者能否改用无任务成像。结果显示，静息态与任务态在运动及语言映射上呈中等程度空间吻合，特异性较高，但敏感度中等，提示部分功能重要区域可能未被检出；同时静息态信号更稳定、需剔除的运动污染数据更少。作者据此认为，这属于初步的假设生成性证据，支持将静息态fMRI纳入无法完成任务范式患者的多模态术前评估流程，但其定位灵敏度不足仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Dopamine-Deficiency-Related Reorganization of the Somatomotor Network in Prodromal and Early Parkinson's Disease.
papers.authors: Asendorf AL, Dzialas V, van Eimeren T, Hoenig MC.
papers.journal: Movement disorders : official journal of the Movement Disorder Society
papers.abstract: Introduction Network attack tolerance (NAT) measures the brain's ability to sustain information flow despite the loss of critical brain regions. In Parkinson's disease (PD), NAT has been linked to cognitive and motor function. However, it remains unclear how dopaminergic degeneration shapes NAT, and whether it relates to motor symptom progression. Objective To examine dopamine deficiency-related changes in NAT across the early PD disease continuum and its association with longitudinal motor outcomes. Methods We used cross-sectional resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging of 28 healthy controls, 60 prodromal, and 94 clinical PD patients to create graph-theoretical networks. NAT was assessed at the global and subnetwork levels by calculating the global efficiency upon iterative node removal at different network densities. Using linear mixed-effects models, we assessed how putaminal dopamine transporter (DaT) binding or disease status affected NAT, controlling for network density, age, sex, and education. Baseline somatomotor (SMN) NAT was examined as a predictor of motor symptom progression in 145 patients. Results Lower putaminal DaT signal was associated with higher SMN NAT across groups. PD patients exhibited elevated SMN NAT relative to controls. Neither global nor other subnetworks showed effects. While the effect of baseline SMN NAT on motor progression was not significant, an exploratory analysis (Johnson-Neyman) suggested that higher SMN NAT may associate with slower motor decline across most of the observed NAT range. Conclusions Dopaminergic depletion is associated with a targeted SMN reorganization, potentially maintaining network information flow despite progressive hub loss. Whether this reorganization represents compensation or a consequence of progressive pathology requires further longitudinal assessment. © 2026 The Author(s). Movement Disorders published by Wiley Periodicals LLC on behalf of International Parkinson and Movement Disorder Society.

relevance.reason: 用静息态fMRI图论分析帕金森病多巴胺缺失相关的感觉运动网络重组，属脑疾病中网络组织与可塑性研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注多巴胺缺乏如何影响帕金森病早期大脑网络的抗攻击能力（NAT），即网络在关键节点丢失后维持信息流的能力，并考察其与运动症状进展的关系。研究利用健康对照、前驱期和临床期帕金森病患者的静息态功能磁共振数据构建图论网络，在不同密度下通过逐步移除节点计算全局效率。结果显示，壳核多巴胺转运体信号越低，感觉运动网络（SMN）的NAT越高，且患者该网络NAT高于对照，而全局网络和其他子网络未见此效应，提示多巴胺耗竭伴随SMN的选择性重组，可能在枢纽逐渐丢失时维持信息流。基线SMN NAT对运动进展的预测未达显著，探索性分析仅提示较高NAT可能与较慢的运动衰退相关；作者指出这种重组是代偿还是病理进展的结果，仍需进一步纵向研究。

papers.title: Brain-wide magnetic resonance imaging analysis of neurobehavioral comorbidities in temporal lobe epilepsy.
papers.authors: Fadaie F, Caldairou B, Bernhardt BC, Bernasconi A, Bernasconi N.
papers.abstract: Objective In temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE), patients often present with neurobehavioral comorbidities encompassing affective and cognitive difficulties. Whereas the latter have been related to atypical connectivity of mesiotemporal and frontotemporal circuits, the brain basis of affective symptoms remains incompletely understood. Here, we assessed functional network substrates of affective symptoms and examined their relationship to structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), cognition, and clinical parameters. Methods We studied 42 drug-resistant patients who underwent multimodal 3-T MRI as well as self-report questionnaires of affective and cognitive functions outside the scanner, alongside 41 age- and sex-matched healthy controls. Partial least squares (PLS), a brain-wide multivariate associative technique, examined relationships between resting-state functional MRI connectivity strength (FCS) and affective measures. Linear models assessed relationships with morphology and microstructure, as well as cognitive and clinical parameters. Results Moderate to severe anxiety was present in 79% of patients, with concealing and adjustment as coping strategies, and 40% experienced depression. Quality of life scores were below published norm for epilepsy. PLS analysis revealed a latent component that accounted for 67% of the covariance between FCS and affective symptoms, linking weaker connectivity in temporoparietal and prefrontal cortices, as well as mesiotemporal, thalamic, and pallidal regions, to anxiety, low energy/fatigue, medication-related complaints, and reduced quality of life. Among cognitive domains, verbal memory positively correlated with the same brain areas. Cortices with the strongest covariance between FCS and affective variables presented with marked atrophy and myelin alterations (indexed by T1/fluid-attenuated inversion recovery decreases). Controlling for verbal memory and metrics of brain structure, the temporal-parietal network remained the most compromised. Significance Dysconnectivity of the temporal-parietal network emerges as a key contributor to affective symptoms in TLE, and limbic network dysfunction additionally impacts cognition. These findings emphasize the importance of multidisciplinary care targeting both emotion regulation and stress reduction, alongside cognitive rehabilitation, for improved well-being and quality of life.

relevance.reason: 以颞叶癫痫患者为对象，用静息态功能连接与结构MRI考察情绪/认知共病的脑网络基础，属疾病中认知与脑组织机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注耐药性颞叶癫痫患者情感与认知共病的脑网络基础，对患者与健康对照进行静息态功能磁共振成像及情感、认知问卷评估，并用全脑多变量方法分析功能连接强度与情感症状的关系。结果发现，一个潜在成分可解释功能连接与情感症状间的大部分协变，颞顶及前额叶等区域连接较弱与焦虑、疲乏、用药相关困扰和较低生活质量相关；同一批脑区还与言语记忆呈正相关，且结构上伴有萎缩和髓鞘改变。控制言语记忆和脑结构指标后，颞顶网络仍是最受累的网络。作者据此认为，颞顶网络连接异常是颞叶癫痫情感症状的重要相关因素，边缘系统功能异常还影响认知，提示照护需同时关注情绪调节、压力管理与认知康复。

papers.title: Hippocampal Seizure-Related Burden is Associated with Accelerated Long-Term Forgetting in Focal Epilepsy.
papers.authors: Bratu IF, Lambert I, Felician O, Villalon SM, Trébuchon A, Bartolomei F.
papers.abstract: Objective Memory impairment is a frequent comorbidity of focal epilepsy, incompletely explained by seizure frequency or structural pathology. Ictal and postictal hippocampal dysfunction disrupt memory processes, but their cumulative impact remains poorly quantified. This study introduces cumulative hippocampal seizure-related burden metrics and examines their association with long-term memory consolidation. Methods A total of 20 consecutive patients undergoing stereo-electroencephalography in Marseille (2016-2018) were prospectively included. Continuous stereo-electroencephalogram recordings between 2 memory assessments (30 minutes and 1 week postencoding) were analyzed. Hippocampal ictal involvement and durations were assessed using epileptogenicity markers and visual stereo-electroencephalogram analysis. The postictal period was quantified using permutation entropy. Cumulative hippocampal seizure-related burden metrics (ictal, postictal, and combined) were computed across hippocampus-involving ictal events. Verbal and visual memory were assessed using standardized recall and recognition tasks. One-week performance was defined as the percentage score obtained at the 1-week assessment, whereas retention was defined as 1-week performance expressed as a percentage of 30-min performance. Associations were examined using univariate and multivariate analyses. Results Higher dominant-hemisphere hippocampal burden was associated with poorer 1-week verbal memory (performance and retention), independently of most covariates. Higher cumulative hippocampal seizure-related burden was associated with lower total recall performance (free + cued) and total recall retention (β = -25.04 and -23.88; R2 = 0.57 and 0.53; p < 0.05), and accounted for the greatest variance in both outcomes (adjusted R2 = 0.59 and 0.53; β = -25.45 and -24.27; p < 0.01), particularly when adjusting for epilepsy duration. No robust associations were observed between nondominant-hemisphere hippocampal seizure-related burden metrics and visual memory. Effects predominantly involved recall. Interpretation Cumulative ictal-postictal hippocampal dysfunction is a major predictor of impaired long-term verbal memory consolidation in focal epilepsy. ANN NEUROL 2026.

relevance.reason: 以局灶性癫痫患者颅内脑电研究海马发作相关负荷与长期记忆巩固的关系，属记忆神经机制与脑疾病认知研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注局灶性癫痫患者长期记忆巩固受损是否与累积的海马发作相关负担有关，并借助立体脑电监测在两次记忆评估之间量化海马的发作期参与和发作后状态。结果显示，优势半球海马的累积负担越高，一周后的言语记忆表现和保持率越差，且这一关联在多数协变量调整后仍存在，并在总回忆表现及其保持率上解释的方差最大；非优势半球负担与视觉记忆之间则未见稳健关联，效应主要体现在回忆而非再认。作者据此认为，累积的发作期与发作后海马功能障碍是局灶性癫痫长期言语记忆巩固受损的重要预测因素，但这是观察性关联，尚不能说明因果或治疗效应。

papers.title: Brain cognition gaps reveal associations with dopamine and factors related to brain health through artificial intelligence prediction of functional connectome.
papers.authors: Esmaeili M, Bjørkeli EB, Pedersen R, Falahati F, Johansson J, Nordin K, Karalija N, Bäckman L, Nyberg L, Salami A.
papers.abstract: A key question in human neuroscience is to understand how individual differences in brain function relate to cognitive differences. However, the optimal condition of brain function to study between-person differences in cognition remains unclear. While many studies have developed objective biomarkers to accurately predict intelligence and general cognition, consensus on domain-specific markers has not yet emerged. Brain age has been proposed as a potential candidate, but recent research suggests that brain age offers minimal additional information on cognitive decline beyond what chronological age provides, prompting a shift toward approaches focused directly on cognitive prediction. Using a deep learning approach, we evaluated the predictive power of the functional connectome during various states (resting state, movie-watching, and n-back) on episodic memory and working memory performance. Our findings show that connectomes during tasks, especially during movie-watching, predict individual differences across cognitive domains, while resting state connectomes predict episodic memory meaningfully. Furthermore, individuals with a negative brain cognition gap (where brain predictions underestimate actual performance) exhibited lower physical activity and higher cardiovascular risk compared to those with a positive gap. This shows that knowledge of the brain cognition gap provides insights into factors contributing to cognitive resilience. Further, lower PET-derived measures of dopamine binding were linked to a greater brain cognition gap, mediated by regional functional variability. Together, our findings highlight the importance of brain state in connectome-based cognitive prediction and introduce the brain cognition gap as a potentially informative, dopamine-modulated marker of vulnerability to compromise brain function.

relevance.reason: 研究不同脑状态（静息、看电影、n-back）功能连接组预测情景/工作记忆个体差异，并关联多巴胺与脑健康因素，属认知与脑功能网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人脑功能连接的个体差异能否预测认知表现，以及何种脑状态最适合做这种预测。作者用深度学习方法，比较静息、看电影和n-back任务状态下的功能连接对情景记忆与工作记忆的预测能力，发现任务态连接（尤其看电影时）能预测多个认知领域的个体差异，静息态连接则对情景记忆有实质预测作用。研究进一步提出“脑认知差距”这一指标，即脑预测值低于实际表现的程度，发现负向差距者体力活动更少、心血管风险更高；较低的PET多巴胺结合指标与更大的脑认知差距相关，且该关系由区域功能变异性中介。作者据此认为脑状态对基于连接组的认知预测很重要，脑认知差距可能是受多巴胺调节、反映脑功能易损性的潜在标记，但相关发现尚属关联层面。

papers.title: Mapping and anatomo-surgical techniques for language preservation in brain tumours (Review).
papers.authors: Liu X, Ouyang J, Wang J.
papers.abstract: Glioma resection surgeries require balance between language functioning protection and maximal tumour removal. Surgical planning is key for the success of resection procedures and the techniques involved are often associated with cortical mapping and tissue differentiation. These techniques include direct electrical stimulation, stereo-electroencephalography, functional magnetic resonance imaging, diffusion tensor imaging, functional ultrasound, hyperspectral imaging and intraoperative optical imaging. The present review explores the anatomical features of language-eloquent areas and the techniques and technologies developed to map cortical areas and distinguish tumour tissue from functional tissue. The benefits and limitations of each technique are discussed, along with their intraoperative and preoperative uses. All techniques are discussed in the context of their effectiveness in the preservation of cortical areas responsible for language processing.

relevance.reason: 综述聚焦脑肿瘤手术中语言功能区定位与保护，涉及语言皮层解剖及电刺激、fMRI、DTI等脑定位技术。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕胶质瘤切除中如何在保护语言功能与最大程度切除肿瘤之间取得平衡，梳理了语言功能区定位及区分肿瘤与功能组织的相关技术。文章介绍了直接电刺激、立体脑电图、功能磁共振成像、弥散张量成像、功能超声、高光谱成像和术中光学成像等手段，讨论其术前与术中的用途及各自的优势与局限，并置于语言加工皮层区保护这一目标下加以评价。综述强调手术规划对切除成功的重要性，但未报告原始实验数据或疗效比较。

papers.title: Auditory neural entrainment: frequency-specific functional roles and emerging applications in neurological and psychiatric disorders.
papers.authors: Yang H, Li Y, Chen Z, Lu J.
papers.abstract: Among sensory inputs, auditory information plays a significant role. Neural entrainment may establish a bridge for the brain's perception of rhythmic sound signals. It refers to the synchronization of ongoing neuronal activity with internal and external rhythmic stimuli, demonstrating the brain's plasticity and adaptive dynamics. Across canonical EEG bands, delta activity is associated with temporal prediction and hierarchical auditory processing over longer time scales; theta activity with speech parsing, audiovisual integration, and memory-related timing; alpha activity with cross-modal information processing; beta activity with predictive timing and auditory-motor coordination; and gamma-range responses with fine temporal encoding and steady-state activity. These associations overlap rather than represent one-to-one functional mappings. This mini review included studies based on speech, music, pure tones, and other natural or artificial auditory stimuli. We explored the functional roles of these oscillatory activities and their interactions. Finally, we prudently reviewed the emerging applications of auditory neural entrainment for brain diseases. These explorations have yielded some exciting results, but the evidence remains in its early stages and shows heterogeneity. It is also limited by small sample sizes and short study periods. Moreover, many music- and rhythm-based interventions have shown symptom improvement, but most provide only indirect evidence. Therefore, we emphasize that future studies should more deeply explore the relationship between neural entrainment and proven therapeutic benefits, while also attending to safety, individual differences, and the adequacy of control groups in sham interventions.

relevance.reason: 综述听觉神经夹带在语音解析、时间预测等听觉语言与认知加工中的频率特异性功能，属人脑机制框架。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕听觉神经夹带展开，即持续神经活动与内外节律刺激的同步现象，梳理了不同脑电频段在听觉加工中的功能角色。作者指出，delta活动与较长时间尺度上的时间预测和层级听觉加工相关，theta活动涉及言语解析、视听整合与记忆相关计时，alpha活动参与跨模态信息处理，beta活动与预测性计时和听觉—运动协调有关，gamma范围反应则关联精细时间编码与稳态活动；这些关联彼此重叠，并非一一对应的功能映射。文章还审慎评估了听觉神经夹带在脑疾病中的新兴应用，认为虽有令人关注的初步结果，但证据仍处早期且异质性明显，受样本量小和研究周期短限制，许多音乐与节律干预虽见症状改善，却多为间接证据，未来需深入检验夹带与疗效的关系，并关注安全性、个体差异和假干预对照的充分性。

papers.title: Localizing Sports-Related Concussion and Characterizing Recovery Trajectories with Multimodal Brain Imaging.
papers.authors: Bell NM, Holcomb JM, Holmes SG, Broughton MR, Johnson CC, Cullum MC, Yu FF, Talai A, Maldjian JA, Stokes MA, Davenport EM.
papers.abstract: This clinical report uses magnetoencephalography (MEG), electroencephalography (EEG), diffusional kurtosis imaging, pseudocontinuous arterial spin-labeling (pCASL), and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) to compare female, high-school soccer dizygotic twins who differed in recent concussion history. One twin, Twin A, sustained her first clinically diagnosed concussion 72 hours before baseline imaging. Twin B was not concussed and served as a control for Twin A. Participants completed clinical, neuropsychological, and neurophysiological assessments at baseline (T1), 1-month (T2), and 3-month (T3) time points. Imaging and electrophysiology were acquired using a harmonized protocol across modalities. MEG was collected with a Triux Neo whole-head system, and 64-channel EEG was acquired simultaneously. MRI was conducted on a 3T Prisma scanner following the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development protocol. Diffusional kurtosis imaging was processed using FSL to generate fractional anisotropy and mean diffusivity maps. pCASL was analyzed using Bayesian Inference for Arterial Spin-Labeling to estimate cerebral blood flow. rs-fMRI preprocessing and denoising were performed in CONN, and voxelwise power spectral density (range, 0.01-0.1 Hz) was computed to quantify low-frequency oscillatory activity. Twin A demonstrated acute symptoms, left frontal hypoperfusion, reduced rs-fMRI power, and increased low-frequency electrophysiological activity at T1, with gradual recovery across modalities. Twin B exhibited stable findings across all assessments. Our findings highlight the potential of multimodal brain imaging to localize sports-related concussion and to help inform return-to-play decisions.

relevance.reason: 以脑震荡双胞胎为工具，用MEG/EEG/扩散/灌注/静息fMRI追踪脑功能与恢复轨迹，涉及损伤后脑组织与自发活动改变。

papers.summary_zh: 这份临床报告以一对近期脑震荡史不同的高中女足双卵双胞胎为对象，用脑磁图、脑电图、扩散峰度成像、动脉自旋标记灌注和静息态功能磁共振进行多模态对比，并在基线、1个月和3个月随访评估。有脑震荡的一方在基线表现出急性症状、左侧额叶低灌注、静息态低频功率下降和低频电生理活动增强，随后各模态指标逐渐恢复；未脑震荡的一方各次评估保持稳定。作者据此认为多模态脑成像有助于定位运动相关脑震荡并辅助重返赛场决策，但该结论来自个案式双胞胎比较，仍需更大样本验证。

papers.title: Not just for play: fNIRS reveals complex linguistic, perceptual, and sociopragmatic functions of Japanese ideophones
papers.authors: McLean B, Akita K, Dewey DP.
papers.abstract: This study investigates the neural processing of Japanese ideophones (expressive words depicting sound, movement, texture, taste, or emotion) compared to verbs and adjectives matched on semantic measures of perceptual strength and multimodality. Using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), we recorded brain activity while participants listened to ideophones and matched non-ideophones (verbs and adjectives) with meanings spanning five sensory categories: visual, auditory, haptic, gustatory, and interoceptive. General linear model analyses revealed significant differences between brain activity during the processing of ideophones compared to words of other classes, with ideophones eliciting broader activation in occipital, prefrontal, and parietal regions—areas associated with visualization, higher level thinking, and integrative cognition. Principal component analysis further revealed that patterns of neurological activation across sensory categories are different for ideophones than for non-ideophones: compared to non-ideophones, ideophones activated a shared multisensory network of channels with extensive cross-modal coactivation and strong internal coherence. The findings provide new insights into how semiotic distinctions influence processing, and underscore how ideophones—once dismissed as marginal embellishments or ‘playthings’—are perfectly honed tools for a variety of complex linguistic and social functions, by virtue of their depictive natures and the special connections to sensori-affective systems this affords them.

relevance.reason: fNIRS记录听日语拟态词与非拟态词时的人脑活动，比较语言类别加工的神经表征差异。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究用功能性近红外光谱比较日语拟态词与在知觉强度和跨模态性上匹配的动词、形容词加工时的脑活动，考察不同词类是否带来不同神经加工模式。结果显示，拟态词在枕叶、前额叶和顶叶引发更广泛激活，且跨视觉、听觉、触觉、味觉和内感受等语义类别表现出共享的多感觉网络与较强跨模态共激活，而其他词类未见同样模式。作者据此认为，拟态词的描绘性使其与感觉—情感系统紧密相连，从而支持复杂的语言与社会语用功能，而非仅是边缘性的修辞点缀。

papers.title: Toward a Layered Framework of Environmental Experience: Integrating Sensory, Perceptual, and Semantic Processes
papers.authors: Huynh DC, Hussein AK, Behzadi F, Kalantarifard A, Fich LB, Møgelmose A, Kühn S, Gramann K, Djebbara Z.
papers.abstract: Environmental experience is shaped by sensory stimulation, perceptual organization, and semantic meaning, yet these dimensions are often studied in isolation or reduced to broad environmental categories. This fragmentation limits our ability to explain how environments are experienced, how bottom-up and top-down processes interact, and how person-environment relations can be studied in a mechanistically informative way. Here, we provide an integrative review of work spanning embodied cognition, predictive processing, environmental psychology, and related traditions, and use this synthesis to develop a human-centered framework of environmental experience. In this framework, environmental experience unfolds across three analytically separable but experientially intertwined dimensions: sensory, perceptual, and semantic. The sensory dimension concerns immediate stimulation and salience; the perceptual dimension concerns the organization of environmental input into coherent, action-relevant structure; and the semantic dimension concerns learned meaning, cultural interpretation, familiarity, and contextual relevance. We argue that these dimensions are not sequential stages, but parallel, co-active, and mutually constraining aspects of lived environmental engagement. We then outline methodological implications for studying both dimension-specific contributions and their interaction, emphasizing convergent, multimethod, and temporally sensitive designs spanning behavioral, physiological, neurocognitive, and computational approaches. The framework provides an integrative basis for moving beyond static or overly coarse descriptions of environments and toward a more precise account of how environmental experience emerges across brain, body, and world.

relevance.reason: 提出环境体验的感知-语义整合理论框架，涉及神经认知但未报告具体人脑机制或数据，相关性不明确。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合具身认知、预测加工与环境心理学等研究传统，提出一个以人为中心的环境体验框架，将环境体验分为感官、知觉和语义三个维度：感官维度涉及即时刺激与显著性，知觉维度涉及将环境输入组织为连贯且与行动相关的结构，语义维度涉及习得意义、文化解释、熟悉度和情境相关性。作者强调这三个维度并非先后阶段，而是并行、共同激活且相互约束的体验侧面，并据此讨论如何用行为、生理、神经认知和计算等多方法融合、时间敏感的设计，分别考察各维度的贡献及其交互，从而超越对环境的静态或过于粗略的描述。

papers.title: Perceiving others’ difficulties in motor sequence learning: behavioral and fMRI evidence from physical and observational practice
papers.authors: CHANRAUD S, MICHELET T, ZENON A, BOUTIN A, BADETS A.
papers.abstract: Abstract From a behavioral and neuronal perspectives, observational and physical practice have often been considered functionally equivalent during motor learning. However, specific learning contexts may challenge such a functional equivalence hypothesis. In observational learning, the perception of difficulties experienced by others may allow learners to partially distance themselves from these episodes, thereby limiting their impact on learning. In contrast, during physical practice, performance difficulties are directly experienced, which may constrain such distancing mechanisms. Indeed, an observer watching a model that uses a wrong physical strategy can ignore erroneous trials in order to preserve action encoding. The main goal of the present study was to prevent such observer avoidance and to test the relative neurocognitive functional equivalence between physical and observational practice. During this experiment, both groups learned two motor sequences. Only one sequence was repeatedly interrupted to perturb encoding. Behavioral results revealed that both groups were similarly negatively impacted by such interruptions. At the neural level, however, no corrected whole-brain task-fMRI interactions were observed; accordingly, task-related activation findings should be interpreted as exploratory descriptive signatures rather than confirmatory evidence of modality-specific neural mechanisms. Resting-state connectivity analyses nevertheless revealed candidate post-training changes suggesting that physical practice predominantly engages motor and striato-cerebellar feedback loops, whereas observational learning relies more strongly on fronto-cerebellar and episodic memory networks. Overall, these findings indicate that comparable behavioral outcomes may emerge from partially distinct post-training neural adaptations, highlighting a context-dependent form of functional equivalence between learning modalities.

relevance.reason: 研究运动序列学习（学习/记忆的神经机制）并报告训练后静息态连接变化，属认知与静息态脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较动作序列学习中身体练习与观察练习是否功能等价，并考察他人所遇困难的影响。行为结果显示，两种练习方式受到序列编码干扰的负面影响相似；任务态fMRI未发现经校正的全脑交互，相关激活仅作探索性描述。静息态连接分析提示，身体练习更多涉及运动及纹状体-小脑反馈环路，观察学习则更依赖额-小脑和情景记忆网络。作者据此认为，相近的行为结果可能来自部分不同的训练后神经适应，两种学习方式的功能等价具有情境依赖性。

papers.title: Working memory deficits under high cognitive load in older adults with insomnia disorder: associations with frontoparietal control network connectivity and glymphatic function
papers.authors: Xu K, Wang X, Liao H, Sun Y, Bai L, Guo Z, Zhang L, Liu Z.
papers.abstract: Abstract Insomnia disorder (ID) is associated with cognitive impairment, but the neuroimaging correlates of high-load working memory deficits in older adults remain unclear. We recruited 80 older adults, including 40 participants with ID and 40 healthy controls (HCs) matched for age, sex, and education. Working memory was assessed using digit span and N-back tasks. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging was used to characterize functional connectivity (FC) within the frontoparietal control network (FPCN). Glymphatic function was assessed using the diffusion tensor imaging analysis along the perivascular space (DTI-ALPS) index. We compared groups, examined brain–behaviour associations, and tested whether the DTI-ALPS index moderated the association between functional connectivity within the FPCN and high-load working memory performance. Compared with HCs, participants with ID showed lower backward and total digit-span scores, reduced 2-back accuracy, and longer reaction times during the 1-back and 2-back conditions. They also showed significantly reduced FC between the left lateral prefrontal cortex and the left posterior parietal cortex. In addition, the ID group exhibited a lower DTI-ALPS index, indicating glymphatic dysfunction. Moderation analysis further showed that glymphatic function, as indexed by DTI-ALPS, moderated the association between left lateral prefrontal cortex–left posterior parietal cortex FC and 2-back accuracy. These findings link high-load working memory vulnerability in older adults with ID to altered functional connectivity within the FPCN and lower DTI-ALPS values. This multimodal neuroimaging profile provides a framework for investigating sleep-related cognitive vulnerability.

relevance.reason: 研究失眠老年人高负荷工作记忆缺陷与额顶控制网络功能连接及类淋巴功能（DTI-ALPS）的关联，涉及认知脑机制、结构-功能关联及脑疾病认知脆弱性。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注老年失眠障碍患者在高认知负荷下的工作记忆缺陷及其神经影像相关因素，比较了失眠障碍组与健康对照组在工作记忆任务、额顶控制网络功能连接和类淋巴功能上的差异。结果显示，失眠障碍患者在高负荷工作记忆任务中表现更差，左侧外侧前额叶与左侧后顶叶之间的功能连接减弱，且反映类淋巴功能的DTI-ALPS指数更低。进一步分析表明，类淋巴功能调节了上述功能连接与高负荷工作记忆表现之间的关联。作者据此提出，额顶控制网络连接改变与类淋巴功能下降共同构成了老年失眠障碍患者高负荷工作记忆脆弱性的多模态神经影像特征，但相关结果尚属关联性发现，其因果方向与临床意义仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Reduced Resting-State Connectivity Is Associated with Subjective Well-Being and Engagement in Chinese Children and Early Adolescents
papers.authors: Hu X, Chen S, Yan C.
papers.abstract: Abstract Subjective well-being is a critical protective factor during childhood and adolescence, yet its neural mechanisms remain poorly characterized, in part because prior neuroimaging work has relied on unidimensional hedonic scales and pathological cohorts. We examined whole-brain neural correlates of multidimensional well-being in a typically developing Chinese cohort (N = 196, ages 6–18 years) using resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI), network-based statistics, and graph-theoretical analysis. Well-being was assessed with the PERMA-Profiler, in which higher scores indicate greater flourishing across five domains. Higher overall well-being, driven mainly by the Engagement dimension, was associated with reduced functional connectivity (FC) across large-scale networks. The strongest pattern involved functional decoupling between the default mode network (DMN) and task-positive networks and between the somatomotor and ventral attention networks. Complementary topological analyses linked higher engagement to lower global network integration. Edge-level FC associations survived stringent correction for multiple comparisons, and engagement-specific topological associations proved more robust than total well-being scores after accounting for nonlinear age effects. Rather than indicating dysfunction, this sparse connectivity profile may reflect a more economical, lower-density resting-state architecture in healthy development. These findings position engagement as a candidate bridging between positive psychological functioning and intrinsic brain network organization in youth, and demonstrate that multidimensional well-being frameworks can reveal domain-specific neural signatures invisible to unidimensional approaches.

relevance.reason: 研究儿童青少年静息态功能连接与主观幸福感（含Engagement维度）的关联，属静息态脑网络组织与心理功能的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注儿童青少年主观幸福感的静息态脑网络关联，以典型发育的中国儿童和青少年为对象，用静息态功能磁共振结合网络统计与图论分析，考察多维幸福感（PERMA框架）与全脑功能连接的关系。结果显示，总体幸福感较高——主要由投入（Engagement）维度驱动——与大规模网络间功能连接减弱相关，最突出的是默认网络与任务正网络之间、以及感觉运动网络与腹侧注意网络之间的功能解耦；图论分析还提示投入较高者全局网络整合程度较低。作者认为，这种较稀疏的连接模式未必代表功能异常，而可能反映健康发育中更经济、低密度的静息态网络架构，并提示投入可能是连接积极心理功能与内在脑网络组织的候选桥梁。

papers.title: Aberrant anterior insular functional connectivity patterns and intestinal microbiota differences in mild traumatic brain injury patients accompanied by cognitive impairment
papers.authors: Li Y, Chen L, Chen J, Zhao P, Li T, Yin B, Bai G.
papers.abstract: Abstract This study aimed to explore the correlation between differences in the abundance of gut microbiota and functional connectivity (FC) in the bilateral anterior insula (aIns) among patients with mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI). Twenty-six mTBI patients and forty-six age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HCs) were recruited for this study. Participants underwent clinical and neuropsychological assessments, resting-state functional MRI scans, fecal sample collection, and sequencing of intestinal microbial genes. Comparing the relative abundance of gut microbiota between mTBI patients and HCs revealed several bacterial genera showing increased or decreased abundance in mTBI patients. Furthermore, disrupted FC was observed between the aIns and various regions (such as the left cerebellum Crus2, the orbital part of the right middle frontal gyrus (ORB.Mid.R), and the bilateral putamen) in mTBI. Particularly, decreased FC from the left aIns to the ORB.Mid.R, along with reduced levels of Prevotella , may collectively be associated with the onset or exacerbation of depression in mTBI patients. Notably, a potential shift characterized by an increase in Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus , could be associated with brain damage and cognitive impairment among mTBI. These findings offer insights that could guide future clinical investigations towards the development of targeted probiotic formulations aimed at alleviating various mood disorders.

relevance.reason: 研究轻度脑外伤患者前岛叶静息态功能连接改变与认知/情绪障碍及肠道菌群关联，涉及脑网络组织与脑损伤后认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究以轻度创伤性脑损伤患者与健康对照为对象，结合静息态功能磁共振、肠道菌群测序和神经心理评估，考察双侧前岛叶功能连接与肠道菌群差异之间的关联。结果显示，患者前岛叶与多个脑区的功能连接出现异常，同时若干菌属的相对丰度发生改变；其中左侧前岛叶与右侧额中回眶部连接减弱及普雷沃菌水平降低，可能共同与抑郁的发生或加重有关，而双歧杆菌和乳杆菌增多则可能与脑损伤及认知障碍相关。作者据此提出，这些关联或可为今后开发针对情绪障碍的靶向益生菌制剂提供线索，但相关关系尚不能说明因果。

papers.title: Positive and Negative Retinotopic Codes in the Human Hippocampus.
papers.authors: Angeli PA, Steel A, Robertson CE.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: The hippocampus sits at the apex of the visual hierarchy, yet little is known about the visual properties of this core memory structure. Recent work suggests that a latent, bivalent retinotopic code persists in large-scale memory networks at the cortical apex, scaffolding interactions with sensory networks. Here, we tested whether a bivalent retinotopic code also persists within the hippocampus. To do this, we leveraged high-resolution 7 T functional MRI along with voxel-scale visual population receptive field (pRF) modeling in seven densely sampled individuals (five female). Our findings reveal a robust, voxel-scale retinotopic code broadly distributed across subfields and along the long axis of the human hippocampus, comprising roughly equal proportions of pRFs with positive and negative-amplitude responses to visual stimulation. Hippocampal pRFs displayed canonical visual properties, including stable valence and visual field preferences across runs and a contralateral bias. Retinotopic structure also persisted at rest: hippocampal voxels with similar pRF locations were more strongly correlated than voxels representing different visual field locations. Finally, across the ventral visual stream, the prevalence of negative-amplitude pRFs increased with mnemonic involvement, culminating in the balanced, bivalent organization within the hippocampus. These findings support the view that sensory and mnemonic systems are coupled through a shared retinotopic code at the apex of the visual hierarchy.

relevance.reason: 用7T fMRI在人海马中刻画视觉群体感受野编码及其静息态组织，属感知/记忆的脑机制与自发活动组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨人类海马是否保留视觉拓扑编码，采用高分辨率7T功能磁共振结合体素尺度视觉群体感受野建模，在少量个体中检验海马对视觉刺激的反应组织。结果显示，海马各亚区及长轴方向广泛存在稳定的拓扑编码，正、负振幅感受野比例大致相当，并表现出稳定的视野偏好和对侧偏置；静息状态下，感受野位置相近的体素相关更强。作者还发现，从腹侧视觉通路到海马，负振幅感受野随记忆参与程度增加而增多，最终形成海马内正负平衡的双价组织，提示感觉与记忆系统可能通过共享的拓扑编码相互耦合。

papers.title: Hippocampal Theta Distinguishes between Memory-Guided and Exploratory Saccades in Humans.
papers.authors: Castelblanco Riveros CA, Angeli PA, van der Meer MAA, Bujarski KA, Robertson CE.
papers.journal: The Journal of neuroscience : the official journal of the Society for Neuroscience
papers.abstract: Memory shapes how we explore the visual world, but the neural mechanisms linking mnemonic processes to eye movements during naturalistic viewing remain poorly understood. Theta-band oscillatory activity in the hippocampus is time-locked with eye movements in primates, suggesting a putative mechanism for coordinating mnemonic processing and oculomotor behavior. Yet, it remains unknown whether this coupling generalizes to episodic memory-guided viewing in humans, whether slow (3-6 Hz) and fast (6-10 Hz) theta bands play dissociable functions, and whether this coupling is sensitive to the direction of upcoming eye movements. Here, we used intracranial EEG and eye-tracking data from 11 neurosurgical patients of either sex (Keles et al., 2024) to address these questions. Using fixation-locked analyses, we found that hippocampal theta dynamics differentiate memory-guided from memory-independent fixations of episodically encoded naturalistic scenes (i.e., movies) through power and coherence mechanisms that are temporally and spectrally dissociable. First, immediately after fixations (∼0-250 ms), slow-theta power was more strongly suppressed during memory-guided trials (i.e., true positive, TP) than correct memory-independent trials (i.e., true negative, TN). Second, in the period around fixations (-80 to 60 ms), theta phase coherence increased independent of power during TP versus TN trials. This increase in coherence was most pronounced for contraversive relative to ipsiversive fixations, consistent with direction-sensitive hippocampal-oculomotor coordination during memory-guided viewing. Together, these findings suggest that hippocampal theta plays dissociable, time-locked roles in memory-guided fixations during naturalistic retrieval, supporting an ecologically relevant role of the hippocampus in coordinating memory and active visual behavior.

relevance.reason: 颅内脑电记录显示海马theta活动区分记忆引导与探索性眼动，涉及记忆与自然观看中的脑机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注海马theta振荡是否以及如何将情景记忆与自然观看中的眼动协调起来，利用颅内脑电和眼动追踪记录神经外科患者观看已编码影片时的注视相关活动。结果显示，记忆引导的注视与记忆无关的正确注视相比，海马慢theta功率在注视后早期受到更强抑制，而注视前后的theta相位一致性则在功率之外升高，且这种一致性升高在反向注视时更明显。作者据此提出，海马theta可能通过可分离的功率与一致性机制，在自然提取过程中参与记忆引导的注视，并支持海马协调记忆与主动视觉行为的生态作用；这些结果来自特定患者样本，尚不能直接推广为临床干预依据。
