papers.title: Disruption of Sensorimotor Network Connectivity in Patients With Supratentorial Gliomas During Mild Sedation With Midazolam: An Exploratory Interventional Study.
papers.authors: Yin X, Wang Q, Gelb AW, Peng Y, Han R, Ma D, Zeng M, Dong J, Zhang X, Ma T, Jia X, Lin N.
papers.abstract: Introduction Midazolam has been shown to induce transient motor deficits in patients with supratentorial gliomas. However, its effects on brain networks remain unclear, given the compensatory network reorganization in response to tumor-induced damage. This study examined sensorimotor network (SMN) intra- and internetwork functional connectivity before and after midazolam mild sedation in patients with motor cortex gliomas, compared with healthy controls. Methods Glioma patients and healthy volunteers underwent resting-state functional MRI in the awake state and mild midazolam sedation. Regions of interest were defined in the primary motor cortex (M1) using a 6 mm radius. Statistical significance was set at an uncorrected voxel-wise threshold of P<0.001 and a false discovery rate-corrected cluster-wise threshold of P<0.05. This trial was registered at clinicaltrials.gov (NCT03984240) on June 11, 2019. Results Thirty-four participants (18 glioma patients and 16 healthy volunteers) were analyzed. Glioma patients showed reduced negative functional connectivity between the SMN and the default mode network (DMN) in the awake state (P<0.05) and decreased SMN intranetwork connectivity. Following mild midazolam sedation, glioma patients demonstrated enhanced SMN intranetwork connectivity, with increased connectivity between M1 and the bilateral precentral gyrus, postcentral gyrus, and supramarginal regions (all P<0.001). Internetwork connectivity was decreased between M1 and the temporal fusiform cortex (T=8.05 and P=0.01), and between M1 and the occipital fusiform gyrus/inferior lateral occipital cortex (T=5.88 and P=0.002). Conclusion Midazolam mild sedation alters SMN connectivity in glioma patients, characterized by enhanced intranetwork compensation and impaired cross-network integration. These findings suggest potential vulnerabilities of functional brain networks during the perioperative period.

relevance.reason: 研究胶质瘤患者感觉运动网络在镇静前后的静息态功能连接改变，涉及脑网络组织与肿瘤相关重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性干预研究考察了运动皮层胶质瘤患者在咪达唑仑轻度镇静前后感觉运动网络（SMN）内及网络间功能连接的变化，并与健康对照比较，采用静息态功能磁共振成像。结果显示，患者在清醒状态下SMN与默认模式网络之间的负向连接减弱、SMN网络内连接降低；轻度镇静后，SMN网络内连接反而增强，而M1与部分颞枕区域之间的网络间连接下降。作者据此认为，咪达唑仑镇静在胶质瘤患者中表现为网络内代偿增强与跨网络整合受损并存，提示围手术期脑功能网络可能存在脆弱性；这些发现来自小样本探索性研究，尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: The Differential Impact of Sleep-Dependent Consolidation in Speech Perceptual Learning: A Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Zhou X, Earle FS.
papers.journal: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR
papers.abstract: Purpose Sleep plays a critical role in speech-sound learning. However, owing to methodological heterogeneity and inconsistent findings, the mechanisms by which sleep consolidates speech sounds are poorly understood. This review synthesizes evidence on sleep-dependent speech-sound consolidation to identify consistent behavioral patterns. Method Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 guidelines, we searched five major databases supplemented by reference list screening and expert consultation. We selected and reviewed 30 empirical articles representing 1,646 participants, primarily healthy young adults, in the full text for qualitative analysis. No meta-analysis was performed because of considerable variability in study designs and outcome measures. Results Sleep robustly supports stabilization of fragile speech-sound traces from wake-dependent degradation, while enhancement and generalization emerge only conditionally. We observed enhancement effects in approximately half of the included studies, which were predominantly modulated by learner aptitude. Generalization occurred most consistently when the training variability was sufficient to support feature abstraction. Notably, the null findings tended to be correlated with signal degradation or elevated computational demands at encoding or assessment, suggesting that consolidation mechanisms may be resource limited and sensitive to encoding fidelity. Conclusions Taken together, our findings suggest that sleep acts as a selective filter. The brain prioritizes the stabilization of weakly encoded speech-sound traces, while allowing active reorganization only for representations that were robustly encoded. We propose a hierarchical framework to account for the observed patterns, along with translational research directions that leverage distinct learning pathways.

relevance.reason: 综述睡眠依赖的语音感知学习巩固机制，涉及人脑对语音表征的稳定与重组，属语言与学习记忆的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述关注睡眠如何巩固言语声音学习，按系统综述流程梳理了以健康年轻成人为主的实证研究，因设计与测量差异较大而未做元分析。主要发现是：睡眠能稳定清醒时易衰退的脆弱言语声音痕迹，而增强和泛化只在特定条件下出现——增强约见于半数研究，多受学习者能力调节；训练变异性足以支持特征抽象时泛化更一致。未发现效应的结果常与信号退化或编码、评估时认知负荷较高相关，提示巩固机制可能受资源限制并依赖编码质量。作者据此提出睡眠像选择性过滤器，优先稳定弱编码痕迹，仅对稳固表征进行主动重组，并给出层级框架及转化研究方向。

papers.title: Longitudinal brain dynamics and prediction of craving changes in individuals with methamphetamine use disorder.
papers.authors: Song Q, Yang W, Du Z, Wang D, Wen X, Liu J, Yuan K.
papers.abstract: Individuals with methamphetamine use disorder (MUD) exhibited functional and structural brain recovery during abstinence. However, longitudinal neural changes of large-scale brain networks after prolonged abstinence remain unclear. Here, energy landscape analysis was applied to resting-state fMRI to characterize dominant activity patterns in 41 healthy controls and 40 individuals with MUD at baseline and after prolonged abstinence. We compared the dynamic characteristics of these patterns across groups and stages. Support vector regression model was constructed using baseline dynamic indices to predict craving changes after prolonged abstinence. We found that individuals with MUD exhibited rigid brain dynamics, which were correlated with abnormal brain network coordination and behaviors. Following prolonged abstinence, neural flexibility showed partial improvement, and dynamic indices could predict longitudinal craving changes. We revealed atypical brain network dynamics and their partial recovery during prolonged abstinence in MUD and suggested that dynamic indices could serve as biomarkers for predicting craving changes.

relevance.reason: 研究甲基苯丙胺使用障碍者长期戒断后大规模脑网络静息态动态变化及其与渴求的关系，属脑疾病中脑网络组织与可塑性研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注甲基苯丙胺使用障碍者在长期戒断后大规模脑网络动力学的纵向变化，用静息态fMRI能量景观分析比较患者与健康对照在基线和戒断后的主导活动模式，并尝试用基线动态指标预测渴求变化。结果显示，患者表现出僵化的脑动力学，与异常的网络协调和行为相关；长期戒断后神经灵活性仅部分改善，且动态指标能够预测渴求的纵向变化。作者据此认为，这些动态指标有望作为预测渴求变化的生物标志物，但改善是部分的，预测价值仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Striatal dopaminergic function and cortical functional connectivity in 22q11.2 deletion syndrome: an integrative multimodal <sup>18</sup>F-DOPA PET and magnetic resonance imaging study.
papers.authors: Mancini V, Rogdaki M, Jauhar S, Moretto M, Veronese M, Turkheimer F, Howes OD, McCutcheon RA.
papers.abstract: Dopaminergic signalling is critical for regulating large-scale brain network dynamics and is implicated in the pathophysiology of psychotic disorders. 22q11.2 deletion syndrome (22q11DS), a high-penetrance genetic risk factor for schizophrenia, is associated with both dopaminergic alterations and disruptions in functional connectivity (FC), yet the degree to which these separate people with 22q11DS from healthy controls and their inter-relationship remains unclear. Eighteen individuals with 22q11DS (no history of psychosis or antipsychotic use) and 22 controls underwent [18 F]-DOPA PET imaging to assess striatal dopamine synthesis (indexed by Kicer values) and resting-state fMRI to examine FC. Classification performance using FC, dopamine measures, and their combination was assessed via repeated 10-fold cross-validation. Associations between Kicer , connectivity, and psychotic symptoms were evaluated using linear regression. FC alone classified 22q11DS with 68% balanced accuracy (p = 0.004), Kicer alone with 77% (p < 0.001), and combined measures with 85% balanced accuracy (p < 0.001), indicating additive value. The somatomotor and auditory networks contributed most to group discrimination. Across individuals, higher Kicer was significantly associated with more control-like connectivity profiles (p = 0.011), with significant effects in all striatal subdivisions. No association was found between FC and subclinical psychotic symptoms. This multimodal study demonstrates a significant association between striatal dopamine synthesis capacity and functional brain network architecture in 22q11DS. Higher dopamine synthesis was linked to more normative FC, potentially suggesting FC differences reflect a compensatory, rather than pathogenic role. These findings bridge genetic risk at the 22q11.2 locus with dopamine dysfunction and large-scale networks, offering novel insights into the neurobiology of 22q11DS and related neuropsychiatric risk.

relevance.reason: 以22q11.2缺失综合征患者为对象，结合PET多巴胺合成与静息态fMRI功能连接，探讨脑网络组织与精神疾病风险的神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究探讨22q11.2缺失综合征（一种精神分裂症高外显率遗传风险因素）中纹状体多巴胺合成能力与皮层功能连接的关系，以及二者能否区分患者与健康对照。研究对象为无精神病史且未使用抗精神病药的22q11.2缺失个体和健康对照，方法结合18F-DOPA PET测纹状体多巴胺合成与静息态fMRI测功能连接。结果显示，功能连接与多巴胺指标各自具有一定区分能力，二者结合后区分准确率进一步提高，提示信息具有叠加价值；其中感觉运动网络和听觉网络贡献最大。个体层面，多巴胺合成能力越高，功能连接模式越接近对照者，这一关联在各纹状体亚区均存在；功能连接与亚临床精神病症状未见关联。作者据此提出，22q11.2缺失中的功能连接差异可能反映代偿而非致病作用，但该解释仍属推测。

papers.title: Landscaping neurodevelopment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder.
papers.authors: Liu N, Wang YS, Zhou ZX, Gao P, Luo C, Zhang X, Zhu Z, Gao Y, Ren F, Zhu Y, Chen LZ, Li H, Ju C, Wang P, Bedford S, Terroba CP, Dorfschmidt L, Bethlehem RAI, Yang N, Gong ZQ, Xu T, Zang Y, Wang Y, Lifespan Brain Chart Consortium (LBCC), Chinese Color Nest Consortium (CCNC), Chinese Brain Health Imaging Consortium (CHART), Chinese Child Brain Development (CCBD) Consortium, Dong Q, Liu L, Qian Q, Zuo XN.
papers.abstract: We aim to decipher the neurodevelopmental diversity of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) using lifespan brain charts within a brainality landscape framework. It first generated age- and sex-referenced centile scores of brain morphology for 270 children with ADHD by revising the worldwide lifespan brain chart (n = 177,701) for 31,894 healthy Chinese samples, including 25,768 scans from the Chinese Brain Health Imaging Consortium (CHART) and 6126 scans from the Chinese Child Brain Development (CCBD) study. Children with ADHD were then classified using partitioning around medoids based on their centile scores as deviations from a developing control reference to identify trait constellations underlying ADHD's landscape heterogeneity. The brainality landscape identified two neurotypes: children with smaller volume (SVC-ADHD) and children with larger volume (LVC-ADHD), who are not different between sex, imaging site, gestational and maternal age as well as clinical symptom composition. SVC-ADHD children are younger and have lower mean birth weight, and showed neurocognitive impairments and poorer hemispheric differentiation within the default network as well as more gene expressions related to organism developmental processes, and more prenatal risk factors such as maternal passive smoking. In contrast, LVC-ADHD children are older and demonstrated more pronounced behavior and emotional impairments, while their language, somatomotor, and cognitive control networks exhibited poorer hemispheric specialization. Genetic findings were less pronounced in LVC-ADHD and remained exploratory and mainly linked to neurogenesis. Our work charted the brainality of ADHD to reflect distinct developmental profiles with combinations of genetic, prenatal, and later-life influences, implying clinical potential of future precision translation.

relevance.reason: 该研究以ADHD儿童脑形态发育分型，并关联半球分化与认知网络组织，属于脑发育与疾病机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在借助寿命脑图谱和“脑性景观”框架，刻画注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的神经发育异质性。作者先基于大规模健康中国人群数据修订脑形态的年龄和性别参照百分位，再据此对ADHD儿童进行聚类，识别出脑体积偏小和偏大两种神经类型。两类儿童在性别、成像站点和临床症状构成上无差异，但偏小类型年龄更小、出生体重更低，表现为神经认知受损、默认网络半球分化较差，并与更多发育相关基因表达及母亲被动吸烟等产前风险因素相关；偏大类型年龄更大，行为和情绪问题更突出，语言、躯体运动和认知控制网络的半球特化较差，遗传关联较弱且仍属探索性。作者认为，这反映了遗传、产前和后期因素组合形成的不同发育轨迹，并提示未来精准转化的可能，但相关发现尚不能直接用于临床。

papers.title: Multilevel brain functional heterogeneity in major depressive disorder based on normative modeling of multicenter resting-state EEG.
papers.authors: Sun S, Guo H, Kong W, Wang Z, Chen H, Li X, Hu B.
papers.abstract: Background Depression exhibits substantial neurobiological heterogeneity. Conventional group-level EEG analyses often fail to identify reproducible biomarkers, limiting objective diagnosis and treatment. This study employed a normative modeling framework to characterize individual EEG abnormalities by quantifying deviations from a healthy reference distribution. Method This study integrated multicenter resting-state EEG data from 1163 participants (participants with major depressive disorder [MDD] = 369; healthy controls [HC] = 794). Normative models were constructed using Dortmund Vital Study data (HC = 608). In the test set, individual deviations in time- and frequency-domain EEG features were quantified at both scalp and source levels. Abnormal patterns were subsequently characterized across electrode, regional, connectivity, and network levels. Group differences were assessed using permutation testing with FDR correction. Results Normative modeling revealed that EEG abnormalities in MDD were predominantly characterized by highly individualized deviation patterns, with limited overlap at the group level. Significant abnormalities were mainly observed in prefrontal regions and the orbitofrontal cortex (OFC), particularly in beta-band relative power. At the network level, only the limbic subnetwork remained significant after multiple-comparison correction, with approximately 25% of MDD patients showing significant deviations. Conclusion Multilevel EEG analysis based on normative modeling reveals pronounced individualized neurofunctional abnormalities in MDD and identifies relatively stable alterations in the OFC and limbic network. This framework provides a robust basis for characterizing neurobiological heterogeneity and supporting individualized precision diagnosis in depression.

relevance.reason: 用多中心静息态EEG规范建模刻画抑郁症个体化脑功能异常与网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注重性抑郁障碍在脑功能上的异质性，采用规范建模框架，基于多中心静息态脑电数据，在头皮和源层面量化个体在时域与频域特征上偏离健康参考分布的程度，并考察电极、区域、连接和网络多个层面的异常模式。结果显示，患者的脑电异常主要表现为高度个体化的偏离模式，组水平上的重叠有限；较一致的异常集中在前额区域和眶额皮层，尤其是β频段相对功率，网络层面则只有边缘子网络在多重比较校正后仍显著，约四分之一患者表现出显著偏离。作者据此认为，规范建模下的多层面脑电分析能够刻画抑郁的神经功能异质性，并提示眶额皮层和边缘网络存在相对稳定的改变，为个体化精准诊断提供了框架，但相关发现仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The developing adolescent brain: Implications for youth justice and children in criminal proceedings.
papers.authors: Blakemore SJ.
papers.abstract: Adolescence is a unique developmental stage, defined by neural reorganisation and a heightened sensitivity to the social environment. Brain maturation is a prolonged process extending well into the twenties, involving microstructural refinements such as axonal myelination and synaptic pruning, which are partly dependent on environmental input. This period of heightened neuroplasticity coincides with a shift toward peer affiliation and increased susceptibility to risk-taking, particularly in social settings. Consequently, adolescent decision-making should be viewed through a social lens, in which the drive to avoid social exclusion and to secure peer acceptance acts as a powerful motivator of behaviour. This framework underscores the importance of social connections and suggests that, conversely, disruptions to these relationships, and in particular social isolation, can be harmful to adolescent development. Studies have demonstrated that even brief periods of social isolation in adolescence can increase reward seeking and reward learning, heighten threat sensitivity and reduce risk perception. The research reviewed in this paper has implications for how young people are treated in the youth justice system. I argue that justice systems should evolve from punitive approaches toward rehabilitative frameworks and age-appropriate legal thresholds grounded in evidence-based insights into the developing adolescent brain and mind.

relevance.reason: 综述青少年脑发育（髓鞘化、突触修剪、神经可塑性）与社会认知/风险决策的关系，属脑发育与认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 本文围绕青少年大脑发育及其对少年司法与刑事诉讼中儿童待遇的意义展开论述。作者指出，青春期伴随持续的神经重组和对社会环境的高度敏感，脑成熟延续至二十多岁，涉及部分依赖环境输入的微结构变化；这一时期神经可塑性较高，同伴归属需求增强，在社会情境中更易冒险，回避社会排斥和争取同伴接纳成为行为的重要驱动。文中还引用研究说明，青少年期即使短暂的社会隔离也可能增强奖赏寻求与奖赏学习、提高威胁敏感性并降低风险感知。作者据此主张司法系统应从惩罚转向康复框架，并依据对青少年大脑与心理发育的证据设定适龄法律门槛。

papers.title: Distribution and age-interactions of cortical thickness associated with specific classes of medication used to treat obsessive-compulsive disorder: Results from the international ENIGMA consortium.
papers.authors: Ivanov I, Dzinalija N, Abe Y, Alonso P, Ameis SH, Arnold PD, Baker JT, Balachander S, Banaj N, Bargalló N, Batistuzzo MC, Benedetti F, Beucke JC, Bollettini I, Brennan BP, Buitelaar J, Calvo R, Cheng Y, Ching CR, Cho KIK, Dallaspezia S, Denys D, Diniz JB, Ely BA, Ferreira S, Feusner JD, Fitzgerald KD, Fontaine M, Gruner P, Hanna G, Hirano Y, Hoexter MQ, Hu H, Huijser C, Jahanshad N, James A, Jaspers-Fayer F, Jiang H, Kang MJ, Kathmann N, Kaufmann C, Kim M, Koch K, Kwon JS, Lázaro L, Liu Y, Lochner C, Marsh R, Martínez-Zalacaín I, Mataix-Cols D, Menchón JM, Minuzzi L, Morer A, Morgado P, Naaijen J, Nakagawa A, Narayanaswamy JC, Nurmi EL, Oh S, Perriello C, Phillips ML, Piacentini JC, Picó-Pérez M, Piras F, Piras F, Reddy YJ, Rodríguez-Manrique D, Sakai Y, Shimizu E, Simpson HB, Soreni N, Soriano-Mas C, Stern ER, Stevens MC, Stewart SE, Szeszko PR, Tang J, Thomopoulos S, Tolin DF, van der Werf YD, van Wingen GA, Vecchio D, Veltman DJ, Venkatasubramanian G, Walitza S, Wang Z, Watanabe A, Xu X, Yun JY, Zarei M, Zhang F, ENIGMA-OCD Working Group, Thompson PM, Stein DJ, van den Heuvel OA, O'Neill J.
papers.journal: Cortex; a journal devoted to the study of the nervous system and behavior
papers.abstract: MRI studies have revealed structural brain abnormalities in obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). Less is known about how age and medication influence them. We analyzed cortical thickness (CT) data from the ENIGMA-OCD Consortium, the world's largest OCD MRI database (46 datasets from 35 centers). Subjects comprised 2057 healthy controls, 1167 unmedicated individuals with OCD, and 1073 individuals with OCD taking one or more psychiatric medications at time of scan. Using a harmonized FreeSurfer protocol, each MRI was parcellated into 68 cortical regions. Linear mixed models controlling for site and symptom severity mapped associations of OCD diagnosis and medication-any psychiatric medication and the medication classes serotonin-reuptake inhibitors (SRIs), tricyclics, antipsychotics, and benzodiazepines-on CT and their interaction with age in each region. Findings surviving FDR-correction included: 1) Unmedicated OCD participants showed thicker cortex and/or lesser CT decrease with age than controls in precentral, inferior parietal, superior parietal, and superior temporal regions (p < .001-.002); 2) In several regions, OCD participants taking any medication had thinner cortex than unmedicated; negative associations of age with CT were similar to controls (p < .001-.005). 3) Findings for SRIs resembled those in for any psychiatric medication. 4) CT was lower in participants taking benzodiazepines than in unmedicated participants in 30 regions (p < .001-.014). No associations of CT involving tricyclics or antipsychotics survived FDR-correction. Commonly prescribed OCD drugs may influence CT in ways that vary with cortical region and medication class. Potential mechanisms are discussed.

relevance.reason: 该研究在强迫症患者中考察药物与年龄对皮层厚度的交互影响，属于以脑结构改变理解精神疾病的脑机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于ENIGMA-OCD联盟的多中心MRI数据，分析强迫症诊断及不同类别精神药物与皮质厚度的关联，并考察其与年龄的交互作用。结果显示，未服药的强迫症患者部分脑区皮质较厚或随年龄变薄更慢；服用任何精神药物者多个脑区皮质较薄，且与年龄的负相关类似健康对照，其中血清素再摄取抑制剂的结果与总体用药相似。苯二氮䓬类使用者在较多脑区皮质更薄，而三环类和抗精神病药未见经校正后仍显著的关联。作者提示常用强迫症药物可能以随脑区和药物类别而异的方式影响皮质厚度，相关机制尚待探讨。

papers.title: Divergent neural dynamics of multidimensional semantic access for concrete and abstract words.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Wang S, Zong C, Lin N.
papers.abstract: Semantic comprehension requires accessing multiple dimensions of meaning, yet the temporal dynamics of these dimensions remain unclear. Previous research has predominantly examined the neural dynamics of lexical semantics as a whole, which is equivalent to investigating the average of neural dynamics across various dimensions of semantic processing. Here, we analyzed openly released electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from 9 participants listening to naturalistic stories and used time-resolved encoding models to decompose neural responses into six semantic dimensions: vision, motor, space, time, socialness, and emotion. When analyzing all words together, nearly all dimensions showed a common response peaking around 350 ms. However, when neural dynamics of multidimensional semantic access were analyzed separately for concrete and abstract words, a dissociation in access latencies emerged: for concrete words, sensorimotor dimensions reached peak activation earlier than non-sensorimotor dimensions; whereas for abstract words, the social dimension peaked at 225 ms, earlier than other dimensions. These findings demonstrate that the brain dynamically prioritizes semantic dimensions depending on concept type.

relevance.reason: 用颅内电生理解码自然故事中具体/抽象词语义维度的时序神经动态，属语言语义加工的脑机制研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语义理解中不同意义维度的神经加工时序，利用公开的颅内脑电记录和时程编码模型，将听故事时的神经反应分解为视觉、运动、空间、时间、社会性和情绪六个语义维度。若把所有词合并分析，多数维度呈现约350毫秒的共同峰值；但按具体词和抽象词分开看，则出现加工潜伏期的分离：具体词的感知运动维度早于非感知运动维度达峰，抽象词则是社会维度在225毫秒最早达峰。作者据此认为，大脑会依据概念类型动态调整各语义维度的优先顺序，提示语义加工并非单一平均过程，而具有维度特异的时间组织。

papers.title: Muscle age acceleration shapes resting-state brain connectivity: an EEG study on older adults.
papers.authors: Frasca F, Pappalettera C, Cacciotti A, Ventura L, Morrone M, Manca A, Deriu F, Vecchio F.
papers.abstract: Aging is a multifaceted process where physiological metrics, such as brain age and muscle age (MA), provide deeper insights than chronological age alone. These nonlinear trajectories are heavily influenced by exogenous factors like lifestyle and nutrition. In older populations, muscle age acceleration (MAA) critically impacts functional autonomy and cognitive health, necessitating research into its link with brain network organization to refine assessments and, based on these, integrated motor and cognitive rehabilitation strategies. In this study, eyes-closed resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) was recorded from 101 healthy, neurologically intact older adults. MA and MAA were quantified using a regression model incorporating the functional assessments recommended by the European Working Group on Sarcopenia in Older People (EWGSOP-2) consensus (anthropometrics, muscle strength, and motor functional tests). Participants were stratified into three groups based on their MAA: decelerated MA, normal MA, and accelerated MA. Brain connectivity was assessed through magnitude-squared coherence (MSCoh) and node strength analyses. The results demonstrated that decelerated MA subjects exhibit significantly lower MSCoh compared to the normal and accelerated groups in the Alpha 1, Alpha 2, and Beta 1 bands. Furthermore, node strength analysis revealed that the decelerated MA group possessed lower values in the right frontal area across Alpha 1, Beta 1, and Beta 2 bands. Conversely, the normal MA group exhibited lower values in the right temporal region compared to the accelerated MA group. These findings may suggest that divergent muscle aging trajectories significantly modulate brain network topography. This brain-body interconnection highlights the potential for personalized interventions designed to redirect muscle aging trajectories, ultimately enhancing global functioning and quality of life of older people.

relevance.reason: 研究老年人静息态EEG脑网络连接与肌肉老化加速的关系，属静息态脑功能组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注老年人肌肉年龄加速（MAA）与静息态脑网络组织之间的关系，对健康、神经系统完好的老年人进行闭眼静息态脑电记录，并依据肌肉年龄将其分为减速、正常和加速三组，比较脑连接与节点强度。结果显示，肌肉年龄减速组在多个α和β频段的连接强度低于正常组和加速组，其右侧额区节点强度也较低；而正常组与加速组之间则在右侧颞区呈现差异。作者据此提出，不同的肌肉衰老轨迹可能与脑网络拓扑结构相关，提示肌肉与大脑之间存在联系，并可能为通过干预肌肉衰老轨迹来改善老年人整体功能和生活质量提供线索；但这一关联性发现尚不能说明因果关系或干预效果。

papers.title: Cognitive and Neural Preservation in Older Language Learners: The CNPOLL Framework.
papers.authors: Zhang H, Li J, Xiao Y, Wu YJ.
papers.abstract: The plasticity of bilingual language systems across the lifespan remains a central issue in theories of language representation and control, yet late-life language learning is rarely integrated into these accounts. This review synthesizes behavioral and neurocognitive evidence on older adults acquiring an additional language, with the aim of clarifying how aging shapes bilingual language learning mechanisms. We first report a quantitative synthesis of behavioral studies examining the effects of late language learning on control-related domains implicated in bilingual language processing, including executive coordination, attentional regulation, and working memory. Results indicate a small but reliable effect, with modest improvements primarily observed in higher-order executive processes rather than broad enhancements in general cognitive function. We then review neuroimaging evidence showing that late language acquisition engages language, control, and memory systems, including frontal-parietal and memory-related networks, in patterns shaped by task demands, age-related constraints, and learning stage. Building on these findings, we propose the Cognitive and Neural Preservation in Older Language Learners (CNPOLL) framework as a lifespan account of bilingual language plasticity in older adulthood. By situating late-life language learning within contemporary models of bilingualism, this review highlights older learners as a theoretically informative population for understanding the adaptability and limits of bilingual language systems.

relevance.reason: 综述老年人晚期语言学习的双语语言可塑性及神经影像证据，涉及语言表征、控制与记忆网络，符合语言与认知神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述整合行为与神经影像证据，考察老年人学习额外语言时双语语言系统的可塑性。行为研究的定量合成显示，晚期语言学习对执行协调、注意调节和工作记忆等控制相关领域有较小但可靠的效果，改善主要见于高阶执行过程，而非一般认知功能的普遍提升。神经影像证据则表明，晚期语言习得会调动语言、控制和记忆系统，其活动模式受任务需求、年龄相关限制和学习阶段影响。作者据此提出CNPOLL框架，将晚年语言学习纳入双语研究视角，并强调老年学习者是理解双语语言系统适应性与局限性的重要人群。

papers.title: [Advances in the application of individualized white-matter functional networks in children and adolescents with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder].
papers.authors: Yang HH, Hou JL.
papers.journal: Zhongguo dang dai er ke za zhi = Chinese journal of contemporary pediatrics
papers.abstract: Individualized white-matter functional networks provide a new paradigm for parsing individual differences and neural mechanisms in attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) among children and adolescents. This review summarizes construction approaches for such networks, including clustering analysis and independent component analysis, and synthesizes current progress. Group-level studies in children with ADHD have shown increased white-matter functional connectivity in the default mode and sensorimotor networks, but decreased white-matter functional connectivity in attention-related networks; these connectivity abnormalities are associated with core symptoms and impairments in executive function. However, group analyses can obscure inter-individual network heterogeneity and overlook gray-white matter functional coupling, limiting clinical translation. Individualized white-matter functional networks hold promise as potential neuroimaging markers for early screening and precision intervention in ADHD, yet challenges persist, including methodological inconsistency and the difficulty of acquiring pediatric data.

relevance.reason: 综述儿童青少年ADHD个体化白质功能网络及其与注意/执行功能关联，涉及白质功能连接与认知机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了儿童青少年注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）中个体化白质功能网络的构建方法（如聚类分析和独立成分分析）及研究进展。基于组水平的研究显示，ADHD儿童在白质默认模式网络和感觉运动网络的功能连接增强，而注意相关网络的功能连接减弱，这些异常与核心症状及执行功能受损相关。作者指出，组分析会掩盖个体间网络异质性并忽视灰白质功能耦合，限制临床转化；个体化白质功能网络有望成为早期筛查和精准干预的潜在影像标记，但方法学不一致和儿童数据获取困难仍是障碍。

papers.title: [Early resting-state functional connectivity characteristics in preterm and full-term infants: an exploratory study using functional near-infrared spectroscopy].
papers.authors: Wu Y, Zhu XY, Meng FZ, Gao HR, Cao JY, Yang H, Luo DD, Jin ZP, Zhou H, Wang J.
papers.journal: Zhongguo dang dai er ke za zhi = Chinese journal of contemporary pediatrics
papers.abstract: Objectives To compare resting-state brain functional connectivity among neonates of different gestational ages using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). Methods Forty hospitalized neonates were enrolled and categorized by gestational age into very preterm (n =10), moderate-to-late preterm (n =10), and full-term (n =20) groups. At a corrected gestational age of (40 ± 4) weeks, resting-state whole-brain oxygenation signals were acquired with fNIRS. The frontal, parietal, and temporal lobes were defined as regions of interest (ROI). Functional connectivity strength was calculated, and between-group comparisons were performed at both the whole-brain and ROI levels. Results At the whole-brain level, the mean functional connectivity strength in preterm infants was significantly lower than that in full-term infants (0.55 ± 0.20 vs 0.68 ± 0.16, P =0.030). Subgroup analysis showed the lowest connectivity strength in the very preterm group (0.46 ± 0.19), significantly lower than in the moderate-to-late preterm group (0.64 ± 0.19, P =0.030) and the full-term group (0.68 ± 0.16, P <0.01). At the ROI level, the very preterm group exhibited significantly reduced connectivity relative to the full-term group across multiple key connections, including left frontal-right frontal, left temporal-right frontal, bilateral frontal-bilateral parietal (both ipsilateral and contralateral), and left parietal-right parietal connections (all P <0.05). Conclusions Preterm birth exerts a gestational age-dependent gradient effect on resting-state brain functional connectivity, with smaller gestational age associated with more pronounced reductions. Very preterm neonates show widespread decreases in connectivity at the whole-brain level and between key cortical regions.

relevance.reason: 用fNIRS比较早产与足月新生儿静息态脑功能连接，报告脑网络组织与发育差异，属静息态脑组织及脑发育研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该探索性研究用功能性近红外光谱比较不同胎龄新生儿在矫正胎龄约足月时的静息态脑功能连接，按胎龄分为极早产、中晚期早产和足月三组。结果显示，早产儿全脑平均功能连接强度低于足月儿，且胎龄越小降低越明显，极早产组最低，并显著低于中晚期早产组和足月组；在感兴趣区层面，极早产组在额叶、颞叶和顶叶之间的多条关键连接上也较足月组减弱。作者据此认为，早产对静息态功能连接存在随胎龄变化的梯度影响，极早产儿表现为全脑及关键皮层区域间较广泛的连接下降，提示早产程度可能与连接减弱相关，但研究为探索性设计，相关发现尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Time-averaged and Time-varying Structure of the Gastric Network Revealed Through fMRI-Electrogastrogram Synchronization
papers.authors: Zair Y, Avidan G.
papers.abstract: The gastric network, comprised of brain regions whose activity synchronizes with the stomach’s slow-wave rhythm, offers a unique window into the brain-body interaction involved in interoceptive processing. While previous work has established the existence of this network, its intrinsic organization and temporal unfolding remain poorly understood. Here, we reanalyzed resting-state fMRI-electrogastrogram data from 43 healthy adults of both sexes to characterize the time-averaged architecture and time-varying reconfiguration of the gastric network. We identified regions exhibiting phase-locked synchronization with the stomach slow electrical rhythm (0.05 Hz) and characterized cortical parcels comprising this network. Time-averaged graph-theoretical analysis revealed a fixed unimodal organization of functional communities, with primary visual, default mode network (DMN) and dorsal attention regions emerging as the principal time-averaged hubs. Next, we applied edge-centric functional connectivity (eFC) to capture the network state during transient high-amplitude “bursts”. Time-varying community detection revealed communities whose compositions formed integrative combinations of DMN, visual, attentional and control elements. Edge-derived hubs shifted away from primary visual dominancy in the time-averaged analysis, and were instead directed by DMN regions, suggesting that moments of heightened connectivity in the network are coordinated by multisensory integration rather than passive sensory processing. These findings demonstrate that the gastric network is not merely a time-averaged, sensory-bound system, but rather a flexible and dynamically reconfiguring interoceptive network whose organization is selectively coordinated by transient cofluctuation events. This work provides a comprehensive network analysis of gastric-brain coupling and reveals a temporally structured mode of interoceptive integration that may support adaptive physiological and cognitive regulation.

relevance.reason: 该研究利用静息态fMRI-胃电同步分析人脑胃网络的时间平均与动态组织，属于内感受相关的脑网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究重新分析健康成人静息态fMRI与胃电图同步数据，考察胃网络的时间平均架构及其动态重组。时间平均的图论分析显示，功能社区呈固定的单峰组织，主要枢纽包括初级视觉区、默认模式网络和背侧注意区；而在瞬时高幅共波动期间，网络社区由默认模式网络、视觉、注意和控制等成分整合而成，枢纽也从视觉区转向默认模式网络区域。作者据此认为，胃网络并非仅由感觉输入限定的静态系统，而是一个由瞬时共波动事件选择性协调、具有时间结构的灵活内感受网络，可能支持适应性生理与认知调节。

papers.title: Preserved brain hierarchy supports residual vision without awareness after visual cortex damage
papers.authors: Orsenigo D, Luppi AI, Diano M, Ciorli T, Borriero A, Willis HE, Petri G, Bridge H, Tamietto M.
papers.abstract: Damage to the primary visual cortex causes loss of conscious vision, yet some patients retain the ability to respond to stimuli despite reporting no visual experience. Why similar lesions produce such different behavioral phenotypes remains unclear. While research to date has focused primarily on spared pathways that bypass V1, here we asked whether these divergent outcomes are also linked to the brain's intrinsic functional architecture. In the largest resting-state fMRI cohort of patients with unilateral V1 damage reported to date, we quantified information sharing between regions across cortical and subcortical parcels in blindsight-positive and blindsight-negative patients, as well as in age-matched healthy controls. Despite comparable lesions, the two patient groups displayed distinct hierarchical patterns on the cortex: B+ patients preserved a sensory-to-association organization as in healthy controls, whereas B- patients exhibited a marked flattening of this hierarchy. The effect was driven by abnormally low shared-information coupling within unimodal cortices and scaled continuously with single-subject behavioral blind-field detection performance. A thalamic region consistent with the pulvinar, linking the contralesional visual cortex and the frontal eye field, discriminated B+ from B- patients. These findings highlight the system-level consequences of V1 damage supporting blindsight, suggesting that the unimodal-transmodal axis might track not only global states of consciousness, but also whether sensory information can guide behavior without awareness.

relevance.reason: 研究V1损伤后盲视患者的静息态功能层级组织与残余视觉意识，涉及感知意识机制及脑损伤后网络重组。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注初级视觉皮层损伤后，为何部分患者虽无视觉意识却仍能对刺激作出反应（盲视），而另一些患者则不能。作者利用单侧V1损伤患者的大样本静息态fMRI数据，比较盲视阳性、盲视阴性患者与健康对照者脑区间信息共享的分层组织。结果显示，尽管病灶相近，盲视阳性患者仍保留类似健康人的感觉—联合层级，盲视阴性患者该层级明显扁平化；这一差异与单模态皮层内异常低的信息耦合有关，并随个体盲视野检测表现连续变化。研究提示，V1损伤后的系统层级组织可能与无意识下的视觉行为有关，但相关关系不等于因果，其临床意义仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Structure-Constrained Intrinsic Timescales Across Tasks
papers.authors: Wu K, de Palma Aristides R, Herzog R, Mirasso CR, Sorrentino P, Gollo LL.
papers.abstract: Intrinsic neural timescale (INT) quantifies the persistence of spontaneous neural dynamics and offers a principled metric for characterizing brain-wide temporal organization. Although a hierarchy of INTs has been established during rest, how task engagement reconfigures this organization and how it is constrained by the structural connectome (SC) remain poorly understood. Here, we systematically mapped whole-brain INT using high-resolution fMRI data from the Human Connectome Project during rest and seven tasks spanning working memory, gambling, motor, language, social, relational, and emotion domains. Task engagement induced robust, regionally heterogeneous changes in INT while largely preserving the brain-wide temporal hierarchy across cognitive states. SC-INT coupling remained strong but consistently decreased during tasks, indicating that anatomical architecture continues to constrain INT, although its influence is attenuated under task demands. To investigate these findings mechanistically, we employed a multiscale, whole-brain neuronal-network model, which revealed that INT increase and peak within a broad critical-like regime. Strong SC-INT coupling, as observed empirically, emerged in the subcritical regime, weakened progressively with increasing network excitability, and reversed in the supercritical regime. These results demonstrate that task engagement reconfigures INTs while maintaining their hierarchical organization, suggesting that both resting and task states operate largely within a common subcritical dynamical regime.

relevance.reason: 用高分辨率fMRI映射全脑内在时间尺度，考察任务对时间组织的重构及结构连接组的约束，属脑功能组织与结构-功能耦合。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注任务参与如何重塑全脑内在神经时间尺度（INT）及其与结构连接组的耦合关系，利用高分辨率功能磁共振数据比较了静息状态与涵盖工作记忆、语言、情绪等多个领域的任务状态。结果显示，任务引起区域异质性的INT变化，但全脑时间尺度层级在认知状态间基本保持；结构连接与INT的耦合在任务中依然较强却持续减弱，说明解剖架构仍施加约束，只是任务需求下影响被削弱。作者进一步用多尺度全脑神经网络模型解释这一现象，发现INT升高及峰值出现在类临界区间，而经验观察到的强结构-功能耦合出现在亚临界区间，并随网络兴奋性升高而减弱、在超临界区间反转。这些结果提示，静息与任务状态可能主要运行于共同的亚临界动力学区间。

papers.title: Education Moderates the Biomarker-Cortical-Thickness Relationship in Females With Cognitive Decline: A Descriptive Study With Sex Comparisons.
papers.authors: Moon Y, Jeon HJ, Kim HJ, Noh MY, Kim SH, Han SH, Kim H, Moon WJ.
papers.abstract: Background and purpose Education is a well-established proxy for cognitive reserve and hence may influence the relationship between Alzheimer's disease pathology and brain structure. This is particularly relevant in South Korea, where historical sex disparities in educational level among current elderly populations create unique cohort characteristics. This study examined how educational level moderates the biomarker-cortical-thickness relationship in females with cognitive decline, with descriptive sex comparisons used to contextualize these findings within a cohort reflecting disparities in the history of educational opportunities in South Korea. Methods In 80 patients (58 females, 22 males) with cognitive decline, we assessed plasma amyloid-β 42 (Aβ42), phosphorylated tau 181 (p-tau), and total tau levels, p-tau/Aβ42 ratio, regional cortical thickness, and scores on the Mini-Mental State Examination. Given the substantial confounding between sex and educational level in this cohort, moderated mediation analyses examining the biomarker-cortical-thickness-cognition pathway were restricted to females (n =53 with complete data). Results Females had a higher p-tau/Aβ42 ratio (p =0.026) and thicker frontal cortex (p =0.049) despite the absence of a significant difference in age-adjusted cognition. No significant sex× educational level interaction was observed for the biomarkers or cognition. In females, educational level moderated the relationship between the p-tau/Aβ42 ratio and cortical thickness (p <0.05 in all five brain regions), with high-educational level females showing the expected cortical thinning with pathology, while low-educational level females exhibited preserved thickness, which did not mediate the cognitive performance. Conclusions Descriptive sex comparisons revealed a higher biomarker burden yet greater cortical thickness in females. Importantly, educational level significantly moderated the biomarker-cortical thickness relationship specifically in females, with lower-educated individuals showing structural preservation despite the presence of pathology. These findings suggest that measurements of the cortical thickness can underestimate the disease burden in lower-educated females, which highlights the need for educational level-stratified interpretations of structural biomarkers.

papers.title: [Alterations in olfactory and spatial navigation abilities and their neural mechanisms in subjective cognitive decline: an fMRI study].
papers.authors: Li SY, Ma XF, Li WP, Lu H, Lu JM, Zhang X, Zhang B.
papers.abstract: Objective: To investigate the characteristics and neural mechanisms of altered olfactory and spatial navigation abilities in individuals with subjective cognitive decline (SCD). Methods: A total of 44 cognitively normal participants and 69 participants meeting diagnostic criteria for SCD were recruited from Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital, Affiliated Hospital of Medical School, Nanjing University from September 2023 to October 2025. All participants underwent neuropsychological assessments, olfactory testing, spatial navigation testing, 3.0 T resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI), task-based functional MRI (task-fMRI), and high-resolution T1-weighted imaging. Independent samples t -tests and Mann-Whitney U tests were used to compare olfactory and spatial navigation behavioral differences between the two groups. Left and right anterior lateral entorhinal cortex (alEC), posterior medial entorhinal cortex (pmEC), and primary olfactory cortex (POC) were selected as seeds to analyze functional connectivity (FC) under resting state and during odor stimulation, with multiple comparisons corrected using false discovery rate (FDR). Partial correlation analysis was performed to explore the relationship between olfactory and spatial navigation and FC metrics in the SCD group, controlled age, gender and years of education. Results: No significant differences were found between the two groups regarding age, gender and years of education. Compared with the NC group, SCD participants showed reduced olfactory memory (old) (Z =-3.05, P =0.005), lower composite olfactory memory Z-score (t =3.53, P =0.001), and lower overall olfactory Z-score (t =2.48, P =0.014). They also exhibited increased average error distances in allo-egocentric navigation (AEN) (Z =-9.17, P =0.001), egocentric navigation (EN) (Z =-8.84, P =0.003), and allocentric navigation (AN) (Z =-8.09, P =0.024), along with a decreased composite spatial navigation Z-score (t =3.84, P <0.001). rs-fMRI results revealed that, SCD participants showed significantly reduced resting-state FC within EC and POC related pathways, but enhanced FC with frontal, cingulate, and parietal regions during odor stimulation (all q <0.05, FDR-corrected). Partial correlation analysis indicated that in the SCD group, the FC between left alEC and left angular gyrus (ANG) positively correlated with EN average error distance (r =0.26, P =0.033), while the FC between right POC and right posterior cingulate cortex(PCC) positively correlated with AEN average error distance (r =0.29, P =0.028). Conclusion: SCD individuals already exhibit deficits in olfactory memory and spatial navigation, suggesting possible coexistence of impaired baseline network connectivity and compensatory network activation during tasks, or inefficient and abnormal recruitment due to diminished network integration efficiency. Abnormal functional connectivity between alEC and ANG, and between POC and PCC, is associated with spatial navigation performance and may represent key neural substrates underlying olfactory and spatial navigation changes in SCD.

papers.title: Central executive network-related neuromagnetic abnormalities in chronic and episodic migraine: a resting-state magnetoencephalography study.
papers.authors: Huang L, Huang X, Yu Y, Yu C, Wang Y.
papers.abstract: Background Chronic migraine (CM) is more disabling than episodic migraine (EM), but the neurophysiological mechanisms underlying migraine chronification remain incompletely understood. We investigated central executive network (CEN)-related neuromagnetic abnormalities in CM and EM. Methods The original cohort included 22 patients with CM, 20 with EM, and 25 healthy controls (HCs). An independent validation cohort included 30 patients with CM and 30 with EM. Source-space analyses focused on 10 predefined CEN-related regions from the Desikan-Killiany atlas. Relative power spectral density (PSD) across six frequency bands and functional connectivity using corrected amplitude envelope correlation and network-based statistics were assessed. An exploratory support vector machine (SVM) analysis evaluated the discriminative value of CEN-related spectral and connectivity features. Results PSD abnormalities were mainly observed in the theta, beta, and gamma1 bands and were largely driven by CM. Compared with HCs, CM showed increased theta-band relative power in left frontal CEN-related regions and reduced beta- and gamma1-band relative power in right frontal regions. Compared with EM, CM showed increased theta-band relative power in left frontal regions. Functional connectivity analysis revealed frequency-specific subnetworks in the theta, beta, delta, and gamma1 bands. Compared with HCs, CM showed increased theta- and gamma1-band connectivity and reduced beta-band connectivity, whereas EM showed more limited reductions in beta- and gamma1-band connectivity. CM also showed stronger delta- and gamma1-band connectivity than EM, predominantly involving prefrontal regions. The SVM combining two PSD and eight connectivity features achieved an accuracy of 90.48% and an AUC of 0.9773 (95% CI: 0.93-1.00) in the original cohort, and an accuracy of 86.67% and an AUC of 0.8322 (95% CI: 0.76-0.95) in the independent validation cohort. Conclusion CM is associated with more extensive and frequency-specific CEN-related neuromagnetic abnormalities than EM, particularly within prefrontal-frontoparietal circuits. These findings suggest altered executive-control-related cortical dynamics during migraine chronification, while combined spectral and connectivity features may help differentiate CM from EM.

papers.title: Structural and functional alterations of posterior cingulate cortex subregions in successful cognitive aging.
papers.authors: Wang J, Li Y, Feng T, Xu R, Li J, Zheng Y, Hu Y, Zhao X.
papers.abstract: Successful cognitive aging (SCA) describes the preservation of cognitive abilities into advanced age, but its neural basis remains incompletely understood. Metabolic and pathological evidence implicates the posterior cingulate cortex (PCC) as a key region supporting cognitive resilience. However, functionally distinct PCC subregions have rarely been examined using complementary structural, microstructural, and functional imaging measures. In this cross-sectional secondary analysis of publicly available Human Connectome Project in Aging data, we identified 29 adults aged at least 80 years who met successful cognitive aging criteria based on episodic memory and executive function. We selected 29 adults with normal aging (NA) group and 29 middle-aged adults (MA) group matched for sex and education, yielding 87 participants. We combined structural MRI, neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging, and resting-state functional MRI to assess multimodal features across three PCC subregions. These features included cortical thickness, Neurite Density Index (NDI), Orientation Dispersion Index (ODI), Free Water Fraction (FWF), and cortex-wide functional connectivity. Both older groups showed lower cortical thickness in the dorsal and ventral PCC than the MA group. Cortical thickness, NDI, and ODI did not differ significantly between successful and normal aging. FWF was numerically lower in the left ventral PCC in SCA group, but this exploratory observation did not reach significance (Tukey-adjusted P = 0.059). Compared with the NA group, the SCA group showed significantly weaker connectivity between all PCC subregions and widespread prefrontal cortices (adjusted P < 0.05). In the pooled older-adult sample, weaker left ventral PCC-medial prefrontal connectivity correlated with better episodic memory (r = -0.430, FDR-adjusted P = 0.026), although neither within-group association was significant. These findings suggest that SCA was associated with lower PCC-prefrontal functional connectivity, but not with detectable preservation of PCC cortical thickness. The numerical FWF difference in the left ventral PCC remains exploratory and requires independent replication. These subregion-specific patterns provide a potential framework for understanding heterogeneous cognitive-aging trajectories, but require confirmation in larger longitudinal cohorts.

papers.title: From Womb to Brain: A Systematic Review of the Impact of Prenatal Maternal Anxiety on Paediatric Brain Structure and Function
papers.authors: Anthony NL, Ipser J, Koopowitz S.
papers.abstract: Background: Prenatal maternal anxiety has been implicated in altered paediatric brain structure and function, but findings from neuroimaging studies are heterogeneous. A PRISMA-aligned systematic review was conducted to evaluate associations between prenatal maternal anxiety and paediatric brain structure and function. A secondary aim was to identify potential sensitive periods across gestation. Methods: Electronic databases were searched for studies examining associations between prenatal anxiety and paediatric brain structure and function. Eligible papers used magnetic resonance imaging in children exposed to prenatal anxiety. Of 2,668 records retrieved, 1,701 unique records remained after deduplication and 12 met inclusion criteria. These studies included 1082 mother-child dyads with neuroimaging data. Maternal ages ranged from 18 to 45 years and paediatric imaging ages spanned from 5 days to 7 years of age. Results: Ten of the 12 studies reported statistically significant associations between prenatal maternal anxiety and paediatric neuroimaging outcomes. Associations of mixed directionality were reported across structural, diffusion and functional modalities, involving fronto-limbic regions (including the amygdala and hippocampus), their connecting white-matter pathways (including the uncinate fasciculus, cingulum and fornix), and amygdala-centred functional networks. Trimester-specific findings indicated that anxiety measured during mid- to late gestation was consistently associated with variation in infant limbic development. Conclusions: This review suggests that prenatal maternal anxiety is associated with variation in paediatric fronto-limbic development. Although the evidence does not establish causality or intervention effectiveness, the findings support the importance of recognising and addressing prenatal maternal anxiety as part of broader maternal and child health initiatives and highlight the need for longitudinal studies to identify mechanisms and intervention targets.

papers.title: Longitudinal Changes in Hippocampal-Default Mode Network Connectivity and Cognition During Electroacupuncture Intervention in Type 2 Diabetes-Associated Cognitive Decline: A Pilot Resting-State fMRI Study.
papers.authors: Yao L, Li MY, Liu YZ, Cao JZ, Lian Z, Zhu HN, Huang HP, Zhong Z, Wang HF.
papers.abstract: Background Type 2 diabetes mellitus-associated cognitive dysfunction (T2DACD) is strongly linked to disruption of cognition-supporting brain networks. Electroacupuncture (EA) has increasingly been examined as a nonpharmacological intervention targeting cognitive impairment; however, the longitudinal neurobiological patterns accompanying EA in T2DACD have not been fully characterized. In this exploratory pilot study, we evaluated alterations in resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC) across hippocampal subregions and default mode network (DMN) nodes in individuals with T2DACD. Methods For this exploratory, open-label, non-randomized, uncontrolled pilot investigation, we enrolled 20 individuals with T2DACD and 26 healthy controls (HCs). Longitudinal analyses included 15 participants who had usable post-treatment data. T2DACD was defined according to clinical type 2 diabetes mellitus criteria, and a Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) score <26. Patients underwent an 8-week Adjust Zang-fu and Arouse Spirit electroacupuncture (AZASE) intervention. Cognitive, emotional, metabolic, and seed-based resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) outcomes were evaluated. Clinical longitudinal analyses were carried out according to protocol, whereas imaging analyses were limited to participants with usable scans after treatment. Results At baseline, individuals with T2DACD showed lower MoCA scores than HCs and had poorer executive and working-memory outcomes. Among the 15 participants with complete longitudinal neuroimaging data, MoCA scores increased from 23.27 ± 1.71 to 26.07 ± 1.53 over the intervention period. Within-group alterations were observed for Flanker-conflict reaction time and accuracy, Stroop-conflict reaction time, 1-back reaction time, Self-Rating Anxiety Scale score, and Hamilton Depression Rating Scale score. Omnibus group analyses detected significant effects for the left anterior hippocampus-left angular gyrus connection and the left posterior hippocampus-right middle occipital gyrus connection. Post-treatment scans demonstrated reduced RSFC in several hippocampal-DMN and intra-DMN connections. The association between change in left anterior hippocampus-left angular gyrus RSFC and change in Stroop-conflict performance was no longer statistically significant after Bonferroni correction. For neuroimaging outcomes, cluster-level family-wise error (FWE) correction (p < 0.05) was applied to control for multiple comparisons; clinical outcomes are reported descriptively as hypothesis-generating findings. Conclusions In this exploratory pilot study, we identified preliminary alterations in cognitive outcomes and hippocampal-DMN connections over an 8-week EA intervention in individuals with T2DACD. In view of the small sample size and the open-label, non-randomized, uncontrolled design, the findings should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating observations rather than definitive evidence of a specific causal treatment effect. Larger controlled studies will be needed to determine whether the observed neural and behavioral alterations are reproducible and clinically meaningful in practice. Clinical trial registration

papers.title: Resting-State Functional Connectivity Alterations in Insomnia Disorder: A Systematic Review of Studies Published from 2020 to July 2025.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Zhang Y, Shi C, Wang T, Xian R, Wu D, Fan S, Liu H.
papers.abstract: Insomnia disorder is increasingly linked to abnormalities in resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC). We systematically synthesized rs-fMRI studies published from January 2020 to July 2025 to characterize disorder-related connectivity patterns and methodological limitations. Twenty-four study reports met the eligibility criteria; reported sample sizes summed to 1,229 participants with insomnia disorder and 1,077 healthy controls, although some cohorts may overlap across publications. Alterations involved the default mode, salience, executive-control, emotion, and sensorimotor systems and sleep-wake regulatory hubs, including the thalamus and hypothalamus. The overall pattern is compatible with hyperarousal, but both increased and decreased connectivity were reported; diagnostic definitions, sex, symptom severity and duration, medication exposure, acquisition conditions, and seed-based versus data-driven analyses may moderate direction and magnitude. A formal study-level appraisal with the JBI analytical cross-sectional checklist identified predominantly low risk or some concerns, most often related to confounding control. Because all included comparisons were cross-sectional, rsFC alterations cannot be interpreted as causes rather than consequences or correlates of insomnia. Methodological heterogeneity precluded quantitative pooling. Standardized phenotyping, medication control, acquisition and preprocessing, preregistered longitudinal studies, and external validation are required before connectivity markers can be used clinically.

papers.title: Brain Structural Changes Underlying Dysphagia in Parkinson’s Disease: An Exploratory Multimodal Quantitative MRI Study
papers.authors: Krishnamurthy R, Avecillas-Chasin JM, Situ-Kcomt M, Gliske SV.
papers.abstract: Abstract Dysphagia is a substantial and often underrecognized burden in Parkinson’s disease (PD), and its neural underpinnings remain poorly understood. In this retrospective study, we employed a multimodal neuroimaging approach to investigate structural brain changes associated with dysphagia in PD. We included 105 participants in the age range of 45 to 84 years: 35 PD with dysphagia (PDD), 35 PD without dysphagia (PDnD), and 35 age- and sex-matched healthy controls (HC). Oropharyngeal dysphagia was confirmed through clinical swallowing evaluation or video fluoroscopic swallow study. We obtained T1 and diffusion-weighted MRI from all our participants. We analyzed them using voxel-based morphometry, surface-based morphometry, tract-based spatial statistics, and graph-theoretical structural connectivity analysis. Relative to HC and PDnD groups, the PDD group showed widespread gray matter atrophy ( p < .05) in the cerebellum, temporal lobes, subcortical regions, and prefrontal cortices. Surface-based morphometry revealed significant cortical thinning ( p < .00001), reduced sulcal depth, altered fractal dimension, and increased gyrification (all p < .05) in motor, limbic, and orbitofrontal regions. The PDD group also showed significant white matter atrophy in brainstem, cerebral, and cerebellar areas, with reduced fractional anisotropy and increased mean diffusivity in key sensorimotor and autonomic pathways ( p < .05). No widespread differences were observed between the PDD and PDnD groups across structural modalities. Graph-theoretical analysis showed trends toward reduced global network integration and segregation in the PDD group, though these did not reach statistical significance. Together, these findings support a model in which dysphagia in PD reflects widespread, network-level structural degeneration across both gray and white matter, extending beyond classical brainstem swallowing centers.

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注帕金森病吞咽障碍的脑结构基础，采用多模态定量MRI，比较伴与不伴吞咽障碍的帕金森病患者及健康对照的灰质、白质和结构网络特征。结果显示，伴吞咽障碍的患者在多个脑区存在较广泛的灰质萎缩和皮层形态改变，白质也出现萎缩及弥散指标异常，提示吞咽障碍可能与超出经典脑干吞咽中枢的网络层面结构退变有关。不过，伴与不伴吞咽障碍患者之间在各结构模态上未见广泛差异，图论指标仅呈网络整合与分离下降的趋势而未达显著，因此上述关联仍需谨慎解读。

papers.title: A Multi-Stage EEG Hyperscanning Connectivity Framework for Robust Estimation of Inter- Brain Networks
papers.authors: Ghodousi M, Pousson JE, Bernhofs V, Griškova-Bulanova I.
papers.abstract: Abstract Robust estimation of inter-brain connectivity during naturalistic interaction remains a major challenge in biomedical signal processing due to shared sensory input, synchronized motor activity, and environmental confounds. To address this problem, this study proposes and evaluates a multi-stage robust connectivity estimation pipeline for hyperscanning EEG datasets that integrates symmetric phase-based connectivity (Phase-Locking Value, PLV), directed predictive connectivity (Granger Causality, GC), and graph-theoretical network analysis. EEG was recorded simultaneously from one trained percussionist (leader) and 27 partners (followers), forming 27 leader–follower dyads/sessions, during two interaction contexts: Rehearsal (practice/learning) and Rhythmic performance (structured coordination). Connectivity estimates were subjected to surrogate-based permutation testing and recurrence-based stability filtering, followed by control-based edge exclusion using Baseline and Mechanical control conditions and ROI-level dimensionality reduction. Connectivity related to musical interaction was predominantly expressed in the beta (13–30 Hz) and gamma (30–80 Hz) frequency bands. Rehearsal was characterized by more reciprocal directed inter-brain interactions and broader follower involvement in several network measures, whereas Rhythmic performance showed a more asymmetric topology with predominantly leader-to-follower gamma-band influence. Graph-theoretical metrics further demonstrated task-dependent reconfiguration of hyper-brain networks, with prominent condition-related effects involving frontal, centro-parietal, and parieto-occipital regions. These findings indicate that high-frequency oscillations support rapid interpersonal adaptation during joint musical performance. Methodologically, the proposed framework provides a multi-stage approach for increasing the specificity and robustness of hyperscanning connectivity estimates by reducing contributions from shared sensory, motor, and unstable connectivity patterns.

relevance.reason: 该研究用EEG超扫描考察自然音乐互动中人际脑网络连接与任务依赖重组，属自然情境下脑网络组织。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对自然互动中脑间连接估计易受共享感觉输入、同步运动和环境混淆影响的问题，提出并评估了一套多阶段超扫描脑电连接分析流程，结合相位连接、有向预测连接与图论网络分析，并用于分析一名打击乐手与多名跟随者在排练和节奏表演两种情境下的互动数据。结果显示，与音乐互动相关的连接主要体现在beta和gamma频段：排练时双向有向互动更多、跟随者参与更广，而节奏表演时网络拓扑更不对称，以领导者到跟随者的gamma频段影响为主，额区、中央顶区和顶枕区呈现任务相关的网络重组。作者据此认为高频振荡可能支持联合音乐表演中的快速人际适应，同时强调该框架通过抑制共享感觉运动和不稳定连接的贡献，有助于提高超扫描连接估计的特异性和稳健性。

papers.title: MRI Evidence of Anterograde Trans-synaptic Degeneration After Eye Loss: Preserved Primary Visual Cortex Thickness Despite Lateral Geniculate Nucleus Atrophy
papers.authors: Llanos D, Santos E, Saenz-Frances F, Pedraja Ídl, Arrazola J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Anterograde trans-synaptic degeneration (ATD) of the visual pathway following eye loss is well recognized, but its in vivo characterization remains limited. We investigated structural changes in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) and primary visual cortex (V1) using automated analysis of high-resolution 3-T magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Methods: This cross-sectional study included 30 patients with unilateral or bilateral eye loss (≥6 months after enucleation or evisceration) and 75 healthy controls. All participants underwent standardized 3-T brain MRI. Automated LGN segmentation and cortical parcellation were performed using FreeSurfer version 7.2. Bilateral LGN volumes and mean V1 cortical thickness were compared between groups, and the relationship between LGN volume and time since eye loss was assessed. Results: Patients showed significantly smaller bilateral LGN volumes than controls (both p < 0.001). No significant association was found between LGN volume and time since eye loss, suggesting that most LGN atrophy develops early after visual deprivation. In contrast, mean V1 cortical thickness did not differ significantly between patients and controls (left hemisphere: p = 0.704; right hemisphere: p = 0.106). Conclusions: Eye loss is associated with marked bilateral LGN atrophy, but no significant reduction in V1 cortical thickness was detected with the methodology used, suggesting differential susceptibility of subcortical and cortical visual structures to ATD. Automated analysis of high-resolution 3-T MRI provides a practical, non-invasive method for investigating structural changes of the visual pathway in vivo.

relevance.reason: 研究人眼丧失后视觉通路结构变化，报告LGN萎缩与V1皮层厚度保留，属脑结构可塑性/跨突触变性机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注眼球丧失后视觉通路是否出现顺行跨突触变性，采用横断面设计，对眼球摘除或内容物剜除术后患者与健康对照的高分辨率3-T脑MRI进行自动化分析，比较外侧膝状体（LGN）体积与初级视皮层（V1）厚度。结果显示，患者双侧LGN体积显著小于对照组，且LGN体积与眼球丧失后时间未见显著关联，提示LGN萎缩可能在视觉剥夺后较早阶段即已大部分形成；而V1平均皮层厚度在两组间未见显著差异。作者据此认为，眼球丧失与明显的双侧LGN萎缩相关，但所用方法未检测到V1皮层厚度显著降低，提示皮层下与皮层视觉结构对顺行跨突触变性的易感性可能不同，同时强调该发现受方法学条件限制，尚不能据此推断因果关系或临床意义。

papers.title: Executive Function Development, Metacognitive Regulation, and Working Memory Dynamics Across Adolescence: A Longitudinal Cognitive Neuroscience Perspective
papers.authors: Latif MA, Jahangir R, A. Al-Atram A, Saad K.
papers.abstract: Objective: This investigation examined the longitudinal trajectories of executive function development, metacognitive regulation, and working memory dynamics across adolescence from a cognitive neuroscience perspective, with the aim of characterizing the maturational interdependencies among these core cognitive systems during a critical neurodevelopmental window. Method: A community-based longitudinal cohort of 612 adolescents (52.4% female; baseline age = 12.3 years, SD = 1.1; assessed at three annual waves) was drawn from a larger neurodevelopmental study. Participants completed computerized neuropsychological assessments including the N-back working memory paradigm, the Delis-Kaplan Executive Function System (D-KEFS), and the Metacognitive Awareness Inventory (MAI). Resting-state functional MRI data were acquired from a subsample (n = 218) to examine frontoparietal network connectivity patterns associated with cognitive gains. Results: Latent growth curve modeling revealed significant linear increases in executive function (intercept = 47.32, slope = 3.14, p < .001), metacognitive regulation (intercept = 68.45, slope = 2.87, p < .001), and working memory capacity (intercept = 0.72, slope = 0.18, p < .001) across the three assessment waves. Parallel process analyses demonstrated significant positive covariances among growth slopes: executive function with working memory (covariance = 1.24, p < .001), executive function with metacognition (covariance = 0.89, p = .002), and working memory with metacognition (covariance = 0.76, p = .008). Resting-state fMRI analyses in the subsample revealed significantly increased frontoparietal network connectivity (t(217) = 3.42, p < .001, Cohen’s d = 0.46) that positively correlated with executive function gains (r = .38, p < .001). Conclusions: The observed developmental patterns demonstrate synchronized maturation of executive function, metacognitive regulation, and working memory systems during adolescence, underpinned by strengthening frontoparietal network connectivity. These findings carry substantial implications for educational practice, adolescent mental health policy, and the timing of cognitive training interventions, providing a neurocognitive foundation for designing developmentally sensitive instructional and clinical approaches during adolescence.

relevance.reason: 纵向追踪青少年执行功能、工作记忆发展与额顶网络静息态连接，属认知脑发育与静息网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究从认知神经科学视角考察青少年期执行功能、元认知调节与工作记忆的发展轨迹及其相互关系，采用社区青少年纵向队列，结合计算机化认知测评与静息态功能磁共振。潜变量增长曲线分析显示，三项认知指标在三次年度评估中均呈显著线性上升，且增长斜率之间两两正相关，提示这些核心认知系统在青少年期同步成熟。子样本的影像结果进一步显示额顶网络连接增强，并与执行功能增益正相关。作者据此认为，青少年认知发展可能以额顶网络连接的强化为神经基础，并为教育实践和认知训练干预时机提供了参考；但相关结果尚不能直接推断因果或治疗效果。

papers.title: Scene Perception-Memory Pairing Extends to the Superior Parietal Cortex.
papers.authors: Tang RN, Panek D, Barkoff LH, Scrivener CL, Silson EH, Steel A.
papers.abstract: Visual scene analysis relies on a set of scene-selective regions in the posterior cerebral cortex (OPA, PPA, MPA), with a paired memory-responsive counterpart located in the anterior (LPMA, VPMA) or overlapping (MPMA) cortex. The interaction between these pairs of regions is thought to integrate visual input with mnemonic context. Recently, a fourth scene perception area in the superior parietal cortex (the superior place area, SPA) was identified, with a proposed role in visually guided navigation. Whether this region also has an anterior paired memory region is currently unknown. Across two independent fMRI datasets (total N = 24, 14 females) using static or dynamic stimuli and distinct memory tasks, we show that recalling visual scenes evokes robust responses in a region immediately anterior and dorsal to SPA (referred to here as the superior place memory area, SPMA). During resting-state fMRI, SPA preferentially coupled with the other scene perception areas, while SPMA preferentially coupled with the other place memory areas. At the whole-brain level, seed-based connectivity revealed that SPA sits at the confluence of four processing streams spanning regions implicated in egocentric scene perception, map-based navigation, perspective taking, and goal-directed movement. These findings extend the perception-memory motif associated with visual scene processing to a fourth cortical surface. The widespread anatomical coupling between scene perception and memory processes reflects the importance of this interaction for flexible, context-grounded navigation.

relevance.reason: fMRI研究揭示顶叶上场景感知区SPA及其记忆配对区SPMA的功能组织与静息态连接。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注上顶叶的场景感知区SPA是否像后皮层其他场景选择区一样，存在与之配对的前部记忆区。作者利用两个独立fMRI数据集，结合静态或动态刺激与不同记忆任务，发现回忆视觉场景会在SPA紧邻的前背侧区域引起稳定反应，并将其称为SPMA。静息态下SPA更倾向与其他场景感知区耦合，SPMA则更倾向与其他场景记忆区耦合；全脑连接还显示SPA处于自我中心场景感知、地图导航、视角采择和目标导向运动等多条通路的交汇处。作者据此认为，视觉场景加工中感知与记忆配对的组织模式可延伸至第四个皮层区域，这种广泛的解剖耦合可能支持灵活且依赖情境的导航。

papers.title: Impaired midfrontal‑motor theta phase synchronization characterizes maladaptive motivational behavior in people with obsessive‑compulsive disorder.
papers.authors: Pang Y, Zhou D, Peng Z, Liu W, Huang R, Seger CA, Chen Q.
papers.abstract: Obsessive‑compulsive disorder (OCD) is characterized by an insight‑action dissociation, in which people with OCD recognize that their behavior is irrational but still struggle to inhibit habitual responses. This dissociation may be related to abnormally strong motivational biases, reflected in excessive tendencies to approach reward and avoid punishment. We employed a motivational Go/NoGo learning task, combined with computational modeling and electroencephalography (EEG), to investigate how 36 people with OCD and 37 healthy controls (HC) regulate maladaptive biases during motivated action. People with OCD showed stronger Pavlovian bias and lower learning rates. Similar to HC, people with OCD also showed increased midfrontal theta power related to conflict detection and to the generation of a control demand to increase the weighting of instrumental action values during choice, suggesting that they were able to detect the mismatch between their behavior and task goals. However, in OCD, conflict‑related theta enhancement overlapped with the response window, indicating that control signals emerged or arrived too late to effectively influence choice. Midfrontal‑motor theta phase synchrony provided the strongest model evidence for the modulation of maladaptive biases in OCD, yet this pathway showed no significant conflict‑related enhancement and failed to effectively modulate motivational biases under conflict. Taken together, these findings suggest a neural mechanism underlying the insight‑action dissociation in OCD and identify midfrontal‑motor theta phase synchrony as a potential treatment target.

relevance.reason: 用EEG研究强迫症患者动机性行动控制与冲突检测的额中线-运动theta相位同步机制，属认知控制与脑疾病神经机制。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注强迫症患者为何能意识到行为不合理却仍难以抑制习惯性反应，采用动机性Go/NoGo学习任务，结合计算建模与脑电记录，比较患者与健康对照在动机性行动中的调节机制。结果显示，患者表现出更强的巴甫洛夫偏向和更低的学习率；其与冲突检测相关的额中线theta增强虽仍存在，却与反应窗口重叠，控制信号出现或到达过晚，难以有效影响选择。额中线-运动区theta相位同步对患者不良动机偏向的调节具有最强模型证据，但该通路未表现出显著的冲突相关增强，也未能在冲突下有效调节动机偏向。作者据此提出，这一同步异常可能构成强迫症“洞察-行动分离”的神经机制，并被视为潜在干预靶点。

papers.title: Arousal-driven critical roaming reproduces human functional connectivity dynamics.
papers.authors: Pathak A, Battaglia D.
papers.abstract: Ongoing brain activity displays rich temporal variability associated with efficient cognition, with functional connectivity (FC) continually reconfiguring over time. The resulting functional connectivity dynamics (FCD) specifically show complex, fat-tailed statistics that alternate between persistent epochs and faster reconfiguration transients. While nonlinear whole-brain models tuned nearby a critical point have reproduced some aspects of FCD, they fall short of capturing its full temporal complexity. We propose that slow fluctuations in arousal offer a biologically plausible mechanism for exploring critical regimes in large-scale brain dynamics and thus enrich FCD. Using a connectome-based model of coupled cortical populations, we identified phase boundaries where system dynamics transition between regimes of faster or slower FCD. We then phenomenologically incorporated arousal changes, modeling them as stochastic fluctuations in key parameters such as cortical excitability, input gain, and noise amplitude. This explicitly time-dependent formulation enables the system to roam dynamically across regime boundaries, flexibly tuning its distance from critical transition lines and producing intermittent transitions that mirror the stochastic evolution observed in empirical FCD. Fitting these models to human resting-state fMRI and performing model comparison, we find that arousal-driven models more accurately reproduce the distinctive quantitative features of FCD, with the greatest improvements coming from the previously poorly accounted fat-tailed portions of the distributions. Together, these results suggest that arousal fluctuations-likely mediated by changes in neuromodulatory tone-shape the brain's attractor landscape over time, expanding the repertoire of accessible functional network states and providing a mechanistic basis for the complexity of spontaneous functional dynamics.

relevance.reason: 以人类静息态fMRI为拟合对象，建模唤醒波动如何产生功能连接动态，属自发活动与功能网络组织研究。

papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大脑功能连接动态（FCD）中持续时段与快速重组交替出现的复杂重尾统计特征，并提出觉醒水平的缓慢波动可能是其机制。作者用基于连接组的耦合皮层群体模型，先确定系统在快慢FCD之间转换的相边界，再把觉醒变化建模为皮层兴奋性、输入增益和噪声幅度等关键参数的随机波动，使系统能动态跨越这些边界。将模型拟合人类静息态fMRI并比较后，发现觉醒驱动模型更能准确再现FCD的定量特征，改善主要来自此前难以解释的重尾部分。作者据此认为，觉醒波动可能通过神经调质变化随时间塑造大脑的吸引子景观，扩展可及的功能网络状态，为自发功能动态的复杂性提供机制解释。
